discussions.title: [Windows] workspace-write sandbox blocks node.exe / msedge.exe launch (0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED / "Access is denied")
discussions.body:
## Summary

On Windows, commands run in the confined sandbox modes (`read-only` / `workspace-write`) intermittently fail to launch `node.exe`. The failure surfaces in two ways:

1. PowerShell reports a launch failure that DSH classifies as a sandbox denial:
   ```
   Program 'node.exe' failed to run: Access is denied
   CategoryInfo : ResourceUnavailable: (:) [], ApplicationFailedException
   [sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]
   ```
2. A Windows modal dialog appears — `应用程序无法正常启动(0xc0000142)` (i.e. `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`) — recorded in the System event log as `Application Popup` (event ID 26).

The same command can succeed once and then fail moments later. `msedge.exe` is blocked the same way, so this does not look Node-specific.

## Environment

- Windows 10 Pro 22H2, build `10.0.19045.6466`, x64
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`, session sandbox policy `workspace-write`
- Node.js `v24.19.0` (`C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`), npm `11.17.0`
- Windows Defender real-time protection enabled (the only AV on the box; tamper protection on)

## Expected vs actual

**Expected:** per `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`'s README, the Windows ACL runner restricts **writes** only — *"Reads are unrestricted on Windows (the ACL runner restricts writes only)"*. Launching an executable that lives outside the granted trees should still work.

**Actual:** launching `node.exe` (and `msedge.exe`) is refused, or the process dies during image initialization.

## Evidence

### 1. Raw failures recorded in the session log

Extracted from `~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.jsonl.zstd` (multi-frame zstd) for a session whose own `sandbox:policy` snapshot read `Current DSH file policy: workspace-write`:

```
[15:23:16] Program 'node.exe' failed to run: Access is denied
           CategoryInfo : ResourceUnavailable: (:) [], ApplicationFailedException
           [sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]
           [exit code: 1]
[15:23:19]  (identical)
[15:23:54]  (identical)
[15:36:56] Program 'msedge.exe' failed to run: Access is denied
```

### 2. Popup timestamps line up with sandboxed `node` invocations

System event log (`Application Popup`, ID 26) for the same window:

```
15:21:24.736  node.exe
15:22:45.101  node.exe
15:22:45.602  node.exe
15:22:45.805  node.exe
15:22:46.261  node.exe
15:24:01.873  node.exe
15:24:09.688  node.exe
15:24:18.030  node.exe
15:24:18.534  node.exe
```

Cross-referenced with the session log:

- `15:24:18.030` / `.534` ↔ a call issued at `15:24:14`:
  `node tools/hi.mjs > tools/out2.txt; ... ; node tools/fetch.mjs search "…" > tools/out3.txt`
  The redirect targets were left behind at **0 bytes** (`out2.txt` at 15:24:17, `out3.txt` at 15:24:18) — i.e. both `node` processes died during initialization and never executed a line of script. The tool result came back as *"Empty and no exit code"*, consistent with a process that died before PowerShell could set `$LASTEXITCODE`.

- `15:22:45` (four failures inside 1.2 s) ↔ an `npm init -y; npm install …` issued at `15:22:41`. The same npm run then reported:
  ```
  The variable '$LASTEXITCODE' cannot be retrieved because it has not been set.
  At C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.ps1:17 char:5
  ```
  i.e. npm's own `node` child never started.

### 3. Same command, same session, one success then one failure

`node tools/hi.mjs`, where the script is 47 bytes (`console.log('hi from file', process.cwd())`):

- `15:23:24` → **succeeded**, printed `hi from file <workspace>`
- `15:24:14` → **failed** (0xC0000142 popup; output file left empty)

This intermittency is what makes it look like "it always fails" from the user's side.

### 4. The sandbox's own source already names this failure mode

`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types/token.d.ts` (lines 62–64):

> The logon SID + EVERYONE keep-alive group is shared by both modes: **early DLL init dies with 0xC0000142** and CNG (`\Device\CNG` write trustee — pwsh crashes 0xE0434352) fails without them.

So `0xC0000142` is the known failure mode of this `WRITE_RESTRICTED` restricted token — the popup the user sees is DSH's sandbox token construction failing at a point it is not supposed to.

## Why this looks like it is on the DSH side

- The failure happens during **image initialization, before `main()`** — no user/Node code has run. Reinstalling or upgrading Node cannot affect it.
- DSH's own classification attributes it to the sandbox: `[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]`.
- `msedge.exe` is blocked identically, so it is the launch path, not anything Node does.
- It contradicts the documented contract that only writes are restricted.
- Outside the sandbox, Node is provably healthy on this machine: all 7 `node.exe` binaries on disk are intact and validly signed; **200 sequential** launches and **80 concurrent** launches all succeeded; `npm`/`npx`/`corepack`, crypto, ICU and ESM file execution all fine; no `node.exe` crash events in the event log; the running Node processes load only Microsoft + Node.js modules (no third-party injected DLLs).

## Reproduction hints (not yet deterministic)

I could not trigger it on demand. Faithful replays of the runner's exact argv — including the real `--write-sid` / `--temp-write-sid` values captured from a live process — all passed: read-only 8/8, workspace-write 8/8, seam-managed 12/12, plus 3×15 concurrent invocations. So it is **not** "the restricted token always fails", but something conditional.

The conditions that correlate in the field:

1. Work in a `workspace-write` session.
2. Run something that spawns `node` processes in quick succession — `npm install` (which spawns `node` via the npm shims) preceded all the failures seen so far.
3. Immediately afterwards, ordinary `node <script>.mjs` invocations start failing intermittently.

Suggesting an area to look at: state shared across overlapping sandbox invocations (token construction, the ACE grant/revoke around the private temp dir, and the `dsh-acl-locks` handling), rather than a single deterministic denial.

## Impact

`node`, `npm` and scripted workflows are effectively unusable in `read-only` / `workspace-write` sessions on Windows, which are the fail-safe defaults. The user-visible symptom is a stream of modal `0xC0000142` dialogs plus silently empty command output.

## Workaround

Switching the session's sandbox mode to `danger-full-access` avoids the sandbox path entirely (`dsh-pwsh-sandbox/lib/index.js` returns `super.run(spec)` unchanged for that mode) and no failures occur. That works, but it means giving up confinement to run an interpreter.

---

## 中文摘要

在 Windows 上，`read-only` / `workspace-write` 受限模式内的会话会**间歇性无法启动 `node.exe`**，表现为两种形式：

1. PowerShell 报 `Program 'node.exe' failed to run: Access is denied`，DSH 归类为 `[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]`；
2. Windows 弹出模态框「应用程序无法正常启动(0xc0000142)」，并在系统日志留 `Application Popup` 记录。`msedge.exe` 同样被拦。

关键点：

- 失败发生在**进程镜像初始化阶段（main 之前）**，与 Node 无关 —— 本机 7 个 `node.exe` 全部签名有效，顺序 200 次 + 并发 80 次启动零失败；
- 同一条命令（`node tools/hi.mjs`，脚本仅 47 字节）15:23:24 成功、15:24:14 失败；
- `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types/token.d.ts:62` 自己写明 `early DLL init dies with 0xC0000142`；
- 这与 README 声明的「Windows 只限制写入」相矛盾。

复现线索：先跑 `npm install`（瞬间拉起大量 node 子进程），随后普通 `node xxx.mjs` 就开始间歇失败。我用现场真实参数做的沙箱复现全部成功（8/8、8/8、12/12、并发 3×15），所以**不是**受限令牌必然失败，而是特定条件触发，建议排查并发/时序相关的共享状态。

临时规避：把会话切到 `danger-full-access`（该模式完全绕过沙箱，实测不再出现）。

discussions.title: [问题反馈][DS 4.1] 身份提示影响推理模式，疑似伴随严重能力下降
discussions.body:
## 问题概述

在使用 **DSH + goat（Command Code Provider API）的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash** 时，我反复观察到一种让我感觉任务能力明显、甚至严重下降的推理状态：以 `We need… / I need…` 展开，随后连续叙述局部操作；相比之下，同渠道的 ZCode 有时会先判断任务性质、列出整体结构，再用 `Let me…` 进入设计，实际体验更好。

我怀疑系统提示中的身份描述会影响这种状态的出现，希望官方协助排查。我们随后进行了 **1,044 次有记录的对照请求**，观察到：**只改变短系统提示中的身份名称，早期推理文本的分布也会显著变化。**

需要明确区分：

- **实际使用观察**：我认为某种 Need/连续叙述型状态伴随严重的能力下降，这是本帖最想解决的问题。
- **实验已验证的部分**：身份提示条件与推理开头、分项列表、自我规划措辞的出现频率有关。
- **尚未验证的因果链**：没有按最终答案正确率或完成质量评分，因此还不能把这些实验写成“Need 这个词导致能力下降”或“已确认路由到了更弱模型”。Need 起句和连续叙述型也不是同一指标。

## 环境与现场对比

- DSH：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1**，macOS。
- 接入：`llm-pi-ai` / `openai-completions`。
- Provider base URL：`https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1`。
- 请求模型 ID：`deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`。
- 对比客户端：DSH 与 ZCode，使用相同渠道、相同用户任务；对比的 High 会话记录已核对。
- **DSH 现场启用了自定义 Oh My DSH preset，不是干净的官方默认 preset。** 两客户端完整系统提示、工具列表和上下文并不相同，尚未完成 stock DSH 的完整端到端归因。
- 现场 DSH 记录为 `reasoningEffort: high`，适配器检查也确认发送 `reasoning_effort: high`。ZCode 的 High 记录包含 `reasoningEffort: high` 和 `thinking: enabled`，但取得的是 SDK options，不是完整的最终 HTTP body。
- 现场输出上限也不同：DSH 配置为 384,000，ZCode SDK options 为 128,000；下面的受控测试统一使用较小上限，避免这个变量混入组间比较。

原始用户任务：

> 直接给我生成一个秦始皇骑自行车的动态svg

DSH 中让我觉得质量下降的片段：

> We need to create an animated SVG showing Qin Shi Huang riding a bicycle…
> So I'll set up a rotation animation with a nested group…
> I'm also adding vertical motion…
> Now I'm working out the layering…

ZCode 中我觉得更好的片段：

> The user wants an animated SVG of Qin Shi Huang… This is a creative task — I should just generate it. No need for plans or questions.
> Let me design it carefully:
> - A side-view bicycle with rotating wheels
> - A cartoon Qin Shi Huang figure…
> - Animation…
> Let me think about the geometry.

这些是用户提供/本地记录中的风格示例，不是经过盲评的质量证据，也不能用模型自称判断后端身份。

## 对照实验设计

后续实验**直接调用同一个 goat API，绕过两个客户端**，用于隔离短提示条件；不能把它们等同为 1,044 次 DSH 客户端缺陷复现。

共四个预先定量的批次，没有“跑到显著才停止”，也没有过滤不利样本：

| 批次 | 条件 | 次数 | 每次输出上限 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 中文任务初轮 | 5 种短系统提示 × 3 题 × 8 次 | 120 | 384 |
| 中文身份词复测 | 同一角色句，替换 ZCode / DSH / coding；1 题 × 8 次 | 24 | 256 |
| 英文扩展 | 5 种短系统提示 × 3 题 × 20 次 | 300 | 384 |
| 英文身份名称复验 | 完全相同角色句中的 10 个身份词 × 3 题 × 20 次 | 600 | 256 |

共同条件：同一个 provider、模型 ID、API key；`reasoning_effort: high`；无工具、无历史；未额外设置 temperature；正式比较内保持相同输出上限。各区组包含全部条件并随机交错发送，批次内并发量固定。

请求使用短输出上限以降低成本，正式初轮/英文轮的输出均被上限截断。检查的是**早期返回的推理文本**，不是完整 SVG、最终答案或长程推理质量。不同批次的语言、输出上限和时间不同，不能直接把跨批次差值当成某个单变量的因果效果。

### 英文任务原文

1. `Directly generate an animated SVG of Qin Shi Huang riding a bicycle.`
2. `Analyze possible reasons why asynchronous tasks occasionally execute more than once.`
3. `Design a minimal solution for two processes to safely update the same JSON file.`

### 最后一轮：只改变一个身份名称

系统提示固定为：

```text
You are an interactive {identity} agent that helps users with software engineering tasks.
```

`identity` 为 ZCode、DSH、coding、Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Codex、Gemini、Atlas、Aster。最后两个是虚构名称对照；没有要求模型以 Need 或 Let me 开头。

**全部 600 次 HTTP 200，每格 20 次；Need 类起句次数如下，完整列出所有条件：**

| 身份 | SVG | 异步排错 | JSON 并发方案 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| ZCode | 0/20 | 9/20 | 1/20 |
| DSH | 10/20 | 14/20 | 7/20 |
| coding | 4/20 | 20/20 | 20/20 |
| Claude | 1/20 | 20/20 | 7/20 |
| ChatGPT | 0/20 | 20/20 | 20/20 |
| DeepSeek | 1/20 | 20/20 | 16/20 |
| Codex | 0/20 | 20/20 | 20/20 |
| Gemini | 3/20 | 20/20 | 20/20 |
| Atlas | 4/20 | 20/20 | 12/20 |
| Aster | 2/20 | 20/20 | 15/20 |

Need 类：推理起句以 `We need / I need / Need to` 开始（此前中文轮次也识别中文等价形式），不包括后文才出现的 need。

预定主要观察窗口为前 600 个 Unicode 字符，指标包括 Need 类起句、分项列表、自我规划措辞（如 Let me / I should）、特定连续叙述标记。按任务及随机区组置换身份标签 20,000 次，四项指标使用 Holm 多重比较校正：

- Need 类起句、分项列表、自我规划措辞：校正后均 `p < 0.001`。
- 特定连续叙述标记：本轮没有命中，不能声称复现了原始连续叙述状态，更不能凭这个指标判断智能。

**统计显著针对文本分布，不是任务能力。** 某些 Need 起句的样本仍然有清晰列表；相同身份也会生成不同风格。

### 较早英文轮中的同条件切换

在完整 DSH 短角色句 + 同一英文 SVG 任务 + High + 384 输出上限下，20 次中出现：Need 类 10 次、先概括用户任务 6 次、Let me 起句 4 次。

其中捕获 1 条与最初连续叙述形式接近的样本：

> I need to create an animated SVG… I'll work through the design process.
> First, I'm planning the visual composition…
> Now I'm drafting the SVG structure…
> I'm defining the bike geometry precisely…

因此，身份提示不是决定单次输出风格的固定开关。

## 最小复现（Python 标准库）

以下是小规模检查方式，不是上述 600 次的全部统计脚本。默认每种身份 2 次；重跑最后一轮时使用 10 个身份、3 个任务、每格 20 次，并随机分区组发送。API key 仅从环境变量读取，不要贴进讨论。

```python
import json
import os
import random
import re
import urllib.request

key = os.environ["CMD_API_KEY"]
url = "https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/chat/completions"
identities = ["ZCode", "DSH", "coding"]
repeats = int(os.environ.get("REPEATS", "2"))
randomizer = random.Random(20260913)
prompt = "Design a minimal solution for two processes to safely update the same JSON file."

for block in range(repeats):
    order = identities.copy()
    randomizer.shuffle(order)
    for identity in order:
        body = {
            "model": "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
            "reasoning_effort": "high",
            "max_tokens": 256,
            "stream": False,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content":
                 f"You are an interactive {identity} agent that helps users with software engineering tasks."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
            ],
        }
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
        message = result["choices"][0]["message"]
        reasoning = message.get("reasoning_content") or message.get("reasoning") or ""
        need = bool(re.match(r"(?:we\s+need\b|i\s+need\b|need\s+to\b)", reasoning.strip(), re.I))
        print(json.dumps({
            "block": block, "identity": identity, "need_opening": need,
            "opening": reasoning[:600], "model": result.get("model"),
            "request_id": result.get("id"),
        }, ensure_ascii=False))
```

## 希望官方帮助核查

1. 对 DS 4.1，是否已知身份措辞会显著影响这种推理组织方式？有没有推荐的身份句或提示组装方式？
2. 如何方便地导出并对比 **最终发送的、脱敏后的**系统提示、工具 schema、`reasoning_effort`、`thinking` 和输出上限，以排除 UI High 与实际协议参数不一致？
3. 能否用官方 DeepSeek 路由或可确认后端的环境验证同样现象，再比较 stock DSH 与上述自定义 preset？这样才有可能分开模型行为、渠道行为和 harness 组装影响。
4. 有没有适合检验“这种状态伴随严重质量下降”的小型、真实任务对照方法？我希望最终解决的是实际能力回退，而不是仅把开头改成 Let me。

我也怀疑渠道可能混用不同后端，但目前返回的模型 ID、每次不同的 fingerprint 和 `reasoning_details.format: unknown` 都不足以确认。**本帖不指控已经证实的模型替换，也不声称问题一定在 DSH 核心。**

原始请求 ID、返回文本、全部条件表和分析结果已在本地保留，后续可按需要提供脱敏样本；此处没有公开凭据、私人会话路径或完整私人提示配置。

discussions.title: Automatically disable thinking during context compression
discussions.body: Add an option to automatically disable model thinking/reasoning when performing context compression. Models such as Qwen can consume the available thinking budget during compression without producing useful output, wasting tokens and increasing compression time. Compression should therefore default to thinking: off, independently of the model's normal reasoning setting.

discussions.title: [Bug] Every session open / client reconnect re-decodes the session log and retains the decoded copy until V8 heap OOM (~30–90s of UI activity)
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh: `0.1.5-rc.1` **and** `0.1.5-rc.2` (via npm; `dsh web` profile, shipped bundles only)
- Node: v24.15.0, Linux x64 (Debian), 3.8 GB RAM
- Access: browser UI over an SSH port-forward

## What happens

`dsh web` boots fine and serves the UI, then the server process dies with a V8 heap OOM after roughly 30–90 seconds of session activity:

```
FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
```

The heap climbs to the V8 default limit (~1.9 GB) and mark-compact cannot reclaim it (`1936.9 (1947.6) -> 1935.1 (1942.9) MB`). With `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1024` it OOMs in ~28 s; with the default limit in ~83 s. Raising the limit only postpones the crash proportionally.

The trigger is **opening/switching sessions in the web UI — or the frontend auto-reconnect re-opening the last session**. A stale client that reconnects every ~3 s (e.g. an auto-retrying port-forward with the tab still open) will crash a freshly booted, otherwise idle instance in ~80 s with no human interaction.

Control experiment: an instance whose webserver failed to bind (EADDRINUSE) sits flat at ~383 MB RSS for many minutes — the leak requires a successfully served UI + session loads.

## Evidence (V8 sampling heap profile)

Captured with `HeapProfiler.startSampling` (512 KB interval) during the growth window, ~170 s:

```
TOTAL sampled: 1122.8MB

== TOP by call frame ==
 1095.1MB consumeEventLine @ @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js
    4.0MB decodeSeqRanges @ @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2/lib/index.js
    3.0MB apply @ @deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter/lib/index.js
    1.5MB Session @ @deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js
    1.0MB _processDelta @ @deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js
    ... (noise)
```

97.5% of all sampled allocation lands in `consumeEventLine` (the `SessionLogScanner` path: `JSON.parse(line)` + `restore.decodeRow(decoded)` per JSONL row).

The session in question is small (~3.8 MB of JSONL), so a single decode cannot fill the heap — the observed ~35 MB/s sustained allocation rate with net retention implies the log is **re-decoded on every session open / reconnect and the decoded copies are retained** long enough to ratchet the heap up until OOM.

## Reproduction

1. `dsh web --no-open` in a workspace that has a session with history
2. Open the UI and repeatedly open/switch that session (or keep a reconnecting client polling it)
3. RSS climbs at ~35 MB/s; the process aborts with the OOM above in under 90 s

## Expected

Repeated opens of the same session revision should reuse the memoized decode (or release prior decoded copies). The heap should stay flat across open/close cycles.

## Notes

- `coldLogMemo` is bounded (`COLD_LOG_MEMO_MAX_ENTRIES = 2`), so the retention appears to live in the per-open consumers downstream of `decodeStoredLog`/`scanLog`, not in the memo itself.
- `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js` is byte-identical between rc.1 and rc.2, so upgrading does not fix it.
- Happy to attach the full sampling profile JSON or test patches against a checkout.

discussions.title: lsp 工具的工作区边界能否与会话的沙箱权限同步？(Should the lsp tool boundary follow the session sandbox mode?)
discussions.body:
`lsp` 工具的工作区边界没有与会话的沙箱权限同步——它硬编码为会话 `cwd`，三档权限下行为完全一致。下文的每一处引用都对照 `master` @ `c291e79` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` / `dsh-lsp-stdio` `0.1.5-rc.2` 的实际产物核对过。

## 现象

一个 `danger-full-access`（完全权限）的会话里：

- fs 工具可以读任意路径的文件；
- **`lsp` 工具却只能在会话 `cwd` 内查询**，工作区外的文件一律被拒：

```
Error: source "C:\...\some-other-repo\file.ts" resolves outside the workspace
```

同一会话里两个读取类能力对"能看到什么"给出不同答案，这本身就不自洽。

## 三条链路

**1. 边界来源是会话 `cwd`，而不是解析后的策略根**

`packages/lsp/tool-lsp/src/session-cwd.ts`（编译产物 `lib/index.js` L174–175）：

```js
function sessionCwd(exec) {
  return exec.agent?.session.header.cwd;
}
```

调用点 L351–359：

```js
const workspaceRoot = sessionCwd(exec);
if (workspaceRoot === void 0) throw new LspError("the lsp tool requires a session workspace cwd", "LSP_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED");
const result = await ctx.lsp.query({ operation, filePath, position, workspaceRoot }, exec.signal);
```

**2. 两个包都拿不到策略**

```
dsh-tool-lsp   inject = ["tools", "lsp", "systemPrompt"]
dsh-lsp-stdio  inject = ["fs", "lsp", "subprocess"]
```

两者都没有 `sandboxPolicy`。

**3. 围栏是纯路径判定**

`packages/lsp/lsp-stdio/src/host.ts` → `lib/index.js` L109（`readHostSource`，L96 起）：

```js
if (!fs.contains(workspace.target, target)) throw new Error(`source "${filePath}" resolves outside the workspace`);
```

而 `fs.contains(parent: FsTarget, child: FsTarget): boolean` 不感知模式。`lsp-stdio` 的 `Config` 也只有 `servers` 表，没有任何 workspace 相关字段。

## 为什么我认为这是个缺口，而不是有意的设计

`ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve()` 返回的正是这件事，而且注释本身就在邀请调用方消费它：

```ts
export type SandboxMode = 'read-only' | 'workspace-write' | 'danger-full-access';

export interface SandboxExecutionPolicy {
  mode: SandboxMode;
  /** Absolute root directory `workspace-write` may write under. */
  workspaceRoot: string;
  // …注释：The root is carried even under modes that do not consume it
  //   so callers can resolve the effective path.
}
```

`SandboxPolicyRequest` 也已经是这个形状：

```ts
export interface SandboxPolicyRequest {
  /** Calling session; its immutable cwd becomes the workspace boundary. */
  session?: Session;
  mode?: SandboxMode;
}
```

也就是说：**"会话 + 其 cwd 作为边界"这套语义早就被策略服务精确表达了**，`danger-full-access` 更是被明确定义为非受限模式（`ConfinedSandboxMode = Exclude<SandboxMode, 'danger-full-access'>`）。`lsp` 只是没走这条路。

## 建议的改法

| 位置 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| `tool-lsp` | inject 加 `sandboxPolicy`；把 `sessionCwd(exec)` 换成 `ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session: exec.agent.session })`，用返回的 `workspaceRoot` 作为传给 seam 的根（`mode` 一并带上） |
| `lsp-stdio` | inject 加 `sandboxPolicy`（或在 query 请求里接收 mode）；`readHostSource` 改为 `mode !== 'danger-full-access' && !fs.contains(...)` 时拒绝 |

这样三档行为就自洽了：`read-only` / `workspace-write` 仍在会话 `cwd` 内（与写权限同界），`danger-full-access` 放开。

**如果只想改一处**，也有一个更小的选项：把 `tool-lsp` 的工作区根直接取自 `resolve().workspaceRoot`，`mode` 作为新的 query 字段透传，围栏判断本身挪到 `tool-lsp` 做（拒绝发生在向 seam 发请求之前）。这能避免动 `lsp-stdio`，但会把"源文件围栏"这条不变式从 provider 挪到工具层——我不确定你们更喜欢哪一种，所以两种都列出来。

## 两个请求

1. **确认这是不是缺口。** 如果 `lsp` 边界故意不跟随权限（例如为了让 provider 保持策略无关、只做纯路径围栏），那我理解，只是希望能从文档里读到，而不是从报错里推断。这一点和我在 #6503 里提的是同类问题：**边界规则没有写进文档时，使用者只能靠试**。
2. **如果可以做，请指方向：** `mode` 透传到 provider，还是把围栏上提到工具层？

## 关于"现在就要用"

我在本地把 `lsp` / `lsp-stdio` / `tool-lsp` 挂在宿主平面（按 web-app 的原样，工具行默认被 `disabled`，我显式打开），配了四个语言服务器（clangd / csharp-ls / pyright / typescript-language-server）。改编译产物会随 DSH 升级被覆盖，所以我**没有**擅自打补丁——先来问上游。

我需要"在完全权限会话里跨仓库做 LSP 导航"这个能力，而按目前行为，唯一的绕过办法是把会话 `cwd` 抬到很宽的目录，那会连带放宽 fs 工具与 grep 的范围，我不想为了 LSP 付这个代价。

---

## 中文摘要（English summary below）

`lsp` 工具的工作区边界硬编码为会话 `cwd`（`tool-lsp/lib/index.js` L174–175、L351–359），围栏是 `fs.contains` 纯路径判定（`lsp-stdio/lib/index.js` L109），两个包的 `inject` 都不含 `sandboxPolicy`。因此 `read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access` 三档权限下 LSP 行为完全相同——同一个 `danger-full-access` 会话里，fs 能读任意文件而 LSP 不能，二者不自洽。而 `ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve()` 返回的 `{ mode, workspaceRoot }` 恰好就是所需语义，其注释明确说 root 即使在"不消费它的模式"下也会带上，以便调用方解析有效路径。建议：`tool-lsp` 用 `resolve().workspaceRoot` 取代 `sessionCwd`，`lsp-stdio` 在 `mode !== 'danger-full-access'` 时才施加 `contains` 围栏。想先确认这是缺口而非有意设计。

## English summary

`dsh-tool-lsp` resolves its workspace from the session `cwd` and nothing else (`lib/index.js` L174–175, L351–359), and `dsh-lsp-stdio` enforces containment with a pure path test — `if (!fs.contains(workspace.target, target)) throw` (`lib/index.js` L109). Neither package injects `sandboxPolicy` (`["tools","lsp","systemPrompt"]` and `["fs","lsp","subprocess"]`), and `lsp-stdio`'s `Config` has no workspace field.

So all three sandbox modes behave identically: a `danger-full-access` session can read any file through the fs tools but cannot point `lsp` outside its `cwd`. That looks inconsistent rather than intended, because `ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve()` already returns exactly this decision — `{ mode, workspaceRoot }` — with a doc comment noting the root is carried even under modes that do not consume it so callers can resolve the effective path, and `danger-full-access` is explicitly the non-confined mode.

Suggested change: inject `sandboxPolicy` into both packages, take the workspace root from `resolve({ session })` instead of `session.header.cwd`, and gate the containment check on `mode !== 'danger-full-access'`. Happy to prototype if you confirm the direction — I have not patched the compiled packages locally, since an upgrade would overwrite it.

discussions.title: fix(client-connection): resolve webServer from Connection, not the RPC caller (PRs appear disabled — fix branch attached)
discussions.body:
## Summary

A third-party plugin that registers an RPC endpoint through the public, carrier-neutral `connection.rpc.handle()` API silently fails to mount its route in a Web composition, because the Host implementation resolves `webServer` from the **calling plugin's own context** instead of from Connection's own context. I found the root cause, fixed it, and added regression coverage. Pull requests appear to be disabled on this repository, so I'm posting the fix here instead, with the full diff on a public branch for a maintainer to cherry-pick or pull directly.

**Branch (fork):** https://github.com/SergioMazariego/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/client-connection-external-rpc-web
**Commit:** `118e6c9be8bd4408fc965d7826864d0fb2dc0a0b`
**Compare view:** https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...SergioMazariego:deepseek-harness:fix/client-connection-external-rpc-web

## Regression

```text
DSH 0.1.5-rc.1
Windows

Settings -> Subscriptions

Failed to load proxy settings:
transport failure for /subscriptions-auth/proxyGet: HTTP 405
```

The endpoint belongs to a third-party plugin that authenticates providers via subscriptions/OAuth instead of API keys. It registers its RPC endpoints through Connection's public API (`connection.rpc.handle(...)`), declaring only `inject: ['connection']` — the documented contract for that API, which is meant to be carrier-neutral.

## Root cause

`HostConnectionService.register()` (the implementation behind `connection.rpc.handle()`, in `packages/client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts`) mounted the channel's route by calling `owner.webServer.register(route)` directly on `owner`, the *calling* plugin's own context (`get rpc()` captures `owner = this.ctx`, rebound per caller — see the class doc: "whose channel registrations belong to the caller fiber").

Cordis resolves a service reference by walking the accessing fiber's own ancestor chain; a fiber that never crosses a `webServer`-providing ancestor gets `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`. A plugin that only declares `inject: ['connection']` — exactly what the public API asks for — has no such path to `webServer` whenever `webServer` is provided by its own separate plugin fiber rather than directly on the root context (the shape of a normal Web composition, and the shape the existing test suite happened not to exercise: its `mounted()` helper called `ctx.provide('webServer', …)` directly on the literal root, which masks the bug).

So the very first call to `connection.rpc.handle()` from such a plugin throws synchronously inside the registration effect. That failure is local to the registering plugin's own fiber, so the rest of the app keeps running — but the plugin's channel is never mounted. A later request to that channel's path finds no route, falls through to the webServer's fallback seat, and — under the shipped Web composition, where the fallback is `frontend-static` — receives HTTP 405, because `frontend-static`'s fallback answers any non-GET/HEAD request with 405 outside its own named routes (`packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts`).

This is not a new dependency requirement working as intended: `connection.rpc.intercept('/api', …)` and `connection.fetch.register(...)` — the *other* two RPC/Fetch registration APIs on the same service — never touch `webServer` at all; they only touch Connection's own internal maps and piggyback on the one `/api` route Connection's own `apply()` already mounts through its existing optional `ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)`. `rpc.handle()` was the one path that bypassed that abstraction and reached for the caller's own `webServer` access instead.

## Fix

`HostConnectionService` now resolves `webServer` itself, through its own soft dependency declared in its constructor (`ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)`, on Connection's own context — the same context that already optionally mounts `/api`), instead of requiring the calling plugin's context to reach it:

- `register()` records the channel's `WebRoute` in an internal map (`channelRoutes`) and mounts it immediately if `webServer` is already active.
- The constructor's `ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)` callback mounts every already-recorded channel whenever `webServer` (re)activates, and withdraws every mounted channel when `webServer` stops (a restart, or an isolated realm unloading).
- The disposer returned to the caller (`rpc.handle()`'s return value) still belongs to the **caller's own fiber** — removing the channel's registration when that plugin unloads — preserving the class's existing "channel registrations belong to the caller fiber" contract. Only the *route-mounting* step moved off the caller's context.

This is the minimal change: no changes to `registerInterceptor`/`registerFetchRoute` (already carrier-neutral), no changes to the public `HostConnectionRpc`/`HostConnectionFetch` types, and `client-connection`'s own top-level `inject = ['credentials']` is untouched — `webServer` stays optional for the whole plugin, exactly as the existing doc comment describes ("Provides carrier-neutral RPC and Fetch registries. When `webServer` is present, the plugin also mounts the `/api` browser transport"), so Desktop, headless, and other webServer-less compositions are unaffected.

## Tests

- Added `packages/client/connection/tests/external-rpc-web.host.spec.ts`:
  - Mounts `webServer` as its own nested plugin fiber (not directly on the root context, which is what let the existing suite miss this) alongside `client-connection`, then a sibling plugin declaring only `inject: ['connection']` that calls `connection.rpc.handle(...)`. Asserts the route mounts, a real request reaches the handler (not a 405), and disposing the external plugin withdraws the route.
  - A second case registers the channel *before* `webServer` exists anywhere in the tree, asserts nothing is mounted yet, then activates `webServer` and asserts the channel mounts; disposing `webServer` withdraws the route without disturbing the external plugin's own registration.
  - Both cases fail against the pre-fix code with `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`, and pass with the fix.
- Updated the one existing assertion whose expected error text changed (`packages/client/connection/tests/node-half.host.spec.ts`): the duplicate-channel error is now raised by `HostConnectionService` itself (`already registered`) rather than by (in that test) the fake webServer's own duplicate-route check.
- Ran the full `packages/client/connection` suite (165 tests) and `packages/host/webserver` + `packages/host/frontend-static` (5 tests): all green.
- `tsc -b packages/client/connection/tsconfig.host.json` and `tsconfig.client.json`: no errors.
- `oxlint` over the changed files: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- Verified 100% statement/branch coverage on `rpc-host.ts` (this repo's per-file coverage gate) with the new test alone.

## Manual verification

```text
Before:
POST /subscriptions-auth/proxyGet -> HTTP 405

Temporary local workaround (evidence used to localize the regression,
not the fix landed here):
client-connection inject changed from:
['credentials']
to:
['webServer', 'credentials']

After restarting DSH:
subscription proxy settings loaded correctly and external RPC calls succeeded.
```

That workaround happened to work because it moved `client-connection`'s own base fiber onto a Web composition where `webServer` was declared close enough in the tree for the caller's own context to resolve it in that particular installation's plugin layout — it does not hold in general (e.g. it cannot help a plugin mounted where no ancestor of its own fiber ever provides `webServer`), and it makes `webServer` mandatory for the whole `client-connection` plugin, which is not architecturally correct (see `packages/client/connection/src/index.ts`'s doc comment). The fix on the branch above resolves `webServer` from Connection's own context unconditionally, so it works regardless of where a `connection.rpc.handle()` caller sits in the plugin tree, and keeps `webServer` optional for `client-connection` as a whole.

## Note on delivery

I tried opening a pull request first (`fix/client-connection-external-rpc-web` on my fork, `SergioMazariego/deepseek-harness`, against `master`), but this repository has Pull Requests disabled at the repository-feature level (confirmed via the API: `has_pull_requests: false` — listing existing PRs also 404s), so posting here per the README's contribution guidance. Happy to adjust the change, split it, or answer questions — the branch above stays up to date if I need to push a revision.

discussions.title: [dsh-compaction] A compaction/prune span stored by 0.1.1-rc.2 is unaddressable under 0.1.5 — the v0 migration refuses the whole session
discussions.body:
**Environment / 环境**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Product | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (DeepSeek Harness) |
| Version observed | `0.1.5-rc.1` / `0.1.5-rc.2` (migration packages); source log written by `0.1.1-rc.2` |
| Where observed | a real session log migrated through the official `v0 → v1 → v2 → v3` chain |
| Source of the log | written by `0.1.1-rc.2`, 20,179,981 B / 64,085 lines, unmodified (read-only) |
| Gates referenced | `dsh-compaction/lib/invariant.js` (`validateShadowedSeqs`) · `dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1/lib/index.js:2576` · `dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner/lib/index.js:137-169` |

## Summary

A session log written by `0.1.1-rc.2` contains **17 `compaction/prune` entries whose declared span does not resolve on the surface model that `0.1.5` validates against**. The migration refuses the whole session at the first such entry:

```
compaction/prune 151836 shadowedRange start targets consumed assistant/chunk 1299
```

The point of this report is not "a log has bad data". It is that **the meaning of a stored prune span is not versioned**: a span is a pair of coordinates that is only interpretable relative to *some* surface model, and nothing on disk records which one. When the surface model changes, previously-stored spans become unaddressable, and the failure mode is "the entire session will not open" rather than "this one log-only entry is ignored".

## What the 17 entries look like

- **0 of 17** have `shadowedRange.start` on the surface that the invariant is checked against. All 17 land **inside a packed `assistant/chunk` run**.
- `v1 → v2` folds chunk runs, so chunk coordinates are **not addressable** in the v2/v3 coordinate space — there is no mapping entry that produces them.
- Each of the 17 has **no paired `surfaceOp: replace` `tool/result`**. The 7 compliant `compaction/prune` entries in the **same** log all have one.
- Recomputing the official per-message price (`dsh-token-meter`, `ceil(len/4)+4`-class estimator) reproduces the stored `shadowedTokenCount` for the compliant entries in **7/7** cases; for the 17 entries, the stored value matches **no node in the log (0/17)**.

Together these say the span was **not** written against the same surface model that `0.1.5` checks. We could not find any derivable repair: the coordinates are not a spelling of a current node, the price is not a price of any current node, and there is no replacement to resolve against. Guessing a span would be inventing history, so none was synthesised — these entries are simply outside what can be reconstructed from the artifact.

## The part that seems worth fixing

We cannot tell from the artifact whether the span was **legal when it was written** and became unaddressable later, or was **already illegal at write time**. That is exactly the problem:

1. **A stored span carries no version of the surface model it was computed against.** Two builds can read the same bytes and disagree about whether the entry is well-formed.
2. **`ToolResultPruner` only ever prunes `tool/result` nodes that are on the surface at that moment** (`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner/lib/index.js:137-169`). So a span pointing into a chunk run should not be producible by the current write path — which makes it ambiguous whether this is (a) an old write path that skipped the check, or (b) a surface model that changed underneath data that was legal when written.
3. **The failure is hard, not soft.** An unsatisfiable *log-only* entry takes down the *entire session*. Prunes are not part of the visible conversation; users get "your session is gone" for data that was never shown to them.

## Suggested direction (any one would help)

1. **Validate at write time** — reject a span that does not resolve against the current surface when the prune is appended, so illegal data never reaches disk.
2. **Make the span self-describing** — record the surface model / a generation marker alongside the span, so a later reader can migrate it instead of rejecting it.
3. **Fail soft on log-only entries** — if a prune's span is unsatisfiable but the entry is not on the surface and is not referenced by anything, skip it with a warning rather than refusing the whole session. (We understand this trades strictness for availability; it may be acceptable for entries that can never be shown.)

## What we did not claim

- We did not claim a specific write path produced this; we only established that the stored span does not resolve under the checked model, and that no mapping to the current space exists.
- We are not asking for the 17 entries to be "fixed" — we are asking that the ambiguity be removed so that the next occurrence is decidable.
- Our ask is about the gate itself, not about our data — how one chooses to handle unsatisfiable log-only entries is the reader's call.

---

*Reported by the **OfferKuai Team** — Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. Website: https://www.offerkuai.com/ | Contact: contact@offerkuai.com*

*Authorship note: measured and documented by me against my own session store; root-cause tracing and drafting assisted by AI; verification and publication by me. I have no engineering background — if any technical claim reads wrong, please call it out; I will re-verify against the toolchain and correct.*

---

## 中文版

**环境**

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 产品 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（DeepSeek Harness） |
| 观察版本 | 迁移包 `0.1.5-rc.1` / `0.1.5-rc.2`；被迁移的源日志由 `0.1.1-rc.2` 写入 |
| 观察位置 | 一份真实会话日志，走官方 `v0 → v1 → v2 → v3` 链迁移 |
| 源日志 | 由 `0.1.1-rc.2` 写入，20,179,981 字节 / 64,085 行，**未改动**（只读） |
| 涉及判据 | `dsh-compaction/lib/invariant.js`（`validateShadowedSeqs`）· `dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1/lib/index.js:2576` · `dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner/lib/index.js:137-169` |

**摘要**

一份由 `0.1.1-rc.2` 写入的会话日志里，有 **17 条 `compaction/prune` 的声明区间在 `0.1.5` 校验所用的 surface 模型上不成立**。迁移在第一条处就拒收整条会话：

```
compaction/prune 151836 shadowedRange start targets consumed assistant/chunk 1299
```

这份报告想说的不是"某份日志里有坏数据"，而是：**一个被存在磁盘上的 prune 区间，其含义是没有版本标记的**。区间是一对坐标，只有相对于**某个** surface 模型才可解释，而磁盘上没有任何东西记录它是按哪一个算出来的。当 surface 模型变了，先前存下的区间就变得不可寻址，而失败方式是"**整条会话打不开**"，而不是"这一条纯日志条目被忽略"。

**这 17 条长什么样**

- **0/17** 的 `shadowedRange.start` 落在校验所用的 surface 上；17 条**全部落在一段被打包的 `assistant/chunk` 运行内部**。
- `v1 → v2` 会把 chunk 运行折叠掉，所以 chunk 坐标在 v2/v3 坐标空间里**不可寻址**——不存在能产生它们的映射项。
- 这 17 条**都没有配对的 `surfaceOp: replace` 的 `tool/result`**；而**同一份**日志里 7 条合规的 `compaction/prune` **都有**。
- 复刻官方逐消息计价（`dsh-token-meter`，`ceil(len/4)+4` 一类）后：合规条目的 `shadowedTokenCount` 能被复算出来 **7/7**；而这 17 条存下的值，**在整份日志的任何节点上都对不上（0/17）**。

三条合起来说明：这些区间**不是**按 `0.1.5` 校验所用的那个 surface 模型写下的。我们找不到任何可推导的修复——坐标不是某个当前节点的另一种拼法，价也不是任何当前节点的价，而且没有配对的替换可供解析。**猜一个区间等于伪造历史**，所以那 17 条我们按"无法从产物重建"处理，没有去合成。

**我们认为值得修的部分**

从这份产物上，我们**无法判断**该区间是"写入时合法、后来变得不可寻址"，还是"写入时就已经非法"。而这正是问题所在：

1. **存下的区间不带它当时所依据的 surface 模型的版本。** 两个 build 读同一段字节，对"这条是否良构"可以给出不同答案。
2. **`ToolResultPruner` 只会裁剪当刻在 surface 上的 `tool/result` 节点**（`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner/lib/index.js:137-169`）。所以指向 chunk 运行的区间**不该**由当前写路径产生——这让"这是旧写路径漏了检查"还是"下面那层 surface 模型变了"变得无法区分。
3. **失败是硬的，不是软的。** 一条无法满足的**纯日志**条目，拖垮的是**整条会话**。prune 不属于可见对话；用户得到的是"你的会话没了"，而那些数据从来没给他看过。

**建议方向（任一条都有帮助）**

1. **写入时校验**：prune 落盘前就拒绝无法在当前 surface 上解析的区间，让非法数据到不了磁盘。
2. **让区间自描述**：把 surface 模型 / 世代标记与区间一起记录，后来的读者可以**迁移**它，而不是拒收。
3. **纯日志条目软失败**：若某条 prune 的区间无法满足、但它不在 surface 上、也没有被任何东西引用，则跳过并告警，而不是拒收整条会话。（我们理解这是拿严格性换可用性；对于永远不会被展示的条目，这或许可以接受。）

**我们没有主张的**

- 我们没有主张是某条具体写路径产生了它；我们只确认了"存下的区间在被校验的模型上不成立，且不存在到当前坐标空间的映射"。
- 我们不是要求把那 17 条"修好"，而是要求**消除这种歧义**，让下一次出现时可判定。
- 我们的诉求是这道门本身，而不是我们的数据——无法满足的纯日志条目怎么处置，由读者自行决定。

---

*本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。官网：https://www.offerkuai.com/ ｜ 联系：contact@offerkuai.com*

*署名说明：本文由我对自己的会话库实测并整理；根因追溯与成稿有 AI 协助；核验与发布由我完成。我并非工程背景——若任何技术表述有误，请直接指出，我会对照工具链复核并更正。*

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: "Reveal in File Explorer" from a deliverables card silently does nothing (execFile + windowsHide + exit-1 swallow)
discussions.body:
### Summary

On Windows, the deliverables card menu item **"在文件资源管理器中显示"** (reveal in File Explorer) — and the same
`action=reveal` path behind it — produces **no window and no error**: nothing happens at all. The same gesture from
PowerShell works every time, so the OS side is fine; the dsh-side launch is what fails, silently.

### Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.5-rc.1` (subpackages `0.1.5-rc.2`), installed via npm |
| OS | Windows (Windows 11), shell: Windows PowerShell 5.1 available; `explorer.exe` running normally |
| Surface | dsh web UI (browser; reproduced in VS Code Simple Browser webview) |
| Packages involved | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` |

### Steps to reproduce

1. Let the agent call `present` with a file (or any turn that produces a deliverables row).
2. Open the card's `⋯` menu.
3. Click **"在文件资源管理器中显示"**.
4. Observe: no Explorer window appears, and the card shows no error state.

### Expected

Explorer opens with the file selected — exactly like the OS gesture does.

### What I measured (same machine, same target file, alternating)

| # | How the launch is issued | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Node `execFile("explorer.exe", ["/select,", fileURL], { windowsHide: true })` — **what dsh does today** | **no window** (repeated runs: 0 windows; in one batch only 2 of 4 variants showed a window) |
| 2 | Node `spawn` with `windowsHide: false`, and with a plain path instead of a `file://` URL | also unreliable — 0, then 1, then 0 windows across runs |
| 3 | PowerShell `& explorer.exe "/select,<plain path>"` | ✅ window appears, file selected, every time |
| 4 | PowerShell `Start-Process explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,"<path>"'` (ShellExecute) | ✅ window appears, file selected, every time |

`explorer.exe` **is** being started in all cases (new PIDs appear while the failing calls run), so this is not a
"spawn denied" failure — the reveal request is being handed to the already-running shell and then not landing as a window.

### Why the user sees nothing at all

Two effects combine:

1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`'s `revealNativePath()` runs
   `execFile("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], { windowsHide: true })`.
   `windowsHide: true` sets `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE` for the child — and `/select,` works by *delegating*
   to the running shell, which is exactly the path that becomes unreliable under that flag.
2. The same function **swallows the only signal that exists**:

   ```js
   try { await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal) }
   catch (error) { if (error.code !== 1) throw error }   // exit 1 == "accepted handoff"
   ```

   Explorer exits with code 1 **both** when the handoff succeeded and when it did not, so a genuine failure is
   indistinguishable and never reaches the UI. (The client does have a `revealError` phase that would redden the
   card — it just never fires.)

### Suggested fix (small, contained)

`revealNativePath()` / `openNativePathWithIntent()` on `win32` could launch through the shell instead of spawning
Explorer directly, e.g.

```js
// instead of: execFile("explorer.exe", ["/select,", fileUrl], { windowsHide: true })
spawn("powershell.exe", ["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-WindowStyle", "Hidden", "-Command",
  `Start-Process -FilePath explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,"${path}"'`], { windowsHide: true, detached: true, stdio: "ignore" })
```

`Start-Process` returns as soon as the shell accepts the request, so the caller does not wait for the window, and
the reveal no longer depends on the `windowsHide`d delegation path. Keeping the exit-1 tolerance is fine, but it
should not be the **only** signal; a short timeout or an OS-level confirmation would let real failures surface.

### Workaround

A small host-plane plugin replaces the two instance openers the Session Controller calls
(`sessionController.revealPath` / `openPath` — both plain instance properties set from injectable internals), so
**no core file is touched** and uninstalling restores the stock behavior:

```js
ctx.inject(["sessionController"], () => {
  service.revealPath = (path, signal) => run(revealScript(path), signal);
  service.openPath   = (path, signal) => run(openScript(path), signal);
});
// revealScript: Start-Process -FilePath explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,"<path>"'
// openScript:   Start-Process -FilePath "<path>"
```

Verified on a throwaway `dsh web` instance (`/explorer-reveal/status` → `patched: true`) and by hand — the window
appears and the file is selected. Happy to publish the plugin (MIT) if it is useful as a reference.

---

<details>
<summary>中文摘要</summary>

### 摘要

Windows 上，产物卡片菜单里的 **「在文件资源管理器中显示」** 点了**没有任何反应，也没有任何报错**。
同一个动作改用 PowerShell 发起每次都成功，说明系统侧没问题——失败在 dsh 这一侧的启动方式上，而且被静默吞掉了。

### 复现

1. 让 agent 用 `present` 交付一个文件（或任何产生产物行的回合）；
2. 打开卡片 `⋯` 菜单 → 点「在文件资源管理器中显示」；
3. 结果：资源管理器不出现，卡片也不显示任何错误态。

### 实测（同一台机器、同一个文件，交替验证）

| 发起方式 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| Node `execFile("explorer.exe", ["/select,", fileURL], { windowsHide: true })`（**dsh 现状**） | 不出窗（多次重复 0 次；某一批 4 个变体只有 2 个出窗） |
| Node `spawn`，`windowsHide:false` / 纯路径 | 同样不稳——0、1、0 次 |
| PowerShell `& explorer.exe "/select,<纯路径>"` | ✅ 每次出窗并选中文件 |
| PowerShell `Start-Process explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,"<路径>"'` | ✅ 每次出窗并选中文件 |

失败时 `explorer.exe` 确实被拉起了（能看到新 PID），所以**不是 spawn 被拒**，而是委派给已运行 shell 的 `/select` 请求没落地成窗口。

### 为什么用户看不到任何提示

1. `windowsHide: true` 给子进程设了 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE`，而 `/select,` 依赖"委派给已运行的 shell"这条不稳的路径；
2. `revealNativePath` 把 explorer 的 `exit=1` **一律当成"已成功转交"吞掉**——而成功与失败**同样是 1**，
   于是真实失败永远冒不到 UI（客户端其实有 `revealError` 态，只是从不触发）。

### 建议

Windows 分支改为经外壳启动（`Start-Process explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,"<路径>"'`），
或至少别把 `exit=1` 当作唯一判据。完整实验数据与调用链位置见本机报告（如有需要我可以整理成附件）。

</details>

discussions.title: Let your agent safely treat spreadsheets as databases (Excel / CSV / MySQL / PostgreSQL → local libSQL)
discussions.body:
Hi all 👋 —— Sharing a community plugin I just finished: **[dsh-lh-data](https://github.com/linkedshine/dsh-lh-data)**.

In one sentence: it imports "Excel / CSV files in your workspace" and "tables from remote MySQL / PostgreSQL" into a local Turso (libSQL), then hands the model a set of **handle-based `dataset_*` tools** for CRUD operations; on the human side, there's also a browser-based settings page ("Settings → Datasets") for visual management.

---

## 1. The three real pain points it aims to solve

There are three common ways to have an agent work with tabular data, and each one has pitfalls:

| Approach | Problem |
| --- | --- |
| Stuffing the whole CSV into context / having the model write Python snippets | A few thousand rows blows up the context; it re-reads everything on every question; results can't be reviewed |
| Letting the model connect directly to the production DB and write SQL | Connection strings, passwords, and real table schemas are all exposed to the model; `UPDATE` has no gate; one slip is an incident |
| Just reading the file as text | Can't aggregate, can't write incrementally, can't "keep asking on this same table next time" |

The idea behind `dsh-lh-data` is: **give the model a "data handle layer", not a database connection.**

- The model only knows the `datasetId` / registered name / business column names (keeping Chinese headers), and **never sees the physical table name**;
- The model only gets "a few preview rows + a full statistical summary", with the **complete result fetched by the frontend table card via `viewId` with pagination**;

---

## 2. Installation

```bash
# Install from the central registry (local source paths are also supported)
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lh-data

# Uninstall
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lh-data
```

It works out of the box with zero required configuration. The database defaults to `$DSH_HOME/lh-data/data.db` (falling back to `~/.dsh` when `DSH_HOME` is unset); the plugin injects default config via `cordis.patch.yml` and also provides a visual management page under "Settings → Datasets" in the browser.

When you need a remote database, just configure `dbUrl` (`file:` or `libsql://`) + `TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN` — no code changes required.

`mysql2` / `pg` ship installed with the plugin by default, but use **dynamic loading** — when you only import Excel / CSV, they are never `require`d at all, so startup is unaffected.

---

## 3. Tool overview (12 tools, 4 of which can be disabled wholesale)

`dataset_*` —— the dataset itself:

| Tool | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataset_list` | Read | What datasets exist in the current workspace: row count, column count, status, source |
| `dataset_schema` | Read | Column names (original headers), inferred types, nullability, sample values |
| `dataset_query` | Read | Structured query (`columns` / `where` / `orderBy` / `limit`) or restricted `sql` |
| `dataset_import` | Write | Import `.xlsx` / `.xls` / `.csv`; large files auto-switch to a background task |
| `dataset_insert` / `_update` / `_delete` | Write | Row-level add/update/delete, located via the system column `_row_id` |
| `dataset_drop` | Write | Delete together with the physical table and metadata |

`datasource_*` —— fetch from remote databases (not registered at all when `datasourceEnabled=false`):

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `datasource_list` | List registered data sources (MySQL / PostgreSQL), returning no credentials whatsoever |
| `datasource_test` | Connectivity test: latency + server version |
| `datasource_tables` | Browse remote tables: schema, estimated row count, primary keys, column metadata |
| `datasource_import` | Import a remote table in chunks into the **current workspace**, after which it has exactly the same rights as an Excel-imported dataset |

On the credentials side: the return value of `datasource_*` contains **only "whether a password is set"**, never the password itself; on connection failure it returns human-readable messages like "connection refused (host reachable, but port not open or service not started)" or "wrong username or password", and the driver's raw stack never crosses the module boundary.

Two typical sessions:

> You: Import `sales_detail.xlsx` and tell me which region has the highest return rate
>
> agent: `dataset_import(path=…)` → `dataset_schema` → `dataset_query(sql="SELECT region, COUNT(*) … FROM ds GROUP BY region")`
>
> The model only gets 5 preview rows + the statistical summary per column; the full 30k rows are paginated in the frontend card, sortable and exportable to CSV.

> You: Pull the production `orders` table down and reconcile the amounts against this Excel
>
> agent: `datasource_list` → `datasource_tables(source=…)` (view schema / estimated rows / column structure) → `datasource_import(source=…, table="orders")` → after that it's just an ordinary dataset, and filtering and aggregation go back to `dataset_query`
>
> Once the whole chain is done, the model still only holds the `datasetId` — it doesn't know the database name, the instance address, or the password. (The import is a full-table pull, so if you really want "the last three months", you land it in the DB first and then filter with `dataset_query`; if it feels too big you can cap it with `datasourceMaxImportRows`.)

---

## 4. A few design trade-offs worth talking about

### 1. Handle-based: the physical table name is the plugin's private state

The `datasets` metadata table holds `table_name` (of the form `d_<scopeHash8>_<base40>_<ts36>`), and it only appears inside `store.ts` / `view.ts`. **The physical table name does not appear in tool descriptions, tool return values, HTTP responses, or error text** — the model has no opportunity to "guess a table name", and the frontend only gets the `datasetId`.

This also incidentally closes the SQL-injection surface: the raw SQL in `dataset_query` is **stripped of comments and string literals** before validation — a single `SELECT` / `WITH` / `EXPLAIN`, table references must be within a whitelist (using the reserved alias `ds` to refer to the dataset), DDL or write keywords are rejected outright, and overly long statements are rejected.

Datasets imported from a data source follow the same rule: only positioning info like `schema.table` is left in `source_id` / `source_ref` (desensitized, with no credentials), and `source_path` is written as `db:<data source name>`, so `dataset_list` and the settings page can search by data source name with zero changes.

### 2. Context economy: fragments for the model, the full set for the eyes

Under `viewMode=auto`, a result view is only created when the matched row count > 20 or the fragment bytes > 4KB. Once a view is created:

- The model only gets 5 preview rows + the whole-table aggregated `summary` (column stats, value distribution);
- `viewId` / `endpoint` are passed to the frontend via **`presentationMeta`** — **invisible to the model**;
- The frontend card (`src/client/index.ts` taking over `tool.call.toolview`) handles pagination, sorting, and CSV export;
- View metadata persists to `lh_views`, so **pagination still works after restart**; when paginating it queries the original table live, and the card keeps a "data may have changed" hint.

The HTTP interface **accepts no SQL whatsoever** (statements are held by the host-side `ViewRegistry`), and every request first passes through the Host/Origin fence of `connection.requestRejection()` and browser authentication.

### 3. Write operations fail-closed: triple protection

1. `tools/pre-execute` returns `ask` for the 6 write tools (`dataset_import` / `_insert` / `_update` / `_delete` / `_drop`, plus `datasource_import`), with the target handle included in the approval reason;
2. `ctx.tools.guard()` monotonic guard — write tools lacking `dataset` / `path` / `source` are all rejected, and subsequent listeners can't undo it;
3. `readOnly=true` directly results in `deny`.

**No approval channel = rejection**, rather than "just execute it then".

A deliberate trade-off: `requireApprovalForWrites` in the `Config` schema defaults to `true`, but the `cordis.patch.yml` shipped with the repo injects it as `false` — to make it "run through right after install", without the user getting stuck on a popup on first use. **The other two layers of protection are unaffected by this switch**; to go back to per-call confirmation, just change this line back to `true`.

### 4. Data source credentials: encrypted at rest, never echoed back

Passwords use AES-256-GCM (cipher format `iv:authTag:encrypted`, key derived via `scryptSync`), with key priority `datasourceEncryptKey` → `LH_DATA_ENCRYPT_KEY` → built-in default (using the default value triggers a startup warning "unsafe for production"). **Plaintext only exists in memory at the moment of establishing the connection**: tool descriptions, return values, HTTP responses, logs, and error text never contain the password — only "whether a password is set" is exposed.

### 5. Workspace isolation + optional dependency degradation

Datasets are scoped by session cwd (or `ws:<id>` when `perWorkspace=true`); imported files, after parsing, must land within the scope directory (no `../` traversal), with an extension whitelist of `.xlsx` / `.xls` / `.csv`. **When the session cwd can't be obtained it fails loudly**, never silently falling back to `process.cwd()`.

If any of `jobs` / `systemPrompt` / `webServer` / `connection` is missing, only the corresponding capability is degraded: under CLI / TUI profiles the result view automatically degrades to a plain-text fragment, the management interface isn't registered, and the rest of the plugin's capabilities are unaffected. The same applies to database drivers — `mysql2` / `pg` are dynamically `require`d, so when the package is missing only `datasource_*` errors out and gives an install command, while `dataset_*` is completely unaffected.

### 6. Not pinning to dsh's RC waves

`tooling.ts` (the tool-definition adapter) has **zero dsh runtime dependency**; the plugin context is a duck-typed minimal interface that only declares the members actually used. The only runtime dependencies are `@libsql/client` / `xlsx` / `papaparse` + cordis/schemastery (`mysql2` / `pg` are dynamically loaded and never enter the critical path). So however dsh's `0.1.0-rc.x` wave moves, this basically doesn't need to change alongside it — which should also be good news for embedders (scenarios that embed the dsh runtime into a host application).

### 7. Some "pitfalls" in type inference

Column names have the highest priority: `编码 / 编号 / 代码 / 账号 / 证件号 / 邮编 / 电话` (and `code` / `sku` / `ean` / `isbn` / `zip` / `phone` …) are all judged as `text`, to avoid "order numbers read as numbers losing leading zeros"; integers over 13 digits or scientific notation like `1.78E+12` are also forced to `text`, preventing precision loss. The rest are judged `numeric` / `boolean` / `date` / `text` by sampling proportion (default first 100 rows). Column names **keep their original names (including Chinese)**, wrapped in double quotes in SQL.

---

## 5. Settings page: tools are for the model, but the data ultimately belongs to the human

In the browser "Settings → Datasets" (partition id `lh-data`, order 100) there are two tabs:

| Tab | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Datasets | A cross-workspace aggregated list (searchable by name), create an empty table, rename / change description / change column notes, view data read-only with pagination, delete together with the physical table |
| Data sources | Register MySQL / PostgreSQL connections (when `test:true` it tests connectivity first and won't persist if unreachable), test connectivity, browse remote table structure and estimated row count, one-click import a table into a specified workspace |

The management interface is fixed at `/api/lh-data/admin` (not registered when `adminEnabled=false`); every request also first passes through the Host/Origin fence and browser authentication; error responses are desensitized and do not echo SQL, physical table names, or passwords. `scope` can only be returned by the caller from a "known workspace list" — **arbitrary paths are not accepted**.

> The column structure corresponds to the physical table DDL and **cannot be changed after creation** — this is also deliberate: rather let you rebuild a dataset than run `ALTER TABLE` on a table the agent might be reading.

---

## 6. How to verify

Instead of adopting a test framework, there are four self-contained scripts, each constructing a minimal fake ctx to run the full chain (requires `pnpm run build` first):

```bash
pnpm run import      # Unit validation + import → list → schema → query → write ops → gate → lifecycle
pnpm run view        # Large result set → fragment → frontend pagination → auth / persistence recovery / degradation
pnpm run admin       # Aggregated list / create empty table / rename & change description / delete / paginated data view
pnpm run datasource  # Encryption & decryption / column mapping / loading gate / data source CRUD / desensitization / auth / degradation
```

To run a real end-to-end import: replace `DEMO` at the top of `run-datasource.mjs` with your own database, then `node examples/run-datasource.mjs --live`.

---

## 7. Known boundaries / open questions

Listing honestly, and discussion or PRs are welcome:

- **Row-level writes, no conditional updates**: `_update` / `_delete` can only locate by `_row_id`, with no "conditional batch update" yet; if needed, I'd lean toward adding a structured `where` that also goes through approval, rather than opening up raw `UPDATE`.
- **Conservative scale limits**: `maxQueryRows` defaults to 200, `maxInsertRows` 500, `maxViewRows` 50000. This is deliberate — it's an "agent's workbench", not a data warehouse.
- **Data sources only cover MySQL / PostgreSQL**: SQLite, SQL Server, and Oracle aren't done yet; connections are cached and reused by `sourceId` (changing / deleting a data source closes the old connection first), pool upper limit defaults to 5, but there's no real stress test of idle reclamation and concurrency limits yet.
- **Default encryption key is insecure**: when `datasourceEncryptKey` / `LH_DATA_ENCRYPT_KEY` aren't configured, a built-in default key is used (with a startup warning). It guards against "password plaintext into logs / into context", not against local attackers — for production use please configure a key.
- **Remote import is a full snapshot**: `datasource_import` pulls the table in chunks (default 1000 rows/batch) and lands it in the DB, with no incremental sync; `datasourceMaxImportRows` can set a ceiling, default unlimited.
- **Data snapshot semantics**: view pagination queries the original table, so "the page you saw at the time" may have been changed. Should we add an optional snapshot to the view (materialized at import time)?
- **Cross-workspace shared datasets**: it's now strictly isolated by scope (though data source config is globally shared). Does anyone actually need "import once, reference across multiple workspaces"? If so, how should the handle layer express the reference relationship?
- **`dbUrl` pointing to remote Turso (`libsql://`)** has only basic validation; there's no real-world data on import performance under high latency yet.

Also, if your team is using cost/performance observability toolchains (such as the community's Langfuse telemetry backend, see #1007): the "preview + summary + view" of `dataset_query` is precisely designed to compress the token consumption of a single session — I'd love to know your measured context savings.

---

Feedback, issues, and PRs welcome!

- Repo: <https://github.com/linkedshine/dsh-lh-data>

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: every shell tool call opens a visible console window (Windows subprocess runner spawned without windowsHide)
discussions.body:
### Summary

On Windows, **every shell tool invocation opens a new visible console window**. With Windows Terminal set as the default terminal application, each call surfaces as a new Terminal window whose title is the runner process (`…\nodejs\node.exe`). Command output, stderr and exit codes are correct — the only defect is the visible window.

### Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** (`dsh-subprocess-local` 0.1.5-rc.1, `dsh-win32-process` 0.1.5-rc.1)
- Windows 11 (10.0.26100), Node.js v24.19.0, PowerShell 7.6.6
- Default terminal application: **Windows Terminal**
- The host is started **without a console** (e.g. an Electron desktop shell spawning `node <DSH_HOME>/.runtime/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js web --no-open --port 3080` with `detached: true`)
- Regression note: the previous release we ran (**0.1.1-rc.2**) has no `dsh-win32-process` and no Windows runner, and does **not** exhibit this.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Start the host detached (no console), e.g.

   ```js
   spawn(node, ['.runtime/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js', 'web', '--no-open', '--port', '3080'],
         { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' })
   ```

2. Run any command through the `pwsh` tool.
3. Observe one new visible console window per call.

### Expected

No visible window; stdout, stderr and exit code unchanged.

### Actual

One new visible console window per tool call (Windows Terminal window + `PseudoConsoleWindow` + `conhost.exe`). Measured with a window enumerator: **2 new console windows per call; 0 during a 30 s idle period**.

### Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js`, `launchWindowsJob()` (~L493-507):

```js
child = (internals.spawn ?? spawn)(command, [
    ...prefix,
    "--",
    ...spec.argv
], {
    cwd: process.cwd(),
    env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation),
    stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe")
});   // ← missing windowsHide: true
```

In the Windows `windows-job` containment mode the host first spawns a **Node runner process**, which then creates the target via `CreateProcessW` (`dsh-win32-process`). The runner is started with a plain `spawn` **without `windowsHide`**, so when the **host process has no console**, Windows allocates a **new visible console** for the runner.

The sibling fallback path `spawnSubprocess()` in the same file (~L1137-1147) already passes `windowsHide: platform === "win32"`, so only the runner spawn is affected.

It stays invisible whenever the host has a console (any console, including a hidden one), because the runner inherits it. It becomes user-visible as soon as the host is started without a console (detached / service / headless launcher).

### Suggested fix

```diff
         ], {
             cwd: process.cwd(),
             env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation),
-            stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe")
+            stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe"),
+            windowsHide: true
         });
```

`launchWindowsJob()` is Windows-only, so no platform guard is needed. This does **not** remove the console: the runner still gets a console (windowless) and the target inherits it, so console-dependent programs keep working.

### Evidence

| Parent console state | child `spawn` | New visible console windows |
|---|---|---|
| has console (inherited) | bare | 0 |
| hidden console (`CreateNoWindow`) | bare | 0 |
| **no console (`detached` / `DETACHED_PROCESS)** | **bare (= current runner spawn)** | **2** (Terminal window + `PseudoConsoleWindow`) |
| no console (`detached`) | `windowsHide: true` | **0** |

Live-host confirmation of the process chain: `node …/dsh/lib/bin.js web …` → `node …/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner.js -- pwsh …` → `pwsh.exe`; the flashing window's title is the **runner's** console (`…\nodejs\node.exe`).

### Please do not "fix" this in the restricted-token path

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process`'s restricted-token path (`spawnInheritedJobProcess`, creation flags `4`) must not naively receive `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`: `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` documents that under a restricted token `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` / `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` children die with `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`. The current-token path (flags `1028`) was also measured **not** to be the cause of this issue.

### Workaround until a release contains the fix

Start the host from a launcher that gives it a console — e.g. a `wscript` host that runs the command with `SW_HIDE` (window style 0) from the very start.

discussions.title: Accessibility: composer Access trigger lacks aria-expanded/aria-haspopup (with verified fix)
discussions.body:
## Problem

The composer's Access trigger opens the permission menu but rendered no `aria-expanded` and no `aria-haspopup`. Assistive technology announced a plain button: screen-reader users could not tell that it discloses a menu, nor hear its open state. Two pieces of evidence:

- **In-repo inconsistency.** The command launcher trigger in the same bar already reflects `aria-expanded` under a pinned spec ("passes the textarea selection to the command menu launcher and reflects its expanded state"), so two disclosure triggers in one composer row disagreed.
- **Live probe.** The shipped 0.1.5-rc.2 web build measured `expanded: null` on the trigger while the menu was open.

## Change

- `PermissionSelect.tsx`: the trigger sets `aria-haspopup="menu"` (its only popup is the permission menu) and binds `aria-expanded` to the menu's open state. Fixed tokens, not product copy — locale ownership is unaffected.
- `input-bar.client.spec.tsx`: new behavioral test mirroring the launcher's disclosure test — closed → `false`, open → `true`, selection → `false`.
- Agent Note pair (EN + 中文 + pairing record) recording the decision: every composer trigger that toggles a popup reflects disclosure semantics.

The permission apply flow, including the Full-access `RiskConfirmation` step, is unchanged. `Menu` is strictly owner-controlled (the list renders iff the same `open` state feeds `aria-expanded`), so attribute and menu visibility cannot diverge on any close path — selection, outside click, Escape, or the task-lock effect.

## Testing

- `pnpm vitest run packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx` — 95 passed, including the new `the Access trigger exposes menu disclosure semantics`.
- `pnpm run build:lib:host && pnpm run typecheck:contracts-ready` — pass.
- `verify-agent-note-format`, `verify-agent-note-classification`, `verify-translation-pairing` — pass.

No visual delta, so no GIF: the change is screen-reader semantics only (closed-state `aria-expanded="false"` renders no marker in the Playwright `ariaSnapshot` goldens — same as the launcher trigger already shipping `aria-haspopup="listbox"` bare in the hero golden).


## Proposed patch

The complete change (including an Agent Note pair following the repository's note conventions and a bilingual pairing record) is on a single clean commit on my fork:

**`https://github.com/almazom/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/access-trigger-disclosure-semantics`** (commit `44e57ef7f`)

Since external pull requests are not accepted at the moment, here is the source diff for review; happy to open a PR the moment the policy changes:

```diff
diff --git a/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/PermissionSelect.tsx b/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/PermissionSelect.tsx
index 0a63c4cca..4c6e0ebe8 100644
--- a/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/PermissionSelect.tsx
+++ b/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/PermissionSelect.tsx
@@ -161,6 +161,8 @@ export function PermissionSelect({ value, locked, command, t }: PermissionSelect
             type="button"
             className={css.trigger}
             aria-label={t('input.accessMode', { name: currentLabel })}
+            aria-haspopup="menu"
+            aria-expanded={open}
             title={current?.description}
             disabled={locked || busy}
             onClick={() => { setOpen(!open) }}
diff --git a/packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx b/packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx
index 13266b1ca..a7206327f 100644
--- a/packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx
+++ b/packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx
@@ -1740,6 +1740,21 @@ describe('command launcher chrome and control seats', () => {
     expect(command).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
   })
 
+  it('the Access trigger exposes menu disclosure semantics', () => {
+    const permissions = {
+      options: [{ value: 'read-only', name: 'read-only' }],
+      currentValue: 'read-only',
+    }
+    const { view } = bench({ permissions })
+    const trigger = view.getByLabelText(/^访问模式/) as HTMLButtonElement
+    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-haspopup')).toBe('menu')
+    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
+    fireEvent.click(trigger)
+    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true')
+    fireEvent.click(view.getByRole('menuitem', { name: '仅可查看' }))
+    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
+  })
+
   it('a registered entry fills its seat and receives the locked owner prop', () => {
     const { view, slotCalls } = bench({
       disabled: true,

```

## Verification

- `pnpm vitest run packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx` — 95 passed, including the new `the Access trigger exposes menu disclosure semantics`
- `pnpm run build:lib:host && pnpm run typecheck:contracts-ready` — pass
- `verify-agent-note-format`, `verify-agent-note-classification`, `verify-translation-pairing` — pass

Found while polishing a custom composer UI: a Playwright probe of the shipped 0.1.5-rc.2 web build measured `expanded: null` on this trigger while the menu was open. Cross-checked against master source before reporting — both attributes are absent at `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/PermissionSelect.tsx:160-166`.

discussions.title: DSH master (0.1.6-alpha.2 / ddefc45fbc) 仍未修复的问题清单（社区核实版）
discussions.body:
核实人：社区成员 PerryLink。初版基准提交：`c291e7961a515f6d7af9304e7fd1d257929aef26`（2026-09-10 快照，0.1.5-rc.2 era）。**2026-09-15 已对照最新 master `0d1f50007f9bca3f52b06e1c3074fa14d5fb0720`（0.1.6-alpha.1 世代，区间 666 提交 / 3123 改动文件）整体复核**：1 项已修复（次级 #6129，`e779831f40`）、1 项转为部分修复待复测（#2）、22 项仅行号/路径漂移、其余结论不变——下方行号已按复核结果更新。方法：逐条对照该提交的源码（read/grep）复核，下方每个「位置」都在该快照上成立；无法在源码里复核的两处已如实标注。**2026-09-19 再对照 `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`（`dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`，较上一基线再 +882 提交）复核**：#27 已修复、#1 的「同级模式」半边已修复（更窄/不受支持仍抛错，条目改写），另有多条位置漂移（见各条），其余结论不变。本清单是对 73 个社区讨论的收敛：凡涉及的问题都已链接到原帖，便于维护者直接看到完整分析、复现与既有补丁。

**1. 同级/更窄的 `sandbox_permissions` 直接报错（模型整轮循环失败）**
- 症状：workspace-write / danger-full-access 会话里模型反射式带上 `sandbox_permissions`（同级或更窄）时，工具调用直接报错，GPT 系模型会整轮循环。
- 位置：`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts:160`（“not strictly wider” 抛错，更窄/不受支持的目标仍过不去；**同级模式已在 `:155` 短路返回**）；schema 恒广告全枚举 `:41`。danger-full-access 变体：`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:234` 强制 policy=never，而 `packages/fs/fs-sandbox/src/index.ts:65-67` 仍返回默认模式导致 `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/sandbox.ts:39-45,59-70` 继续广告升级字段。
- 现状：**部分修复**（`dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`）。`61c548e200`（fix(sandbox): accept repeated effective permission modes，PR #4326）让同级模式直接返回：`escalation.ts:155` 是 `if (mode === effectiveMode) return effectiveMode`，抛错移到 `:160`；spec 改为断言同模式成功（`tests/escalation.spec.ts:84`：`it.each(ESCALATION_TARGETS)('repeating %s succeeds without asking for approval' …)`）。**更窄/不受支持的目标仍然抛错**，故本条保留并改写为：剩「schema 恒广告全枚举、而更窄组合必失败」的不一致。
- 临时规避：persona 加一行“当前已是该模式时不要携带 sandbox_permissions”；read-only 默认下升级走审批可正常终止。
- 相关讨论：#4021 #4481 #4672 #4742 #4763 #4976 #4990 #5570（同族 #5238 #5298 #6215）

**2. 纯推理轮毒死整会话（之后每轮 400）**
- 症状：某轮模型只输出 reasoning 时，该条消息以空 content 落盘；此后该会话每轮重放都被网关 400，整会话报废。
- 位置（已迁移）：`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/chat-completions/serialize.ts:196-229`——**chat-completions 协议**下推理轮仍序列化为 `content:""`（无 tool_calls），风险注释 `:212-219` 原样保留；旧路径 `src/serialize.ts` 已随 `6a137ea702`（2026-09-10 协议统一重构）删除。
- 现状：**部分修复 / 待复测**。master 已把 DeepSeek 默认协议切到 Messages（`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/config.ts:81,207`，`b0641b83fc`），Messages 侧把推理块序列化为 `thinking`（`src/protocols/messages/serialize.ts:29-32`），不再产出空 content；因此**默认路由上的 400 砖化未在源码内复现**，需真机对 `messages`（默认）与 `chat-completions`（显式配置）两条路由各复测一次才能定论。若 profile 显式配置了 `protocol: chat-completions`，下述规避手段仍然适用。
- 临时规避：备份后解压 session.v3.jsonl.zstd，把 reasoning-only 的 assistant 记录 content 改为占位（或删除该条），重压回。
- 相关讨论：#5466（同族 #1850 #6218 #6431）

**3. Windows windows-acl 沙箱：缓存临时目录消失后该会话永久损坏**
- 症状：按 (sessionId, workspaceRoot) 缓存的私有临时目录被删后，ACL runner 首次预检永远失败，误导性的 SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE 文案诱导用户反复批准升级。
- 位置：`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts:415-417`（`tempCapabilities` 缓存命中直接 `return existing`，无 existsSync/statSync 复核）；预检失败点 `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/runner.ts:110-113`（由 `:120-121` 对 `--workspace`/`--temp` 各调一次）。
- 现状：master 未修复；#6483 的 re-validate-before-return 修复方向正确。
- 临时规避：重启 dsh host 进程重建临时目录/SID；勿在已中毒会话里反复批准 danger-full-access。
- 相关讨论：#6483（同族 #5034：会话失去工作区绑定后 pwsh ENOENT）

**4. read_image 在所有预设中一调即失败**
- 症状：`cannot get property 'fs' without inject`；注册时传错 scope，兄弟工具正常。
- 位置：`packages/fs/tool-fs/src/index.ts:70-71`（`ctx.inject(['attachments'], imageCtx => applyReadImageTool(imageCtx))`，imageCtx 只声明 attachments）；执行体解引用 `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/read-image.ts:209`（`:265` 同类）。
- 现状：master 未修复；一行修复（传外层 ctx）形状不变。
- 临时规避：无产品内规避；走外部视觉路径读图。
- 相关讨论：#4612

**5. 升级后 `code` 预设会话全部无法恢复（无 legacy 别名）**
- 症状：0.1.2 起内置预设 code→ptc 更名，但会话记录里的 preset 值未迁移，旧会话 resume 报 `preset "code" not found (available: standard, ptc, minimal, cordis)`。
- 位置：`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts:372-381`（resolve 逐字查找，无 legacy 映射；仓库中不存在 LEGACY_PRESET_IDS）；删除自定义预设的会话错误仍被包成 `gateway/internal`（`packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts:216`）。
- 现状：master 未修复。
- 临时规避：复制内置 ptc 预设目录到 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/code/`（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.agent-presets\code\`）后重启；或改绑 standard/ptc；settings.yaml 里 `agent-presets.default: code` 一并改掉。
- 相关讨论：#5657 #5381 #5781 #4167 #5585

**6. exFAT 卷 write 必败（EISDIR）+ 盘根写入 EPERM**
- 症状：exFAT 上新建文件必报 `EISDIR ... link`（覆盖/编辑正常）；任何卷的盘根写入报 EPERM。
- 位置：`packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts:633-638`（createIfAbsent 用硬链接发布，默认 `link` 在 `:608`，失败即 `throwGuardedCreateFailure`，`:536-571` 无 rename 降级；exFAT 不支持硬链接）；`:597-598`（mkdir recursive 只容忍 EEXIST，Windows 盘根返回 EPERM）。
- 现状：master 未修复；#4981 的“link 失败 → open('wx') 占名 → rename”补丁方向正确（社区已附测试建议）。
- 临时规避：write 目标放 NTFS；勿直写盘根（先写子目录）。
- 相关讨论：#5704 #4981（相关 #2402）

**7. Node < 22.19/24.2 安装后静默深埋失败**
- 症状：Node 版本低于引擎下限时 npx 安装“成功”，随后无任何友好提示地在深处失败（npx 静默退出、Iterator/undefined 类报错）。
- 位置：`apps/cli/src/bin.ts`（入口共 66 行，无任何运行时版本检查）；`apps/cli/package.json`（无 engines）；仅根 `package.json:8-9` 声明 `"node": "^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0"`——npm 对 engines 只警告不拦截。
- 现状：master 未修复；实测下限约为 24.2（24.0/24.1 有 undefined 报错）。
- 临时规避：升级 Node ≥ 24.2（或 22.19+）；全局安装替代 npx 启动。
- 相关讨论：#6115 #6124 #6126 #6584 #6605

**8. 单个损坏插件条目令所有对话请求失败（REQUEST_EXTENSION）**
- 症状：某个 loader 条目损坏（残留空 scope 目录/市场状态）后，每个 chat/title 请求都报 `DeepSeek request extension preparation failed`（REQUEST_EXTENSION）。
- 位置（已迁移）：`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/common/request-extensions.ts:20-24`（`prepare()` 任何异常一律升级为 `LlmError(..., 'REQUEST_EXTENSION')`，cause 不进入 UI 文案）——原 `src/adapter.ts:627-637` 已随 `6a137ea702` 的协议拆分消失；`packages/llm/plugin-package-inventory-deepseek/src/index.ts:123`（`resolve()` 对不可解析包抛错）；该插件在基础 bundle 默认挂载（`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:70-71`）。
- 现状：master 未修复；统计型扩展应降级为警告并跳过损坏条目，而非中断请求。
- 临时规避：profile patch 禁用 `plugin-package-inventory-deepseek`；治本是修复损坏的 loader 条目。
- 相关讨论：#6161（相关 #5683 #5968 #6108）

**9. PTC 模式零参数工具绑定必失败**
- 症状：零参数工具绑定调用时被拒，报“binding arguments must be lossless JSON”。
- 位置（包已改名）：`packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/src/bootstrap.ts:326-335`（无参调用 args=undefined → `snapshotPtcJsonValue` 返回 undefined → `:333-334` 拒绝 `binding arguments must be lossless JSON`）；wire 侧 `packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/src/json-wire.ts`（原 `worker-json.ts`）。旧包 `packages/code-runtime/code-runtime-worker-thread` 已随 `7c9bb5914c`（2026-09-12，PTC 命名统一）删除。合同歧义：参数快照校验未区分“无参”与“非法参数”。
- 现状：master 未修复；帖内一行修复已由社区验证。
