discussions.title: ACP: surface in-process subagent activity to clients (extension notification)
discussions.body:
Running `dsh --profile acp` as a stdio ACP server behind an ACP client, in-process delegation works but is invisible to the client: `subagent` / `subagent_fork` run, and the client sees only one long generic tool call on the root session, for as long as the children run. The DSH web/TUI shows the whole child tree, so the gap is specific to the ACP surface.

### Where it comes from

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp` is deliberately standard-only and maps only the bridge-owned root session. Descendant sessions' committed events already reach the global `session/event` firehose — `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` persists every session through the same listener — but `ownsSession()` in `packages/acp/acp/src/index.ts` drops every descendant, and `src/updates.ts` only projects message / thought / tool / usage.
- Secondary effect: the `tool_call` projection carries `title: event.data.name` only, so the model's `description` label on a delegation never reaches the client either.

### Proposal

Keep the standard ACP v1 surface exactly as it is and add one extension notification for descendants of a bridge-owned root:

```
method: `_dsh/sdk/subagent/update`
params: { sessionId, provider, events: [ {type:"upsert"|"timeline"|"remove", …} ] }
```

- Descendants are resolved by walking `header.parentSession` to a bridge-owned root, so no dependency on the subagent service is needed.
- `upsert` carries title / description / cwd / status; `timeline` carries a read-only item; status is derived from the child's `turn/start` / `turn/end`.
- One notification carries an ordered batch per root session, delivered on the same tail as the root's `session/update`.
- A client that does not know the method ignores the whole notification, so every existing ACP client is unaffected.

### Reference implementation (verified locally, not upstreamed)

Fork branch `apple-ouyang/deepseek-harness@feat/acp-provider-subagents` (`fa5c50435`, based on `feat/acp-session-load-replay`) — new `packages/acp/acp/src/subagents.ts`, plus `src/session.ts` (`onDescendantEvent`) and `src/index.ts` (`extNotify`, `descendantRecord`).

Verified end to end against a minimal ACP client: one prompt that delegates produced 5 ordered batches — descriptor (running + cwd), a title derived from the child's first user message plus its `user_message` timeline, the child's `assistant_message`, and `completed` — while the root's standard `session/update` traffic stayed intact.

On the client side, Paseo has the matching consumption seam proposed in getpaseo/paseo#4849 (with #3145 closed asking for a discussion first). I run both locally.

### Questions

1. Is an extension notification the shape you want, or would you rather see descendants exposed through additional ACP sessions or some standard-surface mechanism?
2. Should the bridged timeline vocabulary be ACP-shaped (the client maps it) or the consumer's own timeline vocabulary (the server maps it)? The local patch chose the latter to keep the consumer-side patch minimal — happy to flip it if you prefer keeping DSH vendor-neutral.
3. Is there an upstream-preferred method namespace for this kind of extension?
4. Happy to rework this into a PR-shaped change with tests and docs if the direction is acceptable.

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows Job 主路径 launchWindowsJob 仍缺 windowsHide：0.1.5-rc.2 下每次命令仍弹出控制台窗口
discussions.body:
## 与既有讨论的关系

发帖前已检索，本仓库有多条同类报告：[#3460](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3460)（汇总帖）、[#1102](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1102)、[#1344](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1344)、[#810](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/810)，以及社区幂等补丁 [#1564](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1564)。先说明本文的增量，避免重复：

| 创建点 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| `subprocess-local` 降级路径 `spawn.ts` 的 `spawn()` | 已在 #3460 由 argszero 定位并落地修复 |
| `sandbox-windows-acl` 两处 `CreateProcessAsUserW` | 方案明确（`STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW \| SW_HIDE`），见 #1344 与 #3460 |
| `taskkill` teardown | 已知，待一并处理 |
| **`windows-job.ts::launchWindowsJob()` 中 spawn runner 的调用** | **本文补充：截至 `0.1.5-rc.2` 仍未覆盖** |

第四点不在 `spawn.ts` 上，且与降级路径**互斥**——Windows 上 `probeWindowsJob()` 通过时执行的是它，所以 `spawn.ts` 的修复对这一条无效。

## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` 的 Windows Job 主路径 `launchWindowsJob()` 在 spawn runner 时没有设置 `windowsHide`。当 DSH 宿主进程自身没有控制台时（GUI 启动器、服务、pm2 等），Windows 会为每个 runner 新分配一个可见控制台窗口，因此**每一次普通命令执行都会弹出一个黑色命令窗口**；`run_in_background` 的任务更严重——窗口在整个任务生命周期内持续存在，而不是闪一下。

截至 2026-09-14，该缺陷在**仓库 master 与 npm 最新发布版 `0.1.5-rc.2` 中均存在**。

## Reproduction

1. 让 DSH 运行在没有控制台的宿主下。本机为 GUI 启动器：

   ```text
   explorer.exe
   └─ DSH Control Panel.exe
      └─ node.exe  "<npm-global>/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" web
   ```

   验证宿主确实无控制台：枚举 `conhost.exe` / `OpenConsole.exe`，没有任何控制台宿主进程挂在 DSH 宿主或其 runner 之下。

2. 在 Web UI 中触发任意一次 shell 工具调用（前台或后台均可）。

3. 观察桌面：每次调用都会出现一个标题为 `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe` 的控制台窗口。

窗口计数采样（每 350ms 枚举一次可见的顶层控制台窗口，期间穿插两次极简命令调用）：

| 时间 | 可见控制台窗口数 | 事件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 21:38:59.8 | 1 | 空闲（采样器自身的后台 runner） |
| 21:39:00.6 ~ 00.9 | **2** | 一次前台命令调用（21:39:00.947 返回） |
| 21:39:01 ~ 06.1 | 1 | 空闲 |
| 21:39:06.5 ~ 06.9 | **2** | 另一次前台命令调用（21:39:06.732 返回） |

基线 1 来自采样器自己的后台 runner——它常驻不退出，正好也印证了「后台任务窗口不消失」这一点。每次前台调用精确 +1、结束随即回落，因果明确。

窗口标题恰好是 runner 的 node 进程被分配新控制台时的默认标题，实测进程链：

```text
node.exe  ".../@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" web               (无控制台)
└─ node.exe  ".../dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner.js"         ← 持有可见控制台窗口
   └─ powershell.exe                                          (ConPTY 伪控制台，不可见)
```

## Current behavior

`packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/windows-job.ts`（master blob `56dac9951988354a09c843473a8aa47260033f1c`）：

```ts
child = (internals.spawn ?? spawn)(command, [
  ...prefix,
  '--',
  ...spec.argv,
], {
  cwd: process.cwd(),
  env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation),
  stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? 'pipe'),
}) as RunnerProcess
```

这里没有 `windowsHide`。Node 的 `windowsHide` 默认为 `false`，即创建进程时不带 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`；当父进程没有控制台时，Windows 会为新进程分配一个新控制台，于是产生可见窗口。

对照 `spawn.ts`（降级路径）则设置了 `windowsHide`，所以该路径不弹窗。两者互斥：

```ts
handle = bindManagedProcess(
  spec,
  containmentMode === "linux-scope" ? launchLinuxScope(spec, env) : launchWindowsJob(spec, env),
  binding,
)
```

在整个 `packages/subprocess/subprocess-local` 内检索 `windowsHide`，只命中 4 个文件：`src/spawn.ts`、`src/windows-inspector.ts`、`tests/windows-inspector.spec.ts`、`tests/spawn.spec.ts`——**`src/windows-job.ts` 不在其中**。

## 上游状态确认：官方最新发布包同样存在该缺陷（截至 2026-09-14）

为避免被当作"旧版本残留、升级即可解决"，这里给出三点互相独立的核对结果：

| 检查对象 | 版本 / 标识 | `launchWindowsJob` 的 spawn 是否带 `windowsHide` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 仓库 master 源码 | `packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/windows-job.ts`，blob SHA `56dac9951988354a09c843473a8aa47260033f1c` | 否 |
| 仓库 master HEAD | `c291e796`（2026-09-10） | 提交历史中无相关修复 |
| npm 官方最新发布包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.5-rc.2`（`next` dist-tag） | 否 |

其中 npm 一项是**直接拉取官方 tarball 解包核对**的，而不是只读仓库源码：

```console
$ npm pack @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.5-rc.2
deepseek-ai-dsh-subprocess-local-0.1.5-rc.2.tgz

$ grep -n windowsHide package/lib/runner-launch-*.js
140:    windowsHide: true
851:    windowsHide: true
1146:   windowsHide: platform === "win32"
```

即：三处应设 `windowsHide` 的位置（两处 `taskkill` + 降级 spawn）在**发布产物中都已正确设置**，唯独 `launchWindowsJob` 缺失——源码与产物表现完全一致，不存在"源码漏改但产物已修"的情况。

> 附注：该包的 dist-tag 为 `{ "alpha": "0.1.5-alpha.2", "latest": "0.0.1-rc.1", "next": "0.1.5-rc.2" }`。`latest` 仍指向 `0.0.1-rc.1`，因此不带标签的 `npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` 会装到非常旧的版本；判断"是否仍受影响"应以 `next` 或按 `^0.1.5-rc.1` 解析得到的 `0.1.5-rc.2` 为准。

## 与 2026-09-03 既定决策不一致

`.agents/notes/archived/bug-fix/2026-09-03-hidden-windows-subprocess-windows.md`（`Status: implemented`，`Archived: 2026-09-04`）记录的目标策略是：

> The provider sets `windowsHide: true` on **every non-terminal `spawn`** and on both synchronous `taskkill` call sites.

但 Job 主路径这一处没有落地。该笔记同时提到测试固定了 "the main child and both `taskkill` paths" —— runner spawn 未被覆盖，可能正是漏网的原因。

## 关于 0xC0000142 边界

按 argszero 在 #3460 的说明，受限令牌下 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 导致 `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142)` 的约束属于**沙箱原生路径**（`sandbox-windows-acl` 的 `CreateProcessAsUserW`），与 `subprocess-local` 无关。因此这里补 `windowsHide: true` 不涉及该边界。

## Expected behavior

Windows Job 主路径的 runner spawn 同样设置 `windowsHide: true`，使普通（非终端）命令在无控制台宿主下不产生任何可见窗口，与上述已归档决策保持一致。terminal 进程的可见性继续由 PTY 实现负责。

建议改法：

```ts
    ], {
      cwd: process.cwd(),
      env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation),
      stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? 'pipe'),
      windowsHide: true,
    }) as RunnerProcess
```

`launchWindowsJob` 本身只在 win32 上被调用，因此无需再加平台判断。

另外建议补充测试：现有用例固定了主 child 与两处 `taskkill` 路径的 `windowsHide`，但 Windows Job 路径的 runner spawn 尚未被覆盖。可照 `native-path-opener.spec.ts:157` 的 mock 模式（mock `node:child_process` 的 `spawn` 并断言选项含 `windowsHide: true`）。

本修复与 #3460 的两层方案互补：这一层盖非沙箱链的 Job 主路径；沙箱链仍需 `STARTUPINFOW` 的 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW | SW_HIDE`。

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1（全局 npm 安装于 `AppData\Roaming\npm`），其依赖解析到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` **0.1.5-rc.2**
- npm 上最新的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` 正是 0.1.5-rc.2（`next` dist-tag）
- 仓库 master HEAD `c291e796`（2026-09-10）上该文件仍缺少该选项（blob SHA `56dac995` 未变）
- Node.js v24.18.0
- Windows 11（默认终端为 Windows Terminal）
- 宿主启动方式：GUI 启动器（无控制台）

注意：**从终端启动 `dsh web` 时无法复现**，因为子进程会继承终端已有的控制台，不会新建窗口。这大概也是它容易被漏掉的原因。

**本地验证（构建产物）**：给该 spawn 补上 `windowsHide: true` 并重启 DSH 后，用同一套窗口采样器复测——43 个样本（含两次前台命令调用与一个后台任务）中，标题含 `node.exe` 的可见控制台窗口数**恒为 0**：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 空闲基线（采样器自身后台 runner 存活） | 1 | **0** |
| 前台调用进行中 | 2 | **0** |
| 后台任务运行期间 | 常驻不消失 | **0** |
| 样本数 / nodeWin 最大值 | 23 / 2 | 43 / **0** |

同时统计了更宽的「全部可见控制台类窗口」计数，全程稳定在 2（宿主本就存在的窗口），即期间**没有任何新增控制台窗口**。`node --check` 与模块 `import` 亦正常。

> 说明：该验证在 `danger-full-access` 策略下进行，确认 Job 主路径是此配置下的唯一窗口来源；沙箱链是否触发取决于具体策略，不在本次验证范围内。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 4.0 预览：把插件生态、移动端和完整开发工作台装进 Windows
discussions.body:
我已经搜索并阅读了现有的相关讨论。社区里已有一些优秀的 Windows 桌面壳和早期项目介绍，这篇主要分享 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 4.0** 在插件架构、安全边界和完整工作流上的新进展。

## 让 Harness 成为真正开箱即用的 Windows AI 工作台

**DeepSeek Harness Desktop** 是一个由社区维护的开源 Windows 客户端。

它不是简单地给网页套一层 Electron，而是把官方 Harness Web 体验、本地 DSH Runtime、Skills、插件生态、任务自动化、Git、远程开发、移动端控制和桌面原生能力整合进同一个应用。

下载安装 EXE 即可启动完整工作环境，不需要用户另外安装或配置 Node.js、Git、pnpm 和 DSH。

- 项目仓库：https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop
- 产品网站：https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/
- 稳定版下载：https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest

## 4.0 真正升级了什么

### 一、插件操作不再是“装上去试试看”，而是一套可验证、可回滚的发布流程

插件安装、更新、卸载、批量安装和 Preset 导入都会经过：

**隔离暂存 → 兼容性准入 → 依赖图验证 → 原子激活 → Runtime 健康检查 → 提交或回滚**

目标很明确：一个有问题的社区插件，只能影响它自己，不能拖垮整个工作台。

对于旧版 Desktop Profile，4.0 会在本地完成完整性审计。能够证明安全的依赖漂移会自动修复；无法确认的异常会进入专门的修复流程，同时保留用户会话、配置和个人数据。

4.0 RC 还恢复了第三方插件迁移能力：精确 NPM 版本可以通过 staging 事务安全恢复；Git 来源会继续固定旧 commit，并在激活前要求用户明确确认。

### 二、手机可以访问，但不会把整个 Runtime 暴露到局域网

4.0 新增了由 Desktop 独立管理的本地 LAN Gateway，官方 Runtime 仍然留在经过认证的操作系统管道后面。

这套入口：

- 默认关闭，必须由用户主动启用
- 只绑定用户选择的一个私网 IPv4 和高位端口
- 永远不监听 `0.0.0.0`
- 使用短期、一次性配对凭据
- 只开放移动页面、配对、心跳和受限的 `/m/api`
- 拒绝完整 Runtime API、本机管理接口、Desktop IPC、文件系统和伪造 Origin

这不是把 Harness 后端直接扔到局域网上，而是为移动端建立一条窄小、明确、可关闭的安全通道。

### 三、它已经是一套插件化工作台，而不只是启动器

当前经过验证的 Desktop 基线保留了 **19 个社区插件、11 个内置集成、29 个桌面功能面和 15 套皮肤**。

目前主要能力包括：

- **性价比模式 Value Mode**：专家模型负责分析、拆解、调度和验收，工作模型执行有边界的子任务
- **模型用量看板**：Token、上下文、缓存、延迟、费用、生成速度和峰值速度实时可见
- **Claude Code / Codex 项目导入**：只读发现、导入预览、敏感信息脱敏、历史工具调用不可执行
- **任务看板与自动化**：计划、执行、定时任务、运行记录和 Evidence 证据链
- **完整 Git 与文件工作区**：文件浏览编辑、Diff、SCM、Git Graph 和多种文件预览
- **远程开发**：SSH、SFTP、Web Terminal、端口转发和多主机工作流
- **插件与个性化能力**：模型偏好、个人 Prompt、本地长期记忆、图片理解
- **桌面体验**：主题、粒子背景、桌宠、通知、托盘、独立窗口和窗口状态恢复

### 四、兼容优先，不修改 DSH 官方源码

项目不会修改 DeepSeek Harness 官方源码树。

所有扩展都基于公开的官方 `@deepseek-ai/*` NPM SDK 开发，并通过 Cordis Patch 和 Desktop Profile 机制挂载。

我们的原则是：

> 先完整保留官方 Harness 行为、用户数据和插件契约，再在外围增加真正属于桌面端的能力。

## 当前发布状态

**4.0 目前仍处于 Release Candidate 和最终打磨阶段，公开稳定版仍然是 3.5.0。**

已经完成验收的 4.0 RC Windows 安装包通过了 32 套打包态回归，其中包含 162 项核心检查，覆盖插件隔离与恢复、历史版本升级、移动网关允许与拒绝路径、桌面窗口、SSH/终端、Skills、主题和退出清理等场景。

当前公开安装包尚未进行代码签名，因此 Windows SmartScreen 可能显示安全提醒。项目支持 Windows 10/11 x64，采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可证，并明确属于非官方社区项目。

## 特别希望听到插件作者的意见

- 哪些 Desktop 能力应该继续下沉为更小、更通用的 SDK 接口？
- 插件安装或升级中，哪类故障目前最难恢复？
- 在不扩大安全边界的前提下，移动端下一步最应该增加什么？
- 哪些优秀社区插件应该加入下一轮兼容性验证矩阵？

如果你正在开发 DSH 插件，欢迎试用、审查我们的集成边界，并提交 Issue 或 Pull Request。

Star 是支持，真实的兼容性反馈更有价值。我们希望做的不是另一个“能启动的壳”，而是一个经得住升级、故障和长期使用的 Harness 桌面生态。

---

## English summary

**DeepSeek Harness Desktop 4.0** is a community-maintained Windows workspace built around the official Harness Web experience and public `@deepseek-ai/*` npm SDKs. It adds transactional plugin operations, an opt-in and narrowly scoped LAN mobile gateway, task automation, Git, SSH, usage analytics, project import, themes, and native desktop integrations without modifying the official DSH source tree.

Version 4.0 is still in release-candidate and final-polish work; the latest public stable release remains 3.5.0. Feedback from plugin authors is especially welcome.

discussions.title: [Bug] revealNativePath: explorer.exe /select, fails on Windows — path passed as a separate argv entry and as a percent-encoded file URL
[Bug] 仅修改 Skill 正文后，已有会话可能继续沿用旧指令
discussions.body:
## 问题概述

本地 Skill 已加载后，如果只修改 `SKILL.md` 的正文，正在进行的会话可能继续使用旧指令。文件系统加载器能够读取新正文，但普通的后续请求不一定触发重新加载，也不一定让模型知道此前加载的正文已经过期。

该现象已通过 DSH Web UI 和真实模型复现。**并非每次必现**：模型有时会主动读取文件，获取最新指令。这里关注的是：对于已经加载过的 Skill 正文，缺少可靠的更新提示。

## 运行环境

- DSH：`0.1.5-rc.2`，源码提交 `c291e7961a515f6d7af9304e7fd1d257929aef26`
- macOS，Node.js `v22.22.2`
- 构建命令：`pnpm run build`
- 启动命令：`node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web --port 3080`
- Web UI，标准模式，DeepSeek-V4-Flash / High
- 项目级 Skill：`.agents/skills/harbor-greeting/SKILL.md`
- 实测日期：2026-09-14

## 复现步骤

1. 在选中的工作区创建以下 Skill：

   ```markdown
   ---
   name: harbor-greeting
   description: 用户要求海港问候时，按正文给出问候语。
   ---

   用户要求海港问候时，只回复：白帆迎晨光。
   ```

2. 新建会话，发送 `请给我一句海港问候。`。
3. 确认模型调用 `skill` 工具加载 `harbor-greeting`，并回复 `白帆迎晨光。`。
4. 在 DSH 外部**只修改正文**，保持名称和描述不变：

   ```text
   用户要求海港问候时，只回复：海风送星河。
   ```

5. 不重启、不 fork、不切换会话，发送 `请再给我一句海港问候。`。
6. 作为对照，在同一会话发送 `请重新调用 skill 工具加载 harbor-greeting，然后给我一句海港问候。`。

## 实测结果

| 轮次 | Web UI 中的工具调用记录 | 回复 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 首次请求 | 调用一次 `skill`，加载 `harbor-greeting` | `白帆迎晨光。` |
| 修改正文后的普通请求 | 没有工具调用 | **`白帆迎晨光。`，仍是旧正文** |
| 明确要求重新加载 | 调用一次 `skill`，加载 `harbor-greeting` | **`海风送星河。`，获取到新正文** |

这些轮次之间没有发生上下文压缩。在普通后续请求完成前，已检查磁盘文件，确认正文修改成功。仅修改正文后，没有看到新的替换目录消息。

此前一组测试使用了明显的缓存探针名称及 OLD/NEW 标记，模型主动读取文件并返回了新值。上述复现则使用中性 Skill 名称，并在没有那组探针历史的新会话中进行。因此，这证明的是旧指令复用可能发生，并不意味着每个模型或每次运行都会如此。

## 源码观察

- [`digestCatalogEntries`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/c291e7961a515f6d7af9304e7fd1d257929aef26/packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts#L328) 对目录条目的名称和描述计算哈希；已加载正文的内容或版本不在该摘要中。
- 同一插件在 `agent/pre-step` 中比较该摘要，决定是否发布替换目录。
- [`FileSystemSkillProvider.get`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/c291e7961a515f6d7af9304e7fd1d257929aef26/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/src/index.ts#L210) 每次被调用时都会重新解析文件，与明确要求重新加载后成功获取新正文的结果一致。

因此，注册表／目录缓存失效，与更新模型会话中已经加载的正文，是两件事。即使查询能够返回最新内容，只要模型不再次加载，历史 Skill 指令仍可能继续被使用。本次实测没有对 watcher 的失效事件进行插桩，不能据此判断这些事件是否触发或具体何时触发。

## 预期行为与设计问题

如果 Skill 的运行时更新预期在已有会话中生效，那么已加载正文发生变化时，应向模型提供可采取行动的更新提示，或在再次使用前可靠地重新加载指令。用户不应必须重开会话或手动要求重新加载，才能让模型发现指令发生了变化。

一种可能的方案是记录已加载 Skill 的版本，在版本变化时追加针对该 Skill 的失效／重新加载通知。这样可以保留已有会话前缀，而不必改写历史消息。仅依赖目录元数据摘要，无法识别正文单独变化。

如果设计上就是将已加载正文作为会话生命周期内的快照，也希望在文档或界面中明确这一约定，以及受支持的刷新方式。

## 相关讨论

- [#5374](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5374) / [#5608](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5608)：Host 目录变化后，Web 斜杠菜单不刷新。本帖关注已经进入模型上下文的指令，涉及的问题不同。
- [#1650](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1650)：查询时将已存在的 Skill 报告为不可用。本次测试中，明确加载可以成功获取当前正文。
- [#5766](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5766)：压缩后不恢复已加载的 Skill 正文。本次复现没有发生压缩。

discussions.title: DSH Web UI is unusable in headless/containerized workflows without manual hacks — please make remote access a first-class feature
discussions.body:
Hi DSH team,

First of all, thanks for building DSH. The "everything is a plugin" architecture is promising and I've been testing it seriously for my workflow.

I want to report a concrete usability blocker that I believe affects a very common category of users: developers working on headless servers, in containers, or in datacenters.
### **The scenario**
I develop Python code for QLoRA fine-tuning on a headless Linux server (Devuan). I run DSH inside a Docker container on that server, and I access the machine over a VPN. The server has no desktop environment.

This is not an edge case. It's the standard setup for anyone doing model training, MLOps, backend development, or data science on remote machines. In fact, the DSH README itself describes an SSH launch scenario, which suggests the team is aware of remote use cases .

### **The problem**
DSH's Web UI binds exclusively to 127.0.0.1:3080 and, by design, rejects requests that do not originate from loopback or carry a non-loopback Host header. When I try to access DSH from another machine on the same VPN (or even from the host itself using its LAN IP), the connection is established at TCP level but DSH immediately closes it.

I understand and appreciate the security rationale: DSH executes arbitrary code, so exposing it to 0.0.0.0 without authentication would be dangerous. The explicit error message when passing --host 0.0.0.0 confirms this is intentional.

However, the practical consequence is that there is no supported, clean way to use DSH's Web UI from a remote machine.

### **What users end up doing (workarounds)**
To make it work, I had to explore several unofficial workarounds, none of which are satisfactory:

1. SSH tunnel (ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:3080 server) — fails because the Host header becomes 127.0.0.1:8080, which DSH rejects.

2. Third-party plugins like dsh-remote-access — require manually patching DSH's source code (dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js) to whitelist the plugin in the settings namespace. This patch is fragile and breaks on every DSH update.
 
3. External gateways (e.g., dsh-gateway-server) — functional but add architectural complexity (a separate public-facing service, WebSocket tunnel, admin portal) just to access a local dev tool.
 
4. Reverse proxies with header rewriting — requires understanding DSH's internal trust model and configuring Nginx/socat to fake Host and Origin headers.

All of these feel like workarounds for a missing feature, not solutions.

### **What I'm asking for**
Please consider adding first-class support for remote access to the DSH Web UI. A few possible directions:

- **A documented** --remote / --bind mode with built-in authentication (password or persistent token), listening on a configurable interface. This is what Jupyter, code-server, and Open WebUI do.

- **Configurable host whitelist** for the Host header check, so DSH can sit behind a reverse proxy at dsh.mydomain.com without hacks.

- **Official documentation** for headless/containerized deployment: which options exist, their security trade-offs, and how to configure them correctly.

- **A stable plugin API** for remote-access extensions, so plugins like dsh-remote-access don't need to patch DSH's source to register settings.

### **Additional context**
I explored this scenario extensively with DeepSeek (the AI assistant) before filing this issue. The conclusion we reached was that the current design optimizes for the "single developer on a laptop" case while neglecting the "developer on a remote headless machine" case, which is arguably just as common in professional environments.

I'm happy to provide logs, configuration details, or test any proposed solution. The container setup is reproducible and minimal (Docker + npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web).

Thanks for your consideration.

discussions.title: Sessions are pinned to the workspace directory — no way to give one its own working copy
discussions.body:
A follow-up to #6631, from the same external workbench plugin. That one asked for
more than one session's event window to stay open. This one is about where those
sessions do their work.

## What I ran into

A session can only attach to a workspace when its `cwd`, after `realpath`, is
**exactly** the workspace path — `packages/workspace/workspace/src/entity.ts`
rejects anything else with `its cwd resolves to '<other>'`.

So every session in a workspace shares one directory. That is fine when one
session runs at a time. It stops being fine the moment a workbench puts several
live sessions side by side: two agents editing the same files at the same time
overwrite each other, and neither the harness nor the plugin can tell them apart
— they are, by construction, in the same tree.

I don't think this is an oversight. `packages/workflow/workflow-worker-thread/src/runtime.ts`
already names `isolation` in `DEFERRED_AGENT_OPTIONS`, commented "Deferred Claude
Code options we name explicitly in the rejection message" — the concept is
recognised and reserved, just not implemented yet. This post is a concrete use
case for it.

## The workaround I have, and why it isn't enough

`workspaces.create({ path })` takes any directory, and a git worktree is a
directory. So I can run `git worktree add ../repo-feature-x -b feature-x` and add
that as its own workspace. The isolation is real, and it works today with no
harness change.

What it costs:

- The worktree becomes a **sibling workspace** in the sidebar, not a session
  inside the workspace it came from. The grouping that made the workbench useful
  ("these four cards are all the login-flow task") is exactly what gets lost.
- The sidebar fills up with near-duplicate entries of the same repo.
- Nothing records that one workspace is a working copy of another, so cleanup is
  manual and easy to get wrong.

## The ask

Some way for a session's working directory to be *derived from* its workspace
rather than identical to it — a per-session working copy that still belongs to
the workspace it came from. Two shapes that would both solve it:

- Relax the attach rule to accept a cwd the harness itself minted for that
  session (e.g. a git worktree of the workspace), and carry the relationship on
  the session record.
- Or a first-class "fork this session into its own working copy" in the session
  controller, with the harness owning creation and cleanup.

Either one turns "run three agents on this repo at once" from a data-loss hazard
into an ordinary thing. The plugin side is ready — it already renders the
sessions side by side; it just has nowhere safe to put their work.

For reference, other harnesses land in three different places on this: a git
worktree per agent (Claude Code's `isolation: "worktree"`), a remote checkout
whose diff you apply back locally (Codex Cloud's `codex apply`), and an
in-place permission sandbox that restricts what a process may touch without
giving it a separate tree (Codex's local `sandbox`, and this repo's own
`packages/sandbox/*`). Only the first two make concurrent edits safe; the third
solves a different problem.

discussions.title: 插件用 followup 注入纯文本时，核心监听器会因缺失 source 抛错并中断回合——这是预期契约吗？
discussions.body:
插件用 `agent.followup("纯文本")` 注入提醒时，inbox 里会出现没有 `source` 的消息，接着 `session/event` 与 `agent/inbox/claimed` 的监听器会抛 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')`，整个回合失败（0.1.5-rc.1）。

想确认两点：
1. 这是预期契约吗（插件必须传结构化消息）？如果是，能否在文档里写明？
2. 还是核心侧会给这几处读取加空值守卫？按 dsh-context 作者的排查，`dsh-goal-round-driver` 的 `isGoalRoundSource`、`dsh-repeat-tool-reminder`、`RuntimeContextProjection` 等都是直接读 `source.kind`，而 `agent/pre-step` 是 waterfall，任一监听器抛错就会中断整个回合。

需要的话我可以补完整日志与会话事件片段。

discussions.title: Windows git-bash: .i18n.yaml merges silently degrade to text conflicts on non-C: checkouts
discussions.body:
**Problem**

Any merge touching `*.i18n.yaml` degrades to plain text conflicts and prints
`runtime is unavailable; leaving an ordinary text conflict`. Reproduced with 11 files at once.
`.gitattributes` declares `*.i18n.yaml merge=dsh-translation-pairing`, but on this platform the driver never works.

**Environment**
- Windows 10
- git-bash (Git for Windows)
- dsh checkout on `D:` (any drive other than `C:`)

**Root cause**

git passes the absolute path to a merge driver in MSYS form (`/d/APP/...`). The driver hands it to tsx, and tsx resolves a non-`/c/` prefix as an absolute Windows path, producing `D:\d\APP\...`:

```
tsx /d/APP/dsh-github-alpha/scripts/merge-translation-pairing.ts --probe
-> ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND  D:\d\APP\dsh-github-alpha\...   (module not found)
```

`/c/` works because `C:\` is the drive git-bash bootstraps on. `/d/`, `/e/`, and onward are all broken.

**Second-order effect worth documenting**

`scripts/install-lefthook.mjs:780` probes the driver *before* registering it:

```
780:      probePairingMergeDriver(root)   // throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND under git-bash
781:      rollbackPairingMergeDriver = installPairingMergeDriver(root, worktreeConfigPath)
```

The probe throws, so line 781 is never reached and the driver install is rolled back. The `merge.dsh-translation-pairing` config is therefore never written. What looks like "the merge driver falls back to text conflicts" is actually "the driver was never installed" - the config is missing, and the merge-time probe then also fails.

**Same bug for node**

`node /c/Users/.../x.cjs` -> `Cannot find module 'D:\c\Users\...'`. Windows-form paths are required when passing script paths to node/tsx from git-bash.

**Suggested fix**

1. probe the original path first; on failure, convert MSYS form to Windows form (`/d/` -> `D:/`) and retry
2. convert `%A` / `%O` / `%B`, but **not** `%P` - per the git merge-driver protocol `%P` is repository-relative
3. uppercase only the drive-letter character. Uppercasing the whole string turns `dsh-github-alpha` into `DSH-GITHUB-ALPHA`

**Scope**: Windows + git-bash + non-C: checkout. The failure mode is silent - users get ordinary text conflicts in 11 pairing files with no indication that the bilingual pairing records were skipped.

discussions.title: Subagent claims can ship with citations that don't support them — a concrete case and a cheap fix
discussions.body:
**Version**: 0.1.5-rc.1

**What happened**

I asked DSH to research the current camera market and write up an overview. One line in the
delivered report read:

> Hasselblad XCD 2.8-4/35-100E (2025) — the company's first zoom, equivalent 28-76mm...

with a citation to a reputable review site attached to it.

I happen to know this field, and the claim looked wrong to me: Hasselblad had zoom lenses
well before that one. So I asked the agent to go back and check the source. It did:

- The cited review never says "first zoom". Its only mention of that lens is
  "the new 35-100mm f/2.8-4 zoom lens".
- The manufacturer's own press release never says it either — and in fact compares the new
  lens against an *earlier* zoom by name, which by itself disproves "first".
- Grepping the entire review for "first" returns only unrelated hits
  ("first-class build", "continuous AF for the first time").

So the superlative was fabricated by a subagent, and a genuine citation was attached to it.

**Why this is worse than an ordinary hallucination**

An unsourced wrong claim is easy to distrust. A wrong claim wearing a plausible citation
looks *more* trustworthy than the same claim bare. As the person reading the report, I had
no reason to suspect that line — it had a source, and the source was real.

It also compounds with depth: a subagent produced the claim, the parent agent folded it into
the deliverable, and neither layer re-checked the source.

**Suggested fixes**

1. **Require quotes, not just URLs, in subagent results.** If structured output supported
   `{claim, source_url, quote}`, a fabricated superlative would be far harder: the subagent
   would have to emit a quote that does not exist, rather than merely attach a URL that does.
2. **Ship a citation-check helper.** A tool taking a URL plus keywords and reporting whether
   they occur on the page. This is fetch + grep, trivial to implement, and would have caught
   this case in a single call.
3. **Prompt-level: flag superlatives as high-risk.** "First / most / only / never" deserve a
   mandatory "does the source literally say this?" step before the claim is allowed into a
   deliverable.

Cost of verification here was about two seconds of grep. Cost of skipping it was a false
claim in a finished report — caught only because I happened to know the domain well enough
to be suspicious. In a field I don't know, I would have had no way to tell.

**Note on attribution**

I understand part of this is model behaviour — both the fabrication itself and the
instinct to attach a real citation to it come from the model. I'm filing it here because
every fix I can think of is harness-level, and because I'm not aware of a dedicated
channel for the model itself. If useful, please forward the model-side half to the right
team.

The discussion is drafted by ds and reviewed by me.

discussions.title: [Plugin] DSH BrowserScope  把完整 Chromium DevTools 搬进 DSH：断点调试、网络拦截与 30 个自动化工具 | Full Browser DevTools for Agents
discussions.body:
> **更新（2026-09-17）**：BrowserScope 已发布至 npm，当前唯一发布候选为 `1.0.0-rc4`。
> 支持 DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` 与 `0.1.6-alpha.1`，一条命令即可安装，不再需要手动指定版本或额外参数。
> Latest npm release: `1.0.0-rc4` (DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` / `0.1.6-alpha.1`).

![BrowserScope 嵌入 DSH Web 的实况工作台](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/main/assets/browser-scope-hero.png)

### 让 Agent 不再只是“截个图猜报错”，而是拥有完整的浏览器调试能力

大多数浏览器插件只能让 Agent 打开网页、点点按钮、截个图。遇到异步竞态、接口 500、生产代码报错时，Agent 只能“刷新试试”。

**DSH BrowserScope** 在 DSH Web 右侧栏嵌入了一个完整的 Chromium DevTools 工作台，为 Agent 提供 **30 个专门定制的自动化工具**：

- 🔍 **深度断点调试**：连上 CDP Debugger，支持断点、单步进入/跳过、读取调用栈与 Scope 变量；支持 Source Map 直接还原线上压缩代码。
- 🌐 **全量网络掌控**：实时 Network Journal，支持请求/响应阶段拦截、修改 Mock、Continue/Abort、重放与时序追踪。
- 🖱️ **DOM 与元素操作**：DOM 快照、属性提取、文本输入、按键组合、点击与文件上传下载。
- 📺 **实况与多页协作**：右侧栏实时投屏、上下/左右双页分屏对比、人工随时无缝接管、Chrome 扩展支持。
- 🛡️ **优雅共存隔离**：单 Session 单浏览器锁定机制，每个 Session 首次自主选择，不与其他浏览器插件打架，重启后自动恢复。

#### 快速安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-browser-scope
```

在 Profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加一行启用：
```yaml
- insert:
    - id: browser-tools
      name: dsh-browser-scope
```

启动 DSH Web，新建 Session 发送消息后，在输入框旁的“浏览器”菜单选择启用即可。

- **GitHub 仓库**：https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope
- **Release (v1.0.0-rc4)**：https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/releases/tag/v1.0.0-rc4
- **详细文档与架构**：[TECHNICAL.md](https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/blob/main/TECHNICAL.md) · [测试报告](https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/blob/main/VALIDATION.md)

欢迎体验并提出任何 Issue 和建议！🎉

---

![BrowserScope Live Workbench inside DSH Web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/main/assets/browser-scope-hero.png)

### Stop letting Agents "guess errors from screenshots" — Give them full browser DevTools capabilities

Most browser plugins only let agents open pages, click buttons, and take screenshots. When facing race conditions, 500 errors, or production exceptions, agents are stuck in "refresh and retry" loops.

**DSH BrowserScope** embeds a full Chromium DevTools workbench into DSH Web's right sidebar, providing **30 purpose-built automation tools**:

- 🔍 **Breakpoint Debugging**: Attach CDP Debugger with breakpoints, stepping, call stacks, and scope variables; map minified production bundles back to source code via Source Maps.
- 🌐 **Network Control**: Real-time Network Journal with request/response interception, custom mock responses, continue/abort, replay, and async timing tracking.
- 🖱️ **DOM & Elements**: DOM snapshots, attribute extraction, IME text input, key chords, clicks, and robust file uploads/downloads.
- 📺 **Live Workbench**: Real-time screencast, dual-page split view (vertical/horizontal), seamless manual takeover, and Manifest V3 extension support.
- 🛡️ **Clean Coexistence**: Session-scoped lock: each session chooses its browser toolset once and stays locked without conflicting with third-party browser plugins; persists across restarts.

#### Quick Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-browser-scope
```

Enable in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
```yaml
- insert:
    - id: browser-tools
      name: dsh-browser-scope
```

Start DSH Web, create a new session, send a message, and pick your browser toolset from the "Browser" menu.

- **GitHub Repo**: https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope
- **Release (v1.0.0-rc4)**: https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/releases/tag/v1.0.0-rc4
- **Technical Specs**: [TECHNICAL.en.md](https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/blob/main/TECHNICAL.en.md) · **Validation**: [VALIDATION.en.md](https://github.com/HakureiMonika/dsh-browser-scope/blob/main/VALIDATION.en.md)

Feedback & contributions are welcome! 🎉

discussions.body: Hi DeepSeek-Harness Team & Developers, I wanted to share a milestone achievement showcasing what this amazing harness framework can do when tackling ultra-hardcore, low-level system development. 🚀 Project Name: PE_SmartFixer 🔗 GitHub Repo: https://github.com/ziyouzhiyi666888/PE_SmartFixer/blob/main/README_EN.md ### 💡 What is it? It is the world's first AI Agent designed to run within the extreme constraints of a Windows PE (Preinstallation Environment). It completely bypasses volatile `.dmp` log analysis. Instead, it utilizes DeepSeek's Vision capabilities to analyze blue-screen screenshots, and the pure Go-driven backend directly executes offline registry hive manipulation (`reg load HKLM\SysTemp`) to rescue paralyzed operating systems. ### 🧠 The Multi-File Challenge & Why Claude Failed where DeepSeek Nailed It: This project consists of 7 tightly coupled files (`main.go`, `registry.go`, `presenter.go`, etc.). To successfully compile in a 512MB WinPE RAMDisk, the codebase requires: 1. Raw Win32 API GUI rendering (`CreateWindowExW`) via dynamic DLL loading to ensure a zero-dependency footprint. 2. A strict `unsafe.Pointer` global harbor to lock memory lifecycles against Go's GC runtime to prevent sudden UI crashes. 3. Dynamic ControlSet00X identification and registry query parsing. During the automated loop, Claude-3.5-Sonnet and GPT-4o continuously hallucinated Win32 type definitions and completely lost memory context after 25+ rounds of intense multi-file compilation debugging (`go build` error feedback). However, thanks to **DeepSeek's Reasoning model** coupled with this Harness, the AI spent thousands of thinking steps deducing the Win32 message pump, self-corrected over 40 compilation errors, and completed the full 1600-line multi-file project for less than $1! The 99% Context Caching hit rate provided by DeepSeek literally made this automated generation dirt cheap. ### 🎯 Tribute to the Harness Team Without your brilliant tool-calling architecture and context tracking, the Agent wouldn't have been able to navigate the complex Windows API and registry logic. This project stands as a textbook showcase of DeepSeek-Harness's absolute dominance in real-world, industrial-level automated engineering. Feel free to check out the repo, star it, or add it to the official Showcase list! 🚀 --- 大家好！特来向 Harness 团队致敬并分享一个终极实战案例。 《PE_SmartFixer》是国内首款在 Windows PE 环境下运行的离线 AI 修复工具。它通过多模态视觉识别蓝屏截图，由 Go 底层在脱机状态下强行挂载（reg load）损坏系统的注册表进行内核级修复。 在面对极其凶险的 Win32 原生指针防死锁、以及与 Go 语言 GC 强夺内存生命周期的硬核多文件逻辑中，Claude 等模型在几十轮的自动编译报错中彻底迷失。而 DeepSeek 配合本 Harness 框架，凭借强大的深度推理和近乎免费的缓存机制，几块钱就帮我把这套 7 个文件的项目全部完美写完并编译成功。 这是本框架和 DeepSeek 推理能力在底层运维落地上的最佳活广告！欢迎大家围观！ GitHub 仓库链接：https://github.com/ziyouzhiyi666888/PE_SmartFixer

discussions.title: fix(session): 在每一条通路上收敛非 JSON 投影值
discussions.body:
**Summary**

A projection unit whose state or wire value is not lossless JSON currently fails — or silently corrupts — the whole carrier that delivers it. One such field from one installed plugin made an otherwise healthy Session unusable: `session/fork` rolled back and the session's row disappeared from the listing on reconnect, while the transcript stayed readable through a different path.

**Root cause**

Projection definitions validate their value with a Zod `viewSchema`, which is not a JSON check: it accepts a `Map`, a `Date`, or an object holding an `undefined`-valued key. Four carriers then mishandle such a value in two different ways:

| Carrier | Serialization | Failure |
|---|---|---|
| `SessionProjectionCache.put()` (checkpoint record) | `snapshotJsonValue` validation | throws; the write is fail-soft, so every row of that session stays at the previous cut (observed: 129 events of lag) |
| forwarded host event `api-session/added` | `assertJsonArgs` validation | throws, so the Client never receives the session |
| `session/control` baseline and change frames | `JSON.stringify`, **no JSON check** | silently corrupts (`Map` → `{}`) |
| `session/follow` snapshot projections block | same | silently corrupts |

Observed trigger: a step that ends without usage leaves `state.active.actualTokens` undefined, and a stats plugin copies it into `lastSettled`, so the wire value is `{"activeStep":{"lastSettled":{"actualTokens":undefined}}}`. Six sessions on one machine hit this; the session logs themselves stayed fully readable.

**What this changes**

- `SessionProjectionCache.put()` detaches and validates each row separately; a row that is not losslessly serializable is omitted with one warning naming the key and session — an absent row is already that key's refold floor through `restoreFloor` — and the remaining rows land on the same cut.
- A new `losslessProjectionValues()` owns the cell rule for every wire carrier: the listing hints, the control baseline, and the `session/follow` projections block each keep only the cells `isJsonValue` accepts and warn per dropped key.
- The control change feed drops a frame whose value is not lossless JSON instead of broadcasting one the Client can only receive corrupted.
- `asOfSeq` stays the registry's cut in every carrier, so an omission can only overstate staleness; `isJsonValue` keeps its strictness; nothing normalizes, strips, or reinterprets a business value, and no Session log is touched.

**What this does not do**

- It does not fix producers: a persistently offending unit keeps losing its own cell or row, and costs that key a full-log replay on the next cold read. Producer-side correctness stays a separate obligation.
- It adds no strict mode, counter, or metric — that is a policy choice better made by you.
- It does not relax the forwarded-event rejection, does not change the Client, and does not change any wire type.

**Verification**

- Focused specs: `session-projection-cache/tests/cache.spec.ts` 26/26, `api/session-controller/tests/session-projections.host.spec.ts` 28/28; the 5 touched/neighbour packages' full spec set: 65 files / 1426 passed.
- Every new case fails in a real variant without its guard (temporary reverts of the sources), so the guard is proven bidirectional rather than merely green.
- Coverage: the new module is at 100% lines/branches/functions, and the three modified files stay at 100%.
- The commit carries the required Agent Note (bilingual pair + i18n record).

**Why the platform rather than the producer**

Projection units are an open set, while the consequence of one bad field is session-level unavailability. The carriers already define the needed semantics: the projection cache is documented as a fold shortcut that is "as stale as their rows, never wrong", the listing hints are documented as partial ("missing cells and cache rows are never materialized here"), and `restoreFloor` already reads an absent row as that key's refold floor. The read side is already tolerant in exactly this way — `viewCheckpoint` leaves a key absent for a mismatched, malformed, or absent row, and `hydratePrepared` retries from the exact log because "cached rows are disposable derived data" — while the write side had no such tolerance. This change completes that existing asymmetry instead of introducing a new policy.

**On the "trust typed same-process boundaries" rule**

`AGENTS.md` says not to add runtime validation for values a static interface requires, and to validate at parser/config, queued, model/tool JSON, durable/file, worker, process, and wire boundaries instead. That rule is why this gap survived: the registry is same-process and its units are typed. It does not apply to the output side of these values, because (a) the producer set is open — third-party plugins, which no static interface can close — and (b) the values leave through durable and wire boundaries (the persisted checkpoint record, a forwarded host event, and two Remote stream items). What was missing is not another validation layer but the right failure granularity at boundaries that are already required to validate.

---


**摘要**

当某个投影单元的状态或 wire 值不是无损 JSON 时，**承载它的整条通路**会失败或**静默腐化**。某个已安装插件的一个字段就让一个本来健康的会话不可用：`session/fork` 回滚、重连后列表行消失，而正文仍能通过另一条路径读到。

**根因**

投影定义用 Zod `viewSchema` 校验取值，而 Zod 校验不是 JSON 校验：它接受 `Map`、`Date`、以及含 `undefined` 值的对象。于是四条通路以两种方式处理失当（表同上）：检查点写入与转发事件**整条抛错**；`session/control` 的 baseline/变更帧与 `session/follow` 快照块因为只做 `JSON.stringify`（**没有 JSON 校验**）而**静默腐化**（`Map` 变成 `{}`）。

触发实例：步骤在没有 usage 的情况下结束，`state.active.actualTokens` 为 `undefined`，统计插件把它复制进 `lastSettled`，wire 值即 `{"activeStep":{"lastSettled":{"actualTokens":undefined}}}`。单机 6 条会话命中；会话日志本身仍完全可读。

**改了什么**（同英文四条）与**没改什么**（不修生产方、不加 strict/计数器、不放宽转发拒绝、不动客户端与 wire 类型）。

**为什么由平台承担**：投影单元是开放集合，而一个坏字段的代价是会话级不可用；四条通路早已各自定义了所需语义（缓存是"至多陈旧、绝不错"的折叠捷径；列表提示按契约就是部分；`restoreFloor` 本就把缺失行当作该 key 的重折底线）。
https://github.com/drscrewdriver/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/session-projection-row-containment

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows NTFS: Spurious FS_STALE_VERSION from nanosecond timestamp jitter & module resolution fallback failure on non-C: drive checkouts
discussions.body:
### Environment
- **OS:** Windows 11 Pro 64-bit (NTFS volume)
- **Repo Location:** `D:\deepseek-harness` (non-`C:` drive checkout)
- **Node.js:** v24.11.1
- **DeepSeek Harness:** v0.1.5-rc.2 (commit `c291e7961a`)
- **Shell / Runtime:** Native Windows (`pwsh` 7.x, non-WSL2)

---

### Summary
When running DeepSeek Harness natively on Windows from a secondary drive (e.g. `D:\deepseek-harness`), two distinct platform defects impact session persistence and plugin resolution:

1. **Spurious `FS_STALE_VERSION` rejections during multi-turn edits**: NTFS atomic rename operations exhibit sub-microsecond timestamp jitter. Using raw nanosecond precision (`mtimeNs` / `ctimeNs`) in `versionOf()` causes optimistic concurrency tokens to mismatch even when the file content has not changed.
2. **Silent module resolution failure for drive-letter paths**: In `ClientModuleRegistry.locatePkgJson()`, when `internal.resolveSync` throws on absolute Windows drive paths (`D:\...`), the `catch` block unconditionally returns `undefined` instead of attempting a `createRequire(baseUrl)` fallback, causing client plugins to fail loading.

*(Note: These defects do not trigger on CI because Windows CI runners execute on Windows Server 2025 with ReFS block-cloning enabled (`ci.yml:498`), where NTFS timestamp jitter does not exist and checkouts are rooted on the default drive).*

---

### Issue 1: NTFS Nanosecond Jitter Causes Spurious `FS_STALE_VERSION`

#### Location
`packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts:74-80` (`versionOf`)

#### Mechanism & Root Cause
`versionOf()` constructs file freshness tokens using raw BigInt nanosecond fields:
```typescript
function versionOf(info: BigIntStats): FsVersion {
  return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${info.mtimeNs}:${info.ctimeNs}`)
}
```
On Windows NTFS, atomic file publication via `writeFileAtomic` (which performs guarded temp-file publication and native replacement) causes the operating system to update file timestamp metadata with nanosecond-level fluctuations. When an agent subsequently executes a mutation guarded by `replaceIfVersion`, `versionOf(info)` evaluates to a mismatched token despite identical file bytes, throwing `FS_STALE_VERSION`.

While Discussions #4672 and RFC #5040 noted metadata changes from cloud-sync daemons and editor view touches, on native NTFS volumes this jitter occurs spontaneously under standard agent file-writing workflows.

#### Proposed Patch
Truncate `mtimeNs` and `ctimeNs` to millisecond precision (`/ 1_000_000n`). BigInt division naturally truncates, absorbing NTFS nanosecond jitter while retaining millisecond precision—which is fully sufficient for optimistic concurrency control (CAS):

```diff
--- a/packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts
+++ b/packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts
@@ -72,7 +72,11 @@ async function readFileAbortable(absolutePath: string, verb: 'read' | 'edit', si
 
 /** Opaque version token from high-resolution identity and freshness metadata. */
 function versionOf(info: BigIntStats): FsVersion {
-  return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${info.mtimeNs}:${info.ctimeNs}`)
+  // Truncate to millisecond precision to absorb NTFS nanosecond jitter
+  // during atomic rename operations on Windows.
+  const mtimeMs = info.mtimeNs / 1_000_000n
+  const ctimeMs = info.ctimeNs / 1_000_000n
+  return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${mtimeMs}:${ctimeMs}`)
 }
```

#### What this does NOT do:
- Does not weaken concurrency protection: true concurrent writes separated by >1 ms still trigger `FS_STALE_VERSION`.
- Does not affect Linux or macOS POSIX semantics.

---

### Issue 2: Missing `createRequire` Fallback in `locatePkgJson` for Windows Paths

#### Location
`packages/client/modules/src/index.ts:781-806` (`locatePkgJson`)

#### Mechanism & Root Cause
In `locatePkgJson()`, `internal.resolveSync` is probed. Similar to the drive-path issues reported in #6644 and #3620, when `resolveSync` encounters absolute Windows drive-letter paths (e.g. `D:\deepseek-harness\...`) or loader signature variations under Node 24, the call throws. 

Currently, the `catch` block unconditionally discards the candidate:
```typescript
    } catch {
      // The Loader cannot resolve the name: its row cannot have imported, so
      // the name is permanently not a client row.
      return undefined
    }
```
However, the same method *already* recognizes that `createRequire(baseUrl)` is a valid fallback earlier in the function (`lines 771–776` when `internal` is absent). When `resolveSync` throws on Windows, falling back to `createRequire(baseUrl)` successfully resolves the declaring package manifest.

#### Proposed Patch
1. Protect `internal.resolveSync` call against v2/v1 signature mismatches.
2. In the `catch` block, if `expectedPackageName` is present, attempt `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve(`${expectedPackageName}/package.json`)` before giving up:

```diff
--- a/packages/client/modules/src/index.ts
+++ b/packages/client/modules/src/index.ts
@@ -781,12 +781,26 @@ export class ClientModuleRegistry extends Service {
     }
     let moduleUrl: string
     try {
-      moduleUrl = internal.version === 'v2'
-        ? internal.resolveSync(baseUrl, { specifier: loaderName, attributes: {} }).url
-        : internal.resolveSync(loaderName, baseUrl, {}).url
+      if (internal.version === 'v2') {
+        try {
+          moduleUrl = internal.resolveSync(baseUrl, { specifier: loaderName, attributes: {} }).url
+        } catch {
+          moduleUrl = (internal as any).resolveSync(loaderName, baseUrl, {}).url
+        }
+      } else {
+        moduleUrl = internal.resolveSync(loaderName, baseUrl, {}).url
+      }
     } catch {
-      // The Loader cannot resolve the name: its row cannot have imported, so
-      // the name is permanently not a client row.
+      if (expectedPackageName !== undefined) {
+        try {
+          return {
+            path: createRequire(baseUrl).resolve(`${expectedPackageName}/package.json`),
+            packageName: expectedPackageName,
+          }
+        } catch {
+          return undefined
+        }
+      }
       return undefined
     }
     return this.nearestPackage(moduleUrl, expectedPackageName)
```

---

### Verification & Local Testing
- **Local Reproduction & Fix Verification**:
  - Tested on Windows 11 with Node.js v24.11.1 on `D:\deepseek-harness`.
  - `pnpm dsh web`: Starts cleanly, client modules register without `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.
  - Long multi-step agent coding sessions on NTFS complete without false-positive `FS_STALE_VERSION` interruptions.
- **Related Discussions Cross-Reference**:
  - Complements **#4672** & **RFC #5040** (FS stale version / concurrency).
  - Aligns with **#6644** & **#3620** (Windows secondary drive-letter path handling).
  - Follows up on **#4968** & **#5084** (Node 24 `resolveSync` loader shape probing).

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-feishu-bot｜飞书接入 Harness，支持 Webhook 与长连接
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护，与 DeepSeek、飞书无隶属关系。**

项目地址：[icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot) · [English README](https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot/blob/main/README.en.md)

## 项目介绍

`dsh-feishu-bot` 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 飞书机器人插件：从飞书发送文本任务，由本机 Harness Agent 执行，再将最终文本答复回复到原消息。

```text
飞书文本消息 → Webhook / 长连接 → Harness Agent → 回复原飞书消息
```

插件提供两种可在设置页切换的接收方式：

| 方式 | 适用场景 | 配置要点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 开发者服务器（HTTP Webhook） | 已有公网 HTTPS 入口，或本机使用 ngrok | 支持地址验证、Verification Token 校验、加密请求解密和签名校验；默认回调路径为 `/webhook/feishu` |
| 长连接（WebSocket） | 本机运行、不希望配置公网入口 | 本机主动连接飞书，不需要公网地址或 ngrok |

两种方式都需要飞书企业自建应用、机器人能力、消息权限，以及 `im.message.receive_v1` 事件订阅。

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

插件安装到 Harness 的 **Web profile**，在插件列表和「飞书机器人」设置页中提供原生入口。设置页可填写应用凭据，选择工作目录、Agent 预设和权限预设，测试应用认证并查看连接状态。

接收有效文本消息后，插件为该消息创建一个独立 Harness 会话；Agent 完成后回复最终文本，较长回复分段发送。另外注册了 `feishu_*` 工具，可供 Agent 调用飞书消息、文档、电子表格、日历等接口，具体可用范围取决于应用权限和资源授权。

## 设置界面

![飞书插件实际设置界面（独立演示环境，未填写凭据）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot/main/assets/settings-webhook.png)

*实际设置界面（独立演示环境，未填写凭据）；截图展示设置入口，不代表真实飞书消息收发已验收。*

## 源码安装

需要 Node.js **22 或更新版本**、npm、Git，以及已配置模型、能够正常执行会话的 Harness。当前兼容验证基于 Harness **0.1.5-rc.2** 相关组件的 Web profile。

尚未安装 Harness 时：

```bash
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
```

安装插件并启动：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot.git
cd dsh-feishu-bot
npm ci
npm run install:harness
npm run start:harness
```

安装脚本将当前仓库链接到 Web profile，修改已有配置前会备份，因此安装后请保留仓库目录。已有 Harness 实例占用端口时，请先在原终端停止该实例，再启动。

进入 **设置 → 插件 → 飞书机器人**，填写凭据和实际项目目录，选择接收方式。Webhook 模式中，飞书后台应填写完整回调地址，例如 `https://your-domain.example/webhook/feishu`；长连接模式不需要该地址。

详细步骤：[飞书接入指南](https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot/blob/main/docs/setup.md) · [常见问题与排错](https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)

## 当前范围与验证状态

当前版本 **0.1.2**，使用 **MIT** 许可证，通过 GitHub 源码安装，**尚未发布到 npm**。

- 支持文本输入和最终文本回复；每条消息创建独立会话，下一条消息需要带上必要背景。
- 暂不支持按聊天延续的多轮会话、图片/文件输入、流式回复、插件斜杠命令或 `card.action.trigger` 卡片按钮回调。
- 目前只处理 `im.message.receive_v1`；入群/出群、已读/撤回、reaction、文档评论和会议类事件尚未接入。
- 消息去重和回复关联保存在进程内存中，重启后不会恢复未交付的答复。
- 插件没有独立的用户/群聊白名单，请在飞书中设置适当的应用可用范围，并按任务选择 Harness 工作目录和权限预设。

**已有单元测试和本地浏览器检查，真实飞书消息收发尚未完成验收。** 应用认证成功、地址验证通过或长连接显示已连接，只能证明各自环节；需要实际发送消息并收到最终答复，才能确认完整链路。

欢迎试用并通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot/issues) 反馈环境版本、复现步骤和脱敏日志。请勿在公开反馈中提供 App Secret、Verification Token、Encrypt Key 或私人聊天内容。

---

**English summary:** An unofficial Feishu bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with native settings and a choice of HTTP webhooks or WebSocket connections. Each accepted text message creates an independent Harness session, with the final text sent back as a reply. Source installation only; Node.js 22+ required. Real Feishu message delivery has not yet completed end-to-end acceptance testing. See the [English README](https://github.com/icanotcode/dsh-feishu-bot/blob/main/README.en.md) for setup and current limitations.

discussions.title: Corrupt session log (first frame is not the header) blocks `dsh web` startup and session listing
discussions.body:
### Environment

- dsh `0.1.5-rc.1` (npm-global `@deepseek-ai/dsh`), Node v22.22.3, Linux
- Launch: `dsh --profile web --no-open` (reproduced with a plain manual launch too)

### Summary

Three times in ~5 days, a session log under `~/.dsh/sessions/<project-slug>/<session-id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd` ended up with its **first line being an event instead of the `{"type":"session",...}` header**. Once such a file exists:

1. `dsh --profile web` fails to boot (exit code 1):

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): failed to apply loader entry workspace (@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace): corrupt Zstandard session log: first frame is not exactly one header line
    at assertZstdHeaderFrame (.../dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js)
    ...
    at async WorkspaceRegistry.listStoredHeaders (.../dsh-workspace/lib/index.js)
```

2. In earlier occurrences the process still started, but `session/list` failed wholesale and **every workspace showed no sessions**, so the UI looked like all history was gone:

```
gateway/internal: session persistence listing failed: corrupt Zstandard session log: first frame is not exactly one header line
```

### What the corrupt file looks like

- It decompresses fine with standard zstd (this is not a torn trailing frame). The **first decoded line is a normal event**, e.g.:

```
{"type":"agent/inbox/spliced","seq":3,"time":...,"data":{"target":"next-turn", ...}}
```

- The first surviving event has `seq: 3`, i.e. the header plus events `seq 0..2` are missing — as if the **beginning of the file was truncated/replaced**, rather than a partial write at the end. Files are single-generation (`session.v3.jsonl.zstd`, no plain sibling).
- All three affected sessions use the `session-<uuid>` directory naming.

### Impact

- One bad artifact bricks the harness: `dsh web` cannot start at all, not just the affected session.
- When boot succeeds, the session list returns nothing for every workspace.

### Expected

- **Writer:** a session log must never lose frame 0. New generations should be published atomically (write temp + rename) and appends must never truncate the existing prefix.
- **Reader:** `SessionPersistence.list()` / `WorkspaceRegistry.listStoredHeaders` should skip (or quarantine) an unreadable log and continue; boot should not be blocked by a single corrupt session.

### Workaround

Move the offending session directory out of `~/.dsh/sessions/` (e.g. to `~/.dsh/quarantine/`). `dsh web` then boots and lists normally.

### Notes

The raw logs contain session content, so I have not attached them; the redacted first line above is the essential shape. I can provide structural dumps (event type/seq only, no content) or a sanitized sample if that helps.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-honcho | Memory that reasons about you, shared with Claude Code and Codex
discussions.body:
> The official [Honcho](https://honcho.dev) plugin for DeepSeek Harness, built and maintained by [Plastic Labs](https://plasticlabs.ai), the team behind Honcho. Community plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

Most memory plugins here are a store: the agent writes notes, later turns read them back. **dsh-honcho** is different. Turns stream to Honcho, which runs a background reasoner that builds a model of *you*: what you are working on, how you like to work, what you decided and why. That model comes back into the prompt each turn, and the agent can ask it questions.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Install** | `dsh plugin --profile web add @honcho-ai/dsh-honcho` |
| **Repo** | https://github.com/plastic-labs/dsh-honcho (MIT) |
| **npm** | https://www.npmjs.com/package/@honcho-ai/dsh-honcho |
| **Developed against** | DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` (peer deps pinned there). Testing on the `0.1.5` rc line now — if `plugin add` complains on a newer harness, please open an issue with the version. |
| **Needs** | A Honcho API key from [app.honcho.dev](https://app.honcho.dev), or a self-hosted Honcho at `baseUrl` |

## Why it is different

- **Reasoning, not retrieval.** `honcho_chat` answers questions of judgment ("what does this user care about in code review?") over everything Honcho has learned, not just what matches a keyword. `honcho_search` hits raw messages and derived conclusions in parallel. `honcho_remember` pins a fact.
- **One model of you across agents.** It reads the same `~/.honcho/config.json` as [claude-honcho](https://github.com/plastic-labs/claude-honcho), [codex-honcho](https://github.com/plastic-labs/codex-honcho), and opencode-honcho. Point two at the same `workspace` and DSH knows what you told Claude Code yesterday. Not a shared file the agents take turns writing to: one representation, reasoned over on the server, that every harness reads.
- **Injection shaped to your message.** Session start gets your profile, the project summary, and the relevant slice of the representation. Each turn refreshes using your current message as the search query, so recall is associative rather than merely recent. The first turn waits up to 5 seconds for memory. Later turns never block.

## How it is built (for plugin authors)

- Native Cordis bundle, not a hook bridge. Injection goes through `ctx.systemPrompt.context()`, the cache-safe dynamic-context slot.
- Capture rides `session/event`. No transcript parsing. It is cursor-based against DSH's own durable session log, so retry after a network failure falls out for free.
- Secrets are redacted before upload. Flushes at turn boundaries, before compaction, and on shutdown.
- `/honcho` shows status and surfaces the last upload error instead of hiding it. `/honcho config` prints resolved settings and names any config key the plugin does not act on, so nothing is accepted and quietly ignored.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/plastic-labs/dsh-honcho/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md) explains each extension point and why.

Credit to [@nanpaidashi](https://github.com/nanpaidashi)'s [dsh-honcho-sync](https://github.com/nanpaidashi/dsh-honcho-sync), which inspired the first design.

Feedback and issues welcome. Happy to compare notes with the other memory plugin authors here.

---

## 中文

**dsh-honcho** 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 [Honcho](https://honcho.dev) 记忆。和大多数"记笔记再读回来"的记忆插件不同，对话会流式发送到 Honcho，由后台推理器构建一个关于*你*的模型：你在做什么、习惯怎么工作、做过什么决定以及为什么。这个模型每轮注回提示词，agent 也可以直接向它提问（`honcho_chat`）。

- 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @honcho-ai/dsh-honcho`
- 与 claude-honcho、codex-honcho 共用同一份 `~/.honcho/config.json`，指向同一个 `workspace` 即可让 dsh 和 Claude Code 共享同一份记忆——不是共享文件，而是服务端统一推理出的同一份用户表征。
- 原生 Cordis 插件：通过 `ctx.systemPrompt.context()` 注入，通过 `session/event` 采集，上传前脱敏。
- 基于 DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` 开发，正在 `0.1.5` rc 上测试；新版本遇到问题请开 issue。

欢迎反馈。

discussions.title: dsh-http-proxy writes bracketed IPv6 [::1] into child process env, crashing httpx-based MCP servers
discussions.body:
DSH 报告稿：[::1] 写进子进程环境，导致 Python/httpx 客户端启动即崩

用途：报给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）项目。我这边查证过程与证据都在下面，可直接复制。
关联：basicmachines-co/basic-memory#1541（第三方项目受害方的复现与定性）。

摘要

@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy 会把含方括号的 IPv6 字面量 [::1] 合并进代理绕行列表，
并通过 applyPolicyEnv() 写回 process.env 的 no_proxy / NO_PROXY。
于是 DSH 启动的所有子进程都继承 NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]，
任何用 httpx（0.28.1）解析该变量的 Python 程序在构造默认 client 时直接抛异常退出：

httpx.InvalidURL: Invalid port: ':1]'

受影响场景：basic-memory（MCP server，stdio 启动）、FastEmbed 语义嵌入、Hugging Face
snapshot_download 等。表现为「子进程静默退出、工具不加载」，排查成本极高。

定位（dsh 0.1.5-rc.1）

文件：node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy/lib/index.js

// 19-24 行
const LOOPBACK_NO_PROXY = [
	"localhost",
	"127.0.0.1",
	"::1",
	"[::1]"      // ← 这一项会写进子进程环境
];

调用链：

  • withLoopback()（149-153 行）把该数组并入策略的 noProxy；
  • applyPolicyEnv()（334-347 行）→ writeProxyEnv()（364-375 行）把
    no_proxy / NO_PROXY 两个名字都写入 process.env；
  • 之后 DSH 通过 stdio / 子进程启动的任何程序都会继承这个值。

为什么 [::1] 现在可以去掉

它被加进来的理由是 12-18 行注释里那句：「undici 会把裸 ::1 读成 host : port 1，
所以必须同时列 [::1]」。

该理由对未安装的 undici 已经不成立。 本机 undici 8.10.2 的
lib/dispatcher/env-http-proxy-agent.js 明确处理裸 IPv6：

  • 120-139 行 #parseNoProxy()：「An IPv6 entry with a port must be bracketed: [::1]:443.
    A bare IPv6 address like ::1 contains colons that must not be confused with a
    host:port separator, so we handle it separately.」
  • 65-87 行 #getProxyAgentForUrl()：去掉端口后缀，并把 [::1] 归一成 ::1 再比对。

实测（无网络请求，只判路由，undici 8.10.2 + Node 24.14.0），目标 http://[::1]:7078：

no_proxy 取值 | 结果 -- | -- localhost,127.0.0.1,::1 | 直连（绕过代理） localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1] | 直连（绕过代理） localhost,127.0.0.1,[::1] | 直连（绕过代理）

即：去掉 [::1] 不影响 DSH 自身环回流量绕过代理的设计目标。

复现

# 1) 确认 DSH 子进程继承到的值（在 DSH 里跑任意命令即可）
$env:NO_PROXY      # → localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]

# 2) 该值足以让 httpx 构造 client 失败
$env:NO_PROXY = "localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]"
python -c "import httpx; httpx.Client()"
# httpx.InvalidURL: Invalid port: ':1]'

# 3) 去掉括号项即恢复正常
$env:NO_PROXY = "localhost,127.0.0.1,::1"
python -c "import httpx; httpx.Client(); print('ok')"   # → ok

建议改动

  1. 常量去掉 "[::1]"（保留 localhost、127.0.0.1、::1）；
  2. 同步更新 12-18 行注释：说明 undici ≥ 8.x 已正确处理裸 IPv6 字面量，
    [::1] 是为旧版 undici 加的兼容项，且会破坏不认括号字面量的 HTTP 客户端
    （httpx、requests/urllib3 生态里部分实现同理）；
  3. 如果确有必须同时写入括号形式的场景，可只在交给 undici 的那份里补，
    不要写进 process.env（子进程是共用的）。

建议的替代方案（若上游不愿改常量）

至少不要在 process.env 上留下括号项——例如：

  • 环境里只写裸 ::1；
  • 需要括号形式的消费者（若还有）由 DSH 内部在读取时补，而不是改全局环境；
  • 或提供一个开关/白名单，让宿主声明「我的子进程是 Python 客户端」。

影响面

  • 只要宿主机器上存在「代理开着 + 子进程用 httpx」的组合就会复现，与操作系统无关
    （Windows 11 / Python 3.12 / httpx 0.28.1 实测）。
  • 排查难度高：MCP 子进程崩溃后 harness 只是静默跳过，日志里往往只有一句
    Invalid port，很容易被误判为模型或网络问题。

本机环境（供参考）：Windows 11 10.0.26200；Node v24.14.0；dsh 0.1.5-rc.1；
undici 8.10.2；httpx 0.28.1（basic-memory 0.23.2 内置）。

discussions.title: DSH | dshcloud | 一键自建多用户 DSH 服务，带自动证书、平滑升级与版本快照
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目**，由社区成员独立开发和维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。基于 MIT 协议开源。

**项目地址**：https://github.com/eskim2001/dshcloud

## 项目介绍

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）是个极佳的 Agent 环境，但官方设计主要是本地/单机单人使用。

很多开发者尝试把 DSH 放到自己的云服务器上长期跑，或者想分享给朋友/团队一起玩，但很快就会遇到几个实际痛点：
1. **多人共用互相干扰**：简单挂一个 DSH 端口，所有人的 API Key、对话记录、工作区代码全混在一起；
2. **换镜像升级丢配置**：DSH 迭代很快，Docker 重新 pull 镜像后，辛苦配好的插件、提示词和环境容易被冲掉；
3. **缺乏资源防护**：Agent 会跑 Shell 和自动化脚本，一人跑起死循环或重载任务，整台服务器 CPU/内存直接宕机；
4. **网络与鉴权繁琐**：想在外网安全访问，得自己手写 Nginx/Caddy 反代、配置 SSL 证书和登录密码。

**dshcloud** 就是为了解决这些问题而生的**自托管多用户云底座**——装在你的 Linux 服务器上，让你和朋友在任何设备上打开浏览器，就能拥有各自独立的 DSH 环境。

---

## 核心优势（相比手动 Docker 跑 DSH）

- **一人一个独立工作空间（零干扰、防越权）**  
  管理员通过邀请链接分发账号。每个用户对应独立的 Docker 容器 + 独立存储卷（`/data`）+ 独立的宿主回环端口。所有访问前置 HMAC 签名门禁与认证，用户之间数据物理隔离，互不串会话、互看不见。
- **平滑升级与版本快照（绝不丢插件和工作区）**  
  平台与上游官方镜像版本同步，用户可在控制台自选 DSH 版本。**升级前自动对数据卷打快照**，如果新版 DSH 与某个插件不兼容，随时一键回滚。
- **原生配额管理（防止拖垮宿主机）**  
  可为每个工作空间单独分配 CPU、内存和磁盘限额。再也不怕 Agent 意外失控拖死整台服务器。
- **全自动域名与 TLS 证书**  
  底层集成 Traefik，自动完成二级域名路由（`<slug>.你的域名`）与 Let's Encrypt 证书申请，全自动 HTTPS，无需手动折腾反代。
- **对 DSH 核心零侵入**  
  工作空间里运行的就是原汁原味的 DSH Web UI。模型端点、API Key、插件生态全部保留在用户各自的 DSH 内部管理，平台只做外围的安全编排与运维保障。

---

## 快速体验（一行命令安装）

准备一台 Linux 服务器并解析泛域名，运行一键安装脚本，如果没有域名也没关系：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eskim2001/dshcloud/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

安装完成后终端会输出初始引导链接，打开浏览器即可完成管理员建号与域名初始化，管理控制台落在 `console.<你的域名>`。

---

## 截图

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eskim2001/dshcloud/main/docs/screenshots/zh-CN/light/workspaces.png)
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eskim2001/dshcloud/main/docs/screenshots/zh-CN/light/workspace-settings.png)
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eskim2001/dshcloud/main/docs/screenshots/zh-CN/light/admin-versions.png)

> 注：完整页面截图（含中英双语、明暗两套主题）可在仓库 README 查看。

---

## 现状与诚实说明（Limitations）

1. **项目处于早期**：装机流程、引导初始化、ACME 证书和多租户基础隔离已在真机上验证；部分边缘功能仍在快速完善，仓库 README 附有完整的真机自测清单。
2. **隔离级别**：基于 Linux 容器隔离（共享宿主内核），适合团队内部协作、极客自用或朋友间共享，**不适合面向公众提供无信任的多租户公有云服务**。
3. **版本基线**：当前发布的实例镜像基于 dsh `0.1.5-rc.2`（镜像 tag `0.1.5-rc.2_3`）。上游迭代很快，有兼容问题欢迎开 issue。

discussions.title: [Bug] 低并发场景下频繁出现服务器繁忙与turn error，零点时段规律性服务中断
discussions.body: # 环境信息 使用场景：子代理多会话调用 主会话数量：2个 子代理并发数：16 平台标注最大并发上限：500 出现问题的时间：2026年9月起，每日0点左右规律性触发，近期非零点夜间时段也随机复现 报错类型：服务器繁忙提示、turn error 中断错误 联系邮箱：Haoxiang.Zhu25@student.xjtlu.edu.cn --- # 复现步骤 正常开启2个主会话，配置16个子代理并发调用 未触发任何超并发、高频刷请求的违规操作，完全在平台标注的合理使用范围内 每日0点左右，服务突然进入繁忙状态，所有请求无法正常响应（官方交流4群群友提出），等待约10分钟后，服务自行恢复正常 近期非零点的夜间时段，也会无规律弹出turn error错误，直接中断正在执行的任务 --- # 期望行为 在用户远低于平台标注的并发上限时，不应出现无理由的服务器繁忙提示 每日零点时段不应出现规律性的服务中断，保障全时段的基础可用性 turn error 异常不应直接中断正常任务，至少给出明确的错误原因和重试指引 --- # 实际行为 仅16并发的低负载场景下，频繁触发服务器繁忙，完全无法正常提交请求 每日0点左右准时出现服务卡顿，必须等待10分钟左右才能自动恢复 关键任务执行中途弹出turn error，直接打断工作流程，严重影响使用体验 --- # 附加信息 群友反馈多次遇到该问题，并非偶发网络波动导致，属于可稳定复现的规律性故障 该问题多次在关键任务执行时突发，已经对正常工作造成了明显影响 已排查本地网络、代理配置、调用逻辑，确认所有参数设置符合平台规范，问题出在服务端侧 邮箱可能同时崩溃

discussions.title: [Bugfix] Deepseek Harness 会话分支自动执行父会话的下一次对话
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

9月8日，我拉取了 Deepseek Harness 的远程仓库（`commit c389f96bf3a9b6807cb71ed6bdad5849be0df6d8`）并重新进行了构建。在这一次更新后，我注意到 dsh 在在新建分支的时候会自动发送原分支的下一个提问，且该问题能够稳定复现，严重影响了使用体验。

## 复现

先创建一个测试对话：

![父会话](https://github.com/Haruka-Hua/Haruka-Hua.github.io/blob/main/content/technology/dsh-fork-bug/parent_session.png)

然后在第三轮（test2）末尾进行 fork，得到一个子对话。

![新建的子会话](https://github.com/Haruka-Hua/Haruka-Hua.github.io/blob/main/content/technology/dsh-fork-bug/new_child_session.png)

此时再尝试发送新的对话（test5），发现 dsh 会先发送一次原对话的 test3（消息的 `rpcId` 和父对话相同），然后再发送 test5。

![发送消息时出现bug](https://github.com/Haruka-Hua/Haruka-Hua.github.io/blob/main/content/technology/dsh-fork-bug/bug_child_session.png)

## 日志排查

查看对话的日志，发现在 fork 出来的分支里面是这样的（`SEED`为从父对话中继承的部分，`OWN`为子对话自己的部分：
```
SEED     29 09-11 17:54:43 turn/start           turn 3
## 这里是test2
SEED     30 09-11 17:54:43 agent/inbox/spliced  target=next-turn start=0 removed=1 insert=0
SEED     31 09-11 17:54:43 step/start           
SEED     32 09-11 17:54:43 user/message         id=2543275b rpc=9c947169 'test2'
SEED     33 09-11 17:54:44 assistant/message    
SEED     34 09-11 17:54:44 step/end             
SEED     35 09-11 17:54:44 turn/end             turn 3 {"kind": "completed"} 
## test2 结束
SEED     36 09-11 17:54:47 agent/inbox/spliced  target=next-turn start=0 removed=None insert=1 'test3' 
## 父进程在消息队列里面插入的 test3 也被继承了
OWN      37 09-11 17:57:14 session/end-seed     {"inherited": true}
OWN      38 09-11 17:57:14 session/title        
OWN      39 09-11 17:58:43 agent/inbox/spliced  target=next-turn start=1 removed=None insert=1 'test5'
## 可以看到插入 test5 的时候，消息队列非空，里面有 test3
OWN      40 09-11 17:58:43 turn/start           turn 4
## 位于队首的 test3 先被运行
OWN      41 09-11 17:58:43 agent/inbox/spliced  target=next-turn start=0 removed=1 insert=0
OWN      42 09-11 17:58:43 step/start           
OWN      43 09-11 17:58:43 user/message         id=42e9db8f rpc=38d6d44f 'test3'
OWN      44 09-11 17:58:43 request/header       
OWN      45 09-11 17:58:49 assistant/message    
OWN      46 09-11 17:58:49 step/end             
OWN      47 09-11 17:58:49 turn/end             turn 4 {"kind": "completed"}
OWN      48 09-11 17:58:49 turn/start           turn 5
## 等 test3 运行完之后，test5 才被运行
OWN      49 09-11 17:58:49 agent/inbox/spliced  target=next-turn start=0 removed=1 insert=0
OWN      50 09-11 17:58:49 step/start           
OWN      51 09-11 17:58:49 user/message         id=31ecb176 rpc=c3ed5ec4 'test5'
OWN      52 09-11 17:58:53 assistant/attempt    
OWN      53 09-11 17:58:53 step/end             
OWN      54 09-11 17:58:53 turn/end             turn 5 {"kind": "aborted", "reason": {"kind": "user"}}
```

可以看到，在对话分支的节点存在问题，复制的是 test3 被插入队列后的那个状态，而不是 test2 刚刚运行完的状态。导致发送 test5 的时候 inbox 队列不为空，里面已经有 test3 了，因此会先运行 test3 再运行 test5。

## 根因分析

为了确定 bug 的根源，我阅读了源代码，发现该 bug 的机制是这样的：

用户发送消息时，宿主机先把该消息写入待处理队列，日志记录为一条`agent/inbox/spliced`插入实践，然后才写入`turn/start`开始新一轮，取出队首的动作再记录一条`removedCount`事件，因此插入事件位于上一轮`turn/end`与下一轮`turn/start`之间。fork 时，会从锚点轮次的`turn/start`开始向后扫描，跳过所有非`turn/start`事件并在下一个`turn/start`的地方停止。`slice(0,cut)`会把插入事件复制进子会话的seed，并把对应取出事件留在seed之外。

子会话在确定队列的时候是由`inbox`投影折叠日志得到的，`aaf50dc39a`这次提交之后，投影从 seq 0 覆盖整份日志，继承前缀中那条插入了但是没有取出的消息被当成了待处理消息，占据了`next-turn`的下标0；而旧实现在构造时从`seedLength`之后重放，看不到这条记录。

用户在分支中发送第一条消息时触发`followup`唤醒驱动，新一轮的`claim`删除下标 0，分支首轮执行的消息携带父会话的`id`与`rpcId`，用户自己的消息留在队列中等待下一轮。

该 bug 的触发条件为父会话在锚点轮次之后开启过下一轮，且该轮由排队消息开启，对应版本自`dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1`起。

## 源码阅读

> Note: 以下的源码分析部分是在 AI 辅助下完成的，已经过人工审核，请放心食用。

### 1. 一条排队消息在日志中的事件顺序

用户发送消息时，宿主侧入口在 `packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts`：

```ts
if (request.mode === 'steer') agent.steer(message)   // commands.ts:363
else agent.followup(message)                          // commands.ts:364
```

followup 走到 `agent.send(message, 'next-turn', true)`（`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:128`）。send 先修改队列，再唤醒驱动：

```ts
this.inbox.splice(resolvedTarget, Infinity, 0, [message])  // agent.ts:133
if (wakeup) this.wakeDriver(wakingAfterAbort)               // agent.ts:134
```

inbox 的每次修改都写一条日志事件（`packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts:238`）：

```ts
const event = this.session.append('agent/inbox/spliced', splice)
```

唤醒后的新一轮先写 `turn/start`（`agent.ts:278`），随后 preStep 调用 `this.inbox.claim(target, position.turn)`（`agent.ts:244`）取走队首，取走动作再写一条 `agent/inbox/spliced`，字段为 `removedCount: 1`。

一轮由排队消息开启时，日志顺序固定为（父会话 seq 35 到 40）：

```
35 turn/end           上一轮结束
36 agent/inbox/spliced  inserted: [test3]      放入队列
37 turn/start         新一轮开始
38 agent/inbox/spliced  removedCount: 1        取出队首
39 step/start
40 user/message       test3 进入模型上下文
```

### 2. 分支切点停在下一个 turn/start 上

`commands.ts` 的 fork 先定位边界轮次，再向后推进 cut：

```ts
const anchoredBoundary = atSeq === undefined
  ? undefined
  : source.events.find(event => event.type === 'turn/end' && event.seq >= atSeq)  // commands.ts:229
const boundary = anchoredBoundary
  ?? (atSeq === undefined || atSeq > lastSeq
    ? source.events.findLast(event => event.type === 'turn/end')
    : undefined)

let cut = SessionLogOffset(boundary.seq + 1)                                       // commands.ts:243
while (cut < source.events.length && source.events[cut]?.type !== 'turn/start') {
  cut = SessionLogOffset(cut + 1)
}
```

循环从边界轮次的 `turn/end` 之后开始，跳过所有类型不为 `turn/start` 的事件，停在下一个 `turn/start` 的下标上。随后创建子会话：

```ts
await this.ctx.agents.create({                 // commands.ts:261
  sessionId: childId,
  seed: source.events.slice(0, cut),           // 不含 cut 位置的 turn/start
  inheritedEventCount: cut,
  meta: { parentSession: source.header.id, isSeeded: true, /* … */ },
})
```

对照第 1 节的顺序：插入记录位于 `turn/end` 与 `turn/start` 之间，落在 slice 范围内；取出记录位于 `turn/start` 之后，落在 slice 范围外。子会话日志因此带着一条没有取出记录与之配对的插入记录，随后由 `session/end-seed` 标记继承前缀的结束。

### 3. inbox 投影从 seq 0 折叠

子会话的队列来自 `inbox` 投影（`packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts`）：

```ts
init: (): InboxState => ({ 'next-turn': [], 'next-step': [] }),    // inbox.ts:30
apply(state: InboxState, event) {
  if (event.type !== 'agent/inbox/spliced') return state           // inbox.ts:32
  const splice = event.data
  // …
  const next = inbox.toSpliced(splice.start, removedCount, ...splice.inserted)
```

投影注册表构建状态时传入整份日志（`packages/session/session-projection/src/index.ts`）：

```ts
init(header: SessionHeader, inheritedEventCount: SessionLogOffset): NoInfer<S>  // index.ts:62

// index.ts:609
let state = def.init(header, inheritedEventCount)
for (const event of events) state = def.apply(state, event)

// index.ts:618 起，cellFor 的调用参数
cell = this.buildCell(registration.def, session.header, session.inheritedEventCount,
  session.snapshotEvents())        // 整份日志，含继承前缀
```

框架把 `inheritedEventCount` 交给 init，由各投影自行决定是否使用。inbox 的 init 未声明该参数，apply 也不检查 `event.seq`，折叠从 seq 0 开始。第 2 节那条未配对的插入记录被折叠成一条待处理消息，位于子会话 `next-turn` 队列的下标 0。

同仓库的 schedule 投影给出了对照写法，它在 apply 中跳过继承前缀（`packages/schedule/schedule/src/projection.ts:74`）：

```ts
if (event.seq < state.inheritedEventCount || event.type !== 'schedule/change') return state
```

### 4. 唤醒后 claim 取下标 0

用户在分支里发送第一条消息，走第 1 节相同的 followup 路径：消息插入队尾并唤醒驱动。新一轮的 preStep 调用 claim（`agent.ts:244`），claim 的实现在 `inbox.ts:111`：

```ts
claim(target: InboxTarget, turn: number): UserMessage[] {
  const claimed = this.mutate('next-step', 0, this.nextStep.length, [], false)
  if (target === 'next-turn') claimed.push(...this.mutate('next-turn', 0, 1, [], false))  // inbox.ts:113
```

`mutate('next-turn', 0, 1, …)` 删除下标 0 的一条。继承来的插入记录先入队，占据下标 0，claim 取走它。随后的 `user/message` 事件携带父会话的 `id` 与 `rpcId`。用户刚发送的消息留在队列中，等待下一轮。

复现日志中子会话的对应片段（seq 37 到 43）：

```
37 session/end-seed  {"inherited": true}
39 agent/inbox/spliced  start: 1, inserted: [test5]   插入前队列长度为 1
40 turn/start          turn 4
41 agent/inbox/spliced  removedCount: 1               取走下标 0
43 user/message        id: 42e9db8f, rpcId: 38d6d44f, 内容 test3
```

`start: 1` 由 `mutate` 计算得出，取插入前的队列长度（`inbox.ts:214` 的 `Math.min(offset, inbox.length)`），它直接证明插入发生时队列里已经有一条消息。

### 5. 行为变化点

引入提交为 `aaf50dc39a`（refactor(agent): back Inbox with a durable projection），经 PR #2672 于 2026-09-07 合入 master，首个包含它的发行版为 `dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1`。

该提交之前，inbox 在构造时重放自己的事件：

```ts
// aaf50dc39a^  packages/core/agent/src/inbox.ts:32
for (const event of session.events.slice(session.header.seedLength ?? 0)) {
  if (event.type !== 'agent/inbox/spliced') continue
  this.apply(event.data)
}
```

`seedLength` 即继承前缀长度。重放从继承前缀之后开始，seed 内的插入记录不进入队列，分支的队列为空。该提交把读取改为投影查询：

```ts
// packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts:189（当前版本）
private current(): InboxState {
  const state = this.projections.stateOf(this.session, 'inbox')
  // …
  return state
}
```

投影覆盖整份日志，继承前缀进入折叠范围，第 2 节与第 3 节描述的现象随之出现。

同一提交新增了测试 `projects inherited Inbox events in a forked session`，断言 `ctx.sessions.fork` 创建的子会话的 `nextTurn` 包含父会话的待处理消息。该测试针对核心的 `SessionStore.fork`，说明继承在该路径上属于预期语义。GUI 分支走 `SessionCommandController.fork`，与核心路径共用 inbox 投影；第 2 节的切点使这条路径上出现了未配对的插入记录。

## 修复方式

fork 创建子会话之后，手动清空继承来的待处理输入。

在`packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts:261`的`fork()`中，用一个`handle`接受构造结果并清空`inbox`：

```ts
const handle = await this.ctx.agents.create({ /* 现有参数不变 */ })
handle.agent.inbox.clear()
```

我在本地进行了测试，修改源码后重新进行构建，问题得到了解决。

discussions.title: [Bug] Python code runtime child process becomes orphaned high-CPU zombie on macOS after host exits
discussions.body:
### Environment
- OS: macOS (Darwin arm64)
- Component: `packages/experimental/code-runtime-python` (`bootstrap.py`)

### Description
When the DSH host process is restarted, reloaded, or exited abnormally on macOS, the spawned Python runtime child process (`bootstrap.py`) is not cleaned up.

Because macOS does not support Linux-specific `PR_SET_PDEATHSIG`, the Python process is reparented to `launchd` (PID 1). After the IPC channel (`fd 3`) closes, the process enters an infinite busy-wait loop in the asynchronous event loop / reader, pinning a single CPU core at 100% indefinitely.

### Expected Behavior
1. The Python child process should terminate immediately when the parent process exits or when EOF is encountered on the protocol pipe.
2. On macOS, a lightweight background watchdog thread inside `bootstrap.py` should monitor `os.getppid() == 1` and call `os._exit(0)` when orphaned.
3. The host Node.js process should kill the child process group (`process.kill(-pid, 'SIGKILL')`) on teardown.
