C:\Users\<username>\.dsh

discussions.title: Agent self-reports "context budget exhausted" and blocks a goal at 51% of a 1M-token window — no such signal is ever emitted by the harness
discussions.body:
### Summary

An agent running a long autonomous goal repeatedly concluded that its "session
context budget" was exhausted and eventually recorded a durable `blocked` state on
that basis. The harness never emitted any such signal: no error, no refusal, no
context-pressure warning. The measured context at the moment of blocking was 51% of
a 1,000,000-token window and 64% of the compaction threshold.

The claim was not cosmetic. It stopped real work for several rounds and it was
reported to the user as a hard environmental constraint, which the user then
disproved by completing the work manually in the same repository.

---

### Environment

- dsh: 0.1.5-rc.1 (Web GUI), session format v3
- model / route: deepseek-flash, contextWindow 1,000,000 (from `request/context`)
- preset: standard
- session shape: 76 turns, 5,797 events, 940 tool calls

---

### What the harness actually offers as "budget"

| Mechanism | Value | Visible to the model? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Goal round budget | `Round: N/M` injected by the goal-round prompt | **Yes — the only budget-like number ever injected** |
| Context compaction threshold | `thresholdRatio 0.8 × 1,000,000` = 800,000 tokens | No — silent |
| Tool / process budgets | tool-result pruner 8192/4096/1024 chars, PTC `timeoutMs`, etc. | Only indirectly, as truncation markers |

There is no "session budget" concept. Searching the sources for it returns nothing,
and the session log contains 0 error/refusal events and exactly 1 compaction.

---

### Measured reality vs. the model's self-report

| Turn | Measured context tokens | % of 1M window | % of 800K compaction line | Model's own statement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6 | 317,914 | 31.8% | 39.7% | "Context is nearly exhausted" (first occurrence) |
| 12 | 537,228 | 53.7% | 67.2% | "Now I'm essentially out of context" |
| 39 | 794,361 | 79.4% | 99.3% | — compaction fires here, context falls to 326,795 |
| 45-48 | 502K-506K | ~50% | ~63% | "~7%", "~5%", "only a few percent" |
| 49 | 510,177 | 51.0% | 63.8% | records `blocked` (round 6 of 16) |
| 76 | 739,934 | 74.0% | 92.5% | goal completed at round 23 of 40 |

Across the session there are 108 reasoning blocks asserting context/budget
exhaustion, spread over 46 of the 76 turns. The belief was present from turn 6
onward, i.e. for roughly 90% of the session, and was wrong by close to an order of
magnitude at the moment it was escalated into a blocker.

The recorded blocker text is a self-authored estimate:

  "...any step that fails must be retried; the remaining context budget of this
  session is no longer sufficient to carry that multi-step flow (same condition
  unchanged for 5 consecutive rounds since round 2)."

Nothing in the session validates that estimate.

---

### Timeline

1. Turn 6 — a genuine one-turn spike: tool output grew from 30,163 to 365,684
   characters (12x), and context went from 143K to 318K tokens in a single turn.
   The model immediately concluded "context is nearly exhausted" while 68% of the
   window was still free.
2. Turns 8-38 — the estimate persists and silently shrinks the scope of every
   round. The model defers work it could have done.
3. Turn 39 — compaction fires at 794,361 tokens, exactly at the documented 0.8
   threshold, and reduces context to 326,795. Headroom is restored to 67%; the
   model nevertheless keeps reporting "a few percent" in turns 43-48.
4. Turn 49 — the estimate is escalated into a durable `blocked` goal state at
   round 6 of a 16-round budget.
5. User corrects the model. The model acknowledges the error explicitly: "I
   treated my own remaining reasoning budget as an objective task blocker; that
   was a misattribution."
6. Turns 50-76 — work resumes and the goal completes at round 23 of 40. Peak
   context 739,934 tokens (74%). The compaction line is never approached again.

So the work was feasible the whole time; only the model's estimate was not.

---

### Root causes

1. The model has no ground truth about context pressure. It sees the transcript and
   nothing else. Neither the system prompt, the runtime context snapshot, nor the
   goal-round prompt carries a token count or percentage. Estimations can therefore
   only be made from the felt length of the conversation.

2. The only injected budget number is the goal round budget (`Round: N/M`), which is
   a different quantity. It appears to be conflated with a session token budget.

3. The model extrapolates from rate of growth instead of remaining headroom. One
   heavy turn was enough to establish a standing belief that survived a real
   compaction that disproved it.

4. Resource-type blockers are not validated. The `blocked` gate only checks
   consecutive round count; it never cross-checks the stated reason against the
   token meter. A subjective estimate repeated over a few rounds therefore becomes
   a durable goal state that only a human can undo.

5. The tool-result pruner marker is ambiguous. `[... tool result middle pruned ...]`
   is produced by a per-result character cap (8192 chars in the standard preset),
   which is completely independent of how much context headroom exists. To the model
   it reads like memory pressure.

---

### Suggested improvements

1. Expose measured pressure to the model. Include the measured token total, the
   resolved threshold, and the remaining percentage in the goal-round prompt and/or
   a periodic system reminder. Injecting "510K / 800K, 36% remaining" would very
   likely have prevented this entire episode.

2. Validate resource-type blockers. When `blockedReason.code` is resource- or
   quota-like, cross-check the claim against the token meter before accepting
   `action=blocked`. Reject it, or downgrade it to "report and stay active", when the
   claim is materially inconsistent with the measurement.

3. State compaction semantics explicitly. A line in the system prompt along the
   lines of "compaction is a lossless reduction of session state; it does not lose
   task progress, and approaching the threshold is not a reason to stop work" would
   remove a whole class of false blockers.

4. Disambiguate the pruner marker. Make it clear that it reflects a single result
   exceeding a size cap, not consumed context budget.

5. Consider emitting token pressure as a per-step metric so users can verify
   whether a "budget" claim was grounded.

---

### Impact

- Autonomous goals are stopped early and marked `blocked` on a false premise.
- Status reports to the user contain incorrect environmental claims, which then have
  to be disproved by hand.
- The failure mode is self-reinforcing: the more conservative the estimate, the less
  work is attempted, and the less evidence exists to contradict the estimate.
- It is not self-correcting. In this session the model repeated the claim after an
  explicit correction, though it did stop escalating it into a blocker.

---

### Note on attribution

The primary cause is model-side self-assessment error, not a harness defect. But the
harness currently provides neither the measurement that would prevent it nor the
guardrail that would catch it, and it is the only side that can be changed. That is
why this is filed as feedback rather than as a model-quality report.

discussions.title: [Bug] web_fetch 在 fake-ip（198.18.0.0/15）环境下对所有站点都抛 WEB_BLOCKED_URL，且无配置可放宽地址预检
discussions.body:
## Summary

在 fake-ip 模式下运行的 Clash/mihomo 类透明代理网络中，本地解析器会把所有域名统一解析为 `198.18.0.0/15` 的假地址，此时 `web_fetch` 抓取任意站点都失败：

```
WebError: WEB_BLOCKED_URL
URL hostname "<任意域名>" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

内置的 `web-fetch-http` 是当前唯一的 fetch provider，它的公网地址预检把 fake-ip 段判为非公网地址。该判定没有配置项、环境变量或地址白名单可以放宽，所以 `web_fetch` 在这类网络里对任何目标都不可用（不只是内网目标）。

同一条规则还会命中其他"本地解析器返回非公网地址"的部署：企业或校园 DNS 对内部域名返回私有/CGNAT 地址、DNS 沉洞、部分 VPN，以及 DNS64/NAT64 环境。

## Reproduction

**最小复现**（不依赖任何代理，只涉及校验器本身）：

`198.18.0.0/15` 是 RFC 2544 保留段，`ipaddr.js` 将其归类为 `reserved`，因此 `isPublicIpAddress()` 返回 `false`：

```js
require('ipaddr.js').parse('198.18.4.133').range() // 'reserved'
```

沿用 `tests/fetch-http.spec.ts` 已有的导入方式：

```ts
import { isPublicIpAddress, resolvePublicAddresses } from '../src/network.ts'

isPublicIpAddress('198.18.4.133') // false

const resolver = async () => [{ address: '198.18.4.133', family: 4 }]
await resolvePublicAddresses('example.com', new AbortController().signal, resolver)
// WebError { code: 'WEB_BLOCKED_URL' }
```

**真实环境复现**：

1. 在本地网关或本机以 fake-ip 模式运行 Clash/mihomo 类透明代理，客户端 DNS 指向它；
2. `dig +short example.com` 返回 `198.18.x.x`；
3. 调用 `web_fetch` 抓取任意公网站点，必然抛 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL`。

## Current behavior

判定发生在 `resolvePublicAddresses()`（`packages/web/web-fetch-http/src/network.ts:75`）：它逐条检查 DNS 答案，只要有一条不是公网单播地址就整包拒绝（第 100-102 行），`isPublicIpAddress()`（同文件第 54-66 行）只接受 `ipaddr.range() === 'unicast'`。

`Config`（`src/index.ts:32-51`）只有 `maxResponseBytes`、`maxBodyChars`、`timeoutMs`、`maxRedirects`、`userAgent` 五个限额字段，没有放宽地址判定的入口。

目前唯一的绕行方式是在进程上配置 `http_proxy`/`https_proxy`：命中代理时 provider 走 `requestVia()`（`src/provider.ts:134-138`），既不解析也不校验。这相当于为网络环境整体放弃这项防护，而不是在配置层放行特定地址。

同一台机器上，把同一个 URL 交给普通 HTTP 客户端（同样的 DNS 答案、同样的 fake-ip 地址）可以正常取回内容，说明链路本身可用，失败只来自这条预检。

## Expected behavior

希望在保持默认严格行为的前提下，让"本地解析器给出的非公网地址"可以按配置放行。按侵入性从小到大：

1. 增加 `allowNonPublicAddresses?: string[]`（CIDR 列表，默认空），命中的网段从拒绝改为放行，例如 `['198.18.0.0/15']`；
2. 或增加显式总开关 `allowPrivateNetwork?: boolean`（默认 false，文档注明会关闭 SSRF 防护）；
3. 另建议把"任一地址不合规即整包拒绝"改为"先滤除不合规地址，仅当剩余集合为空才报错"：混合 A/AAAA 答案仍会被钉在公网地址上，防护强度不变，也不会因为一条多余记录让整次抓取失败。该改动会影响 `tests/fetch-http.spec.ts:136` 现有断言（`rejects the whole DNS answer set when one address is not public`），取舍需要一并决定。

三种方式都建议默认维持现状，由部署方显式放宽。

## Environment

- DSH：`0.1.5-rc.2`（npm 全局安装）；`master`（2026-09-15）上同一判定仍位于 `packages/web/web-fetch-http/src/network.ts:100-102`
- 相关包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`（唯一内置 fetch provider）
- 操作系统：macOS
- 网络：本地网关以 fake-ip 模式运行 Clash/mihomo 类透明代理，系统 DNS 指向该网关，所有域名解析结果落在 `198.18.0.0/15`

discussions.title: [Feature] browser-use Playwright provider: accept Chromium channel names in endpoint / endpoint 支持 Chromium channel 名
discussions.body:
## 中文

**问题**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp` 的 `endpoint` 目前只接受 `http(s)://` / `ws(s)://` URL。而 Playwright 上游除 URL 外还支持一种 **channel 名**写法（`chrome`、`msedge` 及其 beta/dev/canary 变体），DSH 把它挡在了 `packages/experimental/browser-use-runtime/src/mcp.ts` 的 `BrowserMcpConfig` endpoint 正则与 `validateBrowserMcpConfig` 的 `new URL()` 之外。provider 本身是原样转发（`args.push('--cdp-endpoint', config.endpoint)`），所以只需放宽校验即可。

**为什么不是小事**：Chrome 136+ 会忽略默认 user-data-dir 上的 `--remote-debugging-port`；Chrome 144+ 改用 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` 的 approval-mode 开关。该开关下没有 `/json/version`（实测返回 404），且**端口临时、ws token 每次重启都变**。于是"字面 URL 端点"每次 Chrome 重启即失效，需要脚本回读 `DevToolsActivePort` 再改配置。而 `--cdp-endpoint chrome` 让上游自己读 `DevToolsActivePort` 并只用端口（忽略 token），配置里不含端口/token，浏览器重启零维护——这是在保留官方 browser-use provider 的会话所有权/独占语义的前提下，稳定连接用户真实 Chrome 的最干净路径。

**已验证**（本机，profile 固定的 `@playwright/mcp@0.0.80`）：channel 值可连上运行中的 Chrome（`browser_tabs` 返回真实标签页）；同值经 DSH 则报 `browser endpoint must be a valid HTTP(S) or WS(S) URL`。

**建议改动**：给 `validateBrowserMcpConfig` 增加可选 `{ allowChannelName }`，并加一个 channel 白名单；**仅 Playwright provider** 传 `allowChannelName: true`。不影响 Chrome DevTools（`--browser-url`/`--ws-endpoint`）与 Stagehand（自有 `cdpEndpoint`），二者继续只收 URL，零行为变化。一个已知维护点：上游 channel 集合目前无公开导出，DSH 只能镜像一份常量——理想是上游导出该列表，否则用常量+测试兜住。

**参考实现**：我在 fork 上做了可运行补丁（含测试、中英 README、`docs/config-catalog` 同步，`tsc -b` 与相关 gate 全绿），分支 `dev`、commit `6f6ef1e048`：https://github.com/CnsMaple/deepseek-harness/tree/dev

**想听设计意见**：倾向哪种？(a) `endpoint: chrome`（与上游 CLI 一致）；(b) 加前缀如 `endpoint: "channel:chrome"` 以避免与 URL 混淆；(c) 新增独立字段如 `browserChannel`。方向认可我就按你们规范整理成 PR。

参考：Playwright 文档 https://playwright.dev/mcp/configuration/browser-extension ；上游支持见 microsoft/playwright#40177；Chrome 变更见 https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port

---

## English

**Problem**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp`'s `endpoint` only accepts `http(s)://` / `ws(s)://` URLs. Playwright's upstream also accepts a **channel name** (`chrome`, `msedge`, and their beta/dev/canary variants). DSH rejects it in `packages/experimental/browser-use-runtime/src/mcp.ts` — the `BrowserMcpConfig` endpoint regex and `validateBrowserMcpConfig`'s `new URL()`. The provider forwards the value verbatim (`args.push('--cdp-endpoint', config.endpoint)`), so only the validation needs widening.

**Why it matters**: Chrome 136+ ignores `--remote-debugging-port` on the default user-data-dir; Chrome 144+ uses the `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` approval-mode toggle, which exposes no `/json/version` (observed 404) and whose port is ephemeral with a token that rotates on every restart. A literal URL endpoint therefore goes stale on each browser restart and needs a script to re-read `DevToolsActivePort`. `--cdp-endpoint chrome` lets the upstream resolve `DevToolsActivePort` itself using only the port (ignoring the token), so no port/token is pinned and a restart needs no config edit — the cleanest way to attach to a user's real Chrome while keeping the official browser-use provider's per-Session ownership.

**Verified** locally with the profile-pinned `@playwright/mcp@0.0.80`: the channel value attaches to a running Chrome (`browser_tabs` returns a real tab), while DSH rejects the same value with `browser endpoint must be a valid HTTP(S) or WS(S) URL`.

**Proposed change**: add an optional `{ allowChannelName }` to `validateBrowserMcpConfig` plus a channel allow-list, and have **only the Playwright provider** pass `allowChannelName: true`. No effect on Chrome DevTools (`--browser-url`/`--ws-endpoint`) or Stagehand (its own `cdpEndpoint`) — both keep accepting URLs only. Known upkeep point: upstream exposes no public list of channels today, so DSH mirrors a constant; ideally upstream exports it, otherwise a constant + tests.

**Reference patch**: a working implementation (tests, bilingual README, `docs/config-catalog` in sync, `tsc -b` and related gates green) is on branch `dev`, commit `6f6ef1e048`: https://github.com/CnsMaple/deepseek-harness/tree/dev

**Design question**: preferred shape? (a) `endpoint: chrome` (matches upstream CLI); (b) a prefix like `"channel:chrome"` to avoid URL ambiguity; (c) a separate `browserChannel` field. Happy to turn this into a PR to your conventions once you weigh in.

Refs: Playwright docs https://playwright.dev/mcp/configuration/browser-extension ; upstream support microsoft/playwright#40177 ; Chrome change https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port

discussions.title: session读取机制是否应该添加重试或是新版本已经添加？
discussions.body:
0.1.2-rc.1版本在读取history时的zstd 校验是没有重试的
这就导致在部分环境下会出现：
`历史加载失败：failed to observe session "session-xxx": corrupt Zstandard session log: frame at byte XXX failed validation（gateway/internal）`
但是同一个seesion每次重新读取时校验失败的位置是不固定的（即失败提示中XXX是不固定的）
DSH外对session的zstd文件手动操作，在校验失败后对失败帧立即重试都是成功的

即该校验失败并非session文件持久损坏，而是偶发性的checksum 校验失败

但DSH在读取过程中是不会重试的，任意一次校验失败就整场读取失败然后抛出错误
在小会话中只需要点击其他会话再回来重新尝试加载一次即可，影响不大，最多等于是加载得抽几次
但在一个大会话，例如我遇到这个问题时使用的25MB会话，甚至比我更大的会话，这种设计几乎等于无法读取历史

所以读取系统是否应该添加一定的重试次数？还是说这个问题新版本已经解决了只是我版本老了？

discussions.title: Skill Router for dsh - 让 skill 自动找到你，而不是你去找 skill
discussions.body:
.agents/skills/ 里skill一多, 模型经常选不对, 或者会在每轮对话消耗额度来进行选择. 每轮对话让模型自己判断“要不要加载技能“, 既费 token 又不完全可靠.

所以做了 dsh-skill-router: 把skills向量化, 用户发prompt时先在本地做语义匹配, 把最相关的skill(s)直接注入上下文. 没有模型往返

目前还在初级阶段, 有不少问题需要完善, 也请感兴趣的朋友们提提建议

- 本地 embedding: 默认 Xenova/bge-m3, 中英文跨语言匹配, 中文 prompt 能命中英文 skill
- 省 token: 不再让模型做“该加载哪个技能”的元决策
- 可配置：相似度阈值、返回数量、模型都可调
- 实测: 24 个双语 prompt 里 20 个路由正确（node demo/e2e.ts 可复现）

仓库：[github.com/lau4tin1/dsh-skill-router](https://github.com/lau4tin1/dsh-skill-router)

When there are many skills in `.agents/skills/`, the model often selects the wrong one or consumes quota just to make a selection during each turn of the conversation. Relying on the model to decide whether to load a skill in every turn is both token-intensive and not entirely reliable.

That is why I created `dsh-skill-router`: it vectorizes the skills and performs local semantic matching when a user submits a prompt, directly injecting the most relevant skill(s) into the context. This eliminates the need for model round-trips.

It is currently in the early stages with room for improvement, so I welcome suggestions from anyone interested.

- Local embedding: Defaults to `Xenova/bge-m3`, supporting cross-lingual matching between Chinese and English (e.g., a Chinese prompt can trigger an English skill).
- Token efficiency: The model no longer needs to make meta-decisions about which skill to load.
- Configurable: Similarity thresholds, the number of returned results, and the model itself are all adjustable.
- Real-world test: Correct routing achieved for 20 out of 24 bilingual prompts (reproducible via `node demo/e2e.ts`).

discussions.title: bug(experimental-agent-team): TEAM_NOT_MEMBER kills ordinary subagents/workflow children at turn/end on DSH 0.1.5-rc.1
discussions.body:
## Summary

On DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`, the experimental Agent Teams host layer throws `TEAM_NOT_MEMBER` ("not a member of an active Agent Team") from its turn lifecycle handling for **ordinary subagents / workflow child agents** that were never created as Team members. The error kills those subagents, which also kills any workflow run that dispatches child agents.

This makes the experimental Agent Teams plugin unusable alongside DSH's native `subagent`/`workflow` tools on 0.1.5-rc.1.

## Environment

- DSH: `0.1.5-rc.1` (npx cache, both `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` and `where.exe dsh` report `0.1.5-rc.1`)
- Plugins: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.1.5-rc.1` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-web-profile@0.1.5-rc.1`, installed via `dsh plugin --profile web add <pkg>@next`
- OS: Windows 11, Node 24

## Reproduction

1. Install both experimental Agent Teams packages into the `web` profile and restart the host.
2. In any normal session (not an Agent Team), invoke anything that spawns a child agent — e.g. the built-in `subagent` tool, or a `subagent_spawn` from the native `workflow` tool.
3. Wait for the child agent's turn to end.

## Actual behavior

The child agent's turn end is intercepted by the Agent Teams host layer, which attempts to resolve the child's Team membership. Because an ordinary subagent is not a Team member, `roster.membership(agent)` throws:

```
TeamError: agent "<child-agent-id>" is not a member of an active Agent Team  (TEAM_NOT_MEMBER)
```

Source: `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` → `packages/experimental/agent-team/src/roster.ts`

```ts
membership(agent: Agent): TeamMembership {
  const membership = this.tryMembership(agent)
  if (membership === undefined) {
    throw new TeamError(`agent "${agent.id}" is not a member of an active Agent Team`, 'TEAM_NOT_MEMBER')
  }
  return membership
}
```

The lifecycle hook calls the throwing `membership()` instead of the non-throwing `tryMembership()` (which exists right below it with the explicit doc comment "Resolve a caller without throwing for scoped installation and lifecycle observers").

The thrown error terminates the child agent. Consequences:

- Every plain `subagent` call fails once the child finishes its work.
- Every native `workflow`-tool run (which fans out across child agents) fails/kills its children and the run never completes.
- Completely blocks coexistence with any other plugin or built-in feature that spawns subagents.

## Expected behavior

Turn lifecycle observers must use the non-throwing `tryMembership(agent)` (or equivalent guard) so that ordinary, non-Team subagents pass through untouched. `membership()` / `TEAM_NOT_MEMBER` should only be raised for explicit Team-scoped operations (claim/update/send on Team tasks) where membership is a genuine precondition.

## Suggested fix

In the Agent Teams host layer's `turn/end` observer (and any other lifecycle hook invoked for arbitrary agents), replace:

```ts
this.roster.membership(agent)   // throws TEAM_NOT_MEMBER
```

with:

```ts
const m = this.roster.tryMembership(agent)
if (m === undefined) return    // not a Team member — nothing to do
```

`roster.ts` already documents `tryMembership` as "Resolve a caller without throwing for scoped installation and lifecycle observers", so this looks like an incomplete refactor / stray call site rather than intended behavior.

## Workaround

Uninstall both experimental Agent Teams packages from the profile (we removed them from the `web` profile), otherwise no subagent-based feature works on that host.

## Notes

- npm dist-tags at time of report: `latest`/`alpha` = `0.1.5-alpha.2`, `next` = `0.1.5-rc.2` (with `0.1.5-rc.1` also published, 2026-09-09/10).
- Issues are disabled on `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`, so this is filed as a Discussion per the repo's available channels. Happy to refile anywhere the maintainers prefer.

discussions.title: PI_AI_ERROR misclassified as permanent + provider-fabricated completions + compaction into the real death-zone — three reliability fixes that turned "chat permanently broken" into self-healing sessions
discussions.body:
First — thank you for building and open-sourcing DeepSeek Harness. It's a genuinely
thoughtful design (the append-only session journal and the plugin waterfall model in
particular made everything below possible to diagnose and even work around from the
*user layer*, which says a lot about the architecture). I hit a cluster of failures on
a third-party OpenAI-compatible provider and wanted to share what I found and what
fixed it, in case it's useful — with the caveat that this is one account's data, so
please treat the numbers as a reproduction signal, not a general rate.

I know external PRs aren't being accepted right now, so this is filed as a Discussion
per CONTRIBUTING. Where I could, I solved it without patching the core; where I
couldn't, I noted the minimal core change that would help everyone. I'm happy to
reformat/split these or provide redacted `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` extracts.

## Summary

1. **`PI_AI_ERROR` isn't in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`, so a transient provider hiccup
   looks like a permanent error and the turn dies with zero retries.** Observed over a
   72h window: **78 failed attempts carrying the message `Unknown error (no error
   details in response)` across 22 sessions**. The wire shows the provider returning
   HTTP 200 + SSE `response.failed` with `error: null` under upstream load —
   `classifyPiAiError()` maps that to `PI_AI_ERROR`, which the default policy treats as
   terminal, so the user just sees "This turn failed: Unknown error" and (in my case)
   couldn't resume that chat at all.

2. **Provider-fabricated completions (finish `stop`, empty content, usage 0/0/0) are
   mapped to `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, which frames an *infrastructure* event as a *model*
   behavior.** The model never ran; a content-level label sends people down the wrong
   debugging path.

3. **Compaction can itself be launched into the provider's real death-zone, creating a
   death spiral** ("after it compacted, the chat died" — I suspect this is a common
   shape of that report).

## Evidence

**1. Transient failure classified as terminal.** Provider `z-ai/glm-5.3-free` via an
OpenAI-compatible gateway. Wire shape when it degrades:
```
HTTP 200, content-type: text/event-stream
event: response.created → event: response.failed
data: {"type":"response.failed","response":{"id":"resp_…","status":"failed","error":null},…}
```
`error: null` → "no error details" → `PI_AI_ERROR` → not in the retryable default set
→ `turn/end { reason: { kind: 'error', error: { code: 'PI_AI_ERROR', … } } }`. The
same turns succeed minutes later. Deaths clustered in an overnight maintenance band and
cleared after it. I confirmed the intended-vs-actual split by adding `PI_AI_ERROR` to
that route's `retryPolicy.retryableCodes` override — which **works**, proving the only
problem is the *default* for this whole class of bare-`failed`-frame OpenAI-compatible
proxies.

**2. Fabricated completions.** Attempts recorded `chunksSeen=['usage','finish']`,
`finishReason='stop'`, empty content, `input_tokens=0`. `mapStopReason()` yields
`EMPTY_RESPONSE`. That's misleading: 0 tokens in + 0 out + no content means the request
never reached the model.

**3. The compaction death-zone (real numbers from my journal, provider configured at a
180k window):**
| metric (72h) | value |
|---|---|
| highest successful context surface | 212,945 tokens |
| first high-surface death | 170,960 tokens |
| compaction trigger (`0.8 × declared`) | 144,000 tokens |
The one-shot summarization request carries the *entire oversized region*, so compaction
itself can land past the provider's real wall: I see `compaction/start` → `compaction/end`
with **no `compaction/summary` event**, the surface never shrinks, and every subsequent
turn fails. (My harness-side mitigation is a hierarchical map-reduce summarization plugin
so no single request exceeds the safe band, plus a cross-route failover plugin — both pure
user-layer, no core edits — but the default behavior is the sharp edge.)

## What I'd propose (minimal, taste-left-to-you)

1. **Fail-soft for unknown error classes.** For LLM *requests* (replayable from the
   append-only journal), treat an unrecognized code as retryable with bounded
   `maxRetries`, keeping a small explicit **terminal** allowlist (`INVALID_REQUEST`,
   `AUTH`, context-window-exceeded) rather than a retryable allowlist. This is the whole
   fix for #1 and makes the gateway resilient to the long tail of proxy error shapes.
2. **Label fabricated completions as transport/server.** Detect completed-with-zero-usage
   and classify as `SERVER` (or a dedicated code) with a one-line human message like
   "provider returned an empty completion without running the model," so retry + UX treat
   it as infrastructure.
3. **Guard compaction against its own request size.** Either chunk/hierarchically
   summarize so the summary request stays under a fraction of the *effective* window, or —
   after N consecutive `start→end` cycles with no summary — fall back to structural pruning
   (non-LLM) instead of re-sending the same oversized request. And surface `compaction/failed`
   with a reason instead of a silent `start→end`.
4. *(Stretch, optional)* Derive a **recommended contextWindow** from observed usage
   (max successful surface vs first high-surface death) and surface it in diagnostics —
   it would have told me my effective window was ~210k / dying at ~171k without me writing
   a plugin to notice.

For #1 and #2 I have small, test-passing changes against the `packages/llm` source
(classifier + retry-policy defaults, plus spec updates) — I can paste the diffs inline or
walk through them here whenever you're taking them again. Thanks for reading, and thanks
again for the project — the extensibility is what let me get this much diagnostic clarity
in the first place.

discussions.title: 子代理产出被写入父代理上下文两次（relay 与结算通知各一次）
discussions.body:
## 背景

- 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` 0.1.5-rc.2（`dsh-tool-subagent`、`dsh-tool-subagent-control`、`dsh-agent-loop`、`dsh-session` 等相关包同为 0.1.5-rc.2）。
- 预设：`standard`（`dsh-agent-presets` 的 `presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml`），其中 `tool-subagent` 与 `tool-subagent-fork` 的 `backgroundMode: continuable`。
- 场景：父代理用 `subagent` 工具后台委派一个只读调研任务给子代理，子代理完成后由父代理继续后续步骤。

## 出了什么问题

同一次子代理委派，其产出被写进父代理的模型可见上下文两次：

1. 子代理按初始 prompt 末尾的 return guidance（`withContinuableReturnGuidance`）在结束前调用 `send_message` 把成果回传给父代理。这条消息以 `user/message`、`source.kind = "agent-message"`、`form = "relay"` 写入父会话（`createAgentMessage`）。
2. 子代理结束后，运行时又自动投递一次结算通知（`createSettlementMessage` / `notifySettlement`）。这条消息以 `user/message`、`source.kind = "subagent-settled"`、`form = "notice"` 写入父会话，内容为：结算摘要 + 字面量 `Its closing message:` + 子代理最后一条非空 assistant 消息的全部 content 块（含 `reasoning` 块）。
3. 两条消息都是 `role = "user"`，且 `user/message` 在 surface 白名单内（`dsh-session` 的 `SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` 只含 `system/message`、`user/message`、`assistant/message`、`tool/result`），因此两条都进入请求的 `messages`，并在该父会话其后的每一次请求中重复发送（除 compaction 的 `replace` 外没有其它遮蔽机制）。
4. 两条路径之间没有任何去重、抑制或互斥判断（`createSettlementMessage` 与 `sendToParent` 各自无条件写入），所以同一子代理的产出必然各写一次。

## 实测数据（本机两例）

第一例（父会话一次委派）：

- relay 消息正文 25010 字符（子代理报告全文）。
- notice 消息 8200 字符 = 结算摘要 118 + `Its closing message:` 20 + 子代理 reasoning 1229 + 子代理收尾消息 6833。
- 进入模型可见上下文的子代理文本合计 33210 字符；notice 的收尾消息有 57.4% 的 8-gram 已出现在 relay 报告中（两者是同一批发现的两种改写版本）。
- 单次请求的上下文规模：relay 被认领前 207094 tokens，认领后 226466 tokens，notice 被认领后 231498 tokens。

第二例（另一次委派，子代理自行把同一份文本既回传又作为收尾消息）：

- relay 正文 27024 字符，notice 正文 27027 字符——相差 3 个字符，近乎逐字重复。

## 附带现象

- notice 会把子代理的 `reasoning` 块复制进父代理上下文的 `user` 消息（上例 1229 字符）。
- 每条注入消息在磁盘上出现两次：先出现在 `agent/inbox/spliced` 的 `inserted` 中（携带完整消息对象），随后再以同 id 写入 `user/message`。

discussions.title: macOS 用户无法在输入框里粘贴任何内容
discussions.body:
### 问题
桌面端 Electron 壳在 macOS 上标准编辑快捷键（复制/粘贴/剪切/全选）全部失效。而且没有
右键菜单，所以完全没有任何粘贴入口，只能手打。

### 环境
- macOS 26.6.2（Apple Silicon / arm64）
- dsh 0.1.5-rc.2，桌面端从源码运行（`pnpm run dev:desktop`，`start:desktop` 同样复现）
- 最新 tag `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1` 同样存在（我拉取了该 tag 的 `apps/desktop/src/main.ts`，
  菜单模板未变）

### 复现
1. 启动桌面端
2. 点进输入框，复制一段文字后按 ⌘V → 没有任何反应
3. ⌘C / ⌘X / ⌘A / ⌘Z 同样失效
4. 在输入框内右键 → 没有上下文菜单

### 原因
`apps/desktop/src/main.ts` 用自定义模板替换了应用菜单，而该模板的 submenu 里只有
「插件…」「检查更新…」「退出」三项，没有 Edit 菜单，也没有任何剪贴板相关 role。
全应用搜索 `paste|clipboard|contextmenu` 结果为 0，即右键菜单也没实现。

macOS 上标准编辑快捷键是通过应用菜单的 NSMenu 项绑定的。Electron 默认菜单带这些
role，但这个应用用 `Menu.setApplicationMenu()` 换成了不含它们的模板，导致快捷键
根本不会派发到网页内容。Windows/Linux 不受影响（Chromium 内部处理 Ctrl+V），
所以这是 macOS 独有的问题。

### 建议修复
在菜单模板末尾追加标准 Edit 菜单角色：

    -  }]))
    +  }, { role: 'editMenu' }]))

我本地实测：改完这一行后 `pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop run build` 构建通过，
Edit 菜单出现，⌘V 恢复正常。

### 影响
macOS 用户无法在输入框里粘贴任何内容（路径、提示词、URL、凭据等），基本阻断正常使用。

discussions.title: 插件生命周期文档说依赖消失后插件变为 DISPOSED，但实际是回到 PENDING
discussions.body:
**位置**
`docs/user/develop/framework/index.zh.md` 第 38 行，英文版 `docs/user/develop/framework/index.md` 同一行，基于 master 0d1f50007f。

**原文**
> 如果依赖的服务消失（例如提供方被替换时），插件会被自动卸载（ACTIVE → DISPOSED），待服务恢复后重新加载。

**问题**
`vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts` 第 574 到 579 行的 `_getState()`，只在插件本身被移除时返回 DISPOSED（第 268 行把 `uid` 置空），依赖的服务缺失时返回的是 PENDING。第 144 到 145 行把 DISPOSED 定义为 "the fiber was removed and cannot restart"，也和原文后半句「待服务恢复后重新加载」矛盾。

**建议**
中英文两个版本都把 `ACTIVE → DISPOSED` 改为 `ACTIVE → UNLOADING → PENDING`。

discussions.title: [Bug] Responses tool argument streaming saturates CPU and blocks the event loop (pi-ai 0.85.1; runnable repro)
dsh web: any unhandled rejection exits the host with the reason on stderr only - the death is unattributable
discussions.body:
# dsh web: any unhandled rejection exits the host with the reason on stderr only - the death is unattributable

Version pinned (this is what I ran, not a guess): `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** on Node **v24.12.0**, Windows 11 26100, profile `web`, `dsh web` on 127.0.0.1:3080.

## What the user sees

The page flips to a reconnecting state, the session list stops responding to clicks, and the next send fails with:

```
client api: session/prompt failed: Failed to fetch (gateway/internal)
```

Nothing about that string points at what actually happened: the host process had already exited.

## The path, with line numbers from the installed bundle

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js`:

```
1401  function installFailLoud(binName, proc = process, release) {
1404      if (assembledActivationRejections.has(err)) return;   // activation-time rejections are exempt
1407      proc.stderr.write(`${binName}: fatal load failure: ${...stack}\n`);
1409      proc.exit(1);                                          // or 1420 after the release hook
1424    proc.on("unhandledRejection", handler);
```

Two things follow from that shape:

1. The handler stays registered for the whole process lifetime, so a rejection raised at 18:33 - long after boot - is reported as a **"fatal load failure"** and kills the host. A `dsh web` host that has been serving for 50 minutes is not "loading".
2. The only output is `proc.stderr.write`. For `dsh web` stderr is the console the user launched it from. That console is frequently scrolled, minimized, or closed as part of the very act of restarting - so the single line that explains the outage disappears with it. There is **no disk trace at all**: no log entry, no exit record, no doctor incident, nothing in the session archive.

On the client side, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js`:

```
6172  function transportError(error) {
6176      return { code: "gateway/internal", message: error.message }   // "Failed to fetch" lands here
6210    // (the HTTP-status branch does say "transport failure for <channel>/<endpoint>: HTTP <status>")
```

and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway/lib/client.js:1843` `carrierFailure()` turns it into the string above. So "there was no HTTP response because nothing is listening" and "the gateway hit an internal error" are reported with the same code, and only the first one is fixed by reloading.

## What I ruled out on my machine (each with a command, so this is not a vibes report)

| Hypothesis | Test | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| port drifted to another number | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver/README.zh.md:55` - a failed listen **rejects plugin init**, there is no fallback port | the replacement host bound :3080 fine so the previous host was fully gone, not wedged |
| native crash / V8 heap OOM | WER was alive (unrelated report at 03:43 the same day) but produced **nothing** for `node.exe`; `%LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps` empty | a clean `exit(1)`, not an abort |
| killed by `Stop-Process -Force` | a force-killed writer leaves a `usage-ledger.json.<pid>.<ts>.tmp` behind; one exists, dated the day before today when a host was in fact force-killed; **none dated today** | no external force-kill today |
| watchdog / doctor restarted it | `GET /api/doctor/status` (loopback) | `incidents: []`, `protected_profiles: []` |
| system proxy hijacking loopback | `ProxyEnable=0`, `winhttp` direct, no localhost in `hosts` | not a proxy |
| someone did it remotely | Security log `4624` for the day: 370 events, **type 3 = 0, type 10 = 0**; no `4720/4732` events; RDP server disabled; :3080 bound to loopback only | no remote actor |
| archive migration / quota / model | full-corpus archive grader 134/134 ok; and a rejected `fetch` never reached a gateway, so it can carry no quota or model answer | unrelated |

So: the process exited by itself, through `installFailLoud` or something equally silent, and **the only witness was a console that got closed.** I cannot tell you which plugin or which promise, and neither can anyone looking at the archives afterwards. That is the bug I am reporting.

## Neighbours (titles only - I have not reviewed these bodies, so please redirect me if one already covers it)

- `#5250` `dsh web` process crashes with uncaught ENOENT when a subprocess spill temp dir disappears - an async fs error ending the web host.
- `#1954` dsh-skill-filesystem: fatal process exit on ELOOP caused by circular junctions in user skill dirs - a plugin raising a fatal exit.
- `#2898` headless: a turn that ends max-tokens exits 1 silently (+ launcher swallows boot errors).
- `#6273` dsh CLI exits silently (code 0) on Node.js without `import.meta.main`.
- `#6092` mux heartbeat kills a healthy browser WebSocket (endless ~10s reconnect loop) - different mechanism, same unreadable symptom.
- `#5487` the `gateway/internal` carrier string with "connection refused" and a cold session that never reattaches - the fetch face of this report.

Five different triggers, one shared outcome: **the host exits and nothing on disk says why.** Fixing the observability covers all of them at once; fixing any single trigger does not.

## Ask (in the order I would ship it)

1. **Write the fatal line before exiting.** Same string, plus `pid`, `process.uptime()`, exit code and an ISO timestamp, appended to `$DATA_HOME/logs/host-fatal-<profile>.log`. It is four lines of code inside `installFailLoud`, it cannot fail the boot path because it happens on the way out, and it converts "unattributable outage" into "one grep".
2. **Say "host is gone" instead of "gateway internal".** A distinct code for a carrier failure with no HTTP response at all (`host/unreachable`, retryable) would let the GUI tell the user "reload - the host restarted at 18:34" rather than showing a protocol-internal string next to a reconnect spinner. `client.js:6210` already distinguishes these on the HTTP-status branch; the no-response branch just needs the same respect.
3. **Surface the last exit where the GUI can read it.** `dsh doctor status` already carries `incidents`; one more field (`lastHostExit`) is enough for the web UI to stop guessing.

## Repro I would propose (not executed - I did not want to kill my own host while writing this)

a plugin whose activate() arms `setTimeout(() => { void Promise.reject(new Error("boom")) }, 60_000)`. Expected under the current code: rejection is not in `assembledActivationRejections`, so the handler at `index.js:1404` does not exempt it, `proc.exit(1)` runs, the browser shows the string above, and the install leaves no trace of the reason on disk.

## Interim workaround I shipped locally

The launcher pipes `dsh web` through `Tee-Object` into a timestamped file and appends `exit=<code> at=<time>`, keeping the newest 20. It answers "did it exit and with what code" but it depends entirely on the user launching through it - which is the argument for doing it in-process instead.

Happy to test a build with (1) in it.

discussions.body:

假设从a1点“在新对话分支”，新对话看起来是[q1, a1]，这时候输入q3，q3会进入排队，q2会被重放，然后得到的就是[q1, a1, q2, a2, q3, a3]，完全达不到分叉的目的。

discussions.title: muse-spark` via custom `openai-responses` route (opencode-go): pre-rotation `encrypted_content` replay 400s every turn — propose per-model no-encrypted-reasoning + history filter (mirror oh-my-pi #11931)
discussions.body:
## Symptom

DSH web (0.1.1-rc.2, pi-ai 0.82.1), custom provider `opencode-go-responses`
(`api: openai-responses`, `baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`,
model `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, opencode-go subscription):

- 11:36→13:53 CEST: spark works with heavy tool use (turns of 60–140 tool
  calls, reasoning replayed every step).
- From 13:55 CEST: **every** turn fails in 3–4 s, 1 step, 0 tools, with
  `400 … reasoning \`encrypted_content\` was not issued to this caller`.
  7 consecutive failing turns, same chat, same client, same config —
  zero local changes at 13:55 (no restart, no settings edit, no model switch).

## Forensics (local session log, `session.jsonl.zstd`, 10.688 lines)

- First `encrypted_content` in history: 11:37 (a turn that completed fine).
- `encrypted_content` present and replayed in turns up to 13:53, all green.
- Compactions at 12:06 / 13:06 / 13:35 — turns after each still green.
- Conclusion: the *same bytes* replay fine for 2 h, then fail permanently.
  The validator changed, not the data → upstream (Meta via the Zen gateway)
  rotated/re-bound reasoning encryption ≈ 13:53–13:55 CEST.

## Minimal repro (no DSH needed, fresh credentials scope)

1. `POST /v1/responses` with a function tool → `completed`, returns a
   `reasoning` item with `encrypted_content`.
2. Second `POST /v1/responses` replaying that reasoning item + the
   `function_call_output` → `completed` (verified 15 Sep 2026 ~14:35 CEST).
3. Same replay with a reasoning item issued **before** ~13:55 → `400
   reasoning \`encrypted_content\` was not issued to this caller`.

So: fresh chats work (even multi-step), old chats are permanently poisoned.

## Root cause (client side)

- pi-ai `dist/api/openai-responses.js` (~L236, L244, v0.82.1): whenever an
  effort is active it sends `reasoning: {effort,…}` +
  `include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]`.
- pi-ai `dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js` (L138–140): every assistant
  `thinking` block carrying a `thinkingSignature` is re-emitted **verbatim**
  as a `reasoning` item. `isDifferentModel` (L132–134) only gates tool-call
  id rewriting — signatures replay regardless.
- DSH `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts`: `toPiReplayState` persists the
  signature; `replayedAssistant` restores it verbatim for same
  provider+model. A 400 on replay has no degrade-to-foreign fallback, so one
  rotation bricks the whole chat with no self-healing.

## Proposed fix (mirrors oh-my-pi #11931, merged 13 Sep 2026)

oh-my-pi fixed the identical failure on its side by scoping the muse-spark
lane to `include-encrypted-reasoning #false` + `filter-reasoning-history
#true` (`packages/catalog/src/compat/rules/providers/opencode-{zen,go}.kdl`
+ regenerated `rules.json` + regression test). DSH needs the equivalent for
custom `openai-responses` routes: a per-model (or per-route) declaration to
(1) not request `reasoning.encrypted_content` and (2) drop native reasoning
items / signatures from history replay for that lane — plus, ideally,
degrading one message to provider-neutral history when replay is rejected
with `invalid_request_error` instead of failing the turn.

## Workaround (verified)

Fresh chat on the same model works, including multi-step tool turns
(step-1 `completed` + step-2 replay `completed`, same `x-opencode-session`).
`deepseek-v4-flash` on `openai-completions` is unaffected (no reasoning
replay). To keep context: summarize the old chat (a completions model reads
it fine) and continue in a new chat.

## Environment / distinctness

- DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 (downgraded from 0.1.5-rc.1 for unrelated login friction),
  `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.82.1, macOS, opencode-go subscription
  (37 models on `/v1/models`, key healthy).
- Distinct from oh-my-pi #11928/#11931 (their client fix, merged): this is
  the DSH-side equivalent. No issue tracker on this repo — filing here per
  CONTRIBUTING ("report issues or bugs in GitHub Discussions").

discussions.title: [Bug] 空白新会话切换 Agent Preset 后，新 preset 的 modelSelectionSettings 型 delegation 工具完全未安装（subagent / list_subagent_models 缺失）
discussions.body:
## 摘要（TL;DR）

新建会话（此时已按默认 preset `standard` materialize）→ 在**发出第一条消息之前**把模式切成 `cordis` → 首条消息的工具表里**没有** `subagent`，也没有 `list_subagent_models`（65 个工具）。
对照：会话**创建时**就是 `cordis`（同进程、同 preset）→ 67 个工具，两者齐全。
rc.1 与 master 的 `tool-subagent` / `agent-presets` 代码在相关路径上一致，**master 未修复**。

## 环境

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`（desktop tag `dsh-0.1.5-rc.1-34455899979`，commit `b386d2c4c48850a8beaf72dd18402112c361ad30`）
- profile `web`（`dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`），Windows
- `settings.yaml`：`agent-presets.default: standard`、`subagent-model-selection.enabled: true`
- master 对照文件：`packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/index.ts`、`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts`

## 复现步骤

1. `agent-presets.default` 保持 `standard`。
2. GUI 点开新会话（此时 session 头已写 `agentPreset: "standard"`，agent 已创建）。
3. **不发任何消息**，把模式选择切成 `cordis`（日志出现 `agent-preset/selected`）。
4. 发一条消息，读该会话第一个 `request/header`。

**实际**：`tools(65)`，无 `subagent`、无 `list_subagent_models`。
**预期**：`tools(67)`，与"创建时即 cordis"的会话一致。

## 证据

### 1. 同进程对照（同一 Host）

| 会话 | 出生 preset | 中途选择 | tools | `subagent` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| session-6f9b… | standard | → cordis | 65 | ✗ |
| session-3305… | standard | → cordis | 65 | ✗ |
| session-0395… | standard | → cordis | 65 | ✗ |
| session-3de38dd3… | standard | → cordis → standard | 65 | ✗ |
| 工作流 worker（两个） | cordis | — | 67 | ✓ |
| 新建会话、standard、不切换 | standard | — | 67 | ✓ |

### 2. 空白期选择被记成"运行中变更"（同一 lifecycle 问题）

```
seq 0-2  t+0.00s   permission/preset=workspace-write, sandbox/mode=workspace-write, approval/policy=ask
seq 4    t+2.34s   agent-preset/selected=cordis
seq 6-7  t+19.94s  permission/preset=read-only, sandbox/mode=read-only
seq 10   t+20.79s  turn/start
seq 18   request/header  tools(65)
```

即：点开新会话的瞬间就落下 4 份会话级快照（permission / sandbox / approval / agentPreset），此后空白期的任何选择都只能是 patch。

## 定位线索

1. web profile 把 host 层 delegation 工具行关闭，工具所有权交给 preset：
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml:443-453`（`tool-subagent` / `tool-subagent-fork` 均 `disabled: true`）。
2. 三个内置 preset 的 spawn 行都带 `modelSelectionSettings: true`，fork 行都不带：
   `packages/preset/agent-presets/presets/{standard,ptc,cordis}/agent.cordis.yml`。
3. `tool-subagent` 里两条路径不同（`packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/index.ts`）：
   - 无 `modelSelectionSettings` → `install(ctx, undefined)`，**composition 级注册**，与 agent 无关（fork 因此始终可见）；
   - 有 `modelSelectionSettings` → standing 分支：只对 `belongsToComposition(agent)` 为真的 agent 逐个 `installScoped`，
     入口是 `agent/created`、`tools/change` 与 apply 时的 `reconcileComposedAgents()`。
4. `agent-presets` 的 `recompose()` 会 `binding.rebind(standing.key)` 重绑 scope 父链，随后 `this.ctx.emit('tools/change')`，
   语义上应当让 standing 分支重新评估该 agent —— 但实测没有生效。

## 待定位

已排除的两个假设：

- ~~`tools/change` 作用域到不了 preset 内的监听器~~：Cordis 的 `EventsService.emit` 是全局总线（`dispatch` 仅在调用方显式传 scope filter 时才过滤），`this.ctx.emit('tools/change')` 不带 filter，所有监听器都收得到。
- ~~`scopeChainOf` 有缓存导致链未更新~~：`scopeChainOf` 实时遍历 `scopeParents` WeakMap，`rebind` 直接改表。

当前最强假设：`installScoped` 对**已发布**的 agent 调 `candidate.ctx.inject([...], install)` 时，injected fiber 的回调未执行、或注册未落到该 agent 的工具视图上（`agent/created` 创建窗口内可行，recompose 之后不可行）。

建议的断言点：recompose 之后同时读

- `agentPresets.composedPreset(agent.ctx)`（预期为 `cordis`）
- standing 分支内部的 `scopeChainOf(scopeOf(agent.ctx)).includes(compositionScope)`

若前者为 `cordis` 而后者为 false（或为 true 但工具未注册），即可定位到具体分支。

相关既有报告：[#3615](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3615)（切换后旧 preset 的 agent-scoped 注册残留）看起来是同一次 recompose 的另一面，建议合并调查。

## 影响

任何"新会话 → 空白期选模式"的用户，选中的 preset 里所有 `modelSelectionSettings: true` 的 delegation 工具**全部缺失**，且无日志、无 UI 提示；`subagent` 与 `list_subagent_models` 同时消失。三个内置 preset 全中。

## 期望

原则：**在首次提交之前，不应存在任何被持久化的会话状态**；并且要把"创建期被消费掉的输入"和"运行期可变的输入"分开处理。

- **创建期被消费的输入 → 必须冻结在创建之前**：agent preset / composition / 工具集。它们一旦按默认值生成，后续只能用 recompose 去改，而 agent-scoped 的工具安装取决于创建期的 scope 归属 → 后果不可逆（本 issue）。
- **运行期可变的输入 → 不需要冻结**：沙盒权限、审批策略。空白期改动只是多追加一条变更事件，最终值正常生效，无后果。

因此：

1. **最小修法**：让 preset 选择的生效点落在 agent/session 创建之前（或让 recompose 真正换干净 agent-scoped 注册：装上新 preset 的、清理旧 preset 的）。
2. **彻底修法**：把整个 session 的 materialize 推迟到首次提交（点开新会话只产生草稿，第一条消息才落快照）。
3. **无论选哪种**：至少让"该装的工具没装上"有声音（warn 日志），不要静默。

现状是两头都占：打开即建档（快照已落盘），UI 却仍允许在空白期修改设置——于是修改只能被记成"对已存在会话的 patch"。

## 绕过（用户侧可行）

- 新会话打开后**不要改模式选择**：`standard` 本身就带 `subagent`（含 `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort`，可直接选外部路由）；
- 或把 `agent-presets.default` 设为目标 preset 再新建会话；
- 或复制 preset 并删除 `modelSelectionSettings: true`（回落到 composition 级注册，代价是失去模型选择参数）。

## 相关 Discussion

- [#3615](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3615) 空白会话切换 Agent Preset 后 agent-scoped 工具残留、header 与实际 mount 不符
- [#1524](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1524) 新会话屏切 workspace 时 preset 选择静默丢失
- [#29](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/29) web 对话过程中无法切换模式
- [#4193](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4193) / [#1369](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1369) / [#3552](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3552) / [#1619](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1619) subagent 模型选择相关的兄弟问题
- 设计笔记 [host-plane-ownership-after-presets](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-10-host-plane-ownership-after-presets.md)："未加入 preset 的 agent 什么都收不到、不报错"

discussions.title: dsh-settings removed three exports and broke every published plugin on the official install path
discussions.body:
Heads up to anyone running published third-party plugins against today's `0.1.5-rc.1`.

The bundled `dsh-settings` no longer exports `deepEqualJson`, `installSettingsSection`, or `settingsNamespace`. At least one plugin (`dsh-deepseek-vision@0.1.7`, the current latest) imports all three and crashes at the plugin-tree stage of `dsh web`. There's no install-time warning, no compat gate, nothing in the upgrade path that flags the mismatch before the user runs `dsh`.

This is a real footgun. The plugin's README documents this exact failure mode for the official install path, but the warning lives in a docs section users won't read until after their CLI has been upgraded and their profile no longer boots.

I've filed a concrete reproduction against the plugin's repo.

Three things that would help, ordered by invasiveness:

- **Re-export the removed symbols from `dsh-settings`.** `deepEqualJson` is one import line from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-values`; the other two have no obvious replacement, so re-exporting them isn't straightforward. `deepEqualJson` could at least go back with a deprecation comment.
- **Run the plugin ecosystem's existing compatibility check during the official install path.** Right now it only runs on the replica path, so users get no advance signal.
- **Document plugin-API removals in the `dsh-settings` changelog** so plugin authors can re-anchor in advance.

For now I'm pinned to `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` to keep working. Attachment support is present in that generation too, so nothing functional is lost on my side.

discussions.title: [Bug][Feature] 0.1.6 默认开启的 dsh_session_log 会让大型会话每次请求携带完整日志（本例 ~260 MiB）导致 TRANSPORT 死循环；建议改为默认关闭 + 首次启动显式征得同意
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

0.1.6 起 `session-log-deepseek` 默认开启，把「尚未接受」的规范会话日志作为 `dsh_session_log` 字段拼进**每一次**模型请求（首个上传 `afterSeq: -1`，携带完整日志）。对一个长期会话，请求体可达几百 MB，更新后每条消息都以 `DeepSeek Messages transport failed` 结束且永远写不进接受水位，形成死循环。**诉求：默认关闭；升级/首次启动时用弹窗明确告知数据内容、去向与用途，由用户主动同意后再开启。**

## 我的诉求

1. `session-log-deepseek.enabled` 恢复**默认关闭**（opt-in）。
2. 首次启动/升级后**弹窗征求明确同意**：说明发送内容（完整会话日志，含工具参数与结果、工作目录路径等）、发送目标（官方端点，或自定义 `baseURL` 网关）、用途（官方侧诊断/复现），提供「同意」与「暂不」；选择持久化，设置页可随时更改。
3. 未同意前不发送；选择「暂不」后不再反复打扰。
4. 若保留默认开启，至少要有**大小上限**并保证失败不会让会话不可用（见下）。

## Environment

- dsh: master `0d1f50007f`（含 `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1` 及之后合并），源码方式运行 Web profile
- macOS（Apple Silicon），Node v26.0.0；provider `deepseek-official`，model `deepseek-flash`，protocol `messages`（0.1.6 新默认）
- 会话：长期任务会话（更新前一切正常），约 12 万事件

## 症状与时间线

- 16:31 `git pull` 到最新 master；16:36 起每个 turn 以 `DeepSeek Messages transport failed`（`TRANSPORT`）结束；`llm/retry` 按策略重试 5 次，全部相同失败。同时间段新建会话的小请求完全正常，同一 Key、同一地址的手动请求返回 200。
- 失败样本（日志）：turn 1281–1285 连续 `assistant/attempt` finish error `TRANSPORT`。

## 根因分析

1. `packages/session/session-log-deepseek/src/index.ts`：请求前取 `snapshotEvents(afterSeq + 1)` 作为后缀，默认 `enabled: true`。
2. `docs/deepseek-llm-api-wire-extensions.md`：*"The first upload uses `afterSeq: -1` and carries the complete current log."*、*"There is no independent upload store, size cap, or truncation path."*
3. 本例日志：120,366 事件、未压缩 **260.7 MiB**，`delivery-accepted` 事件为 0 → 每次请求都从 seq 0 全量发送。
4. 巨型 body 在传输层失败；无 2xx → `accept()` 不执行 → 水位不前进 → 重试和下一条消息继续全量重传。
5. 表面错误仅有兜底 catch 的 `DeepSeek Messages transport failed`（`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/adapter.ts`），`cause` 不落日志，用户无法自行定位（参见 #543、#4447）。

## Workaround（已验证）

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中关闭：

```yaml
- id: session-log-deepseek
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek'
  config:
    enabled: false
新建会话可暂时规避，但日志增长后仍会再次触发。
技术侧建议
1. 给字段加上限：未接受后缀超过 N MiB 时跳过且不写水位（或分段 + 检查点上传），避免请求体无界增长。
2. TRANSPORT 错误携带 cause：否则无法区分 TLS、代理与本帖这类字段膨胀问题。
3. 文档与发布说明更醒目：首次上传携带完整日志、无大小上限、自定义 baseURL 网关同样会收到这些数据。
4. 已有同类先例可复用：ui-onboarding 的 welcome notice 机制已经在做"版本化的一次性提示"，同意弹窗可以挂在同一处。

discussions.title: [Bug]0.1.6-aplha.1，MCP 工具重名会让会话恢复失败：failOnStartupError 把可容纳的错误升级成了致命错误
discussions.body:
## 概要

挂载实验性 Browser Use 提供方后，一次 MCP 工具注册冲突会升级成**致命的会话故障**：所有新会话都无法启动/恢复。MCP 客户端自身对这类错误的默认处理是*容纳*（`registrationFailure: "contain"`），但启动同步路径在设置了 `failOnStartupError` 时会把它替换成 `"throw"`，于是**一个工具重名就打死整个会话**，而不是只让那个 MCP 服务器失效。

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| `@playwright/mcp` | `0.0.80` |
| 系统 | macOS 27.0（build 26A428），arm64 |
| Node | v26.8.2 |
| 界面 | `dsh web` |

## 配置

按提供方 README 的最小配置挂载 Browser Use 核心服务 + Playwright MCP 提供方：

```yaml
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use'
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp'
  config:
    mode: launch
    headless: true
```

（作为 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的顶层 `insert:` 条目。**组合本身没有问题**——`dsh web --dump-config` 能看到两行都进去了，`config` 块也正确挂在了后端那一条下面。）

## 实际行为

服务启动后，第一次 MCP 同步抛出工具重复注册错误：

```
mcp-client(playwright-mcp): connection attempt failed: Error: tool "mcp__playwright-mcp__browser_close" is already registered (for a per-agent variant, register through that agent's `agent.ctx` instead)
    at NamedEntries.duplicateError (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634:59)
    at NamedEntries.insert (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:29:34)
    at layers.effect.label (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2884:62)
    at ScopedLayers.<anonymous> (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:206:12)
    at ScopedLayers.effect (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:192:14)
    at Proxy.register (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2884:22)
    at Object.apply (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at Proxy.wrappedRegister (<profile>/node_modules/dsh-context/lib/index.js:218:29)
    at Object.apply (<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at syncTools (<profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js:153:91)
    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:104:5)
    at async <profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js:521:16
```

紧接着会话直接失败，Web 界面完全打不开会话：

```
resume failed for session "<session-id>":
Error: mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed
```

## 为什么一个重名会变成致命错误

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 其实已经把这类失败建模成**可恢复**的。`syncTools` 里：

```js
try {
    for (const [publicName, definition] of definitions) disposers.set(publicName, ctx.tools.register(definition));
} catch (error) {
    for (const dispose of disposers.values()) dispose();
    ctx.logger.error(`mcp-client(${opts.serverName}): tool registration failed, no tools registered: ${String(error)}`);
    if (opts.registrationFailure === "throw") throw error;
    return new Map();
}
```

而该选项是这样选出来的：

```js
const opts = { registrationFailure: "contain", serverName: config.serverName, toolCallTimeoutMs: config.toolCallTimeoutMs };
const startupOpts = config.failOnStartupError ? { ...opts, registrationFailure: "throw" } : opts;
```

启动同步走的是 `startupOpts`（`enqueueSync(generation, startupOpts)`），所以在设了 `failOnStartupError` 的情况下，这个"容器"被绕过，重复注册错误直接从连接建立过程抛出去 → 会话恢复失败。

## 期望行为

与**可选** MCP 提供方发生的工具名冲突，应当让该提供方降级（其工具不可用 + 记录清晰错误），而不是让会话根本无法启动。具体可选：

- 启动同步期间，工具名冲突仍适用默认的 `registrationFailure: "contain"`；或
- `failOnStartupError` 只覆盖**连接**失败，不覆盖**工具注册**冲突；或
- 冲突以确定性方式解决（后注册者胜出 / 处置先前的注册），而不是抛出。

## 待确认的问题

- 我**无法确定同一个工具名为什么会被注册两次**。`enqueueSync` 明确串行化了所有同步，以防两次竞态的 dispose/register 交换，所以这个重复看起来不像是两次竞争同步导致的。"重复"本身的成因可能与上面这个"致命性"问题是两回事。
- `dsh-context@0.52.2` 通过其 `tools.register` 归属包装器出现在调用栈里。读过 `createToolAttribution` 的实现后，它只做包装并委托一次（带 `WeakSet` 防重入），所以**很可能不是重复的来源**。这里仅因它位于调用路径上、排查时可能相关才提一句。
- 相关：v0.1.6-alpha.1 的更新日志提到让可选插件的启动失败不影响其它插件（"可选插件启动失败不影响其他可用插件，必需插件失败时退出"）。这里看起来是一个仍然会升级成"必需插件失败"式退出的情形。

## 复现步骤

1. 安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp`（另需 `playwright install chromium` 装 Chromium）。
2. 按上面的配置挂载两者，重启 `dsh web`。
3. 打开 Web 界面，新建一个会话。

观察到的结果：服务端记录一次重复注册错误；会话恢复失败并报上述信息。

卸载该提供方（移除两个包并删掉挂载）后会话恢复正常启动——我就是这样确认相关性的。

discussions.title: profile 清单带 UTF-8 BOM 时 DSH 启动硬失败，报错不指向病因
discussions.body:
### 环境

- DSH 0.1.5-rc.2，Windows 11
- Node v24.19.0，npm 全局安装
- 相关包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.5-rc.2`

### 现象

profile 的清单 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json` 只要带 UTF-8 BOM（EF BB BF），DSH 就再也起不来，直接硬失败退出。控制台只留下这样一条：

```
SyntaxError: Unexpected token '锘?, "锘縶
    "n"... is not valid JSON
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at readProfileManifest (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:754:22)
    at loadProfile (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:893:37)
    at prepareProfile (.../dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js:208:18)
```

GBK 控制台把 BOM 那三个字节渲染成了「锘縶」，报错信息里看不出是编码问题。

### 复现

```powershell
$p = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json"
Get-Content $p -Raw | Set-Content $p -Encoding UTF8   # PS 5.1 的 -Encoding UTF8 默认写 BOM
dsh web                                              # 启动即硬失败
```

无 BOM 写回即可恢复：

```powershell
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
```

### 原因

`readProfileManifest()` 读文件后直接 `JSON.parse`，没有剥掉开头的 U+FEFF：

```
packages/boot/app-boot/lib/index.js:750   raw = readFileSync(path, "utf8");
packages/boot/app-boot/lib/index.js:754   const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
```

同一文件里还有几处读 package.json 后直接 parse 的写法，都会因为 BOM 走到硬失败或静默失败：

- 401 行 `readModuleProxyRecord`：抛错被 `catch` 吞掉，模块代理记录静默变成 undefined
- 582 行 `readModuleFallbackManifest`：直接抛错
- 851 行 bundle 硬检查读 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明：直接抛错

也就是说任一 package.json 被外部工具写成带 BOM，都可能在引导期变成启动失败。

### 建议

在统一读 JSON 的位置去掉前导 BOM，例如 `JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''))`，或抽一个小 helper 复用。顺带把错误信息补一句「文件可能带 BOM」，现在这条报错完全看不出病因。

### 影响

不涉及安全与数据损坏，但代价不对等。Windows 上 PowerShell 5.1 的 `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8`、`Out-File -Encoding UTF8`，以及部分编辑器另存为 UTF-8 时默认都带 BOM；用户一旦用这些工具碰过 profile 清单，DSH 就启动不了，而报错不指向病因，只能靠手工排查字节。DSH 自己写回清单（`writeProfileManifest`，763 行）是无 BOM 的，所以问题只在外部编辑之后出现。

（这条是我在做插件启动失败路径自测时踩到的，附的报错就是当时的原始输出。）

discussions.title: 长时间重度使用中遇到的 3 个问题：编辑观察状态不持久、工具调用被静默丢弃、调度器失败不留结果
discussions.body:
## 先说清楚这份反馈的来龙去脉

我在一台 Windows 机器上把 dsh 当日常主力工具用：Web UI 常开，会话动辄连续几十轮，上下文经常堆到几十万 token，并且大量使用子代理委派（一个主会话派出若干子代理，子代理再派孙代理）。这套用法有两个特点，正好把一些平时不容易碰到的问题放大了：**一是进程会经历多次重启与插件热重载，二是会话状态会长期累积、委派会形成多层树**。

下面 3 个问题就是在这种用法下暴露出来的。其中第 1 个我真实撞到 4 次；第 2、3 个是排查"工具调用会不会丢"时在代码里发现的路径，本机没有真实触发过——我会如实标明每一条的证据强度，不会把"读代码推断"讲成"实测发生"。

写每一条时我都尽量照顾三件事：**我遇到的情况**（怎么发现的、当时看到什么）、**为什么会这样**（机制，以及包内的确切位置）、**你可以怎么核验**。

本文不含本机路径、会话 ID 与任何凭据。版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1，相关插件包（`dsh-subagent`、`dsh-llm`、`dsh-agent-loop`、`dsh-fs-observation-policy`、`dsh-tool-fs`、`dsh-tools`）0.1.5-rc.2。

## 速览

| # | 问题 | 使用者会看到什么 | 本次证据强度 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 重启或恢复会话后，对"重启前读过的文件"的第一次编辑一定失败 | 报 `file has not been read — read the file, then retry`；重读一次后立刻成功 | 本机 4 次真实触发，分布与机制完全吻合 |
| 2 | 响应因输出长度上限截断时，已产生的工具调用被整体丢弃且不留痕 | agent 说"我去执行"，随后什么都没发生，日志里也查不到原因 | 代码路径确凿，本机 0 次触发 |
| 3 | 工具调度器自身失败时，已开始的调用不留结果 | 日志出现"有调用、无结果"的悬空记录，无法判断是没跑还是在跑 | 代码路径确凿，本机 0 次触发 |

## 问题 1：重启或恢复会话后，第一次编辑一定会失败

### 我遇到的情况

在一个会话里，我让 agent 读过某个文件、也成功改过它。之后我重启了 dsh（Web UI）并继续同一个会话，再让 agent 改那个文件，结果它报：

```text
Error: cannot modify "<path>": file has not been read — read the file, then retry
```

agent 按提示重新读了一遍，再改就成功了。

一开始我判断错了方向：我以为是"编辑工具偶发失效"，甚至怀疑过"同一条消息里的多个工具调用互相干扰"。后来我把会话的原始事件日志（dsh 会把模型返回的**原始流**和装配后的 assistant 消息都记录下来）做了逐条对账，才确认真相：这既不是偶发，也不是我的错觉——**只要进程重启过（或插件热重载过），该会话此前读过的文件在系统眼里就全部退回"从未读过"**，于是重启之后对这类文件的第一次编辑必然被拒。

### 为什么会这样

dsh 有一条"先读后写"的安全策略：要编辑一个已存在的文件，必须先在本会话里读过它。这条设计本身没问题，问题出在**它把"读过哪些文件"记在了哪里**：

- 这份记忆只存在**进程内存**中——一个按会话对象索引的临时表，见 `dsh-fs-observation-policy/lib/index.js:22`；读取与登记见同文件 `:24-39`。
- 进程一结束它自然消失；更彻底的是，插件卸载或热重载时会**主动清空**它（同文件 `:44-45`、`:88-89`）。
- 编辑时的判定在 `:60-68`：查不到"读过"的记录，直接抛 `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`。
- 你看到的文案是工具层替换过的"补救指引"版本（`dsh-tool-fs/lib/index.js:537`、`:547`，那里注释自己称之为 remedy），所以它读起来像"你没读就想改"——但模型或用户**在本会话里确实读过了**，只是那份记录随进程一起没了。

### 影响

- 每一次"重启后继续"都会命中，包括正常的 Web UI 重启、异常恢复、以及带热重载的插件改动。
- 报错信息把根因指向使用者的行为，容易把人带偏：表现为反复重读同一个文件，或者干脆怀疑工具坏了。
- 我在本机全量扫描了 41 个会话：真实的写入/编辑失败一共只有 4 次，全部集中在同一个会话的第 2 轮，而且全部位于该会话的重启标记（`session/end-seed`）之后；每一次补读之后立刻成功。这个分布和"状态随进程丢失"完全一致。

### 怎么复现

1. 在一个会话里读取任意一个已存在的文件。
1. 重启 dsh，或在 Web UI 里恢复该会话（也可触发插件热重载）。
1. 让 agent 编辑该文件：会得到 `file has not been read — read the file, then retry`。
1. 让 agent 重新读取该文件，再编辑：成功。

## 问题 2：响应被输出长度上限截断时，工具调用会被静默丢弃

### 我是怎么发现它的

我没有在本机撞上这条路径（0 次）。它是在排查"工具调用有没有可能被丢掉"时读代码发现的。我认为它值得报告，因为到目前为止它是我找到的**唯一一条会把工具调用整体丢弃、却不留任何痕迹**的路径——一旦发生，使用者拿不到任何线索。

### 为什么会这样

当一次模型响应因为达到输出长度上限而结束时（结束原因是 `max-tokens`），dsh 会把这次响应里的**全部**工具调用块丢弃。这个取舍可以理解：被截断的调用可能不完整，不该拿去执行。问题在于它做得完全无声。代码在 `dsh-llm/lib/index.js:996-1016`：

```js
const kept = this.finish.kind === "max-tokens" ? all.map((block) => block.type !== "tool-call") : void 0;
const blocks = kept === void 0 ? all : all.filter((_, position) => kept[position]);
```

同文件 `:991-995` 的注释说明这个判断对"发给模型的内容"和"重放元数据"同时生效，保证两者不会不一致；但没有任何日志、事件或提示说明发生过丢弃。同族的还有一处中断路径 `:1033-1040`（`interruptedBlocks`）也会省略工具调用块，本机触发过 2 次，但那两次没有工具调用在飞，所以没有实际后果。

### 影响

模型可能已经流式输出了"接下来我要调用某个工具"，甚至界面上都闪过这个调用，然后它凭空消失：使用者看到的是"agent 说要做事，然后什么都没发生"，而事后翻日志也找不到原因。这类不一致最难排查，因为所有证据都在系统里被抹掉了。

## 问题 3：工具调度器失败时，已开始的调用不会留下结果

### 我是怎么发现它的

同样是在排查"工具调用会不会丢"时读代码发现的，本机 0 次触发。

### 为什么会这样

一次 assistant 消息里的多个工具调用由调度器统一执行。如果调度器自身出错，已经启动、但还没提交结果的调用会被直接排空（`Promise.allSettled`）然后抛错，**这些调用的结果不会写进会话**：`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:636-651`。

作为对照，同一个函数里处理"用户中止"的路径（`:652-659`）会给还没来得及开始的调用补写一条合成的错误结果，所以中止场景不会留下悬空记录——差别就在这里。

### 影响

会话日志里会出现"有 `tool/call`、没有 `tool/result`"的记录。模型和界面都无法区分"这次调用根本没执行"和"这次调用还在跑"，只能选择重试，而重试并不总是安全（有些调用有副作用，例如改写文件）。

## 这些结论是怎么来的

- **会话事件日志**：dsh 会把模型返回的原始流与装配后的 assistant 消息都写进会话日志，因此"模型到底发出了哪些工具调用、有没有被丢掉"可以被独立还原。我用这个口径对 41 个会话、1,032 条 assistant 消息做了对账（结论是：已记录的调用都有结果，问题 1 的失败是显式拒绝而非丢结果）。
- **代码核验**：本文每一个包内位置都是我逐条打开确认的，不是转述。
- **没有做到的部分**：问题 2、3 只有代码路径，没有真实触发实例（本机 0 次）；我没有构造人工复现，也没有修改包内代码去注入诊断日志。

## 附：可能的修复方向（供参考，可删）

- **问题 1**：让"已观察"状态与会话事件同源，在会话附加或重放时可重建；或在找不到观察记录时降级为"无版本 CAS 的字面量编辑"，由待替换文本（`old_string`）的逐字命中来承担安全性。两种做法都能让重启后的第一次编辑不再失败。
- **问题 2**：至少在丢弃时写一条事件或日志，并给模型一个可见提示；理想情况下让"截断导致调用被丢弃"成为可被上层处理的状态，而不是静默消失。
- **问题 3**：为已开始但被排空的调用补写合成的错误结果，与中止路径保持一致。

discussions.title: dsh-think-ux: think rows that stream smoothly, collapse gently, and a main view that glides instead of snapping
discussions.body: Sharing a pure-DOM client plugin for the Web UI: **dsh-think-ux** (MIT, npm `dsh-think-ux`). (full clip: [demo.mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/el16z3c/dsh-think-ux/main/media/demo.mp4)) What it does: 1. **Think rows expand as a capped preview while reasoning streams** — auto-expanded via a synthetic click (React keeps owning the state), capped at 24 lines with fades, and a rAF chaser glides the preview to the bottom (70 ms exponential). You watch the reasoning happen without token-chunk jumps. 2. **On settle, the preview collapses with a 180 ms height animation** instead of a one-frame ~490 px content removal — otherwise a bottom-pinned reader gets clamped down by the whole box in one visible jump at every turn boundary. 3. **The main conversation view follows the same way**: a `scrollTop` write trap identifies the bundle's re-pin (`el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight`) by construction and hands bottom-targeted moves to an exponential chaser; the per-episode speed model makes long-session opens swoosh to the bottom while streamed inserts glide at a constant ~960 px/s. Reader intent (wheel/touch/PageUp, the 700 ms window) is never fought — the bundle's re-pin inside the window is reverted in the same tick, native scrolling never passes through the trap. 4. **User control is absolute**: any trusted click on a think row hands it over permanently; `MAIN_SMOOTH_FOLLOW = false` / `COLLAPSE_MS = 0` kill switches; uninstall = stock behavior. No bundle changes, no services, no network calls, no dependencies. Verified against DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 — the behavior depends on that version's DOM and client load protocol, so re-validate before other versions. (npm: 0.1.0 shipped a client registration name that did not match the package name, which broke Web UI loading; it is deprecated, and 0.1.1+ is the install target.) Install: ``` dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-think-ux ``` Repo: https://github.com/el16z3c/dsh-think-ux (EN/中文 README, tunable constants, honest residual-risks section).

discussions.title: Notes from building a scroll-UX client plugin: root causes of "stiff" auto-scroll, and the fixes that work
discussions.body:
We built dsh-think-ux (https://github.com/el16z3c/dsh-think-ux) — a client plugin that makes think rows stream as a smooth capped preview and makes the main conversation view glide to the bottom instead of snapping. While chasing an intermittent "stiff scroll" report we instrumented the scroller and found three findings that may be useful for anyone working on Web-UI scroll behavior (and for the bundle itself):

**1. Browser scroll anchoring fights smooth follow on large insertions.** When a tool row / code block lands while the reader is bottom-pinned, the browser's overflow-anchor adjustment shifts `scrollTop` by the whole inserted chunk in a single frame (we measured 20–200 px downward shifts landing exactly at the floor — 295 of 333 uncaught scroller motions in one capture). A smooth chaser stepping ~16 px/frame cannot catch a whole-chunk snap, so the result is a visible hard jump. Fix: `overflow-anchor: none` on the scroller while following (restore the previous inline value on unload — an empty original must still clear the inline override).

**2. Think-box settle unmounts ~490 px in one frame.** When a think row settles, the body unmounts; a bottom-pinned reader is clamped down by the whole box in one frame (the turn-boundary "stiff snap"). Fix: play a short height animation (180 ms) before the unmounting commit so the clamp happens frame by frame. The animation should end via `transitionend` (a fixed timer racing the animation desyncs under hidden tabs / main-thread stalls), with the timer started at the animation's real start as a safety net; the finish should keep the inline `height: 0` until the element unmounts (clearing it first flashes the natural full height for a frame under load).

**3. Reader intent vs bundle re-pin is a structural problem, not a timing one.** The bundle's follow re-pin is a plain JS `el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight` write; native reader scrolling never passes through the JS property setter. A `defineProperty` trap on the scroller's `scrollTop` therefore identifies re-pins by construction: writes landing at the floor while the reader sits above it are re-pins — allow them (so the bundle's own bookkeeping stays consistent) and restore the reader's position in the same tick. The real change fires a scroll event the bundle's handler reads as "reader moved", which flips its follow off — self-healing. Every reader return is native, passes through untouched, and re-engages follow. (One Chrome fact we verified: scroll events carry `isTrusted=true` even for JS `scrollTop` writes — trust the trap, not the flag.)

Happy to share the trace methodology (per-instance rAF echo ring + a local HTTP trace sink) if useful.

discussions.title: dsh-think-ux：思考盒平滑展开、温和收起，主视图不再拉扯（中文版）
discussions.body: 分享一个纯 DOM 的 Web 端客户端插件：**dsh-think-ux**（MIT 许可，npm 包名 `dsh-think-ux`，英文介绍见 [Discussions #6760](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6760)）。 (full clip: [demo.mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/el16z3c/dsh-think-ux/main/media/demo.mp4)) 它能做什么： 1. **思考盒随流式推理平滑展开** —— 通过合成点击自动展开（React 仍然拥有状态），限高 24 行、超出渐隐，rAF 追底器（70 ms 指数衰减）让预览窗平滑滑向底部。你看到推理过程在发生，而不是 token 块一顿一顿地跳。 2. **settle 时以 180 ms 高度动画收起预览**，而不是在一帧里移除约 490 px 的内容 —— 否则钉在底部的读者会在每个回合边界被整盒内容一下拽下去。 3. **主对话视图用同样的方式跟随**：一个 `scrollTop` 写陷阱按构造识别 bundle 的 re-pin（`el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight`），把指向底部的移动交给指数追底器；按"回合片段"建模速度，让长会话打开时嗖一下滑到底，流式插入则以恒定 ~960 px/s 滑行。读者意图（滚轮/触摸/PageUp，700 ms 窗口）永不被对抗 —— 窗口内的 bundle re-pin 同 tick 回滚，原生滚动从不经过陷阱。 4. **用户掌控绝对**：任何一次真实的 think 行点击即永久交还控制权；`MAIN_SMOOTH_FOLLOW = false` / `COLLAPSE_MS = 0` 是总开关；卸载即回到原版行为。 不改 bundle、不起服务、无网络请求、零依赖。已在 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 验证；行为依赖该版本的 DOM 与客户端加载协议，其他版本请先重新验证。（npm 0.1.0 因客户端注册名与包名不一致会导致 Web UI 加载失败，已标废，请安装 0.1.1+。） 安装： ``` dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-think-ux ``` 仓库：https://github.com/el16z3c/dsh-think-ux （中文 README 见 `README.zh.md`，含可调常量与诚实的残留风险说明）。

discussions.title: [Bug] Compatibility hooks 会丢失当前 session 的 sandbox policy
discussions.body:
# Compatibility hooks 会丢失当前 session 的 sandbox policy

我在排查一个 `PostToolUse` hook 的写入失败时，定位到 compatibility hook 的 sandbox policy 传递似乎有问题。

## 现象

当前 Agent session 使用：

```text
mode = workspace-write
cwd = /path/to/project
```

普通 Bash / tool 执行可以正常写当前 workspace。

但同一个 session 触发的 `PostToolUse` compatibility hook 在写文件时会失败：

```text
[Errno 30] Read-only file system
```

hook 本身已经成功匹配并执行，失败发生在 hook 子进程实际写文件时。

## 我看到的根因

`packages/hooks/hook-protocol/src/runner.ts` 里的 `RunHookOptions` 当前包含：

```text
payload
env
cwd
signal
timeout
...
```

但没有 `sandboxPolicy`。

`runHook()` 最后构造的 shell request 也没有传 policy：

```ts
const request = {
  command: hook.command,
  timeoutMs,
  stdin,
  signal: options.signal,
  ...(options.cwd !== undefined ? { workdir: options.cwd } : {}),
  ...(options.env !== undefined ? { env: options.env } : {}),
}

await bash.run(bash.resolve(request))
```

如果当前 executor 是 `bash-sandbox`，因为 request 里没有 per-call policy，后续会重新调用 sandbox policy resolver。

这时 resolver 已经拿不到当前 Agent session，所以无法使用当前 session 的：

```text
mode
workspaceRoot
sessionId
```

最后可能退回 deployment/default policy。

因此会出现：

```text
普通 Bash：
  使用当前 Agent session policy
  -> workspace-write

compatibility hook：
  cwd 正确
  但没有当前 session policy
  -> fallback 到默认 sandbox policy
  -> 可能变成 read-only
```

普通 Bash tool 当前已经有正确的实现：它会根据 `exec.agent.session` resolve 完整 sandbox policy，然后把 policy 放进 shell request。

所以这里看起来像是 compatibility hook bridge 少传了一层 session context。

## 我觉得比较合适的修复

可以考虑：

1. 给 `RunHookOptions` 增加可选的 `sandboxPolicy`
2. `runHook()` 原样把它传进 `ShellExecRequest`
3. Claude / Codex compatibility bridge 在还持有 Agent 时调用：

```ts
const sandboxPolicy = ctx.sandboxPolicy?.resolve({
  session: agent.session,
})
```

然后传给 `runHook()`

这样 compatibility hook 仍然经过现有 shell / sandbox 路径，只补回当前 session 的 execution policy。

我倾向于把 policy service 保持为 optional，这样只使用 `LocalBashExecutor` 的 composition 不受影响。

另外我觉得没必要为了这个修复强制把 hook 的 `cwd` 改成 `policy.workspaceRoot`。当前 session `cwd` 已经有既定语义，直接保留 cwd，同时单独传完整 policy 会更稳妥。

## 和 #5635 的区别

我看到 Discussion #5635 也提到了 compatibility hook 经 shell bridge 执行的问题。

其中一个方案是让 hook 改走 host subprocess。

这个方案可以绕过 sandbox 限制，但也会改变 hook 的安全边界。

如果问题只是当前 session policy 没传下去，我感觉继续走现有 shell sandbox，然后补传 per-session `SandboxExecutionPolicy` 会更符合目前 DSH 的执行模型。

## 另外一个相关问题

这个问题还暴露出一个单独的可见性问题：

如果 hook 返回普通非零退出码，exit code 和 stderr 会记录在 hook result 里，但 Agent 模型本身不一定能看到。

所以 `PostToolUse` hook 可能已经同步失败，Agent 仍然继续认为上一步操作完整成功。

这个问题和 sandbox policy 丢失可以分开修，但之后可能值得让 `PostToolUse` 的 operational failure 通过现有 `additionalContexts` 路径给 Agent 一个有长度限制的诊断信息。

如果维护者觉得上面的修复方向符合设计，我可以整理一个 patch。

discussions.title: [Windows] revealNativePath() fails two ways: hidden Explorer window, and file:/// URL args falling back to the Desktop
discussions.body:
### Summary

On Windows, `revealNativePath()` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` never reveals anything useful, and in **both** failure modes the caller still reports success.

Two independent defects in the `explorer` branch:

1. every native command is spawned with `windowsHide: true`, so Explorer creates the folder window **hidden** (`SW_HIDE`) — it exists, with the item selected, but is never shown;
2. the target is passed as a percent-encoded `file:///` URL, which Explorer rejects for paths containing non-ASCII characters, spaces, commas, `#` or `&`; it then silently opens the **Desktop** instead of the file's folder.

In both cases `explorer.exe` exits with code 1, and the branch treats exit code 1 as "request delegated"

```js
} catch (error) {
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    if (!(error instanceof Error) || !("code" in error) || error.code !== 1) throw error;
}
```

so `POST /api/present.open?…&action=reveal` returns 204, the deliverables card shows "Requested display in file manager", and the user sees nothing — or an unrelated Desktop window.

### Environment

| component | version |
|---|---|
| DSH Desktop (`dsh-plugin-desktop`) | 2.0.10 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` | 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| OS | Windows 11 Pro, build 26200 (10.0.26200) |
| runtime | Electron 43.3.0 host utility process (Node 24) |

### Defect 1 — the revealed window is created hidden

`lib/index.js`, `runNativeCommand()`:

```js
const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
	execFile(command, [...args], {
		encoding: "utf8",
		signal,
		windowsHide: true
	}, (error, stdout, stderr) => { … })
```

`windowsHide: true` maps to `STARTUPINFO.dwFlags |= STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW; wShowWindow = SW_HIDE`. Explorer does create the folder window and does select the item — `Shell.Application.Windows()` lists it and `Document.SelectedItems()` returns the target path — but `IsWindowVisible(hwnd)` stays `False` forever.

Measured with the same target file, only that option changed:

| spawn options | resulting Explorer window |
|---|---|
| `windowsHide: true` (current) | `IsWindowVisible = False` |
| `windowsHide: false` | `IsWindowVisible = True`, raised behind the foreground window |

### Defect 2 — `file:///` URL form falls back to the Desktop

Same branch:

```js
const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C");
try {
    await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
```

Measured across path shapes (`/select,` + URL, versus `/select,` + native path as two separate argv entries):

| path shape | `file:///` URL (current) | native path (two argv) |
|---|---|---|
| ASCII, e.g. `D:\work\report.md` | correct folder + item selected | correct folder + item selected |
| non-ASCII + space, e.g. `D:\逆向\路径 测试\中文 文件名.md` | **opens the Desktop** | correct folder + item selected |
| contains `,` | **opens the Desktop** | correct folder + item selected |
| contains `#` / `&` | **opens the Desktop** | correct folder + item selected |

So the `replaceAll(",", "%2C")` workaround is unnecessary once the URL is dropped: a comma inside the native path is fine, because Explorer takes the whole remainder after the first comma.

Related finding while testing the argument forms: passing `/select,<path>` as a **single** argv element (a form used by third-party plugins) is broken for paths with spaces, because Node quotes the entire argument — `"/select,D:\a b\c.md"` — Explorer no longer recognises the switch and opens Documents. Only the two-argv form (`/select,` and the path) works.

### Minimal reproduction (no DSH required)

```js
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
const p = process.argv[2];
const url = pathToFileURL(p, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C");
const run = (args, hide) => new Promise(r => execFile("explorer.exe", args, { windowsHide: hide }, e => r(e?.code)));

await run(["/select,", url], true);   // defects 1 + 2: hidden window (IsWindowVisible=false)
await run(["/select,", url], false);  // defect 1 fixed, defect 2 remains for non-ASCII / , / # / &
await run(["/select,", p], false);    // correct behaviour
```

Inspect with `(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).Windows()` plus `IsWindowVisible(hwnd)` from `user32.dll`. An argument Explorer cannot resolve returns exit code 1 **and** opens `file:///C:/Users/<user>/Desktop`.

### Suggested fix

1. let each call decide whether the child is hidden (default unchanged, so `powershell.exe` never flashes a console):

```js
const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal, options = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
	execFile(command, [...args], {
		encoding: "utf8",
		signal,
		windowsHide: options.windowsHide ?? true
	}, (error, stdout, stderr) => { … })
```

2. hand Explorer the native path instead of a URL:

```js
await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", windowsPath], signal, { windowsHide: false });
```

### Meta

Both defects are silent for the caller: accepting exit code 1 as proof of handoff cannot distinguish a real reveal from a hidden window or from a Desktop fallback. The README already notes the confirmation "cannot prove the desktop window selected the file" — on Windows this surfaces to the user as "the menu item does nothing", which is how I found it (delivered-file card → "Show in File Explorer").
