discussions.title: dsh-usage-panel：设置页 Token 用量统计，与侧边栏同口径的历史账单（中文版）
discussions.body: 分享一个设置页 Token 用量统计插件：**dsh-usage-panel**（MIT，npm 包名 `dsh-usage-panel`，v0.2.3 已发布）。 它能做什么： 1. **历史账单式的用量统计** —— 累计 KPI、半年活跃热力图（UTC 日桶）、按模型堆叠的每日柱状图、模型环形图、Top 会话、provider 分布、缓存命中率，支持 JSON/CSV 导出。回答"到底花了多少"，与实时监控类插件（估算当前速率）互补。 2. **会话数与侧边栏严格对齐** —— KPI 只计 `delegationDepth === 0` 且未归档的主会话（含零用量空会话）；子代理消耗计入 token 总量但不混入会话条数，独立披露。 3. **fork/resume 语义正确** —— fork 会话拷入的父历史按 `inheritedEventCount` 精确去重（不重复计费），resume 会话追加的 `session/end-seed` 只切 epoch 不做边界门控（历史用量不丢）。这两类错误都真实踩过并修了，细节见 [issue #4](https://github.com/AlfredChaos/dsh-usage-panel/issues/4)（感谢报告者的高质量根因分析）。 4. **只读、可审计** —— 投影增量聚合 + 失败回退全量重扫，两条路径共用同一 reducer；读不了的日志（如旧版 `subagent/descriptor` v2）计入 coverage 并在 UI 披露"部分数据"，不静默吞掉。经共享 `/api` 通道暴露端点，继承宿主鉴权。 已在 DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` 验证（用到 `inheritedEventCount` / `assistant/attempt` / 新 projection 契约，低于此版本请勿安装）。 安装： ``` dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-usage-panel ``` 源码与反馈：https://github.com/AlfredChaos/dsh-usage-panel （issue 欢迎提，上一轮真实数据的口径 bug 就是靠用户反馈定位的）

discussions.title: [Bug] Android/Termux：会话写入失败 — flock is not supported on android-arm64
discussions.body:
> **重复报告，请勿在此追加。** 同一问题已有更完整的 [#6148](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6148)。本条的新增证据已合并到该帖的评论中：0.1.6-alpha.1 上依然存在、`native/system/scripts/build.ts` 的第二处平台判断、以及失败时残留 `session.lock` 的特征。

### Summary

在 Android / Termux 上，任何需要写入 Session 的操作都会失败，报 `flock is not supported on android-arm64`。跨进程写租约依赖 POSIX `flock(2)`，而提供它的原生插件只面向 linux（glibc、musl）与 darwin 发布和构建产物，Android 在加载入口被显式拒绝。0.1.6-alpha.1 与 0.1.5-rc.2 表现一致，该问题自 `d927cbff99`（把租约实现从 `fs-ext` 换成自研预编译 addon）起存在。

### Reproduction

环境为 Android + Termux + Node v26.4.0（`process.platform === 'android'`，bionic libc）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web        # 新建会话，或打开已有会话写入
```

最小复现（无需启动 UI）：

```sh
cd packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/flock').then(m => m.tryLockExclusive(0)).then(() => console.log('ok')).catch(e => console.log(e.code, '|', e.message))"
# ERR_FLOCK_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM | flock is not supported on android-arm64
```

### Current behavior

1. `native/system/packages/entry/src/flock.ts:15` 的加载器只放行 `linux` 与 `darwin`，Android 落到第 16-19 行的 `throw`，错误码 `ERR_FLOCK_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM`。
2. 放宽闸门也无产物可用：`native/system/packages/` 下只有 `linux-x64`、`linux-arm64`、`darwin-x64`、`darwin-arm64`；`native/system/scripts/build.ts:27` 有相同的双平台判断，因此 Termux 上 `pnpm run build` 不会产出 `system.node`（实测 `find native -name '*.node'` 为空）。Android 使用 bionic，glibc/musl 的 `.node` 也无法直接加载。
3. 租约调用点 `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/lease.ts:94` 只把锁竞争（`EAGAIN`/`EWOULDBLOCK`）映射为 `SessionAlreadyOwnedError`（第 95-97 行），其它错误原样抛出，于是“平台不支持”直接中断写打开。只读路径不碰锁，读取历史会话不受影响。
4. 现场表现：会话目录里留下 `session.lock` 空文件（失败前 `open` 已创建该文件），而 `session.jsonl.zstd` 不再更新。实测最后一次成功写入早于该改动，之后只剩 lock 残留。

### Expected behavior

希望二选一：

- 支持 android-arm64：发布或可本地构建对应产物（注意 bionic，不是 glibc/musl）；或
- 平台不支持时优雅退化，例如复用仓库里已有的单进程桩思路——`packages/experimental/webworker-runtime/src/node/external_packages/node-addon-system-flock.ts` 直接 `Promise.resolve()`，代价是放弃跨进程互斥；至少在文档中明确 Android/Termux 不受支持。

### Environment

- Android 16（机型 23113RKC6C、XT2507-5），Termux
- Node v26.4.0（`process.platform === 'android'`、`process.arch === 'arm64'`、无 glibc）
- dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1，commit `0d1f50007f`；同一现象在 0.1.5-rc.2（`c291e7961a`）一致
- pnpm 11.7.0

补充：`flock.ts`、`build.ts`、`lease.ts` 在两个版本之间逐字节相同（`git diff c291e7961a..master` 为空），因此这不是某次升级引入的回归，引入点是 `d927cbff99`。替换前 `fs-ext` 实现在 Android 上是否可用未经验证，此处仅作背景记录。

discussions.title: 极简模式中 Agent Bash 工具遇命令裸 ! 卡住：dsh 持久 shell 的 history expansion 中止包装命令
discussions.body:
## 现象

极简模式中 Agent 的 Bash 工具执行任何包含**裸 `!`（未转义的感叹号）**的命令时会卡住，命令通常没有真正执行。手动在 zsh / 终端里执行同样的命令则立即成功。

首次发现于以下 Swift 单行命令：

```bash
swift -e 'import Foundation; enum U: Codable { case h(URL); init(from d: Decoder) throws { let c = try d.singleValueContainer(); self = .h(try c.decode(URL.self)) }; func encode(to e: Encoder) throws { var c = e.singleValueContainer(); switch self { case .h(let u): try c.encode(u.absoluteString) } } }; let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(["url": U.h(URL(string:"https://media.example.com/a.heic")!)]); print(String(data:data, encoding:.utf8)!)' 2>&1 || true
```

手动终端正常输出：

```json
{"url":"https:\/\/media.example.com\/a.heic"}
```

Agent Bash 工具内相同命令一直无响应，看起来像进程死锁。

## 影响

- 所有经过 Agent Bash 工具、且命令文本中存在裸 `!` 的命令都可能无法执行。
- 不限于 Swift；最小复现 `echo 'hi!'` 同样卡住。
- Swift 代码里非常常见的强制解包（`URL(...)!`、`String(...)!`）会触发，
  因此这类命令无法作为单行 `swift -e` 交给 Agent 执行。
- `sudo`、网络、URL、代码签名均无关；换用 `sudo` 也不会恢复。

## 复现

在 Agent Bash 工具中：

1. 以下命令会卡住：

   ```bash
   echo 'hi!'
   ```

   或

   ```bash
   rm -f /tmp/bang; echo 'hi!' > /tmp/bang; cat /tmp/bang; echo done
   ```

2. 以下命令正常，可对照证明问题来自裸 `!`：

   ```bash
   swift -e 'print(1)'
   swift -e 'import Foundation; print(URL(string:"https://x.com"))'
   echo 'hi\!'
   printf 'hi\041\n'
   ```

3. 在同一个 Agent 持久 shell 中先执行 `set +H`，再执行原始命令，立即成功：

   ```bash
   set +H
   swift -e 'import Foundation; enum U: Codable { case h(URL); init(from d: Decoder) throws { let c = try d.singleValueContainer(); self = .h(try c.decode(URL.self)) }; func encode(to e: Encoder) throws { var c = e.singleValueContainer(); switch self { case .h(let u): try c.encode(u.absoluteString) } } }; let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(["url": U.h(URL(string:"https://media.example.com/a.heic")!)]); print(String(data:data, encoding:.utf8)!)' 2>&1 || true
   ```

   输出：

   ```json
   {"url":"https:\/\/media.example.com\/a.heic"}
   ```

## 根因

### 运行环境

Agent Bash 工具由 dsh 的持久 PTY 提供，底层 shell 为：

```text
/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -i
```

相关环境变量与选项：

```text
DSH_SHELL=1
DSH_PTY_SESSION_ID=pty-25
set -o | grep histexpand   # histexpand on
```

### dsh 的命令包装

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent` 为了识别输出与退出码，会把用户命令包装成类似：

```bash
printf '%s\n' $'__DSH_PERSISTENT_BASH_START_<uuid>__'
eval -- $'<用户命令>'
__dsh_persistent_bash_status=$?
printf '%s%s\n' $'__DSH_PERSISTENT_BASH_END_<uuid>:' "$__dsh_persistent_bash_status"
```

其中 `quoteForBash(value)` 使用 Bash ANSI-C 引号 `$'...'`，并在 `value` 中替换：

- `\` → `\\`
- `'` → `\'`
- `\r` → `\r`
- `\n` → `\n`

**但没有处理裸 `!`。**

### Bash history expansion 中止包装行

持久 shell 是 interactive Bash，`histexpand` 默认开启。Bash 在解析整条包装命令前先做历史展开，
此时会看到用户命令中的 `!`，例如原始命令 `echo 'hi!'` 经 dsh 转义单引号后，
包装文本里出现类似：

```text
$'echo \'hi!\''
```

Bash 尝试把 `!\'` 当历史事件名查找，直接报错：

```text
bash: !\'': event not found
```

整行包装命令因此不会执行，`START` 和 `END` 标记都不会输出。dsh 收不到结束标记，
就一直等待，直到约 30 秒超时，再由工具层统一报错/重置 shell。这就是“卡住”的来源。

### 为什么手动终端成功

手动终端是 zsh；`!` 位于单引号内时既不触发 zsh history expansion，
也没有 dsh 的 `$'...'` 包装层。因此 shell 收到的是原始命令，Swift 能正常编译执行。

## 证据

在 Agent Bash 工具内，包装逻辑与 Bash 行为的对照验证：

```text
$ set -o | grep histexpand
histexpand     on

# 裸 !：卡住/超时，无 markdown 文件生成
$ rm -f /tmp/bang; echo 'hi!' > /tmp/bang; cat /tmp/bang; echo done

# 转义/编码掉裸 ! 后成功
$ rm -f /tmp/bang2; echo hi\! > /tmp/bang2; cat /tmp/bang2; echo done
hi!
done

$ printf 'hi\041\n' > /tmp/bang3; cat /tmp/bang3
hi!
```

用与 dsh 相同的包装形式在 `/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -i` 中复现，确实出现：

```text
bash: !\'': event not found
```

且后续 `__DSH_PERSISTENT_BASH_END_...` 标记不会输出。

## 规避方案

### 1. 执行命令前关闭 histexpand（临时）

在同一个 Agent 持久 shell 中先单独执行：

```bash
set +H
```

之后包含裸 `!` 的命令即可原样执行。注意 `set +H` 必须**单独先执行**，
不能和含 `!` 的命令写在同一条包装命令里，因为 history expansion 发生在整行解析阶段。
如果 shell 被 dsh 重置，需要重新执行。

### 2. 避免命令文本中出现裸 `!`

Swift 强制解包改为 `guard let` / `if let`：

```swift
guard let url = URL(string: "https://media.example.com/a.heic") else { fatalError("bad url") }
guard let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { fatalError("bad utf8") }
print(text)
```

Shell 层使用 `printf` 的八进制转义生成感叹号：

```bash
rm -f /tmp/bang; printf 'hi\041\n' > /tmp/bang; cat /tmp/bang; echo done
```

也可以使用无引号 `echo hi\!`（注意不能写成 `echo 'hi\!'`，否则单引号会保留反斜杠）。

### 3. 源码写入文件再执行

对于必须保留原代码 `!` 的场景，可把 Swift 源码先写入文件（例如通过不含 `!` 的
base64 传输），再执行 `swift /tmp/test.swift`，避免命令文本经过 shell 的 history expansion。

## 建议修复（dsh 上游）

1. 在 `quoteForBash` 中把 `!` 编码为 ANSI-C 八进制转义 `\041`，再放进 `$'...'`。
   这样发送给 PTY 的包装文本里没有裸 `!`，Bash history expansion 不会触发，
   而 `eval` 会还原出真正的 `!`。需要保证替换顺序在反斜杠转义之后，不能二次转义。
2. 或者在持久 shell 启动阶段、发送任何用户命令之前，单独执行一次 `set +H` 关闭历史展开。
   不能仅在每条包装命令前加 `set +H`，因为同一行内的 `!` 仍在 history expansion 阶段被扫描。
3. 增加回归测试：经过 `wrapCommand` + `quoteForBash` 后，`echo 'hi!'`、
   `echo "a!b"`、强制解包 Swift 单行命令等都必须正常返回输出和退出码，且不超时。

## 验收标准

- [ ] Agent Bash 工具执行 `echo 'hi!'` 不再超时，输出 `hi!` 和正确退出码。
- [ ] Agent Bash 工具执行含 `URL(...)!` 和 `String(...)!` 的原始 `swift -e` 单行命令成功。
- [ ] 不再需要人工先执行 `set +H` 作为 workaround。
- [ ] 原有不含 `!` 的命令行为、输出解析、退出码传递无回归。

discussions.title: [Bug] Official Agent Team profile makes ACP `session/new` fail during JSONL persistence flush
discussions.body:
## Summary

Enabling the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` on the official ACP profile makes `session/new` fail before the first model request.

The same ACP + JSONL persistence setup completes `session/new` and `session/prompt` when the Agent Team profile patch is omitted.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: `0.1.6-alpha.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp`: `0.1.6-alpha.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`: `0.1.6-alpha.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team`: `0.1.6-alpha.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`: `0.1.6-alpha.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team`: `0.1.6-alpha.1`
- `@agentclientprotocol/sdk`: `1.4.0`
- Node.js: `v24.13.0`
- Platform: Darwin `25.6.0`, arm64

The same failure was previously reproduced with the DSH package family pinned to `0.1.5-rc.1`.

## Minimal comparison

Both cases use:

- the published `dsh` CLI
- `--profile acp`
- the official JSONL persistence included by that profile
- an empty temporary working directory and temporary DSH home
- a local deterministic provider endpoint used only to count whether a request is made
- ACP `initialize`, followed by `session/new`

No private plugins, custom tools, custom persistence backend, or custom system prompt are loaded.

### Case A: ACP without Agent Team patch

Start:

```console
dsh --profile acp
```

Observed:

- `initialize` succeeds
- `session/new` returns a session id
- `session/prompt` reaches the local provider endpoint
- the turn ends normally

### Case B: ACP with the published Agent Team profile patch

Start:

```console
dsh --profile acp \
  --patch node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile/cordis.patch.yml
```

Send the same ACP `initialize` and `session/new` requests.

Observed response:

```json
{
  "code": -32603,
  "message": "Internal error",
  "data": {
    "details": "ACP session persistence flush failed"
  }
}
```

Additional observations:

- the local provider receives zero requests
- the process writes no `team/*` events before the failure
- stderr is empty
- the DSH process exits normally after the ACP client disconnects
- removing only the official Agent Team patch restores successful `session/new`

The failure therefore appears before any `spawn_teammate`, Team task, or Team message operation.

## Expected behavior

`session/new` should create the ordinary root Session/implicit Team Lead and return a session id. Team state can remain empty until the first Team mutation, as described by the Agent Team durability contract.

If this composition is intentionally unsupported, the profile or ACP layer should reject it with a specific configuration error rather than a persistence-flush failure.

## Questions

1. Is the published Agent Team profile expected to compose with the official ACP profile and JSONL session persistence?
2. Does this composition require an additional official profile row or ordering constraint?
3. If it is a bug, which diagnostic hook can expose the inner persistence/flush cause currently wrapped by the ACP error?

I can provide a standalone minimal reproduction script using only the published packages if that would help.

discussions.title: [Desktop] macOS: ⌘V/⌘C/⌘X/⌘A do nothing — the packaged application menu has no Edit menu
discussions.body:
## Summary

In the packaged Desktop application on macOS, the standard editing shortcuts do nothing: ⌘V, ⌘C, X and ⌘A are inert in every text field, including the composer. There is no right-click context menu either, so text cannot be pasted by any route.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.1.6-alpha.1, packaged build, macOS (arm64)
- dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1

## Steps to reproduce

1. Copy text in any other application.
2. Focus the composer (or any text input) in the Desktop window.
3. Press ⌘V.

Observed: nothing is inserted; ⌘C, ⌘X and ⌘A behave the same way. Typing works normally.

## Cause

`apps/desktop/src/main.ts` installs a custom application menu whose only top-level menu is the application menu:

```ts
Menu.setApplicationMenu(Menu.buildFromTemplate([{
  label: process.platform === 'darwin' ? app.name : messages.application,
  submenu: [desktop plugins…, check updates…, separator, quit],
}]))
```

macOS delivers the standard editing shortcuts through menu roles. Without an Edit menu, the paste/copy/cut/select-all commands never reach the renderer, and the Desktop adds no `webContents` context-menu handler as a fallback. Repository evidence:

- `rg "role: '(copy|paste|cut|selectAll|undo|redo)'"` over the repository returns nothing.
- There is no `context-menu` handler under `apps/desktop/src`.
- `git log -S editMenu -- apps/desktop/src/main.ts` is empty, so the packaged Desktop has never offered an Edit menu.

The composer itself is fine: its Lexical `PASTE_COMMAND` handler (`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/editor/keymap.ts`) already routes pasted text, images and files. It simply never receives the gesture.

This is macOS-specific: on Windows and Linux the renderer handles Ctrl+V natively, so the same source shows no symptom there.

## Suggested fix

Add the standard editing menu where the platform requires it:

```ts
...(process.platform === 'darwin' ? [{ role: 'editMenu' as const }] : []),
```

Role-based entries keep the labels system-localized, so no UI copy needs to be added to the locale dictionaries. A regression assertion can check that the macOS template contains the `editMenu` role (for example in `apps/desktop/tests/main-startup.spec.ts`).

discussions.title: [Desktop] PTC run_code fails immediately with worker-exit …before completing (0) after the host moved to the ASAR runtime
discussions.body:
## Summary

On a packaged Desktop build (0.1.6-alpha.1), every `run_code` call in the `ptc` preset fails immediately with:

```
Error: code run failed (worker-exit): Node process exited before completing (0)
```

The call fails in well under a second with empty stdout/stderr, so no tool can be used in PTC sessions. Restarting the application does not help.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.1.6-alpha.1, packaged build, macOS (arm64)
- dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1, agent preset `ptc`, file policy `danger-full-access`
- First observed after the application was updated to a build that contains `feat(desktop): run runtime host from asar`

## Cause

Three facts combine:

1. For packaged builds `apps/desktop/src/main.ts` uses `process.execPath` as the Host executable, and `apps/desktop/src/host-process.ts` launches it with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`. Inside that Host, `process.execPath` is therefore the Electron application binary.
2. `packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/src/index.ts` resolves its default worker executable from `process.execPath` and builds the worker environment by clearing inherited names, which removes `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`.
3. The worker spawn therefore boots the desktop application again instead of a Node process. The already-running application owns the single-instance lock, so the new process quits with exit code 0 and no output, which the runtime reports as `worker-exit`.

Local verification supporting the cause:

- While the application is running, spawning the application binary with the worker argv and without `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` exits with code 0 in under a second with empty stdout and stderr — exactly the reported failure.
- The same command with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` boots the worker (it reaches the control-channel handshake), so the worker itself is fine.

## Suggested fix

Keep the worker in Node mode when the resolved executable is the current Electron binary, next to the existing executable/bootstrap selection:

```ts
export function nodeModeEnvironment(executable: string, hostExecutable: string, electron: boolean): Record<string, string> {
  if (!electron || executable !== hostExecutable) return {}
  return { ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1' }
}
```

and merge it into the worker environment in `run()`. Local verification after this change: an end-to-end PTC run against a packaged build returns the program result, the package suite passes on plain Node, and it passes under an Electron-as-node Host except for one fixture whose program spawns `process.execPath` itself (that case still starts the application, because the program-visible environment is empty by design).

discussions.title: [功能建议] 工作区文件目录支持移到左侧边栏；右侧工作区增加「保留左侧边栏」的展开模式
discussions.body:
## 现状（网页端）

- 左侧边栏是会话（对话）列表，工作区文件目录在右侧边栏。
- 右侧边栏有「全屏」显示模式，全屏后左侧边栏也会被盖掉。

## 建议

1. **工作区文件目录支持放到左侧边栏**（对话那一侧）。比如左侧边栏增加「文件」分区/标签页，或允许面板选择停靠在左边。这样左侧同时有会话列表和文件树，右侧专心当工作区。
2. **右侧工作区增加一种「保留左侧边栏」的展开模式**：目前除了常规大小就只有全屏，希望中间多一档——保留左侧边栏、右侧工作区占据剩余的全部屏幕。在全屏入口上做成「盖掉左侧边栏 / 保留左侧边栏」两种选择就行。

## 场景

这两条配合起来就是接近 IDE 的布局：左侧常驻文件目录 + 会话列表，右侧工作区占满其余空间。宽屏下经常需要一边对照文件树，一边在编辑器/终端里干活；现在一切全屏就看不到左侧边栏了，想看文件树只能来回切。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-zhihu-search | 免费知乎搜索 API
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目**，由社区成员独立开发和维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。 > > **Unofficial project**, independently developed and maintained by community members. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. **[简体中文](#zh)** · **[English](#en)** ---

--- ## 简体中文 > [!NOTE] > **基于知乎开放平台官方 API 构建**，非爬虫抓取。所有检索结果均附带可引用的原始链接，知乎站内结果另附点赞数，让模型的每一次回答都有据可查。 搜索不幻觉，引用有出处。给 DSH 装上知乎：站内检索、全网检索与直答三个工具，返回可引用的来源列表，而不是一段无法核对的摘要。 ### 与 DSH 的集成方式 - **插件装配** — `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zhihu-search`，走官方 CLI，不手改配置。 - **工具注册** — 三个工具注册进 DSH 工具注册表，模型直接可调，无需额外配置。 - **原生设置卡片** — 在「设置 → 插件 → 插件配置」里填密钥，即刻生效，不碰配置文件。 - **密钥走凭据存储** — 存进 DSH 自己的凭据文件；`settings.yaml` 里只有引用名，可以安全截图或分享。 - **可选隐藏原生网页工具** — 一个开关让模型只看到知乎的三个工具，不看 DSH 原生的 `web_search` / `web_fetch`。 ### 三个工具 | 工具 | 用途 | |---|---| | `zhihu_search` | 知乎站内问答与文章，支持按点赞 / 评论 / 时间排序筛选高赞内容 | | `zhihu_global_search` | 知乎全网索引，可按域名和时间过滤，查找特定网站上的资料 | | `zhihu_zhida` | 知乎直答，成体系的综合回答，支持 `fast` / `thinking` / `agent` 三档 | 知乎原生的字符串查询语法由插件内部编译，模型只看到语义化参数——设计上不可能写错。 ### 截图


设置 → 插件 → 插件配置

### 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zhihu-search ``` 重启 DSH 后，在设置面板填入 Access Secret 即可。密钥在[知乎开放平台个人中心](https://developer.zhihu.com/profile)获取。 ### 链接 - GitHub：https://github.com/zlZayn/dsh-zhihu-search - npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-zhihu-search ↑ 回到顶部 --- ## English > [!NOTE] > **Built on the official Zhihu Open Platform API**, not web scraping. Every search result carries a citable original link, and Zhihu's own results also carry upvote counts — so every model answer can be traced back. Grounded search, cited answers. Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, global index search, and Zhida direct answers — returning a list of citable sources instead of an unverifiable summary. ### How it integrates with DSH - **Plugin mounting** — `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zhihu-search`, through the official CLI; no hand-edited config. - **Tool registration** — the three tools register into DSH's tool registry and are callable by the model with no extra setup. - **Native settings card** — enter the key under **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration**; it takes effect immediately. - **Key stored in the credential store** — the secret goes into DSH's own credential file; `settings.yaml` holds only the reference name, so it is safe to screenshot or share. - **Optional hiding of native web tools** — one switch leaves the model with only the three Zhihu tools, hiding DSH's native `web_search` / `web_fetch`. ### The three tools | Tool | Use it for | |---|---| | `zhihu_search` | Zhihu's own questions and articles, sortable by votes / comments / time to surface highly upvoted content | | `zhihu_global_search` | Zhihu's global web index, filterable by domain and date, for finding material on a specific site | | `zhihu_zhida` | Zhihu Zhida: a synthesized answer that pulls a topic together, in `fast` / `thinking` / `agent` modes | Zhihu's native string query syntax is compiled inside the plugin — the model only ever sees semantic parameters, so it cannot get them wrong. ### Screenshots


Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration

### Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zhihu-search ``` Restart DSH, then enter your Access Secret in the settings panel. Get the key from the [Zhihu Open Platform profile](https://developer.zhihu.com/profile). ### Links - GitHub: https://github.com/zlZayn/dsh-zhihu-search - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-zhihu-search ↑ Back to top --- 欢迎试用、交流或提 Issue。 · Feedback and issues welcome.

discussions.title: dsh-neubrutalism-theme: Neubrutalism Web UI theme for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body: 给 DSH 写了一套最近个人非常喜欢的 Neubrutalism 风格的主题 仓库：[https://github.com/MoriTang/dsh-neubrutalism-theme](https://github.com/MoriTang/dsh-neubrutalism-theme) ## 视觉与字体 主题遵循 [Neubrutalism 指南](https://neubrutalism.com/)的视觉语法：2px 控件描边、3px 容器描边、方角、零模糊偏移阴影、有限的纯色强调面，以及按钮抬起/按下反馈。 - 浅色基底采用 `#FFFDF5`，强调色使用 `#FFD23F`、`#FF6B6B`、`#74B9FF`、`#88D498`、`#FFA552` 和 `#B8A9FA`。 - 深色模式保留同一信息层级，改用深色表面、米白描边和高亮强调色。 - 层级阴影采用紧凑的 2px、4px 和 6px 硬偏移；消息次要操作降为 1px。 - 展示标题：Syne Variable 800。 - 标题与控件：Space Grotesk Variable 700。 - 正文：Inter Variable；中文回退为 PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei。 - 代码：Space Mono 400/700。 字体由 Fontsource 包安装。构建时只取 Latin WOFF2，并以内联 data URL 写入 `lib/client.js`，因此浏览器运行时不访问 Google Fonts，也不要求操作系统预装字体。 ## 安装 ```sh git clone https://github.com/MoriTang/dsh-neubrutalism-theme.git ``` 插件已经提交构建产物，使用者不需要在插件目录运行 `pnpm install` 或重新构建。从 Harness checkout 将插件注册到 `web` profile： ```sh cd /path/to/deepseek-harness pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-neubrutalism-theme ``` 注册后重启 `pnpm dsh web`。bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会插入 `neubrutalism-theme` Loader 条目，package manifest 会把 `lib/client.js` 作为 Web client half 加载。 卸载时运行： ```sh pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-neubrutalism-theme ``` 主题通过两个 Cordis effect 持有 token 覆盖和 `

discussions.title: [Bug] v0.1.6-alpha.1 Web 侧边栏终端（Windows）：① 选区 Ctrl+C 触发中断而非复制 ② 受限权限模式下 PSReadLine 历史文件 Access denied，终端不可用
discussions.body:
**环境**：v0.1.6-alpha.1（pre-release）· Windows · 网页端 · 新增的 Web 侧边栏终端（多标签）· shell 为 PowerShell

v0.1.6-alpha.1 新增的 Web 侧边栏终端用下来遇到两个问题：

## ① 有选区时按 Ctrl+C 触发中断，而不是复制选区

**复现**：终端有输出时用鼠标选中一段文字，按 `Ctrl+C`。
**期望**：有选区时 `Ctrl+C` 复制选区；无选区时才发送 `^C` 中断当前命令。这也是 Windows Terminal / VS Code 集成终端的共同惯例。
**实际**：`Ctrl+C` 直接走了中断路径，选中的文字没有被复制，正在运行的前台命令被打断。

**建议**：处理按键时先看终端选区——非空则复制并清选区、拦截这次按键不下发 `^C`；为空再走中断。另可保留 `Shift+Ctrl+C` 之类强制中断的兜底。社区插件 dsh-kit 的终端面板就是按这个惯例分流的（无选区且无 Shift 时才把 `Ctrl+C` 下发为中断），可供参考。

## ② 同一工作区、不同权限模式的对话打开终端：PSReadLine 历史文件 Access denied

**复现**：同一工作区开多个对话、以不同权限模式运行；在权限更受限的对话里打开侧边栏终端，PowerShell 启动/敲命令即报（报错中的用户名与工作区路径已打码）：

```
PS <工作区路径>>
Error reading or writing history file 'C:\Users\<用户名>\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\PSReadLine\ConsoleHost_history.txt': Access to the path 'C:\Users\<用户名>\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\PSReadLine\ConsoleHost_history.txt' is denied.
This error will not be reported again in this session. Consider using a different path with:
    Set-PSReadLineOption -HistorySavePath <Path>
Or not saving history with:
    Set-PSReadLineOption -HistorySaveStyle SaveNothing
```

之后使用中还伴随输入回显异常，命令历史完全不可用，实际观感是**终端不可用**。

**可能原因**：终端里的 PowerShell 共享用户级 PSReadLine 历史文件（`%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\PSReadLine\ConsoleHost_history.txt`），而受限权限模式启动的终端进程对该路径没有读写权限。

**建议方向**：

1. 受限权限模式下给终端注入会话级独立的 history 路径（例如以 `-NoExit -Command "Set-PSReadLineOption -HistorySavePath <会话/工作区级路径>"` 方式启动或注入对应 profile），顺带避免多个终端互抢同一个全局历史文件；
2. 或在受限终端里默认 `Set-PSReadLineOption -HistorySaveStyle SaveNothing`；
3. 至少让 PSReadLine 读写失败静默降级，不要以「终端不可用」的观感呈现给用户。

discussions.title: [computer-use] Mac Retina 实测 4 条改进建议（坐标双标/快照15秒/不可验证/省图模式）
discussions.body:
## 背景（实测）

Mac Retina 2x（1440x900pt @2x），DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1 + dsh-computer-use 0.3.1 + cua-driver 0.23.2。
用自研比例点击（截图估 fx/fy → 窗口 frame × 比例 → cliclick 直点）+ 官方 observe 混跑，完整下完国际象棋人机对局并走通网易云音乐全链路：45+ 次棋盘小格点击坐标零失手。以下 4 条是官方链路实测中的硬伤。

## 1. 统一坐标空间（最痛，P0）

- 实测：`computer_click(x, y)` 把输入按**物理像素**处理（传 401 落到 200.5pt，即内部 /2）；而 AX 树报的是 **pt**。两套数字混用必偏，且无文档说明。
- 建议：统一为 pt 并写进文档，或原生支持比例坐标 `fx/fy`（0~1），Retina 天然免疫。

## 2. 快照 15 秒过期太短（P0）

- 实测：模型一轮推理必超 15 秒，`observe → click` 跨回合 100% 被拒，只能同回合连发。
- 建议：TTL 放宽到 120 秒，或点击时允许“过期快照 + 强制刷新确认”参数。

## 3. `effect: unverifiable` 等于没说（P1）

- 实测：每次点完都要自己再截一图验证，等于双倍图片 token。
- 建议：点击后可选返回落点小图 diff 或点中/疑似偏/失败三态置信度。

## 4. 省图模式（P1）

- 实测：OpenAI 上游 50 张/请求硬限制，每步截图的 Agent 必死。我们用“定标一次+公式走位+AX 文字验盘”绕过（全程 12 张图）。0.1.6 的 image offload 是对的方向，请求 computer-use 侧配合：observe 加 `text-only` 轮询模式 + 文档给长闭环省图示例。

## 附：我们的融合形态（供参考）

官方管看（observe/AX/截图）+ 自研管点（frame × 比例 → cliclick，无虚拟光标动画）。frame 取数三源 fallback：osascript → Quartz（免自动化权限）→ 报错停手。

discussions.title: [Migration] v0→v1 拒收两种由 0.1.1-rc.2 写出的合法形态（descriptor v2 / plugin source summary）—— 升级后 255/256 条会话打不开
discussions.body:
## 摘要 / Summary

真实环境从 **0.1.1-rc.2（当时 npm `latest`）升到 0.1.5-rc.2（`next`）** 后，**256 条旧会话里 255 条打不开**，GUI 里逐条报 `历史加载失败: failed to observe session …`。原因不是数据损坏，而是 v0→v1 迁移器**拒收两种由 0.1.1-rc.2 自己写出的、已发布的 v0 形态**——迁移器接受的形态清单没覆盖它们：

1. `subagent/descriptor` 的 `data.version: 2`（迁移器只认 3；**231 / 256** 条会话命中）；
2. 插件注入消息的 `source.summary` 搭配非 `notice` 的 `form`（写方是 dsh-mnemon 0.3.5；**223 / 256** 命中）；**199** 条两者都有。

fail-fast 本身没问题——`source v0 artifact remains unchanged`，原件一个字节没动（76,081 个 zstd 帧、0 撕裂）。但对**正常升级路径**代价很大：一次版本升级就让近 90% 的历史不可读。我已用**未修改的**迁移链验证：只把这两处形态本地规范化，**256 / 256 全部通过（241,872 个事件、0 失败）** ⇒ 缺口在"迁移器接受的形态清单"，不在数据。

这两条形态此前未被上报（与 #5694 的 `replayState.kind`、#5909 都不是同一个）；另外我核对了 **0.1.6-alpha.1 的同一段代码逐字节相同** ⇒ 目前所有已发布版本都尚未修复。

---

Upgrading one real installation from **0.1.1-rc.2 (then npm `latest`) to 0.1.5-rc.2 (`next`)** left **255 of 256** legacy sessions unreadable (`failed to observe session …`). Two released-v0 shapes are refused, and both were **written by 0.1.1-rc.2 itself** — the accepted-variant inventory is simply missing them: `subagent/descriptor` with `data.version: 2` (231/256 sessions; the migrator accepts only `3`, behind *two* gates), and a plugin source carrying `summary` with a non-`notice` `form` (223/256; writer was dsh-mnemon 0.3.5). Fail-fast is the right default (`source v0 artifact remains unchanged`; 76,081 zstd frames, 0 torn), but on the ordinary upgrade path it costs ~90% of a user's history. With those two shapes normalized locally, the **unmodified** chain migrates **256/256 sessions, 241,872 events, 0 failures** — the gap is the inventory, not the data. Neither shape appears in the previously reported threads, and **0.1.6-alpha.1 ships byte-identical code**, so no published version fixes it yet.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` (npm `next`); previously `0.1.1-rc.2` (npm `latest`) for ~2.5 weeks
- macOS 14 (Darwin 23.6.0, arm64), node v24.20.0, launchd-managed `dsh web --no-open` (127.0.0.1:3080)
- Plugins present: `dsh-mnemon` 0.3.5 (upgraded to 0.5.9 in the same window), `dsh-context`, `dshmarket`, `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`, and a few local plugins
- Sessions are all header `version: 0` (`session.jsonl.zstd`), i.e. they never got rewritten; the v0→v1→v2→v3 migration runs lazily **on read**, which is why the breakage only appears when a conversation is opened

## Shape 1 — `subagent/descriptor` with `data.version === 2`

Verbatim record from `session.jsonl.zstd` (real, `label` is the delegating plugin's own text):

```json
{"type":"subagent/descriptor","seq":152547,"time":1788023939929,"data":{"version":2,"mode":"one-shot","provider":"fork","label":"Mnemon idle checkpoint review"}}
```

Observed error:

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1 refuses this format v0 Session:
subagent/descriptor 152547 uses unsupported descriptor version 2
source v0 artifact remains unchanged
```

Refusal site — `dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1/lib/index.js:1584-1588`:

```js
if (event.type === "subagent/descriptor" && data["version"] !== 3) {
  const descriptorVersion = sessionFormatCount(data["version"], `${event.type} ${event.seq} version`);
  if (version === 0) throw new SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError(`${event.type} ${event.seq} uses unsupported descriptor version ${descriptorVersion}`);
  return;
}
```

**There is a second gate behind it.** Relaxing only the `if` above moves the failure to the generic literal validator (`lib/index.js:591`):

```
subagent/descriptor 152547 version must be one of 3
```

So a fix has to widen the accepted `version` inventory (disposition/payload validation), not just the early check.

Scale: **231 / 256** sessions, 1–N occurrences each, all `version: 2` (no other historical values observed).

## Shape 2 — plugin source carrying `summary` with a non-`notice` `form`

Verbatim record (message text elided, 275 chars):

```json
{"type":"user/message","seq":9,"time":1788877342296,"data":{"id":"7104423c-d1b6-4885-8cc6-bc0a1ca09529","role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"[MNEMON] <instructions, elided>"}],"source":{"kind":"plugin","plugin":"dsh-mnemon","form":"instructions","summary":"Optional memory recall and remember reminder"}},"surfaceOp":"append"}
```

Observed error:

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1 refuses this format v0 Session:
user/message 9 source summary requires notice form
source v0 artifact remains unchanged
```

Refusal site — `lib/index.js:948-949`, with the form allowlist at `934-941`:

```js
if (form === "notice") stringValue(source["summary"], `${label} summary`);
else if (source["summary"] !== void 0) throw new SessionFormatError(`${label} summary requires notice form`);
```

Note that released v0 declared `summary` as an **optional member of any plugin source** (`assertReleasedV0Keys(source, ["kind","plugin"], ["form","sections","summary"], label)` at `lib/index.js:919-926`), so the *cross-field* rule ("summary ⇒ notice") is the newer, stricter constraint. The historical writer is dsh-mnemon 0.3.5, whose `createPluginMessage(text, form)` emits `{kind:"plugin", plugin, form}` plus a UI `summary`; **mnemon 0.5.9 no longer emits `summary`** (verified in its source), so this shape stops being produced — but it stays in every log written before the plugin upgrade.

Scale: **223 / 256** sessions, exactly 1 occurrence each. **199** sessions carry both shapes.

## Impact

- 255 / 256 sessions refused; the GUI reports `历史加载失败: failed to observe session … (gateway/internal)` per session.
- Nothing is lost: the migration leaves the source artifact untouched, and the persistence publishes a validated current successor once a read succeeds (verified: after local normalization, `session.jsonl.zstd` and `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` coexist in the same session directory).

## Repro (no private data required)

```js
import { sessionFormatCatalog } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-catalog';

const rows = [headerRow, ...physicalEventRows]; // decoded JSONL rows of a v0 artifact
const restore = sessionFormatCatalog.createRestore(rows[0], { recovery: 'strict', validation: 'current' });
for (const r of rows.slice(1)) restore.decodeRow(r);
restore.finish(); // throws with the messages above
```

A minimal artifact consisting of the session header plus either record above is sufficient.

## Verified local normalization (what a fix would need to do)

Applied in-memory per file, then run through the **unmodified** chain above:

1. `subagent/descriptor.data.version`: `2 → 3` (231 records);
2. delete `source.summary` where `form !== "notice"` (223 records).

Result: **256 / 256 sessions migrate, 241,872 events, 0 failures.** Every touched payload also passes the v3-side validation — i.e. these `version: 2` descriptor payloads satisfy the `version: 3` key/type/semantic checks as-

discussions.title: Windows 0.1.6-alpha.1: embedded CUA loses snapshot handles and DPI alignment
discussions.body:
# Windows 0.1.6-alpha.1: embedded CUA loses actionable snapshot metadata and DPI alignment

Two independently reproduced integration problems prevent reliable native computer use in DSH Web on Windows. Both are currently worked around locally; this report asks for supported upstream fixes rather than adopting the local workaround verbatim.

## Environment

- Windows 11, build 26100.9278; display scaling is relevant (not a verified 100%-scaling-only reproduction).
- Node.js 24.20.0; official DSH CLI/Web 0.1.6-alpha.1.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use`, `dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native`, and `dsh-mcp-client`: 0.1.6-alpha.1.
- Provider-pinned `@trycua/cua-driver`: 0.28.0.
- Profile dependencies use the official CLI core through the profile fallback resolution mechanism.

## 1. Required snapshot handles are absent from model-visible results

Reproduction:

1. Enable the native CUA provider in the Web profile.
2. Call `cua_driver_native__get_window_state` on a normal window with a button and editable field.
3. Compare the canonical result with the model-facing text/image projection.

The native result contains `structuredContent.snapshot_id` and `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Its ordinary text contains a tree with element indices but no snapshot ID or token. The DSH MCP adapter preserves `structuredContent` as canonical data, yet `createOutput().render()` only calls `extractText(value.content, rawName)`. The image projection likewise uses the content blocks.

Consequently the model cannot supply the fresh handle required by UIA actions, even though the provider's guidance tells it to use `element_token`. This pushes the model toward coordinate/WM_CHAR routes that do not work for all targets, including the tested WinUI Notepad editor.

Local workaround: append a textual projection of native structured metadata in the CUA provider before passing the result to the existing MCP adapter, retaining canonical data and image handling. Omit duplicate tree text, legacy windows, and screenshot base64 from that projection. This also exposes action evidence such as `effect: confirmed` versus `unverifiable`.

Validation through the live DSH ToolRuntime (with actual session agents): model-visible snapshot text contains both handle fields; a button click changes a counter; UIA text input reports confirmed readback. Separately, a new empty WinUI Notepad tab accepted and returned the exact test string through ValuePattern. Test text/tab was removed without modifying the restored user document.

Expected: actionable snapshot identity and outcome evidence should remain available to the model with or without image admission. A general MCP bridge fix may be more appropriate than the narrow local provider workaround.

## 2. Embedded Node host DPI initialization affects coordinate input

In an independent process using the exact installed native SDK, a WinForms test window exposed inconsistent coordinate spaces before DPI initialization: UIA frames/screenshot dimensions differed from the physical window bounds. UIA token invocation succeeded, whereas a screenshot-coordinate click reported delivery without changing the counter. A foreground attempt also failed to land on the intended window.

Initializing the Node process with `SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2)` before creating the native driver corrected the observed coordinate alignment. In a DPI-aware test fixture, background screenshot-coordinate clicking and explicit foreground SendInput each incremented the counter (0 → 1 → 2). No elevation or Windows permission bypass was used.

The local DSH provider initializes DPI before importing/creating the native SDK, using a small Win32 FFI dependency. It fails explicitly if the existing host awareness is incompatible. This is a local workaround, not a recommendation to silently change arbitrary embedding hosts: the durable upstream solution should address the SDK/host contract, worker thread awareness, and capture coordinates, including DPI-unaware target apps.

Evidence limits: these are bounded local reproductions, not certification for every display layout or Windows framework. A target that closes itself can also cause foreground verification to complain after successful closure; applications without suitable background input support still need outcome verification and appropriate foreground handling.

## Related Web-profile findings

- Earlier, New Session silently failed with `tools.restrict() requires a scoped context (agent.ctx)`. Core tools and the profile browser runtime resolved separate instances of `dsh-scope`, even at the same version. Making both resolve the core's exact module instance fixed session creation and cold history resume. This appears related to existing reports such as https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/927 . Sharing only a symbol should not be assumed sufficient without also considering module-local ancestry/carrier state.
- The experimental Chrome attach provider's first-live-session exclusivity is documented behavior, not reported here as an implementation defect. For this user's desired shared real Chrome, the official host-scoped `dsh-mcp-client` bridge worked: four live sessions each saw 29 Chrome tools and successfully called `list_pages`. A dedicated fixture also passed click/fill/readback through DSH.
- One browser reconnect timeout was explained by the user not yet seeing Chrome's Allow prompt. It is not evidence of a transport defect. The local tool deadline was extended to allow time for that user-controlled approval.

No credentials, browser session tokens, user conversation contents, or full runtime logs are included in this report.

discussions.title: dsh-anthropic-membership — Sign in with Claude Pro/Max (no API key)
discussions.body:
**dsh-anthropic-membership** — Sign in with Claude Pro/Max inside DeepSeek Harness. No Anthropic API key.

https://github.com/antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership
```

Restart `dsh web`, then **Settings → Models → Sign in with Claude Pro/Max**. It stores the same membership OAuth grant Claude Code uses (`llm-pi-ai/anthropic`).

**Plan badge (main chat)** — a composer-dock pill: `CLAUDE · 5H % · WK % · DSH n`. 5-hour and weekly percents come from `GET /api/oauth/usage` (same source as Claude Code `/usage`). Message count is DSH user turns in the current 5h window only. Anthropic does not publish remaining messages; the card never invents a leftover count, tokens, or dollars.

It also patches two Anthropic lockups that otherwise freeze a long session:

1. **Many-image 2000px** — DSH can send request images with a 2048px long edge. Anthropic rejects many-image requests above 2000px and retries keep sending the same history. The plugin downscales request images to 2000px. Same class of failure as https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5728
2. **`/compact` over a 1M window** — when the live prompt is already over the model cap, DSH's summarizer replays that same prompt and returns `Compaction could not produce a useful summary`. The plugin slims compaction calls (drop images and reasoning, truncate huge tool text) so `/compact` can land.

Loopback control API is `127.0.0.1:8185`, Origin pinned to the DSH UI, CSRF header required. Usage fetch is host-side only (60s cache). MIT.

discussions.title: Web profile Connection RPC routes fail to mount because webServer is not injected
discussions.body:
## Summary

In a DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` web profile, a profile-bundle plugin that mounts a Connection RPC channel through `connection.rpc.handle()` can fail silently.

`HostConnectionService.register()` resolves `owner.webServer`, but the assembled connection loader row injects only `webRuntime`, not `webServer`. Cordis therefore throws `cannot get property "webServer" without inject` inside a nested-inject child fiber's effect. That exception is not surfaced in the parent fiber state or normal logs, so the RPC channel is never mounted.

Browser requests such as `POST /ollama-cloud/settings/read` then fall through to the web server's SPA/static fallback and return `405`. In the downstream UI this appears as `0 models / Not configured` and a failed Provider Usage panel.

This affects any web-profile plugin calling `connection.rpc.handle()`, not only `dsh-llm-ollama`.

## Environment

- DSH core (`app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*`): `0.1.5-rc.2`
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis`: `4.0.2`
- Web profile bundles:
  - `dsh-llm-ollama`: `0.6.24`
  - `dsh-llm-providers-ui`: `0.2.9`
  - `@dsh-external/dsh-super-injector`: `0.3.3`
  - `dsh-session-search-pro`: `0.2.0`
- Host: Windows 11 portable installation
- DSH web endpoint: `127.0.0.1:3080`

The plugin's compatibility table declares DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` compatible.

## Expected behavior

After installing `dsh-llm-ollama@0.6.24` and `dsh-llm-providers-ui@0.2.9` into a web profile:

- The host mounts the `/ollama-cloud` RPC channel, including `settings/read`, `credential/status`, `usage/read`, `models/discover`, and `settings/save`.
- The LLM Providers card displays discovered models and credential state.
- Provider Usage displays quota data.

## Actual behavior

- The provider card renders but shows `0 models / Not configured`.
- Provider Usage shows `加载失败`.
- Authenticated `POST /ollama-cloud/settings/read` with the expected envelope returns `405`.
- The web server prefix-route table contains `/super-injector/api`, `/plugins`, `/api`, and `/open-in-app/icon`, but no `/ollama-cloud`.

The rest of the host-side plugin is active:

- `llm.adapters` contains `ollama-cloud`.
- `llm.discoveries` contains `llm-ollama`.
- `web.searchProviders` and `web.fetchProviders` contain `ollama-cloud`.
- `settings.describe()` contains the `llm-ollama` section.

The failure therefore occurs after the plugin mounts its other services, specifically while registering the RPC channel. The fiber remains active, exposes no error property, and produces no stdout/stderr error.

## Reproduction

1. Create a fresh web profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`, `dsh-llm-ollama@0.6.24`, and `dsh-llm-providers-ui@0.2.9`.
2. Start `dsh web` and open **Settings → LLM 供应商**.
3. Observe the `0 models / Not configured` card and failed Usage panel.
4. In DevTools, observe `POST /ollama-cloud/...` returning `405`.
5. Inspect the running host's web server route table: `/ollama-cloud` is absent.
6. Instrument `HostConnectionService.register()` or wrap the plugin's `rpc.handle()` call with `try/catch`.

Observed instrumentation:

```text
register CALL channel=/ollama-cloud
register THROW channel=/ollama-cloud
ERR: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
```

Captured stack:

```text
Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:618:35)
    at Proxy.register (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:618:16)
    at Object.handle (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:543:39)
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (dsh-llm-ollama/lib/index.js:1868)
    at Object.callback (dsh-llm-ollama/lib/index.js:1864)
```

## Root cause

`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js` effectively does the following:

```js
get rpc() {
  const owner = this.ctx;
  return {
    handle: (channel, handler) => this.register(owner, channel, handler),
    // ...
  };
}

register(owner, channel, handler) {
  // ...
  const route = { kind: "prefix", path: channel, handler: /* ... */ };
  return owner.effect(
    () => owner.webServer.register(route),
    // ...
  );
}
```

`register()` requires the owner context—the context that obtained the connection service—to resolve `webServer`. Cordis's context proxy rejects that property access unless `webServer` is in the relevant fiber's inject list.

Two assembly details compound the problem:

1. Injecting `webServer` into the downstream plugin's top-level or nested inject does not fix it. `register()` resolves `webServer` through the connection service's captured `this.ctx`/owner context. This was verified with the plugin fiber injecting `['llm', 'connection', 'webServer']`; the same exception remained.
2. The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` bundle patch assembles the connection row with `inject: [webRuntime]`. The module's own default injection (`['credentials']`) also omits `webServer`. Nothing in the resulting assembly gives the connection service's host context a resolvable `webServer`.

Because the throw occurs inside `connectionCtx.effect(...)` in a nested-inject child fiber and is not logged, the parent plugin appears healthy while the channel is absent.

## Verified workaround

Adding `webServer` to the connection row in `data/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` fixes the problem. Patch merge is per key, so the row's existing name/config remains intact:

```yaml
# HostConnectionService.register() reads owner.webServer.
- id: connection
  inject:
    - webRuntime
    - webServer
```

After reloading the connection plugin or restarting DSH:

- The `/ollama-cloud` prefix route is registered.
- `settings/read` returns the full model catalog and credential state.
- `credential/status` returns `configured: true, writable: true`.
- `usage/read` returns real quota data.

## Suggested fixes

Either of these would address the core defect:

1. In the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` bundle patch, declare `inject: [webRuntime, webServer]` for the connection row while leaving `register()` semantics unchanged.
2. Change `HostConnectionService.register()` so route registration uses the connection service provider's own context captured during construction/apply, instead of resolving `webServer` through the caller-owned context. The connection plugin row should then declare `webServer` unconditionally.

## Debuggability improvements

- Log Cordis child-fiber/effect exceptions instead of silently swallowing them.
- Return `404` rather than `405` for unknown-path POST requests in the SPA/static fallback, so a missing route can be distinguished from a mounted route rejecting the method.
- Add an integration test covering the real web-profile assembly (bundle row injection plus Cordis proxy guards). `dsh-llm-ollama`'s current `tests/rpc.spec.ts` injects a mock connection, so it does not exercise this path.

## Downstream impact

The directly affected plugin is [`NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama`](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama). Its large provider-avatar empty state is a consequence of `settings/read` failing; after the route is mounted, the card returns to its normal compact state.

discussions.title: directory-picker: 客户端无法查询 capability，非 loopback 绑定下第三方 directoryFlow 必然失败（dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1 实测）
discussions.body:
## 现象

`dsh web`（profile web）把 webserver 的 host 配成 `0.0.0.0`（局域网绑定）后，任何**抢占 `conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow` / `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` 两个洞**的第三方插件，点「添加工作区」都会必然失败：

```
directory picker failed: directoryPicker.pick needs the native capability; the composed picker serves "browse"
```

这不是远程/手机独有：**从本机 `127.0.0.1` 打开这个 0.0.0.0 绑定的实例同样复现** —— capability 由 `bindHost` 决定，与客户端从哪来无关。

## 根因（两层）

**1）宿主只组装一个后端，这是设计如此。** `packages/host/directory-picker-auto/src/resolve.ts`：

```ts
if (facts.bindHost !== '127.0.0.1') return 'browse'
if (facts.ssh) return 'browse'
// darwin/win32 且非 SSH 才是 native；linux 还要 DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY + zenity/kdialog
```

只有「仅绑 loopback + 非 SSH + 有可用显示会话」才组装 `native`；其余一律 `browse`。而 `browse` 的 wire 动词**只有** `list` / `createDirectory`，`pick` 被 `DirectoryPickerController.requireCapability('native', 'pick')` 明确拒绝为 `directory-picker/unavailable`。

**2）客户端拿不到这个事实 —— 契约与实现之间有缺口。** `packages/host/directory-picker/src/index.ts` 的模块文档写着：

> Consumers switch on `capability().kind`; the union is merge-extensible, and the documented default for an unknown kind is to hide the picking affordance rather than fail.

但浏览器侧**没有任何通道能读到 `kind`**：

- `ctx.remote.directoryPicker` 只暴露 `pick` / `list` / `createDirectory`，没有 capability 查询方法；
- 唯一的门面 `UiWorkspaceService.pickDirectory()`（`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/navigation.ts`）把结构化失败压成普通 Error：

```ts
async pickDirectory(): Promise<string | null> {
  const result = await this.directoryPicker.pick()
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`directory picker failed: ${result.error.message}`)
  return result.value
}
```

宿主其实在错误里带了结构（`new RemoteError('directory-picker/unavailable', ..., { capability: capability.kind })`），但到调用方这里 `code` 与 `details.capability` 全部丢失，只剩一句人类可读文案。对比同一文件里的 `listDirectory` / `createDirectory` 走的是 `DirectoryBrowseError`（保留 `rpcError`）—— **只有 `pick` 这一条路丢了结构**。

于是第三方 flow 若按「宿主一定有 native」写（0.1.2 之前这是唯一形态），在 LAN 绑定下 100% 失败，而且失败信息只能靠字符串匹配去理解。

## 影响面与实测

- 所有以 `priority: -1` 抢占两个 `directoryFlow` 洞的第三方插件（要压过官方 0.1.2 起的默认占位者就必须这么做）；
- 我们自己的插件 `dsh-better-workspace` 实测（dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1 / Windows / webserver `host: '0.0.0.0'`）：
  - 0.11.2：点「添加工作区」→ 逐字弹出上面那句错误，工作区一个也加不上；
  - 同一环境换 0.11.3（按下面 workaround 修的版本）→ 应用内目录浏览器正常列出宿主目录、可选目录、能新建文件夹，自有流程完全保留。

## 我们目前的 workaround（能用，但都不干净）

1. **用 `list` 试探 capability**：`list` 在 `browse` 后端成功、在 `native` 后端以 `directory-picker/unavailable` 被拒 —— 一次调用即可判定。代价是 browse 侧会真的做一次目录列举（宿主主目录的 I/O），native 侧则白跑一个往返。
2. **对宿主文案做子串匹配**：捕获 `pick` 失败后匹配 `needs the native capability`。因为错误结构被 (2) 丢掉了，这是当前唯一能识别「不是 native」的信号 —— 文案一改就断。
3. `browse` 后端下自绘交互（用 `list` + `createDirectory` 做面包屑 / 新建文件夹 / 显示隐藏文件），`native` 后端下继续走 `pick`。

## 建议（按性价比排序）

1. **给客户端一个 capability 查询**：一个 `@Remote('capability')` 返回 `{ kind }`，并在 `UiWorkspace` 上透出（或退一步，让 `ctx.remote.directoryPicker` 暴露该字段）。这样第三方 flow 一次往返就能决定渲染哪种交互，不必拿真实 I/O 去试探，你们文档里那句 "consumers switch on `capability().kind`" 也才真的成立；「未知 kind 默认隐藏 picking 交互」这个约定也才可实现。
2. **别让 `pick` 独独丢掉错误结构**：`pickDirectory()` 至少保留 `code`（抛 `DirectoryBrowseError` 同款，或把原始 `RemoteFailure` 挂在 `cause`），让调用方能判别 `directory-picker/unavailable`。这是零协议风险的小改动。
3. **文档补一句现状**：在 directory-picker seam 与 ui-workspace 的 slots 契约里写明「客户端当前没有 capability 通道，第三方 directoryFlow 需自行探测」。否则文档会把第三方引向一条走不通的路。

如果 1 因为 API 冻结暂时不做，2 已经足够让第三方写出**不依赖文案**的降级逻辑。

## 环境

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1`（Windows / Git Bash）
- `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`：`- id: webserver` + `config: { host: '0.0.0.0', port: 3080 }`
- 复现：本机打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`（capability 仍是 browse）→ 点侧栏「添加工作区」
- 验证：隔离 DSH_HOME + 独立端口（不动正在运行的实例），headless Chrome over CDP 做 A/B

discussions.title: npm lines of dsh plugins are unusable: hooks-claude-code latest breaks every tool call, full next pin breaks boot
discussions.body:
## Context

Plugin-author report (measured 2026-09-15, not from docs): I am integrating an existing Claude Code plugin through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` and hit three packaging/documentation problems that make the published npm lines unusable. Environment: launcher `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` installed via npx (its core packages resolved to `0.1.5-rc.2`), macOS, pnpm 9.15.0, separate `headless` profile for the measurements.

## 1. Bridge `latest` breaks EVERY tool call (most severe)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code@latest` = `0.0.1-rc.5`. With the current launcher, every tool call in a headless session fails with:

```
agent.session.events is not iterable
```

Root cause (installed package, `lib/index.js:342`): `const last = [...agent.session.events].findLast(...)` — the runtime no longer exposes an iterable there. The fix exists in the alpha line: main branch uses `ctx.sessionProjections.stateOf(agent.session, "turnBoundary")` (`packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/index.ts`, `inject: ["shell", "sessionProjections"]`). Because the PreToolUse/PostToolUse listener throws, every tool call is normalized to a failure — tools are unusable, and PreToolUse hooks (guards) can never gate anything.

## 2. Pinning the whole set to `next` breaks profile boot

Full pin of `0.1.5-rc.2` across `dsh-hooks-claude-code`, `dsh-llm`, `dsh-tools`, `dsh-subagent`, `dsh-skill`, `dsh-skill-filesystem`, `dsh-fs`, `dsh-home-paths`:

```
dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to import loader entry subagent (@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent):
The requested module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm' does not provide an export named 'CallId'
```

Skill packages at `latest` (`0.0.1-rc.1` / `0.0.1-rc.3`) fail the same way on `assertNever` when mixed with the rc.2 line. The registry's `next` peer graph does not close: `dsh-subagent@0.1.5-rc.2` imports an export that registry `dsh-llm@0.1.5-rc.2` does not provide. Net effect: **neither npm line works** — `latest` breaks tools, `next` breaks boot; only the installation's internal, non-registry copies are consistent (which is why a vanilla profile works until you add an out-of-tree plugin).

## 3. `dsh plugin add` fails on pnpm 9

For a fresh profile (`dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg>`):

```
ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT  Running this command will add the dependency to the workspace root…
dsh: pnpm failed in profile directory …
```

The generated profile `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is `packages: ['.']`, so the profile directory IS the workspace root and pnpm 9 demands `-w`. Workaround used: `pnpm add -w` directly in the profile dir.

## 4. Bridge README drift (measured against the loader)

- "`transcript_path` stays in the payload for compatibility but is always `''`" — measured: a REAL path to a Zstandard-compressed session log (`~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`). Hook authors parse plain JSONL; a zstd path needs its own handling.
- "Smallest working setup" patch row (`- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'`) is rejected by the loader: `patch: id is required for non-insert patches`; with an `id` added, `patch: entry … not found`. Working form measured: `- insert: - id: <id>, name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code', config: {…}`.

## Requests

1. Make dist-tags line-consistent (all packages of one line under the same tag) or publish the supported launcher↔plugin pairing matrix — which bridge version matches launcher `0.1.5-rc.1`?
2. Fix `dsh plugin add` for pnpm 9 (or pass `-w` internally).
3. Update the bridge README (transcript_path, patch-row form).
4. Any guidance on a deployable pin today (e.g. alpha line from one tree) would be appreciated.

All findings are re-runnable: mount the bridge in a `headless` profile with a marker hook and trigger a bash tool call.

discussions.title: deepDDW — 把 DSH 变成局域网小团队的共享工作台：多用户记忆/知识库隔离 + 团队记忆治理（v0.6.0）
discussions.body:
## 这是什么

[deepDDW](https://github.com/ccch713/deepddw)（MIT）把官方 DSH 打包成**局域网小团队自部署**形态：服务器上部署一次，同一内网的电脑 / 手机 / 平板用浏览器访问同一份记忆和知识库。纯本地运行，数据不出内网。

动机很直接：DSH 官方默认只监听本机，且没有跨会话记忆；[为了局域网访问，社区里各种 tailscale + 自签 CA + Nginx 改 Host 的绕法](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/242)我们也都试过，deepDDW 把这条路做成了开箱即用的安装包。

## 三层能力（全部可核对）

**1. LAN 多端共享**
- 浏览器直连，无 App；每台设备独立 `device_id`（localStorage）+ 心跳在线状态
- Token 门禁（`Authorization: Bearer` / `X-DDW-Token`）+ 滑动窗口限速（默认 60 req/min/token，全局过载 503 保护）
- SQLite WAL + busy_timeout + 进程级写锁（20 并发写实测无 `database is locked`）

**2. 多用户记忆 / 知识库隔离**
- 每个成员独立记忆/知识库命名空间；设置面板三页签管理成员（在线状态 / 已吊销可提取记忆到共享空间 / 已删除）
- 设备绑定一人多机；成员识别手动验证防冒充

**3. 团队记忆治理（v0.6.0 新增）**

| 能力 | 入口 |
|---|---|
| 导入（JSONL / Markdown，含 Claude Code `MEMORY.md` 形状） | `POST /api/v1/migration/import`，支持 `dry_run` 预检 |
| 导出（JSONL / Markdown） | `POST /api/v1/migration/export` |
| 私有 → 团队共享提升 + 冲突队列 | `POST /api/v1/scope/promote` · `GET /api/v1/scope/conflicts` · resolve |
| 无痕会话（不写记忆、MCP `ddw.memory.put` 拦截） | `POST /api/v1/privacy/incognito` · 会话 `"privacy": true` |
| 检索健康探针（FTS5 / LanceDB / kb_search，拒绝静默降级） | `GET /api/v1/privacy/retrieval-health` |
| 注入预览（此刻会注入什么） | `GET /api/v1/privacy/injection-preview` |
| 中文检索调优 | bigram 分词 + `DDW_MEMORY_MIN_SCORE` 相关性阈值 |

## 快速开始

```bash
# 服务器上（已装 Node）
npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
git clone https://github.com/ccch713/deepddw.git && cd deepddw
./install.sh --with-dsh
./install.sh --port 8600
```

只要插件、不要整套部署：`dsh plugin add ./plugins/ddw-teams-panel`（deepDDW 也是纯 DSH cordis 插件，声明 `dsh.bundle`）。

## 质量与状态

- v0.6.0：[Release](https://github.com/ccch713/deepddw/releases/tag/v0.6.0) · 全量测试 203 passed · ruff F/E9 干净
- 已收录于 [awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness)（Memory & Knowledge 板块）；awesome-dsh-plugin 收录 PR 在审

## 求反馈

1. LAN 安装路径顺不顺（`install.sh` 在你的机器上跑了没有）
2. 隔离 / 治理模型是否符合你团队的协作习惯（尤其 scope promote 的冲突裁决流程）
3. 从 Claude Code / Codex 迁移记忆的真实成功率——Markdown 导入通道对 `MEMORY.md` / `AGENTS.md` 的覆盖还有哪些缺口

欢迎 issue：https://github.com/ccch713/deepddw/issues

discussions.title: [Bug] v0.1.6-alpha.1: computer-use packages missing dsh.bundle break profile boot
discussions.body:
### Summary

Since `dsh` **v0.1.6-alpha.1**, any profile that lists `@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use` or `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native` in `dsh.profile.bundles` crashes on boot with a hard error.

Both packages were published to npm at version `0.1.6-alpha.1` **without any `dsh.bundle` manifest**, while the new `dsh-app-boot` loader (also `0.1.6-alpha.1`) strictly requires `dsh.bundle.patch` for every package listed in `dsh.profile.bundles`. Because `dsh plugin add` is the documented installation flow and it appends the package to the profile's `bundles` list, following the docs makes the profile unbootable immediately after upgrading `dsh` from v0.1.5-rc.2 to v0.1.6-alpha.1.

### Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| dsh | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.1` (npm) |
| dsh-app-boot | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| OS | Windows 11 |
| Node.js | v25.8.2 |
| Profile | application-owned profile (desktop shell launches `dsh web`) |

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.1`.
2. Add the official computer-use plugin into a profile:
   `dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use@0.1.6-alpha.1`
   (the CLI appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`).
3. Run `dsh --profile web`.

### Actual result

Boot aborts during profile composition (the model backend — NINFER — starts fine; the crash is purely in the profile layer composition):

```
file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1019
                if (declared === void 0) throw new Error(`${binName}: profile bundle ${JSON.stringify(packageName)} declares no dsh.bundle in its package.json`);
                                               ^

Error: dsh: profile bundle "@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use" declares no dsh.bundle in its package.json
    at file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1019:34
    at Array.map (<anonymous>)
    at loadProfileDirectory (file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1016:25)
    at loadProfile (file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1061:9)
    at prepareProfile (file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/profile-boot-CuwbWsnH.js:208:18)
    at composeProfile (file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/profile-boot-CuwbWsnH.js:233:18)
    at runProfile (file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/profile-boot-CuwbWsnH.js:286:25)
    at async runCli (file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js:146:4)
    at async file:///…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js:168:23

Node.js v25.8.2
```

### Expected result

Per the official guide ("Package and install a plugin"), a package *without* a `dsh.bundle` declaration "still installs, but only as a plain dependency: `dsh plugin` prints a warning and activates no layer" — i.e., warn-and-skip, not a hard crash. Alternatively, the two official 0.1.6-alpha.1 packages should ship a valid manifest so the documented install flow works end to end.

### Evidence — verified against the npm registry

The published tarballs were downloaded and unpacked directly:

**1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use@0.1.6-alpha.1`**
Tarball: `https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use/-/dsh-computer-use-0.1.6-alpha.1.tgz`

- Contents: `package.json`, `lib/index.js`, `lib/types/*`, READMEs, LICENSE.
- Its `package.json` contains **no `dsh` key at all** (no `dsh.bundle`), and the package ships **no `cordis.patch.yml`** (the `files` list is only `lib/*`).

**2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native@0.1.6-alpha.1`**
Tarball: `https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native/-/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native-0.1.6-alpha.1.tgz`

- Same situation: no `dsh` key, no patch file.

The `dsh-app-boot` v0.1.6-alpha.1 loader (`loadProfileDirectory`) then executes:

```js
const declared = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(packageDir, "package.json"), "utf8")).dsh?.bundle?.patch;
if (declared === void 0) throw new Error(`... declares no dsh.bundle in its package.json`);
```

Result: a package that `dsh plugin add` is happy to append to `dsh.profile.bundles` is **guaranteed** to make the profile unbootable.

### Note on the manifest format change (possible breaking change)

The v0.1.5-rc.2 manifest format was the boolean form:

```json
{ "dsh": { "bundle": true } }
```

which booted fine under the old loader. v0.1.6-alpha.1 requires the object form with a patch path:

```json
{ "dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } } }
```

If this is an intentional breaking change, it deserves a release note, and the two computer-use packages need to be re-published with the new format.

### Workaround (confirmed working)

Remove the two entries from both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The profile then boots normally on 0.1.6-alpha.1 with no other plugins affected.

### Suggested fixes (any of the three)

- **(a)** Re-publish `@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native` with a valid `dsh.bundle` manifest (including the referenced patch file).
- **(b)** Have `dsh plugin add` not append bundle-less packages to `dsh.profile.bundles` (install as a plain dependency with a warning, as the docs describe).
- **(c)** Document the new strict loader behavior and the manifest-format change in the v0.1.6-alpha.1 release notes, and adjust the computer-use install flow accordingly.

discussions.title: [Bug] v0.1.6-alpha.1: "only one session can stay in browser" bug - by browser-use with attach mode
discussions.body: # [Bug] v0.1.6-alpha.1: browser-use runtime declares `dsh-scope` as a dependency — the profile loads two copies and every session after the first fails ### Summary Since v0.1.6-alpha.1, any profile that mounts the official browser-use provider (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp`) can no longer create a second session. The first session works; every session created while it is open fails, with the UI either doing nothing or discarding a saved session row. The cause is not browser-use. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime@0.1.6-alpha.1` declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` as an ordinary **dependency**, so the package manager materializes a second physical copy of `dsh-scope` inside the profile's own `node_modules`. `dsh-scope` identifies a scope with a plain per-module symbol, so with two copies `scopeOf(agent.ctx)` returns `undefined` for a genuinely scoped context. Core APIs that need that resolution then either throw or silently fall back to the global layer, and because the failing calls run inside the `agent/created` hook, session creation aborts. The same manifest already lists `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `dsh-agent`, `dsh-browser-use` and `cordis` as **peerDependencies** — exactly the treatment `dsh-scope` and `dsh-mcp-client` do not get. ### Environment | | | |---|---| | dsh | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.1` (npm `alpha`) | | dsh-scope | `0.1.6-alpha.1`, two physical copies loaded per process | | browser-use packages | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime` — all `0.1.6-alpha.1` | | OS | Windows 11 x64 | | Node.js | v24.19.0 | | Profile | CLI-created profile (`dsh --profile repro --from-default-profile web`) | | Reproduced | twice: on a long-lived install and on a clean machine | ### Steps to reproduce 1. Install `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.1` and create an empty profile: ``` npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@alpha dsh --profile repro --from-default-profile web ``` 2. Add the official browser-use plugins (the documented flow — the CLI appends them to `dsh.profile.bundles`): ``` dsh plugin --profile repro add @deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp ``` 3. Because `mode: launch` masks the failure (see below), mount the provider in attach mode instead. `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\repro\cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: browser-use name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use' - id: browser-use-playwright-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp' config: mode: attach endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9222 ``` 4. Start a Chrome with a live CDP endpoint and start the UI: ```powershell & "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" ` --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9222 ` --user-data-dir="$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\chrome-cdp-repro" about:blank curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version # must return JSON dsh --profile repro web ``` 5. Create **session #1**, send `hi`. It works, and browser tools are available. 6. **Leave session #1 open.** Create **session #2**, send `hi`. It fails. ### Actual result DevTools → Console (with *Preserve log*) shows the rejected RPC: ```json { "type": "server-response", "rpcId": "…", "result": { "ok": false, "error": { "code": "gateway/internal", "message": "failed to create session \"session-…\": Error: tools.restrict() requires a scoped context (agent.ctx): a context-global restriction would mask every agent — deny the tool for the intended agent instead" } } } ``` UI-level symptoms of this one failure: | | | |---|---| | Clicking "New session" does nothing | | | Clicking a saved session makes its row vanish until the page is refreshed | | | Choosing a workspace folder fails to create a session | | | A ~330-byte orphan session file is written each time | exactly 3 records, then nothing | The same defect produces a second, differently-worded error when the second Agent goes down the tool-registration path instead: ``` failed to create session "session-…": Error: mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed ``` with the underlying cause visible only in the server log: ``` mcp-client(playwright-mcp): tool registration failed, no tools registered: Error: tool "mcp__playwright-mcp__browser_close" is already registered (for a per-agent variant, register through that agent's `agent.ctx` instead) at NamedEntries.duplicateError (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634:59) at ScopedLayers. (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:206:12) at Proxy.register (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2884:22) ``` ### Expected result Session creation should not depend on whether another session holds the browser. The provider's own contract says so — `dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime/lib/types/mcp.js:39-45`: > *Await one MCP client during each future Agent's creation. **A busy attachment leaves that activation without browser tools; its other turns continue.** Calls are serialized per Session.* i.e. the second activation should lose browser tools and keep working, not abort `session/create`. ### Evidence — verified against the npm registry The published manifests were read directly from the registry. **1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime@0.1.6-alpha.1`** — `https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime/0.1.6-alpha.1` ```json "dependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope": "^0.1.6-alpha.1", "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "^3.18.2", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client": "^0.1.6-alpha.1" }, "peerDependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.0.2", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent": "^0.1.6-alpha.1", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "^0.1.6-alpha.1", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use": "^0.1.6-alpha.1", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt": "^0.1.6-alpha.1" } ``` `dsh-tools`, `dsh-agent`, `dsh-browser-use` and `cordis` are peers — the host provides them, one copy each. `dsh-scope` and `dsh-mcp-client` are ordinary dependencies, so the package manager is obliged to materialize its own copies. **2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp@0.1.6-alpha.1`** depends only on `@playwright/mcp@0.0.80` and the runtime; it does not pull `dsh-scope` directly. The duplication originates in the runtime's manifest. **3. Resulting install layout** — `\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\`: ``` cosmokit duplicated dsh-browser-use profile-only dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp profile-only dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime profile-only dsh-mcp-client duplicated dsh-scope duplicated ← dsh-util-values duplicated schemastery duplicated ``` None of these is a link, while the host continues to resolve its own copies from the global install: ```powershell $a = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\repro\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-scope\lib\index.js" $b = "$(npm root -g)\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-scope\lib\index.js" (Get-Item $a).FullName -eq (Get-Item $b).FullName # False — two distinct physical files, therefore two module instances ``` ### Root cause `packages/core/scope/src/index.ts` (read from a pristine checkout — `git status --porcelain` empty, `HEAD 141eb6fef8`): ```ts :18 const kScope = Symbol('dsh.scope') :137-140 export function createScope(ctx, key, options) { … const scoped: Context = fiber.ctx.extend({ [kScope]: key }) } :154-155 export function scopeOf(ctx) { return (ctx as …)[kScope] } ``` `createScope` **writes** `ctx[kScope]`; `scopeOf` **reads** `ctx[kScope]`. `Symbol()` returns a new unique symbol on every evaluation, so the handshake only works when both sides hold the same object — i.e. when `dsh-scope` exists once in the process. With two copies, `scopeOf(agent.ctx)` is `undefined`. Two core APIs then ask that question and get the wrong answer: **A — the designed-degradation path throws.** In `dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime/lib/types/mcp.js`, a second activation against an exclusive resource is admitted as `blocked`, then masked: ```js // :53-70 const refreshBlockedMasks = () => { … try { for (const [agent, state] of clients) { if (state.status !== 'blocked') continue; // :59 … state.mask ??= createScope(ctx, agent); // :64 writes kScope[copy B] state.mask.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny: inherited.map(t => t.name) }); // :65 reads kScope[copy A] } } finally { refreshingMasks = false; } // :68 try/finally — no catch }; ``` `dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2894-2895` then throws, and the exception escapes `refreshBlockedMasks` → the `agent/created` handler at `:129-141` → session creation. **B — tool registration lands in the global layer.** `dsh-tools.register()` is documented as *"Register globally or in the calling agent scope"* and resolves the layer with the same `scopeOf` (`:2876-2884`). Degraded, every Agent's MCP tools are inserted into the **global** layer, so the second insertion trips `NamedEntries.duplicateError` (`:2634`) — the stack quoted under *Actual result*. Because the provider hardcodes `failOnStartupError: true` (`mcp.js:102`), `dsh-mcp-client` swaps its default `registrationFailure: "contain"` for `"throw"` (`dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js:489-493`, rethrown at `:155-157`) and wraps it as `initial connection or tool synchronization failed` (`:832`), which is what makes an otherwise contained conflict fatal. ### Why `mode: launch` hides it The provider makes the browser resource exclusive only in attach mode (`dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp/lib/index.js:40`): ```js exclusive: config.mode === "attach", ``` so under `mode: launch` — the example in the provider README — `available()` short-circuits to `true` for every Agent (`dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime/lib/types/index.js:45-49`), `status` is never `'blocked'`, and line :65 is unreachable. The defect needs **attach mode or two concurrent Agents** to surface; with a single session nothing looks wrong. Ordinary MCP servers are also unaffected because they keep the default `failOnStartupError: false`, which contains the same conflict. ### Workaround (confirmed working) Replace the profile-local **real** copies of modules that are also provided by the host with directory junctions pointing at the host copy, so each module has exactly one physical file per process: ```powershell # quit dsh completely first — a running node.exe keeps these directories locked $p = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\repro\node_modules\@deepseek-ai" Move-Item "$p\dsh-scope" "$p\dsh-scope.bak" New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$p\dsh-scope" ` -Target "$(npm root -g)\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-scope" ``` Applied to all five duplicated modules (`dsh-scope`, `dsh-mcp-client`, `cosmokit`, `dsh-util-values`, `schemastery`); the three profile-only browser-use packages are correctly left alone, as the host has no copy to point at. Only `dsh-scope` is strictly necessary — the other four do not export identity tokens. Session creation recovers immediately. Two caveats: it must be re-applied after any `pnpm install` / `dsh plugin add`, and it should touch only `\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\*` — do **not** wipe `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`, since the heal step rebuilds only the install closure and would drop third-party scopes. ### Suggested fixes (any of the three) - **(a)** Move `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` from `dependencies` to `peerDependencies` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime` and re-publish — the identical treatment `dsh-tools`, `dsh-agent` and `dsh-browser-use` already receive in that same manifest. This removes the duplication at its source for every profile. - **(b)** Make the scope tag cross-instance in core: `packages/core/scope/src/index.ts:18` → `const kScope = Symbol.for('dsh.scope')`. This is layout-independent and is the level the fix belongs at; it is also this repo's existing idiom (Schemastery uses `Symbol.for('schemastery')`). Note it covers the `Symbol` facet only — `dsh-scope` also keeps carrier state in module-local collections, so (a) and (b) are complementary, not alternatives. - **(c)** Contract the blast radius: give `refreshBlockedMasks` a `catch` so the documented `blocked` degradation cannot abort `agent/created`; do not let a per-Session provider mount turn `session/create` into a 500; and include `cause` in the wrapped MCP error, which currently sends diagnosis toward "connection" when the failure is registration. ### Related reports - [#3148](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3148) — same root cause, same one-line fix, with a branch to cherry-pick (`kongminOS/deepseek-harness:fix/dsh-scope-symbol-for`). - [#2149](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2149) — same class of defect via `dsh-scope`'s module-local `WeakMap` carrier registry (`isScopeCarrier()` false for every dispatch). - [#6722](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6722) and [#6755](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6755) — the same browser-use symptom under `mode: launch`, with the duplicate-registration stack. - [#3984](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3984) → [#4025](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4025) — the design-level note that `activeServerNames` is keyed process-wide while the tool registry is per-agent, i.e. the `ctx.root` fallback this report explains the precondition of. - [#6459](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6459) — the shared `profiles/node_modules` fallback tree is rewritten per install anchor; do not delete it wholesale. *Screenshots of the install layout, the two-copies check and the workaround's verification output are attached below.*

discussions.title: Inline math: single-dollar spans always become math because the option is read from an empty object
discussions.body:
## Summary

Any `$…$` span in a chat message is rendered as inline math (KaTeX), so currency and shell text are destroyed: the dollar signs disappear, the words in between switch to math type, and every space inside the span is swallowed.

Input that a normal assistant answer produced:

```
tek tasarım için $1.64, diğer ikisi toplam $0.62.
```

Rendered as: `tek tasarım için 1.64, diğerikisitoplam 0.62.` — the two `$` are gone and "diğer ikisi toplam" is set as one italic math run.

## Environment

- `dsh` 0.1.1-rc.2 (npm global install), web profile, browser surface, dark theme
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend`, bundled `dist/assets/vendor-*.js`
- Reproduced with plain assistant prose — no extensions, no plugins, no custom theme

## Root cause

In the bundled frontend, the micromark math **text** construct reads its option from a fresh empty object:

```js
function w4(e) {
  let n = {}.singleDollarTextMath;
  n == null && (n = !0);            // always true
  return { tokenize: r, resolve: x4, previous: k4, name: "mathText" };
  …
}
```

`{}.singleDollarTextMath` is always `undefined`, so the `?? true` default always wins. The option can therefore never be disabled from outside: no matter what a caller passes, the bundled code inspects an empty literal. This looks like constant folding of an inlined `options = {}` argument at the call site — the construct parameter `e` is never read.

The same expression is present in the two newest published builds:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` 0.1.5-rc.2 → `function w4(e){let n={}.singleDollarTextMath;return n==null&&(n=!0),…}`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` 0.1.6-alpha.1 → `function t4(e){let n={}.singleDollarTextMath;return n==null&&(n=!0),…}`

So this is not fixed by upgrading, and passing `{singleDollarTextMath: false}` cannot work in the current build.

## Impact

- **Currency** in normal prose: `$1.64 … $0.62`, `$10 … $20`.
- **Shell / environment text**: `$HOME`, `$PATH`, `$1` — any two of them in one paragraph pair up into a math span.
- Inline code and code blocks are safe; ordinary prose, list items and table cells are not.
- `\(…\)`, `\[…\]` and `$$…$$` behave correctly — only the single-dollar **text** form is the problem.

## Suggested fix

1. Read the option from the real argument (`options?.singleDollarTextMath ?? true`) so a caller can turn it off, and
2. consider defaulting single-dollar text math to **false** — requiring `\(…\)` or `$$…$$` for math, the way most Markdown renderers do it — since `$` is far more common as a currency sign than as a math delimiter in chat.

A configuration setting for it would also be enough.

## Workaround (verified)

Escaping works: `\$1.64` renders as a literal `$1.64`, which confirms the construct honors character escapes and only the raw trigger is at fault.
