discussions.title: A settled background subagent poisons the session: its `reasoning` block is copied into a `user` notice, and every later turn fails with UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a background subagent settles, the harness splices a notice into the parent session as a **`user`** message:

> Background subagent `<id>` finished and will do no further work unless you send it more.
> Its closing message:
> …

That notice copies the subagent's closing message **verbatim, including its `reasoning` block**. But the DeepSeek Messages serializer only accepts `text` and `image` blocks in `user`/tool-result content, so it throws:

```
UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: DeepSeek Messages cannot represent user/tool-result content reasoning
```

Because the notice is persisted in the session log, the failure is **permanent and unrecoverable from the UI**: every subsequent turn re-serializes the same history and fails again. Retrying ("try again", sending a new message) cannot help — the poisoned message never goes away. The session is effectively dead, and the user loses all of its context.

Two of my sessions were killed this way. Fresh sessions are fine, which is what makes this look like an update regression at first glance.

## Reproduction

1. In a session, spawn a **background** subagent and let it run to completion.
2. Make sure the subagent's closing message contains a `reasoning` block (with `deepseek-flash` this is the normal case).
3. When the subagent settles, the parent session receives the `subagent-settled` notice.
4. Send any further message in the parent session.

Every turn from step 4 onward fails, including a bare "try again".

The offending events are `agent/inbox/spliced` and `user/message`, whose message carries
`source.kind: "subagent-settled"` and content blocks in this shape:

```jsonc
{
  "role": "user",
  "source": { "kind": "subagent-settled", "form": "notice", "summary": "Background subagent … finished…" },
  "content": [
    { "type": "text",      "text": "Background subagent <id> finished and will do no further work unless you send it more." },
    { "type": "text",      "text": "Its closing message:" },
    { "type": "reasoning", ... },   // <-- rejected by the serializer
    { "type": "text",      "text": "<the subagent's actual answer>" }
  ]
}
```

## Current behavior

`serialize()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` rejects the message, since its `input()` mapper allows
only `text` and `image` for `user`/tool-result content:

```js
if (block.type !== "image") return unsupported(`user/tool-result content ${block.type}`);
```

(`packages/.../dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js`, in the Messages `serialize` path; the thrower is
`unsupported()` → `LlmError(..., "UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT")`.)

So a block the harness itself put into the history is one the harness cannot serialize.

## Expected behavior

A settled-subagent notice should never be able to poison its parent session. Either:

- **drop (or downgrade to text) the `reasoning` block when composing the `subagent-settled` notice** — the subagent's internal reasoning has no value to the parent, and its final text is already included; or
- make the serializer skip `reasoning` blocks in `user`/tool-result content instead of throwing, the same way empty `text` blocks are dropped.

The first seems right — the bad data should not be written in the first place. The second would additionally rescue sessions that are already broken, of which there are presumably many in the wild, since nothing in the UI can repair them.

A migration or a repair path for already-poisoned session logs would help too: right now the only fix is to edit `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` by hand, and that file is a **chain of separate zstd frames whose first frame must be exactly one header line** — recompressing it as a single frame makes the harness reject it with `corrupt Zstandard session log: first frame is not exactly one header line`. So the repair has to re-compress only the affected frames and copy the rest byte for byte, which is not something a user can reasonably be expected to do.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.6-alpha.1** (installed globally from npm; the `latest` tag still points at `0.1.5-rc.1`)
- Model: `deepseek-flash`, agent preset `standard`, web profile
- Node.js 26.8.2, macOS 26.6.2 (arm64)

Side note that may be worth a separate look: `dsh --profile headless --session-id <id>` refuses sessions
that run under the `standard` agent preset ("which the one-shot runner does not compose"), so headless
cannot be used to inspect or rescue a session created in the web UI.

discussions.title: ``` (dsh-ssh-tui)为弱网环境/跳板机设计的 dsh 终端TUI 可以后台挂任务，有AI自动审核哦 ```
discussions.body:
自己经常从公司跳板进测试机写东西。官方默认那个 headless 跑完只往终端打最后一段 Markdown，中间模型在想什么、改了哪几个文件、子代理在干什么，屏幕上一片空白。链路再差一点，就干等，然后突然刷出一大块。

我也尝试过早期的dsh-tui，但dsh-tui更多是为本地环境考虑的，实际运行中还是有一些卡点，当时也没有我想要的功能，最后还是放弃了

所以做了 **dsh-ssh-tui**。人已经 SSH 坐在那台没桌面的机器上，过程就在这个终端里跟着画。纯 ANSI，一帧一次 `stdout.write`。README 里有同一条任务的对照图；还有按 **2 kB/s** 回放的 GIF，那次大概 14 次绘制、18 KB、8.8 秒画完，命令可以自己复现：`npm run screenshots:slow`。

合盖、跳板 idle、换网把 SSH 掐掉的时候：空着就落盘退出；模型还在跑就把 Host 留在机器上，重新连回去同一条 `--resume` 接着看。别再开第二个窗口，会抢会话。想让当轮自己在后台跑完，会话里 `/disconnect continue` 不用担心模型跑命令遇阻，我在里面添加了AI审核命令，默认由子代理完成，先过一遍基本规则，然后看情况再跑AI复审，避免模型执行遇阻发问卡住流程（尤其是在挂机后台跑的时候）也避免模型失控对机器造成一些不可逆破坏。

要尝鲜的朋友可以尝试安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile tui add dsh-ssh-tui@latest
dsh --profile tui
```

截止此文发布时间，现在发出来的是 **0.7.1**。如果加了 `@latest` 还是旧版，把后面换成 `dsh-ssh-tui@0.7.1`（pnpm 有时会咬着 lockfile，刚发布的包也可能被 `minimumReleaseAge` 悄悄跳过）。

dsh 这边 CI 过了 `0.1.5-rc.2`、`0.1.5-rc.1` 和 `0.1.2-rc.1`。已经跟到 `0.1.6-alpha` 的话，先停在 `0.1.5-rc.2`。

0.1.6 官方也出了远程盘那套（本机跑 dsh、文件在另一台）。我这边是人已经坐在跳板 / 服务器的 SSH 里开终端，两套可以一起用。

仓库和截图：https://github.com/cyjyyd/dsh-ssh-tui

装不上、断线接不回去的话，会话里跑一下 `/doctor` 和 `/diag`，把输出贴过来就行。
```

discussions.title: [Bug] 安装社区插件后 dsh web 不监听端口且 GUI 整体空白：启动路径零容错的根因与修法建议
discussions.body:
# 安装社区插件后 `dsh web` 不监听端口、GUI 整体空白 —— 启动路径零容错的根因报告

> **English abstract.** After installing a community plugin, `dsh web` can stay alive but never bind its port and print nothing at all, while the browser GUI goes entirely blank. Two independent zero-tolerance policies are responsible: (1) the host awaits tree settlement with an **unbounded** `while (true)` loop, so one plugin whose `apply`/top-level `await` never settles blocks boot forever; (2) the web client **throws away the whole client plugin tree** if *any single* client entry is not `active`, replacing the entire GUI — including the plugin marketplace page and the "local settings" page — with a failure screen. The host already ships a timeout for the marketplace's hot-mount path, so the unbounded boot path looks like an oversight rather than a design choice. Minimal fixes are proposed at the end of the body.

- **Component:** `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` (host + web client), plus the third-party plugin market `dshmarket` (unofficial, independently maintained) as an amplifier.
- **Version where reproduced:** `0.1.6-alpha.1` (installed CLI and repository checkout both `0.1.6-alpha.1`).
- **Platform:** macOS (Apple Silicon), Node per the package `engines` range.
- **Status of the code references below:** all harness-side references were re-verified against the current default branch (`master`) while writing this report; see [Verification status](#verification-status). The unbounded wait and the client-wide abort are **still present**.

---

## 1. 一句话结论

不是用户机器的问题，是 dsh 对"社区插件不 settle / 客户端条目未激活"**零容错**：

1. **宿主没有超时**：`boot()` 会 `await loader.await()`，而 `LoaderTree.await()` 是**无上限的 `while (true)`**，等待每个插件的 `apply` 与顶层 `await` 落定。只要有一个插件永不 resolve，`dsh web` **进程活着，但 HTTP 服务器永远创建不出来** → 端口不监听、日志一行不输出、所有页面打不开。
2. **客户端零容忍**：浏览器端只要**任意一个**客户端插件条目没变成 `active`，就 `throw` 掉**整个**客户端插件树，GUI 被替换成失败页 → 插件广场与"本地配置"（`ui-settings-plugin-inventory`）**一起**加载不出来。

两条策略互相独立，但它们会让用户看到同一个现象："整个 dsh 卡死了"。

---

## 2. 用户现象（复现步骤）

1. 在 Web GUI 的插件市场里安装某个社区插件（本次为 `@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`，非官方插件，独立维护）。
2. 按提示重启 `dsh web`。
3. 观察：
   - 终端**没有任何输出**（连 `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?token=…` 都不打印）；
   - `lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN` 里**没有**该进程的监听项；
   - `curl http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` 连接失败；
   - 进程**没有退出**，也没有崩溃日志。

对照组：同一个 profile 去掉这个插件后，`dsh web` 约 12 秒内正常打印 URL，`/` 与市场接口全部 200。

---

## 3. 决定性实验：一个永不 settle 的插件 = 整个应用不监听

在隔离的临时 `DSH_HOME` 中复刻 profile，只额外插入一个插件：

```js
// node_modules/hang-plugin/index.js
export const name = 'hang-plugin'
export async function apply(ctx) { await new Promise(() => {}) }
```

启动 `dsh web --port 0 --no-open` 后的观测：

| 观测项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 进程是否存活 | **活着**（未崩溃、未 exit） |
| 是否监听端口 | **完全没有**（LISTEN 条目 = 0） |
| stdout / stderr | **0 行** |
| `curl` 任意页面 | 连接失败 |

这就是"整个 dsh 卡死"的物理形态：**进程在，HTTP 服务器根本没起来**。机制上，`webserver` 是在插件激活过程中通过 `[Service.init]()` 执行 `listen()` 的；某个插件把树拖住后，`connection` / `frontend-static` 所在的激活阶段永远不完成，于是既没有监听、也没有就绪日志。

---

## 4. 根因链条

### 4.1 宿主：树落定无超时 → `loader.await()` 永不返回

```ts
// vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts
/** Wait until this tree has no pending import or lifecycle tasks. */
async await() {
  while (true) {
    const tasks = this.getTasks()
    if (!tasks.length) return
    await Promise.allSettled(tasks)
  }
}
```

调用点是裸 `await`，没有任何超时或竞速：

```ts
// packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts
await ctx.get('loader')?.await()   // boot() 路径
await ctx.loader.await()           // watchUserPatches 重建路径，同样无超时
```

Cordis 的 `fiber.inertia = this._reload()`：只要 `apply` 返回的 promise 不 settle，`inertia` 永不清空，于是永远留在 `getTasks()` 里，`await()` 的循环条件永远成立。

**启动路径上唯一的超时不在 boot**：`installFailLoud` 的 `FAIL_LOUD_RELEASE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000`（`index.ts`，导出常量）只用于"致命退出前把终端还回去"，不覆盖树落定等待。

值得注意的**内部不一致**：同一仓库的第三方插件市场热挂载代码（`dshmarket/lib/hot.js`）调用 `handle.await()` 时**包了一层超时**：

```js
function raceActivationTimeout(awaitable) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      reject(new ActivationTimeout(`activation did not settle within ${HOT_MOUNT_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000}s — the plugin may be waiting on a service that never arrives`))
    }, HOT_MOUNT_TIMEOUT_MS)
    Promise.resolve(awaitable).then(v => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(v) }, e => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(e) })
  })
}
```

也就是说，"插件可能永远不 settle"这件事**在仓库里已经被明确认知并处理过**，只是没有应用到 boot 路径上。这让 4.1 更像遗漏而非有意设计。

三类失败的不同命运（解释了为什么有的插件"只是不工作"、有的直接"卡死"）：

| 插件问题 | DSH 的反应 | 用户看到 |
|---|---|---|
| bundle 解析不到 / 缺 `dsh.bundle` | 立刻 throw（`profile.ts` 的 `resolveBundleDir` / `loadProfileDirectory`） | 进程退出，有明确报错 |
| 模块 import 抛异常 | 只记日志，条目标 `failed to import`，**boot 继续**（`vendor/loader/src/config/entry.ts`） | 该插件静默不生效 |
| **`apply` / 顶层 `await` 不 settle** | **彻底卡住**（`tree.ts` 的 `await()`） | **进程活着但什么都不响应** |

### 4.2 客户端：一个条目没激活 → 整个 GUI 被替换成失败页

```ts
// packages/client/web/src/boot-client.ts
export async function bootClient(options: ClientBootOptions): Promise<void> {
  // …每个 manifest 行 loader.create({ name })…
  await loader.await()
  assertEntriesActive(ctx)          // ← 任一非 active 条目即 throw
}

export function assertEntriesActive(ctx: Context): void {
  const failures: string[] = []
  for (const entry of ctx.loader.entries()) {
    // entry.fiber undefined → "import failed"
    // pending → "pending (waiting for service: …)"
    // 其它 → 状态名
  }
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(`web boot: ${failures.length} entr… did not activate\n${failures.join('\n')}`)
  }
}
```

`packages/client/web/src/boot.ts` 的 `catch` 直接 `this.page.fail(...)`，于是整个 UI 不再挂载。插件广场页面与"本地配置"页面都在这套 UI 内，所以**一起**消失。用户看到的是白屏/失败页，而真正的原因（哪个条目 pending、缺哪个 service）只在浏览器 console 里。

注意宿主与客户端策略的**不对称**：宿主只把 `requiredStartupEntryIds`（`agent-loop`、`webserver`、`modules`、`connection`、`headless-runner`、`acp`、`sdk-jsonrpc-server`）视为致命，普通插件失败只 warn；客户端却是"一个都不许失败"。这正是"宿主看起来没事、界面却空了"的来源。

### 4.3 还有一条硬致命路径

`modules` 属于 required id。若某个插件声明了 `dsh.client` 但没有可加载的 `./client` bundle（`packages/client/modules/src/index.ts`：`client-modules: <pkg> declares dsh.client but exports no "./client" bundle`），则启动审计直接把 required 失败升级为 throw → `boot()` reject → **整个 `dsh web` 进程退出**。比"卡死"更彻底：进程直接没了。

### 4.4 为什么会和"装插件"强相关

- **宿主侧没有任何版本闸门**：`dsh plugin add` 只是把包交给包管理器安装并写入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；Node 在 import 时也不校验插件声明的宿主/peer 版本区间。于是"装得上"与"跑得起来"完全脱钩，而加载发生在**下一次重启**。
- 本次触发环境的插件（`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`）其 `compatibility.json` 声明的 `supportedHosts` **不包含** `0.1.6-alpha.1`。这说明"插件自己声明的兼容范围"目前对 dsh 没有任何约束力；即使不装这个插件，任何"apply 不 settle"或"client 条目 pending"的插件都会命中 4.1 / 4.2。
- 插件市场把第三方代码 **import 进宿主进程**执行（热挂载），失败半径天然是整个应用，而不是单个页面。

---

## 5. 建议的修法

### 5.1 dsh 本体（主要责任方）

1. **给树落定加超时（最小改动、收益最大）**：把 boot 路径的 `await ctx.get('loader')?.await()` 改为 `Promise.race([loader.await(), timeout(N)])`；超时后把仍未落定的条目列为 failed 并输出诊断，让"卡死"变成"可诊断降级"。`watchUserPatches` 里的那次 `await ctx.loader.await()` 同理。仓库内 `hot.js` 已有可复用的超时语义。
2. **客户端改为降级而不是全盘放弃**：`assertEntriesActive` 只应对"必选客户端条目"致命，其余条目让 `mountClient` 照常挂载并单独标记失败。当前策略会让**一个**社区插件清空整个 GUI。
3. **把 `web boot:` 诊断送到宿主日志/接口**，不要只留在浏览器 console —— 否则用户只能看到白屏。
4. **启动阶段输出进展**：`dsh web` 在等待树落定期间应打印"正在激活 N/M 个插件"，卡住时用户就能直接指出是哪个插件。
5. **fallback 闭包的不完整依赖应给出警告**：profile 模块回退解析对"声明了但解析不到"的依赖是静默 skip，这会让后续出现难以定位的"模块找不到"。

### 5.2 插件市场（放大器）

6. **把共享 event loop 上的同步扫描改为异步 + 缓存**：`/dsh-market/check` 目前是同步 handler，内部 `analyzeProfile()` 全同步（`readdirSync` + 逐包 `readFileSync` + peer 解析 + lockfile 扫描），且同一函数在 install/update 流程里还会被重复调用。实测 300 个合成插件时单次 207–271 ms、响应体 534 KB，执行期间并发请求首延迟从约 2 ms 涨到 183 ms。它不是本次卡死的主因，但会随插件数量把全站冻结推向秒级。
7. **失败校验应判失败而不是放过**：对"声明了 `./client` 但文件缺失 / 无法用当前解析器判断"的情况，当前实现直接返回 `ok: true`（源码注释里自述为 weak guard）。这会让用户的插件永远过不了客户端那关，而市场显示"安装成功"。
8. **重启流程需要可观测的确认**：当前实现会在起 detached helper 后无条件 `process.kill(process.pid, 'SIGTERM')`（本版本还加入了"先等端口空闲、再启动、再确认端口被占用"的探测，方向正确）。仍建议在 UI 上把"新进程是否绑定端口"的结果反馈给用户，而不是把诊断只写进临时目录的日志文件；替换进程起不来时用户看到的同样是"整个 GUI 卡死"。

### 5.3 用户的自我保护（在修复落地前）

- 装完插件先做一次**不启动服务器**的快速校验：`dsh --profile web --dump-config >/dev/null && echo OK`。
- 真要启动时用超时包一层：`timeout 30 dsh web --port 3080 --no-open`；30 秒没打印 `dsh web: http://…` 就说明有插件把树拖住了。
- 不要用 Web 里的市场重启按钮；手动 Ctrl-C 再起，观察 stderr 里的 `required startup failure` / `failed to import` / `web boot:` 三类信息。
- 出事后最快的恢复：把新插件从 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中移除，或在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 disable 它。
- 装插件前看它的 `compatibility.json` / peer 区间是否包含当前宿主版本。

---

## 6. Verification status

| 结论 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 一个永不 settle 的插件 → 进程存活 / 0 监听 / 0 输出 | 本机隔离复现（`0.1.6-alpha.1`） |
| 对照组去掉该插件后正常监听并有就绪日志 | 本机对照实验 |
| `LoaderTree.await()` 无上限、boot 裸 await | **已在当前 `master` 复核**（`vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts`、`packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts`） |
| 客户端任一非 active 条目 → 整树 throw → 整页 fail | **已在当前 `master` 复核**（`packages/client/web/src/boot-client.ts`、`boot.ts`） |
| 声明 `dsh.client` 但缺 `./client` → 致命 | **已在当前 `master` 复核**（`packages/client/modules/src/index.ts`） |
| 仓库内热挂载路径已有激活超时、boot 路径没有 | **已复核**（`hot.js` 的 `raceActivationTimeout`） |
| `/dsh-market/check` 同步扫描的耗时与阻塞 | 市场实测 2 插件 15–32 ms / 合成 300 插件 207–271 ms；并发首延迟 2 ms → 183 ms |
| 市场 `dshmarket@1.47.0` 的同步扫描与弱校验、重启时序 | 已从 npm 拉取该版本源码复核（结论比最初报告更保守：重启已含端口探测；弱校验与同步扫描仍成立） |
| 具体某个社区插件不在宿主兼容范围内 | 来自该插件自身 `compatibility.json` 的声明，未独立验证其运行时行为 |

**关于证据时效**：复现用的临时目录与当时的运行态 profile 已被清理，因此上面"本机复现"部分为实验记录；所有仓库侧代码位置均按当前默认分支重新核对，**两条根因都仍然存在**。

---

## 7. 最小修复 PR 草图（供讨论）

如果维护者接受 5.1 的方向，最小的可验证改动是两处：

```ts
// packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts（示意，非最终实现）
const settled = await settleWithTimeout(ctx.get('loader')?.await(), BOOT_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS)
if (!settled) warnActivationDiagnostic('boot', await inactiveEntries(ctx))
```

```ts
// packages/client/web/src/boot-client.ts（示意）
// assertEntriesActive 只对必选客户端条目致命；其余条目交由 mountClient 挂载并单独标记失败
```

---

*插件市场 `dshmarket` 与文中提到的社区插件均为第三方、非官方项目，独立维护，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或推荐。本报告中的市场行为描述基于其公开发布的包源码，仅用于说明失败半径，不构成对其维护者的评价。*

discussions.title: 求一个累计压缩次数的 durable 计数：轮和步已经有了，压缩没有，压到第 11 次的会话全程零提示
discussions.body:
先把版本钉住：本机在跑的运行时是 0.1.5-rc.2。下面的源码位置原本取自本机一份源码克隆（HEAD `a5701f7`），**2026-09-22 我按 master tip `c36a83ff6b`（提交时间 2026-09-22T04:12Z）逐文件重核过**，有两处落点已经漂了，就地标出来（下面标了 ①②），标识名为准。

## 这条会话是怎么死的

一条站立跑了约 35 小时的会话，统计条显示 **32 轮 / 622 步**，在第 11 次自动压缩之后的第一个请求上被 provider 侧的输入内容审核拒掉（HTTP 400，错误码 `data_inspection_failed`；某些国内端点会把整段输入送去审核）。因为每一步都重放整段历史，从那一刻起这条会话**每一步都会再炸一次**，用户之后只输入了 2 个字，同样 400。事后我量了那一轮真正进请求的体量：约 197 万字符、23.6 万个中日韩字符，其中约 4.2 万是 agent 指令文件被反复改动了 9 次后叠进来的副本（谁都不去重）。

重点不是那个 400 —— 端点侧策略我不打算请你们绕。重点是：**「这条会话已经压缩了 11 次」这件事，没有任何一处能当成一个数读到。**

① 2026-09-22 先更正我原帖那句过头话：失败**并非完全无人渲染** —— `ui-trajectory` 已经能把带 error 的那条压成 `layout.compactionFailed` 一行标签（`locales.ts`:180/:382、`layout.ts`:339 `: request.error ?? t(...)`）。但那是按条列出的事件账：要拿到「这条会话压了几次、白跑几次」这两个数，用户仍然得自己开那个 tab 去数。

## 现有实现我核对过的几处

- 统计条那两个数来自全日志的 durable 折叠：`packages/session/session-stats/src/types.ts`（现 46 行，字段止于 `decodeTokens`）里 `turns`/`steps` 的定义，以及 `projection.ts`（现 212 行）的 `apply()` —— master 上那个 switch 认 7 类事件（`step/start`、`assistant/attempt`、`assistant/message`、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`step/end`、`turn/end`）。**`compaction/*` 一类都不进这个折叠，投影里也没有压缩维度。**
- 可扩展的投影成员实测只有 `tokenUsage`、`contextPressure`、`contextBreakdown`、`plan`、`subagentTiming`、`sessionStats`。全库搜 `compactionCount` / `numSummaries` / `summaryCount` / `compactions++`：零命中。没有任何地方累计过压缩次数。
- 客户端关于压缩的文案只有单次那张卡片：`packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/locale.ts`（zh :105-110 / en :263-268）的 `message.compaction.completed` = "已压缩 {items} 条历史记录（约 {tokens} tokens）"，外加 `.running` / `.expand` / `.unavailable`。没有累计，也没有阈值。（② 顺带一条自我更正：这条线本身也从 `ui-conversation` 的 `StatsLine.tsx` 搬进了新包 —— master 上统计条是 `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/StatsPills.tsx`，我原帖引的那个文件现在 404。）
- 挨着统计条唯一会上色的设备是 composer 尾部那枚 14px 占用环（`ContextMeter.tsx`），它读 `contextPressure`。而 `projectedTokens` 的设计目标恰恰是"压缩一发生就立刻把数降下来"—— 你们 README 的原话是 "so a compaction registers immediately"。**这个信号结构上不可能用来提示压缩累计**：压过 11 次的会话和从没压过的会话，环看起来一样。
- Host API 侧 `session.*` 的方法名实测为 append / attachment / cancel / create / deriveMessages / events / export / fork / header / history / id / jsonl / list / models / prompt / rename / requestHeader / search，**没有读投影的路由**。外部工具要这个数只能自己解 `$DATA_HOME/sessions/<ws>/<id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd` 数事件 —— 我本机就是这么量的，脚本现成。

## 为什么这个数值得占一格

压缩会把早于检查点的正文永久变成一份模型自己写的转述。压得越多，模型越容易把"当时推断出来的"当成"已经核实的"往下写。这条会话在我这边留下两次记录：一次把 10 轮误记成 10 次压缩并写进了交接文档；一次跑判级脚本时把并行跑的另一个会话的压缩数认成了自己的，判成"正常"，又续了 8 轮直到报废（会话拿不到自己的 id，这个我另开一条）。

更麻烦的是时机：自动压缩发生在一轮中途，而注入正文（`packages/compaction/compaction-basic` 里的 `CHECKPOINT_PREAMBLE`）明确要求模型 "Continue the task directly from the messages that follow, **without acknowledging this checkpoint**"。这句话本身没错，但它把唯一一个会自动出现的边界变成了"别停，接着干"。该插件的可配项只有 `thresholdRatio`/`retainRatio`/`auto`/`compactionRetries`/`maxOverflowRetries`/`modelPolicies`，没有往注入文本里再附加一句的口子。于是**没有任何时刻会触发"我该收尾交接了"这个判断** —— 模型没有，人也没有。

你们 8 月做过 full-session 的轮次/步数统计，说明"durable 折叠 + 统计条展示"这条路是通的，缺的只是第三个数。

## 想要的东西（按成本排）

1. `SessionStatsProjection` 加**两个**字段：`compactions: number`（对 `compaction/summary` 自增）与 `compactionFailures: number`（对带 `data.error` 的 `compaction/end` 自增）。**只数成功那一半，会在最需要数的时刻给出最小的数**：一次失败压缩只留下带 error 的 end、没有 summary（fail-closed —— 总结被输出上限截断，或总结请求自身超限，就不提交检查点），于是这种会话读出来是「压了 1 次」，真相是「压不动了」。本机 174 份存档：`start` 201 = `summary` 122 + 带 error 的 `end` 79，两半不重叠，**三成尝试白跑**。折叠单测可以直接写不变量 `compactions + compactionFailures == count(compaction/start)`。形状与你们 `.agents/notes/archived/bug-fix/2026-08-05-context-meter-blind-to-compaction.md` 同构（给既有投影加第二个分子、`stateVersion` 一起 bump、旧 checkpoint 恢复时降级而不是消失），默认值取 0。
2. 统计条把它跟轮/步并排显示，按可配置阈值上色（参考值：累计 3 准备交接、6 换会话）。落点按 master 更新：`ui-chat/src/client/chat/StatsPills.tsx`（372 行）里 `TimePill`:137、`UsagePill`:235，在 349 那个 div 里多一颗 `css.pill` 就行 —— pill 样式与 338 行 `if (stats.steps === 0 && !hasTokens) return null`（无数据整条不显）都是现成的，本条不提任何样式要求。**纯提示，不需要任何自动动作**，更不要自动压缩或自动截断。`mode === 'compact'` 那个变体要不要带这个数由你们定，我方意见是不带（那里是刚跑完一轮的即时读数，累计数属于整场视图）。
3. 同一个数带进 `session.header` 或会话列表 metadata（或者干脆开一条读投影的路由），这样外部体检脚本不必自己解 zstd。
4. 可选：`doctor` 的导出带上它。本机 136 个存档做一次体检就能列出"哪几条会话已被审核打死、各自重放密度多少"，靠的全是自己数事件流。

## 复现

口径自查（任何一条长会话都能做）：数存档里的 `step/end` 条数 = 统计条的步数，数其中不同的 `turn` = 轮数（我这边 32/622 逐字对得上）；同一份存档再数 `compaction/summary` = 11，以及 `compaction/end` 里 `data.error` 非空的条数，两半相加应等于 `compaction/start` —— 这两个数在产品里都读不到一个累计值。

死法复现：一条会话撑到跨天、几十轮、自动压缩 10 次以上（工具输出照实往里灌、不做削减），再接一个会对整段输入做内容审核的端点，就会看到"从压缩后第一个请求起，每步 400"这个形状。

discussions.title: [Bug] released-v0 migration refuses every session written during the `permission/preset.origin` window (2026-08-19 .. 2026-08-21)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Master briefly carried an **optional `origin` member on the `permission/preset` payload**, then reverted it.
The released-v0 → v1 validator never admitted that member, so **every session written while the field
existed on master is now permanently unmigratable** — the migration refuses the whole artifact, and by
design leaves the source file unchanged.

This is not user error or local corruption: the sessions were produced by an official master build.

## Reproduction

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness

# 1. Build the window revision that writes the field
git checkout 35778ec2ff          # or any revision in 2026-08-19..2026-08-21
pnpm install && pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web                     # create a session; it records
                                 # {"type":"permission/preset","seq":0,"data":{"preset":"...","origin":"default"}}

# 2. Move to any later revision (the field is gone from the writer)
git checkout master              # e.g. 0d1f50007f
pnpm install && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

3. Open the session created in step 1 from the history list.

## Current behavior

Opening the session reports a history-load failure:

```
failed to observe session "session-<id>": @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1
refuses this format v0 Session: permission/preset 0 data has unexpected member "origin";
source v0 artifact remains unchanged (raw log: <...>/session.jsonl.zstd)
(gateway/internal)
```

The session never appears. The raw artifact is left untouched, so nothing is lost on disk but the
history is unreachable.

## Expected behavior

Sessions written by an official build of that window should migrate. Either the member is admitted and
dropped during the edge (preferred), or the migration explicitly declares it as a known historical
member that carries no v1 meaning.

## Environment

- DSH: `master` at `0d1f50007f` (the failure reproduces on every revision after the revert)
- Node: v22.19.0
- Platform: Windows 11 (reproduced from a Linux side as well; the failure is platform-independent)
- Session format: released v0 (`session.jsonl.zstd`, concatenated-Zstandard container)
- Observed scale in one real installation: **11 of 11** v0 sessions affected, **13** occurrences of the
  member; values seen: `"default"` (12x) and `"selection"` (1x)

## Root cause

| Step | Evidence |
|---|---|
| The member was introduced | `35778ec2ff` — *fix(web): address permission preset review feedback*, 2026-08-19 22:45:54 +0800. Declares `'permission/preset': { preset: string; origin?: 'default' \| 'selection' \| 'inferred' }`, commented as "`origin` is optional so logs written before origin tracking remain readable". |
| Then reverted, with no format edge | `7ce85283b5` — *Revert "Merge pull request #2608 from deepseek-harness/fix/permission-copy-and-default"*, 2026-08-21 16:21:13 +0800. |
| The v0 inventory never listed it | `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/dispositions.ts`: `'permission/preset': disposition(['preset'])` |
| The refusal site | `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/validation.ts` → `assertReleasedV0Keys(data, disposition.required, versionOptional, \`${event.type} ${event.seq} data\`)` |

So the window produced sessions that no released validator has ever accepted. Note that the opposite
compatibility direction *was* handled at introduction time — the comment above shows the author
deliberately made `origin` optional so that **older** logs stay readable — but nothing was done for the
**newer** logs once the field was withdrawn.

## Suggested fix

Pick one (A is closest to "the field carries no v1 meaning"):

**A. Admit and drop on the edge.** Add the member to the v0 disposition's optional list and strip it
during migration, e.g. `'permission/preset': disposition(['preset'], ['origin'])` plus an explicit drop at
the edge. This records "the released v0 inventory was narrower than what an official build wrote" rather
than silently widening semantics.

**B. Declare a known-window-member tolerance list.** Keep the frozen validator intact and teach the edge
about the specific historical members produced by reverted writer revisions, with a test fixture per
window.

Option B is closer to the constraint stated in
`.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-31-released-session-format-migrations.md`:

> "Narrowing native acceptance or editing frozen predecessor validators would change independent
> promises rather than establish safe conversion."

Either way, a `session-format-corpus` fixture captured from `35778ec2ff` would pin the behavior.

## Workaround used locally (data-side, no code change)

The member was removed from the stored artifacts. This is safe because origin-less data is an official,
already-supported shape — `permission-presets` keeps legacy origin-less selections pinned:

```
legacy origin-less data ... remain pinned
```

Procedure (each frame decompressed, edited, re-compressed with the repository's own
`scanZstdFrames` / `compressZstdFrame` from `session-persistence-jsonl`, so the container stays
byte-compatible; every file backed up to `.bak` first):

1. scan `.dsh/sessions/**/session.jsonl.zstd`
2. per frame: `decompressZstdFrame` → per line, if `type === 'permission/preset'` delete `data.origin`
3. re-compress each frame and write back
4. re-scan: 0 remaining, 0 decode failures, all histories load again

A reusable script for this is attached below (also usable via `--dry-run`).

<details>
<summary>fix_session_origin.mts</summary>

```ts
// Removes permission/preset.data.origin from released-v0 session artifacts.
// Usage: node --import tsx/esm fix_session_origin.mts <sessions-dir> [--dry-run]
import { copyFileSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { compressZstdFrame, decompressZstdFrame, scanZstdFrames } from './packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/zstd.ts'

const dryRun = process.argv.includes('--dry-run')
const root = process.argv[2]
if (root === undefined) {
  console.error('usage: node --import tsx/esm fix_session_origin.mts <sessions-dir> [--dry-run]')
  process.exit(2)
}

function findLogs(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const path = join(dir, entry.name)
    if (entry.isDirectory()) findLogs(path, out)
    else if (entry.name === 'session.jsonl.zstd') out.push(path)
  }
  return out
}

const logs = findLogs(root)
console.log(`scanned ${logs.length} released-v0 session files\n`)

let filesNeedingFix = 0
let totalRemoved = 0
let failed = 0

for (const file of logs) {
  try {
    const buf = readFileSync(file)
    const scan = scanZstdFrames(buf)
    if (scan.tornStart !== undefined) {
      console.log(`skip (torn final frame): ${file}`)
      continue
    }
    let removed = 0
    const frames: Buffer[] = []
    for (const frame of scan.frames) {
      const text = (await decompressZstdFrame(buf.subarray(frame.start, frame.end))).toString('utf8')
      const out = text.split('\n').map((line) => {
        if (line.trim() === '') return line
        let obj: Record<string, any>
        try {
          obj = JSON.parse(line)
        } catch {
          return line
        }
        if (obj?.type === 'permission/preset' && obj.data !== null && typeof obj.data === 'object'
          && Object.hasOwn(obj.data, 'origin')) {
          const origin = obj.data.origin
          delete obj.data.origin
          removed += 1
          console.log(`  ${file}\n    seq=${obj.seq} removed origin=${JSON.stringify(origin)}`)
          return JSON.stringify(obj)
        }
        return line
      })
      frames.push(await compressZstdFrame(Buffer.from(out.join('\n'), 'utf8')))
    }
    if (removed > 0) {
      filesNeedingFix += 1
      totalRemoved += removed
      if (dryRun) {
        console.log('  -> [dry-run] not written\n')
      } else {
        copyFileSync(file, `${file}.bak`)
        writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat(frames))
        console.log('  -> fixed (original backed up to .bak)\n')
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    failed += 1
    console.log(`failed: ${file}\n  ${(error as Error).message}\n`)
  }
}

console.log('='.repeat(56))
console.log(`files:            ${logs.length}`)
console.log(`needing fix:      ${filesNeedingFix}`)
console.log(`origin removed:   ${totalRemoved}`)
console.log(`failed:           ${failed}`)
console.log(dryRun ? 'mode: dry-run' : 'mode: written (.bak backups kept)')
```

</details>

## 中文摘要

2026-08-19 22:45 至 2026-08-21 16:21 之间，master 上的 `permission/preset` 事件带有一个可选字段
`origin`（提交 `35778ec2ff` 引入），该字段随后被 revert（`7ce85283b5`），但 v0→v1 迁移器的成员
白名单里从来没有它（`dispositions.ts` 只有 `['preset']`）。

结果是：**该窗口期内用官方版本写出的会话，任何后续版本都无法迁移**，报
`permission/preset 0 data has unexpected member "origin"`，历史加载失败。实测一个真实安装中
11 个 v0 会话**全部**受影响。

引入时作者特意把 `origin` 设为可选、以兼容"更早的日志"，但字段撤回后没有为"这段窗口期的日志"
留下任何迁移路径。建议二选一：迁移边缘承认并丢弃该成员，或维护一份"已知窗口期成员"的容忍表，
并用该窗口的 fixture 固化行为。

discussions.title: [Bug] 出站 HTTP/2 无开关：undici v8 默认 allowH2=true，H2 会话级故障会拖死 agent 主路径
discussions.body:
### Summary

DSH 的出站 HTTP 全部经过进程级 undici dispatcher，而 undici v8 的 `allowH2` 默认为 `true`。DSH 自身既不设置该选项，也没有任何用户可配置的开关，因此只要 TLS ALPN 协商到 `h2`，模型请求、MCP、web search、网页抓取等全部流量都跑在 HTTP/2 多路复用会话上。

HTTP/2 的故障域是**整条会话**而非单个请求：会话一旦被 GOAWAY、被 abort 污染，或进入「不可用但仍被判定为可复用」的状态，同一会话上的其他在途请求会一起失败或悬挂。DSH 的核心流量恰好是 H2 最脆弱的形态——长时间存活的 SSE 流式 POST + 频繁 `AbortController` 取消 + 并发突发。用户侧可观察到的现象是：单个连接出问题后，整个 agent 卡死、长时间无输出，而不是那一个请求失败。

### Reproduction

**1）确认 ALPN 会协商到 h2**（无需 API key，仅 TLS 握手，见同目录 `alpn-repro.mjs`）：

```js
import tls from 'node:tls'
const probe = (host, alpn) => new Promise((res) => {
  const s = tls.connect({ host, port: 443, servername: host, ALPNProtocols: alpn }, () => {
    res({ offered: alpn, negotiated: s.alpnProtocol }); s.end()
  })
  s.on('error', (e) => res({ offered: alpn, error: e.code || e.message }))
  setTimeout(() => { res({ offered: alpn, timeout: true }); s.destroy() }, 12000)
})
console.log(await probe('api.deepseek.com', ['http/1.1', 'h2']))  // undici v8 默认
console.log(await probe('api.deepseek.com', ['http/1.1']))        // allowH2: false 的行为
```

实测输出（Node v26.4.0，无代理，2026-09-16）：

```text
{ offered: [ 'http/1.1', 'h2' ], negotiated: 'h2' }        // ← DSH 当前走的就是这条
{ offered: [ 'http/1.1' ],       negotiated: 'http/1.1' }
```

**2）确认 DSH 没有关掉它的手段**：在 `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1` 全树（11,217 文件）`grep -rn allowH2` 命中 **0 处**；`packages/util/http-proxy/README.md` 也明确写着 *"Nothing to mount, and nothing to configure."*

**3）本地缓解已验证有效**：在本机安装里对下述两处 dispatcher 构造点加 `allowH2: false`（共 7 处编辑）后，同样请求的 ALPN 变为 `http/1.1`，卡死症状消失；直连分支与 CONNECT 隧道分支都已端到端验证（隧道内由本地 origin 侧回报其协商到的 ALPN，确认隧道内也退回 HTTP/1.1）。

### Current behavior

- 出站 h2 默认开启，且无法通过配置关闭；
- H2 的会话级故障会扩散到同会话的无关请求，表现为 agent 整体卡死而非单请求失败；
- web-fetch 工具的 pinned Agent 同样未设 `allowH2`。

### Expected behavior

提供把出站固定到 HTTP/1.1 的能力（作为配置项或默认值）。理由是 DSH 的流量形态与 H1 更匹配：请求寿命长（SSE）、取消频繁、并发突发，而 HTTP/2 多路复用把这些请求的故障域绑在了一起，收益远小于风险。

### Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.1.5-rc.2`（npm `next` 通道）；`0.1.6-alpha.1` 源码复核同样适用 |
| Node | v26.4.0（undici 要求 `>= 22.19.0`） |
| undici | 8.10.2（两个 DSH 版本均声明 `undici: ^8.10.0`） |
| 平台 | macOS arm64 |
| 代理 | 无（`policy.source === 'none'`，即问题最直接的路径） |

### 补充证据：undici 8.10.2 当下就带着未修的 H2 缺陷

undici 最新发版仍是 **v8.10.2（2026-09-04）**，而 8.10.2 之后合并的 H2 修复尚未发版，也就是 DSH 用户必然运行在一个包含已知 H2 缺陷的组合上（状态复核于 2026-09-16）：

| undici | 类型 | 标题 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#5787](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/5787) | issue | Support maxRequestsPerClient for HTTP/2 sessions | **open** |
| [#5802](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/pull/5802) | PR | feat(h2): honor maxRequestsPerClient | **open**（未合并） |
| [#5782](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/pull/5782) | PR | fix(h2): do not unref a session with open streams | 已合并 2026-09-10，**未发版** |
| [#5788](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/pull/5788) | PR | fix(h2): do not replay a request whose response already started after GOAWAY | 已合并 2026-09-13，**未发版** |
| [#5524](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/5524) | issue | HTTP/2: `fetch` POST hangs while an SSE stream is open | 已修（v8.8.0） |
| [#5468](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/5468) | issue | HTTP/2: concurrent in-flight requests reject with `UND_ERR_INFO` (frameError) | 已修（v8.8.0） |

其中 **#5787 与本报告最相关**：h2 会话不遵守 `maxRequestsPerClient`，一个实际已经卡住但被判定为「可复用」的会话会继续被选中，且没有任何防御手段——这正是「一条坏连接拖死后续所有请求」的机制。已修的两条（#5524、#5468）也说明这段代码路径在「SSE 打开时卡住」和「GOAWAY 时并发请求批量失败」上反复出过问题，用户遇到的是同一类故障域。

Node 侧相关未决项：[nodejs/node#65677](https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/65677)（v26.3.0+/v24.20.0 上 h2 缓冲响应被 async iteration 报为提前关闭）。

### 建议的修复（已定位到确切位置）

把 `allowH2: false` 加在 DSH 自建 undici dispatcher 的三个位置（行号基于 `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1`）：

1. **`packages/util/http-proxy/src/install.ts:143-157` `createPolicyDispatcher`** —— 这是进程级 dispatcher：
   - L145 `new Agent({` → `new Agent({ allowH2: false, ... })`
   - L150 `new ProxyAgent({ ...passed, uri: proxy })` → 追加 `allowH2: false`
   - L154 `new Pool(origin, passed)` → `new Pool(origin, { ...passed, allowH2: false })`
2. **`packages/util/http-proxy/src/install.ts:174-187` `installGlobalProxy` 的 `policy.source === 'none'` 分支** —— **这是 LLM 主路径**：当前在 `previousPolicy === undefined` 时直接 `return`，什么都不装，于是 Node 自带的、支持 h2 的默认 dispatcher 继续生效；未配代理的用户 100% 走这里。需要在返回前显式 `setGlobalDispatcher(new undici.Agent({ allowH2: false }))`，并在 disposer 里还原。
   - 顺带：同函数后段 `const direct = new undici.Agent()`（撤销策略后的直连 dispatcher）同样需要 `allowH2: false`。
3. **`packages/web/web-fetch-http/src/network.ts:203` `requestPinned`** —— `new Agent({ autoSelectFamily: true, connect: { lookup: createPinnedLookup(addresses) } })` 追加 `allowH2: false`（注意保留 `lookup`，那是 SSRF 钉地址保护）。

如果倾向不改默认行为，建议至少加一个配置项（例如 `http.pinHttp1: true` / `HTTP2=off`）——目前用户除了修改安装目录里的文件之外没有任何办法。

### English TL;DR

DSH routes all outbound HTTP through a process-wide undici dispatcher, and undici v8 defaults `allowH2` to `true`; DSH neither sets the option nor exposes any config for it. `api.deepseek.com` negotiates `h2` via ALPN when offered `['http/1.1', 'h2']` (verified 2026-09-16, Node v26.4.0), so all model traffic (long-lived SSE streaming POSTs, frequent aborts, bursts) runs over multiplexed HTTP/2 where a single session-level failure — GOAWAY, polluted session, or a stalled session still considered reusable (undici [#5787](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/5787), unfixed) — takes down unrelated in-flight requests, which users observe as the whole agent hanging. The three dispatcher construction sites are listed above; adding `allowH2: false` there (verified locally end-to-end, including inside CONNECT tunnels) or exposing a config knob would fix it.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] SDK 会话与 web 视图互通 / SDK session ↔ web UI visibility
discussions.body:
### 背景

我用 `dsh --profile sdk`（0.1.5-rc.1，macOS）做程序化编排。实测发现：SDK 会话与 web 会话**共用同一存储池**（`~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`，同为 v3 JSONL），但**两个前端之间互不可见**。

### 现状（实测，2026-09-16）

1. **SDK 创建的会话不出现在 web UI 会话列表**——web 列表读 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` 的会话登记表；SDK 运行时不写登记。
2. **web 创建的会话无法被 SDK 打开**——对已存在 sessionId 调 `session/prompt` 得到 `-32603 session "<id>" already exists`（`agents.create` 拒绝已存在的身份，协议也没有 open/resume 方法）。
3. 反向亦然：SDK 无法把自己的会话登记进某个 workspace。

### 使用场景（为什么需要）

- **程序化编排 + 人在界面看/接管**：常驻编排进程（SDK）驱动多条会话线，人想随时在 web UI 里打开同一会话观察或接管；
- **混合工作流**：在 web 里起草一个会话，稍后让脚本/编排进程接手；或反之；
- 关键点：数据层没有任何阻碍（同池、同格式），阻碍只在「两个前端各管各的登记」。

### 与已有讨论的关系（避免重复）

- [#6295](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6295)（resume after restart）、[#2888](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2888)（cancel/close）、[#6520](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6520)（未修复清单）覆盖了协议内的生命周期问题；
- 本帖聚焦这组问题的**另一个面**：跨前端的**视图与接管**（workspace 登记 / 按 id 打开）。即使 resume 落地，只要两侧登记不互通，"前端看不到会话"仍成立。

### 建议（任一方向即可）

1. SDK 侧增加「会话登记」选项：SDK 创建的会话可 opt-in 加入某 workspace（供 web 打开）；
2. 或 web 侧增加「按 id 打开」入口：从同一存储池直接打开任意会话；
3. 或明确设计立场：两套前端有意隔离——那也建议写进 README（目前使用者需自行摸索才能得知）。

### 环境与复现

- dsh 0.1.5-rc.1（`--profile sdk`；相关包 0.1.5-rc.2），macOS 26 / Apple Silicon
- 复现：`initialize` → `session/prompt`（新 id，成功）→ 关闭进程 → 重开进程对同 id `session/prompt` → `already exists`；web 端对照观察列表无此会话。
- **附录（顺带发现）**：`sdk-minimal` profile 对库中已有的 `.jsonl.zstd` 会话报格式错误（完整 `sdk` profile 无此问题）；如需可单独展开。

（完整实测记录与最小复现脚本可按需提供。）

---

### Context

I use `dsh --profile sdk` (0.1.5-rc.1, macOS) for programmatic orchestration. Testing showed that SDK sessions and web sessions share the same storage pool (`~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`, both v3 JSONL), yet the two frontends cannot see each other's sessions.

### Current behavior (measured, 2026-09-16)

1. **SDK-created sessions do not appear in the web UI session list** — the web list reads the session registry in `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`; the SDK runtime does not write to it.
2. **Web-created sessions cannot be opened by the SDK** — `session/prompt` on an existing sessionId returns `-32603 session "<id>" already exists` (`agents.create` refuses an identity that already exists; the wire has no open/resume method).
3. Vice versa: the SDK cannot register its sessions into a workspace.

### Use cases

- **Programmatic orchestration + human observation/takeover**: a long-running orchestrator (SDK) drives multiple session lines; the human wants to open the same session in the web UI at any time.
- **Mixed workflows**: start a session in the web UI, hand it off to a script/orchestrator later — or the other way around.
- Key point: nothing in the data layer blocks this (same pool, same format); the block is purely that the two frontends keep separate registries.

### Relation to existing discussions (to avoid duplication)

- [#6295](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6295) (resume after restart), [#2888](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2888) (cancel/close), [#6520](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6520) (unfixed-issues list) already cover in-protocol lifecycle issues.
- This post focuses on **a different face of the family: cross-frontend visibility and takeover** (workspace registration / opening by id). Even after resume lands, "the frontend can't see the session" remains.

### Suggestions (any one would help)

1. Add an SDK-side "register" option: opt-in registration of SDK-created sessions into a workspace (openable from the web UI).
2. Or add a web-side "open by id" entry: open any session in the same storage pool directly.
3. Or state the design stance: the two frontends are intentionally isolated — in that case please document it in the READMEs (currently one must reverse-engineer this).

### Environment / reproduction

- dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 (`--profile sdk`; related packages 0.1.5-rc.2), macOS 26 / Apple Silicon
- Repro: `initialize` → `session/prompt` (new id, succeeds) → close the process → new process, same id, `session/prompt` → `already exists`; web UI shows no such session.
- Appendix (incidental): the `sdk-minimal` profile errors on pre-existing `.jsonl.zstd` sessions (the full `sdk` profile is fine); can be broken out if useful.

(Full measured notes and minimal repro scripts available on request.)

discussions.title: [Feature Request / PR-Ready] Add explicit "Delete Session" action with danger styling to session menu (ui-workspace)
discussions.body:
### Summary / 概述
Currently, the session action menu (`...`) in the sidebar only provides:
- `重命名` / Rename
- `分叉会话` / Fork session
- `归档会话` / Archive session (with an archive folder icon)

As noted in `packages/client/ui-workspace/README.md` (*"No Session deletion or unarchive control"*), users who want to delete conversations cannot find an explicit "Delete" button. This leads to confusion and perceived clutter.

### Proposed Solution / 解决方案
1. Add a dedicated **"Delete session" / "删除会话"** action to `SessionNodeItem` with red danger styling (`danger: true`) and `<IconTrashOutline16 />`.
2. Map it to the underlying `archiveSession` method so the session is cleanly removed from the sidebar tree and search results without corrupting append-only event persistence logs.

### Code Changes / 变更代码
- **`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/locales.ts`**:
  ```ts
  // zh
  'delete.session': '删除会话',
  // en
  'delete.session': 'Delete session',
  ```
- **`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/rows/Rows.tsx`**:
  ```tsx
  const sessionMenuItems = [
    { id: 'rename', label: t('rename'), icon: <IconEditOutline16 /> },
    { id: 'fork', label: t('menu.fork'), icon: <IconBranchOutline16 /> },
    { id: 'archive', label: t('menu.archiveSession'), icon: <IconArchiveOutline20 size={16} /> },
    { id: 'delete', label: t('delete.session'), icon: <IconTrashOutline16 />, danger: true },
  ]
  ```
- **`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/rows/WorkspaceBrowser.tsx`**:
  Passed `onSessionDelete={onSessionArchive}` across both grouped (`SessionTree`) and flat (`FlatList`) browser views.

### Verification / 测试结果
- All 161 tests in `packages/client/ui-workspace` passing.
- Verified danger styling and dispatch in `rows.client.spec.tsx` and `workspace-browser.client.spec.tsx`.

`dsh-session-log-deepseek` attaches the full session-log suffix to every official request with no size cap; after a format-version change the acceptance watermark can never be written, permanently bricking the session with HTTP 413
discussions.body:
#### Summary `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek` (enabled by default) attaches the **entire session event suffix** to **every** official API request via the `dsh_session_log` field. When no acceptance watermark matching the current session format generation exists, the cursor starts at `-1`, so the suffix is **every event from seq 0** — with **no size cap and no chunking**. For a long session this makes a single request body **>160 MB**, which the gateway rejects with **413**. Because the acceptance watermark is only appended after a 2xx response, the suffix can never shrink: **permanent deadlock**, and the user-visible symptom is that the session can no longer send *any* message. The field rides on **every** official request (normal turns **and** compaction), so switching the summarization model to a local one does **not** work around it. Disabling the plugin is currently the only escape. **The broader principle: a telemetry/sync extension must never be able to fail the user's request.** Here it can, and does. #### Environment | | | |---|---| | dsh | `0.1.6-alpha.1` (npm `latest` = `0.1.5-rc.1`; `0.1.6-alpha.1` is the newest published) | | plugin | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek` `0.1.6-alpha.1` (package has existed since `0.1.2-alpha.2`) | | platform | Windows 11 + WSL2, x86_64 | | endpoint | official DeepSeek API (current default model) | | affected session | one long-lived session: v3 artifact **58,693 events**, v0 artifact **358,003 events** | #### Symptom Sending **any** message to that session in the web UI (including `/compact`) fails with: ``` DeepSeek Messages request failed (413) ``` The response body is a gateway page, not a model error: ```html 413 Request Entity Too Large

413 Request Entity Too Large

openresty
``` #### Evidence 1 — instrumented measurement of the actual request We temporarily pointed `llm-deepseek.baseURL` at a local logging proxy to measure the real payload instead of guessing. Raw log (same session, same model, same `max_tokens`): | time | Content-Length | messages | msg_bytes | `dsh_session_log` present | result | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 13:00:14 | 167.47 MB | 3 | 190,004 | yes | **413** (17.3 s) | | 13:01:42 | 168.87 MB | 595 | 1,358,960 | yes | **413** (16.8 s) | | 13:04:57 | 167.50 MB | 3 | 190,076 | yes | **413** (16.2 s) | | 13:07:26 | 167.50 MB | 3 | — | yes | **413** (15.8 s) | | 13:10:31 | 0.22 MB | 3 | — | **no** | 400 (unrelated path) | | 13:12:25 | 1.59 MB | 595 | — | **no** | **200** | | 13:12:37 | 1.59 MB | 597 | — | **no** | **200** | Top-level field sizes for the 167.50 MB request (proxy breakdown): ``` messages 190,076 B (0.19 MB) files 31,818 B tools 26,208 B system 127 B session 124 B model 37 B thinking 18 B max_tokens 4 B stream 4 B top_keys = [model, stream, messages, max_tokens, thinking, output_config, dsh_plugin_packages, dsh_session_log] ``` ⇒ **The conversation is ~0.19–1.36 MB. ~167 MB of a 168.87 MB request is the `dsh_session_log` field.** Removing it takes the same request to **1.59 MB → HTTP 200** (a ~106× reduction in payload; ~760× for the small-request variant). Each failed attempt still uploads the full 160+ MB before failing (15.8–17.3 s per attempt), with no warning, no cap and no backoff. #### Evidence 2 — independent cross-check by re-parsing the canonical log Without the proxy, we re-parsed the on-disk canonical log and computed the suffix by the plugin's own rule. Both artifacts of the affected session: ``` v3 artifact: 58,693 events, header.version=3, highest matching watermark = -1, suffix = 144.60 MB v0 artifact: 358,003 events, header.version=0, highest matching watermark = -1, suffix = 106.59 MB ``` Same order of magnitude as the wire measurement (differences come from `wireEvent` field rewriting and the log continuing to grow). A scan of all 78 local artifacts is in the appendix. #### Evidence 3 — 413 is the gateway, 400 is the model Same endpoint, same key: | case | result | |---|---| | 214k input tokens + `max_tokens` 256k | **200** | | 6.5 MB request body | **200** | | beyond context window | **400** + `This model's maximum context length is 1048576 tokens...` | | 168 MB request body | **413** + openresty error page | ⇒ The two are unrelated. A large session does **not** by itself fail: only the log field does. #### Root cause (exact code) `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek/lib/index.js`: ```js // line 86 — with no matching acceptance, the cursor starts at -1 let throughSeq = previous?.throughSeq ?? -1; // line 95 — the watermark only counts if it matches the CURRENT session format generation if (acceptedFormatVersion !== session.header.version) continue; // line 126 — suffix = every event from afterSeq+1 to the end: no cap, no chunking const suffix = session.snapshotEvents(SessionLogOffset(afterSeq + 1)); // line 136 — the watermark is appended only after acceptance accept: () => { session.append("session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted", { sessionId: session.id, sessionFormatVersion: session.header.version, throughSeq }); } ``` `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js`: ```js // line 823-826 — the extension fields are merged into the payload unconditionally payload: JSON.stringify({ ...body, ...extensions.fields }) // line 1338 — non-2xx branch ... if (!response.ok) { ... throw ... } // line 1355 throws // line 1362 — ... so accept() is reachable ONLY on a 2xx response await extensions.accept(); ``` (Also `prepareRequestExtensions` calls at lines 1321 and 2745: normal messages and compaction both go through the same path.) This ordering is what makes the failure permanent: **acceptance requires a 2xx; a 2xx requires the suffix to fit; the suffix only ever grows.** #### Why it cannot self-heal ``` no matching watermark → suffix = ALL events (>160 MB) → gateway 413 ↓ non-2xx ⇒ watermark not written ↓ next request is again "no matching watermark" → loop ``` Trigger conditions (either is sufficient): 1. **First use.** A pre-existing long session that has never had an acceptance (e.g. the plugin was just enabled, or enabled for the first time on an old session) starts at `-1`. **Existing users with long sessions are bricked as soon as the default-on plugin applies.** 2. **Session format-version change** (e.g. a v0 → v3 migration). Watermarks are matched by session id **and format generation**, so after a migration every old watermark stops matching and the cursor resets to `-1`. #### Impact - It is **not** "compaction is broken": **every request in that session fails**, including ordinary chat turns. - **Switching compaction to a local model does not help** — the field is attached in the request-construction layer, independently of which model summarizes. - Every failed attempt really transfers 160+ MB (15.8–17.3 s each): wasted bandwidth, wasted latency, no warning, no cap, no backoff. - The risk grows monotonically: sessions only get bigger. #### Workaround (verified) Disable the plugin in the profile overlay (the path documented in the dsh README): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: session-log-deepseek config: enabled: false ``` Documentation gotcha worth noting: putting the same under `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` has **no effect** (verified: after restart the field is still injected and the request is still 167 MB). Only the profile `cordis.patch.yml` works. It would help to make that distinction explicit in the README. #### Suggested fixes (in priority order) 1. **A telemetry extension must never fail the user request.** On any non-2xx caused by the extension payload (especially 413), retry once **without** the field rather than failing the turn. This single change removes the whole class of failure. 2. **Bound the suffix.** If it exceeds a threshold (bytes, or last-N-events), send a bounded window (or nothing) and record "skipped" in the watermark semantics — never an unbounded resend from seq 0. 3. **Rebuild the watermark across format generations.** On migration, write an equivalent acceptance record for the new generation, or define "no watermark" as "start from a bounded window" instead of seq 0. 4. **Optional:** surface extension failures to the user (at least a warning) so that "160 MB upload + 16 s timeout" cannot repeat silently. #### An observation we could not resolve (please confirm — this is not a claim) Across **all 78 local session-log artifacts on this machine, the number of `session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted` events is exactly 0** — and in fact the number of `session-log-deepseek/*` events of **any** type is 0. We do **not** know which of these is true: - **(a)** acceptances are effectively never persisted (in which case the plugin's incremental semantics never hold, every request uploads the full log, and issue 1 above is far more severe than the file-size case alone); or - **(b)** these sessions never had a *successful* official-endpoint request while the plugin was active, so there was simply nothing to record. We note that the package itself has been published since `0.1.2-alpha.2`, so "the plugin is brand new" does not by itself explain the zero. Method (JSON top-level `type` only — a plain string grep is unreliable because session content can contain the same literal): ```bash zstd -dc session*.jsonl.zstd \ | grep -c '"type":"session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted"' ``` #### Minimal reproduction 1. `dsh` 0.1.6-alpha.1 with `session-log-deepseek` at its default (enabled). 2. Create a session whose event suffix exceeds the gateway body limit (we used a long-lived session: 58,693 events / ~145 MB suffix). 3. Send any message to that session. 4. Observe: the request carries the full `dsh_session_log` suffix → 413; **retrying does not converge** (the watermark is never written). 5. Control: set `enabled: false` in the profile overlay → the same session immediately returns 200. #### Redaction This report contains no conversation content, API keys, internal addresses or personal data. Session ids are abbreviated (`session-6c0de4b8…`).

[Feature] Expose compaction integration points for plugins that own model-visible context
discussions.body:
## Summary

It would be useful to expose an explicit integration point before summary compaction mutates the session surface, and possibly a corresponding post-compaction hook.

The main use case is plugins that inject or otherwise own model-visible context: memory systems, workspace instructions, retrieved context, long-lived reminders, or similar components. Such plugins often know more about the semantics of their own artifacts than the generic summarizer does, and may want to deterministically reduce, replace, remove, or re-materialize those artifacts around compaction.

## Motivation

Today `compaction-basic` already performs one specialized model-free reduction before summarization: `toolResultPruner.pruneSession()` runs before the compactable range is selected and the surface is summarized.

Other plugins can have the same need.

For example, consider a memory plugin that has injected several progressively superseded memory snapshots into the conversation. Before generic summarization, it may be preferable to:

* remove obsolete snapshots from the model-visible surface;
* retain only the current canonical memory state;
* replace large historical injections with small markers;
* or otherwise transform plugin-owned context deterministically before asking an LLM to summarize the remaining conversation.

The same applies to workspace instructions and other context-injection-producing plugins.

The important point is that the plugin that produced an artifact often knows whether that artifact is:

* historical conversation content that should be summarized;
* replaceable state that should instead be folded to its latest value;
* disposable derived context;
* or something that should be re-materialized after compaction rather than summarized.

A generic summarizer cannot reliably infer those semantics from message text.

## Why `compaction/start` / `compaction/end` are not sufficient

The durable `compaction/*` events are useful for observation and replay, but they are not currently suitable as mutation hooks for this purpose.

`session/event` is post-commit, and compaction has already entered its transaction by the time `compaction/start` is observed. Mutating the surface asynchronously from such a listener can also invalidate the stability assumptions of the in-progress compaction.

Conversely, `compaction/end` is too late to affect the input that was already sent to the summarizer.

What is missing is an integration point owned by the compaction pipeline itself.

## Possible direction

One option would be a generic pre-compaction reduction seam, conceptually something like:

```text
pressure / overflow detected
        ↓
plugin-owned deterministic surface reductions
        ↓
remeasure
        ↓
select compactable range
        ↓
summarize if still necessary
        ↓
commit compaction
```

The exact API could be a service registry, waterfall hook, reducer collection, or another Cordis-native mechanism. The important properties seem to be:

1. It runs before the final token measurement and range selection used for summarization.
2. It may durably transform model-visible state using normal Session mechanisms.
3. Compaction remeasures after the transformation.
4. Multiple independent reducers can compose deterministically.
5. It is generic rather than tied specifically to tool results.

`toolResultPruner` could eventually become one consumer of such a mechanism rather than a special case hard-coded into `compaction-basic`.

A post-compaction integration point could also be useful for plugins that intentionally remove derived context before summarization and want to re-materialize the current canonical state afterward.

## Broader rationale

Compaction is not only about making arbitrary conversation text shorter. In an extensible agent harness, part of the model-visible context is often generated by plugins and represents structured state.

Memory systems in particular are likely to accumulate context whose lifecycle is different from ordinary conversation history. The same is true for retrieved context, workspace instructions, plans, runtime context, and other injected artifacts.

Giving their owning plugins a controlled place in the compaction pipeline would allow them to preserve their own semantics while leaving generic summarization responsible for actual conversational history.

discussions.title: [Enhancement] Avoid full AGENTS.md reinjection after agent-originated edits
discussions.body:
## Summary

`agent-instructions` currently appends the complete current instruction file whenever an already-loaded `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` changes, including when the change was just made by the same agent through a successful `write` or `edit` tool call.

This is robust and makes instruction state self-contained in the model-visible history, but it can also produce substantial redundant context.

It may be possible to separate durable instruction state from its model-visible materialization and avoid full reinjection after agent-originated edits.

## Current behavior

A typical sequence can look like this:

```text
AGENTS.md v1 injected in full

assistant → edit AGENTS.md
tool result → applied edit

Updated instructions from: AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md v2 injected in full
```

If the file is large and the edit is small, the next request contains:

* the original full instruction file;
* the tool call describing the edit;
* the tool result describing the applied change;
* and another complete copy of the updated instruction file.

Repeated edits can therefore accumulate multiple full snapshots before compaction.

## Observation

Immediately after an agent-originated `write` or `edit`, the model already has direct evidence of the mutation in its conversation history.

The additional full-file reinjection is mainly useful for a different reason: it establishes a durable, self-contained representation of the new effective instruction state so that later turns, resume, pruning, and compaction do not have to reconstruct it from the original file plus a sequence of edits.

Those two concerns could potentially be separated:

1. persist the authoritative instruction state;
2. materialize the full text into the model-visible surface only when necessary.

## Proposed direction

After a successful agent-originated instruction-file mutation, instead of immediately appending another full `user/message`, persist a log-only instruction-state event containing the new canonical state.

For example, conceptually:

```ts
'agent-instructions/state': {
  scopes: [{
    scope,
    path,
    digest,
    content,
  }],
}
```

The exact schema is not important, but storing the complete current content rather than only a digest would preserve deterministic replay and avoid making resume depend on whatever happens to be on disk later.

The model-visible surface could continue to contain the older materialization temporarily because the model also sees the edit that transformed it.

Then, when `agent-instructions` determines that no sufficient model-visible materialization of the current instruction state remains — for example because the previous instruction message was shadowed by compaction — it can append one fresh complete baseline containing the latest state.

Conceptually:

```text
AGENTS v1 full          ← model-visible

edit v1 → v2
state(v2)               ← log-only

edit v2 → v3
state(v3)               ← log-only

... later compaction shadows old instruction materialization ...

fresh AGENTS v3 full    ← model-visible again
```

This would preserve the useful invariant that the model receives a complete current instruction state when required, without paying for a complete replacement snapshot after every self-edit.

## Scope

This optimization could initially apply only to mutations known to originate from the current agent through successful first-party `write` / `edit` operations.

Other cases can retain the current behavior:

* externally modified files;
* newly discovered nested instruction scopes;
* removals;
* candidate precedence changes;
* changes discovered on resume.

Those cases do not necessarily have an equivalent mutation already visible in the conversation.

## Interaction with compaction

Without a pre-compaction integration point, the earlier materialized `AGENTS.md` may still be included in the summarizer input. That is acceptable as a first implementation: after compaction shadows that materialization, `agent-instructions` can re-materialize the latest complete state before the next model request.

A more complete solution could additionally remove or collapse obsolete instruction materializations before generic summarization; see #6850.

That would make instruction state behave more like replaceable structured context rather than ordinary conversation history.

## Benefits

For large instruction files and sessions where the agent updates project guidance, this could significantly reduce repeated prompt content while retaining:

* durable and replayable instruction state;
* deterministic resume behavior;
* a complete current instruction snapshot whenever the model actually needs one;
* append-only Session semantics;
* and compatibility with later compaction.

It would also separate two concepts that are currently encoded in the same `user/message`: the durable state of workspace instructions and the particular point at which that state is materialized for the model.
