discussions.title: DSH | dsh-pptx-editor | Edit PowerPoint presentations through conversation
discussions.body:
## English

> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community
> member. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

[Project and source](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor) ·
[1.0.0 release](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/releases/tag/v1.0.0) ·
[npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pptx-editor) · [Usage](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/blob/main/docs/usage.md)

## What it does

Send a `.pptx` attachment in a DSH Web conversation. The presentation opens in
the right sidebar, where you can use the full editor or ask the Agent to change
it. For example:

- “Add a slide at the end titled Next steps.”
- “Center the title on slide 3 and make it blue.”
- “Change the second row's score to 42.”
- “Insert the image I uploaded on this slide.”

Version **1.0.0** supports slide creation and management, text and paragraph
formatting, element alignment, shapes, tables, six chart types, uploaded images,
and undo/redo. Changes appear directly without an extra apply-confirmation step.

![Editor showing a new slide in a synthetic presentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/main/docs/assets/editor-example.png)

_Editor example from a synthetic presentation used in browser regression._

## Install

With Node 24 and a configured DeepSeek Harness:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pptx-editor@1.0.0
dsh web
```

Save open documents before restarting an existing DSH service. Open DSH's login
URL in Chrome or Edge. This is a prebuilt bundle; users do not need to build the
plugin or configure a separate model key. Tested with DSH CLI `0.1.5-rc.1`,
public DSH packages `0.1.5-rc.2`, and `pptx-react-viewer` `3.19.2`.

## DSH integration and current boundaries

The plugin registers a native sidebar tab and conversation tools through DSH's
public plugin APIs. Sent PPTX attachments open through the admitted-message
feed; the editor and Agent share the same document and undo history. It uses the
model selected in the DSH conversation. No DSH source patch is required.

- The viewer's **Save** button downloads a PPTX. **AutoSave** keeps a browser
  recovery copy; it does not overwrite the original file.
- The plugin reads attachments admitted to the current conversation. Document
  text and structured data read by tools can reach the configured model
  provider.
- Native attachment-card clicks are not an extension point; ask “Reopen the
  PPTX on the right.”
- Animation, master/theme editing and other unavailable public APIs are not
  exposed to conversation. Imported charts and complex formatting have explicit
  [capability limits](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md).

Bug reports and reproducible examples are welcome in the
[issue tracker](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/issues). Please use
a synthetic or anonymized presentation rather than private content.

---

## 简体中文

> 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护，与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系，也不代表官方推荐。

[项目与源码](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor) ·
[1.0.0 版本](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/releases/tag/v1.0.0) ·
[npm 包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pptx-editor) · [使用说明](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/blob/main/docs/usage.zh-CN.md)

## 能做什么

在 DSH Web 对话中发送一个 `.pptx`
附件，演示文稿会在右侧打开。既可以使用完整编辑器，也可以直接向 Agent 提出修改需求，例如：

- “在末尾新增一页，标题写下一步计划。”
- “把第三页标题居中，字体改成蓝色。”
- “把第二行的分数改成 42。”
- “把我上传的图片放到这一页。”

**1.0.0**
支持新增和管理幻灯片、文字与段落格式、元素对齐、形状、表格、六类图表、上传的图片，以及撤销与重做。修改会直接显示，无需额外点击确认应用。

![编辑器展示合成演示文稿中新增的一页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/main/docs/assets/editor-example.png)

_编辑器示例：浏览器回归测试使用的合成演示文稿。_

## 安装

先安装 Node 24 并配置 DeepSeek Harness：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pptx-editor@1.0.0
dsh web
```

如果 DSH 已在运行，请先保存文稿再重启。在 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开 DSH 输出的登录链接。安装包包含构建产物，不需要用户自行构建，也不需要单独配置模型密钥。已测试 DSH
CLI `0.1.5-rc.1`、DSH 公开插件包 `0.1.5-rc.2` 和 `pptx-react-viewer` `3.19.2`。

## 如何接入 DSH，以及当前边界

插件通过 DSH 公开插件接口注册右侧页签和对话工具，在附件消息被接收后打开 PPTX。编辑器与 Agent 共用当前文稿和撤销历史，使用 DSH 对话中选定的模型，无需修改 DSH 源码。

- 组件的**保存**按钮下载 PPTX；**自动保存**保留浏览器恢复副本，不会覆盖本机原文件。
- 附件读取限定在当前对话已接收的文件。工具读取的文稿文字和结构化数据可能进入当前配置的模型服务商。
- 当前没有普通附件卡片点击扩展接口；可以通过对话说“重新打开右侧的 PPTX”。
- 动画、母版和主题等缺少公开接口的能力尚未接入对话。导入图表与复杂格式也有明确的[能力边界](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/blob/main/docs/capabilities.zh-CN.md)。

欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/yunfeizhu/dsh-pptx-editor/issues)
反馈问题和可复现示例。请使用合成或脱敏文稿，避免提交私人内容。

discussions.title: Deepseek v4.1 flash + dsh有很多问题啊
discussions.body: 今天用了一天dsv4.1f配dsh工作，问题太多了，现在基本是没法用的状态。 首先是一些比较软的问题，例如我用goal设了一个目标，它会不停实现->测试->推翻自己的工作->新实现->...这样循环往复一直不收敛，花费了大量token活没干出来。 还有大家经常说的大肥鱼会唱歌的问题，确实输出里面会有大量let me, go等等词，有大量毫无意义的话语，虽说能干出来活我不在乎你的思考过程，但是这些垃圾token也要扣我钱啊。 还有一些硬性的bug，例如： 它会把应该输出的内容放到思维链里面，结果导致我看不到任何输出它就停止了，我打开思维链才发现输出内容在里面。 还有循环输出： 这个就比较严重了，要不是我发现的早，不知道它要吃掉多少钱。 这些问题我不知道是dsv4.1f的问题还是dsh的问题，总之希望尽快修复吧。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: Open In... launches the workspace folder behind the browser and never takes focus (result depends on the launching process)
discussions.body:
<details>
<summary>中文摘要</summary>

### 摘要

Windows 上，会话头部的 **「Open In...」** 会在会话的工作区目录上启动目标应用，但窗口开在**浏览器后面**，永远拿不到焦点。窗口是好的，内容也对：点任务栏上该应用的按钮就能把它切到前面。用户不该需要多做这一步。

窗口能否到前台，取决于 dsh 宿主进程当时所处的环境，与目标应用无关，也与进程怎么创建无关。同一个可执行文件、同一个目录，换一个调用方发起就能到前台，换另一个就留在浏览器后面；把启动方式从 `CreateProcess` 换成经 Windows 外壳，结果不变。插件里没有任何一步尝试激活窗口，也没有相关配置项。

### 环境

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2**，npm 安装，`dsh web`（profile `web`），`open-in-app` 使用 bundle 默认值 |
| 系统 | Windows 11（build 26100） |
| 会话 | 本地 Console 会话，非 SSH、非容器 |
| Node | v24.16.0 |
| 浏览器 | `msedge.exe`，最大化 |
| 配置 | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 为空 `[]`；`settings.yaml` 无 `open-in-app` 项 |
| 涉及包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` |

### 复现

1. 在 dsh web UI 打开一个会话，浏览器保持最大化；
2. 点会话头部 `Open In...`（或从下拉菜单选应用）；
3. 用同一个工作区目录多试几次，目标应用分别处于"未运行"和"已运行"两种状态；
4. 点任务栏上该应用的按钮，才能看到那个窗口。

**期望**：应用窗口出现在最前并获得焦点。**实际**：应用启动了、窗口内容正常，但 `GetForegroundWindow` 全程是 `msedge.exe`，屏幕上什么都看不到，界面上也没有任何报错或状态变化。

### 证据

1. `GetForegroundWindow` 以 250ms 间隔连续采样 14-16 秒，全程没有离开 `msedge.exe`；VS Code 冷启动时新窗口 Z 序 `z02`，已运行（不同文件夹 / 同一文件夹）均为 `z03`。
2. 屏幕取点的栈序枚举显示窗口是**被完全遮挡**而不是被最小化（浏览器与 VS Code 窗口都最大化，浏览器画在它上面），所以点任务栏才能看到它。
3. 结果取决于"谁发起启动"。固定机器、目标应用、目录和启动代码，只换调用方：交互式终端里的 python `Popen` + `DETACHED_PROCESS` 0/11；同 python 换各种 creationflags 0/6；隐藏窗口的后台 node（复刻 dsh 形态）走**插件真实路由** `POST /open-in-app/open` 0/3；交互式终端里的 node 用插件自己的 `spawn(..., {detached:true, stdio:'ignore'})` 7/7；上述任意失败调用方再加一步显式激活窗口 10/10。
4. 换外壳启动也没用。同一个隐藏后台服务、每次都先确认浏览器在前台，四种启动方式结果一致：`CreateProcess`（现状）、`Start-Process`（`ShellExecuteEx`）、`Shell.Application` 的 `ShellExecute`（双击路径）、以及直接对文件夹用外壳关联——目标窗口一律停在 `z02`，前台始终是 Edge。第四种是核对项：它确实把资源管理器打开了，说明外壳路径本身工作正常，只是同样不置前。前三种我重复跑过，结果相同。
5. 插件本身不是差异点：它的 `vscode` 启动器解析到 `D:\Software\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe`，与成功那组用的是同一个可执行文件。
6. `dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js:348-357` 是 `spawn(command, args, { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide, env })`。包内搜索 `SetForegroundWindow` / `AllowSetForegroundWindow` / `AppActivate` 均无结果，没有任何一步尝试激活窗口，启动成功与否也不看窗口是否出现。
7. `dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js:1219-1223`：`Config` 只有 `probeTimeoutMs`、`iconTimeoutMs`、`launchWatchMs`，没有焦点或前台字段，属于缺配置项而不是我没找到。

### 排除了的

- 目标应用、目录参数与 PATH 解析（同一可执行文件、同一参数，只有调用方不同）。
- 进程创建方式（`CreateProcess`、`ShellExecuteEx`、外壳 open verb、文件夹关联都不置前）。
- 本机特殊性（本地 Console 会话而非 SSH；同一台机器确实有 7/7 成功到前台的时候）。
- VS Code 自身的单实例激活（它只能解释"同一文件夹时窗口在自己窗口栈内上移一位"，解释不了冷启动，且失败路径每种情况都一样）。

### 尚未确定

- 为什么调用方会决定成败，因此修复要满足哪一条规则还不明确。Windows 前台锁只允许当前拥有前台窗口、刚收到用户输入、或被显式授权的进程调用 `SetForegroundWindow`；从前台进程尝试 `AllowSetForegroundWindow(ASFW_ANY)` 被拒绝（false，`GetLastError`=5 拒绝访问），没找到可行授权路径。第 4 条的外壳结果也不支持"外壳会补上前台授权"这种解释：`ShellExecute` / `ShellExecuteEx` 带有裸 `CreateProcess` 没有的前台权限，窗口依然留在浏览器后面。
- macOS / Linux 是否同样。启动函数三平台共用一个，但只在 Windows 上验证过。

### 建议方向

- 启动后由宿主自己把窗口带到前台，不要依赖启动动作顺带把焦点带过去：等目标窗口出现（带超时），再 `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)`，并用 `AttachThreadInput` 结合 `SetForegroundWindow` 提升（实测 10/10，包括那些所有启动方式都失败的调用方）。实现难点是定位窗口：单实例应用（如 VS Code）的可见窗口属于另一个进程，按启动进程的 pid 找窗口并不可靠。
- 增加 `focus` / `foreground` 配置项。前台激活会打断用户正在做的事，做成可关的开关比直接改默认值稳妥。
- 若都不做，请在文档里写明「应用会启动但不保证置前」，避免用户反复排查自己的配置。

### 临时绕过

- 用完 **Open In...** 后点任务栏上该应用的按钮。
- 启动函数可注入（`internals.launch`，`dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js:400`），可以用一个宿主侧插件替换成会提升窗口的启动器，不必改任何核心文件。

</details>

---

### Summary

On Windows, the session-header **"Open In..."** button starts the target application on the session's workspace directory, but its window opens **behind the browser** and never takes focus. The window is there and its content is correct: clicking the application's taskbar button brings it forward. The user should not have to do that.

Whether the window comes forward depends on the environment the dsh host process happens to be in, not on the target application, and not on how the process is created. The same executable and the same folder come to the front from one caller and stay behind the browser from another; switching the launch from `CreateProcess` to the Windows shell does not change the outcome. Nothing in the plugin raises the window, and there is no configuration for it.

### Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Package | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2**, npm install, `dsh web` (profile `web`), `open-in-app` on its bundle defaults |
| OS | Windows 11 (build 26100) |
| Session | local Console session, not SSH, not a container |
| Node | v24.16.0 |
| Browser | `msedge.exe`, maximized |
| Config | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` is `[]`; `settings.yaml` has no `open-in-app` entry |
| Packages involved | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` |

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a session in the dsh web UI with the browser maximized.
2. Click the session-header **"Open In..."** button (or pick an application from its chevron menu).
3. Repeat with the same workspace directory a few times, with the target application both cold and already running.
4. Click the application's taskbar button to see the window.

**Expected**: the launched application's window comes to the front and takes focus, the way it does when the same application is started from a terminal or the Start menu.

**Actual**: the application starts and its window content is correct, but `GetForegroundWindow` stays on `msedge.exe` for the whole launch and nothing new is visible on screen. There is no error and no state change anywhere in the UI.

### Evidence chain

1. `GetForegroundWindow`, sampled every 250 ms for 14-16 s after the click-equivalent launch, never leaves `msedge.exe`:

   | Case | Foreground throughout | New window's z-position |
   |---|---|---|
   | VS Code cold start, workspace folder | `msedge.exe` | `z02` behind `z01` Edge |
   | VS Code already running, a different folder | `msedge.exe` | `z03` behind Edge |
   | VS Code already running, the same folder | `msedge.exe` | `z03` — moved up one slot inside VS Code's own window stack, still behind Edge |

2. A stacking-order probe at one screen point (`WindowFromPoint` + `GetAncestor`, first result front-most) shows the window is fully occluded rather than iconized, which is why the taskbar click is what reveals it. One desktop state, with the browser confirmed in the foreground before the launch:

   ```
   foreground: msedge.exe pid=21388
     z01 msedge.exe  pid=21388  rect=(476,39)-(2078,1458)   'dsh ... Microsoft Edge'
     z02 Code.exe    pid=15764  rect=(-11,-11)-(2571,1539)  '.dsh - Visual Studio Code'
   ```

   The new VS Code window is maximized to cover the screen and the browser still draws on top of it.

3. The result depends on which process issues the launch. Holding the machine, the target application, the folder and the launch code constant, and changing only the caller, flips the outcome:

   | Caller | How it launched | Reached the foreground |
   |---|---|---|
   | python in an interactive terminal | `Popen` + `DETACHED_PROCESS` | 0/11 |
   | same python | creationflags varied (`CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP` added/removed, none at all) | 0/6 |
   | hidden background node, dsh's shape | **the plugin's real route**, `POST /open-in-app/open` with `app=vscode` | 0/3 |
   | node in an interactive terminal | the plugin's own `spawn(..., { detached: true, stdio: "ignore" })` | 7/7 |
   | any of the failing callers above | the same launch, followed by explicit window activation | 10/10 |

4. Row 3 is the real code: a throwaway HTTP server hosting `dsh-host-open-in-app`'s `apply()`, which resolved its own catalog (`["explorer","vscode","windowsterminal","gitbash"]`) and ran its own launcher. The route answered `200 {"ok":true}` and VS Code appeared at `z02`, with the foreground on `msedge.exe` for the whole window.

5. The plugin's launcher is not the differentiator: its `vscode` entry resolves to `D:\Software\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe`, the same executable row 4 used successfully.

6. Going through the Windows shell does not help either. I ran four launch methods from the same hidden background service, with the browser confirmed in the foreground before each launch:

   | Method | Launch call | Result |
   |---|---|---|
   | `CreateProcess` (what the plugin does now) | `spawn(exe, [folder], { detached: true, stdio: "ignore" })` | window at `z02`, foreground stays Edge |
   | `Start-Process` (`ShellExecuteEx`) | `Start-Process -FilePath <exe> -ArgumentList <folder> -WindowStyle Hidden` | window at `z02`, foreground stays Edge |
   | shell open verb (the double-click path) | `Shell.Application`'s `ShellExecute(<exe>, <folder>, '', 'open', 1)` | window at `z02`, foreground stays Edge |
   | folder association | `Start-Process -FilePath <folder>` (Explorer opens the folder) | Explorer window at `z02`, foreground stays Edge |

   The folder association row is the sanity check: it opened Explorer on the folder, so the shell path does work, and it still did not take the foreground. I repeated the first three methods and got the same result each time.

7. `dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js:348-357` is `spawn(command, args, { detached: true, stdio: "ignore", windowsHide, env })`. Searching the package for `SetForegroundWindow`, `AllowSetForegroundWindow` and `AppActivate` returns nothing: no step attempts to activate a window, and launch success is decided without checking whether the application became visible.

8. `dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js:1219-1223`: `Config` has only `probeTimeoutMs`, `iconTimeoutMs` and `launchWatchMs`. This is a missing option, not a setting I failed to find.

### What I could not determine

- Why the caller decides the outcome, and therefore which of the two mechanisms the fix has to satisfy. Windows' foreground lock permits `SetForegroundWindow` from the process that owns the foreground, from a process that just received user input, or from an explicitly authorized process. An attempt to authorize via `AllowSetForegroundWindow(ASFW_ANY)` from the foreground process was refused (`false`, `GetLastError` = 5, access denied), so I did not find a viable authorization path. The shell results in row 6 argue against "the shell supplies the missing grant": `ShellExecute` and `ShellExecuteEx` carry foreground rights the raw `CreateProcess` path does not, and the window still stayed behind the browser.
- Whether macOS and Linux behave the same. The launch function is shared by all three platforms, so they may, but I only tested Windows.

### Ruled out

- The target application, the folder argument and PATH resolution. Row 4 and row 3 above launch the identical executable with the identical argument; only the caller differs.
- The way the process is created. `CreateProcess`, `ShellExecuteEx`, the shell open verb and the folder association all leave the window behind the browser (row 6).
- My machine as a special case. It is a local Console session rather than SSH (under SSH the plugin returns an empty catalog and no button renders), and the same machine does bring the same application to the front 7/7 from a different caller.
- VS Code's own single-instance activation. It explains the one-slot move inside VS Code's window stack when the folder already matches, but it cannot explain the cold-start case, and the failing code path is the same in every case.

### Narrowed suspects

1. The launch has no activation step and relies on whatever permission the host process happens to carry. Something in the caller's environment supplies that permission inconsistently, and no process-creation route compensates for it.
2. The file-manager entry takes a second path, `/open-in-app/open`'s `shell-open` branch (`lib/index.js:917-936`), which calls `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`'s `openNativePath()` (`dsh-native-command/lib/index.js:112-117`) and runs `powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Invoke-Item -LiteralPath <path>"` through `execFile` with `windowsHide: true`. I measured its launcher rather than the click: the hidden invocation, the same invocation without `windowsHide`, and a direct `explorer.exe` spawn all left the Explorer window behind the browser. It needs its own item rather than sharing one with the case above.

### Suggested fix direction

- Have the host bring the window forward after the launch instead of relying on the launch to carry focus. This step covered every caller in testing: wait for the target window to exist (with a timeout), then `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)` and raise it with `AttachThreadInput` plus `SetForegroundWindow` (10/10, including the callers where every launch route failed). Locating the window is the awkward part: a single-instance application such as VS Code owns its visible window from a different process, so looking up windows by the launched pid is not enough.
- Add a `focus` / `foreground` option. Foreground activation interrupts whatever the user is doing, so making it switchable is safer than changing the default outright.
- If neither is done, say in the docs that applications are started but not guaranteed to come forward. Users currently cannot tell a plugin limitation from their own misconfiguration.

### Workarounds for users until a fix

- Click the application's taskbar button after using **Open In...**.
- The launch function is injectable (`internals.launch`, `dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js:400`), so a host-plane plugin can supply a launcher that raises the window without touching any core file.

### Probes

I can share the probes behind these numbers: continuous foreground sampling, window z-order and rectangle enumeration, screenshots, the throwaway host that runs the real plugin route, and the background launcher service used for the four-method comparison.

discussions.title: 【实践笔记】插件里调模型做结构化输出，请默认把推理关掉——推理 token 和正文共用一份预算
discussions.body:
这个坑我踩过两次，写出来省得别人再绕一遍。

插件里调模型做翻译、抽取、出题这类结构化输出的时候，默认是把推理开着的（DeepSeek 适配器上
默认 high）。模型会先在心里想一大段，而这段思考跟正文共用一个输出预算——预算不够的时候，
全花在思考上了，正文一个字都没写出来。

最坑的不是它出错，是它不出错。请求正常返回，不抛异常，你那边就是拿不到 JSON。
程序一看"没报错"，也就不重试了，最后表现成"模型没返回这个单词"，你还以为是提示词写坏了。

改起来很简单：插件里所有调模型的地方，显式传 reasoningEffort: "off"，别靠宿主默认。
翻译、抽取、打标签、出题、分类、写短文案，这些都是照规则干活的活。真正需要多步推演的
（规划、难题求解）才留着。

还有一条，别拿"我本地测过了"当证据。本地那个模型不思考、宿主路由思考，这类失败你根本测不出来。
要测就用宿主实际路由的模型，或者至少强制开着推理跑一轮。

--- 以下是AI助手提供的技术细节，不关心的可以跳过 ---

定位说明：这是插件作者的实践笔记，不是 bug 报告。下面这个根因，针对 harness 自身辅助调用的部分
官方已被通知过（#3468 会话标题、#6797 压缩摘要）。我没找到的是另一半——第三方插件该怎么做。
这篇补的是这一半。

---

一句话结论

插件里调 ctx.llm.stream() 产出结构化输出（翻译、抽取、打标签、出题、分类、短文案）时，
显式传 reasoningEffort: "off"。DeepSeek 适配器上默认是 high，而推理 token 和你的正文
共用一个 maxTokens 预算。

失败是静默的：请求成功、不抛异常，你就是拿不到可用输出。

---

与既有帖子的关系（以及差异）

- #3468 —— 会话标题辅助调用：报的是核心辅助调用没有关推理的配置口。同模式，对象是核心组件。
- #6797 —— 压缩摘要：「default maxTokens=8192 is consumed by reasoning tokens」。同根因，对象是核心组件。
- #6510 —— 功能请求：压缩时自动关思考。同思路，仅限压缩。
- #3002 —— 压缩丢失 reasoningEffort；评论区指出 pi-ai 路径上推理上限正是按 reasoningEffort 门控的。
- #6532 / #6218 —— 空响应守卫不触发，因为一个流式 reasoning token 就会打开一个块。
  这正是把「输出被饿死」变成「静默成功」的机制。

以上都不是讲插件自己的模型调用。如果维护者认为已被覆盖，说一声，我把它并进相关帖。

---

我们遇到的现象

插件：dsh-word-vault（生词记忆卡生成）。任务：为一批 6 个单词生成结构化 JSON 卡片，maxTokens = 4500。

结果：6 个全部返回「模型未返回该词」。

- 没有抛异常。
- 解析器兼容了我们能想到的所有 JSON 形状。
- 同一提示词直连 API、用无推理模型（deepseek-chat）跑，6/6 成功。

也就是说：请求没问题，解析没问题——模型压根没吐出 JSON。

---

根因

来自 @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek README 原文：

    「生成的 token 遵循请求中记录的推理强度与 maxTokens」

以及

    reasoningEffort: off | low | high | max      # 模型默认 high

推理 token 从和可见正文同一个 maxTokens 预算里扣。我们宿主路由是 DeepSeek-V4-Flash High，
推理阶段把 4500 的预算先花光，JSON 还没开始写就停了。

顺带解释了我们一直归因到别处的一个现象：关掉推理后，同一批调用明显变快。

---

最小复现

同一宿主路由、同一模型、同一提示词、同一 maxTokens：

  A) reasoningEffort: "high"（或直接不传——在该适配器上等价）
  B) reasoningEffort: "off"

看组装后的 assistant 消息，不要只看「有没有抛错」。A 组应该能看到推理块吃掉预算、
正文被截断或为空。我们 A 侧的表现是解析为空，而不是报错——这正是它难查的原因。

也可以直接观察：每次请求实际生效的调用配置是被记录的——推理强度属于请求信封，不是连接级设置。

---

最费时间的那个坑

我们用一个无推理模型验了提示词，6/6 通过，于是判断插件没问题——「我这儿能跑、宿主那边不行」。
这个差异本身就是 bug。

如果你的开发期模型不思考、而用户的宿主路由思考，你的测试根本看不见这类失败。
请用宿主实际路由的模型验证，至少跑一轮强制开着推理。

---

改法

把插件里所有模型调用收敛到一个函数，默认值只在这一处注入：

    export async function collectText(llm, options, signal) {
      // 翻译 / 抽取 / 出卡 / 出题都是「照规则干活」，不是多步推演。
      // 2026-09-16 实测：宿主 reasoningEffort=high 时，推理吃光整个 maxTokens 预算，
      // JSON 从未被输出。
      const opts = options?.reasoningEffort
        ? options
        : { ...options, reasoningEffort: "off" };
      let out = "";
      for await (const chunk of llm.stream({ ...opts, signal })) { ... }
    }

调用方仍可显式传 reasoningEffort 覆盖。

在我们这个插件里 cardgen / examgen / translate 都走这一个函数，所以改一处覆盖全插件。
补了测试：默认是 "off"，显式传值被尊重。

---

判断标准

  照规则干活的结构化输出  -> 关
  （翻译、抽取、打标签、拆词、出题、分类、短文案）

  真正多步推演的任务      -> low / high
  （规划、难题求解）

推理并不能让「翻译这个单词」做得更好。它只是让你为它付费，并且在预算紧时悄悄拿走你的答案。

---

同一次事故带来的两条配套纪律

1. 即使关了推理也要留余量。不要按预期 JSON 的大小去卡 maxTokens。
   我们用 min(16000, 2500 * 批大小 + 2000)。

2. 「解析为空」必须当失败处理并重试。只 catch 异常不够。
   上面那个响应，按我们当时所有的检查都算成功——没抛错、正常结束——只是里面什么都没有。
   于是代码逐项记了「模型未返回该词」，并且从不重试，因为它认为没出错。
   现在解析为空即失败：批次对半拆开重试。

---

环境

- @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek，deepseek-official 路由
- dsh 0.1.5-alpha / rc 线，插件侧 API（ctx.llm.stream）
- 宿主模型 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，reasoningEffort=high
- 修复版本 dsh-word-vault v0.5.3（commit 75eef23）

---

两个插件，相隔八天

值得明说：这个坑我们踩了两次。

- 2026-09-08，另一个插件（简历筛选，deepseek-v4-pro）：「模型把全部 token 预算烧在推理链上，
  无可见输出」。同样方式修好了，但结论只留在那个插件自己的笔记里。
- 2026-09-16，生词库插件：同一根因，又从头查了一遍。

这就是为什么这条经验该写在一个通用的地方，而不是某个项目的笔记里——
也是为什么每个产出结构化输出的插件，都该默认传 reasoningEffort: "off"。

如果你也在写会调模型的 DSH 插件，想知道你有没有遇到、怎么处理的；
以及你认为 "off" 是工具类调用的正确默认值，还是说单开一条不思考的专用路由更干净。


---

[Field note] Structured-output calls in plugins should default to
reasoningEffort: "off" — reasoning tokens share the maxTokens budget

Context first: this is a plugin-author field note, not a bug report. The root
cause below has already been reported against harness-internal auxiliary calls
(#3468 session titles, #6797 compaction). What I did not find anywhere is the
plugin-side half: what a third-party plugin should do about it. That is what
this post is.

---

TL;DR

If your plugin calls ctx.llm.stream() to produce STRUCTURED OUTPUT — translation,
extraction, tagging, question generation, classification, short copy — pass
reasoningEffort: "off" explicitly. Do not rely on the host's default. On the
DeepSeek adapter the default is `high`, and reasoning tokens are counted against
the same maxTokens budget as your answer.

The failure is silent: the request succeeds, nothing throws, and you simply get
no usable output.

---

Related, and how this differs

- #3468 — session-title auxiliary call: reports no config way to disable
  reasoning for a core auxiliary call. Same pattern, core component.
- #6797 — compaction summarizer: "default maxTokens=8192 is consumed by
  reasoning tokens". Same root cause, core component.
- #6510 — feature request to auto-disable thinking during context compression.
  Same idea, compression only.
- #3002 — compaction drops reasoningEffort; the comments point out that on the
  pi-ai path the reasoning cap is gated on reasoningEffort.
- #6532 / #6218 — the empty-response guard never fires because a streamed
  reasoning token opens a block. This is the mechanism that turns "starved
  output" into "silent success".

None of these are about the plugin's own LLM calls. If a maintainer considers
this covered, tell me and I will fold it into the relevant thread.

---

What we saw

Plugin: dsh-word-vault (word-vault / flashcard generator for a DSH setup).
Task: generate structured JSON cards for a batch of 6 words. maxTokens = 4500.

Result: all 6 came back as "the model did not return this word".

- No exception was raised.
- The parser handled every JSON shape we tested.
- The same prompt against the API directly, with a non-reasoning model
  (deepseek-chat), returned 6/6.

So the request was fine, the parser was fine — the model just never emitted the
JSON.

---

Root cause

From the @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek README:

    "Generated tokens follow the reasoning effort recorded in the request and
     maxTokens."

and

    reasoningEffort: off | low | high | max      # model default is high

Reasoning tokens are drawn from the same maxTokens budget as the visible answer.
Our host route was DeepSeek-V4-Flash at High. The reasoning pass consumed the
4500-token budget before the JSON ever started, so generation stopped with
nothing visible.

This also explains the latency we had been blaming on something else — the same
calls got noticeably faster once reasoning was off.

---

Repro recipe

On the same host route, same model, same prompt, same maxTokens:

  A) reasoningEffort: "high"  (or omitted — same thing on this adapter)
  B) reasoningEffort: "off"

Read the assembled assistant message, not just "did it throw". In case A you
should see a reasoning block eating the budget and a truncated / empty answer.
Our A-side showed up as an empty parse, not as an error, which is exactly why it
took a while to find.

You can also watch it directly: every request's effective call config is
recorded — the reasoning effort is part of the request envelope, not a
connection setting.

---

The trap that cost us the most time

We validated our prompt with a non-reasoning model, got 6/6, and concluded the
plugin was fine — "works on my machine, fails on the host". That difference WAS
the bug.

If your dev-time model does not think and your user's route does, your tests
cannot see this class of failure at all. Validate against the model the host
actually routes, or at minimum run one pass with reasoning forced on.

---

Fix

Collapse every model call in the plugin into one function and inject the default
there, so you only have to get it right once:

    export async function collectText(llm, options, signal) {
      // Translation / extraction / card generation / question generation are
      // rule-following tasks, not multi-step reasoning.
      // Measured 2026-09-16: with the host at reasoningEffort=high, reasoning
      // consumed the whole maxTokens budget and the JSON was never emitted.
      const opts = options?.reasoningEffort
        ? options
        : { ...options, reasoningEffort: "off" };
      let out = "";
      for await (const chunk of llm.stream({ ...opts, signal })) { ... }
    }

Callers can still opt back in by passing reasoningEffort explicitly.

In our case cardgen / examgen / translate all went through this one function, so
one edit covered every model call in the plugin. Added tests: default is "off",
and an explicit value is respected.

---

Decision rule

  Structured output from a rule-following task  -> off
  (translation, extraction, tagging, splitting, question gen, classification,
   short copy)

  Genuinely multi-step work                   -> low / high
  (planning, hard problem solving)

Reasoning does not make "translate this word" better. It just bills you for it
and, on a tight budget, silently removes your answer.

---

Two companion disciplines from the same incident

1. Leave headroom even with reasoning off. Do not size maxTokens to the expected
   JSON. We use min(16000, 2500 * batchSize + 2000).

2. Treat "parsed to empty" as a failure and retry. Catching exceptions is not
   enough. The response above succeeded by every check we had — no throw, valid
   finish — it just contained nothing. Our code recorded a per-item failure
   ("model did not return this word") and never retried, because from its point
   of view nothing had gone wrong. An empty parse is now a failure: the batch is
   split in half and retried.

---

Environment

- @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek, deepseek-official route
- dsh 0.1.5-alpha / rc line, harness-side plugin API (ctx.llm.stream)
- Host model DeepSeek-V4-Flash at reasoningEffort=high
- Fixed in dsh-word-vault v0.5.3 (commit 75eef23)

---

Two plugins, eight days apart

Worth saying out loud: we hit this twice.

- 2026-09-08, a different plugin (resume screening, deepseek-v4-pro): "the model
  burned the entire token budget on the reasoning chain with no visible output".
  Fixed the same way, but the conclusion stayed inside that one plugin's notes.
- 2026-09-16, the word-vault plugin: same root cause, found from scratch again.

That is the argument for writing it down somewhere general rather than in a
single project's notes — and for passing reasoningEffort: "off" by default in
every plugin that produces structured output.

If you build DSH plugins that call the model, I would like to know whether you
hit this and how you handled it — and whether you think "off" is the right
default for utility calls, or whether a separate dedicated route with no
thinking would be cleaner.

discussions.title: DSH | Timeseries Workbench | An interactive time-series analysis and forecasting workspace for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body: > **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community member.** > > **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或推荐。** # Timeseries Workbench for DeepSeek Harness A time-series analysis, forecasting, and decision-support workspace integrated into DeepSeek Harness. 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个面向时间序列任务的交互式工作台，将 **数据导入、可视化、统计分析、多序列关系分析、预测和事件感知分析** 集成到 DSH 对话工作流中。 ## Project - GitHub: https://github.com/Crash0524/Timeseries-Workbench-DSH - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-timeseries-workbench - License: Apache-2.0 ## What it does Timeseries Workbench adds a dedicated **TS Workbench** interface to DSH. You can upload time-series files, inspect and edit metadata and events, visualize one or multiple series, and reference selected data directly in DSH conversations. Instead of asking the model to reason only from raw numeric values in the prompt, the agent can use specialized time-series tools for analysis and forecasting. Main capabilities include: - **Interactive TS Workbench** - DSH chat + time-series workspace - Multi-series visualization - Zooming and range selection - Event annotation - Metadata editing - Shared references between the Workbench and DSH chat - **Unified data import** - JSON / JSONL - CSV / TSV - XLSX - Plain-text numeric data - Text-based PDF / DOCX - **Time-series analysis** - Summary statistics - Trend analysis - Seasonality analysis - Autocorrelation - Stationarity tests - Volatility analysis - Anomaly detection - Change-point detection - **Multi-series analysis** - Association analysis - Lag analysis - Similarity analysis - Coherence analysis - Predictive-value analysis - Granger causality tests - **Forecasting and event-aware analysis** - Time-series forecasting - Historical and future event evidence - Decision records - Time-series memory - **Visual-first analysis** - The agent can render the actual time series as a persistent chart, inspect its visual structure, and then use numerical tools for further validation. ## DSH Integration The project integrates with DeepSeek Harness through: - A native DSH plugin - A dedicated time-series Skill - A Python tool backend - A forecasting service The npm package is: ```bash dsh-timeseries-workbench For an already adapted DSH host: pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-timeseries-workbench@0.1.0 pnpm dsh --profile web After installation, a session can enter TS Workbench, upload time-series data, and use the same series references from both the Workbench UI and the DSH agent. Analysis outputs such as charts, forecasts, anomaly results, and multi-series analysis results can also be stored as reusable references in the conversation. Architecture DeepSeek Harness │ ┌────────────┴────────────┐ │ │ TS Workbench DSH Chat │ │ └────── shared refs ──────┘ │ Time-Series Skill │ ┌────────────┼────────────┐ │ │ │ Analysis Relationships Forecasting │ │ │ └────────────┴────────────┘ │ Python Tool Backend Forecasting is provided through an independent forecasting service. Toto-2 is currently included as the default forecasting backend, while the forecasting interface can be replaced with other models. Current Status The project is still under active development. The currently validated DSH baseline is: dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1 One important limitation of the current release: The complete Workbench still requires a small DSH host patch in addition to the npm plugin. dsh plugin add installs and registers the plugin, but does not currently apply the required host patch or automatically install all Python-side dependencies. Full deployment instructions are available in the repository: https://github.com/Crash0524/Timeseries-Workbench-DSH I plan to continue reducing host-side modifications and simplifying the installation process in future versions. Screenshots Recommended screenshots: 1. TS Workbench + DSH chat 2. Multi-series analysis 3. Forecast result 4. Event-aware forecasting / anomaly analysis Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are very welcome. If you are working on time-series forecasting, monitoring, causal or relationship analysis, or agentic data analysis with DSH, I would be very interested in hearing about your use cases.

discussions.title: dsh 0.1.5-rc.1/rc.2 depend on unpublished @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-code-runtime-python (npm 404)
discussions.body:
`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.5-rc.1` (current `latest`) and `0.1.5-rc.2` (`next`) declare a dependency on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-code-runtime-python@^0.1.5-rc.X`, but that package was never published: `https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai%2fdsh-experimental-code-runtime-python` returns 404.

Any install of the published tarball fails at dependency resolution:

```
npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
npm error 404 Not Found - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai%2fdsh-experimental-code-runtime-python - Not found
npm error 404  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-code-runtime-python@^0.1.5-rc.1' is not in this registry.
```

Reproduced with npm 11 (node 24) and npm 10.9 (node 22) against both releases, published 2026-09-10. The repo's own archived note (`.agents/notes/archived/architecture/2026-07-31-code-runtime-portable-identifier-seam.md`) describes this package as a "private experimental CPython subprocess backend", so it looks like a private package leaked into the public release's dependency list.

`0.1.6-alpha.1` (`alpha` tag, 2026-09-15) no longer lists it and installs cleanly. Users tracking `latest`/`next` have been stuck on it for about a week; downstream tooling that auto-updates from the `latest` tag keeps failing on it.

Fix options: publish the package, or cut a new `rc`/release off the alpha state that drops the dependency and move the `latest` tag to it.

discussions.title: [dsh_session_log] First upload carries the entire session log, permanently breaking long sessions with HTTP 413
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1` (profile: `web`)
- Provider: `deepseek-official`, wire protocol `messages` (the new default since `b0641b83fc`)
- Model: `deepseek-v4-pro` / `deepseek-flash` (reproduces on both)
- `session-log-deepseek` enabled with defaults (`2389b65246` made the upload default-on)
- macOS, Node v24.15.0, `pnpm dsh web`

## Symptom

Long-lived sessions fail every turn with:

```json
{"message":"DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)","code":"INVALID_REQUEST","status":413}
```

recorded in the session log as `assistant/attempt` → `turn/end`. A brand-new session
works fine with the same provider, model, and settings. The failure is **permanent**:
the session never recovers, no matter how many times it is retried or restarted.

The `413` is returned by the provider, not by the local `dsh web` server. The local
HTTP bridge caps buffered bodies at 300 MiB and streams responses, so it is not the
source.

## Evidence

Four sessions in one profile, same provider and model:

| Session | State | Log JSONL bytes | `delivery-accepted` watermarks |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `f7d378ca…` | fails 413 (turn 230) | 95,881,363 (~91 MiB) | **0** |
| `93b06c99…` | fails 413 (turn 231) | 95,912,073 (~91 MiB) | **0** |
| `4b44862f…` | fails (see note) | 135,112,977 (~129 MiB) | **0** |
| `01155af0…` (new) | works | 1,720,673 (~1.7 MiB) | **55** |

Two further observations:

1. The first attempt of the failing turn reports `TRANSPORT`, and only the retry gets a
   clean `413` — consistent with an oversized body dying mid-upload.
2. `providerError()` in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/transport.ts`
   tests `isContextWindowExceededError(detail)` *before* `status === 413`. The result was
   `INVALID_REQUEST`, not `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, so the response carried **no
   context-overflow wording** — this is a body-size rejection, not a context overflow.

## Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek` contributes the `dsh_session_log` request-body
field. Its contract is incremental: it sends only the log suffix after the greatest
accepted watermark.

`packages/session/session-log-deepseek/src/index.ts` computes the pending suffix and
sets `throughSeq` to the **log tail**, with **no bound on the suffix size**:

```ts
const throughSeq = snapshot.at(-1)?.seq          // log tail
const suffix = session.snapshotEvents(SessionLogOffset(afterSeq + 1))
const value = { …, throughSeq: Number(throughSeq), events: suffix.map(wireEvent) }
```

For a session that has never been uploaded there is no watermark, so `afterSeq === -1`
and the **first** request carries the **complete** log — 91 MiB here, embedded as a JSON
member of the request body.

This is a dead end rather than a transient failure: the provider rejects the body, no
2xx follows, `accept()` never runs, no watermark is recorded, and the next attempt
rebuilds the same oversized body. A session whose log grows past the provider's request
limit is **permanently unresumable**.

`README.md` documented exactly this gap under Known Limitations:

> **No independent request-size cap** — complete delivery is fail-closed; provider
> rejection leaves the cursor unchanged instead of truncating the log.

## Expected

A large pending suffix should drain across successive requests instead of being sent as
one body the provider rejects. `dsh_session_log` is documented as adding **zero
model-input tokens** (`README.md` → Model Experience → Token effect), so bounding it
costs no model context.

## Suggested fix

Bound the contributed batch to an oldest-first prefix and make `throughSeq` name the
last sequence the request **actually carries**:

```ts
export const DEFAULT_MAX_BATCH_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024

// Config gains: maxBatchBytes?: number  (schema default DEFAULT_MAX_BATCH_BYTES)

function takeBatch(events, maxBytes) {
  const batch = []
  let bytes = 0
  for (const event of events) {
    const size = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(event), 'utf8')
    if (batch.length > 0 && bytes + size > maxBytes) break
    batch.push(event)
    bytes += size
  }
  return batch
}

const events = takeBatch(suffix.map(wireEvent), config.maxBatchBytes ?? DEFAULT_MAX_BATCH_BYTES)
const throughSeq = events.at(-1)?.seq ?? Number(tailSeq)   // last carried, not the tail
```

Properties:

- **Lossless.** The batch is a *prefix*; the watermark advances to its last sequence and
  the next request resumes at the following one. Nothing is skipped or reordered.
- **Convergent.** One accepted request drains one batch, so a 91 MiB backlog drains in
  ~23 requests instead of failing forever.
- **No stall on a single oversized record.** The first event is always admitted even if
  it alone exceeds the ceiling; withholding it would freeze the watermark below it.
- **Zero model-visible change.** The field stays outside `messages`, the system prompt,
  and tool schemas.

Full diff: 11 files, +162/−20 — `<https://github.com/bozhang1214/deepseek-harness/commit/bff8e9a7cf>`

## Verification

- 2 new regression tests (bounded drain without gaps/duplicates; single oversized event
  still advancing the watermark); package suite **45/45 passing**, `oxlint` clean,
  `verify-config-catalog` and `verify-translation-pairing` (919 pairs) clean.
- Committed as `bff8e9a7cf`; passes the repository's own `lefthook` gates — pre-commit
  (translation pairing, staged lint, whitespace, vendor manifest guard) and pre-push
  (`typecheck`).
- Controlled A/B on a real affected session (`93b06c99`, 91 MB log), counting **structured**
  413 records only (`assistant/attempt` / `turn/end` with `failure.status == 413`); the
  string "413" in prose gives false positives:
  - `maxBatchBytes: 1073741824` (≈ pre-fix behaviour) → 413 reproduces: **yes**
    (3 real 413s at 20:58:47, 21:00:01, 21:00:58, and the watermark did not advance at all)
  - default `4194304` → the same session recovers: **yes**
    (watermarks resume at 21:03:02 with 3.2–3.8 MiB batches, and no further 413s)
  - the contributed batch is now 3.6–3.9 MiB per request, versus a single ~91 MB body
  - independently corroborated: the profile patch file's mtime is 21:02:53 — between the
    last 413 (21:00:58) and the recovery (21:03:02)

## Impact

Any long-lived session whose log exceeds the provider's request-body limit becomes
permanently unusable on upgrade — and because it fails *silently on first upload*, users
see only a generic 413 and are likely to misdiagnose it as a context-window problem
(as in #2770) or a compaction problem (as in #2107).

## Related, but not duplicate

- #2770 — same 413 symptom, **different root cause**: provider context overflow on Qwen.
  Here the field is not model input, and a new session on the same model works.
- #2107 — web profile auto-compaction disabled. Independent (model-visible context).

## Note

While upgrading I also saw `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT` ("DeepSeek Messages cannot represent
user/tool-result content reasoning") on a pre-existing session after the `protocol:
messages` default landed — likely a separate migration issue. Happy to file that
separately if useful.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-novel-craft | 如何让 AI 写出你觉得好的文字
discussions.body:
**让 AI 写出你觉得对味的文字。**

**你只点赞、点踩，模型自己总结规律。**

读候选稿的时候顺手点一下：好段落 👍，坏段落 👎。然后让模型把这批点选总结成几条能照着做的写法，写进一份档案。下一轮写稿带着这份档案，写完再点、再总结。

### 解决的痛点

**自己写提示词太累了。**"别写那么用力"它听不懂，你得反复调；调好这一次，下次开个新对话又得重来。

**逐段给它写评语太烦了。** 一轮摊开八到十篇候选，每篇两三千字，读完还要说"哪里好"——说不出来，只会觉得"这篇有感觉"。勉强写下的那些"更细腻""节奏不错""有点刻意"，翻译回写作等于没说，第三轮它还是同一个毛病，只是换了个说法。

说到底：**判断很好下，表达很难写。** 点一下是一秒钟的事，让你把"我想要什么"说清楚，你写得动十次，写不动一百次。

所以别让作者表达，让模型总结。

它总结出来的东西长这样（我自己的档案）：

```
## 已验证偏好（作者喜欢什么）
- 用旁观者的沉默或退缩接住血腥场面
- 新角色登台只给三两个动作细节
- 宝物价值直接用特性栏点明
## 避免的写法（作者不喜欢什么）
- 不要用比喻堆砌来写人群的恐惧
- 不要在施法后补旁白解释动机
- 不要用四字词连排描写街市与人群
- 不要让角色替读者盘点和总结收获
- 不要在对话后补一句安抚式旁白
- 不要给次要配角成段的外貌描写
```

这些不是我写的，是我点出来的。每条后面能点「证据」，看它当年是从哪几段原文里总结的；不认同的直接删。

**档案里只有规律，没有原文。**这一点是这个方法能成立的前提：原文一轮几千字，带两轮上下文就满了；规律是几百字节（我的是 714 字节），每一轮都带得动。所以它能一轮轮跑下去，越用越对味——而且模型记住的是"怎么写"，不是"这几句长什么样"。

---

装：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-novel-craft`　仓库：https://github.com/shiyan688/dsh-novel-craft

不想装也能先看界面：`docs/preview.html` 是真组件渲染出来的快照，浏览器直接打开。

discussions.title: Messages 协议拒绝遗留的 reasoning 内容，导致旧会话永久打不开
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1` (profile: `web`)
- Provider: `deepseek-official`, wire protocol `messages` — the default since `b0641b83fc`
- The affected session was created before 2026-09-14 and had used a background subagent

## Symptom

A pre-existing session fails on **every** turn with:

```
DeepSeek Messages cannot represent user/tool-result content reasoning
code = UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT
```

Retrying, switching models, and restarting the process all fail. Setting
`protocol: chat-completions` makes the same session work again, which points at the protocol
rather than at the data.

## Root cause: the two protocols disagree on identical durable history

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/serialize.ts:11-13, 57-59` accepts only
`text` and `image` in a user/tool-result position and throws for anything else.

Scanning `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v3.jsonl.zstd` found **7** `user/message` events in one
session whose `data.content` carries a `reasoning` block directly. All 7 come from the same
producer — the **background-subagent settlement notice**, which inlined the child's closing
content blocks verbatim into the parent's user message (timestamps 2026-09-03 and 09-09).

That producer was already fixed:

`29debb8b24 fix(subagent): keep settlement notices text-only` (2026-09-14) —
`packages/subagent/subagent/src/continuation-messages.ts:143` now keeps text blocks only. But
history persisted before that date cannot be rewritten, and Messages fails closed on it.

Running the same legacy user message through both serializers:

```
--- chat-completions ---  OK    -> [{"role":"user","content":"Its closing message:"}]
--- messages ---          THREW -> DeepSeek Messages cannot represent user/tool-result content reasoning
```

chat-completions' `flattenText()` keeps only text blocks and silently drops the rest
(`serialize.ts:95-100`); its `assertTextOnly()` rejects only images. Messages throws for any
non-`text`/non-`image` block.

So this is not data corruption — it is a **contract mismatch between the two protocols**.
Because `0.1.6-alpha.1` made `messages` the default, that mismatch silently made a class of
existing sessions permanently unusable.

## Why simply dropping every non-text block is wrong

Scanning all local sessions for non-text blocks in user/tool-result positions gives
`reasoning` (20), `file` (5), `image` (47). `image` is already supported. A `file` block is
**real model-visible input** — discarding it would silently change what the model sees — so it
must keep failing closed. Only `reasoning` carries no model-visible meaning in that position,
and chat-completions already drops it.

## Suggested fix

Treat `reasoning` in a user/tool-result position the way chat-completions already does: drop
it and report the degradation through the existing `onReplayDegrade` channel, keeping every
other unrepresentable block fail-closed.

```ts
if (block.type === 'reasoning') {
  onReplayDegrade?.('discarded reasoning content from a user/tool-result turn')
  return []
}
if (block.type !== 'image') return unsupported(`user/tool-result content ${block.type}`)
```

Patch (1 commit, 2 files, +30/−1 — `serialize.ts` + its spec, on my fork; no PR per CONTRIBUTING):

https://github.com/bozhang1214/deepseek-harness/compare/bff8e9a7cf...225ffa14dd

Alternatives the team may prefer:

- **Sanitize at derivation** (`Session.deriveMessages()` / the surface fold) and keep the
  protocol serializers strict. Caveat: `SessionMessageProjection` is designed for
  plugin-owned event types, so intercepting the core `user/message` would replace the built-in
  derivation.
- **A session migration** that strips these blocks from persisted logs — most thorough, but it
  rewrites user history.

All three need the same underlying decision: **legacy history must be allowed to degrade**,
because the producer fix can only apply going forward.

## Verification

- Implemented the serializer-alignment variant (patch linked above): `reasoning` in a
  user/tool-result position is dropped with a degradation diagnostic; `text` / `image`
  unchanged; every other type still fails closed.
- Added a regression test (drop in both user and tool-result positions) and converted the
  assertion that previously required a throw into a `tool-call` fail-closed assertion
  (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tests/messages/serialize.spec.ts:299` on upstream master).
- Targeted specs **113/113** and the whole `llm-deepseek` package **577/577** pass; `oxlint`
  clean.
- Same-input check after the change: `messages` returns
  `[{"type":"text","text":"Its closing message:"}]` — identical to chat-completions — plus the
  degradation diagnostic.
- Scope note: that is a serializer-level check plus unit tests. I have **not** re-run the
  affected session end-to-end against the provider yet (that needs a process restart).

## Impact

Any session persisted before 2026-09-14 that used a background subagent becomes permanently
unusable once the `messages` protocol becomes the default — and it fails on every single turn.
The error names only "content reasoning" and never hints that the data is legacy or that
chat-completions still handles it, so users are unlikely to find the cause.

## Related, but not duplicate

Separate from the `dsh_session_log` first-upload issue (HTTP 413): that one is about request
body size, this one about representable content.

discussions.title: DSH Mobile — Run the DeepSeek Harness agent natively on Android (no root, no Termux)
discussions.body:
Hi all! Sharing a community port I have been working on:

**DSH Mobile** — https://github.com/Soodok/Deepseek-Harness-Local-Android

It packages the full DeepSeek Harness agent stack into a 70MB APK:

- **Self-built bionic runtime**: node/bash/rg/pnpm/curl collected from the Termux package ecosystem with ELF closure verification — runs fully offline, no Termux app, no root
- **Blazing fast first launch**: cold start to engine-ready in **under 10 seconds** on a mid-range phone (~15s on tablets) — most Termux-based alternatives take minutes
- **Extension Center**: 19 on-device toolchains (Python, Go, Rust, Clang, OpenJDK, Git, Ruby, ...) installed directly from China-mirror Termux repos, with dependency-closure resolution and SHA-256 verification. The agent can also self-install tools through a local bridge
- **System capability bridge**: task-completion notifications, accessibility-based screen reading and tapping (scr dump / scr tap-text), name-based process management (psx/killx)
- **Three-tier permissions**: sandboxed (default) / Shizuku (adb-level via shz) / Root (with double confirmation, automatic dsh-home backup, and a su gate so the agent can not escalate outside Root mode)
- **Self-healing**: crash-signature based rollback and safe-mode pipeline, config surface only

A few hard-won notes from porting (full write-up coming soon):

1. TUNA mirror WAF silently 403s non-standard user agents — identify as APT/... instead
2. GNU tar longname bodies are NUL-padded; if your hand-rolled tar parser keeps the NUL, file creation explodes with "Invalid file path"
3. Android PathParser rejects SVG arc commands with compact flags ("0 01.292") — normalize flags before feeding Simple Icons paths to VectorDrawable
4. "su -c exec node" spawns su as the tracked child; killing the shell leaves the root node orphaned and still bound to your port — kill the process group

v1.2.23 is live under Releases (signed APK, arm64-v8a). Issues and ROM-compatibility reports are very welcome!

DeepSeek Harness is developed by DeepSeek AI (MIT). DSH Mobile is an independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

discussions.title: [Bug] `workflow` tool clips its result to 50,000 chars BEFORE the spill policy runs; the spill file labelled "Full formatted result" is truncated and the rest is lost
discussions.body:
**Versions:** dsh 0.1.5-rc.1, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow` 0.1.5-rc.2, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-spill-policy` 0.1.5-rc.2. Same code in `dsh-tool-workflow@0.1.6-alpha.1` (`lib/index.js:130-134`).

## What happens

A `workflow` script that returns more than `maxResultChars` (default 50,000) loses the excess for good. The tool's own `render()` clips the JSON and appends `… [truncated: N more characters]`. The spill policy runs later, on `tools/post-execute`, and only ever sees that clipped text. It saves it to the spill file and labels the file **"Full formatted result stored at: …"**. The file is not full, and nothing in the message says so.

Nothing else keeps a copy. The `tool/result` session event stores the same clipped text, and the inline `workflow` tool writes only `tool-workflow/run-start` and `run-end` events, neither of which carries the value. The `workflow_manage` run records belong to a different package (`@dsh-external/workflow`), not to this tool.

On 2026-09-16 a 39-agent workflow here returned ~226 KB. 78% of the findings were gone before anything reached disk; the run had to be repeated with hand-capped return values.

## Repro

Any script with a return value over 50,000 characters, zero agents needed:

```js
return { blob: "x".repeat(60000), tail: "END-OF-VALUE" };
```

Result: a spill file of 50,098 bytes that ends with `… [truncated: 10042 more characters]`. `tail` never reaches disk. The inline notice reads `(Omitted 292 bytes. Full formatted result stored at: /tmp/dsh-spill-…/…-workflow.txt. …)`.

## Where

- `dsh-tool-workflow/lib/index.js:130-134` — `renderResult()` slices to `maxChars` and returns the clipped string.
- `dsh-tool-workflow/lib/index.js:226-229` — `output.render` calls it with `maxResultChars`.
- `dsh-tools/lib/index.js:3415-3445` — `createSuccessResult()` renders before post-execute; the full value is still on `result.value`.
- `dsh-spill-policy/lib/index.js:155-172` — the post-execute arm reads `decision.content ?? result.content`, the already-clipped text, and calls `formatSpillNotice()` (`:21-23`), which always says "Full formatted result".

## Two defects

1. **Ordering.** Spill exists to keep the full output out of context without losing it. Clipping in `render()` first defeats that: the spill file holds a copy of the truncation, not of the result.
2. **A false claim.** "Full formatted result stored at" is wrong whenever a producer clips before the policy runs. Either the policy needs to be told the text is partial, or the wording should not promise completeness.

## Why the cap can't be raised from user config

`tool-workflow` registers no settings namespace, so a `tool-workflow:` section in `settings.yaml` is ignored (verified: same 50,000 cut after adding one). The live row is inside the `standard` agent preset (`dsh-agent-presets/presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml:227`), which no `cordis.patch.yml` layer reaches. The base-bundle row at `dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml:374` is disabled by `dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml:458`. And a bigger cap only widens the window; it does not fix the ordering.

## Suggested fix

In `dsh-tool-workflow`, let `render()` emit the full JSON and leave bounding to the spill policy, which already does head/tail preview plus a locator. If a cap must stay in the tool for deployments without a spill store, spill first and clip second, or hand the policy a "partial" flag so `formatSpillNotice()` can say so.

## Work-around we run

A ~40-line local plugin on `tools/post-execute` that, for a successful `workflow` call, re-renders `result.value` whole and replaces the content, so the policy spills the real thing. It is pushed (not prepended), so it always runs inside the policy's `next()` whichever row loads first. With it, the 60 KB repro lands whole in the spill file with no truncation marker. Happy to share it if useful.

discussions.title: gateway: 2s websocket heartbeat default disconnects relayed mobile clients (remote.mux / $events)
discussions.body:
## Summary

The gateway's WebSocket heartbeat default (`websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs`, default **2000 ms**) combined with a fixed 2-missed-ping termination kills any client that goes silent for ~6 s. This kills mobile clients connected through [dsh-relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay): Android freezes backgrounded apps, so the phone's mux socket stays open at the TCP level while the app stops answering pongs — and the gateway terminates its `$events` stream seconds after the app is backgrounded.

## Reproduction

1. Harness `0.1.2-rc.1` with `dsh-relay` 0.2.1 in front (relay binds `:3443`, proxies to the loopback gateway).
2. Connect DSH Mobile 0.11.0 from a phone over the relay. `/api/remote.mux` upgrade and the `$events` stream open succeed (relay log: `OPEN` → `WS-READY clientId=...`).
3. Background the app (or let Android freeze it after ~30–60 s).
4. The gateway heartbeat sweep terminates the connection. Relay lifecycle log shows `CLOSED upstream-side after Nms` with **N ≈ 6–11 s** under the default interval.

## Impact

The phone app cannot hold its event stream while backgrounded — which is exactly when it needs it (to be notified when a turn completes). Completion notifications on mobile are unusable without a config workaround.

## Workaround (verified)

Set `websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs: 60000` on the `typert-gateway` composition row. At a 60 s interval the same phone held its mux for **3+ hours**; only truly frozen sockets were reaped (observed `159537 ms` / `170215 ms` kills, matching 60 s × 2-miss + sweep alignment).

## Suggestion

Make the termination deadline an **absolute silence time** (e.g. terminate only after ≥ 120 s of no pong) instead of a fixed 2-missed-ping count at whatever interval is configured — a 2 s interval with 2 misses is far too aggressive for networked/mobile clients, while a 120 s absolute deadline still reaps genuinely dead sockets promptly. Alternatively (or additionally), raise the default interval for remote/mux streams to 30 s.

Happy to test a patch if that's useful.

discussions.title: [Bug] Web 端输入法预编辑未上屏时点击「发送」，未提交的拼音被当作消息内容发出（Windows / 源码版 0.1.2-alpha.1 cd5ef81）
discussions.body:
## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 11 |
| 版本 | 源码版 `0.1.2-alpha.1`（commit `cd5ef81`，2026-08-28 构建），`dsh web` 本地跑 |
| Node | v24.18.0 |
| 浏览器 | Chrome（干净 profile，CDP 驱动，无扩展干扰） |
| 输入法 | 组合事件序列用 CDP `Input.imeSetComposition` 复刻微软拼音的 pre-edit → commit 流程 |

## 问题描述

输入法组合（预编辑）还没上屏时点「发送」，harness 会把编辑器当前 state 里的**原始拼音**当作用户消息发出去。回车路径有守卫，发送按钮没有。

## 复现步骤

1. `dsh web`，打开任意会话，聚焦输入框
2. 输入已上屏文字「什么是」
3. 开始组合输入，保持预编辑态 `xianzai`（不选词、不上屏）
4. 点「发送」

**实际**：消息发出，会话日志记录 `user/message = "什么是xianzai"`；模型回了「xianzai = 现在（pinyin）」。

同法单测两次（预编辑单段、直接点发送）：

| 预编辑内容（未上屏） | 实际发出的消息 |
|---|---|
| `mo'x` | `mo'x` |
| `ceshi` | `ceshi` |
| `什么是` + 预编辑 `xianzai` | `什么是xianzai` |

**期望**：预编辑未提交时不应产生任何消息；草稿保留，等用户选词上屏后再发送。

## 证据（`$DSH_HOME/sessions/<cwd>/session-<id>/session.jsonl.zstd` 中 `source.kind === "user"` 的行）

```
[21]  "只回复两个字：正常"
[41]  "mo'x"
[342] "ceshi"
[595] "什么是xianzai"
```

同一会话（同一个浏览器会话、同一次输入法状态）里，只有「组合中点击发送」这三次出现污染，正常上屏后再发送的那条是干净的：

```
[840] "什么是现在"
```

## 根因

- composer 是 Lexical 的 contenteditable。组合期间预编辑文本**已经在 editor state 里**（DOM 里就是个普通的 `data-lexical-text` 节点），而草稿投影来自 `editor.getEditorState().read(...)`（`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/facade.ts`，~L231）。
- 目前只有**键盘**路径被守卫：`src/client/input/editor/keymap.ts` 的 `isComposingEvent()`（`event.isComposing || keyCode === 229 || compositionend 后 10ms`）拦住 Enter / 方向键 / Esc。
- `InputFacade.submit()` 不查 composition 状态 → **发送按钮、菜单提交、任何非键盘入口**都会把未提交的预编辑当正文发出去。

## 建议修复

`submit()` 开头补一句同源的守卫：

```ts
submit(mode: InputSubmitMode = 'queue'): void {
  // The IME owns the composition until the user commits it: a submit that
  // arrives while composing (send button, menu, any path the keymap guard
  // never sees) would ship the un-committed pre-edit text as content.
  if (this.editor.isComposing()) return
  ...
```

我在本地源码版验证过（改 `src` + 同步改已构建的 `lib/client.js`，因为浏览器加载的是构建产物）：

| | 组合中点发送 |
|---|---|
| 补丁前 | 发出 `什么是xianzai` |
| 补丁后 | 不发送、草稿保留；正常上屏后发送照常工作 |

对应的回归用例（放 `tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx` 的 Enter semantics 里，当前没有覆盖点击路径的用例）：

```ts
it('the send button withholds a live composition: the keymap guard covers keys, not clicks', () => {
  const { textarea, button, sink } = bench({ draft: 'hello' })
  fireEvent.compositionStart(textarea)
  fireEvent.click(button)
  expect(sink).not.toHaveBeenCalled()   // 去掉守卫这句就失败
  fireEvent.compositionEnd(textarea)
  fireEvent.click(button)
  expect(sink).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
})
```

## 版本核对（升级修不了）

对比了发布包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation@0.1.6-alpha.1`（最新 alpha）的 `submit()` **同样没有守卫**；`0.1.2-alpha.2 → 0.1.6-alpha.1` 之间 composer 只新增了 `data-composer-composing`（组合期间隐藏 placeholder/hint 的 CSS）与 `registerUpdateListener(syncComposition)`，不涉及提交路径。

## 与 #3504 的关系

和 #3504（macOS 候选窗不出现、拼音直落输入框）不是同一个失败：这里是**组合区间存在、预编辑也确实进了 editor state**，缺的是非键盘提交路径的守卫；候选窗、焦点、扩展注入都正常。两者可以并存，修复点不同。

discussions.title: [BUG]: OpenAI strict mode forces `sandbox_permissions` into `required`, causing unrecoverable "sandbox escalation is not strictly wider" loop
discussions.body:
## What's happening

I'm running `pnpm dsh web` with a profile that uses `azure-openai-responses` (Azure OpenAI, GPT-4/GPT-6 class models). Every single tool call the agent tries to make fails immediately with this error:

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
```

The agent can't do anything. Every bash command, every file read, everything fails with the same error. The session is completely stuck.

## What I found after digging in

The session is already running at `workspace-write` mode. The agent shouldn't be sending `sandbox_permissions` at all on normal calls, but it does, on every single call.

After tracing through the code, here's what happens:

1. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts` calls `snapshot.models.streamSimple()` to stream to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
2. The `pi-ai` SDK (`openai-responses.ts`) detects `strict: null` on the tool and calls `makeStrictJsonSchema(tool.parameters)`.
3. That function sets `schema.required = propertyNames`, which promotes **every** property to required, including `sandbox_permissions` and `justification`.
4. The model sees those fields as required in the schema, so it fills them on every call.
5. `approveEscalation` in `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` (line 162) then rejects it because `workspace-write` is not strictly wider than the current `workspace-write` mode.

The `approveEscalation` logic is correct. The bug is that the tool schema sent over the wire wrongly marks `sandbox_permissions` as required.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Set up a `cordis.yml` profile using `openai-responses` or `azure-openai-responses` with any GPT-4 or newer model.
2. Run `pnpm dsh web`.
3. Open a new session (default `workspace-write` mode).
4. Ask the agent to do literally anything that would use bash or file tools.
5. See `sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode` on every attempt.

## Fix that works locally

Add an `onPayload` hook to the `streamSimple()` call in `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts`. The hook needs to:

1. Set `tool.strict = false` so `makeStrictJsonSchema` doesn't get triggered.
2. Remove `sandbox_permissions` and `justification` from `required` if they got added.
3. Use object spread instead of mutating in place, because `pi-ai` freezes the payload object before calling the hook. Direct mutation throws `TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property`.

```typescript
onPayload: (payload) => {
  if (typeof payload !== 'object' || payload === null) return
  const body = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  const tools = body['tools']
  if (!Array.isArray(tools)) return

  const patched: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = []
  let changed = false
  for (const tool of tools as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) {
    if (tool['type'] !== 'function') { patched.push(tool); continue }
    const params = tool['parameters']
    const required: unknown = typeof params === 'object' && params !== null
      ? (params as Record<string, unknown>)['required'] : undefined
    const filteredRequired = Array.isArray(required)
      ? required.filter((k): k is string => k !== 'sandbox_permissions' && k !== 'justification')
      : required
    const needsStrict = tool['strict'] == null || tool['strict'] === true
    const needsRequired = filteredRequired !== required
    if (!needsStrict && !needsRequired) { patched.push(tool); continue }
    changed = true
    patched.push({
      ...tool,
      ...needsStrict ? { strict: false } : {},
      ...needsRequired && typeof params === 'object' && params !== null ? {
        parameters: { ...(params as Record<string, unknown>), required: filteredRequired },
      } : {},
    })
  }
  if (changed) body['tools'] = patched
},
```

This only touches the wire payload before it goes to the API. Nothing in the tool registry, sandbox policy, or escalation logic changes. I also added a unit test that runs against a frozen payload object to make sure it doesn't throw.

## Note

Don't change the `WIDER_MODES` check in `approveEscalation`. That part is doing exactly what it should.

This affects anyone using strict-mode OpenAI-compatible endpoints (openai-responses, azure-openai-responses, openai-codex-responses) once the session is already at `workspace-write` or `danger-full-access`.

discussions.title: [Bug] Web client: a persisted view-store payload missing a newly added field crashes the whole sidebar.workspaces slot
discussions.body:
## Summary

升级 DSH 之后，Web GUI 左侧边栏只剩下「新会话」按钮：**工作区分组、会话列表、搜索框全部消失**，且页面无任何可见提示。实际是 `sidebar.workspaces` 槽位在渲染时抛异常，被槽位错误边界接住后整块区域被丢弃。

根因不在数据，而在客户端持久化状态：浏览器 `localStorage` 里存着一份旧构建写入的视图状态，其中缺少新版本才引入的字段；store 还原时**整体替换** state 而不与 `init()` 默认值合并，导致 `retainAccountKeys` 对 `undefined` 调用 `Object.entries` 抛错。

用户数据完全正常——会话文件、索引、工作区注册都没问题，**只是这块 UI 被异常吞掉了**，用户会误以为「历史对话丢了」。

## Reproduction

### 确定性最小复现（无需装两个版本）

1. 启动 DSH Web GUI，确认侧边栏正常。
2. 浏览器打开 DevTools → Console，执行下面这段（构造一份「缺少 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 字段」的持久化状态，模拟旧构建写入的数据）：

```js
const k = Object.keys(localStorage).find(k => k.startsWith('dsh.workspace.view.v5'))
localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify({
  groupBy: 'workspace',
  orderBy: 'updated',
  groupExpansion: {},
  sessionOrderByAccount: {},
}))
location.reload()
```

3. 刷新后侧边栏只剩「新会话」，工作区/会话列表/搜索框全部消失。

### 自然触发路径（真实用户场景）

1. 使用较早的 DSH 版本，打开 Web GUI，使 `localStorage['dsh.workspace.view.v5']` 被写入（该版本的 `WorkspaceViewState` 不含 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount`）。
2. 升级到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace@0.1.5-rc.2`。
3. **不清除站点数据**，直接重新加载 GUI。

### 恢复验证

```js
Object.keys(localStorage)
  .filter(k => k.startsWith('dsh.workspace.view'))
  .forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k))
location.reload()
```

刷新后侧边栏立即恢复正常，四条历史会话全部回来。

## Current behavior

侧边栏只剩外壳渲染的「新会话」按钮，`sidebar.workspaces` 区域为空。Console 报错：

```
client.js:526 slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces':
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries (<anonymous>)
    at retainAccountKeys (client.js:218:1)
    at index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:69359
    at index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:68694
    at produce (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:66201)
    at Object.update (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:68674)
    at a.<computed> [as retainAccountKeys] (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:69348)
    at client.js:2017:1
```

崩溃点（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace@0.1.5-rc.2` 构建产物 `lib/client.js:214-218`）：

```js
retainAccountKeys: (d, workspaceKeys) => {
    const retained = new Set(workspaceKeys);
    d.groupExpansion            = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.groupExpansion).filter(...));          // 216 正常
    d.sessionOrderByAccount     = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount).filter(...));   // 217 正常
    d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount).filter(...)); // 218 ← undefined，抛错
},
```

调用点：`WorkspaceBrowser.tsx:785`（master 源码位置）在 `workspacePhase === 'ready'` 时执行 `actions.retainAccountKeys([...])`。三个字段里只有 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 为 `undefined`，说明持久化数据里缺的正是它。

## Expected behavior

侧边栏应正常渲染工作区分组、会话列表与搜索框。持久化状态的字段增减不应让 UI 整块崩溃——至少应满足以下任一：

1. store 还原时与 `init()` 默认值合并，补齐缺失字段；
2. `retainAccountKeys` 对持久化字段做空值防御（`Object.entries(d.groupExpansion ?? {})`）；
3. `persist` 键版本号在 state 形状变化时递增，使旧数据自然失效。

## Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | `0.1.5-rc.1`（npm 全局安装） |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` | **`0.1.5-rc.2`**（浏览器实际加载的构建） |
| Profile | `web` |
| 触发存储键 | `localStorage['dsh.workspace.view.v5']` |
| OS | Windows |
| Node | v24.15.0 |
| 浏览器 | Microsoft Edge 153.0.4234.32 |
| 参考 master 版本 | `0.1.6-alpha.1`，HEAD `0d1f50007f`（2026-09-15） |

---

## 补充：根因定位（master 上仍未修复）

### 1. 持久化还原是「整体替换」，不与 `init()` 合并

`packages/client/store/src/index.ts:146-158`（**master `0.1.6-alpha.1` 仍然如此**）：

```ts
function attachPersistence<T>(api: StoreApi<T>, name: string): void {
  if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(name)
    if (raw !== null) {
      api.setState(devFreeze(JSON.parse(raw) as T), true)   // ← 整体替换，不补 init() 默认值
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`snapshot store '${name}' rehydration failed:`, error)
  }
  ...
}
```

注释里写明这是有意的 "Whole-value JSON persistence"。但对**新增字段**而言，这份旧 JSON 会让新代码读到 `undefined`。

### 2. `retainAccountKeys` 无空值防御

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/stores.ts:81-90`（master 已删掉 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount`，但另外两行仍无 `?? {}` 保护）：

```ts
retainAccountKeys: (d, workspaceKeys: readonly string[]) => {
  const retained = new Set(workspaceKeys)
  d.groupExpansion = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(d.groupExpansion).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)),      // 无防御
  )
  d.sessionOrderByAccount = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)),  // 无防御
  )
  delete (d as ... ).sessionUpdatedAtByAccount
},
```

### 3. `persist` 键版本号没有随形状变化递增

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/stores.ts:72` 一直是 `persist: 'dsh.workspace.view.v5'`——先加 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount`、后又删除，**两次形状变化都没有升版本号**，于是新旧数据落在同一个 key 上。

### 关于 master 的现状

master 已经移除了 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 字段（`stores.ts:19-26` 的 `WorkspaceViewState` 只剩 4 个字段），并在 `packages/client/ui-workspace/tests/workspace-browser.client.spec.tsx:361` 加了回归测试 *"drops the obsolete timestamp ledger from persisted viewing state"*。所以**上面这段具体堆栈在 master 上不会再出现**。

但第 1、2、3 点都还在：只要以后任何一个持久化 store 再新增字段，老用户升级后仍会踩到完全一样的坑——而且是「整个功能区域静默消失」这种最难排查的表现。建议按第 1 点（合并 restore）或至少第 2 点（防御性读取）做一次系统性处理。

---

## 给其他用户的临时解法

在 DSH 页面按 `F12` → Console：

```js
Object.keys(localStorage)
  .filter(k => k.startsWith('dsh.workspace.view'))
  .forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
location.reload();
```

该键只存 UI 视图偏好（分组方式、排序、折叠状态、会话顺序），**不含任何对话内容**，删除不会丢失历史记录。

discussions.title: [Bug] Desktop 打包因测试脚本遗留 fs-ext 调用而 100% 失败 (runtime-payload-smoke.mjs)
discussions.body:
### 问题描述 / Problem Description

在执行任何桌面端打包命令（例如 `pnpm run package:desktop:win:x64`、`pnpm run package:desktop:win:x64:unsigned` 或 `pnpm run prepare:desktop`）时，构建流程会在 `prepare:dsh` 阶段的内置运行时烟测中直接抛错并中断：

```
D:\code\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\scripts\prepare-dsh.ts:144
          if (error !== null) reject(new Error(`desktop native payload smoke failed: ${stderr}`, { cause: error }))
                                     ^

Error: desktop native payload smoke failed: node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1500
  const err = new Error(message);
              ^

Error: Cannot find module 'fs-ext'
Require stack:
- D:\code\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\dsh\package.json
    at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1500:15)
...
```

### 根因分析 / Root Cause

在提交 `d927cbff99` (*feat(native): add prebuilt Node-API flock support*) 中，官方为了解决 Node 26 ABI 兼容问题，已将 `fs-ext` 彻底替换为自研原生模块 `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system`，并从整个 Monorepo（`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 及 `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/package.json`）中移除了 `fs-ext`。

但桌面端运行时烟测脚本 `apps/desktop/tests/fixtures/runtime-payload-smoke.mjs` 中仍遗留了对 `fs-ext` 的硬编码测试：

```javascript
/** fs-ext implements seek on Windows through SetFilePointerEx and on POSIX through lseek. */
function checkFsExt() {
  const fsExt = requireRuntime('fs-ext')
  const file = join(scratch, 'seek.txt')
  ...
}

try {
  checkFsExt()
  checkKoffi()
  ...
```

由于 `resources/dsh` 打包出的生产依赖树中已不再包含 `fs-ext`，该脚本在执行 `checkFsExt()` 时必然抛出 `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`，导致桌面端打包 100% 失败。

### 修复方案 / Proposed Fix

直接在 `apps/desktop/tests/fixtures/runtime-payload-smoke.mjs` 中移除已淘汰的 `checkFsExt()` 函数定义、调用及 `fsExt: true` 日志标记。

修改代码与提交参考：
- Commit: [`49dc394f3c`](https://github.com/zhangxaochen/deepseek-harness/commit/49dc394f3c4e34928d3283286ba6d1c801e00a35)
- Branch: [`zhangxaochen:fix/desktop-remove-obsolete-fs-ext-smoke`](https://github.com/zhangxaochen/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/desktop-remove-obsolete-fs-ext-smoke)

discussions.title: [BUG]Terminal cleanup failure notice cannot be dismissed and resurrects on every page load when the session's agent preset was deleted
discussions.body: Summary 终端关闭失败提示条既无法关闭，又会在每次页面刷新/进程重启后自动复活，唯一解法是手动清 localStorage。触发条件：某个会话头部的 agentPreset 指向的 preset 已被删除。 Reproduction 创建会话（其头部写入 agentPreset: router-standard），在其中开一个终端。 删除 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/router-standard。 关闭该终端 → 右下角 shell.overlay 出现常驻卡片「终端「tab3」未能结束：resume failed for session "…": RemoteError: agent-presets: preset "router-standard" not found」。 点「重试」、重启 DSH、归档该会话 —— 都不能消除。 手动清除 localStorage 中 dsh.terminal.close.v1.* 后卡片仍在内存中；只有再刷新一次页面才消失。 Current behavior packages/client/ui-sidebar-terminal/src/client/TerminalCleanup.tsx：failures 来自 webTerminals.closeFailures，只有 Retry 按钮，没有 dismiss。 packages/api/terminal-controller/src/client/index.ts:152：cleanup() 仅对 session/not-found 静默清除；agent-preset/not-found 落入失败分支并渲染卡片。 packages/api/terminal-controller/src/client/close-requests.ts:41：失败请求持久化到 localStorage['dsh.terminal.close.v1.' + id]。 packages/api/terminal-controller/src/client/index.ts:57：构造函数 for (const request of this.requests.pending()) this.cleanup(request) 每次加载重放 → 再失败、再写回、卡片复活。形成自愈不能的闭环。 Expected behavior 关闭失败卡片应可 dismiss；或 「会话存在但其 agent preset 已消失」应视为终态（不可重试），如 session/not-found 一样静默清除待办，并移除 localStorage 键。 Environment @deepseek-ai/dsh-root 0.1.6-alpha.1，commit 0d1f50007f（2026-09-15，master），Windows，web GUI（127.0.0.1:3080）。

discussions.title: Session restore fails after hard-closing browser — "SessionAlreadyOwnedError: already owned by an active write handle"
discussions.body:
**Environment**
- DeepSeek Harness: 0.1.5-rc.1
- Browser: Chrome
- OS: Windows 11 (Build 26200)

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open DeepSeek Harness in browser, create/run two goal tasks
2. Close the browser directly (no graceful exit)
3. Reopen browser and launch DeepSeek Harness
4. Click the two most recent goal task sessions

**Expected behavior**
Sessions restore successfully with full conversation history.

**Actual behavior**
Restore fails with the following error:

```
resume failed for session "session-807d0f0a-c4ed-4a8b-9522-178e29148c92":
SessionAlreadyOwnedError: session "session-807d0f0a-c4ed-4a8b-9522-178e29148c92" is already owned by an active write handle (gateway/internal)
```

**Possible root cause (my guess)**
The active write handle in `gateway/internal` isn't released when the browser tab is killed abruptly, so a fresh session restore is rejected as "already owned".Session restore fails after hard-closing browser — "SessionAlreadyOwnedError: already owned by an active write handle"**Environment**
