discussions.title: No $schema reference on user-editable YAML: cordis.patch.yml and preset agent.cordis.yml cannot be validated in an editor
discussions.body:
**The gap**

Every YAML surface a user is expected to hand-edit — `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`, a per-profile `cordis.patch.yml` / `cordis.yml`, and a preset's `agent.cordis.yml` — is unvalidatable. None carries a schema reference in its header, and no schema is published for an editor to bind to, so a config edit gets no editor-time feedback.

**What exists instead**

The accepted-field contract does exist at runtime: plugins declare config with `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. For example the `agent-instructions` row accepts `maxBytes`, `maxSourceBytes`, `projectRootMarkers`, `instructionFileCandidates`, and `localInstructionFileCandidates`. But that contract is not reachable from the file being edited.

1. **No JSON Schema is published.** No `*.schema.json` ships in any `@deepseek-ai/*` package.
2. **The runtime schema has no JSON-Schema export.** `Schema.prototype.toJSON` (`schemastery/lib/index.mjs:70`) emits an internal descriptor — `{ uid, refs }` over the schema's own fields plus a recursion table — shaped for config-form rendering, not for validators or editors.
3. **No YAML file carries a schema header.** Neither `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`, a per-profile `cordis.patch.yml` / `cordis.yml`, nor a preset's `agent.cordis.yml` contains `# yaml-language-server: $schema=...` — verified across the installed distribution and a populated `$DSH_HOME`. Even a published schema would have nothing pointing an editor at it.
4. **The configuration catalog is not shipped.** The `dsh-agent-presets` README calls `docs/config-catalog.md` "the exhaustive source for every accepted field", but that path exists only in the source repository; the npm package does not contain it.

**Ask**

- Add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` headers to the user-editable YAML surfaces, pointing at per-plugin JSON Schemas.
- Publish those schemas — a small generator over the schemastery definitions would produce them, and would give the config UI a portable format at the same time.

**Why it matters**

A config edit is only ever checked when the plugin applies it. For files users are expected to edit by hand, that is a slow and silent feedback loop — and with no schema reference, nothing else can catch it.

discussions.title: [Bug] Live sessions have no retention policy: heap grows with opened-session count and OOMs at any heap cap (128 GB host, measured per-session costs)
discussions.body:
## 英文版（建议作为正文）

### Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.5-rc.1` (global npm install) |
| Node | v22.23.1 |
| OS | Linux x64, 128 GB RAM (≈64 GB actually free at the time) |
| Launch | `dsh web` (web profile; 4 local profile plugins) |
| Heap cap | V8 default → 4144 MB; later runs with explicit `--max-old-space-size` |

### Summary

`dsh web` grows its heap in proportion to **the number of sessions the process has opened**, not merely to one large log, and **nothing ever evicts** those live sessions. Three separate runs died the same way at three different heap caps, and raising the cap only moved the wall:

| run | heap cap | survived | crash signature |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4144 MB (default) | 19 h | `Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit` |
| 2 | 4144 MB (default) | 16 h | same |
| 3 | **8240 MB** (`--max-old-space-size=8192`) | **44 h** | **`Reached heap limit`** |

In every crash the last mark-compacts reclaimed almost nothing (e.g. `4030.2 → 4014.1 MB`, i.e. 0.4 %), so the heap was **live retained data**, not uncollected garbage.

### Measured: resident cost is per open session

Fresh boot with 8 sessions open (each holding an OS file lock on its `session.lock`), measured at the HTTP API (`heapUsed` ≈ 2875 MB):

| session | events | decompressed log | resident heap | resident RSS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 49,032 | 200.2 MB | 708.4 MB | 1195.9 MB |
| B | 36,797 | 202.3 MB | 679.9 MB | 1168.7 MB |
| C | 13,746 | 46.6 MB | 176.4 MB | 337.3 MB |
| D | 11,061 | 40.1 MB | 137.2 MB | 289.5 MB |
| E | 5,287 | 16.8 MB | 63.2 MB | 171.6 MB |
| F | 1,310 | 6.6 MB | 24.3 MB | 95.3 MB |
| G | 588 | 1.7 MB | 9.5 MB | 60.1 MB |
| H | 384 | 1.5 MB | 8.9 MB | 58.2 MB |
| **Σ** | **93,205** | **515.8 MB** | **1807.8 MB** | **3376.6 MB** |

The RSS sum (3376.6 MB) matches the process measurement (3354 MB) almost exactly; the `heapUsed` sum (1807.8 MB) accounts for ~63 % of the process's 2875 MB. Method: each transcript was streamed through the same path the host uses when it opens a session (line-wise `JSON.parse` → lossless clone → `deepFreeze`), one file per isolated process.

### Measured: opening a session is one-way

I opened one **not-yet-live** session through the real wire protocol (`/api/remote.mux`, `session/follow` with `maxMessages: 1`), then closed the WebSocket. Evidence is the process's held session locks, which is not affected by background noise:

| moment | sessions held by the process | heap |
|---|---|---|
| before | **8** | 3044 MB |
| 6 s after open | **9** | 3015 MB |
| 3 s after socket close | **9** | 3015 MB |
| 20 s after socket close | **9** | 3029 MB |

The count never returns. Repeating page loads/streams accumulates.

### Measured: growth does not require activity

A `/proc`-based sampler watched one process for its whole life (3,861 samples): anonymous memory went **1.05 GB → 4.64 GB in 16.2 h, monotonic**. During that window there were **zero session-log writes and zero queue/storage writes** — only a handful of attachment files. So the slope is not "work done"; there is an additional time/aggregate-proportional term.

### Upstream source locations (checked against `master`, 0.1.6-alpha.1, pushed 2026-09-15 — all still present)

Verified by fetching the files and grepping the current master tree:

1. **No live-session retention policy.**
   `packages/api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/manager.ts`
   - `:96` `private readonly sessions = new Map<SessionId, Session>()`
   - `:292` `this.sessions.set(sessionId, session)` (lazy build, never evicted)
   - `:245` `async drop(sessionId)` exists; `:247` `this.sessions.delete(sessionId)`
   - `grep -nE "idleTimeout|maxSessions|evict|retention"` over the package: **no hits**

2. **A read handle pins the whole decoded log.**
   `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts`
   - `primed` — **2 occurrences** on master
   - `COLD_LOG_MEMO` — **2 occurrences** (the decoded-log memo, count-bounded by entries, not bytes)
   - `decodeStoredLog` 3, `freezeStoredEvents` 3, `memoizeStoredLog` 4

3. **The observation cache can exceed its own cap.**
   `packages/session-query/session-query/src/index.ts:122-131`
   - `const preparedSessionCacheSize = config.preparedSessionCacheSize` (default 5)
   - entries pinned by an active lease (`refs > 0`) are skipped by eviction, so a cache bounded by *count* is not a bound in bytes.

4. **The raw log is append-only and compaction does not trim it.** `Session.log` keeps every streaming chunk; surface `replace` removes shadowed entries from *model input* only.

> Items 1–4 are source reading + sampling. I do **not** have a heap snapshot from the crashing process (it aborted with SIGABRT and no `.heapsnapshot` was written), so “which single holder dominates” is an analysis, not a measurement. Independent reports (#3275, #5995, #5696, #6511, #4722) reach the same conclusion with heap snapshots of their own.

### Why "more RAM" is not the fix

The crash is not physical-memory exhaustion: a 64 GB host still died at ~4.1 GB (#5995), and one reporter measured that with `--max-old-space-size=16384` the heap still climbs past 4 GB with no plateau (#3275). The resident term is `opened sessions × per-session cost`, so any fixed cap is eventually crossed.

### Reproduction (minimal)

```bash
# 1. a session store with many/large sessions
ls -la "$DSH_HOME/sessions"/*/ | head

# 2. start with a known cap and no client
NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 dsh web --no-open

# 3. sample heap every 60 s (no client needed) — RSS/heap climbs monotonically
while :; do grep VmRSS /proc/$(pgrep -f 'dsh/lib/bin.js web')/status; sleep 60; done

# 4. connect one client and open a *stored* session; then close the socket.
#    The server keeps the session resident: watch the held session locks
ls -l /proc/$(pgrep -f 'dsh/lib/bin.js web')/fd | grep -c session.lock
```

### What I ruled out on my host

- **Browser side**: the server paginates the opening frame (`DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50`), and the leak reproduces with **no client at all** (`--no-open`), so the renderer is not the cause of the host heap.
- **Legacy session format**: `bcahlit` in #3275 showed hiding all v2 files and keeping only v3 still OOMs.
- **Projection cache**: same reporter — moving `session_projcache` aside makes it OOM *faster*.
- **Third-party plugins**: disabling a 21-row community bundle cut the slope ~4× (75 → 17 MB/s) but did not stop it.
- **Invalid agent preset** (#6415's trigger): checked — my own preset has the required `persona.prefix`, so that path is not active here.
- **Not corruption**: no `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` / `SessionFormatUnsupportedError` in ~10 boots; only heap exhaustion. All sessions load.

### Suggested fixes (ordered by leverage)

1. Give live Sessions/Agents a **retention policy**: idle timeout and/or a byte-aware cap with real eviction (`manager.get()` ↔ `drop()`), plus a public eviction entry point — today the only `drop()` caller is scope teardown.
2. Don't retain the decoded log in the handle state (`primed`) for read handles; stream the fold instead of materialising every event.
3. Make both memos **byte-bounded** (they are count-bounded today: 2 entries and 5 entries) and let leases expire.
4. Bound the resident reconstruction window separately from durable history (see the community handbook's four-budget model).

### Related

- #3275 — Web server OOMs within ~60s of a client connecting when a workspace contains a large session
- #5696 — V8 heap OOM after ~8h: opened Conversations fully hydrated and never evicted
- #5995 — 内存随会话事件数持续增长，约 8 小时后堆触顶（含 26.1 MB/会话 的官方基准引用）
- #6511 — every session open / reconnect re-decodes the log and retains the decoded copy
- #4722 — in-memory session log is unbounded (append-only), compaction never trims it
- #5347 — 超长会话因流式增量碎片未清理导致 OOM

---

## 中文版（可放在英文之后，或作为主帖）

### 环境

`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1（全局 npm 安装）· Node v22.23.1 · Linux x64 · 物理内存 128 GB（实际可用约 64 GB）· web profile（含 4 个本地 profile 插件）· 启动方式 `dsh web`。

### 结论

`dsh web` 的堆占用与**「该进程打开过的会话数量」**成正比（不只是单个大日志），而且**没有任何驱逐机制**。三次运行在三个不同的堆上限上以同一方式崩溃，抬高上限只是把墙往后挪：

| 运行 | 堆上限 | 存活 | 崩溃签名 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4144 MB（默认） | 19 小时 | `Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit` |
| 2 | 4144 MB（默认） | 16 小时 | 同上 |
| 3 | **8240 MB**（`--max-old-space-size=8192`） | **44 小时** | **`Reached heap limit`** |

每次崩溃前最后一次 mark-compact 几乎回收不到东西（例如 `4030.2 → 4014.1 MB`，即 0.4%），说明堆里是**活着的保留数据**，不是没回收的垃圾。

### 实测一：常驻成本按「每个已打开会话」计

全新启动、8 个会话处于打开状态（各自持有 `session.lock` 的 OS 文件锁），经 HTTP API 读到 `heapUsed ≈ 2875 MB`：

| 会话 | 事件数 | 解压日志 | 常驻 heap | 常驻 RSS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 49,032 | 200.2 MB | 708.4 MB | 1195.9 MB |
| B | 36,797 | 202.3 MB | 679.9 MB | 1168.7 MB |
| C | 13,746 | 46.6 MB | 176.4 MB | 337.3 MB |
| D | 11,061 | 40.1 MB | 137.2 MB | 289.5 MB |
| E | 5,287 | 16.8 MB | 63.2 MB | 171.6 MB |
| F | 1,310 | 6.6 MB | 24.3 MB | 95.3 MB |
| G | 588 | 1.7 MB | 9.5 MB | 60.1 MB |
| H | 384 | 1.5 MB | 8.9 MB | 58.2 MB |
| **合计** | **93,205** | **515.8 MB** | **1807.8 MB** | **3376.6 MB** |

RSS 合计（3376.6 MB）与进程实测（3354 MB）几乎完全吻合；heap 合计占进程 2875 MB 的约 63%。测法：把每份日志**分别**喂给一个独立进程，走 host 打开会话时的同一条路径（逐行 `JSON.parse` → 无损克隆 → `deepFreeze`）。

### 实测二：打开会话是单向的

我用真实线协议（`/api/remote.mux` + `session/follow`，`maxMessages: 1`）打开一个**当时尚未 live** 的会话，然后关闭 WebSocket。判据用进程持有的会话锁数——它不受后台噪声影响：

| 时刻 | 进程持有会话数 | heap |
|---|---|---|
| 打开前 | **8** | 3044 MB |
| 打开后 6 秒 | **9** | 3015 MB |
| 关闭 socket 后 3 秒 | **9** | 3015 MB |
| 关闭 socket 后 20 秒 | **9** | 3029 MB |

**计数不回落。** 反复刷新页面/重连会持续累加。

### 实测三：增长不需要活动

用一个只读采样器盯住某次进程的完整生命周期（3,861 个样本）：匿名内存 **16.2 小时内从 1.05 GB 单调涨到 4.64 GB**。该时间窗内**会话日志零写入、队列与 storages 零写入**（只有几个附件文件）。所以斜率不是「做了多少活」，另有一项与时间/累计量成正比的增长。

### 上游源码位置（已对照 `master` / 0.1.6-alpha.1，最后推送 2026-09-15，**四处都还在**）

1. **live 会话没有保留策略**：`packages/api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/manager.ts`
   - `:96` `private readonly sessions = new Map<SessionId, Session>()`
   - `:292` `this.sessions.set(sessionId, session)`（懒建，永不淘汰）
   - `:245` `async drop(sessionId)` 存在、`:247` `this.sessions.delete(sessionId)`
   - 对 `idleTimeout|maxSessions|evict|retention` 全包 grep：**零命中**
2. **读句柄钉住整份解码日志**：`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts` —— `primed` 2 处、`COLD_LOG_MEMO` 2 处、`decodeStoredLog` 3 处、`freezeStoredEvents` 3 处
3. **观察缓存可超出自身上限**：`packages/session-query/session-query/src/index.ts:122-131`，`preparedSessionCacheSize` 默认 5，且 `refs > 0`（被租约钉住）的条目在淘汰时被跳过 —— 一个「按条数」的上限在字节维度上不构成上限
4. **原始日志 append-only 且 compaction 不裁剪**：`Session.log` 保留全部流式碎片；surface `replace` 只影响**模型输入**，不删原始事件

> 上述 1–4 是源码阅读 + 采样归因。**我没有拿到崩溃进程的 heap snapshot**（它以 SIGABRT 退出、未落盘 `.heapsnapshot`），所以「单一主导持有者」属分析判断而非定论。#3275 / #5995 / #5696 / #6511 / #4722 等报告各自带堆快照，得出相同结论。

### 为什么「加内存」不是解法

这不是物理内存耗尽：一台 64 GB 的机器同样死在 ~4.1 GB（#5995）；另有人实测 `--max-old-space-size=16384` 时堆仍越过 4 GB 且无平台期（#3275）。常驻项是 `已打开会话数 × 单会话成本`，因此任何固定上限终将被越过。

### 已排除项（避免后来者重复踩）

- **不是浏览器侧**：开局帧被分页（`DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50`），且**完全没有客户端**（`--no-open`）时同样复现。
- **不是旧格式**：隐藏全部 v2、只留 v3 仍 OOM（#3275 评论）。
- **不是投影缓存**：把 `session_projcache` 移开反而**更快** OOM（同上）。
- **不是第三方插件**：关掉 21 行社区 bundle 使斜率降约 4×（75 → 17 MB/s），但**没有停止**。
- **不是非法 preset**（#6415 的触发点）：已自查，本机 preset 的 `persona.prefix` 存在，该路径未激活。
- **不是数据损坏**：约 10 次启动中没有任何 `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` / `SessionFormatUnsupportedError`，只有堆耗尽；全部会话可加载。

### 建议修法（按杠杆排序）

1. 给 live Session/Agent 加**保留策略**：空闲超时和/或字节感知的上限 + 真正的驱逐（`manager.get()` ↔ `drop()`），并补一个公开驱逐入口——今天 `drop()` 的唯一调用者是 scope teardown。
2. 读句柄不再保留解码日志（`primed`）；把 fold 改成流式，而不是物化每个事件。
3. 两个 memo 改成**按字节封顶**（现在是按条数：2 条与 5 条），并让租约到期。
4. 把「常驻重建窗口」与「持久历史」分开设界（参见社区手册的四预算模型）。

### 相关讨论

#3275 · #5696 · #5995 · #6511 · #4722 · #5347

discussions.title: Bug: v0-to-v1 migrator rejects subagent/descriptor version 2 written by earlier releases, breaking session search
discussions.body:
### Environment
- dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 (upgraded from 0.1.0-rc.7), Windows
- session-query-sqlite with `openAt: first-search`

### Summary
After upgrading, every session search fails. Both `searchSessions` and `searchEvents` run the
same global reconcile step, so a single un-migratable session breaks the whole feature.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Have sessions written by 0.1.0-rc.7 in which a subagent was spawned — they contain
   `subagent/descriptor` records with `data.version === 2`.
2. Upgrade to 0.1.5-rc.2.
3. Call the session search service (`searchSessions({ query, limit })`), or any plugin tool
   that wraps it (here: `session_search`).

### Actual
```
session-search persistence observation failed:
subagent/descriptor 0 uses unsupported descriptor version 2;
source v0 artifact remains unchanged (raw log: ...\session.jsonl.zstd)
```

### Expected
Legacy sessions migrate, or are skipped with a warning, and search over the remaining
sessions keeps working.

### Root cause
Two gates, both keyed on the descriptor version. (Line numbers are from the published package
build, `lib/index.js`; the function names are the stable part.)

**1) `dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1`, the v0-to-v1 migrator:**
```js
if (event.type === "subagent/descriptor" && data["version"] !== 3) {
  const descriptorVersion = sessionFormatCount(data["version"], `${event.type} ${event.seq} version`);
  if (version === 0) throw new SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError(
    `${event.type} ${event.seq} uses unsupported descriptor version ${descriptorVersion}`);
  return;
}
```

**2) `dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1`, `subagentDescriptorValue()`** — reached through
`assertReleasedPayloadSemantics()`, which `dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3` imports directly
(line 3 of that package):
```js
literalValue(data["version"], [3], `${label} version`);
```

Relaxing gate 1 alone only moves the failure to gate 2:

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3 refuses this format v2 Session:
subagent/descriptor 0 version must be one of 3
```

Earlier releases wrote descriptor version 2, and neither gate has a v2 branch.

### Measured payload shapes of the version-2 records (76 records)
- 49 × `continuable`: `mode`, `provider`, `version`, `label`, `agentProvider`, `agentModel`
  (the agent pair is complete)
- 27 × `one-shot`: `mode`, `provider`, `version`, optional `label`

They satisfy every other field check, so the version literal is the only rejection.

### Impact (measured on my machine)
163 v0 session files; 76 contain `subagent/descriptor` records; all 76 are version 2 and none
are version 3. Session search was therefore 100% unavailable rather than occasionally failing.
The failed migration leaves the source artifact unchanged, so no data is lost.

### Local verification
Relaxing both gates locally (`[3]` → `[2, 3]`, and not throwing in the generation-0 branch)
restores search immediately: all 76 legacy artifacts then pass validation, search returns hits
from the previously un-migratable sessions, and 162 of the 163 source files are byte-identical
by SHA-256 (the one change is the live session log being written).

### Suggested fix
- Accept descriptor version 2 alongside 3 at both gates, or add a proper v2 normalization branch.
- More importantly: make observation resilient — skip an artifact that cannot be migrated, with a
  warning, instead of failing the global reconcile that both `searchSessions` and `searchEvents`
  depend on. One legacy session should not be able to disable the whole query service.

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.6-alpha.1: mounting an experimental browser provider makes every Session fail to create/resume
discussions.body:
**English TL;DR** — On `0.1.6-alpha.1`, after a profile mounts any of the experimental browser providers (`playwright-mcp` or `chrome-devtools-mcp`), every Session fails to create or resume: clicking a Session in the Web UI makes it disappear. The profile holds a second physical copy of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`, so the per-Session scope tag is invisible to the harness and the browser tools register in the **global** tool layer; the second Session then collides on the same tool name, and `failOnStartupError: true` rolls back its Agent creation/resume. Root cause, evidence, fix branch, and verification below.

## 环境

- DSH `0.1.6-alpha.1`，macOS arm64，Node `v24.15.0`
- profile `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 中 `insert` 挂载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp`（`mode: launch`）
- `@playwright/mcp@0.0.80`（该包精确 pin 的版本）

## 现象

页面能打开、工作区与会话列表正常，但**点会话没反应**：`api-session/added` 之后立刻 `removed`，会话从侧边栏消失（不是归档，`archivedSessionIds` 全程未变）。展开全部工作区连点多个会话时 100% 复现。服务端先后报出：

```
mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed

Error: tool "mcp__playwright-mcp__browser_close" is already registered
  (for a per-agent variant, register through that agent's `agent.ctx` instead)
```

## 复现步骤

1. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `insert` 上述两个包（`mode: launch`、`headless: true`）。
2. 重启 Host，新建或打开任意会话（第 1 个会话可能正常，因为它的工具占住了全局名字）。
3. 打开第 2 个会话 → 会话创建/恢复失败并被移除。

## 根因

`mountSessionMcp` 用 `createScope(ctx, agent)` 为每个会话铸造注册作用域，而该作用域标签是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 的**模块内 symbol**。DSH profile 会把插件包装进自己的 `node_modules`（profile 生成器写出 `nodeLinker: hoisted` + `autoInstallPeers: false`，即声明为 peer 的包应当解析到共享的那一份），而 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime` 把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 声明成了**普通 dependency**——它是所有 scope 消费方中唯一这样做的一个。于是：

```
provider 侧（写标签）: profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope   ← runtime 的 dependency 物化出的副本
harness 侧（读标签）:  <dsh 安装>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope      ← dsh-tools / dsh-agent / dsh-agent-loop
```

`scopeOf()` 在 harness 副本里返回 `undefined`，浏览器工具因此被注册进**全局**工具层。第一个会话占住全局名字，第二个会话挂载即重名冲突；叠加 `mountSessionMcp` 的 `failOnStartupError: true`，冲突直接回滚 Agent 的创建/恢复——这就是「点会话就消失」。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 读标签时用的是同一个 profile 副本，所以它的 `serverName` 独占保留仍按会话生效，故障才表现为**工具重名**而不是命名空间重名。

在故障机器的真实模块图上隔离验证（未改动生产安装）：

```
# 未修复
profile-copy scopeOf(scopedA.ctx) === agentA : true
GLOBAL layer after agent A mount              : [ 'mcp__playwright-mcp__browser_close' ]
second agent mount                            : THROWS
   tool "mcp__playwright-mcp__browser_close" is already registered
   (for a per-agent variant, register through that agent's `agent.ctx` instead)

# 修复后（两份副本均为修复版）
harness copy and profile copy differ : true
harness copy reads the profile tag   : true
GLOBAL layer after agent A mount     : []
second agent mount                   : OK, no conflict
GLOBAL layer after both mounts       : []
```

**影响面**：`playwright-mcp`、`chrome-devtools-mcp`、`stagehand-native` 都依赖 `browser-use-runtime`，因此 `0.1.6-alpha.1` 上只要在 profile 里挂载这三个中的任一个就会命中。这些包**首次出现在 `0.1.6-alpha.1`**（`git tag --contains` 只有该 tag；`0.1.5-alpha.2` 的 `packages/experimental` 下没有任何 browser 包），所以是随新版本首次发布的缺陷，而不是升级动作本身或用户配置问题。

顺带一个容易误判的点：`inputSchema` 与 `outputSchema` 的规范化确实不对称（24 个 playwright 工具 24/24 含 `$schema` 等越界词汇），但**只修它并不能恢复可用**——`ToolRuntime.register()` 只校验 `output.schema`，`parameters` 在整条注册路径上从不做子集校验（把未打补丁的已发布产物单独挂载，24 个工具全部注册成功）。它是真实缺陷，但不是这次故障的原因。

## 修复

已在 fork 上完成并验证，分支 `fix/mcp-browser-use-session-startup`（3 个提交，基于 `0d1f50007f`）：

- `fix(scope)` — 作用域标签改为 `Symbol.for('dsh-scope.context-tag')`，父链关系与 carrier 标记放进 `globalThis` 上的单一进程全局槽位；与 Cordis 自身跨副本标记 context（`Symbol.for('cordis.is')`）的做法一致。即使 profile 仍存在两份副本也不再出错。
- `fix(scope)` — `browser-use-runtime` 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 从 `dependencies` 移入成对的 `peerDependencies` + `devDependencies`，与其它所有 scope 消费方一致（含 `pnpm-lock.yaml`）。
- `fix(mcp-client)` — 输入 schema 规范化为受限子集（保留受支持约束、丢弃未实现词汇、`required` 过滤、`additionalProperties` 归为开放默认值、声明的 `type` 优先于并存的 `oneOf`），并补上回归测试与 Agent Note。

> 单独「改为通过 `agent.ctx` 注册」不能修复本故障：副本分裂仍在时 `dsh-mcp-client` 自己的 `scopeOf` 也读不到标签，`serverName` 保留会回落到应用根，第二个会话会改报 `serverName "playwright-mcp" is already in use`。需要修复的不变量是「scope 包同一实例」。

分支与补丁：

- compare：https://github.com/idoall/deepseek-harness/compare/master...fix/mcp-browser-use-session-startup
- 补丁：`git format-patch` 产出（如需我可以贴到帖子里或另附）

## 验证

- 新增 `packages/core/scope/tests/copies.spec.ts`：同一进程加载两份 `dsh-scope`，断言两份副本读到相同的标签、父子链、carrier 标记；**修复前 3/3 失败，修复后 3/3 通过**。
- `735 passed`（core/scope、core/tools、mcp-client、browser-use-runtime、browser-use-stagehand-native、依赖分类门禁，38 个文件）。
- `pnpm run typecheck` 0；`pnpm run lint` 0 warnings/0 errors；`pnpm run test:docs` 20/20；全量 `build` + `hygiene` **16 passed, 0 failed**。
- 上面的生产模块图探针（故障前复现 / 修复后通过）。

## 说明

`CONTRIBUTING.md` 写明当前不接受外部 PR，且仓库 issues 已关闭，因此按指定渠道发在这里。如果维护者希望以分支、补丁或 issue 模板的形式转交，我按需要补齐。

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.6-alpha.1 升级后所有会话无法创建/恢复：profile 内 dsh-scope 双副本导致 scope 身份失配
discussions.body:
## Summary

升级到 `0.1.6-alpha.1` 后，Web 端**所有会话都无法创建或恢复**：页面能打开、工作区和会话列表正常，但点会话没反应（会话会从侧栏消失）、发不了消息、也建不了新会话，前端控制台无报错。服务端 WebSocket 报：

```
mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed
```

根因不是 MCP 工具的 JSON Schema 词汇（那是另一个独立问题，见本贴末尾说明），而是 **profile 安装里出现了第二份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 物理副本，而 `dsh-scope` 的上下文标识是模块内局部 symbol**，导致 `scopeOf()` 在 `dsh-tools` 中返回 `undefined`，MCP 工具被注册进**全局层**而非会话作用域；第二个会话再次挂载同一 server 时撞名，`failOnStartupError: true` 随即回滚整个 Agent 创建/恢复。

## 证据链

**1. 同一进程内存在两份 `dsh-scope` 模块实例**

| 位置 | inode | 版本 |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` | `32084695` | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| `…/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` | `32045561` | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |

两者 `import()` 得到的模块对象不是同一实例（`a === b` 为 `false`），导出的 API 完全相同（`createScope`、`scopeOf`、`scopeChainOf`…）。

**2. 上下文标识是模块内局部 symbol**

`packages/core/scope` 编译产物 `lib/index.js:229`：

```js
const kScope = Symbol("dsh.scope");
```

`Symbol("dsh.scope")` 每次模块求值都产生**新的** symbol。于是 profile 副本 `createScope()` 打上的标记，harness 副本的 `scopeOf()` 读不出来。

**3. 第二份副本是怎么来的**

安装态 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime@0.1.6-alpha.1` 把 `dsh-scope` 声明为**普通依赖**：

```json
"dependencies": {
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client": "^0.1.6-alpha.1",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope": "^0.1.6-alpha.1",
  "@schemastery": "..."
}
```

profile 是独立 npm 工程，`dependencies` 会被真实安装，于是 pnpm 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里落了一份独立副本，而不是解析到 harness 共享的那份。（`dsh-scope` 在其它消费方都是 `peerDependencies`。）

**4. 失败链路**

`createScope()`（profile 副本）打标 → `dsh-tools` 的 `register()` 走 `scopeOf(ctx)`（harness 副本）返回 `undefined` → 工具被归入 context-global 层而非会话作用域 → 第一个会话的 `mcp__playwright-mcp__*` 泄漏到全局 → 第二个会话挂载同一 server 时 `syncTools` 注册阶段抛：

```
tool "mcp__playwright-mcp__browser_close" is already registered
```

`failOnStartupError: true` 时 `registrationFailure` 为 `'throw'`（`packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/connection.ts:138`），异常一路上抛到 `apply()` 的 `packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/index.ts:201`，包装成 `initial connection or tool synchronization failed`；`mountSessionMcp` 的 `agent/created` 监听器随之 reject，Agent 创建/恢复被回滚——表现为「点会话没反应 / 会话从侧栏消失」。

## 建议修复方向

1. **跨副本共享身份**（治本）：`kScope` 等标记改用 `Symbol.for('dsh-scope.context-tag')`，父子关系与 carrier 标记放进进程级槽位，而不是模块内 `WeakMap`。Cordis 对 context 已经这样做了。
2. **消除第二份副本**（治源）：把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 从 `browser-use-runtime` 的 `dependencies` 移到 `peerDependencies` + `devDependencies`，与其它 scope 消费方保持一致，使 profile 解析到 harness 那一份。
3. 建议补一条回归测试：同一进程加载两次 `dsh-scope`，断言 tag、父子链与 carrier 标记一致。

## 关于「MCP inputSchema 词汇」的澄清

排查初期怀疑是 `@playwright/mcp@0.0.80` 的 `inputSchema` 带有 `$schema`、`propertyNames`、`minimum`/`maximum`、对象型 `additionalProperties`（24/24 越出 `assertSupportedJsonSchema` 子集）导致注册失败。实测**该假设不成立**：`ToolRuntime.register()` 只断言 `output.schema`（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:1051`），`parameters` 从不做子集校验；未打任何补丁的 master 源码下，24 个工具全部注册成功，`browser-use-playwright-mcp/tests/upstream.e2e.ts` 全链路 2/2 通过。该词汇问题作为**独立的前瞻性缺陷**记录在 #6876；`failOnStartupError` 的放大效应讨论在 #6877——本次故障正是被 #6877 描述的那个放大机制拖垮的，触发源则是本贴的 scope 双副本。

discussions.title: macOS: Desktop app has no Edit menu, so ⌘V / ⌘C / ⌘X / ⌘A / ⌘Z do nothing in any text field
discussions.body:
The desktop shell installs an application menu template that contains no Edit
menu, and therefore no `paste` / `copy` / `cut` / `selectAll` / `undo` roles. On
macOS, Electron delivers those shortcuts as *application-menu key equivalents*,
so with no Edit menu the shortcuts never reach the focused text field. There is
also no `context-menu` handler in the shell, so right-click offers no Paste
either — as far as I can tell there is currently no way to paste into the
desktop app at all.

This blocks the documented first-run flow: **Settings → Models → enter a
DeepSeek API key**. The field accepts typed characters, but the key cannot be
pasted into it.

## Reproduction

1. `pnpm install && pnpm run build`
2. `pnpm run dev:desktop` (Electron 44.0.0, macOS 27.0 arm64)
3. Open **Settings → Models** and focus the API key input
4. Copy any text, press ⌘V → nothing is inserted
5. Right-click the field → no context menu appears

Affects ⌘C, ⌘X, ⌘A and ⌘Z in every text field in the app, not just this input.
The menu template is shared, so packaged builds are affected too.

discussions.title: [Bug] iCloud-offloaded (dataless) plugin files fail with EDEADLK on boot, and the loader's AggregateError masks all 13 member failures
discussions.body:
**Environment**: macOS (Apple Silicon), `dsh web` **0.1.2-rc.1** (npx cache `2f3a729d991ac520`), `web` profile with ~20 plugins, launchd-managed instance.

**What happened**

The plugin directories had been moved out of an iCloud-synced `~/Desktop` path to `~/dsh/plugins` two days earlier. On the next boot the backend crash-looped, and the UI banner showed only:

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include):
loader entries failed to apply / AggregateError
```

…plus a loader-entry hash fingerprint that changed on every run. The real story was only visible in the launchd log: the `AggregateError` had **13 members**, all failing identically at the bottom:

```
failed to import loader entry ... errno: -11 (EDEADLK), syscall: read
```

In other words, 13 plugin files were in the **cloud-offloaded (dataless)** state — macOS had evicted their contents after the move, and the concurrent reads during plugin import all hit `EDEADLK` instead of returning data.

**Why this was miserable to debug**

1. **The failure self-heals when observed.** A full-tree scan during triage (`find … -exec cat`) materialized the dataless files, after which every error vanished. The bug disappears when you look at it.
2. **Hash-only fingerprints.** Loader-entry errors identify entries by a hash (`2f3a729d991ac520`) that changes per run and is not a plugin name. The same problem looked like three different problems across three reboots. We later hit the same masking pattern with a plugin slot-id conflict (superseded plugin registered in two places) — the hash changed on every attempt, which sent us hunting three separate bugs.
3. **No member enumeration in the UI.** The aggregate hid 13 failures behind one line; per-member info was only in the launchd log.
4. **No detection or guidance for dataless files.** Nothing tells you "this file is cloud-offloaded, reads will block/fail".

**Status on 0.1.6-alpha.1**: the release note "optional plugin startup failures no longer affect other available plugins" shrinks the blast radius 👍 — but as far as I can tell the two gaps below still stand. Happy to re-test on 0.1.6-alpha.1 and report back.

**Suggestions**

1. When surfacing an `AggregateError` from the loader, include a structured first-line summary: member count + one line per member (plugin id / loader entry, errno / syscall). Full stacks can stay in the logs.
2. On read failures typical of cloud-offloaded files (`EDEADLK` / `EIO`; on macOS dataless files show `st_blocks == 0` and carry CloudDocs xattrs), detect that state and say so: *"plugin file `<path>` appears to be cloud-offloaded — materialize it, or move plugin directories out of iCloud-synced paths (Desktop/Documents)"*.
3. A docs note warning against placing `~/.dsh` or plugin directories under iCloud-synced paths would have saved us a P0.

**Repro sketch**: put a plugin directory on an iCloud-synced path, let macOS evict it (`brctl evict <path>`), point a profile `link:` entry at it, boot `dsh web` → N × `EDEADLK` behind a single `AggregateError`.

---

**中文版**

- **环境**：macOS（Apple Silicon），`dsh web` 0.1.2-rc.1，`web` profile 约 20 个插件，launchd 托管实例。
- **现象**：插件目录两天前从 iCloud 同步的 `~/Desktop` 迁到 `~/dsh/plugins`。开机后端崩溃循环，UI 只报 `plugin tree failed to load … AggregateError` 和一个每次都变的 hash；launchd 日志里 AggregateError 有 **13 个成员**，底层全是 `errno: -11 (EDEADLK), syscall: read` —— 13 个插件文件处于 iCloud **dataless（内容已腾挪）**状态，插件导入期的读取全部撞墙。
- **排查痛苦点**：① 排查时全树扫描触发了文件物化，错误集体消失（薛定谔式故障）；② 报错只有 hash 指纹、不是插件名，同一问题三次重启像三个问题（后来另一起 slot id 冲突事故同样被 hash 掩盖）；③ UI 不展开成员错误，逐成员信息只在 launchd 日志里；④ 对 dataless 文件无检测、无指引。
- **0.1.6 现状**：「可选插件启动失败不影响其他可用插件」已收窄爆炸半径，但上述 ②③④ 仍未覆盖，乐意在 0.1.6-alpha.1 复测补充。
- **建议**：① AggregateError 首行给结构化摘要（成员数 + 每成员插件 id / errno）；② 对 `EDEADLK/EIO` + `st_blocks==0` 等 dataless 特征给出可执行提示（"文件被云端腾挪，请物化或把插件目录移出 iCloud 同步路径"）；③ 文档警告勿把 `~/.dsh` / 插件目录放在 iCloud 同步路径下。
- **复现要点**：插件目录放 iCloud 同步路径 → `brctl evict` 腾挪 → profile `link:` 指向 → `dsh web` 启动 → 单条 AggregateError 掩盖 N 个 EDEADLK。

discussions.title: [Idea] First-class subscription quota windows (5-hour / weekly / monthly) for Coding Plan providers
discussions.body:
**Context**

More and more DSH instances are pointed at **subscription plans** (GLM Coding Plan, Kimi, …) instead of pay-as-you-go API keys. These plans don't meter like API bills: they use **rolling windows** — 5-hour, weekly, monthly / billing period — with provider-specific semantics: unused quota doesn't carry over, plan changes reset the clock, and the API side still prices by model × pricing era × peak/off-peak.

DSH's usage accounting today is request- and session-scoped (token-meter, session stats). **The plan window exists nowhere in the product** — so users find out about limits only when a call dies with 429/403, and per #3338 / #5715 those failures aren't even classified clearly when they do.

**Proposal: treat quota windows as first-class**

1. **Quota model in provider config** — per provider: window kinds (5-hour rolling / weekly / monthly / billing period), limits, and reset semantics.
2. **Per-window aggregation + UI** — a badge and settings-dashboard progress bar per window; warnings at configurable thresholds (e.g. 80% / 95%).
3. **Pre-flight guard for long work** — before a multi-subagent turn or a long autonomous run, estimate cost against the remaining window budget, and optionally pause at a threshold instead of dying mid-turn.
4. **Adapter interface for provider data** — provider quota/balance APIs differ far too much for core to own them all, but core can own the **window semantics + UI**, and let plugins feed per-provider data into the same surface.

**Why core, not only plugins**: window aggregation needs request-time hooks (model routing, subagent fan-out) that plugins can only observe after the fact — and every budget/dashboard plugin would benefit from one shared notion of "the window I'm spending against".

**Reference implementation**

I maintain [dsh-usage](https://github.com/nanami-0713/dsh-usage) (npm: `@hsinsekai-nanami/dsh-usage`), which implements GLM/Kimi adapters with 5-hour/weekly/monthly progress badges, per-request pricing by model × pricing era × peak/off-peak, and session + global dashboards. Happy to contribute the window/adapter design if this direction interests the team.

Related: #5624 (expose per-session token/cost in a documented form — still unanswered), #1280 (simulating vendor subscription quotas), #3338, #5715.

---

**中文版**

- **背景**：越来越多 DSH 实例接的是**订阅制 Coding Plan**（GLM、Kimi 等）而非按量计费 API key。订阅额度按**滚动窗口**计量——5 小时/周/月/订阅周期，且各家语义不同：额度不结转、套餐变更重置时钟、API 侧还叠着模型×涨价时代×峰谷计价。
- **现状缺口**：DSH 的用量统计停留在请求/会话级，**订阅窗口在产品里不存在**——用户只有在被 429/403 打断时才知道额度见底，而这类报错的分类目前还是乱的（#3338 / #5715）。
- **提议**：① provider 配置里声明窗口种类/上限/重置语义；② 徽标 + 设置页看板按窗口展示进度，80%/95% 阈值告警；③ 长 task（多 subagent、长自主运行）启动前对照剩余额度做预检，可选项"到阈值即暂停"而不是中途暴毙；④ 核心拥有**窗口语义 + UI**，插件经适配器接口喂数据——各家 API 差异太大，不该由核心全包。
- **为什么该进核心**：窗口聚合需要请求时钩子（模型路由、subagent 扇出），插件只能事后观察；一个共享的"当前窗口"概念能让所有预算/看板类插件受益。
- **参考实现**：[dsh-usage](https://github.com/nanami-0713/dsh-usage)（npm `@hsinsekai-nanami/dsh-usage`）已实现 GLM/Kimi 适配器、5 小时/周/月进度条与逐请求计价，愿意贡献窗口/适配器设计。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-usage | Token usage & quota, unified: per-request cost badge, global billing dashboard, GLM/Kimi Coding Plan quota bars
discussions.body:
**English TL;DR**: one plugin that answers "how much am I spending right now / in total / what's left" — a live per-session cost badge priced per request (model × pricing era × peak/off-peak), a global billing dashboard built from session logs, and Coding Plan quota progress bars (5-hour / weekly / monthly) for GLM & Kimi. npm: `@hsinsekai-nanami/dsh-usage` · repo: <https://github.com/nanami-0713/dsh-usage>.

---

## dsh-usage：把「正在花多少、一共花了多少、还剩多少」装进一个插件

三个 UI 面，同一套计价内核 —— 是 `dsh-token-cost` / `dsh-usage-board` / `dsh-quota-visor` 三个插件的合并后继。

### ① 实时徽标（对话头部左侧）

当前会话累计 Token 与费用。按**每条请求实际使用的模型 × 涨价时代 × 峰谷时段**逐桶计价，不做"当前单价 × 累计 tokens"的粗估；悬停可看逐模型明细与上下文组成。

### ② 全局用量看板（设置页）

扫描 `~/.dsh/sessions` 全部会话日志，按官方刊例精确折算全局账单：1/7/30 天与全部时间筛选、各模型花费折线图、模型/文件夹维度明细，支持自定义单价与汇率。

### ③ 订阅额度徽标 + 看板「订阅额度」板块

GLM / Kimi Coding Plan 的 5 小时/周/月/订阅周期进度条，切换模型自动对齐 provider；设置页看板里当前 DSH 配置的全部 Coding Plan 一屏一览。

### 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hsinsekai-nanami/dsh-usage@1.0.1
dsh web
```

> 建议精确指定版本号而非 `@latest`：pnpm 11 会暂扣 24 小时内发布的新版本，`@latest` 可能解析到旧版。

### 设计上比较坚持的两点

- **计价口径**：模型单价经历过多次调价（"涨价时代"）且分峰谷时段，粗估会系统性失真——所以逐请求分桶。内置截至 2026-08 的官方公开刊例；未收录模型 tokens 照计、费用不计，绝不套用别家价格。
- **密钥边界**：API key 全程留在 host 侧（进程环境变量 → `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`），浏览器只经同源 API 取数。

### 从三个旧插件迁移

首次启动自动合并旧配置（旧文件改名保留、绝不删除），旧 API 路径（`/api/dsh-token-cost/*`、`/api/dsh-usage-board/*`、`/api/dsh-quota-visor/*`）作为别名继续工作；旧插件可直接卸载，回退只需把 `config.migrated.json` 改回 `config.json`。

- 仓库：<https://github.com/nanami-0713/dsh-usage>
- 配套 Ideas 帖：#6895（把订阅窗口额度做成一等公民）

欢迎反馈——尤其想知道下一批该优先适配哪家 provider 的窗口语义。

discussions.title: [BUG] Client bundle combo route `/plugins/??...` returns 404 when installed with a non-default `--prefix`
discussions.body:
## Summary

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh` is installed to a **non-default prefix** (e.g. `npm install -g --prefix /usr/local/dsh-v015`), the web GUI loads its HTML shell but the client bundle combo route returns 404, so the UI is broken (cannot create a new chat, cannot click into the chatbox).

## Environment

- dsh version: `0.1.5-rc.1` (CLI) / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona 0.1.5-rc.2`
- Node.js: `v24.20.0`
- npm: `11.19.0`
- OS: Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS

## Observed behavior

- `GET /` → 200 (full HTML with `__DSH_BOOT__` populated correctly)
- `GET /assets/index-*.js` → 200
- `GET /plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat/client.js,...&rev=...` → **404**

All `/plugins/??...` requests (the combined combo-route URL generated by `comboUrl()`) return 404.

For comparison, the same profile on `0.1.1-rc.2` uses single-format URLs (`/plugins/@deepseek-ai/<pkg>/client.js`) and those return 200.

## Root cause (traced in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js`)

- `comboUrl()` generates the combined `??` URL — this is by design ("shared combo route").
- `serveBundle` registers a `prefix` route at `/plugins` and delegates to `bundleResource(method, url)`.
- `bundleResource()` looks up `this.responses.get(resourceUrl)` and returns `{ status: 404 }` when the entry is absent.

The `responses` map is populated by the loader-entry scan (`processOne` → `reconcilePackage` → `initialBundleSnapshot`). With a **minimal profile bundle list** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) installed to a non-default prefix, the client bundles do not get scanned into the map, so every combo request 404s.

## Steps to reproduce

1. `npm install -g --prefix /usr/local/dsh-v015 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`
2. Create a minimal profile whose `dsh.profile.bundles` is `["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app"]`
3. Boot with a separate home: `DSH_HOME=/root/.dsh-v2 dsh web --port 3031`
4. Open the web GUI → HTML renders but chat is non-functional
5. `curl http://127.0.0.1:3031/plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat/client.js` → 404

## Question

Is the combo route expected to work with a minimal profile bundle list (`dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`), or does 0.1.5 require additional bundles in the profile so the client plugin registry scans them? If the latter, what is the correct minimal bundle list (and is it documented anywhere)?

## Context

This was discovered while doing a blue-green deployment of 0.1.5 next to a running 0.1.1 instance (separate `--prefix` + separate `DSH_HOME`). Happy to provide more logs/config if useful.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-word-vault | 多用户英语生词库：复制即弹窗点选录入、拍照识别标记词、带 IPA 音标的趣味记忆卡 + 考试闭环
discussions.body:
> ⚠️ **非官方社区项目 / Unofficial community project** — 独立社区维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。
> Independent, community-maintained, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## 简介

给家长和两个孩子用的**多用户英语生词库**。

复制一段英文 → 鼠标处弹出选择框，**中文意思已经填好** → 点一下就把词收进对应孩子的词库。
同一个词每被标记一次就累加计数，「反复遇到却还没记住」的词会自动浮到最前面。
之后可以打印**记忆卡**（每块都带真实 IPA 音标），或者做一次小测验——**连对 3 次自动标记「已学会」**。

## 功能

- **四种录入**：复制点选（秒弹窗、释义原地补上）、拍照识别荧光笔/红笔标记的印刷词、对话里贴一段英文、页面查缺补漏
- **带真实音标的记忆卡**：每块上排真实 IPA、下排中文谐音，字母组合有规律时加一行小字（如 `ght` → 「gh 不发音」），再配一句荒诞梗钉住拼写。段音标要过**机械校验**：各块音标拼起来必须等于整词音标，否则重试
- **故事锁**：一句梗首次定稿后**固定不变**——重新生成只刷新事实字段（音标/词性/释义/拆解块），绝不换梗（孩子记的是同一句话）
- **考试闭环**：本地网页答题（点选即判分、连对 3 次当场标记已学会、答错摘牌）+ 可打印试卷 PDF
- **词库界面**：按孩子切换、分组（已记住/没记住/高频易错）、搜索排序、就地改释义、删除前显示影响清单、对勾选的行出卡出卷
- **设置**：18 项分五组，与 DSH 原生设置页**同一份配置**（真读真写），另有一个注册到 `settings.section` 的原生设置面板
- 翻译/拆词/出题一律 **`reasoningEffort: "off"`**——这些都是照规则干活，关掉推理更快、更省、更稳

## 截图

| 词库总览 | 记忆卡（每块带 IPA） |
| --- | --- |
| ![library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault/main/assets/screenshots/01-library.png) | ![cards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault/main/assets/screenshots/02-cards.png) |
| **在线答题** | **原生设置面板** |
| ![exam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault/main/assets/screenshots/03-exam.png) | ![settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault/main/assets/screenshots/04-settings.png) |

## 在 DSH 里使用

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-word-vault
# 重启 dsh web 后：
#   http://127.0.0.1:3080/word-vault        词库界面
#   http://127.0.0.1:3080/word-vault/help   使用说明
```

- **宿主半边**：13 个工具（录入/查询/出卡/出卷/照片扫描…）、node:sqlite 存储、Web 路由、常驻剪贴板助手
- **客户端半边**：手写的 loader 产物（无构建步骤），注册一个 `settings.section` 设置面板
- **数据**：单个 SQLite 文件，不在插件仓库里；卸载插件不会动你的词

## 说明（如实写）

- 常驻助手是 PowerShell + WinForms 小进程，**目前仅 Windows**
- 拍照只识别**荧光笔/红笔标记的印刷体单词**，手写内容按设计忽略
- 卡片音标与题目干扰项由模型生成，但都过了机械闸门（音标必须能拼回整词；选项不足 4 个的题直接判废），**打印给学生之前仍建议人眼看一遍**

**欢迎反馈与建议** —— 用起来哪里别扭、哪里不准，回帖或开 issue 都行，我会跟。

---

## Intro (EN)

A **multi-user English vocabulary vault** for DSH, built for a parent and two kids.

Copy any English text → a picker pops up at the cursor with the Chinese meaning **already filled in** →
one click files the word into that kid's library. Every time a word is marked, its count goes up,
and the ones you keep meeting but keep forgetting rise to the top. From there you print a
**memory card** (every chunk carries its real IPA) or take a quick quiz where **three correct
answers in a row mark the word as learned**.

## Features (EN)

- **4 ways to capture**: clipboard picker (dialog appears instantly, meanings stream in), photo scan of
  highlighter / red-pen marked printed words, pasting text in chat, or searching the library.
- **Cards with real IPA**: chunk-level IPA on top, Chinese sound-alike below, plus a phonics note when the
  letter group has a rule (`ght` → "gh is silent"), and one absurd line to pin the spelling. A gate checks
  that the chunk IPAs concatenate back into the whole-word IPA.
- **Story lock**: the one-liner is frozen after first generation — regenerating refreshes facts only,
  never rewrites the joke.
- **Exam loop**: interactive local quiz (instant grading, 3-in-a-row = learned, a wrong answer un-marks it)
  plus a printable paper PDF.
- **Library UI**: per-child switcher, groups (learned / not learned / high-frequency), search, inline
  meaning editing, delete-with-impact-preview, and card/exam actions for checked rows.
- All LLM calls run with **`reasoningEffort: "off"`** — faster, cheaper and far more reliable for these
  rule-following jobs.

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-word-vault
- Tests: 137 node + 17 helper end-to-end + 14 visual, all green.

discussions.title: [Bug] bwrap `workspace-write` fails when `/tmp` is an absolute symlink: `Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/tmp`
discussions.body:
# bwrap `workspace-write` fails when `/tmp` is an absolute symlink: `Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/tmp`

## Summary

On Linux hosts where `/tmp` is an **absolute symlink** (e.g. `/tmp -> /media/disk/tmp`, the usual way to relocate temp onto a bigger volume), every `workspace-write` command fails:

```
bwrap: Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/tmp: No such file or directory
```

The bwrap profile mounts an ephemeral tmpfs at the literal path `/tmp`, and bwrap cannot mount at a destination that is an absolute symlink. **Relative** symlinks are followed normally and are unaffected — I isolated the difference below.

The `read-only` functional probe contains no `/tmp` mount, so it **passes**; bwrap is selected and the verdict is cached, so the failure only surfaces at execution time. Since `bwrap: ` is a registered fatal runner signature, the command fails closed instead of falling back to the Landlock rung. Root cause is upstream ([containers/bubblewrap#275](https://github.com/containers/bubblewrap/issues/275), "Mounting tmpfs on top of a symlink fails", still open). Fix: canonicalize the mount target.

## Environment

- CentOS Linux 8, kernel 4.18.0-348.7.1.el8_5, Node v22.23.2
- `bubblewrap 0.4.0`
- dsh `master` @ `0d1f50007f` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` 0.1.6-alpha.1)
- `/tmp` relocated to another filesystem:

```
$ ls -ld /tmp
lrwxrwxrwx. 1 nobody nobody 20 May 30  2024 /tmp -> /media/nvme1n1p1/tmp
```

## Reproduction (bwrap alone — no dsh needed)

Exactly the argv the profile produces:

```
$ bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --unshare-pid --proc /proc --die-with-parent --tmpfs /tmp true
bwrap: Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/tmp: No such file or directory
$ echo $?
1

$ bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --unshare-pid --proc /proc --die-with-parent \
    --tmpfs /media/nvme1n1p1/tmp true
$ echo $?
0
```

The only difference is whether the destination is spelled through the symlink.

### The trigger is the *kind* of symlink, not the mount type

Same target directory, same command, only the destination's spelling differs:

| destination                 | `--tmpfs`  | `--bind`   |
| --------------------------- | ---------- | ---------- |
| real directory              | exit 0     | exit 0     |
| **absolute** symlink → it   | **exit 1** | **exit 1** |
| relative symlink → it       | exit 0     | exit 0     |

```
$ bwrap ... --tmpfs <dir>/abs-link <cmd>
bwrap: Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/<dir>/abs-link: No such file or directory
$ bwrap ... --bind <dir>/real <dir>/abs-link <cmd>
bwrap: Can't bind mount /oldroot/<dir>/real on /newroot/<dir>/abs-link: No such file or directory
```

This also explains why the host's other symlinks are harmless: `/bin -> usr/bin`, `/var/run -> ../run`, `/var/lock -> ../run/lock` are *relative*, so `--tmpfs`/`--bind` on them succeed (bwrap follows the link and mounts at the target). `/tmp` here is *absolute*, so it is the one that breaks.

## User-visible symptom

Because the probe passes, the failure surfaces at execution time as a fail-closed runner failure rather than as the command's own failure:

```
Error: sandbox mode "workspace-write" is requested but no sandbox backend is usable on
this host; refusing to run the command unconfined. Install bubblewrap or run a
Landlock-enforcing kernel (Linux), ensure sandbox-exec is usable (macOS), or ensure the
ACL restricted-token runner can start (Windows) — otherwise switch the consumer to
danger-full-access. Runner failure: bwrap: Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/tmp: No such file or directory
```

The advice is misleading for this failure mode: bwrap *is* installed, its probe passes, and the Landlock rung is available. Distinguishing "the runner refused its profile" from "no sandbox backend is usable" may be worth a separate diagnosability improvement.

## Root cause

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/profiles.ts:19` (at `0d1f50007f`):

```ts
args.push('--tmpfs', '/tmp')
```

`/tmp` is a literal here, while elsewhere in the sandbox seam writable roots are canonicalized first: `confine()` already canonicalizes the workspace root through `canonicalPath()` (`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts:319`; `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/roots.ts:30`, which uses `realpathSync.native` and falls back to the spelling as-is). The hardcoded `/tmp` is the one mount destination that never goes through that canonicalization.

## Why this is not recovered automatically

1. The bwrap probe runs the **read-only** profile, which has no `--tmpfs` (`index.ts:69`), so it succeeds on an affected host:

```
$ bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --unshare-pid --proc /proc --die-with-parent -- true
$ echo $?
0
```

2. The chain verdict is computed once and cached (`index.ts:496`), so bwrap stays selected for the provider's lifetime; the Landlock rung is never re-considered.
3. `bwrap: ` is registered as a fatal runner signature (`index.ts:232`), and the consumer turns a match into `SandboxUnavailableError(mode, runnerFailure.detail)` (`packages/shell/bash-sandbox/src/index.ts:121`), i.e. the mode fails closed.

## `--bind /tmp /tmp` (as proposed in #3174) hits the same wall

#3174 proposes changing `--tmpfs /tmp` to `--bind /tmp /tmp` (aligning with Codex's bwrap profile) so bash and the fs tools share one `/tmp`. On a host whose `/tmp` is an absolute symlink that fails identically (verified, exit 1), and combining both does not help, because the bind destination is still the symlinked spelling:

```
$ bwrap ... --tmpfs /media/nvme1n1p1/tmp --bind /tmp /tmp true
bwrap: Can't bind mount /oldroot/media/nvme1n1p1/tmp on /newroot/tmp: No such file or directory
```

So whichever way #3174 lands, the mount destination needs canonicalization too.

## Suggested fix

Reuse the existing canonicalization helper, so "the path the kernel actually resolves" keeps a single authority:

```diff
--- a/packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/profiles.ts
+++ b/packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/profiles.ts
@@
-import { writableRoots } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox'
+import { canonicalPath, writableRoots } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox'
 import type { SandboxPolicy } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox'
 
+/** The temp path the bwrap workspace-write profile replaces with a fresh tmpfs. */
+const TMP_PATH = '/tmp'
+
+/**
+ * bwrap cannot mount at a destination that is an ABSOLUTE symlink (`--tmpfs
+ * /tmp` fails with "Can't mount tmpfs on /newroot/tmp" when /tmp is relocated
+ * to another volume; containers/bubblewrap#275). Relative symlinks are followed
+ * normally, so only this case needs resolving. Mounting the canonical target
+ * keeps /tmp writable through the symlink with unchanged ephemeral semantics.
+ */
+function tmpfsMountTarget(): string {
+  return canonicalPath(TMP_PATH)
+}
+
 export function bwrapProfileArgs(policy: SandboxPolicy): string[] {
   const args = ['--ro-bind', '/', '/', '--dev', '/dev', '--unshare-pid', '--proc', '/proc', '--die-with-parent']
   if (policy.mode === 'workspace-write') {
-    args.push('--tmpfs', '/tmp')
+    args.push('--tmpfs', tmpfsMountTarget())
     args.push('--bind', policy.workspaceRoot, policy.workspaceRoot)
   }
   return args
 }
```

A local `realpathSync('/tmp')` with a `catch` fallback to `/tmp` behaves the same. Using `canonicalPath` just avoids a second canonicalization implementation, and keeps the change coverage-neutral: its fallback statement is already exercised by `packages/sandbox/sandbox/tests/roots.spec.ts`, whereas an inline `catch` here adds a statement no unit test can execute (the repo gates `packages/*/*/src` at per-file 100% statements/lines).

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/tests/local.spec.ts` needs its expectation updated to the resolved path:

```diff
-      '--tmpfs', '/tmp', '--bind', '/ws', '/ws',
+      '--tmpfs', canonicalPath('/tmp'), '--bind', '/ws', '/ws',
```

### Verification

With the change, `bwrapProfileArgs({ mode: 'workspace-write', workspaceRoot: '/ws' })` yields the resolved tmpfs target, the reproduction command above exits 0, and a write to `/tmp` inside the confined command is readable there while leaving no file at the host target — so the ephemeral `/tmp` semantics are unchanged. I have also been running a local variant of this patch in my own build, and it restores `workspace-write` end-to-end; without it every `workspace-write` shell command fails with the error quoted above.

## Impact scope

Any Linux host where `/tmp` is an **absolute** symlink. A `/tmp` that is a real directory, or a *relative* symlink, is unaffected today.

## Workaround (no code change)

- Make `/tmp` a real directory (bind-mount a real directory over the mount point instead of symlinking it), or
- keep bwrap out of the dsh process's `PATH` so the probe fails and the chain falls through to the Landlock rung (Linux's second rung; enforcement may be `full` or per-ABI `partial`) — this trades away bwrap's ephemeral `/tmp` semantics.
- `runnerCommand` does **not** help: it appends the same `bwrapProfileArgs` (`index.ts:322`).

## Prior reports

I searched existing discussions before posting (`"Can't mount tmpfs"`, `/newroot`, `tmpfs`, `mount tmpfs on`, 软链接/符号链接, `realpath tmp`, …) and found no duplicate of this root cause. The nearest threads are #3174 (same code line, different symptom — bash vs fs tool `/tmp` visibility), #1769 and #5359 (quote the same profile args, different topics), and #6018 (Windows/pwsh temp-dir `realpath` failure, different cause).

discussions.title: [Bug] Desktop dev launcher treats native pnpm executable as JavaScript
discussions.body:
## Summary

`pnpm run dev:desktop` fails before the desktop build when pnpm is installed as the native `@pnpm/exe` executable. The desktop development launcher reads `npm_execpath` and unconditionally passes that path to Node, although `npm_execpath` may name a native executable rather than a JavaScript entry point.

This prevents contributors who use the native pnpm distribution, including installations managed through Aqua or mise, from running the documented desktop development command.

## Reproduction

1. On macOS arm64, use Node 24.21.0 and pnpm 11.7.0 installed through the native `@pnpm/exe` distribution.
2. Check out `master` at `0d1f50007f`.
3. Install the complete workspace:

   ```sh
   pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
   ```

4. Start the desktop development application:

   ```sh
   pnpm run dev:desktop
   ```

## Current behavior

`apps/desktop/scripts/dev.ts` reads `process.env.npm_execpath` and invokes it through `process.execPath`:

```ts
const packageManager = process.env.npm_execpath
await run(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], cwd)
```

With native pnpm, `npm_execpath` points to a Mach-O executable under `@pnpm/exe`. The resulting command is equivalent to `node /path/to/native/pnpm run build`, so Node attempts to parse the executable as JavaScript and exits before Electron starts:

```text
$ tsx scripts/dev.ts
file:///.../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm:1
����
X
SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token
    at compileSourceTextModule (node:internal/modules/esm/utils:319:16)
    at ModuleLoader.moduleStrategy (node:internal/modules/esm/translators:89:18)
Node.js v24.21.0
desktop development: .../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm run build exited with 1
```

The platform warnings for non-arm64 workspace packages are unrelated; execution continues past them and fails only when the launcher starts the nested build.

Using the workspace's JavaScript pnpm entry instead allows the same desktop build and Electron launch to complete.

## Expected behavior

`pnpm run dev:desktop` should build and launch the desktop application regardless of whether the invoking pnpm entry is JavaScript, a shim, or a native executable.

The launcher should treat `npm_execpath` as an executable entry or explicitly resolve a known JavaScript pnpm entry. It should not unconditionally pass an arbitrary package-manager executable to `process.execPath`.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `master` at `0d1f50007f` (`0.1.6-alpha.1`)
- macOS arm64
- Node.js 24.21.0
- pnpm 11.7.0 from native `@pnpm/exe` (Mach-O arm64)

## Prior reports

I searched upstream Issues, pull requests, and Discussions for `npm_execpath`, `@pnpm/exe`, `dev:desktop`, `runPackageScript`, the reported syntax error, and native pnpm desktop-launch failures, and found no matching report or fix.

discussions.title: Remote Web UI 中 present 文件生成了不可用的 loopback 下载链接
discussions.body:
### 环境

- DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.1.5-rc.1
- 通过远程 Web UI 访问 DSH workspace

### 问题描述

Agent 可以在 workspace 中成功创建文件，并通过 present 在 Web UI 中展示文件卡片。但当远程 Host 桌面不可用时，Agent 会在最终回复中自行生成如下下载链接：

```
http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/file?path=<abs file path>
```

这个地址是 DSH 容器内部的 loopback 地址。对于通过远程 Web UI 访问的用户，浏览器访问 127.0.0.1 时指向的是用户自己的机器，而不是 DSH 容器，因此文件无法下载。

### 复现步骤

- 通过远程 Web UI 进入 DSH workspace；
- 在 workspace 中创建一个 ZIP 或其他文件；
- 调用 present 展示该文件；
- 在远程 Web UI 中点击 Agent 返回的下载链接；
- 浏览器访问给出的链接，会下载失败，因为该地址不是当前用户可访问的 DSH Web origin。

### 预期行为和当前临时方案

预期情况下，`present` 的文件应由 Web UI 通过当前公开 origin 提供下载，Agent 不应自行生成指向 DSH 内部 loopback 地址的链接。

目前暂时的方案是进入机器进行文件下载。

但长期来看应该有更好的方式：Web UI 所在机器与 workspace 所在机器并不保证相同。对于 Agent 回传给用户下载的文件，可以考虑专门准备交付文件隔离区，并提供独立的受鉴权的下载 API。

discussions.title: 功能请求：已归档会话支持单条删除与批量一键删除
discussions.body:
## Motivation（动机）

当前 Web UI 的会话归档是"单向隐藏"，归档集没有任何清理手段，只能无限累积：

- 归档操作是非破坏性的（会话日志与 workspace 记账槽都保留），这个设计本身合理，作为"软删除缓冲"很合适；
- 但「已归档会话」设置页（`packages/client/ui-settings-unarchive-sessions`）每行只有「取消归档」一个操作，**没有删除入口**，也不支持多选/批量；
- `workspace-controller` 仅暴露 `archiveSession` / `unarchiveSession` 两个 Remote，整个仓库（UI 与宿主层）都不存在 `deleteSession` 类接口；「删除工作区」也明确保留会话日志；
- 结果：想把不再需要的会话彻底清理，只能手动删除磁盘上的持久化文件，对普通用户不可用，归档页会越来越长。

## Behavior（期望行为）

1. **单条删除**：「已归档会话」设置页每行增加「删除」操作（带确认弹窗），删除该会话的持久化日志与 workspace 记账条目，并同步从全局归档集中移除该条目。
2. **批量一键删除**：设置页支持多选（如「全选」+「删除所选」），或提供「清空归档」一键操作；宿主侧需新增批量接口（例如 `deleteSessions(sessionIds: SessionId[])`），返回清理结果以便 UI 回显。
3. **安全性建议**：仅允许在「已归档会话」页删除——归档本身充当回收站缓冲，误归档仍可通过「取消归档」找回，删除作为第二道需要二次确认的破坏性操作。

## 环境信息（分析依据）

基于仓库 HEAD `0d1f500`（v0.1.6-alpha.1，2026-09-15）的源码核查，相关文件：

- `packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/rows/Rows.tsx` — 会话菜单仅 Rename / Fork / Archive
- `packages/client/ui-settings-unarchive-sessions/src/client/ArchivedSessionsSection.tsx` — 归档页仅逐条 Unarchive
- `packages/api/workspace-controller/src/commands.ts` — 现有 Remote 定义（无删除、无批量）
- `packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts` — 归档集为 registry-global `archivedSessionIds`，归档不触碰日志与记账

discussions.title: Bug 报告：Web 界面滚动持续卡顿——侧边栏终端 openWhenSized 每帧强制布局轮询、窗口被遮挡时帧率骤降约 180 倍（每帧强制同步布局 + 遮挡帧产抑制）
discussions.body:
## 一句话问题
侧边栏终端插件的 `openWhenSized` 在终端面板隐藏后**每帧轮询宿主尺寸（每帧强制同步布局）**，永不退出；叠加"窗口被遮挡时 Chromium 抑制帧产"（同一窗口前台 179.9 fps → 被遮挡 0–26 fps），导致 Web 界面滚动持续卡顿：实测空闲 p99 67.5 ms、最坏 137.2 ms，被遮挡时低至 0.78 fps。

## 复现步骤
1. 启动 `dsh web`，浏览器打开界面
2. 展开侧边栏底部面板，打开一个**终端**标签
3. 关闭 / 隐藏该面板（面板获得 `.paneTabHidden`）
4. 打开「设置」并滚动列表

终端标签**只要挂载过一次**即可，不需要它保持可见。

## 实际结果
- 设置弹窗滚动：画面成段冻结 0.2–1.25 秒后突然跳变；会话消息区滚动同样掉帧
- **与是否滚动无关**：窗口空闲时也卡。会话视图空闲实测 p99 **67.5 ms**、最坏 **137.2 ms**（180 Hz 屏满帧为 5.6 ms）
- 隐藏终端面板后，宿主仍留在 DOM：`nArs4W_terminalWrap / nArs4W_terminal` 均为 `w=0 h=0 isConnected=true`
- 主线程最热函数定位（25 秒手动滚动 CPU profile）：

```
  890 ms  step                    @ sidebar/bundle/terminal.js:8270   ← 比其它任何函数热一个数量级
   94 ms  (garbage collector)
   27 ms  onScroll                @ ui-conversation/client.js:308248
   27 ms  $n                      @ assets/index-BKQ_L1z6.js:53
同一 profile 中 (program)（内核态）= 8670 ms / 25 s，与反复强制同步布局一致
```

- 另一个独立现象：窗口被其它窗口完全覆盖时，`document.visibilityState` 变为 `hidden`，帧产塌缩。同一窗口同一页面受控 A/B：

| 前台窗口 | `visibilityState` | fps | p50 | p99 | worst |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 另一个浏览器窗口 | **hidden** | 0 – 26.2 | 11.0 | 1600.8 | 1600.8 |
| DSH 窗口 | **visible** | **179.93** | 5.6 | 6.7 | 11.4 |

- 系统无资源瓶颈：显存 1.2 / 8.2 GB、内存 11.4 / 15.8 GB、CPU 0.9%、GPU 15–31%、53 °C、已插电，`gpu_compositing: enabled`

## 预期结果
- 终端面板隐藏后不应有任何每帧轮询与强制布局，界面空闲应维持满帧（帧间隔 ≈5.6 ms）
- 纯 UI 滚动不应出现 25 ms 以上的帧
- 窗口被遮挡导致的帧率变化不应使界面看起来像假死

## 环境
- DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`（npx 发行包），前端 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend@0.1.5-rc.2`
- Microsoft Edge 131.0.2903.70，Windows 11
- 2560×1440 @ 180 Hz，`devicePixelRatio` 1.25，窗口 1440×900
- NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop，ANGLE/D3D11
- 已装插件：`dsh-better-sidebar@0.19.0`、`dsh-image-gen`、`dshmarket`、`@linxin666/dsh-web-all`（含 `dsh-pet`）
- 数据规模：43 个会话，最大会话投影缓存约 96 MB

## 根因分析（代码定位）

### 成因一：`dsh-better-sidebar` 终端面板的每帧强制布局轮询
`dsh-better-sidebar/src/client/open-when-sized.ts`（打包产物 `lib/client-terminal.js`）：

```ts
export function openWhenSized(
  host: HTMLElement,
  open: () => void,
  raf: (cb: FrameRequestCallback) => number = requestAnimationFrame,
  caf: (id: number) => void = cancelAnimationFrame,
): () => void {
  let frame: number | null = null
  const step = (): void => {
    frame = null
    if (!host.isConnected) return                 // 只有"卸载"才会停止该循环
    if (host.clientWidth > 0 && host.clientHeight > 0) { open(); return }
    frame = raf(step)                             // 已挂载但被隐藏 ⇒ 永远重新挂帧
  }
  frame = raf(step)
  return () => { if (frame !== null) { caf(frame); frame = null } }
}
```

**终止条件覆盖了「卸载」(`isConnected`)，未覆盖「已挂载但被隐藏」**。而 `clientWidth` / `clientHeight` 是会触发布局的读取，因此每次迭代都强制一次同步样式/布局刷新。函数注释本身已预见到该触发条件（*"any `display:none`-hidden ancestor does the same"*），但循环并未处理。

调用点：`lib/client-terminal.js:9559`（终端挂载时 `openWhenSized(host, () => { term.open(host); fit.fit(); sendResize() })`）。

### 成因二：窗口遮挡导致帧产抑制
`packages/client/connection/src/browser-auth.ts` 的 index 授权路径（`authorizeIndex`）在存在 `?token=` 时会对根请求返回 303 并 `Set-Cookie`，因此**浏览器可能以「带 token 跳转」的形式重新加载根页面**。在窗口被覆盖期间发生该重载，页面会话会被重新初始化，此时可见性为 `hidden`，帧产被抑制，表现为长时间无响应。

> 说明：本条的**机制为推断**。实测到的是 `visibilityState` 与帧产的强相关（A/B 差约 180 倍）以及开关 `CalculateNativeWinOcclusion` 的效果；Chromium 具体的遮挡/可见性判定路径未做追踪。

### 上游状态（本次已确认）
- npm 最新版 `dsh-better-sidebar@0.19.1`（2026-09-11）的 `src/client/open-when-sized.ts` 与 0.19.0 **逐字节相同**，打包产物中仍有两处 `raf(step)`
- 0.19.1 发布说明为「适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 · 文件与 Tab 图标彩色 · CI 三类失败修复」，无性能相关改动
- **因此升级插件不能修复该问题**

## 建议修复
1. `openWhenSized` 改为由 `ResizeObserver` 驱动 —— 覆盖原轮询的全部触发场景（`display:none` → 可见的切换同样会派发 entry），且仅在尺寸真正变化时回调，隐藏期间不再运行。保留一个低频兜底检查：

```ts
export function openWhenSized(
  host: HTMLElement,
  open: () => void,
  _raf?: (cb: FrameRequestCallback) => number,
  _caf?: (id: number) => void,
): () => void {
  let done = false
  let interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
  let observer: ResizeObserver | null = null

  const teardown = (): void => {
    if (interval !== null) { clearInterval(interval); interval = null }
    if (observer !== null) { observer.disconnect(); observer = null }
  }
  const finish = (): void => {
    if (done) return
    done = true
    teardown()
    open()
  }
  const check = (): void => {
    if (done) return
    if (!host.isConnected) { done = true; teardown(); return }
    if (host.clientWidth > 0 && host.clientHeight > 0) finish()
  }

  if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
    observer = new ResizeObserver(check)
    observer.observe(host)
  }
  interval = setInterval(check, 250)
  check()

  return () => { done = true; teardown() }
}
```

  若需保留可注入 `raf` 的确定性测试契约，等效替代是保留 `raf`，但在**帧数上限**用尽后、或宿主 `offsetParent === null` 时退出。

2. 关闭的底部面板建议直接从 DOM 卸载，或至少在 `display:none` 期间不保留零尺寸终端宿主。

3. 针对成因二，可考虑：`dsh web` 打开的根 URL 在完成 cookie 交换后，避免在窗口不可见时触发根页面重载；或对遮挡导致的帧率骤降做容错提示（本次实测差约 180 倍，用户极易误判为应用假死）。

## 验收条件
- 打开过终端标签后隐藏面板，界面空闲帧间隔 p99 < 10 ms、>50 ms 帧数为 0（当前 67.5–137.2 ms / 15 帧每 6 秒）
- `client-terminal.js` 不再出现在 CPU profile 热函数列表中
- 设置弹窗与会话区滚动不出现 >25 ms 的帧

discussions.title: Markdown 渲染器误把单波浪号 ~内容~ 解析为删除线（singleTilde 默认开启）
discussions.body:
## 问题

会话消息中的 Markdown 渲染器把 `~内容~`（单波浪号对）解析为 `<del>`。两个相邻片段如 `~100~ ~200~` 会稳定渲染成删除线。GitHub.com 的 GFM 只认 `~~内容~~`，同样的文本在 GitHub 上显示正常。

**复现环境**：DSH Desktop 2.0.9 与 dsh web 0.1.5-rc.1 均可复现。

## 复现步骤

1. 在会话中发送 `区间 ~100~ 到 ~200~ 之间`
2. 观察渲染结果：文本被加上删除线

## 根因

`packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/parse.ts` 的两条 mdast 管线以 `gfm()` 无参构造 micromark GFM 扩展，继承了库默认值 `singleTilde: true`：

```ts
extensions: [gfm(), cjkFriendlyStrong()],
```

## 建议修复

两条管线都传入 `gfm({ singleTilde: false })`。我们已在 fork 中实现并验证：

- 分支：https://github.com/GUODnuli/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/markdown-single-tilde
- 改动：`parse.ts` 两处 `gfm()` → `gfm({ singleTilde: false })`，含回归测试（33/33 通过）与 Agent Note（双语）

上游仓库关闭了 Issue/PR 通道，因此通过 Discussion 提交，供团队参考采纳。

discussions.title: 编译desktop版本时，存在fx-ext阻拦编译
Fork 会继承父会话排队未发送的消息，顶替用户在子会话发送的新消息
discussions.body:
复现步骤

在一个会话中等待 agent 完成一轮（出现 turn/end）；
立刻再发一条消息（此时进入 next-turn 排队队列，未被认领）；
立即对这条消息所在回合点 fork；
在 fork 出的子会话中发送一条新消息。
实际表现：子会话第一轮回复的是第 2 步那条继承来的旧排队消息；用户第 4 步发送的新消息被插到队列末尾（agent/inbox/spliced
 为 start:1），要等旧消息处理完才轮到，甚至一直不被处理。

根因

dsh-api-session-controller.fork() 中：cut 从 turn/end.seq + 1
 推进到下一个 turn/start
 为止，把回合间隙内的 agent/inbox/spliced
（未认领的排队消息）一并切进了 seed: source.events.slice(0, cut)；
子会话 Agent 的 inbox 由日志中的 splice 事件重放重建，因此继承了一条 pending 消息；
用户新消息经 agent.followup() 插到队列末尾（index 1），而 inbox.claim("next-turn") 只取 index 0，于是旧消息被当作"用户刚发的消息"写入子会话日志（user/message
 携带父会话的旧 rpcId）并被回复。
期望行为：fork 只继承已完成回合；子会话不应包含父会话 pending 的排队消息（建议：cut 时排除未认领的 agent/inbox/spliced
 事件，或子会话初始化时清空重建出的 inbox 队列）。

discussions.title: [Bug] Pi-AI adapter (`dsh-llm-pi-ai`) duplicates tool result text as `role: "user"` messages, causing model hallucination
discussions.body:
在AI多次调用工具后，会错误地把工具返回结果当成用户发言，从而引发幻觉擅自行动下去。经过我和AI的排查，定位bug如下：
---
## Summary

The Pi-AI LLM adapter (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`) incorrectly duplicates tool result text as `role: "user"` messages when serializing conversation history for the model request. This causes the model to occasionally misinterpret tool output as user speech, leading to hallucination.

## Environment

- DSH version: `0.1.5-rc.1` (via npx)
- Provider: `tokendance` (Pi-AI protocol)
- Session preset: both `standard` and `ptc` (PTC mode)
- Platform: Windows 10

## Root Cause

The bug is in two functions in `lib/index.js` of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`:

### 1. `flattenText` (line 1129) recursively extracts text from `tool-result` blocks:

```javascript
function flattenText(message) {
    return blocks.map((block) => 
        block.type === "text" ? block.text : 
        block.type === "tool-result" ? toolResultText(block.content) : ""
    ).join("");
}
```

This is different from the DeepSeek adapter's `flattenText`, which only extracts from `type: "text"` blocks.

### 2. `textOnlyContext` (line 1249) uses `flattenText` on every message:

```javascript
const text = flattenText(message);            // ← extracts text from tool-result blocks
const results = message.content.filter((block) => block.type === "tool-result");

if (text.length > 0 || results.length === 0)  // ← always true for tool results
    messages.push({
        role: "user",                          // ← tool result text pushed as user message!
        content: text,
        timestamp: 0
    });

for (const result of results)
    messages.push({
        role: "toolResult",                    // ← also pushed correctly as tool result
        toolCallId: result.toolCallId,
        ...
    });
```

### For comparison, `toPiContextWithImages` (line 1316) does NOT have this bug:

```javascript
const content = await userContent(message.content.filter((block) => block.type !== "tool-result"), ...);
//                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
//                                 Filters out tool-result before processing user content
```

## Impact

- **Every text-only tool result** generates a duplicate `{role: "user", content: "tool output text"}` message
- The model sees the tool output text as if the user said it
- Most of the time this noise is harmless, but **when the tool output text happens to align suggestively with other context**, the model can form a false inference chain and hallucinate
- Two confirmed hallucination events in the reporter's usage over several sessions

## Symptoms

The model generates reasoning like:
- "The user said the DSH would still crash after the fix" (when the actual tool result was `send_meme` output containing "修复 搞定")
- "The user wants to install skill-hub" (when the actual tool result was `memory_log` output containing "pnpm升级完成")

In both cases, the tool result text was duplicated as a `role: "user"` message, and the model interpreted it as a new user instruction.

## Fix

In `textOnlyContext` (around line 1249), filter out `tool-result` blocks before computing user content text, matching the behavior of `toPiContextWithImages`:

```javascript
// Fix for textOnlyContext:
// BEFORE:
const text = flattenText(message);

// AFTER:
const text = flattenText(message.content.filter((block) => block.type !== "tool-result"));
```

Or alternatively, exclude `tool-result` block text in `flattenText` for user messages:

```javascript
function flattenText(blocks) {
    return blocks
        .filter((block) => block.type === "text")  // ← only extract from text blocks
        .map((block) => block.text).join("");
}
```

(Bringing it in line with the DeepSeek adapter's `flattenText` implementation.)

## Related code locations

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js`
  - `flattenText()` ~ line 1129
  - `toolResultText()` ~ line 1133
  - `textOnlyContext()` ~ line 1235 (bug at line 1249-1268)
  - `toPiContextWithImages()` ~ line 1281 (no bug, correct implementation)

## Additional note

PTC mode (`run_code` based tool orchestration) produces nested `tool/ptc-dispatch` events alongside the standard `tool/result`. These `tool/ptc-dispatch` events appear to have a different structure (no `role: "user"` wrapper) and may not go through the same `textOnlyContext` path — this should be verified.

## References

- Session logs showing tool/result → user-message duplication pattern
- Reflection entry: "幻觉根因定位" in project memory
- Discussion: `tool/result` events are stored with `role: "user"` + `source: {kind: "tool"}` in session logs, and `createToolResultMessage` in `dsh-llm` calls `createUserMessage` with `source.kind = "tool"`. The adapter is responsible for correctly converting this to `role: "tool"` (or `role: "toolResult"` for Pi-AI) — but `textOnlyContext` fails to exclude the extracted text.

discussions.title: 【Bug】--patch 被用户设置层静默覆盖（silently overridden by user settings layer），--dump-config 报告失真
discussions.body:
## 中文

### 环境

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1`（`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` 安装）
- macOS，Node v24.18.1

### 期望与实际行为

`--help` 把 `--patch` 描述为 "extra patch-list overlay applied **after** the profile layer"，字面理解应当"覆盖 profile 层"。我期望 `--patch` 里对 `agent-default-model` 的覆盖能决定 headless 运行实际使用的模型。

实际发生的是：一旦用户层（`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`，由 UI 里选择默认模型 / `saveSelection` 写入）存在 `agent-default-model` 段，**用户层会在运行时静默胜出**，`--patch` 的值被降级为兜底默认值。全程没有任何警告，`--json` 事件流里也没有任何字段能暴露实际生效的模型。

### 最小复现

```bash
# 1. 用户层：在 dsh UI 里任选一个默认模型，或写入 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml：
#    agent-default-model:
#      provider: kimi-coding
#      model: k3-256k

# 2. 一个请求不同模型的 patch 覆盖层
cat > /tmp/model.patch.yml <<'EOF'
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-flash
EOF

# 3. 查看组合后的配置
dsh --patch /tmp/model.patch.yml --profile headless --dump-config
# → 显示: agent-default-model: provider deepseek-official, model deepseek-flash

# 4. 跑一次 headless 任务
echo "reply with the single word: ok" | dsh --patch /tmp/model.patch.yml --profile headless --json -

# 5. 核对实际服务的模型——看 ~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v3.jsonl.zstd 里的会话记录：
# → "provider":"kimi-coding","model":"k3-256k"
# （注入的系统提示词里也能看到："powered by the k3-256k model"）
```

同样的 CLI 调用，仅仅因为看不见的 global 状态（`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`）就服务了不同的模型。

### 根因（来自打包后的插件源码）

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model/lib/index.js` 把组合树里的配置项作为*兜底默认值*安装，然后让 settings provider 的用户层在运行时实时替换它：

```js
const entry = { provider: config.provider, model: config.model }; // 组合树的值（--patch 落在这里）
this.source = () => entry;
ctx.inject(["settings"], (settingsCtx) => {
  settingsCtx.settings.installSection(ctx, "agent-default-model", SCHEMA, entry, {
    setSource: (current) => { this.source = current; }, // 用户层替换 source
  });
});
// 注释原文: "when one is mounted, its user layer is read live"
```

所以优先级是刻意设计的：**用户层 > `--patch` > profile bundles**。我理解"用户显式选择优先"对交互式使用是合理的 UX——问题在于对 headless / 自动化场景，这一切都是静默且不可检测的。

### 为什么这是问题（两个具体缺陷）

1. **`--dump-config` 报告了一个不会运行的配置。** `--help` 说 `--dump-config` 打印 "the composed profile tree"，并把它和 `--dump-default-config`（"without its user layer or --patch overlays"）对比——强烈暗示 `--dump-config` *包含*用户层。实际并不包含：上面第 3 步打印 `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`，第 4 步却实际运行 `kimi-coding/k3-256k`。官方提供的"看生效配置"工具给出了错误答案，排查这种问题非常痛苦。

2. **自动化无法信任自己的注入。** 我们用 headless 模式（`--profile headless --json`）驱动无人值守的修复流水线，并通过 `--patch` 钉死模型。某天有人在 dsh UI 里设置了默认模型后，我们所有的运行都悄悄迁移到了另一个 provider/model 上。直到预期 provider 的用量面板一片空白才发现。对一个明显面向自动化的 headless/JSON 模式来说，"服务的模型 ≠ 请求的模型、且无任何信号"是最糟糕的失败形态。

### 建议

- 在 headless `--json` 事件流里输出**实际生效的 provider/model**（比如放在 `session` 事件里），让调用方可以核对；
- 当 `--patch` 的某项被用户层覆盖时，在 stderr 打**警告**；
- 让 `--dump-config` 反映用户层的效果，或新增 `--dump-effective-config`；
- 在文档里明确写出优先级顺序：用户层 > `--patch` > profile bundles > 内置默认值。

可提供更多日志或协助测试修复。感谢 dsh 团队的工作！

---

## English

### Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1` (installed via `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`)
- macOS, Node v24.18.1

### Expected vs. actual

`--help` describes `--patch` as "extra patch-list overlay applied **after** the profile layer", which reads as "wins over the profile". I expected a `--patch` entry for `agent-default-model` to determine the model a headless run actually uses.

What actually happens: once the user layer (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, written via model selection in the UI / `saveSelection`) contains an `agent-default-model` section, **the user layer silently wins at runtime** and the `--patch` value is demoted to a fallback default. There is no warning, and the effective model is not exposed anywhere in the `--json` event stream.

### Minimal repro

```bash
# 1. User layer: pick any default model in the dsh UI, or write ~/.dsh/settings.yaml:
#    agent-default-model:
#      provider: kimi-coding
#      model: k3-256k

# 2. A patch overlay requesting a *different* model
cat > /tmp/model.patch.yml <<'EOF'
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-flash
EOF

# 3. Inspect the composed config
dsh --patch /tmp/model.patch.yml --profile headless --dump-config
# → shows: agent-default-model: provider deepseek-official, model deepseek-flash

# 4. Run one headless task
echo "reply with the single word: ok" | dsh --patch /tmp/model.patch.yml --profile headless --json -

# 5. Check what actually served — the session record under ~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v3.jsonl.zstd:
# → "provider":"kimi-coding","model":"k3-256k"
# (also visible in the injected system prompt: "powered by the k3-256k model")
```

Same CLI invocation serves a different model depending on invisible global state (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`).

### Root cause (from the bundled plugin source)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model/lib/index.js` installs the composed config entry as a *fallback default* and then lets the settings provider's user layer replace it live:

```js
const entry = { provider: config.provider, model: config.model }; // composed tree value (--patch lands here)
this.source = () => entry;
ctx.inject(["settings"], (settingsCtx) => {
  settingsCtx.settings.installSection(ctx, "agent-default-model", SCHEMA, entry, {
    setSource: (current) => { this.source = current; }, // user layer replaces the source
  });
});
// comment: "when one is mounted, its user layer is read live"
```

So the precedence is by design: **user layer > `--patch` > profile bundles**. I understand "user's explicit choice wins" is reasonable UX for interactive use — the problem is the *silent and undetectable* part for headless/automation use.

### Why this hurts (two concrete defects)

1. **`--dump-config` reports a config that will not run.** `--help` says it prints "the composed profile tree" and contrasts with `--dump-default-config` ("without its user layer or --patch overlays") — strongly implying `--dump-config` *includes* the user layer. It does not: step 3 above prints `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` while step 4 actually runs `kimi-coding/k3-256k`. The one tool meant for "what will my config be" gives the wrong answer, which makes debugging this a real pain.

2. **Automation cannot trust its own injection.** We drive dsh headless (`--profile headless --json`) from an unattended bug-fixing pipeline and pin the model via `--patch`. After someone set a default model in the dsh UI, all our runs silently moved to a different provider/model. We only noticed because the expected provider's usage dashboard showed nothing. For a headless/JSON mode that is clearly aimed at automation, "served model ≠ requested model, with no signal" is the worst kind of failure mode.

### Suggestions

- Emit the **effective provider/model** in the headless `--json` stream (e.g. in the `session` event), so callers can verify what actually served.
- Print a **stderr warning** when a `--patch` entry is shadowed by the user layer.
- Make `--dump-config` reflect the user layer's effect, or add a `--dump-effective-config` that does.
- Document the precedence order explicitly: user layer > `--patch` > profile bundles > built-in defaults.

Happy to provide more logs or test a fix. Thanks for the great work on dsh!
