discussions.title: DSH | dsh-ditto | AI is great at doing one file. Ditto is for doing the same thing to 30 files without babysitting all 30.
discussions.body:
> ⚠️ **Unofficial community project / 非官方社群專案** — independent and community-maintained, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. 獨立社群維護，與 DeepSeek 官方無關。

## Review a few. Ditto the rest.

AI is great at doing one file. **Ditto** is for doing the same thing to dozens of files without supervising every one.

Ask DSH for "a consistent Markdown spec for every module in `src/`" and Ditto:

1. **Discovers** the modules (and tells you exactly what it excluded and why)
2. **Picks 3 representative samples** and lets the agent draft them from real, line-numbered source evidence
3. **Waits for you** to edit the samples until they look right, then records your **explicit approval**
4. **Previews everything** — every remaining module in the same style; every factual line cites source lines, and anything the source cannot support lands under **Needs confirmation** instead of being stated as fact
5. **Applies** only after you approve the full preview — into a separate output folder, never into your source tree, never over an existing file — and keeps a durable, resumable record

![dsh-ditto demo: discover 16 modules, review 3 samples, approve, preview everything, apply 16/16 with 0 source files modified](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/main/docs/assets/demo.svg)

Second use case: organising **copies** of files under one reviewed naming rule (originals are never moved or modified).

## It is a plugin, not a Markdown skill

- one Cordis service that registers on the host's public `skills` / `tools` services (clean unload on bundle removal)
- the `ditto` skill — a plain [`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/blob/main/skills/ditto/SKILL.md) you can read; it routes ordinary requests ("every module", "the whole folder", "same format for each"), so nobody has to say "use Ditto"
- 14 typed native tools (9 for Code → Spec, 5 for file organisation) — [reference generated from the live schemas](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md)
- a deterministic core: discovery, evidence ids, citation validation, rendering, hashes, revision/digest gates, durable state
- optional loopback-only review page for the demo

Ditto never calls a model itself and never stores model API keys. With a DSH approval service present, the host asks you once more before any batch write (`approval: host`).

## Safety by design

Your source stays untouched · nothing is batch-written before approval · Ditto does not execute your source code · Ditto does not store your model API keys. Every guarantee maps to a test — [docs/SAFETY.md](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/blob/main/docs/SAFETY.md).

## Install · verify · try without a model

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ditto
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-ditto doctor   # ✓ 14 of 14 tools registered · ✓ skill "ditto" registered …
npx dsh-ditto demo --headless                    # 16 synthetic modules, no model, no API key
```

Tested against DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 and rc.2 (CI: Node 22/24 × Ubuntu/Windows, plus a real `dsh plugin add` + profile boot); canary against 0.1.6-alpha. Details in [COMPATIBILITY.md](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).

## Looking for contributors

TypeScript/JavaScript is supported today. A new language is one small `LanguageAdapter` (extensions + structural facts from text; the safety core stays untouched): [Python](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/issues/1) · [Java](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/issues/2) · [C#](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/issues/3) · [Go](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/issues/4). Also open: custom spec templates, better sample selection, a DSH Web review panel, localisation.

Repo: https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto · npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ditto · MIT

---

## 中文｜先改幾份，其餘照樣做

AI 做一份很快。Ditto 解決的是做 50 份時，你不必盯 50 次。

叫 DSH「把 `src/` 每個模組都寫成一致的 Markdown 規格」，Ditto 會：

1. **掃描**模組（並明確列出排除了什麼、為什麼）
2. **挑出 3 份有代表性的樣本**，由 agent 依真實、帶行號的來源證據起草
3. **等你**把樣本改到滿意，再記錄你的**明確核准**
4. **預覽全部**——其餘模組以同樣風格產生；每句事實都引用來源行號，來源答不出的問題集中在 **Needs confirmation**，不會被寫成事實
5. 你核准完整預覽後才**寫入**——寫進獨立輸出資料夾，不碰原始碼、不覆寫既有檔案，而且可續跑

第二個用途：依一條審閱過的命名規則整理檔案**副本**（原檔不搬、不改）。

**它是插件，不是一份 Markdown skill**：一個 Cordis service、可直接閱讀的 `SKILL.md` 路由層、14 個原生工具、確定性核心、選用的本機審閱頁。插件本身不呼叫模型、不保存 API key；有 DSH approval service 時，每次批次寫入前 host 會再向你確認。

**安全設計**：來源不被動到 · 核准前不批次寫入 · 不執行你的程式碼 · 不保存模型 API key。每條保證都對應到測試（[docs/SAFETY.md](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/blob/main/docs/SAFETY.md)）。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ditto
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-ditto doctor
npx dsh-ditto demo --headless   # 不需要模型、不需要 API key
```

已對 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1／rc.2 測試（含真實 `dsh plugin add` + profile 啟動），0.1.6-alpha 為 canary。目前支援 TypeScript／JavaScript；Python、Java、C#、Go 的 language adapter 開放貢獻，介面很小。

Repo：https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto · 中文說明：[README.zh-TW.md](https://github.com/darrien1998/dsh-ditto/blob/main/README.zh-TW.md) · MIT

discussions.title: Desktop 壳缺少 Edit 菜单导致 macOS 复制粘贴失效（修复已就绪，dsh）
discussions.body:
# 问题

Desktop 客户端（`apps/desktop`）不支持复制粘贴。

Electron 壳只安装了一个应用菜单，其唯一子菜单只包含插件管理器、更新检查和退出。macOS 通过应用菜单分发 ⌘C、⌘V、⌘X、⌘A 等标准剪贴板快捷键，因此在缺少 Edit 菜单时，这些快捷键无法到达聚焦的渲染进程：dsh Web UI 和插件管理器中的复制粘贴都会失效。Windows/Linux 依靠 Chromium 自身处理仍可工作，但所有平台都缺少标准编辑入口。

# 修复（Fixed by dsh）

修复已完成并在 macOS 上验证，对应 commit `387bb8a394`，分支 `fix/desktop-edit-menu-clipboard-shortcuts`：

- 分支：https://github.com/comeonzhj/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/desktop-edit-menu-clipboard-shortcuts
- commit：https://github.com/comeonzhj/deepseek-harness/commit/387bb8a3947778b3f8a95d5d4193534d02578dc5

改动内容：

- `apps/desktop/src/main.ts`：在通过 `Menu.buildFromTemplate` 构建的应用菜单中加入顶层 Edit 菜单，菜单项使用 Electron 角色 `undo`、`redo`、`cut`、`copy`、`paste`、`selectAll`。快捷键与编辑命令由角色提供，壳不自行实现剪贴板操作；菜单在创建任何窗口前安装一次，主窗口与插件窗口共享。
- `apps/desktop/src/locale.ts`：中英文各新增 7 个 Edit 菜单文案键（编辑/撤销/重做/剪切/复制/粘贴/全选），保持 locale 归属文案约定。
- `apps/desktop/tests/main-startup.spec.ts`：捕获传给 `Menu.buildFromTemplate` 的模板，断言 Edit 子菜单的角色顺序与本地化标签。
- `apps/desktop/README.md`、`apps/desktop/README.zh.md`：说明应用菜单包含标准编辑操作。
- 新增 Agent Note：`.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-09-17-desktop-edit-menu-clipboard-shortcuts.md`（含中文与 i18n 记录）。

用户可观察行为：macOS 上主窗口与插件窗口的复制、粘贴、剪切、全选、撤销、重做快捷键恢复；Windows/Linux 增加可见的 Edit 菜单。命令、配置、API、协议或持久化格式无变化。

# 验证

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/tests/main-startup.spec.ts apps/desktop/tests/locale.spec.ts`

  ```text
   ✓ apps/desktop/tests/locale.spec.ts (3 tests)
   ✓ apps/desktop/tests/main-startup.spec.ts (14 tests)

   Test Files  2 passed (2)
        Tests  17 passed (17)
  ```

- `pnpm run verify-client-ui-i18n`

  ```text
  verify-client-ui-i18n: 633 Client UI source file(s) use locale-owned copy.
  ```

- `pnpm run doc-sync`

  ```text
  run-gates: 41 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in 76.10s.
  ```

- macOS 运行时验证（dev 壳，主进程 inspector）：读取实时应用菜单，确认 Edit 菜单的角色与加速键；随后确认 `webContents.paste()` 能把系统剪贴板插入聚焦的渲染进程输入框。

  ```json
  {
    "label": "编辑",
    "items": [
      { "label": "撤销", "role": "undo", "accelerator": "CommandOrControl+Z" },
      { "label": "重做", "role": "redo", "accelerator": "Shift+CommandOrControl+Z" },
      { "label": "剪切", "role": "cut", "accelerator": "CommandOrControl+X" },
      { "label": "复制", "role": "copy", "accelerator": "CommandOrControl+C" },
      { "label": "粘贴", "role": "paste", "accelerator": "CommandOrControl+V" },
      { "label": "全选", "role": "selectall", "accelerator": "CommandOrControl+A" }
    ]
  }
  ```

  ```text
  paste command: { focused: true, role: 'paste' } | probe: DSH-PASTE-PROBE-1789616594082
  textarea value: "DSH-PASTE-PROBE-1789616594082"
  PASTE CHAIN OK: true
  ```

- 手工测试：在开发壳中选取工作区后，复制、粘贴、剪切、全选、撤销/重做均正常。

# 备注

尝试提交 PR 时发现 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 关闭了 Pull Requests（`has_pull_requests=false`，REST `GET /pulls` 返回 404），CONTRIBUTING 也写明目前无法接受外部 PR，因此按 CONTRIBUTING 的建议改用 Discussion 提交，供团队参考或采纳。

discussions.title: [Bug] 更新/构建失败后无法启动（Windows + 便携 Node，仅 corepack 环境）
discussions.body:
# DeepSeek Harness 更新/构建失败后无法启动（Windows + 仅 corepack 环境）

> **类型**：Bug 报告
> **组件**：构建脚本（`package.json` scripts、`scripts/build.ts`）、客户端构建记录、自更新流程
> **版本**：`0.1.6-alpha.1`（commit `0a15e36e7f82b6ed45af6fa9759f29b40dcd965d`）
> **平台**：Windows 11（10.0.22631，64 位）

## 摘要（English abstract）

On Windows with a portable Node install (only `corepack` present, `corepack enable` never run),
the full source build fails because the `package.json` script chains (`build:lib`, `build:web`)
invoke a **bare `pnpm`** that is not on `PATH`.

The DSH self-update then degrades into **per-package** `tsc`/`tsdown` builds. Those produce
`packages/*/lib` artifacts but never run `scripts/build.ts`, so
`.dsh-build/client-build-environment.json` (the client build record) is never written.
The server still boots, but the client fails with a cryptic module-table error:

```
failed to import loader entry ... (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-resources):
client-modules: require("@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store") missed the module table
```

Running the official full pipeline (`pnpm run clean && pnpm run build`) restores a working install.

---

## 环境信息

| 项目 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 操作系统 | Windows 11 家庭中文版，10.0.22631，64 位 |
| Node.js | v24.19.0，安装目录 `E:\node`（便携/解压安装，非官方 MSI） |
| npm | 11.17.0 |
| corepack | 0.35.0 |
| pnpm | 仓库 `packageManager` 固定为 `pnpm@11.7.0`；系统 PATH 上**没有** `pnpm` 可执行文件 |
| Git | 2.45.1.windows.1 |
| 仓库路径 | `E:\DeepSeek Harness` |
| 运行方式 | 源码仓库 + `corepack pnpm dsh web` |

关键环境特征：`E:\node` 目录下只有 `corepack.cmd`，**没有** `pnpm.cmd`。
该目录 ACL 为 `BUILTIN\Users:(OI)(CI)(RX)`，普通用户不可写。

## 复现步骤

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
corepack pnpm install
corepack pnpm run build      # 在“仅 corepack、未 enable”的 Windows 环境必然失败
```

## 实际结果

### 问题 1：构建脚本链依赖 PATH 上的 `pnpm`

```
$ tsx scripts/build.ts
$ tsx native/system/scripts/build.ts --host-addon-only
$ pnpm run build:lib:host && pnpm run build:lib:client
'pnpm' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
operable program or batch file.
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
E:\DeepSeek Harness\scripts\build.ts:27
    throw new Error(`build: ${script} exited with ${String(result.status ?? result.signal)}`)
Error: build: build:lib exited with 1
```

`package.json` 中使用字面量 `pnpm` 的脚本（部分）：

```
build:lib = pnpm run build:lib:host && pnpm run build:lib:client
build:web = pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend run build
```

值得注意：`scripts/build.ts` **自身**已经通过 `scripts/pnpm-invocation.ts` 的
`pnpmInvocation()`（基于 `npm_execpath`）做免 PATH 的子进程调用，但 `package.json`
这一层脚本链没有走同样机制，因此仍然硬性要求 `pnpm` 出现在 PATH 上。
`build:web` 有同样问题——即便修好了 `build:lib`，下一步依然会失败。

### 问题 2：`corepack enable` 在 Windows 上需要管理员权限，且报错无指引

```
> corepack enable
Internal Error: EPERM: operation not permitted, open 'E:\node\pnpm'
```

原因：`E:\node` 的 ACL 为 `BUILTIN\Users:(OI)(CI)(RX)`，普通用户只读 + 执行。
对使用“便携安装 Node”的 Windows 用户，官方常见的 `corepack enable` 修复方案
并不总是可用，而报错也没有提示需要提权，或给出替代方案。

### 问题 3：更新流程把仓库留在“半构建”状态，程序启动后客户端崩溃

构建失败后，自更新流程退化为**逐个包**运行 `tsc` / `tsdown`。这会生成
`packages/*/lib`，但不会执行 `scripts/build.ts`，因此
`.dsh-build/client-build-environment.json` 永远没有生成。结果是服务端能启动，
但页面显示插件加载失败：

```
HARNESS
Failed to load plugins
failed to import loader entry 7af484e3 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-resources):
client-modules: require("@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store") missed the module table
— not a platform seed word, not a materialized module, and no registered package
factory (a build-time externals drift, or a dynamic dependency that did not arrive)
```

这个问题对用户非常不友好：

- 错误信息完全没有提到“客户端构建记录缺失”，也没有提示“请执行完整 `pnpm run build`”。
- 此时任何“逐包构建”的补救只会持续放大不一致，无法自愈。
- 结果是“更新失败 = 程序不可用”。

## 根因分析

1. `package.json` 的脚本链使用字面量 `pnpm`，在“只装 corepack、未 `corepack enable`”
   的 Windows 环境中必然失败。
2. `.dsh-build/client-build-environment.json` 是客户端模块表的唯一来源，且**只由完整流水线**
   （`build:native-system` → `build:lib` → `build:web`）写入；单包构建不会写它。
3. 构建记录的读取端本身有清晰报错
   （`client build record ... is missing; run a complete pnpm run build first`），
   但该错误没有在启动/更新路径上被优先抛出，用户最终看到的是难以理解的 module table 漂移错误。

## 本地修复过程（已验证）

```powershell
# 1) 让 pnpm 在 PATH 上可用（无需管理员）：
#    在“已在 PATH 上”的用户级 npm bin 目录放置委托给 corepack 的 shim
#      C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm.cmd
#      C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm.ps1
#    内容形如：
#      "E:\node\node.exe" "E:\node\node_modules\corepack\dist\corepack.js" pnpm %*

# 2) 完整重建（关键：不要逐包构建）
cd E:\DeepSeek Harness
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run clean
pnpm run build
#   ✓ built in 3.19s
#   build: recorded 240 client artifact(s) with 3 public value(s)

# 3) 启动
pnpm dsh web
```

修复后客户端正常渲染：标题 `DSH 本地构建`，版本 `0.1.6-alpha.1-0a15e36`，
会话列表与模型选择均正常，不再出现 `Failed to load plugins`。

## 给官方的修复建议

1. **消除对 PATH 上 `pnpm` 的隐式依赖**：把 `build:lib`、`build:web` 等脚本链改为
   经由 `pnpmInvocation()` / `npm_execpath` 派生子进程，或统一收敛到 `scripts/build.ts` 内部调度。
2. **启动时优先校验构建记录**：当 `.dsh-build/client-build-environment.json` 缺失或与产物不一致时，
   直接抛出可执行指引（`run a complete pnpm run build first`），而不是让用户面对 module table 漂移错误。
3. **自更新要具备原子性**：构建先落到暂存目录，只有完整流水线（含构建记录写入）成功后才切换；
   失败时保留上一个可用版本，避免“更新失败即不可启动”。
4. **前置条件检测与明确报错**：在构建/自更新入口检测 `pnpm` 是否可解析、corepack 是否已启用；
   不可用时提示 `corepack enable`（并说明 Windows 便携安装路径可能需要管理员），
   或提示 `corepack prepare pnpm@<version> --activate`。
5. **禁止/警告逐包构建**：当检测到“存在 `lib` 产物但缺少客户端构建记录”时给出明确警告，
   因为逐包 `tsc`/`tsdown` 会破坏客户端模块表一致性。
6. **文档补充**：Windows + 便携 Node 环境下说明 `corepack enable` 的前置要求，
   并提供无需管理员的替代方案（例如 `npm i -g pnpm@11.7.0` 或用户级 shim）。

## 附：涉及的文件

- `package.json` — `build` / `build:lib` / `build:lib:host` / `build:lib:client` / `build:web` / `clean`
- `scripts/build.ts` — 流水线编排与客户端构建记录写入
- `scripts/pnpm-invocation.ts` — 基于 `npm_execpath` 的免 PATH 调用
- `scripts/client-build-environment.ts` — `CLIENT_BUILD_RECORD_PATH = '.dsh-build/client-build-environment.json'`，缺失/不一致时的报错
- `scripts/clean.ts` — 清理仓库自有构建产物（本次清理移除 315 个陈旧路径）

discussions.title: [Bug] master 桌面端打包必失败：prepare:dsh 的产物 smoke 仍在检查已被移除的 fs-ext
discussions.body:
> 相关：同一台机器上遇到的另一处阻塞（pnpm 静默漏装两个平台二进制包）见 #6920。两者独立。

### 摘要

在 `master`（`0d1f500`，`0.1.6-alpha.1`）上执行桌面端打包，会在最后一步 `prepare:dsh` 失败：

```
Error: desktop native payload smoke failed: node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1500
Error: Cannot find module 'fs-ext'
    at checkFsExt (apps/desktop/tests/fixtures/runtime-payload-smoke.mjs:69:17)
Error: desktop package: pnpm run prepare:dsh exited with 1
```

从证据看这是一处**残留检查**：仓库已在 2026-09-07 用预编译的 `native/system` `system.node` + koffi 取代了 `fs-ext`，但产物 smoke 仍在 `require('fs-ext')`，因此桌面端打包在最后一步必然挂掉（mac / win 都一样）。

### 复现

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git && cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

export DSH_DESKTOP_APP_ID='com.example.dsh-desktop'
export DSH_DESKTOP_MACOS_SIGNING_IDENTITY='<Developer ID 证书限定名，不含前缀>'
export DSH_DESKTOP_MACOS_TEAM_ID='<10 位 Team ID>'
export APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE='<任意非空值；--prepare-only 不会真的公证>'

pnpm --dir apps/desktop run package:mac:arm64 --prepare-only
```

`--prepare-only` 会跑到 `prepare:dsh` 并在 payload smoke 处失败，不涉及签名与公证。

（小坑：`pnpm run package:mac:arm64 -- --prepare-only` 会把 `--` 一并作为位置参数传给脚本，报 `desktop package: expected at most one target`；直接跟 `--prepare-only` 即可。）

### 证据

1. **迁移决策已落地**：`.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-07-prebuilt-system-primitives.zh.md` —— JSONL 写入方不再依赖 fs-ext，改用 `native/system` 的 Node-API `system.node`（flock 经 koffi FFI）。

2. **lockfile 里已经没有它**：
   ```sh
   grep -n "fs-ext" pnpm-lock.yaml | grep -v fs-extra   # 无输出
   ```

3. **生产闭包里没有任何包声明它**。我把 `apps/desktop/.desktop-build/targets/mac-arm64/packed/dsh/*.tgz` 的 **287 个 tarball** 逐个解开读 `package.json`，无一命中 `"fs-ext"`；实际出现的是：

   ```
   @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl  dependencies  koffi
   @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local                   dependencies  koffi
   @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local           dependencies  koffi, node-pty
   @deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local           dependencies  sharp
   ```

4. **检查是无条件的**：`runtime-payload-smoke.mjs` 主流程直接调用 `checkFsExt()` / `checkKoffi()` / `checkSharp()` / `checkHtml()` / `checkPty()`，没有按平台或可用性分支。该文件最近一次改动是 2026-09-09 的 `feat: 优化 windows 安装包打包`，晚于 09-07 的迁移。

### 影响

桌面端发布链路在当前 master 上必然失败。而且 `prepare-dsh.ts` 在 `catch` 分支里会 `rmSync(DSH_OUTPUT_ROOT)`，失败后连部分产物都不留，重试成本 = 完整的 `prepare:runtime` + `prepare:packages` + `prepare:dsh`。

### 本地绕行

让这条历史检查在模块缺失时跳过（其余 PTY / FFI / sharp / HTML 检查都正常通过）：

```js
function checkFsExt() {
  let fsExt
  try {
    fsExt = requireRuntime('fs-ext')
  } catch {
    console.warn('payload smoke: fs-ext is not part of this runtime; skipping the legacy seek check')
    return
  }
  // ...原逻辑
}
```

绕过后 `prepare:dsh` 通过，`electron-builder --dir` 能产出可运行的 `DeepSeek Harness.app`：内置 Node 24.17.0 + pnpm 11.7.0 + dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1，不监听端口，`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop` 正常工作，会话/设置与 CLI、Web 共享。

### 建议

- 删除 `checkFsExt()`，或改为验证替代实现的 flock 行为（`system.node` / koffi）；
- `apps/desktop/scripts/runtime-file-policy.ts:26-30` 仍在按 `fs-ext` 排除编译产物与构建配置，可一并清理（`runtime-file-policy.spec.ts:20-23` 的用例同源）。

### 环境

macOS 27.2 (26B5086k) arm64 · Node v22.22.0 · pnpm 11.7.0（仓库 `packageManager`）· commit `0d1f500`

### 附带（非阻塞）

`apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.mjs` 未设置 `mac.icon`，打包产物使用 Electron 默认图标。我用 `website/public/favicon.svg` 按 macOS 图标网格生成了一份 `.icns`（深色圆角 + 品牌蓝鲸）并通过 `--config.mac.icon=...` 覆盖打包成功；如果官方愿意接受，可以把这个素材补进仓库。

discussions.title: [Bug] pnpm install 静默漏装两个平台二进制包，导致 pnpm run dev:desktop 链接阶段 ENOENT
discussions.body:
> 相关：同一台机器上遇到的另一处桌面端阻塞（master 打包链路的 `fs-ext` 残留 smoke 检查）见 #6919。两者独立，各自都有本地绕行。

### 摘要

`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 在本机为两个平台二进制包创建了虚拟目录，但**没有解出任何内容**；`node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules/` 下的别名因此成为断链，重跑 install 也不会修复。最终表现为 `pnpm run dev:desktop` 在链接一次性开发项目时 ENOENT 崩溃。

### 复现

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git && cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

cd node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules
find . -maxdepth 2 -type l | while read -r l; do [ -e "$l" ] || echo "BROKEN: $l -> $(readlink "$l")"; done
```

首次安装后的输出：

```
BROKEN: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64 -> ../../@anthropic-ai+claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64@0.3.263/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64
BROKEN: @openai/codex-darwin-arm64 -> ../../@openai+codex@0.153.4-darwin-arm64/node_modules/@openai/codex
```

然后：

```sh
pnpm run dev:desktop
# ...
# ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat '<repo>/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64'
```

出处是 `apps/desktop/scripts/development-project.ts` 的 `linkDirectory()` → `realpathSync(source)`：`mirrorDependencyLinks()` 会镜像整个 hoisted 目录，**一条断链就中断整个开发项目准备**。

### 观察

- 两个虚拟目录存在但为空：`.pnpm/@anthropic-ai+claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64@0.3.263/node_modules/` 是空目录，里面连 `@anthropic-ai/` 都没有。
- 重跑 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` → `Already up to date`，不会补齐。
- 平台是匹配的：两个包声明 `os: ["darwin"]`、`cpu: ["arm64"]`，机器即 darwin/arm64，不是平台筛选问题。
- 包本身没问题：手动下载 tarball 后 sha512 与 registry 的 `dist.integrity` 逐字节一致（`@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64@0.3.263` 解包 199 MB，`@openai/codex@0.153.4-darwin-arm64` 解包 288 MB），解开到目标路径后断链即消失。
- 本地没有全局 `minimumReleaseAge` 配置（`pnpm config get minimumReleaseAge` → `undefined`），而 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` 已明确列出这两个精确版本，所以看起来也不是发布年龄策略拦截。

### 影响

dev 形态桌面端（`pnpm run dev:desktop`）无法启动。打包形态不受影响——`prepare:dsh` 走独立的 package-set 安装路径。

### 本地绕行

按 registry 元数据下载 tarball、校验 sha512 后解开到对应路径即可，`dev:desktop` 恢复正常。等价的占位包也能让链接阶段通过（但会让 Claude Code / Codex 子代理后端不可用）。

### 环境

macOS 27.2 (26B5086k) arm64 · Node v22.22.0 · pnpm 11.7.0（仓库 `packageManager` 固定）· `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.6-alpha.1 · commit `0d1f500`

discussions.title: Session opens blank stuck on "Loading history…" — client render state machine loops forever on a session containing a turn=null step block (found in production testing)
discussions.body:
## EN / English

### Summary

Opening a session causes a **blank screen stuck on "Loading history…"** — the client render loop never advances (`openState=loading`), with the renderer at elevated CPU. The data layer is 100% healthy: `our offline contract checker` passes, the official `Session` fold + `deriveMessages` succeeds, pagination is fast. The one anomaly in the session log is a **`step/start → assistant/message → step/end` block whose `data.turn` is `null`** (a surface-replace marker written by a third-party edit operation in the gap between an open turn's steps). The client's render state machine cannot attribute the null-turn step to any turn → it waits forever → render loop → blank screen.

This is a **client-side robustness gap**: the renderer should degrade (skip/ignore the unattributable block) instead of looping indefinitely on one malformed-but-persisted event. We hit this during production testing of DSH with a large session (~330k events, 724 messages); restarting DSH, clearing projcache, and rebuilding frames did not help — only rewriting the null-turn block to its owning turn (turn 95) restored the session.

**Status as of `0.1.5-rc.2` (re-read 2026-09-17)**: the open state machine is unchanged in shape. In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller@0.1.5-rc.2` (`lib/client.js:1979-2006`), `Session.doOpen` sets `openState = "loading"` and has exactly two exits — `"open"` after `await events.open({ maxMessages: 50 })` resolves, and `"error"` **only when `isRemoteFailure(error)`**; any other error is re-thrown out of `doOpen` without setting `"error"`, leaving the UI on `"loading"`. An earlier note (0.1.3-alpha.1) also stands: the v2 migration may normalize some legacy null-turn blocks during upgrade, narrowing the trigger surface for newly migrated sessions — while this state machine still has **no degradation path** for an unattributable step that survives into the log.

*Honest boundaries: (1) the blank-screen loop was **not** re-tested end-to-end on 0.1.5-rc.2 — what was re-read is the state machine; (2) we did **not** trace which of the two routes (hang vs. non-remote throw) a `turn=null` block actually takes through `SessionEventStream.open`.*

### Trigger Condition

1. A session contains a `step/start`+`assistant/message`+`step/end` block with `data.turn === null` (any plugin/operation that writes an edit marker outside an open step — including while its turn is still open — can produce this shape)
2. The client opens the session → render state machine receives the null-turn step
3. The step is unattributable to any turn → render loop → blank screen stuck on "Loading history…"

### Proposed Fix

1. **Client-side**: treat a `turn=null` step/marker as non-renderable (skip/ignore with a warning) instead of entering a wait-for-start state that never resolves — the renderer must not loop on persisted data it cannot attribute
2. **Data-side (optional)**: `our offline contract checker` gains a rule flagging `turn=null` step/marker blocks so affected sessions are caught offline before opening

### Related

- #4795 (valid-but-unreadable on the read path) — sibling: data layer healthy, a consumer still fails with no degradation path
- #5692 (turn-tail update-before-start on boundary-cut turns) — sibling client robustness gap: same robustness class, throw instead of degrade
- **#4513 / #4416 ("Loading history…" freeze on large sessions) — same symptom, different cause**: those are size/performance (host event loop and browser main thread both blocked; 535,316 events measured), whereas this report is data-shaped — a `turn=null` step block loops the render state machine at any session size. Cross-linked so the two are not read as one defect.

### Environment

- Found during production testing; one production session (~330k events, 724 messages, 2 frames)
- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1-rc.2 line (client render path; data layer verified on @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2)
- macOS 26.3 (arm64)

*Authorship note: reproduced and measured by me against my own store; root-cause tracing and drafting assisted by AI; verification and publication by me. I have no engineering background — if any technical claim reads wrong, please call it out; I will re-verify against the toolchain and correct.*

*Reported by the **OfferKuai Team** — Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. Website: https://www.offerkuai.com/ | Contact: contact@offerkuai.com*

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 摘要

打开会话 → **白屏卡在「载入历史…」**——客户端渲染循环永不前进（`openState=loading`），渲染进程 CPU 升高。数据层 100% 健康：`our offline contract checker` 通过、官方 `Session` 折叠 + `deriveMessages` 成功、分页很快。会话日志中唯一异常是一个 **`data.turn` 为 `null` 的 `step/start → assistant/message → step/end` 块**（第三方编辑操作在某个已打开 turn 的 step 间隙写入的 surface-replace marker）。客户端渲染状态机无法将该 null-turn step 归属到任何 turn → 永远等待 → 渲染死循环 → 白屏。

这是**客户端健壮性缺口**：渲染器应对无法归属的持久化事件降级（跳过/忽略），而不是无限死循环。我们在生产环境测试 DSH 时命中（约 33 万事件、724 条消息的大会话）；重启 DSH、清 projcache、重建帧均无效——只有把 null-turn 块改写为其所属 turn（turn 95）后会话才恢复。

**版本现状（@`0.1.5-rc.2` 实读，2026-09-17）**：open 状态机**结构未变**。在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller@0.1.5-rc.2`（`lib/client.js:1979-2006`）里，`Session.doOpen` 置 `openState = "loading"` 后**只有两个出口**——`await events.open({ maxMessages: 50 })` 成功后的 `"open"`；以及**仅当 `isRemoteFailure(error)` 时**的 `"error"`；**其它异常会被重新抛出 `doOpen` 而不设 `"error"`**，于是 UI 没有任何状态可去，**只能停在 `"loading"`**。此前的 0.1.3-alpha.1 注也仍成立：v2 迁移可能在升级时规范化部分旧数据的 null-turn 块（新迁移会话触发面收窄），而该状态机对存活进日志的无法归属 step **仍无降级路径**。

*诚实边界：（1）白屏死循环**未**在 0.1.5-rc.2 上端到端重测——本次**实读的是状态机**；（2）我们**未**追查 `turn=null` 块经 `SessionEventStream.open` 实际走的是「挂住」还是「抛非远端错误」哪条路。*

### 触发条件

1. 会话含 `data.turn === null` 的 `step/start`+`assistant/message`+`step/end` 块（任何在打开的 step 之外写编辑 marker 的插件/操作都可能产生此形态——包括其 turn 仍打开时）
2. 客户端打开该会话 → 渲染状态机收到 null-turn step
3. step 无法归属任何 turn → 渲染死循环 → 白屏卡在「载入历史…」

### 建议修复

1. **客户端**：将 `turn=null` 的 step/marker 视为不可渲染（跳过/忽略 + 警告），而不是进入永不 resolved 的 wait-for-start 状态——渲染器不得对无法归属的持久化数据死循环
2. **数据侧（可选）**：`our offline contract checker` 增加规则标记 `turn=null` 的 step/marker 块，让受影响会话在打开前就被离线发现

### 相关

- #4795（读路径 valid-but-unreadable）——姊妹问题：数据层健康，某消费者仍失败且无降级路径
- #5692（turn-tail 对被切开的 turn 报 update-before-start）——姊妹客户端健壮性缺口：同一健壮性类，抛错而非降级
- **#4513 / #4416（大会话卡在「载入历史…」）——同症状、不同根因**：那两条是**规模/性能型**（host 事件循环与浏览器主线程双阻塞，实测 535,316 事件），而本条是**数据形状型**——一个 `turn=null` 的 step 块在**任何规模**下都会让渲染状态机打转。做交叉引用，是为了别把两者读成同一个缺陷。

### 环境

- 生产环境测试中发现；一个生产会话（约 33 万事件、724 条消息、2 帧）
- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1-rc.2 线（客户端渲染路径；数据层在 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 验证）
- macOS 26.3（arm64）

*声明：本次实测与统计由我针对自己的数据完成；根因追查与文稿撰写由 AI 辅助；核验与发布由我本人负责。我没有工程背景 —— 若任何技术表述有误，请直接指出，我会对照工具链重新核实并更正。*

*本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。官网：https://www.offerkuai.com/ | 联系：contact@offerkuai.com*

---

discussions.title: [Bug] Web 对话视图在长会话后不再渲染助手正文，仅重启 dsh web 可恢复
discussions.body:
> **提交去向 / Where to submit**
>
> 仓库是公开的，bug 走 **GitHub Discussions**（不是 Issues），标题惯例加 `[Bug]` 前缀：
>
> **https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions** → New discussion
>
> 建议标题 / Suggested title:
> `` [Bug] Web 对话视图在长会话后不再渲染助手正文，仅重启 dsh web 可恢复 ``
>
> 相关既有讨论 / Related existing discussions:
> [#1915](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1915) ·
> [#5909](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5909) ·
> [#6680](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6680) ·
> [#4668](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4668) (Plugins can break the wire protocol) ·
> [#3471](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3471) (npm 闭包缺少客户端包导致第三方插件崩溃)

---

# 中文摘要

**组件**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat`（Web 对话视图），可能与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`（follow 事件流）有关
**版本**：`dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1（入口包）/ 客户端各包 0.1.5-rc.2
**环境**：Windows、Node v24.21.0、Microsoft Edge、`dsh web` @ `127.0.0.1:3080`、profile `web`

## 现象

Web **对话视图**里助手**工具调用卡片正常显示，助手正文完全不渲染**。同时**轨迹视图始终完整正常**，同一份数据、同一时刻，正文一条不缺。

- 浏览器刷新（含强制刷新）**无法恢复**
- **重启 `dsh web` 可以恢复**，两次复发两次生效
- 在同一个会话里**复发过两次**

## 已排除（均有证据）

| 猜测 | 结论 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 服务端没发出正文 | 否 | 117/117 条 `assistant/message` 均带 `surfaceOp:"append"` 且 text 块非空 |
| 压缩 / surface 替换遮蔽了事件 | 否 | 746 个事件中 `surfaceOp` **只出现过 `"append"`**，无任何压缩事件 |
| 轮次中断或异常 | 否 | 13/13 回合以 `{"kind":"completed"}` 正常结束 |
| 客户端 bundle 陈旧 / Service Worker | 否 | 前端**不含任何 service worker**；硬刷新无效，而重启**服务端**有效 |
| 对话渲染器依赖缺失 | 否 | `dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 10 个 `dsh.client.inject` 全部可解析 |
| 客户端包版本错位 | 否 | 232 个包中 230 个统一为 0.1.5-rc.2，仅 `dsh` 入口包是 rc.1 |
| 第三方皮肤 `uiskin-theme` 抢占级联 | 否 | 禁用它**没有**修好问题；重新启用也**没有**让问题复现 |
| `ui-chat.transcriptView` 设置 | 否 | 第二次复发时该设置**已经是 `normal`** |

## 唯一的相关性

两次复发都紧跟在**异常庞大的回合**之后。第二次复发时的会话规模：

```
events 746 · messages 131 · assistant/message 117 · step/start 117 · tool/call 157
会话日志 1,017,341 字节
```

而对话视图加载的是**按消息对齐的分页窗口**，不是整个会话：`DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50`（`dsh-api-session-controller`）。131 条消息已远超一页。

**这是相关性，不是证明**——在更早、渲染正常的回合里，会话同样已经超过 50 条消息。

## 假设（未验证）

客户端 `follow` 连接的游标在超大回合之后发生漂移，导致后续 `assistant/message` 事件**根本没有送达浏览器**，那些步骤的 `assistant-step` 节点因此从未被创建。这与全部观察一致：轨迹视图走的是持久化读取（`session/page`）所以不受影响；已加载窗口内的工具卡片仍在；服务端数据干净；重启服务端会强制重建快照与游标，所以能恢复；而单纯刷新页面不能，因为坏掉的状态在服务端侧。

### 如何证实或证伪

**在故障仍然存在时**（重启之前），在对话视图的浏览器控制台执行：

```js
[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-chat-flow-kind]')]
  .map(e => e.dataset.chatFlowKind + (e.hasAttribute('hidden') ? '*' : ''))
  .join(',')
```

- `assistant-step` 节点**不存在** → 节点从未被创建 → 投递/投影问题（支持上述假设）
- `assistant-step` **存在且带 `*`（hidden）** → 是 `ChatNodeSeat` 的可见性问题
- `assistant-step` **存在且未隐藏** → 问题在 `AssistantMarkdown` 之下

## 临时办法

重启 `dsh web`；或开新会话（该故障只在长生命周期会话中出现过）。

---

# English (full detail)

# Web conversation view stops rendering assistant text; only a `dsh web` restart recovers

**Component:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` (chat conversation view) — possibly interacting with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` (follow stream)
**Severity:** user-visible data loss in the transcript (content is durable, but unreadable in the primary view)
**Version:** `dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1 / client packages 0.1.5-rc.2
**Status of this report:** root cause NOT confirmed; two occurrences, one correlation, one unverified hypothesis. Client-side evidence could not be captured while the fault was active.

---

## 1. Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Harness entry package | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** |
| Client/UI packages | **0.1.5-rc.2** (230 of 232 `@deepseek-ai` packages; the two exceptions are the `dsh` entry package and one unrelated dep) |
| Install | npx cache (`_npx/<hash>/node_modules`) |
| OS / runtime | Windows, Node v24.21.0 |
| Browser | Microsoft Edge |
| Entry point | `dsh web` on `http://127.0.0.1:3080` |
| Profile | `web` |
| Profile bundles | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`, **`uiskin-theme` 1.1.0** (third-party), **`qq-mode-console`** (third-party) |
| Relevant setting | `ui-chat.transcriptView` — was `compact` (default) at occurrence 1, already `normal` at occurrence 2 |

Third-party bundles were **excluded as the cause** (see §4). The report is submitted anyway because the same profile shape is trivially reachable by any user who installs a client-side bundle.

## 2. Symptom

In the **conversation view** (`conversation.view` = *chat*, the default transcript surface):

- Assistant **tool-call cards render normally**.
- Assistant **text does not render at all** — not shortened, not collapsed; absent.
- User messages render.
- The **trajectory view** (`dsh-client-ui-trajectory`) renders the **same session completely and correctly**, including every assistant text block, at all times.

Recovery:

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Browser refresh (including hard reload) | **does not recover** |
| Restarting `dsh web` | **recovers**, repeatedly |

Occurred **twice** in a single session; both times recovered by restarting the server process.

## 3. Was it the compact transcript fold?

The first occurrence coincided with `ui-chat.transcriptView = compact` (the `DEFAULT_TRANSCRIPT_VIEW_MODE`). That mode folds each completed turn's process behind a one-line disclosure whose label is built from tool-call/message counts:

```js
// dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js ~L3282
if (node.data.toolCallCount > 0) labels.push(t("message.turnProcess.toolCalls.other", { count: … }));
```

so a folded turn reads as e.g. *"8 次工具调用"*. Switching to `normal` was applied and **did** change the symptom — but **the second occurrence happened with the setting already at `normal`, and a restart fixed it.** The setting is therefore **not** the root cause, and the first occurrence's apparent fix is now attributed to the restart that accompanied it.

Measured behaviour of `compact` for the record (may still be a separate design question, see §7): replaying the client's own predicates over the real session log shows `compact` hides **every** node in `[turn/start.seq, answerAnchorSeq)`, which in this session was **1–21 assistant steps per turn**, and those steps carried essentially all intermediate narration. That is by design ("show the conclusion, fold the process"), but it means any user-facing text authored in an intermediate step is discarded from the chat view in `compact` mode.

## 4. Explicitly ruled out (with evidence)

| Candidate | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Server never emitted the text | **No** | 117/117 `assistant/message` events carry `surfaceOp:"append"` and non-empty `text` blocks |
| Surface replacement / compaction shadowing the events | **No** | 746 events; the **only** `surfaceOp` value present anywhere is `"append"`; no compaction event of any kind |
| Interrupted / malformed turns | **No** | 13/13 turns closed with `{"kind":"completed"}` |
| Stale client bundle / service worker | **No** | the shipped frontend contains **no service worker**; hard reload did not help; a restart of the *server* did |
| Missing client dependency of the chat renderer | **No** | all ten `dsh.client.inject` entries of `dsh-client-ui-chat` resolve on disk |
| Version skew across the client package set | **No** | 230/232 packages at 0.1.5-rc.2; only the `dsh` entry package is rc.1 |
| Third-party theme (`uiskin-theme`) hijacking the cascade | **No** | disabling the bundle did **not** fix the symptom; re-enabling it did **not** reintroduce it |
| `transcriptView` setting | **No** | occurrence 2 happened with the setting already at `normal` |

## 5. The one correlation

Both occurrences followed unusually large turns. Session metrics at the second occurrence:

```
events                       746
messages (user+assistant)    131
assistant/message            117
step/start                   117
tool/call                    157
session log                  1,017,341 bytes (zstd JSONL)
```

The conversation view loads a **message-aligned window**, not the whole session:

```js
// dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js ~L1328
const DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50;
const MESSAGE_TYPES$1 = new Set(["user", "assistant"]) // i.e. user/message, assistant/message
```

At 131 messages the session is well beyond one page. Note this is a **correlation, not a proof** — the session had already exceeded 50 messages during turns when the chat view rendered correctly.

## 6. Hypothesis (unverified)

The client's `follow` connection cursor drifts after very large turns, so subsequent `assistant/message` events are never delivered to the browser, and the `assistant-step` nodes for those steps are consequently never built.

This is consistent with every observation:

- **trajectory** reads the durable log through `session/page` and is unaffected;
- **tool-call cards** for the already-loaded window are still present (they are separate nodes produced by `dsh-client-ui-tool`);
- **server data is clean** (§4);
- **restarting the server** forces a fresh snapshot and a fresh cursor, which recovers;
- **a browser refresh alone** does not, because the stale cursor state lives in the server-side session/stream, not in the page.

### How to confirm or refute

While the fault is **active** (before restarting), run this in the browser console on the conversation view:

```js
[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-chat-flow-kind]')]
  .map(e => e.dataset.chatFlowKind + (e.hasAttribute('hidden') ? '*' : ''))
  .join(',')
```

- if `assistant-step` nodes are **absent** → the nodes were never built → delivery/projection problem (supports the hypothesis)
- if `assistant-step` nodes are **present and marked `hidden`** → a visibility problem in `ChatNodeSeat`
- if `assistant-step` nodes are **present and not hidden** → a rendering problem below `AssistantMarkdown`

The server-side reachability of `/api/client-modules` and the `/plugins/**` bundle route could not be checked from the same host (401 / 404 without the process token), which is why this evidence is still outstanding.

## 7. Code locations that matter

| Location | Role |
|---|---|
| `dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js` ~L1544 `ChatNodeSeat` | per-node process visibility |
| … ~L1555 `processWindowReady` | requires `compactTranscript && answerAnchorSeq !== null && turnClosed && !historyIncomplete` |
| … ~L1573 `processHidden` | `controllerInactive \|\| (foldable && processMember && !processOpen)` |
| … ~L1611 `data-chat-flow-kind` / `data-turn-process-hidden` | the DOM hooks used by the console probe above |
| … ~L4369 `blockIsVisible` | **excludes `tool-call`** — a step whose message is reasoning+tool-calls only is "not visible content" |
| … ~L4611 `assistantDefinition.buildViewNode` | marks the node `visibility: hidden` when `hasVisibleContent(data.blocks)` is false |
| … ~L6751 `latestAnswer` | returns `null` when the last step's message contains a `tool-call` block |
| `dsh-client-ui-tool/lib/client.js` ~L2370 | registers the separate `tool-call` conversation node |
| `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` ~L1328 / ~L1436 | `DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50`; `follow()` and the `assistantStream` opt-in |

## 8. Workaround

Restart `dsh web`. Opening a new session also clears it (the fault has only been observed in a long-lived session).

## 9. What would help most from maintainers

1. Whether a `follow`-connection cursor rebaseline is expected to survive turns of this size, and what the client-side symptom of a drifted cursor is supposed to look like.
2. Whether the `[class$="_fade"]`-style CSS reach of a **profile bundle** is intended to be able to outrank `dsh-client-ui-chat`'s own styles (this report cleared the theme, but the capability is worth a decision).
3. Whether `compact` hiding *all* intermediate narration is intended when an assistant authors user-facing text in intermediate steps — the `latestAnswer` answer-lifting path only ever surfaces the **last** step's reply.

discussions.title: Web client: no eager reconnect when the tab becomes visible again — long "disconnected" wait on mobile
Deepseek Harness compaction missing thinking tokens
discussions.body: The fundamental issue I am having right now is when using Qwen3.8 27b, which is a model that tends to think a LOT, and in fact most of its useful output is done in thinking, Deepseek Harness only compacts the actual "output" tokens, which leads to it missing a lot of context, and ends up having it redo things it has already done in thinking. A good example is file generation, the model will build files through thinking and then add them to the directory but not necessarily comment on them in the output tokens. This leads to the compaction acting as if they never existed in the first place. If there is a general fix to this I would be happy to hear suggestions.

discussions.title: A BOM in a client plugin's package.json disables the whole session, with no user-visible error
discussions.body:
### Summary

A profile client-plugin package whose `package.json` begins with a UTF-8 BOM breaks Harness
activation. The web GUI still opens, but every message fails while preparing the request —
before it is sent to the model — and the user sees no error at all. Removing the BOM and
restarting the server fixes it.

### Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1, profile `web`, started with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`
- Windows 11 (10.0.26200), Node v24.21.0
- Custom client plugin installed under `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\<plugin>\`, with a row
  added to `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a profile client-plugin package: a `package.json` declaring `dsh.client`
   (`platform: web`) and exporting `./client`, plus a host half and a client bundle.
2. Write that `package.json` with a leading UTF-8 BOM (`EF BB BF`).
3. Add the row `./<plugin>/lib/index.js` to the profile patch file and restart `dsh web`.
4. Open the GUI and send a message.

**Expected:** the plugin either loads, or fails with an error naming the file and the reason.

**Actual:** the GUI opens normally, the client plugin never loads, and every message fails while
preparing the request — before it reaches the model. Nothing is shown to the user: the session
simply looks dead.

### Cause (verified)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules`, `lib/index.js`, `resolveMeta()` reads the manifest with a
strict parse:

```js
const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgPath, "utf8"))
```

`JSON.parse` does not tolerate a BOM. On Node v24.21.0:

```
JSON.parse('\uFEFF{}')
  -> SyntaxError: Unexpected token '', "﻿{}" is not valid JSON
```

Control checks on the same machine:

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` with BOM, parsed as JSON | fails |
| `.mjs` module with BOM, imported | works (Node strips it) |
| `Set-Content -Encoding utf8` (PowerShell 7.6.5) | does **not** add a BOM |

So only the package manifest is sensitive to the BOM, and one invisible byte is enough to take
the session down.

### How it was unblocked

A second agent inspected the installed code, removed the invisible character from the plugin
file and restarted the server; the session answered again immediately.

### Requests

1. **Tolerate (strip) a BOM** when reading the package manifest, or reject it with an explicit
   error that names the file. One invisible byte should not leave the user unable to work.
2. **Surface profile activation failures in the UI.** Today a row that does not activate produces
   no visible error: the GUI opens and the agent simply stops answering.
3. **Worth checking where the BOM came from.** The file was written by the harness's own `pwsh`
   tool with `Set-Content -Encoding utf8`, and the control test above shows that combination does
   not add a BOM, so the command transport is a possible source. This affects any file an agent
   writes that way.

discussions.title: Official compaction checkpoint: the loader and the writer disagree on the shadowed range — session fails to load (S5 violation)
discussions.body:
## EN / English

### Summary

Official DSH auto-compaction writes a `user/message` checkpoint with `surfaceOp: replace`, and the session then **fails to load**:

```
surface replace: sourceEventSeqs must include every shadowed surface node; missing XXXX, YYYY
```

The mismatch is between **two different computations of "the shadowed range"**:

- **At write time**, compaction enumerates the shadowed nodes from the surface **as it stands at that moment** — what *its* selection sees, and a complete enumeration of that (`dsh-compaction-basic`);
- **At read time**, the loader recomputes the range from the surface **as replayed so far** (`replacementRange(state, op)`) and validates the event against *that* (`dsh-session`).

**When the two computations disagree about that set, `missing` is non-empty and the session becomes permanently unloadable.** Our instance shows the disagreement directly: a node whose `seq` lies **inside** the checkpoint's own `[startSeq, endSeq]`, which the checkpoint does not cite. **We have not located *why* the two sets differ** — see the last honest boundary.

### Version note (re-read 2026-09-17, `0.1.5-rc.2`)

Both halves were re-read on the current line:

- `dsh-compaction-basic@0.1.5-rc.2`: `shadowedSeqs: nodes.slice(startIdx, endIdx + 1)` (`:547`) is snapshotted at selection time; the two write-side assertions (`:554` before summarization, `:596` before commit) only guarantee the surface does not change **during summarization**;
- `dsh-session@0.1.5-rc.2`: `planSurfaceEvent` (`:385`) → `replacementRange(state, surfaceOp)` (`:393`) → `assertProvenance(event, range.shadowedSeqs)` (`:394`), whose predicate is `shadowedSeqs.filter(seq => !sources.has(seq))` (`:299`).

⇒ The write-side guards cannot cover the read-side recomputation.

*Honest boundaries: (1) this is a **code read**, not an end-to-end reproduction — we have not re-run an affected real instance on `0.1.5-rc.2` to show it still throws `missing`; (2) we did not check what `replacementRange` does when `op.startSeq` has itself been removed by an earlier replace (`indexOf` → `-1`); (3) **we have not located why the write-time enumeration and the read-time range differ.** Candidates we did not test: surface ordering vs. `seq` ordering (a node whose `seq` is inside the range but whose position is not), and a surface change after the checkpoint was written. We have an instance of the disagreement, not a proven cause.*

### Trigger Condition

1. A session contains an official compaction checkpoint with `surfaceOp: replace`;
2. At replay, the checkpoint's `[startSeq, endSeq]` covers a node that its own `sourceEventSeqs` does not cite (in our instance: a node whose `seq` lies inside that range);
3. At replay, the read-time range includes that node while `sourceEventSeqs` does not → `missing` → load fails.

### Proposed Fix

Make the two computations agree on one definition of the shadowed range. Two shapes:

1. **At write time**: derive `sourceEventSeqs` from the **same** `[startSeq, endSeq]`-to-nodes mapping the loader will use, so both sides compute the range identically;
2. **At read time**: when the read-time range is wider than `sourceEventSeqs` and the extra nodes lie inside the checkpoint's own declared range, report the mismatch instead of failing the load.

### Related

- **@2522669008-zcy's #6348** (chunk-provenance refusal after manual renumbering) — **same validator, different trigger**: that report's mismatch is introduced by an *external repair tool* renumbering `seq` without remapping internal references; this one originates in **the product's own compaction write**. #6348 itself lists `compaction.shadowedRange` among the cross-references a renumbering tool must remap — this report is the native-write instance of that item.
- **@flizzywine's #6212** (Surface replace vs `sourceEventSeqs` validation conflict on `0.1.5-rc.1`) — related validator-facing family; we participate there.
- **#6514** (a compaction/prune span stored by `0.1.1-rc.2` is unaddressable) — sibling in the compaction-span family, reported separately.

*Authorship note: reproduced and measured by me against my own store; root-cause tracing and drafting assisted by AI; verification and publication by me. I have no engineering background — if any technical claim reads wrong, please call it out; I will re-verify against the toolchain and correct.*

*Reported by the **OfferKuai Team** — Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. Website: https://www.offerkuai.com/ | Contact: contact@offerkuai.com*

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 摘要

官方 DSH 自动压缩会写入一个带 `surfaceOp: replace` 的 `user/message` checkpoint，随后该会话**加载失败**：

```
surface replace: sourceEventSeqs must include every shadowed surface node; missing XXXX, YYYY
```

**分歧出在「被遮蔽范围」被算了两次、算法不同**：

- **写的时候**，compaction 按**那一刻的 surface** 枚举被遮蔽节点 —— 这是**它那次选取所能看到的、且在该范围内是完整的**枚举（`dsh-compaction-basic`）；
- **读的时候**，加载器按**重放至今的 surface** 重新算这个范围（`replacementRange(state, op)`），并用**它**来校验事件（`dsh-session`）。

**当这两次计算对该集合的判断不一致时，`missing` 非空、会话即永久不可加载。** 我方实例直接展示了这种不一致：**一个 `seq` 落在该 checkpoint 自己的 `[startSeq, endSeq]` 之内、而 checkpoint 并未引用它**的节点。**至于这两集合为什么不同，我们尚未定位** —— 见最后一条诚实边界。

### 版本现状（@`0.1.5-rc.2` 实读，2026-09-17）

两侧都按当前线实读：

- `dsh-compaction-basic@0.1.5-rc.2`：`shadowedSeqs: nodes.slice(startIdx, endIdx + 1)`（`:547`）**在选取时快照**；两处写侧断言（`:554` 摘要前、`:596` 提交前）**只保证摘要期间 surface 不变**；
- `dsh-session@0.1.5-rc.2`：`planSurfaceEvent`（`:385`）→ `replacementRange(state, surfaceOp)`（`:393`）→ `assertProvenance(event, range.shadowedSeqs)`（`:394`），其判据为 `shadowedSeqs.filter(seq => !sources.has(seq))`（`:299`）。

⇒ **写侧护栏覆盖不到读侧的重新计算。**

*诚实边界：（1）本次是**代码走查**，不是端到端复现——我们**没有**用真实受影响实例在 `0.1.5-rc.2` 上重跑以证明它仍会抛 `missing`；（2）我们**没有**核 `replacementRange` 在「`op.startSeq` 本身已被更早的 replace 删除」时（`indexOf` → `-1`）会怎样；**（3）写时枚举与读时区间为何不同，我们尚未定位。** 未测的候选包括：surface 的位置序 vs `seq` 序（某节点 `seq` 在范围内、位置却不在），以及 checkpoint 写入之后 surface 发生了变化。**我们有的是「不一致」的实例，不是已证的成因。***

### 触发条件

1. 会话含带 `surfaceOp: replace` 的官方 compaction checkpoint；
2. 重放时，该 checkpoint 的 `[startSeq, endSeq]` 覆盖了一个**它自己的 `sourceEventSeqs` 未引用**的节点（我方实例中：该节点的 `seq` 落在这个范围之内）；
3. 重放时，读时范围包含该节点而 `sourceEventSeqs` 不含 → `missing` → 加载失败。

### 建议修复

让两侧对"被遮蔽范围"采用**同一个定义**。两种形态：

1. **写时**：用**加载器将来使用的同一套** `[startSeq, endSeq]` → 节点 映射来推导 `sourceEventSeqs`，使两侧算出的范围一致；
2. **读时**：当读时范围比 `sourceEventSeqs` 更宽、且多出的节点落在该 checkpoint **自己声明的范围之内**时，**报告该不一致，而不是让加载失败**。

### 相关

- **@2522669008-zcy 的 #6348**（手工重编号后 chunk 溯源被拒）—— **同一个校验端、不同触发源**：那篇的不一致来自*外部修复工具*改了 `seq` 却没同步内部引用；本篇来自**产品自身 compaction 的写入**。#6348 自己就把 `compaction.shadowedRange` 列在"重编号工具必须重映射的跨引用"里 —— **本篇正是该项的原生化写实例**。
- **@flizzywine 的 #6212**（`0.1.5-rc.1` 上 Surface replace 与 `sourceEventSeqs` 校验冲突）—— 同一校验端家族；我方在该帖有参与。
- **#6514**（`0.1.1-rc.2` 写入的 compaction/prune 跨度不可寻址）—— compaction 跨度家族的同族，另行报告。

*声明：本次实测与统计由我针对自己的数据完成；根因追查与文稿撰写由 AI 辅助；核验与发布由我本人负责。我没有工程背景 —— 若任何技术表述有误，请直接指出，我会对照工具链重新核实并更正。*

*本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。官网：https://www.offerkuai.com/ | 联系：contact@offerkuai.com*

discussions.title: experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp: only the first Session per Host gets browser tools; later Session create/resume fails
discussions.body:
**Version:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.6-alpha.1 (Windows, `web` profile)
**Mount:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp`

### Symptom

Only the **first** Session in a Host process works. Every later one fails to be created:

```
session create failed: gateway/internal: failed to create session "session-…":
  Error: mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed
```

In the web UI this reads like data loss: clicking a cold Session loads it briefly, then its row disappears from the sidebar with **no client-side error**; `F5` brings it back.

### Cause 1 — launch mode: per-Session tool-name collision

The provider mounts one `mcp-client` per Agent, all with `serverName: "playwright-mcp"` (`dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime/lib/types/mcp.js:94`). The first Agent registers the 24 `mcp__playwright-mcp__*` names; the second collides. The startup attempt is strict:

```js
// @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js:489
const startupOpts = config.failOnStartupError
  ? { ...opts, registrationFailure: "throw" } : opts;
```

and the provider sets `failOnStartupError: true` while awaiting MCP readiness in a **prepended** `agent/created` handler (`mcp.js:129`), so the collision aborts Agent creation instead of degrading.

### Cause 2 — attach mode: blocked-mask path throws

`exclusive` is `true` only for attach (`mcp.js:40`), so later Sessions take the `blocked` branch and skip MCP startup — but then run:

```js
state.mask ??= createScope(ctx, agent);
state.mask.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny: inherited.map(tool => tool.name) });  // mcp.js:64
```

which throws `tools.restrict() requires a scoped context (agent.ctx): a context-global restriction would mask everything`. So attach fails too, just with a different message.

### Evidence

- Browser-independent: default `chromium` and `--executable-path` → Edge 153 reproduce identically.
- `@playwright/mcp` alone is fine: `--browser chromium`, `--browser msedge` and `--cdp-endpoint` all complete `initialize` → `tools/list` (24 tools) → `browser_navigate`; three concurrent instances do not interfere.
- Exactly one success per root-layer generation: after a live `cordis.patch.yml` reload the next Session succeeds, then every later one fails again.
- Same Host, measured: 1 good Session (42 KB log, MCP child spawned with the expected args), then 5 consecutive failed Sessions (0 KB each), on both browsers.

### Suggested direction

Namespace the MCP server per Session (e.g. include the Session id in `serverName`), or make the per-Session tool registration scope-local; and fix the context scope used in `refreshBlockedMasks()`.

discussions.title: [Windows] 托管子进程以 windowsHide: true 启动时失败 (0xC0000142) 并弹出模态错误对话框
discussions.body: [DSH-issue-windowsHide-0xC0000142.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32322846/DSH-issue-windowsHide-0xC0000142.md) ## 环境 - OS: Windows 10.0.19045 (x64) - DSH 核心: `0.1.5-rc.1` - 启动方式: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` + `dsh web --port 3080` - Node: 22.x - 涉及工具: `pwsh` ## 问题描述 在 Windows 上,`dsh-subprocess-local` 以 `windowsHide: true` 启动托管子进程时,子进程无法完成初始化,以退出码 `0xC0000142` (`STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`) 失败。 失败进程会弹出系统级模态对话框: xxx.exe - 应用程序错误 应用程序无法正常启动(0xc0000142)。请单击"确定"关闭应用程序。 同一可执行文件、同一参数,仅把 `windowsHide` 改为 `false` 即稳定成功。**唯一变量是这一个布尔值。** ## 最小复现 ```js const { spawnSync } = require("child_process"); // 失败 spawnSync("cmd.exe", ["/c", "exit"], { stdio: "ignore", windowsHide: true }); // => status 3221225794 (0xC0000142) // 成功 spawnSync("cmd.exe", ["/c", "exit"], { stdio: "ignore", windowsHide: false }); // => status 0

discussions.title: [Bug] Desktop shell: plugin host APIs 403 for the renderer, and shared web-profile plugins never load (patches attached)
discussions.body:
## Environment

* macOS, official source build, unpackaged dev shell: `pnpm run dev:desktop --skip-build`, `DSH_HOME=~/.dsh`, renderer origin `dsh-app://app`.
* Plugin set installed in the shared `profiles/web` profile: `dsh-better-sidebar`, `@goodandready/dsh-time-machine`, `@dsh-market/plugin`, `@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`, `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`, `dsh-persona-memory`, `dsh-plugin-model-proxy`, `dsh-sidebar-title`, `dsh-answer-reviewer`, `dsh-loop-continue`.

Two separate desktop-shell gaps, both found while trying to use the *same* plugin set in the desktop app that already works in the browser UI. Patches are applied locally and working; posting here because `CONTRIBUTING` closes issues and the repo takes Discussions only.

---

## Symptom 1 — plugin host APIs answer **403** for the desktop renderer

Every plugin whose host half fences on browser same-origin signals answers `403` inside the desktop shell, while the identical request works in the browser UI. Concrete case: task-board's agent control plane (its non-idempotent `POST /dsh-task-board/...` calls).

Root cause: the renderer's origin is `dsh-app://app`, so a request the host forwards to the embedded `webServer` still *reads* as cross-origin. The desktop host owns both the renderer and the webServer, so the honest presentation is "same-origin loopback":

```ts
// apps/desktop-host/src/index.ts
function loopbackForwardHeaders(request: Request, port: number): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers(request.headers)
  headers.delete('host')
  const authority = `http://127.0.0.1:${String(port)}`
  headers.set('origin', authority)
  headers.set('sec-fetch-site', 'same-origin')
  return headers
}
```

## Symptom 2 — plugin host routes are unreachable from the shell

`assetHandler` only served the dist bundle plus the connection gateway. But plugin host halves register their routes on the **`webServer` service** (`skill-explorer`, `task-board`, `time-machine`, `market`, …), which the desktop host never consulted, so those routes fell through to the SPA `index.html` (GET) or `405` (everything else).

Patch: forward any non-asset request to `ctx.get('webServer')` and treat `404` as "no plugin route" (fall back to the gateway); non-idempotent methods are proxied too instead of being rejected by the blanket `405`:

```ts
if (request.method !== 'GET' && request.method !== 'HEAD') {
  const proxied = await proxyToWebServer(request)   // 404 => undefined
  if (proxied !== undefined) return proxied
  return new Response(null, { status: 405 })
}
```

For `/api/*` the gateway must stay the fallback, and the connection prefix route answers rejected requests with a plain-text `unauthorized` / `forbidden` marker — that marker is distinguishable from a real plugin response because plugin routes answer JSON (related: #5770, #3186):

```ts
if ((response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) && !(contentType?.includes('application/json') ?? false)) {
  const text = await response.text()
  if (text === 'unauthorized' || text === 'forbidden') return api.fetch(rebuild())
  return new Response(text, { status: response.status, headers: response.headers })
}
```

## Symptom 3 — `dsh-remote-web-ui`'s boot patch makes the in-app renderer hit its LAN gate

That plugin's boot patch rewrites loopback-fenced paths (`/api/*`, `/sidebar/*`, `/git/*`, `/pet/*`) onto its gated `/remote` prefix so a LAN browser can proxy through the desktop's webServer. The desktop renderer runs *inside* this host and is the host owner (`ownsHost`), so no pairing applies — but the rewritten path still arrives at the host. Unwrapping before dispatch fixes it:

```ts
if (url.pathname.startsWith('/remote/')) {
  url.pathname = url.pathname.slice('/remote'.length)
}
```

## Symptom 4 — the dev shell never loads the shared web profile's plugins

The disposable development project links only first-party workspace deps, and the unpackaged dev shell exposes no settings UI to install anything. Meanwhile `DSH_PROFILE` is effectively the *only* channel that reaches family plugins: the host child strips every `DSH_DESKTOP_*` override, and the dev `userData` dir carries no profile-selection state.

Patch (2 parts, in `apps/desktop/scripts/`):

* `dev.ts` — `DSH_PROFILE: process.env.DSH_PROFILE ?? SHARED_WEB_PROFILE_NAME` (`'web'`).
* `development-project.ts` — link the third-party bundles found in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules` into the dev project, merge `dsh.profile.bundles` from the profile manifest, and copy the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
  * `mergeWebProfileManifest()` derives bundles from the manifest and filters `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, so first-party rows keep coming from the workspace build.
  * `WEB_PROFILE_THIRD_PARTY_BUNDLES` is the weak spot: I hardcoded *my* plugin set as a fallback. A maintainer-grade version probably wants either manifest-only derivation or an explicit opt-in list — guidance welcome.

Also `apps/desktop-host/config/desktop.cordis.patch.yml` needs `web-runtime` enabled (`inject: [webServer]`, `openBrowser: false`, `printUrl: false`, `surfaceContext: false`) because plugin rows inject the `webRuntime` service it supplies; `webserver` gets pinned to loopback `127.0.0.1:3199` with `compression: none`.

---

## Verification

With the patches above, in the unpackaged dev shell: task-board's control plane no longer returns 403, and `dsh-better-sidebar` + `@goodandready/dsh-time-machine` behave exactly as in the browser UI (bottom panel renders, toggle shows/hides it, time-machine registers its tab and snapshots the workspace). Checked over CDP against `dsh-app://app/index.html`, plus a full host restart to confirm the fixes are not artifacts of one process.

Diff: 4 files, +183/−6 (`apps/desktop-host/src/index.ts`, `apps/desktop-host/config/desktop.cordis.patch.yml`, `apps/desktop/scripts/dev.ts`, `apps/desktop/scripts/development-project.ts`). Happy to turn it into whatever shape maintainers prefer — or to drop the env-specific pieces.

## Questions

1. Is proxying through `ctx.get('webServer')` inside `desktop-host` the right seam, or should this be a first-class request-level seam (#3186) so each host doesn't re-implement it?
2. For the honest same-origin presentation of forwarded requests — is rewriting `origin`/`sec-fetch-site` acceptable, or would you rather plumb the renderer origin as trusted in the webServer's own config?
3. For Symptom 4, should the dev shell mirror a profile at all, or is "install into the desktop profile" the intended path once it has a settings UI?

---

## 中文摘要

在官方源码构建的**未打包桌面 dev 壳**里发现两处桌面端专属缺口（同一套插件在浏览器 UI 上工作正常）：

1. **插件 host API 全部 403**：渲染进程 origin 是 `dsh-app://app`，宿主转发到内嵌 `webServer` 的请求被插件按跨域信号拒绝；宿主同时拥有渲染进程与 webServer，故按同源 loopback 呈现（改 `origin` + `sec-fetch-site`）。
2. **插件 host 路由根本不可达**：插件 host 半边把路由注册在 `webServer` 服务上，而 `assetHandler` 只看 dist 与 connection gateway → 落到 SPA `index.html` 或 `405`；改为非资产请求先问 `webServer`（404 视为无插件路由再回落 gateway），并放行非幂等方法；`/api/*` 上用「plain-text `unauthorized`/`forbidden`」区分网关拒绝与插件响应。
3. **`dsh-remote-web-ui` 的 boot patch** 把 loopback 路径改写到它带门禁的 `/remote` 前缀；桌面渲染进程本身就是 host owner，故先脱壳再派发。
4. **未打包 dev 壳不加载 `profiles/web` 的第三方插件**，且 `DSH_PROFILE` 是唯一能到达 family 插件的通道（host 子进程会剥离 `DSH_DESKTOP_*`，dev userData 无 profile 选择状态）→ `dev.ts` 设 `DSH_PROFILE ?? 'web'`，`development-project.ts` 镜像 profile 的第三方 bundle + 合并 `dsh.profile.bundles` + 复制 `cordis.patch.yml`；另需在 `desktop.cordis.patch.yml` 启用 `web-runtime` 并固定 `webserver` 到 `127.0.0.1:3199`。

补丁已在本地工作树（4 文件 +183/−6），验证方式为 CDP 检查 `dsh-app://app/index.html` + 完整重启宿主。因为 `CONTRIBUTING` 关闭 issues、只收 Discussions，故发在此处征求方向。

discussions.title: ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION poisons the process until restart — forcing HTTP/1.1 (undici allowH2:false) restores recoverability (measured)
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

After a single TLS-layer failure, every subsequent model request failed in **1–2 ms** with
`ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION` ("The session has been destroyed") and never recovered — only restarting
`dsh` fixed it. Forcing the process to **HTTP/1.1** (undici global dispatcher with `allowH2: false`)
restores recoverability: the underlying connection errors still happen, but each one is now an
ordinary retryable request failure that recovers within the same turn — **no restart, and zero
`ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION` since**.

Measured before/after (same machine, same route, same provider):

| | before | after (~1.1 h observation) |
|---|---|---|
| `ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION` | **24** (continuous, 4 min) | **0** |
| failure shape | 1–2 ms, no DNS/TCP egress (reusing a dead h2 session) | ~0.9–1.2 s — connection is really established, then closed by the peer (`UND_ERR_SOCKET: other side closed`) |
| recoverable? | ❌ no — retries hit the same poisoned session; **restart required** | ✅ yes — retry #1/#2 recovers inside the same turn |
| turns | session paralyzed | **4/4 completed**, no restart |

## Symptom and evidence

Captured at the fetch layer (`error.cause` chains), DeepSeek Harness `0.1.5-rc.2`, Node `v26.8.2`:

```
15:25:06  POST https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/chat/completions
          TypeError: fetch failed
            └─ ... SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:ssl/tls alert bad record mac
          code = ERR_SSL_SSL/TLS_ALERT_BAD_RECORD_MAC        <- trigger

15:25:07 → 15:29:30   (24 consecutive requests)
          TypeError: fetch failed
            └─ The session has been destroyed
          code = ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION   elapsed = 1–2 ms
```

While poisoned, the local tunnel logged **no DNS query and no TCP connection** for those requests —
i.e. the failures were entirely local, consistent with re-use of a destroyed HTTP/2 session rather
than a reconnect. Retries could not help, and raising `retryPolicy.maxRetries` only changed how long
each turn waited before dying.

## Mechanism

undici **enables HTTP/2 by default** — `allowH2 = allowH2 != null ? allowH2 : true`
(`undici/lib/core/connect.js`), ALPN `['http/1.1','h2']`. Against an h2-capable edge an HTTP/2 session
is negotiated; once that session is destroyed (here by a TLS record failure on the wire), the client
keeps re-using it instead of reconnecting, so every later request fails locally.

Note the installed undici is **8.10.2, which already contains** nodejs/undici#5310 ("reset invalid
HTTP/2 sessions") and #5453 ("requeue request on GOAWAY'd session") — `lib/dispatcher/client-h2.js`
has the `ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION` → `resetHttp2Session()` + `requeueUnsentRequest()` path — yet the
session stayed poisoned for 4 minutes here. A standalone reproduction was not achieved: three
self-contained attempts (graceful h2 session destroy, socket destroy between requests, socket destroy
mid-stream) all reconnected correctly on the next request in undici 8.10.2. The production failure
needs the TLS-layer failure to occur on a live h2 connection.

## Mitigation (verified)

Install a global dispatcher that never negotiates h2:

```js
const { Agent, setGlobalDispatcher } = await import('undici')
setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ allowH2: false }))
```

Verification that it takes effect (the same process also uses Node's built-in `fetch`, whose
dispatcher is shared through the undici global symbol):

| dispatcher | measured ALPN |
|---|---|
| default Agent | `HTTP 200  ALPN=["h2"]` |
| `new Agent({ allowH2: false })` | `HTTP 200  ALPN=["http/1.1"]` |

HTTP/1.1 has no session-level state: a broken connection is an ordinary socket error and the next
request opens a fresh connection. We run this as a small local plugin that installs the dispatcher
after `dsh-http-proxy` does, with a guard that skips overriding when a proxy dispatcher is already
installed (so `HTTPS_PROXY` setups are not broken), and logs the before/after dispatcher on every
boot for verification.

## What this does *not* claim

- **The underlying connection closures are not fixed.** After the mitigation the same endpoint still
  saw 18 `UND_ERR_SOCKET: other side closed` events in ~1.1 h (17 of them at ~1 s elapsed: connect +
  TLS, then closed by the peer; one at 17.9 s). Who closes them — the gateway, an intermediary, or the
  local tunnel — is **not determined**; no speculation here.
- **The observation window is short** (~1.1 h of real use at the time of writing; continuing).
  The claim is narrow and falsifiable: *if a poisoned h2 session returns, `ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION`
  will reappear here.* So far it has not.
- The original criterion for "fixed" was **recoverability, not error-freeness**: transient path errors
  are expected on this route; what must never happen again is a session that can only be recovered by
  restarting the process.

## Suggestion for the harness

In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy`'s direct (no-proxy) path, install the agent as
`new undici.Agent({ allowH2: false })`, or reset the dispatcher/connection when a `TRANSPORT` failure
carries `ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION`. That converts a "process is dead until restart" failure into a
single retryable request error — which is what we measured after applying it locally.

## Related

- nodejs/undici#5310 (merged) and #5453 — HTTP/2 resilience fixes already present in 8.10.2.
- github/copilot-cli#3304 — same symptom in another long-running CLI, still open.
- openclaw/clawhub#245 (merged) — same class, fixed by removing `allowH2`.
- earendil-works/pi#4682 — the same error surfacing in another transport; auto-closed.

discussions.title: Bug: reasoningEffort=max burns whole output budget on thinking, yields empty content, turn ends max-tokens forever
discussions.body:
## Symptom

On DeepSeek reasoner models (`reasoningEffort: max`), a single request can spend the **entire** `maxTokens` output budget on internal reasoning tokens and end the turn with an **empty assistant message** (`content: []`) plus a `max-tokens` finish. The user keeps pressing continue and never gets an answer.

Observed in real durable session logs:

| turn | inputTokens | outputTokens | reasoningTokens | message.content | turn/end |
|------|-------------|--------------|-----------------|-----------------|----------|
| 18 | 99,434 | 8,192 | 8,191 | `[]` | `{kind: "max-tokens"}` |
| 19 | 99,438 | 8,192 | 8,192 | `[]` | `{kind: "max-tokens"}` |
| 20 (after compaction) | 14,039 | 8,192 | 8,191 | `[]` | `{kind: "max-tokens"}` |

Key: after compaction input was only ~14k tokens, far below the 262k window — this is NOT context overflow. It is the reasoning budget exhausting the output token ceiling.

## Proposed fix (implemented on a fork branch)

`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts`: when a step ends `max-tokens` with **no produced content** (no text, no tool-call) and the request carried a `reasoningEffort`, auto-downshift the effort one rung (`max -> high -> medium -> low -> off`) and retry the step once. Truncation WITH produced content keeps existing behavior. Recovery is at most one rung per step (no infinite loops).

Branch: `fix/empty-max-tokens-retry` at https://github.com/martin-lee07/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/empty-max-tokens-retry (commit `28ec0f3`)

Includes 4 regression tests (all pass: 421 agent-loop tests green, tsc + oxlint clean).

Since issues/PRs appear disabled on this repo, posting here as a discussion.

discussions.title: [Bug] 桌面端缺少编辑菜单：macOS 上 ⌘C/⌘V/⌘X/⌘A/⌘Z 无响应
discussions.body:
> 说明：本仓库无法提交 Issue 或 PR，因此按 CONTRIBUTING 的指引发到 Discussions。两份报告都来自真实使用，且我已在本地构建上验证了修复。

## Summary

桌面端（Electron 壳）没有注册编辑菜单，因此 macOS 上标准的文本编辑快捷键——⌘C、⌘V、⌘X、⌘A、⌘Z——在应用内无响应。Web UI（`dsh web`）不受影响，因为浏览器自带这些行为。任何需要在 DSH 里粘贴 API Key、粘贴代码片段或复制回答的用户都会遇到。

## Reproduction

1. 复制任意文本到剪贴板：`printf 'PASTE-PROBE' | pbcopy`
2. 打开桌面端，聚焦任意输入框（例如 **设置 → 模型 → API 密钥**）。
3. 按 ⌘V。

为排除「焦点不对」的干扰，用辅助功能接口确认焦点确实在输入框上：

```console
$ osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "DeepSeek Harness" \
    to get value of attribute "AXFocused" of UI element 1 of window 1'
true
```

## Current behavior

在未改动的 `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1` 桌面端构建上实测：

- ⌘V 之后输入框 `value` 仍为空字符串，剪贴板内容不变：

  ```console
  $ pbpaste
  PASTE-PROBE
  ```

  即按键被丢弃，而不是粘贴失败。同机的其他原生应用粘贴同一段文本正常。

由代码可判定、但我没有逐项实测的部分：⌘C/⌘X/⌘A/⌘Z 与输入框右键菜单同样没有处理者。`main.ts` 的模板里不存在 `editMenu` role，而 `Menu.setApplicationMenu()` 会整体替换 Electron 的默认菜单——默认菜单正是这些 accelerator 与右键项的来源。⌘V 不是特例，只是最容易被注意到的那一项。

## Expected behavior

桌面端作为原生 macOS 应用，应提供标准编辑快捷键与右键菜单：⌘C/⌘V/⌘X/⌘A/⌘Z 可用，输入框右键出现剪切/复制/粘贴/全选。

## Cause

`apps/desktop/src/main.ts` 用自定义模板整体替换了默认菜单：

```ts
Menu.setApplicationMenu(Menu.buildFromTemplate([{
  label: process.platform === 'darwin' ? app.name : messages.application,
  submenu: [
    { label: …pluginsMenu…, accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+,', … },
    { label: …checkUpdatesMenu…, … },
    { type: 'separator' },
    { role: 'quit' },
  ],
}]))
```

macOS 上这些快捷键由应用菜单里的 role 分发到 responder chain（`editMenu` role 提供 Undo/Redo/Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All 及其 accelerator）。模板里没有它，默认菜单又已被替换，于是没有对象处理这些按键。右键菜单同理：没有注册 `webContents.on('context-menu')`。

## Fix（已在本地验证）

保持现有应用菜单不变，补回平台编辑菜单：

- 模板追加 `{ role: 'editMenu' }`；
- 为窗口注册 `context-menu`：可编辑区域提供 undo/redo/cut/copy/paste/pasteAndMatchStyle/selectAll，选中文本时提供 copy/selectAll。

重新打包安装后逐项实测通过：

- 菜单栏出现 Edit 菜单（`Apple, DeepSeek Harness, Edit`），「Paste」项可用；
- 真实按键 ⌘V 把剪贴板内容写进了输入框；⌘A 后 ⌘C 可复制；
- 输入框上右键弹出编辑菜单。

由于本仓库不接受外部 PR，我可以把补丁直接贴在讨论里（约 60 行，含测试），或按维护者偏好的其他实现方向调整——例如保留 Electron 默认菜单再增量追加应用条目。请告知倾向。

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1`（tag `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1`，`apps/desktop` 构建的已签名 `.app`）
- Electron 44.0.0，内置 Node 24.17.0
- macOS 26.5.2（build 25F84），Apple Silicon
- 未安装第三方插件，`$DSH_HOME` 为全新目录

discussions.title: [Bug] 桌面端内置 Node 不信任系统证书库：受 TLS 检查/私有 CA 影响的端点请求全部失败
discussions.body:
> 说明：本仓库无法提交 Issue 或 PR，因此按 CONTRIBUTING 的指引发到 Discussions。两份报告都来自真实使用，且我已在本地构建上验证了修复。

## Summary

桌面端的内置 Node 进程按 Node 默认只信任自带根证书，不读取操作系统的信任库。因此在私有网关、企业 TLS 检查代理或内网 CA 环境下，应用内的所有出站 HTTPS（模型推理、账号接口、网页抓取）都会失败，而在同一台机器上用 curl 或浏览器访问同一地址却是正常的。用户看到的是模型请求直接报 `TRANSPORT` 失败，很难自行判断原因。

## Reproduction

1. 在一台受 TLS 检查代理（或私有 CA）影响的机器上运行桌面端。
2. 配置一个经该代理提供服务的模型端点（自定义提供方，或任何走 HTTPS 的网关）。
3. 发送一条消息，或在设置里点「刷新」。

对照三组结果（同一台机器、同一地址、同一时刻）：

```console
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<gateway>/api/v1/settings/public
200
```

浏览器访问同一地址也正常。但桌面端内置 Node：

```console
$ /Applications/<app>.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/node/node -e \
    "fetch('https://<gateway>/api/v1/settings/public').then(r=>console.log(r.status)).catch(e=>console.log('FAIL', e.cause?.code))"
FAIL SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN
```

## Current behavior

- 应用内模型请求失败，会话里记录的是传输层错误，而不是认证或配额错误：

  ```json
  {"kind": "error", "error": {"message": "… request to https://<gateway>/v1 failed", "code": "TRANSPORT"}}
  ```

- 同一个 `node` 二进制加上 `--use-system-ca` 后，同一请求返回正常：

  ```console
  $ .../runtime/node/node --use-system-ca -e "…same fetch…"
  200
  ```
- 也就是说这不是网络不通，而是信任集不同：Node 只用自带根证书，而 curl 与浏览器用系统信任库。

## Expected behavior

桌面端作为 macOS 应用，其出站 HTTPS 应与同机的系统工具遵循同一套信任判断，即信任操作系统的信任库（用户/系统钥匙串中已信任的根证书）。企业代理或私有 CA 环境下的用户应能直接使用，而不必改代码或额外配置环境变量。

## Environment

- dsh：`0.1.6-alpha.1`（tag `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1`，`apps/desktop` 构建的已签名 `.app`）
- Electron：44.0.0，内置 Node：24.17.0（`apps/desktop/.desktop-build/…/runtime/node`）
- macOS：26.5.2（build 25F84），Apple Silicon（arm64）
- 网关证书链：企业代理自签根（`SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN`），该根已安装在系统钥匙串并被系统信任

## Cause and suggested fix

`apps/desktop/src/host-process.ts` 启动内置 Node 时只传了自身参数：

```ts
const child = spawn(this.executable, [
  ...(this.inspectPort === undefined ? [] : [`--inspect=…`]),
  entry,
  this.runtimeDir,
  this.projectDir,
], { … })
```

Node 默认不启用系统 CA（`--use-system-ca` 未开），所以内置进程的信任集与用户系统不一致。由于桌面端的宿主进程承担**全部**出站请求，这一处差异会让所有 HTTPS 路径同时失效。

建议在 `spawn` 参数中加上 `--use-system-ca`：

```ts
const child = spawn(this.executable, [
  ...(this.inspectPort === undefined ? [] : [`--inspect=…`]),
  '--use-system-ca',
  entry,
  this.runtimeDir,
  this.projectDir,
], { … })
```

关于取舍：`--use-system-ca` 会把信任集扩大到操作系统信任的内容（也就是浏览器已经信任的内容）。这会改变信任边界，因此值得明确决定；我认为对桌面应用而言这是正确的默认——用户认为自己机器信任的证书就是这个应用信任的证书。若维护者更希望保持 Node 默认并通过 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 交给用户配置，我也可以按那个方向实现（只是需要文档说明，因为当前报错信息难以让用户定位到这一点）。

由于本仓库不接受外部 PR，我可以把补丁直接贴在讨论里（这是 `spawn` 参数上的一行改动），或按维护者偏好的方向实现——例如保持 Node 默认、改为文档说明 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`。

discussions.title: [移动端] 会话划到底时输入框上浮约 168px：能否让 composer 对"末尾外部流内元素"免疫？
discussions.body:
在 Android WebView 宿主上遇到一个 composer 贴底失效的问题：定位到根因后想请维护者确认，这层防护值不值得做在上游。下面是现象、代码级定位与真机采样数据。 > **English TL;DR** — On an Android WebView host, a *foreign in-flow spacer* injected after `[data-composer-seat]` inside `[data-conversation-scroll]` makes the sticky-bottom composer float by exactly the spacer height when the conversation is scrolled to the end. `position: sticky; bottom: 0` only ever shifts an element **up**; it can never push it **down**, so once the spacer becomes the content tail, the composer parks above the container bottom. ### 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | DSH | `0.1.5-rc.1`（web profile） | | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` | `0.1.5-rc.1` | | 宿主 | Android 17 WebView（DSH Mobile，`com.dshmobile.app`） | | 视口 | 横屏，CSS 约 1090×728（屏幕 2506×1673，DPR ≈ 2.3） | 桌面浏览器端我没能复现（那边没有这个垫片），触发条件看起来与 WebView 宿主注入的 DOM 有关。 ### 复现步骤 1. 打开任意一个已有若干轮历史的会话； 2. 把消息列表**划到最底部**； 3. 输入区（输入卡片 + 底部 `N 轮 … tok/s` 统计行）整体上浮，下方出现一片空白；往回滚一点又贴回底部。 **实际**：划到底时 composer 停在内容末端上方，浮起量 = 其后方流内内容的总高度（本机为 168px）。 **期望**：composer 始终贴在滚动容器底边，不因外部插入的元素而漂移。 ### 定位与根因 输入区是滚动容器的最后一个子元素，用 `sticky; bottom: 0` 贴底 （`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/ConversationRoot.module.css`）： ```css .wSkVaW_root[data-phase=active] .wSkVaW_viewArea{flex:1 0 auto;min-height:auto} .wSkVaW_root[data-phase=active] .wSkVaW_composerSeat{z-index:7;position:sticky;bottom:0} ``` `ConversationRoot` 往滚动容器里只渲染两个子节点： ```jsx
{sessionId !== undefined ? renderSlot("conversation.session", {}) : null}
{composer}
``` 但真机上的滚动容器有**三个**子节点，第三个是无 class 的 `DIV`，高 168px （= `--dsh-composer-height` 152 + 16），且是**参与布局的流内元素**： ``` conversation.session ~ wSkVaW_composerSeat(h152) ~ DIV(h168) ``` 它不在 DSH 的任何包中产生（我搜过 `data-composer-seat` / `data-conversation-scroll` / 所有 `createPortal` / 所有 index 注入点，都不符合），因此判断来自 WebView 宿主的注入 （大概率为键盘预留空间）。 `position: sticky; bottom: 0` 的约束是单向的： ``` 自然位置在容器底边之下 → 被向上拉，贴在底边（正常滚动时的表现） 自然位置已在底边之上 → 不做任何事（sticky 永远不会往下推） ``` 于是设 `trailing` = seat 之后流内内容总高度： ``` scrollTop ≤ max - trailing → 贴底 max - trailing < scrollTop ≤ max → 上浮量 = scrollTop - (max - trailing)，划到底为 trailing ``` 采样数据与该线性关系完全一致（修正量 17 → 34 → 53 → … → 168 递增）。 ### 现场数据（真机采样，多次一致） ``` 滚动容器 clientHeight = 628，底边 y = 728（= 视口底边，容器高度正常） scrollHeight - clientHeight = 5627（max scrollTop） 划到底：scrollTop ≈ 5628 seat 自然位置底边 y = 560 容器底边 y = 728 差值 = 168 ← 正好是那个垫片的高度 ``` ### 影响面 - 所有"输入区 sticky 贴底 + 滚动容器尾部被外部插入流内元素"的宿主都会触发，与 DSH 版本无关： 我对比过 `0.1.5-rc.1` / `0.1.5-rc.2` / `0.1.6-alpha.1`，composer 相关 CSS **内容逐字节相同**， `0.1.6-alpha.1` 的 JS diff 也未见定位相关改动 —— 也就是说升级 DSH 不会解决。 - 视觉后果：划到底时输入区脱离底边、下方留白；因为 seat 与统计行属于同一元素，两者会一起上浮。 ### 建议（上游可选的两条改法） 1. **让"贴底"不依赖"必须是最后一个流内盒子"**：给 seat 加 `margin-bottom: calc(-1 * var(--dsh-composer-trailing, 0px))`， 由脚本测量 seat 之后的流内兄弟高度写入该变量（0 时无副作用）。这属于纯布局修正，滚动不经过 JS。 2. **或把 seat 移出滚动容器**：滚动容器只放消息，seat 作为兄弟节点常驻底部（此时"末尾多出元素"再也影响不到它）。 顺带一个请求：如果 DSH 有官方推荐的"宿主向页面注入元素"的约定/钩子，欢迎在文档里写明， 这样移动端宿主就不必往滚动容器里塞垫片了 —— DSH 的 composer 本身是**流内 sticky**，已经为消息列表预留了高度， 再叠一个 `composer 高度 + 16` 的垫片是重复预留。 ### 附：无 DevTools 时的自查代码 ```js const seat = document.querySelector('[data-composer-seat]'); const sc = seat.closest('[data-conversation-scroll]'); console.log([...sc.children].map(k => `${k.className || k.tagName}:${Math.round(k.getBoundingClientRect().height)}`)); sc.scrollTop = sc.scrollHeight; // 划到底 console.log('seat 高于容器底边', Math.round(sc.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - seat.getBoundingClientRect().bottom), 'px'); ``` ### 附：我方的临时规避（仅作参考，不代表上游方案） 按上面建议 1 做了一个独立插件：测量 seat 之后的流内兄弟高度，写入 CSS 变量并负 margin 抵消； 不删、不改宿主注入的垫片，其键盘预留高度原样保留；垫片不存在时自动休眠。真机验证：划到底贴合、快速甩动不抖。
