discussions.title: [bug] DSH 侧边栏会话列表整体空白：持久化视图快照缺字段导致 sidebar.workspaces slot 崩溃
discussions.body:
**产品**：DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）
**版本**：Web UI 构建 `0.1.5-rc.2-449af19`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1` CLI + `profiles/node_modules` 内 `0.1.5-rc.2` 插件集）
**平台**：Windows 10/11（`node v26.7.0`，Edge）
**严重级**：高（核心导航功能不可用，且不会自愈）
**类型**：客户端状态持久化缺少容错（前端崩溃），非数据损坏

---

## 1. 摘要

升级到 0.1.5-rc.2 后，Web GUI 左侧边栏的**会话/工作区列表整体空白**：既看不到已有会话，也看不到工作区分组或「添加工作区」入口。会话数据本身完好（主机侧可正常枚举、可正常读取），崩溃完全发生在前端。

根因是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 的持久化视图 store 在**浏览器 localStorage 快照不完整**时，水合（rehydrate）以「整体替换」方式覆盖初始状态，使 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 等字段变成 `undefined`；随后 `retainAccountKeys` 对该字段调用 `Object.entries()`，抛出 `TypeError`，`sidebar.workspaces` 这个 slot 组件崩溃被错误边界捕获，整块区域渲染为空。

这既是 **store 水合策略的健壮性缺陷**（上游应修），也是 **slot 内一个 action 缺少空值兜底**的直接触发点。

---

## 2. 现象与复现

### 2.1 现象

1. 打开 `dsh web` 提供的 GUI（例：`http://127.0.0.1:3080`），主对话区正常、可以正常收发消息；
2. 左侧边栏只有外壳（品牌区、新会话按钮、面板图标、底部设置），**中间「工作区 / 会话」区域完全空白**；
3. 页面不会恢复，刷新后依旧空白；
4. 控制台可见明确报错（见 2.3）。

### 2.2 浏览器控制台报错（原文）

```
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries (<anonymous>)
    at retainAccountKeys (client.js:218:1)
    at index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:69359
    at index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:68694
    at produce (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:66201)
    at Object.update (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:68674)
    at a.<computed> [as retainAccountKeys] (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:69348)
    at client.js:2017:1
    at zi (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:24417)
    at bn (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:42760)
client.js:526 slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces': TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries (<anonymous>)
    at retainAccountKeys (client.js:218:1)
    ...
componentDidCatch @ client.js:526
```

即：`slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces'`，崩溃点是 `client.js:218` 的 `retainAccountKeys`。

### 2.3 触发条件

浏览器 localStorage 中持久化的视图快照 `dsh.workspace.view.v5` **缺少** `groupExpansion` / `sessionOrderByAccount` / `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 三者之一，或该字段为 `null`。凡是这类不完整快照（例如被外部工具裁剪过、写入中断留下残片、旧构建写入后被当前构建读取等），每次加载都会稳定复现。

> 注：该快照里目前实际是缺少还是 `null`，可用 2.4 的命令读出确认；两种情形都会触发同一处崩溃。

### 2.4 现场确认命令（在出问题页面的 DevTools Console 执行）

```js
// 1) 看当前快照内容，确认到底缺哪个字段
copy(localStorage.getItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5'));

// 2) 立即恢复（备份后清除该键并刷新；只丢失展开/排序等浏览器本地偏好）
(() => {
  const k = 'dsh.workspace.view.v5';
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(k);
  if (raw) { localStorage.setItem(k + '.bak', raw); localStorage.removeItem(k); }
  location.reload();
})();
```

---

## 3. 根因分析

### 3.1 直接原因：`retainAccountKeys` 未做空值兜底

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace@0.1.5-rc.2` → `lib/client.js`（压缩后行 214-219）：

```js
retainAccountKeys: (d, workspaceKeys) => {
  const retained = new Set(workspaceKeys);
  d.groupExpansion          = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.groupExpansion).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
  d.sessionOrderByAccount   = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
  d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));  // ← :218 抛错
}
```

调用点 `client.js:2017`（WorkspaceBrowser 的 effect，`workspacePhase === 'ready'` 后执行）：

```js
useEffect(() => {
  if (workspacePhase !== 'ready') return;
  actions.retainAccountKeys(['', FLAT_SESSION_ORDER_KEY, ...workspaces.map(w => w.workspaceId)]);
}, [actions.retainAccountKeys, workspacePhase, workspaces]);
```

只要 `d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 为 `undefined`/`null`，`Object.entries` 就抛 `TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object`。

### 3.2 根本原因：持久化 store 的「替换式水合」丢掉了 `init()` 默认值

前端 shell 内联的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`（`dist/assets/index-BKQ_L1z6.js`）里，快照 store 的水合逻辑是：

```js
function createSnapshotStore(initial, options) {
  const api = createStore(() => initial);          // 初始状态含完整默认值
  if (options?.persist) {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(options.persist.name);
    if (raw !== null) api.setState(M6(JSON.parse(raw)), true);   // ← replace = true
    api.subscribe((state) => localStorage.setItem(name, JSON.stringify(state)));
  }
  ...
}
```

而 `M6` 只是 immer 的 `freeze`（`function M6(t){return No(t,!0)}`，`No` 是 `freeze`），**不是 merge**。底层 zustand store 的 `setState` 语义是：

```js
setState: (partial, replace) => {
  const next = typeof partial === 'function' ? partial(state) : partial;
  state = replace ?? (typeof next !== 'object' || next === null)
    ? next                                   // replace === true → 直接替换
    : Object.assign({}, state, next);        // 否则才浅合并
}
```

由于水合传入 `replace = true`，**快照里没有的键不会被 `init()` 的默认值补齐**，于是 `init()` 里明明声明过的 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount: {}` 在运行时是 `undefined`。这是"schema 漂移/残缺快照"场景的通用隐患：任何持久化 store 一旦被旧版本或残缺内容写坏，就会让消费方拿到 `undefined`。

`init()` 本身声明是完整的（同版本 `lib/client.js` 195-203 行）：

```js
init: () => ({
  groupBy: 'workspace',
  orderBy: 'updated',
  groupExpansion: {},
  sessionOrderByAccount: {},
  sessionUpdatedAtByAccount: {},
}),
persist: 'dsh.workspace.view.v5',
```

### 3.3 为什么"整块空白"而不是显示错误

`sidebar.workspaces` 是 `single` 类型的 slot，由 `ui-workspace` 插件注册（`client.js:2794`）。该 slot 的组件在渲染期 effect 中抛错 → 被 slot 错误边界捕获（`slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces'`）→ 该 slot 渲染为空。而这一块正是"工作区/会话浏览区域"（`SidebarRoot` 里的 `renderSlot('sidebar.workspaces', …)`），所以表现为**会话列表整体消失**，外壳仍在。

### 3.4 与版本演进无关

已核对 npm 上 `0.1.3-alpha.2`、`0.1.5-alpha.1/2`、`0.1.5-rc.1`、`0.1.5-rc.2`、`0.1.6-alpha.1` 的 `lib/client.js`：三个字段与 `persist: "dsh.workspace.view.v5"` **在所有版本中都存在**，即本崩溃不是"新增字段未迁移"造成，而是**已有字段在持久化快照中缺失/为 null 时缺少兜底**。

---

## 4. 最小确定性复现（无需浏览器）

附件 `repro-store-crash.mjs` 直接抽取**已发布 bundle 中真实的 `createWorkspaceViewStore` 定义**，配合按 shell 压缩代码逐行对齐复刻的 `createSnapshotStore`/`defineStore`/zustand `setState` 语义，注入不同的 localStorage 快照运行 `retainAccountKeys`：

```
$ node repro-store-crash.mjs
extracted 1342 chars of the shipped store definition
A. no persisted snapshot (fresh install)              -> OK
B. complete snapshot                                  -> OK
C. snapshot missing sessionUpdatedAtByAccount         -> THREW TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
D. snapshot with sessionUpdatedAtByAccount: null      -> THREW TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
E. snapshot missing groupExpansion                    -> THREW TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
F. snapshot missing sessionOrderByAccount             -> THREW TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object

4 scenario(s) reproduced the sidebar crash
```

> 注：脚本默认读取**已打过本地补丁**的 `lib/client.js`，因此在报告作者的机器上会显示 0 崩溃（这本身也是补丁生效的回归证明）。要在**未打补丁**的原始 bundle 上看到崩溃，请指向随包备份或未修改的安装：
>
> ```powershell
> $env:DSH_WORKSPACE_CLIENT='C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-workspace\lib\client.js.orig-backup'
> node repro-sidebar-crash.mjs
> ```
>
> 预期输出：场景 C/D/E/F 全部 `THREW TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object`。

复现命令（PowerShell，Windows）：

```powershell
# 把附件 repro-store-crash.mjs 放到任意目录，改脚本内的 bundle 路径为你的安装路径后：
node repro-store-crash.mjs
```

脚本内默认读取：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-workspace\lib\client.js`

---

## 5. 建议修复

### 5.1 上游（推荐，两处）

**(a) `packages/client/store`：水合时以 `init()` 默认值兜底**（治本，消除所有 store 的同类隐患）

```ts
// snapshot store：把初始状态作为默认层，快照覆盖其上，而不是整体替换
function rehydrate(store, name) {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(name);
  if (raw === null) return;
  store.setState({ ...store.getInitialState(), ...JSON.parse(raw) }, true);
}
```

**(b) `packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/stores.ts`：action 内对三个字段做空值兜底**（防御性，成本极低）

```diff
  retainAccountKeys: (d, workspaceKeys) => {
    const retained = new Set(workspaceKeys);
-   d.groupExpansion = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.groupExpansion).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
-   d.sessionOrderByAccount = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
-   d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
+   d.groupExpansion = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.groupExpansion ?? {}).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
+   d.sessionOrderByAccount = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount ?? {}).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
+   d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount ?? {}).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));
  },
```

配套建议（防同类复发）：

* `syncSessionOrderAccount` 同样写入这两张表，可在写入前 `??=` 初始化；
* 为 slot 组件建议增加"渲染期异常不应清空整个 slot"的降级路径（当前行为是整块消失，用户无从得知原因）；
* 若快照 schema 有变，`persist` 键升版（`v5` → `v6`）或在水合时校验字段集合，比静默替换更安全。

### 5.2 本地临时修补（已验证可用）

本次已在安装目录打上等价补丁（升级 `dsh` 后会被覆盖）：

| 文件 | 修改 |
|---|---|
| `.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js` | 三处 `Object.entries(d.xxx)` → `Object.entries(d.xxx ?? {})` |
| `.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-*.js` | 水合 `t.setState(M6(JSON.parse(i)),!0)` → `t.setState(M6(Object.assign({},gc(),JSON.parse(i))),!0)`（`gc` 即该文件内的 `getInitialState`） |

验证结果：`node --check` 对两文件均通过；复现脚本 6 个场景（含缺失/为 null 的三种字段）由 4 个崩溃降为 **0 个崩溃**；`retainAccountKeys` 全部返回 OK，快照缺失字段被 `init()` 默认值补齐。

回滚方式：同目录保留有 `*.orig-backup` 原文件，覆盖即可。

---

## 6. 影响范围

* 所有使用 Web 表面（`dsh --profile web`）且 localStorage 中 `dsh.workspace.view.v5` 不完整的用户；
* 失效功能：会话列表浏览、工作区分组、会话搜索入口、`openSession` 导航（均挂在 `sidebar.workspaces` 区域）；
* 会话数据、日志、格式迁移、`session/list` 主机接口均**不受影响**（实测主机侧 6 个会话全部可枚举、可 stat、可解析，含 v0 命名的历史会话）；
* 该故障**不会自愈**，必须修代码或清 localStorage。

---

## 7. 验证过的"不是这些原因"

为避免社区重复排查，以下均已实测排除：

1. **会话文件损坏/格式不支持** —— 直接用已安装的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl@0.1.5-rc.2` 枚举 `.dsh/sessions`，6 个会话（含 `session.jsonl.zstd` 的 v0 历史会话）全部 `LIST OK`，`stat` 正常；
2. **工作区记录丢失** —— `.dsh/storages/workspace.json` 中两个工作区、全部 `sessionIds` 完整，`archivedSessionIds` 为空；
3. **插件未加载/配置缺失** —— `dsh --dump-config --profile web` 组合树正常，`ui-workspace`、`session-query-sqlite`（`openAt: never`）、`session-controller` 等行均在位；
4. **前端资源 404** —— `index.html` 引用的 `index-BKQ_L1z6.js` / `vendor-*.js` 与磁盘文件名一致，`/plugins/...` 路由按 `rev` 精确匹配属预期行为。

---

## 8. 环境明细

```
dsh CLI            : @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1
profile 插件       : @deepseek-ai/* 0.1.5-rc.2
Web 构建           : 0.1.5-rc.2-449af19
                 (client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js localBuildVersion())
前端资源           : dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-BKQ_L1z6.js
崩溃文件           : dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js:218 (retainAccountKeys)
持久化键           : localStorage["dsh.workspace.view.v5"]
Node / OS          : node v26.7.0 / Windows (Edge)
```

discussions.title: DSH Desktop (Windows)：workspace-write 模式下 `pwsh` 工具完全不可用
discussions.body:
# DSH Desktop (Windows)：workspace-write 模式下 `pwsh` 工具完全不可用

> 受限令牌 + Electron 托管 runner 的组合，使被沙箱化的控制台子进程在 DLL 初始化阶段直接死亡
> （`0xC0000142` / `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`），宿主日志无任何记录。

- **报告类型**：缺陷（Defect）
- **严重程度**：高 —— 默认文件策略下 agent 无法执行任何 shell 命令
- **平台**：Windows x64（DSH Desktop 版）
- **状态**：已确定性复现；根因已定位到「runner 宿主进程」与「受限令牌模式」的组合

---

## 1. 环境

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop | `2.0.10`（`dsh-plugin-desktop`） |
| dsh 内核 | `0.1.5-rc.2` |
| 沙箱后端 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.1.5-rc.2`（依赖 `koffi ^3.1.0`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process@0.1.5-rc.2`） |
| Electron 内置 Node | `v24.18.1`（宿主日志头部） |
| 复现脚本所用 Node | `v24.21.0` |
| Windows 内部版本号 | **（请运行 `winver` 填写，例如 Windows 11 23H2 / 22631.4169）** |
| 工作区 | `<workspace 路径>`（非系统盘） |
| 宿主进程权限 | 管理员（`whoami` = `<machine>\<user>`，`IsInRole(Administrators)` = True）。**已用同样提权的对照排除此项**（见 §4 第 5、6 组） |
| PowerShell 7 | 未安装 → `pwshPath` 回退到 `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`（5.1） |
| 会话文件策略 | `workspace-write`（出厂默认） |
| profile | 桌面版默认 profile，`cordis.patch.yml` 无任何 pwsh/permission 相关改动 |

---

## 2. 现象

文件策略为 `workspace-write` 时，`pwsh` 工具的**每一次**调用都返回：

```
(no output)
[exit code: 3221225794]
```

- `3221225794` = `0xC0000142` = `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`：进程在 DLL 初始化阶段就退出，**命令一行都没执行**。
- 连 `echo hello` 这种最简命令也一样。
- **宿主机日志零记录**：对 `%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs` 全量检索 `windows-acl-run`、`0xC0000142`、`STATUS_DLL` **无任何命中**。runner 只是把子进程的退出码原样回传（`runner.js` 的 `return (await sandbox.spawn(...).wait()).exitCode`），子进程崩溃不产生 stderr、不产生日志 —— 诊断信息完全缺失，这是本缺陷可观测性上的第二个问题。

切到 `danger-full-access` 后同一条命令立刻正常（实测两次），证明问题**只**出在沙箱化路径。

---

## 3. 最小复现

脚本只**读取**安装目录、**只**需要一个已存在的临时目录，**不修改**任何 profile / 配置 / ACL 之外的持久状态（standalone 模式下临时授权会在退出时撤销）。

保存为 `repro-acl-electron-pwsh.js`，执行：`node repro-acl-electron-pwsh.js <一个已存在的临时目录> [工作区目录]`

```js
// repro-acl-electron-pwsh.js
// 复现：同一 ACL 受限令牌 runner，用 node 与 Electron 两种宿主启动，各跑 read-only / workspace-write。
const { spawnSync } = require("node:child_process");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");

const APP    = "C:\\path\\to\\DSH Desktop\\resources\\app";       // 按实际安装路径修改
const EXE    = "C:\\path\\to\\DSH Desktop\\DSH Desktop.exe";     // 同上
const TRAMP  = path.join(APP, "lib", "windows-acl-runner.js");    // 桌面版 Node 模式 trampoline
const RUNNER = path.join(APP, "node_modules", "@deepseek-ai",
                 "dsh-sandbox-windows-acl", "lib", "runner.js");
const WS  = process.argv[3] || process.cwd();   // 工作区（须存在）
const TMP = process.argv[2];                    // 临时根目录（须存在，且不在工作区内）

// 用 runner 自己的导出计算 capability SID，复刻宿主 seam-managed 调用形态
const MOD = "file:///" + path.join(APP, "node_modules", "@deepseek-ai",
              "dsh-sandbox-windows-acl", "lib", "types-DuU3lSVe.js").replace(/\\/g, "/");

function show(label, r) {
  const code = r.status === null ? "null" : `${r.status} (0x${(r.status >>> 0).toString(16)})`;
  console.log(`${label}: status=${code} signal=${r.signal}`);
}

async function main() {
  const mod = await import(MOD);
  const writeSid = mod.r(WS);      // workspaceWriteSid(workspace)
  const tempSid  = mod.n(TMP);     // tempWriteSid(temp)

  const shell = ["--", "powershell.exe", "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive",
                 "-Command", "echo OK"];
  const base  = ["--workspace", WS, "--temp", TMP];

  const cases = [
    ["node     standalone  read-only            ", process.execPath, false,
      [...base, "--mode", "read-only"]],
    ["node     standalone  workspace-write      ", process.execPath, false,
      [...base, "--mode", "workspace-write"]],
    ["node     seam-managed workspace-write     ", process.execPath, false,
      [...base, "--mode", "workspace-write", "--write-sid", writeSid, "--temp-write-sid", tempSid]],
    ["electron standalone  read-only            ", EXE, true,
      [...base, "--mode", "read-only"]],
    ["electron standalone  workspace-write      ", EXE, true,
      [...base, "--mode", "workspace-write"]],
    ["electron seam-managed workspace-write     ", EXE, true,
      [...base, "--mode", "workspace-write", "--write-sid", writeSid, "--temp-write-sid", tempSid]],
  ];

  for (const [label, exe, electron, runnerArgs] of cases) {
    const args = [TRAMP, RUNNER, ...runnerArgs, ...shell];
    const env  = electron ? { ...process.env, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1" } : process.env;
    console.log("--- " + label.trim());
    show("    ", spawnSync(exe, args, { stdio: "inherit", env }));
  }
}
main();
```

---

## 4. 实测结果

| # | runner 宿主 | 沙箱模式 | seam-managed | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `node` | `read-only` | 否 | ✅ `0` |
| 2 | `node` | `workspace-write` | 否 | ✅ `0` |
| 3 | `node` | `workspace-write` | 是 | ✅ `0` |
| 4 | **Electron**（`DSH Desktop.exe`） | `read-only` | 否 | ✅ `0` |
| 5 | **Electron** | **`workspace-write`** | 否 | ❌ **`0xC0000142`** |
| 6 | **Electron** | **`workspace-write`** | 是 | ❌ **`0xC0000142`** |

对照结论（全部为同机、同账户、同提权状态，唯一变量是宿主与模式）：

- 同一份 runner、同一个受限令牌构造代码，**换成 `node` 启动就全部正常** → 不是沙箱实现逻辑本身坏了；
- Electron 宿主下 **`read-only` 正常** → 不是「Electron 不能跑受限子进程」这么笼统；
- 失败只出现在 **Electron × `workspace-write`** 这一组合，且与控制台无关（`read-only` 同样无控制台却正常）。

---

## 5. 分析（已确认 / 推断分开标注）

**已确认**

1. 桌面版把 runner 的启动方式换成了 Electron 自身（`resources/app/lib/windows-pwsh-sandbox.js:33-76`）：
   argv 变成 `[process.execPath, windows-acl-runner.js, upstreamRunner, ...]`，并注入
   `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`。
2. `read-only` 与 `workspace-write` 的差别只在受限令牌的可写 capability（`lib/types-DuU3lSVe.js`）：

   - restricting list：`read-only` = `[logonSid, EVERYONE]`；
     `workspace-write` = `[logonSid, EVERYONE, workspaceSid, tempSid]`；
   - 默认 DACL 授权：`setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(token, tempWriteSidPtr ?? writeSidPtr ?? worldSid)`
     —— 于是 `workspace-write` 把 **capability SID（S-1-4-…）** 写进令牌默认 DACL，而 `read-only` 写的是 **EVERYONE**。
3. 该文件自身的注释已经记录过同类失败（`0xC0000142`、以及 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`/`CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` 的边界），说明这是已知的脆弱面，但**本报告的组合不在既有注释覆盖范围内**（子进程以继承方式 spawn，且 `node` 宿主完全正常）。
4. 基线故障在宿主日志中**完全无记录**（见 §2），`runner.js` 只回传子进程退出码。

**推断（待维护者确认）**

Electron 主进程的令牌（完整性级别 / 特权集 / 所属 JOB 对象 / 默认 DACL）与 node 存在差异；当受限令牌的默认 DACL 被替换为 capability SID 时，Electron 宿主下的控制台子系统子进程无法完成 DLL 初始化，而 node 宿主下可以。read-only 之所以正常，可能正是因为它沿用了 EVERYONE 这一"人人都能访问"的默认 DACL。

**建议的排查/修复方向**

1. 对比 `node.exe` 与 `DSH Desktop.exe` 作为 runner 宿主时的进程令牌差异（`TokenDefaultDacl`/`TokenIntegrityLevel`/受限 SID 集/JOB 归属），定位 `workspace-write` 下子进程 DLL init 失败的确切 API 失败点；
2. 是否可为 runner 选择宿主：在 Electron 环境下优先用一个真正的 Node 可执行文件启动 runner，或在能力探测失败时降级/回退；
3. 补齐可观测性：runner 侧在子进程异常退出（尤其 `0xC0000142`）时输出诊断（例如 `windows-acl-run: child died before init, mode=…, sid=…`），并入 `RUNNER_FAILURE_RULES`；
4. 文档层面明确：Windows 默认组合下 `workspace-write` 目前不可用，唯一可用的临时手段是 `danger-full-access`。

---

## 6. 同一次调查中发现的两个关联问题（附证据，供参考）

### 6.1 非沙箱执行器无法替换（组合硬门槛）

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets/lib/index.js:109`：

```js
if (ctx.shell.sandboxMode === void 0) throw new Error(
  "permission: the mounted bash executor does not confine (no sandboxMode) — " +
  "presets bundle a sandbox mode, so composing this plugin over an unconfined executor is a misconfiguration");
```

把一个不设沙箱的执行器（如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-local`）挂成 `ctx.shell` 时，**整棵插件树加载失败、DSH 无法启动**（实测报错原文见 §7）。这意味着：

- 用户**无法**用「非沙箱 shell + 保留 `sandbox-policy`/`fs-sandbox` 文件边界」这种组合绕过本缺陷；
- 若同时挂两个执行器，还会得到 `service "shell" has been registered at <PwshLocalExecutor>`（见 §7）。

建议：允许无 confined executor 时伴随 `sandbox-policy` 一起降级（或给出明确的配置指引），而不是直接 fail 掉整棵插件树。

### 6.2 Cygwin/MSYS2 系 shell 在受限令牌下无法启动

用社区插件 `dsh-gitbash-shell` 的机制（继承 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox`，仅把内层 argv 换成 `bash.exe -c`）实测 Git for Windows 的 `bash.exe`（`<Git 安装目录>\bin\bash.exe`）：

| runner 宿主 | 模式 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electron | `workspace-write` | ❌ `0xC0000142` |
| Electron | **`read-only`** | ❌ `0xC0000142` |
| **`node`** | `workspace-write` | ❌ `0xC0000142` |

bash 自身给出的根因：

```
cygheap_user::init: NtSetInformationToken (TokenDefaultDacl), 0xC0000022
*** fatal error - couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5
```

`0xC0000022` = `STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED`。Cygwin 初始化时需要**写自己进程令牌的默认 DACL**并创建 signal pipe，`WRITE_RESTRICTED` 令牌直接拒绝 —— 注意这里 **`read-only` 也失败、换 `node` 宿主也失败**，说明它与 §5 的 Electron 组合问题是**两个独立的失败**。

结论：在当前令牌方案下，**`dsh-bash-sandbox` 家族在 Windows 上不可能工作**。若官方希望支持 Git Bash / MSYS2 工具链（该社区插件方向），这是必须先解决的前置问题。

---

## 7. 附：本次调查中产生过的宿主日志证据

`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\*.log`（均为尝试"替换执行器"期间的组合错误，**不是**基线缺陷的日志）：

```
[E] [permission-preset-service] Error: permission: the mounted bash executor does not confine
    (no sandboxMode) — presets bundle a sandbox mode, so composing this plugin over an
    unconfined executor is a misconfiguration
    at new PermissionPresetService (.../dsh-permission-presets/lib/index.js:109:47)

[E] [desktop-windows-pwsh-sandbox] Error: service "shell" has been registered at <PwshLocalExecutor>
    at new PwshLocalExecutor (.../dsh-pwsh-local/lib/index.js:223:3)
    at new SandboxPwshExecutor (.../dsh-pwsh-sandbox/lib/index.js:133:3)
    at new DesktopWindowsPwshSandbox (.../app/lib/windows-pwsh-sandbox.js:58:3)
```

（§4 表格所依据的复现脚本运行时，宿主日志**没有**新增任何条目。）

---

## 8. 影响与临时绕行

| | |
| --- | --- |
| 影响面 | Windows 桌面版**默认**配置（`workspace-write`）下，`pwsh` 工具 100% 不可用 → agent 无法运行任何 shell 命令（构建、测试、git 等全部不可用） |
| 临时绕行 | 权限预设切到 `danger-full-access`（`/permission danger-full-access` 或界面权限选择器）。实测可用，但会同时放弃 shell 与文件工具的工作区写入边界 |
| 不可行的绕行 | ① 换非沙箱执行器（被 §6.1 的门槛拦住）；② 换 Git Bash 执行器（被 §6.2 拦住） |

discussions.title: Web UI composer collapses to 0×0 when Chrome auto-translate is active and Backspace is pressed
discussions.body:
Environment

DSH: 0.1.0-rc.7 (Windows)
Web GUI served by dsh web at 
http://127.0.0.1:3080/
Browser: Chrome, page auto-translated to Chinese (Chrome's built-in Google Translate; reproduces with translation extensions too)
OS: Windows
Summary With Chrome's auto-translate enabled on the DSH Web GUI, pressing <kbd>Backspace</kbd> in the message composer makes the input box collapse to zero width and zero height, leaving the composer unusable until the page is reloaded (or translation is turned off).

Steps to reproduce

Open the DSH Web GUI in Chrome.
Let Chrome translate the page to Chinese (right-click → Translate to Chinese, or accept the translate bubble).
Click into the composer and type any text.
Press <kbd>Backspace</kbd> to delete a character.
Observe the composer input area.
Expected The character before the caret is deleted; the composer keeps its normal width and content-driven height.

Actual The input box's width and height become 0. The composer area is no longer visible/typable. (DevTools box model shows 0 × 0 for the composer input element.) Turning translation off / reloading restores it.

discussions.title: A provider can truncate a response mid-stream and still send finish=stop — mapStopReason() records the turn as completed when content is non-empty but usage is 0/0/0
discussions.body:
## Summary

A provider can **truncate a response mid-stream and still signal a clean completion**. When it does, DSH records the turn as `completed` and the assistant's half-finished message is treated as a finished answer. The existing guard in `mapStopReason()` only catches the fully-empty case, so a truncated-but-non-empty response slips through silently.

Filed as a Discussion per CONTRIBUTING (issues/PRs are closed on this repo).

## Observed behavior

In a real durable session, the final step of a turn ended like this:

```
15:31:31.661  block-start (reasoning)
15:32:13.207  block-end          (+41.5s)
15:32:13.207  text-chunks (1)
15:32:13.208  usage    { inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, totalTokens: 0 }
15:32:13.208  finish   reason={"kind":"stop"}  stopReason="stop"
```

Then:

```
turn/end  {"turn": 1, "reason": {"kind": "completed"}}
```

The user-visible result: my reply stopped in the middle of a sentence (`"The spawn in runner-launch has "` — literally trailing off mid-clause). The system considered the turn **successfully completed**, so there was no retry and no error surfaced. The only reason I could explain it afterwards was by reading the journal.

## Why the existing guard doesn't catch it

`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts` — `mapStopReason()` (line ~208):

```js
case "stop":
  if (message.content.length === 0) return {
    kind: "error",
    failure: { message: `model "${message.model}" returned a completed response with no content`, code: EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE }
  };
  return { kind: "stop" };   // ← any non-empty content is accepted as a clean stop
```

The guard is `content.length === 0`. In this incident the step carried **1033 characters** of reasoning plus **1033 characters** of text (the text block was a duplicate of the reasoning), so `content.length !== 0` and the response was accepted as a legitimate `stop`.

## The discriminating signal: zero usage

Across all **57 steps** of that turn, this was the **only** step reporting `usage = 0/0/0`:

| | step 56 | step 57 (terminal) |
|---|---|---|
| usage (in/out/total) | 3365 / 1574 / 150859 | **0 / 0 / 0** |
| finish reason | `{"kind":"tool-calls"}` | `{"kind":"stop"}` |
| stopReason | `toolUse` | `stop` |
| blocks | reasoning, text, tool-call, tool-call | reasoning, text |

Steps 1–56 all carried non-zero usage (thousands to 226k). A genuinely completed generation cannot report zero tokens in and zero out. Compare the other two completed turns in the same session, whose terminal steps had normal accounting:

| turn | terminal step | usage (in/out/total) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 57 | **0 / 0 / 0** ← truncated |
| 2 | 58 | 444 / 905 / 227653 |
| 3 | 16 | 139 / 664 / 246435 |

## Contributing factor: a flaky relay

The provider route (`deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` via a third-party OpenAI-compatible relay) was returning **502 with no body** earlier in the same turn:

```
turn=1 step=10 retry=1 :: OpenAI API error (502): 502 status code (no body)
turn=1 step=11 retry=1 :: 502
turn=1 step=11 retry=2 :: 502
turn=1 step=13 retry=1 :: 502
```

Those were retried and recovered (`SERVER` is retryable by default). The terminal truncation is the same infrastructure degrading, but it arrives as a *successful* stream with a fabricated terminal event, so the retry policy never engages — retry covers failed *requests*, not truncated-but-"successful" *responses*.

## Relationship to existing discussions

This is **adjacent to but distinct from #6743** (which is excellent and I read carefully before filing):

| | #6743 item 2 | This report |
|---|---|---|
| content | **empty** | **non-empty but cut mid-sentence** |
| current mapping | `EMPTY_RESPONSE` (mislabeled as model behavior) | `{kind:"stop"}` → turn `completed` |
| requested change | relabel to infra/transport | **detect** and treat as retryable failure |

#6743 asks to relabel the empty case. My case is the gap *next to* it: the guard is keyed on emptiness, so a truncated response that produced *some* content is indistinguishable from a clean finish and never even reaches `EMPTY_RESPONSE`.

Also related, though about `length` truncation rather than a fabricated `stop`: #2143, #1703, #1263 (all `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE` after `length` truncation), and #6918 (client discards already-streamed body when the server drops). None of these covers "`stop` + non-empty + zero usage".

## Proposed approach

Treat a `stop` with zero usage as a transport fault rather than a model outcome:

1. In `mapStopReason()`, extend the `stop` case: if `content.length === 0` **or** the usage is all-zero (`inputTokens === 0 && outputTokens === 0`), map to an error.
2. Classify it as `SERVER` (or a dedicated code such as `TRUNCATED_RESPONSE`) so the existing `dsh-llm-retry` policy retries it automatically — `SERVER` is already in the default `retryableCodes`.
3. Keep a one-line human message that names the real cause, e.g. `"provider ended the stream with zero usage — response was likely truncated, not completed"`.

This is deliberately narrow: it only fires on the combination (`stop` + zero usage), so it cannot affect normal completions, and since usage totals are already recorded per step it needs no new bookkeeping.

A secondary, complementary idea: when a terminal step's finish is `stop` and neither text nor a tool call ended on a sentence/pre-block boundary, that is suspicious — but I'd treat that as much weaker evidence than the zero-usage signal and would not gate on it.

## Environment

- DSH: DSH Desktop 2.0.10 (also reproducible against the npm packages `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.1.5-rc.2`)
- OS: Windows 11 10.0.26200
- Provider: OpenAI-compatible third-party relay (`openai-responses` API), model `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`
- Relevant config: `retryPolicy: { mode: normal, maxRetries: 5, retryableCodes: [EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT] }`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300000`

I can provide a redacted `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` extract with the exact step-57 records (stream chunks, `usage`, `finish`, `turn/end`) if that's useful.

## Impact

This is worse than it first looks. A half-sentence is obvious, but the same mapping applies to **any** long turn: if the relay truncates while the model is mid-way through editing files or running a multi-step task, the turn is recorded as `completed`, no retry happens, and the work silently stops halfway with the agent believing it finished. In this session the truncation was cosmetically obvious; on a code-editing turn it would not be.

Thanks for the harness — the append-only journal is what made this diagnosable at all.

discussions.title: [Bug Report] 会话可「无归属」落盘 + 工作区记账被并发静默回滚：55% 的会话在 UI 中不可见且无法恢复
discussions.body:
**报告类型**：缺陷（Defect）
**严重程度**：高 —— 用户视角等同「会话被弄丢了」；会话日志完好，但 UI 中永久不可见，且无任何恢复入口
**状态**：本机数据已完整量化；发现一为确定性（单实例可复现），发现二为高置信度（结构证据充分，未端到端复现）
**版本**：`0.1.5-rc.2`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`、`dsh-base`、`dsh-workspace`、`dsh-api-session-controller`、`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`、`dsh-storage-json` 同版本）
**平台**：macOS 15.6 arm64 ／ Node v22.23.2 ／ npm 全局安装 ／ `DSH_HOME=<HOME>/.dsh`

## 1. 现象

- 侧栏里某个工作区的会话整批消失，或「这个目录我明明用过却一个会话都没有」；重启宿主也不恢复。
- 会话日志仍在 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<cwd slug>/<session-id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`，可正常解压、内容完整。
- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json` 的 `sessionIds` 不含这些会话；而 `WorkspaceEntity.sessionIds`
  按 canonical cwd 过滤（`dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:102-103`），未记账的会话在侧栏 / 会话列表 /
  搜索面板一律不可见。
- 具体案例（本机某个业务工作区，别名 `proj-8`）：磁盘 2 条会话、记账 1 条。丢失的是
  `session-ec9f3585…`（2026-09-17T05:50:39.989Z 创建、11 轮、1.4 MB）。该工作区的注册记录
  `createdAt = 2026-09-17T08:17:42.775Z`，记录里唯一的会话 `session-6307b366…`
  `createdAt = 08:17:42.856Z`：注册是这次新建会话时才出现的，旧会话被留在外面。

## 2. 影响量化（本机实测）

| 指标 | 数值 |
|---|---|
| 磁盘上的会话日志 | **437** |
| `workspace.json` 记账的会话 | **196** |
| **UI 中不可见的会话** | **241（55 %）** |
| 磁盘上的工作区目录 | **44** |
| `workspace.json` 中的工作区注册 | **10**（34 个目录完全没有注册） |
| 丢失时间跨度 | 2026-08-14 ~ 2026-09-17（持续发生，含当天新建的会话） |

按目录样例（`proj-1` 64 条、`proj-2` 19 条、`proj-3` 9 条、`proj-4` 8 条、`proj-5` 7 条、`proj-6` 7 条、
`proj-7` 3 条、`proj-8` 1 条……），完整分布见附录 C。

## 3. 根因

### 3.1 会话可以「无归属」地落盘（确定性，单实例可复现）

1. `session.create` **仅当请求带 `workspaceId`** 时才挂载到工作区：
   `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/commands.js:110-117`。
2. 请求允许「只给 cwd」甚至「什么都不给」：
   `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/types.d.ts:253-258`（`workspaceId?` / `cwd?` / `sessionId?`）。
3. 什么都不给时落在**宿主进程的 `process.cwd()`**：
   `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js:2729`
   → `this.commands = new SessionCommandController(ctx, this.agents, process.cwd())`；
   `create` 里 `const cwd = workspace?.path ?? request.cwd ?? this.defaultCwd`（`commands.js:102`）。
4. 客户端确实存在「裸 create」路径。例如第三方插件 `@hyzyn/dsh-search` 的「新建会话」兜底就是
   `const id = await sessions.create()`（该插件自带注释：优先走 GUI 服务、其次点侧栏按钮、最后才自己建）。

**本机证据**：`<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<host-cwd slug>/` 下有两条 0 KB 会话，cwd 恰好等于 web 宿主的
`process.cwd()`，且没有任何工作区注册：

```
<cwd> | session-1b515d04… | 2026-09-12T08:38:22.695Z | accounted=false | 0KB
<cwd> | session-a99bab14… | 2026-09-12T08:38:23.336Z | accounted=false | 0KB
```

> 期望：工作区归属应当由**宿主**保证（`create` 在 `workspaceId` 缺省时按最终解析出的 cwd
> `resolveByPath()`，必要时创建注册），而不是留给每个客户端自行遵守。

### 3.2 已入账的记账会被第二个宿主静默回滚（高置信度）

1. 存储根与 profile 无关：`dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml:151` → `root: !!js dshHomePath('storages')`。
   全机只有一个 `workspace.json`（`find <DSH_HOME> -name 'workspace.json*'`）。
2. `workspace` 域未声明 layout（`dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:248-260`），按
   `dsh-storage-json/lib/index.js:575` 落到 `single` 布局 → 整个域（global + 全部 records）
   写在**一个文件**里，任何一次变更都重写全量。
3. 写入协议是「内存快照 → 临时文件 → `rename()` 覆盖」（`dsh-storage-json/lib/index.js:26-38`），
   模块注释（`:8-16`）写着：

   > a unit file has exactly one writer per process and last-write-wins is correct

   即没有锁、没有 revision 校验、没有冲突检测；`dsh-storage-domain/lib/index.js:316-320` 的
   「single-open per domain name」只覆盖**单进程内**。
4. 本机**同时运行两个宿主且共用 `DSH_HOME`**（`lsof` 证据见附录 A）：
   profile `web` → `*:3080`，profile `test` → `127.0.0.1:3082`。

于是：宿主 A 把 `workspace.json` 读进内存 → 宿主 B 新增注册/挂载会话并写回 → A 之后任意一次 workspace
变更用陈旧快照覆盖 → B 的记账静默消失（反之亦然）。会话日志走的是另一套「每会话独立文件 + 追加写 +
no-clobber」协议（`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:2858-2888`），所以**只有记账丢**。

`dsh-storage-json/README.md:12` 只泛泛建议「写量大或高并发时选 SQLite」，没有任何地方提示
「同一 `DSH_HOME` 并发运行多个宿主会丢记账」，宿主也不做检测 / 拒绝 / 只读降级。

### 3.3 损坏不可观测、不可恢复

- **历史重建是一次性的**：`if (!this.state.initialized) { ...bootstrap... }`
  （`dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:336-353`，实现自 `:595`）。`initialized` 一旦为 `true`，
  之后每次启动只做 `replaceHeaderIndex`，**永远不再收编「磁盘有日志但没有记账」的会话**。
- **没有 reconcile 入口**：workspace 域 RPC 只有 `create / rename / delete / insertBefore /
  insertSessionBefore / archiveSession / createDirectory / pick / list`，没有 rescan/reconcile/rebuild；
  客户端 `sessions.open(id)` 只能选中「已列出」的会话（`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/client.js:3089-3095`），
  搜索面板点开走的还是同一个 `sessions.open()`。
- **诊断信号被丢掉**：被过滤的会话只通过 `ctx.logger.warn` 打到宿主 stdout
  （`dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:737-747`），宿主是终端前台进程、日志不落盘。

> 与 README 已声明限制的关系：`dsh-workspace/README.md:160-164` 已声明「删除注册不删数据」
> 「re-adding a directory starts fresh — the old sessions do not come back automatically」
> 「归档单向」；本报告**不主张**改变这些产品决策，只主张：当记账被 3.2 静默回滚时，
> 用户会在**什么都没做**的情况下落到同一结局，而 3.3 让这个结局无法被发现、无法被修复。

## 4. 最小复现

**R1（无归属落盘，单宿主确定性）**
1. 令目录 `Q` 没有工作区注册。
2. 调用 `session.create` 且不带 `workspaceId`（`{cwd: Q}`，或什么都不带 → 落在宿主 `process.cwd()`）。
3. 结果：会话日志落盘并可正常打开，但不属于任何工作区 → UI 不可见，重启也不出现，
   `workspace.json` 中没有任何记录包含它的 id。

**R2（双宿主覆盖）**
1. 同一个 `DSH_HOME` 下同时启动 profile A（3080）与 profile B（3082）。
2. 在 A 中打开目录 `P1` 并新建会话 → 出现 `P1` 注册。
3. 在 B 中打开目录 `P2` 并新建会话 → 出现 `P2` 注册。
4. 回到 A 做任意一次 workspace 变更（新建会话 / 归档 / 重排 / 删除 / 重命名）。
5. 结果：B（或 A 在第 3 步之后新增）的记账从文件消失，会话日志仍在，UI 不可见，重启不恢复。

## 5. 建议修复

**P0-1 · 让「落盘的会话必有归属」成为宿主不变量**
`session.create` 在 `workspaceId` 缺省时按最终解析出的 cwd 做 `resolveByPath()`：命中则 `attachSession`，
未命中则创建注册（或至少明确报错）。另外 `defaultCwd = process.cwd()`（`lib/index.js:2729`）对 GUI 宿主
是个尴尬落点，建议改为「无 cwd、无 workspaceId 的创建必须由连接上下文给出 cwd」。

**P0-2 · 单写者保护 / 多实例检测**
- `dsh-storage-json` 增加跨进程互斥（同目录锁文件 + PID/心跳 + 陈旧锁回收），或写入前比对
  `mtime`/revision，发现外部变更就重载合并、不可合并则报错，而不是静默覆盖；
- 或把 `workspace` 域改成 `layout: "per-record"`（`session_projcache` 已是该布局），把覆盖粒度降到单工作区；
- 宿主启动时检测「同一 `DSH_HOME` 是否已有活跃宿主」，第二个实例拒绝启动或只读降级；
  至少在 `dsh-storage-json` README 中写明这一风险。

**P1 · 让记账可自愈 + 有入口**
把一次性 bootstrap 改成**可重入的 reconcile**（启动时把未被任何注册收编的 header 按 canonical cwd 归并回去；
`initialized` 不该是永久闸门），并提供 `dsh workspace reconcile`（CLI）与 GUI「重新扫描历史会话」入口。

**P2 · 可观测性**
`reportFilteredCandidates()` 的结果进入可查询的诊断面，而不是只打 stdout；
`workspace.json` 写入带 revision + writer 标识，便于定位被回退的写入者。

## 6. 我已做的临时缓解（仅供参考，不算修复）

- 用只读脚本量化了损失范围，并快照备份了 `workspace.json`；
- 准备了兜底恢复工具：宿主停止后把 `global.initialized` 置回 `false`，让 bootstrap 重新收编
  （本机 196/437 → 299/437；剩余 138 条属于完全没有注册的目录）；
- 写回前用同一份代码在副本上预演，并做 workspace 域不变量校验（唯一路径、会话不被两个工作区重复记账、
  注册顺序与表一致）。

## 附录 A：双宿主证据（`lsof`，节选，路径已脱敏）

```
$ lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep node
node <pid-A> ... TCP 127.0.0.1:3082 (LISTEN)   # profile test
node <pid-B> ... TCP *:3080 (LISTEN)           # profile web

$ lsof -p <pid-A> | grep '\.dsh'      # profile test 读同一套 $DSH_HOME
... <DSH_HOME>/settings.yaml
... <DSH_HOME>/cordis.patch.yml
... <DSH_HOME>/profiles/test/cordis.yml

$ lsof -p <pid-B> | grep '\.dsh'      # profile web
... <DSH_HOME>/settings.yaml
... <DSH_HOME>/cordis.patch.yml
... <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.yml

$ find <DSH_HOME> -name 'workspace.json*'
<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json          # 全机只有一个，两个宿主共用
```

本机 `profiles/test/cordis.patch.yml` 里为避开端口冲突固定了 3082，说明双开是**有意**的配置
（不是偶发多开），因此这一并发形态很可能不是个例：

```yaml
- id: webserver
  config:
    host: '127.0.0.1'
    port: 3082
```

## 附录 B：核查脚本（只读，可直接运行）

```js
const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), { execSync } = require('child_process');
const ROOT = path.join(process.env.HOME, '.dsh');
const store = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'storages', 'workspace.json'), 'utf8'));
const accounted = new Set();
for (const r of Object.values(store.tables.workspaces)) for (const id of r.sessionIds) accounted.add(String(id));

const dirs = (p) => fs.readdirSync(p, { withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isDirectory()).map((e) => path.join(p, e.name));
let onDisk = 0, orphans = 0;
for (const project of dirs(path.join(ROOT, 'sessions')))
  for (const session of dirs(project)) {
    const log = fs.readdirSync(session).filter((f) => /^session(\..+)?\.jsonl\.zstd$/.test(f)).sort().pop();
    if (!log) continue;
    onDisk++;
    const header = JSON.parse(execSync(`zstd -dc -q "${path.join(session, log)}" 2>/dev/null | head -1`).toString());
    if (!accounted.has(String(header.id))) orphans++;
  }
console.log(`initialized=${store.global.initialized} workspaces=${store.global.workspaceIds.length}`);
console.log(`session logs on disk=${onDisk} accounted=${accounted.size} invisible=${orphans}`);
```

本机输出（修复前）：

```
initialized=true workspaces=10
session logs on disk=437 accounted=196 invisible=241
```

## 附录 C：两种失效签名（判别线索）

对**已有注册**的工作区，比较「已记账会话的创建时间范围」与「未记账会话的创建时间范围」：

- 未记账会话**都比已记账最新会话更旧** → 与「注册被后建/重建」一致（README 已声明的 *starts fresh*）。
- 出现**比已记账最新会话更新**的未记账会话 → 后建注册无法解释，指向 3.1 或 3.2。

| 工作区（别名） | 已记账 条数/时间范围（UTC） | 未记账 条数/时间范围（UTC） | 未记账中「更新」的条数 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `proj-1` | 69 / 08-15 13:50 ~ 09-15 06:37 | 64 / 08-15 05:44 ~ 09-17 05:44 | **3** |
| `proj-3` | 51 / 08-18 08:18 ~ 09-15 09:21 | 9 / 08-19 03:30 ~ 08-29 07:55 | 0 |
| `proj-4` | 29 / 08-14 01:31 ~ 09-15 14:16 | 8 / 08-17 08:30 ~ 09-16 09:19 | **2** |
| `proj-10` | 14 / 08-22 02:08 ~ 09-11 08:12 | 2 / 08-24 01:17 ~ 08-29 07:54 | 0 |
| `proj-7` | 14 / 08-18 01:20 ~ 09-16 04:40 | 3 / 08-29 07:57 ~ 08-29 08:37 | 0 |
| `proj-5` | 9 / 08-25 03:24 ~ 09-03 04:11 | 7 / 09-01 07:44 ~ 09-02 02:56 | 0 |
| `proj-11` | 5 / 09-16 01:52 ~ 09-17 08:09 | 0 | 0 |
| `proj-6` | 3 / 09-07 12:35 ~ 09-15 08:35 | 7 / 09-12 08:33 ~ 09-17 04:41 | **1** |
| `proj-9` | 1 / 09-14 07:03 | 2 / 09-14 07:30 ~ 09-16 07:46 | **2** |
| `proj-8` | 1 / 09-17 08:17 | 1 / 09-17 05:50 | 0 |

`proj-9` 最干净：注册与其唯一会话在 09-14 07:03 同时建立，而同目录 07:30 之后创建的会话全都没被记账 ——
说明「无归属落盘」可以发生在宿主正常使用、且工作区已注册的情况下。

## 附录 D：待确认的观察

- 排查期间 16:24 → 16:30 之间，某条工作区注册（3 条会话，日志完好）从文件中消失。
  无法确认是用户经 GUI 删除，还是 3.2 的覆盖 —— 这本身也说明缺少写入者标识/revision。

---

**关于补丁**：注意到本仓库外部 PR 已关闭（`has_pull_requests: false`）。如果需要，我可以把
「可重入 reconcile」或「`create` 时兜底 attach」的小改动放到 fork 分支上，再在这里贴链接；
需要的话请告知倾向哪条修复路线。

---

*说明：本报告只引用会话元数据（创建时间、字节数、按目录的计数）与代码位置，未包含任何会话消息内容、
业务文档、仓库名或凭据；路径与项目名已用占位符/别名替换。*

discussions.title: Web: loading large session history transfers the full event stream (25MB / 42k events; 54% is streaming chunks) — request WS compression and lazy loading
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1` (npm registry), web profile, macOS, served behind a reverse proxy
- one long-running coding session from daily usage as the test case

## Measurement (real session)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Log on disk (zstd) | 12 MB |
| Uncompressed event stream | 22.5 MB |
| Events | 41,794 |
| Turns / assistant settlements | 76 / 468 |

Event-type breakdown of the transferred payload:

| type | count | bytes |
|---|---|---|
| reasoning-chunks | 18,128 | 5.0 MB |
| tool-call-chunks | 8,162 | 3.2 MB |
| assistant/chunk | 6,133 | 3.1 MB |
| tool/code-dispatch | 1,154 | 3.5 MB |
| assistant/message (settlements) | 468 | 2.3 MB |

**54% of the transferred bytes are streaming chunk events** that are superseded by the settlement events in the same log (settlements fully cover all 76 turns). Stripping chunk events yields 10.2 MB / 5,072 events with zero content loss.

## Where the time goes

- Server-side read is **not** the bottleneck: decompress + JSON-parse of all 42k events ≈ 0.5 s; the projection cache is effective once warm.
- The cost is (a) transferring ~25 MB over the browser WebSocket, then (b) rendering 42k events in the DOM. Over a proxied HTTPS path this is a 10–40 s blocking wait for a single session open.

## Feature requests

1. **permessage-deflate on the session-stream WebSocket** — the stream is JSON text and compresses ~3–5×; no protocol change needed.
2. **Settlements-first history load**: when a client opens a session for viewing, send settlements only (or a compact projection), and fetch chunk streams lazily only when the UI needs them.
3. **Virtualized / paginated rendering** for very long sessions in the web UI.

Happy to provide more traces. Thanks for the great harness — the session-log rebuildability and the 0.1.6 perf work are already a big step up.

discussions.title: [bug] `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 `session/list` 默认全量加载，随使用数据逐渐爆炸，建议增加分页、懒加载机制
discussions.body:
# 建议给 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 `session/list` 做成懒加载：首屏只给摘要，展开分组和点开对话时再取详情

## 一、问题：会话只会越攒越多，而列表接口没有任何上限

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 `session/list` 一次返回**全部**会话，既没有条数上限，也没有分页：

```ts
export interface SessionListRequest {
    readonly cursor?: string;   // 签名里预留了游标
}
```

```js
// @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller, lib/index.js
async list(_request, signal) {          // 但参数收下没用
    return { items: await this.listState.list(signal) };
}
```

这意味着**这个接口的开销只会随使用时间单调增长**，不会自己收敛。

近期我在重度使用dsh，我的实验服务器上存了 1075 个会话，实测：

| 项目 | 数值 |
| --- | --- |
| 未压缩的返回体 | **1.33 MB** |
| gzip 压缩后（浏览器「传输大小」一栏看到的量） | 323 KB |
| 其中属于各种派生字段（`projections.values`）的部分 | **80.8%** |
| 行本身的字段只用掉 | 17.2% |

也就是说，真正属于"会话列表"的信息只占六分之一，其余全是跟着走的附加内容。用得越久，这个数字越大。

## 二、为什么现在的做法没必要：前端本来就是折叠展示的

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 里写死了：

```js
/** Session rows visible per Workspace before the local overflow control. */
const COLLAPSED_SESSION_LIMIT = 5;
```

**侧边栏里每个工作区默认只显示 5 条会话**，其余的要人点"展开"才看得见。也就是说首屏上人眼真正会看到的行非常少，而接口把全部 1075 行连同附加内容一起传了过来。

附加字段里最夸张的是 `turnOutline`，占整个返回体的 **34.2%**。它的内容是每一轮对话一条记录，每条带问题的前 50 个字符和回答的前 120 个字符：

```json
"turnOutline": [
  { "turn": 1, "seq": 5,
    "prompt": "看一下reference，codesharp和scalar的设置里环境的最大长度都是多少？craf…",
    "response": "两篇论文我都逐字查过了，结论先说：**只有 SCALAR 明确写了…" },
  …
]
```

它是给聊天窗口右侧那个"跳到第几轮"的导航用的。**只有人真的点开某一条对话、并且需要翻它内部的轮次时，这份内容才有意义**。一进页面就把全部会话的轮次摘要都载进来，纯属白传。

同样的道理也适用于 `tokenUsage`、`contextPressure`、`contextBreakdown`、`sessionStats`、`todos`、`plan`、`inbox`、`modelSelection`、`subagentCatalog` 这些 —— 它们都是"某一条对话自己的细节"，不是"列表要显示的东西"。

## 三、建议

### 1. 列表首屏只返回摘要行

只给真正要用来渲染侧边栏的东西：会话号、最后活动时间、是否在跑、是否空白、工作目录、父会话、来源、以及标题。按实测，这部分只占全部内容的一小部分。

### 2. 分组展开时再取那一组

分组本身已经有了（侧边栏就是按工作区分组的），而且展开状态前端已经记着（`setGroupExpanded` 会把展开的工作区写进浏览器本地状态）。所以很自然的分工是：

- 首屏：每个工作区只要够填那 5 行的摘要（要不就按"最近活动的 N 条"取）
- 人点"展开"某个工作区时：再取这一个工作区的完整列表
- `cursor` 字段已经预留了，实现它就能做到，不需要新增协议

### 3. 对话细节改成点开时才取

`turnOutline` 以及其他"某一条对话自己的细节"，改成**人点开那条对话时再取**。聊天窗口本来就有 `useProjection("turnOutline")` 这条实时订阅，扩展一下让它负责"需要时才去取"就行。

discussions.title: [Bug Report] 陈旧持久化状态使「工作区 / 会话列表」整格静默消失：`retainAccountKeys` 对反序列化状态缺键零容忍
discussions.body:
## 概要 DSH Web GUI 左侧边栏的**工作区与会话列表整块不再显示**（只剩品牌行、`新会话` 按钮与底部设置入口），且**没有任何可见错误提示**。 取证实锤：客户端插件 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 已加载并注册了槽位 `sidebar.workspaces`，但其组件在首次渲染时抛异常；槽位级错误边界捕获后按 `abdicate` 语义**将该 entry 永久退场**，格子只剩一个空的 `data-slot-error` 占位 div： ```html
``` 崩溃来自一段**纯视图偏好**代码：浏览器持久化状态里缺少 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 键，而 `retainAccountKeys` 对它直接 `Object.entries(...)`。 --- ## 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | OS | Windows（`process.platform === "win32"`） | | Node | v22.22.3 | | DSH CLI | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` | | 内嵌包 | `dsh-web-app` / `dsh-client-ui-workspace` / `dsh-client-ui-renderer` / `dsh-client-ui-sidebar` / `dsh-api-remotes` 等均为 **0.1.5-rc.2** | | profile | `web`（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`） | | GUI | `http://127.0.0.1:3080` | | 第三方 Web UI 插件 | 另装有全家桶式第三方插件（`@linxin666/dsh-web-all@0.3.23`、`dshmarket`、`dsh-pet`、`dsh-whale-widget`、`dsh-better-sidebar`、`dsh-context`、`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`）；下文 §已排除 已说明其与本缺陷无关 | | 工作区数据 | 1 个工作区 / 3 条会话，无归档（即数据侧正常） | --- ## 复现步骤 1. 以上述 profile 启动 `dsh web`，浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`。 2. DevTools → Console 勾选 **Preserve log**，然后强刷（Ctrl+F5）。 3. 左侧边栏缺少工作区与会话列表。 4. Console 出现如下堆栈（原始输出）： ``` index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56 TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object at Object.entries () at retainAccountKeys (client.js:218:1) at index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:69359 at index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:68694 at produce (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:66201) at Object.update (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:68674) at a. [as retainAccountKeys] (index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56:69348) at client.js:2017:1 ... client.js:526 slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces': TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object at Object.entries () at retainAccountKeys (client.js:218:1) componentDidCatch @ client.js:526 ``` 5. 槽位 DOM（原始值）： ```js document.querySelector('[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]').outerHTML // '
' // + '
' ``` 补充：该现象**跨 `dsh web` 进程重启稳定复现**（重启前后 PID 不同、现象一致），**与主机侧插件配置无关**（曾把目录选择器由 `auto` 改为静态 `browse` 后重启，现象不变）。 ## 实际结果 左侧边栏的「工作区 + 会话列表 + 会话搜索 + 重命名 / 分叉 / 归档 + 排序分组」入口全部消失，且无任何 UI 提示、无自愈路径（刷新后重新注册 → 再次崩溃 → 再次退场）。 ## 期望结果 即使持久化状态陈旧/缺键，也应： - 该组件不崩（缺失键按默认值处理）；且 - 万一崩了，用户应能看到「此面板加载失败」之类的可见提示与重试入口，而不是整格静默消失。 --- ## 根因分析 ### 1) 崩溃点：`retainAccountKeys` 对该 store 的键零容忍 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace@0.1.5-rc.2`，构建产物 `lib/client.js`： ```js // L194 工作区浏览器的「视图偏好」store function createWorkspaceViewStore() { return defineStore({ init: () => ({ groupBy: "workspace", orderBy: "updated", groupExpansion: {}, sessionOrderByAccount: {}, sessionUpdatedAtByAccount: {} // ← 后加的键 }), persist: "dsh.workspace.view.v5", // ← 版本号未随结构变更升级 actions: { // ... retainAccountKeys: (d, workspaceKeys) => { // L214 const retained = new Set(workspaceKeys); d.groupExpansion = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(d.groupExpansion).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key))); // L216 d.sessionOrderByAccount = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key)));// L217 d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key))); // L218 ← 抛错 }, // ... } }); } ``` 崩溃帧精确落在 **L218**（第三个 `Object.entries`），意味着 L216/L217 成功执行、即 `groupExpansion` 与 `sessionOrderByAccount` 在状态中是可用对象，而 `d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 为 `undefined`。 ### 2) 调用方：工作区就绪后的清理 effect ```js // L1976 function WorkspaceBrowser({ ..., useStore, actions, ... }) { const groupBy = useStore((s) => s.groupBy); // L1983 const sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = useStore((s) => s.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount); // L1987 // ... useEffect(() => { // L2015 if (workspacePhase !== "ready") return; actions.retainAccountKeys([ "", FLAT_SESSION_ORDER_KEY, ...workspaces.map((workspace) => workspace.workspaceId) ]); }, [actions.retainAccountKeys, workspacePhase, workspaces]); // L2022-2026 } ``` `workspaceKeys` 恒为字符串数组，因此参数侧不是问题；崩溃只可能来自 `d.*` 缺键。该 effect 仅在**工作区投影就绪**后触发，与「边栏先空白、再无自愈」的观感一致。 ### 3) 状态为何缺键 `init()` 提供了全部 5 个键，因此缺键只能来自**持久化状态的再水合**：浏览器里 `dsh.workspace.view.v5` 这份 blob 是**旧结构**（含 `groupExpansion` / `sessionOrderByAccount`，不含后加的 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount`）。可能的设计缺口： - `persist` 版本号仍为 **v5**，未随结构变更升级/迁移； - `retainAccountKeys` 没有 `?? {}` 兜底； - 客户端 store 运行时（`defineStore`）表现为**以持久化对象作为状态**，而非 `{ ...init(), ...persisted }` 之类的合并，因此新增键拿不到默认值。 > 说明：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` 在本机安装树中不存在为独立目录，`defineStore` 运行时实际内联在 Web shell bundle 中（堆栈里的压缩帧 `index-BKQ_L1z6.js:56`），故本报告只能给出行为观测，其再水合语义（替换 or 合并）需维护者确认。 > > 同一 origin 下曾存在多个 DSH 安装来源（npm 全局安装 + 本地源码 checkout），共享同一份 `localStorage`，因此旧结构 blob 被当前构建采用的可能性较高。**建议维护者按 §建议修复 的 7.1/7.2 一并处理**，无需依赖这一具体成因。 ### 4) 为什么一个偏好读取失败会让整个入口消失 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer@0.1.5-rc.2`（`lib/client.js`）： ```js // L519 var SlotErrorBoundary = class extends react.Component { state = { failed: false }; static getDerivedStateFromError(error) { if (error instanceof SlotAssemblyError) throw error; // 装配错误仍然响亮失败 return { failed: true }; } componentDidCatch(error) { console.error(`slot entry crashed in '${this.props.slotKey}':`, error); // L526 this.props.onEntryError(error); // L527 } render() { if (this.state.failed) return
; // L530 return this.props.children; } }; ``` ```js // L789-790 const onEntryError = (error) => { host.reportEntryError(slotKey, entry, error, { abdicate: spec.kind !== "chain" }); }; ``` `sidebar.workspaces` 的声明为 `kind: "single"`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`，构建产物 `lib/client.js` L391-394），于是 `abdicate: true`：**该 entry 被永久移除**，格子变干后由出口渲染无内容的崩溃面；刷新只会重演同一过程。由于 `ui-workspace` 是该格子的唯一占据者，整个会话管理入口一次性消失。 ### 5) 为什么用户几乎看不到错误 - 异常发生在**加载瞬间**的首轮渲染，`console.error` 只打一次，极易被后续插件日志淹没； - 崩溃面是**无文本空 div**，UI 无提示； - 主机侧一切正常：配置树中 `ui-workspace` 启用且 id 唯一、无第三方插件占用该槽位、`GET /api/dsh-web-all/degraded` 为空、工作区/会话数据正常。常规主机侧诊断会得出「没问题」的结论。 --- ## 影响 - **用户侧**：核心导航与会话管理（工作区切换、会话列表、搜索、重命名 / 分叉 / 归档、排序分组）全部不可用。 - **可诊断性**：静默失败 + 主机侧全绿，误导排查方向。 - **持久性**：状态在浏览器侧，跨重启存在，表现为「环境坏了」而非「这次运行坏了」。 - **触发面**：任何在**同一 origin** 上发生过版本变更（升级 / 多 checkout 并存 / 回退）的浏览器都可能命中。 --- ## 临时规避（用户侧） 清除该 origin 下过期的视图偏好状态（只影响分组/排序/展开态等本地偏好）： ```js (() => { const keys = Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => /workspace/i.test(k)); for (const k of keys) { console.log(k, '=>', localStorage.getItem(k)); localStorage.removeItem(k); } location.reload(); })() ``` 或 DevTools → Application → Local Storage → `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → 删除 `dsh.workspace.view.v5*`；兜底可 Clear site data。 验证标准：刷新后边栏恢复，且 Console 不再出现 `slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces'`。 --- ## 建议修复 **7.1 组件侧（最小止血）** ```js retainAccountKeys: (d, workspaceKeys) => { const retained = new Set(workspaceKeys); d.groupExpansion = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(d.groupExpansion ?? {}).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key))); d.sessionOrderByAccount = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount ?? {}).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key))); d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount ?? {}).filter(([key]) => retained.has(key))); } ``` **7.2 store 侧（结构性，建议优先）** - 再水合时**合并默认值**：`{ ...init(), ...persisted }`（对声明键逐个补默认），使「新增键」对旧 blob 天然安全； - `persist` 版本号**随结构升级**（新增 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 时应为 `dsh.workspace.view.v6`）并提供迁移或直接丢弃旧版； - 反序列化后做**结构校验**，不符则丢弃整份状态并记 warn，而不是把半成品交给 actions。 **7.3 失败面收敛（本缺陷的放大器）** - `kind: "single"` 的崩溃面建议渲染可见提示（含错误摘要）并提供重挂载/重试入口； - 将 `reportEntryError` 的错误汇总暴露为可查询状态（目前只进 ledger 订阅，用户与诊断手段都取不到）。 **7.4 测试建议** 1. 以「缺少 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 的 v5 快照」初始化 store，调用 `retainAccountKeys`，断言不抛错且缺失键补为 `{}`； 2. 渲染测试：用该状态挂载 `WorkspaceBrowser`，断言 `sidebar.workspaces` 未进入错误边界； 3. 门禁：`persist` 键名与其状态形状的一致性检查（形状变更必须伴随版本变更）。 --- ## 已排除项（供维护者参考，避免重复排查方向） | 假设 | 排除依据 | |---|---| | `ui-workspace` 被配置层禁用 / 未合成 | 只读合成整棵配置树：该行启用、id 唯一，无任何层禁用 | | 第三方插件抢占 `sidebar.workspaces` | 全量检索第三方插件代码：无 `slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.workspaces' })`，它们只做 DOM 行注入 | | 目录选择器链条（`remote.directoryPicker` 缺失导致 `apply` 未执行） | 静态钉 `browse` 后现象不变；且浏览器取证显示 `apply` 已执行（否则不会有 `retainAccountKeys` 崩溃帧） | | 客户端模块未下发 / bundle 404 | `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`（10 项 client inject 齐全），Console 无 bundle 加载失败 | | 槽位未声明 | DOM 中 `data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"` 存在，外壳其他部分正常渲染 | | 数据缺失 | 工作区存储含 1 工作区 / 3 会话；崩溃发生在 `workspacePhase === "ready"` 之后 | --- ## 诊断片段（复现/定位用） ```js console.log(JSON.stringify({ entries: (window.__DSH_BOOT__?.entries ?? []) .filter(e => /workspace|sidebar|session/i.test(e.id)).map(e => ({ id: e.id, inject: e.inject })), slots: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot]')].map(e => e.dataset.slot), wsHTML: document.querySelector('[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]')?.outerHTML ?? null }, null, 1)) ``` 判别要点：`wsHTML` 出现 `data-slot-error="sidebar.workspaces"` ⇒ **注册成功但渲染崩溃**（本缺陷）；若为空 div 且 `entries` 中无该插件 ⇒ 属插件未加载的另一类故障。 ### 相关代码位置（本机 0.1.5-rc.2 构建产物） | 用途 | 位置 | |---|---| | 崩溃代码 | `dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js` L194-229、L1976、L2015-2026 | | 错误边界 | `dsh-client-ui-renderer/lib/client.js` L519-533、L789-790 | | 槽位声明 | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar/lib/client.js` L375-405 | | 持久化键 | `localStorage["dsh.workspace.view.v5"]`（或该前缀） |

discussions.title: [Bug] 过期的 dsh.workspace.view.v5 会让整个侧边栏浏览器留白（会话历史"消失"）
discussions.body:
# [Bug] 过期的 `dsh.workspace.view.v5` 会让整个侧边栏浏览器留白（会话历史"消失"）

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.5-rc.1`（`dsh web`，Windows 11，Chrome/Edge）
- 浏览器 localStorage 中存在旧版本写入的 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`
- 复现无需任何服务端改动；Host 数据完好（`session/list` 正常返回，`workspace/follow` 正常下发 baseline）

## Summary

浏览器里若存着结构过期的 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`（缺少 `groupExpansion` / `sessionOrderByAccount` 等字段），`sidebar.workspaces` 的组件会在渲染时抛 `TypeError`，被插槽的错误边界吞掉，结果是**整块侧边栏浏览器直接消失**——只剩「新会话」按钮和「设置」，连「工作区」标题、搜索框都没有。用户会误以为对话历史丢失。

## Reproduction

1. 打开 `dsh web` 的 GUI，按 F12 打开 Console。
2. 写入一个旧结构的状态：

   ```js
   localStorage.setItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5', JSON.stringify({ groupBy: 'workspace', orderBy: 'updated' }))
   ```

3. 刷新页面。

## Current behavior

侧边栏只剩 `新会话 | 设置`，`sidebar.workspaces` 区域整块留白。Console：

```
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries (<anonymous>)
    at SessionTree (.../dsh-client-ui-workspace/client.js...)
error: slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces': TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
```

之后再刷新也无法恢复，必须显式清理该 localStorage 键。清理后立即恢复正常：

```js
localStorage.removeItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5')
// 刷新后侧边栏恢复：新会话 | 工作区 | <工作区…> | 设置，Console 无报错
```

## Expected behavior

持久化状态过期或字段缺失时，侧边栏应以默认值正常渲染（工作区分组、全部折叠），而不是整块消失；至少应给出可见的错误提示而不是留白。

## Root cause

1. `packages/client/store/src/index.ts:154`（`attachPersistence`）恢复时是**整体替换**，不补默认值、不校验、无 schema 版本：

   ```ts
   api.setState(devFreeze(JSON.parse(raw) as T), true)
   ```

2. `packages/client/ui-workspace` 假定这些字段一定存在：
   - `src/client/rows/WorkspaceBrowser.tsx:239` `Object.entries(groupExpansion)`
   - `src/client/stores.ts:83,86`（`retainAccountKeys`）`Object.entries(d.groupExpansion)` / `Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount)`
3. `packages/client/ui-renderer/src/client/scoped-slots.tsx:334-338`（`SlotErrorBoundary`）捕获后渲染空 `div`（`data-slot-error="sidebar.workspaces"`），所以表现为"整块消失"。

触发条件的现实性：同一个 `dsh.workspace.view.v5` 键下状态结构变过——`retainAccountKeys` 至今仍在删除一个历史字段 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount`（`stores.ts:89`），说明该键在不同版本间承载过不同字段集；旧版本写入的状态被新版本读到就会缺字段。

## Impact

升级后部分用户的侧边栏浏览器会永久不可用，直到手动清 localStorage；由于会话列表一起消失，很容易被判定为"对话历史丢失"。

## Suggested fix

- 给 client store 的持久化恢复加 schema/version 与迁移，或至少与 `init()` 浅合并（`{ ...init, ...parsed }`）并校验 JSON；
- 状态结构变化时提升 persist key（`v5` → `v6`）而不是沿用同键；
- ui-workspace 侧对 `groupExpansion` / `sessionOrderByAccount` 兜底默认值。

## Workaround

F12 → Console → `localStorage.removeItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5')` → 刷新。

discussions.title: Web chat pinned on "Loading history…" forever when a live assistant baseline fails validation
discussions.body:
## Summary

`session.follow` includes the host's in-memory copy of an in-flight assistant
attempt in its opening snapshot. The host folds those frames as trusted and never
validates chunk shape. The browser validates them strictly during the first
window install. When a chunk fails, `expandAssistantStream` throws a plain
`TypeError`, and every handler on the open path recognises only `RemoteError`.
The `TypeError` is rethrown before `openState` is ever assigned, so the chat
stays on `"Loading history…"` with no error surface, no timeout and no retry.

Users see a chat that never loads. Reloading does not help, because the same
baseline is served again. It clears only when the host drops the attempt.

Present in `0.1.5-rc.1` and unchanged in `0.1.6-alpha.1`.

## Reproduction

Against a running `dsh web`, intercept the gateway socket and attach an
`activeAttempt` whose stream carries one non-object chunk to the opening
snapshot frame:

```js
frame.value.assistantStream = {
  revision: 1,
  activeAttempt: {
    attemptId: 'repro', startedAfterSeq: lastSeq, turn: 1, step: 1, nextIndex: 1,
    stream: [{ type: 'chunk', time: Date.now(), chunk: 'not-an-object' }],
  },
};
```

Result: the chat column shows `chat.loadingHistory` indefinitely, zero rows, no
`openError`, and the console carries an unhandled
`TypeError: Assistant stream raw chunk must be a lossless JSON object`.
Observed for 30 s, and in the wild for minutes across repeated hard refreshes.

## Chain

All paths in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`.

1. `lib/index.js` — `SessionAssistantStreamAccumulator` retains live frames for
   reconnecting web followers, documented as folding "one trusted frame". No
   chunk validation.
2. `lib/index.js` — `follow()` emits
   `assistantStream: this.assistantStreams.get(target)?.snapshot() ?? { revision: 0 }`
   in the opening snapshot.
3. `lib/client.js` — `ClientAssistantStream.replace()` calls
   `expandAssistantStream(opening.stream)`, which runs `validateRecord` and
   throws `TypeError` for a chunk that is not a lossless plain JSON object.
4. That call sits under `installWindow` → `acceptEventChange('replace')` →
   `RemoteJournalStream.replaceFromOpening` → `publish`, inside `open()`'s try
   block, so it rejects `events.open()`.
5. `lib/client.js` — `doOpen`:

   ```js
   } catch (error) {
     if (generation !== this.openGeneration || this.events !== events) return;
     if (!isRemoteFailure(error)) throw error;   // openState still "loading"
     this.events = void 0;
     this.openState = "error";
     this.openError = error;
   }
   ```

   `isRemoteFailure` requires `isDSHRemoteError === true`, so a `TypeError`
   escapes. `openState` is never moved off `"loading"`.
6. `followCurrent()` calls `record.session.open()` with no `.catch()`, so the
   rejection is unhandled and nothing re-opens: `followCurrent` returns early
   while `current === this.watched`.

`failEventStream` has the same shape, so a non-`RemoteError` raised by the
background consumer also throws out of a callback rather than settling state.

## Why storage looks clean

Only the live copy is affected. Validating every stored assistant stream with
the shipped browser validator gave zero rejections over 13,502 streams in 567
sessions. A malformed **durable** event behaves correctly and renders
`chat.loadError`. The asymmetry is that durable events cross a validating
boundary and the live baseline does not.

## Suggested fixes

1. Validate the accumulator's frames on the host, at the point they are folded,
   so a bad chunk cannot reach the wire and fails where it can be attributed.
2. Make the browser's open path total. `doOpen` and `failEventStream` should
   settle `openState` for every error class, not only `RemoteError`; rethrowing
   inside a callback leaves the UI with no way back.
3. Treat an unreadable live baseline as recoverable in
   `ClientAssistantStream.replace()`: drop the transient tail, keep the durable
   window, let live frames resync. The in-flight text arrives again anyway.

Fix 2 alone converts a dead screen into a visible error. Fix 3 keeps the session
usable. We are running 3 locally as a patch.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 0.1.5-rc.2
- Node 24.21.0, Linux, Chromium
- Also checked `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller@0.1.6-alpha.1`: the
  `doOpen` and `failEventStream` handling is byte-identical.

discussions.title: **标题：[BUG] 侧边栏：docx/pptx/xlsx 文件点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」提示无法打开**
discussions.body:
### Bug report
**标题：[BUG] 侧边栏：docx/pptx/xlsx 文件点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」提示无法打开**

#### 复现步骤
1. 在DSH v0.1.5 web界面，把docx/pptx放入工作区，在右侧侧边栏选中
2. 点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」
3. 弹窗提示：无法在文件资源管理器中显示，请重试

#### 预期行为
无论文件是否支持侧边预览，点击按钮都应该唤起系统资源管理器并选中目标文件。预览能力和文件定位功能应该解耦，不应该根据文件后缀拦截资源管理器跳转。

#### 实际行为
Office类后缀被拦截，直接报错。
验证：将同一个docx修改后缀为txt，定位功能立刻恢复，证明文件路径、权限、系统调用没问题，是后缀校验逻辑拦截。

#### 环境
- DSH版本：0.1.5
- OS：Windows11
- 启动方式：dsh web

#### 附加信息
这个功能底层调用 explorer /select ，文件存在且路径合法，建议移除文件类型黑名单，文件定位不应该依赖预览器支持列表。

discussions.title: [Bug] browser-use-playwright-mcp provider hangs agent/created — blocks ALL new session creation (v0.1.6-alpha.1, Windows)
discussions.body:
# BUG Report: browser-use-playwright-mcp provider hangs agent/created, blocking ALL new session creation

**Environment**
- DSH: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1 (npm alpha channel), web profile, Windows Server 2022 (10.0.20353), Node v24.16.0
- Provider: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp@0.1.6-alpha.1
- Deps: @playwright/mcp 0.0.80 (playwright 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-31), pnpm 12.4.2 profile install
- Config: `{ mode: launch, headless: true }` (also reproduced with `executablePath` → Chrome 141)

## Symptom

Every new session creation hangs silently forever. Session files are written header-only (~340-520 bytes compressed) and never grow:

```json
{"type":"session","version":3,"id":"session-…","createdAt":…,"cwd":"F:\\…","isSeeded":false,"delegationDepth":0,"agentPreset":"ptc"}
```

No stderr/stdout output from the host process (console buffer read via Win32 AttachConsole: startup clean, zero warnings). 35 consecutive creation attempts across two host restarts all hung. UI shows a stuck new-session view; sidebar unusable for new chats.

## Mechanism

`mountSessionMcp` (dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime/lib/types/mcp.js) registers a `ctx.on('agent/created', { prepend: true })` handler that awaits `resources.get(agent, signal)` → `scope.ctx.plugin(McpClient, …)` with:

```js
transport: 'stdio', failOnStartupError: true, reconnect: { enabled: false },
cwd: agent.session.header.cwd,
```

The agent/created event is serial: the first hung init blocks every subsequent creation.

The spawned MCP server process is ALIVE and idle the whole time (observed: node cli.js --browser chromium --isolated --headless, 16+ min, 0.4s CPU, no browser children).

## Ruled out (all tested directly)

1. MCP server itself: hand-rolled JSON-RPC initialize → initialized → tools/list → prompts/list over stdio **completes in ~260ms** — byte-identical args, identical cwd (CJK path), identical env filtering. Repeated 5×.
2. Browser availability: reproduced the hang with `executablePath` → installed Chrome (so not a missing-chromium issue).
3. prompts/list surface: responds instantly (Method not found — proper JSON-RPC error, no hang).
4. Blender MCP bridge mounted alongside: unaffected (works with failOnStartupError: false).
5. Computer-use native provider mounted alongside: unaffected; its 56 tools work fine in live sessions.

⇒ Failure is internal to dsh-mcp-client's startup path under the DSH host process on Windows (spawn → handshake → readiness), **not** in the upstream @playwright/mcp server.

## Recovery

- Disabling the provider entry (patch `disabled: true`, live HMR) stops NEW hangs but does not release the already-hung serial event: a host restart is required to clear the queue.
- Sessions stuck at creation complete normally after a host restart (resumed session went 509 B → 42 KB and works).
- With the provider disabled, session creation is fully functional; computer-use (cua-driver native) remains fully functional.

## Reproduction summary

1. Mount dsh-computer-use + dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native + dsh-browser-use + dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp (launch/headless) in the web profile composition.
2. Restart host. Create any new session → hangs; session file header-only; one idle playwright-mcp node child remains.
3. Disable the playwright provider entry, restart host → session creation works.
4. Re-enable (even with executablePath) → hangs again on first creation.

## Suggested upstream directions

- Add a bounded startup timeout / failure path to the per-session McpClient mount (failOnStartupError: true currently yields a permanent silent await on this platform).
- Investigate dsh-mcp-client stdio handshake on Windows when spawned with a CJK cwd and DSH host env (black-box repro impossible — fails only inside the host process).
- Consider decoupling browser MCP init from the serial agent/created critical path (lazy init on first browser tool call) so a provider failure can never block session creation.

---
*Evidence collected 2026-09-17 via DSH agent with cua-driver native computer-use tools (which worked flawlessly throughout the investigation).*

discussions.title: [Bug] llm-deepseek: SSE keep-alives re-arm the idle watchdog forever — a 300s idle timeout actually waited 17.7 min, and a chatty provider can hang a turn unboundedly
discussions.body:
## Summary

`llm-deepseek` (chat-completions protocol) can receive a **complete** assistant
message — reasoning and tool-call blocks included — yet never receive a terminal
event from the provider. The connection stays open and keeps emitting SSE
comment lines. Because `onActivity` → `watchdog.pulse()` re-arms the idle timer
on every comment line, the configured `streamIdleTimeoutMs` does **not** bound
the wait.

Two distinct consequences:

1. **The failure text does not match reality.** It reads
   `DeepSeek stream idle timeout after 300000ms`, but the measured wait was
   10.0 / 17.3 / 17.7 minutes across three attempts.
2. **The wait is unbounded in principle.** A provider that keeps emitting
   keep-alives without ever terminating can hold one attempt open indefinitely;
   no configuration value bounds it, in either direction.

## Environment

- macOS (Apple Silicon); `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`
- provider `deepseek-official`, model `deepseek-v4-flash`
- `baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com/beta`, protocol left at its default (`chat-completions`)
- `reasoningEffort: max`, `maxTokens: 256000`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300000`
- session context ≈ 190k tokens (`cacheReadTokens` ≈ 180k)

## Observed stream, in order

```text
[+ 0.00 min] chunk block-start      blockType=reasoning
[+ 0.00 min] run   reasoning-chunks   1560 members, span 0.12 min
[+ 0.05 min] chunk block-start      blockType=tool-call
[+ 0.05 min] run   tool-call-chunks   1169 members, span 0.14 min
[+17.39 min] chunk finish           {kind: "error", failure: {code: "TIMEOUT"}}
```

The trailing `finish` is a **local synthesis** — its reason carries the timeout
error — not a provider event. In the same session, every successful request
instead ends with `finish {kind: "tool-calls"}` or `{kind: "stop"}` at
**0.00 min** after the last content record.

Three consecutive attempts on the same step, all `TIMEOUT`, all with the
payload fully delivered before the hang:

- `retry 1/5` — 10.02 min of silence after the last content record
- `retry 2/5` — 17.34 min
- `retry 1/5` (next step) — 17.70 min

User-visible effect: a turn that produced no output for ~59 minutes, then failed.
The retry delay itself was only 475–999 ms, so essentially all of the wait was
the hang.

## Why `streamIdleTimeoutMs` does not bound it

`packages/util/timeout/src/index.ts`:

```ts
next<T>(iterator) { outstanding = true; arm(); /* ... */ }
pulse(): void {
  if (disposed || !outstanding) return
  arm()               // re-arms from now, it does not accumulate
}
```

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/chat-completions/adapter.ts:211` passes
`() => { watchdog.pulse() }` as `onActivity`, and `sse.ts` documents that
callback as *"optional transport-activity callback; comments never enter the
yielded payload stream"*.

So every SSE comment line resets the timer. `streamIdleTimeoutMs` is therefore a
**keep-alive-silence** timeout, not a ceiling on how long an attempt may hang:

- raising it strictly makes the failure later;
- lowering it does not help while the keep-alive interval stays below it.

## Related

- #6594 — same class of defect on a different adapter (`llm-pi-ai` /
  `openai-responses`): final answer item complete, `response.completed` missing,
  hangs until the idle timeout. This report adds an independent reproduction on
  `llm-deepseek` / chat-completions, where the reasoning text *and* the tool
  calls are both complete.
- #5673 — different mechanism (undici `bodyTimeout`/`headersTimeout` killing a
  silent prefill before the first byte). Not this.

## Expected behavior

1. An absolute per-attempt ceiling that keep-alive traffic cannot extend (e.g. a
   separate `streamMaxDurationMs`), reported with the value actually elapsed.
2. The timeout message should name the measured silence / elapsed duration, not
   only the configured threshold.
3. Ideally, a bounded grace path once a complete assistant payload has arrived,
   as #6594 proposes (`terminalEventGraceMs`).

Raw session transcript (zstd jsonl) and the extraction script are available on
request.

discussions.title: Our reports and the fixes that followed — a timeline table, shared as a record rather than a claim **[Update 2026-09-18: re-verified on 0.1.6-alpha.2; two rows corrected]**
discussions.body:
## EN / English

> [!IMPORTANT]
>
> **Update — 2026-09-18.** This is an append, not a rewrite. Every row of **Table B** has been re-verified against a newer build — **`0.1.6-alpha.2`** (released 09-17, i.e. after this post) instead of `0.1.5-rc.2` — and the **Basis** column below now reads `0.1.6-alpha.2`. All ten rows still hold: we found no fix for any of them on that build, so each "unfixed" row is now anchored to the newest alpha rather than to `rc.2`.
>
> **Two rows in Table A described the code inaccurately** and are corrected below:
>
> - **#4025** — we wrote that the leak had **no explicit teardown**. That is not what the code does: the registry removes the name when the effect is disposed (`return () => void names.delete(...)` in `dsh-mcp-client`). What still holds is the **scope keying** (`scopeOf(ctx) ?? ctx.root`) — our original point;
> - **#5905** — we wrote that `0.1.5-alpha.2` rejects repeated cursors, **and left it as the current behaviour**. The first half stands, the second does not: on `0.1.6-alpha.2` that manual pagination loop and its cursor guard are **gone**, and tool listing is delegated to the MCP SDK (`client.listTools(…, { cacheMode: "refresh" })`). We have not re-tested whether the original hang still reproduces, so the row now says only what the code says.
>
> **One row keeps its 🔴 and gains a note: #6532.** `0.1.6-alpha.2` **added** an empty-completion guard that `rc.2` did not have (`blocks.size === 0 && stop` → `EMPTY_RESPONSE`). Its predicate counts **blocks, not visible content**, so the shape we reported — a completion whose only blocks are reasoning — still passes as a legal `stop`. The row stays in Table B because our shape is still unmatched.
>
> Everything else is unchanged.


**First, what this is and is not.** This is a table we assembled for our own records and are sharing in case it is useful: **the reports we filed, and the version each fix shipped in.** **We are not claiming those fixes exist because of our reports.** Some of them were plausibly already on the team's plan, or noticed independently by others; a timeline only shows what shipped *after* what was filed, which is **not** the same as cause. If any row overstates our part, or a correspondence is wrong, **say so and we will change the wording or drop the row.**

Three notes on how to read it:

- **"Correspondence" is our own judgment**, reached by reading the source on the version in question — it is **not** an official statement;
- **Dates**: the filing date of the report, and the **official Release** publication date of the fix (both UTC+8). Release dates, not npm dates — one of these versions (`0.1.3-alpha.1`) was released on GitHub without a matching npm publish;
- **Table B is deliberately not a scoreboard.** It lists reports where we could **not** find a fix — open items on our side; we may simply have missed one.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **How to read the colour on each row**
> 🟢 **matches** — the fix lines up with the mechanism we reported · 🟠 **partial / residual** — a fix shipped, but a boundary or residual remains · 🔴 **unfixed** — we could not find the fix on the version we checked

### A. Reports where a fix shipped afterwards

| Report | Area | What we reported | Filed | Fix version | Shipped | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **#3633** | session storage | Session writes had no lock — multiple writers could silently corrupt a shared home | 08-20 | `0.1.3-alpha.1` | 09-04 | 15 d | ![partial](https://img.shields.io/badge/-partial%20%2F%20residual-d97706?style=flat-square) |
| **#3662** · **#3664** | subagent lifecycle | Cancelling a task that had spawned subagents could permanently corrupt the session | 08-20 | `0.1.5-rc.2` | 09-10 | 21 d | ![matches](https://img.shields.io/badge/-matches-16a34a?style=flat-square) |
| **#3994** | background jobs | Finished background-job records were never reclaimed | 08-22 | `0.1.5-rc.2` | 09-10 | 19 d | ![partial](https://img.shields.io/badge/-partial%20%2F%20residual-d97706?style=flat-square) |
| **#4025** | MCP client | The client's registry leaked across lifecycle scopes, eventually blocking new sessions | 08-22 | `0.1.5-rc.2` | 09-10 | 19 d | ![partial](https://img.shields.io/badge/-partial%20%2F%20residual-d97706?style=flat-square) |
| **#4793** | subagent lifecycle | Disposing a parent agent did not propagate to its continuable subagents | 08-28 | `0.1.5-rc.1` · `0.1.5-rc.2` | 09-10 | 13 d | ![matches](https://img.shields.io/badge/-matches-16a34a?style=flat-square) |
| **#4910** | session format | Every persistence format hard-refused non-current versions, with no migration path | 08-28 | `0.1.3-alpha.1` · `0.1.5-rc.1` | 09-04 | 7 d | ![matches](https://img.shields.io/badge/-matches-16a34a?style=flat-square) |
| **#5905** | MCP client | A misbehaving MCP server could hang the app forever listing its tools | 09-08 | `0.1.5-alpha.2` | 09-09 | **1 d** | ![partial](https://img.shields.io/badge/-partial%20%2F%20residual-d97706?style=flat-square) |

**Where a fix shipped but something remains** (the 🟠 rows), so nobody has to dig:

- **#3633** — the lock landed in `0.1.3-alpha.1` ("at most one process per session"); on our side the runtime still has none, and that lock conflicts with our second-process tooling;
- **#3994** — owner-scoped reclamation landed, but the cancel-does-not-settle hang is **still documented as present** in the official README;
- **#4025** — switched to owner-scoped `WeakMap` access; the residual is the **scope keying** (`scopeOf(ctx) ?? ctx.root`). *(Corrected 09-18: an earlier version of this bullet also said there was "no explicit teardown" — the registry does delete the name on effect disposal.)*
- **#5905** — `0.1.5-alpha.2` rejected **repeated** cursors. *(Corrected 09-18: that manual loop and its guard are no longer present on `0.1.6-alpha.2` — tool listing is delegated to the MCP SDK; the original loop has not been re-tested.)*

### B. Reports we have not been able to match to a fix

Listed for completeness, not as a demand — if a fix exists that we missed, we would rather be corrected than keep an outdated row.

| **#5917** | MCP client | Saving a tool's image result can hang the session — the storage step has no deadline | 09-08 | `0.1.6-alpha.2` | ![unfixed](https://img.shields.io/badge/-unfixed-dc2626?style=flat-square) |
| **#5920** | compaction / metering | `/compact` fails forever once a plugin writes a marker with a null turn/step | 09-08 | `0.1.6-alpha.2` | ![unfixed](https://img.shields.io/badge/-unfixed-dc2626?style=flat-square) |

**Related:** @PerryLink's **#6520** is the community-verified list of what is *still* unfixed on master — it is the more rigorous artefact for that question, and we are adding one entry there rather than duplicating it here. This post is only the other direction of the same timeline: *what was filed, and what shipped afterwards.*

**Data sources:** report numbers and filing dates from the community discussions; fix dates from the **official GitHub Releases** (UTC+8). Corrections welcome — we will re-verify against the toolchain and update this post.

*Authorship note: reproduced and measured by me against my own store; root-cause tracing and drafting assisted by AI; verification and publication by me. I have no engineering background — if any technical claim reads wrong, please call it out; I will re-verify against the toolchain and correct.*

## 中文版 / ZH

> [!IMPORTANT]
>
> **更新 —— 2026-09-18。这是追加说明，不是改写。** **B 表**每一行都已换到更新的构建上重核 —— 从 `0.1.5-rc.2` 改为 **`0.1.6-alpha.2`**（09-17 发布，即**本帖发布之后**），下表的「**复核基准**」列现已写为 `0.1.6-alpha.2`。**十行结论全部维持**：在该构建上我们仍未找到任何一行的修复，因此每一行"未修"现在都挂在**最新 alpha** 上，而不是 `rc.2`。
