discussions.title: [0.1.6-alpha.2] BUG: every tool call fails with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')"
discussions.body:
## Summary

Every tool call on a freshly-built `0.1.6-alpha.2` checkout (`ddefc45fbc`) fails at the dispatch stage with:

> This turn failed: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') — UNKNOWN

The model itself responds fine; the failure is in the host-side tool-execution layer immediately after the model emits the tool call.

## Reproduction

```
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

Then in the GUI send any prompt that triggers a built-in tool, e.g. "list the files in this folder". The model generates text, suggests a tool call (e.g. `Pwsh · List files in the working directory`), and the turn fails before any tool body runs.

Confirmed on a completely fresh tree (full delete of repo + `~/.dsh/`, `git checkout HEAD -- .`, fresh `pnpm install`, fresh `pnpm run build`, new DeepSeek API key).

## Affected version

`0.1.6-alpha.2` (`ddefc45fbc`). `0.1.5-rc.2` works. The regression appears in one of these three commits between `0.1.5-rc.2` and `0.1.6-alpha.2`:

- `8dfc6fe1ec` Merge PR #4471 worktree-resolutionmode
- `e68f5d5aba` fix: test
- `d9a55c7c0d` fix: revert desktop

The first one touches `resolutionMode` plumbing in `apps/desktop-host/src/index.ts:21` and `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-boot.ts` — most plausible culprit.

## Root cause (confirmed via runtime diagnostic)

Failure site: `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170`

```ts
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)
```

`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined` even though the `ToolRuntime` instance owns a property whose key is a Symbol with the exact same description `Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler")`.

Diagnostic added to the failing line printed, at runtime:

```
=== DSH-DIAG: ctx.tools diagnostic ===
ctx.tools type: object is undefined: false
ctx.tools ctor name: ToolRuntime
ctx.tools own names: ["ctx","name","deferredContexts","concludingExecutions","cancellationStates","contentFinalizers","layers","defaultMode","maxParallelSubCalls","ptcTransport","canonicalResults"]
ctx.tools own symbols: ["Symbol(cordis.tracker)","Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)"]
imported symbol id: Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)
object has matching string desc: true
matching symbol === imported: false
ctx.tools[imported symbol] type: undefined is undefined: true
=== END DSH-DIAG ===
```

`Symbol("foo") !== Symbol("foo")` in JavaScript — the property key and the imported symbol have matching descriptions but are different instances. This means `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is being loaded **twice in the same process**: once by `cordis-plugin-loader` (at `vendor/loader/`) to instantiate `ToolRuntime`, and once by `agent-loop`'s ESM `import`. Both loaders resolve the package to the same physical file via pnpm symlinks, but Node's module cache keys on the resolved URL — if the two paths produce different URLs (e.g. one walks up `vendor/loader/node_modules/`, one walks `packages/core/agent-loop/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` symlink), they get separate module instances and therefore separate Symbol instances.

The Symbol `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is defined exactly once across the entire `lib/` tree — `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js:2526` — so a duplicate definition is not the cause.

## Suggested fix

Ensure the cordis-plugin-loader and the workspace packages (agent-loop in particular) resolve `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` to the **same module URL** at runtime, so Node shares the module instance and therefore the Symbol instance. Candidates:

- Build ordering: ensure tools's `lib/` is built before any consumer that imports its Symbols.
- Loader resolution: have `cordis-plugin-loader` resolve plugin names from the same node_modules root as the consumers.
- Module resolution: add `"type": "module"` consistency, or use Node's `--experimental-vm-modules` / explicit `Symbol.for(...)` / shared module instances.

## Workaround

Pin to `0.1.5-rc.2` until upstream fixes this. Boots and dispatches tool calls correctly.

discussions.title: 【Bug】源码启动下所有工具调用失败:"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" —— runtime 解析默认值导致 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 被加载两份,TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER Symbol 分裂
discussions.body:
## 问题概述

自提交 `9ddef327a4`("feat: resolution mode link to runtime",随 `0.1.6-alpha.2` 发布)起,**源码启动**(`pnpm dsh web`、`pnpm dsh --profile …`)下每一次模型工具调用都会失败:

TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

界面上回合直接报错结束,日志中没有对应的 `tool/result` 事件。

根因是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 出现了**双模块实例**:Loader 挂载插件走一个解析面,agent-loop 运行时 bundle 导入同一包走另一个解析面。模块级的 `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol(...)` 被求值两次,产生两个不相等的 Symbol,于是 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 解析为 `undefined`。

## 环境

- commit `ddefc45fbc`(master,`0.1.6-alpha.2` 发布合并);回归由 `9ddef327a4`(2026-09-17)引入
- Node `v22.23.2`,pnpm `11.7.0`,Linux x64
- 启动方式:`pnpm dsh web` / `pnpm dsh --profile headless`(即源码启动:`node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`)
- 使用官方 profile、**不装任何第三方插件**即可复现

## 最小复现(无需 API key)

仓库自带的快照测试在开发默认的源码模式下即可复现:

```sh
npx vitest run --config vitest.snapshot.config.ts -t "bash-tool-turn"
stderr:
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

FAIL snapshots/session/headless.snapshot.ts > … replays bash-tool-turn through dsh --profile headless
任意触发一次工具调用的交互任务同样失败。
根因
apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:
-  const resolutionMode = packaged ? 'runtime' : options.resolutionMode ?? 'link'
+  const resolutionMode = packaged ? 'runtime' : options.resolutionMode ?? 'runtime'   // 9ddef327a4
在 tsx 源码启动下,runtime 解析把 workspace 包图劈成两个平面:
1. Loader 把 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 插件经 tsx 加载(tsconfig paths → packages/core/tools/src/index.ts);
2. agent-loop 运行时 bundle(packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js)静态 import '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools',由 Node 常规解析到 packages/core/tools/lib/index.js。
两份副本都会执行 const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler'):
- 存活的 ToolRuntime 实例用符号 A(src 副本)作为调度器槽位键;
- agent-loop 用符号 B(lib 副本)查找槽位;
- ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] → undefined → startCall 中的 .prepare(…) 抛错(agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170)。
插桩诊断证实:Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(ctx.tools) 里存在与 TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER 描述相同的 Symbol,但取值是 undefined —— 描述相同、对象不同。两次加载的模块 URL 分别观测为 …/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts(插件)与 lib 副本(bundle 导入)。
捕获的堆栈:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
    at startCall (packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js:586:60)
    at fillPool (…)
    at runGroup (…)
    at executeToolCalls (…)
    at ReactLoopAgent.step (…)
为什么 CI 没拦住
快照/冒烟 CI 以 DSH_EXAMPLE_MODE=lib 运行,所有导入都解析到构建产物 lib/ —— 单一模块实例、符号一致,全部通过。只有开发默认的 src 模式(tsx)会踩中这次分裂。
修复建议
方案一:恢复非打包启动的原默认值:
const resolutionMode = packaged ? 'runtime' : options.resolutionMode ?? 'link'
本地已验证:改回 link 后 bash-tool-turn 快照端到端通过。
方案二:修正 runtime 模式,让源码启动下 workspace 包保持单一模块面(例如让 Loader 的插件解析与 tsx 使用同一套模块图)。
长期建议:加一个廉价的启动检查(或在 CI 中增加一条 src 模式快照),校验存活服务上 ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] 可解析,在启动时响亮失败,而不是在第一次工具调用时才暴露。
受影响用户的临时规避
本地把默认值改回上面一行,或完整构建后统一跑构建产物以避免 src/lib 混载。注意在上游修复落地前,git pull 会在这一行产生冲突。

discussions.title: [0.1.6] Source launch (pnpm dsh) loads @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools twice, so every tool call fails with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')"
discussions.body:
### Summary

Launching dsh from source (`pnpm dsh web`, i.e. `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web`) on 0.1.6-alpha.2, the first tool call in any session fails:

```
This turn failed  Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')   UNKNOWN
```

Every later attempt in that session then fails with `DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results` (`INVALID_REQUEST`), because the assistant message has tool calls whose results were never recorded.

### Environment

- OS: Windows 11 (win32)
- Node: v22.20.0
- pnpm: 11.7.0 (matches `packageManager`)
- dsh: 0.1.6-alpha.2 (repo HEAD `ddefc45f`)
- Launch: `pnpm dsh web` (source launch via tsx), default `resolutionMode: runtime`

### Steps to reproduce

1. `pnpm install && pnpm run build` (so `packages/*/*/lib` exists)
2. `pnpm dsh web`
3. In any session, send a prompt that triggers a tool call (e.g. `run pwsh: Get-Date`)

### Actual

The `tool/call` event is appended, then the turn ends with:

```
turn/end { reason: { kind: 'error', error: { message: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')", code: "UNKNOWN" } } }
```

No `tool/result` is recorded; the session is left with a dangling tool call and becomes unusable.

### Expected

The tool executes and its result is recorded.

### Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is loaded as **two different module instances** in one process, so the `unique symbol` `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` has two identities:

- The plugin entry is resolved by the runtime profile resolver to the built file `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js` (generation entry `packageDir`/`declarer`: `apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`).
- `packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js` imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, and tsx applies the tsconfig `paths` alias, resolving it to `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`.

`ToolRuntime` stores its scheduler under the symbol defined in the **lib** copy; `tool-calls.ts` looks it up with the symbol from the **src** copy, so `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined` and `.prepare(...)` throws.

This is a regression from the new immutable profile resolution generations (`.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-09-profile-resolution-generations.md`): the runtime resolver delegates entry resolution to the installation's nested package path, where tsx no longer applies the tsconfig aliases, while nested workspace imports still resolve to `src`. A fully built launch (plain Node, no tsx) is consistent and does not reproduce.

### Evidence

Reproduced with the real `web` profile generation:

```js
const gen = await createProfileResolutionGeneration({ installAnchor, profile })
installProfileResolution(gen, 'enforce')
const entry = await loader.import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools', profileBaseUrl, {})
const src   = await import('./packages/core/tools/src/index.ts')
entry.TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER === src.TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER  // false
```

- entry resolves to `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js`
- `import.meta.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools', '.../packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js')` resolves to `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`
- both symbols stringify as `Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)` but are not identical

Relevant code:

- `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170` - `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)`
- `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463` - `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER`
- `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:798` - the scheduler class field

### Suggested fix

Make the internal cross-package scheduler key survive duplicate module instances by registering it in the global symbol registry (already the repo's pattern for this, e.g. `packages/typert/protocol/src/owned-value.ts`, `packages/subagent/subagent/src/internal.ts`):

```ts
export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol = Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')
```

A one-line change in `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` (plus rebuilding `lib/`) fixes it; verified locally (a fresh session then executes tools normally). Fixing the resolver so plugin entries and their imports resolve on the same source/lib plane would remove the underlying inconsistency, but is a larger change.

### Notes

- Reproduced on Windows; the nested pnpm `node_modules` layout (`.../dsh-agent-instructions/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) may differ on macOS/Linux, so this may be platform-dependent. Snapshot tests boot source via tsx but do not appear to exercise this path.
- Workaround without a code change: launch the built entry instead of the tsx source entry.

discussions.title: Honor `purpose` when an auxiliary call names no reasoning level
discussions.body:
**What happens now.** The harness marks its auxiliary model calls with a `purpose`, and they name no `reasoningEffort`:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` — `summarizeWithLlm` (`lib/index.js:299`) streams with `purpose: "compaction"` and no `reasoningEffort`;
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-llm` (`lib/index.js:216`) streams with `purpose: "session-title"` and no `reasoningEffort`.

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` then fills the gap from the *route*: `resolveCallWithInfo` (`lib/index.js:2147`) takes

```js
const requested = defaulted.reasoningEffort;
// …
const effective = requested ?? reasoning.defaultEffort;
```

So on any route whose profile default level is a thinking level, compaction and session titles think.

**Why that is wrong rather than merely expensive.**

- Those calls exist to produce a *bounded* amount of visible text — a checkpoint or a title — inside an output cap the caller chose (`maxTokens`). Thinking spends that cap first, which is the failure the old Qwen plugin's author described: a summariser whose thinking eats the cap truncates the checkpoint.
- On a local model the cost is wall-clock, not quota. Measured on a base M3 with 24 GB and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 4-bit: **~5.8 tok/s** decode, so a few hundred thinking tokens is minutes per compaction and tens of seconds per new session's title.
- The harness already decided this for its own route: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`'s `resolveThinking` (`lib/index.js:32`) returns `{ thinking: "disabled" }` for `purpose === "session-title"`, and the compaction call carries `x-deepseek-harness-compact: 1` for the server to act on. A pi-ai-backed route has no equivalent, so the same harness behaves two ways depending on which adapter serves the model.

**Suggested patch** (one place, no schema change): treat an auxiliary purpose as naming `off` when the call names no level, in whichever layer resolves the default — e.g. in `dsh-llm`'s `resolveCallWithInfo`:

```js
const AUXILIARY_PURPOSES = new Set(["compaction", "session-title"]);
// …
const requested = defaulted.reasoningEffort
  ?? (AUXILIARY_PURPOSES.has(defaulted.purpose) ? "off" : undefined);
```

Every reasoning model the harness can route lists `off` among its efforts, so the existing `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` check stays the guard it is today. Alternatively a profile field (`auxiliaryReasoning`, defaulting to `off`) would let a deployment opt out; the seam-level default seems truer to the intent.

**Acceptance.** With a thinking route, a session's first prompt issues a `purpose: "session-title"` request with no thinking (no `reasoning_content`, no reasoning tokens in usage), and a compaction call behaves the same, while an ordinary turn still thinks at the route's default.

**Local mitigation meanwhile.** TinyTitan ships `plugins/dsh-tinytitan`, a thin bundle that mounts a compaction backend forcing `off` for those calls; the route's own `reasoning` default still decides ordinary turns.

*(Re-verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.6-alpha.2; the line numbers above are that version's.)*

discussions.title: Map pi-ai's reasoning usage into `reasoningTokens`
discussions.body:
**What happens now.** pi-ai parses the provider's split (`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js:1201`):

```js
reasoning: rawUsage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens || 0,
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `mapUsage` (`lib/index.js:1403-1410`) then maps `input`, `output`, `totalTokens`, `cacheRead` and `cacheWrite` — and drops `reasoning`:

```js
function mapUsage(usage) {
	return {
		inputTokens: usage.input,
		outputTokens: usage.output,
		totalTokens: usage.totalTokens,
		...usage.cacheRead > 0 ? { cacheReadTokens: usage.cacheRead } : {},
		...usage.cacheWrite > 0 ? { cacheWriteTokens: usage.cacheWrite } : {}
	};
}
```

**Consequence.** The harness's `TokenUsage.reasoningTokens` is populated on the DeepSeek route (visible in a session transcript as `{"inputTokens": 9707, "outputTokens": 153, "totalTokens": 11140, "cacheReadTokens": 1280, "reasoningTokens": 132}`) and never on a pi-ai route, so the context meter and any per-turn accounting cannot separate thinking from answer there — exactly where local models spend most of their output tokens. The server does report the field; the adapter discards it. The doc comment ("reasoning folded into output by pi-ai") describes pi-ai's *output* bucket, not the separate count pi-ai also returns.

**Suggested patch** (one line, mirroring the cache fields' "only when non-zero" rule):

```js
...usage.reasoning > 0 ? { reasoningTokens: usage.reasoning } : {},
```

**Acceptance.** On a pi-ai route, a thinking turn's `assistant/message` record carries `reasoningTokens` matching the provider's `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`; a non-thinking turn omits it, as the cache fields do.

*(Re-verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.6-alpha.2 and `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.85.1; the line numbers above are those versions'.)*

discussions.title: Allow `dsh web --host` to bind a specific LAN interface
discussions.body:
**What happens now.** `dsh web --host` accepts only the loopback and all-interfaces literals (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` `lib/index.js:141`):

```js
host: z.union([z.const("127.0.0.1"), z.const("0.0.0.0")]).required(),
```

and the Web app refuses the second one at startup (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` `lib/startup.js:40`):

```
error: --host 0.0.0.0 is intentionally not supported yet for safety: it would expose remote code execution to the network; use 127.0.0.1 instead
```

**Consequence.** There is no way to expose the Web UI — or anything built on it, such as a LAN manager for a small fleet of harness instances — to another machine on the same network. A specific interface (the LAN address the machine already has) cannot be named at all.

**What makes this worth revisiting.** The fence a LAN bind would need already exists and already runs: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`'s `resolveLanTrust` (`lib/index.js:83`) computes the non-internal IPv4 addresses, folds them into `trustedHosts` for the `/api` browser-trust fence, and the ready banner announces a LAN candidate (`lib/index.js:199`). All of it is gated on `bindHost === "0.0.0.0"`, which startup rejects, so on the CLI path it is unreachable.

Note also that with a non-wildcard bind that function returns an empty `lanAddresses` and a `trustedHosts` of only the explicit `--trusted-host` values, so a specific-interface bind would need its own address added to the fence to be usable.

**Suggested shape.** Accept an explicit interface literal — `--host 192.168.1.5` — and continue to reject the all-interfaces wildcard, or gate that wildcard behind an explicit opt-in. Binding one address exposes the listener only on the subnet that address is on, and lets the existing trust fence do its job. If remote code execution is the concern, an opt-in flag that also requires a token or an allowlist is the safer form than a silent wildcard bind.

**Acceptance.** `dsh web --host <a non-internal IPv4 literal of this host>` serves on that address and prints it in the ready banner; a browser on another machine on the same subnet can load it; and the `/api` fence still rejects a Host header that is neither the bound address nor an explicit `--trusted-host`.

*(Re-verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.6-alpha.2; the line numbers above are that version's.)*

discussions.title: [Bug] Web 侧栏会话列表在 0.1.5-rc.1 → rc.2 升级后整块消失（dsh.workspace.view.v5 缺 sessionUpdatedAtByAccount）
discussions.body:
### 概述
把官方 CLI 从 `0.1.5-rc.1` 升级到 `0.1.5-rc.2` 后，Web 左侧边栏的「工作区 + 会话列表」整块消失，只剩「新会话 / 插件面板 / 设置」。**会话数据完好**，是前端 slot 抛异常导致渲染中断。

### 现象
浏览器控制台：
```
slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces': TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries (<anonymous>)
    at retainAccountKeys (... @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/client.js ...)
```

### 根因
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js`：
- `retainAccountKeys`（约 :214）直接对 `d.groupExpansion`、`d.sessionOrderByAccount`、`d.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount` 做 `Object.entries(...)`；
- 它在侧栏 effect（约 :2017，`workspacePhase === "ready"` 时）被调用；
- 该状态持久化在浏览器 localStorage 的 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`；`init()` 的默认值含上述三个对象字段，但 **`init()` 只在键不存在时生效，不做字段级合并**；
- 旧版本写入的 v5 只有 4 个字段，**缺 `sessionUpdatedAtByAccount`** → 新代码读到 `undefined` → `Object.entries(undefined)` 抛错 → 整个 slot 崩掉 → 会话列表整块消失。

即：新版本读取了旧版本从未写入的字段，却没有升 persist 键版本（仍是 v5），也没有在 hydrate 时补默认值。

### 复现
1. 在 0.1.5-rc.1 下正常使用 Web UI（localStorage 里生成 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`）；
2. 升级 CLI 到 0.1.5-rc.2（同一浏览器、同一 origin）；
3. 打开 Web UI → 侧栏会话列表消失，控制台报上述错误。

### 临时修法（本机已验证）
补齐缺失字段并保留其余内容，然后刷新页面（先把原值备份一份）：
```js
const k = 'dsh.workspace.view.v5'
const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))
for (const f of ['groupExpansion', 'sessionOrderByAccount', 'sessionUpdatedAtByAccount'])
  if (o[f] === null || typeof o[f] !== 'object') o[f] = {}
localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(o))
```
刷新后控制台崩溃消失、会话列表恢复，原有会话排序保留。

### 建议修法
任选其一：① 升 persist 键（v5 → v6，优雅重置）；② hydrate 时按字段合并默认值；③ 给 `retainAccountKeys` 加空值防御。

### 环境
- dsh 0.1.5-rc.2（Windows 11，Node v24.19.0，Chromium 系浏览器）
- `DSH_HOME=C:\Users\Zhuang\.dsh`，profile `web`
- 备注：本仓库未开 Issues，故发在这里；需要日志或最小复现工程我可以补充。

discussions.title: [Bug] Uncaught ENOENT in dsh-subprocess-local OutputCollector.spillAll crashes the whole dsh web process (external cleanup removed temp dir)
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2`（npm 全局安装）
- OS: Windows 11 家庭中文版 build 22631
- Node: v24.19.0
- 启动方式: `dsh web --no-open`，连续运行约 19 小时

## 问题一（主）：`OutputCollector.spillAll` 遇临时文件缺失即整进程崩溃，无容错

### 现象

dsh web 主进程运行中突然退出（无任何用户操作），3080 立即不可达，全部在线会话随之中断。

### 崩溃栈（`%DSH_HOME%\dsh-web.log` 尾部原文）

```
node:fs:622
  return binding.open(
                 ^

Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\wneve\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-subprocess-nohJfW\dsh-subprocess-48336-2-68fa54d82f1d-stdout.log'
    at openSync (node:fs:622:18)
    at OutputCollector.spillAll (file:///C:/Users/wneve/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/output.js:101:19)
    at OutputCollector.push (file:///.../dsh-subprocess-local/lib/output.js:77:75)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (file:///.../dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner-launch-DGV26RBf.js:863:14)
```

### 触发链（已实证定案）

1. `dsh-subprocess-local` 把子进程 stdout 缓冲落盘到 `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-<rand>\`；
2. 外部清理工具（360 安全卫士「C 盘垃圾清理」）在 **dsh 运行期间**把该目录当垃圾整体删除——清理器视角这些确实是临时文件，清理行为本身合理；
3. dsh 侧 `OutputCollector.spillAll` 持有旧路径继续写入 → `ENOENT`；
4. 该路径无 try-catch，未捕获异常沿 `Socket → OutputCollector.push` 直接击穿主进程 → Node 整进程退出。

### 影响

单点临时文件丢失 = 整个 web 主机崩溃 + 全部会话中断。清理类软件在 Windows 上极常见，dsh 长时运行场景（本例 19 小时）几乎必然与某次清理撞车。

### 请求

1. `spillAll` / `output.js` 写盘路径加容错：目录/文件缺失时重建目录，或降级（放弃落盘仅保留内存缓冲、或仅记录 warning），不应让主进程崩溃；
2. 最低限度：catch `ENOENT` 并跳过该次 spill。

### 复现要点

Windows 上启动 `dsh web`，触发一个会产出子进程输出的任务，任务运行期间手动删除 `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-*` 目录，等待下一次 spill 即可复现崩溃。

## 问题二（附带，独立缺陷）：compact 的 `session/update` 通知被校验拒收（-32602）

同一份 `dsh-web.log`、崩溃之前记录：

```
Error handling notification { jsonrpc:'2.0', method:'session/update', params:{ ..., update:{ sessionUpdate:'agent_message_chunk',
  messageId:'compact-maxtoken-44df692f-...-1789758374222', content:[Array], _meta:[Object] } } }
{ code:-32602, message:'Invalid params', data:{ _errors:[], update:{ _errors:[], content:[Object], sessionUpdate:[Object], ... } } }
```

compact（`compact-maxtoken-*`）产出的 `agent_message_chunk` 通知未通过参数校验被拒。不致命（与本次崩溃无关），但 compact 结果可能因此丢失/不完整。请检查 compact 路径的 update 序列化是否符合 schema（怀疑缺字段或字段形态不符）。

discussions.title: [Bug] Host enters a CPU-bound loop and blocks the event loop when a turn starts in a large session (~700k+ tokens)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Starting a turn in a large session (~700k+ tokens of history) puts the host into a CPU-bound loop that blocks the Node event loop and never recovers on its own. The only way out is killing the process.

The web UI keeps showing its working indicator forever, and the HTTP endpoint stops answering entirely — so the in-UI stop button cannot reach the host either.

Observed twice, on two unrelated sessions. In one case the turn was a `/compact`; in the other it was an **ordinary user message**. So this is not specific to the compaction command.

## Reproduction

Not yet reduced to a minimal case — reporting the two observed occurrences.

- Session A: 3090 session events (~10.8 MB decompressed log). Wedged turn was `/compact`.
- Session B: 2109 session events (~9 MB decompressed log). Wedged turn was a plain user message.

In both cases the session had grown to roughly 700k–800k tokens of surface history before the wedging turn.

## Current behavior

Measurements taken while wedged (Windows):

- **CPU:** sustained 118–134% of one core — 376 s of CPU time accumulated over ~8 minutes of wall clock, and still climbing when the process was killed.
- **RSS:** ~1.25 GB.
- The session log (`session.v3.jsonl.zstd`) receives **no further events** — frozen for 8+ minutes.
- `GET http://127.0.0.1:3080/` times out: the event loop is blocked, so the host cannot serve anything at all.

The most useful clue: the **last recorded event is `turn/start`** (plus the `agent/inbox/spliced` that consumed the prompt). There is **no `step/start`, no `request/header`, and no `assistant/attempt`** afterward.

That means the runaway happens *before any model request is issued* — in turn preparation / context assembly / measurement, not in the LLM call. A normal long model call would be async and would leave the event loop responsive.

## Expected behavior

Either the turn proceeds, or it fails with an error. It should not be possible for a turn to block the host's event loop with no timeout and no recovery path.

## Environment

- DSH **0.1.5-rc.2** (profile copy and global npm install)
- Windows 11 Pro, build 26200
- Node **v24.21.0**
- Route: `llm-deepseek` (DeepSeek provider)

## Possibly related: the default completion reserve is larger than the compaction threshold leaves room for

Flagging this separately because I can reproduce it cleanly and it may share a root cause — it is also why my sessions grew large enough to hit the wedge above.

`dsh-llm-deepseek` defaults to `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 256e3`, and the automatic compaction threshold does not account for that reserve:

```
thresholdTokens = floor(contextWindow * thresholdRatio)   // thresholdRatio = 0.8
```

With `contextWindow = 1_000_000` the compaction threshold is **800,000**, while the request ceiling against the provider's real limit is `1_048_576 − 256_000 = 792_576` — i.e. **below** the threshold.

So any session in the ~792k–800k band fails with `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` before compaction ever gets a chance to run:

```
This model's maximum context length is 1048576 tokens. However, you requested 1053235 tokens
(797235 in the messages, 256000 in the completion).
```

Reproduced three times on the same session (turns 39, 41, 42), with slightly different message counts each attempt.

**Local workaround that removed it completely:** set an explicit top-level `maxTokens: 65536` for the `llm-deepseek` namespace (the per-model value would only cover one model). Request ceiling becomes 983,040 against a threshold of 800,000.

## Local workaround for the wedge itself

Raising the compaction threshold's safety margin by lowering the model `contextWindow` (which the threshold is computed from) — not a fix, just moving the point where sessions stop growing. The wedge itself remains reachable.

discussions.title: Bash execution failed from duplicate dsh-tools module instances
discussions.body:
## Summary

The Web runtime failed during bash execution with:

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading prepare)
```

## Root cause

`agent-loop` and the profile-loaded `ToolRuntime` resolved `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` through different module URLs in the same Node process. Each module instance created its own `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` symbol with `Symbol(...)`. The symbols had the same description but different identity, so `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` returned `undefined`.

Printf diagnostics showed a real `ToolRuntime` containing `Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)`, while the lookup from `agent-loop` still failed.

## Fix

The scheduler key now uses:

```ts
Symbol.for("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler")
```

This preserves symbol identity across duplicate module instances. The temporary diagnostics were removed.

## Validation

- Bash integration tests: 4 passed
- Host library build: passed
- Live Web bash execution: passed

This is a runtime module-resolution duplication issue, not a pnpm version duplication issue.

discussions.title: session/fork inherits the next turn's inbox insert → phantom queued input in the child
discussions.body:
## Summary

`session/fork` with an `atSeq` inside a non-final turn produces a child whose inbox contains a phantom queued input: the child inherits the parent's `agent/inbox/spliced` **insert** for the *next* turn's user message, but not the `turn/start` / inbox **remove** that consumed it. The child is idle (no turn starts on seed), so the queued item never runs and cannot be explained from the child's own transcript.

Version: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-alpha.2 (`dsh-api-session-controller`).

## Reproduction

1. Session with ≥ 2 completed turns, each started by a normal user message (inbox → turn).
2. `session/fork { sessionId, atSeq: <seq of turn N's turn/end> }` where turn N+1 exists.
3. Inspect the child: `inheritedEventCount` covers seq up to just before turn N+1's `turn/start`; the last inherited event is `agent/inbox/spliced { target: "next-turn", inserted: [<turn N+1 user message>] }`. The child shows one pending queued input and never runs it.

Concrete log tail from a parent (turn 10 → 11):

```
seq 188 turn/end            {turn: 10}
seq 189 command/run         permission
seq 190 command/done
seq 191 agent/inbox/spliced target=next-turn inserted=[user message for turn 11]   <- inherited
seq 192 turn/start          {turn: 11}                                              <- NOT inherited
seq 193 agent/inbox/spliced target=next-turn removedCount=1                         <- NOT inherited
```

Forking at `atSeq: 188` yields a child with `inheritedEventCount: 192` (seq 0–191), then `session/end-seed`, `session/title`.

## Cause

`packages/api/session-controller` (`lib/index.js`, `fork()`):

```js
const boundary = source.events.find(e => e.type === "turn/end" && e.seq >= atSeq) ?? ...;
let cut = SessionLogOffset(boundary.seq + 1);
while (cut < source.events.length && source.events[cut]?.type !== "turn/start") cut++;
```

Advancing `cut` up to the next `turn/start` is presumably meant to carry over inter-turn housekeeping (`session/title`, `feedback/*`, `session/end-seed`, `command/*`), but it also swallows the `agent/inbox/spliced` insert that precedes every user-initiated `turn/start`. Since the matching removal is emitted *after* `turn/start`, the child's inbox fold ends with an unconsumed item.

The same applies to a steer queued mid-turn N that is later promoted to turn N+1 (`next-turn` insert inside turn N, removal after `turn/start` N+1).

## Expected

A fork through turn N should have an empty inbox. Either:

- stop the cut at `boundary.seq + 1` and let housekeeping events be re-derived, or
- keep advancing but skip `agent/inbox/spliced` (allow-list only the housekeeping types), or
- after seeding, emit a compensating `agent/inbox/spliced removedCount` for any items the seed leaves pending.

## Workaround (client side)

After fork, inspect the child's inbox projection and cancel inherited items, or send a new message (the phantom item runs first).

discussions.title: [Bug] messages protocol: prepare undefined crash on tool_use, then INVALID_REQUEST on retry
discussions.body:
## Environment
- DSH version: `0.1.6-alpha.2` (source deploy)
- OS: Windows 11
- Provider: `deepseek-official` (default `deepseek-flash`)
- Protocol: `messages` (default)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start `pnpm dsh web`, open Web UI
2. Send a message that triggers tool calling (e.g. ask the model to search, read files, or use any MCP tool)
3. Model returns `tool_use` blocks
4. DSH client crashes with: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`
5. On the next turn (or retry), DeepSeek API rejects with: `INVALID_REQUEST: DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results`

## Expected Behavior
Tool result should be prepared and sent back to the API as `tool_result` blocks following the `tool_use` assistant message.

## Actual Behavior
1. Client-side JS error: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` — the tool result preparation step crashes
2. Because tool results are missing from the conversation, the next API call fails with `INVALID_REQUEST: tool calls need immediate results` (the messages protocol requires `tool_result` blocks immediately after `tool_use`)

## Root Cause Hypothesis
In `messages` (Anthropic) protocol mode, the tool result serialization path references a `prepare` method on an object that is `undefined`. This may be a missing null-check or a race condition where the tool handler isn't fully initialized before results are expected.

## Workaround
Switch to `chat-completions` protocol (works fine):
```yaml
llm-deepseek:
  protocol: chat-completions
  baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com/v1
  apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
```

## Logs
```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
UNKNOWN

DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results
INVALID_REQUEST
```

discussions.title: Bug: approveEscalation fails closed on equal-mode sandbox_permissions, bricking sessions
discussions.body:
## Bug: `approveEscalation` fails closed on equal-mode `sandbox_permissions`, bricking sessions

### Summary
When a model includes the **optional** `sandbox_permissions` field on a `bash` tool call with the session's *current* sandbox mode, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox` rejects the call with:

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
```

Because some models (observed with gpt-6-astra via an OpenAI-compatible proxy) attach this field to *every* bash call, the entire session becomes unusable — every tool call fails before executing, even though nothing is being escalated.

### Reproduction
1. Start a DSH session (default mode `workspace-write`).
2. Model emits a `bash` call including `"sandbox_permissions": "workspace-write"` (the field is optional per the tool schema: "Only valid as a one-shot retry of a command the sandbox just denied").
3. `approveEscalation` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox` throws because `workspace-write` is not strictly wider than `workspace-write`.
4. The command never executes. Repeat for every call → session bricked.

Prompt-level steering ("omit the field") does not reliably work — the model treats the exposed field as required.

### Why this is a bug, not a model problem
Requesting the mode the session *already operates at* confers zero additional privilege. Failing closed here buys no security; it only turns a harmless redundant field into a total denial of service. The schema marks the field optional, but the validator treats any non-wider request as a violation — those two are inconsistent.

### Proposed fix
In `approveEscalation`, treat `requested == current mode` as a no-op grant (return the current mode):

- `requested == current` → allow (no privilege change)
- `requested` strictly narrower → keep failing closed
- `requested` strictly wider → keep the existing approval flow

This preserves all real escalation checks while making sessions robust against models that redundantly echo the optional field.

### Environment
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox@0.1.5-rc.2` (also present in earlier 0.1.5 pre-releases)
- Observed via DSH web UI sessions backed by an OpenAI-compatible model proxy

discussions.title: [Bug][0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.6-alpha.2] sessionQuery.readSession rejects valid forked sessions
discussions.body:
`sessionQuery.readSession()` rejects a valid forked session, even immediately after the native `SessionStore.fork()` producer creates it. `readSurface()`, `listEvents()`, title reads and restoration-based `observeSession()` succeed on the same session.

Reproduced with complete, matching package graphs for **0.1.5-rc.2** and **0.1.6-alpha.2**, on macOS ARM64 / Node 24.19.0. The fixtures used native Session/Agent producers and persistence; no edited JSONL, model turn or provider call was involved.

### Reproduction

In a native integration test with `sessions` and `sessionQuery` mounted, use a live parent at a stable between-turn boundary:

```js
const child = ctx.sessions.fork(parent, undefined, crypto.randomUUID())
await ctx.sessionQuery.readSurface(child.id) // succeeds
await ctx.sessionQuery.readSession(child.id) // throws
```

Observed error:

```text
seeded session constructor seed must equal its inherited prefix
```

Expected: the complete, replay-validated raw log of the valid child.

The Agent factory path reproduces too: capture the parent's actual `snapshotEvents()`, call `agents.create()` with that seed, `inheritedEventCount: seed.length`, and `meta: { parentSession: parent.id, isSeeded: true, cwd }`. Its original inherited prefix was verified unchanged. Awaiting handle disposal and restarting DSH do not resolve the failure.

| Native observation | rc.2 | alpha.2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Factory child immediately after creation, before its own human message | throws | throws |
| Child after its own human message | throws | throws |
| Official `sessions.fork()` child | throws | throws |
| Persisted child after disposal and after restart | throws | throws |
| Unseeded parent after restart | succeeds | succeeds |

### Cause

The published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query` reader loads the **complete** log, then calls:

```js
Session.create(sessionId, loaded.events, loaded.header, loaded.inheritedEventCount)
```

This is at `lib/index.js:1075` in rc.2; alpha.2 retains the call at line 1076 with an additional projections argument.

`Session.create()` selects creation/snapshot mode. Its seeded-session invariant requires the supplied event count to equal the inherited prefix. But native construction itself appends a child-owned `session/end-seed` marker, so the complete log already exceeds that prefix before any child message. In the factory reproduction the cut was 4 and the immediate log length was 5; after the child message/title it was 7.

A narrow repair direction is to validate complete logs through the restoration path (`Session.fromRestore`), respecting its event-ownership contract. Keep the original inherited count and the strict creation invariant. I have not applied or validated that repair.

Suggested regressions: native fork before/after its own append, cold fork after restart, and an unseeded control. This report exercises the native factory and SessionStore APIs; it does not claim an end-to-end UI fork test.

discussions.title: [bug]「只有 reasoning、无可见正文也无工具调用」的响应被判为成功 ⇒ 静默空回复
discussions.body:
# [Bug] 只含 reasoning 的响应被判为成功完成 ⇒ 静默空回复 / Response with only reasoning blocks is reported as completed ⇒ silent empty reply

## 摘要

当模型产出一条**只含 `reasoning` block、既没有 `text` 也没有 `tool-call`** 的最终消息时，Harness 把它当作**正常完成**：`turn/end` 记 `completed`、不报错、不重试、日志里没有任何异常痕迹。用户侧表现为「思考区滚完，正文一个字都没有」——看起来像客户端卡死或断流，而实际请求被判为"成功"。

同一判据缺陷在**两个适配器**里各出现一次（见「同一缺陷的第二个适配器」）。

## 环境

- DSH Desktop `0.1.5-rc.2`，Windows 11
- provider `deepseek-official`，model `deepseek-v4-flash`
- `reasoningEffort: high`，`maxTokens: 256000`
- 复现会话：单会话 46 轮，其中 **6 条**符合下述退化特征

## 证据

退化消息的共同铁证是 **`outputTokens` 恰好等于 `reasoningTokens`** ⇒ 整个输出预算都花在 reasoning 上，可见正文零 token：

| 本地时间 | turn/step | outputTokens | reasoningTokens | 输入侧上下文 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 16:46:11 | 39/9 | 259 | 259 | ≈627k |
| 17:10:24 | 42/1 | 1007 | 1007 | ≈634k |
| 17:11:17 | 43/1 | 976 | 976 | ≈635k |
| 17:14:09 | 44/1 | 537 | 537 | ≈636k |
| 17:15:09 | 45/1 | 991 | 991 | ≈637k |
| 17:17:01 | 46/1 | 928 | 928 | ≈642k |

推理内容本身呈**自我催促循环**（复读），例如结尾形如：

```
好。**Go.** 好。（执行。）好。**（输出。）**好。—— 立即。
好。**（我停止循环，输出工具调用。）**好。写。好。**Go.** 好。（我立即输出。）
```

### 与「流中断」的区别（同一现象，两个成因）

审计同一批日志时还发现另外 2 条「只有 reasoning」的消息，但它们是**另一种成因**，混为一谈会开错处方：

| 成因 | 判据（可机械区分） | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **推理退化**（本文将报的） | 有 `usage`，且 `outputTokens === reasoningTokens`；推理文本呈低熵复读 | 需要模型侧/框架侧干预 |
| **流中断** | `data.interrupted === true`，或整条没有 `usage`；推理文本正常，只是被硬切断（本次两条的思考停在半条 shell 命令上） | 传输问题，与上下文体积无关 |

## 相关因素（统计，非因果断言）

扫描 18 个会话日志、共 2584 条 `assistant/message`：

| 输入侧上下文 | 消息数 | 其中「只有 reasoning」 | 占比 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 – 50k | 278 | 0 | 0% |
| 50k – 100k | 274 | 0 | 0% |
| 100k – 200k | 538 | 0 | 0% |
| 200k – 400k | 798 | 0 | 0% |
| 400k – 600k | 414 | 0 | 0% |
| **≥ 600k** | **280** | **6** | **2.14%** |

- 6 条退化**全部**落在同一个「上下文 ≥ 600k」的会话里；
- **但大上下文不是充分条件**：另有两个会话最大上下文达 **791k / 793k**，退化 **0** 条（轮数 56 / 115）；
- **一旦出现就会连续**：turn 42 → 43 → 44 → 45 → 46 连中五轮 ⇒ 疑似「空消息被写回上下文后**自我强化**」（模型看到自己上一轮"只想了没说"，更容易重复）。

## 根因定位（源码）

### 1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`

`lib/index.js` 的 `translate()` 处理 `[DONE]` 哨兵处：

```js
const reason = pendingFinish ?? { kind: "stop" };
yield {
  type: "finish",
  reason: reason.kind === "stop" && order.length === 0 ? {
    kind: "error",
    failure: { message: "model returned a completed response with no content",
               code: EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE }
  } : reason
};
```

判据是 **`order.length === 0`**（一个 block 都没打开）。而 reasoning block 会先 `open("reasoning")` 并进入 `order`，因此**「只有 reasoning」的消息 `order.length === 1`** ⇒ 直接走 `reason`（`stop`）⇒ 被判为**成功**。

另外，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 已导出 `assistantStreamHasVisibleContent` / `assistantStreamHasVisibleText`（见该包 `lib/index.js` 导出表），但本 adapter 未使用它们。

### 2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`（同一缺陷的第二个适配器）

`lib/index.js` 的 `mapStopReason()`：

```js
case "stop":
  if (message.content.length === 0) return {
    kind: "error",
    failure: { message: `model "${message.model}" returned a completed response with no content`,
               code: EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE }
  };
  return { kind: "stop" };
```

同样是**只看「块数为 0」**。而该 adapter 的 `content` 里有思考块（pi-ai 原生 message 用 `type: "thinking"`；`completeTerminalMessage()` 从流块恢复时用 DSH 风格的 `type: "reasoning"`）⇒ 只要模型思考过，`content.length ≥ 1` ⇒ 判 `stop` ⇒ **同样静默成功**。

修判据时需注意：这里**两种类型名都要认**（工具块为 `toolCall` 或 `tool-call`，正文块两条路径都是 `text`）。

## 影响

- 用户侧完全无感于"出错"：**没有报错、没有重试、日志无痕**（`turn/end` 仍是 `completed`），无法自查；重发也常继续退化（见上表连续五轮）；
- 与另一种故障形态可区分：真·断流（服务端未发 `[DONE]`）会抛 `STREAM_CLOSED`，那条路径**至少有错误**。

## 建议

1. **主建议**：把两个适配器的判据都从「块数为 0」放宽为「**没有可见正文且没有工具调用**」（`dsh-llm-deepseek` 可直接改用现成的 `assistantStreamHasVisibleContent`），并映射为 `EMPTY_RESPONSE` —— 该错误码**已在默认重试白名单内**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/types/retry-policy.js` 的 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`），于是这类空回复能被自动重试救回，而不是静默失败。
2. **可选**：重试时不要把这条"空消息"原样写回上下文（针对上面的自我强化现象）。
3. **可选（框架层）**：目前内置的 `guard/` 家族（`timeout-policy`、`repeat-tool-reminder`）都以**工具调用**为中心，而退化的典型形态恰恰是**不发工具调用**。若在 agent-loop 层增加一个「连续 N 步无可见产出」的守卫，可在重试之外更早地打断（这一层的事前干预比事后重试更省 token）。
4. **附带一问**：`STREAM_CLOSED`（真正的流截断）**不在** `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 里，因此真断流不会自动重试（对比：`TRANSPORT` 在内，故传输类失败会自动重试）。是否有意如此？若纳入，用户侧"说一半没了"的问题也能显著减少。

## 自查方法

扫描会话日志（多帧 zstd，需逐帧解压）中所有 `assistant/message` 记录，判定：

```js
const blocks  = rec.data.message.content;             // 数组
const hasText = blocks.some(b => b.type === 'text'   && b.text?.trim());
const hasTool = blocks.some(b => b.type === 'tool-call');
const hasReason = blocks.some(b => b.type === 'reasoning' && b.text?.length);
const suspect = hasReason && !hasText && !hasTool;    // ← 候选；还需按下表分类

// 分类（两者成因不同，处置也不同）
const u = rec.data.usage || {};
const degenerate = suspect && u.reasoningTokens > 0
  && u.outputTokens === u.reasoningTokens;            // ← 本文所述退化
const interrupted = suspect && (rec.data.interrupted === true
  || Object.keys(u).length === 0);                    // ← 流中断，非本文所报
```

配合 `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens`（上下文体积）即可定位高发区间。

discussions.title: 侧边栏 Markdown 文档预览不渲染本地/相对路径图片（未接入 pathImages 改写器）
discussions.body:
说明：仓库未开放 Issues，故将此问题反馈发在 Discussions；如需最小示例工程或补充信息可以留言。

### 环境

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`（npm 全局安装）
- Web GUI（`127.0.0.1:3080`），macOS + Chrome

### 现象

- 在侧边栏 preview 打开工作区内的 `.md` 文件，标准 Markdown 图片语法 `![alt](images/xxx.png)` 不渲染图片，只显示 alt 文本
- 同一文件在 VS Code / Obsidian / GitHub 中渲染正常（语法与相对路径均无问题）
- 对比：聊天消息流中，Markdown 里以 `/` 开头的**绝对路径**图片可以正常显示（经 `/api/file?path=...` 加载）

### 复现步骤

1. 工作区放置 `demo.md`，内容包含 `![示例](images/example.png)`，且 `images/example.png` 存在
2. Web GUI 侧边栏打开 `demo.md`
3. 图片位置仅显示 alt 文本「示例」

### 根因分析（源码定位）

`dsh-client-ui-primitives` 中 `imageSource(url, pathImages)` 的逻辑：非 `http(s)/blob/data` 协议的图片 URL 必须由 `pathImages.resolve()` 改写，否则返回 `undefined`，渲染层退化为 alt 文本 span：

```js
function imageSource(url, pathImages) {
  const remote = remoteImageUrl(sanitizeUrl(normalizeUri(url)));
  if (remote !== void 0) return remote;
  const rewritten = pathImages?.resolve(url);
  return rewritten === void 0 ? void 0 : vocabularyImageUrl(rewritten);
}
```

两个调用方的差异：

- **聊天渲染**（`dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 `AssistantMarkdown`）：传入了 `pathImages`，resolver `localPathMediaUrl` 把以 `/` 开头的绝对路径改写为 `${origin}/api/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` —— 所以聊天里本地图可见；
- **侧边栏文档预览**（`dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview` 的 `MarkdownBody`）：调用共享渲染器 `MarkdownText` 时只传 `text / streaming / labels`，**未传 `pathImages`** —— 导致侧边栏预览中本地图片（相对路径、绝对路径均）一律降级为 alt 文本。

### 期望行为

侧边栏 Markdown 预览支持本地图片：

1. 至少与聊天一致：支持以 `/` 开头的绝对路径；
2. 更理想：支持**相对路径**，按被预览文件所在目录解析（与 VS Code / Obsidian 行为一致），这样工作区内可移植的 Markdown 文档开箱即读。

### 修复建议

- `MarkdownBody` 构造与 chat 相同的 `pathImages` resolver；
- 相对路径先 join 被预览文件所在目录得到绝对路径，再交给 `/api/file`；
- 解析结果应限制在 workspace 根目录内，防止目录穿越。

### 补充

- `/api/file?path=` 路由已存在（无鉴权直接请求返回 401），鉴权加载链路可用；
- 社区已有 dsh-md-reader、dsh-sidebar-frog 等插件通过自带渲染器实现 Markdown 图片预览，可佐证该需求的普遍性。

discussions.title: [Bug] Tool call fails on Windows: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') — TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER unimplemented, ptc-runtime absent from all bundles
discussions.body: ### Environment - OS: Windows 11 (win32, x64) - Node.js: v24.12.0 - pnpm: 11.7.0 (pinned via `packageManager` in root package.json) - dsh version: `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2` (tag `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`, commit `ddefc45fbc`) - Install method: source build (`git clone` → `pnpm install` → `pnpm run build`) - Profile: `web` (via `pnpm dsh web`) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Fresh clone at tag `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2` 2. `pnpm install` 3. `pnpm run build` 4. `pnpm dsh web` — **startup succeeds, zero failed plugins** 5. Open a **new** session, send any prompt that triggers a tool call (e.g. a `Glob` file search) ### Actual behavior Every tool call fails with two cascading errors: ``` Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') ``` ``` DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results (400 INVALID_REQUEST) ``` The UI shows "本轮运行失败" (turn failed) with `UNKNOWN` / `INVALID_REQUEST` status tags. ### Root cause analysis The failure originates at: ```ts // packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170 const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec) ``` Grepping the whole repo, `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` appears **only as a declaration — there is no implementation assigned to it anywhere**: ``` packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:448 export interface ToolRuntimeScheduler { ... } packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463 export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:798 readonly [TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]: ToolRuntimeScheduler packages/core/tools/src/ptc.ts:550 const scheduler = registry[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] // consumer packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:153,154,170,174 // consumers packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/api-catalog.ts:6797,6800,6801 // API doc catalog only ``` So `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` resolves to `undefined`, and `.prepare(...)` throws immediately. Because the tool never executes, no tool result is produced. DeepSeek's API strictly requires each `assistant.tool_calls` entry to be followed by a matching `tool` message, so the next request is rejected with `400 INVALID_REQUEST / tool calls need immediate results`. **The second error is a consequence of the first, not an independent issue.** ### Suspected missing provider (needs maintainer confirmation) `packages/ptc-runtime/` exists in the tree and is the most likely provider of this scheduler. However: ```powershell Select-String -Path D:\dsh-fresh\packages\bundle\*\*\package.json -Pattern "ptc-runtime" # → no matches ``` `ptc-runtime` does **not** appear in the `package.json` of any of the six bundles: `packages/bundle/{base, web-app, headless, acp-app, sdk-app, sdk-minimal}`. I am **not certain** that `ptc-runtime` is the intended provider — this is my inference from the package name. If another package is supposed to register `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER`, please correct me. ### Important: startup is clean This is **not** a dependency or build problem. I verified: - `pnpm run build` completes successfully (all `lib/` produced) - `pnpm dsh web` starts with **zero failed plugins** (no new `Failed plugins` entry in `.dsh/logs/startup-*.log`) The failure happens at **runtime, during tool dispatch**, not at plugin activation. ### Things already ruled out - ✅ Corrupted `node_modules` — fully removed (`\\?\` prefix to bypass MAX_PATH) and reinstalled from scratch; also cleared the pnpm store - ✅ Wrong build entry — the correct entry is `pnpm run build` (`tsx scripts/build.ts`); note that `packages/*/*` have **no** `build` script, so `pnpm -r build` is a no-op for them - ✅ Port conflict (`EADDRINUSE` on 3080) — killed stale node processes - ✅ Poisoned session transcript — reproduced in a **brand-new** session - ✅ Platform-specific native addon — `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-landlock-run` (landlock) is Linux-only, but `sandbox-local` failing is non-blocking and unrelated to this stack ### Impact **Every** tool call fails, so the agent cannot do anything requiring tools on Windows. The session transcript also becomes permanently poisoned once an unpaired `tool_call` is written: all subsequent messages in that session return the same 400, and a restart does not repair it (the broken transcript is reloaded as-is). ### Questions for maintainers 1. Which package is supposed to provide the `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` implementation? 2. Should `ptc-runtime` be included in the `web` / `headless` bundles? If so, its absence looks like a packaging omission. 3. Is there a supported Windows path here, or is `web` profile unsupported on win32 at this version? 4. Can the runtime emit a clear error (e.g. "tool runtime scheduler not registered") instead of a raw `undefined` dereference? ### Additional context Happy to provide the full startup diagnostic log (`~/.dsh/logs/startup-*.log`) after redacting credentials, plus a screenshot of the failing turn.

discussions.title: 源码启动（pnpm dsh）后任何工具调用都失败：Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
discussions.body:
## Summary

非打包（源码检出）启动时，`runProfile` 的默认解析模式在 `9ddef327a4` 后从 `link` 变成 `runtime`。
该模式下 profile 插件被强制从各包目录的 `main`（`lib/index.js`）解析，而宿主自身经 tsx +
tsconfig `paths` 解析到 `src/`。同一份代码被加载两次，`Symbol` 型服务键在两个模块实例间不相等，
`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 得到 `undefined`，工具分发在 `.prepare` 处抛错。
任何工具调用都失败，全新会话第 1 轮即挂。

## Reproduction

    git checkout ddefc45fbc   # 0.1.6-alpha.2，与 upstream/master 一致
    pnpm install
    DSH_TOOLS_MODE=ptc pnpm dsh --profile headless "Run the bash tool to print exactly: PROBE_OK"

（`pnpm dsh` 即仓库脚本 `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`。）

## Current behavior

模型先正常产出一条 `run_code` 工具调用，随后：

    dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

该轮会话日志只有 `assistant/message` + `tool/call` + `step/end` + `turn/end`(error)，没有 `tool/result`。

定位过程：

- `tsconfig.base.json` 的 paths 将 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 映射到 `./packages/core/tools/src`，
  故宿主侧加载 `src`。
- `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` 与 `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js` 各自定义
  `Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler")`，是两个独立实例。
- `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts` 在 `resolutionMode !== 'link'` 时给 `PluginPackages` 传
  `{ generation, behavior: 'enforce' }`；`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts`
  在 `enforce` 分支直接 `return expected`，强制走 generation 的入口。

将 `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts` 中该默认值改回 `'link'` 后，同一条命令打印 `PROBE_OK`。

## Expected behavior

源码启动应正常工作。`dsh web` 路径没有任何 flag 或环境变量可覆盖此默认值
（`apps/cli/src/args.ts` 不解析 resolutionMode），该回归使源码检出完全不可用。

## Environment

- upstream/master `ddefc45fbc`（0.1.6-alpha.2）
- macOS 15 (darwin 23.6.0)，Node v26.3.0
- 引入提交：`9ddef327a4 feat: resolution mode link to runtime`（2026-09-17）

建议：非打包时保持 `'link'`；若确需 `'runtime'`，`behavior` 是否应从 `'enforce'` 降为
`'verify'`，以免覆盖宿主已有的 `src` 解析。

discussions.title: 工具分发抛错后未补合成 tool/result，会话被永久毒死且无恢复路径
discussions.body:
## Summary

`tool/call` 一旦落盘，若其后的调度 `prepare` 抛错，该调用永远不会得到 `tool/result`。
此后该会话的每次请求都会因 provider 侧配对校验失败而报
`DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results`（INVALID_REQUEST），会话永久不可用。

## Reproduction

制造任意一次工具分发失败（例如 resolutionMode 那个 issue 引起的失败），然后向同一会话继续发言。

代码路径：`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts` 的 `startCall` 中，

    callSeqs[index] = appendToolCall(session, turn, step, call.block)              // 先落 tool/call
    const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)    // 在此抛出

异常冒泡至外层 `catch` 后被 rethrow。该 call 既没有结果，也未进入 `inFlight`，
因此 `commitReady()` 同样不会补。

## Current behavior

    turn/end { kind: 'error', error: { message: 'DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results', code: 'INVALID_REQUEST' } }

每次发言都如此。`packages/core/session/src/repair.ts` 不会介入：它以 `openTurn === null`
判定日志 balanced 并直接 `return []`（注释 "Balanced log (no crash mid-turn): nothing to close"），
而此处 turn 已正常结束（`turn/end` 已写入）。也没有任何 CLI 或产品内恢复路径，用户只能放弃该会话。

会话日志形态（实测）：

    assistant/message  content=[reasoning, tool-call(id=X)]
    tool/call          callId=X
    step/end
    turn/end           { kind: 'error', ... }

## Expected behavior

分发 `prepare` 抛出时，应为已记录的 `tool/call` 追加一条错误 `tool/result`
（可直接复用 `repair.ts` 已有的合成结果形状与 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`），使 transcript 始终
provider-valid。`repair.ts` 也宜覆盖「turn 已结束但仍有未配对调用」的情形。

## Environment

- upstream/master `ddefc45fbc`（0.1.6-alpha.2）
- macOS 15 (darwin 23.6.0)，Node v26.3.0

补充：本地已按 `repair.ts` 的格式手工补合成结果恢复该会话——只需追加一条 `surfaceOp: 'append'`
的 `tool/result`；serialize 会合并连续的 user 消息并把 tool_result 重排到前，正好清掉 pending。

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-discord｜把 DSH 会话搬进 Discord：@提及派活、流式看进度、审批问询手机上点按钮
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**

**一句话：在绑定的频道里 `@机器人` + 任务描述，一个线程被锚定、DSH 会话开跑，回答流式渲染进线程；审批和问询变成按钮和下拉框，手机上就能答。**

项目地址 / 文档：
- GitHub：https://github.com/addozhang/dsh-discord
- npm：[`@addozhang/dsh-discord`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@addozhang/dsh-discord)
- 文档：[中文 README](https://github.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/blob/main/README.zh.md) ｜ [English README](https://github.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/blob/main/README.md)

## 为什么做这个

DSH 的会话活在浏览器里。人一离开电脑，agent 卡在审批上就只能干等；想在手机上看一眼进度，也没有顺手入口。

所以写了这个插件，把 Discord 当 DSH 的「驾驶舱」：**无需额外进程**——适配器以插件形式直接挂载到 `dsh web` profile 上；会话状态始终留在 DSH，持久化绑定存 profile 的 storage domain。

## 能干什么

- **@提及即派活** — 授权用户在绑定频道 `@bot <任务>`：消息成为线程首帖，DSH 会话创建并**至多提交一次**；线程内后续消息免提及排队。附带图片走多模态模型（CDN 下载、严格尺寸/域校验）。
- **流式渲染** — typing 指示、一条 head 消息原位编辑、每工具活动行、长回答分栏、收尾一次性 finalize；verbosity 三档可调（`text-only` / `essential-tools` / `full-tools`）。
- **审批与问询变交互控件** — DSH 的 ask 渲染成按钮、下拉选择和文本弹窗；所有权校验（提问人或线程主人才能点），过期自动拒绝、fail-closed，已处理的控件原地置灰。
- **会话控制** — `/steer` `/stop` `/queue list|remove`（回合所有权校验）；`/project bind|list|info` 服务器↔工作区绑定；`/session resume` 从历史会话恢复进新线程（重启后只补投错过的消息，持久化渲染水位防重放）。
- **模型切换** — `/model show` 读会话实时目录；`/model select` 走 provider → model → reasoning 级联选择，默认全体授权成员可用，可收紧到 Host 操作员。
- **双语开箱即用** — 所有 Discord 可见文案中英双份，跟随 DSH 语言偏好；设置卡片管 token 引导、服务器白名单、自动归档、语言。
- **默认收紧的安全设计** — deny-first 授权 + 显式服务器白名单（白名单外零调用）；mention 双重抑制；提交 at-most-once + 未知结果 nonce 对账，绝不盲目重发；绑定跨重启存活，READY 对账自愈被删频道。

## 安装

按你当前的 dsh 通道选一条：

| 你的 dsh | 安装命令 | 适配器版本 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.1.5` stable（`latest`） | `dsh plugin --profile web add @addozhang/dsh-discord` | 0.4.0 |
| `0.1.6-alpha`（`alpha`） | `dsh plugin --profile web add @addozhang/dsh-discord@next` | 0.5.0-rc.2 |

> 0.5.x 使用 0.1.6 的 controller 服务面，不兼容旧 `apiProxy` 面（那条线由 0.4.x 对应）。适配器 0.5.x 走 npm `next` 通道，宿主升 stable 后会跟发正式版。

装好后三步：
1. [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) 建应用 + bot，打开 **MESSAGE CONTENT** privileged intent，邀请 bot（View Channels、Manage Channels、Send Messages、Create Public Threads、Send Messages in Threads、Attach Files、Read Message History）
2. 重启 `dsh web` → 网页 **Settings → Discord**：粘贴 bot token → **Connect**（token 存 Host credential service，不进 settings/日志/客户端），填 **Allowed servers**，选语言
3. 在绑定频道里 @机器人，开跑

要求：Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`。

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

function/namespace 插件，注入 `sessionController` / `workspaceController` / `sessionQuery` / `webServer` / `credentials` / `settings` / `storageDomain` / `connection` 八个服务：Discord Gateway 长连接、斜杠命令面、流式渲染器和设置卡片全部挂载在 web profile 上。会话提交走 `sessionController.prompt`（requestId 幂等）；审批/问询通过服务边界补丁接入 Discord 按钮流，未绑定会话原样透传——web UI 的审批面板不受影响。

## 截图

一次任务的完整生命周期（@提及锚定线程 → 工具活动行流式刷新 → 最终回答以 Markdown 表格落格）：
![task lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/main/docs/images/discord-task-lifecycle.jpg)

流式中：head 消息原位编辑 + 每工具活动行 + typing：
![streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/main/docs/images/discord-thread-streaming.jpg)

审批/问询以按钮与下拉呈现，处理后原地置灰：
![approval flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/main/docs/images/discord-approval-flow.jpg)

服务器侧：DSH 分类与工作区频道由适配器供给、READY 自愈：
![channel list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/main/docs/images/discord-channel-list.jpg)

网页设置卡片（连接、白名单、自动归档、语言）：
![settings card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/main/docs/images/settings-card.png)

## 质量与诚实边界

- **729 个测试**（含 gateway/REST digital-twin E2E），CI 绿，npm 走 OIDC trusted publishing——任何地方都不存发布凭证
- 已知边界直说：verbosity 目前是全局单一设置；`/preset` `/skill` `/host` 暂未注册（模块已实现，等路由接线）；流式编辑最小间隔 250ms，撞 Discord 编辑限额时靠 429 自愈
- 完整能力表、配置项与已知限制都写在 [README](https://github.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/blob/main/README.zh.md)，不藏着

有 bug、有想法，欢迎评论区聊或去 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/addozhang/dsh-discord/issues)——每个反馈都会被看到。

**再贴一次安装命令，方便直接复制：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @addozhang/dsh-discord        # dsh 0.1.5 stable
dsh plugin --profile web add @addozhang/dsh-discord@next   # dsh 0.1.6-alpha
```

🔗 https://github.com/addozhang/dsh-discord

discussions.title: [Bug] 大会话下拖动滚动条 / 分栏手柄，浏览器主进程单线程 100% 自旋，页面长时间失去响应
discussions.body:
## Summary

当**一个大会话（50 轮以上）正处于工作中**（agent 在跑、最好同时有子代理在工作）、**且它是当前选中的会话**时，以下两种鼠标拖拽操作会让浏览器**主进程（browser process）单线程 100% 自旋**（该线程 `Running`、优先级 `AboveNormal`，其余线程全部 `Wait`），页面随即完全失去响应，持续数十秒到数分钟，直到拖拽停止才自行恢复：

- **拖动顶部栏「子代理」hover 浮窗中，子代理列表的滚动条**
- **拖动对话区分栏的尺寸手柄，来回改变对话区宽度**

同一页面在三个不同的 Chromium 宿主上均可复现；DSH 服务端进程全程正常（其它客户端可继续交互），**只有当前这个浏览器页面卡死**。

## Reproduction

**前置条件（关键）**：

1. 一个**轮数较多（50 轮以上）**的会话
2. 该会话**处于工作中** —— agent 正在执行，**最好同时有子代理在工作**
3. 该会话是**当前选中的会话**（在界面上打开并聚焦着它）

**触发步骤（两种都稳定复现）**：

- **方式 A（子代理浮窗）**：把鼠标移到顶部栏的「子代理」上，等 hover 浮窗展开，然后**按住浮窗中「子代理列表」的滚动条上下拖动**
- **方式 B（分栏手柄）**：**按住对话区分栏的尺寸手柄，来回拖动改变对话区宽度**

**触发稳定性说明**：

- 上述两种**拖拽**操作稳定复现；**鼠标滚轮只是偶发**，不是稳定触发方式
- 会话**空闲时不容易触发**，必须处于工作状态（有持续流式更新/子代理状态推送）
- 会话轮数少时未复现，50 轮以上明显更容易触发
- 与第三方插件无关（见 Environment，已在纯净 profile 下复现）

## Current behavior

页面失去响应时，浏览器主进程的线程级读数：

| 宿主 | 版本 | 主进程 CPU | 线程读数 | 句柄 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chrome | 153.0.8010.52 | 94.9% | `tid=9012` 94.9% `Running` `AboveNormal`，其余 58/59 全 0% | 不动 |
| Edge | 153.0.4234.32 | 96.1% | `tid=25088` 94.1% `Running` `AboveNormal`，其余 73/74 全 0% | 1865→1865 |
| WebView2 | 153.0.4234.32 | 97.7% | `tid=17400` 97.7% `Running` `AboveNormal`，其余 60/61 全 0% | 不动 |

共同特征：**单线程吃满一个核、优先级 AboveNormal、其余线程全部 Wait、句柄数不增长**。renderer 进程只是正常重渲染（实测 27%~77%），不是它卡住；DSH 的 node 服务进程 CPU 平稳。

页面无响应期间，同一 DSH 服务下的**其它浏览器客户端完全正常**；拖拽负载停止后自行恢复。

## Expected behavior

拖动子代理浮窗的列表滚动条、拖动分栏尺寸手柄，应当只引起页面按帧重绘，不应使浏览器主进程进入持续忙循环，更不应导致页面长时间（数十秒~数分钟）无法交互。

## Environment

- DSH：`0.1.6-alpha.2`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`，pnpm 全局安装）
- profile 内**仅 4 个官方组合包**（dsh-base / dsh-web-app / dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile / dsh-experimental-agent-team-web-profile），**第三方插件已全部移除** —— 已排除第三方插件因素
- OS：Windows（x64）
- 浏览器：Chrome 153.0.8010.52、Edge 153.0.4234.32、WebView2 Runtime 153.0.4234.32（三种宿主均复现，与具体浏览器产品无关，指向 Chromium 层）
- 会话状态：**running（agent 执行中，含活跃子代理）**，轮数 50+，且为当前选中会话

## 补充分析（供参考，不影响复现）

### 1. 为什么必须「会话工作中」才触发

会话工作时，页面处于**持续流式更新**状态：消息增量、子代理状态、列表投影都在不停重建。此时拖拽产生的 100+ Hz `pointermove` 与这些更新**叠加**，才会把主进程推入忙循环；会话空闲时同样拖拽，负载不足以触发。子代理在跑会进一步放大——浮窗里的子代理列表需要反复重建（对应 trace 中的 `indexSubagentDescendants`）。

### 2. 前端拖拽 helper 没有做按帧节流

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend@0.1.6-alpha.2` 的 `dist/assets/index-8VXBH-f-.js`，偏移 **593246** 处的拖拽 helper（压缩名 `Tw`）：

```js
function Nw(e, r) { typeof e.setPointerCapture == "function" && e.setPointerCapture(r) }

function Tw(e, r, i) {
  Nw(e, r);
  const s = new AbortController, { signal: l } = s, c = f => f.pointerId === r;
  return window.addEventListener("pointermove", f => {
    c(f) && i.move(f)            // 每个 pointermove 直接同步调用 move
  }, { signal: l }),
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", f => { c(f) && (s.abort(), i.up(f)) }, { signal: l }),
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", f => { c(f) && (s.abort(), i.cancel()) }, { signal: l }),
  () => { s.abort() }
}
```

要点：**每个 `pointermove` 都直接、同步执行 `i.move(f)`，没有任何 `requestAnimationFrame` 或时间戳节流**；监听还挂在 `window` 上。整个 index bundle 中 `requestAnimationFrame` 仅出现 **2 次**，而 `ResizeObserver` 出现 **12 次**，节流基本没用在拖拽路径上。

### 3. 自采 Chrome trace 的热点与操作吻合

用户自采 trace（432.9s、800,691 个事件、233,167 个 CPU 样本 / 85.8s）：

```
idle                                      75.4%
(program)  布局/样式/绘制/合成/GC 合计     11.4s
JS                                          约 8%

热点函数：
  toBottom                   672ms   ← 滚动到底
  buildListSnapshot          296ms   ← 列表快照重建（@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller/lib/client.js，带 listSnapshotCache）
  projectList                 79ms
  indexSubagentDescendants    58ms   ← 子代理后代索引（对应子代理浮窗）
```

### 4. 可能的机制

拖拽产生 100+ Hz `pointermove` → 每个事件同步执行重量级重算 → 与流式更新叠加 → renderer 侧输入处理滞后 → **Chromium browser 进程的输入事件路由积压** → 主进程进入忙循环（单线程 `Running`/`AboveNormal`）。这也解释了滚轮（离散事件、浏览器自带节流）为何不稳定触发、会话越大越容易触发（列表快照与子代理索引耗时随规模增长）、以及为何必须会话处于工作中。

### 5. 建议

在拖拽 helper 中按帧合并 `pointermove`（每帧最多执行一次 `move`），手感不变但负载可降一个数量级：

```js
function Tw(e, r, i) {
  Nw(e, r);
  const s = new AbortController, { signal: l } = s, c = f => f.pointerId === r;
  let pending = 0, last = null;
  const onMove = f => {
    if (!c(f)) return;
    last = f;
    if (pending) return;
    pending = requestAnimationFrame(() => { pending = 0; i.move(last); });
  };
  window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { signal: l });
  // pointerup / pointercancel 同原实现，注意同时 cancelAnimationFrame(pending)
}
```

### 6. 附：这不是第三方插件导致

最初怀疑是第三方插件，已通过实验排除：移除全部第三方插件（profile 只剩 4 个官方组合包）后，Chrome 上仍稳定复现；且该现象在三种不同 Chromium 宿主上表现完全一致。

discussions.title: v0→v1 session migration refuses logs whose permission/preset event carries origin (producer/schema drift)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Sessions written around 0.1.2-rc.1 (2026-09-06 era) stamp the `permission/preset` event with an extra `origin` member:

```json
{"type":"permission/preset","seq":0,"time":1787364897008,"data":{"preset":"danger-full-access","origin":"default"}}
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1` declares the released v0 shape as exactly `{ preset }` (`disposition(["preset"])`, no optional members), so `assertReleasedV0Keys` throws on `origin` and the whole session is refused:

```
failed to observe session "…": @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1 refuses this format v0 Session: permission/preset 0 data has unexpected member "origin"; source v0 artifact remains unchanged
```

Current builds (0.1.6-alpha.2, and master as of 2026-09-19) no longer write `origin`, so this is producer/schema drift from a version window — but the affected v0 logs on disk stay permanently unloadable, and the session list plus any usage aggregation silently skips them.

## Minimal reproduction

A v0 `session.jsonl` containing only:

```jsonl
{"type":"session","version":0,"id":"session-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","createdAt":1787364896985,"cwd":"/tmp","delegationDepth":0,"agentPreset":"standard"}
{"type":"permission/preset","seq":0,"time":1787364897008,"data":{"preset":"danger-full-access","origin":"default"}}
```

framed as a zstd log (first frame = header line) fails migration with the error above. Removing `"origin"` lets it migrate cleanly.

## Suggested fix

Admit `origin` as optional in the v0 disposition for `permission/preset` and strip it during migration (a small `normalizeLegacyPermissionPreset` alongside the other normalizers in `migration.ts`), so the emitted v1 event stays schema-exact. More generally, the v0→v1 migration could tolerate and drop unknown informational members instead of refusing the whole session — fail-closed on unknown *event types* still makes sense.

(Issues are disabled on this repo, hence posting here. Observed on 20 real sessions across several workspaces; all load fine after locally stripping the member. Happy to send a PR if you agree with the approach.)

discussions.title: [Bug] DSH桌面版 0.1.0-rc.6 自定义中转站 DeepSeek V4 调用工具报 400 错误
discussions.body:
标题：DSH 使用自定义中转站时，DeepSeek V4 推理模型在工具调用轮次必现 400

### 环境
- DSH 版本：0.1.5-rc.2
- 操作系统：Windows 11
- 接入方式：自定义 OpenAI 兼容中转站（地址已脱敏）
- 协议：openai-completions
- 默认模型：gpt-5.6-terra（可用）
- 问题模型：deepseek-v4-flash、deepseek-v4.1-flash（必现 400）

### 复现步骤
1. 在 settings.yaml 中配置自定义中转站，api 设为 openai-completions。
2. 将默认模型切换为 deepseek-v4-flash 或 deepseek-v4.1-flash。
3. 新建会话，发送中文指令：“帮我列出当前目录的文件”。
4. 模型先输出 Think 思考内容，然后尝试调用 Pwsh 工具。
5. 工具调用轮次返回 400。

### 实际结果
本轮运行失败 400:
{"message":"Upstream error: 400","type":"invalid_request_error"}
代码：INVALID_REQUEST

### 对比测试
同一中转站、同一配置下，切换模型为 gpt-5.6-terra，工具调用正常。只有 DeepSeek V4 系列在开启思考模式并调用工具时必现 400。

### 推测原因
DSH 在序列化包含 tool_calls 的 assistant 历史消息时，可能丢弃了 reasoning_content 字段，导致中转站校验失败。非推理模型不受影响。

### 已尝试的兼容配置（均无效）
compat:
  supportsDeveloperRole: false
  requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true
  thinkingFormat: deepseek
  supportsStrictMode: true
  suppressReasoningContentReplay: false

### 附件
- session log（已脱敏，完整记录了 400 错误的触发过程和与 gpt-5.6-terra 的对比测试）
- settings.yaml（已脱敏）
