discussions.title: [Bug] Windows-only: empty `apiKeyEnv:` (YAML null) on a pi-ai route crashes every turn — 空值 apiKeyEnv 让 Windows 上每一轮请求都崩在 toUpperCase
discussions.body:
# 中文

## 摘要

在 pi-ai 路由上把 `apiKeyEnv` 留空（写成 `apiKeyEnv:`，YAML 解析为 `null`）之后，**Windows 上每一轮对话都必崩**，界面只显示一行：

```
本轮运行失败  Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')
```

错误码是 `UNKNOWN`，没有堆栈、也不指向任何配置项，用户基本无法自诊。同一份配置在 Linux/macOS 上不会崩——因为崩溃点本身带平台分支，见下文根因。

影响面不小：自定义中转/本地网关大多不需要密钥，「把 `apiKeyEnv` 留空」是写这类配置最自然的一步。

## 环境

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`（npm 全局安装，`dsh --version`）；`0.1.5-rc.2` 表现完全相同
- Windows（win32），Node v22.22.2
- 触发命令：`dsh web`；`dsh --profile headless "hi"` 同样复现
- 与预设无关：崩溃发生在模型调用之前的凭据解析阶段（我这边是默认的 `minimal` 预设）

## 最小复现

`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`（`baseURL` 指向一个不存在的端口，无需任何可用网关）：

```yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: myroute
  model: my-model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    myroute:
      apiKeyEnv:                 # 空值即可；换成有名字的凭据就不崩
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:9/v1
      models:
        - id: my-model
```

```sh
DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-repro dsh --profile headless "hi"
# dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')
```

`/tmp/dsh-repro/` 里只放这一份 `settings.yaml`，与真实配置隔离，结果一致。

## 实际结果

失败发生在**任何网络往返之前**，会话日志（`~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/session-*/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`）可以完整还原：

```json
{"type":"step/start","seq":6,"data":{"turn":1,"step":1}}
{"type":"request/header","seq":9,"data":{"header":{"config":{"provider":"myroute","model":"my-model",...}}}}
{"type":"assistant/attempt","seq":13,"data":{"turn":1,"step":1,"stream":[{"type":"chunk","chunk":{"type":"finish","reason":{"kind":"error","failure":{"message":"Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}}]}}
{"type":"turn/end","seq":15,"data":{"turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}}
```

`step/start` 到 `assistant/attempt` 相隔约 11 ms，而 `request/header` 已经正常生成（provider、model、tools 齐全），可见失败在发请求之前。

对照组（同样配置，只改 `apiKeyEnv` 一行）：

| 写法 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv:`（空值） | `dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')` |
| `apiKeyEnv: MYROUTE_API_KEY`（未设值） | `dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-pi-ai: no credential for provider route "myroute"; its profile resolves MYROUTE_API_KEY, which is not set ...` |
| `apiKeyEnv: ""`（显式空字符串） | `dsh: NO_ADAPTER: no adapter registered for provider "myroute"` |

第二行是「设计好的失败」——信息完整、可自诊；第一行是崩溃。第三行的 `NO_ADAPTER` 也是空值引发的一条费解路径，我没有继续深查，仅作记录。

## 根因

`null` 被当作「已命名的凭据」一路带到环境变量查询，最后在 win32 分支上对 `null` 调用 `toUpperCase()`：

1. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:491` —— 只有 `undefined` 才算「未命名凭据」，`null` 原样保留：

   ```ts
   ...apiKeyEnv === undefined ? {} : { apiKeyEnv: credentialRef(apiKeyEnv) },
   ```

2. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts:172-183` —— `ref = profile.apiKeyEnv`（`null`），`ref === undefined` 检查不成立，于是 `credentials.resolve(ref)`。
3. `packages/credentials/credentials-local/src/index.ts:558-561` —— `launchEnvironmentOf(ctx).getFrom(ref, ['process'])` 原样接收 `null`。
4. `packages/util/launch-environment/src/index.ts:60-63`：

   ```ts
   function lookupKey(name: string): string {
     return process.platform === 'win32' ? name.toUpperCase() : name
   }
   ```

   → `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')`
5. `packages/llm/llm/src/adapter-failure.ts:19` —— 非 `HarnessError` 的裸异常被包成 `HarnessError(thrownMessage(value), 'UNKNOWN')`，界面只剩一行 message，堆栈只在 `cause` 里。

**为什么只在 Windows**：`lookupKey` 只有 win32 分支会调用字符串方法；POSIX 分支直接返回原值，随后 `Map.get(null)` 查不到 → 落到凭据文件兜底 → 最终正常抛 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。同一份配置跨平台行为不同，是这个问题最难受的地方。（POSIX 侧为读码推导，本机无法实测。）

**为什么 schema 没拦住**：`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:323` 声明 `apiKeyEnv: z.string().role('credential-ref')`，而 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery@3.18.2` 的 `z.string()` 对 `null` 既不报错也不归一：

```js
z.object({ apiKeyEnv: z.string() })({ apiKeyEnv: null })   // → { apiKeyEnv: null }
```

## 期望结果

空值应当在**配置加载期**被处理，而不是运行期以 `TypeError` + `UNKNOWN` 的形式暴露：

1. 首选：把 `null` 与 `undefined` 同等看待（作者写下 `apiKeyEnv:` 时的本意几乎必然是「这条路由不配密钥」）。此时自定义路由会得到清晰的 `No API key for provider: myroute`，一眼可懂。
2. 或者：在 profile 解析阶段显式校验 `apiKeyEnv` 必须是非空字符串，直接报配置错误（例如「`apiKeyEnv` 不能为空；不需要凭据请删除整行」）。由于 `z.string()` 不拒 `null`，这一步得在 schema 或解析代码里补。
3. `lookupKey` 加个 `null` 守卫是便宜的保险，但根子在前两步——一个声明为 `string` 的参数不该由配置层递进 `null`。
4. 顺带一提：适配器把任意异常折叠成 `UNKNOWN` 时，若能带上抛出模块或 cause 摘要，这类问题可以少排查几个小时。

## 备注

- 绕过办法（本机已验证）：`apiKeyEnv:` 写成有名字的凭据，并在环境变量或网页 Models 页给出值；或整行删除（自定义路由会转为 `No API key for provider`）。
- 仓库不接 PR/Issue，故按 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 发在 Discussions；不需要补丁也没关系，希望这份根因定位能省下别人的时间。

---

# English

## Summary

Leaving `apiKeyEnv` empty on a pi-ai route — i.e. `apiKeyEnv:` with no value, which YAML parses as `null` — makes **every turn fail on Windows**, with the UI showing only:

```
本轮运行失败  Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')
```

The error code is `UNKNOWN`, there is no stack trace, and nothing points at the offending config key, so the failure is essentially undiagnosable from the UI. The same configuration does not crash on Linux/macOS, because the throwing call sits behind a platform branch (see Root cause).

The blast radius is not small: custom relays and local gateways usually need no API key, and leaving `apiKeyEnv` blank is the most natural way to write such a route.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2` (npm global install, `dsh --version`); `0.1.5-rc.2` behaves identically
- Windows (win32), Node v22.22.2
- Reproduced with `dsh web` and with `dsh --profile headless "hi"`
- Independent of the agent preset: the failure happens during credential resolution, before any model call (observed with the default `minimal` preset)

## Minimal reproduction

`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (`baseURL` points at a dead port, so no reachable gateway is needed):

```yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: myroute
  model: my-model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    myroute:
      apiKeyEnv:                 # empty is enough; a named credential does not crash
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:9/v1
      models:
        - id: my-model
```

```sh
DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-repro dsh --profile headless "hi"
# dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')
```

`/tmp/dsh-repro/` contains only this `settings.yaml`, isolated from the real configuration, with the same result.

## Current behavior

The failure happens **before any network round trip**, and the session log (`~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/session-*/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`) reconstructs it exactly:

```json
{"type":"step/start","seq":6,"data":{"turn":1,"step":1}}
{"type":"request/header","seq":9,"data":{"header":{"config":{"provider":"myroute","model":"my-model",...}}}}
{"type":"assistant/attempt","seq":13,"data":{"turn":1,"step":1,"stream":[{"type":"chunk","chunk":{"type":"finish","reason":{"kind":"error","failure":{"message":"Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}}]}}
{"type":"turn/end","seq":15,"data":{"turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}}
```

`step/start` to `assistant/attempt` is about 11 ms apart, and `request/header` was built normally (provider, model, and tools are all there), so the failure precedes the request.

Control group (same configuration, only the `apiKeyEnv` line changed):

| Spelling | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv:` (empty) | `dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')` |
| `apiKeyEnv: MYROUTE_API_KEY` (unset) | `dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-pi-ai: no credential for provider route "myroute"; its profile resolves MYROUTE_API_KEY, which is not set ...` |
| `apiKeyEnv: ""` (explicit empty string) | `dsh: NO_ADAPTER: no adapter registered for provider "myroute"` |

The second row is a designed failure — complete message, self-diagnosable. The first one is a crash. The third row's `NO_ADAPTER` is another opaque path triggered by an empty value; I did not dig into it and record it for completeness only.

## Root cause

`null` is treated as a named credential and carried all the way to an environment lookup, where the win32 branch calls `toUpperCase()` on it:

1. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:491` — only `undefined` counts as "no credential named"; `null` is kept verbatim:

   ```ts
   ...apiKeyEnv === undefined ? {} : { apiKeyEnv: credentialRef(apiKeyEnv) },
   ```

2. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts:172-183` — `ref = profile.apiKeyEnv` (`null`), the `ref === undefined` test fails, so `credentials.resolve(ref)` runs.
3. `packages/credentials/credentials-local/src/index.ts:558-561` — `launchEnvironmentOf(ctx).getFrom(ref, ['process'])` receives `null` unchanged.
4. `packages/util/launch-environment/src/index.ts:60-63`:

   ```ts
   function lookupKey(name: string): string {
     return process.platform === 'win32' ? name.toUpperCase() : name
   }
   ```

   → `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')`
5. `packages/llm/llm/src/adapter-failure.ts:19` — a non-`HarnessError` throw becomes `HarnessError(thrownMessage(value), 'UNKNOWN')`, so the UI keeps only the message and the stack survives only as `cause`.

**Why Windows only**: only the win32 branch of `lookupKey` invokes a string method; the POSIX branch returns the value as-is, `Map.get(null)` then misses, the lookup falls through to the credential file, and the run ends in a normal `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`. Different behaviour for the same configuration across platforms is the worst part of this report. (The POSIX behaviour is derived by reading the source; I could not test it locally.)

**Why the schema did not catch it**: `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:323` declares `apiKeyEnv: z.string().role('credential-ref')`, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery@3.18.2`'s `z.string()` neither rejects nor normalizes `null`:

```js
z.object({ apiKeyEnv: z.string() })({ apiKeyEnv: null })   // → { apiKeyEnv: null }
```

## Expected behavior

An empty value should be resolved at configuration load time, not surfaced at run time as a `TypeError` under `UNKNOWN`:

1. Preferred: treat `null` the same as `undefined` (anyone writing `apiKeyEnv:` almost certainly means "this route needs no credential"). A custom route then reports the clear `No API key for provider: myroute`.
2. Alternatively: validate in profile resolution that `apiKeyEnv` is a non-empty string and fail as a configuration error (e.g. "`apiKeyEnv` must not be empty; delete the line if the route needs no credential"). Since `z.string()` accepts `null`, this has to be added to the schema or to the resolution code.
3. A `null` guard in `lookupKey` is cheap insurance, but the fix belongs in the two steps above — a parameter declared `string` should never receive `null` from the configuration layer.
4. Related: when the adapter flattens an arbitrary throw into `UNKNOWN`, keeping the throwing module or a `cause` summary would have saved hours of diagnosis here.

## Notes

- Workaround (verified locally): give `apiKeyEnv:` a name and provide the value through the environment or the web Models page, or delete the line entirely (a custom route then reports `No API key for provider`).
- The repository takes no PRs or issues, so this goes to Discussions per `CONTRIBUTING.md`. No patch needed — I hope the root-cause analysis saves someone else the time.

discussions.title: [Bug] Turn changed-files card attributes a concurrent writer's changes to this session (workspace-wide git snapshot, no per-session attribution)
discussions.body:
## Summary

The per-turn changed-files card lists **every** path whose content differs between the turn's start and end working-tree snapshots, regardless of who wrote it. When two sessions share one workspace — or any other process writes to it while a turn is in flight — session A's card includes session B's files, so the card reads as "this agent edited these files" even though none of A's tool calls touched them. Verified on `0.1.6-alpha.2`.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.6-alpha.2`, Web UI on macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), Node v26.5.1, git 2.50.1
- One workspace open in **two** DSH sessions at the same time (different models); the same workspace also had a Gradle build and a separate daemon writing files

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the same working directory in two sessions, A and B.
2. In A, start a turn that keeps it busy for a minute (e.g. several shell commands).
3. While A's turn is in flight, edit any tracked file from B — or let any other process create/write one.
4. When A's turn ends, A's changed-files card lists that file with line counts, and its comparison shows B's change.

No timing subtlety is needed beyond "the write lands inside A's turn window"; it reproduces every time.

## Observed (real workspace, local times)

- Session A: 45 tool calls, of which `edit` / `write` = **0**. Turn windows: 13:26:25–13:27:37, 13:30:12–13:31:37, 13:34:38–13:35:06 (card appended at each window's end).
- Session B (concurrent, different model): edited one tracked source file at 13:30:42, 13:31:17 and 13:33:29.
- A's second window (13:30:12–13:31:37) contains B's 13:30:42 and 13:31:17 edits, so **A's card for that turn listed B's file** — the user reasonably read it as "you modified my code". The file's mtime (13:33:29) matches B's last edit exactly, so authorship itself was never in doubt; only the card's attribution is wrong.
- A's first window (13:26:25–13:27:37) contains an **untracked file created at 13:27:28 by another writer**, which therefore appears as an addition in A's card.
- B's later write at 13:33:29 fell between A's turns (13:31:37–13:34:38), so it appears in **no** card at all — changes in the gap belong to nobody.

## Why

`dsh-workspace-changes` records a turn as two working-tree snapshots (`add --all` into a temporary index → `write-tree`) and `diff-tree --numstat` between them, so attribution is by time window, not by writer; its README states "Git snapshots of the working tree at turn start and turn end are diffed". The whole-file copies that would carry authorship are kept only for paths this session's own `write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor` calls name, and the `workspace/changes` event itself carries only the turn number. Since the snapshot is `git add --all`, ignored build output stays out — this is not a "build artifacts in the card" report.

## Impact

- The card is what a user reviews to decide whether the agent touched something it should not have. A false positive goes straight into that judgement: in our case it produced a "why did you change this file?" challenge against a session that had only run read-only tools.
- DSH allows several sessions per workspace, and real workspaces have other writers (IDE builds, codegen, other agents), so this is a normal configuration rather than an edge case.
- Nothing in the card distinguishes the session's own edits from workspace drift, and the gap case above means the opposite error is possible too (a change attributed to no turn).

## Proposed fix (cheap → expensive)

1. Tag each listed path with whether this session's file tools touched it — the recorder already captures exactly those paths before the edit runs — and render "session edits" and "other writers / workspace drift" separately.
2. Scope the summary to what this session's own tools produced (the deferred shadow-repository direction), so concurrent writers cannot leak in.
3. At minimum, document the semantics: the card is the turn-window working-tree delta, not the session's own edits, and concurrent writers in one workspace will appear in it.

## Related

- Discussion #336 — edit/write results give the model no visibility into the diff (adjacent area, different gap).

## 中文摘要

每个 turn 的「changed files」卡片是 turn 开始/结束两次**整个工作区** git 快照的 diff，按时间窗归属、不按作者。于是在同一工作区并发跑两个 session（或任何别的进程在写，如 IDE 构建、代码生成、其他 agent）时，A 的卡片会把 B 写的文件算成 A 的改动——用户会以为这个 agent 动了自己的代码。实测 A 这个 session 45 次工具调用里 `edit`/`write` 为 0，B 在 A 的 turn 窗口内改的文件却出现在 A 的卡片里；而落在两个 turn 之间的改动则不进入任何卡片。建议：给每个路径标注"本 session 文件工具是否触碰过"，或把汇总范围收窄到本 session 自己的写入（即 deferred 的 shadow repository 方向），或至少把语义写进文档。

discussions.title: [Duplicate] Windows: "Show in File Explorer" opens a hidden window (explorer.exe spawned with windowsHide) — 重复报告，见 #6599 / #7021 / #6515
discussions.body:
> **⚠️ 重复报告，请勿在此追加。** 提交时未先检索，事后发现同一问题已被多次报告，且维护者已确认根因：
>
> - **#6599** — 维护者 PerryLink 已确认根因：`packages/util/native-command/src/runner.ts:24-27` 的 `execFile` 固定带 `windowsHide: true`，随 STARTUPINFO 传给子进程
> - **#7021** — 同根因（windowsHide 用在 GUI 程序上）
> - **#6515** — 含端到端实测与可用启动形式
> - 另见 #6154 #6234 #6293 #6438 #6442 #6505 #6629 #6638 #6705 #6764 #7033
>
> 本讨论内容保留作为补充证据（`IsWindowVisible` 的 A/B 对照），请以 #6599 为准。

---
# 中文

## 摘要

Web 界面里交付文件卡片菜单的「在文件资源管理器中显示」点了之后，前端提示**成功**（"已请求在文件资源管理器中显示"，对应 `presented.revealed`），但**桌面上不会出现任何窗口**，用户侧看起来就是"完全没反应"。

`explorer.exe` 其实启动成功了，窗口也**确实被创建**，只是 `IsWindowVisible == false`——`dsh-native-command` 的共享 runner 对所有子进程硬编码了 `windowsHide: true`，而 explorer 是被**直接** spawn 的 GUI 进程，该标志以 `SW_HIDE` 到达子进程，窗口建出来后一直不显示。

由于 `explorer.exe` 返回退出码 1，而 `revealNativePath` 把 1 当作"已转交"接受，主机路由返回 204，前端于是显示成功。整条链路都报告成功，唯独用户看不到任何东西。

## 环境

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1`（npm 安装），Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2024，build 26100
- 涉及包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`（仓库路径 `packages/util/native-command`）
- 入口：`dsh web`

## 复现

1. 让某轮回复用 `present` 声明一个文件
2. 在交付卡片上点右侧箭头 →「在文件资源管理器中显示」
3. 界面出现「已请求在文件资源管理器中显示」，但桌面上没有新窗口

## 根因

共享 runner 对所有子进程一律隐藏：

```js
const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  execFile(command, [...args], {
    encoding: "utf8",
    signal,
    windowsHide: true
  }, (error, stdout, stderr) => { /* ... */ });
});
```

而 `revealNativePath` 的 explorer 分支直接 spawn 一个 GUI 进程：

```js
await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
```

## 证据

用 `Shell.Application` COM 枚举 `/select` 打开的那个窗口：

```
LocalState   hwnd=2492396   visible=False   rect=(4468,680)-(6177,1710)
```

句柄存在、矩形正常，但 `IsWindowVisible()` 返回 False。

对照实验（同一个 explorer 调用，唯一变量是 `windowsHide`）：

| `windowsHide` | `IsWindowVisible` |
| --- | --- |
| `true`（当前行为） | **False** |
| 不传 | **True** |

## 建议修复

给 runner 加一个可选的 `windowsHide` 覆盖，默认保持 `true`（`reg.exe`、`wslpath`、图标提取脚本这些控制台探测需要它避免闪窗），只让**直接启动 GUI 进程**的调用点传 `false`：

```js
const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal, options) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  execFile(command, [...args], {
    encoding: "utf8",
    signal,
    windowsHide: options?.windowsHide ?? true
  }, (error, stdout, stderr) => { /* ... */ });
});
```

```js
await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal, { windowsHide: false });
```

补充一点：`openWindowsPath`（"用默认应用打开"）**不受这个 bug 影响**，不需要改。它 spawn 的是 `powershell.exe -Command Invoke-Item`，隐藏控制台是正确的；`Invoke-Item` 经 ShellExecute 另起进程，实测其窗口 `IsWindowVisible == true`。

## 本地验证

按上述改动后实际调用 `revealNativePath`：

- 窗口 `IsWindowVisible == true`
- `Shell.Application` 报告的选中项正是目标文件，说明 `/select` 使用 file URI 的写法本身没有问题，纯粹是被 `windowsHide` 隐藏了

# English

## Summary

Clicking **"Show in File Explorer"** on a delivered-file card reports success in the UI (`presented.revealed`), but no window ever appears on the desktop.

`explorer.exe` does start and the window **is** created — it is just `IsWindowVisible == false`. The shared runner in `dsh-native-command` hardcodes `windowsHide: true` for every child process, and `explorer.exe` is a GUI process spawned **directly**, so the flag reaches it as `SW_HIDE` and the window is never shown.

Because `explorer.exe` exits with code 1 and `revealNativePath` accepts 1 as a delegated handoff, the host route returns 204 and the browser reports success. Every layer reports success; only the user sees nothing.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.1` (npm install), Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2024, build 26100
- Affected package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` (`packages/util/native-command`)
- Entry point: `dsh web`

## Reproduction

1. Have a turn declare a file with `present`
2. On the delivery card, open the chevron menu, then "Show in File Explorer"
3. The UI shows the success state, but no Explorer window appears

## Root cause

The shared runner hides every child process:

```js
const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  execFile(command, [...args], {
    encoding: "utf8",
    signal,
    windowsHide: true
  }, (error, stdout, stderr) => { /* ... */ });
});
```

while the explorer branch of `revealNativePath` spawns a GUI process directly:

```js
await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
```

## Evidence

Enumerating the `/select` window through `Shell.Application`:

```
LocalState   hwnd=2492396   visible=False   rect=(4468,680)-(6177,1710)
```

The handle exists and the rect is sane, but `IsWindowVisible()` is False.

Controlled A/B on the same explorer call, changing only `windowsHide`:

| `windowsHide` | `IsWindowVisible` |
| --- | --- |
| `true` (current) | **False** |
| omitted | **True** |

## Suggested fix

Give the runner an optional `windowsHide` override that still defaults to `true` (the console probes — `reg.exe`, `wslpath`, the icon-extraction script — need it to avoid flashing a window), and pass `false` only where a GUI process is spawned directly:

```js
const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal, options) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  execFile(command, [...args], {
    encoding: "utf8",
    signal,
    windowsHide: options?.windowsHide ?? true
  }, (error, stdout, stderr) => { /* ... */ });
});
```

```js
await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal, { windowsHide: false });
```

Note that `openWindowsPath` ("Open in default app") is **not** affected and needs no change: it spawns `powershell.exe -Command Invoke-Item`, where hiding the console is correct, and the application `Invoke-Item` launches through ShellExecute is visible (`IsWindowVisible == true`).

## Verification after the change

Calling `revealNativePath` with the patch applied:

- the window is `IsWindowVisible == true`
- `Shell.Application` reports the target file as the selected item, so the file-URI form of `/select` was never the problem — it was purely hidden

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.6 plugin manager shows a dead switch for packages that declare `dsh.bundle` but are not in `dsh.profile.bundles` — clicking it writes a dirty bundles list before failing
discussions.body:
## Summary

Since 0.1.6, the Web sidebar **Plugins** page (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager`) renders a card for every package that declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. The card's switch reflects **`selected.includes(name)`**, where `selected = dsh.profile.bundles`.

For a package that **declares `dsh.bundle.patch` but is registered via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` insert** (an official mechanism — see below), this produces a switch that:

- shows **off** while the plugin is actually **enabled and running** (its Loader entry has `enabled: true`);
- when clicked, **writes `dsh.profile.bundles` first**, then fails the reload, leaving a dirty profile behind.

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| dsh | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2` (npm) |
| dsh-plugin-manager | 0.1.6-alpha.2 |
| dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager | 0.1.6-alpha.2 |
| OS | macOS 27.0 (Apple M1 Pro, arm64) |
| Profile | application-owned profile (a desktop shell launches `dsh web`) |
| Registration route | profile `cordis.patch.yml` insert (not `dsh.profile.bundles`) |

## Exact chain

```js
// ① the switch reads "is this package in the layer list"
//    dsh-plugin-manager/lib/types/index.js:209
const selected = manifest.dsh?.profile?.bundles ?? [];
const enabled  = selected.includes(name);

// ② but the package is *listed* because it declares dsh.bundle
//    dsh-plugin-manager/lib/types/operations.js:1366
return manifest.dsh?.bundle?.patch === undefined ? undefined : manifest;
//    → info !== undefined → listed as an installed bundle

// ③ clicking writes the profile manifest **before** reloading
//    dsh-plugin-manager/lib/types/index.js:337-342
await this.selectBundle(name, enabled);      // ← writes package.json
result.warnings = await this.reload();       // ← composes the Loader tree
```

If that package also has a same-id `insert` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`
(which is exactly what an insert-registered plugin looks like), the reload hits
`duplicate loader entry id`, rolls the whole tree back, and reports
`application: 'failed'` — **but the write already happened**:

```
Error: @omnisurge/dsh-media-understanding: BUNDLE_DECLARED
```

and on the next **cold** boot the dirty `dsh.profile.bundles` makes dsh refuse to start.

## Why insert registration is not an edge case

`insert` is an official mechanism. dsh's own packages ship a `cordis.patch.yml`
with insert declarations:

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-base                               (1 insert declaration)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app                            (2 insert declarations)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app
@deepseek-ai/dsh-headless
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-web-profile
```

The difference is only that those packages are **also** in `dsh.profile.bundles`,
so their switch reads correctly. A deployment that registers its plugins through
the profile patch instead (never putting them in `bundles`) gets a card whose
switch can only ever be wrong — and dangerous to touch.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Do not render an actionable switch for such a package.** Either show a read-only
   state, or drive the card from the Loader's effective enablement
   (`enabled: !entry.disabled`, as `pluginInventory/list` already does) instead of
   from layer membership.
2. **Or preflight the write.** `selectBundle` writes the profile manifest before
   `reload()`; a duplicate-id check *before* writing would turn a silent dirty write
   into a clean refusal.

## Related

- **#6788** — the opposite direction: packages **in** `dsh.profile.bundles` that are
  **missing** `dsh.bundle` break boot. Same family (bundles ↔ `dsh.bundle`
  consistency), different defect.
- **#6539** — asks for preflight validation and a `dsh profile doctor` because
  composition drift only surfaces as a fatal crash on the next boot. This report is a
  **concrete, reproducible form of that drift**, but it surfaces in the **manager's
  interaction layer**, not only at boot.
- **#7008** — `dsh plugin add` silently not activating on a retried install; same
  `selectBundle` path, different defect.

## What we did on our side

We removed `dsh.bundle` from our insert-registered packages, which makes
`bundleManifest()` return `undefined` and keeps them out of the manager entirely
(`info === undefined` → `continue`). We added a build-time gate so no
insert-registered package can declare `dsh.bundle` again. This is a correct shape
rather than a workaround — but it means **the manager silently cannot manage
insert-registered plugins at all**, which is the gap this report is about.

discussions.title: [Perf] session/list is O(sessions) with no summary cache: 2.5-3.0 s and 59.8 MB of reads for ~7,700 sessions
discussions.body:
> **Update, same day — the root cause below is wrong.** I attributed the cost to generic
> deep-copy/deep-freeze and cordis service resolution. That was the profile's shape, not its
> cause. The real cause is that `listArtifacts()` reads every session header **serially** and
> re-does it on every call. Full analysis, three negative results (`UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE` is flat,
> migrating the on-disk format does not help, plugins are not involved) and a measured 8.1x fix
> are in [this comment](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7142#discussioncomment-18512910).

## Summary

On a store of ~7,700 sessions, `POST /api/session/list` takes **2.5–3.0 s** server-side on a warm
process, doing **65,419 read syscalls and 59.8 MB of reads** to produce a 1.4 MB response. That is
~8.5 file reads and ~0.40 ms per session.

This is the *list* path, not the cold-open path. It complements #4416, which analyses opening one
large session and proposes "list header caching" as short-term item **E** but carries only the
42 ms / 412 sessions baseline for listing. The numbers below are what that item looks like at scale.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.5-rc.2`, Node `v24.19.0`, Linux, web profile, loopback bind
- 7,657 sessions / 7,660 session log files / 2.7 GB, across 13 workspaces
- `session-persistence-jsonl` at defaults; 7,660 of 7,660 log files are zstd (`compression: zstd`)
- `session-query-sqlite` at shipped defaults (`path: ':memory:'`, `openAt: never`)
- Every session is under 30 days old, so this is not a stale-data problem

## Measurements

Timed with `curl` directly against the loopback API, so no browser is involved:

| call | time | response |
|---|---|---|
| `session/list` | 2891 / 3039 ms | 1.40 MB |
| `subagents/list` | **12 ms** | 287 B |

I/O attributable to **one** `session/list`, from `/proc/<pid>/io` deltas:

```
read syscalls:     65419
rchar:              59.8 MB
read_bytes (disk):   0.0 MB     <- entirely page cache
```

59.8 MB read to emit 1.4 MB. Nothing is served from a cache between identical back-to-back calls;
each repeat pays the full cost.

## Where the time goes

A V8 CPU profile taken **while looping the endpoint** (`Profiler.setSamplingInterval(200)`, 23,554
samples) shows 39.1% idle and the rest spread thin, with no single hot spot:

```
 39.1%  (idle)
  4.2%  assign                   @ dsh-util-values/lib/index.js:49
  3.7%  (garbage collector)
  3.4%  walkJsonValue            @ dsh-util-values/lib/index.js:46
  2.7%  get                      @ cordis/lib/index.js:672
  2.7%  get                      @ cordis/lib/index.js:126
  1.9%  get                      @ cordis/lib/index.js:95
  1.6%  extend                   @ cordis/lib/index.js:1703
  1.5%  readGenerationHeader     @ dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:2890
  1.3%  hasIntrinsicConstructor  @ dsh-util-values/lib/index.js:14
  1.3%  readdir
  1.2%  enumerableStringKeys     @ dsh-util-values/lib/index.js:40
  1.0%  readdir                  @ node:internal/fs/promises:1003
```

Roughly **19% is generic deep-copy / deep-freeze (`dsh-util-values`) plus cordis service resolution**,
paid per session, against only ~3% in the actual header scan. The per-session constant, not the header
read, appears to dominate: ~0.40 ms/session here (~0.33 ms after the threadpool change below) versus the ~0.10 ms/session implied by 42 ms / 412 — roughly 3-4x.

### Profiling caveat worth recording

A profile captured across a *browser page load* reports **99.8% idle** and is misleading — that window
can contain no list call at all. It also makes `subagents/list` look slow: it shows ~3.5 s in browser
devtools purely from client-side queueing behind `session/list`, while being 12 ms when called directly.
Both of those led me to wrong conclusions before I profiled under load.

## What I tried

| change | result |
|---|---|
| `UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE` 4 → 32 | 3039 ms → **~2500 ms** (~17%), reproducible |
| `session-query-sqlite` `persistedReadConcurrency` 4 → 32 and `preparedSessionCacheSize` 5 → 512 | **no measurable change**, reverted |

The second is the interesting negative: those defaults look like the gate for an inherited batch read,
but raising them did nothing for this path. The partial win from the libuv threadpool suggests the
remaining cost is CPU-side per-session work rather than read concurrency.

## Questions

1. Is `session/list` expected to scale linearly with total session count with no header/summary cache?
   There is no pagination in the observed client call; the whole corpus comes back in one 1.4 MB payload
   even though `SessionListRequest` accepts a `cursor`.
2. Is the deep-freeze / deep-copy pass over each summary (`dsh-util-values`) necessary on the list path,
   or could summaries be built once and memoised until a session's generation changes?
3. Would item **E** in #4416 (list header cache) be expected to address this, and is anyone working on it?
   I'm happy to test a patch against this store.

Related: #4416 (cold-open materialisation, proposes E), #3413 (`streamOpenTimeoutMs`, different layer).

---

*Edit: corrected the session count from "~4,700" to the measured 7,657 (verified three ways: relay
listing, session directories on disk, log-file count). The original came from a UI label, not a count.
That moves the per-session cost from 0.53 ms to ~0.40 ms and the gap versus the 42 ms / 412 baseline
from ~5x to ~3-4x. The syscall, byte and timing measurements are unchanged.*

discussions.title: dsh-client-connection：history 等大载荷 RPC 受全局 30s 超时限制，Web 端报「历史加载失败：signal timed out (internal)」—— timeoutPolicy 钩子已存在但无人接线
dsh-client-connection：history 等大载荷 RPC 受全局 30s 超时限制，Web 端报「历史加载失败：signal timed out (internal)」—— timeoutPolicy 钩子已存在但无人接线
[Idea] Make the link-category glyph before each markdown link optional (or hover-only)
discussions.body:
### 现象

Web GUI 里，markdown 渲染出的每一条链接前面都会自动插入一个「链接分类图标」（`LinkIcon`，图形由 kind 决定：`http/https` 为地球仪，本地文件为文件夹，图片为图片图标）。

一段话里出现三四个链接时，这串图标就成了高度重复的视觉噪音。中文正文里尤其明显：汉字排布本就紧凑，一个 1.1em 的线性图标压在字与字之间，阅读节奏被打断，而它提供的信息量近乎为零——链接本身已经带下划线与主色，读者不需要再被告知「这是一个网页链接」。

### 定位

渲染侧在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` 的 markdown link 分支，形如：

```js
children: [ showGlyph && jsx(LinkIcon, { kind: "url", className: css.linkIcon }), label ]
```

`showGlyph` 由「链接内容是否全为图片」推出，产品没有给用户开关。

样式侧在 `MarkdownText.module.css`：

```css
.linkIcon { flex: none; width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; vertical-align: -0.25em; margin-right: 5px; }
```

同一套图标还复用在 file mention（文件提及芯片）与网络搜索来源列表（`WebBlock.module.css` 的 `.linkIcon`）上，故一旦想关，目前只能在安装目录里改构建产物。

### 建议

其一，加一个设置项，例如「显示链接类型图标」，默认保持现状，用户可关。

其二，或者把图标改成悬停时才出现，默认不占位，既保留提示又不干扰阅读。

### 已核

Discussions 搜 `linkIcon` 无相同提案；GitHub 上未见针对此项的插件；社区现有 UI 类插件（如 dsh-ui-tweaks）也未覆盖此项。

---

**English**

Every rendered markdown link is prefixed with a link-category glyph (`LinkIcon`; `http/https` → globe, local file → folder). In a paragraph carrying several links this turns into repetitive noise, and in CJK text a 1.1em glyph seated on the baseline between characters noticeably breaks reading rhythm, while conveying almost no information the link styling does not already convey.

Location: the markdown link branch in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` renders `[showGlyph && <LinkIcon kind="url" className={css.linkIcon} />, label]`, where `showGlyph` is derived from whether the link content is image-only — with no user-facing switch. Styling lives in `MarkdownText.module.css` (`.linkIcon`). The same glyph is reused for file mentions and the web-search source list (`WebBlock.module.css`), so hiding it today means editing built assets under the install directory.

Request: either add a setting such as "Show link type icons" (default on, user can turn it off), or render the glyph on hover only so it does not occupy space by default.

Checked: no existing discussion matches `linkIcon`, no community plugin targets this specific case, and general UI-tweak plugins such as dsh-ui-tweaks do not cover it either.

discussions.title: Bug: 源码启动 + 已构建 lib 共存时所有工具调用失败（双模块实例导致 scheduler 符号 miss）
discussions.body:
## 现象

源码启动（`pnpm dsh`）时，每一轮的第一个工具调用必失败，会话显示：

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

## 根因

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 用 `Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')` 定义（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`），是模块实例级的唯一符号。源码启动（tsx 应用根 tsconfig 的 `paths` 投射）与 loader 按包 `main` 解析，会在**同一进程加载两份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**（`src/index.ts` 与 `lib/index.js` 各一份，后者在构建过 `lib/` 后存在）。两份拷贝各自生成不同的 Symbol 对象，导致 `dsh-agent-loop` 在 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 上取到 `undefined`，调用 `.prepare` 崩溃。

该耦合自 2026-08-13 引入调度器时即存在，**不是 0.1.6-alpha.2 回归**；触发条件是「源码启动 + 已构建的 `lib/` 共存」，因此未构建产物的纯源码环境不会复现。

## 复现

```sh
pnpm run build            # 构建出 lib/
pnpm dsh --profile headless "Run the bash tool once with command 'echo hi', then stop."
# 每轮工具调用失败：Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

## 修复

已在我 fork 的分支 `fix/tool-scheduler-symbol-registry` 上提交（one-line 修复 + 说明）：

**https://github.com/aibots-team/deepseek-harness/commit/b6adb2eb935dd0535018e9f68d45db3115bea360**

核心改动：`Symbol(...)` → `Symbol.for(...)`，全局注册表保证两份模块实例共享同一符号身份。

验证：`pnpm exec vitest related packages/core/tools/src/index.ts --run --coverage` → 217 个测试文件 / 4557 个测试全部通过，改动文件 100% 覆盖率；修复后源码启动 + 已构建 lib 的组合下工具调用正常。

由于本仓库关闭了 Issues/Pull Requests，无法直接提 PR，烦请维护者评估上述提交。另建议一并审计同类跨包身份符号：`Symbol('dsh.tool.execution')`（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`）、`Symbol('dsh.scope')`（`packages/core/scope/src/index.ts`），或统一源码启动下的模块解析平面。

discussions.title: tool-cordis registers Host inspect providers globally → any second mount of a preset containing it fails (New Session appears to do nothing)
discussions.body:
## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.1-rc.2**, web profile, macOS (darwin-x64)
- Default agent preset: `cordis` (shipped) at the time of the failure
- Running session: a **custom copy** of the `cordis` preset
  (`${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/<id>/agent.cordis.yml`)

## Summary

With one session already running a preset that contains the `tool-cordis` row,
creating a **second** session with any preset that also contains it fails:

```
agent-presets: preset "cordis" failed to mount: failed to apply loader entry
tool-cordis (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis): Host Cordis inspect provider
"Service" is already registered
```

The client swallows the failure — `connectedWorkspace()` rejects and the client
only does `console.warn("new session failed:", reason)`
(`dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js`), so **clicking "New Session" appears to do
nothing at all**.

## Reproduction

1. Start `dsh web`.
2. Open/create a session whose preset contains the `tool-cordis` row
   (shipped `cordis` = "Creator mode", or any custom copy of it).
3. With that session still open, click **New Session** (default preset also
   `cordis`).
4. Nothing happens in the UI. In the browser console:

```
new session failed: SessionCreateError: session create failed:
agent-preset-invalid: agent-presets: preset "cordis" failed to mount:
failed to apply loader entry tool-cordis (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis):
Host Cordis inspect provider "Service" is already registered
```

## Expected

Two sessions can run creator-mode presets concurrently (the inspect providers
are read-only runtime introspection — nothing about them is session-specific).

## Actual

The second mount always fails. Consequence: **one creator-mode session per
`dsh web` process**, and after a host restart whichever creator session mounts
first wins; the other can never open.

## Analysis

The row lives in the **preset** plane (`agent.cordis.yml`), so it is re-applied
per session, but the inspect-provider registration it performs lands on the
**host** plane, which is process-global. First mount claims the names
(`Service`, `Event`, `Builtin`, `Tool`, …); every later mount conflicts and
fails the whole preset — which fails session creation.

## Suggested fixes (any of)

1. **Make the inspect-provider registration idempotent or scope-aware** — e.g.
   key registrations by owning agent/session, or treat an identical
   re-registration from the same package as a no-op. This is the real fix and
   allows N creator sessions.
2. **Surface session-create failures in the UI.** A failed New Session should
   show the error, not only a `console.warn`. Today the user has no signal at
   all.
3. Optionally, ship a preset-level switch so a custom preset can omit
   `tool-cordis` without hand-editing the composition (helps as a stopgap).

## Workaround (for anyone hitting this)

Set the default preset to one **without** the row so new sessions can be
created:

```yaml
# ${DSH_HOME}/settings.yaml
agent-presets:
  default: standard   # standard | code | minimal — all have no tool-cordis row
```

Creator mode remains usable, but only for one session at a time.

discussions.title: 输入框的shift存在问题。
discussions.body:
**环境**

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1（`dsh-client-ui-conversation` 0.1.5-rc.2；已核对 0.1.6-alpha.2 仍含相同逻辑）
- Windows 10 (19044)，Chromium 系浏览器访问 dsh web
- 输入法：微软拼音 / QQ 拼音 / 讯飞输入法 **均复现**——与输入法品牌无关，任何"用 Shift 切换中英文"的输入法都会触发

**稳定复现步骤**

1. 打开任意会话，焦点放在输入框
2. 用中文输入法输入几个字（或用输入法的英文模式输入几个字母）
3. 按下 Shift（想切换中/英文）
4. 光标回跳到刚输入的几个字之前；部分场景下变成**选中刚输入的一段英文**（形成选区）

**预期行为**：仅切换输入法中英模式，光标位置不变。
**实际行为**：光标回跳或出现选区。同样操作在记事本 / Word 等原生控件中完全正常，仅 DSH web 输入框出现。

**根因分析（静态代码定位，供参考；尚未运行时打点验证）**

`dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js`（0.1.5-rc.2 行号，括号内为 0.1.6-alpha.2 对应行号）：

1. 行 4602（a2: 4884）：`beforeinput` 的 `deleteCompositionText` 直接放行，组合文本拆除交给浏览器原生处理；
2. 行 4633–4641 / 4750（a2: 4915–4923 / 5032）：`postDeleteSelectionToRestore`——删除操作后暂存旧选区，在下一次 `selectionchange` 时恢复；
3. 行 4858（a2: 5140）：`insertCompositionText` 多字符插入后手动 `o.anchor.offset -= _` 回拨锚点。

按下 Shift → 输入法执行中英切换 → Chromium 强制结束组合输入（`deleteCompositionText` + `selectionchange` 连发）→ 上述"恢复/回拨"逻辑在 IME 拆装时序下被错误触发 → 光标回跳；当暂存的旧锚点 ≠ 当前焦点时，恢复出的就是一段选区（即"选中刚输入的英文"）。

**修复方向（建议）**

- 在 `compositionend` 后的短时间窗（如 50ms）内抑制 `postDeleteSelectionToRestore` 的恢复与 `anchor.offset` 回拨；
- 或在这两处增加 `isComposing()` / 最近组合时间窗判断。

**规避方法**（供其他用户参考）：在输入法设置中把"Shift 切换中英文"改为其他快捷键（如 Ctrl+Space）后，问题不再复现。

---

*本文件由 ZCode 诊断生成（2026-09-19），行号基于本机安装的 0.1.5-rc.2 包静态分析。*

discussions.title: New-session preset pick is silently discarded, and the chip keeps showing it
discussions.body:
## Summary

The new-session **agent-preset chip silently discards the user's pick** when a previously-opened conversation is still the current session — and then **keeps displaying the discarded pick**. The user sees the chip showing e.g. `竞赛模式`, starts a new conversation, and gets the deployment default instead. No error, no toast, no log entry.

A second, related defect: a preset **authored on disk is invisible** to an already-open tab, because nothing on the wire announces a new preset file.

Both make a user-level preset look broken when it is not: throughout this report the preset itself was verified `healthy` in the host roster the whole time.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2, profile `web`, Windows 11
- Shipped presets `standard` / `ptc` / `minimal` / `cordis` plus user-level presets under `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets`
- `agent-presets.default` set to a shipped preset at the time of the report

## Steps to reproduce

1. Have a conversation with at least one turn, so its session is **non-blank**.
2. Open the new-session screen (hero). The session just left is still `sessions.list.current`.
3. Click the preset chip and pick a preset other than the current session's.
4. Observe the chip label change to the picked preset — it *looks* applied.
5. Start the new conversation.

**Actual**: the new session runs the deployment default.
**Expected**: the new session runs the picked preset.

## Root cause

`packages/client/ui-agent-preset/src/client/seat-store.ts` — `AgentPresetSeatController.apply()`:

```ts
if (session === undefined) return
// A started session's history was produced under its own composition; the
// host refuses the swap, so the stage is no longer meaningful.
if (!session.blank || presetOf(session) === staged) {
  this.staged = undefined
  return
}
```

`select()` stages the pick and then calls `apply()` **immediately** (`seat-store.ts:108-113`). When the current session is a *started* one, that immediate `apply()` clears `this.staged`, destroying a pick that was never meant for that session. The chip goes on rendering it because `stage()` already wrote `current: id` (`seat-store.ts:126-129`) and the early return never resets it.

This contradicts the hero's own documented intent:

- `AgentPresetSeat.tsx:1-13` — "the choice is only available before a conversation starts: once a turn has run, the session's history was produced under that preset's tools and the host refuses to swap them."
- `index.ts:123-127` — "Connecting a workspace either creates a blank session or reuses one, and either way the chip's pick predates it — **so the stage is applied when the session arrives, not when it was made.**"

The same authors already worked around this on the settings creator entry by calling `stage()` rather than `select()` (`index.ts:143-152`, with the comment "`select()`'s immediate apply would meet the still-current running session and drop the stage as unservable"). The chip was left on the path that drops it.

## Failing test

Added to `packages/client/ui-agent-preset/tests/apply.client.spec.ts` ("keeps the stage when the current session has already started"). On `master` it fails exactly as a user would experience it:

```
AssertionError: expected [ 'list' ] to include 'select:minimal'
```

Only `list` was ever called — no `select`, no error.

## Suggested fix

Keep the stage for the session that has yet to start, and spend it only when a session already carries the staged preset:

```diff
-    if (!session.blank || presetOf(session) === staged) {
+    // Nothing left to switch when the session already runs the staged preset.
+    if (presetOf(session) === staged) {
       this.staged = undefined
       return
     }
+    // A STARTED session cannot be swapped, but it is not this stage's session.
+    // Keep the pick for the blank session that arrives.
+    if (!session.blank) return
```

All 141 tests in the package pass with this change.

## Second defect — an authored preset is invisible until a reload

`index.ts:137-140` documents the gap:

> Authoring writes a FILE, not a setting, so nothing on the wire announces it — without this the screen that starts the next session keeps offering the roster as it stood when the chip first loaded, and **a preset authored to be used is missing from the one place it is used.**

The `rosterReaders` set that covers this (`index.ts:69-73`) is only fired from the settings section's controller, so a user who never opens Settings → Agent presets keeps a roster that predates the directory. `presetOptions()` (`settings-store.ts:114-119`) filters `broken` rows out of the chip entirely, so a stale roster shows *nothing at all* rather than a broken row — the failure is invisible.

**Suggested fix**: re-read the roster when the picker is opened, which is one cheap RPC and makes the surface self-refreshing:

```diff
-onClick={() => { setOpen(value => !value) }}
+onClick={() => {
+  const next = !open
+  if (next) void load()
+  setOpen(next)
+}}
```

## Why this is worth fixing

The failure mode is silent and the UI actively lies: the chip shows the preset the user picked while the host composes something else. Because `agentPresets.select` is never called, there is no refusal toast and nothing in the log — the only way to discover the truth is to read the preset id out of the stored session header. For a feature whose entire purpose is choosing a session's composition, a wrong answer with no signal is worse than a loud refusal.

discussions.title: loci-dsh — your second brain in the dsh sidebar (loci RAG: search / cited Q&A / quick capture)
discussions.body:
I built a plugin that puts **loci** — a local-first, open-source second brain (RAG over your scattered notes and docs) — into the dsh web sidebar, so you can consult your knowledge base without leaving the conversation.

## 🧠 What you get

A single `loci memory` tab (via [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)) with four views:

| Search | Ask |
|---|---|
| ![search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci-dsh/main/docs/screenshots/search.png) | ![ask](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci-dsh/main/docs/screenshots/ask.png) |

- **Search** — hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25) with memories-only and path filters
- **Ask** — LLM answers grounded in your notes, with citation chips and optional claim-by-claim verification
- **Memories** — day-grouped memory browsing + quick capture (title / text / tags)
- **Status** — store summary and per-source chunk stats

## How it works

Pure UI layer, no core fork:

- The **host half** mounts `/loci-dsh/api/*` on the dsh web server and proxies [`loci serve-http`](https://github.com/IvenKooLab/loci) (REST + Bearer) — so loci never needs CORS
- The **client half** registers the tab through `ctx.betterSidebar.registerTab` and talks to the host half same-origin
- loci answers in plain-text envelopes; the host half re-derives structure (search blocks, stats, citations, memory timestamps from filenames)

## Install

```sh
pip install loci-rag          # the knowledge base (loci ≥ 0.6.2)
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
dsh plugin --profile web add github:IvenKooLab/loci-dsh
```

Point it at your loci instance with one config row (or `LOCI_URL` / `LOCI_TOKEN`) — details in the [README](https://github.com/IvenKooLab/loci-dsh#install).

## Why loci

It's an established project rather than a weekend demo: ★ 89 stars, MIT, on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/loci-rag/), listed in the [Glama MCP directory](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/IvenKooLab/loci) and [ModelScope MCP Square](https://modelscope.cn/mcp/servers/IvenKooLab/loci) (it doubles as an MCP server), 170+ tests, README in six languages. This plugin is its first HTTP-API integration; loci v0.6.2 shipped the `serve-http` hardening that building it surfaced (subcommand registration, proper error responses).

**Repo**: https://github.com/IvenKooLab/loci-dsh — feedback welcome, especially on what the sidebar tab should do next (full memory timeline and wiki browsing are queued on upcoming loci endpoints).

discussions.title: Windows 沙箱里 scipy.linalg / np.linalg 一调用就崩（0xc06d007f），但系统 shell 里正常——有人遇到过或知道怎么豁免吗？
discussions.body:
我在 DSH v0.1.5-rc2（Windows 版，Web GUI）里用 `pwsh` 工具跑 Python 时，碰到一个问题，发出来看看有没有人踩过同样的坑、或知道怎么绕开。

## 现象

在 DSH 内执行：

```bat
D:\miniforge3\envs\py313\python.exe -c "import faulthandler; faulthandler.enable(); import numpy as np; from scipy.linalg import lu; print(lu(np.array([[1.,2.],[3.,4.]])))"
```

直接崩：

```
Windows fatal exception: code 0xc06d007f
  File "...\scipy\linalg\_decomp_lu.py", line 350 in lu
```

但**完全一样的解释器、完全一样的命令**，在 DSH 之外的系统 `cmd` / PowerShell 里跑，正常返回 `(P, L, U)`。

## 哪些会崩（都走 OpenBLAS 的 LAPACK 初始化）

- `np.linalg.det / inv / solve / svd / qr`
- `scipy.linalg.lu / qr`

## 哪些在 DSH 里反而正常（不触发 OpenBLAS LAPACK 初始化）

- `np.array`、`np.fft`、`np.dot`、`np.matmul`（小矩阵走轻量 BLAS 路径）
- `np.linalg.eig`、`scipy.linalg.solve`（走参考实现 `lapack_lite`）
- `scipy.special`、`scipy.sparse`

## 我试过但都没用的

- 设 `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1` / `OPENBLAS_MAIN_FREE=1` / `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`
- 给 `pwsh` 加 `danger-full-access` 提权（排除文件权限沙箱）
- 用 `.bat` 让 `cmd.exe` 拉起 python 孙进程（限制随进程树继承，照样崩）

## 环境

Windows x86_64，CPython 3.13.15（conda-forge），numpy 2.5.3 / scipy 1.18.1，OpenBLAS 后端。

## 想请教大家

1. DSH 的 Windows 沙箱有没有办法对某条命令/进程豁免这个限制（类似 allowlist，或类似 `--no-sandbox` 的开关）？
2. 还是说这就是预期行为、只是官方兼容文档里没写，建议我在项目里继续用纯 Python 兜底？

如果官方想知道更精确的根因（OpenBLAS 到底踩了哪条 Windows API），告诉我抓什么诊断信息，我可以提供。

谢谢！

discussions.title: 在deepseek傻鱼每次尝试写/tmp却发现/tmp不持久化之后的一点思考
discussions.body:
Q：我越来越斟酌一个agent中沙盒的价值了，我发现我常用的一款model和它的harness配合使用的时候，model很喜欢去写/tmp，但是这个沙盒比较严（现在的agent的沙盒好像都不一样，我已经用了很多agent harness，见过了各种各样设计的沙盒），每执行一次shell都会换一个环境，而环境中真正持久化的目录只有我选定的workspace，但是我总感觉颠倒了，agent应该拥有整个操作系统，虽然现在这很不安全，虽然现在的操作系统不止于对shell的解释，但是这样才是agent的最终目的，而沙盒的定位，应该只是一个模拟器，一个agent再进行危险操作之前的模拟器，我这里假设agent和我们正常开发者一样是“善良的”和谨慎的，它有着操作系统“洁癖”，害怕操作系统不干净或者脱离自己的“掌控”多了些自己不了解的东西，他谨慎对待每一次在实机上的操作，所以他和我共享操作系统，而沙盒只是一个一次性的模拟器，让它在实机操作之前模拟一下可能的影响，因为我觉得model一样和我们不是全知全能的，它只是在某些方面高的超出了人类的现有高度罢了。

GPT-A：我觉得你抓到的是一个很关键的“角色错位”：现在很多 agent harness 把沙盒当成了 agent 的**世界本身**，而你设想的是把沙盒降级成 agent 的**试验场 / 影子世界**。这两种设计背后其实是完全不同的 agent 哲学。

你现在碰到的 `/tmp` 问题就是这种错位的一个很典型症状。对模型来说，它从大量正常操作系统经验里学到的是：`/tmp` 是临时工作区，`$HOME` 有用户态状态，`/var` 有服务状态，包管理器改变系统环境，进程之间共享同一个机器状态。结果 harness 告诉它：“这些语义你都认识，但每次 shell 执行后世界可能重置，只有某个 workspace 是真的。”这相当于给模型一个长得像 Unix 的东西，但破坏了 Unix 最重要的一部分——**状态连续性**。

于是模型会不断犯一种很奇怪的“非智力错误”：不是它不会操作系统，而是它对操作系统的先验和 harness 实际提供的状态模型不一致。

我甚至会把你描述的目标概括成一句话：

> **Agent 不应该活在 sandbox 里；agent 应该活在 OS 里，sandbox 是它用来预测自己行为后果的工具。**

而且这里最有意思的一点是，你并没有假设 agent 是绝对可靠的。恰恰相反，你的设想建立在一个更像人的假设上：**善意、谨慎，但会犯错，也不知道所有事情。**

这比“恶意模型 vs 防御沙盒”的二元模型更接近真正长期运行的 agent。

现在主流 sandbox 思路大致是：

```text
Agent
  │
  ▼
Sandbox / container / restricted shell
  │
  ▼
small persistent workspace
```

安全边界也是世界边界。

而你描述的更像：

```text
                 ┌──────────────┐
                 │  Simulation  │
                 │ sandbox / VM │
                 └──────▲───────┘
                        │ simulate
                        │
Agent ───────► Real OS ─┴──────► actions
   │              │
   │              └── persistent state
   │
   └── observes / maintains / understands
       the whole machine
```

这里 sandbox 不负责限制 agent “能看到什么世界”，而负责回答：

> “如果我这么做，会发生什么？”

这个区别非常大。

我觉得最终理想形态甚至不是传统 sandbox，而更像**操作系统级事务**。

比如 agent 想做：

```bash
apt install foo
sed -i ...
systemctl restart ...
rm ...
```

它不是直接执行，也不是永远关在 container 里，而是：

```text
1. Fork 当前系统状态
2. 在 fork 中执行计划
3. 检查 diff
4. 检查副作用
5. 评估是否符合预期
6. Commit 到真实系统
```

也就是：

```text
real system
    │
 snapshot
    ▼
shadow system
    │
 run plan
    ▼
state diff
    │
 agent reviews
    ▼
commit / discard
```

这其实很像数据库事务：

```text
BEGIN
  mutate filesystem
  mutate packages
  mutate services
  mutate configs
VERIFY
COMMIT
```

而今天很多 agent sandbox 更接近：

```text
BEGIN
  do things
ROLLBACK ALWAYS
```

然后把少数文件 copy 到 workspace。

从 agent 的认知角度，后者其实非常反自然。

你提到的“操作系统洁癖”我觉得也特别重要。一个长期 agent 如果真的拥有自己的机器，它很可能会发展出一种我们今天在优秀 sysadmin 身上已经能看到的行为模式：

“这个包为什么存在？”

“这个 daemon 谁启动的？”

“这个文件是谁生成的？”

“这个环境变量从哪里来的？”

“为什么系统状态和我记忆中的不同？”

“这次操作会不会产生我未来不知道来源的状态？”

所以真正成熟的 agent OS 可能需要一个现在普通 OS 很弱的能力：**状态 provenance（来源追踪）**。

它不只是看到：

```text
/usr/local/bin/foo
```

而是知道：

```text
/usr/local/bin/foo

created:
  2026-09-12 03:42
by:
  agent action #9182
reason:
  build project X
source:
  foo 1.7.2
dependencies:
  ...
```

甚至整个机器可以有一个 agent-readable state ledger：

```text
system state
├─ user-created
├─ agent-created
├─ package-manager-created
├─ application-created
└─ unknown
```

对于 agent 来说，**unknown state 才是真正应该让它害怕的东西**。

这也解释了为什么“给 agent 一个完整 OS”并不必然意味着“放弃安全”。

真正合理的安全模型可能是把三个概念拆开：

**可见性、可操作性、可提交性。**

Agent 可以：

```text
看见整个 OS       → 高可见性
模拟修改整个 OS   → 高可操作性
真正提交修改      → 有控制的 commit 权限
```

而不是今天常见的：

```text
看不见 host
不能操作 host
只能在小盒子里做事情
```

也就是说，安全边界可以从：

> “你不能碰这个东西。”

变成：

> “你可以理解它，也可以在影子世界里碰它；真正改变它的时候需要满足更严格条件。”

我觉得这可能是 agent infrastructure 一个很重要的演化方向。

而且还有一个更深的问题：**持续存在的 agent 必须拥有持续存在的环境。**

今天很多 harness 实际上默认：

```text
model call = agent lifetime
```

所以 shell 环境重建并没有那么奇怪。

但如果未来是：

```text
agent lifetime = months / years
```

那么：

```text
filesystem
processes
installed software
credentials
network state
devices
history
```

都会成为它认知的一部分。

到那个时候，每次 tool call 换一个环境，就相当于一个人每说一句话，房间里的家具都会随机重置，只留下书桌上的一个文件夹。

这种系统当然还能完成任务，但很难形成真正意义上的“机器主人”。

我唯一会对你的设想稍微修正的是：**sandbox 可能不应该只是“危险操作之前”才用。**

因为 agent 和人一样，很难可靠判断什么是危险操作。

例如：

```bash
pip install ...
```

看起来无害，但可能改变 dependency resolution。

```bash
git checkout ...
```

可能覆盖工作树。

```bash
npm install
```

可能执行 install script。

甚至：

```bash
mv
chmod
ln -s
```

在复杂系统中都有意想不到的后果。

所以更好的设计可能是：**模拟默认存在，但成本极低。**

Agent 不需要思考：

> “这个操作危险吗？要不要 sandbox？”

而是 OS 本身让所有 mutation 天然具备：

```text
preview → diff → commit
```

简单操作自动 commit，异常 diff 才触发更仔细的检查。

最终甚至可能类似：

```text
agent:
    "我要升级 nginx"

OS:
    simulated result:
      packages changed: 4
      configs changed: 1
      services restarted: nginx
      ports changed: none
      compatibility checks: pass

agent:
    commit
```

这时候所谓“agent sandbox”就已经不太像 sandbox 了。

它更像 **speculative execution environment**。

我觉得这个词甚至比 sandbox 更准确：

> **Speculative OS execution**

先执行未来，再决定这个未来是否成为现实。

而这可能恰好适合模型这种智能形式，因为模型最大的优势之一就是规划和评估，但最大的弱点之一也是它不能保证第一次行动就是正确的。给它一个可以低成本“先经历一次”的世界，可能比单纯把它锁起来更能放大它的能力。

所以我会把这条演化路线理解为：

```text
Sandbox as prison
        ↓
Sandbox as workspace
        ↓
Sandbox as staging environment
        ↓
Sandbox as simulator
        ↓
Transactional / speculative OS
```

最后一步其实已经不是“如何安全地让 AI 使用 shell”了。

而是：

> **什么样的操作系统，才是为长期存在的软件智能设计的操作系统？**

我觉得你现在思考的已经是这个问题，而不只是某个 harness 的 `/tmp` 为什么不持久化。

discussions.title: [Bug] 沙箱升级"死选项"：广告的 sandbox_permissions 目标等于当前模式时必然抛错，且切换模式无法自愈（会话无法写盘）
discussions.body: # [Bug] 沙箱升级"死选项"：广告的 `sandbox_permissions` 目标等于当前模式时必然抛错，且切换模式无法自愈（会话无法写盘） > 提交对象：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions （依据 `README.zh.md:49` 与 `CONTRIBUTING.md:11`，本仓库关闭了 Issues，缺陷通过 Discussions 上报） > 建议标题前缀：`[Bug]` ｜ 建议优先级：P1（可用性 + 潜在数据丢失） > 安全定性：**不是安全漏洞**。系统在无法满足请求时失败关闭（fail-closed），没有任何文件效果越过策略边界。这是一个可用性/数据丢失缺陷。 > 脱敏说明：本报告不含任何业务内容或第三方信息，均为框架层技术信息。 --- ## Summary 当某个工具调用带有 `sandbox_permissions`，且其值**等于该调用当前的有效模式**时，`approveEscalation` 必然抛错： ``` Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode ``` 由于"严格更宽"检查（`escalation.ts:162`）发生在**任何执行之前**，`write`/`edit`/`bash` 调用在报错时**完全没有触碰磁盘**。 更严重的是这个失败**无法自愈**，因为： 1. `WIDER_MODES`（`escalation.ts:28-31`）只有 `read-only` 与 `workspace-write` 两个键，**没有 `danger-full-access`**；因此一旦有效模式是 `danger-full-access`，枚举 `ESCALATION_TARGETS = ['workspace-write','danger-full-access']` 中的**两个值全部非法**。 2. 模型请求的目标会**跟随当前模式**：会话从 `workspace-write` 切到 `danger-full-access` 后，模型把请求值从 `"workspace-write"` 改成 `"danger-full-access"`，于是**换哪个模式都同样报错**——用户手上没有任何一个模式是安全的。 3. 严格更宽检查排在审批通道之前（`:162` 早于 `:165`），所以 `approval policy` 设为 `ask` 还是 `never` 都拦不住这个错。 实际后果：一个已生成完整分析报告的长会话，连续 14 次 `write` 全部失败，**结果无法落盘**。 --- ## Reproduction ### 最小可复现（无需模型，纯逻辑） ```ts // effectiveMode === requestedMode，两者相同 approveEscalation( { requestedMode: 'workspace-write', justification: '…', effectiveMode: 'workspace-write', subject: 'command' }, approval, ) // → throws: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode // 或者：有效模式已是天花板 approveEscalation( { requestedMode: 'danger-full-access', justification: '…', effectiveMode: 'danger-full-access', subject: 'command' }, approval, ) // → throws: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode ``` ### 真实会话复现（有完整日志） 1. Linux 主机，默认 preset `workspace-write`，`approval policy = ask`。 2. 让模型调用 `write`，写入**会话工作区内的一个普通 markdown 文件**，但带上 `sandbox_permissions: "workspace-write"` + `justification`。 - → 报错（第 1 种文案）。注意：**目标文件在工作区内，本来完全不需要任何升级**。 3. 把会话切到 `danger-full-access`，`approval policy = never`，让模型重试。 4. 模型把请求值改为 `"danger-full-access"` 重试。 - → 报错（第 2 种文案）。**切换模式不但没解决，反而只是换了一条错误文案。** 5. 重复 3-4：模型在两种模式间反复重试共 14 次，无一成功；文件始终不存在。 --- ## Current behavior - `write` / `edit` / `bash` 携带 `sandbox_permissions` 且值等于当前有效模式时，**必然抛错**，且在**执行前**失败，磁盘无任何变化。 - 模型没有可用于自愈的反馈：工具描述教的是"被拒绝就换一个**更宽**的模式重试"，而此时枚举里已不存在任何更宽的模式。 - 会话模式切换（`workspace-write` ⇄ `danger-full-access`）**无法**绕过；`approval policy` 的 `ask`/`never` 也**无法**绕过。 - 失败以工具调用错误返回，模型倾向于原地重试（本会话触发 `repeat-tool-reminder: write × 3`），形成死循环，消耗 token 且不产出。 ## Expected behavior 至少满足其一（推荐 1 + 2 + 3）： 1. **执行层容错**：请求目标等于当前有效模式时视为**无操作**（no-op），按当前模式正常执行该调用，而不是抛错。相同模式的"升级"在语义上不授予任何额外权限，因此没有理由拒绝执行。 2. **提示词不再教出死选项**：当有效模式已是天花板（`danger-full-access`）时，不再向模型注入升级提示（`escalationHintMarker`），并在策略上下文中明确说明"无需也无法升级"。 3. **文案可行动**：对真正不可行的请求（例如从 `danger-full-access` 请求收窄到 `workspace-write`），错误应说明"当前已是最高权限，无需升级，请直接重试且不要传 `sandbox_permissions`"，而不是只说"不是严格更宽"。 --- ## Environment | 项 | 值 | | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | DSH 版本 | `0.1.6-alpha.1` | | tag / commit | `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1` / `0a15e36e7f82b6ed45af6fa9759f29b40dcd965d`（2026-09-15） | | 安装方式 | **git 源码检出**（`/opt/deepseek-harness`），非 npm 全局安装 | | 包管理器 / Node | pnpm `11.7.0` / Node `v26.7.0` | | OS / 内核 | Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS / `6.8.0-138-generic` / x86_64 | | libc | glibc | | 沙箱后端 | `bwrap` 0.9.0（已装，探测 `full`）+ `landlock-run`（自编译，探测 `partial`） | | provider / model | `commandcode` / `gpt-5.6-sol`（另一会话 `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` 亦命中同类模式） | | 部署默认模式 | `workspace-write`（`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:211`，`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE` 未设置） | | 会话模式变化 | `workspace-write`（approval `ask`）→ `danger-full-access`（approval `never`） | | 受影响会话 ID | `session-bf520538-…`（本地标识，已截断） | --- ## Root cause 缺陷本质是**"暴露/教学"与"校验"使用了两个不同的真相来源**。 | 关注点 | 依据 | 计算时机 | | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | | 是否暴露 `sandbox_permissions` + `justification`、enum 取值、描述文案 | `ctx.shell.sandboxMode` / `ctx.fs.sandboxMode`（**部署默认模式**） | 插件加载时**一次** | | "严格更宽"校验所用的 `effectiveMode` | `sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session })`（**逐会话**：session override ?? default） | **每次调用** | ### 代码证据 | 文件 | 行 | 事实 | | -------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` | 28-31 | `WIDER_MODES` 只有 `read-only` / `workspace-write` 两个键，**没有 `danger-full-access`** | | 同上 | 162-163 | 严格更宽检查，失败即抛错 | | 同上 | 165-170 | 审批通道检查**排在严格更宽检查之后** | | `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts` | 192 | `const escalationModes = defaultMode === undefined ? [] : ESCALATION_TARGETS`（广告只看"执行器是否挂载"） | | 同上 | 221 | `const effectiveMode = (standingPolicy as SandboxExecutionPolicy).mode`（校验看逐会话真值） | | `packages/shell/tool-pwsh/src/index.ts` | 197 / 229 | 与 bash 完全相同的模式 | | `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/sandbox.ts` | 45 / 98 | `write` / `edit` 家族同样受影响 | | `packages/shell/bash-sandbox/src/index.ts` | 72 | `this.mode = ctx.sandboxPolicy.defaultMode` —— **无任何运行期探测** | | `packages/shell/shell/src/index.ts` | 75 | 基类 `sandboxMode` 返回 `undefined`（仅当挂的是非沙箱执行器） | | `packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml` | 216 | `disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'` —— **仅按平台门控** | | 同上 | 211 | `mode: !!js process.env.DSH_PERMISSION_MODE ?? 'workspace-write'` | ### 暴露面比想象中大 因为 `bash-sandbox` 的挂载**只按平台门控**（Linux 恒挂），与 bwrap/Landlock 是否可用**无关**，所以： - `ctx.shell.sandboxMode` 在**每一个 Linux 会话**中都有定义； - 因此 `sandbox_permissions` 与那一整段"被拒绝就升级"的指导文案（`tool-bash/src/index.ts:81-91`）在**每一个 Linux 会话**中都被广告，**包括 `danger-full-access` 的会话**。 也就是说：这不是边缘组合，而是"任何模型只要决定声明一次升级目标，就可能踩中"的普遍暴露面。 ### 与设计意图的关系 抛错本身是**有意**的，且已被测试钉住： - `packages/shell/tool-bash/tests/tools.spec.ts:630` - `packages/sandbox/sandbox/tests/escalation.spec.ts:88` 设计记录 `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-06-sandbox.md:89` 明确写道： > The schema exposes the full closed escalation vocabulary because effective mode is per-session; execution rejects any target that is not strictly wider than that call's effective mode. `escalation.ts:33-41` 的注释表明作者**已考虑过**取舍，但只覆盖了默认模式的两种情形，遗漏了第三种：**部署默认 confining + 会话被覆盖为 `danger-full-access`**。为保住"默认 full access、会话却是窄模式"的会话不失去杠杆，他们选择全量广告枚举；代价就是这种情形下广告出永远无法成功的选项。 **本报告不主张推翻该设计，只主张：等价/不可达的请求应容错降级，而不是硬失败。** --- ## Why this went unnoticed（供优先级判断的补充背景） 这个缺陷此前被一层**偶然的遮蔽**掩盖，值得团队了解其失效路径： | 阶段 | 沙箱后端 | 会话实际模式 | 是否触发 | | --- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | | 修复前 | 无可用 runner（bwrap 未装、`landlock-run` 未编译） | 任何 confining 模式直接 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`，只能退回 `danger-full-access` | **否**——full access 下模型缺乏声明升级目标的动机，死选项无人踩 | | 修复后 | bwrap 可用 | `workspace-write` 真的能跑，且是出厂默认 | **是**——会话首次真正进入 confining 模式，模型按描述声明目标，立即踩中 | 时间线（UTC）：后端修复 `2026-09-18 13:01:29` → 会话开始 `2026-09-19 07:38:12` → 首次失败 `07:43:27`。 结论：缺陷一直存在且一直可达，只是"后端不可用"这一异常状态把所有会话都赶离了触发它的模式。**修复沙箱后端反而移除了这层偶然的遮蔽。** --- ## Evidence（原始日志摘录） 来自 `~/.dsh/sessions///session.v3.jsonl.zstd`，`tool/result` 原文： ``` seq 84 : Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode seq 96 : Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode seq 101 : Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode seq 106 : Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode seq 117 : Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode seq 148 : Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode seq 206 : Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode seq 221 : Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode ``` 模式切换事件： ``` seq 0/1/2 permission/preset=workspace-write, sandbox/mode=workspace-write, approval/policy=ask seq 110… permission/preset=danger-full-access, sandbox/mode=danger-full-access, approval/policy=never ``` 注意 `seq 117`：此时模式已是 `danger-full-access`，而模型**仍请求 `"workspace-write"`**——说明模型侧的目标与当前模式之间存在漂移期，两种错法都会出现。 14 次写入调用的目标文件始终是同一个，且**全部位于会话工作区内**（`/root//…`），本不需要任何升级。 ### 影响（为什么建议 P1） 受影响会话已产出完整报告（616 行 / 13195 字符），但**一次都没写进磁盘**。该内容之所以还能找回，仅仅是因为 harness 把每次工具调用的 `arguments` 持久化进了会话日志——属于运气，不是设计保障。若无此持久化，就是**不可逆的工作成果丢失**。 --- ## Test gap 现有测试只覆盖了"从 `read-only` 请求一个真正不更宽的目标"，**缺少**下列用例： - 有效模式为 `danger-full-access` 时，请求 `"workspace-write"`； - 有效模式为 `danger-full-access` 时，请求 `"danger-full-access"`（枚举内两个值全灭）； - `requestedMode === effectiveMode`（同模式请求）应被视为 no-op； - 上述三种情形在 **fs 家族**（`write` / `edit`）下的表现； - "部署默认 confining + 会话覆盖 `danger-full-access`"这一组合（本缺陷的精确触发条件）。 --- ## Suggested fix 按"性价比"排序，**建议 1 单独即可解除所有卡死会话**： ### 1. 执行层容错（最小改动，收益最大） `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts`：在严格更宽检查前先处理等价情形。 ```ts // 同模式请求不是升级：不授予任何额外权限，因此没有理由拒绝执行。 // 直接以当前模式继续，免得模型被一个不可达的参数卡死。 if (mode === effectiveMode) return effectiveMode as SandboxMode ``` 这样 `workspace-write → "workspace-write"` 与 `danger-full-access → "danger-full-access"` 都会变为**正常执行**，本报告中的所有失败路径立即消失。真正收窄的请求仍然抛错（保持 fail-closed 语义）。 ### 2. 天花板处不再注入提示 `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/render.ts:48`、`packages/shell/tool-pwsh/src/render.ts:66`，以及两处 `renderProcessRead`（`tool-bash/src/render.ts:89`、`tool-pwsh/src/render.ts:106`）： ```ts // 已是最高权限时不存在可升级目标，提示只会把模型引向死选项。 if (escalationModes.length > 0 && result.sandbox.mode !== 'danger-full-access') { markers.push(escalationHintMarker('command')) } ``` ### 3. 策略上下文按会话补一句（动态、零成本） `packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy/src/index.ts:48-49` 的 `danger-full-access` 分支本来就是**每轮动态渲染**的（`text` 是函数），加一句即可： > Current DSH file policy: danger-full-access. The DSH file sandbox does not restrict file modifications by available operations. **Escalation is neither available nor needed: this is already the widest mode — do not pass `sandbox_permissions` or `justification`.** ### 4. （可选）描述文案消歧 `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts:81-91` 的升级指导可以补一句"当会话已是 `danger-full-access` 时不要设置 `sandbox_permissions`"，与建议 3 形成双保险。 --- ## Recovery note（供其他遇到该问题的用户） 被卡住会话的产出**可以从会话日志恢复**，因为每次 `write` 的 `content` 参数都被持久化了： ```bash zstdcat ~/.dsh/sessions///session.v3.jsonl.zstd \ | python3 -c " import sys,json for line in sys.stdin: o=json.loads(line) if o.get('type')!='tool/call': continue d=o['data'] if d.get('name') not in ('write','edit'): continue a=json.loads(d.get('arguments') or '{}') print(o['seq'], a.get('file_path'), len(a.get('content') or '')) " ``` 另外，`read` / `glob` / `grep` 等**只读工具不受影响**（本会话中全部成功）。因此即使用户不恢复日志，也可以让卡住的会话改走"只读核验 + 在对话里给结论"的路径先把成果取出来。 --- ## English abstract **Title:** Sandbox escalation dead option — `sandbox_permissions` equal to the call's effective mode always throws, and switching modes cannot recover. When a tool call carries `sandbox_permissions` whose value equals the call's current effective mode, `approveEscalation` (`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts:162`) throws before anything executes, so `write`/`edit`/`bash` never touch disk. Because `WIDER_MODES` (`escalation.ts:28-31`) has no `danger-full-access` key, once the effective mode is `danger-full-access` **both** values of `ESCALATION_TARGETS` are invalid. The model's requested target tracks the current mode, so switching the session between `workspace-write` and `danger-full-access` only changes which of the two error strings appears — there is no mode the user can switch to. The strict-widening check precedes the approval-channel check (`:162` before `:165`), so the approval policy cannot intervene either. The advertisement side is computed from the **deployment default** (`tool-bash/src/index.ts:192`, `tool-pwsh/src/index.ts:197`, `tool-fs/src/sandbox.ts:45`) while validation uses the **per-session** mode (`tool-bash/src/index.ts:221`, `tool-fs/src/sandbox.ts:98`). Since `bash-sandbox` is mounted by a platform-only gate (`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:216`), the dead option is advertised in **every** Linux session, including `danger-full-access` ones. Observed: 14 consecutive failed `write` calls in one session; a completed 616-line report could not be persisted. Nothing escaped confinement — this is an availability/data-loss bug, not a security hole. **Proposed fix:** treat `requestedMode === effectiveMode` as a no-op in `approveEscalation` (return the current mode and execute); additionally suppress `escalationHintMarker` when the mode is already `danger-full-access`; and add a sentence to the per-turn `danger-full-access` policy context telling the model not to pass `sandbox_permissions`.

discussions.title: session-persistence抢占session.lock导致插件无法resume
discussions.body:
我有一个DSH插件，触发运行后会dispose；
然后如果在DSH里打开这个session，只是打开，什么都不做；
然后插件触发resume就会报错：session "dsh-xxxxxx-032b77e23bc41872" is already owned by an active write handle

分析了下是DSH打开session时就占了写锁session.lock，感觉这个不合理，打开session只是看看，应该是发送prompt时再去占session.lock比较合理点。

```
:deepseek-harness $ find . -type f | xargs grep -ni "is already owned by an active write handle" 
./packages/session/session-persistence/tests/storage-contract.spec.ts:297:    expect(owned.message).toBe('session "errored" is already owned by an active write handle')
./packages/session/session-persistence/src/errors.ts:34:    super(`session "${sessionId}" is already owned by an active write handle`)
:deepseek-harness $ git log -1
commit ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887 (HEAD -> master, tag: dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2, origin/master, origin/HEAD)
Merge: 8dfc6fe1ec 6b1808f432
Author: CreatixChu <142372241+CreatixChu@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Thu Sep 17 21:19:19 2026 +0800

    Merge pull request #4469 from deepseek-harness/worktree/release-dsh-0.1.6-alpha.2
    
    release(dsh): 0.1.6-alpha.2
:deepseek-harness $ 
```

以下是codex的分析：
-------------------------------
结论：我按远端 master 的最新源码核对后，DSH 仍是之前的逻辑。
正常打开 session 的链路是：
1. 客户端打开 live event stream。
2. history.follow() 先返回 snapshot。
3. 对 prepared session，返回 snapshot 后立即后台调用 promote()。[history.ts](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/api/session-controller/src/history.ts)
4. promote() 会尝试 agents.resume()；如果没有现存 Agent，就进入 Agent resume 流程。[session-controller](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/api/session-controller/src/index.ts)、[agent.ts](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts)
5. Agent loop 最终执行 persistence.open(id, 'write')，JSONL persistence 原子地抢占写锁。[agent-loop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts)、[session-persistence](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts)
所以：
- “打开但不执行模型”不等于“不占写锁”；Agent 激活本身就会占写锁。
- 切换到其他 session 也不一定释放锁。当前客户端设计会让 session 常驻，off-screen 的 Remote source 继续运行。[client Session](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/session.ts)
- 最新代码主要只是把冲突错误规范化为 session/writer-held，没有取消自动 promote/resume 的行为。
- page() 等只读路径不会激活 Agent，但普通 UI 打开走的是 live follow 路径。
因此，之前判断仍成立：插件持有 reservation 时，DSH 可以先显示 session snapshot，但后台激活会失败并提示 session/writer-held；要让 DSH 真正“只读打开”，仍需要 DSH 提供或使用 read-only open 模式。

discussions.title: Writer-lock timeout error names only the path, leaving an orphan lock unrecoverable in practice
discussions.body:
### What happened

A desktop host (a Tauri shell wrapping `dsh web`) was killed while writing a profile manifest. The `withFileLock` `finally` never ran, so `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock` survived holding a dead pid.

Every later writer then blocked for the full `waitMs` — the plugin manager passes 120s — and failed with:

```
atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock at C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json.lock
```

That message names the path and nothing else: not the pid the lock records, not what to do about it. `withFileLock` deliberately leaves orphan recovery to an operator, so the operator is exactly who needs those two facts — and the timeout error is the only place they are surfaced. In practice the failure reads as "installs and updates hang, then fail", with no route to the cause.

### Why the lock is not recovered automatically

We agree with the current design: the recorded pid is not proof the owner is gone. On this machine the orphan lock's pid (`2948`) had already been reused by `WindowsTerminal.exe` before we looked, so any "pid is alive, keep the lock" check would have been wrong. File age has the same problem.

### Suggested change

Keep the recovery decision manual, but make the timeout error carry the facts that decision needs:

- report the pid the lock records (omitted when the lock cannot be read);
- state that deleting the lock releases it when the recorded process is gone.

We could not open a pull request (the repository does not accept external ones at this stage), so the patch lives on a fork branch: https://github.com/dustinmoon78/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/atomic-write-lock-timeout (commit 6c6c8297a779cf42d1555dafe01af03e03729f91). It updates the package README and JSDoc and adds unit tests for the holder and unreadable-lock cases.
