discussions.title: dsh-persian-rtl — automatic per-paragraph RTL for Persian/Arabic/Hebrew answers
discussions.body:
Hi everyone! Sharing a small plugin that fixes RTL rendering until it's handled officially: **[dsh-persian-rtl](https://github.com/ireza7/dsh-persian-rtl)**.

**What it does**

Fully automatic per-paragraph text direction (`unicode-bidi: plaintext`): every paragraph follows its own first strong character — Persian/Arabic/Hebrew paragraphs render right-to-left, English ones stay left-to-right. No buttons, no settings.

Covered surfaces:

- **Assistant answers** — including while streaming
- **Thinking / reasoning cells** (`turn-process`)
- **Question boxes** (`ask_user_question` tool rows, plan-review and question composer cards)

**Latin runs stay intact** — `code`, `pre`, `kbd`, and links are isolated LTR, so English words and numbers keep their order inside Persian text instead of jumping around.

User messages, the composer, sidebar, and settings are left alone, and no shipped renderer is replaced — the plugin only adds CSS.

**Install**

In any DeepSeek Harness session with the plugin-manager tool:

```
install_bundle with target = /path/to/dsh-persian-rtl
```

Or publish the folder to npm and install by package name.

Feedback and edge cases welcome — especially mixed Persian/English sentences. MIT licensed.

discussions.title: Fix: profile resolution loads dsh-tools twice under tsx dev mode, breaking every tool call
discussions.body:
## Bug report with fix: `pnpm dsh web` breaks every tool call ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')")

**Symptoms:** Since 0.1.6-alpha.2 (PR #4471), running the CLI in dev mode (`pnpm dsh web`, i.e. `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`) makes **every tool call fail** with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` at `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170`, regardless of model or tool. Built mode (`node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`) works.

**Root cause (confirmed by an instrumented boot of the web profile):** The new runtime profile resolution routes profile-scoped requests to the declaring package's anchor as the native resolution parent. That anchor is found by walking pnpm's `node_modules` symlinks (`packageDirFromAnchor`), so it contains symlink segments (e.g. `apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app/package.json`). tsx's resolver (`resolveTsPathsSync`) keys its tsconfig-paths rewriting off the parent URL and treats parents under `node_modules` as external packages, skipping the rewrite. The routed request therefore resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` to the built `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js`, while in-tree imports (agent-loop etc.) resolve to `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`. The package loads twice, `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` (a `unique symbol`) splits, and `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined` — hence the crash on every tool call.

**Fix (3-line change):** canonicalize the fallback declarer (realpath) before using it as the native resolution parent, in the ESM and CJS fallback paths of `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts`. Node realpaths parents internally, so default resolution results are unchanged; only the parent URL visible to loader hooks changes.

**Verification:**
- Repro plugin inside the booted tree: before the fix the slot read via the `src` module's symbol was `undefined`; after the fix all probed parents resolve to `src/index.ts` and the slot is populated.
- Added a regression test in `packages/boot/app-boot/tests/profile-resolution.spec.ts` (spies the native resolver and asserts the canonical declarer parent; verified it fails without the fix).
- Existing suites pass: profile-resolution.spec.ts (63), profile-resolution-service.spec.ts, profile-resolution-worker-bootstrap.spec.ts, profile.spec.ts, app-boot.spec.ts (132 total).

PRs are disabled on this repository, so the fix is available at:
https://github.com/jimmyfreecoding/deepseek-harness/commits/fix/profile-resolution-canonical-declarer
(commit `e522d99e47`, cherry-pickable onto master)

discussions.title: DSH｜DSH-Guild｜在 DSH 面板里建社区与实时聊天，可分享 / 克隆 DSH 会话
discussions.body:
项目地址：
github：https://github.com/seolhw/dsh-guild
文档：https://dsh-guild-docs.huiwang.fun/

## 项目介绍

DSH-Guild 把「社区」装进 DSH：在 DSH 面板内注册一个账号，就能自建或加入社区，实时聊天、贴图传文件、`@` 提醒、管理成员与角色权限，全程不用跳出 DSH。它的定位不是又一个网页版聊天室，而是**让社区内容和你的 Agent 工作区待在同一处**。

最有 DSH 味道的一点是**会话分享 / 克隆**：把自己本机的一个 DSH 会话打包发到社区，别人点开卡片就能「克隆到本地」，直接还原成一个能继续跑的本地会话。团队复现问题、分享一次成功的 Agent 编排，不用再靠截图和复制粘贴。

功能上大致齐了：公开 / 私有社区与邀请码、文字 / 公告 / 话题三种频道、Discord 式角色与频道级权限覆盖、表情回应、消息置顶、按频道 / 作者 / 时间 / `@我` 的全文搜索、`@everyone` 提醒、输入中状态、在线人数、未读与站内信，以及图片和任意文件的粘贴 / 拖拽上传。

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

不是外挂一个网页，而是作为 DSH 插件运行，并且复用了 DSH 自己的几项能力：

1. **以 DSH 插件形式安装**，装完在侧栏出现「DSH-Guild（社区）」入口：

   ```bash
   npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-guild
   npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
   ```

2. **Host 侧依赖 DSH 内置服务启动**：插件声明 `inject = ["settings", "webServer", "sessions", "sessionPersistence"]`，等这些服务就绪后才加载；聊天面板本身通过 DSH 的 `webServer` 提供的路由访问，不额外起服务、不占用新端口。

3. **配置接入 DSH 设置页**：`serverUrl` / `handle` / `token`（secret）/ `autoReconnect` / `share.maxSizeMb` 都在 DSH 的设置文档里，首次启动会把默认 `serverUrl` 写进 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` 的 `guild` 段，之后以该文件为准，改过的值不会被启动流程覆盖。

4. **读写本机 DSH 会话**：分享是**显式触发**的——只有你在面板里选中某个会话点「分享」时，host 才通过 DSH 的 `sessionPersistence` 以只读方式打开该会话并打包；克隆方向则用官方的 `sessions` 服务按包内事件 `seed` 还原成一个新的本地会话，并挂接到当前工作区。没有后台扫描或自动上传。

## 截图

![公告与置顶](https://r2.huiwang.fun/PixPin_2026-09-16_22-57-33.png)

![全员频道](https://r2.huiwang.fun/PixPin_2026-09-16_22-57-52.png)

![频道菜单](https://r2.huiwang.fun/PixPin_2026-09-16_22-58-43.png)

![角色管理](https://r2.huiwang.fun/PixPin_2026-09-16_22-59-43.png)

![权限位与频道覆盖](https://r2.huiwang.fun/PixPin_2026-09-17_00-03-24.png)

## 适合谁

- **插件 / 技能作者**：用「公告」频道发版、收集反馈、把讨论分流。仓库里有一份专门的用法文档。
- **团队 / 小组**：私密社区 + 角色分层，把沟通和会话上下文放在一起，出问题直接把会话分享给同事复现。
- **公开社区运营**：做会话分享广场，策划精选、组织话题讨论。

## 数据与自部署

插件本体是 MIT。默认后端是作者自建的 Cloudflare 服务（`https://dsh-guild-api.huiwang.fun`，Worker + Durable Object + D1 + R2），账号邮箱、消息、附件、分享包都存在这个后端上——**这是一个第三方服务，用之前请自行评估**。

不想依赖它的话，仓库里有完整的自部署文档，可以把整个 Server 部署到你自己的 Cloudflare 账号，然后在 DSH 设置页把 `serverUrl` 指过去即可，插件不用改代码。

仓库还附了开发文档，想边改边跑（热重载、watch 打包）或者自己托管 Server 都能直接上手。欢迎在评论区提问题和拍砖。

discussions.title: Web profile fails to boot: strict ctx.get disagrees with proxy service read in client-modules guard (crash under Bun 1.4), plus two Bun-compat notes
discussions.body:
# Web profile boot crash: strict `ctx.get` disagrees with the proxy service read in the client-modules guard

## Summary

`dsh web` (profile `web`, dsh 0.1.5-alpha.2, commit b2e3b2a012) can fail to boot with:

```
Error: failed to apply loader entry modules (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules): cannot get property "webServer" without inject
```

The guard in `packages/client/modules/src/index.ts` (`ClientModuleRegistry` activation, ~line 576):

```ts
if (ctx.get("webServer") === undefined) ctx.inject(["webServer"], registerWebCarrier)
else registerWebCarrier(ctx)
```

assumes strict `ctx.get("webServer")` and a bare `ctx.webServer` read agree. They can disagree during activation: under Bun 1.4.2 fiber timing, `ctx.get("webServer")` returned a **present (but not strictly active)** implementation, so the guard took the eager branch, and the carrier then crashed on `webCtx.webServer.register(...)` because the proxy read rejects a not-yet-active service (`cannot get property "webServer" without inject`, cordis `vendor/cordis/src/reflect.ts:144`). Under Node the same probe returned `undefined` and the deferred branch ran, so this only reproduces on non-V8 runtimes today.

## Reproduction

With Bun 1.4.2 as `node` (and `node:sqlite` resolving, which Bun 1.4+ provides):

```sh
pnpm dsh web --no-open
# → plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry modules
#   (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules): cannot get property "webServer" without inject
```

A probe on that line printed, on the same machine and config:

```
Bun 1.4.2: strict-get: present   → eager branch → crash
Node v24:  strict-get: undefined → inject branch → boots
```

## Suggested fix

Probe with the same resolution the carrier uses. When the property read rejects, defer through inject (which is also correct when the service is live, since a pending inject fiber resolves immediately once the service is active):

```ts
try {
  void ctx.webServer
  registerWebCarrier(ctx)
} catch {
  ctx.inject(["webServer"], registerWebCarrier)
}
```

Verified locally: `dsh web` boots and serves the app page (HTTP 200, `__DSH_BOOT__` present) under both Node v24.15.0 and Bun 1.4.2, and the `packages/client/modules` suite passes 81/81 under Node. The eager branch is preserved, so the synchronous-registration tests keep passing.

## Two related Bun-compatibility notes from the same debugging session

1. `packages/code-runtime/code-runtime-worker-thread` imports `stripTypeScriptTypes` from `node:module` as a **named ESM import**, which fails to link at load time on runtimes that lack the export (Bun < 1.5). `process.getBuiltinModule("node:module")` with a typeof guard degrades to a clean per-run `exception` failure instead of a boot failure. (This one is arguably Bun's gap, filed on their side too, but the import shape is the difference between "web cannot boot at all" and "one tool degrades gracefully".)
2. The `web` profile template sets `patchReload: "live"`, and `profile-boot` then force-creates the Cordis HMR service, which hard-requires Node internals (`--expose-internals` or the V8-symbol native addon `node-addon-require-builtin`). HMR is therefore structurally unavailable under Bun (JavaScriptCore has no V8 internals), and the requirement surfaces as a boot failure. A watch-only fallback or a friendlier error for this combination would help non-Node runtimes.

Happy to provide more environment details if useful. Thanks for the great harness.

discussions.title: Bug report + fix: an unclosed `$$` block turns the rest of a reply into one failing formula
discussions.body:
# Bug report + fix: an unclosed `$$` block turns the rest of a reply into one failing formula

Reporting a settled-Markdown rendering bug we hit in the web client's math path, together with a fix and tests. (Per CONTRIBUTING we are not opening a PR; raising it here instead.)

## What the user sees

When an assistant reply contains a `$$ … $$` display block whose closing fence ends a content line — for example:

```
$$\sec_g(X,Y)=\frac{1}{\lambda},\qquad
\Omega^k=0$$
```

the reply stops rendering at that point: everything from the block onward appears as raw LaTeX **in red**, bold/lists/inline math inside that region render literally instead of as Markdown, and the formula text on the opening line disappears entirely.

## Reproduction with the repo's own parser

```ts
import { parseGfmWithMath } from 'packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/parse.ts'

parseGfmWithMath('$$a,\nb$$\n\n**after**\n\n- item\n').children.map(n => n.type)
// observed: [ 'math' ]  — one math node whose value contains 'b$$\n\n**after**\n\n- item',
//                        with the opening line's 'a,' dropped
// expected: [ 'math', 'paragraph', 'list' ]
```

Verified on `master` (`ddefc45fbc`), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 0.1.6-alpha.2 / `dsh-web-frontend` 0.1.5-rc.2.

## Root cause

1. `mathCompatibility()`'s dollar flow construct was same-line only (`createMathFlow(…, multiline: false)`), so any line ending inside `$$…$$` failed it.
2. `parse.ts` additionally registered upstream `math()` (`micromark-extension-math` 3.1.0), whose fence rules then took over. That construct reads the remainder of the opening `$$` line as `mathFlowFenceMeta` (not part of the math node) and only recognises a closing fence at the start of a line, so a block whose closer ends a content line never closes: it consumes to the end of the document, KaTeX rejects the resulting node, and the consumed remainder never re-enters the Markdown grammar.
3. Fixing that without care also makes the failure path quadratic — every failed attempt can rescan to the document end — so the fix ships a fail-fast rule for a fence that starts its line, plus a linear fallback for every shape we could construct (odd backslash runs included).

## Fix (branch on our fork)

https://github.com/VitalyAnkh/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/dollar-math-runaway

* `mathCompatibility()` now owns the `$$` block form: the closing fence may end any line of the block, text on the opening line stays formula content, and a block with no closing fence fails the construct so its text stays literal instead of consuming the reply. A closing fence may repeat its `$`, and a longer opening fence counts when it ends its line, so `$$\n…\n$$$`, `$$$\n…\n$$$` and `$$$$\n…\n$$$$` render as display math again while `$$$\theta$$$` keeps upstream's inline text math.
* The extension also carries upstream's inline `$…$` *text* math **without** upstream's `$$` flow construct, and `parse.ts` registers `mathCompatibility()` alone — exactly one construct owns `$$`, so the runaway fallback is gone.
* A closing-fence attempt that instead meets a fence at the start of a line fails the construct as well (the rule the backslash marker already had), which keeps an unclosed block literal; a mid-line `$$` stays inside the formula, because formulas contain it. Failure stays linear for every adversarial shape: 4 000 unclosed `$$` lines of each shape parse in 27–58 ms, where leaving that fence as content rescanned to the document end on every later attempt (about five seconds, and 7–12 s for the odd-backslash-run shape).

## Verification

* `pnpm exec vitest run packages/client/ui-primitives` — 930 passed (41 in the owning spec).
* Coverage on the two changed sources: 100 % statements / branches / functions / lines.
* `pnpm exec tsc -b packages/client/ui-primitives/tsconfig.json` and `tsx scripts/run-oxlint.ts …` — clean; `pnpm run doc-sync` — 41 gates passed.
* Browser lane `apps/web/tests/math-rendering.e2e.ts` now seeds a `$$` block whose closing fence ends a content line, followed by a table and the reply's done marker; it and `thinking-markdown.e2e.ts` (the other golden with math) pass (7 KaTeX nodes, 3 display, no `katex-error`). As a negative control, reverting the two parser files in the worktree and rebuilding the client + web bundles makes that same run fail on the missing done marker — the block had consumed the rest of the reply.
* Unit tests added: a multi-line block with a trailing closer (formula value and following Markdown asserted), an unclosed block that stays literal with its paragraph structure asserted, repeated unclosed blocks that stay bounded (no KaTeX node, one paragraph per block), a parse-level bound for the odd-backslash shape, a parse-level case proving a mid-line `$$` stays inside the formula, the dollar form inside a list and a blockquote, and table rows for the fence runs and for `$$a,\nb$$`, `$$a,\n$$`, `$$x` with their formula values.

The change went through three review rounds against this repository's own conventions, code-review requirements, and Agent Note rules; every finding is resolved in the pushed revision.

## Known follow-ups (not part of this change)

* Divergence from upstream: an info string on the opening `$$` line (`$$asciimath`) is now formula content rather than `node.meta`. This renderer does not use `meta`, and keeping that text is what makes the reported form render.
* After an **unclosed** `$$` (or `\[`) block, a list or blockquote later in the document still settles as a paragraph — the same shape already follows an unclosed `\[` — while headings, tables, and code fences are unaffected. Removing it would need a non-consuming lookahead for the closing fence.

discussions.title: Windows: custom title bar drag region makes the caption buttons unclickable
discussions.body:
**Version:** `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2` (commit `ddefc45`)
**Platform:** Windows 11 x64 (build host Windows 11 26200, display scaling 125%)
**Build:** unsigned local build via `pnpm run package:desktop:win:x64:unsigned`

## Summary

The new Windows custom title bar draws a full-width drag region across the top of the
window. It overlaps the system caption buttons that Electron renders through
`titleBarOverlay` in the top-right corner, so **minimize, maximize and close do not
respond to clicks**. The application menu (top-left) and the sidebar buttons keep
working because they opt out of dragging explicitly; nothing opts out the
caption-button area, which the page cannot see.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Build the Windows desktop app from `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`
   (`pnpm run package:desktop:win:x64:unsigned`) and install it.
2. Launch it and open any session.
3. Left-click the minimize / maximize / close buttons drawn at the top-right of the window.

**Actual:** nothing happens; the clicks are consumed by the drag region. Dragging the
window by the same strip still works, so the strip itself is live.

**Expected:** the buttons behave like ordinary window controls.

**Workarounds:** `Alt+F4`, `Win+↑`, `Win+↓`, `Alt+Space`, or the application menu's Exit.
`CloseMainWindow()` (WM_CLOSE) also does not close the window, which suggests the
custom chrome swallows the close path as well.

## Root cause

Windows opts into the Windows Controls Overlay for the primary window:

- `apps/desktop/src/main.ts:118-122` — `titleBarStyle: 'hidden'` with
  `titleBarOverlay: { height: WINDOWS_TITLEBAR_HEIGHT, color, symbolColor }`
- `apps/desktop/src/windows-layout.ts:4` — `WINDOWS_TITLEBAR_HEIGHT = 40`

The page then paints a full-width drag strip over exactly that strip:

```css
/* packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/AppFrame.module.css:34-41 */
:global([data-windows-titlebar]) .frame::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 0 auto;                            /* full width, pinned to the top */
  height: var(--dsh-windows-titlebar-height); /* 40px — the overlay strip */
  background: var(--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill);
  -webkit-app-region: drag;
}
```

`inset: 0 0 auto` spans the entire window width, so the pseudo-element also covers the
top-right corner where the overlay buttons are drawn. Chromium hit-tests that area as
`HTCAPTION` (non-client) before the system reaches the caption buttons, so the buttons
never receive the click.

The codebase already excludes interactive chrome from this strip everywhere else, which
makes the omission look accidental:

- `apps/desktop/src/preload-menu.ts:18` — the application menu (`no-drag`)
- `packages/client/ui-sidebar/src/client/SidebarRoot.module.css:50` — sidebar buttons (`no-drag`)
- `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/ConversationRoot.module.css:39-46` — the macOS
  title row opts out its buttons, links and header clusters (`no-drag`), but that rule is
  scoped to `[data-platform='darwin']`

Nothing covers the caption cluster because the page has no layout knowledge of it.

## Suggested fix

Keep the caption-button region out of the drag region. Two workable directions:

1. Read the overlay geometry from `navigator.windowControlsOverlay.getTitlebarAreaRect()`
   and size a `no-drag` element over that rectangle, re-applying it on the
   `geometrychange` event (this also tracks window resizes and DPI changes).
2. Or end the drag strip before the caption cluster by reserving its width on the right
   edge, the same way `preload-menu.ts` reserves the left edge with
   `--dsh-windows-menu-start`.

Option 1 is preferable because the caption-button width is system-defined and varies with
DPI scaling, tablet mode and system language.

## Secondary observation (unconfirmed, worth a separate look)

On the same machine the reporter described the whole window surface as visually soft
compared with other applications on the same display (Windows 11, 125% scaling:
1536x864 logical over 1920x1080 physical). I could not verify this from the build host,
and it may be unrelated to this report, so I am flagging it rather than asserting it. If
it is reproducible, it is likely to sit in the same new-title-bar area:

- the primary window now uses `titleBarStyle: 'hidden'` on Windows
- `backgroundColor: '#00000000'` appears only in the macOS branch
  (`apps/desktop/src/main.ts:125-133`), so Windows does not get a transparent window
- `WINDOWS_TITLEBAR_HEIGHT` is a fixed 40 CSS px, while the real caption height is scaled
  by the display factor

A follow-up with a screenshot comparison against another application on a fractional
scaling setting would settle whether this is real.

discussions.title: Bug: settings UI unavailable on --trusted-host deployments (web behind tunnel/reverse proxy)
discussions.body: ## Summary `dsh web` served through Cloudflare Tunnel (or any reverse proxy + Access) loses the entire settings UI: Settings → Models fails with > Loading the provider directory failed: settings are unavailable in this browser even though the page authority is declared via `--trusted-host` and every API and websocket RPC works. The agent itself is unaffected (models come from the environment). This looks like a bug rather than a policy: the `/api` trust fence and the settings mirror are fed by the same `trustedHosts` declaration, but they make opposite decisions. ## Reproduction 1. `dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open --trusted-host example.com` 2. Reach the page via a tunnel/reverse proxy at `https://example.com/?token=...` 3. Settings → Models → `Loading the provider directory failed: settings are unavailable in this browser` 4. Loading the same server through a loopback origin (e.g. SSH port-forward) makes the settings UI work. ## Current behavior `packages/client/ui-settings/src/client/index.ts` (verified at `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`; same line exists in `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2`): ```ts const persistence = ctx.remote.$host.isLoopback ? 'host' : 'memory' ``` On any non-loopback page the settings mirror is `'memory'`. `settings-mirror.ts` documents `'unavailable'` as "the terminal non-loopback state" and `ensure()` short-circuits in memory mode, so the Models store's `describeFace.getSnapshot().view` stays `undefined` and it renders that fallback string (`packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/store.ts`). This contradicts the deployment's own trust declaration: `--trusted-host ` (`packages/bundle/web-app/src/startup.ts`) declares authorities to the `/api` trust fence, and the `connection` row wires it through (`trustedHosts: !!js ctx.webRuntime.trustedHosts` in `web-app/cordis.patch.yml`). The fence accepts the page; the settings mirror does not — the same authority list produces two different trust decisions. Not a broken deployment: `dsh web --dump-config` shows `settings → @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings-file` mounted, Settings → General renders (so the provider works), and the Models page's `llm/listProviders` / `llm/listConfigurableProviders` RPCs return `ok:true` with the full directory — only the describe-mirror path fails. ## Expected behavior A page loaded from a declared `--trusted-host` authority should get `'host'` persistence, same as the `/api` fence grants. Undeclared non-loopback authorities can stay `'memory'`/unavailable. (Or, if remote settings are intentionally out of scope, an explicit opt-in flag such as `--allow-remote-settings` — but the current silent split between the fence and the mirror reads as an oversight.) ## Environment - dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2` (also present in `0.1.5-rc.2`), Linux arm64, Node 22.23.2 - `dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open --trusted-host dsh.petr.ie` behind a Cloudflare Tunnel with Access in front - Settings document absent (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` never created) ## Workaround SSH port-forward to the loopback page, or edit `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` directly (hot-reloaded). Both work today; the UI is simply unreachable for remote deployments. PRs are disabled on this repository, so no code is attached — the fix is a one-line change to the `persistence` selection (honor the page authority's presence in the declared `trustedHosts`), happy to provide a fork commit if you'd like one.

discussions.title: [security] bwrap sandbox can be bypassed by accessing X11 socket or dbus
discussions.body:
I'm running latest DSH `master` on a machine running latest Ubuntu LTS with an X11 desktop environment.

By default the `bwrap` sandbox is fully read-permissive, but forbids writes outside of workspace dirs. I've just walked V4.1 Flash through the following steps:

* Read `~/.Xauthority` from my homedir
* Open a terminal
* Enter `touch ~/foobar` to demonstrate bypass of `bwrap` write restrictions
* Read back `~/foobar` through fs tools to check it exists

This is a full bypass of the sandbox for anyone running DSH in default configuration on a machine with an X11 session. dbus is also accessible, so it's not strictly just an X11 issue.

I think this could be mitigated by applying some network restrictions to `bwrap`, and it would probably be sensible to revoke reads to `~/.Xauthority` (and/or path indicated by `$XAUTHORITY`) too.

The exact `bwrap` confinement is:

```
bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --unshare-pid --proc /proc --die-with-parent --tmpfs /tmp --bind <workspace> <workspace>
```

(note no unshare-net).

I asked the same DSV4.1 instance to translate my description above and add its own notes:

---

我在一台运行最新 Ubuntu LTS、使用 X11 桌面环境的机器上运行最新 DSH `master`。

默认情况下，`bwrap` 沙箱对读取完全放行，但禁止写入工作区目录之外的位置。我刚才引导 V4.1 Flash 完成了以下步骤：

* 从我的主目录读取 `~/.Xauthority`
* 打开一个终端
* 输入 `touch ~/foobar`，以演示绕过 `bwrap` 写入限制
* 通过文件系统工具回读 `~/foobar`，确认它确实存在

对于任何在默认配置下、于带 X11 会话的机器上运行 DSH 的人而言，这是对沙箱的完全绕过。dbus 同样可以访问，所以这严格来说并不只是 X11 的问题。

我认为可以通过对 `bwrap` 施加一些网络限制来缓解；此外，撤销对 `~/.Xauthority`（和/或 `$XAUTHORITY` 所指向路径）的读取权限，大概也是合理的。

确切的 `bwrap` 约束如下：

```
bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --unshare-pid --proc /proc --die-with-parent --tmpfs /tmp --bind <workspace> <workspace>
```

（注意其中没有 unshare-net。）

我让同一个 DSV4.1 实例翻译了我上面的描述，并让它补充自己的说明：

---

**我自己的说明**

* 会话模型：DSH 会话日志记录的是 `deepseek-flash`（provider 为 `deepseek-official`），并没有出现 "V4.1 Flash" 这个写法。如果该别名对应的就是 V4.1 Flash，请忽略；否则建议改为日志中的别名，以免上游核对时对不上。
* 回读是用 bash 的 `ls -l`，不是 `read` 文件系统工具；沙箱允许读取，所以两种方式都可以，只是与原文不一致。
* `~/.Xauthority` 的可读性确实是该路径成立的前提：把 `XAUTHORITY` 指向空文件后，`XOpenDisplay(":1")` 会失败。因此撤销读取权限这条缓解措施是有效的。
* 网络限制只能覆盖 X11 这一半：X 仅通过抽象套接字 `@/tmp/.X11-unix/X1` 可达（6000–6009 无 TCP 监听），而抽象套接字没有文件系统路径可供遮蔽，所以 `--unshare-net` 是 bwrap 层唯一的手段——代价是 bash 失去全部网络访问。会话总线是文件系统套接字（`/run/user/<uid>/bus`，位于只读绑定的 `/` 之下），`--unshare-net` 对它无效，需要单独处理（例如遮蔽该目录，或改用独立 uid）。
* 整条路径没有用到任何工具：注入是通过普通 bash 调用完成的，因此 `tools/pre-execute` 与 `ctx.approval.request` 都不会触发——审批机制约束的是工具，而这里根本不是一次工具调用。
* 受限子进程的写入限制仍然有效：在同一沙箱内直接 `touch` 该路径仍返回 `Read-only file system`。

discussions.title: [BUG] High CPU usage in web while pending,  `dsh-client-ui-tool`: row sweeps ignore prefers-reduced-motion and dominate paint while a turn streams
discussions.body:
Summary

`dsh-tool-row-sweep` and `dsh-bash-row-sweep`, both from
`dsh-client-ui-tool`, animate regardless of the platform's reduced-motion
setting. Twelve other `dsh-client-ui-*` packages guard their animations with
`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` — `chat`, `conversation`, `layout`,
`sidebar`, the settings panes and more — while `dsh-client-ui-tool` does not
mention the media feature at all.

They are also the single largest contributor to main-thread paint while a turn is
streaming. In two recordings of the same length doing the same thing, paint falls
from **16.3% of wall time (526 paints/s) to 3.9% (231 paints/s)** when reduced
motion is emulated, and the main thread goes from 51% to 67% idle. In the
browser's own task manager the tab's CPU drops markedly under the same
emulation.

All of these animations animate *paint-only* properties — `background-position`,
`background-color`, `outline-color`. None of them can be composited, so every
animation frame goes through paint. On a streaming transcript, where tool rows
are changing anyway, that competes directly with the work the browser has to do.

Not claimed by this report: layerisation is **not** explained by animations (see
*Also observed*), so roughly half of the paint-pipeline cost is something else.

## Reproduction

1. Start a turn in the DSH web UI and leave a tool call running (I held a steady
   running call for 10–20 s; nothing re-flowing, just the running row).
2. DevTools → Performance → record ~20 s.
3. DevTools → Rendering → *Emulate CSS media feature* → `prefers-reduced-motion:
   reduce`, then record another ~20 s of the same kind of window.
4. Compare **per second of wall time**, not totals: activity varies between
   windows and moves every metric at once, which is easy to mistake for the
   change under test.
5. Independently, with reduce emulated: `document.getAnimations()` still lists
   `dsh-tool-row-sweep` and `dsh-bash-row-sweep`, while `dsh-turn-status-shimmer`
   (in `dsh-client-ui-chat`, which does have the guard) stops.

## Current behavior

Five recordings, all while a turn was streaming. Paint is given as a share of
profiled wall time, and as events per second, because the windows differ in
length:

| recording | state | Paint | paints/s | Layerize | main thread idle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 37.9 s | animations on | 15.9% | 886 | 10.1% | 53% |
| 24.9 s | animations on | 19.3% | 380 | 13.0% | 30% |
| 22.1 s | animations on | 16.3% | 526 | 12.0% | 51% |
| 22.3 s | reduced motion | 3.9% | 231 | 10.2% | 67% |
| 8.3 s | reduced motion | 1.0% | 33 | 0.3% | 86% |

The 22.1 s / 22.3 s pair is the matched one. `Paint` is 4.2× cheaper under
reduced motion; `UpdateLayoutTree` halves (3.8% → 1.9%).

It is worth saying what this is **not**: JavaScript is not the cost. The busiest
JS frames in these recordings were React's own internals (~0.4% of self time),
and a third-party sidebar plugin measured 0.13–0.14%. The main thread is idle
half the time. The cost is downstream of JS, in paint.

Animations running with a call live, and their owners:

| animation | package |
|---|---|
| `dsh-tool-row-sweep` | `dsh-client-ui-tool` |
| `dsh-bash-row-sweep` | `dsh-client-ui-tool` |
| `dsh-turn-status-shimmer` | `dsh-client-ui-chat` (has the guard) |
| `_dsh-state-dot-chase` ×8, on SVG `rect` | a UI package — the name did not pin from the bundle |

## Expected behavior

1. `dsh-client-ui-tool`'s animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`,
   as its sibling packages do. This is worth fixing on its own merits: a reader
   who has asked their operating system for less motion currently gets two
   perpetual sweeps in the transcript whether they want them or not.
2. Consider animating a composited property for the sweeps — `opacity` or
   `transform` instead of `background-position`. An animation the compositor can
   run costs no paint at all, which is where almost all of the measured
   difference above comes from.

## Also observed

`Layerize` sits at 10–13% of wall (~100–120 per second) in **every** recording,
including both reduced-motion ones and one taken before any of this was
investigated. It does not respond to animations, so it looks like compositor
layer management rather than the spinners — probably worth a separate look, and
deliberately not bundled into the ask above.

## Environment

- DSH web `0.1.6-alpha.2`
- Windows 10/11 x64, Microsoft Edge `153.0.0.0` (Chromium 153), 24 logical cores
- Device pixel ratio 1.5, viewport ≈1684×755 CSS px
- Profile bundles: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `dsh-web-app`, `dshmarket`,
  `dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer`, `archify-dsh`, the agent-team bundles
- Method: DevTools Performance traces; `prefers-reduced-motion` emulated through
  DevTools → Rendering. No application code was modified for any recording.

discussions.title: Working solution for OAuth-protected MCP servers on DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2
discussions.body:
I spent the last week trying to get OAuth-protected MCP servers (Supabase, Vercel, AWS) working on 0.1.6-alpha.2 and finally found a solution that works. Posting it here in case it helps anyone else.

The problem

The built-in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client only supports static headers. It cannot run OAuth flows, so any server that requires browser-based login returns 401 and cannot be used. This has been tracked in #3813.

Community plugins that used to handle this, like ArvinQi/dsh-mcp, worked on alpha.1 but break on alpha.2 because they depend on @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime, which was removed in this version. The error looks like:

```
HARNESS
Failed to load plugins
dsh-mcp
web boot: 1 entry did not activate
dsh-mcp: failed
```

The solution

Two community packages provide a parallel MCP runtime with full OAuth support. They run alongside the official client without modifying it:

· pi2dsh — a bridge that runs Pi ecosystem packages as native DSH plugins
· pi-mcp-adapter — a complete MCP runtime that owns transport, OAuth, caching, and token refresh

Together they implement OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE, dynamic client registration, loopback callback, and secure credential persistence.

Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-mcp-adapter
```

Configuration

Create ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json in the standard MCP format:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "supabase": {
      "url": "https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp",
      "auth": "oauth",
      "lifecycle": "keep-alive",
      "timeout": 60000
    },
    "vercel": {
      "url": "https://mcp.vercel.com",
      "auth": "oauth",
      "lifecycle": "keep-alive",
      "timeout": 60000
    },
    "aws": {
      "url": "https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp",
      "auth": "oauth",
      "lifecycle": "keep-alive",
      "timeout": 60000
    },
    "stripe": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@stripe/mcp", "--api-key=rk_live_YOUR_KEY"],
      "lifecycle": "keep-alive",
      "timeout": 60000
    },
    "playwright": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@playwright/mcp@latest"],
      "lifecycle": "keep-alive",
      "timeout": 60000
    }
  }
}
```

The keep-alive lifecycle makes the adapter connect at startup and auto-reconnect via health checks if the connection drops. Without it, the default lazy lifecycle only connects on the first tool call.

Authentication

In a DSH session, run:

```
/mcp-auth supabase
/mcp-auth vercel
/mcp-auth aws
```

A browser window opens for each login. Tokens are stored in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, or Linux Secret Service) and persist across DSH restarts.

Stripe and Playwright are stdio servers — they need no authentication.

What I verified

· 5 servers connected: Supabase (29 tools), Vercel (212 tools), AWS (8 tools), Stripe (11 tools), Playwright (25 tools)
· All 285 tools available to the agent
· OAuth tokens survive DSH restarts automatically — no re-authentication needed
· stdio servers work via command and args in the same config file

Important notes

· This is not a fix for the official dsh-mcp-client. It's a parallel runtime that runs alongside it.
· On a headless/SSH setup, the OAuth callback listener on localhost:19876 may not be reachable from the remote browser. Manual URL paste is available as a fallback.
· The adapter stores tokens in the OS credential store and fails closed if the store is unavailable — no plaintext fallback.
· The pi2dsh bridge is a community project, not an official DSH feature. If it breaks on a future DSH version, it will need to be updated by its maintainers.

Common issues

If /mcp-auth says the server is not found, the config file is in the wrong location. The adapter reads from ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json first, then ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json. Make sure the file is at ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json.

If the server shows disconnected after startup, check that lifecycle is set to keep-alive. The default lazy mode only connects on first use.

If the browser doesn't open during OAuth, copy the authorization URL from the terminal or chat output and paste it into your browser manually.

Credits

Both pi2dsh and pi-mcp-adapter are separate community packages. I'm just documenting how to use them together on alpha.2. All credit goes to their maintainers.

discussions.title: [Bug][0.1.5-rc.2 + 0.1.6-alpha.2] Web 发送链静默挂起：prompt 类 unary RPC 无 deadline，传输挂起时 echo 永不退场（#2060 的翻转面）
discussions.body:
# Bug Report：Web 发送链静默挂起——#2060 去 deadline 后的翻转面

- **仓库**：`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`
- **严重程度**：高（用户输入静默丢失、无任何可见错误，只能整页刷新恢复）
- **关联**：#2060（30s 固定超时误杀发送 → prompt 类 RPC 去 deadline）。本帖报告同一发送链在该修复之后的**反向失败模式**。

## 环境

- macOS 15（darwin 24.6.0，arm64）
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2**（npx 安装，web profile）
- 观察于注入了自定义 client bundle 的宿主（`dsh.profile.bundles` client slot），但下述发送链四级全部是宿主自有代码路径，不涉及对宿主代码的任何修改

## 现象（GUI 实测复现 2 次）

页面静置约 13–17 分钟后，同标签页再发消息：

1. 用户气泡正常上屏，但消息**从未到达后端**——宿主侧 `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` 的 mtime 停在上一轮完成时刻；
2. 无任何错误横幅（`promptError` 不触发），回合不启动，也没有 Stop 可按；
3. **New Session 按钮同样失灵**（同一 unary 通道）；
4. 刷新页面后幻影气泡消失——本地 echo 从未被宿主承认。

即用户输入「三重静默丢失」：气泡滞留 + 无报错 + 宿主零痕迹。

## 根因（源码级；发送链四级，任何一级都没有 deadline）

1. `dsh-client-connection` `createWebConnectionRpc().call()`：一元请求走 `fetch(POST /api/<channel>/<endpoint>)`，仅当调用方传入 signal 才透传，无内建超时。传输层挂起（空闲后连接死掉、渲染进程饱和等）时 promise 永不结算。
2. `dsh-client-ui-conversation` `mintAttempt()`：`new AbortController()` 裸构造，无任何超时臂；Enter 发送把这个**永不触发的** signal 经 `sendSession` → `session.prompt` → `rpc.call` 一路传到底。
3. `dsh-api-session-controller` `beginSubmission()` / `prompt()`：用户气泡是 `beginSubmission` 的本地 echo；`retireFailedSubmission` 仅在 RPC 返回错误/抛异常时退场，`promptError` 同理。挂起 = echo 永不退场、错误态永不进入。
4. `ConnectionRecoveryConfigSchema` 只覆盖 SSE generation 握手（`generationReadyTimeoutMs` 默认 15s）与重连退避，对一元请求无效——SSE 侧已重建新 generation 时，在途的一元 fetch 仍挂着。

## 与 #2060 的关系

#2060 报告的是 30s 固定超时**误杀**发送（`signal timed out (internal)`）；其修复方向（`session.prompt` / `subagents.prompt` 归类 caller-signal-only、去掉固定 deadline，cf. @zoahdev 的 `fix/prompt-user-paced-no-deadline`）解决了误杀，但把失败模式翻转成了**无限静默挂起**。@setieroth 在 #2060 的实测（超大 session 拖饱和渲染进程、空闲后下一条消息无回音、重启恢复）已经描述了本帖的触发面，并建议在 caller-signal-only 之外对发送类 RPC 再加一层保护——本帖补上这层缺失的证据与参考实现。

## 版本核对（0.1.6-alpha.2 未修复）

npm pack 逐包 diff（0.1.5-rc.2 本机安装 vs 0.1.6-alpha.2 registry 产物）：

- `dsh-client-connection`：`createWebConnectionRpc().call()` 与 `ConnectionRecoveryConfigSchema` 逐字相同；
- `dsh-api-session-controller`：`prompt()` / `beginSubmission` / `retireFailedSubmission` 逐字相同；
- `dsh-client-ui-conversation`：`mintAttempt()` 逐字相同，全包无任何 deadline 逻辑；
- `dsh-host-webserver`：`lib/index.js` 字节级相同。

## 参考修复（已在下游产品 bundle 落地，未改宿主源码）

客户端 boot 时包装全局 `fetch`：

- 按 `POST /api/*` + 请求体信封 `{"type":"client-request"}` **精确识别**一元请求；
- 30s 无响应展示可操作横幅（提示刷新），**不 abort**——刻意避免重蹈 #2060 的误杀（合法慢的用户步调 RPC 不受影响）；
- 迟到结算自动撤横幅，零干扰。

对宿主侧的建议（bundle 侧做不了的部分）：

1. 区分「传输挂起」与「合法慢」：用连接活性（generation 心跳 / SSE 存活）作为一元请求的结算依据，而不是固定 deadline；
2. generation 轮换时对在途 admission RPC 做退场处理（新 generation 出现 = 旧请求永远不会被其目标连接结算）；
3. echo 退场路径增加「连接已死」的触发条件，让 `promptError` 可见。

---

> **AI 标识**：本报告由 AI 辅助生成（ZCode · GLM-5.3）；源码结论基于 npm 发布产物的逐包 diff 取证，GUI 复现为真实浏览器会话观察。

discussions.title: Agent Team 页面顶部工具栏支持固定
discussions.body: 建议将顶部工具栏设置为固定显示（Sticky Header），无论页面滚动到哪个位置，都能始终看到并访问顶部操作区域。这样可以减少不必要的滚动操作，提升整体使用体验和工作效率。 当前 Agent Team 页面在内容较长时，需要频繁上下滚动。当页面下拉后，顶部工具栏会消失，导致每次想关闭窗口、切换 Agent 或进行其他操作时，都必须先滚动回页面顶部，使用起来不太方便。

discussions.title: [Bug] Compaction selects its own previous checkpoint as the whole span, so a long session never converges (59/79 attempts rejected, 44.6 min burned)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Automatic compaction can select the checkpoint written by the **previous** compaction as its entire shadowed span. Re-summarizing a summary produces a same-size summary, the shrink guard rejects it, and the `agent/pre-step` listener simply tries again on the next step. One session produced **59 rejected attempts in 44.6 minutes of summarization** (48 of them inside a single turn), 5 failed manual `/compact` runs, and a session that never got below its threshold.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`, commit `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`, `--profile web`
- routed model `openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`
- compaction defaults: `thresholdRatio 0.8`, `retainRatio 0.16`, `compactionRetries 1`, `maxOverflowRetries 1`
- session `session-2496881f-8d36-4ce6-93d9-1954a31930c7` — 1,423 events, 5.28 h, exported log attached

## Reproduction

1. Run any session long enough to compact once. The first compaction lands normally (in the log: `shadowedRange 9–246`, 38,883 tokens).
2. The replacement checkpoint now sits at the head of the surface: `[system head, checkpoint, …retained tail]`.
3. Let compaction trigger again — by `agent/pre-step` pressure or by overflow recovery. `selectCompactableRange` always starts at the first non-system surface node, so the only eligible span is the checkpoint itself, and `shadowedRange` comes back as a **one-node** span (`{start: 709, end: 709}`).
4. The summarizer rewrites that checkpoint into another checkpoint of the same size. The guard in `summarizeCompaction` rejects it, `compactIfNeeded` throws, the `agent/pre-step` listener logs `step compaction failed: …; continuing the turn`, and the next step starts the cycle again.

## Current behavior

Every rejected attempt is this guard, from `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts`:

```
summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (N estimated framed tokens >= M)
```

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| `compaction/start` | 79 |
| failed `compaction/end` (with `error`) | **59** |
| succeeded | 20 |
| wall time in failed attempts | **2,678 s = 44.6 min** (median 38.9 s, max 97.8 s) |
| wall time in successful attempts | 887 s |
| failures where summary tokens **equal** shadowed tokens | **39 of 59** |
| attempts in turn 20 alone | **48** |
| user `/compact` commands | 5, **all 5 failed** |

19 of the 20 successful compactions are single-node spans on the previous checkpoint — the last one shadows 2,238 tokens and produces a 2,237-token framed checkpoint, which is exactly the equality the guard then rejects:

| summary seq | selected span | span is prior checkpoint | shadowed tokens |
|---|---|---|---|
| 708 | 9–246 | no | 38,883 |
| 873 | 709–709 | **yes** | 2,453 |
| 877 | 874–874 | **yes** | 2,442 |
| 922 | 878–878 | **yes** | 2,432 |
| … | … | **yes** | … |
| 1338 | 1256–1256 | **yes** | 2,238 |

## Expected behavior

A compaction candidate that cannot shrink should not be retried in a loop. Concretely:

1. Do not offer a compaction checkpoint (a `user/message` whose `data.source.plugin == "compact"`) as a summary span, or treat such a span as non-compactable when it is the only candidate.
2. When the shrink guard rejects a summary, record that the selected region is non-shrinking for this surface generation and stop retrying it — do not re-run the same doomed summarization on the next `agent/pre-step`.
3. Bound the total work: 48 full summarization calls inside one turn is not a bounded retry policy, and each call costs ~38k input tokens on top of the wall time.

## Relation to existing reports

- #5669 ("suppress repeated pressure summaries after non-converging compaction") describes the *successful-but-still-above-threshold* case. This is a different failure mode: here the compaction **throws before commit**, so nothing is landed and there is no result to suppress — the loop is driven by the throw.
- #6672 reports overflow recovery with **no** compaction attempt at all. This session is the mirror image: 59 attempts, all rejected.

## Evidence bundle

`https://gist.github.com/gorban/4725c87390cb391047a2f14b56b98d28`

- `EVIDENCE.md` — how to recompute every number above from the log
- `session-2496881f-sanitized.jsonl` — full session log (credential-redacted)
- `session-2496881f-checkpoint-chain.tsv` — the span table
- `session-2496881f-stats.json` — counts, wall time, failure messages

Recompute the chain directly:

```sh
jq -r 'select(.type=="compaction/summary")
       | "\(.seq)\t\(.data.shadowedRange.start)-\(.data.shadowedRange.end)\t\(.data.shadowedTokenCount)"' \
  session-2496881f-sanitized.jsonl
```

discussions.title: [Bug] llm-pi-ai silently resolves an unconfigured route to a 262144 context window while the provider declares 1048576
discussions.body:
## Summary

`llm-pi-ai` resolves an unconfigured route's context window from `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW` (262,144) even when the provider publishes a larger capacity for the same model id. In this session two routes on the same profile disagreed:

| route | harness-resolved `contextWindow` | provider-declared |
|---|---|---|
| `modlens-openrouter/deepseek-v4-flash` | 1,024,000 | 1,024,000 |
| `openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | **262,144** | **1,048,576** |

The profile declares the model with only `id` and `name`, so the default applies silently. Compaction then fires ~4× early, and the harness *infers* context overflow at 262,144 while the provider accepts 1,048,576.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`, commit `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`
- `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    openrouter:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
      models:
        - id: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
          name: Deepseek Flash v4.1
```

No `defaultContextWindow`, no per-model `contextWindow`, no built-in catalog entry for this id.

## Current behavior

The harness-resolved capacity is recorded in the session's `request/context` events:

```sh
jq -c 'select(.type=="request/context") | .data' session-2496881f-sanitized.jsonl
```

```
{"provider":"modlens-openrouter","model":"deepseek-v4-flash","contextWindow":1024000}
{"provider":"modlens-openrouter","model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash","contextWindow":262144}
{"provider":"openrouter","model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash","contextWindow":262144}
```

The provider's own catalogue for that exact id, from `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models`:

```
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash | context_length=1048576 | max_completion=384000
```

Two consequences in this session:

1. `resolveCompactSpec` derives `thresholdTokens = 0.8 × 262144 = 209,715` and `retainTokens = 0.16 × 262144 = 41,943`, so pressure compaction starts at a quarter of the usable context.
2. `isContextOverflow(message, contextWindow)` is called with 262,144, so the harness declares `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` for a ~287k-token prompt that the provider served without complaint.

## Expected behavior

The default should not silently stand in for a capacity the provider publishes:

- resolve `contextWindow` from provider metadata when the route is reachable (the `discoverModels` seam already reads `context_length`), or
- require an explicit `contextWindow`/`defaultContextWindow` for a model id with no built-in entry, failing loud at load, or
- at minimum log a warning when the default is applied to a route whose provider declares a different capacity.

A 4× under-declaration is not a conservative fallback: it changes compaction scheduling, and it makes the harness reject requests the provider would accept.

## Relation to existing reports

- #5123 and #6671 cover the *threshold ratio* versus the per-request output reserve — a different quantity.
- #3684 covers the indicator showing a placeholder window; #1495 asks for a session-level override. Neither addresses the resolved capacity used for compaction and overflow detection.

## Evidence bundle

`https://gist.github.com/gorban/4725c87390cb391047a2f14b56b98d28` — `EVIDENCE.md` section 2, plus the full session log.

discussions.title: [Bug] A length stop with one output token escapes overflow detection, so a dead session never recovers and continue is a no-op
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a provider truncates an oversized prompt it can return `finish_reason: "length"` with a tiny non-zero output. pi-ai's overflow sniff requires **exactly zero** output for that case, so dsh classifies the response as an ordinary `max-tokens` stop: `agent/request-error` never sees `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, no overflow-recovery compaction is spent, and the user's `continue` produces one token and ends the turn — repeatedly, with no way out.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`, commit `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`
- routed model `openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, harness-resolved window 262,144
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.1`
- session `session-2496881f-8d36-4ce6-93d9-1954a31930c7`

## Reproduction

The session's last five turns, each answering `continue`:

| turn | input | cacheRead | output | total | `turn/end` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | 269,321 | 17,792 | **1** | 287,114 | `max-tokens` |
| 23 | 11 | 287,104 | **1** | 287,116 | `max-tokens` |
| 24 | 17 | 287,104 | **1** | 287,122 | `max-tokens` |
| 25 | 19 | 287,104 | **1** | 287,124 | `max-tokens` |
| 26 | 21 | 287,104 | **1** | 287,126 | `max-tokens` |

Each assistant message's entire content is a single `reasoning` block containing `"The"`. The prompt is 287k tokens against a 262,144 window, so the truncation signal is unambiguous — the only difference from the two turns that *did* raise `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` is that their output was `0`.

## Current behavior

`@earendil-works/pi-ai`'s `isContextOverflow` handles the length-stop case with:

```js
if (contextWindow && message.stopReason === "length" && message.usage.output === 0) {
      const inputTokens = message.usage.input + message.usage.cacheRead
      if (inputTokens >= contextWindow * 0.99) return true
}
```

One output token and the check misses. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts` then falls through to:

```ts
case 'length': return { kind: 'max-tokens' }
```

so the turn ends normally from the harness's point of view. Nothing records that the model produced a single token on a full prompt, and the `agent/request-error` overflow listener in `compaction-basic` never runs. A user-visible dead end: every `continue` costs a full request and returns nothing.

## Expected behavior

A `length` stop whose *prompt* already fills the resolved window is context pressure, not an output cap. Suggested direction:

- Treat `stopReason === 'length'` as overflow when `usage.input + usage.cacheRead >= contextWindow × ~0.99`, regardless of whether the output was 0 or 1–2 tokens; or
- consult pi-ai's `isRecoverableLength(message, desiredMaxOutput)`, which already exists for "a length stop below the caller's intended output limit" and is currently unused by dsh (`grep -rn isRecoverableLength packages` finds only `node_modules`).

Either way the turn should reach the existing overflow-recovery path, which is exactly what the two `output = 0` turns did.

## Relation to existing reports

- #6672 and #4956 describe overflow recovery not running when the provider *does* report an error. This is the opposite direction: the provider reports `length`, the harness does not recognise it as overflow, and no recovery is even attempted.
- #5263 is the inverse misclassification (a bodyless 400 treated as overflow). The pair suggests the length/overflow classification needs a single documented rule.

## Evidence bundle

`https://gist.github.com/gorban/4725c87390cb391047a2f14b56b98d28`

- `session-2496881f-degenerate-length-stops.json` — the five stops with full usage
- `EVIDENCE.md` section 3
- `session-2496881f-sanitized.jsonl` — full session log

discussions.title: [Bug] Turns whose final assistant message has no text block render no branch or copy actions at all
discussions.body:
## Summary There are turns from which a session **cannot be forked at all**, and the UI gives no hint why: 1. If a turn's final assistant message contains no non-empty **text** block (for example a `length` stop that produced only a `reasoning` block), `closing` is `null`, and `TurnTailNodeView` returns before rendering `MessageIconActions` — so neither the branch nor the copy action exists in the DOM. 2. If a turn ended with `reason.kind === "error"`, `branchUnavailable` is true and the branch action renders but is inert. In the attached session that is turns 20–26 of 26: the last seven turns have no reachable fork point. The remaining turns are not the latest turn, so their actions are revealed only on hover. ## Environment - dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`, commit `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`, web profile - session `session-2496881f-8d36-4ce6-93d9-1954a31930c7` ## Reproduction 1. Drive a turn to a `length` stop that returns a reasoning block only — e.g. the five one-token turns in the attached log (turns 22–26), or any truncated reasoning-only reply. 2. Look at that turn's footer: there is no branch icon and no copy icon. The whole action row is missing. 3. Separately, end a turn with a runtime error (turns 20–21 in the log). The branch icon renders but `aria-disabled` is set and clicking does nothing. ## Current behavior `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/conversation-nodes/turn-tail.ts`: ```ts const closing = finalized.findLast(hasText) ?? null branchUnavailable: closing === null || latestTranscriptSeq !== closing.finalNode.seq ``` `hasText` requires `block.kind === 'text' && block.text.trim() !== ''`. A reasoning-only assistant message fails it, so `closing` is `null` — even though a finalized assistant node *does* exist (`finalized` includes it). `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/TurnTailNodeView.tsx`: ```tsx if (closing === null) return tail === null ? null :
{tail}
``` The early return skips the entire `` block, so the user loses copy *and* branch on exactly the turns that are most likely to be unusable — a truncated turn is the moment you most want to branch away from it. For error turns, `latestTranscriptSeq` is advanced past the closing node by the error event itself: ```ts || (event.type === 'turn/end' && event.data.reason.kind === 'error') ``` so `branchUnavailable` is true and the control is dead. ## Expected behavior - Keep the action row rendered whenever a finalized assistant node exists, independent of whether it produced text; `branchUnavailable` can stay for the enabled/disabled decision without removing the row. - On a turn that ended in an error, the fork target should be the last transcript seq, not "nothing" — that turn is precisely where a user wants to retry from. - Some affordance should explain *where* forking is possible (the current rule — "last message of a completed turn" — is only discoverable from a hover tooltip). ## Relation to existing reports - #4200 already covers the swallowed rejection in the two fork gestures (`forkAt`/`forkSession`), and I am not re-reporting it. This report is the separate defect that on some turns the control is never rendered or is unconditionally disabled, so the swallow is never even reached. - #6499 / #7118 / #7175 concern fork *state* correctness after a fork succeeds; #6150 is a plugin. None covers the missing affordance. ## Evidence bundle `https://gist.github.com/gorban/4725c87390cb391047a2f14b56b98d28` — `EVIDENCE.md` section 4; the session log shows the reasoning-only assistant messages for turns 22–26 and the two `reason.kind: "error"` turn ends for turns 20–21.

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows] 每条命令都会闪一个可见的控制台窗口（launchWindowsJob 缺 windowsHide）
discussions.body:
# 上游报告：Windows 上每条命令都闪一个可见控制台窗口（`launchWindowsJob` 缺 `windowsHide`）

> 提交去处：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions
> （该仓库 Issues 关闭、Discussions 开启；MIT，TypeScript，默认分支 master）

**环境**

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.1.5-rc.1`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`） |
| 相关包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.5-rc.2` |
| 系统 | Windows 11，**默认终端应用 = Windows Terminal** |
| 复现方式 | 任意一次工具调用（pwsh / bash 工具，前台或后台任务都算） |

**现象**

每条命令都会**弹出一个可见的控制台窗口**，标题是 `D:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`（即该命令的 runner 进程），命令结束即消失。连续工作时窗口"一直跳"，非常干扰。宿主自身没有控制台（由 vbs/detached 拉起），所以这不是"宿主的窗口"。

**证据**（窗口枚举探针：每 120ms 扫一次可见的 `ConsoleWindowClass` / `CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS`，只在集合变化时记录）

```
02:46:41.355  CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS :: D:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe ;; ConsoleWindowClass :: cmd.exe
02:46:42.480  CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS :: node.exe ;; CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS :: node.exe ;; ConsoleWindowClass :: cmd.exe   ← 多出来一个
02:46:43.508  CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS :: node.exe ;; ConsoleWindowClass :: cmd.exe                                              ← 命令结束即消失
```

**根因**

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` 的 `launchWindowsJob()` 在拉起 Node runner 时**没有传 `windowsHide`**：

```js
// lib/index.js —— launchWindowsJob()
child = (internals.spawn ?? spawn)(command, [...prefix, "--", ...spec.argv], {
  cwd: process.cwd(),
  env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation),
  stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe")
  // ← 少了 windowsHide: true
});
```

同一包里的其它 spawn 点都传了，唯独这条漏掉：

- `spawnSubprocess()` → `windowsHide: platform === "win32"`
- `taskkillTree()` / `taskkillProcessTree()` → `windowsHide: true`

宿主进程没有控制台，于是 Windows 给 runner **新分配**一个控制台；当默认终端是 Windows Terminal 时，就是一个可见窗口。

**一行修复**（已在本机构建产物上验证）

```diff
 		], {
 			cwd: process.cwd(),
 			env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation),
-			stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe")
+			stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe"),
+			windowsHide: true
 		});
```

**同类漏点（建议一起看）**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` 的 `defaultProbeWindowsAcl()` —— Windows ACL 探测那条

```js
spawnSync(program, [...runnerInvocation.slice(1), "--workspace", tmpdir(), "--temp", tmpdir(),
  "--mode", "read-only", "--", "cmd", "/c", "exit", "0"], { timeout: timeoutMs, stdio: "ignore" });
```

也没有 `windowsHide`，所以受限（workspace-write / read-only）模式下启动时会闪一下。

**验证**

打上上面两处补丁后，用同一个探针再跑 45 秒（期间执行 4+ 次命令，含后台任务与子进程）：

- 补丁前：每条命令出现 1 个可见控制台窗口；
- 补丁后：**0 个新窗口**（窗口集合全程无变化）。

**备注**

- 我的补丁是直接改 `node_modules` 构建产物的（本机必须立刻生效），并配了一个幂等脚本重打（升级会还原）。上游应在源码里修。
- 如果某些环境里 `windowsHide`（libuv 走 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW`/`SW_HIDE`）仍被 Windows Terminal 忽略，可用 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 语义兜底；**本机实测 `windowsHide: true` 已经足够**。
- 复现脚本（窗口枚举探针）我可以直接附上，需要的话说一声。

---

**English summary（for a bilingual post）**

On Windows, every tool command spawns a Node "runner" process that briefly opens a **visible console window** (Windows Terminal, titled `node.exe`). Root cause: `launchWindowsJob()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` spawns the runner without `windowsHide`, unlike every other spawn site in the same package (`spawnSubprocess`, `taskkillTree`, `taskkillProcessTree` all set it). The host itself has no console, so Windows allocates a fresh one for the runner. Fix: add `windowsHide: true` to that spawn (verified: a 45s window-enumeration probe shows 1 visible console window per command before the patch, 0 after). Same omission exists in `dsh-sandbox-local`'s `defaultProbeWindowsAcl()`.

discussions.title: [Bug] Since dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2 every tool call fails under `pnpm dsh` source launch: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`
discussions.body:
**Summary**

On a clean checkout of master (`ddefc45fbc`, release `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`), any `pnpm dsh --profile headless "<task>"` that triggers a tool call aborts with:

```
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

Introduced by PR #4471 (`9ddef327a4`, "feat: resolution mode link to runtime"), which changed the plain-Node source-launch default `resolutionMode` from `'link'` to `'runtime'`.

**Environment**

- Windows 11 (10.0.26200), Node v24.16.0, pnpm 11.7.0
- Source launch (`pnpm dsh` → `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`)
- master `ddefc45fbc`, real `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`

**Repro (deterministic)**

```sh
pnpm dsh --profile headless "Use the shell tool to run 'echo hello' and report its output."
```

The model emits a tool call, `tool/call` is appended to the session log, then the turn ends with the error above and exit code 1. Any task that triggers a tool call fails; tasks without tool calls complete normally.

**Root cause**

Under the tsx source launch, tsconfig `paths` project workspace bare imports to `src/`. The runtime profile resolver routes plugin imports through the declaring package manifest (`entry.declarer`, e.g. `apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/package.json`); resolution from that parent follows package `exports` into built `lib/`, bypassing tsx's paths projection. The same workspace package then loads twice from different planes in one process (verified with module-evaluation probes: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` load from both `src` and `lib`; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-headless` only `src`; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` only `lib`).

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a `Symbol(...)` (`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463`), so the two `dsh-tools` copies hold distinct symbol identities. Tool dispatch looks the scheduler up by symbol — `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(...)` (`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170`) — and when the registry instance and the lookup come from different copies, the lookup is `undefined` and every tool call crashes.

**Verified fix (one line)**

Restore the `'link'` default for plain Node launches in `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts`:

```diff
-  const resolutionMode = packaged ? 'runtime' : options.resolutionMode ?? 'runtime'
+  const resolutionMode = packaged ? 'runtime' : options.resolutionMode ?? 'link'
```

After this change tool calls work again end to end (shell + read verified in one session). Packaged executables and the Electron Host still force `runtime` explicitly, so they are unaffected. Longer term, runtime routing would need to honor tsconfig `paths` (or otherwise keep one module plane) before it can be the source-launch default; a keyless source-launch e2e that performs at least one real tool call would have caught this regression.

**中文摘要**

0.1.6-alpha.2 起，源码启动的 `dsh` 一调用工具就报 `UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` 并退出。根因是 #4471 把普通启动的默认解析模式从 `link` 改为 `runtime`：runtime 路由以声明方 manifest 为父上下文重新解析插件 import，绕开了 tsx 的 tsconfig `paths`，同一个工作区包被同时从 `src` 和 `lib` 加载两份；`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 是 `Symbol`，两份副本符号身份不一致，agent-loop 派发工具时取到 `undefined`。把 `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts` 的默认值改回 `'link'` 即恢复（打包产物与 Electron Host 强制 runtime 的路径不受影响，已端到端验证）。

discussions.title: 裸 413（无错误体）被归一化为 INVALID_REQUEST → 长会话永久卡死（0.1.6-alpha.2）
discussions.body:
# 诊断报告：DeepSeek Messages 接口返回「裸 413」被归一化为 INVALID_REQUEST → 长会话永久卡死

> 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2` ｜ 日期：2026-09-20 ｜ OS：Windows x64 ｜ 模型：`deepseek-flash`

## TL;DR

1. 服务端对某个请求返回**不带错误体的 413**（裸 413，无 JSON 详情）。
2. 适配器把它归一化为 `INVALID_REQUEST`：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js` 第 1159 行 `if (status === 413) return "INVALID_REQUEST";`，第 2340 行兜底文案 `` `DeepSeek Messages request failed (${status})` `` —— 该文案出现即说明响应体里**没有** `error.message`。
3. 由于只有 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 才会驱动 `compaction-basic` 的溢出恢复，**自动压缩与重试完全不触发**，该轮直接失败。
4. **坏状态留在会话历史中**：此后每一次发送都 413 —— 连 `/compact` 的摘要请求也 413，会话**永久卡死**，用户只能新建会话（丢上下文）。

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.1.6-alpha.2`（升级前 `0.1.5-rc.1` 正常） |
| 模型 | `deepseek-flash`（V4.1 Flash），`reasoningEffort: high` |
| 协议 | 适配器默认 `messages`（`/anthropic/v1/messages`） |
| OS / 运行时 | Windows x64 / Node 24.19.0 |
| 首次失败 | 2026-09-20 09:01（服务 08:56 重启；受影响会话均跨越 9/10、9/16、9/19 三次版本升级） |

## 症状

- 在某会话中发送任意消息（哪怕只有一句纯文本），`step 1` 立即失败：

```
finish.reason = { kind: "error", failure: {
  message: "DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)",
  code: "INVALID_REQUEST", status: 413 } }
```

- 在该会话内把模型 `deepseek-flash` → `deepseek-v4-pro`，**仍然 413**。
- 在该会话执行 `/compact`：`compaction/end` 事件同样记录 `error: "DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)"`，界面提示 `Compaction could not produce a useful summary.`
- **新建会话完全正常**；同账号、同服务、同模型的其他会话均正常。

### 受影响会话 vs 正常会话（同机实测）

| 会话 | 日志大小 | 压力 tokens(占窗口) | 413 次数 | 最后成功 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A（8/31 创建，421 轮） | 9.8 MB | 90,908 (9%)† | 10 | 09-17 09:31 | ❌ 卡死 |
| B（旧会话） | 8.9 MB | — | 2 | 09-19 12:16 | ❌ 卡死 |
| C（旧会话） | 8.5 MB | — | 2 | 09-17 09:31 | ❌ 卡死 |
| D（同工作区，正常） | 9.8 MB | 484,364 (48%) | 0 | 09-17 15:30 | ✅ 正常 |
| E（当日新建） | 0.6 MB | — | 0 | 09-20 09:16 | ✅ 正常 |

† 卡死会话的压力值是卡死前的旧快照（失败轮次不更新投影）。

**注意 D 与 A 日志同为 9.8 MB，且 D 的压力（48%）远高于 A（9%），但 D 正常** → 与体积/上下文占用**无关**。

## 已实测排除（均为直接调用 DeepSeek 接口，非推测）

| 假设 | 实测结果 |
|---|---|
| 输入超 100 万 tokens | ✅ 通过：累计 **950,037 tokens** → HTTP 200 |
| 请求体字节数超限 | ✅ 通过：单请求体 **33.4 MB** → HTTP 200 |
| 图片过大 | ✅ 通过：单张 9.29 MB PNG（base64 12.4 MB）→ HTTP 200 |
| 图片数量多 | ✅ 通过：5 张大图（33.4 MB）→ HTTP 200 |
| 消息条数多 | ✅ 通过：**3,000 条** messages → HTTP 200 |
| content 片段数多 | ✅ 通过：单条消息 **3,000 个** text 片段 → HTTP 200 |
| `max_tokens` 预留值 | ✅ 通过：256000 / 200000 / 131072 / 64000 均 200 |
| thinking 签名无效/缺失 | ✅ 通过：伪造签名、缺失签名均 200 |
| 历史含 `<system-reminder>` 注入消息 | ✅ 通过：200 |
| 对话中间出现 `role: "system"` 消息 | ✅ 通过：200 |
| 单个 tool_result 过大 | ⚠️ 200–1000 KB 返回 **400**（`content[].thinking must be passed back`，属另一问题），**非 413** |
| 模型路由（flash / v4-pro、`systemPromptUpdate: in-history`） | ❌ 无区分度：卡死会话三种路由各不相同 |
| 工作区路径 / cwd 不匹配 | ❌ 无证据：会话身份 `cwd` 与日志一致，工作区内无指令文件 |

## 目前掌握的边界

- 触发条件**不在**可枚举的请求量纲里（token / 字节 / 条数 / 图片 / 模型 / 路径 / 内容形态）。
- 触发点**位于这三个会话的历史**中：整段请求失败，**重放历史的压缩请求也失败**（压缩会重放最老的 balanced head）。
- 三个卡死会话的共同点：**均为跨多次版本升级的老会话**（8/31 创建，`isSeeded: true`，历史含 21–22 条 `session/end-seed`、6–7 次 `compaction/*`、8 条 `system/message`）。新建会话与同日其他会话均正常。
- 倾向判断：老会话的 **surface / 压缩 / seed 状态**在新版（0.1.6-alpha.x，协议默认切到 `messages`）下被重新解释，产生了服务端拒绝的请求；但**因服务端未返回任何错误体，客户端无法定位具体字段**。

## 建议修复（按优先级）

1. **归一化修正**：把 `413`（以及 `Input token exceed the limit` 这类生产措辞）归入 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`，使 `compaction-basic` 的溢出恢复能够触发 —— 本报告的核心诉求。
2. **兜底恢复**：即便归类失败，在 `INVALID_REQUEST + 413` 时也应尝试一次**缩减重试**（保留最近 N 轮或丢弃最老的非必要内容），避免会话进入"每次都失败"的永久卡死态。
3. **可观测性**：错误对象应保留**服务端原始响应**（即使 body 为空，也记录 status / headers / 请求体字节数 / token 估算），否则现场无法诊断 —— 目前只有一句兜底文案。
4. **请求侧可观测性**：在会话日志中记录**序列化后的请求大小（bytes）**与分词估算，便于二分定位。
5. （可选）`/compact` 失败时应区分"摘要不够小"与"请求被拒"，给出可操作提示。

## 诊断包（按官方手册模板）

```
Harness version:        0.1.6-alpha.2 (Web profile)
Surface and profile:    web / $DSH_HOME/profiles/web
Provider and model:     deepseek-official / deepseek-flash（v4-pro 同样失败）
Raw provider status:    413（响应体为空，无 error.message）
Normalized code:        INVALID_REQUEST
Provider contextWindow: 1000000（适配器声明）
Conversation maxTokens: 256000（默认；改为 64000 仍失败）
Compaction:             未覆盖（默认 thresholdRatio 0.8 / maxOverflowRetries 1）
Request 体积:           该会话 surface 约 3.8 MB 事件数据（合成请求 33.4 MB 可通过）
Recovery request:       /compact 的摘要请求同样 413
Repeated fingerprint:   同一会话连续 10 次 413；切换模型后仍 413
New empty session:      正常（同账号、同服务、同模型）
Previous route:         deepseek-flash / 1,000,000
Pending route:          deepseek-v4-pro / 1,000,000（切换后仍 413）
```

## 复现路径

1. 用 0.1.5 及更早版本长期运行若干会话（跨多次升级）；
2. 升级到 0.1.6-alpha.2 并重启服务；
3. 打开其中**规模较大的老会话**，发送任意一句文本 →
   `DeepSeek Messages request failed (413) / INVALID_REQUEST`，该会话此后永久无法发送（新会话正常）。

> 备注：本报告已脱敏（不含密钥、用户名、会话 ID、私有路径）。如需原始日志片段可另行提供。
以上报告是我让DSH自己写出来的，我本人是个小白，它修不好那些旧的会话，最后得出一个结论上Github让官方修

discussions.title: 单个损坏的会话文件会让整个 list() 失败，连带破坏工作区 / 搜索 / 删除
discussions.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` `0.1.5-rc.2`
- DSH `0.1.5-rc` 系列（web profile）
- Windows 11 / Node 24

## 问题

`SessionPersistence.list()` 在遇到**任意一个**无法读取的会话文件时会整体抛错，
而不是跳过该文件继续扫描。

由于 `list()` 被多个包依赖，**一个损坏的会话文件**即可让下列功能全部不可用：

- 会话列表 / 删除 / 归档
- 工作区注册表操作
- 会话全文检索
- ACP 桥

而这些功能与那个损坏文件本无关系。

## 复现

在会话根目录下放置一个正常会话和一个损坏文件：

```
<DSH_HOME>/sessions/--D-project--/session-good-0001/session.v3.jsonl.zstd   # 合法 zstd
<DSH_HOME>/sessions/--D-project--/session-bad-0002/session.v3.jsonl.zstd    # 非 zstd 内容
```

调用 `sessionPersistence.list()`。

**实际**：整个调用抛错，正常会话也拿不到。

```
corrupt Zstandard session log: invalid frame magic at byte 0
```

**期望**：跳过 `session-bad-0002`，返回 `session-good-0001`，并能从日志得知跳过了哪个文件。

### 实测影响

删除**任意**会话都会失败并返回 `list-failed`——即使要删的那个会话完全健康。
（在插件开发中遇到：只要目录里存在一个损坏文件，删除功能就整体不可用。）

## 根因

`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl` → `lib/index.js` → `listArtifacts()`：

```js
for (const dir of await this.listSessionDirs(project, signal)) {
  signal?.throwIfAborted();
  const selected = await this.resolveGenerationInDirectory(dir, signal);
  if (selected === void 0) continue;
  let header;
  try {
    header = await this.readGenerationHeader(selected, void 0, signal);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof SessionFormatUnsupportedError) continue;   // 只放过「版本不支持」
    throw error;                                                    // ← 其它一律中断全库
  }
  ...
}
```

目前只对 `SessionFormatUnsupportedError` 做「跳过」，其它读取错误
（zstd 帧损坏、写到一半的残留、IO 错误等）会中断整个扫描。

## 影响面

`list()` 的跨包调用者：

| 包 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `dsh-workspace` | 工作区注册表；`sessionKnown()` 用它判断会话是否存在 |
| `dsh-session-query` | 会话全文检索索引 |
| `dsh-session-query-sqlite` | 同上（SQLite FTS5 版） |
| `dsh-acp` | ACP 桥 |

## 建议修法

与 `SessionFormatUnsupportedError` 同等对待 —— 跳过并记录：

```js
} catch (error) {
  /* 取消是控制流，不是数据损坏，必须继续传播 */
  signal?.throwIfAborted();
  if (error instanceof SessionFormatUnsupportedError) continue;
  /* 单个不可读的 artifact 不应让整库不可用；记录后跳过。 */
  this.ctx.logger.warn(
    `${this.name}: skipping unreadable session artifact ${selected.sourcePath}: ` +
    `${error?.message ?? String(error)}`
  );
  continue;
}
```

三个关键点：

1. **`signal?.throwIfAborted()` 置于最前** —— 取消必须继续抛出，
   否则会吞掉中止信号。
2. **只跳过「读取该文件失败」** —— 下方的「重复 id」一致性错误
   （`duplicate JSONL session id ...`）应保持抛出，那是真正的数据完整性问题。
3. **必须记录日志** —— 否则损坏文件会被静默忽略，用户无从得知。

## 本地验证

在隔离沙箱中做的对照实验（1 个正常会话 + 1 个损坏文件）：

| 版本 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 原版 | ❌ `list()` 抛错，正常会话也拿不到 |
| 按上述改法打补丁 | ✅ `list()` 成功，返回 1 个正常会话，损坏的被跳过 |

补丁同时确认未影响正常列表功能。

## 附：另一个同类观察（可能值得一并考虑）

`web_search` 工具在其 provider 不可用时仍会注册，调用必然失败：

```
Error: no usable web provider is registered
```

工具定义处的注释说明这是有意为之（"an enabled tool remains visible when its
provider is unavailable and fails with a structured error at execution time"），
但代价是模型要先失败一次才知道不可用，浪费一轮往返。若能在 provider
不可用时不注册该工具（或提供显式开关），体验会更好。

discussions.title: [Bug] Tool call fails with "prepare" undefined on fresh install
discussions.body: Environment: - Windows 10 native: Node.js v22.22.2, pnpm 11.7.0, DSH source build - WSL2 Ubuntu (Linux 6.x, x86_64): Node.js v24.21.0, pnpm 11.7.0, DSH source build Reproduction: 1. git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git 2. pnpm install && pnpm run build 3. pnpm dsh web 4. In the Web UI, create a new session with default model (official DeepSeek). 5. Send: list files in current directory Expected: The Bash tool executes and returns the file list. Actual: The turn fails immediately with: 本轮运行失败 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') Additional context: 1. The issue persists on a completely fresh install, with no third-party plugins installed. 2. `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` was missing after `pnpm install`. I manually created the symlink (`ln -s ../../packages/core/tools node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) and confirmed `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js` exists. The error persists. 3. `pnpm why @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` returns no output, meaning no installed package depends on `dsh-tools`. Manually symlinking it into `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` does not fix the error — the scheduler still fails at runtime. 4. The same error also reproduces in a native Windows 10 environment (Node.js v22.22.2, pnpm 11.7.0, fresh source build). This is not WSL-specific. 5. The error is triggered by any tool invocation (Bash, Glob, Pwsh), regardless of the model used (official DeepSeek default). 6. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.yml` is an empty array `[]`. The profile is composed entirely from bundles listed in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`: `["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app"]`. 7. `packages/bundle/base/package.json` correctly declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and all `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-*` packages in its `dependencies`. However, `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` only contains a subset that exactly mirrors the root project's `devDependencies` (dsh-agent, dsh-browser-use, dsh-computer-use, dsh-experimental-*, dsh-llm-replay, dsh-skill-office, dsh-tool-session-query, dsh-web-fetch-http). `dsh-tools` and the tool packages are missing. 8. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` contains only `packages: - .` and `nodeLinker: hoisted`. The profile's own `dependencies` field is empty `{}`. This suggests the profile dependency resolution is not following `dsh-base`'s transitive dependencies, but instead only mirrors the root project's `devDependencies` — which happens to not include `dsh-tools`. 9. `~/.dsh/logs/` does not exist after a fresh run, so no DSH logs are available. The only log files in the environment are from npm and ubuntu-pro. This suggests DSH may be failing before its logging subsystem initializes. Attachments: No DSH logs are available (see item 9). A screenshot of the Web UI error is attached.

discussions.title: DSH｜回答高亮批注器 answer-highlighter｜回答生成后自动高亮回答中的关键点 / Auto-highlight key points in assistant answers
discussions.body:
仓库地址 Repository：[Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter](https://github.com/Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter) ## 中文介绍 给 DSH Web 的 AI 回复自动加语义高亮。主回答照常流式输出，回答完成后插件会额外调用一次模型，把其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题标出来。 默认使用 `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`，这次调用会额外消耗 token；原始回答和会话日志不会被修改。 ### 高亮类型 - `key-point` 关键点：亮黄色 - `definition` 定义：蓝色 - `warning` 警告：亮红色 - `question` 问题：绿色 亮色和暗色主题都会自动适配。

### 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter dsh --profile web ``` ### 工作方式 1. 主回答完成后，插件读取用户问题和完整回答。 2. 额外调用一次模型生成批注。 3. 批注写入本地 JSONL。 4. 浏览器轮询批注接口，并在 DOM 中定位文本渲染高亮。 5. 刷新页面后高亮会恢复。 ### 注意 - 每次回答完成后都会额外调用一次模型，会消耗额外 token。 - 不会修改原始回答和会话日志。 - 需要 CSS Custom Highlight API 支持，Safari 目前不支持。 --- ## English version This plugin automatically adds semantic highlights to assistant answers in DSH Web. The main answer still streams normally; after it finishes, the plugin makes one separate model call and highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions inside the completed answer. It defaults to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`, which consumes extra tokens. The original answer and session log are not modified. ### Highlight types - `key-point`: bright yellow - `definition`: blue - `warning`: bright red - `question`: green Both light and dark themes are supported.

### Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter dsh --profile web ``` ### How it works 1. When the assistant answer completes, the plugin reads the user question and the full answer. 2. It makes one separate model call to generate annotations. 3. Annotations are stored locally in JSONL. 4. The browser polls the annotation endpoint and renders highlights in the DOM. 5. Highlights are restored after a page refresh. ### Notes - Each completed answer triggers one extra model call, so it consumes extra tokens. - The original answer and session log are not modified. - It requires CSS Custom Highlight API support; Safari is currently unsupported.

discussions.title: dsh-duet - 让你只用语音，就能操作 DSH
discussions.body:
# duet

**只用语音，就能操作 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）。**

duet，意为「二重奏」。这里的 duet 使用全双工语音模型，可以边听边说，
让你与 DSH 的交流不必一人一句地等待。

说出需求、修改输入、发送任务、切换会话——把键盘上的操作交给声音。
任务完成后，duet 会简短播报结果，让你不用一直盯着屏幕。

你可以随时插话、补充或纠正。处理任务之外，也可以聊聊天。

目前处于**试用阶段**，duet 语音服务可以免费使用。

https://github.com/YuMS/dsh-duet

## 安装

安装插件，再重启 DSH：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-duet
dsh web
```

也支持 DSH 的 GitHub 插件安装方式：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:YuMS/dsh-duet`。
两种方式任选其一。
使用

duet 支持两种模式。

| 按钮 | 模式 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 喇叭 | 播报模式 | 任务完成后，进行简短的播报 |
| 双向箭头 | 交互模式 | 开口操作 DSH、自由聊天，也可以在回复过程中插话 |

### 目前支持的语音操作

| 操作 | 你可以这样说 |
| --- | --- |
| 输入内容 | “输入，帮我整理一下这周的计划” |
| 修改内容 | “把这周改成下周” |
| 清空输入框 | “清空输入框” |
| 发送任务 | “发送”“提交” |
| 新建会话 | “新建一个会话，叫旅行计划” |
| 切换会话 | “切换到第二个会话”“切换到旅行计划” |
| 重命名会话 | “把当前会话改名为周末安排” |
| 分叉会话 | “从当前会话分叉一个新会话” |
| 归档会话 | “归档这个会话” |
| 回答 DSH 的问题 | “选第二个”“用中文就好” |
| 自由聊天 | “什么是全双工语音交互？” |

discussions.title: 交付卡片「在文件资源管理器中显示」对含非 ASCII 字符的文件名静默失效（Windows）
discussions.body:
Summary

Windows 上，在交付文件卡片点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」时，若目标文件路径含非 ASCII 字符（如中文文件名），宿主侧交给资源管理器的命令不产生任何效果：不会打开任何窗口，也不会报错，而界面照旧显示"已请求在文件管理器中显示"，因此用户看到的是"点了没反应"。

纯 ASCII 路径下同一按钮工作正常。问题定位在 @deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command 的 Windows 分支：它把路径转成 percent-encoded 的 file:// URL 再交给 explorer.exe /select,，而 explorer.exe 在该系统上无法解析含非 ASCII 的 URL，静默退出；同时实现显式吞掉了 Explorer 的退出码 1，导致失败被当作成功。

对中文/日文/韩文等非 ASCII 命名习惯的用户，该功能等于不可用。

Reproduction

A. 用户可见路径（Web UI）

  1. 在 Windows 上以 dsh web 启动 Web UI（默认 http://127.0.0.1:3080）。
  2. 让 Agent 交付（present）一个文件名含中文的文件；或在右栏文件树中定位任意中文名文件。
  3. 在该文件的卡片/菜单上点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」。
  4. 观察：没有任何资源管理器窗口出现；卡片状态变为"已请求在文件管理器中显示"。

对纯 ASCII 文件名重复步骤 2–4：资源管理器正常打开并选中该文件。

B. 最小化复现（不依赖 DSH，便于快速验证）

在任意 Windows 终端依次执行下面两条（第二条是 DSH 当前使用的形式）：

bat
:: 1) DSH 当前使用的形式：percent-encoded file:// URL —— 无任何反应
explorer.exe "/select,file:///C:/Users/GM/Desktop/DS/tutorial-review/DSH%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B_0.1.6-alpha.2_%E8%BF%87%E6%9C%9F%E5%AE%A1%E6%9F%A5.md"

:: 2) 原生路径形式 —— 正常打开并选中该文件
explorer.exe "/select,C:\Users\GM\Desktop\DS\tutorial-review\DSH教程_0.1.6-alpha.2_过期审查.md"

对照实验（是否真的弹出窗口，用 Shell.Application.Windows() 计数得到，而非肉眼判断）：

变体 | 结果 -- | -- ASCII 文件名 + file:// URL 形式 | ✅ 窗口弹出 中文文件名 + file:// URL 形式（当前实现） | ❌ 无任何窗口 中文文件名 + 原生路径 /select,"C:\…" | ✅ 窗口弹出 中文文件名 + 拆成两个 argv（run() 的实际传参形状） | ❌ 无任何窗口

根因定位

包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command（仓库内路径 packages/util/native-command） 文件：lib/index.js

js
// L228-230   Windows 分支
const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C");
try {
  await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
} catch (error) {
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  if (!(error instanceof Error) || !("code" in error) || error.code !== 1) throw error;  // L231-234
}

两个问题叠加：

  1. 路径被转成 percent-encoded 的 file:// URL（pathToFileURL().href）再交给 /select,。在本环境的 explorer.exe（19045.5247，CP936）上，含非 ASCII 的 URL 解析失败，Explorer 什么都不做地退出——因此没有窗口、也没有对话框。
  2. 失败被吞掉：L231-234 把退出码 1 视为可接受的交接结果；函数 JSDoc（L206）已自陈这一点： Explorer exit 1 is accepted as a delegated handoff, not proof of selection.

调用链上游同样把它当成功：

@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller lib/index.js L2886-2897：

js
async openWorkspacePath(request, signal) {
  if (request.path.length === 0) throw new RemoteError("gateway/bad-request", …);
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  try {
    if (request.action === "reveal") await this.revealPath(request.path, signal);
    else await this.openPath(request.path, signal);
    return { opened: true };          // ← Explorer 静默失败时依然返回成功
  } catch (error) { … }
}

因此客户端 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables 收到成功响应，显示 presented.revealed（"已请求在文件管理器中显示"）而不是 presented.revealError。

注：同一交付卡片的「在应用中打开」不受影响——它走 openNativePath → openWindowsPath，实现是 powershell.exe -Command Invoke-Item -LiteralPath '<原生路径>'，传的是原样路径而非 URL。这进一步印证问题出在 URL 形式而非权限或路径本身。

修复建议

  1. Windows 分支直接使用原生路径，避免 file:// URL：

    js
    await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", windowsPath], signal);

    （实测该形式对中文路径工作正常；相应地 L228 的 replaceAll(",", "%2C") 逗号转义逻辑也可以一并简化——原生路径形式下 /select,<路径> 的逗号歧义本来就靠引号处理。）

  2. 不要让 UI 无条件报告成功。若保留"退出码 1 视为交接完成"的取舍，建议至少在返回结构或客户端文案上区分"已交给系统、无法确认是否选中"与"确认已打开"，否则任何静默失败都会以成功面貌出现。

  3. 若出于其他平台一致性考虑必须保留 URL 形式，则需要针对非 ASCII 路径做退化：encodeURI 之外再考虑以原生路径作为含非 ASCII 时的回退。

影响面与变通

  • 影响：所有非 ASCII 文件名的 reveal 操作（中文/日文/韩文/含 emoji 等）。中文用户几乎必然命中，且因为静默，用户很难判断是功能坏了还是自己点错了。
  • 数据安全：无数据损坏风险，仅功能不可用。
  • 临时变通：
    1. 文件名改为纯 ASCII，按钮即恢复；
    2. 改用卡片上的「在应用中打开」；
    3. 绕开 UI：Win+R 打开目录，或终端执行 explorer /select,"<原生路径>"。

English summary
