discussions.title: [Bug] `workflow` fails on every call on Windows: PTC control channel is not inherited (reported as worker-exit 0)
discussions.body:
## Summary

`workflow` is unusable on Windows in the packaged Desktop app. **Every** workflow invocation fails — including a control run that passes no `provider`/`model` overrides — with a worker-exit error reported as exit code 0. The real failure is swallowed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | High — a shipped, enabled-by-default tool does not work at all |
| Affected | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` |
| Packages | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| App | DSH Desktop `2.0.11-beta.1` |
| Host | Windows, Electron host, bundled Node `v24.13.0` |

## Symptom

```
workflow run failed: workflow execution failed (worker-exit): Node process exited before completing (0)
```

Reproduced with a minimal script **and** with a no-override control probe (no `provider`/`model`, no `schema`), so it is unrelated to any provider configuration:

```js
// control probe — no overrides at all
const out = await agent("Reply with exactly the word pong. Do not use tools.");
return { out };
```

## Evidence

| # | Finding | Location |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `tool-workflow` + `workflow-ptc` are mounted **enabled by default** (not an opt-in experiment) | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` (`ptc-runtime`, `workflow-ptc`, `tool-workflow`) |
| 2 | The runtime advertises process isolation: `isolation = "process"`, "Each call runs in a fresh Node process" | `dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/index.js` |
| 3 | The PTC runtime requests the control channel: `stdio: { stdin: "ignore", stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe", control: "pipe" }` | `dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/index.js` |
| 4 | Provider stamps the marker: `SUBPROCESS_CONTROL_ENV = "DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL"`; `controlEnvironment()` sets it to `"pipe"` when `control === "pipe"` | `dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner-launch-*.js` |
| 5 | Control is deliberately wired for Windows: `runnerStdio()` appends `"overlapped"` (overlapped named pipe) for the control stream, with a dedicated `launchWindowsJob` path | `dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner-launch-*.js`, `lib/index.js` |
| 6 | The child **requires** the marker and fd 7 | `dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/process.js` |
| 7 | The host reports failure via a generic branch that formats the exit code and then appends `stderr` — yet the report shows `(0)` and empty stderr | `dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/index.js` (`processFinished`) |

Child-side contract (`dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/process.js`):

```js
const SUBPROCESS_CONTROL_ENV = "DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL";

function openInheritedControlChannel() {
  const marker = process.env[SUBPROCESS_CONTROL_ENV];
  Reflect.deleteProperty(process.env, SUBPROCESS_CONTROL_ENV);
  if (marker !== "pipe") throw new Error("subprocess control channel was not inherited");
  return new Socket({ fd: 7, readable: true, writable: true, allowHalfOpen: true });
}
```

## Minimal reproduction

**A — product level** (any workflow call):

```
Invoke the workflow tool with: return { control: await agent("reply pong") };
Result: workflow execution failed (worker-exit): Node process exited before completing (0)
```

**B — transport level** (exposes the swallowed error). Run the PTC worker entry directly with the same argument the host passes:

```powershell
node "<DSH install>\resources\app\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-ptc-runtime-node\lib\process.js" 134217728
```

Observed:

```
Error: subprocess control channel was not inherited
    at openInheritedControlChannel (.../dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/process.js:16:31)
Node.js v24.13.0
# exit code 1
```

Note the contradiction: the child exits **1** with a precise error, while the host reports **`(0)`** with empty stderr. The marker check throwing means `DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL` did not reach the child (and/or fd 7 is not an inherited pipe).

**C — environment probe**: `DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL` is `undefined` in spawned children, whereas `controlEnvironment()` should set it to `"pipe"` for a `control: "pipe"` spawn.

## Root cause (as far as I could verify)

The control channel transport is not delivered to the PTC worker on this host. The runtime's design intent (Windows-specific `"overlapped"` pipe + dedicated `launchWindowsJob`) shows this is meant to work on Windows, so this is a defect rather than an unsupported configuration.

**What I could not determine, and will not guess:** the exact stage that drops the pipe. Plausible candidates, in order of suspicion:

1. The Electron-as-Node runner path — `runnerEnvironment()` injects `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` when `selection === WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION && process.platform === "win32" && process.versions.electron !== undefined`, and the runner must forward fd 7 plus the target env to the target.
2. The packaged single-binary path — `spawnRunnerInvocation()` returns `[process.execPath]` when `"pkg" in process`, i.e. the runner is expected to be a subcommand of the app binary and must still carry the control pipe.
3. Handle inheritance for nested named pipes being blocked by host security software.

Also worth noting: this is **not** explained by the file sandbox. `sandbox.confine()` is only invoked when `policy.mode !== "danger-full-access"`, and only the *host's* policy mode changes — the fd 7 marker is missing regardless.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Primary**: ensure the Windows Job runner inherits and forwards the control pipe (fd 7) to the target, and that `DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL=pipe` reaches the target environment on that path. Pay attention to the nested case (host → runner → target), where both the descriptor and the marker must survive one extra hop.
2. **Defensive**: fail loudly when `control: "pipe"` is requested but cannot be satisfied by the selected provider/path, instead of starting a child that will die at `openInheritedControlChannel`.
3. **Diagnostics (independent of the above)**: the `worker-exit` branch should surface the child's real exit code and captured stderr. Reporting "(0)" for a child that exited 1 with a clear error made this bug take far longer to localize than it should have. (See the companion report about the same branch.)

## Workaround

Use the `subagent` tool instead of `workflow`. In the default composition `subagent` goes through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process` (`providerName: spawn`), i.e. in-process, so it does not depend on the PTC worker. This is not equivalent for every workflow use case (no script-level orchestration, no `pipeline`/`parallel` helpers), but it covers most delegations.

## Environment detail

- Confirmed with the shipped Desktop build; the same control-pipe mechanism is what `workflow`, and any other `control: "pipe"` consumer, depends on.
- If a maintainer wants a targeted diagnosis, running the same workflow under a non-Electron host (CLI / `dsh web`) versus the Desktop app would isolate whether the regression lives in the packaged/Electron runner path.

discussions.title: [Bug] Node PTC runtime reports `worker-exit (0)` and discards the child's stderr, hiding the real failure
discussions.body:
## Summary

Every `worker-exit` failure path in the Node PTC runtime reports **the exit code and nothing else**. The child's captured `stderr` — which the runtime already collects, and which in the case below contains a precise exception with a stack trace — is discarded. This is a diagnostics defect that is independent of the underlying failure it reports; it made a real bug take far longer to localize than it should have.

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | Medium — silent, misleading failure reporting across all out-of-process executions |
| Affected | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node` |
| Package | `0.1.6-alpha.1` |
| App | DSH Desktop `2.0.11-beta.1` |

## Symptom

A failing workflow reports:

```
workflow execution failed (worker-exit): Node process exited before completing (0)
```

Two things are wrong with this message:

1. **`(0)` is reported for a child that actually exited `1`.** Exit code 0 conventionally means success, so the message contradicts itself: it announces failure while quoting a success code.
2. **No stderr.** Running the very same child entry directly yields a precise, actionable error — and the host prints none of it.

## Evidence

`dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/index.js`, `processFinished` (lines 1028–1037):

```js
const processFinished = (outcome) => {
  if (settled) return;
  finish(confined !== void 0 && classifyRunnerFailure(outcome.exitCode, stderr, confined.runnerFailureRules) !== void 0 ? {
    kind: "sandbox-unavailable",
    message: stderr
  } : {
    kind: "worker-exit",
    message: `Node process exited before completing (${String(outcome.exitCode)})${stderr ? `: ${stderr}` : ""}`
  });
};
```

The handler is *written* to append `stderr` when non-empty, and the runtime does collect it (`stderr = (stderr + text).slice(-this.config.maxOutputBytes)` on the child's `stderr` `data` event). Yet in practice it is empty at this point — so the diagnostic that was designed in never reaches the user.

There are **eight** `worker-exit` construction sites in this file (lines 898, 903, 999, 1014, 1034, 1147, 1152, 1164, 1170). Only this one formats `stderr`; the rest pass through `messageOf(error)` or omit context entirely. So stderr visibility depends on which failure branch happens to fire.

## Minimal reproduction

Run the child entry with the same argument the host passes:

```powershell
node "<DSH install>\resources\app\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-ptc-runtime-node\lib\process.js" 134217728
```

Observed:

```
Error: subprocess control channel was not inherited
    at openInheritedControlChannel (.../dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/process.js:16:31)
    at .../dsh-ptc-runtime-node/lib/process.js:1134:13
Node.js v24.13.0
# exit code 1
```

So the child exits **1** with a full stack, while the host surfaces `(0)` and no stderr. Whatever mechanism loses the exit code, the stderr half of this is plainly a bug: the text existed and was dropped.

## Why it matters beyond this one case

`worker-exit` is the generic "the child died" branch. Any failure inside a PTC execution — a thrown import error, a missing module, a syntax error in the user's script, an OOM kill, a crash in the bootstrap — lands here. With stderr discarded, every one of those presents as an opaque `(0)`, and the only way forward is to reproduce the child manually, as above. That is exactly the kind of "silent failure" this project otherwise appears to work hard to avoid.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Always include `stderr` (tail-bounded) in every `worker-exit` message**, not just the one branch that currently does. If stderr was empty, say so explicitly (`stderr: <empty>`) rather than omitting the field — that distinction is itself diagnostic.
2. **Report `outcome.exitCode` truthfully**, and include `outcome.signal` when present (`null` exit code + signal is a different failure mode than a non-zero exit code). If the code genuinely is `0` while the handshake never completed, that is worth surfacing as such rather than formatting it identically to a crash: e.g. `worker exited 0 without completing the control handshake`.
3. **Include which branch fired.** The eight sites have materially different meanings (spawn failure, cleanup failure, stream error, handshake never completed). A stable machine-readable `reason` (plus the branch's own message) would let callers and users tell them apart.
4. **Surface child stderr live** on the execution's log stream so a caller watching a long-running execution sees the failure as it happens, rather than only at settlement.

## Related

This was found while diagnosing a separate, reproducible failure where the control channel is not inherited on Windows, so the worker dies during bootstrap — reported separately. That report depends on this one to be diagnosable at all: the underlying error is currently invisible from the product surface.

discussions.title: Support runtime agent-loop engine switching: the AgentRegistry factory slot is single-shot and claimed at boot
discussions.body:
## Summary

I maintain [`dsh-loop-engine`](https://github.com/kuun993/dsh-loop-engine) ([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-loop-engine)), a third-party out-of-tree plugin (unscoped — not a `@deepseek-ai` package). It adds a Settings-page picker for the agent loop engine: the built-in `in-process` loop, plus hosted `claude-code`, `codex`, `pi`, and `kimi` engines. It ships today, but only through a fragile workaround, because `AgentRegistry` admits exactly one `AgentFactory` and the built-in `AgentLoop` claims that slot from its composition row for the lifetime of the process.

This is a request from a plugin author, not a bug report: **would upstream be willing to make loop-engine selection a first-class, runtime-swappable seam?** If the answer is no, a clear no is genuinely useful — I'd rather build against the real contract than keep a race window.

## The constraint, as the code states it

- `AgentRegistry.setFactory` is a single slot — `packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:355-371`, throwing a **bare** `Error('an agent factory is already registered')` at `:357`. The disposer clears the slot, so the slot is free by construction to exactly one live owner.
- `AgentLoop` claims it from its own constructor — `packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts:420`:

  ```ts
  ctx.effect(() => ctx.agents.setFactory(this), 'agentLoop.setFactory()')
  ```

  There is no suspend or replace path; the only way to release the slot is to unload the fiber.
- That fiber comes from boot composition — `packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:472-473`.
- Swapability is nonetheless an explicit design intent: the `AgentFactory` interface (`packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:171-203`) is deliberately driver-agnostic, and `packages/core/agent/README.md:81` says consumers depend on `dsh-agent` and never on `dsh-agent-loop`, "keeping the driver swappable". The gap is that this is *boot-time* swapability, not runtime swapability.

## What an out-of-tree plugin has to do instead

Outside the repo the only lever is the user patch layer, which the HMR watcher does re-apply live (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts:250-282`). So the plugin does all of the following:

1. Rewrite a managed block in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` — synchronously and atomically — disabling the base `agent-loop` row so the slot opens, plus `command-goal`, since a hosted engine owns the session's command surface.
2. Mount its own factory as a plugin fiber, so a factory is present the moment the loader pass frees the slot.
3. Race the two. `entry.update()` is async while the factory registration is synchronous, so there is a real window in which the base loop still holds the slot. The plugin retries the collision 40 × 50 ms and then gives up with "restart `dsh web`".
4. Identify the collision by **message text**, because the thrown error carries no code. For a hosted → hosted switch (A → B) there is no structural signal at all: `ctx.get('agentLoop')` is already gone and the outgoing engine's fiber is what holds the slot. Rewording that error silently degrades A → B from "retry" to "fail loud and restart".
5. Author a stripped copy of the `standard` agent preset and steer the `agent-presets` roster default at it, so new sessions do not see dsh-native commands an external engine cannot honor — then restore the previous default on the way back.
6. Register a model-less placeholder adapter for the engine's provider label, because the web host refuses a turn whose session names a provider no adapter serves. Without it, the *second* prompt of every hosted session fails with `model-unavailable`.

The user-visible cost: switching `in-process` → hosted hangs on a 2-second window, switching back relies on the same patch-layer HMR pass landing (a restart is the instructed fallback), and one switch direction has no structural error signal to key on at all.

## What I'd like to ask

Is upstream willing to support loop-engine selection as a runtime seam? Roughly in order of how much they would change:

**Option A — per-session engine routing.** Make `AgentFactory` selection per create/resume rather than per process, resolved from something already durable (the session header, or a settings section). Then two engines coexist, there is no contention for a single slot, and a user can run two engines side by side on two sessions. This would also remove most of the preset and command-surface takeover above, because a session knows which engine owns it.

**Option B — replaceable factory registration.** `setFactory` grows explicit replacement semantics, or hands the registering fiber a capability another provider can take over. The base `AgentLoop` keeps its row and its default ownership, but a plugin can atomically take the slot and hand it back without a loader pass.

**Option C — the minimum that removes the fragility.** Give the collision a coded error instead of a bare `Error`, and/or expose a supported runtime path to load and unload the base row. That alone kills the message-text matching and makes both switch directions deterministic. Still an out-of-tree workaround, but a reliable one.

If Option A conflicts with an ownership invariant I am not seeing — the factory provider being the structural co-owner that stops and drains every live handle it made (`packages/core/agent/README.md:115`) — I'd appreciate knowing that; it is exactly the sort of contract I would rather design around than guess at.

Reproducing on harness `0.1.5-rc.1` with `dsh-loop-engine@0.1.5-rc2`. Happy to open a PR in whichever direction you'd prefer; this is only a question about whether the seam is wanted.

discussions.title: Windows 上「在文件资源管理器中显示」永远选不中文件：explorer.exe /select, 传参少了引号
discussions.body:
## 现象

Windows 上，"在文件资源管理器中显示"（`deliverables` 卡片菜单 → *在文件资源管理器中显示*，以及 `SessionController.openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })`）**会报成功，但实际不选中文件**：资源管理器要么弹到"桌面/文档"，要么干脆不弹窗；目标文件永远不会被选中。

## 环境

- DSH `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1`（commit `0a15e36e7f`）；`master` 上仍可复现（2026-09-20 核对）
- 主机：Windows 10 Pro 19045，Node 24.16.0；host 进程在交互式会话（session 1），介质完整性（非管理员）
- 与桌面/窗口环境无关：复现时已有 3 个资源管理器窗口打开

## 复现

1. 让会话 `present` 一个文件，或走 `openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })`；
2. 点卡片菜单里的「在文件资源管理器中显示」；
3. 结果：没有窗口定位到该文件；或弹到"桌面/文档"。

**期望**：打开文件所在目录并选中该文件。

## 实测矩阵

判定方式：用 `Shell.Application` COM 读 `Windows().LocationURL` + `Document.FocusedItem.Path`；每个变体都用一个**全新创建的目录**，避免把已有窗口误判成结果。

| 调用形式 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `cmd /c explorer.exe /select,"C:\path\file.md"`（引号真的进了命令行） | ✅ 打开目录并**选中文件** |
| PowerShell `& explorer.exe /select,"C:\path\file.md"`（PowerShell 会把引号去掉） | ❌ 退回"文档" |
| `spawn('explorer.exe', ['/select,', 'file:///…'])` —— **当前实现** | ❌ 退回"桌面/文档"，或完全不弹窗 |
| node 侧各种试图自己加引号的 argv 变形 | ❌（Node 会把内层引号转义成 `\"`，Explorer 解析不了） |
| `Shell.Application` COM：`$sh.Explore($dir)` + `$w.Document.SelectItem($item, 1)` | ✅ 打开目录并**选中文件** |

中文路径、空格、路径长度都不是变量 —— 用一个全新的纯 ASCII 目录同样复现。

## 根因

`packages/util/native-command/src/path-opener.ts`（master 第 239–255 行）：

```ts
if (manager === 'explorer') {
  // Explorer parses commas itself; a file URI preserves commas and whitespace in the path.
  const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(',', '%2C')
  try {
    await run('explorer.exe', ['/select,', target], signal)   // ← 第 250 行
  } catch (error) {
    ...
    // Explorer can exit 1 after delegating to the existing desktop process.
    if (!(error instanceof Error) || !('code' in error) || error.code !== 1) throw error
  }
}
```

`/select,` 要求路径在**原始命令行里带字面双引号**。而 `['/select,', target]` 两个 argv 拼出来是 `explorer.exe /select, file:///…` —— 没有引号，Explorer 解析失败就打开兜底位置。更麻烦的是：失败时 `explorer.exe` 退出码仍是 0（有时 1），而这段代码**明确把退出码 1 当作"已成功交接"**，于是调用方看到成功、UI 显示"已请求"，实际什么都没选中 —— **静默失败**。

**为什么单测没抓到**：`tests/path-opener.spec.ts:334` 与 `:414` 断言的是 mock runner 被如何调用，也就是"我们想调什么"，而不是"Explorer 能不能解析"。任何 argv 形状的断言都会通过，行为却一直是坏的。

## 建议的修法

推荐用**不需要命令行解析**的 COM 路径（也不再有逗号要转义成 `%2C` 的顾虑），与同文件里 `openWindowsPath()` 已经用 `powershell.exe` 的做法一致：

```powershell
$sh = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
$sh.Explore('<dir>')
foreach ($w in $sh.Windows()) {
  if ($w.LocationURL -eq '<dir file url>') {
    $w.Document.SelectItem($sh.Namespace('<dir>').ParseName('<name>'), 1)
  }
}
```

（在上述机器上实测：目录被打开，`Document.FocusedItem.Path` 等于目标文件。）

次要建议：不要仅凭 `explorer.exe` 退出码 1 就认为 reveal 成功；并补一个"路径没带引号/没被选中就会失败"的测试。

## 临时绕过

```cmd
cmd /c explorer.exe /select,"C:\完整\路径\文件.ext"
```

（引号必需；PowerShell 里写 `& explorer.exe /select,...` 等于没带引号。）

discussions.title: 大会话分叉后所有请求永久 413：dsh_session_log 重传整份继承日志，撞上游约 50 MB 请求体上限
discussions.body:
## 摘要

对一个**规范日志较大**的会话执行"分叉（fork / seeded session）"后，新会话里**任何**请求都会失败，包括 `/compact`：

```
DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)   code=INVALID_REQUEST   status=413
```

而且**不会自愈**：不是偶发，而是每次请求都必然失败。

根因：默认开启的 `session-log-deepseek` 会随每个官方 API 请求上传"上次被服务端接收之后的规范会话日志"。分叉会话的"已接收水位"永远是 `-1`（下面有测量方法），于是**第一个请求就把继承来的整份日志塞进请求体**（实测 48.8 MiB），超过上游网关约 50 MB 的 body 上限被拒；又因为 413 归类为不可重试、且非 2xx 不写接收水位，水位永远不推进 ⇒ 每个后续请求重传同一份 48.8 MiB ⇒ 永久死锁。

## 环境

- DSH `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1`（commit `0a15e36e7f`）；`master` 上相关代码仍在（2026-09-20 核对）
- 主机：Windows 10 Pro 19045 / Node 24.16.0（**该问题与操作系统无关**，取决于会话日志大小与上游 body 上限）
- 模型/协议：`deepseek-official` / `deepseek-flash`，Anthropic Messages 兼容端点 `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages`
- 会话关系：fork 由会话分叉创建（`isSeeded: true`，`parentSession` 指向父会话），父子都在本机

## 复现

1. 让一个会话不断工作，直到其规范日志累计到 ~49 MiB（长期会话很容易达到；本次是 15,121 条事件）；
2. 从它分叉出一个新会话；
3. 在新会话里发任意一条消息 → 413；再执行 `/compact` → 同样 413。

**期望**：分叉会话可以正常工作（哪怕退化成"这一轮不带日志字段"或"分片上传"）。
**实际**：永久失败，而且错误信息完全看不出原因。

## 关键证据

### 1) 分叉会话的已接收水位恒为 `-1`

水位由 `acceptedThrough(session)` 折叠日志中的 `session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted` 事件得到，且要求 `data.sessionId === session.id`（`packages/session/session-log-deepseek/src/index.ts:146`）。

测量方式（注意 `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` 是**多帧** zstd，逐帧解压才能拿到完整 JSONL）：

- 该 fork 日志里共有 1,706 条 `delivery-accepted`，**全部**写的是父/祖父会话 id，写它自己的一条都没有 ⇒ 水位 = `-1`。
- 对照：同一时刻**父会话**的水位是 15,368，因此每个请求只带 4 条事件 ≈ **18 KB**，请求 200 OK —— 父会话此时上下文已达 ~755k tokens 仍完全正常 ⇒ **与上下文长度、模型、图片都无关**。

### 2) 首个请求的载荷 ≈ 48.8 MiB

按 wire 结构累加分叉会话全部 15,121 条事件 ≈ **48.8 MiB**，再加约 3 MB 模型输入 ≈ **52 MB**。

### 3) 上游 body 上限约 50 MB（十进制）/ ≈47.7 MiB

直接对同一端点做体量探针（无模型输入，仅 body 大小）：

| 请求体 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 45 MiB | 200 |
| 48 MiB | **413** `Failed to buffer the request body: length limit exceeded`（`text/plain`） |
| 51 MiB | **413** `Request Entity Too Large`（openresty，`text/html`） |

再用该 fork 的真实日志内容作为 `dsh_session_log` 字段复现：字段 40 MiB（体 44.2 MiB）→ 200；字段 47 MiB（体 51.8 MiB）→ 413。

### 4) 失败闭环

- `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/transport.ts:33`：HTTP 413 ⇒ 归类 `INVALID_REQUEST`，**不可重试**。
- 插件 README 的 Acceptance and retry 一节明确：非 2xx **不追加** `delivery-accepted` ⇒ 水位保持 `-1`。
- `/compact` 也是带 live sessionId 的请求 ⇒ 携带同一个超大字段 ⇒ 同样 413（日志中两次 compact 尝试均以同样错误结束）。

## 根因

`session-log-deepseek` 的 `prepare()` 每次都把 `afterSeq + 1 .. throughSeq` 的**完整**后缀塞进 `dsh_session_log`，**没有任何字节上限**。README 的 Known Limitations 自己也写了：

> **No independent request-size cap** — complete delivery is fail-closed; provider rejection leaves the cursor unchanged instead of truncating the log.

叠加 fork 语义（README:37："Forked sessions ignore inherited parent watermarks"）后，结果就是：**日志大的会话一旦分叉，新会话一出生就不可用**，且没有任何用户侧恢复手段（连压缩都失败）。

另外，错误面也不友好：网关的 413 响应不是 JSON，`providerError()` 只能回落到 `DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)`，用户完全看不出是"日志字段太大"。

我们认为这不是使用姿势问题：该组合结果**本可以优雅降级**，却没有降级。

## 建议修法（低风险、不丢数据）

1. **按字节截窗（推荐）**：字段语义本身就允许只发连续前缀（`afterSeq + 1 .. throughSeq`）。给字段设一个安全上限（例如 32 MiB，远低于 ~47.7 MiB 的网关上限），`throughSeq` 取实际包含的最后一条事件。水位会随着每次成功请求逐步推进：既不丢数据，也不会死锁。
2. **或/并且：seeded session 的继承前缀视为已投递**。若父会话对 `seedLength` 之前的事件已有可核验的接收记录，则从 `seedLength - 1` 起算，避免把几十 MB 重复上传一遍。
3. **错误可读性**：当 provider 因 body 过大而拒绝时，给出明确诊断（例如提示 "session log suffix too large: X MiB"），并考虑让该情况可降级（跳过字段并继续本轮请求），而不是归类为终态 `INVALID_REQUEST`。
4. **补测试**：构造"后缀远超上限"的会话，断言请求体会被截断或跳过，而不是原样发出。

## 临时绕过

- 在 profile 覆盖层里关掉该贡献（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: session-log-deepseek
  config:
    enabled: false
```

  然后重启 dsh ⇒ 请求体回到约 3 MB，分叉会话立刻可用。代价是**全局**不再上传会话日志。
- 或者：不要分叉日志很大的会话（继续用原会话不受影响）。

discussions.title: [Bug] agentOptions() drops reasoningEffort — the web Session Agent route snapshot never carries the effort
discussions.body:
Filed here because the repository issue tracker is disabled.

## TL;DR (中文)

- master 的 `packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts:497-500` 里，`agentOptions()` 用 `const { provider, model } = this.ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` 解构，**把 `reasoningEffort` 丢掉了**。而 `AgentOptions` 本身声明了这个字段（`packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts:32`），`currentSelection()` 也会返回它，`agent-loop` 又用 `this.options.reasoningEffort ?? persistedReasoningEffort` 消费它——读得到、类型支持、有人消费，但在这里被扔掉。
- 同形的解构还有一处：`packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts:257` / `:270`（session fork 时给子会话的 `agentOptions: { provider, model }`）。
- 后果：Web 会话里 `Agent.options.reasoningEffort` 恒为 undefined。常见路径被 Session 的 model-selection 兜住了（所以不容易被发现），但**任何直接消费 Agent options 的路径**（首请求之前就委派的父会话、fork/子会话的路由快照、读取路由的插件或面板）都拿不到 route 上的 effort。
- 顺带一个可复现的旁支（我们实际踩到的症状）：在 composer 里切到「模型目录没有声明 defaultEffort」的模型时，UI 写入的 `model/selection` 不带 effort；按 selection 契约，不带 effort 就等价于**清空** effort。如果网关只在显式 `reasoning_effort` 下才吐思考，思考就会静默消失（#763 家族）。

**Below is the English version.**

## 1. Code (CONFIRMED — master @ 2026-09-20, and 0.1.6-alpha.2 in the published bundle)

```ts
// packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts:497-500
private agentOptions(): AgentOptions {
  const { provider, model } = this.ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()
  return { provider, model }
}
```

- `packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts:26-35` — `AgentOptions` explicitly declares `reasoningEffort?: ReasoningEffortId` (line 32) with the doc "Adapter-owned reasoning effort for the selected provider/model route."
- `packages/core/agent-default-model/src/index.ts:30,37,53-55` — the settings schema contains `reasoningEffort`, and `selection()` returns `{ provider, model, ...(reasoningEffort === undefined ? {} : { reasoningEffort }) }`; `currentSelection()` (line 90) returns that object. So the value is *available* at the destructuring site, and it is deliberately kept when the same selection is rebuilt from a logged header (agent.ts:316-325).
- `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:519` — `const reasoningEffort = this.options.reasoningEffort ?? persistedReasoningEffort`, seeded into the first `request/header` (line 527).
- `packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:69-84` — `parentAgentOptionsForDelegation` treats effort as part of the inheritable route: it takes `requestConfig.reasoningEffort` from the parent's logged header and only falls back to `{ ...parent.options }` *"before the first request"* — i.e. exactly the snapshot that `agentOptions()` produced without an effort.
- `packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts:257,270` — the fork path repeats it: `const { provider, model } = this.ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` … `agentOptions: { provider, model }`.

The published bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2`) matches: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` `agentOptions()` returns `{ provider, model }`; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js` consumes `this.options.reasoningEffort ?? persistedReasoningEffort`. So this is not a build artifact.

## 2. Why it is mostly invisible, and when it is not

In the web profile the Session installs its own model selection (`installSelection` → `installModelSelection`), whose `current` getter falls back to `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` (agent.ts:296-325) when nothing was picked and no header exists yet. So a `agent-default-model.reasoningEffort` still reaches the first request *through that path*, which is why the drop is easy to miss.

What the drop still costs:

1. The Agent's own route snapshot is incomplete, so every consumer of `Agent.options` (delegation from a parent that has not issued a request yet, fork/child creation snapshots, roster/plugins that render the effective route) loses the effort — the same class of gap tracked in #3008 / #4666 / #4850 / #7054, now on the *setter* side.
2. It removes the last non-selection fallback: whenever the session-level selection is absent, stale, or effort-less, there is nothing else that can restore the configured effort.

## 3. The user-visible symptom we started from (effort silently cleared by a model switch)

Deployment: Windows 11, `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2`, `--profile web`, custom OpenAI-compatible gateway reached through a local OpenAI-compatible proxy; the gateway only emits reasoning when `reasoning_effort` is present in the request.

From the persisted session event logs (`~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`, `request/header` + `model/selection` events):

| session (prefix) | persisted model/selection | request/header outcome |
|---|---|---|
| `7fbe4b76` (09-15) | none; `agent-default-model.reasoningEffort: high` | 16 headers, all `eff=high` — the default *does* reach the request via the installed selection |
| `d56bd86d` (09-20) | last write `{"provider":"wb","model":"cbcn/deepseek-v4.1-flash"}` (no effort) | 6 headers, all without `reasoningEffort` → 235 assistant messages, **0 reasoning blocks** |
| `3fae58f3` (09-20, after selecting Max in the composer) | `{"provider":"wb","model":"cbcn/deepseek-v4.1-flash","reasoningEffort":"max"}` | headers `eff=max` → reasoning blocks on every assistant message again |

The clearing happens in the selection contract itself and follows from the code comment at agent.ts:319-324 ("An effort the adapter defaulted is not a conversation choice") plus `model-selection.ts:97-104` (an absent selected effort clears any inherited effort). The UI side writes `reasoningEffort: selection.current?.reasoningEffort ?? model.reasoning?.defaultEffort` (`dsh-client-ui-model-selection/lib/client.js:1000-1004`), so switching to a model whose catalog entry declares no `defaultEffort` sends `{ provider, model }` and that is treated as "clear the effort". Whether that is intended is arguable; what is not arguable is that the request then carries no `reasoning_effort` and the configured/previous effort is gone with no recovery path.

Local mitigation (works because `dsh-llm-pi-ai` resolves `options.reasoningEffort ?? profile.reasoning`): a provider-level `reasoning: high` in the llm-pi-ai profile. That is exactly why #6640 / #1643 / #4627 keep coming up.

## 4. Question + proposed fix

Is dropping the effort in `agentOptions()` intentional? If effort is part of the route (as `child-agent.ts` treats it, and as `AgentOptions`'s own doc says), the snapshot should carry it:

```ts
// agent.ts
private agentOptions(): AgentOptions {
  const { provider, model, reasoningEffort } = this.ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()
  return { provider, model, ...(reasoningEffort === undefined ? {} : { reasoningEffort }) }
}
// or simply: return { ...this.ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection() }
```

Same one-liner in `commands.ts:257/270` (fork). Note the precedence consequence already raised in the #4666 review: an explicitly set `options.reasoningEffort` wins over `adapterDefaults.reasoningEffort === true` in `agent-loop` — worth one sentence in the JSDoc or a test if that is the intended order.

Related threads: #3008 (allow AgentOptions to set effort — the field exists now, the web controller still never sets it), #4666 / #4850 / #4555 (subagent drops), #763 (model switch loses reasoning permanently), #7054 (stale creation-time snapshot read by the roster), #4627 / #6640 / #1643 / #5656 (gateway/per-model effort configuration).

Environment: `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2` (npm, `--profile web`, Windows 11), preset `trisoul-x`, custom OpenAI-compatible provider `wb` via a local proxy. Session logs quoted above are from `~/.dsh/sessions/<cwd>/session-<id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd`.

discussions.title: DSH｜Bilibili Video Research｜Research Bilibili videos with an Agent
discussions.body:
## Bilibili Video Research

> Unofficial community project.

[Bilibili Video Research](https://github.com/7oMB2006/Bilibili-Video-Research) is a standard MCP server for researching public Bilibili videos with language, vision, multimodal, metadata, and optional community-comment evidence.

It can be used with DSH through the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` bridge. This is not a native DSH plugin and does not require a DSH-specific wrapper or fork: DSH discovers the MCP tools and exposes them under names such as `mcp__bilibili_video_research__analyze_bilibili_video`.

### Verified integration

- DSH headless profile with `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash`
- BVR connected through stdio using the official DSH MCP client
- BVR provider: StepFun Step Plan with `step-3.7-flash`
- Successfully exercised multimodal, language/ASR, and vision research modes
- The returned report included Bilibili metadata, sampled comments, visual evidence, and ASR evidence

### Quick setup

The repository contains the full English and Chinese DSH setup guides. The basic shape is:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-bilibili-video-research
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: bilibili_video_research
        transport: stdio
        command: '<PROJECT_DIR>\\node_modules\\.bin\\tsx.cmd'
        args:
          - '<PROJECT_DIR>\\src\\index.ts'
        cwd: '<PROJECT_DIR>'
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 240000
        failOnStartupError: false
```

Keep provider keys in the BVR `.env` file. Full instructions:

- [Bilibili Video Research](https://github.com/7oMB2006/Bilibili-Video-Research)
- [DSH integration guide](https://github.com/7oMB2006/Bilibili-Video-Research#deepseek-harness--dsh)
- [Project demo on Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1dPeP6REwM/)

I would be glad to hear whether this standard-MCP approach is useful for other DSH users, and whether a future native packaging format would make sense.

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 上「在文件资源管理器中显示」对所有路径都不显示窗口：共享 runner 的 windowsHide 把 Explorer 窗口创建成了隐藏窗口
discussions.body:
## Summary

Windows 上，交付卡片菜单的「在文件资源管理器中显示」**不显示任何窗口**——不是"选错了位置"，而是窗口根本不出现。

根因是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 的**共享命令 runner** 给每个子进程都加了 `windowsHide: true`。`explorer.exe` 是这里的**直接子进程**，其 `STARTUPINFO` 携带的 `SW_HIDE` 使 Explorer 用 `SW_SHOWDEFAULT` 创建新窗口时直接保持隐藏：**窗口确实被创建了（`IsWindowVisible` 为 `false`），但永远不会显示出来。**

这是与已有讨论相互独立的第三层缺陷：

- #7227 定位的是「非 ASCII 文件名 + percent-encoded `file://` URL 解析失败」；
- #7246 定位的是「`/select,` 的命令行参数形状 / 缺引号」；
- 本条定位的是**共享 runner 的 `windowsHide`**。它**对纯 ASCII 路径同样成立**，也是"点了完全没反应"最直接的原因。

> 更正一处：#7227 的 UI 复现里写"对纯 ASCII 文件名……资源管理器正常打开并选中该文件"。把**所有**资源管理器窗口都关掉后重测，纯 ASCII 同样不工作（见下方实测矩阵）。推测那次"正常"是因为目标目录已经开着窗口，Explorer 把既有窗口提到了前台。

## Reproduction

### A. 用户可见路径

1. Windows 上以 `dsh web` 启动 Web UI。
2. **先关闭所有资源管理器窗口**（这一步是判定关键）。
3. 让 Agent `present` 任意文件，打开卡片菜单 →「在文件资源管理器中显示」。
4. 观察：没有任何窗口出现；卡片状态仍变为"已请求在文件管理器中显示"。

对照：先打开一个正显示目标目录的资源管理器窗口，再点一次 → 既有窗口被提到前台，看起来"正常"。这解释了为什么该缺陷容易被误判为偶发、或与文件名是否含中文有关。

### B. 最小化复现（不依赖 DSH）

```js
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process'

const args = ['/select,', 'C:\\Windows\\notepad.exe']   // 与产品同形
execFile('explorer.exe', args, { windowsHide: true  }, () => {})  // 窗口被创建，但 IsWindowVisible === false
execFile('explorer.exe', args, { windowsHide: false }, () => {})  // 窗口可见
```

判定方式：`EnumWindows` + `GetClassName() === 'CabinetWClass'` + `IsWindowVisible()`，并枚举**全部**窗口（不要只枚举可见窗口，否则会得出"窗口根本没创建"的错误结论）。每次运行前先关闭所有既有资源管理器窗口，避免把既有窗口误判为新窗口。

## 实测矩阵（调用生产函数本身）

不是手写 explorer 命令行，而是直接 `import` 已安装的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command/lib/index.js` 并调用其导出的 `revealNativePath()`；同一次调用中使用注入的 `run` 作为对照（除 `windowsHide` 外完全相同的 argv）。每次运行前 `EnumWindows` 清零全部资源管理器窗口。

| 目标 | runner | 新建窗口 |
|---|---|---|
| `C:\Windows\notepad.exe`（纯 ASCII） | **生产 runner**（`windowsHide: true`） | 1 个，目录正确，**HIDDEN** |
| `C:\Windows\notepad.exe` | 同一函数 + 不带 `windowsHide` 的 `run` | 1 个，目录正确，**VISIBLE** |
| `<workspace>\中文示例.md` | **生产 runner** | 1 个，目录为「桌面」（错误），**HIDDEN** |
| `<workspace>\中文示例.md` | 同一函数 + 不带 `windowsHide` 的 `run` | 1 个，目录为「桌面」（错误），**VISIBLE** |

结论：

1. 窗口是否可见**只**由 `windowsHide` 决定，与路径是否含非 ASCII 无关；纯 ASCII 同样被隐藏。
2. 非 ASCII 落到「桌面」而非文件所在目录，是另一层缺陷（`file://` URL 形式），与 #7227 描述一致。

## Current behavior

- 不出现任何窗口，不选中文件，不报错。
- `openWorkspacePath()` 仍返回 `{ opened: true }`，客户端显示 `presented.revealed`（"已请求在文件管理器中显示"）。
- 由于窗口确实被创建（只是隐藏），任何仅检查"进程是否启动/退出码"的验证都会误判为成功。

## Expected behavior

- 打开目标文件所在目录并选中该文件。
- `windowsHide` 只应作用于需要静默的控制台子进程（`powershell.exe`、`wslpath`、`defaults` 等），不应作用于**需要弹出窗口的 GUI 打开器**。

## Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows 11（Build 26200，x64） |
| 系统区域 / ANSI 代码页 | zh-CN / 936 |
| Node.js | v24.13.0 |
| DSH 版本 | 0.1.6-alpha.2（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 同为 0.1.6-alpha.2） |
| 安装方式 | 本地目录安装（非 npm 全局安装） |
| `DSH_HOME` | `C:\Users\<user>\.dsh` |
| 启动方式 | `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`，Web UI 位于 `http://127.0.0.1:3080/` |
| 失败时资源管理器窗口数 | 0 |
| 浏览器 | 无关——失败发生在 Host 侧 `spawn explorer.exe` |

## 根因定位

`packages/util/native-command/src/runner.ts`：

```ts
export const runNativeCommand: NativeCommandRunner = (command, args, signal) =>
  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    execFile(
      command,
      [...args],
      { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: true },   // ← 所有原生命令共用
      (error, stdout, stderr) => { /* … */ },
    )
  })
```

Node 的 `windowsHide: true` 在 Windows 上会让 libuv 在 `CreateProcess` 的 `STARTUPINFO` 中设置 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE`（并附加 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`）。GUI 应用创建首个窗口时通常使用 `SW_SHOWDEFAULT`，于是继承了这个隐藏状态——窗口建立、Z 序正常，却从不显示。

调用链：

```
交付卡片菜单 (ui-deliverables/PresentedFileCard.tsx)
  → POST /api/present.open?…&action=reveal
  → sessionController.openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })
  → revealNativePath()  (path-opener.ts)
  → run('explorer.exe', ['/select,', target])  → runNativeCommand({ windowsHide: true })
```

对照：同一张卡片的「用默认应用打开」不受影响。它走 `openWindowsPath()` → `powershell.exe -Command Invoke-Item -LiteralPath '<原生路径>'`，目标 GUI 应用是 ShellExecute 启动的**孙进程**，不继承 `SW_HIDE`。在本机按 hide/show 两种配置实测该路径均能正常弹出应用窗口——这也反证问题出在"explorer.exe 作为直接子进程"这一环。

## 建议修法

1. **让 runner 支持按调用关闭 `windowsHide`**，并在 `revealNativePath` 的 Windows 分支（以及任何直接启动 GUI 打开器的位置）关闭它。不能全局去掉该标志：`powershell.exe` 等控制台子进程正依赖它避免闪黑框。例如给 runner 增加一个可选参数，或为 GUI 打开器单独提供一个不带该标志的 runner。
2. **同时修掉 `path-opener.ts` 里的 `file://` URL**：否则窗口一旦可见，非 ASCII 路径会打开错误的目录（落到「桌面」），而不是选中文件。相关分析见 #7227；`/select,` 的引号/逗号歧义见 #7246。
3. **不要无条件报告成功**。`openWorkspacePath()` 在无法确认是否真的选中时仍返回 `{ opened: true }`，使任何静默失败都以成功面貌呈现。
4. 测试补强：现有 `tests/path-opener.spec.ts` 把 runner mock 掉，只断言 argv 形状（"我们想调什么"），因此既抓不到 `windowsHide` 的行为，也抓不到 Explorer 是否真的解析成功。建议至少补一条真实启动或不带 `windowsHide` 的守卫。

## 影响面

- 只要 Explorer 窗口未创建/未显示，**所有路径**（含纯 ASCII）的「在文件资源管理器中显示」都不产生可见结果；对习惯关闭窗口的用户等于完全不可用。
- 无数据损坏风险，仅功能不可用 + 失败被误报为成功。
- 临时绕过：改用卡片上的「用默认应用打开」；或自行执行 `cmd /c explorer.exe /select,"<原生路径>"`（引号必需）。

## English summary

**Title:** "Reveal in file manager" shows no window at all on Windows — the shared native runner's `windowsHide: true` creates Explorer's window hidden

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`'s `runner.ts` passes `windowsHide: true` to `execFile` for every native command. `explorer.exe` is a *direct* child here, so libuv sets `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE` in its `STARTUPINFO`; Explorer creates the new window with `SW_SHOWDEFAULT` and therefore never shows it. The window **is** created — `EnumWindows` finds a `CabinetWClass` window whose `IsWindowVisible` is `false`.

This is independent of #7227 (non-ASCII `file://` URL resolution) and #7246 (argv/quoting shape), and it holds for **pure ASCII paths too**: closing every Explorer window and invoking the production `revealNativePath()` directly yields a hidden window for `C:\Windows\notepad.exe`, while the same call with `windowsHide` omitted yields a visible one. #7227's observation that ASCII "works" is likely explained by an already-open Explorer window being raised instead.

Suggested fix: exclude GUI openers from `windowsHide` (keep it for console children), and separately stop handing Explorer a percent-encoded `file://` URI. Also stop reporting unconditional success when the handoff cannot be confirmed.

discussions.title: [BUG]WSL下VS Code/Cursor图标显示异常
discussions.body:
# Bug 报告：Linux 上 `GET /open-in-app/icon/<id>` 对已安装编辑器返回 404（vscode、cursor）

## 摘要

在 Linux（WSL2）上，Web 会话头部的 "Open In..." 分体按钮里，**vscode** 与 **cursor** 显示为通用占位方块而非应用真实图标。两个应用**都已被正常探测到、也能正常启动**——坏的只有图标。图标路由返回 `404`，响应体为 `{"code":"not-found","message":"no icon for <id>"}`。

目录路由本身是正常的：

```
GET /open-in-app/apps        -> 200 {"apps":["cursor","vscode"]}
GET /open-in-app/icon/vscode -> 404 {"code":"not-found","message":"no icon for vscode"}
GET /open-in-app/icon/cursor -> 404 {"code":"not-found","message":"no icon for cursor"}
```

期望：`200` 并返回应用真实图标（PNG 或 SVG），与包 README 的描述一致（"图标路由在每个可提取的平台上提供应用真实图标……Linux 上为 desktop 条目在 hicolor 主题中的图标（PNG 或 SVG）"）。

浏览器控制台：

```
:3080/open-in-app/icon/vscode:1  Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
:3080/open-in-app/icon/cursor:1  Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
```

## 环境

| | |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.6-alpha.2`（commit `4eec5ceb01`） |
| 操作系统 | Linux（WSL2，内核 `5.15.167.4-microsoft-standard-WSL2`），以源码检出方式运行 |
| 上报平台 | `linux`——因此走 Linux 图标策略；应用运行在 WSL 内，而非 Windows 宿主 |
| 浏览器 | Edge / Chromium 内核 |
| 相关环境变量 | `DISPLAY=:0`、`WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0`（WSLg 存在）、`XDG_DATA_DIRS=/usr/local/share:/usr/share:/var/lib/snapd/desktop`、`XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP` 未设置 |
| 图标主题包 | **一个都没装**——本机 `/usr/share/icons/hicolor/*/apps/` 为空 |

## 复现步骤

1. 在 Linux 侧以一种**不安装图标主题包**的方式安装 VS Code——例如解包的／便携式目录树，其启动器是 `bin/code` 垫片（Windows 版下载包的布局），使该条目经 `cli` locator 解析并出现在菜单中。确认本机不存在可用的 `code.desktop` 的 `Icon=` 目标，也不存在 `hicolor/…/apps/code.png`。
2. 打开 Web 界面，展开 "Open In..." 菜单。
3. 观察：条目已在列表中且可以启动，但显示通用占位图形；DevTools 中 `/open-in-app/icon/vscode` 返回 `404`。

同一台机器上的 **cursor** 属于**卸载不彻底**的情形：Cursor **以前装过，后来卸载了**，但残留的 `cursor` 垫片仍能在 `PATH` 上解析到。于是条目依旧被提供，却既没有 desktop 条目也没有主题图形，图标路由返回 `404`。

## 根因（读源码所得）

两处失败都在图标提取的 Linux 分支 `packages/host/open-in-app/src/icons.ts`，且共享同一个假设：**desktop 条目里写了图标名，就证明本机真有这张图。** 但 freedesktop 的 desktop 条目只是*声明*了一个图标名，真正的像素通常属于另一个图标主题包——而那个包完全可能没装。

### A. 主题查找写死了 `hicolor` 主题与固定尺寸表

`findLinuxThemeIcon` 只探测：

```
<dataDir>/icons/hicolor/{512x512,256x256,128x128,64x64,48x48,32x32}/apps/<name>.{png,svg}
<dataDir>/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/<name>.svg
<dataDir>/pixmaps/<name>.{png,svg}
```

三个写死的假设，任意一条不成立即 404：

1. **主题永远是 `hicolor`。** 用户的活动主题（`XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP`、`XDG_ICON_THEME`）按 README「Known Limitations」是刻意不查的，因此只存在于活动主题中的图形完全看不见。
2. **尺寸目录名一定在该固定表里。** 真实世界中常见的拼写会被漏掉：`256x256@2`、`symbolic/`、`8x8`、`96x96` 等。
3. **`apps/` 一定直接在尺寸目录下。** RPM 系目录树两种写法都有：`48x48/apps/foo.png` 与 `48x48/foo.png`。

`vscode` 带 `desktopId: 'code'`，所以会进入这条查找，并在上述任一条上 404。

### B. 缺少 `desktopId` 会短路掉整条查找

`extractAppIcon` 中：

```ts
if (completed.platform === 'linux') {
  const desktopId = specFor(app, completed.platform)?.desktopId
  return desktopId === undefined ? null : extractLinuxIcon(desktopId, completed)
}
```

`cursor` 目录条目只声明了 `linux: spec(cli('cursor'))`——**没有 `desktopId`**——因此对 `cursor` 而言该函数立刻返回 `null`，一次文件系统都没碰，尽管这个应用明明已解析成功且能启动。`vscode` 走的则是 A 路径。两条不同代码路径，同一个占位方块。

两条路径都没有考虑应用**自带安装目录内**的图形（例如 `resources/app/resources/linux/code.png`，或解包版 VS Code 携带的 `resources/app/out/media/code-icon.svg`）——而这恰恰是没有安装主题包时唯一可用的图形。

## 建议修法

把 Linux 图标查找由「单次主题表探测」改为**一组有序的文件系统轮次**，并且不再把缺少 `desktopId` 当作「此应用没有图标」：

1. **desktop 条目的图标名**经**活动主题**、其余图标搜索路径、再 `pixmaps` 解析——同时容忍带版本后缀／`symbolic` 的尺寸目录，以及 `apps/` 的两种层级。
2. 对这些主题目录做**有界递归按名搜索**，覆盖任意深度的图形。
3. **已验证启动器旁的打包图形**，相对已解析的可执行文件（覆盖 `resources/app/resources/linux/<name>.png` 与 `resources/app/out/media/<name>-icon.svg`，并包含启动器位于上一层垫片的情形，如 `bin/code`）。
4. 对 XDG 数据目录做**有界递归按名搜索**，覆盖主题之外的厂商目录树。
5. 一小串众所周知的固定位置。

第 2、4 轮会遍历 `/usr/share`，因此需要深度与条目数上限，并且应当只在前面的轮次全部落空后才执行。另外 `catalog.ts` 需要为条目补充图形别名，因为文件名常常既不等于 catalog id 也不等于可执行文件名（`vscode` 条目的 `code.png` / `code-icon.svg`；`cursor` 条目的 `Cursor.png`）。目前只有 Windows 会设置的 `icon: { kind: 'executable', path }` 图标来源，正好可以作为 Linux 第 3 轮的锚点。

## 附带观察（优先级较低，同一片区域）

1. **`desktopId` 的文档描述是「其 `Icon=` 键命名本应用图标的 desktop 条目」，但条目存在并不等于图标已安装。** 把 desktop 条目的存在当作整条查找的闸门，正是这些情形静默失败的原因。把它降级为若干线索之一、而不是入口条件，会更稳妥。
2. **404 响应体无法区分「此应用在本机没有图形」与「没有这个应用」。** 两者都返回 `{"code":"not-found","message":"no icon for <id>"}`，而 `/open-in-app/apps` 又照常列出该 id，排查成本因此被抬高。
3. **`xdg-open` 文件管理器条目（`filemanager`）按设计没有任何图标来源**，所以纯 CLI 安装永远显示通用占位图形。这符合预期——但这也意味着占位图形是 CLI-only 条目的常态，而不是「出问题了」的信号。
4. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 的 `canOpenNativePath` 用 `os.release()` 判定 WSL**（字符串含 `microsoft`），并为此提供了 `osRelease` 测试 seam；但 `packages/host/open-in-app` 没有转发该 seam，于是 `resolveLaunch` 里「WSL 还是桌面 Linux」的判断读的是跑测试那台机器的内核。转发它可以顺带让 `filemanager` 的桌面会话行为在测试中变得可复现。

## 验证说明

- 该 404 在真实主机文件系统上通过路由 handler 可确定性复现，与浏览器缓存无关。
- 浏览器表面每页只请求一次图标（`packages/client/ui-open-in-app/src/client/OpenInAppAction.tsx` 中的 `failedIcons`），因此一次 404 就会在该页锁定为占位图形。
- 对这些 id 而言 `GET /open-in-app/apps` 与 `POST /open-in-app/open` 均正常，说明探测与启动未受影响，缺陷可定位在图标提取这一环。

discussions.title: [bug] dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2 的 commit 9ddef327a4
Windows：云同步目录下edit间歇失败 —— file changed since it was read 与 ReplaceFileW EIO (Win32 1175)
discussions.body:
**环境**

- DSH：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2
- 系统：Windows / NTFS 本地卷（C:）
- Node：v24.16.0
- 工作目录：`C:\Users\User03\Documents\学习笔记\公众号文章`（该目录被坚果云 / Nutstore 同步）

**现象**

在一个被云同步客户端接管的目录里连续编辑同一个文件，`write` / `edit` 会间歇性失败，两种报错：

1. `cannot write/edit "...": file changed since it was read`（`FS_STALE_VERSION`）
2. `ReplaceFileW EIO (Win32 1175): ...`（1175 = `ERROR_UNABLE_TO_REMOVE_REPLACED`）

约 10~20% 的操作会中招，且成簇出现——总是紧跟在一次成功写入之后。

---

### 根因 1：`versionOf()` 把 `ctimeNs` 计入版本号

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local` `lib/index.js:142`：

```js
function versionOf(info) {
  return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${info.mtimeNs}:${info.ctimeNs}`);
}
```

Windows 上 `ctime` 是 ChangeTime，**任何元数据变动都会刷新它，内容可以完全没变**。云同步客户端在检测到文件变更后会打开文件读取、计算哈希，并回写元数据。

实测（每 250ms 采一次五元组）：

| 目标 | 位置 | 写入后 20~30s 内被外部改动 |
|---|---|---|
| 同步目录内的 .md | 坚果云同步目录 | **1 次**（首次 +0.5s / +2.5s / +3.0s） |
| 同一文件复测 | 同上 | **1 次**（+2.50s） |
| 对照文件 | 非同步路径（DSH 私有 TEMP） | **0 次** |

一次典型记录，注意 `size` 和 `mtime` 完全相同，只有 `ctime` 变了：

```
写入    ...:10177:1789884392405105200:1789884392405105200
+0.50s  ...:10177:1789884392405105200:1789884392817220500
```

同步客户端自己的事件库也能对上：写入后 2.6s 它记了一条 EDIT 事件（带新 size 和新 hash），同一秒文件 ctime 也变了。

**验证**：退出同步客户端后，同样的写入测试 churn 归零；同一文件连做 7 次 DSH 写入/编辑（含两次刻意间隔 6 秒，正好落在原来必错的窗口里）全部成功。

**建议**：版本号里去掉 `ctimeNs`，或只保留 `size + mtimeNs`。用 ctime 判断"内容是否被外部改过"，在同步网盘、备份软件、杀软环境下误判率很高。

---

### 根因 2：`copyFileDaclWin32` 用 `PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION` 会削掉沙箱的继承写权限

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local` `lib/index.js:518` 在覆盖**已存在**文件时先 `copyFileDacl(target, temp)`，其实现（`lib/index.js:76`）调用 `SetFileSecurityW(..., 2147483652, ...)`，即 `DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION | PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION`。

Windows 沙箱（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`）是在工作区**目录**上给一个派生 SID（`S-1-4-x-y`，见 `workspaceWriteSid()`）授写权限、由子文件**继承**来放行的。而受保护的 DACL 会关闭继承。

实测 ACL：

```
公众号文章（目录）   Allow Write,Delete,...   inh=False   S-1-4-257365257-801758671
8.10-…md            Allow Write,Delete,...   inh=True    S-1-4-257365257-801758671   ← 沙箱内可写
CLAUDE.md           仅 SYSTEM/Administrators/用户，inh=False，无沙箱 SID             ← Access denied
SKILL.md            同上                                                          ← Access denied
8.9-…md             同上                                                          ← Access denied
```

在 pwsh / node（沙箱内子进程）里对这些文件 `open(..., 'r+')` 直接报 `Access to the path is denied`。宿主进程不受影响，所以 `write` / `edit` 工具本身正常，但沙箱内的子进程会莫名写不进去，且表现是"有的文件能写、有的不能"，很难排查。

**建议**：`copyFileDaclWin32` 不要带 `PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION`；或在替换完成后重新给沙箱 SID 授一次权。

---

### 另一条未定位的现象（供参考，可能无关）

同一目录下，`[System.IO.File]::GetAttributes()`（即 `GetFileAttributesExW`）报 `Archive, ReparsePoint`，而 `GetFileAttributesW`、`FindFirstFileW`、`FSCTL_GET_REPARSE_POINT` 三个途径都说不带重解析点（路径加不加 `\\?\` 结果一样）。没查出是谁注入的。

---

### 复现脚本（churn 测量）

```js
// node churn.js <目标文件>
// 写入一次（内容不变），然后每 250ms 采一次版本五元组，打印任何变动
const fs = require('node:fs');
const fmt = s => `${s.dev}:${s.ino}:${s.size}:${s.mtimeNs}:${s.ctimeNs}`;
const snap = p => fmt(fs.statSync(p, { bigint: true }));
(async () => {
  const t = process.argv[2];
  fs.writeFileSync(t, fs.readFileSync(t));
  let last = snap(t);
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
    const v = snap(t);
    if (v !== last) { console.log(`+${i * 0.25}s ${v}`); last = v; }
  }
})();
```

discussions.title: [bug] dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2 的 commit 9ddef327a4
Profile plugin's stale transitive dep (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale@0.1.0-rc.8) shadows bundled copy and crashes 'dsh web' boot
discussions.body:
## Summary

A stale transitive dependency of a profile-installed third-party plugin (`dsh-notify-yimit`) shadows dsh's own bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`, causing `dsh web` to crash at boot with a misleading error: `The requested module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings' does not provide an export named 'settingsNamespace'`.

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11
- Node.js: v26.4.0
- dsh: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` (via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest web`)
- Profile: `~/.dsh/profiles/web` with `dsh-notify-yimit@^0.1.6` installed

## Steps to reproduce

1. Install the plugin into a profile: `dsh plugin --profile web install` with `dsh-notify-yimit@0.1.6` in the profile's `package.json` dependencies and listed under `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. `dsh-notify-yimit@0.1.6` depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale@^0.1.0-rc.6`, which resolves to the stale `0.1.0-rc.8` and gets installed into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules`.
3. Run `dsh web`.
4. During plugin-tree loading, the loader entry `locale (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale)` resolves to the **profile's stale copy** (`0.1.0-rc.8`) instead of the bundled `0.1.5-rc.2`. That old version does `import { settingsNamespace } from "@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings"`, an export that no longer exists in the current `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@0.1.5-rc.2`, so boot crashes.

## Actual behavior

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): failed to import loader entry locale (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale): The requested module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings' does not provide an export named 'settingsNamespace'
```

Deleting `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules` and reinstalling does not help, because the plugin's dependency range (`^0.1.0-rc.6`) pulls the same stale version back every time.

## Expected behavior

One or more of:

- Loader entries for `@deepseek-ai/*` core packages resolve to dsh's own bundled copies first, so a plugin's transitive dependency can never shadow them.
- `dsh plugin install` detects version conflicts between a plugin's transitive `@deepseek-ai/*` deps and the bundled versions, and warns or aligns them.
- At minimum, the boot error should name the resolved file path and version of the conflicting package, so users can tell this is a version-shadowing problem rather than a missing export.

## Workaround (confirmed working)

Pin the transitive deps in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to match the bundled versions:

```yaml
overrides:
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale': 0.1.5-rc.2
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths': 0.1.5-rc.2
```

After `dsh plugin --profile web install` with these overrides, `dsh web` boots normally. (Note: pnpm v11 ignores `overrides` in `package.json`; they must live in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.)

## Additional notes

- `dsh-notify-yimit@0.1.6` is the latest published version and still depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale@^0.1.0-rc.6`, so any user installing this plugin today hits the same crash. The plugin publishes no repository/homepage on npm, so it cannot be reported upstream.

discussions.title: 修复盲区：已关闭轮次中的悬挂 tool_calls 不会被补齐，导致会话永久不可用
discussions.body:
## 现象

一个会话在 v0 迁移到 v3 之后，每次发消息都被 provider 拒绝：

An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages
responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following
tool_calls message)  [INVALID_REQUEST]

会话因此永久不可用。

## 环境

- DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 (ddefc45fbc, master)
- Node v24.16.0, win32 x64
- Profile: web

## 复现

1. 某轮里 assistant 发出 tool_calls，但该轮在工具结果落盘前被中断，
   此时 step/end 与 turn/end 已写入，tool/result 缺失。
2. 之后在同一会话发新消息。
3. 请求被持续拒绝，会话不可恢复。

实测定位（session-31f06a86-a425-4466-9968-e5fc21638fef）：

  [681] user/message
  [682] assistant/message   tool_calls: pwsh, job_list
  [683] tool/call           仅调用记录，无结果
  [684] step/end
  [685] turn/end
  [686] session/end-seed
  [687] turn/start
  [691] user/message

该会话共 109 条带 tool_calls 的 assistant 消息，只有这一条没有配套
tool/result。缺失的 callId：

  call_00_aHlYRLVwtbX85uYH71LL2751
  call_01_IHkwxtP6F93M25KplUGT1624

## 根因

packages/core/session/src/repair.ts

- 第 50-53 行：case 'step/end' 执行 pendingCalls.clear()，待修复集合被清空。
- 第 82 行：if (openTurn === null || last === undefined) return []
  修复只在最后一个轮次仍未关闭时运行。

二者叠加：任何在已关闭轮次中遗留的悬挂 tool_calls，既不会被记录进
pendingCalls，也不会进入尾部修复路径，因此永久停留在日志中。该结构不是
崩溃残留，而是已正常收尾的轮次中的畸形历史。

## 预期行为

按 packages/core/session/README.md:154 的既定契约，持久化 tool/call 无结果
时应补为 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN 合成结果。该路径对历史上已关闭的轮次也应
生效；或在写入时阻止 step/end / turn/end 在不平衡状态下落盘。

## 补充

该会话的 v0→v3 迁移本身完全通过（transformed 与 current 两种 validation
均 OK），说明迁移层不是成因。畸形结构在迁移前后都存在，只是新 loop 组装
请求时被 provider 的严格校验拦下。

discussions.title: DSH｜Think Ultra｜把每个请求钉在原生 max 推理档，带按模型/模式隔离的深度控制
discussions.body:
**非官方项目**，由社区成员独立开发和维护。Upvote 不代表 DeepSeek 官方审核或背书。

**项目地址：**
https://github.com/YUEYUEXYS/dsh-think-ultra

**项目介绍：**
Think Ultra 是 DeepSeek Harness 的一个推理层插件。它把每个发出去的请求**钉死在宿主原生 max effort 档**（界面上的"Ultra"档就是映射到原生 max），并加了一个按模型/模式隔离的推理深度控制面板：

- Flash / Pro × 迅流(Velocity) / 极境(Apex) **四个独立隔离区**，各自单独持久化
- **0–20 能力滑块**（仅 Ultra 推理档可见，非 Ultra 自动灰掉冻结），跨启动记忆
- 离线推理工具箱 + 可选原生核心：不开任何 socket、不联网；模型流量仍走宿主自己的 llm 适配器

**与 DSH 的集成方式：**
- 真实 `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`（不是只声明 client 的空壳）
- 仓库 tarball 预构建，无需 build、无需 allowBuilds
- `@deepseek-ai/*` 走 peerDependencies，显式预发布范围，**兼容 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2**（排除 0.2.0）

**分发说明（如实写清）：**
浏览器端以混淆加固构建交付，仓库闭源。允许在 DSH 内商用；禁止逆向、修改、提取。插件本身无遥测、无联网。

**安装：**

    dsh plugin add https://github.com/YUEYUEXYS/dsh-think-ultra/tarball/main

discussions.title: Expose writable stdin on ShellProcess (and stop a producer's undefined outcome from killing the host)
discussions.body:
### Request

Expose a way to write to a **running background command's stdin** through the shell seam (`ctx.shell`), so a tool can answer an interactive prompt or feed a process without killing and restarting it.

### What the current seam offers

`ctx.shell.start(spec)` returns a `ShellProcess` that can be **read** and **terminated**, but not written to. In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-local` (0.1.5-rc.2), `startArgv` returns:

```js
const proc = {
  status, exitCode, signal,
  done,        // settles with exit facts
  readOutput,  // incremental: { delta, lossy, stdoutSpillPath?, stderrSpillPath? }
  kill,
}
```

There is no `stdin` member and no write method, so a tool holding only the seam has no route to the child.

### The capability already exists one layer down

The subprocess layer supports it. `dsh-subprocess-local`'s runner builds its result with (runner-launch, ~line 1113):

```js
stdin: stdinMode === "pipe" ? stdin ?? void 0 : void 0,
```

and the parent side hands back `stdin: child.stdin` (index.js, ~line 412). So a live, writable pipe is implemented today — nothing in the shell layer requests it.

### Why it is blocked, precisely

`dsh-bash-local` (and `dsh-pwsh-local`, identically — see below) only ever asks for one-shot data or nothing:

```js
// shell/bash/local/index.js, spawnSpec ~line 189
stdio: {
  stdin: spec.stdin !== void 0 ? { data: spec.stdin } : "ignore",
  stdout: collect(stdoutMaxBytes),
  stderr: collect(this.config.maxOutputBytes)
}
```

and `resolve()` forwards a **one-shot** `stdin` string (line ~174), not a live channel. Even if a caller could somehow request `"pipe"`, `startArgv` computes the collected readers and returns its own `proc` object — the provider's `stdin` stream would be dropped on the floor before any tool could reach it.

So the gap is at the seam, and it is **not bash-specific**: `dsh-pwsh-local` has the same `{ data } | "ignore"` choice at ~line 291 and the same forwarding at ~line 259.

### What I would like to see

Either shape works; the first seems smaller:

1. **A write method on the process handle**, e.g. `ShellProcess.writeStdin(data: string | Uint8Array): boolean` — with a request field to opt in, since a live pipe per command is not free.
2. **Or an exposed writable stream** on the handle, with the close/error semantics owned by the seam rather than by each caller.

### Semantics worth pinning down before implementing

These are the parts I would not want to guess at in a plugin, and the reason I did not work around the seam:

- **Write after exit.** Writing to a closed pipe raises `EPIPE`. An uncaught error here is not a failed write, it is a dead host process, so the method must return a negative result rather than throw — or the seam must swallow and report it.
- **Teardown.** What happens to a pending write when the job is cancelled or the composition disposes? If the producer's `done` must still settle (see the guard requirement below), a write that can never land must not hold settlement open.
- **Backpressure.** A command that never reads its stdin will fill the pipe. A bounded buffer with an explicit "stdin is full / would block" answer is safer than an unbounded queue or a silent stall.
- **Interaction with the retention window.** `start` applies no deadline of its own (unlike `run`, which wraps the signal in `deadline(...)`), so it is straightforward to add a timeout; worth stating whether writing should interact with it.

### A related robustness note

While writing a tool over this seam I found that a producer whose `done` resolves `undefined` makes `dsh-jobs-local`'s `settle` throw on `outcome.status` with no guard, which terminates the **whole host process** rather than failing one job:

```
dsh: fatal load failure: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'status')
    at Proxy.settle (.../dsh-jobs-local/lib/index.js:367:24)
    at .../dsh-jobs-local/lib/index.js:167:9
```

The producer contract is documented, so this is on me — but a defensive check in `settle` would turn a host-wide crash into a rejected job, since `hooks.done` is arbitrary plugin code.

### Context

- Host: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 (desktop bundle), macOS aarch64, Node 26.9.0.
- What I am building: a streaming bash tool whose whole point is to let the model read a command's output and react *while it runs*. One-shot `stdin` covers `cat` style input and is already useful; the remaining hole is a command that stops to ask a question, where the only current options are to kill it and restart with the answers pre-supplied, or to move that work to a PTY.
- PTY is not a drop-in substitute here: it is a separate seam (`ctx.terminals`) with its own executor, so reaching for it means replacing the shell executor rather than extending it.

discussions.title: [Bug + tested fix] 历史会话内存保留、长会话渲染开销与旧格式 context summary 兼容
discussions.body:
历史会话较多时，浏览几个会话就可能让 Host 常驻完整日志；浏览器节点缓存和旧格式迁移也存在独立问题。我按 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 在 Discussions 报告，并提供已验证的修复分支，供维护者评估和选取。

修复分支：https://github.com/YeautyYE/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/session-memory-retention

已推送的最终提交：`29d493281be82a3c7eaeb1e43bf8997dc8413416`；[完整差异](https://github.com/YeautyYE/deepseek-harness/compare/ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887...29d493281be82a3c7eaeb1e43bf8997dc8413416)。

基于上游 `master` 的 `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`（0.1.6-alpha.2）。相关报告：#6172（长历史浏览器内存）和 #5724（历史格式迁移内存）；下列验证不等同于修复 #6998 的 WebKit 原生刷新内存问题。

### 已复现的根因与修复

- 普通 `session.follow` 在首帧后隐式恢复 Agent，关闭历史流并不释放 Agent。真实 AgentLoop + JSONL 测试中，依次浏览并关闭三个历史会话，存活 Agent 数为 `[1, 2, 3]`。去除浏览触发的恢复后为 `[0, 0, 0]`，显式 prompt、队列操作与命令仍正常恢复，事件序列连续。
- 输入框命令目录预加载经 `commands.list(Agent)` 的参数解析再次触发恢复。改由 `session.commandCatalog(sessionId)` 读取记录的 preset 常驻 scope；`goals.get(sessionId)` 也只查询已经在线的 Agent。真实 Chromium 回归验证三个冷会话的 Todo、plan、goal 均显示，浏览后零 Agent，点击实际操作后只激活所选会话。
- SessionQuery 原缓存只有条目数量限制。增加默认 32 MiB 的可配置解码权重上限，保留活动租约、修订失效和 LRU 规则，并计入共享对象的每个引用槽位。
- JSONL 的两条强引用 memo 在上层缓存释放后仍保留完整日志。改为两条弱引用索引，活动句柄和迁移操作保留自身所需数据，已回收结果在后续访问时重新校验读取。
- 长期挂起的 follow 生成器保留首屏完整事件数组。短生命周期首屏生成器在返回游标后结束，监听顺序和实时连续性保持。
- Chat 按键数据源强缓存保留已离开窗口的节点。弱引用查找配合活动订阅强持有，既允许回收废弃数据，也保持仍被使用的数据源身份和通知。
- 已发布历史里的 plugin source `instructions` / `recall` 可带字符串 `summary`，迁移校验却将其判为非法。修复只接受这些已存在的合法字段并原样保留，继续校验类型；迁移读、发布、续写、重开均保持旧文件字节不变。

### 浏览器渲染优化

长历史的消息操作按钮使用三条 `:has(~ ...)` 选择器，为较早 user/steering 行反复扫描后续兄弟。替换为等价的 `:nth-last-child(n + 2 of ...)`，保持最后一条输入常显、旧输入悬停/键盘聚焦显示、无 hover 设备常显。

同一个 built 500 轮页面交替切回 Chat，旧/新各三次，匹配的 499 个旧输入行逐次完全一致。旧样式计算为 261.817 / 257.918 / 256.125 ms，新为 217.353 / 216.318 / 203.740 ms：中位数下降约 **16.1%**。整个切换中位数 692.718 → 666.941 ms，下降约 **3.7%**。这属于局部优化；完整展开仍有 DOM 和重新挂载成本，未采用滚动虚拟化，也没有把整个切换下降写成 16%。

最终已有 240 轮浏览器基准中位打开 243 ms、最慢分页 277 ms、Trajectory 173 ms；生成期间可信输入与后续绘制端点 459 ms。1001 会话 / 500 轮手动场景默认历史打开约 496 ms，完整展开最慢分页约 1.65 s。两组完成条件不同，后一组含探针收敛等待；它们不代表用户 Windows 的部署后延迟。

### 内存证据

固定合成输入，编译后的生产代码在 Node 24.5.0 / macOS arm64 下运行，读取端点仍保持可达，跨事件循环执行 GC。以下为组件保留堆，不是整个 Windows 进程 RSS 或浏览器 GPU 内存：

| 场景 | 原实现 | 修复后 |
|---|---:|---:|
| SessionQuery 依次读取 10 份历史，各 512 条 × 16 KiB 文本 | 41.14 MiB | 8.46 MiB |
| JSONL 两份已关闭的读取，各 2,048 条 × 16 KiB，当前格式 | 65.64 MiB | 0.36 MiB |
| 同样输入，v0 Zstd 历史迁移 | 66.38 MiB | 0.80 MiB |
| 六个等待中的 follow，各 3,000 事件 × 6,144 字符 | 111.657 MiB / 六份数组 | 约 0.15 MiB / 零份数组 |
| Chat 20 次窗口替换，每次 2,000 对节点数据源 | 46,127,088 B | 244,912 B |

原实现的保留断言实际失败；修复后的 GC 再读取保持内容正确。包内保留 `prepared-cache.perf.ts`、`history-retention.perf.ts`、`cold-log-memo.perf.ts` 合成诊断，不含用户历史材料。

### 验证

- 本轮相关单元：120 个文件、2,329 项通过。涵盖 Session Controller、SessionQuery/SQLite、JSONL、历史迁移、Commands、Goal、Todo、Plan 和受影响 UI 包。
- Query + Controller 四个修改源文件精确 coverage：45 文件 / 882 测试，全部指标 100%；JSONL 主实现：14 文件 / 479 测试，全部指标 100%。Goal 主实现和两个纯投影入口的 owning coverage 也通过。既有 GUI coverage 排除规则仍适用，没有宣称全部 GUI 源码覆盖率。
- `cold-history-projections`、`seeded-history`、`stats-paged-history`、`goal-bar` 真实 Chromium 测试：19 通过，1 项仅用于录制而跳过；现有会话显示快照保持一致。
- 240 轮历史的 Chromium 性能场景三次采样及既有预算检查通过，记录冷浏览后不激活、发送后激活。1001 会话 / 500 轮的大规模手动诊断也已运行。
- 原生 Windows Node 24.20.0 对四份实际旧日志的只读 v0→v3 迁移通过，最大样本约九万条物理记录。另有 v0/v1/v2 × plain/zstd 合成读、发布、续写、重开回归；实际历史内容与身份未进入提交。
- CSS 优化还通过 7 项真实滚动契约、2 项长历史交互、11 项 CSS 单测，覆盖 hover/focus、混合 steering、触控、复制、分叉和续聊。背景任务、日程、冷队列和消息反馈的 11 项浏览器用例也通过。
- `pnpm run build`、`pnpm run lint`、`pnpm run hygiene`（16/16）、`pnpm run doc-sync`（41/41）通过。
- `DSH_EXAMPLE_MODE=lib pnpm run test:snapshot snapshots/session/headless.snapshot.ts -t 'session-query-spill|agent-instructions'`：2 项通过。默认 source 模式的 `prepare` 错误已在未修改基线复现，与本修复分开记录；不将其记为通过。

### 范围与权衡

只读浏览不再启动 Agent 插件或提醒运行时；需要 Agent 的显式操作承担首次恢复成本。Todo 与 plan 的纯投影单独挂在 Host，model-facing 工具与命令仍由 preset 决定。已有在线 Agent、后台任务及其日志不会因浏览器导航被终止。弱缓存回收后重新访问会重新解析，活动读取仍可超出缓存复用预算。

浏览器测量使用 built Client 和 source-resolved 的正式组合测试 Host、keyless replay，排除外部模型与网络延迟。提交与推送 hooks（含最终类型检查）通过；此次通过 Discussion 提交，没有上游 PR CI 结果。没有升级或重启原 Windows 服务，没有评估第三方插件的实现，也没有声称所有输入规模下的峰值内存、滚动帧率或 RSS 已被限制。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness really needs an official desktop client
discussions.body:
DeepSeek Harness is already becoming a very capable tool, but there is one thing that feels increasingly out of place:

**We still have to launch the web client through the command line with npm.**

For developers, this is not a huge problem. But for a tool that is becoming a serious AI development environment, relying on:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

and then opening a browser to use it feels more like a development setup than a finished product.

## Why not an official desktop client?

I think DeepSeek Harness would benefit enormously from an official desktop application for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Something similar to the experience of modern AI coding tools would make a huge difference:

* Download and install the application
* Sign in
* Start using DeepSeek Harness
* No Node.js/npm environment required
* No terminal command required
* Automatic updates
* Built-in configuration and model management
* Native file and project access
* Persistent sessions and workspaces
* Better integration with the local development environment

The current web-based interface is actually quite useful. The problem isn't really the UI — **it's the distribution and user experience around it.**

## The command-line requirement creates unnecessary friction

Right now, a new user essentially needs to understand the following before they can even start:

1. What Node.js is
2. What npm is
3. How to install dependencies
4. How to start the development server
5. How to keep the server running
6. How to access the web interface
7. How to update the application

That's a lot of friction for something that should ideally feel like a finished AI product.

Even developers who are perfectly comfortable with the terminal don't necessarily want to start their AI assistant this way every time.

## An official client would also make DeepSeek Harness feel much more mature

There is a big difference between:

> "Here is an open-source project you can run."

and

> "Here is DeepSeek Harness — download it and start working."

I think DeepSeek Harness is already close enough to the second category that the current npm/web-only distribution is becoming the limiting factor.

A desktop client could also provide functionality that is difficult to deliver cleanly through a browser:

* Global keyboard shortcuts
* Native notifications
* File-system permissions
* Better terminal integration
* Project/workspace management
* Background tasks
* Persistent agents
* Git integration
* Multiple projects/sessions
* Automatic updates
* System-level configuration
* Better integration with local AI/development tools

## Even an Electron/Tauri wrapper would be a huge improvement

It doesn't necessarily need to be a completely new frontend.

If the current web client is already working well, an initial official desktop client could simply package the existing experience using **Tauri or Electron**, while providing proper native installation and lifecycle management.

That would already solve a large part of the user-experience problem.

Later, DeepSeek could gradually add deeper native capabilities.

---

### Please consider making an official desktop client a priority

DeepSeek has already demonstrated that the underlying models and AI capabilities can compete at a very high level.

Now I think the next step is **productization**.

I'd love to see something like:

**DeepSeek Harness Desktop**

> Download → Install → Sign in → Choose a project → Start working.

No npm.

No terminal.

No manually starting a local web server.

Just **open the application and use it.**

I think this would make DeepSeek Harness much more accessible to developers while also making the project feel significantly more complete and production-ready.

**Please ship an official desktop client soon! 🚀**
