discussions.title: consider a gradual Rust migration for dsh's core runtime
discussions.body:
I use dsh on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and would like to suggest a possible long-term direction: **would it make sense to gradually migrate dsh's core runtime to Rust and offer native executables, while keeping the TypeScript Web UI and other components where TypeScript remains a good fit?**

My most immediate interest is simpler installation and setup. The npm workflow in the README requires installing Node.js before running `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. Having one less runtime environment to configure would make a practical difference when using dsh across several operating systems. [dsh README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#run)

There have also been community reports of installation and startup problems: `dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` getting stuck in CPU-intensive dependency resolution in some npm environments, and `dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` failing to start through `npx` because a required package could not be resolved. These reports concern particular versions and environments, and are part of what prompted my interest in the installation and distribution experience. [Discussion #4236](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4236), [npm/cli #9934](https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/9934), [Discussion #982](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/982)

Hardware costs are another reason this direction interests me. Memory and flash prices are elevated, and in June 2026 Micron forecast that DRAM and NAND supply-demand conditions would remain tight beyond 2027. [TrendForce market report](https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260703-13134.html), [Micron earnings remarks](https://s25.q4cdn.com/621799436/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/Q3-FY26-Prepared-Remarks.pdf) Against that backdrop, I would value a smaller resident memory footprint, leaving more of my existing machine's capacity available for editors, browsers, and other development tools, with less pressure to upgrade hardware.

The experiences of Codex CLI and GitHub Copilot make Rust seem worth considering to me:

- **Fewer runtime prerequisites for users.** When OpenAI announced the Codex CLI Rust migration in May 2025, reducing installation dependencies was one motivation, and the Node.js 22+ requirement was identified as an obstacle for some users. Codex now offers standalone installation and platform binaries. That is close to the experience I would like when using dsh across different systems. [Codex migration announcement](https://github.com/openai/codex/discussions/1174), [Codex README](https://github.com/openai/codex)

- **The potential for lower runtime overhead.** GitHub published benchmarks after migrating the Copilot agent runtime to Rust. In a ten-client batch, the peak increase in resident private memory above baseline was 1,383 MB for the original TypeScript process tree, 247 MB for Rust out of process, and 126 MB for Rust in process. These are results from a particular test that excluded model inference and external network latency, so they do not predict dsh's gains. They do make the resource efficiency of a native runtime interesting to me. [Copilot runtime migration](https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/generative-ai/migrating-the-github-copilot-runtime-to-rust-using-copilot/)

- **An existing example of gradual migration alongside TypeScript.** GitHub migrated the runtime component by component, and Copilot CLI now uses a Rust runtime while retaining its TypeScript terminal interface. That combination suggests a native runtime and an existing TypeScript interface can both have a long-term place in a project. [Copilot runtime migration](https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/generative-ai/migrating-the-github-copilot-runtime-to-rust-using-copilot/), [Copilot release notes](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-08-28-github-copilot-weekly-releases-august-24/)

I also noticed dsh's existing Desktop and Python runtime packaging designs, so standalone distribution already has several possible approaches. What additionally attracts me to Rust is the potential for lower runtime overhead and easier embedding in other applications. Since dsh's core capabilities are themselves plugins, compatibility with the existing plugin ecosystem and ongoing maintenance costs would also affect whether this direction is a good fit. [dsh architecture](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/architecture.md)

I would be interested to hear what the maintainers and other users think, and whether there have already been discussions or plans along these lines.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Expose an independent Agent.wake(target) operation for pending input
discussions.body:
## Motivation

Related: [discussion #4832](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4832) describes the interrupt-and-send UX and proposes removing and resubmitting queued messages. This proposal focuses on the underlying composable API capability, so clients can implement that UX while preserving the existing inbox.

An Agent can enqueue input without waking execution (`send(message, target, false)`) and cancel execution while retaining its inbox (`cancel(cause, { keepInbox: true })`), but callers cannot explicitly start that retained input without submitting another message.

A concrete use case is an interactive client: while a turn is running, the user submits steering and then interrupts the current execution. The client wants to interrupt first and then process the already queued steering immediately. Today, the retained input can remain pending until another waking message arrives.

Removing and resubmitting pending messages in the client would move inbox scheduling responsibilities into the UI and complicate preservation of message identity, order, and interleaved plugin context. A combined interrupt-and-steer operation would instead couple the core API to one client workflow.

## Behavior

Expose a separate primitive, tentatively `Agent.wake(target: InboxTarget): void`, that requests execution of existing input without inserting or rewriting messages. Callers could compose it with cancellation:

```ts
agent.cancel({ kind: 'user' }, { keepInbox: true })
agent.wake('next-step')
```

Proposed semantics for discussion:

- `next-step` starts with all pending step input; `next-turn` starts with pending step input plus one ordinary queued message. Subsequent turns use the existing queue-draining behavior.
- An empty target does not create a turn. An already running driver continues processing normally.
- During cancellation settlement or maintenance, retain the wake request and recheck the inbox when execution can restart. If both boundaries were requested and step input remains, process the step boundary first.
- Preserve existing message IDs, order, plugin context, cancellation behavior, and durable session format. Clearing cancellation removes pending wake requests; disposal must not restart execution.
- Expose the same operation through `SessionController` for attached, ordinary live Agents, with an acknowledgement rather than a completion promise.

A candidate implementation is available in [this fork comparison](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...Yangeyu:deepseek-harness:feat/agent-wake-pending-input), commit `c5e34d4fa8d0121af0e636b14fe5b4d73d4e807b`. The API name and deferred-wake semantics are proposals for upstream review.

Local validation passed 442 Agent-loop/controller tests, TypeScript SDK session replay, Python SDK snapshots through the built JavaScript CLI with a local mock model service, build, lint, and typechecks. No live-provider or packaged-executable validation is claimed.

discussions.title: [Bug] Every tool call fails with Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') on Windows — regression in v0.1.6-alpha.2
discussions.body:
Environment
OS: Windows (zh-CN), PowerShell 7.6.6
Node: v24.15.0
pnpm: via corepack
dsh: v0.1.6-alpha.2 (commit ddefc45) → broken; v0.1.6-alpha.1 → works
Profile: shipped web template (@deepseek-ai/dsh-base + @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app); cordis.patch.yml = []; no $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml
Native deps verified loadable from the checkout: koffi@3.1.1 (OK), node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15 patched (OK); pwsh 7.6.6 resolves and executes
Summary
On v0.1.6-alpha.2 (Windows), any tool call fails immediately with
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') (error code UNKNOWN).
After the failure the session becomes unusable: every subsequent message returns
DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results (INVALID_REQUEST), because the
assistant message keeps a tool call with no result in the history.

Reproducible 100%. Affects at least two unrelated tools — the Pwsh shell tool and the
Glob file-search tool — which points at a shared tool execution / preparation layer
rather than the shell stack.

Steps to reproduce
pnpm dsh web --no-open
Open the Web UI and create a new session (shipped web profile, no custom patch)
Ask the agent to do anything that requires a tool, e.g. "list the current directory" (Pwsh)
or "find all *.ts files" (Glob)
The run fails: 本轮运行失败 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') — UNKNOWN
Send any further message (even "hello") → DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results — INVALID_REQUEST
Expected
The tool executes normally (as it does on v0.1.6-alpha.1).

Actual
Tool preparation throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare');
the run aborts; the session retains a dangling tool call, and every later turn fails with INVALID_REQUEST.

Ruled out
Native modules: koffi and node-pty are both installed and load successfully
(require('koffi') → OK, require('node-pty') → OK)
pwsh: PowerShell 7.6.6 installed and executable from the shell
Port conflicts: netstat shows :3080 free; the server starts and serves the UI
Profile composition: stock template, empty user patch layer, no home-level patch
No stack trace on stdout/stderr — the error is only surfaced as a structured UNKNOWN error in the UI
Regression window
dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1 (2026-09-15): works
dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2 (2026-09-17, commit ddefc45): fails
Notes
tool-pwsh is disabled and tool-pwsh-persistent is the mounted shell tool, but since the
non-shell Glob tool crashes identically, the failure appears to be in the shared tool
execution path rather than in the persistent-pwsh stack.

中文摘要
在 Windows 上使用 v0.1.6-alpha.2 时，任何工具调用都会立即失败：
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')（错误码 UNKNOWN）。
失败后该会话不可用——之后每条消息都返回
DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results（INVALID_REQUEST），
因为历史里留着一个没有结果的 tool call。

复现率 100%；Pwsh（shell）与 Glob（文件搜索）两个不相关的工具同样崩溃 → 疑似共享的工具执行/准备层
已排除：koffi、node-pty、pwsh 7.6.6、端口冲突、profile 配置污染
回归区间：dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1 正常 → dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2 崩溃
回退到 dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1 后一切恢复正常

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh causes massive macOS Swap explosion (300GB+ System Data / 191GB kernel_task) even when using API-only mode
discussions.body: ### Describe the bug I am experiencing a catastrophic memory and disk space explosion when running `dsh` (DeepSeek Harness) on my 2020 13-inch Intel MacBook Pro. The critical issue is that **I am only using the API, not running local models**, yet the local resource consumption is extreme. The harness (specifically its local `mysqld` process) exhausts my physical RAM, forcing macOS to heavily use virtual memory (Swap). This has bloated my "System Data" to over 300GB and caused `kernel_task` to write 191GB to my SSD. *Note: I have used OpenAI's Codex for similar tasks before, and it never caused this level of resource exhaustion.*

discussions.title: Bug: source launch (pnpm dsh) under runtime resolution mode loads duplicate module instances — every tool call fails with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')"
discussions.body:
# Bug: source launch (`pnpm dsh`) under runtime resolution mode loads duplicate module instances — every tool call fails with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`

> TL;DR: Since #9ddef327a4 (2026-09-17) the CLI defaults to `resolutionMode: 'runtime'`. In a source checkout launched through tsx, this splits one process across two module planes (`src/` for static imports via tsconfig paths, `lib/` for plugin-row imports routed by the resolution generation). `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is loaded twice, the per-instance `Symbol()` `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` no longer matches, and **every tool call of every turn fails** with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2`, source checkout (master @ `ddefc45fbc`), clean tree after `pnpm run build`
- Node v22.23.2, macOS arm64 (also reproduced on Node 26.8)
- Source launch: `pnpm dsh web` / `pnpm dsh --profile headless` (tsx ESM hook)
- Real `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`

## Symptom

Every conversation turn fails at the **first tool call**:

```
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

The session log records the `tool/call` event and then a `turn/end` with that error — no tool result, no step output. Reproduced on both the `web` and `headless` profiles; any task that needs a tool is unusable. This started "these past few days" for daily `dsh web` usage, which matches the merge date of #9ddef327a4 (2026-09-17).

## Root cause

`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170`:

```ts
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)
```

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is created with `Symbol()` at `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463`, i.e. **one distinct symbol per module instance**.

Under a source launch (tsx + `tsconfig.base.json` paths):

- static imports of workspace packages resolve through the tsconfig `paths` facade to `packages/*/*/src/index.ts` (source plane);
- plugin-row imports (vendor loader `Entry` → dynamic import) are routed by the installed profile-resolution generation to `packages/*/*/lib/index.js` (artifact plane).

Result: **two module instances of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` in one process.** The symbol imported by `dsh-agent-loop` differs from the one the `ToolRuntime` service used to define its `[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` field, the lookup returns `undefined`, and the turn aborts at `.prepare`. This violates the documented *"Source plane vs artifact plane, never mixed"* rule (AGENTS.md / docs/development.md#typescript-project-layout).

## Evidence

A temporary probe plugin loaded via `dsh web --patch` (runtime mode, current master):

```
[probe] esm resolve dsh-tools        = file:///…/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts
[probe] ctx.tools instanceof src ToolRuntime = false
[probe] ctx.tools instanceof lib ToolRuntime = true
[probe] scheduler on ctx.tools via src symbol = undefined
[probe] scheduler on ctx.tools via lib symbol = object
```

An evaluation-trace experiment confirms the lib copy is imported by the vendor loader's `Entry` init (`vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts`), while the CLI's own import chain evaluates the src copy first.

## A/B verification

Only the default at `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:263` was changed between runs:

| default `resolutionMode` | result |
|---|---|
| `'runtime'` (current master) | first tool call fails: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` |
| `'link'` (pre-#9ddef327a4 default) | works: `bash` tool executes, turn completes normally |

Packaged executables and Electron force runtime mode but have no source plane, so they stay on a single artifact plane and are unaffected. The in-process test scaffold never mixes planes either, which is presumably why CI did not catch this.

## Suggested fixes (any one)

1. **Smallest change:** default back to `'link'` for non-packaged CLI launches (`options.resolutionMode ?? 'link'` in `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts`), keeping `runtime` for pkg/Electron. Requires syncing `apps/cli/tests/resolved-profile-boot.spec.ts` (asserts the `runtime` default) and the docs updated alongside #0ea890044f.
2. **Root-cause fix:** make the runtime resolver aware of the source-plane facade, so generation-routed imports agree with tsx's tsconfig-paths resolution in source launches.
3. **Band-aid (not sufficient alone):** define `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` with `Symbol.for(...)` so the scheduler seam survives duplicate module instances — the split-brain module identity itself remains a hazard for other cross-package contracts.

## Related operational notes

These may account for intermittent "dsh web won't start" reports beyond the crash above:

- A killed or crashed process leaves `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml.lock` / `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules.lock` behind. `withFileLock` intentionally never removes a foreign lock ("orphan recovery is an operator action"), so every later `dsh web` start fails with `atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock` until the stale lock file is deleted manually. It might be worth surfacing this more prominently (e.g. include the lock's age and PID in the error).
- A stale `dsh web` process holding `127.0.0.1:3080` makes the next launch fail with `EADDRINUSE` (visible in `~/.dsh/logs/startup-*.log`).

Happy to turn this into a PR for option 1 or 2 if that's preferred.

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 下「在文件资源管理器中显示」必然失败，但界面误报成功
discussions.body:
# [Bug] Windows 下「在文件资源管理器中显示」必然失败，但界面误报成功

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 操作系统 | Windows 11 25H2，build 26200.9457（注册表 `ProductName` 仍显示 "Windows 10 Home China"，属 Win11 已知显示残留） |
| 桌面壳 | DSH Desktop 0.9.0 |
| Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| 出问题包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| 安装方式 | DSH Desktop 打包版（Electron） |

## 摘要

在交付文件卡片的操作菜单里点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」，界面提示"已请求在文件管理器中显示"，
但**文件所在文件夹没有被打开、目标文件也没有被选中**，实际弹出的是系统默认文件夹（本机为 `D:\Documents`）。

该故障在 Windows 上**必然复现**，与文件路径是否含中文、是否含空格无关（纯 ASCII 路径同样失败）。
macOS 与 Linux 分支不受影响。

## 复现步骤

1. 在 Windows 上启动 DSH（Desktop 打包版或 `dsh web` 均可，宿主同为 Windows）。
2. 让 Agent 产出或 `present` 至少一个文件，使本轮结束时出现交付文件卡片。
3. 点击该文件卡片右侧的 `⋮` 展开菜单。
4. 选择「在文件资源管理器中显示」。

## 期望结果

资源管理器打开该文件所在目录，并选中该文件。

## 实际结果

- 卡片状态栏显示"已请求在文件管理器中显示"（英文 "Requested display in file manager"）；
- 资源管理器没有打开目标目录；
- 系统默认文件夹（本机 `D:\Documents`）被弹出。

补充：原始现象是"没有任何目标文件夹窗口出现"，很容易让人以为是点击无效。
在进一步复现中发现，失败时**会**弹出系统默认文件夹，只是这个窗口与目标无关，
容易被忽略或误认为与本次点击无关。

## 根因

### 出错代码

`packages/util/native-command` 中 `revealNativePath()` 的 Windows/WSL 分支
（编译产物中的 region 标记为 `lib/types/path-opener.js`，本次定位到 `lib/index.js` 第 220–236 行）：

```js
if (manager === "explorer") {
    let windowsPath = path;
    if (platform === "linux") {
        const translated = await run("wslpath", ["-w", path], signal);
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        windowsPath = translated.stdout.replace(/[\r\n]+$/, "");
        if (windowsPath === "") throw new Error("wslpath returned no Windows path");
    }
    const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C");
    try {
        await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
    } catch (error) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        if (!(error instanceof Error) || !("code" in error) || error.code !== 1) throw error;
    }
    return;
}
```

### 两处不符合 Explorer 的命令行约定

1. **`/select,` 与目标被拆成两个 argv。**
   Explorer 的语法是 `/select,<sub object>`，逗号是分隔符，
   `/select,` 与其后的目标之间不能有空格。

2. **传给 Explorer 的是 percent-encoded 的 `file:///` URL，而不是文件系统路径。**
   Explorer 无法在该位置解析这个参数，于是回退去打开系统默认文件夹。

两处叠加，使得这条路径在 Windows 上无法工作。

### 调用链

```
用户点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」
  → dsh-client-ui-deliverables: POST <present-open 路由>?action=reveal
  → handlePresentOpen()
      · workspaceFiles.stat() 解析文件、校验存在性
      · fs.processPathFromHostPath() + fs.resolve() 校验宿主路径（不通过则返回 422）
  → sessionController.openWorkspacePath({ path, action: "reveal" })
  → revealNativePath()            ← 故障点
  → execFile("explorer.exe", ["/select,", "file:///..."])
```

### 为什么界面误报成功

同一函数的 `catch` 把 Explorer 的退出码 1 当作"已交接"直接吞掉：

```js
if (!(error instanceof Error) || !("code" in error) || error.code !== 1) throw error;
```

Explorer 在命令行参数解析失败时同样会立即退出并返回 1。
于是 `openWorkspacePath()` 返回 `{ opened: true }`，接口返回 204，
前端把状态置为 `revealed` 并显示"已请求在文件管理器中显示"。

该措辞本身是诚实的（"已请求"而非"已打开"），但宿主实际上完全没有能力
验证这次交接是否产生了可见结果，因此失败被静默掩盖。

## 证据

### 实测对照

每轮使用**唯一的目标目录**，避免资源管理器复用已有窗口造成误判；
判定依据是枚举 `Shell.Application.Windows()` 并读取每个窗口 `Document.FocusedItem.Path`。

| 调用形式 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `explorer.exe "/select,<原始路径>"`（单参数 + 原始路径） | 正确打开目标目录并选中文件（中文路径同样正常） |
| `explorer.exe /select, <原始路径>`（两个参数） | 失败，弹出 `D:\Documents` |
| `explorer.exe "/select,file:///..."`（单参数 + file URL，纯 ASCII） | 失败，弹出默认文件夹 |
| `explorer.exe /select, file:///...`（两个参数 + file URL，当前实现） | 失败，弹出 `D:\Documents` |
| `explorer.exe /select, file:///...`（含中文目录，当前实现） | 失败，弹出 `D:\Documents` |

当前实现的形式在本机连续 4 次失败，**其中包含纯 ASCII 路径**，
说明与路径语言无关。

### 测试方法

脚本见文末「附：复现脚本」。核心是让两种形式各自作用于不同的目标目录，
然后读取资源管理器实际选中的对象：

- 正确形式：目标文件出现在 `FocusedItem.Path` 中；
- 当前实现形式：目标文件从未出现，取而代之的是一个新弹出的 `D:\Documents` 窗口。

### 同一张卡片上另外两个动作均正常，可精确定位故障点

| 动作 | 实现 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 点击文件引用 / 卡片预览 | DSH 内部侧边栏预览（workspace-files 读接口） | 正常 |
| 用默认应用打开 | `powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Invoke-Item -LiteralPath '<path>'"` | 正常 |
| 在文件资源管理器中显示 | `explorer.exe /select, <file:/// URL>`（两个参数） | 失败 |

三点补充：

1. 前两个动作成功，说明会话工作区解析、文件存在性、宿主路径映射
   （`handlePresentOpen` 中的 `workspaceFiles.stat` 与 `fs.processPathFromHostPath` 校验）
   全部正常 —— 否则会返回 422 并提示"此文件没有可用的主机路径，请在侧边栏预览"，
   而不是进入 `revealed` 状态。故障被限制在最后一步的原生调用上。
2. 「用默认应用打开」走的是另一条分支（`openNativePath` → `openWindowsPath`），
   路径以 `-LiteralPath` 单引号字面量传递，既不做 URL 转换也不拆分参数，
   因此不受影响。这反证了问题出在 `revealNativePath` 的参数形式，
   而非文件权限、文件关联或路径本身。
3. 修复只需改 `revealNativePath` 一处。

## 影响范围

- **平台**：Windows 与 WSL（走 `manager === "explorer"` 分支的全部场景）。
- **使用者**：宿主为 Windows 的所有 DSH 形态（Desktop 打包版、`dsh web`、CLI），
  因为该代码位于所有宿主共用的底层包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 中。
- **触发条件**：无。任意路径均失败，与路径是否含中文、是否含空格无关。
- **macOS / Linux**：`manager === "finder"` 使用 `open -R`，
  `manager === "directory"` 使用 `xdg-open <父目录>`，两个分支均不受影响。

## 建议修复

### 最小改动

```diff
-        const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C");
         try {
-            await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
+            await run("explorer.exe", ["/select," + windowsPath], signal);
         } catch (error) {
```

即：把 `/select,` 与原始文件系统路径拼成**同一个参数**，不再转成 `file:///` URL。

修改后经该模块的 `run` 注入点验证，生成的参数为：

```
cmd  : explorer.exe
argv : ["/select,G:\\资料\\本科\\课程作业\\2026-2027\\IOT_high\\PPT制作概要-交给其他Agent.md"]
```

这正是上表中被验证可用的形式。

同时注意：改动后 `path-opener` 中的 `pathToFileURL` 导入可能变为未使用，需一并清理
（编译产物中位于 `lib/index.js` 顶部 `import { dirname, extname } from "node:path"` 附近的
`import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"`）。

### 遗留边界：路径含英文逗号

上述最小改动**仍无法处理路径中含英文逗号**的情况，本机实测会退回打开默认文件夹。

原因：`execFile` 只会为包含空格、制表符或引号的参数加引号，
`C:\a,b\x.txt` 这类路径会被原样拼接，Explorer 会在逗号处截断。

若认为该边界需要覆盖，建议按下节处理。

### 建议的彻底修复

二选一：

1. **让 `runNativeCommand` 支持 `windowsVerbatimArguments`**，
   由调用方自行拼出带引号的命令行：

   ```
   explorer.exe /select,"<原始路径>"
   ```

2. **改用 Shell API**：`SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems`，
   或经 Shell.Application COM 定位到父目录并选中目标项。
   这条路径不经过命令行解析，天然免疫逗号、空格与引号问题。

另外建议：**不要无条件把退出码 1 视为成功**。
Explorer 在参数解析失败与正常交接两种情况下都可能返回 1，
无条件吞掉会让调用方无法区分。至少应改为记录日志，或让前端能显示真实失败。

### 回归测试建议

若 `revealNativePath` 已有基于 `internals.run` 注入点的单测，
需要同步更新断言：期望的 argv 由 `["/select,", <file url>]`
改为 `["/select,", <原始路径>]`（或 `["/select," + path]`），
并补充一条「路径含逗号」的用例以明确当前行为边界。

## 附：复现脚本

保存为 `compare-explorer-select.ps1`，在 Windows 上以普通权限运行即可。
脚本会创建自己的临时目录并在结束时留下干净状态；输出为 ASCII 以免脚本编码干扰。

```powershell
# compare-explorer-select.ps1
# Compares two explorer.exe /select, argument forms and reports what Explorer actually
# opened/selected. Output is intentionally ASCII-only.

$root = Join-Path $env:TEMP "dsh-explorer-select-repro"
Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$correct = Join-Path $root "correct\probe.txt"
$broken  = Join-Path $root "broken\probe.txt"
foreach ($p in @($correct, $broken)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $p) -Force | Out-Null
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $p -Value "probe"
}

function Get-Selection {
    $sh = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
    @($sh.Windows() | ForEach-Object { try { $_.Document.FocusedItem.Path } catch {} })
}

function Get-FileUrl([string]$Path) {
    $uri = New-Object System.Uri ("file:///" + ($Path -replace '\\', '/'))
    $uri.AbsoluteUri -replace ',', '%2C'
}

Write-Output "target (correct form) = $correct"
Write-Output "target (DSH form)     = $broken"
Write-Output ""

Write-Output "--- form 1: explorer.exe ""/select,<raw path>""   (single argv) ---"
explorer.exe "/select,$correct"
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
Write-Output "selected: $((Get-Selection) -join ' || ')"
Write-Output ""

$url = Get-FileUrl $broken
Write-Output "--- form 2: explorer.exe /select, <file url>     (two argv, current impl) ---"
Write-Output "url = $url"
explorer.exe /select, $url
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
Write-Output "selected: $((Get-Selection) -join ' || ')"
```

本机实测输出（节选）：

```
--- form 1: explorer.exe "/select,<raw path>"   (single argv) ---
selected: <工作区窗口> || D:\Documents || C:\...\dsh-explorer-select-repro\correct\probe.txt

--- form 2: explorer.exe /select, <file url>     (two argv, current impl) ---
url = file:///C:/Users/.../dsh-explorer-select-repro/broken/probe.txt
selected: <工作区窗口> || D:\Documents || C:\...\dsh-explorer-select-repro\correct\probe.txt || D:\Documents\...
```

form 1 的目标 `correct\probe.txt` 被正确选中；
form 2 的目标 `broken\probe.txt` **从未出现**，而是多出一个 `D:\Documents` 窗口。

discussions.title: DSH｜DSH Safekeep｜让无人值守工作中的常见文件事故尽可能可恢复
discussions.body:
> **非官方社区项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护；未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或背书。**

项目地址：[SPX43JL/dsh-safekeep](https://github.com/SPX43JL/dsh-safekeep)

DSH Safekeep 面向已经主动授予 DSH 高权限、让 Agent 长时间自主工作，又无法逐次确认或一直盯着电脑的用户。目标是在尽量不中断正常工作的情况下，让常见文件事故尽可能可恢复。

- **写前快照**：对可观察范围内的文件覆盖先保存旧字节，普通编辑不新增逐操作确认。
- **可恢复移除**：识别到的常见永久删除会被拒绝；Agent 可在已有授权内调用 `data_safety_trash`，改用可校验、可恢复的移除。
- **校验与恢复**：快照和回收均支持 verify/restore；快照默认恢复到新文件。DSH 无法启动或插件卸载后，仍可通过包内离线 CLI 恢复已保存的数据。
- **确认生效**：`data_safety_status` 展示当前实例的加载状态、代码指纹、存储状态和当前会话计数；安装或升级后还需按 README 完成实际快照/恢复验证。

集成使用 **DSH 原生 profile bundle**，在工具执行前进行检查和快照，并由 guard 核验，保留 DSH 自身的权限检查和文件 observation。Web 与 headless 分别安装；原生恢复工具的写操作要求当前 DSH 为 `danger-full-access`，插件不会自行切换权限模式。

**当前已验证范围**：Windows 11 x64、本地 NTFS、Node.js 24.14.0、PowerShell 7.6.5、DSH **0.1.5-rc.2**，Web / headless 的原生 `read` / `write` / `edit` / `pwsh` 工具模式。其他版本、操作系统、入口和插件组合尚不作兼容承诺。

首版 **v0.1.0-rc.1 是公开预览版**，MIT 许可证。安装请按仓库 README 从 GitHub Release 获取精确 tgz 并核对 SHA-256；无需全局安装本插件，尚未发布 npm package。源码、文档、issue 和 Release 均在上述同一 GitHub 项目维护。

**安全边界**：这不是 sandbox、完整备份或绝对防删保证。任意脚本内部、直接 PTC 文件系统 API、未匹配的 MCP/浏览器/Office 写入、远程文件系统和同权限恶意程序均不能依赖本插件保护。单个旧文件的自动快照上限为 **64 MiB**；同机恢复库不能应对磁盘丢失，也不能找回未保存过的内容。没有自动清理，请关注恢复库占用；完整边界见仓库文档。

![DSH Safekeep 在真实隔离 Web 会话中的脱敏演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPX43JL/dsh-safekeep/e0ce3d3291f629e0e61b1fdd3fca8e37d9c19582/docs/demo-web.jpg)

上图是实际隔离 Web 会话的脱敏总结视图，仅作演示；验收结论以仓库记录中的独立文件与审计核对为准。

欢迎通过项目 issue 提供使用新建合成样本的误拦、漏快照或恢复问题复现；请勿上传 token、私人路径、原始会话或恢复文件。

discussions.title: [Desktop] GUI 进程没有用户 shell PATH:插件调用用户环境工具(node/pnpm)的官方推荐姿势?
discussions.body:
**环境:** 官方桌面端 macOS,GUI 启动(非终端拉起);node 为 brew keg-only `node@24`,仅在 shell PATH(`~/.zshrc` 手动 export);pnpm 为真 pnpm,shebang `#!/usr/bin/env node`。

**现象:** 同一台机器,终端启动的 web 宿主一切正常(子进程继承 shell PATH);桌面端 GUI 里,第三方插件探测到 `/opt/homebrew/bin/pnpm` 后运行报 `env: node: No such file or directory`——GUI 进程由 launchd 启动,不读 shell 配置,PATH 只有系统默认四目录。

我们(第三方市场插件)侧正在做的适配是优先消费 `profileContext.packageManager`(按 `{ command, args, env }` 整档使用),PATH/corepack 保持回退。

**想请教官方两点:**

1. 包安装之外,插件在桌面端需要调用用户环境里的工具(node/pnpm/git 等)时,官方推荐的姿势是什么?`packageManager` 的 JSDoc 写明 scoped to package operations,那么包操作之外是否有官方通道,还是应要求用户配置绝对路径?
2. 是否考虑把内嵌 node 以受控方式暴露给插件子进程?桌面端拉起 host 进程时未把内嵌 node 的 bin 目录前置到 PATH(应该是避免插件隐式依赖内嵌版本);若未来有受控暴露的计划,插件侧的探测可以大幅简化。

**背景:** dsh-market 侧的适配 issue:https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/issues/653

discussions.title: [Bug + patch] Small-viewport overlays and stale clipboard feedback lifecycle
discussions.body:
### Summary

I found and fixed three related UI lifecycle / small-viewport issues in `ui-primitives`, based on upstream master `ddefc45`. Following CONTRIBUTING.md, this is a Discussion with a tested patch rather than an external PR.

Patch: https://github.com/fengnanrui/deepseek-harness/commit/6c75608

### Reproduction and expected behavior

1. Open an anchored menu whose measured width or height exceeds the viewport. The previous `min(max(position, margin), viewport - panel - margin)` clamp can place it at a negative coordinate. A reduced visual viewport (soft keyboard / zoom) also does not update the position. The patch clamps oversized panels to the leading visible margin and listens to visual-viewport resize/scroll, with teardown.
2. Open the provider delete confirmation at 320 × 200. The modal needs a dynamic-viewport height bound and an independently scrolling body so the action footer remains reachable. The existing assembled Models Settings E2E now checks this geometry.
3. Trigger Copy twice while the clipboard promise is pending, or change the hook text / unmount before it resolves. Pending writes were not coalesced, and old completions could create feedback/timers for a changed or removed owner. The patch owns the pending attempt and timer, ignores stale results, and permits retry after refusal.

### Validation performed

- Full GUI lane: 434 files passed; 6,184 tests passed and 1 existing skip.
- Built web Models Settings replay suite: 14 passed in Chromium, including the small-height dialog check.
- `doc-sync`: 41 gates passed; full lint passed; normal pre-commit and pre-push typecheck hooks passed.
- Added hook regressions for oversized geometry, visual-viewport listener cleanup, repeated pending writes, text changes, unmount, and clipboard refusal.

The patch includes synchronized English/Chinese package documentation. Real mobile Safari / Android keyboard behavior still needs physical-device verification; the automated viewport evidence above is Chromium/jsdom, not a claim of hardware certification.

discussions.title: Web 工具调用时 .prepare 未定义的问题
discussions.body:
问题描述：
更新代码后，Web 会话在模型调用工具时失败，页面显示：
```
本轮运行失败
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
UNKNOWN
```
普通文本回复可能正常，但调用 BashProbe、BashTest、job_list 等工具时失败。
问题原因：
dsh-tools 内部的工具调度器使用普通 Symbol() 标识：
`Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')`
当 Web bundle 中加载了多个 dsh-tools 副本时，不同副本生成的 symbol 不相等，导致 agent-loop 无法找到 ToolRuntime 的 scheduler，最终在调用 .prepare() 时触发运行时错误。
修复内容：
将内部 scheduler 标识改为：
`Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')`
相同 key 在同一进程内始终返回相同的 symbol，确保不同 bundle 中的 agent-loop 和 ToolRuntime 可以访问同一个工具调度器。
QA 测试版本：
仓库：sunny-zhai/deepseek-harness
分支：master
Commit：[00649801cfb24ed3e42469d2356fc4d014547eb7](https://github.com/sunny-zhai/deepseek-harness/commit/00649801cfb24ed3e42469d2356fc4d014547eb7)
修改文件：[packages/core/tools/src/index.ts](https://github.com/sunny-zhai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts)
项目版本：dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2
平台：macOS
Node.js：v24.19.0

discussions.title: Tool calls fail with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" - instrumented duplicate-copy root cause + a verified read-side fix
discussions.body:
## Summary

Every tool call fails before it is dispatched:

```
UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

In an ACP session the same failure surfaces as:

```
UPDATE: tool_call
FATAL: RPC_ERROR {"code":-32603,"message":"Internal error: turn failed: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')"}
```

The profile boots normally, the model answers (thought chunks and usage updates arrive), and the failure happens exactly where the scheduler is read: `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts`

```ts
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)
```

## Environment

- Windows 11 dev box, pnpm 11.7.0, Node v24.19.0
- DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2` (tag `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`, `ddefc45fbc`), run from a source checkout (`pnpm install` + `pnpm run build`)
- Reproduced in the `web` profile and the `acp` profile, with a local `llama-local` model **and** with `deepseek-official` (`deepseek-v4-flash`)

## What is not the cause (measured, not assumed)

| Hypothesis | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Model provider | identical failure with a local llama.cpp server and with the official API |
| Settings (`compat.thinkingFormat`, `maxTokens`) | unchanged behaviour after reverting/removing them |
| Broken `node_modules` | `pnpm store prune` + clean reinstall: same failure |
| Stale build artifacts | `pnpm run clean` + full `pnpm run build`: same failure |
| Restarting the backend | no effect |
| A third-party/local plugin | none installed: `~/.dsh/profiles/*/package.json` has `dependencies: {}`, both `cordis.patch.yml` files are empty, and all 240 `@deepseek-ai/*` entries under the profile resolve into the checkout |
| Duplicate copies on disk | every `apps/cli/node_modules/**/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is a symlink to `packages/core/tools`; `require.resolve` from every anchor converges on one realpath |

Because of the last two rows, the "move the duplicate out of the profile" workaround (see the plugin-market tutorial) does not apply here — moving the profile's stale `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` junction away and restarting changed nothing.

## Instrumented root cause

A probe inserted immediately before the crash site prints (one line, trimmed):

```json
{
  "want": "Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)",
  "hit": "UNDEF",
  "toolsType": "object",
  "toolsCtor": "ToolRuntime",
  "ownSymbols": ["Symbol(cordis.tracker)", "Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)"],
  "ownKeys": ["ctx", "name", "deferredContexts", "concludingExecutions", "cancellationStates", "contentFinalizers", "layers", "defaultMode", "maxParallelSubCalls", "ptcTransport", "canonicalResults"],
  "directPrepare": "undefined"
}
```

Two things stand out:

1. `ctx.tools` **is** the `ToolRuntime` service instance — the provider side ran.
2. It carries a property keyed by `Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)` — the very description `agent-loop` imports — yet `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined`.

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is created with a module-local `Symbol()` (`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`). When two copies of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` end up loaded in one process, the writer and the reader each hold their own symbol: same description, different identity. The scheduler is stored under one key and looked up under the other, so the lookup misses and every tool call dies — the same mechanism family discussed in #1486, #1697 and #1994.

## Fix that works here (read-side fallback)

Keep the direct lookup; when it misses, resolve the symbol by description instead of failing. `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts` (+25/−4), applied to the four reads (`prepare`, `dispatch`, `finalize`, `finish`):

```ts
/**
 * `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a module-local `Symbol()`: when two copies of
 * `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` are loaded at once the two symbols share a
 * description but not an identity, so the direct lookup returns `undefined`
 * and every tool call fails. Falling back to the symbol with the same
 * description turns a duplicated package into a redundant install instead of
 * a hard dispatch failure.
 */
function resolveToolScheduler<T>(tools: object, direct: T | undefined): T {
  if (direct !== undefined) return direct
  const key = Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(tools).find(
    (candidate) => candidate.description === TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER.description,
  )
  if (key === undefined) return undefined as unknown as T
  return (tools as Record<symbol, unknown>)[key] as T
}
```

I understand from `CONTRIBUTING.md` that external pull requests are out of scope right now, so I am not opening one — the patch lives on a branch of my fork for anyone who wants to reproduce it:

- `https://github.com/kefong/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/tool-runtime-scheduler-fallback`
- commit `0677826a84` — one file changed, +25/−4

## Verification after the patch

- An ACP session that previously died on its first `tool_call` now runs four rounds of `read` + `glob` and ends with `PROMPT_DONE: {"stopReason":"end_turn"}`.
- The probe at the crash site now reports `"hit": "OK"`.

## Suggestion

Cover both sides of the seam:

1. Writer side: `Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')`, so a healthy install always has a single key (this is the direction of the `fix/tool-runtime-scheduler-symbol` branch).
2. Read side: a description-based fallback on every scheduler read (`core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts`, `core/tools/src/ptc.ts`), so a duplicated install degrades into a redundant copy instead of a broken harness.
3. Optional, loud early failure: when composing a profile, realpath-check every `@deepseek-ai/*` package and report the duplicates at load time rather than at the first tool call.

Related discussions: #783, #1486, #1697, #1994, #2641.

discussions.title: DSH OpenAI Account Connector — browser sign-in, live model catalog, and image generation
discussions.body:
## Community plugin

`dsh-openai-account-connector` connects an OpenAI account to DeepSeek Harness through the official browser sign-in flow exposed by the bundled Codex runtime.

Repository: https://github.com/lxy271713/dsh-openai-account-connector

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-openai-account-connector

### What it provides

- Official OpenAI browser sign-in; users do not paste API keys or OAuth tokens into the plugin.
- A live model catalog read from the authenticated Codex runtime instead of a hard-coded model list.
- Text generation plus runtime-advertised image-generation and dynamic-tool capabilities.
- Generated image files are imported into Harness attachments with path, symlink, file-type, and size checks.
- Disconnecting removes only the DSH connection and route; it does not sign the user out of other Codex clients.

### Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --save-exact dsh-account-authorization@0.1.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --save-exact dsh-openai-account-connector@0.1.4
```

### Verification completed

- `pnpm run typecheck`
- 32/32 unit tests
- package build and pack checks
- isolated DSH Desktop 2.0.3 validation with the plugin enabled and the account connected
- live runtime catalog returned `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, and `gpt-5.5`
- npm package `0.1.4` downloaded and integrity-checked from the public registry

The connector does not read, copy, log, or return the user's OAuth token; OAuth storage and refresh remain owned by the Codex runtime.

Would the maintainers consider listing this community connector in the DSH Desktop optional plugin bundle/catalog? If additional compatibility, security, or UX evidence is required, please let me know the preferred checklist.

discussions.title: Every tool call fails with: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') — dual dsh-tools instance / per-instance Symbol() for TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER
discussions.body:
## Summary

On DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 (commit `ddefc45fbc`, running from a source checkout via `pnpm dsh` / `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`), **every tool call aborts the turn** with:

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

The tool never executes (session log shows `tool/call` followed immediately by `turn/end` with `reason: { kind: 'error', ... }`). This makes any session that calls a tool completely non-functional — no bash, no plugin tools, nothing runs.

## Environment

- DSH version: 0.1.6-alpha.2 (source checkout at `ddefc45fbc`, master)
- OS: Rocky Linux 10.1 under WSL2, Node v22.22.2, pnpm
- Running mode: source checkout — `zdsh.service` runs `dsh web` from `/opt/.../deepseek-harness` via `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`; profiles (`~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*`) symlink back into the repo's workspace `node_modules`

## Reproduction

```bash
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh --profile headless --json 'use the bash tool to run: echo hello'
```

Output:

```json
{"type":"tool_call","callId":"call_...","tool":"bash","input":{"command":"echo hello", ...}}
{"type":"status","phase":"turn_end","turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

No `tool_result` is ever emitted. The same failure occurs for every tool in every turn (hindsight tools, bash, etc.).

## Root cause

The failing call site is `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts`:

```ts
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)
```

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is declared as a per-instance unique symbol in `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`:

```ts
export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol = Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')
```

In this deployment, the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package ends up **loaded twice**:

1. The CLI app itself runs from TypeScript sources via `tsx` → resolves `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`.
2. Profile plugins resolve through `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` (symlinked into the repo workspace), whose `package.json` `main` points at the **built** `lib/index.js` copy of the same package.

Each copy evaluates `Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')` independently, producing **two symbols with identical descriptions that are not `===` to each other**. The `ToolRuntime` service registers its scheduler on the instance it sees, while the agent loop looks it up with the symbol from the other instance:

```js
// ctx.tools is a ToolRuntime and DOES own a symbol with the same description:
own: [
  'Symbol(cordis.tracker)',
  'Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)'
],
expected: 'Symbol(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler)'
// ...but ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] === undefined
```

(The diagnostic above was produced by temporarily logging `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(ctx.tools)` at the call site.)

So the error is a classic dual-package-instance / symbol-identity hazard: the "scheduler is missing" symptom is misleading — it is registered, just under a symbol the consumer cannot see.

## Suggested fix

Use the global symbol registry so the symbol is identical across module instances:

```ts
// packages/core/tools/src/index.ts
export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol = Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')
```

(and the corresponding `lib/index.js` build output).

I can confirm this resolves the issue: after patching both copies (`src/index.ts:463` and the built `lib/index.js:2526`) from `Symbol(...)` to `Symbol.for(...)`, the same headless reproduction succeeds — the tool executes, a `tool_result` is emitted, and the turn ends with `{"kind":"completed"}`.

Alternative/complementary hardening options:

- Deduplicate the package instance (e.g. ensure profile plugin resolution and the tsx-run app resolve to the same module file), though this is harder to guarantee across arbitrary profile layouts.
- Fail with an actionable message at the call site when the scheduler symbol lookup misses (the current generic TypeError took a while to track down; a hint like "tool runtime scheduler symbol not found — possible dual instance of @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools" would help).

Happy to open a PR for the `Symbol.for` change if the approach looks right.

discussions.title: BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit: an optional MCP configuration bundle for DSH
discussions.body:
I prepared an independent community bundle for connecting DSH to the hosted BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit through DSH's existing MCP client:

https://github.com/ct-jaryn/dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit

Disclosure: this contribution is part of integration and promotion work for BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit; it is not an official DeepSeek integration.

It is a small declarative profile layer with a fixed Streamable HTTP endpoint and an environment-sourced API-key bearer header. It does not change DSH's model provider or add a transport, backend wrapper, or credential store. Missing/empty credentials leave the bundle disabled.

The repository includes prerequisites, installation/removal, a concrete first search/read task, account and data/fee considerations, and six tests using the real published DSH loader/tools/MCP client with a synthetic loopback server. Those tests cover initialize, discovery, dispatch, credential boundaries, and disposal. The local tarball also passed the published CLI's profile-plugin installation and bundle-registration path.

Compatibility tested: DSH components **0.1.5-rc.2**. A live BaizhiCloud account, model-driven interaction, web UI, and newer DSH releases have not been qualified. The service's exposed catalog is discovered dynamically; the bundle does not claim every tool is read-only. The configuration/tests are MIT; the hosted backend is not represented as open source.

This is an AI-assisted community contribution; the executable boundary checks and remaining limits are documented in the repository. Feedback on the configuration-bundle approach is welcome.

discussions.title: [Bug] A built-in registration into the "rightbar" seat has no options.id — declaring that seat as list fails the entire client
discussions.body: # D3 发帖包（可直接照做） 日期：2026-09-21 状态：已通过纯净版验证；已实读同族帖子（#2083 / #2229），写法已按"不重复别人诉求"重做。 --- ## 0. 发帖信息速查 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | 分类 | `💬 General` | | 标题 | `[Bug] A built-in registration into the "rightbar" seat has no options.id — declaring that seat as list fails the entire client` | | 附件 | 必贴 1 张：`images\04-证据-D3-全屏失败.png`；建议再贴 1 张：`images\05-证据-D3-回滚恢复.png` | | 不要贴 | `images\03-D3-帖子内容.png`（那是帖子正文自己的渲染图，贴进去等于重复） | | 正文 | 下方第一节（English）或第二节（中文），二选一 | | 必读前置 | 置顶帖 Welcome to DeepSeek Harness Community - Please Read Before Posting | --- ## 1. English 正文（可直接粘贴） 标题： ``` [Bug] A built-in registration into the "rightbar" seat has no options.id — declaring that seat as list fails the entire client ``` 正文（图片插入位置已用 `<<< 图片 >>>` 标出，粘贴时把图片拖到该位置即可）： ```markdown ## Summary `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` registers into the `rightbar` seat without `options.id`. The seat ships as `kind: "single"`, where an id is not required, so the omission is harmless in the stock build. But if that seat is ever declared as `kind: "list"` — a natural thing to try when you want a plugin's panel to sit next to the built-in one — the built-in registration throws, its loader entry fails to apply, and the whole client ends up on the fatal "Failed to load plugins" screen with no UI at all. The failing registration here is the official one, not a third-party bundle. ## Environment - `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2 - Windows 11 (10.0.22621), Node v24.14.1 - Reproduced on a pristine install (separate npm install, isolated `DSH_HOME`, separate port), changing nothing except the seat kind ## What happens Flipping `rightbar` from `single` to `list` and restarting gives: Failed to load plugins @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right failed to apply loader entry 7f69849c (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right): list slot "rightbar" requires options.id <<< 图片：04-证据-D3-全屏失败.png >>> DOM state at that point: | probe | value | |---|---| | app shell rendered | false | | children of the root node | 1 (the error node) | | `style[data-plugin-css]` tags loaded | 106 | The 106 stylesheets matter: every other plugin's CSS was delivered and evaluated. The loader itself is fine — one entry failed and took the screen down with it. ## Root cause The shipped client bundle validates registrations per seat kind: ```js case "list": { if (t.id === void 0) throw new Error(`list slot "${t.name}" requires options.id`); ... } ``` And the built-in right panel registers into that seat without an id (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js`): ```js yield ctx.slots.register({ name: "rightbar", children: { "rightbar.session": { kind: "single", scope: "session" } } }, RightbarRoot); ``` For reference, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/lib/client.js` declares the seat as `"rightbar": { kind: "single", scope: "root" }`. ## What I would ask for 1. Add an id to the built-in registration. One line, and the seat stops being a landmine. 2. Isolation of the failure to the entry that caused it — this part is already requested in #2083 and #2229, so I am not asking again, only noting that this report is a new *trigger* for that known class: here the failing registration is in-tree rather than a third-party bundle. To be explicit: I am not asking for seat kind to be a supported user customization. The point is that the failure is one line away from being impossible, and the blast radius is the entire interface. ## Recovery Reverting the seat kind to `single` and restarting restores the full UI. <<< 图片：05-证据-D3-回滚恢复.png >>> ## Minimal reproduction 1. Start from a working profile. 2. Change the `rightbar` seat declaration from `kind: "single"` to `kind: "list"`. 3. Restart `dsh --profile web` and open the page. 4. Observe the fatal screen; revert the kind and restart to recover. ## Prior art - #2083 — Client module loader crashes the whole UI when one plugin bundle fails to register - #2229 — "Failed to load plugins" fatal screen offers no recovery action ``` --- ## 2. 中文对照正文（可直接粘贴） 标题： ``` [Bug] 内置注册进 "rightbar" 座位时未带 options.id —— 把该座位声明为 list 会让整个客户端失败 ``` 正文： ```markdown ## 现象 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` 注册进 `rightbar` 座位时没有带 `options.id`。 该座位出厂是 `kind: "single"`，这种形态不要求 id，所以缺省在原始状态下无害。 但一旦把该座位声明成 `kind: "list"`——想让某个插件的面板和内置面板并排时，这是很自然的尝试—— 内置注册就会抛错，对应 loader entry 的 apply 失败，整个客户端停在 "Failed to load plugins" 全屏错误页，没有任何可用界面。 这里失败的是官方自己的注册，不是第三方 bundle。 ## 环境 - `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2 - Windows 11 (10.0.22621)，Node v24.14.1 - 在纯净安装上复现（独立 npm 安装、隔离 `DSH_HOME`、独立端口），除座位 kind 外未改动任何东西 ## 实际表现 把 `rightbar` 从 `single` 改成 `list` 并重启后： Failed to load plugins @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right failed to apply loader entry 7f69849c (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right): list slot "rightbar" requires options.id <<< 图片：04-证据-D3-全屏失败.png >>> 此时的 DOM 状态： | 探针 | 值 | |---|---| | 应用外壳是否渲染 | false | | 根节点子元素数 | 1（只剩错误节点） | | 已加载的 `style[data-plugin-css]` 数量 | 106 | 那 106 个样式表是关键：其余所有插件的 CSS 都已下发并执行。加载器本身没问题—— 是一个 entry 失败，把整屏一起带走了。 ## 根因 发布的客户端 bundle 会按座位类型校验注册： ```js case "list": { if (t.id === void 0) throw new Error(`list slot "${t.name}" requires options.id`); ... } ``` 而内置右侧面板注册进该座位时没有带 id （`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js`）： ```js yield ctx.slots.register({ name: "rightbar", children: { "rightbar.session": { kind: "single", scope: "session" } } }, RightbarRoot); ``` 供对照，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/lib/client.js` 里该座位声明为 `"rightbar": { kind: "single", scope: "root" }`。 ## 建议 1. 给内置注册补一个 id。一行改动，座位就不再是地雷。 2. 把失败隔离到出错的 entry —— 这一条 #2083 与 #2229 已经提过，我不再重复诉求， 只指出本条是那个已知问题类的一个新触发源：这里的失败注册在树内，不是第三方 bundle。 说明白一点：我不是在要求把座位 kind 变成受支持的用户自定义项。 重点是：这个失败距离「不可能发生」只差一行，而影响半径是整个界面。 ## 恢复 把座位 kind 改回 `single` 并重启，界面完整恢复。 <<< 图片：05-证据-D3-回滚恢复.png >>> ## 最小复现 1. 从一个正常 profile 出发。 2. 把 `rightbar` 座位声明从 `kind: "single"` 改成 `kind: "list"`。 3. 重启 `dsh --profile web` 并打开页面。 4. 观测全屏错误；把 kind 改回去并重启即可恢复。 ## 相关帖子 - #2083 — Client module loader crashes the whole UI when one plugin bundle fails to register - #2229 — "Failed to load plugins" fatal screen offers no recovery action ``` --- ## 3. 图片说明 | 图片 | 是否贴 | 贴在哪里 | 说明什么 | |---|---|---|---| | `images\04-证据-D3-全屏失败.png` | 必贴 | 「实际表现」段落的报错代码块之后 | 纯净版上的真实画面：HARNESS 标题 + Failed to load plugins + 完整报错原文。这是本条最核心的证据 | | `images\05-证据-D3-回滚恢复.png` | 建议贴 | 「恢复」段落之后 | 改回 `single` 后的完整界面。作用是排除「你的环境本来就坏了」的误读 | | `images\03-D3-帖子内容.png` | 不贴 | — | 它是帖子正文自己的渲染图，贴进去等于重复一遍正文 | | `images\01` / `02` | 不贴 | — | 前者是内部路线图，后者是 D1 的内容 | --- ## 4. 查重依据 | 检查 | 结果 | |---|---| | 精确搜 `"requires options.id"` | 零命中——这条报错原文此前无人报告 | | 搜 `"Failed to load plugins"` | 26+ 条，但全部是第三方 bundle 失败、缓存、环境问题、求助帖 | | #2083 | 已提「隔离单 bundle 失败」的诉求（触发源是 BOM/空文件等第三方 bundle） | | #2229 | 已提「错误页没有恢复动作」的诉求 | | 我们的增量 | 触发源在树内：官方自己的注册缺 id；报错原文零命中；一行修复；含纯净版判据与回滚判据 | 所以本条不以「整屏失败很严重」或「应该做隔离」为卖点——那两点已被占位—— 而是以「官方注册缺 id 这个具体缺陷 + 一行修复」为主体，隔离那部分明确标注为引用已有诉求。 --- ## 5. 发帖红线 - 不要写「我发现了一个新的严重问题」——整屏失败的现象不新，只有这个触发源是新的。 - 不要把隔离诉求说成自己的——#2083 已提，重复提会被当成没做功课。 - 不要贴 `03-D3-帖子内容.png`。 - 标题里 `[Bug]` 前缀要保留（社区惯例），但标题主体必须先是根因、后是现象。

discussions.title: [Bug] 新建会话打不开、输入框永久锁死，每次重选静默多一个空会话
discussions.body:
**版本** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.6-alpha.2`（`ddefc45fbc`）· **平台** macOS arm64 / Node v24.4.0 / profile `web`

## 结论

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-controller` 的客户端插件**没有订阅 `connection.generation`**。

连接换代（宿主重启、WebSocket 断开）后，它的工作区流一旦重试耗尽就进入终态、**永远不再复活**，客户端的工作区投影遂永久冻结；而 UI 正是靠这个投影判断「新会话属于哪个工作区」—— 于是新会话打不开、输入框锁死，用户唯一能点的仍是那个工作区选择器，**每次重选又建一个空会话**。

三件事同时成立才构成这个 bug：流**死了**（A）、**死了没人管**（B）、**会话归属完全依赖它**（C）。

## 现象

- 选工作区建新会话 → 会话**建了但打不开**：输入框灰着，停在「选择一个工作区开始」。
- 再选一次 → 又建一个。实测 **11 次点击 = 11 个空会话**（仅 header，无 `user/message`、无 `turn/start`）。
- **硬刷新即恢复** → 数据是好的，死的是浏览器里的那条流。

## 根因

原始代码（`packages/api/workspace-controller/src/client/index.ts:38,47-52`）：

```ts
export const inject = ['remote', 'remote.workspace']   // ← 缺 'connection'
const control = createWorkspaceStateStream(ctx.remote, { … })
control.start()                                         // ← 只启动一次，永不重启
```

**A. 流会死**（`packages/api/gateway/src/client/`）

1. 宿主重启 → Remote WebSocket 断开 → 所有已打开的流以 `RemoteStreamCarrierError` 失败。
2. 该错误**可重试**，但 Connection 已有活跃 generation，`waitForRemoteStreamRetry` 只重试一次就抛出（`remote-stream.ts:160-168`）—— **重试预算只有 2 个 generation**。
3. `terminalStreamFailure()` 把它升级为标记过的 `RemoteError('gateway/internal')`（**终态**）。
4. `RemoteSnapshotStream.consume()` 捕获后调用 `failed(error)` 就 **`return`**（`snapshot-stream.ts:91`）—— 唯一的消费者循环就此结束。
5. `RemoteStream` 的 `finally` abort 掉 `lifetime`（`remote-stream.ts:152`）—— **`restart()` 从此是空操作**。
6. `handleStreamFailure()` 置 `state:'error'`，但**保留旧 `items`**，`phase` 仍是 `'ready'`。**投影冻结。**

**B. 死了没人管**：插件只 `inject` 了 `remote`/`remote.workspace`，既不订阅连接世代，也没有任何重建路径。

**C. 后果**（`packages/client/ui-conversation/.../ConversationContent.tsx:96,135`）

```ts
const sessionWorkspace = workspaces.items.find(w => w.sessionIds.includes(sessionId))
const chipTitle = pendingWorkspace?.title ?? sessionWorkspace?.title
  ?? (workspaces.phase === 'ready' ? undefined : workspaceLabel(cwd))  // phase 已是 ready → 兜底永久关闭
const inert = sessionId === undefined || (hero && chipTitle === undefined)
```

新会话不在冻结的投影里 → `chipTitle` 恒为 `undefined` → 输入框永久 `inert` → 选择器再次出现 → 再点 → 再建一个。

## 为什么确定是这条流

同一页面、同一条 WebSocket、同一时刻（CDP 读 React fiber 树取得）：

| 客户端流 | 状态 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `sessions`（**有** generation 订阅） | 健康 | 16 个会话，11 个空会话都在 |
| `workspaces`（**没有**） | `state:'error'` / `gateway/internal` | 冻结在 2 个 |

会话流追上了、工作区流没跟上 ⇒ **连接一直是好的，死的只是那条没有 generation 钩子的流**。同机新开一个 tab 立即正确（12 个，与磁盘 `workspace.json` 一致）。

## 为什么是缺陷而不是设计

- 友邻 `session-controller/src/client/index.ts:135-139` **恰好**有这三点：`inject` 含 `connection`、`control.restart()`、订阅 `connection.generation`。而 `dsh-client-connection` **早已是 `workspace-controller` 声明的 peer + dev 依赖**，只是从未被 `inject`。
- `WorkspaceSnapshot.state === 'error'` 在**整个客户端没有任何消费方** —— 终态失败既不可见、也无法恢复。

已排除（均有证据，从略）：preset / localStorage 残留（#6699 #7324）、空白会话复用（#4004）、宿主侧记账（#6949）、创建失败、cwd 非法、目录选择器失败。**它们都解释不了上表。**

## 修复

同一文件，`+115/-8`：`inject` 加 `'connection'`；订阅 `connection.generation`，**世代被替换**时重新武装 —— 流还活着就 `restart()`，已终态则整体 `rebuild()`；补 500ms→15s 退避兜底（覆盖「终态且连接不再发布新世代」），并 `console.warn`。

两个取舍：**只对「替换」反应，不对「首次就绪」反应**（流自身会等第一个 generation；否则每次开页面多开一条流，测试直接抓到 `['cancelled','cancelled']`）；**不改 `RemoteStream`**（重建 follow，而不是让 `restart()` 在 abort 后仍生效），以免动所有流共用的底座。

重试预算、`handleCarrierFailure`、`handleStreamFailure` 全部未动：行为从「重试耗尽 → 永久冻结」变为「重试耗尽 → 短暂 `error` → 重建恢复」。

## 验证

`tsc -b` exit 0；`workspace-controller` **48/48**；下游 ui-workspace / ui-conversation / session-controller **1401/1401**；受控 A/B（接真实 Gateway 类）：修复前 bundle 冻结在 `opens=2` 且永不重建 —— **生产那次冻结在隔离环境复现**，修复后全部通过。

## 规避

硬刷新后在侧边栏直接点开一个已有空会话，无需新建；堆积的空会话可安全归档。

---

## English (brief)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-controller`'s client plugin never subscribes to `connection.generation`. After a WebSocket drop exhausts `RemoteStream`'s 2-generation retry budget, its Workspace stream goes **terminal** and can never revive: `RemoteSnapshotStream.consume()` returns on the failure (ending the only consumer loop) and `RemoteStream`'s `finally` aborts `lifetime`, so `restart()` becomes a permanent no-op. The Workspace projection therefore freezes on its last baseline while `phase` still reads `'ready'`, so a new Session is never in any `workspace.sessionIds`; the composer's `chipTitle` resolves `undefined` (its `cwd` fallback is gated off by `phase === 'ready'`) and the composer stays disabled — and each retry silently creates another empty Session (11 clicks → 11 orphans).

**Decisive evidence:** in one page, over one socket, the `sessions` stream (which *has* a generation hook) was healthy with 16 sessions while the `workspaces` stream was `state:'error'` / `gateway/internal`. The connection was fine; only the stream without a generation hook was dead. Its peer `session-controller` has exactly that hook, and `dsh-client-connection` was already a declared peer + dev dependency.

**Fix:** inject `connection`, re-arm the follow on a generation *replacement* (`restart()` if live, full rebuild if terminal), plus a 500 ms → 15 s backoff. **Verified:** 48/48 unit, 1401/1401 downstream, and an A/B that reproduces the freeze on the pre-fix bundle.

discussions.title: [0.1.6-alpha.2] Source-mode (tsx) breaks every tool call: profile resolution loads lib/, tsx paths load src/
discussions.body:
### Summary

Launching dsh from source — `pnpm dsh ...`, i.e. `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts` — makes
**every tool call fail**:

```
UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
  at startCall (packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js:586:60)
  at fillPool (packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js:626:10)
  at runGroup (packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js:635:9)
  at executeToolCalls (packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js:528:25)
  at ReactLoopAgent.step (packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js:1116:33)
```

The **same build** launched through the compiled entry (`node apps/cli/lib/bin.js ...`) works fine.

### Environment

- dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2` (`ddefc45fbc`)
- Node `v24.18.0`, pnpm `11.7.0`, tsx `4.22.4`
- repo built beforehand (`pnpm build`), so `packages/*/lib/index.js` exists
- Windows host; the mechanism below is platform-independent

### Steps to reproduce

```bash
pnpm install && pnpm build

# ❌ fails on the first tool call
pnpm dsh --profile headless "read package.json and reply with its name"

# ✅ same task, same build, compiled entry
node apps/cli/lib/bin.js --profile headless "read package.json and reply with its name"
```

### Root cause

Plugin entry resolution and the plugin's own internal imports go through **two different resolvers**,
so one package gets instantiated twice:

| Resolver | Applied to | Lands on |
|---|---|---|
| profile resolution generation table (install-form resolution via `package.json#exports`) | plugin rows mounted by the Loader | `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js` |
| tsx hooks honouring `tsconfig.base.json` `paths` | ordinary `import` inside plugin code, e.g. `packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js` | `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` |

Evidence 1 — resolution in source mode:

```
$ node --import tsx/esm --input-type=module -e \
  "console.log(import.meta.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools', 'file:///path/to/repo/packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js'))"
file:///path/to/repo/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts
```

Evidence 2 — the service instance actually injected into `ctx.tools` is the `lib/` class:

```
lib.ToolRuntime === src.ToolRuntime          → false
ctx.tools instanceof lib.ToolRuntime         → true
ctx.tools instanceof src.ToolRuntime         → false
```

`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463` declares the contract with a per-replica symbol:

```ts
export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol = Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')
```

`Symbol()` — not `Symbol.for()` — is unique per module instance, so in the agent-loop copy
`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined` and `undefined.prepare(exec)` throws.
This is the only cross-package `unique symbol = Symbol(...)` contract in the repo today
(`grep -rn "unique symbol = Symbol(" packages vendor`).

Regression window: `6aa2e4633c feat(boot): add profile resolution modes` (2026-09-13) introduced the
generation table that routes plugin rows to the install form. Before it, the Loader's own resolution
also went through tsx, so both sides landed on `src/` and matched. (Inferred from the mechanism and
the commit date — not bisected.)

### Secondary damage: one failed call bricks the session

Because the call is appended (`tool/call`) before the failure, the session log keeps an assistant
`tool_use` with no `tool_result`. Every later request in that session is then rejected:

```
INVALID_REQUEST: DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results
  (packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/serialize.ts:117)
```

Recovery requires starting a new session.

### Suggested fix (either)

1. **Unify resolution in source mode** — make the profile resolution table resolve workspace packages
   to `src/` under tsx (or keep tsx out of plugin-code resolution), so one package has one instance.
2. **Make the contract replica-safe** — `Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')`. This is a
   one-line change and also guards against future duplicate-instance setups (workers, packaged forms).

Option 2 alone removes the crash; option 1 addresses the underlying duplication.

### Workaround

Run the compiled entry until this is fixed:

```bash
node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web
```

discussions.title: Right sidebar slide desyncs from the conversation track under main-thread load (seam on collapse, overlap on open)
discussions.body:
### What happens

Collapsing/expanding the right sidebar panel can visibly desync from the conversation column:

- **Collapse**: the panel slides out faster than the conversation's right edge expands, exposing a bare vertical seam between the two (very visible with translucent/wallpaper themes).
- **Expand**: the panel slides in faster than the conversation yields, so the translucent panel stacks over the conversation and the overlap visibly darkens for the duration of the slide.

The desync scales with main-thread load: it reproduces clearly on a heavy 30-turn session and is essentially invisible on a fresh one — it reads as "however laggy the frame is".

### Why (from the source)

The panel animates `transform` (`translateX(100%) ↔ none`) — compositor-side — while the conversation makes room via `grid-template-columns` easing on `.frame` (main thread; `ui-layout` AppFrame.module.css). Both use `--ds-transition-duration-slow` / `--ds-ease-in-out`, so they only stay aligned while the main thread keeps up. The `SidebarRight.module.css` comment states the intent: "the panel's left edge and the conversation's right edge therefore travel together".

The left sidebar never shows this because its collapse is a single-source animation: content freezes at expanded width, fades in place, and the moving grid track only clips it (`ui-sidebar` SidebarRoot — "nothing reflows mid-slide").

### Environment

macOS arm64, local build 0.1.6-alpha.2. Greatly amplified by the community theme `dsh-any-background` (translucent surfaces + backdrop-filter), but the desync exists under stock styling too — it is just invisible against opaque surfaces.

### Expectation

Panel slide and track easing staying glued together regardless of load (same-thread/same-frame sampling, or a single animation source). The left sidebar's approach is the reference for what "never desyncs" looks like.

Happy to provide a screen recording if useful.

discussions.title: 关于目前的sdk有几方面比较明显的功能缺失
discussions.body:
1. 在绝大部分开发场景下，sdk作为客户端直接接入运行中的dsh实例都是最为轻量也最符合直觉的方式。然而目前的sdk的思路是直接在子线程中启动dsh服务实例，于是这个dsh实例完全与sdk所在的应用系统绑定在一起了，若希望构建稳定可靠的系统，这几乎是不可接受的。
2. 在DeepSeekHarness生命周期内无法动态修改workspace，而在web端可以随时指定新的workspace，这个功能应该是容易做到的。我查看了关于runtime_cwd的逻辑，感觉这个参数也并不“runtime”。
3. sdk需要建立某种机制来获得dsh实例中产生的`事件`，目前这种约等于黑盒函数的状态很难满足真实业务场景的需求。
