discussions.title: [Bug] Official npm quickstart fails with ETARGET: missing sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3
discussions.body:
## Problem
Following the official README's npm quickstart, `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` fails before the Web UI starts:

```text
Need to install the following packages:
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2

npm error code ETARGET
npm error notarget No matching version found for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3.
```

Official instructions: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#run-from-npm

## Environment
- macOS (Darwin 25.4.0)
- Node.js v24.21.0
- npm 11.19.0
- Registry: https://registry.npmjs.org/
- Observed: September 22, 2026

## Reproduction
Run the documented command in a directory without a package manifest or dependency overrides:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Expected: installation succeeds and the Web UI starts.
Actual: npm exits with ETARGET.

## Registry evidence / likely cause
At the time of reporting:
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: latest = `0.1.5-rc.2`, next = `0.1.5-rc.3`.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@^0.1.5-rc.2`.
- That caret range permits `0.1.5-rc.3`.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3` depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3`.
- The document-preview package publishes `0.1.5-rc.1` and `0.1.5-rc.2`, but no `0.1.5-rc.3`. Its newer published versions are prereleases of different release tuples and do not satisfy this range.

These commands expose the mismatch:

```sh
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags --json
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 dependencies --json
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3 dependencies --json
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview versions --json
```

## Verified workaround
A separate local installation with the CLI and its transitive `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` packages (208 DeepSeek packages total) pinned to exactly `0.1.5-rc.2` using npm overrides installs successfully. After the dependency install scripts run, `dsh --version` returns `0.1.5-rc.2`, and the authenticated Web UI loads on localhost. Native PTY command execution also succeeds.

Pinning only the top-level CLI would still leave its caret dependency ranges able to resolve to rc.3.

## Suggested fix
Please publish a complete compatible package set for the affected release (including the missing document-preview package), and consider exact internal prerelease dependency versions plus a clean-registry installation smoke test before promoting releases. The documented latest install should not resolve to an incomplete next release.

## Related reports
I searched Discussions for ETARGET. #6168, #2991, and #3461 describe similar missing-package publication failures in earlier releases; this report concerns the current rc.2 → rc.3 document-preview dependency mismatch.

discussions.title: Windows: the JSONL session lease evaluates the POSIX fs-ext binding at import (fix on a fork branch)
discussions.body:
**Symptom.** On Windows, loading `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` evaluates the POSIX-only `fs-ext` native binding, because `src/lease.ts` imports `flock` at module top level. The Windows lease path never calls it (it holds a named kernel semaphore through `win32.ts`), so a host without a usable fs-ext build fails at import time, before any lock is attempted.

**Fix, on a fork branch since PRs are closed:** https://github.com/zvt-pareidolia/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/lease-lazy-fs-ext (single commit, two files).

- `src/lease.ts`: the `fs-ext` import moves inside the POSIX-only `flockAsync` as a dynamic import, so it runs on the first lock attempt and only on POSIX hosts. Locking, unlock and cleanup paths are unchanged. The web preview stub still resolves through the existing Vite alias.
- `tests/lease-module-loading.spec.ts`: regression test that mocks `fs-ext` to throw on evaluation and asserts the lease module still loads on Windows.

**Testing.** Windows 10: `lease-module-loading.spec.ts` and `lease.spec.ts`, 11 passed, 9 skipped (the POSIX cases). Pre-push typecheck passed. The POSIX cases are exercised by the repository's own CI on the fork.

Happy to adjust anything if the maintainers want to pick it up.

discussions.title: 【Web 客户端】在不解析非特殊 scheme authority 的引擎上,文件预览一律显示「文件资源服务不可用」
@deepseek-ai/dsh is uninstallable on both `latest` and `next` — rc.3 wave shipped dsh-web-app requiring a `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3` leaf that was never published
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

As of **2026-09-22T06:28Z**, the README's documented install command fails on a clean machine for **both** promoted dist-tags:

| dist-tag | version | state |
|---|---|---|
| `latest` | `0.1.5-rc.2` | ❌ ETARGET (broken **retroactively** at 05:53Z today) |
| `next` | `0.1.5-rc.3` | ❌ ETARGET (broken since it was tagged) |
| `alpha` | `0.1.7-alpha.1` | ✅ installs and runs |

All failures are the same missing leaf:

```
npm error notarget No matching version found for
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3.
```

Two independent defects, both in the publish pipeline (not in the code):

1. **The `0.1.5-rc.3` wave published its parents but never published that leaf.** `dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3` was published declaring `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3`, which does not exist on the registry — and still does not.
2. **Carets on intra-monorepo prerelease deps make old releases break retroactively.** `dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` (the `latest` tag) declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@^0.1.5-rc.2`; that range floats to today's `0.1.5-rc.3`, which requires the missing leaf. So `latest` became uninstallable two days after it was published, with zero republishes.

A third, latent issue: the wave itself is racy — parents are published *before* leaves (observed live: parent at 06:21:56Z, leaf at 06:22:16Z), and a dist-tag was promoted while its own tarball still 404'd.

Recurring, not new: #2991, #3461, #5969, #6168, #7135, #7362 are the same class of report. #6168 is literally the same ETARGET on `0.1.5-rc.1`.

## Environment

- Windows 11, `node v24.14.0`, `npm 11.9.0`, clean npm cache, no prior `@deepseek-ai/*` install
- Reproduced identically on macOS 15 / Node 22 / npm 10.9.8 (per #7135)

## Reproduction

```sh
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

```
Need to install the following packages:
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2
Ok to proceed? (y) y
npm error code ETARGET
npm error notarget No matching version found for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3.
npm error notarget In most cases you or one of your dependencies are requesting
npm error notarget a package version that doesn't exist.
```

Same result for `@deepseek-ai/dsh@latest`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh@next`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` directly.

## Evidence (registry.npmjs.org, 2026-09-22T06:05–06:28Z)

### 1. dist-tags and published versions of the missing leaf

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh
  latest = 0.1.5-rc.2   next = 0.1.5-rc.3   alpha = 0.1.7-alpha.1

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview
  latest = 0.1.5-alpha.2   next = 0.1.5-rc.2   alpha = 0.1.7-alpha.1
  versions = 0.1.5-alpha.2, 0.1.5-rc.1, 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.6-alpha.1, 0.1.6-alpha.2, 0.1.7-alpha.1
  → 0.1.5-rc.3 was never published (the leaf skipped the entire rc.3 line)
```

### 2. The rc.3 wave: parents published, leaf skipped

From the `time` field of each package:

```
05:41:09Z  dsh-app-boot@0.1.5-rc.3
05:48:17Z  dsh-base@0.1.5-rc.3
05:53:17Z  dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3        -> requires dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3
05:55:20Z  dsh@0.1.5-rc.3
05:55:48Z  dsh-client-web@0.1.5-rc.3
   —       dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3   ← never published
```

### 3. Why the "stable" `latest` tag broke retroactively

```sh
$ npm view "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@^0.1.5-rc.2" version
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.2 '0.1.5-rc.2'
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3 '0.1.5-rc.3'      # ← npm picks this one

$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3 dependencies
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview": "^0.1.5-rc.3"
```

`^0.1.5-rc.2` accepts `0.1.5-rc.3` (same `[0.1.5]` tuple, so prerelease matching applies), and `0.1.5-rc.3` of the web app needs a leaf that does not exist. Result: `dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` — published 2026-09-10, untouched since — became uninstallable at 05:53Z today the instant the new wave landed. Any user of `latest`, any CI, and any npm mirror that lags the registry sees this.

### 4. Latent: each wave is racy, and tags are promoted before artifacts exist

Observed live on the alpha wave (same publish job):

```
06:21:56Z  dsh-web-app@0.1.7-alpha.1                    -> requires documentpreview@^0.1.7-alpha.1
06:22:16Z  dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.7-alpha.1   (+20s)
```

For those 20 seconds, every install of that wave dies with the same ETARGET. Additionally, at 06:27:13Z the `alpha` tag already pointed at `0.1.7-alpha.1` while its own tarball was not yet fetchable:

```
$ curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh/-/dsh-0.1.7-alpha.1.tgz
404
```

(`npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@alpha` succeeded a moment later — 512 packages, `dsh --version` → `0.1.7-alpha.1` — so this window closed, but it demonstrates tag-before-artifact ordering.)

## Impact

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` is at ~**353,089 downloads/week**; `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` is the only install command the README documents, and it fails out of the box right now.
- `next` currently points at a tree that can never resolve; `latest` points at a tree that broke retroactively — so there is no "known good" stable entry point to recommend.
- Also blocks offline/lagging mirrors and phones-home style installers, which cannot be fixed by "just retry later" (see the registry-mirror discussion in #3461).

## Suggested fixes (publish pipeline, in priority order)

1. **Publish the wave atomically, leaves first.** Topologically sort (leaf plugin packages → app bundles → CLI) and only promote dist-tags once the entire wave is resolvable.
2. **Gate every dist-tag promotion on a resolvability smoke test.** From a clean directory: `npm install --dry-run --no-audit @deepseek-ai/dsh@<tag>`; the ETARGET shows up in under 30 s. Run it for `latest` / `next` / `alpha` before/after `npm dist-tag add`. A `dsh`-shipped `install-doctor` (#3469) would be a good home for this check on the user side, but it must run in CI on the publish side to be preventive.
3. **Roll back a broken tag instead of leaving it promoted.** If a wave fails, point the tags at the last known-good versions (`npm dist-tag add @deepseek-ai/dsh@<prev> next`) and `npm deprecate` the unresolvable version with a pointer. Today `next` has been pointing at an unresolvable tree since 05:55Z.
4. **Stop using prerelease carets for intra-monorepo deps.** `^0.1.5-rc.2` means "any 0.1.5 prerelease ≥ rc.2", so every new wave retroactively invalidates every earlier release of the same line. Either pin exactly (`0.1.5-rc.3`) or let `pnpm publish` rewrite `workspace:*` to exact versions. Exact pins also make the release self-consistent when a wave is partially published.
5. **Publish the tarball before promoting the tag** (the 06:27Z 404 on `dsh-0.1.7-alpha.1.tgz` while `alpha` already pointed at it).
6. **Give the leaf packages a publish check of their own** — a package that is a dependency of a released parent but has no matching version for the wave is exactly what a "wave completeness" assertion would catch.

## Workaround for users right now

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@alpha web        # currently 0.1.7-alpha.1 — verified installing and running
# or pin:
npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2
```

Verified on this machine: `npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@alpha` → `added 512 packages`, `./node_modules/.bin/dsh --version` → `0.1.7-alpha.1`, `dsh web --help` OK. `latest` / `next` still fail as of 06:28Z.

## Related reports (same class)

- #2991 — `0.1.0-rc.6` declares an unpublished dependency
- #3461 — `0.1.0-rc.8` not installable (missing `dsh-agent-loop@^0.1.0-rc.8`)
- #5969 — monolith prerelease ranges cannot select published siblings
- #6168 — `0.1.5-rc.1` global install fails with ETARGET on an unpublished `dsh-util-crypto@^0.1.5-rc.1`
- #7135 — `0.1.5-rc.2` ships incomplete `dependencies` + stale `dist-tags.latest`
- #7362 — imports a symbol from a protocol version that was never published

Happy to re-run the checks and post a follow-up with the fixed state if it helps close this out.

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-diagram｜把会话里的文章变成能继续修改的画布
discussions.body:
> **非官方插件，由社区成员独立开发和维护；不代表 DeepSeek 官方项目或推荐。** 我是这个插件的维护者。

项目地址：https://github.com/hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram

读完一篇方案或复盘后，我经常还想调整图里的节点、措辞和布局。dsh-diagram 把当前 DSH 会话中的文章整理成 Excalidraw 画布：Agent 创建初始结构，你在同一会话的「画布」里继续修改、自动保存并导出；需要继续讨论时，再让 Agent 读回当前画布。

## 0.6.0：分类多的时候，先看全貌，再读明细

一份分类资料有几十个条目，硬挤在一张树图里就很难读。0.6.0 新增「分类总览 + 完整明细」：先看每类有多少项，再点「阅读明细」按宽度查看；文字和图形仍可在画布中修改。

[![0.6.0 原生画布导出：9 个分类、40 个末级条目](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram/f0fa166c854dff02ea3a43864440232a58ecaf22/stable-0.6.0/atlas-example.png)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram/f0fa166c854dff02ea3a43864440232a58ecaf22/stable-0.6.0/atlas-example.png)

这个例子使用固定的 ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Figure 2 分类输入，50 个节点、49 条关系，展示确定性排版；不代表已经自动转换整份 PDF，中文标签是工作译文。

选中 **canvas-diagram** 后，可以对已有分类内容发送：

```text
请把上面的分类内容做成可编辑的分类总览和完整明细。
如果原文是一个根、分类、末级条目的三层树，使用 diagram_create，
kind: hierarchy、composition: atlas，保留所有标签、说明和关系。
如果存在交叉关系或更深层级，改用其他图型，不要为了套图集删掉内容。
```

图集适用于没有分组的三层分类树。循环、多父节点、更深层级和没有条目的分类不适用；手改重复标签或数量不会自动同步，连线不会自动重新排版。

## 编辑、保存与导出

下面是 **已发布 0.5.0 的真实 DSH 操作片段**：放大修改一个节点，观察已保存状态，再展示实际导出的结果。片段经过裁切和近景放大，不展示模型生成等待，也不是用动画重画的产品界面。

![在 DSH 中修改节点、保存并导出](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram/0d74a27d902160305099fb8cf2db958a77394b65/stable-0.5.0/readme-workflow.gif)

这张图来自一次发布复盘，内容按「准备／分发／验证」整理。文字与排版在画布里手动调整后，直接导出为 PNG：

![实际导出的三阶段报告](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram/0d74a27d902160305099fb8cf2db958a77394b65/stable-0.5.0/release-report.png)

## 在你的 DSH 中试一次

**DSH Desktop：** 打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入 `dsh-diagram@0.6.1`，点安装后「立即启用」。

**DSH Web（终端）：** 前置为 Node.js `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24`，PATH 中有 pnpm `>=10`，Web 需绑定 `127.0.0.1`。0.6.1 已在当前 npm latest 的 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` 上真实走通生成、手改、保存、导出；`0.1.5-rc.1`/`0.1.5-rc.2` 仍可用，只需替换下面的 DSH 版本号。

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-diagram@0.6.1
# 已安装的用户：
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2 plugin --profile web update dsh-diagram@0.6.1
```

注意：0.6.0 及更早版本不支持 DSH 0.1.7，安装会被拒绝，请直接装 0.6.1。

重启 DSH Web（Desktop 启用后无需重启），让当前会话先读到一篇文章；输入 `/`，选择 **canvas-diagram**，然后发送：

```text
把上面的文章整理成一张图，只保留三个主要步骤，每个节点用短句。
请使用画布，我需要继续修改和导出。
```

打开顶部「画布」，改一处文字，等到「已保存」，再导出 PNG、SVG 或 `.excalidraw`。如果希望 Agent 基于你的修改继续讨论，可以说：

```text
请调用 diagram_read 读取当前画布，再根据我手动改过的内容继续分析。
```

插件通过 DSH bundle 注册生成/读取工具、canvas-diagram 技能和会话画布标签；图表存在插件自己的持久化存储中。它不负责抓取文章，也不是 Mermaid 代码块渲染器。0.5.0 的预览可能收在工具调用组里，展开工具组或直接打开「画布」即可；Session fork/export 不会复制画布数据。

## 想收集的反馈

欢迎拿一篇你自己正在处理的文章试用。最有帮助的是：

- 是否完成了「生成 → 手改 → 保存 → 导出」；如果没完成，卡在哪一步？
- 哪一类内容值得你第二次使用：技术方案、项目复盘、学习笔记，还是其他？

反馈可直接回在本帖，或到仓库提 Issue。贴图和日志前请去掉密钥、私人文章和本机路径。

discussions.title: sessionQuery.readEvent clones the whole log per call: a documented bounded read costs O(log length), stalling the Host (~257 s on a 4374-event session)
discussions.body:
## Summary

`sessionQuery.readEvent` is documented as "one full event plus a **bounded** raw-log window", but its implementation resolved the source through `SessionCorpus.load`, which detaches the **complete** log. Every single-event read therefore deep-cloned every event in the session.

A point read hides this. A per-seq scan is quadratic, and because it runs on the single Node thread it stops the whole Host from answering HTTP.

## Measured impact

On a 4374-event session (1682 surface nodes):

| Quantity | Value |
| :--- | ---: |
| Full-log `structuredClone` per `readEvent` | **76.5 ms** |
| Nodes × passes in one repair scan | 1682 × 2 |
| Blocked main-thread time | **~257 s** |
| After the fix (`O(window)`) | milliseconds |

Observed symptom: sending one message in a long-lived session pinned one core and made **every** HTTP request time out (the Web GUI showed all requests pending and conversation history would not load). The process stayed alive; only the event loop was blocked.

An 18 s CPU profile taken during the stall put **89.8 % of samples inside `structuredClone`**, and a `structuredClone` tracer confirmed the call chain:

```
readSessionEvent        (a plugin calling the documented bounded read, once per surface node)
  → sessionQuery.readEvent
  → SessionQueryEngine._readEvent
  → SessionCorpus.load          ← resolves the full log
  → snapshotLive                ← snapshotEvents().map(e => structuredClone(e))
```

The window itself was always small (`before`/`after` default to `0`), so the retained result was one event — copied at the price of the entire log.

## Root cause

`_readEvent` needed a header, an inherited-event count, one target event, and a bounded slice. It obtained them from `load`, whose contract is to detach everything:

```ts
const loaded = await this._corpus.load(sessionId, signal)   // clones every event
const target = loaded.events[seq]
const events = loaded.events.slice(startSeq, endSeq + 1).map(snapshotSessionEvent)
```

The copy is `O(log length)` per call, and the documented contract promises `O(window)`. Any consumer reading one seq at a time pays the difference.

## Fix (already implemented locally)

Split resolution from copying:

- `SessionCorpus.borrow` resolves the same live-first source as `load` **without copying** it; `load` is now `borrow` plus the detaching copy.
- `_readEvent` calls `borrow` and snapshots only the retained window.
- `snapshotLive` became dead code and was deleted.

Borrowing is safe because both sources are already immutable: a live Session returns its deeply frozen snapshot, and a persisted read owns the events it just materialized. The observable `SessionEventWindow` contract is unchanged — callers still receive a cloned header, cloned target, and cloned window events.

Verification: the package's 99 tests pass, typecheck passes, `corpus.ts`/`index.ts` reach 100 % coverage, and a new regression test asserts `readEvent` calls `borrow` once and never calls `load` — it fails against the previous full-log implementation (negative control verified).

## Why this is worth reporting even though a plugin triggered it

The triggering plugin was calling a documented bounded read exactly as advertised. The defect is the contract/implementation mismatch in `session-query`, so it will affect the next per-seq reader too — the Host's own history paths go through `readEvent` as well. A consumer-side workaround (batching or caching in the caller) leaves the trap armed for everyone else.

Since this repository does not accept external pull requests, I am reporting it here with the fix and evidence. Happy to provide the patch, tests, and the Agent Note on request.

## Environment

- DSH web profile, source launch (`apps/cli/src/bin.ts` via tsx)
- Windows 11, Node 24
- `packages/session-query/session-query` at `7111db7281`

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 / rc.3 not installable: missing @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3
discussions.body:
## Description

`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` (latest = 0.1.5-rc.2) currently fails with ETARGET on the official npm registry.

## Reproduction

```
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
```

```
npm error code ETARGET
npm error notarget No matching version found for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3.
```

Reproduced on Windows and in a clean Linux environment (Node 22.22.2, npm 10.9.7), registry: https://registry.npmjs.org

## Root cause

- The 0.1.5-rc.3 release set was published at 2026-09-22T05:55Z.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3` depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3`.
- That version was never published. Available versions of documentpreview: 0.1.5-alpha.2, 0.1.5-rc.1, 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.6-alpha.1, 0.1.6-alpha.2, 0.1.7-alpha.1.
- Because `dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` (the `latest` tag) declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@^0.1.5-rc.2`, the caret range resolves to the broken rc.3, so **the `latest` install is broken too**, not only `@next`.

## Workarounds

- `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@alpha` (0.1.7-alpha.1) resolves correctly.
- Local install with `"overrides": { "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app": "0.1.5-rc.2" }` also resolves.

## Suggested fix

Publish `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3`, or deprecate `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3`.

Possibly the same class of issue as #3461 (rc.8 missing dsh-agent-loop). A CI check that verifies every package in a release set is published before tagging might prevent this.

discussions.body:
**Describe the bug**
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web cannot install. The published main package @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 declares a dependency on @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3, but that version has never been published to npm. npm resolves the range, finds no matching version, and the install aborts with ETARGET.

npm error code ETARGET

The package @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview exists on npm, but its version list contains no 0.1.5-rc.3. This looks like a missed publish / version mismatch in the release pipeline for the 0.1.5-rc.2 tag.
**Expected**
The publish pipeline for @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 publishes every workspace sub-package at the matching version (or the main package pins a range that actually exists), so npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web installs cleanly.

discussions.title: opencode-go provider fails with 400 MissingSessionID — pi-ai needs upgrade to >= 0.87.0 (x-opencode-session header)
discussions.body:
## Symptom

Every request through the `opencode-go` provider fails with:

```
400 {"type":"MissingSessionID","message":"Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently. Please see https://opencode.ai/docs/go/#where-can-i-use-it"}
```

Reproduced in DSH Desktop 2.0.10 (Windows) with any opencode-go model — both agent runs and automatic session-title generation.

## Root cause

OpenCode Zen Go now requires the `x-opencode-session` header for per-conversation routing. Support for it was added in **@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.87.0** (`dist/providers/opencode-headers.js`, `withOpenCodeSessionHeader` wrapping all APIs in `opencode.js` / `opencode-go.js`, released 2026-09-21).

`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/package.json` on `master` still pins:

```json
"@earendil-works/pi-ai": "^0.85.1"
```

which resolves to <0.86.0, so the header is never sent.

## Suggested fix

Bump the dependency to `^0.87.0`. The harness side already passes `sessionId` through to pi-ai (`dsh-llm-pi-ai` forwards `options.sessionId`, and `dsh-session-title-llm` sets `sessionId: request.session.id`), so no harness code change is needed beyond the version bump.

Note 0.87.0 also bumps `@google/genai` 1.x → 2.x and `http-proxy-agent`/`https-proxy-agent` 7 → 9, so a quick regression pass on the google/bedrock paths may be warranted.

## Local workaround (confirmed working)

Backported `opencode-headers.js` into the installed pi-ai 0.85.1 and wrapped the opencode/opencode-go APIs with `withOpenCodeSessionHeader()` — fixes the 400s until the dependency is upgraded.

(Issues are disabled on this repo, so posting here.)

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-remote-explorer｜把 dsh 装到远程主机运行
discussions.body: # DSH｜dsh-remote-explorer｜把 dsh 装到远程主机运行，本机只留浏览器，LLM 凭据不离开本机 > 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。 > Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members. **项目地址：** https://github.com/btsd321/dsh-remote-explorer **项目介绍：** `dsh-remote-explorer` 是一个远程开发启动器，同时是一个合法的 dsh 插件包（单包双形态）。它把官方 dsh 安装到你的远程主机（Linux / macOS，经 SSH 连接）上运行，会话与代码都在远端；本机只保留一个管理界面和浏览器窗口——参照 VS Code Remote-SSH / Zed / JetBrains Gateway 的架构。 核心能力： - **凭据不出本机**：远端 dsh 的模型调用经 SSH 反向隧道回到本机的凭据代理注入真实 API key；远端进程环境里只有占位令牌，落盘的也只有令牌（600 权限），真实 key 全程不离开本机 - **远程会话管理**：左导航「远程 SSH 会话」全局面板——选主机（读 `~/.ssh/config`，支持跳板机链）、两种窗口形态连接（当前标签切入远端窗口 / 新标签）、断开、实时进度日志；会话带心跳与自动重连 - **远端窗口交接**：远端 dsh 界面侧栏有一枚状态 pill（主机名 + 状态点），点开可看连接状态与进度日志、返回本地管理页、或「关闭连接 / 停止远端并返回」——对齐 VS Code 的 Close Remote Connection 体验 - **远端插件管理**：远端账号级的插件仓库（对标 `~/.vscode-server/extensions`），本地面板与远端窗口自带的插件 UI 两个表面都能装/卸/启停远端 dsh 的插件，热生效 - **多用户可预期**：不同远程 OS 账号完全隔离；同账号共享会话（多人多视图）；`kill --all` / `clean` 按发起者指纹 scope，不会误杀别人的会话 - **远端隔离契约**：本工具在远端的一切落盘都在 `~/.dsh-remote-explorer/` 单根内，从不写入远端共享的 `~/.dsh` 与 `~/.npm`；完全卸载一条 `rm -rf` **与 DSH 的集成方式：** - **插件形态**（主推荐）：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-explorer` 安装进本机 dsh。bundle patch 向 cordis 层栈注入宿主 entry；浏览器半作为 `dsh.client`（platform `web`）模块经 slots 注册全局面板（`sidebar.panellist` + `main` 槽）与远端窗口状态 pill（`sidebar.footer.action` / `shell.overlay`）；面板路由全部走 `connection.fetch.register` 的已鉴权通道（`/api/dsh-remote-explorer/*`）；另注册 slash 命令 `/remote-ssh` 与 `remote_*` agent 工具（受 dsh 工具审批门槛约束） - **会话编排复用 dsh 本体**：远端装的是官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` npm 包，每会话独立 `DSH_HOME`（settings / 凭据引用 / profiles 全隔离）；远端 dsh 自带的令牌 + Cookie 认证原样使用，本工具只做令牌捕获与隧道转发 - **CLI 形态**：同一套编排的独立命令行（`npx dsh-remote-explorer connect <主机>`），与插件形态共享会话表、互相可见对方维持的会话 - peer 依赖范围 `^0.1.5-rc.2 || ^0.1.6-0`，在 dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2 上完整实测（含 OrangePI aarch64 真机） **安装与体验：** ```bash # 插件形态（需 PATH 上有 pnpm） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-explorer # CLI 形态 npm i -g dsh-remote-explorer dsh-remote-explorer connect myhost --cwd /home/you/project ``` **截图：** 1. 全局面板：左导航「远程 SSH 会话」—— 2. 连接表单（双窗口形态按钮）、会话表、远端插件区、进度日志 3. 远端窗口状态 pill 与管理菜单（连接状态 / 进度日志 / 返回管理页 / 关闭并返回 / 停止并返回） **兼容性与许可：** - 远端主机：Linux / macOS（POSIX）；本机客户端：Windows / Linux / macOS - dsh 版本：≥ 0.1.5-rc.2（peer 范围），实测 0.1.6-alpha.2；桌面版（Electron）机制上兼容但未实测 - 许可：Apache-2.0 欢迎 issue 与 PR。使用第三方项目前请自行甄别；本帖参与社区 Upvote 排序，不代表官方审核或推荐。

discussions.title: 一机一智，多机一队，One agent per machine. Many machines, one crew.
discussions.body:
每台电脑部署一个 Agent，多台电脑的多个 Agent 自动组成 Agent Team，统一管理、调度、协作完成任务。

当前问题：

多台电脑资源分散，无法统一调度 AI 能力和自动化任务。

单机 Agent 只能处理本机任务，无法跨机器协作。

多机协作缺少“团队”抽象：谁在线、谁能做什么、任务给谁、结果怎么汇总。

远程执行、文件处理、日志收集、批量部署等操作缺少统一 Agent 层。

多 Agent 协作通常停留在单机或云端，没有落到“每台电脑一个 Agent”的分布式场景。

典型使用场景：

我在多台电脑安装 Agent，它们自动加入我的 AgentCrew。

我能看到所有在线节点、系统信息、能力和健康状态。

我下发“收集所有机器日志”，系统自动分配并汇总结果。

我指定任务只在带 GPU 的机器上运行。

多 Agent 协作：规划 Agent 拆任务，执行 Agent 执行，汇总 Agent 输出报告。

某台电脑离线，任务自动重试或转移到其他节点。

敏感操作需要人工确认后执行。

我在 CLI 输入 crew run "检查所有节点磁盘空间"，得到汇总结果。

discussions.title: 0.1.7-alpha.1: legacy client service settingsScope silently removed — third-party plugins hang on boot and the failure surfaces as a misleading client-half failed
discussions.body:
Version: DSH `0.1.7-alpha.1` (npm, Windows 11, web profile). Upgraded from `0.1.6-alpha.2`.

## Symptom

After upgrading, multiple third-party plugins with `dsh.client.inject` fail:

- `@xgone/dsh-remote` 0.3.3 — entry permanently `pending (waiting for service: settingsScope)` (xgone/dsh-remote#20)
- `@dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification` 0.1.19 — `web boot: 1 entry did not activate ...: failed` (dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification#5)
- `@michengai/dsh-automation` 0.1.45 — abnormal after upgrade
- Only `dsh-cost-meter` 1.7.32 works

## What we verified (so the report doesn't chase the wrong direction)

- The client injection/module surface is **intact**: `dsh-client-modules` browser half is byte-identical (SHA256) between 0.1.6-alpha.2 and 0.1.7-alpha.1, and the manifests of all five plugins comply with the documented contract (`dsh.client.platform: "web"` + optional inject). The per-plugin failures have unrelated root causes (see linked issues).
- `settingsScope` appears **zero** times in the entire 0.1.7 package tree. 0.1.7 moved settings to per-profile plugin configuration (release notes: "custom settings plugins must adapt") and deleted the legacy client services **without an alias or shim**. `dsh-settings` now provides a service named `settings` whose document is the profile patch; `settings.yaml` is one-time imported (renamed `.imported`).
- Because a failed host-half fiber takes the whole plugin down, the Plugin Manager surfaces these as a misleading **"client-half failed"** shape, which misdirects debugging toward the (verified intact) injection surface.

## Requests

1. Keep a deprecated alias for removed legacy settings client services (`settingsScope`) for one release, **or** make the boot/Plugin-Manager diagnostic name the removed service (e.g. "service X was removed by the settings migration — see release notes") instead of a bare `pending`/`failed`.
2. Attribute activation failures to the failing half (host/client) with the waiting/throwing service name.

## Secondary (same migration family)

`dsh plugin` CLI exits 1 inside `runPluginCommand` (lib/plugin-DJ-rVHUS.js) already on 0.1.6-alpha.2, which broke dshmarket-driven installs/updates **before** the upgrade (log timestamps 2026-09-22 11:54–12:14 local, `.dsh-market/log.ndjson`); full stack available. The same package installs fine via direct `pnpm --dir <profile> add` (7.8 s once the store is warm).

## Linked per-plugin reports

- xgone/dsh-remote#20
- dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification#5

discussions.title: [Feature][Desktop] 希望官方尽快发布桌面端安装包（目前只有源码，公开渠道无成品包）
discussions.body:
## 诉求

希望官方尽快提供一个**可下载的官方桌面端安装包**（macOS dmg / Windows exe）。先以 alpha / nightly 的名义公开也可以，只要能下载安装。

## 现状核实（2026-09-22，逐个公开入口实测）

| 检查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| GitHub Releases（全部 15 个版本） | `assets` 全部为 0，从未挂过 dmg / zip / exe |
| 仓库 tag | 没有任何 `desktop-v*`（README 里写明生产桌面发布成功才会打这个 tag） |
| `.github/workflows/`（20 个 workflow） | 没有任何一个执行桌面打包或上传 |
| 官方落地页 www.deepseek.com/harness（中文/英文） | 页面里「桌面 / Desktop / 下载 / Download / dmg / macOS / Windows」出现 **0 次** |
| 官方文档 quickstart | 页面标题就是「使用 Web UI」，只讲 CLI / Web 安装 |
| 内部/测试源 `download-test.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/...` | 整段前缀 404（连 channel YAML 都没有）——另见 #7325 |

`apps/desktop/README.md` 里桌面发布是**手工流程**：`package:desktop:mac:arm64` → `upload:mac:arm64`（需要 COS 凭据），生产包上传后才打 `desktop-v<version>` tag。目前既没有这样的 tag，也没有公开对象。

## 用户侧情况（需求真实，且桌面壳已经有存量）

- 桌面端 bug 报告已经不少：macOS 缺 Edit 菜单导致 ⌘C/⌘V/⌘X/⌘A/⌘Z 全失效（#6695 #6770 #6893 #6915 #6937 #6551 #6522）、Windows 子进程 `0xC0000142` / `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`（#6884 #6944 #7381 #6822）、插件 host API 403（#6934）、更新弹窗空白卡死 UI（#7251）。
- 需求被反复提出、基本没看到公开回应：#6576（什么时候出官方桌面版）、#7261、#6388、#4781、#6143、#358。
- 社区至少四五个项目各自造了一遍壳（#358 那一串回复可见），重复投入不小。

## 具体请求

1. **公开一个官方桌面端下载入口**（Releases 附件或下载页都行），先给 alpha / nightly 也可以；希望至少覆盖 mac-arm64 与 win-x64。
2. **说明桌面的发布节奏**：文档写着「Electron 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 永远是同一版本，一次 dsh 升级就是一次桌面发布」，但目前 dsh 本体已到 `0.1.7-alpha.1`，桌面仍停在更早的测试版。想确认桌面是否会随版本同步发布。
3. **如果暂时不打算公开分发**，请在 README / 文档里明确写一句「桌面端暂不公开分发及获取方式」，省得大家反复猜（现在只能靠自己从源码构建）。
4. 若继续走 test / nightly 通道，希望能把更新 feed 的对象补齐（#7325）；0.1.7 起 test 发布路径改成了 `dsh-desk/<release-id>/feeds/<target>/`，已安装客户端指向的旧路径已经失效。

## 我的环境

macOS arm64；官方桌面壳 `0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.2`（当时从内部测试直链取得），对照 dsh 本体 `0.1.7-alpha.1`。

（了解此仓库关闭了 Issues、只用 Discussions，故发在此；若分类不合适请帮忙移动。）

---

**EN summary**: Please publish an official desktop build. The desktop source is in `apps/desktop`, but no public channel ships it: every one of the 15 GitHub releases has 0 assets, there are no `desktop-v*` tags, none of the 20 workflows package the desktop, and the official landing page and docs contain no desktop download. The internal test feed (`download-test.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/...`) returns 404. Test desktop builds are already in users' hands (many desktop bug reports) and 4-5 community projects ship their own shells. Asks: (1) a public download entry (alpha/nightly is fine), (2) state the desktop release cadence relative to `@deepseek-ai/dsh`, (3) if it is intentionally not public, document that, (4) fix the update feed (#7325).

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.5-rc.* 中任意一个版本都装不上：rc.3 是一次未完成的发布
discussions.body: # [Bug] 0.1.5-rc.* 中任意一个版本都装不上：rc.3 是一次未完成的发布 Like the English discusssions #7438, #7436. 这里我额外发现 **rc.2 也失败**。 ## 症状 不只是 rc.3，**任何 0.1.5-rc.\* 的安装都会失败**： ```console $ npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 npm error code ETARGET npm error notarget No matching version found for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3. ``` 注意报错了的依赖是 **rc.3**，而命令里装的是 rc.2。 ## 为什么装 rc.2 也会因为这个 rc.3 而失败 - `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` 声明的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@^0.1.5-rc.2`； - npm 在 `^0.1.5-rc.2` 这个范围里取**同 patch 段的最高版**，也就是 `0.1.5-rc.3`； - 而 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3` 要求 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3`，该版本从未发布 → ETARGET。 所以 rc.2 自己的依赖树是完好的，问题出在 rc.3 这个"半成品"上。**rc.3 已经把整条 rc 线污染了。** ## 证据一：把版本解析冻结在 rc.3 发布之前，同一条命令就能装上 ```console $ npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 --dry-run → exit 1，ETARGET (…@^0.1.5-rc.3) $ npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 --dry-run --before=2026-09-12 → exit 0 change @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 => 0.1.5-rc.2 …（整份安装计划都正常列出） ``` 同一个包、同一条命令，只把 `--before` 定在 rc.3 发布（2026-09-22T05:55Z）之前，就成功了。 ## 证据二：rc.3 在仓库里没有对应的 tag Tags 页当前最新是 `dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`，往前 `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2`、`dsh-v0.1.5-rc.1` 都在， **但没有 `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.3`**。而 npm 上 rc.3 这一批大部分包（含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 本身和 `dsh-web-app`）却已经发布。 两件事合起来看：**那是一次中途中断的发布** —— `npm publish` 已经跑了一部分，打 tag / 建 release 那一步没执行到。这也解释了为什么"漏发布"的恰恰是 rc.3，而不是有 tag 的 rc.2。 ## 建议 1. **补发** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3`。其余 rc.3 的包都已 在 npm 上，这是改动最小的一条。 2. **或撤回整批 rc.3**：`npm unpublish` 掉 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.3` 及同批已发布的包 （72 小时窗口内）。撤掉之后 `^0.1.5-rc.*` 会回落到 rc.2，整条线立即可用。 只撤 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 本身不够 —— 解析到 `dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.3` 一样会踩到缺的那个包。 ## 环境 Windows 11 / Node 22.22.2 / npm 12.0.2，registry 为官方 `https://registry.npmjs.org`（非镜像）。 Linux / WSL2 上亦可复现。

discussions.title: TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER 符号用裸 Symbol(...) 导致源码启动时模块双份副本间身份不一致
discussions.body:
## Summary

packages/core/tools/src/index.ts 中的跨模块身份键 TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER 用裸 Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler') 声明（当前 master 第 470 行）。

该键是"调度器实例写入 / 读取"的约定键：ToolRuntime 服务把调度器挂到这个键上，agent-loop 消费方通过 ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] 读取。在源码启动（tsx ESM hook / tsconfig paths→src）时，@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 的 src 平面与 npm exports→lib 产物平面两份模块可共存于同一进程，裸 Symbol 在这两份副本中是不等价的，导致读方取不到写方放入的值。

受影响场景：dsh 源码启动下运行含并行/独占工具调度的 agent-loop（读方会拿到 undefined）。

## Reproduction

触发条件（源码启动，src 平面与 lib 平面同时装载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools）：

dsh 通过 tsx 从源码启动；agent-loop 经 tsconfig paths 解析 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 到 src，拿到 Symbol('…') 的 src 副本。
Cordis 加载 ToolRuntime 服务时经 npm exports 解析 "."→lib/index.js，拿到产物平面 Symbol('…') 的另一实例。
两个 Symbol 不相等，ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] 读不到 ToolRuntime 写入的调度器（挂载点见 packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:798 的 [TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]）。
关键代码位置：

生产者：packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:470 声明，:798 用 [TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] 挂载调度器。
消费者：packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:17 导入，:153-154,:170,:174 调用 ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare/.dispatch/.finalize/.finish。
Current behavior

当 src 与 lib 两平面共存于同一进程时，消费侧取到 ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] === undefined，随后调用其 prepare/dispatch 方法触发运行时错误；若进程内恰好只有一份模块副本，则无异常——属于非确定性 / 环境相关故障。

## Expected behavior

无论 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 在进程内被加载多少份副本，写入方与读取方都应认到同一符号。用 Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler') 走全局符号注册表即可保证进程内身份一致；该键也符合仓库"跨模块身份型符号用 Symbol.for"的既有约定（例如 SHADOW = Symbol.for('cordis.shadow')）。

## Environment

源码启动（tsx ESM，tsconfig paths→src）+ 产物平面（npm exports→lib）共存。
任选运行 dsh 源码的 Node / macOS 环境即可复现。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: reveal (在文件资源管理器中显示无效) "Show in File Explorer" has no effect
discussions.body:
Summary

Windows 上点交付文件卡片的「在文件资源管理器中显示」，卡片提示成功，但屏幕上不出现任何文件夹窗口。explorer.exe 确实被启动、窗口也确实被创建，只是继承了 SW_HIDE 而不可见；每次点击还会留下一个常驻 explorer.exe 进程。

Reproduction

（每次都能复现）

  1. 让 agent 交付任意文件（present），得到一张交付文件卡片。
  2. 点卡片右侧箭头 →「在文件资源管理器中显示」。
  3. 卡片状态变为「已请求在文件管理器中显示」，但没有文件夹窗口出现。

Current behavior

explorer.exe 正常启动，CabinetWClass 窗口也被创建（位置、尺寸正常），但窗口 style 为 0x04CF0000，WS_VISIBLE 未置位，因此窗口不可见。explorer 退出码 0/1 被 revealNativePath 当作「已转交」接受，路由返回 204，前端据此显示成功。

根因：packages/util/native-command/src/runner.ts 的 runNativeCommand 固定传 windowsHide: true，libuv 把它落成 STARTUPINFO.dwFlags |= STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + wShowWindow = SW_HIDE；src/path-opener.ts 的 revealNativePath 随后执行 explorer.exe /select,<file-uri>，explorer 在自己进程里建窗并继承该隐藏状态。

最小 A/B 验证（同一台机器，每次用全新目录避免 Explorer 复用已有窗口）：

explorer.exe 启动方式 | 新建窗口 IsWindowVisible -- | -- STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE（=windowsHide: true） | False SW_SHOWNORMAL / 无显示标志（=windowsHide: false） | True

建议修复（本地实测有效）：

diff
-const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal, windowsHide = true) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
-		windowsHide: true
+		windowsHide
@@ revealNativePath
-			await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
+			await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal, false);

默认值保持 true，其余调用方不受影响；explorer.exe 是 GUI 程序，取消隐藏不会带来控制台闪窗。

Expected behavior

Explorer 打开该文件所在目录并选中该文件；「成功」提示应意味着窗口真的可见。

Environment

  • DSH Desktop 2.0.13（固定并原样运行上游版本）；@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.5-rc.2
  • Windows 10 Pro 22H2，build 19045.6466
  • 入口：交付文件卡片菜单 →「在文件资源管理器中显示」（win32 revealNativePath）
  • Explorer「在单独进程中打开文件夹窗口」为关闭（SeparateProcess = 0），排除该设置干扰

关联

检索上游 Discussions 与官方 Windows 排障手册，未发现同一缺陷的已有讨论。需与三条区分：

  • #1344：同一 Windows 机制（STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE）的反向用法——为沙箱子进程隐藏控制台；本缺陷是该约定落到 GUI 子进程上的副作用。
  • #1098：反向症状（漏设 windowsHide 导致无控制台宿主弹 PowerShell 窗口）；该帖把 dsh-native-command 的 windowsHide: true 当作「已正确设置」。
  • #3463：Windows「打开配置目录」失败，走同一条 openWindowsPath 路径，但归因于原生目录选择器的 readUtf16 截断（#3188 / #3279 / #3291 / #3442），非本缺陷。

上游笔记 2026-08-18-tool-row-file-open-failure 已把「被吞掉的拒绝」定为缺陷，但只覆盖拒绝；本缺陷是「成功但窗口不可见」，仍无任何提示。

discussions.title: [Windows] Wrong path passed to read after glob
discussions.body:
Windows · latest DSH (2026-09-22) · `dsh web` · `qwen3.8-27b`

After `glob`, the model keeps dropping an `n` from the path passed to `read`. Example with dummy folder names: `C:\new\node\file.txt` becomes `C:\new\ode\file.txt`.

I suspect `\n` is being misread. Could the prompt use `/` for ordinary Windows cwd paths, while keeping the native path for execution? [Pi already does this](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/95fbc04997eaee961eb673fa7923e9220609ebd5/packages/coding-agent/src/core/system-prompt.ts#L170).

discussions.title: 任务的展示进度和实际进度不一致
settings.yaml legacy import: file is renamed before sections are imported, so a failed import silently loses all settings
discussions.body:
## Version

0.1.7-alpha.1 (dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1)

## Summary

The one-time `settings.yaml` import introduced in 0.1.7 renames the file to `settings.yaml.imported` **before** attempting to import any section. If the running composition cannot accept one or more sections on that boot (e.g. the first boot after upgrade has a plugin entry that fails to activate or stays pending), every rejected section is only logged as a warning, the original file is already gone, and the import never retries — because the file no longer exists on the next boot.

Net effect: a transient first-boot problem turns into **permanent, silent loss of the entire settings.yaml** (model providers, default model, permission presets, plugin settings), with no recovery path other than manual reconstruction.

## Reproduction

1. On 0.1.6, have a populated `settings.yaml` (e.g. LLM provider definitions, agent default model, permission presets).
2. Upgrade to 0.1.7-alpha.1 such that the **first** boot of a profile has any plugin entry that fails to activate or stays pending (in our case a third-party plugin waiting on a service removed in 0.1.7).
3. Start `dsh web`. The loader settles (with the failed entry), `importLegacyDocument()` runs, the file is renamed immediately, and each `update()` for the settings sections throws ("No configurable plugin entry ...") because the composition is not fully addressable.
4. Result: sections are rejected with warnings in server logs only; `settings.yaml` is already renamed. Restarting does not retry — the file is gone.

Observed on 0.1.7-alpha.1 / Linux / `dsh web`. The behavior matches the code comment in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` ("The document is renamed before the first write, so a partial import never repeats") — but that ordering converts a partial failure into an unrecoverable full loss.

## Root cause

`importLegacyDocument()` performs `rename(path, imported)` **before** the per-section import loop. The rename is unconditional; import success is not.

## Expected behavior / suggested fix

Import first, rename last: keep the original `settings.yaml` in place when **any** section fails (rejected sections stay ignored on disk), and retry the import on the next boot — only drop/rename the file once every section has been accepted. That single ordering change makes the one-time import self-healing instead of destructive.

(Optionally also surface a visible notice in the web UI when sections are rejected, instead of server-log-only warnings.)

---

## 中文版（附）

### 标题

settings.yaml 一次性导入：先改名后导入，导入失败即静默丢失全部设置

### 摘要

0.1.7 的 settings.yaml 一次性导入在执行任何 section 导入**之前**就把文件改名为 `settings.yaml.imported`。若该次启动组合树中有插件条目激活失败或 pending，各 section 的导入会被拒绝（仅服务端日志 warn），而原文件已被收走，下次启动也不会重试——文件已不存在。

后果：一次瞬时的首启动异常 → **整个 settings.yaml 永久静默丢失**（模型 provider、默认模型、权限预设、插件设置），除手工重建外无恢复路径。

### 复现

1. 0.1.6 上有一份内容完整的 settings.yaml；
2. 升级到 0.1.7-alpha.1，且某 profile 首次启动时有插件条目激活失败/pending（实测：某第三方插件等待一个 0.1.7 已移除的服务）；
3. 启动 `dsh web`：loader 结束后 `importLegacyDocument()` 立即改名，随后各 section `update()` 因组合不可寻址抛出 "No configurable plugin entry"；
4. 结果：section 全拒（仅日志）、settings.yaml 已被改名、重启不重试。

### 根因

`importLegacyDocument()` 的 `rename(path, imported)` 在按 section 导入循环**之前**无条件执行，改名与导入成败无关。

### 期望行为 / 修复建议

先导入、后改名：任何一个 section 失败时保留原 settings.yaml（被拒 section 留在原文件中），下次启动重试导入；全部 section 接受后才收走文件。仅这一处顺序调整即可让一次性导入从「破坏性」变为「自愈性」。

（可选：section 被拒时在 Web UI 给出可见提示，而非仅服务端日志。）

discussions.body:
# 建議：DeepSeek Harness 主模型原生支援圖像輸入（免 vision API 兜路）

## 問題描述（可重現）
DeepSeek Harness 入面跑嘅主模型（deepseek-v4-pro）冇 declare image input。
Agent 要「睇圖驗證」時用 read_image 會報錯：

ToolCallError: cannot read "xxx.png" as an image:
model "deepseek-v4-pro" does not declare image input;
switch to an image-capable model to read images

## 而家嘅兜路
import base64, requests
img = base64.b64encode(open("截圖.png","rb").read()).decode()
payload = {
  "model": "deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":[
     {"type":"text","text":"描述呢張圖"},
     {"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"data:image/png;base64,"+img}}
  ]}],
  "max_tokens": 2000,
}
r = requests.post("https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions",
  headers={"Authorization":"Bearer sk-xxx"}, json=payload, timeout=180)
print(r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])

## 建議
請俾 DeepSeek Harness 主模型原生支援圖像輸入，令 read_image 工具可以直接俾主模型用。
例如：主模型 declare image input，或者 Harness 內建 vision 轉接層（read_image 自動轉去 vision 模型，對 Agent 透明）。

提議官方加入參考物。每個任務使用眼睛來完成單個加權。確定後數小時自動跑

discussions.title: 设置面板导航列溢出被裁切，底部若干分区无法点击
discussions.body:
Summary

设置面板左侧导航列（SettingsRoot 的 .nav）没有滚动能力。当 settings.section 的注册数超出当前视口的容量后，导航内容高度超出面板高度，被 .panel 的 overflow: hidden 整块裁掉；被裁掉的分区鼠标无法滚动到、也无法点击。

settings.section 是公开扩展点，社区用户装到一定数量必然撞上；而容量由屏幕高度决定，768p 一类屏幕上只有 15 个。

packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/client/SettingsRoot.module.css 中 .panel 的注释写明了设计意图：

One height for every section, taken from the viewport rather than the content: … Whatever does not fit scrolls in .options.

内容列 .options 实现了这一点（overflow-y: auto），导航列 .nav 没有 —— 实现没有兑现注释里的承诺。

Reproduction

主复现（与屏幕无关，100% 必现）：settings.section 注册数达到 ≥ 17 时，任意屏幕、任意窗口尺寸都复现 —— 导航需要 60 + 44×17 = 808px，而面板高度上限只有 800px。装够会注册 settings.section 的插件，打开设置即可看到底部被裁，且在导航列上滚动鼠标滚轮无效。

次复现（与屏幕相关）：注册数不足 17 时，视口高度 < 812px 复现；在 1366×768 一类屏幕上即使全屏也复现（面板 = 100vh − 48 = 720px，容量仅 15）。

本机实测演进：16 个分区时底部 1 项（会话归档）被裁；此后又安装数个插件，问题依旧。

观测方式（无需读源码）：settings.section 是一条 list slot，客户端 ctx.get('slots') 的 occupants 即导航项。

Current behavior

导航内容高度 H(N) = 22 + 24 + 18 + 40N + 4(N−1) = 60 + 44N   （N = 注册数）
面板高度          = min(800px, calc(100vh − 48px))
可完整显示上限 C  = floor((面板高度 − 60) / 44)
屏幕 / 窗口 | 视口 | 面板 | 容量 C -- | -- | -- | -- 768p 屏全屏（1366×768 等） | 768 | 720 | 15 900p / 1080p 屏最大化 | ≈850 / ≈950 | 800 | 16 任意屏幕的绝对上限 | ≥848 | 800 | 16
  • 17 个分区在任何硬件上都不可达（H(17) = 808px > 800px）。
  • 768p 屏上容量只有 15，第 16 个起永久不可达，且最大化也无法改善。
  • .nav 上没有 overflow，.panel 是 overflow: hidden，因此溢出部分被裁切且不产生滚动条；在 .nav 上滚动鼠标滚轮无效。
  • 被裁掉的分区键盘仍可到达（overflow: hidden 的盒子在程序化滚动下仍可滚动，Tab 聚焦会将其滚入视野），但鼠标用户完全够不到；界面也没有任何「下方还有内容」的提示。

Expected behavior

导航列在内容超出可用高度时可滚动，与右侧内容列一致；最后一个导航项与面板下边缘之间保留间距；分区数未超容量时不应出现滚动条。

Environment

  • DSH：0.1.5-rc.2（@deepseek-ai/dsh），profile web
  • 相关包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general（源码位于 packages/client/ui-settings-general）
  • 平台：Windows 11（build 26200）；浏览器 Chrome 153；dsh web 本地实例；界面语言中文
  • 视口高度 ≈ 768（由实机几何反推：导航列恰好完整显示 15 项、第 16 项被裁，对应面板 100vh − 48）
  • 首次复现时 settings.section 共 16 项（12 项由社区插件注册，4 项为官方页面）

根因

packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/client/SettingsRoot.module.css：

css
.panel {
  height: min(800px, calc(100vh - 48px));
  overflow: hidden;              /* ← 裁切来源 */
  /* … scrollbar 令牌在此声明，注释说明是给「whichever descendant scrolls」用的 */
}

/* Nav rail … gap 18, no own fill */
.nav {
  flex: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  width: 188px;
  padding: 22px 12px 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  /* ← 没有 overflow，没有 min-height */
}

/* Options area … scrolls. */
.options {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;              /* ← 只给内容列做了滚动 */
}

.nav 与 .options 是同级的 flex item（主轴 flex: none 固定 188px，交叉轴由 align-items: stretch 撑满面板高度），因此它已经是一个高度确定的滚动容器候选，只差一行 overflow-y。

另外 .panel 上已声明 --dsh-scrollbar-thumb / --dsh-scrollbar-thumb-hover，注释写明是给「whichever descendant scrolls」用的 —— 滚动条样式的基础设施本来就预期存在多个滚动后代，导航列正是其中之一。

建议修复（已实测有效）

复用本文件内容列 .options 已有的同一套写法，只让列表滚动、标题钉住：

diff
--- a/packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/client/SettingsRoot.module.css
+++ b/packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/client/SettingsRoot.module.css
@@ .nav
 .nav {
   flex: none;
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: 18px;
   width: 188px;
-  padding: 22px 12px 0;
+  padding: 22px 12px 12px;
   box-sizing: border-box;
 }
@@ .navList
 .navList {
+  flex: 1;
+  min-height: 0;
+  overflow-y: auto;
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: 4px;
 }
  • .navList 是 .nav（column 方向 flex）的子项，flex: 1; min-height: 0 让它占满标题之外的剩余高度并允许收缩，overflow-y: auto 使其成为滚动容器 —— 与同文件 .options 完全一致。
  • 标题保持可见：.navTitle 与内容列 .header（flex: none）行为对齐，内容列本就是「标题固定、选项滚动」。
  • padding-bottom 由 0 改为非 0，避免滚到底时最后一项紧贴面板下边缘。
  • 滚动条样式无需额外声明：令牌声明在 .panel 上，按注释会继承到滚动后代。

实测记录：作者已把上述改动应用到本地已安装构建产物的对应 CSS 字符串上（.nav 的 padding-bottom、.navList 增加三个属性），文件层面确认两处规则正确写入、无其它字节变动；浏览器强制刷新后，导航列可以滚动了，原本被裁掉、鼠标够不到的分区现在能滚动到达并正常点开，未观察到对内容列或其它界面的影响。

附带一个与修复无关的观察：该本地补丁不具持久性 —— 每次 pnpm add/remove 重新物化 node_modules 都会覆盖手工修改的构建产物（本机实测发生过一次，补丁连同备份一起消失）。这也是本地手段无法替代上游修复的原因。

临时规避（无需改代码）

在 profile 的用户补丁层停用任意一个注册了设置页的插件行，即可把分区数降到容量以下：

yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: web-ui-market      # 该行注册的设置页即从导航中移除
  disabled: true

<id> 取组合树中的行 id（dsh --profile web --dump-config 可查）。这只是规避：容量本身仍随屏幕变小而下降，且每装一个新插件都可能再次越界。

顺带的产品建议

settings.section 的注册契约只提供 { id, order, label }，没有分组/折叠原语，因此导航只能线性增长，第三方能做的只有重排（社区已有若干「设置导航收纳」类插件在绕这个问题）。若希望长期可扩展，建议为外壳增加可折叠分组，或给 settings.section 增加可选的 group 注册字段。

这与本次的可用性缺陷是两个层次的问题，互不冲突，建议先修前者。

discussions.title: [Bug] Anthropic Messages 协议下模型列表只显示 id，不显示已解析的 display_name
discussions.body:
## 问题

添加自定义提供商、协议选 **Anthropic Messages** 时，「获取可用模型」列出的是 `claude-fable-5-dd-anul-6.5-tpg` 这类不可读的 id；同一个网关、同一个 base URL 改用 OpenAI 协议就正常。

## 根因

1. **网关侧**：Anthropic 协议的 `GET {base}/v1/models` 返回的 `id` 是混淆别名 —— `claude-fable-5-dd-` + 模型名逐字符反转（`gpt-5.6-luna` → `anul-6.5-tpg`），人可读名在 `display_name` 里。同一 URL 只换凭据头就能看到差别：

   - `Authorization: Bearer <key>` → `"id":"gpt-5.6-luna"`
   - `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01` → `"id":"claude-fable-5-dd-anul-6.5-tpg", "display_name":"GPT 5.6 Luna"`

   discovery 对这两个字段的解析是对的，`id` 也必须原样保留（它是发请求时要用的值）。

2. **DSH 侧**：候选弹窗只渲染 `candidate.id`，把已经解析出来的 `candidate.name`（来自 `display_name`）丢掉了，所以用户只看到别名。

   `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/ModelListEditor.tsx`：

   ```jsx
   children: candidate.id   // candidate.name 就在手边，搜索框就是按它过滤的
   ```

## 建议

候选行改成「`name` 为主、`id` 为辅」显示。写入配置的仍然是 `id`，行为不变。

discussions.title: chat reaches its maximum length, the conversation ends without any warning
discussions.body:
The Problem

When a chat reaches its maximum length, the conversation ends without any warning. There is:

    no indicator that you are approaching the limit

    no percentage or token counter

    no warning N messages before the end

    no way to carry the conversation over into a new chat

    no way for the assistant to access the previous chat — not even when the user explicitly asks it to

The Consequence

In a chat lasting several hours, a Python project ("NAS Conflict Scanner", roughly 1500+ lines, multiple modules) was being developed collaboratively. Mid-work, the chat was cut off.

Since then, the project has become practically unusable:

    The assistant cannot read the old chat.

    Every attempt to "continue" makes the assistant guess — and it produces code that does not match the original.

    Specifically: a newly generated synology_common.py is incompatible in every core function with the real file (parse_blacklist, is_blacklisted, ensure_default_blacklist_suffixes, _prepare_write all have different signatures and return types). The script is therefore non-functional.

    The user is forced to reconstruct the entire context manually — which, in long chats, is effectively impossible.

Why This Is Unacceptable

An assistant that is marketed for long technical work, yet fails precisely when the work becomes long, is unfit for professional use. The damage is not merely "loss of convenience" — it is lost work.
Concrete Requests

    Visible length indicator (tokens or %) in the chat UI, available at all times.

    Warning at least 10 % before the limit is reached, prominent and not dismissible.

    Automatic summary of the conversation so far, which can be carried into a new chat.

    "Continue chat" function that transfers the old history into a new chat (so the assistant can still read it).

    Failing that: an Export button that outputs the entire conversation as a structured file — so users can at least continue manually.

Urgency

High. Without these features, any chat lasting more than a few hours is a risk of data loss — and is unpredictable for the user.

I would appreciate a response as to whether and when these points will be implemented.

Sincerely,

discussions.title: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web fails with ETARGET — @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3 was never published
discussions.body:
## Summary

The current `latest` release of `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (0.1.5-rc.2) cannot be installed by anyone: its dependency graph requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3`, but that version was never published to npm. The `next` tag (0.1.5-rc.3) fails the same way. Because npm's prerelease semver rule prevents `^0.1.5-rc.3` from falling back to `0.1.6-alpha.1`, resolution fails hard with ETARGET.

## Reproduction

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
# or explicitly:
npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 --dry-run
npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.3 --dry-run
```

Error:

```text
npm error code ETARGET
npm error notarget No matching version found for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@^0.1.5-rc.3.
npm error notarget In most cases you or one of your dependencies are requesting a package version that doesn't exist.
```

## Evidence from the npm registry (checked 2026-09-22, official registry)

- `npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags` → `latest: 0.1.5-rc.2`, `next: 0.1.5-rc.3`, `alpha: 0.1.7-alpha.1`
- `npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview versions` →
  `0.1.5-alpha.2, 0.1.5-rc.1, 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.6-alpha.1, 0.1.6-alpha.2, 0.1.7-alpha.1`
  — there is **no `0.1.5-rc.3`**. A `^0.1.5-rc.3` range only matches prereleases with the same `[major, minor, patch]` tuple, so it cannot resolve to `0.1.6-alpha.1`.
- Both `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.3` fail to resolve against the official registry.
- Verified working: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1` both resolve completely (556 / 585 packages).

## Environment

- macOS, zsh, Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0
- Registry: default `https://registry.npmjs.org` (confirmed from the npm debug log) — verified against the official registry, so this is not a stale-mirror/cache issue

## Workaround for other users

Pin a version whose dependency graph exists:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 web
# or
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2
```

## Suggested fix

Either publish the missing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview@0.1.5-rc.3`, or repoint `latest` (and `next`) to a release whose full dependency graph exists — e.g. a rebuilt 0.1.5-rc.x, or promote `0.1.6-alpha.2` to `latest`.

discussions.title: [0.1.7-alpha.1 regression] dsh-http-proxy undici v8 dispatcher breaks content-encoding on internal undici v6 fetch
discussions.body:
## Symptom (starting from 0.1.7-alpha.1)

The version-update panel (dsh-version-update@1.4.0) always reports:

    registry unreachable (tried https://registry.npmjs.org, https://registry.npmmirror.com):
    Unexpected token U+001F ... is not valid JSON

Bytes 1F 8B 08 are a gzip header: the body arrives undecoded despite HTTP 200.
Same failure hits the plugin's GitHub release-notes fetch, so it is host-global,
not registry-specific. curl and a fresh node process (same URL/headers/timeout,
same proxy or direct) both work. Only the dsh web host fails, deterministically,
across restarts, with or without proxy env vars.

## Root cause

profile-boot calls installProxyFromEnvironment() from @deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy,
which replaces the global dispatcher with one built from bundled npm undici@8.11.0
(Agent factory returning ProxyAgent / Pool). But Node v22.22.2 built-in fetch runs
internal undici 6.24.1. The cross-major dispatcher breaks content-encoding propagation.

Minimal repro (same node binary, internal undici 6.24.1):

    const u8 = await import('<global-dsh>/node_modules/undici/index.js'); // 8.11.0
    const disp = new u8.Agent({
      factory: (origin, opts) => new u8.ProxyAgent({ ...opts, uri: 'http://127.0.0.1:7890' }),
    });
    u8.setGlobalDispatcher(disp);
    const r = await fetch('https://registry.npmjs.org/%40deepseek-ai%2Fdsh',
      { headers: { accept: 'application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' } });
    console.log(r.headers.get('content-encoding')); // null, header lost
    await r.json(); // throws Unexpected token U+001F ... is not valid JSON

With the pristine internal dispatcher (or the same experiment using undici@7.29.0
classes), content-encoding br/gzip is present and r.json() parses. So the
v8-dispatcher + v6-fetch combination is the breaking one.

## Environment

- @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1 (global npm install)
- node v22.22.2 (process.versions.undici = 6.24.1)
- bundled node_modules/undici = 8.11.0
- dsh-version-update 1.4.0 (symptom surface only)

## Suggested fix

Build the global dispatcher from an undici compatible with the runtime internal one
(or reuse the internal instance), or skip overriding the global dispatcher when the
bundled undici major differs from the runtime. Note: with no proxy configured
(source none) nothing is installed and everything works, confirming the dispatcher
is the trigger.

## Workaround

Launch with proxy env fully unset so no dispatcher gets installed:

    env -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u all_proxy \
        -u ALL_PROXY -u no_proxy -u NO_PROXY -u npm_config_proxy \
        -u npm_config_https_proxy -u npm_config_http_proxy -u NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY dsh web

Unsetting only http(s)_proxy is NOT enough: any leftover name (e.g. ALL_PROXY)
still triggers installation.

discussions.title: [Bug] Welcome notice modal permanently locks the UI when settings write fails (no escape hatch)
discussions.body:
## Summary
The internal-testing "welcome notice" modal blocks the entire app and has no exit path when persisting the user's acknowledgement fails. The only dismissal button ("Continue") requires the write to succeed, so on any refused/failed write the user is stuck in an infinite retry loop with no way to close the dialog or use the app.

## What the user sees
- Modal titled **"???? / Internal Testing Notice"** with a single **"Continue"** button.
- After clicking it once: a red error line appears - **"??????????,????"** ("The acknowledgement could not be saved. Please try again.")
- Clicking "Continue" again just shows the same error. There is no X, no mask-click, no ESC, and the sidebar / settings / everything behind the modal is unclickable.
- Refreshing the page just brings the modal right back.

## Why it locks (three independent design defects stacked on top of each other)

**1. Dismissal is hard-coupled to durable persistence.**
In `WelcomeNotice`, the click handler is:
```js
const acknowledge = async () => {
  if (await controller.acknowledge()) finish(); // finish() only runs on success
};
```
`finish()` unmounts the modal. If `acknowledge()` returns `false` (write did not persist), the modal is kept. There is no local / in-session fallback for the durable write path - even though a memory-mode fallback already exists:
```js
if (this.scope.getSnapshot().mode === "memory") {
  this.localAcknowledged = true;
  this.derive();
  return true;
}
```
The durable branch has no equivalent "remember for this session" escape.

**2. The modal removes every other exit.**
`OnboardingModal` does:
```js
const ignoreImplicitDismiss = () => {};
return <Modal open title onClose={ignoreImplicitDismiss} headless ... />
```
- `onClose` is a no-op, so the built-in close button, mask click, and ESC are all swallowed.
- An effect sets `document.getElementById("root").inert = true`, making the *entire* app root non-interactable while the modal is up.

Result: clicking "Continue" is literally the only way out, and that path is exactly the one that fails.

**3. The write itself is designed to not stick.**
The acknowledgement field is declared as volatile in the host plugin config:
```ts
// packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/index.ts
const Config = z.object({ welcomeNoticeVersion: z.string().volatile() });
```
`volatile()` in the Cordis/schemastery model means "runtime-only, not persisted". On the settings side, `write()` strips volatile fields out of the persisted layer, and after `scope.set(...)` the store re-derives from `scope.value.welcomeNoticeVersion`, which is still `undefined` - so `acknowledged` stays `false`, status flips to `error`, and the "could not be saved" message is shown. A field whose entire purpose is to be remembered across restarts should not be marked volatile.

**4. The error state still offers only the failing action.**
The button is only disabled while `status === "saving"`. In `error` state it stays enabled, so the user clicks the same failing action forever, with no "Skip for now" alternative.

## Why the obvious workarounds don't help
- Editing `settings.yaml` / `settings.yaml.imported`: that legacy file is renamed to `settings.yaml.imported` once at first boot during migration and is never read again. Runtime config now lives in `cordis.patch.yml`.
- Even manually editing `cordis.patch.yml` requires knowing the correct entry id (`ui-settings-general`) and bypasses the bug rather than fixing it.
- Refreshing: the store re-reads the still-unset value and re-shows the blocking modal.

## Suggested fixes
1. **Decouple dismissal from persistence.** Add a secondary "Skip for now / Later" button that calls `finish()` with a process-local acknowledgement (mirroring the memory-mode path). Persistence failure should only mean "we'll ask again next launch", never "you cannot use the app right now".
2. **Don't block the whole app on a non-blocking notice.** At minimum, allow ESC / mask close (or a visible close button) when the write is in `error` state, and only set `#root.inert = true` while the modal is genuinely actionable.
3. **Don't mark a cross-launch acknowledgement field as `volatile()`.** Either drop `.volatile()` (so it persists normally) or give the durable write path its own non-volatile storage.
4. **Error-state affordances.** In `error` status, relabel the primary button to "Retry" and add a secondary "Skip this time"; add simple retry backoff to avoid hammering the refused write.

## Files / locations
- `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/WelcomeNotice.js`
- `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/OnboardingModal.js` (`onClose: ignoreImplicitDismiss`, `#root.inert = true`)
- `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/welcome-store.js` (`acknowledge()` returning false; memory-mode fallback only)
- `packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/index.ts` (`welcomeNoticeVersion: z.string().volatile()`)
- Host settings `write()` / `strip()` path in `packages/settings/...`

discussions.title: [Bug] 新建终端 shell 菜单出现两个同名 bash（/bin/bash 与 /usr/bin/bash）
discussions.body:
**环境**: dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1（npm 安装），Ubuntu，`SHELL=/bin/bash`，`/bin -> usr/bin`

**现象**: 「新建终端」右侧的 shell 下拉里列出两条完全相同的 `bash`，界面上无法区分。

**原因**: `packages/api/terminal-controller/src/shells.ts` 的 `discoverShells()` 去重键用的是解析后的**字面路径**，没有做 realpath：

```ts
const key = shell.path.includes('\\') ? shell.path.toLowerCase() : shell.path
```

- 默认 shell 取自 `$SHELL` → `/bin/bash`
- 候选表 `shellCandidates` 中的 `bash` 经 `resolveExecutable` 走 PATH → `/usr/bin/bash`

`/bin` 是 `usr/bin` 的符号链接，二者是同一个文件但路径字符串不同，因此两条都被保留；UI 又只用 basename 作为标签（`shell.name`），于是渲染成两个一样的 `bash`。任何 merged-usr 发行版 + `$SHELL` 为 `/bin/...` 的环境都会遇到，无需自定义配置。

**复现**:

```bash
echo $SHELL      # /bin/bash
which -a bash    # /usr/bin/bash  /bin/bash
ls -l /bin       # /bin -> usr/bin
```

打开侧栏「新建终端」→ 展开箭头 → 下拉出现两条 `bash`。

**期望**: 该函数的 JSDoc 声明 `@returns unique installed shells`，实际并不唯一；下拉里不应出现无法区分的重复项。

**建议**: 去重键改用 `fs.realpath()`（失败时回退原字符串）。

**影响**: 仅 UI 重复，两条指向同一程序，功能正常。

discussions.title: [Bug] 内测声明弹窗在设置写入失败时永久锁死界面（无任何逃生口）
discussions.body:
## 问题概述
内测声明欢迎弹窗（welcome notice modal）在用户确认状态写入持久化失败时，会把整个应用永久锁死：没有任何关闭路径，只能无限点击"继续"并反复看到红色报错"暂时无法保存确认状态，请重试。"。

## 复现现象
1. 首次启动 / 未确认内测声明时，弹出阻塞式弹窗：

![弹窗初始状态](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/UWl2ZnlCCM)

2. 点击"继续"一次后，出现红色错误提示：

![红色错误：暂时无法保存确认状态，请重试。](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/ALBAasJwJV)

3. 再次点击"继续"只会重复同样的错误。弹窗右上角没有关闭按钮，点击遮罩、按 ESC 都无效，背后的侧边栏/设置也全部无法点击（整个 #root 被设为 inert）。
4. 刷新页面后，弹窗会再次出现，无法绕过。

## 根因分析（四重设计缺陷叠加）

### 1. "关闭弹窗"被硬绑定到"持久化写入成功"
`WelcomeNotice` 的点击逻辑：
```js
const acknowledge = async () => {
  if (await controller.acknowledge()) finish(); // 只有返回 true 才关闭弹窗
};
```
`finish()` 负责卸载弹窗。一旦 `acknowledge()` 返回 `false`（写入未持久化），弹窗就一直挂着。durable（持久化）分支没有像 memory 分支那样的"本次会话内本地记住"兜底：
```js
if (this.scope.getSnapshot().mode === "memory") {
  this.localAcknowledged = true;
  this.derive();
  return true;
}
```

### 2. 弹窗同时关掉了所有其他出口
`OnboardingModal`：
```js
const ignoreImplicitDismiss = () => {};
return <Modal open title onClose={ignoreImplicitDismiss} headless ... />
```
- `onClose` 是空函数，关闭按钮 / 遮罩点击 / ESC 全部被吞掉；
- useEffect 把 `document.getElementById("root").inert = true`，整个应用根节点不可交互。

结果：点击"继续"成了唯一出路，而这条路恰恰是正在失败的那条。

### 3. 要持久化的字段本身被标记为"易失、不持久化"
host 端插件配置：
```ts
// packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/index.ts
const Config = z.object({ welcomeNoticeVersion: z.string().volatile() });
```
Cordis/schemastery 体系里 `volatile()` 的语义就是"运行时易失、不持久化"。settings 写入侧的 `write()` / `strip()` 逻辑会把 volatile 字段从持久化层剥离；`scope.set(...)` 之后 store 重新读取 `scope.value.welcomeNoticeVersion` 仍然是 `undefined`，于是 `acknowledged` 恒为 `false`，状态进入 `error`，显示"暂时无法保存确认状态"。一个"跨启动记住用户选择"的字段，却被标记成了 volatile，这是设计自相矛盾。

### 4. 错误状态下仍然只提供那个正在失败的按钮
按钮的禁用条件只看 `status === "saving"`，error 状态下"继续"依然可点，用户只能无限重复同一个失败动作，没有"跳过本次 / 稍后再说"的次级按钮。

## 为什么常规自救无效
- 编辑 `settings.yaml` / `settings.yaml.imported`：旧文件在首次启动迁移时被 rename 为 `.imported`，之后不再被读取；运行时配置已经迁到 `cordis.patch.yml`。
- 我曾在 `.imported` 文件里手动加过 `welcomeNoticeVersion`，但因为命名空间写错（写成了 `ui-onboarding`，正确应为 `ui-settings-general`），且该文件已废弃，弹窗依旧：

![曾手动编辑 settings.yaml.imported 但无效](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/KECg26Cwm3)

- 即使改对了文件，重启后弹窗仍在，因为真正生效的是 `cordis.patch.yml`，且该字段是 volatile：

![重启后弹窗仍然出现](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/akUrH8anjY)

- 刷新页面：store 重新读取仍为空的已确认值，弹窗再次弹出。

## 建议修复方向
1. **把"知情确认"和"持久化落盘"解耦**：增加一个"跳过本次 / 稍后"次级按钮，走 process-local（本次会话内存内）确认后直接关闭。持久化失败只应意味着"下次再问"，绝不能意味着"这次用不了产品"。
2. **不要用一个非阻塞的声明弹窗锁死整个 App**：至少在 error 状态下允许 ESC / 遮罩关闭（或显示关闭按钮），只在真正可操作时才设置 `#root.inert = true`。
3. **不要把跨启动确认字段标记为 `volatile()`**：去掉 `.volatile()` 让它正常持久化，或为 durable 写入单独提供非 volatile 存储。
4. **错误状态的交互优化**：error 时主按钮改为"重试"，增加"本次跳过"次级按钮，并加简单重试退避，避免连续打被拒的写入。

## 涉及文件
- `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/WelcomeNotice.js`
- `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/OnboardingModal.js`（`onClose: ignoreImplicitDismiss`、`#root.inert = true`）
- `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/welcome-store.js`（`acknowledge()` 返回 false；仅 memory 分支有兜底）
- `packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/index.ts`（`welcomeNoticeVersion: z.string().volatile()`）
- host settings 侧 `write()` / `strip()` 逻辑（`packages/settings/...`）

discussions.title: 又挂一个插件
开启「开发者工具」后，改动文件卡片在摘要重新拉取期间整卡消失，导致会话底部输入框与滚动条跳动
discussions.body:
**环境**：dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1（Web 客户端，profile `web`）。设置 → 通用 → 开发者工具：开启（默认开启）。

**现象**

1. 每轮有文件改动时，对话末尾的「已编辑 N 个文件」卡片不是随输出出现，而是在该轮 `turn/end` 之后才「弹」出来。
2. 卡片出现/消失的同时，底部输入框上下跳一次，滚动条拇指位置与内容末尾不再对齐。
3. 关闭开发者工具后卡片不再渲染，现象消失（可作对照）。

**复现**：让 agent 连续几轮修改工作区文件，观察每轮结束时输入框上方的跳动。一轮内出现多次 stop（中途 steering、max-tokens 续写）时会更频繁。

**根因**

(1) 客户端：新 `seq` 到达时卡片先被卸载。`packages/client/ui-deliverables` 按事件的 `seq` 取摘要：

```js
const summary = useChangesSummary((value) =>
  announced === null ? undefined : value[changesSummaryUrl(sessionId, announced.seq)]);
const changes = announced !== null && typeof summary === "object" && summary.files.length > 0
  ? { seq: announced.seq, ...summary } : null;
```

而 `HostReadStore.loadUrl()` 在发起读取前先写入占位：

```js
this.state.update((state) => { state[url] = this.policy.loading; });
```

占位不是带 `files` 的对象，于是新 `seq` 一到就 `changes = null`，**整张卡片卸载**（高度 N → 0），要等 `/api/changes.summary` 返回后才重新挂载。也就是说卡片不是「原地更新」，而是每个新 `seq` 都「消失—重现」一次。

(2) 布局放大：卡片挂在 `conversation.chat.turnTail`，位于滚动容器 `scrollBody` 的末尾，紧邻 `position: sticky; bottom: 0` 的输入框座位 `composerSeat`；会话的滚动记账（`scrollTop/scrollHeight`）和位置锚点捕获（以输入框顶边为阅读线）都作用在同一容器上，所以末尾高度的异步变化正好扰动输入框位置与滚动条拇指。

(3) 宿主放大器：`packages/deliverables/workspace-changes` 的 `TurnRecorder.record()` 只在该轮「尚未记录过任何东西」时才对空变更提前返回：

```js
if (sorted.length === 0 && state.recordedAfterSeq < 0) return;
const event = this.session.append("workspace/changes", { turn: state.turn });
```

该轮记录过之后（`recordedAfterSeq >= 0`），后续每次 stop 都会再追加一个**新 `seq`** 的事件，即使文件列表与上一次完全一致，客户端于是再来一轮「卸载—重新拉取—挂载」。会话日志中该事件总是紧贴 `turn/end` 之前（例如 seq 305/306、380/381、401/402）。

**建议**

1. 客户端：同一轮内保留上一次成功渲染的摘要，新 `seq` 的摘要到达前继续渲染旧内容（不要先卸载卡片）；或让卡片以 turn 为键，只在新数据到达后替换。
2. 宿主：该轮已记录过、且新的列表与上一次相同时不再追加新事件（或在 `stopping()` 侧去重），减少无意义的 `seq` 变化。

discussions.title: 历史消息怎么恢复 直接报错了 无法查看了
发消息也修改了？？
0.1.7-alpha.1插件元信息探测：错误改写裸赋 error.stack，stack 只读环境下静默容忍变成显性报错
discussions.body: ## 摘要 0.1.7-alpha.1 的插件元信息读取（`readPluginMeta()`）会对每个全局插件探测可选资源 `/locale/en.json`，资源缺失属预期，`missingResource()` 按错误 `code` 静默容忍。但探测错误在返回调用方之前，会先经过 profile 解析拦截层的 `throwWithImporter()`，该函数为隐藏内部路由路径而改写错误的 message 与 stack，且对 `error.stack` 的赋值没有任何防御。在真实启动链路上，解析器错误的 `stack` 是只读访问器，赋值即抛 TypeError——而 TypeError 没有 `code`，容忍逻辑认不出它。 后果：一个本应静默跳过的「资源缺失」被错误处理代码自己放大为显性故障。任何未内置 locale 字典的全局插件都会触发——实测「内置插件」页 persona、agent-instructions、tool-bash、tool-pwsh、tool-fs、tool-fs-search 六个全部复现，「全局插件」页的 ui-directory-picker-native 同样触发（见下图），启用与停用状态均可；插件加载与功能不受影响，但报错普遍、持续且具误导性。 ![全局插件页：uidirectorypickernative 显示同一条「包元信息错误」] *截图：设置 → 全局插件（共 180 个）。ui-directory-picker-native 报同一 TypeError；右侧 include（`cordis:include`，非包 specifier）不走元信息探测、显示正常。* ## 复现 1. dsh web 0.1.7-alpha.1（Node v22.23.2 / Windows，源码启动）； 2. 全局插件含任一未导出 `./locale/en.json` 的包（官方 persona / command-goal 即可，无需特殊配置）； 3. 启动 web，打开插件管理器页面； 4. 结果：这些插件条目全部显示「包元信息错误：Plugin metadata for … TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'stack' of object 'Error: Package subpath './locale/en.json' is not defined by "exports" …'」；应用下文补丁并重启后，同一页面不再报错。 ## 根因 `throwWithImporter()`（`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts`）在捕获 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` / `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 后改写错误消息，并**无条件执行** `error.stack = stack.replace(...)`（`throwWithoutCjsAnchor()` 同样如此）——改写与运行时是否允许写入无关；部分链路上解析器错误的 `stack` 为只读访问器，赋值即崩，崩出的 TypeError 又没有 `code`，使 `missingResource()` 的按-code 容忍完全失效。（仓库的 FIXME/TODO/XXX 标签、README Known Limitations 章节、提交历史均无此问题声明，属未预期缺陷。） ## 期望行为 / 修复建议 错误改写必须是 best-effort：对 message / stack 的赋值包 try/catch，任何失败保留原错误对象与 `code`，让 `missingResource()` 按设计静默跳过、元信息回退显示包名。仅这一处防御即可让探测从「显性报错」恢复为「自愈性跳过」。 ```ts const stack = error.stack try { error.message = message if (stack !== undefined) error.stack = stack.replace(originalMessage, message) } catch { /* keep the original error */ } ``` （`throwWithoutCjsAnchor()` 中 message / requireStack / stack 的改写同理；补丁已在本地验证，`resolver.ts` +18/−8。）

discussions.title: 在 dsh 中配置 OpenRouter 作为模型提供方后，无法找到刚发布的新模型，如 xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro
discussions.body:
## 问题

OpenRouter 的 `/api/v1/models` 已返回 `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro`，但 dsh 的“获取可用模型”和模型选择器中都找不到它。

## 原因

`llm-pi-ai` 对 OpenRouter 这类内置提供方只返回 pi-ai 包内的静态模型目录，不会请求实时 `/models` 接口：

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/discovery.ts

dsh 当前锁定的 pi-ai `0.85.1` 不包含该模型

## 期望

用户点击“获取可用模型”时，应实时查询 `/models` 接口，并与静态目录合并。静态目录可以继续用于离线回退和补充协议、能力等元数据。

discussions.title: 侧边栏交互优化建议：文件列表开关 + 新标签页下拉菜单（对齐 Codex）
discussions.body:
侧边栏的两处交互建议（对齐 Codex）：

1）文件列表开关在每个 tab 页都可用
现在文件列表是侧边栏里单独的一个 tab（"文件"）。想看别的文件时，必须先切到"文件" tab，看完再切回去，来回切换很麻烦。
建议像 Codex 那样，在每个 tab 页都保留文件列表的开关（按钮或快捷键），随时能开合文件列表，不用先找到"文件" tab。

2）"+"（新标签页）按钮点击后直接弹出下拉菜单
现在点 "+" 会打开"开始" tab，之后还得把鼠标移到面板中间，再从卡片里选一次，多一步操作。
建议像 Codex 那样，点击后就在按钮旁直接弹出下拉菜单，一次选中要打开的类型。

环境：dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1，Web GUI。

discussions.title: 侧栏终端 Nerd Font / Powerline 图标显示为方块：默认字体链建议补一个图标字体兜底
discussions.body: zsh 的图形化 prompt（starship / powerlevel10k / oh-my-posh）和 `eza` 等图标输出，在侧栏终端里全是方块；iTerm2 / kitty / VS Code 同机正常。 ```bash printf '\ue0b0\ue0b1\ue0b2\ue0b3\n\uf015 \uf07b \ue5ff\n' # 复现：四个分隔符 + 图标 ``` **根因**：`0.1.7-alpha.1` 的 `ui-sidebar-terminal` 里 xterm 构造参数硬编码 ```js fontFamily: "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" ``` 这条链没有任何含 Nerd Font 字形的字体；xterm.js 是 canvas 渲染，CSS 覆盖不生效，只能改渲染器收到的 `fontFamily`。 **建议**（最小改动）： ```js fontFamily: "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, \"Symbols Nerd Font Mono\", monospace", rescaleOverlappingGlyphs: true, ``` `Symbols Nerd Font Mono` 是 Nerd Fonts 官方的 symbols-only 字体，排链尾只补主字体缺的字形、不改格子度量，未安装的机器自然跳过，零回归。主字体 / 图标字体可再做成 Host Config + `settings.general.item` 设置行，交给用户选，不把厂商名写进默认链。 **注意**：`rescaleOverlappingGlyphs` 默认 `false`，开它是行为变更（Powerline 分隔符从溢出变缩放），建议同时给配置位。 **已验证**：本机对已安装的 `0.1.7-alpha.1` 打过补丁，`printf` 输出正常，设置行热更新生效；默认链在没装图标字体的机器上与今天一致。 CONTRIBUTING 说明暂不收外部 PR，故发此帖。想问：更倾向只做默认链兜底，还是一并做可配置的设置行?
