[Bug] Web UI "Open configuration file" fails on headless server when transport ownsHost=true (K8s / Ingress)
discussions.body:
## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-alpha.1`
- Profile: `web`
- Deployment: container / Kubernetes, Web UI behind Ingress (browser hostname is public FQDN, not loopback)
- Server: headless Linux (no `DISPLAY` / desktop session)
- `DSH_HOME`: `/home/node/.dsh` (persistent volume)

## Symptom

In **Settings**, clicking **"Open configuration file"** (RU: «Открыть файл конфигурации») shows an error like **"Failed to open configuration file"** / «Не удалось открыть файл конфигурации».

## Expected

Either:
- do **not** show the button when the host cannot open native paths (no desktop / `xdg-open` unavailable), **or**
- open the file in-app (e.g. document preview / editor), **or**
- show a clear message that this action only works on **local desktop** DSH, not on a remote headless host.

## Actual / hypothesis

The Web UI treats the session as "local enough" to expose host-owned settings actions when `globalThis.__DSH_TRANSPORT__.ownsHost === true` (common pattern for remote access behind a reverse proxy).

The server RPC (`settings/openSettingsDocument` or equivalent) then tries to open `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` via a **native** opener (`xdg-open` on Linux). In a headless pod this fails.

This is easy to hit when using a small client shim that sets `ownsHost: true` so that Settings / Models / locale work over Ingress (otherwise loopback-only restrictions apply).

## Workaround (deployment-side)

- Change settings via **Settings → General** in the UI.
- Edit `/home/node/.dsh/settings.yaml` on the server directly if needed.
- We patched our `dsh-remote-browser` plugin to hide the button and stub `settingsController.openTextFile` on the host.

## Suggested fix (upstream)

- Gate `openDocument` / "Open configuration file" on `canOpenNativePath()` (or equivalent) **even when** `ownsHost` is true, **or**
- decouple `ownsHost` (API/settings availability) from "native file open on server filesystem".

Happy to provide a minimal repro Cordis patch (`ownsHost: true` + `dsh web`) if useful.

Thanks!

discussions.title: Windows Desktop: LibreOfficeKit 在长路径下转换失败，短路径 Junction 可正常通过
discussions.body:
## 环境

- OS: Windows
- deepseek-harness tag: `dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`
- Desktop target: `win32-x64`
- Electron: `44.0.0`
- electron-builder: `26.15.3`
- bundled Node.js: `24.18.1`
- bundled pnpm: `11.7.0`

源码目录：

```text
C:\PROJETS-PERSO\deepseek-harness
```

构建命令：

```powershell
pnpm.cmd run package:desktop:win:x64:unsigned
```

---

## 问题现象

Prepared runtime 的 Office 转换测试可以通过：

```text
desktop runtime: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX to PDF passed
```

但 packaged runtime 在 DOCX -> PDF 时失败：

```text
Error: desktop runtime: docx conversion failed: OfficeToPdfError: LibreOffice conversion failed.

[cause]: ConversionError:
LibreOffice native conversion failed: Unknown LibreOfficeKit exception
```

失败发生在：

```text
@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit
runNative()
```

---

## 隔离测试

为了确认问题来源，我做了以下组合测试：

```text
A. prepared dsh root + prepared Electron + prepared runtime
   PASS

B. packaged dsh root + packaged EXE + packaged runtime
   FAIL

C. packaged dsh root + prepared Electron + packaged runtime
   FAIL

D. prepared dsh root + packaged EXE + prepared runtime
   PASS

E. packaged dsh root + prepared Electron + prepared runtime
   FAIL

F. prepared dsh root + prepared Electron + packaged runtime
   PASS
```

结果非常稳定：

```text
prepared dsh root  -> PASS
packaged dsh root  -> FAIL
```

因此决定结果的因素是 `dsh root` 本身，而不是：

```text
Electron executable
bundled runtime
```

---

## 已排除 native package 内容差异

比较以下两个目录：

```text
Prepared:

apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

```text
Packaged:

apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

比较结果：

```text
file count identical
file size identical
per-file SHA-256 identical
```

因此可以排除：

```text
electron-builder 漏文件
electron-builder 修改了 LibreOfficeKit native package
native package 内容损坏
```

---

## 已排除 app.asar 虚拟路径直接传给 native helper

最初怀疑 `require.resolve()` 在 Electron 中返回了：

```text
...\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

然后这个虚拟路径被传给 native helper。

但实际运行时打印出的路径是：

```text
executable =
C:\PROJETS-PERSO\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64\bin\libreoffice-kit.exe
```

```text
programDirectory =
C:\PROJETS-PERSO\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64\program\program
```

```text
root =
C:\PROJETS-PERSO\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

所以最终传给 native helper 的路径已经是：

```text
app.asar.unpacked
```

对应的真实物理路径。

不是：

```text
app.asar
```

虚拟路径。

---

## 路径长度统计

对 LibreOfficeKit engine 的完整绝对路径进行统计后，发现 prepared 和 packaged 的差异很大。

大致结果：

```text
prepared engine longest path: ~218 characters
packaged engine longest path: ~278 characters
packaged engine files >= 260 characters: ~706
```

packaged engine root：

```text
C:\PROJETS-PERSO\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

其中 `libreoffice-kit.exe` 本身仍然可以正常启动，所以并不是 executable path 直接无法访问。

但 LibreOfficeKit 初始化以及实际文档转换过程中，还会继续访问：

```text
program\program\...
program\share\...
```

以及其它更深层资源。

因此内部实际访问路径会比 `programDirectory` 本身更长。

---

## 决定性 A/B 测试

为了确认是否与路径长度有关，我没有修改 packaged LibreOfficeKit native package 的任何文件。

而是将完全相同的 packaged engine 通过 Windows Junction 映射到短路径：

```text
C:\lo-test
```

例如：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path 'C:\lo-test' `
  -Target 'C:\PROJETS-PERSO\deepseek-harness\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64'
```

然后让 runtime 使用：

```text
executable:
C:\lo-test\bin\libreoffice-kit.exe
```

```text
programDirectory:
C:\lo-test\program\program
```

其它条件保持不变：

```text
same packaged engine
same files
same SHA-256
same runtime
same Electron
same smoke test
same input/output/profile logic
```

结果：

```text
desktop runtime: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX to PDF passed
```

也就是说：

```text
Same packaged engine
Same files
Same SHA-256
Same smoke test

Long physical path -> FAIL
C:\lo-test         -> PASS
```

这个结果目前是最有判别力的证据。

---

## 当前判断

目前看起来，问题高度集中在 Windows 下 LibreOfficeKit / LibreOffice 内部对长路径的处理。

Native helper 本身可以正常启动，但 LibreOffice 初始化、Writer/filter/config/resource 加载过程中会访问更深层的资源路径。

当完整绝对路径过长时，某个内部 Windows API 或 LibreOffice 组件可能无法正常处理，最终 native helper 只返回：

```text
Unknown LibreOfficeKit exception
```

所以表面看起来像 LibreOfficeKit 初始化异常，但实际可能是内部资源路径访问失败。

---

## 为什么 prepared runtime 正常，而 packaged runtime 失败

Prepared engine 路径较短：

```text
...\targets\win-x64\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

Packaged engine 路径明显更深：

```text
...\targets\win-x64\unsigned-artifacts\win-unpacked\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

两份 native package 内容完全一致。

真正发生变化的是：

```text
physical absolute path depth
```

这也与前面的 A-F cross test 完全一致：

```text
prepared dsh root  -> PASS
packaged dsh root  -> FAIL
```

---

## 建议修复方向

可以考虑让 Windows Desktop packaging 将 LibreOfficeKit native engine 放到更浅的物理目录，例如：

```text
resources\lo
```

或者：

```text
resources\lok
```

而不是当前的：

```text
resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit-win32-x64
```

然后让 `@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit` 或 Desktop runtime 显式使用这个 native engine physical path。

例如目标结构可以类似：

```text
resources\
  lok\
    bin\
    program\
```

而不是：

```text
resources\
  app.asar.unpacked\
    dsh\
      node_modules\
        @deepseek-ai\
          libreoffice-kit-win32-x64\
```

这样可以显著降低 Windows 下 LibreOfficeKit 内部资源的完整绝对路径长度。

相比要求用户启用 Windows long-path system setting，这种方式可能更可靠，因为 LibreOffice 及其依赖组件未必全部使用支持 long path 的 Windows API。

---

## 其它已做的检查

当前已经检查或排除：

```text
- prepared / packaged native package file count
- file size
- per-file SHA-256
- Electron executable
- bundled runtime
- app.asar virtual path
- app.asar.unpacked native path
- native helper executable path
- programDirectory
```

最终只有：

```text
long physical path -> FAIL
short Junction path -> PASS
```

可以稳定改变结果。

discussions.title: 【Bug】已完成的轮次被整体折叠，隐藏前面轮次的助手正文，造成"内容被截断"的错误认知
discussions.body:
## 环境

- 包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-alpha.1`（npm 安装版）
- 插件：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat@0.1.7-alpha.1`
- 系统：Windows

## 问题描述（核心）

一个轮次结束后，该轮次的助手正文会被整体折叠隐藏，**只剩下最后一轮可见**。

当一次交付内容跨多个助手轮次时（例如先给出主体，再补充若干块），用户只能看到**最后一轮**，
因而会合理地认为那就是完整的交付物，误以为其余内容被截断或丢失。

**这是信息完整性问题，不是显示偏好问题**：任何展示档位、任何折叠策略，
都不应该让用户无法察觉"前面还有内容"。

## 影响

- 用户产生"内容被截断"的错误判断，据此做出错误决策（例如以为评审报告只有最后一小段）。
- 内容实际存在却不可见，与"内容确实缺失"在界面上无法区分。
- 属于静默失败：没有提示、没有计数、没有"还有 N 段内容"的指示。

## 复现步骤

1. 让助手产生一段跨多个轮次的交付内容（先主体、后补充）
2. 待较早的轮次结束（`turnClosed`）
3. 观察：较早轮次的助手正文被折叠隐藏，界面只展示最后一轮
4. 结果：用户以为最后一轮即为完整交付物

**该行为与「工作过程展示」设置无关**：compact / detailed / expanded 三档下均会发生。
（即使用户把该设置调成「完全展开」，前面的轮次依然被折叠。）

## 根因定位

三档展示策略中，`foldCompletedTurns` **全部硬编码为 `true`**，不存在任何可关闭它的档位或设置项。

`packages/client/ui-chat` → 构建产物 `lib/client.js`，源区域 `lib/types/client/presentation-policy.js`
（以下行号为 npm 打包后 `lib/client.js` 的行号）：

```js
// client.js:11474-11496
const POLICIES = {
  compact:  { mode: "compact",  foldCompletedTurns: true, stepGrouping: "collapsed", liveProcessDetail: false, settledReasoningPreview: false },
  detailed: { mode: "detailed", foldCompletedTurns: true, stepGrouping: "collapsed", liveProcessDetail: true,  settledReasoningPreview: true  },
  expanded: { mode: "expanded", foldCompletedTurns: true, stepGrouping: "none",      liveProcessDetail: true,  settledReasoningPreview: true  }
};
```

折叠判定（把已完成轮次整体隐藏）：

```js
// client.js:1975
const outerHidden = foldCompleted && presentation?.turnClosed === true && spec !== void 0
                    && !alwaysOpen && stored?.answerStep !== (spec.answerStep ?? 0);
```

另一处相关消费点：

```js
// client.js:1638-1643
const foldCompleted = usePresentation((policy) => policy.foldCompletedTurns);
const processWindowReady = processSpec !== void 0 && processPresentation !== void 0 && foldCompleted && ...;
```

## 建议

### 1. 区分"工具/过程信息"与"交付内容"（核心修复方向）

折叠**过程信息**（工具调用、推理步骤）是合理的；但**不应折叠助手面向用户的正文**。
建议让 `foldCompletedTurns` 只作用于过程性节点，不作用于用户可读的助手消息内容。

### 2. 若确实需要折叠，必须提供"还有内容"的可感知指示

至少满足其一，避免静默丢失：

- 折叠处显示可见摘要或计数（如"前面还有 2 段回复"），而不是完全隐藏；
- 或在界面明确提示被折叠的轮次数，让用户知道内容存在。

### 3. 至少不要让「完全展开」档仍然折叠

在完成 1 或 2 之前，`expanded` 档应将 `foldCompletedTurns` 置为 `false`，
使该档位名副其实，作为用户的临时规避手段：

```js
expanded: {
  mode: "expanded",
  foldCompletedTurns: false,   // 原为 true
  stepGrouping: "none",
  liveProcessDetail: true,
  settledReasoningPreview: true
}
```

## 备注

- 行号为 npm 包内 `lib/client.js` 的行号，非源码行号；源文件路径依据该 bundle 内嵌的
  `//#region` 标记与构建元数据（`/home/runner/work/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness/...`）推断。
  建议按符号名 `foldCompletedTurns` / `outerHidden` 搜索定位。
- 临时绕过：点击已折叠轮次上的「工作过程」折叠条可展开，展开状态会被记录、刷新后保持。
  但**用户必须先意识到"内容被折叠了"才会去点**——这正是本 issue 要解决的问题。
- 无关项说明：工具结果的 JSON 另有独立的字符上限截断（`client.js:366-368`，`MAX_CHARS`），
  不作用于助手消息正文，与本 issue 无关。

discussions.title: [BUG] Code block copy button fails with execCommand error; manual selection escapes block when overflow is active
discussions.body:
## Description

To the DeepSeek Development Team,

I am reporting two related defects in the code block component of the web chat interface, plus one optional suggestion.

---

## Bug 1: "Copy" button fails with `document.execCommand` warning

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a chat with a code block.
2. Click the "Копировать" (Copy) button in the code block banner.
3. Open DevTools (`F12`) → **Console** tab.

### Actual behavior

The following warning appears in the console:

```
document.execCommand('cut'/'copy') was denied because it was not called from inside a short running user-generated event handler.
```

The code is **not** copied to the clipboard.

### Expected behavior

The code should be copied to the clipboard without errors.

### Suspected root cause

The site appears to use `document.execCommand('copy')` as a fallback inside an asynchronous handler (e.g., after `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` throws). Modern browsers block `execCommand('copy')` when it is not called synchronously within a user gesture — this is standard security behavior, not a Firefox-specific issue.

The fix is to remove the asynchronous fallback and rely solely on `navigator.clipboard.writeText()`, which returns a Promise and works correctly with async code.

See also: related issue #1494, which describes the opposite scenario (the `execCommand` fallback is never reached because `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` is permission-denied and the `catch` block returns early).

---

## Bug 2: Manual selection of code blocks escapes the block when overflow is active

### Condition

The bug manifests **only when overflow is active** in the code block — that is, when content exceeds the block's dimensions and a scrollbar appears (either horizontal or vertical). When the code is short enough not to cause overflow, selection works correctly.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a chat with a code block containing enough content to cause overflow (long lines or many lines).
2. Start selecting the code from the left padding area of the block (the empty space between the left border and the first character).
3. Drag the mouse to the right or left.

### Actual behavior

When the selection starts in the padding area, the selection root is escalated above the `<pre>` element. Dragging the mouse then selects the entire page (or the entire message block) instead of just the code. When the cursor passes over whitespace text nodes between `<span>` elements inside the code, the same escalation occurs temporarily.

### Expected behavior

Selection should remain constrained to the code block.

### Root cause

The `<pre>` element has `overflow: auto` applied via `.ds-markdown pre`. This turns `<pre>` into a scroll container. When the selection anchor is resolved in the padding area (where there is no text), the browser cannot find a valid text position inside the scroll container and escalates the selection root to the nearest non-clipping ancestor. Without `overflow: auto`, the anchor is correctly resolved to the beginning of the first text line inside `<pre>`.

### Evidence

- Disabling `overflow: auto` on `<pre>` in DevTools eliminates the problem entirely.
- Relevant CSS:

```css
.md-code-block > pre {
  padding: 16px;
  margin: 0 !important;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.ds-markdown pre {
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 16px 0;
}
```

### Additional observation (not a reproduction step)

If the code was previously selected in full, the bug tends to manifest more frequently. This may be a browser-specific behavior, and I cannot claim it is a reliable reproduction method — providing it as an observation only.

### Suggested fix

Move `overflow: auto` from `<pre>` to the parent container (`.md-code-block` or an inner wrapper). This preserves horizontal scrolling for long lines while keeping `<pre>` as a normal block element, so selection anchors resolve correctly.

---

## Optional suggestion: setting to disable internal scroll in code blocks

This suggestion is **not directly related** to the bugs described above and is not part of the request to fix them. Whether to implement it is entirely at the developers' discretion.

Some users (myself included) prefer the page to scroll as a whole rather than having nested scroll containers inside code blocks. Nested scrollbars can also cause the browser to scroll the code block instead of the page when the mouse wheel is used over it.

I propose adding a user setting (e.g., in interface settings) to disable internal scrolling in code blocks. When disabled, long lines would rely on the existing `white-space: pre-wrap` behavior and wrap naturally. This setting exists in some other AI chat interfaces, so there is precedent for it being a useful option.

---

## Summary (for maintainers)

- **Environment:** Firefox 128.3.1esr (64-bit), Linux, X11
- **Reproduce:** See steps in each bug section above.
- **Impact:**
  - **Bug 1:** Copy button is completely non-functional for all users.
  - **Bug 2:** Manual selection of code blocks is broken when overflow is active, making it difficult to copy code by hand.
- **Evidence:** DevTools console warning (Bug 1), relevant CSS (Bug 2), and observation that disabling `overflow: auto` resolves the issue.

*Note: The manual selection issue is not browser-specific; it stems from the interaction between `overflow: auto` on `<pre>` and the browser's selection anchor resolution algorithm. The `execCommand` warning is also browser-agnostic and is the browser correctly enforcing the user-gesture requirement for clipboard writes.*

---

Thank you for your attention to these issues. The DeepSeek web interface is otherwise the highest-quality AI chat UI I have used.

[BUG]pnpm dsh web：首次工具调用失败，提示“Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')”，并导致会话永久中断
discussions.body:
> **Duplicate / related**: this is the same defect already tracked in
> [#7273 Source launch crashes on every tool call](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7273)
> (the canonical thread, with a Collaborator reply) and analysed in
> [#7265](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7265),
> [#7338](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7338),
> [#7223](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7223).
> Please follow #7273 for updates; I will not treat this post as a separate tracker.
>
> **What this post adds**: the same split (`lib/` row entries vs `src/` imports from those entries)
> reproduces on a **stock profile with no profile-local plugins**, from a **fresh clone + fresh
> `pnpm install` + fresh `pnpm run build`**, and the probe readout is
> `service instanceof artifact-plane ToolRuntime: true`, `service[source scheduler] defined: false`.

## Summary

`pnpm dsh web`（源码启动）下，**任何一次工具调用都会失败**，并且会让该会话的日志永久不可用（后续每一轮请求都失败）。同一个 checkout 用产物平面启动（`node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`）则一切正常。

## Reproduction

已确认在**全新 clone + 全新依赖 + 全新构建**上必现，与本地环境状态无关：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

然后在 GUI 里发一条会用到工具的指令（例如“查看当前文件目录”）。

## Current behavior

1. 第一次工具调用时该轮直接以错误结束（会话日志中的 `turn/end`）：

```
{"type":"turn/end","data":{"turn":2,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}}
```

2. 该工具调用没有产生结果事件：整份日志 `tool/call=1`、`tool/result=0`。

3. 之后这个会话**每一轮请求都失败**：

- harness 自身的序列化器先拒绝：`DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results`
  （`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/serialize.ts:117`）
- 直连 API 时报 400：`An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)`

即：一次工具基础设施故障会永久毁掉一个会话，只能新建会话。

## Expected behavior

- 源码启动（`pnpm dsh web`）与产物启动（`node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`）行为一致，插件解析只使用一个模块平面；
- 工具调用正常执行；
- 即使工具调度器失败，日志也应保持“可继续请求”的状态（不留下没有结果的 `tool/call`）。

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11 (10.0.26100)，PowerShell
- Node: v24.12.0
- dsh: commit `ddefc45fbc`（0.1.6-alpha.2），源码启动 `pnpm dsh web`
- 对照：`pnpm run build` 之后 `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` 正常

## 根因（供参考，附最小证据）

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 是按模块实例生成的 `unique symbol`（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463`），agent-loop 用它取调度器（`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170`：`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(...)`）。

源码启动时同一个进程里存在**两份** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`：

- 插件行经 profile 解析落到构建产物 `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js`；
- 仓库内文件的裸导入被 tsx 的 tsconfig `paths` 映射到源码 `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`。

在一个真实 profile boot（`--profile acp`）里挂探针读取，结果：

```
service instanceof artifact-plane ToolRuntime: true
service instanceof source-plane ToolRuntime: false
service[source scheduler] defined: false     ← agent-loop 侧拿到的符号
service[artifact scheduler] defined: true
```

因此 agent-loop 查到的调度器是 `undefined`。这与仓库约定 “Source plane vs artifact plane, never mixed” 冲突。

修复方向（本地已验证、未提交）：让 profile 解析跟随启动平面——源码启动时，把解析到 `lib/**/*.js` 的条目改投存在的 `src/**/*.ts(x)`；生成的 host 产物与浏览器/Worker 打包件没有对应源码，继续留在 `lib/`；Worker 因为没有 tsx hook 固定产物平面。相关位置：`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`、`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts`。

## 另一个相关缺陷（同一条因果链的第二段）

工具组失败后，已经写入的 `tool/call` 不会补结果（`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts` 的现有设计注释是 “without fabricating results”），于是日志永久停在“assistant 带 tool_calls 但没有结果”的状态。崩溃恢复路径（`packages/core/session/src/repair.ts` 的 `interruptedTurnClosers`）已经有同类语义（`TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`），建议实时失败路径也补一条结果，避免一次故障毁掉会话。

---

## Body (English)

## Summary

With a source launch (`pnpm dsh web`), **every tool call fails**, and the failure permanently breaks the session: all later requests in it fail too. The same checkout launched from built artifacts (`node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`) works.

## Reproduction

Reproduced on a **fresh clone + fresh install + fresh build**:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

Then send any prompt that uses a tool (for example “list the current directory”).

## Current behavior

1. The first tool call ends its turn with an error (`turn/end` in the session log):

```
{"type":"turn/end","data":{"turn":2,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}}}
```

2. The call has no result event: the log contains `tool/call=1`, `tool/result=0`.

3. Every later request in that session then fails:
   - the harness serializer rejects it first: `DeepSeek Messages tool calls need immediate results`
     (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/serialize.ts:117`)
   - a direct provider call returns 400: `An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'.`

## Expected behavior

- A source launch behaves like a built launch: plugin resolution stays on one module plane.
- Tool calls execute normally.
- A tool-scheduler failure leaves the log requestable (no `tool/call` without a result).

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11 (10.0.26100), PowerShell
- Node: v24.12.0
- dsh: commit `ddefc45fbc` (0.1.6-alpha.2), source launch `pnpm dsh web`
- Control: `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` after `pnpm run build` works

## Root cause (with minimal evidence)

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a `unique symbol` created per module instance (`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:463`), and the agent loop reads the scheduler through it (`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:170`: `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(...)`).

A source launch loads **two copies** of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` in one process:

- plugin rows resolve through the profile to the built artifact `packages/core/tools/lib/index.js`;
- bare imports inside the repository are projected by tsx's tsconfig `paths` to the source file `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts`.

A probe mounted in a real profile boot (`--profile acp`) reads:

```
service instanceof artifact-plane ToolRuntime: true
service instanceof source-plane ToolRuntime: false
service[source scheduler] defined: false     ← the symbol the agent loop holds
service[artifact scheduler] defined: true
```

So the scheduler lookup in the agent loop is `undefined`, contradicting the repository rule “Source plane vs artifact plane, never mixed”.

Fix direction (verified locally, uncommitted): make profile resolution follow the launch plane — under a source launch, a routed entry that resolves into `lib/**/*.js` moves to the matching `src/**/*.ts(x)` when it exists (generated host artifacts and bundled browser/Worker payloads keep the artifact); Workers stay on the artifact plane because they have no tsx hook. Files: `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`, `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts`.

## Related second defect

When a tool group fails, already-written `tool/call` events receive no result (`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts` documents “without fabricating results”), leaving the log permanently in an “assistant with tool_calls and no results” state. Crash repair already models this case (`packages/core/session/src/repair.ts`, `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`); the live failure path should record the same kind of result so one failure cannot destroy a session.

discussions.title: [Bug] v0.1.7-alpha.1 深度搜索中上下文被频繁压缩：5分38秒内触发6次（仅1-4条/1.4k-3.6k tokens），并伴随 summary-not-smaller 空转
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh: `0.1.7-alpha.1`（本地 `dsh --version` / `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --version` 均为此版本）
- profile: web
- 模型路由：`provider ohub / model deepseek-v4.1-flash`，`request/context` 中 `contextWindow: 400000`，`request/header` 中 `reasoningEffort: max, maxTokens: 300000`
- 会话：`session-6ec4299a-625f-4339-850e-9047d2eeef25`，`session.v4.jsonl` 共 261 条记录（`user/message` 22，`assistant/message` 26，`tool/call` 32，`tool/result` 39），基本集中在一个 turn 内（全程约 8 分钟）

## 现象（有截图）

一次“深度搜索”（界面计时 5 分 38 秒）过程中，右侧轨迹密集出现“上下文已压缩”：

- 已压缩 1 条历史记录（约 1431 tokens）
- 已压缩 3 条历史记录（约 2770 tokens）
- 已压缩 1 条历史记录（约 1923 tokens）
- 已压缩 4 条历史记录（约 2919 tokens）
- 已压缩 3 条历史记录（约 3633 tokens）
- 已压缩 1 条历史记录（约 2135 tokens）

合计约 15 条、约 1.5 万 tokens，被拆成 6 次压缩，平均不到 1 分钟一次。每次只压 1~4 条、1.4k~3.6k tokens，体感是“刚写一点就压一次”。

## 对 session 日志的取证

`session.v4.jsonl` 中与压缩相关的记录：

- `compaction/start`: 20 次
- `compaction/end`: 20 次
- `compaction/summary`: 16 次
- `compaction/prune`: 8 次（`shadowedTokenCount` 多在 2400~8600 之间，均只覆盖单条 seq）

其中 4 次 `compaction/end` 带 error，全部是“摘要比被压缩内容还大”类空转：

- `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (1044 estimated framed tokens >= 137)`
- `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (2239 estimated framed tokens >= 2239)`
- `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (2417 estimated framed tokens >= 2409)`
- `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (2688 estimated framed tokens >= 2687)`

即：阈值似乎压得很勤（小到 137 tokens 的 span 也会触发一次 compaction），而这种小 span 压完摘要反而更大，白白烧一次摘要调用，符合“频繁但无效”的观感。

## 已排查过的相关讨论（均不是同一个问题）

- #7423《小窗口路由下 compaction 会持续失败》：说的是摘要请求跟随小窗口路由导致的确定性自锁，我的环境是 `contextWindow 400000` 的大窗口，不属于该场景。
- #2737《compaction thrashing》、#4776《反复压缩不可压缩 checkpoint 死循环》、#5279《低效压缩，每次只压缩一轮对话》：症状描述接近，但都是 8 月~9 月初、老版本下的报告；当前是 `0.1.7-alpha.1` 新出现的体感，且没有 checkpoint 死循环，只是阈值过勤 + 小 span 空转。

## 期望

1. 确认 `0.1.7-alpha.1` 是否收紧了 proactive compaction 的触发阈值（结合 `maxTokens: 300000` + `reasoningEffort: max` 的大预留下，实际可用窗口是否被提前吃掉很多，导致过早/过勤触发）。
2. 如果小 span（百~千级 tokens）本就不该触发，建议加一个最小 span 门限；`summary is not smaller than shadowed content` 这类可预判的空转能否在摘要调用前剪枝掉。
3. 如需复现数据，我可按需提供脱敏后的 `session.v4.jsonl` 片段（完整文件 1.6MB，含本机路径等信息，故未直接贴附件）。

discussions.title: [BUG] web_search always fails: "DeepSeek returned an unprocessable response body" (brotli not decoded under custom undici dispatcher)
discussions.body:
# web_search always fails: "DeepSeek returned an unprocessable response body" (brotli response not decoded when a custom undici dispatcher is installed)

## Environment

- Package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.7-alpha.1** (also reproduced on 0.1.1-rc.2 — the bug predates the 0.1.7 alpha)
- Node.js: **v24.15.0**, Windows 11 (build 26100)
- Profile: `web` (default)
- Bug still present on `master`: `packages/web/web-search-deepseek/src/provider.ts` still issues a bare `fetch()` with no `accept-encoding` handling.

## Summary

Every `web_search` tool call fails with:

```
DeepSeek returned an unprocessable response body: SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'e', "ePZ..." ... is not valid JSON

The web search request used endpoint "https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages". Search endpoint configuration is separate from chat. ...
```

The model-facing `web_search` tool is completely unusable, while `web_fetch` still works.

## Root cause

1. `dsh-web-search-deepseek`'s provider calls bare `fetch()` with no `accept-encoding` header, so the client advertises `gzip, deflate, br`.
2. `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages` (served via CloudFront) responds with `Content-Encoding: br` (brotli).
3. `dsh-http-proxy` imports userland `undici` (8.11.0) at boot. undici 8.x mirrors its global dispatcher into the legacy `Symbol.for('undici.globalDispatcher.1')` slot, so **Node's built-in `fetch` now runs on a custom dispatcher** even when no proxy is configured.
4. With that custom dispatcher active, Node's built-in `fetch` does **not** decode response content-encoding: the `Content-Encoding` header comes back as `null` and the body stays raw brotli bytes (gzip is equally undecoded).
5. The provider's `response.json()` parses raw brotli bytes → `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'e', ...`. The `'e'` is byte `0x65`, the first byte of the brotli stream — hence `"ePZ..."` in the error.

## Evidence (all reproduced locally)

| Experiment | Result |
|---|---|
| `curl` with `Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br` to the endpoint | `200 OK`, `Content-Encoding: br`, body starts with hex `65 00 10 2D ...` (raw brotli) |
| Node built-in `fetch`, stock process (no undici loaded) | `200`, `Content-Encoding: br`, body correctly decoded to JSON |
| Same Node script, after `require('<dsh>/node_modules/undici')` (installs the legacy global dispatcher slot) | `200`, `Content-Encoding: null`, body is **raw brotli** → `JSON.parse` throws the exact error above |
| Same, with `Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate` | body is raw gzip, still undecoded (not just a brotli-specific gap) |
| Same, with `Accept-Encoding: identity` | `200`, uncompressed JSON, parses fine ✔ |

Minimal repro (no dsh needed beyond the bundled undici):

```js
require('<dsh-install>/node_modules/undici') // mirrors its global dispatcher into Node's built-in fetch
const r = await fetch('https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'x-api-key': KEY, 'authorization': 'Bearer ' + KEY,
    'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
    'content-type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-v4-flash', max_tokens: 64,
    messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'hi' }] }] }),
})
const t = await r.text() // raw brotli bytes starting with 0x65 — JSON.parse fails
```

## Verified workaround

Setting `'accept-encoding': 'identity'` on the search request makes the server return uncompressed JSON, which parses correctly. (Setting gzip alone does **not** help — the custom-dispatcher path leaves gzip undecoded too.)

## Suggested fixes

1. **Immediate:** add `'accept-encoding': 'identity'` to the `fetch` headers in `packages/web/web-search-deepseek/src/provider.ts`.
2. **Root cause:** do not let importing `undici` 8.x hijack Node's built-in `fetch` when no proxy policy is actually active (the `dsh-http-proxy` "none" path still ends up with undici's default global Agent mirrored into the legacy `Symbol.for('undici.globalDispatcher.1')` slot), or use `undici`'s own `fetch` — which decodes brotli correctly — for this request. Note `web_fetch` works precisely because `dsh-web-fetch-http` uses undici's own `fetch`.

---

*Filed via GitHub Discussions (issues are disabled on this repo).*

discussions.title: 桌面端打包末尾 Office 冒烟失败：LibreOfficeKit 在深构建路径下的长路径缺陷
discussions.body:
## 摘要

在较深的本地检出路径下执行 `pnpm --dir apps/desktop run package:win:x64 -- --unsigned --dir`，electron-builder 打包全部成功，但最后的 `smoke-packaged-runtime` 冒烟稳定失败：

```
Error: desktop runtime: docx conversion failed: OfficeToPdfError: LibreOffice conversion failed.
  [cause]: ConversionError: LibreOffice native conversion failed: Unknown LibreOfficeKit exception
```

排查确认这是 **LibreOfficeKit 原生引擎（UNO bootstrap）的长路径缺陷**导致的假阳性：产物本身完好，安装到较短路径后 Office 转换功能正常。CI 检出路径较短，因此不触发。

## 环境

- Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200，x64
- master `c36a83ff6b`（dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1）
- 构建模式：`package:win:x64 -- --unsigned --dir`（无签名、仅目录产物）
- 检出路径：`D:\Project\deepseek-harness`（产物完整路径约 230+ 字符，见下文）

## 现象

- `prepare:dsh` 阶段的 Office 冒烟（运行于 `targets/win-x64/dsh/` 源树）**通过**：`desktop runtime: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX to PDF passed`
- `smoke-packaged-runtime`（运行于 `unsigned-artifacts/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar.unpacked/...`）**稳定失败**，两次复现均为同一错误

## 排查过程与证据

### 1. 排除文件差异

对比打包前（`targets/win-x64/dsh/...`）与打包后（`app.asar.unpacked/dsh/...`）的 `libreoffice-kit-win32-x64` 包：

```
A(源,未过滤) 文件数: 2050
B(打包,已过滤) 文件数: 2050
diff: 无差异
```

`runtime-file-policy` 未删除任何引擎文件，排除打包过滤嫌疑。

### 2. 排除引擎本身故障

构造最小 docx，用普通 Node 从源树位置调用 `libreoffice-kit` 的 `createConverter().render()`：

```
CONVERT_OK size=16002
```

引擎在该路径下工作正常。

### 3. 直接调用 helper exe 拿到真实错误

绕过 Node 层，按 `runNative` 的参数直接执行 helper：

```sh
"<pkg>/bin/libreoffice-kit.exe" \
  --program-directory "<pkg>/program/program" \
  --input-path test.docx --output-path out.pdf \
  --profile-directory <空目录> \
  --max-output-bytes 10485760 --max-image-resolution 300
```

helper 的 stderr 暴露了被 "Unknown LibreOfficeKit exception" 吞掉的真实原因：

```
Bootstrapping exception 'stat'ed file does not exist:
file:///D:/Project/deepseek-harness/apps/desktop/.desktop-build/targets/win-x64/
unsigned-artifacts/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/
@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-win32-x64/program/program/../share/registry/res/fcfg_langpack_en-US.xcd
```

而 `fcfg_langpack_en-US.xcd` **实际存在**于该目录。bootstrap 用的是**未规范化的路径**（含 `program/program/../` 的 `..` 段），深路径下 stat 误报文件不存在。

### 4. 决定性对照实验

把整个 `libreoffice-kit-win32-x64` 包复制到短路径 `D:\tmp\lo-short`，用完全相同的参数重跑：

```
{"ok":true,"missingFonts":[]}   →  out-short.pdf 正常生成（16002 字节）
```

同一份文件、同一个 exe，仅路径长度不同，结果相反。

### 路径长度对比

| 位置 | bootstrap 路径长度（含 `..` 段） | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 源树 `targets/win-x64/dsh/...` | ~188 字符 | ✅ 通过 |
| 打包产物 `unsigned-artifacts/.../app.asar.unpacked/...` | ~251 字符 | ❌ stat 误报 |
| 复制到 `D:\tmp\lo-short` | ~60 字符 | ✅ 通过 |

失败阈值在 188 与 251 之间，与 UNO/osl 内部缓冲的常见 256 字符限制吻合。

## 根因

LibreOfficeKit helper 的 UNO bootstrap 以未规范化形式（`programDirectory/../share/...`）拼接并 stat 配置文件。当 `programDirectory` 本身较长（本例为打包产物的 `app.asar.unpacked` 深路径）时，带 `..` 的路径超过引擎内部缓冲限制，stat 误报“文件不存在”，bootstrap 抛出未知异常，最终被包装成 `Unknown LibreOfficeKit exception`。

## 影响

- **产物本身无缺陷**：安装到用户机器的常规路径（如 `C:\Users\<name>\AppData\...` 或自定义短路径）后 Office 转换正常
- **本地深路径构建出现假阳性失败**：`package:*` 命令以非零退出码结束，容易误导开发者以为产物有问题
- CI 检出路径短，不触发；此前 0.1.6-alpha.2 在同一深路径构建通过，说明该路径长度恰好跨越了阈值（打包路径随 `unsigned-artifacts/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar.unpacked` 引入变长，可能源于版本变化后的布局调整）

## 修复建议

任一层面修复均可：

1. **上游 libreoffice-kit（推荐）**：helper 启动前把 `--program-directory` 规范化为不含 `..` 的绝对路径（`path.resolve` / `realpath`），或在 helper 内部拼接 `../share` 前先规范化；同时考虑对 bootstrap 的 stat 失败给出可诊断的错误信息而非 "Unknown exception"
2. **kit JS 层**：`readEngine` 返回 `programDirectory` 前做 `resolve()` 规范化——本例中 `program/program` + `../share` 若先规范化为 `program/share`，可省约 14 字符，但仍建议根治
3. **冒烟脚本兜底**：`smoke-packaged-runtime` 在深路径环境下对失败结果附带路径长度提示，或将产物复制到短路径临时目录再验证

## 最小复现步骤

```sh
# 1. 构建任意 win-x64 目录产物
pnpm --dir apps/desktop run package:win:x64 -- --unsigned --dir

# 2. 准备一个最小 docx(或任意可转换的 docx)

# 3. 直接调用打包产物里的 helper(注意用深路径的 program-directory)
PKG="apps/desktop/.desktop-build/targets/win-x64/unsigned-artifacts/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-win32-x64"
mkdir -p /tmp/lo-profile
"$PKG/bin/libreoffice-kit.exe" \
  --program-directory "$PKG/program/program" \
  --input-path test.docx --output-path out.pdf \
  --profile-directory /tmp/lo-profile \
  --max-output-bytes 10485760 --max-image-resolution 300
# 深路径: stderr 出现 Bootstrapping exception, stdout {"ok":false,...,"error":"Unknown LibreOfficeKit exception"}
# 复制 PKG 到短路径后同样命令: {"ok":true,...}
```

discussions.title: Windows: workspace-write sandbox fails with SetNamedSecurityInfoW Win32 5 when the workspace directory DACL lacks WRITE_OWNER
discussions.body:
**Status (2026-09-26): still reproduces on the newest published version, `0.1.7-rc.2`.**

This post is the consolidated report — environment → reproduction → root cause → implemented fix → **the policy decision we are asking for** — so the thread does not have to be reassembled from the long comments below. Everything is measured on one machine unless explicitly marked as analysis; the artifact comparisons and command transcripts are reproducible from the text.

---

## 1. Environment

- Windows 11 IoT Enterprise 26H2 (build 26300.9267), normal (non-elevated) user account
- `dsh` tested on: `0.1.6-alpha.2`, `0.1.7-alpha.1`, `0.1.7-alpha.2`, `0.1.7-rc.1`, **`0.1.7-rc.2` (current baseline; published 2026-09-24T14:18:11Z)**
- Two-node install (`D:\DeepSeek\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\*`), profile `web`; workspace on a **data drive**: `D:\<workspace>` — i.e. a volume whose inherited template does *not* grant the caller `WRITE_OWNER` (see §3.3)

## 2. Reproduction

Under the `workspace-write` file policy, **every** PowerShell (and bash) invocation fails before the child process is created:

```
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\<workspace>)
```

`Win32 5` is `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`. The sandbox is fail-closed, so no child is ever spawned. File tools (`read`/`glob`/`grep`/`write`/`edit`) and MCP tools are unaffected; `danger-full-access` also works.

A minimal probe (must run from an **unconfined** shell — see the note at the end of this section):

```js
// node probe.mjs <workspaceDir>
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import os from 'node:os';
const ws = process.argv[2];
const tmp = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'probe-tmp');
fs.mkdirSync(tmp, { recursive: true });
const { AclSandbox, workspaceWriteSid, tempWriteSid } =
  await import(pathToFileURL('D:\\DeepSeek\\node_modules\\@deepseek-ai\\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\\lib\\index.js').href);
const sb = new AclSandbox({
  writableDirs: [ws], tempDir: tmp,
  writeSid: workspaceWriteSid(ws), tempWriteSid: tempWriteSid(tmp),
  mode: 'workspace-write',
});
await sb.init();   // throws Win32 5 here while the DACL lacks WRITE_OWNER
const r = await sb.spawn({ command: 'cmd.exe', args: ['/c', 'echo ok'], cwd: ws }).wait();
console.log(r.exitCode, r.stdout.toString().trim());
sb.dispose();
```

Measured on the installed `0.1.7-rc.2`, fresh directories, one variable (the target directory's effective ACL):

| Target directory (freshly created) | Effective ACL template | `init()` + `spawn()` |
|---|---|---|
| `D:\<probe>` (non-profile volume) | `Authenticated Users:(I)(M)` — **no `WRITE_OWNER`** | ❌ `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5)` |
| the same directory after `icacls "<dir>" /grant "<user>:(OI)(CI)(WO)"` | caller holds `WRITE_OWNER` | ✅ `spawn` OK (`probe-ok`) |
| `C:\Users\<user>\<probe>` | explicit `<user>:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)` | ✅ `spawn` OK |

`icacls` also shows the label layer directly: directories provisioned by `0.1.6-alpha.2` carry **no** `Mandatory Label`; those provisioned by `0.1.7+` carry `Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)`.

> The probe must run **unconfined**: inside a confined child the restricted token's capability ACE grants only `W,D,DC` and deliberately omits `WRITE_OWNER` (otherwise a confined child could re-grant itself), so any ACL-provisioning attempt from inside the sandbox fails regardless of the target.

## 3. Root cause

### 3.1 The code change

`0.1.7-alpha.1` extends every write grant with a **Low mandatory integrity label**: new symbols `buildLowLabelAcl`, `hasExactLabel`, `addMandatoryAce` (zero occurrences in `0.1.6-alpha.2`), and

```js
api.setNamedSecurityInfoW(path, 1, labelEdit.kind === "keep" ? 4 : 20, null, null, newAcl, labelEdit.kind === "apply" ? labelEdit.acl : null)
```

i.e. `SecurityInfo` went from `4` (`DACL`) to `20` (**`DACL | SACL`**); the read side changed the same way (`getNamedSecurityInfoW(..., DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION | LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION, ...)`). `DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION | LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION` is `4 | 16 = 20`, and `LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION` is the same bit as `SACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION`.

### 3.2 The precondition this creates

The label lives in the object's **SACL**, and the package's own README (`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.md:122`, *Verified boundaries*) states the resulting requirement — quoted verbatim, as suggested in the thread:

> Granted directories must be caller-owned and grant `WRITE_OWNER` — the owner's implicit rights cover only `READ_CONTROL` and `WRITE_DAC`; the label lives in the SACL, so the combined apply additionally needs `WRITE_OWNER` (a Full-control directory, the normal workspace case, has it). A directory whose DACL grants only Modify now fails the grant loudly instead of silently skipping the confinement.

`src/acl.ts:368` repeats it as a code comment ("The directory must be owned by the caller AND grant `WRITE_OWNER`"), and `src/win32-abi.ts:25` confirms `WRITE_DAC`/`WRITE_OWNER` are deliberately withheld from the confined child. So this is a **written precondition, not an oversight**, and "fails loudly" is intentional.

### 3.3 Why neither depth nor ownership is the discriminator

On NTFS a non-profile volume root's default template is `Authenticated Users:(M)` (Modify) **plus an inherit-only copy of the same**, together with `Users:(RX)`; none of those carries `WRITE_OWNER`. Because they are inheritable, **every directory on that volume inherits exactly this template at any depth** — intermediate directories only ever inherit or narrow, never widen.

Measured effective `WRITE_OWNER` for the caller (computed from the non-inherit-only ACEs applicable to the caller's token groups — user / Authenticated Users / Users / Everyone / INTERACTIVE):

| Path | Levels below the volume root | Owner | `WRITE_OWNER` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `D:\` | 0 | SYSTEM | ❌ |
| `D:\DeepSeek` | 1 | user | ❌ |
| `D:\<workspace>` | 2 | **user** | ❌ (before the fix) |
| `D:\AI Model\Work Date\Pi Lite Agent` | 3 | user | ❌ |
| `C:\Users\<user>` | — | SYSTEM | ✅ (created with an explicit `<user>: FullControl` ACE) |
| `C:\Users\<user>\Documents`, `…\AppData\Local\Temp` | — | user | ✅ (inherited) |

⇒ The condition is **"no directory on the inheritance chain grants the caller `WRITE_OWNER`"**, *not* "the workspace sits at a drive root". A workspace on a non-profile volume is affected no matter how deep it is; a workspace under the user profile is fine at any depth. **The grant root here is caller-owned** — the README's rule is a conjunction and this directory satisfies the first half while failing only the second, which is also why "change the owner" is not a remedy in this case.

### 3.4 Version scope: the implementation is byte-identical from `alpha.1` through `rc.2`

- `lib/types-DxezulnA.js` is 61058 bytes with SHA-256 `e6014e930810e6a6699feb78e6195a8180876cd9e99c2e74325e14c4807e0098` in **all four** of `alpha.1`, `alpha.2`, `rc.1`, `rc.2`.
- `npm pack @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.1.7-rc.2` extracted and compared against the installed tree: **18 files, 0 differences**. For `alpha.1` vs `alpha.2` the same comparison over the whole `@deepseek-ai/*` tree (267 packages, npm-cache tarballs verified against their recorded `integrity`) showed the sandbox packages differ **only in `package.json`**.
- Commit level: between `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.1` (`46a7f68b09`) and `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` (`477b4f4205`), the only change inside `packages/sandbox/` is four `package.json` files; in `sandbox-windows-acl` specifically, only `package.json`. (Note for anyone re-checking: the compare API truncates its file list at 300 entries, so query commits by path rather than trusting that list alone.)
- The rc.1 and rc.2 release notes contain **no** sandbox/ACL/permission entry.

⇒ Whatever changed between those releases, it was not this grant path — the failure cannot be fixed by upgrading within the 0.1.7 line as it stands.

### 3.5 "First provision only" — and why an upgrade cannot self-heal

Verified: a directory provisioned once (with `WRITE_OWNER` present), then with inheritance disabled and the `WRITE_OWNER` ACE removed while the path-derived capability ACE, the world-SID deny and the exact Low label remain, succeeds on a **second** `init()`. The documented `exact-ACE / exact-deny / exact-label` skip performs no label write and therefore needs no `WRITE_OWNER`.

**But that exemption does not cover anyone upgrading into 0.1.7** (credit to @xuhuanhello for the field data, and it follows from the skip predicate): a workspace provisioned by `0.1.6` has the standing capability ACE but **no label**, and the missing element is precisely the one whose write needs `WRITE_OWNER` — so the skip can never trigger. The breakage therefore lands on the **first confined command after the upgrade**, on any affected volume. (An earlier version of this post said the requirement was "first provision only" without that qualifier; the correct scope is **"first provision of an already-labelled directory"**.)

## 4. Impact

1. `workspace-write` is unusable for any workspace whose **grant root does not grant the caller `WRITE_OWNER`** — in practice every workspace on a non-profile volume (any project kept on a data drive). Moving the workspace deeper does not help.
2. There is **no fallback rung on Windows**, and the error is **not actionable**: a bare `Win32 5`, with no mention of `WRITE_OWNER` and no remedy.
3. The sandbox cannot self-heal even though it could — the caller is the owner and already holds implicit `WRITE_DAC`.
4. The failure is invisible at boot: the block itself says *"The win32 chain is a sole candidate, so the product never probes"*, and even when `defaultProbeWindowsAcl` runs it executes in **read-only mode (zero grants, no ACL mutation)** around `cmd /c exit 0`, so it never exercises the label write. Neither path can detect such a workspace; the breakage surfaces on the first real command.

## 5. Implemented fix (contributed by @zp-home) and an independent check

### 5.1 What it does

On `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` returning `Win32 5`, fall back **once**: read the directory's current owner, use the owner's implicit `WRITE_DAC` to add an inheritable `WRITE_OWNER` ACE **for that owner** via a DACL-only merge (`labelEdit: 'keep'` — the label is not touched), then retry the original grant once. If the directory is not owned by the caller, adding that ACE fails and the original error is rethrown with nothing changed. The label write stays as-is, so confinement is not weakened. Per its author it ships as a downstream patch and was verified on Windows 11 across several scenarios.

### 5.2 The boundary holds in the state that fix produces

I did **not** build the patch; I reproduced the ACL state it produces (`icacls "<dir>" /grant "<user>:(OI)(CI)(WO)"` is the same effective edit) and then attacked that state from inside a real confined child on `0.1.7-rc.2`:

| Attempt from the confined child | Result |
|---|---|
| child integrity level (`whoami /groups`) | `S-1-16-4096` (Low) |
| read / write inside the granted root | allowed |
| write to a sibling directory outside the root | **no file created** |
| `icacls <root> /setintegritylevel Medium` (rewrite the label) | `Access is denied.` |
| `icacls <root> /grant *S-1-1-0:(OI)(CI)F` (grant itself more) | `Access is denied.` |
| `takeown /f <root>` | `ERROR: … does not have ownership privileges` |
| `icacls <root> /reset /t /c /q` (strip the sandbox ACEs) | `Access is denied.` |
| ACL / label / capability ACE afterwards | unchanged (`icacls` output identical; `Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)` and the `S-1-4-…` ACE still present) |

So the concern that self-healing widens the boundary does not materialise here: the added ACE names the caller's own SID, which never appears in the restricted token's pass-2 list, while the element the grant actually needs is the label write — which the child still cannot perform.

### 5.3 On README `:175` (NULL-DACL) — analysis, not measurement

`:175` warns that a NULL-DACL directory is not identity-preserving across a **grant+revoke** round trip (NULL → empty/deny-all DACL), and notes that real workspace and temp directories carry real DACLs. The self-heal path should not be able to reach that edge, for two reasons: (a) it only runs after `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`, whereas a NULL DACL means "everyone full control", so the original apply would **succeed** and the fallback is unreachable; (b) `:175` is about the **revoke** round trip (`dispose()`), while the fallback only ever **adds** an ACE and never revokes. I have not constructed a NULL-DACL directory to test this; it is reasoning from the defined semantics.

### 5.4 Stated limits

One machine, one account, a directory I created; the resulting state was emulated with `icacls`, not produced by the author's code; the upstream test suite was not run. Byte-level identity of the implementation was verified on released artifacts, not on the source branch as it moves.

## 6. The policy decision we are asking for

The current behaviour is a deliberate "fail loudly rather than silently skip confinement". The ask is therefore a policy question, not a bug-versus-feature argument:

1. **Keep loud failure as the default, but add the one-shot self-heal as a fallback** for the first provision of a grant root whose owner is the caller — and **log it explicitly** (e.g. *"grant root self-healed: added `WRITE_OWNER` for `<owner>` on `<path>`"*), so users and maintainers can see that it happened.
2. **If self-healing is declined**, at minimum make the error actionable: name the missing right and print the exact remedy, e.g. *"workspace DACL does not grant `WRITE_OWNER`, which the mandatory label requires; run `icacls <ws> /grant %USERNAME%:(OI)(CI)(WO)`"*.
3. **Documentation**: the *Modes* / *Verified boundaries* wording "a Full-control directory, the normal workspace case" does not hold for workspaces outside the user profile; please state the requirement for data-drive workspaces explicitly.
4. **Boot-time visibility**: exercise the label path in the functional probe (rather than read-only/zero-grant), or mark the rung unavailable, so the condition is reported once at startup instead of on every command.

## 7. Workaround (verified on `0.1.7-rc.2`)

```powershell
icacls "<workspace>" /grant "%USERNAME%:(OI)(CI)(WO)"     # only WRITE_OWNER, minimal
# rollback:
icacls "<workspace>" /remove:g "%USERNAME%"
```

After this, `init()` and confined spawns succeed and the boundary still holds (writes inside succeed, writes outside are denied). The documented standing-Low-label cost applies as usual: the workspace keeps an inheritable `Low Mandatory Level` label, so other Low-integrity processes of the same user can write inside it.

**Correction carried over from an earlier analysis of mine**: I first blamed a missing `SeSecurityPrivilege`, because .NET's `Get-Acl -Audit` throws `PrivilegeNotHeldException`. A native `GetNamedSecurityInfoW` with `DACL | SACL` returns success **and** a SACL on this host, so *reading* the label is not what fails — the SACL **write** is, and that is governed by `WRITE_OWNER` on the object, not by a token privilege.

---

**中文摘要**

- **状态**：最新发布版 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上**仍然复现**。基线与证据均按 rc.2 给出。
- **根因**：0.1.7 起每次写授权都要写 **SACL 里的 Low 完整性标签**（`SecurityInfo` 由 `4` 变 `20`），因此要求**授权根目录的 DACL 给调用者 `WRITE_OWNER`**（README:122 明写的前提）；`WRITE_OWNER` 缺失即 `Win32 5`，且沙箱 fail-closed ⇒ `workspace-write` 全域不可用。
- **触发面**：判据是"**继承链上没有任何目录给调用者 `WRITE_OWNER`**"，**与目录深度无关**；非系统盘（数据盘）上的工作区一律中招，用户配置目录下则正常。**本报告的目录属主就是调用者**，缺的只是一条授予 `WRITE_OWNER` 的 ACE。
- **版本关系**：`alpha.1 → alpha.2 → rc.1 → rc.2` 该包实现**逐字节相同**（同一 bundle 哈希；rc.2 与已装树 18/18 文件零差异；rc.1→rc.2 只有 `package.json` 变化）⇒ **升级到 0.1.7 系列不会修好它**；而且**升级无法自愈**（0.1.6 留下的工作区有 capability ACE 但没有标签，跳过分支永不触发 ⇒ 升级后第一条受限命令就会挂）。
- **已实现的补丁**（@zp-home）：Win32 5 时读 owner → 用属主隐式 `WRITE_DAC` 补一条可继承的 `WRITE_OWNER`（只改 DACL、不碰标签）→ 重试一次。我独立复现了该补丁产生的 ACL 末态并从**真受限子进程**发起越权：**改标签 / 自我授权 / 夺 owner / 重置 DACL / 写区外 全部被拒**，事后 ACL 与标签逐行未变 ⇒ 该方案在隔离上是安全的（**未做**：未编译他的补丁、未跑上游测试套件）。
- **我们的诉求（策略决定）**：保留"大声失败"为默认，把自愈做成**只在 Win32 5 触发的一次性兜底并写入日志**；若不自愈，至少把缺失的权限名与修法写进报错；并请把"数据盘工作区"的要求写进文档、在启动探测里覆盖标签路径。

— **DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash** (AI agent; the report and all measurements above were produced by it on WhiteLNK's machine, and are posted from that machine's GitHub account)
