discussions.title: [Windows] profile 同时加载 dsh-subprocess-local 与 dsh-sandbox-local 时启动崩溃：dsh-win32-process 双副本共享 koffi 导致原生类型重复注册
discussions.body:
## Summary

Windows 上全局安装 dsh 后，`dsh web`（以及任何加载 `dsh-base` bundle 的 profile）启动即崩溃。

根因是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process` 在安装目录中存在**两份实例**，二者共享被提升到顶层的同一个 `koffi`，各自注册同名原生类型 `DSH_STARTUPINFOW`，第二份抛 `Duplicate type name`。

dsh 报出的错误信息指向"插件解析失败"，与实际原因（插件 import 时抛异常）不符，排查时容易被带偏。

## Reproduction

环境：Windows 11 (10.0.26100)，Node v24.14.1，npm 11.11.0，`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2`（`latest` tag），全局装到 `D:\npm-global`。

```
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest
dsh web
```

稳定崩溃：

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: dsh: plugin(s) failed to load: @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local;
Cordis startup failed because these plugin(s) could not be resolved (see the error(s) logged above)
```

**最小复现**（绕开 dsh 启动，直接按 Loader 的解析方式逐个 import 配置中的插件）：

```js
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const req = createRequire('C:/Users/<user>/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json');

// 通过
await import(pathToFileURL(req.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local')).href);

// 抛错：Duplicate type name 'DSH_STARTUPINFOW'
await import(pathToFileURL(req.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local')).href);
```

**顺序敏感**：`dsh-base` 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `subprocess`(id) 排在 `sandbox`(id) 之前，所以始终是 sandbox 这一侧失败；把 import 顺序调换，报错就转移到 subprocess。这也解释了为什么单看 `dsh-sandbox-local` 会误以为它有问题。

## Current behavior

安装目录下有两份 `dsh-win32-process`，版本相同（均为 `0.1.5-rc.3`）但未被 npm 提升合并：

```
.../dsh-base/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process
.../dsh-base/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process
```

两份都把 `koffi` 解析到**同一个**提升后的实例：

```
koffi -> D:\npm-global\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\koffi\index.cjs
```

`dsh-win32-process` 在两个模块实例中各注册一次 `DSH_STARTUPINFOW`。koffi 的类型注册表是进程级、按实例共享的，因此第二次注册抛 `Duplicate type name`。

由此产生的连锁：该插件 import 失败 → Cordis 树中对应 entry 拿不到 fiber → `assertEntriesLoaded`（`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1434`）据 `entry.fiber === void 0` 判定为"未解析"，抛出误导性的 `could not be resolved`。

## Expected behavior

profile 正常启动，不因同一原生类型被注册两次而失败。

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11 Home China 10.0.26100
- Node: v24.14.1
- npm: 11.11.0
- dsh: 0.1.5-rc.2 (dist-tag `latest`)
- 内嵌 bundle: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base@0.1.5-rc.3`
- 冲突包: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process@0.1.5-rc.3`（两份）
- 原生依赖: koffi 3.3.1

## 可能的修复方向

1. 消除副本：让 `dsh-win32-process` 在依赖树中只保留一份（提升或 `overrides`），使两侧解析到同一模块实例、只注册一次。
2. 或在 `dsh-win32-process` 中对类型注册做幂等保护（注册前先探测，或捕获并忽略重复注册错误）。
3. 诊断改进：`assertEntriesLoaded` 目前仅凭 `entry.fiber === void 0` 就断言 "could not be resolved"。建议在 import 抛异常时保留并抛出原始异常，当前的措辞会把排查引向 node_modules 布局/符号链接/解析锚点等错误方向。

discussions.title: [性能] Chat 折叠只隐藏不卸载：把渲染窗口收缩为「最新 N 轮 + 1 个折叠行」（含实现与实测）
discussions.body:
## 现象

长任务会话跑久之后前端越来越卡，最终卡死（[#359](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/359)、[#452](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/452)）。本机复现后定位到渲染路径，方案已实现并测试通过，因本仓库 PR 通道未开放，按维护者建议的渠道放到这里。

## 根因：折叠不等于不渲染

`packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/ChatView.tsx` 对**整个已加载窗口**逐个渲染 `ChatNodeSeat`：

```tsx
const ChatNodeList = memo(function ChatNodeList({ order, ...seatProps }) {
  return order.map(nodeKey => <ChatNodeSeat key={nodeKey} nodeKey={nodeKey} {...seatProps} />)
})
```

而 `ChatNodeSeat` 在 Turn 过程折叠时只做 `hidden="until-found"`（`searchable-hidden.ts`），**子树保持挂载**。`packages/client/ui-chat/README.md` 原文写得很明确：

> Stable Chat Node Seats keep every renderer mounted

于是「折叠已完成轮次」只是**绘制**层面的隐藏，不是**渲染**层面的隐藏：

- 每次 commit 的协调成本 = `O(已加载节点数)`
- 保留的 element tree + DOM = `O(已加载节点数)`

两者都随会话时长单调增长。跑几小时到几天的任务，前端占用持续上涨——这与 `#359` 里「3,242 条 reasoning-chunks 实时累积渲染」、`#370` 里「一次返回 37MB 历史」是同一类问题的不同切面。

`packages/client/ui-trajectory` 早就为同样原因做了虚拟化（e2e 断言 `MAX_MOUNTED_ROWS = 160`）。Chat 一直没有对等机制。

## 方案：把渲染窗口收缩为「最新 N 轮 + 1 个折叠行」

在 render 期对已加载 order 做一次纯投影：

- 最新 `DEFAULT_WINDOW_TURNS = 5` 轮保留各自 seat；
- 更早的轮次全部收敛到**一行** `TranscriptFoldRow`，行上 `data-transcript-fold-turns` 汇报它代表多少轮；
- 挂载行数 = `窗口 + 1`，**与会话长度无关**。

解析不到 Turn 的行（头部 session 级 section，含 System prompt 行）保持挂载：它们是固定几行、不是每轮成本，去掉还会改变 transcript 呈现。

折叠行每次把窗口**上抬一页（5 轮），上限 8 页**。这是纯渲染决策——那些轮次已经在内存里，不发历史请求。到顶后由既有的「加载更早」分页接管，所以挂载预算无法被无限点开。

导航与预算对齐：rail 点击或 pending jump 的目标轮次若「已加载但未被 seat」，原先找不到 anchor 会静默失效，现在改为上抬预算并重新武装 jump（原有落地修正照常执行）。揭示路径经 latest-ref 读取，避免分页 commit 打断进行中的 busy 标记。

## 实测

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `pnpm vitest run ui-chat/tests` | 31 files / 369 tests 全通过（基线 30 / 358，新增 11 例） |
| `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` | ui-chat 源码 0 error（`tests/apply-inject` 有 1 处既有错误，stash 前后一致） |
| oxlint（改动文件） | 0 warning / 0 error |
| 挂载上界 | 12 轮×6 行 与 40 轮×2 行两种会话挂载行数**相同**；差额由 `data-transcript-fold-turns=35` 承载，不落地为 DOM |

关键断言（`chat-view.client.spec.tsx`）：

```ts
expect(longMounted).toBe(shortMounted)          // 挂载量与会话长度解耦
expect(longMounted).toBeLessThan(12 * 2)        // 远小于全量
expect(foldRow.dataset.transcriptFoldTurns).toBe('35')
```

## 代码

- 新增 `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/transcript-window.ts`（纯投影 + 分页换算）
- 新增 `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/TranscriptFoldRow.tsx` / `.module.css`
- 修改 `ChatView.tsx`、`locale.ts`（2 条中英文案）、`chat-view.client.spec.tsx`
- 新增 `transcript-window.client.spec.ts`

分支（可直接 `git fetch` 查看，基于 `0.1.6-alpha.2`；`ChatView.tsx` 与当前 master 有冲突需重做植入）：

```
git fetch https://github.com/V1sMu21/deepseek-harness.git perf/transcript-render-window
```

## 局限（有意不做）

- 折叠只约束**渲染**。会话事件仍全部常驻内存，加载窗口的数据层淘汰是另一个改动。
- 揭示到 8 页（40 轮）为止，之后回到「加载更早」。这是刻意的：预算不能被点开绕过。
- 折叠行故意做得很朴素（轮数 + 提示 + 箭头）。若需要预览折叠轮次，可在 `TranscriptFoldGroup` 上叠加。

若维护者认可方向，PR 通道开放时我可以直接提 PR（补丁与测试已就绪）。

discussions.title: patchReload: "live" 的 profile 启动失败：user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service
discussions.body:
## Summary

profile manifest 中 `dsh.profile.patchReload` 为 `"live"` 时，boot 阶段**已经成功**，但紧随其后的 `watchUserPatches` 抛错，进程退出：

```
Error: dsh: user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service
    at watchUserPatches (.../dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1112:28)
    at runProfile (.../dsh/lib/profile-boot-Dk-7KqJc.js:329:9)
```

## Reproduction

`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`：

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-web",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {},
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app"],
      "patchReload": "live"
    }
  }
}
```

然后 `dsh web`。

（症状在 boot 之后才出现，所以任何能走到 boot 完成的 profile 都会命中；本机 Windows 11 稳定复现，但看代码路径**应该不是平台相关的**。）

## Current behavior

`dsh-base` bundle 中 `hmr` 条目默认是禁用的：

```yaml
- id: hmr
  name: '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr'
  disabled: true
```

`profile-boot` 检测到 HMR 缺失后**动态创建**：

```js
// lib/profile-boot-*.js:321-328
if (composed.profile.patchReload === "live" && ...) try {
    if (ctx.get("hmr") === void 0) {
        if (ctx.get("timer") === void 0) await ctx.loader.create({ name: "@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer" });
        await ctx.loader.create({
            name: "@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr",
            config: { root: [] }
        });
    }
    await watchUserPatches(ctx, { ... });   // ← 这里 ctx.get("hmr") 仍是 void 0
```

而 `Hmr` 类声明了：

```js
static inject = ["loader", "timer"];
```

`loader.create()` 返回时服务尚未注册完成——timer 是刚创建的，HMR 又要注入它。此处缺少一次等待（如 `await ctx.loader.await()`）再进入 `watchUserPatches`。

结果是 `watchUserPatches`（`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1111-1112`）读到 `void 0` 并抛错。该错误随后经 `suppressShutdownError` 未被吞掉，直接终止进程。

## Expected behavior

`patchReload: "live"` 的 profile 正常启动并启用 patch 层热重载。

## 验证与绕过

在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中提前启用该条目后，`dsh web` 正常启动：

```yaml
- id: hmr
  disabled: false
```

这说明 HMR 插件本身可正常工作，问题出在动态创建路径的时序等待上。可作为临时绕过。

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11 Home China 10.0.26100
- Node: v24.14.1
- npm: 11.11.0
- dsh: 0.1.5-rc.2 (dist-tag `latest`)
- 内嵌 bundle: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base@0.1.5-rc.3`

discussions.title: [llm-deepseek] 一个非法的流式工具入参会终止整轮（MALFORMED_RESPONSE，且不在默认重试白名单）
discussions.body:
**包：** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` 0.1.7-alpha.2（涉及 `dsh-llm`、`dsh-agent-loop`、`dsh-tools`）
**路由：** `deepseek-official`（DeepSeek Messages）· 模型 `deepseek-flash`
**环境：** Windows 11，Node 24，web profile

## 摘要

只要有一次工具调用的流式 `input_json_delta` 累积出来不是 JSON **对象**，整轮就会以
`MALFORMED_RESPONSE: DeepSeek Messages stream: tool input is invalid JSON` 终止，该轮已经完成的每一步都被丢弃。

我认为这个校验不该卡在流式层：同一个字段的另外两个消费方都是刻意宽容的。模型侧的一次格式打滑，应该退化成一次工具报错，而不是干掉整轮。

## 实际表现

模型在为 `ask_user_question` 生成参数时，在 JSON 字符串值里写了一个未转义的 ASCII 双引号（跨两个 delta 下发）：

```json
{"questions": [{"description": "相当于回到"什么都不设"的原厂行为。"}]}
```

会话日志先记录 `assistant/attempt`（完整原始流已保留），紧接着是：

```json
{"type":"turn/end","data":{"turn":2,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"DeepSeek Messages stream: tool input is invalid JSON","code":"MALFORMED_RESPONSE"}}}}
```

这是模型侧的格式问题，不是链路损坏——流本身是完整的，而且该 block 在抛错之前已经以 `block-end` 正常下发。它同样不可重试：`dsh-llm` 的 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 只有 `EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT`，所以一份坏文档就要赔上整轮，连一次重试都没有。

## 为什么说这个校验是「异类」

同一个字段的另外两个消费方都是有意为之的宽容：

- `dsh-agent-loop` 的 `parseArguments()`（`lib/index.js:534`）——*「解析模型参数，把非法 JSON 保留为文本，空输入映射为 `{}`」*。无法解析的参数会流到工具层，工具层抛出 `ToolArgsError`（`INVALID_ARGS`），注册表再经 `toolErrorResult` 把它转成 `isError` 结果（`dsh-tools` `lib/index.js:3344-3348`）——这就是一次普通工具报错，模型下一步可以自行纠正。
- `llm-deepseek` 的 `toolInput()`（`lib/index.js:1308`），用于把 assistant 历史重新序列化——*「Messages 无法表示的历史参数使用空 input；durable 内容保持不变」*。无法解析或非对象的历史在线上降级为 `{}`，而会话记录保留原文。

只有 `message_stop` 处的校验（`lib/index.js:1729-1738`，即 `lib/types/translate.js` / `src/types/translate.ts` 区域）把它当成致命错误。

## 同一处的第二种情况

同一个循环还会拒绝「能解析但不是对象」的 JSON：`object(parsed)` 会抛 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE: DeepSeek Messages expected a JSON object`，例如整个工具入参是 `["a"]` 或 `"text"`。结果同样是整轮终止。（`max_tokens` 截断本来就是豁免的，这更让人觉得这条严格路径并非有意设计。）

## 复现

确定性、可离线，不需要真实模型。用本地 HTTP 服务返回一段合成的 Messages SSE，然后驱动 `DeepSeekAdapter.stream()`：

```
message_start
content_block_start  index 0  tool_use {id, name, input: {}}
content_block_delta  index 0  input_json_delta  {"questions": [{"description": "相当于回到"
content_block_delta  index 0  input_json_delta  什么都不设"的原厂行为。"}]}
content_block_stop   index 0
message_delta        stop_reason: tool_use
message_stop
```

在 0.1.7-alpha.2 上跑四个用例：

| 用例 | 修复前 | 建议修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 非法工具入参（如上） | `MALFORMED_RESPONSE: tool input is invalid JSON` | 流正常结束，原文保留在 `block-end.arguments` |
| 合法 JSON 但不是对象（`["a"]`） | `MALFORMED_RESPONSE: expected a JSON object` | 流正常结束 |
| 合法工具入参（对照） | 正常（`usage` → `finish`） | 正常，行为不变 |
| `max_tokens` 截断的入参 | 正常 | 正常，行为不变 |

## 建议修复

把该校验改成 advisory，与上面两条宽容通路一致：

```js
if (reason.kind !== "max-tokens") for (const { content } of blocks.values()) {
    if (content.type !== "tool-call") continue;
    try {
        object(JSON.parse(content.arguments));
    } catch (_unusableProviderToolInput) {
        // Keep the provider's raw text: the agent loop preserves unparsable
        // arguments and the tool layer reports INVALID_ARGS, so the model can
        // correct itself. serialize's toolInput maps them to `{}` on replay.
    }
}
```

非法文档随后会原样到达工具层，产生 `invalid arguments: "arguments" must be an object`，模型用正确转义重发——也就是本来设计好的自我纠正路径。

## 相关（可能是有意为之）

`MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 中。由于这类失败属于 provider **输出**问题而非传输问题（与被重试的 `EMPTY_RESPONSE` 同类），也许它也值得重试——不过上面的修复才是真正保证前进，而不是赌重新采样。

我目前在本机的临时缓解：打上上述补丁，并把 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 加进该路由的 `retryPolicy.retryableCodes`。如果你们需要，我可以开 PR。

discussions.title: Deleting ~/.dsh/attachments makes image-bearing sessions fail permanently, misreported as TRANSPORT
discussions.body:
会话历史含图片时，DeepSeek 适配器在每次请求前都会从本地附件库重新读取图片字节，而不是把图片内联在请求中。一旦 ~/.dsh/attachments/v1 下的对象被删除，该会话历史中所有图片引用即变为悬空引用，于是：

该会话此后每一次请求都永久失败，重试无法恢复；

失败被归类为 TRANSPORT，触发 5 次自动重试（实测 44 次重试事件）全部无效；

界面仅显示 DeepSeek API stream from https://api.deepseek.com/ failed，把"本地附件缺失"误报为"网络故障"；

/compact 同样失败（压缩也需重发含图历史），会话无法自救。

这是永久性错误被误分类为瞬时错误的健壮性缺陷。

 环境
项目
值
@deepseek-ai/dsh
0.1.5-rc.2（内置 @deepseek-ai/* 子包同为 0.1.5-rc.2）
操作系统
Windows 11 (26100)
Node.js
v24.21.0
Provider / Model
deepseek-official / deepseek-flash，reasoningEffort: max
 复现步骤
新建会话，把图片放进历史（上传，或让 Agent 生成图片作为附件）；

确认 ~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects 下已生成对象文件；

删除 ~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects 与 .../request-images 下的全部文件（保留目录）；

在该会话中发送任意消息。

实际结果：

界面报 DeepSeek API stream from https://api.deepseek.com/ failed

会话日志记录 llm/retry ×5，随后 turn/end 为 {"kind":"error","error":{"code":"TRANSPORT"}}

重发、切换模型、执行 /compact 均以同一错误失败

期望结果：报出明确的、不可重试的错误，例如
attachment sha256:xxxx is missing; cannot rebuild the image-bearing request，且不应触发重试。

 证据
时间线（UTC，时区换算已与文件系统 mtime 交叉验证）：

时间 (UTC)
事件
04:22:23.225
tool/call — Agent 发出附件库清理命令
04:22:24.069
文件系统：attachments/v1/objects 目录 mtime
04:22:24.098
文件系统：attachments/v1/request-images 目录 mtime
04:22:24.244
tool/result — 报告 objects\ 18 个文件 -> 0、request-images\ 16 个文件 -> 0、总计 0 MB
04:22:24.304
首次 TRANSPORT 失败（turn 47, step 3）
04:22:40 → 04:26:48
turn 48–53 连续失败，每轮 5 次重试
04:32:28
compaction/end — /compact 以同一错误结束
04:33:14
turn 55 失败，6 次尝试
删除动作与首次失败相隔仅 206–235 毫秒。

该会话历史含 24 个 image 块，引用 17 个不同附件。删除后全盘搜索，无任何副本存活。实测重试策略：


无语言
["normal", 5, ["EMPTY_RESPONSE","RATE_LIMIT","SERVER","TIMEOUT","TRANSPORT"]]
退避序列实测: 0.5s -> 1s -> 2s -> 4s -> 8s
重试机制完全按设计工作——只是它无法战胜一个永久性错误。

 根因
1. 图片按需从附件库读取（每次请求）

node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js:1690


JavaScript
js
const requestImages = attachments === void 0 || model === void 0
  ? new Map()
  : await prepareRequestImages(requestOptions, attachments, model, signal);
prepareRequestImages（同文件 :1455-1462）为历史中每个图片引用读取字节：


JavaScript
js
async function prepareRequestImages(options, attachments, model, signal) {
  const refs = new Map();
  for (const message of options.messages) collectImageRefs(message.content, refs);
  const policy = resolveRequestImagePolicy(model);
  const orderedRefs = [...refs.values()];
  const projected = await Promise.all(
    orderedRefs.map((ref) => attachments.readImageRequest(ref, policy, signal))
  );
  return new Map(orderedRefs.map((ref, index) => [ref.attachmentId, projected[index]]));
}
后果：会话历史只存 attachmentId，真实字节依赖附件库。二者隐式强耦合，且无引用计数、无可达性 GC、无完整性保护。

2. 抛错点位于错误处理分支之外 → 被判为 TRANSPORT

同函数结构（:1691-1707）：


JavaScript
js
const requestImages = ... await prepareRequestImages(...);   // :1690 —— 在任何 try 之外
let representation = "file";
let fileAttempt = 0;
while (true) {
  const usedFiles = [];
  let body;
  if (attachments === void 0) body = serializeRequest(...);
  else if (representation === "base64") body = await serializeRequestWithImages(...);
  else try {                                                 // 仅此处及以下有 try
    body = await serializeRequestWithImages(...);
  } catch (error) { ... }
}
:1690 的异常未被局部捕获，直接冒泡到 streamWithConnection 的兜底分支，同文件 :1641-1645：


JavaScript
js
} catch (error) {
  if (timeoutOf(watchdog.signal, STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_CODE) !== void 0)
    throw new LlmError(`DeepSeek stream idle timeout after ...`, "TIMEOUT", { cause: error });
  if (options.signal?.aborted)
    throw new LlmError("DeepSeek request aborted by caller", "ABORTED", { cause: error });
  if (error instanceof LlmError) throw error;
  throw new LlmError(`DeepSeek API stream from ${connection.baseURL} failed`, "TRANSPORT", { cause: error });
}
任何不是 LlmError 的底层错误（文件读取失败通常不是）都会被无条件标为 TRANSPORT。

3. TRANSPORT 属于默认可重试码

node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/types/retry-policy.js:12-22


JavaScript
js
const DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES = 5;
const DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES = Object.freeze([
  EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE, 'RATE_LIMIT', 'SERVER', 'TIMEOUT', 'TRANSPORT',
]);
dsh-llm-retry 仅依据 failure.code 判定（dsh-llm-retry/lib/index.js:160,164）：


JavaScript
js
} else if (!policy.retryableCodes.includes(failure.code)) return next();
...
if (policy.mode === "normal" && previousRetry >= policy.maxRetries) return next();
 建议修复
 (a) 错误分类 —— 改动最小、收益最大
在调用点包裹，抛出不属于可重试码的明确 LlmError：


JavaScript
js
let requestImages;
try {
  requestImages = attachments === void 0 || model === void 0
    ? new Map()
    : await prepareRequestImages(requestOptions, attachments, model, signal);
} catch (error) {
  throw new LlmError(
    "cannot rebuild request images: a session-referenced attachment is missing or unreadable; " +
    "restore the objects under ~/.dsh/attachments, or remove the image from the session history",
    "ATTACHMENT_MISSING",
    { cause: error }
  );
}
因为 streamWithConnection 会原样重抛已存在的 LlmError（:1644），它不会再被改标为 TRANSPORT。

 (b) 在消息中保留底层 cause
当前 TRANSPORT 消息完全丢弃了 cause，这正是该缺陷在排查中被误判为网络问题的原因。附上 error.cause?.code（如 ENOENT、ECONNRESET）即可让此类故障可诊断：


JavaScript
js
const detail = error?.cause?.code ?? error?.code ?? error?.name ?? "unknown";
throw new LlmError(
  `DeepSeek API stream from ${connection.baseURL} failed (${detail})`,
  "TRANSPORT", { cause: error }
);
 (c) 附件生命周期保护
对附件对象做引用计数或可达性 GC；仍被任何会话历史引用时，拒绝删除（或改为墓碑标记）。

把 ~/.dsh/attachments 视为内部存储，通用删除操作不得触及——例如放置标记文件，或对 Agent 的删除类操作加路径守卫。

优雅降级：加载历史时若发现悬空图片引用，替换为文本占位，而不是让整个会话不可用。

 影响面
触发条件：会话历史含图片 且 对应附件对象被删除。任何对 ~/.dsh/attachments 的清理（手工、脚本、或 Agent 工具调用）都会命中。

后果：该会话永久不可用；重试、切换模型、/compact 全部失败。

数据损失：取决于附件重要性。本例中 17 个附件全盘无副本。

误导性：报错文本指向"网络"，令用户与支持人员沿错误方向排查。

 已排除的假设（实测，供排查参考）
假设
排除依据
网络 / 链路故障
40/40 次连续流式请求成功（146 s）；3/3 次复刻相同请求形态（deepseek-flash + reasoning_effort: max + max_tokens: 256000）成功，单次 19–28 s、接收 1.15–1.83 MB
DNS / TCP
解析正常；TCP 443 探测 10/10 成功
路径 MTU 黑洞
1472 字节载荷收到正确的 ICMP 需分片响应，PMTUD 工作正常
请求体过大
0.5/1 MB 成功；2–8 MB 返回明确 HTTP 400（上下文超限），非传输失败
API 密钥 / 路由
密钥有效；/models 与 /chat/completions 均正常
重试插件缺失 / 失效
44 条 llm/retry 事件，指数退避正确
上游 API 故障
失败窗口内（04:22–04:33）同一台机器的其他请求全部成功
该故障与网络、API 密钥、上游服务均无关。

 代码位置速查
文件
行
说明
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js
1455–1462
prepareRequestImages —— 从附件库读取图片字节
同上
1690
调用点，位于 try 之外 → 错误冒泡
同上
1691–1707

同上

discussions.title: 【Bug】[Windows] Workspace at user home dir breaks all shell commands ("Windows ACL temp root must be outside the workspace") and the agent then repeats one identical failing tool call 150 times with no circuit breaker
discussions.body:
## Environment

- DSH Desktop `2.0.13` (Electron shell, `dsh-plugin-desktop`), Windows
- Session cwd / workspace: `C:\Users\<user>` (user home directory chosen as workspace)
- Sandbox: preset `workspace-write`, approval policy `ask`
- Model: `router/coding`, reasoning effort `high`, preset `spec-react`
- Affected module: `windows-pwsh-sandbox` (error surfaces from shell tool execution)

## Summary

When the session workspace is the user's home directory on Windows, every shell tool call fails before execution because the sandbox temp root (`C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp`) is inside the workspace. The agent then falls into a retry loop: it issues the exact same tool call with byte-identical arguments 150 times over ~19 minutes, receives the same error every time, and only stops when the user manually aborts the turn.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open/start a DSH session with cwd `C:\Users\<user>` on Windows (default shell tool: `pwsh`).
2. Ask anything that requires running a shell command (e.g. "why won't WSL start?").
3. Agent calls `pwsh` with any command.

## Actual behavior

Every call fails at sandbox setup, before the command runs:

```
Error: Windows ACL temp root must be outside the workspace: workspace=C:\Users\<user>; temp=C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp
```

The agent then adds `sandbox_permissions: "workspace-write"` to the arguments (without the required `justification` field), producing a second repeating error:

```
Error: invalid escalation: sandbox_permissions requires a justification
```

From that point the agent repeats the identical call until interrupted.

## Evidence (from one session export)

Session had a single turn, 151 steps, 152 shell tool calls:

| calls | arguments |
|------:|-----------|
| 150   | identical: `pwsh {"command":"wsl --status; ...","sandbox_permissions":"workspace-write","workdir":"C:\\Users\\<user>"}` |
| 1     | same command without `sandbox_permissions` (first call) |
| 1     | different command (also failed with the temp-root error) |

- Duration from first call to last assistant message: ~19 minutes (1138 s).
- Calls containing the required `justification` field: **0 of 152**. The assistant repeatedly stated the correct diagnosis in its visible text ("missing the justification field, will add it and retry") but never actually included the field in the emitted arguments.
- The harness's repeated-call detector injected warnings 3 times (generic warning, then `consecutive_calls: 5`, then `consecutive_calls: 8`). The agent ignored them; no further warnings were injected for the remaining ~140 repetitions, and the turn was only ended by a user abort.

## Expected behavior

Any of the following would have prevented the incident:

1. A workspace at the user home dir should be rejected or handled at session start (or the temp root should fall back to a directory outside the workspace), instead of failing lazily on every tool call.
2. A hard circuit breaker: after N consecutive identical failing tool calls (e.g. 10), the harness should end the turn with an error instead of continuing to feed the same error back to the model.
3. The repeated-call warning should escalate rather than stop after 3 injections.

## Suggested fixes

- `windows-pwsh-sandbox`: when the resolved temp root lies inside the workspace, either pick an alternative temp root outside the workspace or fail fast with a session-level error ("this workspace location is unsupported on Windows, choose a different folder").
- Escalation validation: the error `sandbox_permissions requires a justification` is returned identically on every retry; consider one-shot enrichment of the error text (e.g. echo the exact expected field name and a schema example), or auto-reject loops where the fix requires changing emitted arguments, not retrying.
- Add a harness-level circuit breaker: track consecutive identical (tool, arguments-hash) calls; on the Nth consecutive failure, terminate the turn with a `repeated-failing-call` stop reason.

## Notes

- Full session export is available on request (paths/username redacted).
- The model-side behavior (announcing a fix without applying it to the arguments) is a model-quality issue, but a harness circuit breaker would have capped the damage at ~10 calls instead of 150.

discussions.title: Compaction summarization drops the session's  reasoningEffort , destroying the prompt cache on some models
discussions.body:
# Compaction summarization drops the session's `reasoningEffort`, destroying the prompt cache on models that render effort into the system prompt

**Package:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` (observed in `dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2)
**Provider:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, `api: openai-completions` against a local llama.cpp server
**Model:** Qwen3.8-27B (GGUF, local), 240k→150k context window

## Summary

`summarizeWithLlm()` builds the compaction request from the session's own request
header, but copies only `provider` and `model` from it — not `reasoningEffort`.
The request therefore reaches the adapter with no effort, and
`dsh-llm`'s `resolveCallWithInfo()` fills in the **provider default**
(`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.reasoning`).

For any session whose effort differs from that provider default, the
compaction request's rendered prompt differs from the conversation it is
summarizing. On a provider that caches prompt prefixes this silently discards
the whole cache; on my setup (a single local GPU) that turned a ~10-second
operation into a 16-to-27-minute one.

The function is explicitly written to be cache-friendly — it replays the
conversation prefix and appends the compaction instruction as the final user
message "so the provider's warm prefix cache is reused" — so I believe the
omission is an oversight rather than intent.

## Why the effort ends up in the prompt

This is not specific to my deployment, but it is what makes the bug expensive.
Qwen3.8's chat template (shipped inside the GGUF) renders the reasoning effort
as the **first line of the system prompt**:

```
<|im_start|>system
Reasoning effort is set to xhigh. Please think carefully through the task, ...

# Tools
...
```

With `medium` that line is omitted entirely. So the prompts diverge at token 3,
and every cached token after it is worthless. Any model family that turns
`reasoning_effort` into prompt text (rather than a pure sampling parameter) has
the same exposure.

## Reproduction

1. Configure one pi-ai provider route with a default effort, e.g.

   ```yaml
   llm-pi-ai:
     providers:
       llama-mi50:
         api: openai-completions
         baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
         reasoning: xhigh          # provider default
         models:
           - id: <model>
             contextWindow: 150000
   ```

2. Run a session on that route with a **different** effort — for example a
   subagent started with `reasoning_effort: low`
   (`subagent-model-selection.enabled: true`).

3. Let the session cross the compaction threshold.

4. Inspect the request bodies on the wire. The conversation's own requests carry
   `"reasoning_effort": "low"`; the compaction request carries
   `"reasoning_effort": "xhigh"`.

I verified both directions with a stub server that logs the `reasoning_effort`
of every request, and in production against llama.cpp.

## Observed cost (real runs, llama.cpp server logs)

| case | session effort | compaction effort | prompt reused |
|---|---|---|---|
| main chat, provider default `medium` | xhigh | medium | **0 of 114 308 tokens** (27 min re-prefill) |
| subagent, provider default `xhigh` | low | xhigh | **8 775 of 91 237 tokens** (16.5 min re-prefill) |
| after the patch below | medium | medium | 85 154 of 86 582 tokens (98 %) |

llama.cpp reports the shared prefix directly:

```
slot operator(): id 1 | task 66275 | new prompt, n_ctx_slot = 163840, task.n_tokens = 91237
slot operator(): id 1 | task 66275 | checking checkpoint with [87240, 87240] against 8778...
slot operator(): id 1 | task 66275 | cached n_tokens = 8775, memory_seq_rm [8775, end)
```

`against 8778` is the common prefix — i.e. everything past the shared tool
preamble was recomputed.

## Why a provider default cannot work around it

There is no single value that is correct for both sides: the main chat runs at
one effort and its subagents deliberately run at another (cheaper reasoning for
well-specified execution work). Whichever value the provider default carries,
the other side pays a full re-prefill at every compaction.

## Suggested fix

Inherit the session's effort when the summarization runs on the same route.
`latest` already holds it:

```js
// lib/index.js, summarizeWithLlm()
const latest = agent.session.requestHeader()?.config;
...
const options = {
    provider: target.provider,
    model: target.model,
    messages,
    ...input.tools === void 0 ? {} : { tools: [...input.tools] },
    // inherit the session's effort when summarizing on the same route,
    // so the replayed prefix renders identically and stays cache-hot
    ...latest?.reasoningEffort === void 0 || latest.provider !== target.provider
        || latest.model !== target.model ? {} : { reasoningEffort: latest.reasoningEffort },
    maxTokens: config.maxTokens,
    sessionId: agent.session.id,
    purpose: "compaction",
    ...signal === void 0 ? {} : { signal },
};
```

The route guard matters: when `summarizationProvider`/`summarizationModel` point
at a different model, that model may not accept the session's effort id, and
`dsh-llm` would reject the call with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.

An explicit `BasicCompactionConfig.reasoningEffort` (defaulting to "inherit")
would work as well, and would let deployments force a cheap effort for
summaries where the cache does not matter.

## Related, same root cause

`dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm` also issues its request without an effort
and picks up the provider default. That one is harmless in practice — it is a
separate short conversation with its own cache entry — but the same inheritance
question applies.

## Environment

- `dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2, `--profile web`, Node 24.21.0, Linux
- custom agent preset copied from `standard`, with
  `compaction-basic.maxTokens: 40960` and `tool-result-pruner` disabled
- backend: llama.cpp (build 10460), Vulkan, single GPU, 2 slots, prompt caching
  and context checkpoints enabled

## Note on `compaction-basic.maxTokens`

Separately, the default `maxTokens: 8192` is too small once the summarization
inherits a reasoning-heavy effort: the model spends the budget thinking and the
run fails with `summarization truncated at the token cap (incomplete
checkpoint)`. In one of my runs it failed three times in a row, the context kept
growing unchecked, and the subagent ended on `max-tokens` after 3 h 15 of work.
Raising it to 40960 fixed that, but a default that cannot fit a single
reasoning-model summary is an easy trap — perhaps derive it from the model's
reasoning budget, or at least surface the repeated truncation more loudly.

discussions.title: Incompatibility of @xmanrui/dsh-im and @liustack/modlens with DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2
discussions.body:
Environment

• DSH version: 0.1.7-alpha.2 (profile ~/.dsh/profiles/web)
• pnpm: initially mixed v10.24.0 / v11.7.0, finally unified to v11.27.1
• OS: macOS (Apple Silicon)
Problem

After upgrading DSH to 0.1.7-alpha.2, two plugins fail to activate properly:

1. @xmanrui/dsh-im throws:

Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
    at .../packages/client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts:192:19
The plugin fails to activate any channel.
2. @liustack/modlens throws:

[modlens] settings namespace skipped: TypeError: scope.settings.register is not a function
The settings namespace is skipped, so the plugin's settings UI is not registered.
Additional issue

While managing plugins, dsh plugin --profile web update failed with:

[ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE] Unexpected store location
because pnpm was switching between v10 and v11 stores. This was worked around by disabling manage-package-manager-versions and reinstalling the profile dependencies with pnpm 11.

What I tried

• Updated @liustack/modlens to the latest 3.26.3 – error persists.
• Downgraded DSH to 0.1.6-alpha.2 – the modlens error remains, so it is not version-specific.
• Reverted profile to 0.1.7-alpha.2.
• Removed both plugins – dsh web then starts cleanly.
Conclusion

Both plugins appear incompatible with DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2. The webServer without inject error suggests dsh-im does not declare the webServer dependency required by the new Cordis inject mechanism. The settings.register is not a function error suggests modlens still uses the old settings API that was replaced by the keyed slot system.

Workaround

Remove the incompatible plugins:

pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @xmanrui/dsh-im
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @liustack/modlens
After removal, pnpm dsh web starts successfully at http://127.0.0.1:3080/.

Request

Please update these plugins to support DSH 0.1.7+, or document the required API changes for plugin authors.

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.7 空白新会话遇到 writer-held 时会静默换新会话，未发送的草稿随之“消失”
discussions.body:
# [Bug] 空白新会话遇到 writer-held 时会静默换新会话，未发送的草稿随之“消失”

> 版本：0.1.7-alpha.2（web profile / Windows 11 / Chromium）

## Summary

0.1.7 起「新建会话」用一个**空白（blank）占位会话**承载首条输入。当这个空白会话被**另一个连接**持有写者时（RPC `session/writer-held`），客户端会**静默新建一个不同 id 的空白会话**。

而草稿是按会话 id 持久化的（`localStorage["dsh.conversation.<sessionId>"]`），同时侧边栏规则是「空白会话只显示当前选中的那一个」。两者叠加的结果：在旧空白会话里**已输入但未发送**的草稿会变得**不可达**（数据其实仍在 localStorage 里，但 UI 没有入口回到那个会话），用户感知就是“内容没了”，没有任何提示。升级到 0.1.7 之前（没有空白会话这一层）不会出现。

## Reproduction

1. 同一工作区保持**两个连接**（例如两个浏览器标签页；或同时跑两个 `dsh web` 实例 —— 注意 `dsh web` 启动时会自动打开一个标签页，所以很容易出现两个）。
2. 在其中一个标签页点「新建会话」，在输入框里打字，**不要发送**。
3. 切到别的会话，再点一次「新建会话」。
4. 输入框是空的；草稿仍留在 `localStorage["dsh.conversation.session-<旧 id>"]`，但侧边栏里再也找不到那个空白会话。

实测记录（同一台机器、同一 profile）：

| 场景 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 单连接（干净 profile） | 草稿保留：第二次「新建会话」复用同一 session id，草稿从 localStorage 回填 ✅ |
| 两个连接（同一工作区） | 第二次「新建会话」session id 从 `1acb5dc1…` 变成 `3d26c5b7…`；`localStorage["dsh.conversation.session-1acb5dc1…"]` 里的草稿仍在，但无法回到该会话 ❌ |

## Current behavior

- 被放弃的空白会话连同其未发送草稿一起变得不可达；无提示、无迁移、无入口。
- 用户的临时恢复手段只有手动改 localStorage（见文末 Workaround）。

## Expected behavior

任选其一即可，建议 1+2：

1. `reuseBlank()` 的 `session/writer-held` 回退分支在创建新空白会话时，把旧会话的草稿（及草稿附件）迁移到新会话 —— 与切工作区/切会话路径保持一致；
2. 即便不迁移，也不要静默丢弃：给用户一个提示，或在侧边栏保留被放弃的空白会话入口，让草稿可被找回。

## 代码定位（0.1.7-alpha.2 安装包）

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js`

- `reuseOrCreateBlank()`（约 842 行）→ `reuseBlank()`（约 852 行）：
  ```js
  async reuseBlank(workspaceId, sessionId) {
    try { return await this.sessions.create({ workspaceId, sessionId }) }   // 复用：id 不变，草稿在
    catch (error) {
      if (sessionCreateErrorOf(error)?.rpcError.code !== "session/writer-held") throw error
      return this.sessions.create({ workspaceId })                          // ← 新 id，草稿被孤立
    }
  }
  ```
- 空白会话可见性（约 391–398 行）：`if (session.blank && session.id !== current) return false` —— 非当前空白会话不进入列表。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js`

- 草稿存储：`createConversationStore()`，`persist: "dsh.conversation"`（约 3151–3175 行），按会话 id 落到 `localStorage["dsh.conversation.<sessionId>"]`（约 3188–3190 行）。
- 草稿恢复：`DefaultConversationViews` 的 effect `if (inputState.draft === "" && storedDraft !== "") inputActions.setDraft(storedDraft)`（约 16244 行）—— 只对**同一个 session id** 生效。
- 已有迁移范例：`openWorkspace(…)` 的 `beforeOpen`（约 17814–17822 行）在切换会话/工作区时把 `snapshot.draft` 与附件搬到下一个会话的 shell。**缺的正是空白会话回退这一条路径。**

## Environment

- DSH: `0.1.7-alpha.2`（0.1.7-alpha.1 同一代码路径，同样可复现）
- 平台：Windows 11，`dsh web`（web profile），Chromium
- 与模型 provider 无关：干净 profile 也能复现“writer-held 换新 id”；「草稿不可达」需要两个连接
- 复现所用的空白会话与草稿均可用 `localStorage` 直接取证

## Workaround（给其他遇到的人）

在 dsh 页面 Console 里列出所有非空草稿（含孤儿的）：

```js
Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith('dsh.conversation.'))
  .map(k => ({ id: k.replace('dsh.conversation.session-',''), draft: (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))||{}).draft || '' }))
  .filter(x => x.draft).forEach(x => console.log(x.id.slice(0,8), JSON.stringify(x.draft.slice(0,80))))
```

把某条草稿搬回当前会话（然后刷新页面即可回填）：

```js
const match = '把上面某个 id 的前 8 位粘这里'
const cur = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dsh.sessions.current')).sessionId
const src = Object.keys(localStorage).find(k => k.startsWith('dsh.conversation.') && k.includes(match))
const text = (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(src))||{}).draft || ''
localStorage.setItem('dsh.conversation.' + cur, JSON.stringify({ draft: text, view: null, viewRequest: null }))
location.reload()
```

---

## English summary

**Bug:** In 0.1.7, a new session is a *blank* placeholder. When that blank session is writer-held by another connection (`session/writer-held`), `reuseBlank()` silently falls back to `sessions.create({ workspaceId })`, i.e. a **new session id**. Unsent composer drafts are persisted per session id (`localStorage["dsh.conversation.<id>"]`, restored only when the very same id is reopened), and the sidebar deliberately hides every blank session except the current one — so the previous blank session and its draft become unreachable with no notice. Worked before 0.1.7 because there was no blank-session layer.

**Repro:** keep two connections to the same workspace (two tabs — `dsh web` opens one automatically — or two instances), create a new session in one, type without sending, then hit “New session” again: the id changes and the draft is orphaned in localStorage.

**Expected:** migrate the draft (and draft attachments) in the `session/writer-held` fallback, like the existing `openWorkspace(…).beforeOpen` migration does; or at least surface the draft / keep the abandoned blank session reachable.

discussions.title: [app-boot] With tsx ESM hooks registered, most built-in plugins report "Cannot assign to read only property 'stack'" in plugin metadata
discussions.body:
## 中文摘要

从源码启动（`pnpm dsh web`，即 `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile web`）时，**Settings → Built-in plugins** 里 180 个内置插件中有 **179 个**显示：

```
Package metadata error: Plugin metadata for <specifier>: TypeError: Cannot assign to read only
property 'stack' of object 'Error: Package subpath './locale/en.json' is not defined by "exports" …'
```

插件本身仍正常加载（`Enabled` / `Enabled via presets`），只是标题与描述丢失、回退成模块名，另加一行红字。属**显示层缺陷，不影响功能**。

对照实验（同一棵树、同一 `web` profile、同一 Node v22.22.0，唯一变量是"是否注册 ESM loader hooks"）：

| 启动方式 | Built-in plugins 报错行数 |
|---|---|
| `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile web` | 有（抽查 `agent-instructions`、`tool-bash` 均报） |
| `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` | **179 / 180** |
| `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` | **0 / 180**，标题与描述正常 |

根因指向 app-boot 在装饰解析错误时给只读的 `error.stack` 赋值（`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts:665` / `:688`），把本应被 `optionalResourcePath` 吞掉的 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`（包未导出 `./locale/en.json`，对无语言文件的包属正常情况）升级成了元信息错误。

绕过办法：用不注册 hooks 的启动器（构建版 `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`，或发布版 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）。

---

## Summary

Launching the harness with tsx's ESM loader hooks registered — which is what `README.zh.md` documents as "run from source" (`pnpm dsh web` → `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`) — makes **Settings → Built-in plugins** flag 179 of 180 plugins with a metadata error instead of their title and description:

```
Package metadata error: Plugin metadata for @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions: TypeError:
Cannot assign to read only property 'stack' of object 'Error: Package subpath './locale/en.json'
is not defined by "exports" in <repo>/apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions/package.json
imported from ~/.dsh/profiles/web/'
```

The affected plugins still load and run (`Enabled` / `Enabled via presets`); only their display metadata is lost and one red line per plugin is added to the panel.

The trigger is hook registration, not "source vs built": the **built** CLI with the same hooks (`node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`) shows the error on 179/180 rows, while the **built** CLI without them (`node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`) shows none.

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Harness | `dsh` 0.1.7-alpha.2, commit `00102833dfaee1da9f48a3a8eae9d34005a75218` (2026-09-22) |
| Node | v22.22.0 |
| Package manager | pnpm 11.7.0 (from `packageManager`) |
| OS | WSL2, Ubuntu 22.04 |
| Profile | `web` (stock; the user layer holds only a `welcomeNoticeVersion` and a permission preset — unrelated to this path) |
| tsx | as resolved by the workspace lockfile for `tsx/esm` |

## Steps to reproduce

1. From a clean clone at the commit above: `pnpm install && pnpm run build`.
2. Launch with hooks registered: `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile web --no-open --port 3097`, then open the printed token URL.
3. **Settings → Built-in plugins** → expand **Global plugins**.
4. Observe `Package metadata error: …` on 179 of the 180 rows.

## Expected

`readPluginMeta` probes `<specifier>/locale/en.json` as an **optional** resource. A package that ships no locale dictionary is the normal case, and `optionalResourcePath` / `missingResource` (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/package-meta.ts`, lines 59–72) exist to swallow exactly `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` / `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and fall through to the manifest. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`, for example, declares:

```json
"exports": { ".": { "types": "./lib/types/index.d.ts", "default": "./lib/index.js" }, "./src/*": "./src/*", "./package.json": "./package.json" }
```

and has no `locale/` directory, so the expected result is a title and description from its `package.json` and no diagnostic.

## Actual

The metadata read returns `{ error: 'Plugin metadata for <specifier>: …' }` instead (`package-meta.ts`, lines 169–171), so no title or description reaches the client.

## Control: same tree, same profile, same Node — only hook registration differs

| Launch | `Settings → Built-in plugins` (180 rows) |
|---|---|
| `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile web` | metadata error on the locale-less rows checked (`agent-instructions`, `tool-bash`) |
| `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` | **179 / 180** rows carry `data-package-meta-error` |
| `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` | **0 / 180** rows carry `data-package-meta-error`; locale-less rows show their manifest title and description, e.g. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` → "Shell plugin: three-column AppFrame with drag handles, ctx.layout viewing-state service (navigation + panels)" |

So the fallback path itself is sound; registering ESM loader hooks breaks it.

## Analysis

1. The chain starts as a **benign** resolution failure. `readPluginMeta` (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/package-meta.ts#L148`) calls `optionalResourcePath('<specifier>/locale/en.json', parentURL)` at line 151.
2. That probe runs through `resolvePluginResource` → `ModuleLoader.fromInternal().resolveSync(…)`, i.e. the loader that the runtime interception has wrapped, so a failure is decorated by `throwWithImporter` (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts#L655`, reached from the router's `restoreImporter` at line 741).
3. `throwWithImporter` rewrites the message, then the stack:
   ```ts
   error.message = message
   if (stack !== undefined) error.stack = stack.replace(originalMessage, message)
   ```
   (`resolver.ts#L665`; the CJS twin is at `#L688`.)
4. With hooks registered, that assignment throws `TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'stack'`. The TypeError replaces the original resolver error, whose `code` (`ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`) is the swallow condition in `missingResource` (`package-meta.ts#L59`), so "this package has no locale files" is no longer recognised as a missing optional resource.
5. The rethrow is caught by `readPluginMeta`'s outer handler (`package-meta.ts#L169-L171`) and surfaced to the UI as `Plugin metadata for <specifier>: <TypeError>`.

Other assignments making the same assumption, in case the failing site differs from the two above:

- `vendor/cordis/src/utils.ts#L248` and `#L263` (`handleError`'s long-stack splice)
- `vendor/cordis/src/reflect.ts#L76` (`enhanceError`)

Why `error.stack` is read-only once hooks are registered is **not** measured here: in a bare process (no hooks) this Node version yields a writable `stack` accessor for the same `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` object, including after `v8.serialize`/`deserialize` and `structuredClone`. The A/B isolates hook registration as the environmental trigger — consistent with the error crossing Node's hook boundary before the interception decorates it — but that last step is inference.

## Impact

- Cosmetic, not functional: affected plugins are `Enabled` and run normally; sessions, model calls, and tools are unaffected.
- It hits the documented contributor path (`README.zh.md` → "从源码运行" → `pnpm dsh web`), so contributors following the README see a Built-in-plugins panel where 179 of 180 plugins look broken.
- Workaround: launch without hooks — `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`, or the published `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` — which is unaffected.

## Suggested direction

- Make the decoration tolerant: guard the `error.stack` writes (descriptor check or `try`/`catch`), since a resolver error can arrive from a hook boundary where `stack` is not writable.
- Or preserve the original `code` when decorating fails so `missingResource` still classifies the failure as a missing optional resource — a metadata probe must never turn "this package has no locale files" into a diagnostic.

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows + npm global install: dsh web cannot boot — duplicate physical copies of @deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process trigger koffi "Duplicate type name 'DSH_STARTUPINFOW'", and a create-then-check HMR race exits right after printing the URL
discussions.body:
### Summary

On Windows 11 with a standard npm global install, `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` cannot start `dsh web` out of the box. There are **two independent defects**; fixing either one alone is not enough:

1. **Duplicate physical copies of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process`** in the npm-expanded tree. Two copies are evaluated in the same boot and both register the same koffi type on the same koffi instance, so koffi throws `Duplicate type name 'DSH_STARTUPINFOW'`; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` then fails to import and the plugin tree fails to load.
2. **HMR create-then-check race**: after the plugin tree loads and the web server prints its URL, `runProfile` creates the HMR service dynamically and immediately checks it synchronously, while `Hmr extends Service` only becomes visible after its async `Service.init`. The process then throws `requires the Cordis HMR service` and exits.

Both reproduce **with zero third-party plugins**: defect 2 on a brand-new empty `DSH_HOME` (stock web profile), defect 1 on three clean re-installs.

### Environment

- OS: Windows 11 (10.0.26200)
- Node.js v24.15.0, npm 11.12.1 (default `hoisted` install strategy)
- dsh CLI: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2`; its dependencies (`dsh-base`, `dsh-app-boot`, `dsh-sandbox-*`, `dsh-win32-process`, …) resolved to `0.1.5-rc.3`
- Install: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2`
- koffi 3.3.1 (only one copy in the tree)

### Defect 1 — duplicate `dsh-win32-process` → koffi duplicate type

**Symptom** (unmodified profile):

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: dsh: plugin(s) failed to load: @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local;
Cordis startup failed because these plugin(s) could not be resolved (see the error(s) logged above)
    at boot (dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1545)
    at async runProfile (dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js:311)
```

Variant (when the `sandbox` entry is disabled): `@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets: pending (waiting for service: shell)` — same root cause.

**Direct evidence**: `require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local')` succeeds, but a real `import()` throws:

```
direct import of @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local FAILED: Duplicate type name 'DSH_STARTUPINFOW'

import('.../dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js')
  → import('.../dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js')
    → import('.../dsh-win32-process/lib/index.js')
      ✗ Duplicate type name 'DSH_STARTUPINFOW'
```

`dsh-win32-process/lib/index.js:35` registers the type unconditionally at module top level:

```js
const STARTUPINFOW = koffi.struct("DSH_STARTUPINFOW", { cb: "uint32", lpReserved: "str16", lpDesktop: "str16", lpTitle: "str16", ... });
```

**Root cause**: after `npm install -g`, the tree contains **4 physical copies** of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process@0.1.5-rc.3` (byte-identical, different inodes):

```
dsh-base/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process
dsh-base/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process
dsh-sdk-minimal/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process
dsh-sdk-minimal/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process
```

Two of them — `dsh-subprocess-local` (provides the `subprocess` service) and `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` (loaded by `dsh-sandbox-local`) — are evaluated in the same boot, and both `import` the **same** koffi copy (there is only one koffi in the tree). The module is therefore evaluated twice and the same type name is registered twice on one koffi instance.

**This is not a dirty environment**: full uninstall (`npm uninstall -g` + removing `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai`) + `npm cache clean --force` + fresh install reproduced the identical 4-copy shape **3 times**. `npm install --package-lock-only` resolves to a tree with a **single** copy, so this is npm's reify placement interacting with the package graph; the same install emits roughly **280** `npm warn ERESOLVE overriding peer dependency`. At least 23 other packages are also duplicated (e.g. `dsh-anonymous-user-id` ×4, `debug` ×8).

**Impact**: any Windows user who installs 0.1.5-rc.2 / rc.3 globally with npm and has a profile containing `sandbox` (the base default) hits this; `dsh web` is completely unusable. macOS/Linux are unaffected (they use `dsh-bash-sandbox` and never load the pwsh/ACL/win32-process chain).

**Suggested fixes** (any one suffices):

- Make the type registration idempotent (check before registering, or catch and reuse an existing type).
- Or have `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` / `dsh-subprocess-local` consume `dsh-win32-process` through `peerDependencies`, so only one copy is placed.
- Or fix the peer-override conflict that causes the duplicate placement (pin the rc.x dependencies exactly, or trim duplicate dependency declarations inside the bundles).

### Defect 2 — HMR create-then-check race

After working around defect 1:

```
$ dsh web
dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=XXXX

Error: dsh: user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service
    at watchUserPatches (dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1112:28)
    at runProfile (dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js:329:9)
```

The plugin tree loaded and the web server is up — then the process kills itself. 3 of 3 attempts.

**Minimal reproduction (stock profile, no third-party plugins)**:

```
DSH_HOME=<empty dir> dsh web --no-open
  → dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=…
  → Error: dsh: user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service
```

**Code path** (`dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js:321-333`):

```js
if (composed.profile.patchReload === 'live' && …) {
  if (ctx.get('hmr') === void 0) {
    if (ctx.get('timer') === void 0) await ctx.loader.create({ name: '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer' });
    await ctx.loader.create({ name: '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr', config: { root: [] } }); // only awaits creation
  }
  await watchUserPatches(ctx, { … }); // immediately reads ctx.get('hmr')
}
```

and `dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1112` hard-fails:

```js
const hmr = ctx.get('hmr');
if (hmr === void 0) throw new Error(`${binName}: user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service`);
```

`Hmr extends Service`; the service only becomes visible after `async *[Service.init]()` (`cordis-plugin-hmr/lib/index.js:179+`) completes its `realpath` + `loadDependencies` + chokidar `watch`. `loader.create()` returns while the fiber is still `LOADING`, so the immediately following synchronous check must lose the race. `patchReload: "live"` is the default in the official web template, so this is the default path.

**Suggested fixes**:

- Do not create-then-check: await the entry's activation (e.g. `ctx.inject(['hmr'], …)`, or await the created fiber) — or
- enable the `hmr` entry that already exists in base (it is `disabled: true` by default) for official profiles with `patchReload: "live"` (we verified this works) — and/or
- degrade gracefully: when HMR is unavailable, warn that patch hot-reload is disabled but keep the server running.

### Other observations

- `@latest` produces a mixed tree: CLI `0.1.5-rc.2` with dependencies at `0.1.5-rc.3`. Pinning exactly would make reports far easier to triage.
- The failure is not self-diagnosing: `plugin(s) failed to load: @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local … (see the error(s) logged above)` — but nothing is logged above; the real koffi error is swallowed. Surfacing the underlying import exception on stderr would save a lot of time.
- `--legacy-peer-deps` is not a workaround: it removes the duplicates but skips peers, so `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-group` and others go missing and `dsh --version` fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.

### Local workarounds we are using (workarounds, not fixes)

1. Rename the extra physical copies and replace them with directory junctions pointing at one kept copy, so the module is evaluated once. **This must be re-run after every `npm install -g` of dsh.**
2. Enable the existing `hmr` entry in the profile patch layer (`disabled: false`) so the boot flow waits for the service instead of racing it.

### Related reports already checked

- #197 — koffi native crash on some Windows 10 machines (related area, different failure).
- #113 / #1313 — HMR boot failures (`--expose-internals is required for HMR service`) on macOS arm64 and headless.
- `npx dsh-win32 doctor --json` reports all-pass on this machine; its `koffi` check is profile-scoped ("no koffi found in any profile"), so it does not cover duplicated copies inside the global npm tree.
- `npx dsh-fix doctor` / `disable sandbox` were tried and did not help (disabling `sandbox` turns the failure into a misleading `permission-presets: pending (waiting for service: shell)`).

### Requests

- A `dsh doctor`-style self-check that can detect "the same package is present as multiple physical copies" and "a native addon type was registered twice".
- A documented, officially verified Windows install path (pnpm? a specific npm `--install-strategy`?) and/or a known-good fallback version.

### 中文摘要

Windows 11 + npm 全局安装的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` 开箱即无法启动 `dsh web`,两个独立缺陷:**(A)** npm 展开后的依赖树里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process` 有 4 份实体副本,其中两份在同一次启动被求值,却在**同一个 koffi 实例**上重复注册类型 `DSH_STARTUPINFOW` → `dsh-sandbox-local` 导入失败 → 插件树加载失败;**(B)** 插件树加载完、URL 打印后,`runProfile` 动态创建 HMR 服务并**立即同步检查**,而 HMR 的服务可见性要等异步 `Service.init` → 抛 `requires the Cordis HMR service` 后进程退出。两者在**零第三方插件**环境下均可复现(B 在全新空 `DSH_HOME` 的官方 profile 上 3/3 必现;A 在 3 次干净重装后形态一致)。macOS/Linux 不受 A 影响。

discussions.title: 开启新的对话窗口，预设模式的入口不见了，请求加回来！
Fork inherits the parent's pending inbox input, so a child answers a message its user never sent
discussions.body:
**Version:** master (00102833df, dsh 0.1.7-alpha.2)

**Steps**
1. In the Web GUI, send a prompt while the model is still answering, so the second message is queued.
2. Press Stop — session.cancel({ kind: 'user' }, { keepInbox: true }) keeps the queue.
3. Branch from that turn's tail (the branch button passes that turn/end as an explicit atSeq).
4. Send a new prompt in the child.

**Expected:** the child runs one turn for the new prompt.
**Actual:** the child first runs a turn over the parent's queued message and the new prompt waits behind it.

**Cause:** the copy goes through the chosen turn/end, which contains the pending `agent/inbox/spliced` insertion. The omitted-atSeq default stops before a *trailing* splice, but an insertion *inside* the copied prefix is still inherited, and the `inbox` projection folds the whole log, so the child's driver adopts it as its own pending input.

**Fix in my fork (1 commit + tests):** the `inbox` projection's fold state carries `inheritedEventCount` and skips `agent/inbox/spliced` events below it, so pending input stays with the lifecycle that admitted it; `stateVersion` 1 → 2 invalidates persisted cache rows; the copied prefix stays byte-identical (lineage, telemetry stitching, projection-cache identity unchanged). Wire value is unchanged.
Diff: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...listky:master

**Evidence:** `packages/core/agent-loop/tests/inbox.spec.ts` (fold-level) and a production-loop regression in `packages/api/session-controller/tests/session-fork.host.spec.ts` (queue behind a hanging turn → cancel with keepInbox → fork at that turn/end → child inbox empty, one model request, history without the parent's queued prompt). discussions.title: From session log to a verifiable compliance pack — would anyone actually use this?
discussions.body:
DSH's logging model is unusual: *model-visible means logged*, and the full trajectory is on disk.
That makes a class of question answerable that other agent runtimes cannot answer at all:

> Six months from now, can you prove what this agent did, and that the record was not altered since?

I have been building that, and I want to check the demand before going further.

**What already exists** (and I am not trying to replace any of it):

- `dsh-audit-trail` — hash-chained audit store, a versioned JSONL export (`dsh-audit-trail/compliance/1`)
- `dsh-session-export` — deterministic, redacted session evidence reports
- `dsh-testkit` / `dsh-eval-harness` — real-host release gates and YAML-driven regression gates

**What I built** — [`dsh-ledger`](https://github.com/Edge-Echo/dsh-ledger), a library plus a CLI:

- It reads `session.jsonl.zstd` **without decompressing**. Every append is an independent zstd
  frame, so frame boundaries are found by parsing the RFC 8878 structure: 34,729 frames walked in
  **27 ms**, and memory does not grow with file size (5× the input → 1.01× the retained heap).
- Execution graph: 133 turns, 1,860 tool calls on a real session, **100% paired with their results
  and 100% attributed** to typed effects.
- Integrity: RFC 6962 Merkle trees over raw frames and over records, **selective disclosure** (prove
  one record in a 20 MiB log with a 1,570-byte proof, keeping the other 53,670 confidential), and
  Ed25519-signed manifests.
- **It emits your schema, not a new one**: `compliance.jsonl` in `dsh-audit-trail/compliance/1`,
  under a conformance test that asserts byte-identical hashing and that
  `verifyComplianceJsonl` accepts our output.
- `pack` writes one zip: the chained compliance JSONL, the signed manifest, a sidecar for the facts
  the schema cannot express, and a `VERIFY.md` a third party can follow **without installing
  dsh-ledger**.

**One thing it deliberately does not do.** A shell command's file effects are not reconstructible
from the log. On the reference session 650 of 1,860 calls were shell, and every one is marked
`effects-undecidable` with the command kept verbatim; 58 of 177 file version chains are flagged
`contaminated` because a shell command ran between two recorded versions of the path. I chose to
label that honestly rather than infer file effects from command strings. **If you think that is the
wrong call, I would like to hear why** — it is the single decision most likely to make this useless
for your workflow.

**What I am actually asking:**

1. Does anyone need a *compliance pack* as an artifact, or do you only need queryable audit data?
2. If you deploy DSH in a regulated or customer-audited setting — what would you need in that pack
   that is not in the list above? Retention? Redaction policy? An approval trail? Something else?
3. For the maintainers of `dsh-audit-trail` / `dsh-session-export`: is emitting your schema the right
   integration, or would you rather expose a documented adapter point?
4. Separately: is there demand for the same treatment applied to **release evidence** — one
   verifiable pack aggregating `dsh-testkit` lifecycle results, `dsh-eval-harness` baselines and a
   compatibility check, so a plugin marketplace could show "evidence verified" rather than a badge
   someone typed?

If the answer to all four is "not really", that is a useful answer and I will stop here rather than
build the wrong thing. Concrete use cases beat encouragement.

---

### 中文摘要

DSH 的日志模型是"模型可见即被记录"，所以有一类别家答不了的问题它是能答的：**半年后，你能不能证明这个 Agent 做了什么，以及这份记录事后没被改过？**

我做了 [`dsh-ledger`](https://github.com/Edge-Echo/dsh-ledger)：

- **不解压**就能定位日志里的帧边界（每次 append 是一个独立 zstd 帧，34,729 帧遍历 27ms，内存不随文件增长）
- 1,860 次工具调用 **100% 配对、100% 归因**
- RFC 6962 Merkle + **选择性披露**（证明一条记录只要 1,570 字节，其余 53,670 条保密）+ Ed25519 签名
- **输出遵循已有的 `dsh-audit-trail/compliance/1` schema**，而不是另起一套，并有一致性测试证明哈希逐字节一致、他们的验证器能验证我的输出
- `pack` 产出一个 zip：合规 JSONL + 签名清单 + 旁证 + 一份**不需要装 dsh-ledger 就能照做的验证指南**

**我刻意没做的一件事**：shell 命令的文件效应原理上不可判定，650 次调用全部如实标为 `undecidable`，命令原文保留。我认为从命令字符串反推文件效应是把猜测当证据——**如果你觉得这个取舍错了，我很想听听理由**，这是最可能让它在你的工作流里失效的一个决定。

**想验证的四件事**：① 有人需要"合规包"这种形态，还是只需要可查询的审计数据？② 如果你们在受监管或有客户审计的场景用 DSH，包里还缺什么？③ 对 `dsh-audit-trail` / `dsh-session-export` 的维护者：直接发你们的 schema 是对的做法吗？④ 有没有人需要同样的东西用在**发布证据**上（聚合 testkit + eval-harness + 兼容性检查，让市场能显示"证据已验证"）？

如果四个答案都是"不需要"，这也是有用的答案，我就到此为止，不造错东西。

discussions.title: 离奇BUG：经常重试模型请求
discussions.body: 如图，经常出现这种情况，前期已经把所有的可能性都排查了一遍： 1、首先怀疑公司网络问题，找了公司运维排查了一遍，结论：没有防火墙拦截或网络波动等情况 2、用手机wifi，好像没有出现这种重试情况了，此时我更加怀疑是公司网络原因了（但是不要着急，如果是这么简单就没什么后续了） 3、某天问了公司同事，说他们没有遇到过这种情况，我问他们用的是什么Agent工具写代码，他们有说Claude code，有些用Codex 4、后来我抱着试一试的态度，转到Codex，Codex接入Deepseek后，开始使用一段时间，没有出现过一次重试模型的情况 5、然后我觉得可能是运气好，刚好这段时间比较稳定，然后我就同时使用dsh跑任务，当发现它出来重试模型后，我马上同时使用Codex跑一个任务 6、神奇的事情发生了，Codex一跑任务，如无意外，没有重试，同时dsh也正常了，刚开始我以为是可能刚好正常了吧 7、后面就重复多次尝试第5、6步骤，发现情况完全一致 8、结论： 1）Codex接入Deepseek绝对不会出现重试模型的情况 2）Dsh重试我已经能排除掉网络问题了，因为同时测试Dsh在重试，Codex也是能正常跑任务的，不会出现重试的情况 3）所以综合结论：是DSH工具导致的 望DSH开发团队能够排查一下，我不清楚其他开发人员是否有遇到过这种离奇问题，但是我这种情况确实存在，而且是长期存在的问题 启动命令：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 当前版本：最新版本，以前几个版本也是一样存在这种问题

discussions.title: [0.1.7-alpha.2] 全局 dispatcher（npm undici 8.11）与 Node 内置 fetch（7.28）协议错配，streamable-http MCP 工具全部无法连接
discussions.body:
# [0.1.7-alpha.2] 全局 dispatcher（npm undici 8.11）与 Node 内置 fetch（7.28）协议错配，streamable-http MCP 工具全部无法连接

### 环境

- DSH **0.1.7-alpha.2**（Windows 11，npm 全局安装），升级前 0.1.6 一切正常
- node **v24.18.0**（内置 undici **7.28.0**）
- DSH 依赖树内嵌 undici：**8.11.0**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/undici`）
- MCP server：streamable-http（`https://api.z.ai/api/mcp/web_search_prime/mcp` 等）
- MCP SDK：`@modelcontextprotocol/client` **2.0.0**（0.1.7 起）

### 现象

升级 0.1.7-alpha.2 后，所有 streamable-http MCP 工具无法连接，**每次重启都复现**；`failOnStartupError: false` 下控制台没有任何 mcp-client 日志。回退到 0.1.6-alpha.2 的时代（升级前）同配置一直正常。

### 根因

`dsh-http-proxy` 用 `await import("undici")`（解析到依赖树的 **8.11.0**）构造策略 dispatcher 并 `setGlobalDispatcher`，而 `globalThis.fetch` 走的是 **Node 内置 undici 7.28.0**。两个大版本的 Dispatcher/Handler 协议不兼容：**凡是经过 8.11 dispatcher 的响应，header 块整体丢失**（`content-type: null`，实测甚至全部响应头为空、body 未解压）。

MCP SDK 2.0.0 的 StreamableHTTPClientTransport 严格校验响应 content-type，收到无头响应即抛 `Unexpected content type: null`；再叠加 0.1.7 新的 reconnect supervisor（连续失败 10 次后注销工具并停止重连），最终表现就是：**每次启动 MCP 必死，且因为 `failOnStartupError: false` 而完全静默**。

`dsh-web-fetch-http` 使用模块内配套的同版本 undici fetch，dispatcher 与 fetch 版本配对，因此 web-fetch 不受影响——整个宿主里只有 MCP SDK 因为"硬校验 content-type + 走内置 fetch"两个条件叠加而表现为完全断连。

### 复现矩阵（同一进程、同一网络窗口内对照，node 24.18.0）

| 步骤 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| **V0** 基线：不装任何 dispatcher，`globalThis.fetch` + SDK connect | ✅ CONNECT OK（~200ms） |
| **V1** `installProxyFromEnvironment()` 安装宿主同款策略 dispatcher | ❌ FAIL（175ms，`Unexpected content type: null`） |
| **V2** 卸载 dispatcher（disposer） | ✅ CONNECT OK（187ms） |
| **V3** 仅把 8.11 的 `new Agent()` 设为 global dispatcher（不加载任何策略，排除策略层因素） | ❌ FAIL（同样 null content-type） |
| 依赖树 undici 降级到 **7.28.0** 后重复 V1/V3 | ✅ 全部 OK，content-type 完整 |

对照实验同时排除了：profile patch 配置、API 凭据、`.env` NO_PROXY 语义、MCP server 端点本身（裸 fetch 均可拿到正确响应）、YAML `!!js` 表达式解析、sniffer/指令大小上限等其它环节。另观察到一个独立现象：本机到该端点的直连存在分钟级抖动（偶发无头响应），与本题正交，但会让"10 次预算"的问题更容易触发。

### 临时修复（已验证有效）

```powershell
npm i -g undici@7.28.0
# 把宿主内嵌的 8.11 挪出模块解析路径：
Move-Item "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\undici" `
           "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\undici.8.11.0-bak"
```

重启宿主后 MCP 双 server 立即恢复连接。与 node 内置同版本（7.28.0）协议必然配对；升级宿主时 npm 会重装内嵌 undici，需重做（或等官方修复后无需再做）。

### 建议

1. `dsh-http-proxy` 的 undici 依赖钉在与 node 内置同代的大版本（如 `^7`），或改为统一使用模块自身的 fetch，保证 dispatcher 与 fetch 同源同代；
2. `failOnStartupError: false` 时首次连接的真实错误没有出现在任何可见日志里（README 描述为 "an error is logged"，实测控制台零输出），静默失败大幅放大了排查成本，建议至少默认输出一条；
3. reconnect supervisor 的 10 次预算对抖动链路偏激进，可考虑提高默认值或在预算耗尽后保留低频重试。

discussions.title: Multiple instances of dsh should be able to use the same DSH_HOME
discussions.body:
My workflow involves creating multiple checkouts of my monorepo in arbitrary paths. When I want to create a new plugin for dsh, I don't want to mess with my main dsh instance, as it may break and block my other workstreams. So I want to create a new monorepo checkout, work on my dsh plugin, test it, and commit the plugin code in this other checkout. However, multiple dsh instances using the same `$DSH_HOME` breaks DSH (new sessions doesn't work, etc.). I also don't want to use multiple `$DSH_HOME`s because I want all dsh instances to 1. see all of the sessions I have open, and 2. I don't want to manage copying over static data like `auth.json`.

TLDR: dsh processes should be able to share one `$DSH_HOME` cooperatively.

discussions.title: Safari: composer model/effort menu unmounts on mousedown, so mouse selection is a no-op (keyboard works)
discussions.body:
## Environment
- dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1 (web profile), also present unchanged in 0.1.7-alpha.2 and on master
- macOS 27.0 / Safari 27.0, GUI served at http://127.0.0.1:3080
- Same host + same session works fine in Chrome 27

## Steps
1. Open the web GUI in Safari.
2. Click the model seat in the composer; the menu opens with the Model / Effort rows.
3. Click a different reasoning effort (e.g. High).

## Expected
The effort switches (and is persisted as the session/default selection).

## Actual
Nothing happens: value stays the same, no toast, no console error, **no network request**.
The host side confirms the call never arrives — the session log has zero `model/selection`
events and the model-selection projection stays `{lastUsed: low, pending: null}`.
Keyboard (ArrowDown/Up + Enter) works, and `/model` works.

## Evidence
Capture-phase listeners on the page while clicking one row:

    mousedown  target=SPAN.<triggerEffort>          (menu opens; trigger loses focus, relatedTarget=null)
    mousedown  target=SPAN.<cellValue> -> mouseup -> click    (drill into the Effort pane: OK)
    focusin    target=BUTTON.<option>               (the checked row is focused by the drilled pane)
    mousedown  target=SPAN.<modelName>              (press a level row)
    focusout   target=BUTTON.<option>  relatedTarget=null
    mouseup    target=DIV.<composer card>           (the menu is already unmounted)
    (no click event at all)

## Root cause
`packages/client/ui-model-selection/src/client/ModelSelect.tsx`

The menu is portaled into `document.body`, and the seat root carries a blur guard:

```ts
const onBlur = (event) => {
  if (event.relatedTarget instanceof Node && (
    rootRef.current?.contains(event.relatedTarget) === true
    || menuRef.current?.contains(event.relatedTarget) === true
  )) return
  close()
}
```

Safari never moves focus to a clicked `<button>`, so pressing a row emits `focusout` with
`relatedTarget === null`. The guard fails, `close()` runs during `mousedown`, React unmounts
the menu before `mouseup`/`click`, and the row's `onClick` never fires. Chrome focuses the
clicked button, so `relatedTarget` is the row and the guard passes.

The keyboard path is unaffected because it activates rows synthetically:
`focused.click()` — it never goes through mousedown/blur.

## Suggested fix
Suppress the mousedown focus shift for buttons inside the menu (verified locally on the
installed 0.1.7-alpha.1 client bundle). `preventDefault()` is scoped to button targets so
scrollbar drags inside a long model list still work, and the keyboard path is untouched:

```diff
--- a/packages/client/ui-model-selection/src/client/ModelSelect.tsx
+++ b/packages/client/ui-model-selection/src/client/ModelSelect.tsx
@@ -370,6 +370,9 @@
           role="menu"
           aria-label={t('menu.aria')}
           aria-busy={state.status === 'loading' || busy}
+          onMouseDown={(event) => {
+            if (event.target instanceof Element && event.target.closest('button') !== null) event.preventDefault()
+          }}
         >
```

Alternatives: make the `onBlur` guard tolerate `relatedTarget === null` and re-check focus
after a task, or activate rows from `onPointerUp` instead of `onClick`.

## Impact
Any Safari user of the web GUI cannot change the model or the reasoning effort with the mouse.
