discussions.title: [Bug][DSH Desktop 2.0.13] 调整窗口尺寸后已打开的悬浮窗/弹窗不重新居中（macOS）
discussions.body:
## 问题

调整 DSH Desktop 主窗口尺寸时，**已经打开的悬浮窗/弹窗不会重新居中**，而是停留在原来的绝对坐标上；窗口缩小时会明显偏离中心，甚至部分或完全移出可视区域。

Resizing the main window does not re-center already-open floating windows/dialogs.

## 环境

- DSH Desktop version: **2.0.13**（`CFBundleShortVersionString` = `2.0.13`，对应 release `DSH Desktop v2.0.13`）
- DSH 运行时版本: **0.1.5-rc.2**（随应用内置的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 全家包；未另装 CLI，无 `dsh --version`）
- OS: macOS Apple Silicon — macOS 27.2 (Darwin 27.2.0, arm64)
- 安装位置: `/Applications/DSH Desktop.app`（Bundle ID `ai.deepseek.dsh.desktop`）
- Profile: 默认内置 Profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`，bundles：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`、`dsh-comfyui`）
- 第三方插件: `dsh-comfyui@0.5.1`；内置：`dsh-community-market`（来源 DSH 1024Store 已启用、dshfind 已禁用）、`dsh-desktop-notifications`、`ui-onboarding`
- 全新 Profile 对照: 未测试（界面位置问题）
- 复现频率: 每次都能复现

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 DSH Desktop，打开任意悬浮窗/弹窗，例如左下角「插件市场」打开「社区插件市场」，或「设置」。
2. 保持该弹窗处于打开状态，拖拽调整主窗口尺寸（先放大再缩小）。
3. 观察弹窗相对主窗口的位置。

## 实际结果

弹窗保持打开时的绝对坐标，窗口 resize 后不再与窗口中心对齐；窗口缩小时弹窗偏离中心，可能部分或完全超出可视区域。

## 预期结果

主窗口尺寸变化时，已打开的悬浮窗/弹窗应重新相对窗口居中，或至少被约束在可见区域内。

## 补充信息

- 纯布局问题，无报错文本、无崩溃、无终端输出；诊断 ZIP 未导出，需要的话我可以从托盘「导出诊断信息」后附上（上传前会移除敏感内容）。
- 有截图（窗口尺寸调整后「社区插件市场」弹窗偏离窗口中心），需要的话我补充上传。
- 已在仓库搜过相似 Issue/Discussion（居中 / resize / 悬浮窗 / dialog center），未发现相同问题。
- **修法建议（仅供参考）**：弹窗组件监听容器尺寸变化（`ResizeObserver` / `window.resize`）后重新计算并应用居中定位；若弹窗支持拖拽，则在 resize 时按新容器尺寸重新约束其位置坐标。

> 本内容不含任何 API 密钥、Token、账号信息等敏感数据。

discussions.title: [Bug][DSH Desktop 2.0.13] 已保存的 DeepSeek API 密钥无法删除，导致网络搜索优先走 DeepSeek 并报错
discussions.body:
## 问题

在「设置 → 模型 → DeepSeek」中保存了一个**错误的** API 密钥之后，界面没有提供删除该密钥的入口，密钥无法清除。结果是**网络搜索会优先调用 DeepSeek 提供方并因此报错**，用户无法摆脱这个错误密钥。

A saved DeepSeek API key cannot be deleted, so web search keeps calling the broken DeepSeek provider.

## 环境

- DSH Desktop version: **2.0.13**（`CFBundleShortVersionString` = `2.0.13`，对应 release `DSH Desktop v2.0.13`）
- DSH 运行时版本: **0.1.5-rc.2**（随应用内置的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`；未另装 CLI，无 `dsh --version`）
- OS: macOS Apple Silicon — macOS 27.2 (Darwin 27.2.0, arm64)
- 安装位置: `/Applications/DSH Desktop.app`（Bundle ID `ai.deepseek.dsh.desktop`）
- Profile: 默认内置 Profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`，bundles：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`、`dsh-comfyui`）
- 第三方插件: `dsh-comfyui@0.5.1`；内置：`dsh-community-market`（来源 DSH 1024Store 已启用、dshfind 已禁用）、`dsh-desktop-notifications`、`ui-onboarding`
- 全新 Profile 对照: 未测试（问题与已保存的凭据绑定，换新 Profile 会丢失该凭据，无法用于对照）
- 复现频率: 每次都能复现

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 DSH Desktop，打开「设置 → 模型 → DeepSeek」（`deepseek-official` 适配器）。
2. 在「API 密钥」输入框中填入一个故意错误的密钥，点击「保存」。
3. 重新进入该编辑界面：输入框只显示占位提示「已配置——输入新值可替换」，**没有任何清空/删除按钮**。
4. 尝试清空输入框后再次保存。
5. 重新进入确认密钥仍在；随后触发一次网络搜索，观察其优先使用 DeepSeek 并因密钥错误报错。

## 实际结果

- 密钥字段只支持「输入新值可替换」，没有任何删除入口；清空后保存也无法移除已配置的密钥。
- 错误密钥持续生效，网络搜索阶段固定先调用 DeepSeek 提供方并报错，用户失去对搜索提供方顺序的控制。
- 结果：一个填错的密钥变成"只进不出"。

## 预期结果

- 已保存的 API 密钥可以被删除：提供「删除/清除」按钮，或允许清空输入框并保存以移除密钥。
- 密钥被删除后，该提供方不再参与网络搜索的调用顺序，网络搜索恢复正常。

## 补充信息

- **界面不一致**：同一表单里「API 地址」输入框和「模型目录」的每个条目都带删除（垃圾桶）图标，唯独「API 密钥」字段没有任何删除操作。
- 相关持久化位置为用户配置目录下的 `settings.yaml` 与 `credentials` 配置（**本内容不引用其中任何密钥内容**）；相关配置块：`web-search-deepseek`、`llm-pi-ai`。
- 无崩溃、无启动错误，表现为功能缺失；网络搜索阶段的认证报错文本可在需要时补充。诊断 ZIP 未导出，需要的话我可从托盘「导出诊断信息」后附上。
- 有截图（密钥输入框显示「已配置——输入新值可替换」，无删除入口），需要的话我补充上传。
- 已在仓库搜过相似 Issue/Discussion（API 密钥 删除 / clear api key / 已配置），未发现相同问题。
- **修法建议（仅供参考）**：
  1. 为 API 密钥字段增加「删除」操作；或在保存时把空值视为清除密钥。
  2. 清除密钥后同步从网络搜索的提供方调用顺序中移除该提供方，避免继续优先调用已失效的凭据。
  3. 若出于安全考虑必须隐藏已存密钥，可只显示掩码并保留独立的「删除」按钮，而不是只提供"输入新值可替换"。

> 本内容不含任何 API 密钥、Token、账号信息等敏感数据。

discussions.title: Compaction cannot rescue an oversized session — the summarization request itself exceeds the provider request-size limit (HTTP 413)
discussions.body:
**Summary.** A long session with heavy tool output can reach a state where every request fails with HTTP 413 (payload too large), and automatic compaction cannot recover it: the summarization call replays the compacted region in one request and hits the same limit. The session becomes unusable — no turn succeeds, compaction fails with the same 413, and a fork inherits the corpus (`isSeeded: true`), so it fails from its first turn.

**Environment**
- dsh `0.1.7-alpha.2` launched from source, Windows 11 x64, bundled Node 24.17.0
- provider `deepseek-official`, model `deepseek-v4-flash`, declared `contextWindow: 1000000` in the provider config
- session shape: 126 turns, ~20,800 events (about 3,900 of them `tool/result`); decompressed corpus ≈ 56 MB, stored `.jsonl.zstd` ≈ 8 MB

**Observed**
- At turn 126: `compaction/prune` shadows a few old results (~19K tokens), then `compaction/start` → `compaction/end` with `error: "DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)"`, and the routed request ends with the same 413 (`turn/end`, reason `error`).
- Retrying does not help — the same 413 repeats (hundreds of occurrences in the log), so the session cannot make progress.
- Forking does not help either: the fork is seeded with the parent's history and 413s on its first request.

**Suspected cause (from source)**
- `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts`: `summarizeWithLlm()` builds ONE `ctx.llm.stream()` call carrying the replayed conversation prefix (`input.messages`: system head plus the whole shadowed region) plus the compaction instruction. The replay is intentional (prefix-cache reuse), but there is no chunking and no size guard.
- `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/config.ts`: budgeting is token-only — `thresholdRatio` default 0.8, `retainRatio` default 0.16, `headroomTokens` default 65,536, `maxTokens` defaulting to the headroom. `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts` picks the region purely by token counts; neither module accounts for request bytes.
- With a declared 1M-token window the threshold fires at ~800K tokens — several MB of JSON on the wire — which the provider rejects with 413. The token budget and the transport limit disagree.

**Impact.** Once a session crosses the transport limit there is no way out: automatic compaction cannot run, `/compact` presumably fails the same way, forks inherit the problem, and the only option is to abandon the session — losing continuity for exactly the long-running work the feature exists for.

**Suggested directions**
1. Bound the summarization request by bytes as well as tokens — summarize the region in chunks (progressive/hierarchical: compact the oldest part first, then repeat) instead of replaying all of it at once.
2. Derive the compaction trigger from the transport limit too, so the summarization request always fits.
3. Treat 413 as terminal rather than retryable, with an actionable message ("session too large to send; start a new session or reduce the model's declared contextWindow").
4. Warn or refuse when forking a session whose corpus already exceeds the transport limit.

**Question.** Is there a supported way today to bound a session's request size, or to recover an oversized session (trim / partial compaction)? If yes, please document it; if not, would a byte-aware trigger plus chunked summarization be acceptable? I can share a redacted event excerpt (event names, sizes, error strings) if that helps.

**Workaround** for anyone hitting this: lower the provider model's declared `contextWindow` (for example to 131,072–262,144) so compaction triggers much earlier and new sessions stay inside the provider's request limit. The oversized session itself stays unusable.

discussions.title: 【BUG】 输入框无法拖拽改变大小了
discussions.body:
AI 分析了一波原因，如下：
`提交 1bec11e366（fix(ui): keep transcript resize handles unobtrusive）。它把正文宽度拖拽区域从：

  - 40px 宽、z-index: 8

  改成：

  - 10px 宽、z-index: 0

  而底部输入区是 z-index: 7，所以更新后输入框两侧的拖拽区域被输入区覆盖，用户无法从那里开始左右拖动。`

discussions.title: 桌面端：认领命令（/计划 等）后用拼音输入法打字，整行变色、退格失效（Lexical error #14）
[Bug] DSH Desktop advanced 模式禁用 ui-layout，导致手机/远程等不带 ?dsh-desktop-mode=advanced 的 Web 客户端完全无法加载（附根因定位与修复方向）
discussions.body:
## TL;DR (中文) DSH Desktop 的 `advanced` 界面模式会在**宿主侧**把 `ui-layout` 这一行整行禁用（`disabled: true`），取而代之由**桌面客户端**（`AdvancedFrame`）在运行时提供 `layout` 服务。 但那个替代实现**只在请求带 `?dsh-desktop-mode=advanced` 时才生效**（按请求/按 URL 决定）。于是任何**不带该参数的客户端**——手机浏览器、远程访问、另一台电脑的浏览器——都会进入"两边的 layout 都没有"的状态： `ui-sidebar` / `ui-conversation` 的 `inject` 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`，该行被禁用 → 无 live fiber → 其 client bundle 404 → 从 `__DSH_BOOT__` 清单剔除 → 这两个插件永久 `pending (waiting for service: layout)` → **整个 Web 界面无法挂载**，只剩 "Failed to load plugins" 恢复页。 **核心缺陷是不对称**：宿主侧禁用是**进程级/机器级**决定，客户端侧替代是**按请求**提供。二者不匹配，非桌面客户端必然无解。 --- ## Environment - DSH Desktop `2.0.2` (Windows x64, Electron 43.4.0) - Setting: `dsh-desktop.mode = advanced` - Affected clients: any browser without `?dsh-desktop-mode=advanced` — notably the **mobile browser** and any **remote/LAN** access ## Steps to reproduce 1. Set `dsh-desktop.mode: advanced` (settings) and restart DSH Desktop. 2. Open the DSH Web GUI in a **plain browser** (no query params), e.g. from a phone over LAN/tunnel, or `curl http://127.0.0.1:/`. 3. The page renders the recovery screen: ``` Failed to load plugins web boot: 3 entries did not activate @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar: pending (waiting for service: layout) @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation: pending (waiting for service: layout) @deepseek-ai/dsh-anionex-vision-toolkit: pending (waiting for service: conversation) ``` 4. `GET /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/client.js` returns **HTTP 404** (while `.../ui-sidebar/client.js` and `.../ui-renderer/client.js` return 200). 5. `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` contains **no** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` row. Switching `dsh-desktop.mode` to `compatibility` and restarting immediately fixes it: the entry count goes 42 → 58 and `layout`'s bundle returns HTTP 200. ## Root cause chain (from the shipped bundles) ``` lib/profile-q-NfmwOb.js (~line 620) // host-side profile composition if (mode === "advanced") { for (const [id, packageName] of [["ui-layout", ...], ["ui-sidebar", ...], ["ui-conversation", ...]]) if (rows.get(id)?.name !== packageName) throw ... patches.push( { id: "ui-layout", disabled: true }, // <-- layout row disabled { id: "ui-sidebar", disabled: false }, { id: "ui-conversation", disabled: false } ); } | v lib/client.js (~line 296, 397, 446) // desktop client half function provideDesktopLayout(ctx, layout) { ctx.reflect.provide("layout", layout); } function applyAdvancedShell(ctx, environment) { if (environment.mode !== "advanced") throw ... ctx.effect(() => provideDesktopLayout(ctx, desktopLayout), "desktop: layout service"); } // environment.mode comes from the URL query param dsh-desktop-mode | v @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules lib/index.js (~line 421) processOne(entryName) { for (const entry of this.ctx.loader.entries()) if (entry.options.name === entryName && entry.fiber !== void 0 && !entry.disabled) { qualifies = true; break; } if (!qualifies) return this.table.delete(entryName); // row has no fiber -> dropped ... } | v GET /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/client.js -> 404 | v __DSH_BOOT__ has no layout entry | v packages/client/ui-sidebar/package.json // ALSO TRUE IN THIS REPO "dsh": { "client": { "inject": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout", <-- hard dependency "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale"] } } | v ui-sidebar / ui-conversation never activate -> whole Web UI is unusable ``` Note that `packages/client/ui-sidebar/package.json` in **this repository** declares the same hard `inject` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`, so the coupling is upstream design, not a local artifact. ## Evidence collected | Check | Result | |---|---| | `GET /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/client.js` | **404** | | `GET /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar/client.js` | 200 (17411 B) | | `GET /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client.js` | 200 (39235 B) | | `__DSH_BOOT__.entries` count (advanced) | 42, no `layout` | | `__DSH_BOOT__.entries` count (compatibility) | 58, has `layout` | | Package on disk (`lib/client.js`) | present, 19364 B, valid | | `require.resolve('/package.json')` under Electron-as-node | succeeds | | `require.resolve('/client')` under Electron-as-node | succeeds, file readable | | Composed config (`--dump-config`) | `ui-layout` row present exactly once, not disabled | | Varies by User-Agent / desktop query params? | No — manifest identical across all of them | So the package, the resolution, the manifest declaration and the composed config are all correct; only the **runtime mount** of that one row is missing — exactly what `processOne()`'s `entry.fiber !== void 0` gate then deletes. ## Why the desktop window looks fine The desktop BrowserWindow loads `http://127.0.0.1:/?dsh-desktop-mode=advanced&dsh-desktop-platform=

`, so its client half *does* provide `layout` via `AdvancedFrame`. The breakage only shows up for clients that omit that parameter — which is precisely the mobile / remote case. This makes the bug easy to miss during desktop-only testing. ## Suggested fixes (either one resolves it) **A. Make the host-side disable client-aware.** Do not express "the desktop shell replaces the frame" as a *profile-level row disable*. Keep `ui-layout` mounted and let the advanced shell take over the `root` slot / override the `layout` service at the client level, so any client that does not opt into advanced still finds a working `layout`. **B. Give advanced mode a Web fallback.** When `mode === "advanced"` disables `ui-layout`, also ensure a fallback layout is present for non-desktop clients — e.g. keep the row enabled and have the desktop client half provide the advanced implementation via `ctx.slots`/`reflect.provide` override (with an explicit provider-precedence rule), or serve the compatibility composition to clients that do not carry the desktop marker. **Either way, the invariant to preserve is:** *for every client that can be served the Web GUI, some provider of the `layout` service must be in `__DSH_BOOT__`.* ## Impact Any remote-access scenario is dead in `advanced` mode: - phone browser on the LAN / over a tunnel - a second computer's browser - the `/m/` style mobile clients that community plugins such as `@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui` serve This is currently the only way to use DSH from a phone, so `advanced` mode effectively disables mobile/remote use of DSH. ## Environment detail Reported from a DSH Desktop 2.0.2 installation. The relevant sources are not present in this repository's `apps/desktop` (this repo's copy is `0.1.7-alpha.2` and has no `AdvancedFrame` / `dsh-desktop-mode`), so file paths above are quoted from the shipped bundles with approximate line numbers — happy to re-verify against source if pointed at the right tree.

discussions.title: [Bug] One plugin with a pre-e459e32637 typert manifest withdraws every typert definition — web UI unusable (session/control: definition-unavailable)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Since e459e32637 ("perf(typert): materialize generated schemas on first use"), `typert-loader` requires a `create()` factory on every manifest schema and strict codec, and rejects the previous `schema:` shape outright. That is expected for a pre-stable format. The problem is the blast radius. **One** out-of-tree plugin whose `./typert` artifact was generated before that commit makes the loader throw, and the throw withdraws **every** typert definition, including in-tree ones. The web client then shows only "Failed to load plugins", and no session can run: `session/control` itself is unavailable.

The server log reports this only as `dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate`, which reads as non-fatal.

## Reproduction

1. Install an out-of-tree plugin whose package exports `./typert`, generated by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-generator` before e459e32637. Its manifest codecs carry `schema:` instead of `create:`.
2. Start `dsh web` on 0.1.6-alpha.2 or later. The loader rule is unchanged at 0.1.7-alpha.2 (00102833df).

## Current behavior

Server log:

```
dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate
typert-loader (@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-loader): AggregateError: typert-loader: 1 typert contributor(s) failed to register:
  - typert-loader: <plugin> invocation "<plugin>#<service>/<method>" parameter codec has no create() factory
```

Browser console. The endpoints are in-tree, not the failing plugin's:

```
[session-controller] control stream failed: RemoteError: typert gateway: session/control: its strict definition was withdrawn and SRC fallback is forbidden
[ui-cordis] reading the Cordis inventory failed: Error: gateway/definition-unavailable: typert gateway: dynamicCordisRunner/inventory: its strict definition was withdrawn and SRC fallback is forbidden
[cordis-client-runner] syncing inspect providers failed: Error: gateway/definition-unavailable: typert gateway: dynamicCordisRunner/syncInspectManifest: its strict definition was withdrawn and SRC fallback is forbidden
```

How it spreads, from reading the source at 00102833df:

- `packages/typert/loader/src/index.ts:410` registers each valid contributor (`registered.set(entryName, ctx.typert.register(manifest))`). Only afterwards does `:459` throw the `AggregateError` for the invalid one.
- The throw fails the loader's fiber. Cordis unloads it (`vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts`, the `INACTIVE` / `_unload()` path), which disposes the registrations it had just made.
- `packages/typert/registry/src/service.ts:144` records each committed endpoint in `history`, and `withdraw` (`:151`) does not remove it. So `hasSeen` stays true with no definition behind it, and the gateway answers `its strict definition was withdrawn and SRC fallback is forbidden` (`packages/api/gateway/src/index.ts:750`).

Net effect: one stale third-party artifact disables the typert layer for every in-tree package, while the failing plugin's own endpoints (never committed) still fall through to SRC.

## Expected behavior

- An invalid contributor is rejected on its own, and the valid contributors stay registered. The failure then costs one plugin, not the UI.
- The generated manifest carries a format version, so the loader can say "this plugin was generated for an older typert manifest format; rebuild it with dsh-typert-generator ≥ X" instead of a shape error. There is currently no version signal an out-of-tree author can key on.
- Optionally, a one-release deprecation window where `schema:` manifests load with a warning.

## Workaround

Remove the plugin from the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart, or rebuild it with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-generator@0.1.7-alpha.2`. A rebuilt manifest emits `create:` codecs and loads, and the rest of the UI is unaffected either way.

## Environment

macOS arm64, source checkout, `dsh web`. Observed on 0.1.6-alpha.2 (ddefc45fbc). The loader rule is the same at 0.1.7-alpha.2 (00102833df).

Related, but not the same: #6134 (tolerate plugin failures in the loader), #2229 (the fatal screen offers no recovery).

discussions.title: [插件] Knit — 把工作区文档按「当前对话」排序的侧栏，想找人验证有没有用
discussions.body:
DSH 的「一切皆插件」是我留在这里的原因 —— 分享一下我写的一个插件，顺便求个真实反馈。

## 它解决什么问题

Agent 一天能产出十几篇 `.md`：技术方案、竞品分析、PRD、调研笔记、CHANGELOG。
文件名都挺规范，但我就是说不出上午那份方案叫什么。

试过的办法都不太行：

- **文件树**：要求我先想起文件名 —— 我想不起的恰恰就是文件名
- **「最近打开」列表**：只记我点开过的，**Agent 写的那十几篇我一次都没点开过**
- **搜索**：得先想出一个词，我连它叫什么都不知道

所以我做了 Knit：右侧栏一个 tab，把工作区里已有的 Markdown / 图片 / 视频列出来，
**按我当前正在聊的内容排序**。

## 怎么算的

全程本地字符串运算，**不调模型、不联网**（这也是我不想松动的一条承诺）：

1. 读当前会话最近 6 条真人消息，越新的权重越高（3 / 2 / 1 / 1…）
2. 抽关键词：英文词直接取；中文切 2/3-gram，并丢掉跨词边界的碎片
   （中文没有词边界，「图片和」「个插」这种是相邻两个词粘起来的产物）
3. BM25 + IDF 打分，字段加权 标题 ×4 / 摘要 ×2 / 正文 ×1，各自做饱和与长度归一化

**没上向量检索是刻意的**：这个量级（几十到几百篇）上 BM25 是主流选型而不是降级
（微软 Copilot 的本地语义索引门槛是 2500 个文件，超过反而退回简单检索），
而且不上模型才敢说「你的文档一个字都不出本机」。

## 装

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-knit
```

装完重启 DSH、硬刷新浏览器。

## 我想问的其实不是功能

`knit_docs` 工具也在里面 —— agent 可以问「这个项目里跟当前话题最相关的文档是哪几篇」，
返回时带上每篇里**命中的那段原文**。

但**我最想知道的不是「还缺什么功能」，而是「你什么时候会打开它」**。
哪怕答案是「装了，但一周没打开过」—— 那比一个功能建议有用得多。

原因：这个插件目前**一个真实用户的痕迹都没有** —— 仓库 **2 star / 0 fork / 0 issue**。
npm 上确实有下载数字，但我核过它的**形状**：八个版本几乎均分（各 11–15%），
连被取代多次的旧版本都还在被拉 —— 真人装插件只会装 `latest`，
所以那是**自动化版本枚举**，不是人。（我特意没在这里写那个数字，它读不出任何东西。）
**一条有人味儿的回复能直接改变接下来做什么。**

## 老实说局限

- 对话太短（一两句）时关键词太少，会退回按修改时间排，面板上会直说
- 只有三五篇文档时 IDF 几乎不起作用 —— 文档越多它越准
- 它只能排「和对话用同一批词」的文档；一个词都对不上时分数全一样，退化成时间序
- 中文分词是 n-gram 近似，不是真分词

仓库在 https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-knit ，
静态截图、「排序跟着对话走」的动图、以及为什么选 BM25 的实测数据都在 README 里。

discussions.title: [bug] 上下文超长被误判成普通 API 错误：自动压缩 124 次失败 102 次，会话永久卡死
discussions.body:
> 目标仓库：`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` · 通道：GitHub Discussions（该仓库 Issues 已关闭，`CONTRIBUTING.md` 指定 bug 走 Discussions）
> 复现版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 0.1.5-rc.2（DSH Desktop 0.9.0 内置）

## Summary

在一个长中文 + 代码会话里，真实 prompt 已经涨到模型窗口的 **1.31–1.47 倍**，但 harness 完全没有意识到「上下文超长」这件事：

- 自动压缩触发了 **124 次**，其中 **102 次失败**，失败原因全部是
  `{"failure":{"message":"Response incomplete: length","code":"PI_AI_ERROR"}}`；
- 压缩失败被 `agent/pre-step` **静默吞掉**（只打一行 warning），turn 照常继续；
- `agent/request-error` 的溢出恢复逻辑因为 `failure.code !== CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE` 而**一次都没触发**；
- 主请求最终以同一个 `PI_AI_ERROR` 死掉，**会话从此无法继续**，只能新开。

关键点：**不是压缩没触发，而是压缩在结构上不可能成功，并且所有兜底路径都被同一个错误分类问题挡住了。**

## Reproduction

1. 配置一个 `api: openai-responses` 的 provider。本例：
   ```yaml
   volcengine-ark:
     api: openai-responses
     baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
     models:
       deepseek-v4-1-flash: { contextWindow: 131072, maxTokens: 16384 }
   ```
2. 跑一个长会话（中文 + 代码，token 密度高），让真实 prompt 超过 `contextWindow`。
3. 等自动压缩触发。压缩请求本身返回 `status=incomplete` + `incomplete_details.reason="length"`。
4. 观察 `agent/pre-step` 只留下 `step compaction failed: ...; continuing the turn`，上下文**永不缩小**。
5. 最终主请求返回同样的错误，turn 直接结束，之后每个 turn 都在 30 秒内以同样方式死掉。

## Current behavior

会话 `session-05e8fec4-7176-47a2-9d5b-e111058f5d93`（workspace `E:\mu_ai`）的
`session.v3.jsonl.zstd` 实测数据：

### 1. 压缩统计

`compaction/end` 事件共 **124 次**：成功 **22 次**，失败 **102 次**。
首次失败 `2026-09-23T09:08:34.393Z`，最后一次失败 `2026-09-23T13:27:49.072Z`。
最后一次成功是 seq 3189 / `2026-09-23T12:07:31.970Z` —— 之后 3 小时内压缩 **再没成功过一次**。

### 2. 成功的摘要全部顶到 8192 输出上限

最后一次成功的几次摘要，`outputTokens` 分别是
`7732, 8071, 8096, 8138, 8129, 7356, 7915` —— 明显是贴着 `maxTokens` 默认值 8192 被截断的。

### 3. 主请求的死法完全一样

| seq | 时间 | 事件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3711 | `12:52:06.622Z` | turn 10 结束，`{"failure":{"message":"Response incomplete: length","code":"PI_AI_ERROR"}}` |
| 3722 | `13:09:49.447Z` | turn 11 结束，同上 |
| 3734 | `13:27:52.190Z` | turn 12 结束，同上 |

### 4. 真实 prompt 早就超窗了（provider 自己数的）

| usage (input / cacheRead / output) | 真实 prompt = input+cacheRead | 相对 131072 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `5486 / 166528 / 999` | **172,014** | 1.31× |
| `13671 / 171904 / 16` | **185,575** | 1.42× |
| `7277 / 185472 / 16` | **192,749** | 1.47× |

（`totalTokens == inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + outputTokens` 已在多个样本上核对。
注意 `outputTokens` 只有 16 / 999，所以**这不是输出被截断**，而是输入侧早就超窗。）

**也就是说：harness 手里已经有能证明溢出的精确 usage 数字，只是错误分类那条路径完全没有用它们。**

## 根因链

**① 触发点（第三方依赖）** `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.1`

`dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js:660-688` `mapStopReason`：

```js
case "incomplete":
  return incompleteReason === "max_output_tokens"
    ? { stopReason: "length" }
    : { stopReason: "error", errorMessage: `Response incomplete: ${incompleteReason}` };
```

Ark 返回的是 `incomplete_details.reason = "length"`，不等于 `"max_output_tokens"`，
于是被映射成 `stopReason: "error"` + 消息 `Response incomplete: length`。

**② pi-ai 自己的溢出检测也因此失效** `dist/utils/overflow.js:130-155`（本机 0.85.1 实测）

- case 1（:132-138）：要求 `stopReason === "error"` 且消息命中 `OVERFLOW_PATTERNS` → `"Response incomplete: length"` 一条都不命中；
- case 3（:149-154）：要求 `stopReason === "length"` **且 `usage.output === 0`** → 这里 stopReason 是 `error`，且 output 是 16/999，**两道门都过不去**；
- 连带 `isRecoverableLength`（:163-165）也要求 `stopReason === "length"`，同样失效。

⚠️ 注意：**光把 `length` 映射对还不够。** case 3 里 `output === 0` 这个条件在 0.85.1 里依然存在
（上游 PR #7540「允许非零 output」虽已合并，但并未出现在本机这个构建里），
所以本次的 `output=16 / 999` 即使 stopReason 正确也仍会被判成"非溢出"。

**③ DSH 侧退化成通用错误** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1389-1443` `mapStopReason`

```js
const piAiOverflow = isContextOverflow(message, contextWindow);
const harnessOverflow = stopReason === "error" && errorMessage !== undefined
  && isContextWindowExceededError(errorMessage);
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js:152-167` `isContextWindowExceededError` 的所有正则
（`STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW` / `TOO_LARGE_FOR_CONTEXT` / `EXCEEDS_MODEL_CONTEXT` …）
都要求消息里出现明确的 “context” 字样，`"Response incomplete: length"` 一条都不命中。
→ 最终 `classifyPiAiError(text)` 给出 `code: "PI_AI_ERROR"`。

**④ 兜底路径被这个 code 挡住**

- `dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:820-839` `agent/request-error`：
  `failure.code !== CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE` 就直接 `next()` → 溢出恢复永不触发；
- `dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:798-811` `agent/pre-step`：
  压缩失败只 `log('step compaction failed: ...; continuing the turn')` 然后 `next()` → turn 带着超窗上下文继续跑；
- `dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:873-920` `compactIfNeeded`：
  `thresholdTokens = floor(contextWindow * thresholdRatio)`，超过重试次数后抛
  `compaction still above threshold after N compaction attempts` —— 但此时已经晚了。

**⑤ 阈值本身就算错了**

`dsh-token-meter/lib/index.js:16` 与 `pi-ai/dist/utils/estimate.js:1` 都用 `CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4`。
在中文 + 代码场景下低估约 **1.37×**（`pi-ai` 的 clamp 反推估计值 ≈126k，而 provider 数出 172k）。
于是 preset 里的 `thresholdRatio: 0.75` → 估计 98,304 ≈ **真实 134k**，
**压缩触发点已经落在真实窗口之外**，必然先溢出再压缩。

**⑥ 一旦 surface 超窗，压缩在数学上不可能成功**

摘要请求要重放整个可压缩前缀（surface 减去约 20,971 token 的 retain 尾巴），
输入本身还是超窗 → 又是 `incomplete/length` → 死循环。
这就是 124 次触发里 102 次失败、且成功的那 22 次全在窗口还没被撑爆之前的原因。

## Expected behavior

1. 真实 prompt 超过 `contextWindow` 时，应当被识别为**上下文溢出**（`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`），而不是通用 `PI_AI_ERROR`；
2. 溢出恢复（`agent/request-error`）应当被触发，而不是被 `code` 挡在门外；
3. 压缩失败**不应**被静默吞掉后继续 turn —— 至少要阻塞 turn 并明确告诉用户「上下文已满，压缩失败」；
4. 摘要输出上限不应默认 8192（中文摘要会被腰斩，且腰斩的摘要会被当成有效 checkpoint）；
5. token 估计应当在中文场景下不至于低估到让压缩触发点落在窗口之外。

## Suggested fixes

按「最小改动 → 收益」排序：

1. **`dsh-llm-pi-ai`：加 usage 兜底判定（收益最大、改动最小，且不依赖上游）**
   在 `mapStopReason` 里，除了看错误文本，再用 provider 的 usage 判定：
   若 `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens >= 0.99 * contextWindow`，无论文本是什么都判为
   `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`。本例的 172k / 185k / 192k 会被立刻正确识别。
   **这条不依赖 provider 的 `incomplete_details.reason` 字符串，所以上游不改也能生效。**

2. **`dsh-llm`：让 `isContextWindowExceededError` 认识 pi-ai 自己的包装文本**
   `Response incomplete: <reason>` 是 pi-ai 造出来的字符串，DSH 认识它才算闭环。

3. **`dsh-compaction-basic:820-839`：溢出恢复不要只认 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE`**
   改为 `code === CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE || usageBasedOverflow`。

4. **`dsh-compaction-basic:798-811`：压缩失败要「响」**
   至少 `next(new Error(...))` 或发出一个用户可见事件；`continuing the turn` 是这次事故里最贵的 11 个单词。

5. **`dsh-compaction-basic:72`：`maxTokens: config.maxTokens ?? 8192` 默认值过低**
   建议默认取 `min(model.maxTokens, 某上限)` 而不是硬编码 8192（本例模型 `maxTokens: 16384`）。

6. **`dsh-token-meter:16`：`CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4` 对 CJK 严重低估**
   建议按 CJK 字符占比做加权估计。

7. **阈值用真实 usage 而不是估计值**
   既然 usage 里已经有精确的 `input + cacheRead`，压力判断就应该以它为准（或至少取 `max(估计, 上次真实 usage)`）。

### 上游现状（重要：不能指望上游）

我在写这份报告前先查了上游，结论是**DSH 必须自己兜住**：

- 上游 `earendil-works/pi` **PR #7817**「fix(ai): treat incomplete reason 'length' as a length stop, not an error」
  提的正是本报告 ① 的修复（描述里明确点名 Doubao / Volcengine Ark），
  但**创建当天就被 `github-actions[bot]` 自动关闭且未合并**，理由是：
  > Only contributors approved with `lgtm` can open PRs. Open an issue first and ask a maintainer for approval.
- 同类 issue #7052 也是在创建 **8 秒后**被机器人自动关闭。
  该仓库的策略是「issue/PR 先自动关闭，维护者事后挑着 reopen」，所以**上游修复的时间不可控**。
- 更关键的是：即使 ① 被上游接受，**② 的 `output === 0` 条件仍会漏掉本例**（见上）。
  也就是说这次事故需要上游**两处**同时改才对 DSH 生效。

因此我的建议是：**DSH 侧先加 usage 兜底（下面的第 1 条），不要等上游。**
同时我会另开一个上游 issue 说明 ①+②，但那只是长期对齐，不应当作为 DSH 的修复前提。

### 附带一条：官方 OpenAI 也会这样

上游 issue #7052 里有一个和本例几乎同构的数据（官方 `openai-responses`，272k 窗口）：

```json
{"usage":{"input":3,"output":264,"cacheRead":267059,"cacheWrite":637,"reasoning":110},
 "stopReason":"length"}
```

`input + cacheRead = 267,062` ≈ 98% 窗口，output 极小 —— 和本例「输入早已贴满窗口、输出只有 16/999」
是**同一个现象**，只是官方返回的 reason 是 `max_output_tokens`（能被 pi-ai 正确识别），
Ark 返回的是 `length`（被误判成 error）。
这反过来说明：**本例的 `reason: "length"` 极可能同样是输入侧窗口耗尽，而不是输出被截断**，
所以用 usage 判定溢出是语义上正确的做法。

## Environment

- DSH Desktop `0.9.0`，内置 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` **0.1.5-rc.2**（Windows 11）
- provider：`volcengine-ark`，`api: openai-responses`，baseURL `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3`
- model：`deepseek-v4-1-flash`，`contextWindow: 131072`，`maxTokens: 16384`
- 依赖：`@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.1`
- preset：`standard-70`（`compaction-basic` 的 `thresholdRatio` 被手工设为 0.75）
- 会话文件：`$DSH_HOME\sessions\<workspace-key>\session-05e8fec4-...\session.v3.jsonl.zstd`
  （多帧 zstd，需按 magic `28 B5 2F FD` 切帧后逐帧解压）

## 相关讨论 / 上游记录

- DSH #4657「DSH 中的 pi 组件把 API 错误误判成『上下文超长』」—— 同一个分类器的**反方向**误判，可作为对照。
- DSH #2335「上下文占满窗口时没有任何明确的用户提醒」—— 本次事故正是这条的极端后果。
- 上游 `earendil-works/pi` PR #7817 —— 修 ① 的 PR，被机器人自动关闭未合并。
- 上游 `earendil-works/pi` PR #7540（已合并）—— 引入「length stop + usage 接近窗口 ⇒ 视为溢出」的思路，
  但其「允许非零 output」的放宽**未出现在 `pi-ai@0.85.1` 构建中**。
- 上游 `earendil-works/pi` issue #7052 —— 官方 OpenAI 上的同构现象（输入 ≈98% 窗口 + 极小 output）。
- 上游 `earendil-works/pi` issue #7048 —— 摘要被 token cap 截断后仍被当作有效 checkpoint 持久化。

discussions.title: README 里的 Discord 邀请已失效（discord.gg/Ycq5dCaS4）
discussions.body: **位置**：`README.md` → `## Community and support` → 那一行 `Join DeepSeek Harness Discord community`。 **现象**：这个邀请已经失效，点进去无法加入。Discord 官方 API 的返回是： ``` GET https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/Ycq5dCaS4 → {"message": "Invite is expired.", "code": 50270} ``` **不是探测方式的问题**：同一个接口拿一个不存在的邀请码会回 `{"message": "Unknown Invite", "code": 10006}` —— 上面这个码是明确的「已过期 / 已撤销」。 **为什么值得单独提一句**：`discord.gg/...` 的 301 跳转本身是正常的， 所以光点链接只会看到「Discord 打不开」，不容易意识到是**邀请本身过期**； 而 README 里另一条渠道（GitHub Discussions）是好的，对比之下更容易让人以为是临时的网络问题。 **建议**：换一个不过期的邀请（服务器设置里可以建一个「永不过期」的）。 如果社区其实已经迁到别处，那 README 这一行也顺手更新一下就更好了。 谢谢！

discussions.title: Orphaned profile writer lock silently drops the legacy settings.yaml migration (settings lost, welcome notice cannot be acknowledged)
discussions.body:
**Environment:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.7-alpha.2 (npm global), Node.js v25.1.0, macOS 15.4.1, profile: `web`

## Summary

An orphaned writer lock (`<profile>/package.json.lock` left behind by a killed process) makes the one-shot legacy `settings.yaml` migration fail **silently and permanently**. The user's settings (theme, model defaults, welcome-notice acknowledgement) are dropped, the welcome notice reappears, and acknowledging it fails with a generic "please try again" that can never succeed.

I believe the migration behavior is a bug; the lock timeout reporting and the UI error copy are related rough edges that made this very hard to diagnose.

## What happened

1. A `dsh plugin --profile web add ...` process was killed (timeout) **while it held the profile writer lock**. The lock file survived with the dead PID inside:
   ```
   $ cat ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock
   20702
   $ ps -p 20702   # dead
   ```
2. On the next `dsh web` boot, `SettingsForms.importLegacyDocument()` (in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`) runs:
   ```js
   await rename(path, imported);            // settings.yaml → settings.yaml.imported  (succeeds)
   for (const [section, values] of Object.entries(sections ?? {})) {
       try { await this.update(ns, values); }
       catch (error) { this.ownerContext.logger.warn(...); }   // every section throws
   }
   ```
   Each `update()` goes through `withFileLock(.../package.json)` → waits 2s → `atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock at .../package.json.lock` → caught → `logger.warn` → next section. **All five sections were dropped.**
3. Because the file is renamed *before* the imports, the migration never runs again ("a partial import never repeats"). The settings are gone for good — I had to notice the missing theme, manually rename `.imported` back, delete the stale lock, and reboot to recover.
4. Symptoms in the UI:
   - The 内测声明 / welcome notice reappears even though `welcomeNoticeVersion` was already acknowledged in the old file.
   - Clicking the confirm button shows **"暂时无法保存确认状态，请重试。"** — retrying can never work, because every settings write hits the same orphaned lock.
   - Raw API response (found by driving the page headlessly) :
     ```json
     {"code":"settings/rejected","message":"atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock at /Users/<u>/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock","details":{"ns":"ui-settings-general"}}
     ```

## Repro steps

1. Hold the profile writer lock from any process and kill it (e.g. interrupt `dsh plugin add` with a SIGKILL), leaving `<profile>/package.json.lock` behind with a dead PID.
2. Put a legacy `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` in place (pre-0.1.6 layout) and start `dsh web`.
3. Observe: the file is renamed to `settings.yaml.imported`, no section is imported, nothing is printed to stdout, and the migration will never be retried.

## Why I think this is a bug

1. **Migration is not failure-atomic.** Renaming the source file before knowing the imports succeed converts any transient write failure into permanent, silent data loss. Suggestion: import all sections first and rename only after full success — or rename back on failure — so a later boot can retry.
2. **The failure is invisible.** Neither `logger.info("settings: imported ...")` nor the `logger.warn` for a failed section appeared on stdout in my runs (the success line never appeared either, even when the import worked). A migration that can lose user settings should be loud — or logged to a file.
3. **The lock timeout error is not actionable.** `withFileLock` already writes the holder's PID into the lock file, but the timeout error doesn't include it. Not auto-deleting orphan locks is a defensible choice ("orphan recovery is an operator action"), but then please include the PID and whether it is still alive in the error:
   > `timed out waiting for the writer lock at .../package.json.lock (held by pid 20702, not running); remove the lock file to recover`

   Without this, diagnosis took several steps that an ordinary user would not know to perform.
4. **The UI swallows the real error.** `settings/rejected` carries a precise message, but the welcome notice shows only a generic "请重试" for a condition that retries cannot fix. Passing the server message through (at least in a details/tooltip) would have made this a 10-second fix.

## Current workaround (for anyone hitting this)

```bash
LOCK=~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock
[ -f "$LOCK" ] && ps -p "$(cat "$LOCK")" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -f "$LOCK"   # only if the PID is dead
mv ~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported ~/.dsh/settings.yaml                       # if migration half-ran
# restart dsh web — the migration re-runs and imports everything
```

Was the rename-before-import behavior intentional? Happy to open a PR for (1) and (3) if it helps.

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.7-rc.1 no longer heals $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules (0.1.6 did) — profiles with locally installed plugins break every child process: run_code and voice input die with "subprocess scope exited before its bootstrap consumed the launch request"
discussions.body:
## Symptom

On **0.1.7-rc.1**, a profile that has plugins installed **into the profile** (what `dsh plugin add` / Settings → Plugins produces) still works for chat, but **every tool call and voice input fails**:

```
Error: code run failed (worker-exit): subprocess scope exited before its bootstrap consumed the launch request
Captured output:
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
  imported from <profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js
```

Voice input fails with the same seam error (`语音识别失败：subprocess scope exited before its bootstrap consumed the launch request`).

Environment: dsh `0.1.7-rc.1` (pnpm global install), node `v24.21.0`, pnpm `12.3.4`, Linux.
Profile dependencies: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `dsh-web-app`, `dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`, `dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`.

## Finding 1 — the shared fallback the peers resolve through is stale

Per #5863, `autoInstallPeers: false` is intentional: profile-local plugins are supposed to resolve peers through the shared installation fallback at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`, via Node's ordinary parent-walk.

On this machine that directory exists but is dead — every entry is a symlink into the **0.1.6** pnpm store generation, which the CLI upgrade garbage-collected:

```console
$ find ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules -xtype l | wc -l
493

$ ls -l ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis
... -> ~/.local/share/pnpm/global/v11/569-18d58149f7e02921-0/node_modules/.pnpm/\
      @deepseek-ai+dsh@0.1.6-alpha.1_f31d87c7…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis
$ ls ~/.local/share/pnpm/global/v11/569-18d58149f7e02921-0   # gone
```

So Node walks up from `<profile>/node_modules/...` into `profiles/node_modules`, finds only dangling links, and throws.

## Finding 2 — 0.1.6 created/healed that fallback; 0.1.7-rc.1 only removes it

`dsh-app-boot` **0.1.6**:

```js
/** Heal one module-fallback generation while the cross-process writer lock is held. */
function healProfilesModuleFallbackLocked(entries, modulesDir) { … }
function ensureSymlink(link, target) { … symlinkSync(target, link, "junction"); }
// exported: createProfileResolutionGeneration, healProfilesModuleFallback
```

`dsh-app-boot` **0.1.7-rc.1**:

```console
$ grep -rl symlinkSync <installation tree>/@deepseek-ai/    # no hits
$ grep -n 'healProfiles\|createProfileResolutionGeneration' dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js   # no hits
```

What remains is removal and read-only inspection: `removeLinkProjections()` (unlinks old `.dsh-module-fallback` projections), `linkedProfileRoots()`, `realModuleDirectory()`. Meanwhile `initProfile()` still writes the unchanged `PROFILE_PNPM_WORKSPACE`:

```yaml
nodeLinker: hoisted
autoInstallPeers: false
```

Result: nothing maintains the fallback any more, so a profile-local plugin install has no resolvable peers — and #5863's "the peers are not actually missing" reasoning no longer holds for this case.

## Finding 3 — why the UI survives and only child processes die

- **Main process**: `createRuntimeResolution()` builds an in-memory resolution map (installation closure + profile closure, installation package names reserved), so plugins load and chat works.
- **Child processes**: the PTC `run_code` worker and the speech-to-text worker are plain `node` processes with no such map. `runnerEnvironment()` even deletes `NODE_*` / `TSX_*` from the environment, so `NODE_PATH` cannot compensate. First `import '@deepseek-ai/cordis'` on the profile path kills the process → the scope exits before its bootstrap consumes the launch request.

Both affected features go through `ctx.subprocess.spawn` (`dsh-ptc-runtime-node` worker; `dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice` line ~638), which is why the failure is uniform.

## Finding 4 — clean-room reproduction (no legacy state)

```console
$ export DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-repro
$ dsh web --from-default-profile web --dump-config        # profile created, "dependencies": {}
$ dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle
[WARN] Issues with peer dependencies found. Run "pnpm peers check" to list them.
+ @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle 0.1.7-alpha.1

$ cd $DSH_HOME/profiles/web && pnpm peers check
Issues with peer dependencies found
✕ missing peer @deepseek-ai/cordis
  Wanted: ^4.0.3: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle@0.1.7-alpha.1, …
✕ missing peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway
✕ missing peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes

$ node --input-type=module -e "import('$PWD/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text/lib/index.js')"
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
  imported from …/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text/lib/index.js
```

So this is reachable with the official install path alone; the legacy 493-link tree was only masking it.

## Workaround that restored the machine (verified)

Set `autoInstallPeers: true` in `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run `pnpm install` (30 peer packages, all `0.1.7-rc.1` / `cordis 4.0.4`, same versions as the installation tree). Verified afterwards:

- the previously failing import succeeds in a plain `node` process
- a full `dsh-subprocess-local` Linux scope + runner bootstrap test succeeds end-to-end (launch request consumed, exit 0, child import OK)
- `dsh --profile web --dump-config`: exit 0 / empty stderr; app boots with zero errors

This does not break the single-instance invariant from #5863: `collectProfileScopePackages` passes the installation package names as `reserved` to `dependencyClosure`, so the profile's cordis copy is never put into the main process's resolution map (and both copies are 4.0.4).

## Suggested fix

Either restore the fallback maintenance that 0.1.6 had (`healProfilesModuleFallback`, run while holding the profile writer lock, plus a one-time heal for existing profiles whose links point at a dead store generation), or make the profile install actually install the peers it reports as missing. Right now the removal of the former makes `autoInstallPeers: false` fatal for every profile that installs a plugin, including the two official optional bundles.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Add an "About" page in Settings for GitHub link and update checking
discussions.body:
Overview
I would like to suggest adding an "About" page to the application's Settings. This page would serve as a centralized place for users to access project information.

Motivation
Currently, users might have to look around to find the official GitHub repository or manually check if a new version is available. Adding a dedicated "About" page improves the overall user experience and makes it much easier for users to stay updated with the latest features and bug fixes.

Proposed Solution
I propose that this "About" page should include the following elements:

1.GitHub Repository Link: A direct clickable link to the official deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness repository.

2.Version Information: Display the current application version number (e.g., v1.0.0).

3.Check for Updates: A button that allows users to manually check for newer releases, and a notification/prompt if a new update is available.

4.(Optional) Open-source licenses or credits.

Additional Context
This is a standard feature in many modern applications and would be a great addition to DeepSeek. Thank you for your hard work and for building such a great project!

discussions.title: # [Bug] Sidebar history sessions and workspaces completely lost, and current session has no corresponding entry (Data loss risk)
discussions.body: # [Bug] Sidebar history sessions and workspaces completely lost, and current session has no corresponding entry (Data loss risk) ### 🐛 Description While using DSH, a severe state loss issue occurred: 1. **Sidebar completely empty**: All historical session records disappeared, leaving only the "New Session" and "Settings" buttons. 2. **No corresponding entry for the current session**: Even if a conversation can be opened or re-entered, there is no corresponding highlighted entry for it in the left sidebar. 3. **Workspaces lost**: Original workspace configurations and environmental states have all disappeared. 4. Refreshing the page or restarting the application does not recover them. Suspected local data reset or migration failure. ### 🖥️ Environment - **DSH Version**: `v0.1.7-rc.1` (Modify as needed, e.g., v0.1.5-rc.2 / v0.1.7-alpha.2) - **Runtime**: Web / DSH Desktop (Community desktop client, please specify the project) / Running from source - **OS**: macOS / Windows / Linux (Please specify version) - **Browser**: Chrome / Edge / Firefox (If Web, please specify version) - **Installation Method**: Global npm / npx / Built from source / Desktop client installer ### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce 1. Open DSH, normally create and save multiple sessions, and perform operations within their corresponding workspaces. 2. Normally exit, refresh the page, or update/restart the application. 3. Reopen DSH, and find that the sidebar history list is **completely empty**. 4. Try to create or resume a session, the sidebar still **shows no corresponding entry**. 5. Check workspaces, and find that original workspace configurations and context are **all lost**. ### 🎯 Expected Behavior 1. The sidebar should normally display all historical session records. 2. The currently opened session should have a corresponding highlighted entry in the left sidebar. 3. Workspace configurations and historical states should remain intact. ### ❌ Actual Behavior 1. The sidebar is completely empty, and all historical records are gone. 2. Opening any session shows no corresponding entry in the sidebar. 3. Original workspace configurations and states are lost, making it impossible to continue previous context. ### 🛠️ Troubleshooting Steps Taken - [ ] Refresh page / Restart software (Ineffective) - [ ] **Check local `~/.dsh` directory data files**: - `~/.dsh/sessions/` or `~/.dsh/profiles/` (Confirm whether session data files still physically exist) - `~/.dsh/workspaces/` (Confirm whether workspace data is lost) - *Please note the result here: Files still exist / Files are lost / Files exist but cannot be parsed* - [ ] Disable all third-party plugins (e.g., DSH-better-sidebar) and restart - [ ] Check browser console (F12) or terminal for error messages (e.g., database connection failure, JSON parse error) - [ ] Try creating a new Profile and logging in again ### 📝 Additional Context > **Note**: Recent DSH upstream has many breaking changes (e.g., profile format migration). This issue not only involves UI rendering but is also accompanied by **severe loss of session records and workspace data**. It is suspected that database migration failed during version upgrade, or old Profile parsing crashes caused the frontend to forcefully reset local state. Since this involves core data loss, we hope the official team can prioritize investigating data loading and persistence logic and provide a data recovery solution.

discussions.title: [Bug 报告] minimal 预设：沙箱模式下持久 PTY shell 无法启动（PTY shell exited during startup / Cannot launch conpty）
discussions.body:
## Summary

在 Windows 上，`minimal`（极简模式）预设挂载的是**持久 PTY shell**
（`dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent` + `dsh-terminal-bash`，`shellDialect: pwsh`）。

当权限预设的沙箱**不是** `danger-full-access`（即 `workspace-write` / `read-only`）时，
任何 shell 调用都会立即失败：

```
Error: PTY shell exited during startup
```

同一台机器、同样带沙箱的情况下，`standard`（标准模式）预设的 `pwsh` 工具**完全正常**——
因为它用的是 `dsh-tool-pwsh`（一次性子进程），不经过 ConPTY。

**影响**：用户只要选择「极简模式 + 任意带沙箱的权限预设」，命令行能力就完全不可用，
而且错误信息不指向真正的原因（看起来像 shell 坏了，实际是 PTY 建不起来），
排查成本很高——我自己追查这个问题花了很久，中途还被"会话档案损坏"等无关线索带偏。

---

## Reproduction

### 前置条件

Windows，且**未安装 PowerShell 7**（`C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe` 不存在）——
此时 `resolvePwshPath()` 按设计兜底到 `%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`（5.1）。
该 shell 本身完全可用（标准模式下正常工作）。

### 最小复现（经 DSH）

1. 新建会话，代理模式选 **`minimal`（极简模式）**
2. 权限预设选 **`workspace-write`**（或任何 `sandbox !== danger-full-access` 的预设）
3. 让模型调用 `pwsh` 工具执行任意命令（例如 `echo test`）
4. 立即返回 `Error: PTY shell exited during startup`，重试无效

### 对照实验（三次，均在同一台机器上）

| # | 代理模式 | 权限预设 | 沙箱 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | minimal | workspace-write | workspace-write | ❌ 失败 |
| 2 | **minimal** | **danger-full-access** | danger-full-access | ✅ **成功** |
| 3 | **standard** | auto-approve | **workspace-write** | ✅ **成功** |

第 2 行与第 1 行只差沙箱模式 → 沙箱是判别条件。
第 3 行证明：**带沙箱 + 标准模式**没问题 → 问题只在「持久 PTY × 沙箱」这个组合。

### 更底层的最小复现（绕开 DSH，直接用 node-pty）

在 DSH 沙箱（`workspace-write`）下用一次性 pwsh 工具执行：

```js
// node v24.x + node-pty 1.2.0-beta.15（DSH 自带的那份）
const pty = require('<dsh>/node_modules/node-pty');
pty.spawn(
  'C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe',
  ['-NoLogo', '-NoProfile'],
  { cols: 80, rows: 24, cwd: process.cwd(), env: process.env }
);
// → 抛: Cannot launch conpty
```

> 附带说明：ConPTY 的 agent 文件**存在**
> （`node-pty/prebuilds/win32-x64/conpty/conpty.dll`、`OpenConsole.exe`，约 110 KB / 1.0 MB），
> 所以不是文件缺失，而是创建伪控制台这一步被拒绝。

---

## Current behavior

### 报错位置

`dsh-terminal-bash/lib/index.js:440`：

```js
if (result.waitReason === "session_exit") throw new Error("PTY shell exited during startup");
```

即 `waitReason === "session_exit"`（顶层 shell 已退出），而非启动超时。

### 主机日志没有记录真正的失败

`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\` 下只有良性警告，**没有** PTY spawn 失败的记录：

```
[W] [local-subprocess-runtime] subprocess-local is using weaker process-tree containment
    because Windows ConPTY remains outside Job containment; ...
```

这使得用户/维护者无法从日志定位问题。

### 统计证据

对一份 46 轮的完整会话日志，按调用时生效的沙箱模式分组统计 `pwsh` 工具结果：

| 沙箱模式 | `pwsh` 结果 |
|---|---|
| `danger-full-access` | **成功 40 次，失败 0 次** |
| `workspace-write` | **失败 33 次**（仅最早 5 次成功，发生在服务重启之前） |

### 与第三方插件无关

排查中一度怀疑是第三方审批插件，已排除：上面的对照组第 3 行就是
`workspace-write` 沙箱 + 该审批插件同时启用，工作正常。

---

## Expected behavior

按优先级，以下任一即可：

1. **极简模式在 `workspace-write` 下 `pwsh` 能正常工作**（首选）；
2. 若 ConPTY 在受限环境下确实无法创建，**在启动阶段给出可诊断的错误**——
   明确指出"当前沙箱模式与 PTY 后端不兼容"，而不是笼统的 `shell exited during startup`；
3. **提供后端回退**：沙箱启用时自动降级到非 PTY 的一次性 shell
   （`dsh-tool-pwsh` 已经证明该路径在沙箱下可用）。

---

## Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH 版本 | `0.1.5-rc.2` |
| 桌面客户端 | `dsh-plugin-desktop 2.0.13` |
| OS | Windows (win32) |
| Node | v24.18.1（宿主）/ v24.21.0 |
| PowerShell 7 | **未安装** → 兜底到 Windows PowerShell 5.1（`resolvePwshPath()` 设计行为） |
| node-pty | `1.2.0-beta.15`（随 DSH 分发），win32-x64 prebuild，**仅含 conpty，无 winpty 回退** |
| 相关包 | `dsh-terminal-bash` / `dsh-pwsh-local` / `dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent` / `dsh-tool-pwsh` / `dsh-agent-presets`，均为 `0.1.5-rc.2` |

### 预设差异（关键）

`dsh-agent-presets/presets/minimal/agent.cordis.yml`：

```yaml
# 第 30 / 50 / 57 行
- id: terminal-pwsh
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
  config:
    shellDialect: pwsh
    timeoutMs: 300000

- id: persistent-pwsh
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

`dsh-agent-presets/presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml`：

```yaml
# 第 49-51 行
- id: tool-pwsh
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

`PTY shell exited during startup` 这句错误**只出自 `dsh-terminal-bash`**，
而**只有 minimal 会加载它**。

### 一点未经证实的推测（仅供定位参考，请勿当作结论）

猜测方向：Windows 沙箱可能使用受限令牌（restricting SID）+ Job 对象，
导致 ConPTY 的助手进程（`OpenConsole.exe`）无法创建。
我**没有直接证实**这一点——我能证实的是"沙箱模式是判别条件"

---

## 附：可用的规避方式

1. **用户侧**：改用 `standard`（标准模式）——命令行可用，同时保留沙箱；
2. **用户侧**：自定义一个 preset，把 minimal 的 shell 行换成 `dsh-tool-pwsh`（与 standard 相同），
   放在 `<DSH_HOME>/.agent-presets/<id>/` 下即可，无需改动安装目录、升级不会被覆盖；
3. **上游**：若采纳上面的 Expected behavior 第 2 或第 3 条，则用户无需任何变通。

discussions.title: Reveal-in-file-manager reports success while the Explorer window stays invisible
discussions.body:
> **Status: RESOLVED** — fixed locally by the reporter on 2026-09-23; see "Resolution" at the
> end. **Root cause corrected on 2026-09-25**: the invisible window is caused by
> `windowsHide: true` on the spawned `explorer.exe`, **not** by the token-restricted sandbox.
> The earlier attribution in this report was measured from inside a sandbox child and confused
> the test environment with the cause; the A/B measurement under a plain user token is in
> "Correction" below. The fix is unchanged, and the fix still matters (the bug reproduced on
> 0.1.7-rc.2).

## Summary

With the Windows ACL sandbox active (`workspace-write`, the default), revealing a file in Explorer
from the GUI ("open" → "show in file manager") **reports success and does nothing visible**. The
folder window is created, the target file is even correctly selected inside it, but the window is
never shown, and the process exits with code 1 — which the caller accepts as a successful handoff.

The user sees a success toast ("已请求在文件管理器中显示" / "requested to show in file manager") and
no window.

## Environment

- Windows 11 (Chinese locale), Windows PowerShell 5.1
- Originally reported on `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.3; **re-verified on 0.1.7-rc.2** (2026-09-25),
  where the reveal is still broken and the same fix is still required
- `dsh web` GUI, profile `web`, file policy `workspace-write`

## Reproduction

1. Start `dsh web` with the default `workspace-write` policy.
2. Ask the agent to create any file in the session workspace.
3. In the GUI, use the file card's menu → **show in file manager**.
4. Observe: the toast reports success; no Explorer window appears (check the taskbar — nothing was
   added there either).

## What was measured (2026-09-23)

`EnumWindows` + `Shell.Application` were used to inspect the windows after the reveal. Three windows
for the same folder existed:

| Window | Created by | `Visible` | `SelectedItems()` |
|---|---|---|---|
| HWND=3148338 | COM `Shell.Application.Explore` | **True** | the target file |
| HWND=197996 | `explorer.exe /select,` (the DSH path) | **False** | the target file |
| HWND=329818 | `explorer.exe /select,` (the DSH path) | **False** | the target file |

So the reveal is doing its job — the folder is open and the file is selected — it just leaves the
window hidden.

## Correction (2026-09-25): the cause is `windowsHide`, not the restricted token

The 2026-09-23 investigation ran its probes from a **sandbox child** and attributed the invisible
window to that child's restricted token. A controlled A/B under the **same token the host actually
uses** (a plain, unrestricted user token) shows that attribution was wrong: upstream's code produces
the invisible window there too.

Method: two separate scratch folders, two probe files, and `revealNativePath` imported from the
unpatched `lib/index.js.orig` versus the patched `lib/index.js`, in one process, same token.
Window state read back through `Shell.Application`:

| Stage | node exit | Window | `Visible` | Selected | Foreground window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | — | — | — | — | Chrome |
| upstream `index.js.orig` | 0 ("success") | hwnd=655550 for `_reveal_a` | **False** | `probe.txt` | still Chrome |
| patched `index.js` | 0 | new hwnd=460902 for `_reveal_b` | **True** | `probe.txt` | `_reveal_b - 文件资源管理器` |

The mechanism is in the shared runner, `runNativeCommand`
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command/lib/index.js`):

```js
execFile(command, [...args], { encoding: "utf8", signal, windowsHide: true }, …)
```

`windowsHide: true` is correct for a helper that should never flash a console — but
`explorer.exe /select,` is not such a helper: the folder window it hands to the shell is created as
part of a process launched hidden, and it stays hidden. Explorer then exits 1, and `runExplorer`
deliberately accepts exit 1 as a delegated handoff, so nothing surfaces.

That single flag explains both halves of the bug: the window is never shown, and the caller is told
the handoff succeeded.

### Why the COM route is immune

`Shell.Application` is hosted by the **already-running** `explorer.exe`, so the window is created by
that process and our hidden-child launch flag never applies to it. That is why routing the reveal
through COM displays the window, and why the sandbox token was never the deciding variable.

(Side note, measured on 0.1.7: from *inside* the sandbox the COM route cannot be used — the child
runs at Low integrity, `New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application` fails with "拒绝访问", and piped
stdio to a child fails with `spawn EPERM`. This does not affect the real path: the reveal is served
by the **host** process — HTTP route → `dsh-client-ui-deliverables` →
`ctx.sessionController.openWorkspacePath` → `revealNativePath`, see
`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js`.)

## Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`, `revealNativePath()`. On 0.1.7-rc.2 (unchanged in substance from
0.1.5-rc.3, the encoding helper around it was refined):

```js
if (manager === "explorer") {
    let windowsPath = path;
    if (platform === "linux") { /* wslpath … */ }
    await runExplorer(["/select,", explorerTarget(windowsPath)], signal, run);
    return;
}
```

Two problems compound here:

1. **The window is never shown** — because `runNativeCommand` starts the child with
   `windowsHide: true` (corrected attribution; see above).
2. **The failure is swallowed** — `explorer.exe` exits 1, and `runExplorer` deliberately treats exit
   code 1 as a delegated handoff. So a reveal that displayed nothing is indistinguishable from a
   successful one, and the UI reports success.

Secondary observation (unrelated to the invisibility): on 0.1.5-rc.3 the `/select,` target was a
`file://` URI rather than the native path the switch documents. 0.1.7 encodes that target more
carefully (`explorerTarget()` decodes non-ASCII escapes and escapes both `,` and `=`), so this is
mostly addressed upstream.

## Resolution (applied locally by the reporter, 2026-09-23; re-applied to 0.1.7-rc.2 on 2026-09-25)

Route the reveal through the running shell's COM object instead of spawning `explorer.exe`.
`Shell.Application` is hosted by the already-running `explorer.exe`, so the window it creates is
displayed:

```js
await run("powershell.exe", [
    "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
    "-File", REVEAL_COM_SCRIPT,   // lib/reveal-com.ps1
    windowsPath
], signal);
```

The helper (abridged):

```powershell
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
# reuse an existing window for the folder; Explore() only when none exists
$shell.Explore($parent)
$window = <first shell window for $parent>
$window.Document.SelectItem($window.Document.Folder.ParseName($leaf), 1 + 4 + 8)
$window.Visible = $true
# Document.Focus() does not exist on this shell object; raise the window instead:
# SetForegroundWindow is refused by the Windows foreground lock, so attach to the
# foreground thread first, then BringWindowToTop + SetActiveWindow + SetForegroundWindow,
# falling back to FlashWindowEx so the taskbar button blinks.
```

Measured after the change (2026-09-25 run, host-equivalent token):

- upstream: window created, `Visible = False`, foreground stays on the browser
- patched: window created, `Visible = True`, `SelectedItems() = [target file]`, foreground switches
  to the Explorer window
- re-applied to a clean 0.1.7-rc.2 install via a version-checked, idempotent patch script; the user
  confirmed in the GUI that the window now pops up and shows the file

Three behaviours worth keeping if upstream rewrites the helper:

- **Reuse an already-open window for the folder.** Calling `Explore()` every time piles up duplicate
  windows; during this investigation three appeared.
- **Never let a cosmetic step fail the reveal.** `Document.Focus()` throws
  `does not contain a method named 'Focus'` on this shell object while the window is visible and the
  file is selected; making that fatal would report a working reveal as failed — the same class of bug
  as the swallowed exit code 1.
- **Let it fail loudly, not silently.** Even with the fix, the helper returns a distinct exit code
  when no window can be raised, so a future regression is visible instead of being reported as
  success.

A minimal upstream alternative, if spawning PowerShell is unwanted: keep the `explorer.exe` hand-off
but stop hiding it (`windowsHide: false`, or a per-call override for the reveal), and keep the
"distinguish a real failure from exit 1" handling.

I am happy to open a PR with the helper and the small call-site change if the approach is acceptable.

discussions.title: [Bug] Los modelos de proveedores personalizados (Custom provider) no se cargan en el selector de la pantalla principal (Windows, v0.1.5-rc.3)
discussions.body: **Entorno:** - Versión de dsh: 0.1.5-rc.3 - Sistema Operativo: Windows 11 - Método de instalación: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web **Descripción del problema:** Al configurar un proveedor personalizado (Custom provider) para Google Gemini en Settings → Models, la interfaz muestra el proveedor con un punto verde y el mensaje "Saved". Sin embargo, en el selector de modelos de la pantalla principal (donde aparece "DeepSeek V4.1-Flash"), **no se muestran los modelos del proveedor personalizado** (`gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.5-pro`) ni ninguna opción para cambiar de proveedor. El selector solo muestra los modelos de DeepSeek. **Pasos para reproducirlo:** 1. Arrancar el servidor con `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. 2. Ir a Settings → Models → "Add a custom provider". 3. Rellenar los campos: - Provider ID: `gemini` - Display name: `gemini` - Base URL: `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/` - API protocol: `openai-completions` - API key: (clave de Google válida) 4. Añadir manualmente los modelos: `models/gemini-2.5-flash` y `models/gemini-2.5-pro`. 5. Pulsar "Create provider" (el proveedor aparece con punto verde). 6. Volver a la pantalla principal y hacer clic en el selector de modelos. **Resultado esperado:** Que los modelos del proveedor personalizado (Gemini) aparezcan como opción en el selector de modelos de la pantalla principal. **Resultado real:** El selector de modelos solo muestra `DeepSeek V4.1-Flash`. El archivo `settings.yaml` contiene la configuración completa del proveedor personalizado (`llm-pi-ai.providers.gemini`) con sus modelos definidos, pero la interfaz web no los carga en el selector. **Pruebas realizadas (sin éxito):** - Hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) - Reinicio del servidor (cerrar PowerShell y volver a arrancar) - Reinstalación completa (borrado de carpeta .dsh y caché de npx) - Configuración manual del `settings.yaml` con la sección `models:` escrita a mano - Uso de la opción "Add provider" (Google estándar) y "Add a custom provider" **Archivo settings.yaml (fragmento relevante):** ```yaml llm-pi-ai: providers: google: apiKeyEnv: GOOGLE_API_KEY gemini: displayName: gemini apiKeyEnv: GEMINI_API_KEY api: openai-completions baseURL: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ models: - id: models/gemini-2.5-flash name: Gemini 2.5 Flash - id: models/gemini-2.5-pro name: Gemini 2.5 Pro

discussions.title: 【bug】DSH 0.1.5rc2版本中Web GUI 中切回一个长对话会卡住整个 server 进程
discussions.body:
环境

  • dsh 0.1.5-rc.2（npx @deepseek-ai/dsh），profile web
  • Windows 11，Node.js v24.20.0
  • session-query-sqlite 为出厂配置（path: ':memory:'、openAt: never），即未开启 SQLite 全文检索，实际工作的是 JSONL 后端
  • 单个工作区 12 个会话 / 总计 17.8 MB 会话日志；最大单个日志 9.32 MB（zstd），解码后 33.66 MB，5,843 个事件

现象

对话变长之后，再从侧边栏点回这个对话，界面会明显卡住一段时间。在当前 server 进程里已经打开过若干会话时更严重；而且卡的不只是被切过去的那个会话：同一个 dsh web 进程里的其它工作也会一起停顿（输入、其它面板的流式输出）。这说明瓶颈在宿主事件循环上，而不只是 React。

侧边栏列表本身不背这个锅 —— 它走的是 durable 投影检查点，不读日志。

实测数据

用一个独立脚本复现 JSONL 后端对单个日志做的全部工作（整文件读取 → 切分多帧 zstd → 逐行 JSON.parse）：

会话日志（zstd） | 解码后 JSONL | 事件数 | read | decode | parse | 合计 -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- 9.32 MB | 33.66 MB | 5,843 | 2 ms | 285 ms | 92 ms | 378 ms 3.62 MB | 13.08 MB | 2,101 | — | — | — | 83 ms 1.06 MB | 4.07 MB | 776 | — | — | — | 19 ms

而一次"打开"实际要传的东西，以那个最大会话为例：最后 50 条 user/message + assistant/message 覆盖 243 个事件、1.08 MB JSON —— 因为 tool/result 事件就落在消息窗口里（该会话有 1,116 个 tool/result + 1,062 个 tool/call 事件）。

以上全部发生在宿主主线程上，没有任何东西与之重叠执行。

根因分析

  1. prepared 会话缓存默认只有 5 条，所以回头再点就是冷读。 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query 中的 SESSION_QUERY_DEFAULT_PREPARED_SESSION_CACHE_SIZE = 5（出厂 lib/index.js:12），被 SessionObservationReader 的 LRU 使用（被活跃租约 pin 住的条目不会被淘汰，其余都会被丢弃）。@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite 把这个旋钮暴露为 preparedSessionCacheSize。开过 6 个会话之后，第一个就已经被淘汰了 —— 再点回去就要重读整个日志。

  2. 冷读是整文件、同步、不可切分的。 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl：

    • const bytes = await fs.readFile(path, signal) —— 整个文件被一次性读进内存（出厂 lib/index.js:1649），没有尾读、也没有增量读；
    • 帧由 public-API 回退路径的 zstdDecompressSync(source.subarray(start, end)) 解码（出厂 lib/index.js:1263），否则走原生解压流 —— 两种方式都是先把整个日志解出来；
    • 之后逐行 JSON.parse（出厂 lib/index.js:1083）。 由于 JSON.parse 是同步的、折叠也是一口气跑完，整个重建过程会占满主线程（样例日志约 378 ms），并且随日志大小线性增长。

  3. 上下文压缩并不会给日志设上界。 样例会话里已经有 54 个 compaction/prune 事件，但落盘的日志仍然保留了全部事件。压缩管的是模型上下文，不是每次冷打开都要重读的那份 artifact。

  4. 就算读完了，一次打开的载荷也不小。 客户端打开时用的是 PAGE_MESSAGES = 50（@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller 的 client sessions 模块）；当 tool result 落在窗口里时，50 条消息并不是一个小载荷（上面是 1.08 MB）。

  5. 聊天转录没有虚拟化。 只有 trajectory 视图有：@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-trajectory 里的 VIRTUALIZATION_THRESHOLD = 100 / VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN_ROWS = 12。@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat 里既没有虚拟化，也没有 content-visibility，没有任何对已渲染转录的窗口化处理。所以窗口里带多少内容，就在一次 React commit 里渲染多少。

影响

成本同时随日志大小和被碰过的会话数量增长，而且是进程级的停顿：同一个 dsh web 进程服务的所有会话，都要排在那次解码后面。长会话恰恰是用户会反复回来的那些，所以最坏情况会被日常撞上。

改进方向（建议）

  • 缓存按字节而不是按条数设界。 一个 prepared 条目是该会话完整折叠后的事件数组（样例是 33.66 MB 的 JSON），而 LRU 数的是 5 个条目。
  • 把读取 / 解码 / 解析挪出主线程（worker thread），或者做成增量式的。
  • 尾读，而不是从头读。 日志是只追加的，而打开一个对话只需要最后约 50 条消息；为了显示尾部而解码 33 MB 是纯浪费。尾读 + 直接跳到所需窗口，可以把冷路径砍掉一个数量级。
  • 客户端给聊天转录加窗口化（就用 trajectory 已经在用的那套），以及/或者在打开窗口里裁掉超大 tool/result 载荷。

复现步骤

  1. 在同一个 dsh web 进程里依次打开 ≥ 6 个不同对话（长短混合即可）。
  2. 再点回最大的那个：界面会在它被（重新）读取期间卡住。
  3. 紧接着再点一次同一个会话：宿主侧的卡顿消失（缓存命中），所以此时如果还卡，就是客户端渲染。

给 profile 用的一个有用的打点位置：在 SessionObservationReader 的读取里记录 duration + source: 'live' | 'prepared'，这样一次 trace 就能把冷读成本和渲染成本分开。

discussions.title: [Bug] Agent Teams bundle 在 Web/Desktop 未禁用 subagent：子代理不在 Team roster，list_agents/send_message 找不到也联系不上
discussions.body:
**中文摘要**：在 Web/Desktop（preset 平面）上开启 Agent Teams bundle 后，`subagent` / `subagent_fork` 并没有被禁用（bundle 的 `disabled` patch 只落在 host 平面），而 Team 的 `send_message` / `list_agents` / `interrupt_agent` 又以同名工具遮蔽了 preset 的 continuable-child 控件。结果：模型用 `subagent` 派出的子代理既不在 Team roster 里，也没有任何工具能按 `agent_id` 联系它们 —— 也就是"我明明派了人，却找不到也联系不上"。

**English summary**: With the Agent Teams bundle enabled on Web/Desktop, the bundle's `disabled` patches only hit host-plane rows, so the preset plane still exposes `subagent`/`subagent_fork`. The Team tools shadow the preset's same-named child controls, so children spawned through `subagent` are not Team members: `list_agents` never shows them and `send_message` reports `active teammate "…" not found`.

---

## 环境

- dsh `0.1.7-rc.1`（源码 checkout，HEAD `46a7f68b09`），Web GUI
- profile：`web`，`dsh.profile.bundles = ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile"]`（在 Plugins 页开启 Agent Teams）
- 平台：Windows

## 现象

开启 bundle 后，Lead 会话的工具表同时包含两套语义冲突的委派工具：

- Team：`spawn_teammate`、`send_message`、`list_agents`、`interrupt_agent`、`wait_agent`、`team_task_*`
- 旧的直接委派：`subagent`、`subagent_fork`

其中 `send_message` / `list_agents` / `interrupt_agent` 的描述是 **Team 版**（`target` 为 teammate 名、`role: lead/teammate`），不是 `agent_id` / `scope` 版；即 bundle 想要禁用的旧控件只是被同名遮蔽，而 `subagent` / `subagent_fork` 原样可用。

### 实测（同一会话）

1. 调用 `subagent` 派一个后台子代理，子代理正常返回。
2. `list_agents()` → `[{"target":"lead","role":"lead","status":"running","diagnostics":[]}]`，**只有 lead**。
3. `send_message({target:"<子代理 id 或 label>"})` → `Error: active teammate "190afdd6-…" not found`。

也就是说：模型按 `subagent` 正常委派之后，既无法列出、也无法联系它自己创建的子代理。错误信息只说明"找不到这个 teammate"，不提示任何可行的替代路径。

## 最小复现

1. 在 `web`（或 Desktop）profile 启用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`。
2. 新开一个会话，**不要提及 Agent Teams**，让模型用 `subagent` 委派一个后台子任务。
3. 子代理返回后，调用 `list_agents` → 只有 `lead`。
4. 调用 `send_message({ target: "<子代理 id/label>" })` → `active teammate "…" not found`。

## 根因

1. **bundle 的禁用意图是 host 平面的 id patch**
   [`agent-team-profile/cordis.patch.yml`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team-profile/cordis.patch.yml#L1-L14) 禁用 `tool-subagent-control` / `tool-subagent-list-agents` / `tool-subagent` / `tool-subagent-fork`；README 也承诺 "Ordinary subagent delegation … disabled"（[README L12](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team-profile/README.md#L12)、[L49](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team-profile/README.md#L49)）。

2. **Web profile 里这些 id 属于 host 平面，且早已被 web-app 禁用**
   [`web-app/cordis.patch.yml` L497-L514](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml#L497-L514)。bundle 的 patch 命中了正确的 id，但那一行本来就是关的 —— 静默无效。

3. **真正给模型的 delegation 工具由 agent preset 声明**
   [`presets/standard.patch.yml` L80-L118](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml#L80-L118) 的 `delegation` 组（`tool-subagent-control`、`tool-subagent-list-agents`、`tool-subagent`、`tool-subagent-fork`）；`ptc`、`cordis` 两个 preset 同样声明（`minimal` 没有）。GUI 每个 agent 都会挂默认 preset：[`api/session-controller/src/agent.ts` L381-L397](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts#L381-L397)。

4. **顶层 patch 跨不进 preset 内部，且这是被强制的两平面架构**
   `applyEntryPatches` 只索引顶层条目与同层 `group` 行（[`vendor/include/src/index.ts` L65-L74](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/vendor/include/src/index.ts#L65-L74)），未命中的 id 只 warn 并跳过（[L109-L113](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/vendor/include/src/index.ts#L109-L113)）；同时 [`scripts/verify-cordis-config.ts` L139-L166](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/scripts/verify-cordis-config.ts#L139-L166) 要求"一行只属于一个平面"。因此 preset 行无法被任何其他 bundle 的 patch 层禁用。

5. **Team 工具靠"同名遮蔽"替换旧控件，但只遮蔽了三个**
   preset scope 通过 `bindScopeParent` 成为 agent scope 的父层（[`agent-preset-registry` L248-L257](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/preset/agent-preset-registry/src/index.ts#L248-L257)、[`core/scope` L72](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/scope/src/index.ts#L72)）；Team 工具注册进 agent **自身**的层（[`tool-agent-team` L164-L175](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts#L164-L175)），工具解析里 own 层最后写入并遮蔽 inherited（[`core/tools` L1177-L1208](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts#L1177-L1208)）。于是 `send_message`/`list_agents`/`interrupt_agent` 被替换，`subagent`/`subagent_fork` 存活。

6. **普通子代理不是 Team 成员，因此不可见也不可达**
   `tryMembership` 对带 subagent descriptor 的子代理返回 `undefined`（[`roster.ts` L92-L122](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team/src/roster.ts#L92-L122)），`list` 只返回 Lead + roster（[L129-L160](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team/src/roster.ts#L129-L160)），`send_message` 按 member 名解析并抛 `TEAM_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND`（[L43-L55](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team/src/roster.ts#L43-L55)）。

## 这不是"模型乱用 Agent Teams 语义"

模型的路径其实被工具文档教成这样，且**完全不需要用户提及 Agent Teams**：

- `tool:policy` 只约束"创建 teammate"（`create teammates only when the user explicitly asks…`），不约束是否委派，也不禁止 `subagent`；九件套对 Lead 是**无条件**安装的（[`tool-agent-team` L402-L421](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts#L402-L421)）。
- `subagent` 的系统提示段写着 "Use subagent in the background by default…"（[`tool-subagent` L599-L605](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/index.ts#L599-L605)），工具描述本身也写着 "``send_message`` steers the child's nearest step…"（[L387](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/index.ts#L387)）。
- 但模型拿到的 `send_message` 是 Team 版：传 `agent_id` → `invalid arguments: missing required property "target"`；传子代理名字/id → `active teammate "…" not found`。policy 中没有任何一句说明"本会话的 `send_message`/`list_agents` 只认 Team 成员"。

因此在开启 bundle 的 Web/Desktop 上，**每一次普通委派**都会踩到这条死路；用户不提 teams 时反而更容易踩，因为此时没有 teammate，而可用的控制工具全是 Team 语义。

## 为什么 CI 没有发现

- 录制的 Team 产品快照跑 **headless**，headless 不 mount preset，期望工具表里确实没有 `subagent`（[`snapshots/session/team-targets/tool-schemas.expected.json`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/snapshots/session/team-targets/tool-schemas.expected.json)）—— 测试钉住的是正确组合，与 Web/Desktop 无关。
- Web 侧 [`agent-team-panel.e2e.ts` L36-L54](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/web/tests/agent-team-panel.e2e.ts#L36-L54) 只断言 overlay == bundle patch + 面板 UI，其 scaffold 没有开启 `agentPresets`（[`scaffold.ts` L665-L667](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/web/tests/scaffold.ts#L665-L667)），因此看不到该泄漏。
- 另外 README 的 Known Limitations 其实写了 "Preset-scoped child controls — Web presets can still mount continuable Subagent controls in their own scope; this top-level bundle does not replace those registrations."（[L108](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/agent-team-profile/README.md#L108)），与 Summary / What you get 的"已禁用"表述自相矛盾，且没有说明由此产生的"Team 工具遮蔽 + subagent 存活"混用后果。

## 影响面

- 受影响：Web、Desktop（走 preset 挂载的 GUI 会话）；`standard` / `ptc` / `cordis` 三个 shipped preset 都声明这些行。
- 不受影响：headless / ACP / SDK 等不 mount preset 的组合。
- 严重性：委派与协作能力不可用 + 误导模型（会浪费轮次反复尝试联系不存在的成员），无数据损坏。

## 建议修复

**A（推荐，符合两平面架构的最小改动）**：让 preset 平面对 Team 服务感知 —— 在 `presets/standard|ptc|cordis.patch.yml` 的这 4 个 legacy child-control 行上各加 `disabled: !!js "ctx.get('agentTeams') !== undefined"`（同文件已有 `!!js` 先例，host 平面也有 `!ctx.get('profileContext')` 先例）。注意必须逐行加、**不能禁用整个 `delegation` 组**，否则 `workflow` 也会一起消失（headless Team 快照中 `workflow` 是保留的）。配套：增加一条"Web preset × Team bundle"组合下断言模型可见工具表的产品级测试，并同步 README。

**B**：由 Team bundle 自带一个 Team preset 并 patch 顶层 `agent-preset-registry` 的 default。不动 web-app，但要复制整份 preset 声明，与 preset 编辑器/用户自定义 preset 冲突，实验包还需承担 release preset 的维护成本 —— 不推荐。

**C**：让 `tool-subagent` 检测到 `agentTeams` 就不注册。隐式耦合，且会让 host 平面行也静默消失 —— 不建议。

**D（止血，不足以修复）**：在 Team policy/工具错误信息中说明"本会话仍可能出现 `subagent`，其子代理不属于 Team，`send_message`/`list_agents` 无法到达它们"，并修正 README 的矛盾表述。

## 备注

以上结论均在开启 bundle 的真实 Web 会话中实测（工具表比对 + `list_agents` / `send_message` 的实际返回），代码位置对应 HEAD `46a7f68b09`。
