[Bug] dsh-api-session-controller publishes client types that import @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store, a devDependency only
discussions.body:
## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller@0.1.5-rc.3` publishes client types that import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, but lists that package only under `devDependencies`. In a consumer's pnpm workspace (strict, not hoisted) the import cannot be resolved from the package's own location, so the types that depend on it are unresolved for every plugin author.

## Where

- `lib/types/client/contract/session.d.ts`: `export type SessionFace = ISession & ObservableSnapshot<SessionSnapshot>`
- `lib/types/client/contract/sessions.d.ts`: `ISessions.list: ObservableSnapshot<SessionListState>`
- `ObservableSnapshot` comes from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`.
- `package.json`: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` appears in `devDependencies` only.

## What a plugin author sees

- `tsc` with `skipLibCheck: true` reports nothing: the unresolved import silently becomes `any`, so `ctx.sessions.sessionOf(...)`, `.create(...)` and `face.prompt(...)` lose their types.
- typescript-eslint's type-aware rules (`strictTypeChecked`) report every use as unresolvable ("Unsafe call of a type that could not be resolved", "Unsafe return of a value of type error").

## Expected

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` as a `dependency` (or `peerDependency`) of every package whose published `.d.ts` files import it. The same pattern was reported for `dsh-llm` in #5913, and #6531 describes the runtime side for client peers.

## Workaround

We describe the calls we use in a narrow local interface and cast `ctx.sessions` to it.

discussions.title: [Bug] MCP tool results drop structuredContent — the official computer-use plugin can't reach its own element_token
discussions.body:
The new experimental computer-use provider (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native`) ships a system prompt section that tells the model:

> Use element_token from that snapshot, or coordinates from its screenshot. A new snapshot of that window invalidates its earlier element tokens.

I spent a while trying to follow that instruction and couldn't — the token never arrives. After pulling the chain apart, I think the tool-result bridge is throwing away exactly the half of the result the tool wants the model to use.

Here's what I found.

The provider calls the native driver and hands the raw MCP result to `createMcpToolDefinition` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`:

```js
const result = await activeDriver.callTool(tool.name, JSON.stringify(args), { signal: combined });
return JSON.parse(result.rawJson);
```

`dsh-mcp-client` keeps both halves in `createExecutor`:

```js
const value = {
  content,
  ...result.structuredContent !== void 0 ? { structuredContent: result.structuredContent } : {}
};
```

but the renderer only projects `content`:

```js
render(_args, value) {
  return [{ type: "text", text: extractText(value.content, rawName) }];
}
```

So anything an upstream tool puts in `structuredContent` stays invisible to the model.

That matters here, because cua-driver puts everything useful in there. I asked the native runtime directly (`listToolsJson`) — out of 56 tools, 34 declare an outputSchema, and `get_window_state` is the only one whose schema mentions tokens:

- `elements[].element_token`
- `snapshot_id`
- `elements[].frame` — `{x, y, w, h}`

Then I called it and read the raw JSON. `content` carries the markdown tree and the screenshot. `structuredContent` carries `elements` with 239 entries, and **239 of 239 have both `element_token` and `frame`**. None of it reaches the model — in my session log the string `structuredContent` appears exactly zero times.

Two things this actually cost me:

1. The guidance says to use `element_token`, so the only route left is pixel coordinates. For an Electron window under 175% display scaling, I couldn't get a synthetic click to land at all — three attempts, no error, nothing happened. Pressing the very same button through UIA `InvokePattern` (from a plugin of mine, `gui_uia`) works on the first try, so the accessibility route itself is fine. It's just unreachable from the official provider.

2. `frame` is the authoritative screen rectangle. Dropping it forces coordinate math across DPI scaling and multi-monitor layouts — which is where my mis-clicks came from.

I genuinely don't know whether `render()` ignoring `structuredContent` is deliberate, maybe it's meant to be UI-only. If so, the computer-use provider has no way to opt in, and its prompt ends up asking for something the runtime can't deliver.

Would something along these lines be reasonable: when a tool declares an `outputSchema`, either serialize `structuredContent` into the model-visible text, or let a tool mark which structured fields the model should see?

Happy to test a patch if someone points me at the intended direction. Reproducible on Windows 11 with DSH 0.1.7-rc.2, and I still have the raw outputs if they'd help.

discussions.title: [Feature] 沙箱设备透传:让 GPU(NVML/CUDA)在 workspace-write 模式下可用
discussions.body:
## Motivation

在带本地 GPU 的机器上运行 ML 训练类任务时,bash 沙箱的默认设备隔离使 GPU 在
workspace-write(及更严)模式下完全不可用,只能整体切换到 danger-full-access——
**文件安全边界与本地算力不可兼得**。

实测环境:dsh 0.1.5-rc.1,WSL2,RTX 5060 Ti(驱动 596.21 / CUDA 13.2):

- 沙箱内 `nvidia-smi` → `Failed to initialize NVML: GPU access blocked by the operating system`
- `/dev/nvidia*` 不存在,`lspci` 无输出,`/sys/bus/pci/devices` 仅 4 项
- 同一命令在 danger-full-access 模式下完全正常(`device=cuda` 训练通过)

机制(阅读 `dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js` 源码后定位,双层原因):

1. `bwrapProfileArgs` 使用 `--dev /dev` 合成最小设备层替换真实 `/dev`,
   GPU 设备节点在沙箱内不存在;
2. `landlockProfileArgs` 的 grants 为 `readOnly=["/"]` +
   `readWrite=["/dev/null","/tmp",workspace]`;GPU 驱动访问需要设备上的
   write + ioctl(Landlock 的 `IOCTL_DEV` 访问位),对 `/` 的只读授权不满足。

## Behavior

希望提供**配置化的设备透传**,例如:

- 环境变量:`DSH_SANDBOX_DEVICES=/dev/nvidia0,/dev/nvidiactl,/dev/nvidia-uvm`
  (逗号分隔;默认空 = 维持现状),或
- settings 中的 `sandbox.devices` 列表。

实现位置(供参考,`dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js` 两个函数):

- `bwrapProfileArgs`:对配置的每个设备追加 `--dev-bind <dev> <dev>`;
- `landlockProfileArgs`:把配置设备加入 `readWrite` 列表
  (取得 `WRITE_FILE` + `IOCTL_DEV` 位)。

## 附加说明

- **默认行为零变化**:不配置设备时与现状完全一致,安全语义不放宽;
  用户显式列出设备即自行承担该设备面的暴露。
- 典型受益场景:agent 在沙箱内做本地 GPU 训练/推理(如 Kaggle/ML 实验工作流)。
  当前只能在"放弃文件沙箱"与"放弃本地 GPU"之间二选一,而前者是更差的默认。
- 同样惠及其他字符设备工作流(串口、FPGA、视频采集等)。
- 规避方案(在配置落地前):训练命令以 danger-full-access 执行 + 日志落盘 +
  沙箱内只读监控;或宿主侧常驻 GPU 服务进程。两者都比一个白名单条目重得多。

---

环境信息:dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`(npm 全局),Linux 6.x WSL2,
bubblewrap + Landlock 双层沙箱(源码 `dsh-sandbox-local` 包)。

discussions.title: dsh-auto-memory — native persistent memory for your agent (Claude Code-style MEMORY.md, plus auto-consolidation & forgetting)
discussions.body:
> **Repo: https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory** · npm: [`dsh-auto-memory`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-auto-memory) · [bilingual README](https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory#readme)

I kept starting every session from zero — re-telling the agent who I am and what I am building. dsh ships no memory subsystem (the MCP bridge configs need external servers, and nothing reaches the model unless it decides to call a tool), so I ported Claude Code's auto-memory model as a native plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add dsh-auto-memory
```

What it does:

- Typed memory files (`user / feedback / project / reference`) under `$DSH_HOME/memory` — plain Markdown, one file per memory, hand-editable
- `MEMORY.md` index injected into **every** system prompt: re-evaluated per step, byte-budgeted, and absent entirely when the store is empty
- Six tools (`memory_write / read / list / delete / prune / delete_all`) with Claude Code's write discipline — dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, `[[name]]` cross-links
- Per-workspace + user-level scopes, so projects don't leak into each other. No servers, no embeddings — just files

Why native instead of an MCP bridge: with MCP, memory only exists when the model decides to call a tool, and you run an external server. Here the index rides the system-prompt assembly that already happens every step, so recall is unconditional. (If you need semantic search over thousands of memories, the MCP servers are still the better fit.)

0.2.0 adds things Claude Code doesn't have:

- **Auto-consolidation**: a background pass at root-session end extracts durable new facts and files them as memories (opt-in `autoSummarize`, deduped, capped, silent on failure)
- **Forgetting**: `memory_read` counts references; `staleAfterDays` soft-hides stale zero-read memories from the index; `memory_prune` lists or deletes them
- `memory_delete_all` requires **human approval** — the model can't self-confirm a bulk delete

Crash-safety got the most attention: cross-process locks with orphan-lock recovery, atomic writes, and a guard for the case where a memory named `memory` silently destroys `MEMORY.md` on NTFS. 67 tests.

No-key demo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory && cd dsh-auto-memory && node scripts/demo.mjs
```

On the awesome-dsh-plugin list, so it shows up in dsh-market too. Feedback welcome — especially on consolidation prompt quality and a sensible default for `staleAfterDays`.

discussions.title: [Proposal] 把侧栏列宽暴露给 shell.overlay 的占用方
discussions.body:
/### 背景

`shell.overlay` 的契约把它定义为"frame 级浮层：位于所有列之上、在各列滚动容器之外"，并明确它是"你自己的 frame 级表面的加法座位"（新增 id 加在内置条目旁边，而不是替换它们）。因此把徽标、状态胶囊或一组浮起的小控件放在这里是推荐做法。

然而，问题在于：这个座位不提供任何几何信息，而它恰恰是覆盖在列之上的那一层。

### 现状（`dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2`）

- `shell.overlay` 的 standard props 不包含布局或列宽；
- 客户端服务 `ctx.layout`（`ILayout`）只暴露面板选择、导航与右侧栏上报，没有列宽；
- 侧栏的渲染宽度只作为 owner props 交给 `sidebar` 座位的占用方。

于是，想让浮层精确贴在侧栏右侧（`left = 侧栏宽 + 16`）的占用方只能自行测量 DOM：

```js
const frame = document.querySelector('[data-shell-overlay]').parentElement
const right = frame.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().right
```

这样做有三个具体问题：

1. **窄窗口会覆盖中间列。** 举个例子，1440px 视口时中间列左侧尚有 173px 空隙，窗口缩到约 1000px 时只剩约 16px，测量结果会覆盖输入区域的左缘。
2. **列布局完成前只能取兜底值。** 浮层在列布局提交之前就已渲染，首次读取只能退到兜底值（我们使用 80px），该值会覆盖侧栏底部的「设置」。
3. **依赖未文档化的内部结构。** `firstElementChild` 属于 frame 的内部结构，重构后会静默失效。

### 建议

frame 已经为同类需求发布布局变量：`shell.leading` 座位挂载期间会发布 `--dsh-frame-leading-clearance`（该座位所占的 inline inset，自 frame 左缘量起）。同样的方式可以覆盖列宽，以下任一方案即可，且都只涉及读取：

- **方案 A（改动最小）**：frame 发布左列的解析宽度，例如 `--dsh-frame-sidebar-width`（折叠或隐藏时可以是 0 或 rail 宽度）。占用方零成本读取，与现有两个变量共用同一套机制。
- **方案 B（更通用）**：为 `shell.overlay` 增加一个只读布局 share，例如 `useColumns(): { sidebar, center, rightbar, viewport }`；或让 `ILayout` 暴露解析后的列宽。

我并不请求控制布局的能力，只需要只读几何。如果两者暂时都不考虑，另一个可接受的替代方案是在 `docs/subsystems/slots.md` 中说明浮层占用方应如何获取 frame 几何：目前这两个变量在 `docs/` 下没有任何引用，只能从源码发现，结果是每个插件各自测量 DOM，并在窄窗口上以相同方式出错。

### 代码位置（`dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2`）

- 座位声明与 `shell.leading` 的几何说明：`packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/index.ts`（约 88-113 行；`inject` 在 143 行）
- 侧栏宽度仅通过 owner props 下发：同文件 `SidebarOwnerProps { collapsed, width }`（约 121-127 行）；`packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/AppFrame.tsx` 约 242-245 行的 `renderSlot('sidebar', { collapsed, width: cols.sidebar })`
- `ILayout` 的完整接口（不含列宽）：`packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/service.ts` 28-54 行
- frame 已发布的两个变量（CSS 声明）：`packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/AppFrame.module.css` 94 行、166 与 175 行
- 文档中无 `--dsh-frame-*` 引用：`docs/subsystems/slots.md`（座位树中出现 `shell.overlay`）lay）

### 相关讨论

详见[#4070](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4070) ，4070 请求"参与布局、预留宽度"的第三方面板，本讨论项并不要求直接参与布局，只请求 frame 已经解算出的列宽。

discussions.title: [Bug] Models settings shows DeepSeek twice with identical model lists (Web, 0.1.7-rc.2)
discussions.body:
**What happens**

Settings → Models lists DeepSeek twice: `DeepSeek` (the API-key route, provider `deepseek-official`) and `DeepSeek Account` (the signed-in account route, provider `deepseek-account`). Both rows then show the same model list, so the page reads as a duplicate and there is no way to tell which balance a task will spend.

**Environment**

- Web UI on 0.1.7-rc.2. The split is new in this release ("账号任务与 API Key 任务使用独立的模型入口").
- Signed in to a DeepSeek account, with a DeepSeek API key stored as well, so both rows are shown. The account row appears only when the account catalog has models — `client-ui-settings-models/lib/client.js` filters it on `accountAvailable`.

**Why it reads as a bug**

The split is deliberate (the account route never falls back to the API key), but with the same model names under both rows the intent is invisible: a user cannot tell whether a task will spend account credit or the key's balance, and the two entries look like one setting shown twice.

**Suggestion**

Either merge the two rows into one, or keep them separate and label what each spends (account credit vs API key balance), so the reason for the second entry is visible on the page.

discussions.title: 「我们需要」模式 —— 跑了 20+ 批实验：它不让模型更聪明，但快 2.4–3.8×；附带一个我们没预料到的发现
discussions.body:
**TL;DR (English)** — A DSH agent preset that anchors the reasoning chain into Chinese + "we need…" style.
The experiments mostly *disproved* my own changes, and I kept every negative result.
Effective part: **2.4×–3.8× faster** on medium tasks (1.5× on very large ones), ~0.5× cost, **no measured capability gain**.
Unexpected finding: it makes the model **research far less and guess more** (median fact-checks before first write: 30 → 6).
Repo: https://github.com/walksls/not-smarter-just-faster

---

【这是什么】

一个 agent preset，把思维链锚定成中文 +「我们需要…」风格，同时保留全部工具。

机制是把「首轮条件」和「干活条件」拆开：首轮只给 `bash` + `edit`，让模型走进
「我们需要…」轨迹；会话出现第一个持久事件后，自动恢复完整工具面。
不需要改 dsh 源码，不需要装 npm 包。

【为什么值得一看 —— 因为它的负面结果比正面结果多】

我不觉得「又做了一个风格 preset」值得发帖。发出来是因为这个仓库里
**大部分改动最后都被我自己证伪了**，而这些记录我一条没删：

- **`temperature: 0.1`** —— 曾测出 1.93× 收益 → 真实多轮 n=30 复现失败；
  后续长任务 A/B 实测它会导致**退化循环**（n=3/臂：开着 3/3 崩溃，
  最长单段思维链 12.8 万字符；关掉 3/3 正常完成）。已关闭。
- **「第一句锚定」措辞改动** —— 严格对照下无改善（p=0.21），已退回。
- **能力提升** —— 四种任务类型的 A/B，通过率**均未测出差异**。
- **「加条款治空转」** —— 无效。真实事故里循环内容反复出现「（停止空转）」，
  条款本身变成了循环的填充物。

实测有效的部分：

- 中等任务（标准模式 16–32 次工具调用）：快 **2.4×–3.8×**（n=12–20/臂，外部判卷）
- 超大任务（239 次调用、46 分钟级）：快 **1.5×**（n=2）
- 花费约 **0.5×**（¥0.55 vs ¥1.14）
- ⚠️ 两组数据**配置不同**（早期实验的臂少 4 个插件），**不能画趋势线**。
  早期「任务越大优势越大」的说法**已被新数据质疑，现标为未定**。

【一个我们没预料到的发现：它会少查资料、多靠猜】

同一任务对比标准模式：

| 指标 | 标准模式 | 本模式 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 首次写代码前「真正查证」次数（中位） | **30** | **6** |
| `web_search` / `web_fetch` | 1 / 5 | **0 / 0** |
| 思考里「猜疑词」密度（每千字符） | 0.01 | **0.96** |

典型对比：标准模式前 20 步在搜物理常数反汇编、抓逐帧数据、下载真实关卡数据；
本模式探完环境第 8 步就开始写代码，全程一次网都没搜。

⚠️ **但不能推出「查得少 = 成品差」**：该任务两边判卷都是 16/16 关键词、都能运行，
标准模式反而有 1/2 有效样本是白屏 bug。
**可能的原因是这个任务不需要精确常数。在需要精确性的任务上是否致命，我标为未定。**

【安装】

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/.agent-presets
git clone https://github.com/walksls/not-smarter-just-faster.git /tmp/we-need
cp -R /tmp/we-need/. ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/we-need/
```

然后**完全重启 dsh web**（preset 在启动时扫描），新建空白会话，选「我们需要模式」。

⚠️ 目录名必须是 `we-need`。⚠️ 注意 `cp` 结尾的 `/.`（不带的话**不覆盖**已有文件）。

【当前状态与边界】（先说清楚，免得踩坑）

- 实测环境：DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 / DeepSeek V4.1-Flash。**其他模型未验证。**
- **需要重启 dsh web 才生效**（`.mjs` 改动刷新页面无效）。
- **已知未解决**：风格会随对话变长衰减（漂移）。真实数据里约 **32%** 的思考段
  开头就是英文。试过「改措辞」「加条款」两条路，**都被实测否掉了**。
- **不维护**。这是个人实验的副产品，不承诺修 bug、不保证跟进 DSH 版本。
  欢迎 fork / 改 / 拿去用（MIT）。

【欢迎】

如果你复现出不同结果，或者做出了更有意思的实验，欢迎贴出来。
我最想看到的是：**换一个「必须查准」的任务，验证「少查证」到底有没有害。**
这个仓库公开的原因就是这个。

discussions.title: [Bug] Compaction drops reasoning effort and busts KV cache; idle watchdog cancels active prefill / 压缩丢失推理强度并破坏 KV 缓存
discussions.body:
## English

### Summary

`dsh-compaction-basic` can invalidate the provider's warm KV prefix when the active session uses a per-request reasoning effort different from the provider default. The compaction summarizer carries `provider` and `model`, but not `reasoningEffort`. For providers whose chat template encodes reasoning effort, the auxiliary compaction prompt diverges near the beginning and the intended prefix-cache reuse is lost.

A second problem makes this especially painful for local models: `dsh-llm-pi-ai` cancels a stream after 300,000 ms without a parsed model chunk. A local server can still be actively prefilling a large prompt, but transport keepalives or prompt-progress events do not appear to pulse this watchdog. The Harness cancels healthy work before the server's longer request timeout.

### Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.1`, Web profile
- `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, OpenAI-compatible local endpoint
- 256K-context Qwen model served by Splash on Apple Silicon
- Active session reasoning effort: `xhigh`
- Provider profile default reasoning effort: `medium`
- Provider server request timeout: 3,600 seconds
- Harness `streamIdleTimeoutMs`: default 300,000 ms

### Reproduction and evidence

The normal conversation used `xhigh`. Automatic compaction started around 149K input tokens. Four compaction attempts were observed:

| Attempt | Input tokens | Cached tokens | Approx. uncached input | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | 111,303 | 0 | 111,303 | Harness cancelled after 300 s |
| 2 | 112,925 | 53,248 | 59,677 | Harness cancelled after 300 s |
| 3 | 112,925 | 55,296 | 57,629 | Harness cancelled after 300 s |
| 4 | 112,925 | 94,208 | 18,717 | TTFT 152.4 s; generated 5,541 tokens; succeeded |

The successful request took about 342 seconds in total, but it survived because output began after 152.4 seconds and subsequent chunks reset the idle watchdog. The cancelled attempts appear to have progressively populated a cache for the compaction prompt, eventually allowing attempt 4 to reach its first token in time.

A normal request immediately after compaction showed the same independent watchdog behavior: a 57,413-token cold request was cancelled after 300 seconds; its retry reused 8,384 tokens and succeeded with TTFT 279.4 seconds.

### Code path

The current `summarizeWithLlm()` chooses a target containing only `provider` and `model`, and its `GenerateOptions` omits `reasoningEffort`:

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts

The Pi AI adapter then resolves:

```ts
options.reasoningEffort ?? profile.reasoning
```

The repository's own compaction design note says the replayed request should reproduce the warm prefix verbatim. Omitting a template-affecting request option violates that invariant:

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/archived/bug-fix/2026-07-21-compaction-summary-prefix-cache-reuse.md

For this model, `medium` and `xhigh` produce different system-template text almost immediately, so the whole prior prefix becomes unusable.

### Expected behavior

1. A same-provider/model automatic compaction should inherit the effective reasoning effort of the routed request whose prefix it replays.
2. Long active prefills should not be mistaken for dead streams merely because no generated token has arrived yet.

### Suggested fixes

- Carry the effective `reasoningEffort` from the routed request header into the summarization call. More generally, preserve every request option that can alter prompt rendering.
- Add a regression test where session effort differs from provider default and assert that the summarization call preserves it.
- Let provider progress events or transport activity pulse the idle watchdog, or distinguish prompt-processing idle from a dead connection.
- Consider a separate/default-longer idle bound for `purpose: "compaction"`, since these requests are predictably the largest.

### Workaround

Users can set a larger `streamIdleTimeoutMs` in their provider profile, but that only prevents premature cancellation. It does not repair the cache-breaking reasoning mismatch.

---

## 中文

### 摘要

当当前会话使用的逐请求推理强度与 provider 默认值不同时，`dsh-compaction-basic` 可能会使 provider 已预热的 KV 前缀缓存失效。压缩摘要请求只继承了 `provider` 和 `model`，没有继承 `reasoningEffort`。对于把推理强度写入聊天模板的 provider，辅助压缩请求会从提示词开头附近就发生变化，因此无法实现预期的前缀缓存复用。

第二个问题会让本地模型尤其容易失败：如果连续 300,000 ms 没有收到已解析的模型数据块，`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 就会取消流。此时本地服务器可能仍在正常处理一个很长的输入，但传输 keepalive 或提示词处理进度似乎不会重置该 watchdog。因此 Harness 会在服务器自身更长的请求超时之前取消仍然健康的工作。

### 环境

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.1`，Web profile
- `dsh-llm-pi-ai`，本地 OpenAI 兼容端点
- Apple Silicon 上由 Splash 运行的 256K 上下文 Qwen 模型
- 当前会话 reasoning effort：`xhigh`
- Provider profile 默认 reasoning effort：`medium`
- Provider 服务器请求超时：3,600 秒
- Harness `streamIdleTimeoutMs`：默认 300,000 ms

### 复现与证据

正常会话使用 `xhigh`。输入约达到 149K token 时触发自动压缩。观察到四次压缩请求：

| 尝试 | 输入 token | 缓存 token | 约需新处理的输入 | 结果 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | 111,303 | 0 | 111,303 | 300 秒后被 Harness 取消 |
| 2 | 112,925 | 53,248 | 59,677 | 300 秒后被 Harness 取消 |
| 3 | 112,925 | 55,296 | 57,629 | 300 秒后被 Harness 取消 |
| 4 | 112,925 | 94,208 | 18,717 | TTFT 152.4 秒；生成 5,541 token；成功 |

成功的第四次请求总共约耗时 342 秒，但因为 152.4 秒后已经开始输出，后续数据块不断重置 idle watchdog，所以能够完成。前三次被取消的请求似乎逐步建立了压缩请求自己的缓存，最终使第四次请求能及时产生首 token。

压缩成功后的普通请求也独立复现了 watchdog 问题：一个 57,413-token 的冷请求在 300 秒后被取消；重试复用了 8,384 token，并以 279.4 秒 TTFT 成功。

### 代码路径

当前 `summarizeWithLlm()` 选择的 target 只包含 `provider` 和 `model`，构造的 `GenerateOptions` 没有 `reasoningEffort`：

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts

随后 Pi AI adapter 使用以下逻辑：

```ts
options.reasoningEffort ?? profile.reasoning
```

仓库自己的压缩设计说明强调，重放请求应逐字复现已预热的前缀。遗漏会改变模板的请求选项违反了这一约束：

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/archived/bug-fix/2026-07-21-compaction-summary-prefix-cache-reuse.md

对于本次使用的模型，`medium` 和 `xhigh` 几乎从 system 模板开头就不同，因此之前的整个前缀缓存无法使用。

### 预期行为

1. 使用相同 provider/model 的自动压缩应继承被重放请求的有效 reasoning effort。
2. 很长但仍在正常进行的 prefill 不应仅因尚未生成首 token 就被判断为死流。

### 建议修复

- 将路由请求头中的有效 `reasoningEffort` 传给摘要请求。更一般地说，应保留所有会改变提示词渲染的请求选项。
- 增加回归测试：会话 effort 与 provider 默认值不同，并断言摘要请求仍保留会话 effort。
- 让 provider 进度事件或传输活动重置 idle watchdog，或者区分“仍在处理提示词”与“连接已失效”。
- 可考虑为 `purpose: "compaction"` 设置单独或更长的默认 idle 限制，因为压缩请求通常就是最大的请求。

### 临时解决方法

用户可以在 provider profile 中增大 `streamIdleTimeoutMs`，这只能避免过早取消，不能修复由 reasoning 不一致导致的缓存失效。

discussions.title: [Request] Please enable GitHub Issues / 请启用 GitHub Issues
discussions.body:
## English

Please consider enabling GitHub Issues for actionable bug reports and tracked feature requests, while keeping Discussions for support, open-ended ideas, and community conversation.

The contribution guide currently asks users to report bugs in Discussions, and external pull requests are not accepted. Not accepting PRs is understandable for an early-stage project, but disabling Issues as well makes precise defect tracking unnecessarily difficult:

- Discussions do not provide the same bug templates, labels, milestones, assignees, project integration, duplicate handling, or clear open/closed lifecycle.
- Technical reports are mixed with support questions and general conversation.
- It is harder for users to discover whether a regression is known, fixed, or scheduled for a release.
- Maintainers cannot link commits and releases to a conventional issue record as cleanly.

Enabling Issues would not require accepting external PRs. A minimal setup could use two forms—bug report and feature request—with required version/reproduction fields, a small label set, and Discussions retained for Q&A and broad proposals. GitHub's contribution guidance can still state that unsolicited PRs are not accepted.

The project is open source and already invites reproducible bug reports. Issues are a much better tool for that specific workflow than forum threads.

---

## 中文

建议为可执行的 bug 报告和需要跟踪的功能请求启用 GitHub Issues，同时继续使用 Discussions 处理使用帮助、开放式想法和社区交流。

目前贡献指南要求用户在 Discussions 中报告 bug，同时仓库也暂不接受外部 PR。项目早期暂不接受 PR 可以理解，但同时关闭 Issues 会让准确的问题跟踪变得不必要地困难：

- Discussions 缺少同等完善的 bug 模板、标签、里程碑、负责人、Project 集成、重复问题处理以及清晰的开放/关闭生命周期。
- 技术缺陷报告会与使用问题和一般讨论混在一起。
- 用户更难确认某个回归是否已知、是否已修复，以及会在哪个版本发布。
- 维护者也更难把提交和版本发布清晰地关联到传统 issue 记录。

启用 Issues 并不意味着必须接受外部 PR。最小方案可以只提供两个表单——bug report 和 feature request——要求填写版本与复现信息，配合少量标签；Q&A 和宽泛提案仍然留在 Discussions。贡献指南也可以继续明确说明暂不接受未经邀请的 PR。

该项目是开源项目，并且已经邀请用户提交可复现的 bug。对于这种明确的工作流程，Issues 比论坛讨论串更合适。

discussions.title: 插件重命名/Feature request: Allow local custom display aliases for installed plugins
discussions.body: ## Feature request It would be useful if DeepSeek Harness allowed users to assign a local custom display name to installed plugins without changing the plugin's real package identity. For example: `@liustack/modlens` could be displayed locally as: `视觉强化` while the real package name would still remain `@liustack/modlens` for installation, updates, enable/disable operations, and uninstallation. ## Why this is useful Third-party plugin package names are often technical and not very friendly for everyday use. A local display alias would make the plugin manager easier to understand, especially when many plugins are installed. This would also make DeepSeek Harness more approachable for new users who are not familiar with npm package names or plugin naming conventions. Lowering this barrier can help non-technical users get started with agent tools more quickly and make the product easier to adopt beyond developers and other highly technical users. As more plugins are installed, package names can also become visually overwhelming and harder to distinguish at a glance. Allowing users to rename them locally gives them a simple way to organize plugins using names that are meaningful to them. For users with many installed plugins, custom aliases can also act as a lightweight personal organization system. ## Prototype I implemented a working prototype in the Desktop version. The implementation: - Keeps `pkg.name` unchanged as the technical identity. - Adds an optional local alias only at the presentation layer. - Shows the custom alias in the plugin list. - Shows the custom alias in the plugin detail page. - Keeps the real package name visible in the detail page. - Uses the alias in the uninstall confirmation dialog. - Supports resetting back to the original plugin name. - Persists the alias after restarting the application. - Does not modify the plugin's `package.json` or npm package identity. Example: `@liustack/modlens` → `视觉强化` The real package name is still shown below the display name. ## Validation The prototype has been tested successfully on the Windows Desktop version. - TypeScript typecheck passes. - Desktop development build works. - Windows Desktop packaging succeeds. - Aliases survive application restarts. - Plugin uninstall/enable/disable behavior is unaffected. If this feature is useful to the project, I would be happy to share the implementation details or patch. 补充：这个功能只修改本地 UI 显示名称，不会修改真实 npm 包名或插件身份。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 桌面端高分屏缩放导致 Office 预览图截断/放大（LibreOfficeKit 1.5× DPI 缩放冲突）（v0.1.7-rc.2）
discussions.body:
### 环境
- **客户端版本**：DeepSeek Harness Desktop（Windows 11 x64 桌面端）
- **显示环境**：笔记本屏幕开启 Windows 缩放，例如 150% 缩放（`AppliedDPI = 144`）
- **涉及包**：`@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit@0.1.1` (`libreoffice-kit-win32-x64`)
- **涉及技能**：`office-docx`、`office-pptx`、`office-xlsx`（文档预览图片渲染）

### 问题现象
在开启了显示缩放（如 150% / 144 DPI）的 Windows 机器上，使用 DSH Desktop 桌面端运行 Office 技能渲染预览图时：
- 生成的 PNG 预览图只截取了页面的**左上角约 66.7%**。
- 右侧约 1/3 和底部约 1/3 的内容被挤出画布截断。
- 生成的 `.docx` / `.pptx` 原文件本身完全正常，在 Microsoft Office 中打开排版完好。
- *注：在无显示缩放（标准 96 DPI）或 CLI / Linux 容器环境下无此问题。*

### 根因分析
1. **DPI 上下文继承**：DSH Desktop（Electron 宿主）被 Windows 标记为 Per-Monitor High-DPI Aware。当通过 Node 的 `child_process.spawn` 启动原生的 `libreoffice-kit.exe` 进程时，该子进程继承了宿主 GUI 进程树的 DPI 上下文。
2. **基准冲突**：`cli.js` 内部按标准的 96 DPI（15 Twips/Pixel）计算切片 twips 尺寸。但 Windows 平台上的 `libreoffice-kit.exe` 没有做 DPI 隔离，其底层 VCL 图形引擎检测到了当前屏幕的 `144 DPI`。
3. **二次放大**：LibreOffice 在执行 `paintTile` / `paintPartTile` 渲染时，把每个逻辑图元按 144/96 乘了 **1.5 倍**。导致 144 DPI 的画布中被塞入了 1.5 倍放大的内容，右侧和底部被大量裁切。

### 验证与修复建议
经实测，在 Windows 平台启动 `libreoffice-kit.exe` 时隔离屏幕 DPI，强制其运行在 `DPIUNAWARE`（报告 96 DPI）下，即可完美恢复完整无截断的渲染。

**修复方案一（JS 层，修改 `@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit` 的 `lib/cli.js` 和 `lib/index.js`）**：
在 `nativeEnvironment` 函数中为 Windows 平台追加环境变量隔离：
```javascript
function nativeEnvironment(profile, programDirectory, source = process.env, platform = process.platform) {
    const env = {};
    for (const key of NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_KEYS) {
        const value = source[key];
        if (value !== void 0) env[key] = value;
    }
    if (platform === "linux") env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH = programDirectory;
    if (platform === "win32") env.__COMPAT_LAYER = "DPIUNAWARE"; // <-- 加入此行
    return Object.assign(env, { ... });
}
```

**修复方案二（C++ 原生层，修改 `worker.cxx`）**：
在 `worker.cxx` 的 Windows 入口处（`wmain`）调用：
```cpp
SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_UNAWARE);
```

实测加入 `__COMPAT_LAYER = "DPIUNAWARE"` 后，DOCX（表格全列显示）、PPTX（标题居中、图表完整）均渲染正常，左右边距恢复对称。

discussions.title: Russian (ru) localization for the dsh web GUI — 53 namespaces, 2,163 strings, tracked per release
请求体超过网关上限时，错误被显示为「API 密钥无效」；AUTH 归类掩盖了真实原因
discussions.body:
## Summary

当上游网关因**请求体超过体积上限**而拒绝请求时，DSH 会把这次失败显示成 **「API 密钥无效」**。用户看到的是认证错误，实际问题却是请求体积；而网关返回的真实错误信息在 UI 里无法取得。

## Reproduction

1. 使用 `api: openai-completions`（由 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 服务）的 provider，指向一个对请求体有体积上限的 OpenAI 兼容网关。
2. 在一个会话里累积较多图片（本次为 75 张唯一附件、原始约 39 MB）。历史图片会被重新编码并内联进**每一个**请求体，因此请求体随会话增长。
3. 继续对话，直到请求体超过网关上限。此后**该会话的每一轮都会以同样方式失败**。

体积阈值可用同一把 key、同一模型直接复现（只有体积在变）：

| 请求体 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 7 MB | HTTP 200 |
| **8 MB** | **HTTP 403 `{"message":"Insufficient account balance","type":"bad_response_status_code"}`** |
| 9 MB | HTTP 403（同上） |

7 MB 用同一把 key 成功，说明该 403 是**体积触发的产物**，与凭据或余额无关。

## Current behavior

UI 渲染为 `本轮运行失败  API 密钥无效`，错误码 `AUTH`。而网关实际返回：

```json
403: {"message":"Insufficient account balance","type":"bad_response_status_code"}
```

网关自身日志显示真实原因与故障转移链：

```
channel error (status 413): request body exceeds limit of 8388608 bytes; please reduce conversation context
channel error (status 413): request body exceeds limit of 8388608 bytes; please reduce conversation context
channel error (status 403): Insufficient account balance
relay error: Insufficient account balance
POST /v1/chat/completions | 403
```

即：**主渠道以 413（体积超 8 MiB）拒绝**，网关转移到备用渠道，备用渠道因无关原因返回 403。DSH 只看到最后的 403。

三处成因（按影响排序）：

**1. `failureMessage` 在 `AUTH` 时丢弃真实错误**（对用户最误导）
`dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js`：

```js
function failureMessage(message, code, t) {
    return code === "AUTH" ? t("message.failure.auth") : message;
}
```

`code === "AUTH"` 时真实 `message` 被丢弃、替换成固定文案，用户既看不到 `Insufficient account balance`，也看不到任何细节，只会被告知去检查 API key。

**2. `401|403` 在 413 分支之前就被归类为 `AUTH`**
`dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js` 的 `classifyPiAiError`：

```js
if (/\b(?:401|403)\b/.test(message)) return "AUTH";
if (isQuotaExceededError(message)) return QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE;
if (/\b429\b|rate.?limit/i.test(message)) return "RATE_LIMIT";
if (/\b413\b|failed to buffer the request body:\s*length limit exceeded|payload too large|request body too large/i.test(message)) return "INVALID_REQUEST";
```

413 分支已存在，但含 `403` 的消息会先返回 `AUTH`。（`dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js:1527` 有同样的 `401||403 → AUTH` 映射。）该顺序还与故障转移相互作用：413 与 403 可能出现在同一次逻辑失败里，只有最后一个能活到归类阶段。

**3. 默认图片预算（20 MiB）可能高于网关上限**
`dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js`：

```js
const DEFAULT_MAX_REQUEST_IMAGE_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
```

其文档注释已准确描述了这个意图：

> Every image in history is re-encoded into every request body, so an unbounded conversation eventually exceeds a provider or gateway request-size cap and the session can never complete another request. … Deployments behind stricter gateways lower it per route.

本次正是如此：网关上限为 **8 MiB**，而默认 20 MiB 高于它，卸载策略在网关拒绝之前根本不会触发。

## Expected behavior

1. `AUTH` 时不替换真实错误，展示（或附加）底层 message。
2. 调整 `classifyPiAiError` 顺序/判据，使体积信号不被 `403` 掩盖；可考虑区分「体积被拒后经故障转移产生的 403」。
3. 显著说明与网关上限的相互作用，和/或在收到 request-too-large 时自动收紧图片预算并重试一次，而不是直接让本轮失败。

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.2
- provider `api: openai-completions`（`dsh-llm-pi-ai`），OpenAI 兼容网关，请求体上限 8 MiB（8388608 B）
- 触发会话：75 张唯一图片附件、原始约 39 MB（数张 1–2 MB 截图）

## 备注：`/compact` 不能缓解

实测压缩完成后（文本 0.04 MB、0 张图片），下一轮**仍然 403**。压缩只减少文本，图片载荷会从历史里被重新内联。可行规避是按 provider 下调图片预算：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    <provider>:
      maxRequestImageBytes: 6291456   # 6 MiB，留在网关 8 MiB 之下
```

已验证可解决。

discussions.title: Bug: SessionFormatError "format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind" - agent turns intermittently fail (core 0.1.7-rc.1)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Agent turns intermittently fail with `SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind` when the session persistence layer encodes an event. The session itself survives (later turns succeed), but the failed turn is lost and automatic title generation + projection cache writes also fail.

## Environment

- DSH Desktop 2.0.14 (dsh-plugin-desktop), core **0.1.7-rc.1**
- Windows 11 x64, Node v24.18.1
- Session storage: `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` (v4 format, zstd-compressed)

## Symptom (host log)

```
[E] [dsh-agent-error] agent turn failed (session <id>, turn N, step 0/1): format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
[E] [dsh-agent-error] SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
    at source (…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:126:144)
    at assertV4SourceRowAdmission (…/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:150:71)
    at assertV4RowAdmission (…/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:1112:2)
    at Object.encodeEvent (…/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:1097:3)
    at eventLine (… dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:955:45)
    at eventLines (…/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:947:16)
    at Proxy.encodeEventBatch (…/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:3196:16)
    at Object.apply (…/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at Proxy.appendLines (…/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:3216:30)
```

Followed by:
```
[W] [session-title-service] automatic title generation failed: SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
[W] [session-projection-cache] session projection cache: turn/end write failed (cache stays stale): SessionFormatError: …
```

## Observations

- Occurs on **random hints of a random turn**: in one session turns 1–3 (first hints right after session creation), then the same session works fine for many turns; in another session turns 10–11 failed, and the surrounding turns succeeded. It is not deterministic, and no single message type in the session log obviously differs from successful turns.
- Also reproduced on a session whose first turn failed with `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` (user had picked the `deepseek-official` provider without an API key configured): the failed turn's error-report write then hit the same `SessionFormatError`, masking the primary cause.
- Same core behavior in two independent runs of DSH Desktop 2.0.14 (core 0.1.7-rc.1).

## Analysis / hypothesis

The error is raised by `source()` in `dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js`:
- `assertV4SourceRowAdmission` (line ~142) only throws for messages whose `source.kind === "plugin"` (retired v3 wrapper syntax);
- `assertV4MessageSources` (line ~132) requires every durable message to have a non-empty `source.kind` that is not `"plugin"`.

So at least one event being encoded contains a message with `source.kind === "plugin"` (or an empty/missing source) — most likely the agent-error report message written by `dsh-agent-error` (or an inbox splice produced by a plugin) which still uses the retired v3 `{ kind: "plugin", plugin: "…" }` shape. Because the failure happens inside `encodeEventBatch`, the whole batch write fails and the primary turn error is swallowed (the log shows only the SessionFormatError, no earlier `[E]`).

## Expected behavior

- A turn that fails for a real reason (network, missing credential, etc.) should record its error message in the session log even when that message originates from a plugin producer; the v4 admission check should either accept/adopt plugin-produced error messages or explicitly surface the offending event (seq + type) so the primary error is not masked.
- At minimum, the diagnostic should name the event/seq that failed admission instead of failing the whole batch silently.

## Notes

- This is a release-candidate core (0.1.7-rc.1); happy to provide the zstd session file that reproduces it on request (it contains no credentials; provider names and session ids can be redacted).
- Search of existing issues found no prior report for `SessionFormatError` / "producer-owned source kind".

discussions.title: [Bug] 网页端静默吞掉 session/create 错误；dsh-persona 预设 schema 把 text 改名为 prefix，旧预设无迁移提示直接失效
discussions.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 免责声明 / Disclaimer：本报告由 AI 助手（ZCode，GLM 模型）代为排查并提交，诊断过程在机主本地完成，报告内容已由机主审核确认。
> This report was investigated and submitted by an AI agent (ZCode, powered by GLM) on behalf of the account owner, with content reviewed and approved by the owner.

## 环境
- dsh: 0.1.5-rc.3（从 0.1.1-rc.2 时期的旧版本升级）
- 操作系统: Windows 11 (build 26200)
- 启动方式: web profile（`dsh web`）

## 问题概述
升级到 0.1.5-rc.3 后遇到两个相关问题：

1. **schema 破坏性变更，没有迁移提示**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 把必填字段 `text` 改名为 `prefix`。按旧版字段名写的预设（`config.text: |-`）现在直接校验失败，导致默认 agent 预设挂载失败，**所有新建会话全部失败**。
   - 0.1.1-rc.2 的 schema：`{ text: required, complete, includeRuntimeContext }`
   - 0.1.5-rc.3 的 schema：`{ prefix: required, suffix: "", complete, includeRuntimeContext }`

2. **网页端对 session/create 失败完全静默**：没有任何 toast / 弹窗，浏览器控制台也没有报错。用户点“新建会话”就像点了个死按钮。真实错误只能靠手动抓网络响应才能看到。

## 复现步骤
1. 有一个挂载了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 的 agent 预设，persona 字段使用旧版名 `text:`。
2. 升级 dsh 到 0.1.5-rc.3，运行 `dsh web`。
3. 点击“新建会话”。

实际结果：界面毫无反应，没有创建任何会话，UI 各处都不显示错误。
期望结果：要么对 `text` 做兼容别名 / 迁移提示，要么至少给出一个可见的错误，告诉用户预设挂载失败了。

## 证据
抓到的 `POST /api/session/create`（RPC 信封）响应：

```json
{"type":"server-response","result":{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"agent-preset/invalid","message":"agent-presets: preset \"custom-mode\" failed to mount: failed to apply loader entry persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona): invalid config:\n  - $.prefix missing required value (at prefix) (C:\\Users\\<me>\\.dsh\\.agent-presets\\custom-mode\\agent.cordis.yml)","details":{"agentPreset":"custom-mode","reason":"failed to apply loader entry persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona): invalid config:\n  - $.prefix missing required value (at prefix)"}}}}
```

把预设文件里的 `text:` 改成 `prefix:` 后立刻恢复正常（无需重启），说明挂载是每次 session/create 时重新执行的。

## 建议
- 网页端把 session/create（以及其他 RPC 返回 `ok:false`）的错误以 toast / 通知形式展示出来。
- 考虑在 Host 启动时就校验并大声告警挂载失败的预设，而不是拖到每次新建会话才报。
- 给 `text` 保留一个废弃别名（或在 release notes 里加一行迁移说明），都能避免这种完全无声的破坏。

discussions.title: [Bug] 「加载历史」偶发永久卡住、只有刷新能恢复：等待 socket 的 waiter 永不 settle（含根因与社区补丁）/ Loading history hangs forever: waiters on the Remote stream socket are never settled (root cause & community patch available)
discussions.body:
> 📌 **【现状总结 · 2026-09-27 更新】本楼已经长出三条独立的链，新来的同学请先读这一节。** > 📌 **【Current state · updated 2026-09-27】This thread has grown three independent chains — if you are new here, read this section first.** --- ## 📌 现状总结 / Current state **一句话。** 本楼最初报的「切到会话后『载入历史』永久卡住」，已定位为 **DSH 客户端自身的两处缺陷**（socket waiter 没有超时兜底、会话状态机三处漏格），另有**一条独立的浏览器兼容性 bug**（只在 Gecko / WebKit 上成立）。三条链的**补丁集**与**只读诊断探针**都已开源。 **In one line.** The original report here — "『loading history』 hangs forever when switching to a session" — has been traced to **two defects in DSH's own client** (no timeout on the socket waiter; three holes in the session state machine), plus **one independent browser-compatibility bug** (Gecko / WebKit only). Both the **patch set** and a **read-only diagnostic probe** are open source. ### 三条链 / The three chains | # | 机制 / Mechanism | 症状 / Symptom | 证据 / Evidence | 影响面 / Browsers | |---|---|---|---|---| | ① | `waitForSocket()` 无超时；`maintain()` 只在 connect **失败**时唤醒 waiter；`keepAlive` 只在结算后清空 ⇒ socket 停在 `CONNECTING` 时 waiter 永久 pending / no timeout; `maintain()` wakes waiters only on connect **failure**; `keepAlive` cleared only after settle ⇒ a socket parked in `CONNECTING` leaves waiters pending forever | **永久**卡住，重复点击不重试，只有刷新能恢复 / **permanent**; re-click does not retry; only a refresh recovers | 离线复现 ✅；真机 socket 状态 ⬜ / offline repro ✅; socket state on a real device ⬜ | 全部（与引擎无关）/ all (engine-independent) | | ② | `doOpen` / `resync` 三处状态机漏格（异常在写入 `openState` **之前**抛出、`dispose()` 不碰状态、`resync()` 的 `dispose` 无 try/finally）⇒ 状态永久停在 `loading` / three state-machine holes (the throw precedes the `openState` write, `dispose()` never touches state, `resync()`'s dispose has no try/finally) ⇒ `openState` stuck at `loading` forever | 同上（界面同形）/ same, same UI | 源码 + 离线反证 ✅ / source + offline counterfactual ✅ | 全部 / all | | ③ | `hasIntrinsicConstructor` 用**硬编码单行**比对 `Function.prototype.toString`；Gecko / WebKit 对内置函数返回**多行** ⇒ 判据恒假 ⇒ 一切普通对象被判「不是无损 JSON」/ hard-coded **single-line** comparison; Gecko/WebKit return a **multi-line** form ⇒ the predicate is always false ⇒ every plain object judged invalid | 同上（**界面同形** —— 上游 `doOpen` 先 rethrow 再写 error 态，所以 UI 也只显示「载入历史…」）/ same — upstream `doOpen` rethrows *before* writing the error state, so the UI still shows only "loading history" | 源码（两家引擎）✅ + 真机 ✅ / engine sources ✅ + real device ✅ | **仅 Gecko / WebKit**（Firefox 系、Safari、iOS/iPadOS 上一切浏览器）；**V8 / Hermes 免疫** / **Gecko / WebKit only**; V8 and Hermes are immune | ⚠️ 三条链的**界面症状完全同形**（都停在「载入历史…」）⇒ 光看界面区分不了，需要用下面的判据。 **English:** All three chains **look identical in the UI** (stuck on "loading history"), so the screen alone cannot tell them apart — use the criteria below. ### 怎么判断自己撞的是哪条 / Which chain am I hitting? | 判据 / Criterion | ① / ② | ③ | |---|---|---| | 卡住那一刻，远端 `session/follow` 的**首帧到没到** / did the first `session/follow` frame arrive at the stuck moment | **没到** / no | **到了**（且仍然 loading）/ yes, and still stuck | | 会话当时在不在运行 / was the session running | 运行中（或正在重连）才触发 / only while running (or reconnecting) | 需要**有活跃 attempt**；冷会话走不到这条路 / needs a **live attempt**; - **Seconds late**: sometimes the same session merely takes a few seconds — and a **refresh recovers that instantly too**. **关键对照（都是实测）** / **Key comparisons (all measured)**： | 操作 / Action | 结果 / Result | |---|---| | 切到**静态、不在运行**的会话 / switch to an **idle** session | **完全正常**（秒开）/ **perfectly fine** (instant) | | 切到**正在运行**的会话（主代理**或子代理**都一样）/ switch to a **running** session (main agent **or subagent**) | **卡住**，要等那个 agent 把手上的活干完 / **hangs** until that agent finishes what it is doing | | 同一时刻**刷新页面** / **refresh the page** at that moment | **立刻出来** / **renders immediately** | 还有一层粒度：agent 在**跑命令**时切回去基本不卡；agent 在**思考**（持续流式输出）时切回去**最容易卡**。 Finer granularity: switching back while the agent is **running a command** is usually fine; switching back while the agent is **thinking** (continuously streaming output) is **most likely to hang**. ## 首先排除「慢」/ Not a performance problem - 服务端冷读全路径（6.31 MB / 5,740 事件的会话）：扫帧 2 ms + zstd 解压 107 ms + `JSON.parse` 78 ms + 投影 fold 37 ms + `view`/schema 12 ms ≈ **230 ms**； - 真机端到端连切 6 个会话（含上述最大会话）：**204 / 206 / 208 / 209 / 232 / 285 ms**，没有一次出现 loading 文案、没有一次超时。 - Full server-side cold-read path (6.31 MB / 5,740-event session): frame scan 2 ms + zstd decompress 107 ms + `JSON.parse` 78 ms + projection fold 37 ms + `view`/schema 12 ms ≈ **230 ms**; - Real-device end to end, switching across 6 sessions (including the largest one): **204 / 206 / 208 / 209 / 232 / 285 ms** — the loading UI never appeared and nothing timed out. ⇒ 正常情况下没有可感知等待 ⇒ 本问题**不是性能问题**。 ⇒ Under normal conditions there is no perceptible wait ⇒ this is **not a performance problem**. ## 根因 / Root cause：等待 socket 的 waiter 永远不会被 settle 问题在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway/lib/types/client/stream-client.js`（Remote stream 复用同一条 WebSocket）。**三处「没有兜底」叠加**： The problem lives in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway/lib/types/client/stream-client.js` (the Remote stream muxes every logical stream onto one WebSocket). **Three missing safeguards compound**: 1. **`waitForSocket(signal)`（:246-275）没有超时** —— 退出条件只有两个：socket 变 `OPEN`，或 `signal` 被 abort： **`waitForSocket(signal)` (:246-275) has no timeout** — it can only end when the socket becomes `OPEN`, or when `signal` is aborted: ```js if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) return Promise.resolve(this.socket); ... this.waiters.add(waiter); // 挂进去等 / park the waiter signal.addEventListener('abort', aborted, { once: true }); // 只有 abort 能退出 / only abort wakes it ``` 2. **`maintain()`（:305-318）只在 connect 失败时才处理 waiters**： **`maintain()` (:305-318) only handles waiters when the connect attempt fails**: ```js const revision = this.revision; const task = this.connect().then(() => undefined, (error) => { for (const waiter of [...this.waiters]) { if (waiter.revision <= revision) waiter.reject(error); // ← 只有 connect 失败这条路 / only this path } }); ``` 3. **`keepAlive` 只在该 task settle 之后才清空**（:319-322）⇒ 一旦那次 connect **既不成功也不失败**（socket 停在 `CONNECTING`），`keepAlive` 永远非空；而 `maintain()` 开头就是 `if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN || this.keepAlive !== undefined) return;`（:308）⇒ **再也不会发起新的尝试**。 **`keepAlive` is only cleared once that task settles** (:319-322) ⇒ if the attempt **neither succeeds nor fails** (the socket parks in `CONNECTING`), `keepAlive` stays non-undefined forever; and `maintain()` opens with `if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN || this.keepAlive !== undefined) return;` (:308) ⇒ **no further attempt is ever started**. ⇒ 三者叠加：**waiter 永久 pending** ⇒ `await events.open(...)` 永不返回 ⇒ `Session.openState` 永远停在 `loading`（UI 永久「正在加载」）；同时那个 pending 的 `openPromise` 会被复用（`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/client.js:1857-1865`）⇒ **重复点击不会重发**；**刷新＝全新客户端、没有遗留 waiter** ⇒ 立刻恢复。**四个观察至此全部解释得通。** ⇒ Together: **the waiter stays pending forever** ⇒ `await events.open(...)` never returns ⇒ `Session.openState` stays `loading` (permanent "loading history" in the UI); the pending `openPromise` is then reused (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/client.js:1857-1865`) ⇒ **re-clicking never re-sends**; and **a refresh gives a brand-new client with no leftover waiters** ⇒ immediate recovery. **All four observations are now accounted for.** （附注：`waiter.revision <= revision` 这个过滤确实会漏掉「重连之后新建、带新一代 revision」的 waiter，但**单靠它还不构成「永久」** —— `waiter.revision` 固定、`revision` 只增不减，只要后面还有 connect 失败，它迟早会被 reject。真正让它永久的是上面第 1、3 条。） (Note: the `waiter.revision <= revision` filter does drop waiters created *after* a reconnect (they carry a newer revision) — but **that alone is not what makes it permanent**: `waiter.revision` is fixed while `revision` only grows, so any later connect failure will eventually reject it. What makes it permanent is (1) and (3) above.) ## 离线复现 / Offline reproduction 伪造 `WebSocket` 后直接 `import` 该模块即可复现（**无需宿主、无需网络**），一个脚本、两个场景。实测输出： Fake the `WebSocket` global, `import` the module, and it reproduces (**no host, no network needed**) — one script, two scenarios. Actual output: ``` ===== 场景 A：socket 一直不 open、不 error（卡在 CONNECTING）===== ===== Scenario A: the socket neither opens nor errors (parked in CONNECTING) ===== socket 数=1 readyState=0（0=CONNECTING） 等 1.5 秒（模拟"卡住"）… ⇒ waiter 结果 : PENDING ⇒ waiters 残留 : 1 ⇒ keepAlive 是否非空: true （非空 ⇒ 以后 maintain() 直接 return，不再重试） ✅ 复现：waiter 永久 pending（无超时、无人唤醒） ===== 场景 B：reconnect() 与「新建 waiter」落在同一同步块 ===== ===== Scenario B: reconnect() and creating a waiter in the same synchronous block ===== 此刻 revision=2；waiter 创建于该代 ⇒ waiter 结果 : PENDING ⇒ waiters 残留 : 1 ✅ 复现：waiter 在「旧代 connect 失败」时被 revision 过滤漏掉 ``` ⇒ **只要那条 socket 卡在 `CONNECTING`，`waitForSocket` 的调用方就会无限等下去。** 而 agent 持续产出流（高帧流量）正是最容易把 socket 拖进该状态的时候 —— 与「静态会话正常 / 运行中的会话卡 / 思考时最易卡 / 子代理也一样卡」完全吻合。 ⇒ **Whenever that socket parks in `CONNECTING`, callers of `waitForSocket` wait forever.** An agent continuously streaming output is exactly when the socket is most likely to end up there — which matches "idle sessions fine / running sessions hang / thinking is worst / subagents hang too" precisely. ## 复现状态 / Reproduction status - **GUI 端**：已复现（在子代理持续思考的窗口里切回会话，「正在加载」出现且 **90 秒（353 次采样）不消失**）； - **模块端**：上述离线脚本可稳定复现 waiter 永久 pending。 - ⚠️ 我们**未在真机上直接抓到「某个会话的 waiter 卡住」那一刻的内部状态**（那需要在客户端注入探针），所以「高帧流量 ⇒ socket 卡在 CONNECTING」这一步目前是**由现象反推**、尚未取到直接的 socket 状态证据。欢迎有现场的同学补充。 - **GUI**: reproduced (switching back while a subagent kept thinking showed "loading history" for **90 s over 353 samples**, never resolving); - **Module**: the offline script reproduces a permanently pending waiter reliably. - ⚠️ We have **not** captured the internal state of a stuck waiter on a real device (that would need an injected client-side probe), so "high frame rate ⇒ socket parked in `CONNECTING`" is still **inferred from the symptom**, without direct evidence of the socket state. Reports from anyone with a live reproduction would be very welcome. ## 建议 / Suggested fix 1. 🩸 **给 `waitForSocket()` 加超时**（或统一在 `maintain()` 的收尾里**无条件 reject 全部 waiters**）—— 这是最小、最对症的一条； 2. `maintain()` 的 catch 里**去掉 `waiter.revision` 过滤**，让 connect 失败时**所有**等 socket 的 waiter 一起失败； 3. 顺带：`Session.openState` 的 `loading` 也值得加超时兜底（配合「重试」按钮），避免任何单点失败都表现成「永久转圈」。 1. 🩸 **Give `waitForSocket()` a timeout** (or unconditionally reject every waiter when `maintain()`'s attempt settles) — the smallest and most targeted fix; 2. **Drop the `waiter.revision` filter** in `maintain()`'s catch so that a failed connect fails **all** waiters waiting on the socket; 3. Also worth doing: give `Session.openState === "loading"` a timeout plus a retry button, so no single-point failure can present as an endless spinner. ## ⭐ 后续：补丁与工具已开源 / Follow-up: patches and tooling are now open source 我们把这条链上的**三层问题**都做成了可直接复用的东西，均已开源（MIT）： We turned all three layers of this chain into something directly reusable, and open-sourced it (MIT): **1. 补丁集 / Patch set** —— `dsh-waitforsocket-timeout` 🔗 https://github.com/CNyaotian-Lunar/dsh-waitforsocket-timeout - **第一层（本帖的根因 / layer 1 — the root cause of this thread）**：给**每一次连接尝试**加 **5 秒硬死线** —— 到点仍未 settle 就放弃该次尝试 ⇒ 失败分支接手 ⇒ waiter 被 reject、并触发下一次重试； - **第二层（本帖现象的另一个成因）**：`doOpen` / `resync` 的**三处状态机漏格** —— 非 `RemoteFailure` 异常在被写入 `openState` **之前**就被抛出、`dispose()` 不碰 `openState`、`resync()` 的 `dispose` 没有 `try/finally` ⇒ **状态永久停在 `loading`**（UI 永久转圈且无自愈路径）；修法是「先把状态推进到终结态再抛」+「收尾成 `cold` 后**自动重开一次**」； - **第三层**：一个**独立的 Firefox 兼容性 bug**（详见下面的追加评论）。 补丁脚本自带 **幂等 / 自动备份 / 锚点不匹配即拒绝（exit 2）/ 改后 `node --check` 失败自动回滚**；锚点基于官方 `0.1.7-rc.2` **逐字节核对**过。 **2. 只读诊断探针 / Read-only probe** —— `dsh-open-watchdog` 🔗 https://github.com/CNyaotian-Lunar/dsh-open-watchdog **任何遇到这个问题的人都能安全安装**：它**只观察、不修复**，记录每一次「点击会话行」的完整时间线（加载文案何时出现/消失、**采样的实际间隔**用来识别浏览器节流、`openState` 快照、期间发起的网络请求）。 ⇒ 它正好能补上本帖「复现状态」里那个缺口：**在真实客户端里抓到卡住那一刻的 `openState` / 现场**。（宿主侧那条 HTTP 路由**自己做了 loopback / Host / Origin / content-type 四道闸**，写入侧还有 JSON 校验 + 容量上限 + 限速。） Both are MIT. The **probe** is exactly the piece that fills the gap noted under "Reproduction status" above — it captures the stuck moment *inside a real client*; the **patch set** adds the 5 s deadline plus the state-machine fixes, with idempotence, auto-backup, refuse-on-anchor-mismatch and auto-rollback built into the script, and its anchors are byte-verified against the official `0.1.7-rc.2`. ## 相关 / Related - #7802 —— 原报告（**已撤回**：根因在量级上不成立）/ the original report (**retracted**: the claimed root cause was off by orders of magnitude) - #4416 —— Why Opening a Large Cold History Session Can Stall the Whole Web Server --- *本报告由 DSH agent 定位整理、经人工复核后提交；上述数字与离线复现均可复现。* *Located and written up by a DSH agent, reviewed by a human before posting; every number and the offline reproduction are reproducible.*

discussions.title: [Bug] Web 输入框：微软拼音打中文出现拼音落框、候选词错乱，换输入法即恢复（Lexical 0.49.0）
discussions.body:
## Environment / 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH 版本 | `0.1.5-rc.1`（package.json），install.log 显示实际 tarball 为 `0.1.5-rc.2` |
| 操作系统 | Windows 10 Home（中文版） |
| 浏览器 | 默认浏览器（Chrome / Edge 均有现象） |
| 输入法 | **Microsoft Pinyin（微软拼音）**，系统唯一安装的输入法 |
| 前端编辑器 | Lexical `0.49.0`（见 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js` 中的 `isComposing()`） |
| Profile 第三方插件 | `dsh-connect-workbuddy`、`@liustack/modlens`、`@liustack/modsearch`、`dsh-browser` |

---

## Symptoms / 现象

在 DSH Web 输入框中用微软拼音输入中文时：

1. **拼音字母直接落进输入框**：例如想输入"这样就是…问题就不…"，实际得到 `这样就是jiu问题j不，修苏伊` —— 中间的 `jiu`、`j` 是未被输入法组合窗口吸收的拼音字母
2. **候选词错乱**：出现与所打拼音完全无关的汉字（如 `修苏伊`，xiu-su-yi，与意图输入毫无对应关系）
3. **间歇性**：约 **80% 的时间异常，20% 正常**；切换全角/半角无改善

### 实际输入对照（2026-09-25）

- 意图输入：`这样就是…问题就不…`
- 输入框实际显示：`这样就是jiu问题j不，修苏伊`

### 更早的一次记录（2026-08-16，DSH 会话内）

- 用户原话："现在输入法完全不对了"
- 输入框实际内容：`。ld完全bwan'qwa又wYo舒鲁'芙舒鲁咸习`
- 症状与本次完全一致

---

## ★ Key finding: switching the IME fixes it / 决定性诊断：换输入法即恢复正常

> **This is the most important clue: switching the IME away from Microsoft Pinyin completely resolves the problem.**

在**同一台机器、同一个 DSH 版本、同一个浏览器**下，把输入法从微软拼音切换为其它输入法（如搜狗拼音 / QQ 拼音）后，**中文输入立即恢复正常，问题消失**。

这说明：
- 不是用户环境/系统层面的输入法故障（其它所有应用输入均正常，见下）
- 是 **Microsoft Pinyin 与 DSH 输入框编辑器（Lexical）之间的特定组合兼容性问题**

---

## Ruled out / 已排除的因素

| 候选原因 | 结论 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入法软件本身故障 | ❌ 排除 | **除 DSH 外所有应用（浏览器其它页面、记事本等）中文输入完全正常** |
| 浏览器扩展干扰 | ❌ 基本排除 | 扩展通常全域生效；仅 DSH 出现异常。Edge/Chrome 扩展列表已检查，无翻译类/DOM 改写类扩展 |
| 某次升级引入的回归 | ❌ 排除 | **问题至少自 2026-08-16 起存在**，横跨 `0.1.0-rc.7` → `0.1.1-rc.2` → `0.1.2-alpha.5` → `0.1.5-alpha.2` → `0.1.5-rc.1/rc.2` **共 5 个版本、持续 40 天以上** |
| DSH 第三方插件 | ❌ 排除 | 4 个插件均不触碰 `keydown`/`composition` 事件；且 8/16 出问题时尚未安装 |
| Lexical 版本变更 | ❌ 排除 | `0.1.2-alpha.5` 与 `0.1.5-rc.1` 前端 bundle 内**均为 lexical 0.49.0**，版本未变 |

---

## Steps to reproduce / 复现步骤

1. Windows 中文环境，系统输入法为 **Microsoft Pinyin（微软拼音）**
2. 启动 DSH Web（默认浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）
3. 在聊天输入框中，用微软拼音连续输入中文（如"所以说，问题就是这样"）
4. 观察：约 80% 概率出现拼音字母残留 + 候选词错乱
5. **切换输入法为搜狗拼音 / QQ 拼音，重复步骤 3 → 输入完全正常**

---

## Expected behavior / 期望行为

中文输入法组合期间（composition），拼音字母应只存在于输入法组合窗口，**不应写入编辑器内容**；`compositionend` 后应正确提交用户所选候选词。

---

## Upstream hint / 给开发者的上游线索

Lexical 上游存在专门的 `composition` issue 标签，并有针对微软 IME 的相关报告，例如：

- **facebook/lexical#4396 — "Microsoft IME issue in Markdown shortcuts plugin"**（`all-platforms-bug` + `composition` 标签）
- facebook/lexical#8026 — 非英文输入法导致输入被阻塞
- facebook/lexical#8834 — IME composition 提交时的视口滚动问题（至今 Open）

DSH 当前使用的 Lexical 为 `0.49.0`，上游最新为 `0.51.0`。建议核查：

1. 输入框编辑器对 `compositionstart` / `compositionupdate` / `compositionend` 的处理，是否存在与微软拼音时序不匹配（竞态）
2. 是否可通过升级 Lexical 至 0.50/0.51 缓解
3. 是否需要针对 Microsoft Pinyin 的 composition 事件做特殊处理

---

## Notes / 附加说明

- DSH 从 `0.1.5-rc.1` 到最新 `v0.1.7` 的全部 Release Notes 中，**未见任何 IME / 输入法 / composition 相关修复条目**；GitHub Issues 检索 IME、输入法、composition、pinyin 亦为**零结果**，本 issue 可能是首个报告。
- 用户可接受的临时绕过方式：在其它应用打好中文后复制粘贴到输入框（纯文本粘贴不受影响）。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows：工作区位于非系统盘时 ACL 沙箱必然初始化失败（Win32 5 / grantWrite）/ ACL sandbox fails on non-system drives: the default ACL grants the caller no WRITE_OWNER
discussions.body:
## 环境 / Environment

- Windows 11，全部卷均为 NTFS（`Get-Volume` 确认，**不是** FAT 卷）
- DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`（npm `next` 通道）；沙箱后端 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`（随 0.1.7-rc.2 提供）
- 文件策略：`workspace-write`
- 工作区：**非系统盘**上的目录（`F:\<workspace>`，不在 `%USERPROFILE%` 之下）
- 进程身份：普通用户（未提权），`whoami /groups` 显示 `Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level`

- Windows 11, all volumes NTFS (`Get-Volume` confirms; it is **not** a FAT volume)
- DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` (npm `next` channel); sandbox backend `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` (shipped with 0.1.7-rc.2)
- File policy: `workspace-write`
- Workspace: a directory on a **non-system drive** (`F:\<workspace>`, not under `%USERPROFILE%`)
- Process identity: regular user (unelevated); `whoami /groups` shows `Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level`

## 现象 / Symptom

将文件策略设为 `workspace-write` 后，**所有** pwsh / bash 调用立即失败 —— 连无副作用的最小命令都不行：

With the file policy set to `workspace-write`, **every** pwsh / bash invocation fails immediately — even a side-effect-free minimal command:

```
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(F:\<workspace>)
```

同一会话内把策略切回 `danger-full-access`，同一条命令**立刻正常**。⇒ 失败发生在沙箱初始化阶段（子进程尚未创建），不是命令本身的问题。

Switching the policy back to `danger-full-access` in the same session makes the very same command work **immediately**. ⇒ The failure happens during sandbox initialization (no child process is ever created), so it is not about the command itself.

按包内 README 的说明，`init()` 是 fail-closed：任何 Win32 失败都会抛错、绝不 spawn 未受限的子进程 —— **这个行为本身是对的**；问题在于该环境下**永远无法满足** `grantWrite` 的前提，而且用户拿不到可操作的提示。

As the package README states, `init()` is fail-closed: any Win32 failure throws and an unrestricted child is never spawned — **that behavior is correct**; the problem is that in this environment the precondition of `grantWrite` can **never** be satisfied, and the user gets no actionable hint.

## 根因 / Root cause

`grantWrite()` 在一次 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 调用里同时改 **DACL** 与 **SACL 的 mandatory integrity label**（`LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION`）。

`grantWrite()` changes the **DACL** and the **SACL's mandatory integrity label** (`LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION`) in a single `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` call.

- 目录的**属主**只隐含 `READ_CONTROL` + `WRITE_DAC`；**写标签需要 `WRITE_OWNER`**（与包内 README「被授权目录必须由调用者拥有并授予 `WRITE_OWNER`」的已知限制一致）。
  A directory's **owner** implies only `READ_CONTROL` + `WRITE_DAC`; **writing the label needs `WRITE_OWNER`** (consistent with the package README's known limitation: the granted directory must be owned by the caller with `WRITE_OWNER` granted).
- Windows **非系统盘**的默认 ACL 为 `NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users: Modify` + `BUILTIN\Users: ReadAndExecute`（继承），**不含**创建者/调用者的 FullControl ⇒ 调用者没有 `WRITE_OWNER`。
  A **non-system drive**'s default ACL is `NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users: Modify` + `BUILTIN\Users: ReadAndExecute` (inherited) and does **not** include FullControl for the creator/caller ⇒ the caller lacks `WRITE_OWNER`.
- 于是 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 返回 `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5)`，`init()` fail-closed 抛错。
  Hence `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` returns `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5)` and `init()` throws, fail-closed.

对照事实：`C:\Users\<user>\…` 下新建的目录**天生带**调用者 `FullControl`（继承），因此同样代码在系统盘用户目录下工作正常 —— 这也是为什么该问题在常规开发环境下不会被发现。

For contrast: directories created under `C:\Users\<user>\…` **inherit FullControl** for the caller, so the same code works fine there — which is exactly why this problem is invisible in the usual development setup.

> 复现后现场 ACL 里可以看到沙箱此前成功授予过留下的能力 SID ACE（`S-1-4-…`），说明该目录曾经满足过前提；一旦换成"非系统盘新建目录"这种默认 ACL，就会稳定失败。
> After reproducing, the live ACL shows a leftover capability-SID ACE (`S-1-4-…`) from a previous successful grant, i.e. the directory once satisfied the precondition; with the default ACL of a "fresh directory on a non-system drive" it fails deterministically.

## 最小复现 / Minimal reproduction

不需要启动 DSH，用系统自带 `icacls` 就能复现同一条权限路径：

No DSH install needed — the built-in `icacls` reproduces the very same privilege path:

```powershell
# 1) 非系统盘新建目录（继承该盘默认 ACL）/ create a directory on a non-system drive (inherits that volume's default ACL)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force F:\probe | Out-Null
(Get-Acl F:\probe).Access | Where-Object IdentityReference -match $env:USERNAME   # → 无输出：调用者没有显式 ACE / no output: caller has no explicit ACE

# 2) 写 Low 完整性标签 == 沙箱 grantWrite 要做的同一件事 / write the Low integrity label == what sandbox grantWrite does
icacls F:\probe /setintegritylevel Low
#   → Access is denied. (exit code 5)          ← 与 DSH 报的 Win32 5 一致 / same Win32 5 DSH reports

# 3) 给调用者补一条完全控制（含 WRITE_OWNER）/ grant the caller FullControl (includes WRITE_OWNER)
icacls F:\probe /grant "$env:USERNAME:(OI)(CI)F"

# 4) 同一操作立刻成功 / the same operation now succeeds
icacls F:\probe /setintegritylevel Low
#   → Successfully processed 1 files. (exit code 0)
```

对照实验：在 `C:\Users\<user>\` 下重复第 1~2 步 —— **天生成功**（新目录继承调用者 FullControl）。

Control experiment: repeat steps 1–2 under `C:\Users\<user>\` — it **succeeds out of the box** (new directories inherit FullControl for the caller).

## 影响 / Impact

- 任何把工作区放在非系统盘的 Windows 用户：`workspace-write` **完全不可用**（AI 无法执行任何 shell 命令），只能退到 `danger-full-access` —— 恰好是沙箱想要避免的那个状态。这属于**静默降级成不安全配置**的路径。
  Any Windows user whose workspace lives on a non-system drive: `workspace-write` is **entirely unusable** (the agent cannot run any shell command), forcing a fallback to `danger-full-access` — precisely the state the sandbox exists to prevent. This is a **silent downgrade to an unsafe configuration**.
- 报错只有裸 `Win32 5`，没有说明"该目录缺少 `WRITE_OWNER`"，也没有修复办法；README 里的限制说明在故障当下不可见（用户看到的只是 GUI 里一条报错）。
  The error is a bare `Win32 5` with no mention that the directory lacks `WRITE_OWNER` and no fix; the README limitation is invisible at failure time (all the user sees is one error line in the GUI).
- 失败是**必然且稳定**的（不是竞态），因此会直接劝退这一类用户使用沙箱。
  The failure is **deterministic and stable** (not a race), which effectively drives this class of users away from the sandbox.

## 修复方法 / How to fix

### A. 立刻可用（用户侧）/ Immediately available (user side)

给工作区目录补一条调用者的完全控制（**含 `WRITE_OWNER`**），沙箱即可正常初始化：

Grant the workspace directory FullControl for the caller (**which includes `WRITE_OWNER`**) and the sandbox initializes normally:

```powershell
icacls <workspace> /grant "<user>:(OI)(CI)F"     # 全树继承传播约 3~4 分钟 / propagates across the tree, ~3–4 min
# 回滚 / rollback：
icacls <workspace> /remove:g "<user>"
```

（等价替代：`icacls <workspace> /setowner "<user>"`，或把工作区放到 `C:\Users\<user>\…` 之下。）

(Equivalents: `icacls <workspace> /setowner "<user>"`, or simply put the workspace under `C:\Users\<user>\…`.)

### B. 根治（上游）/ Proper fix (upstream)

1. **启动时预检 + 可执行指引**：在 `init()` 之前对每个 writable root 做能力探测（能否写 SACL / 是否具备 `WRITE_OWNER`）。失败时给出**可直接粘贴的修复命令**（即上面那条 `icacls`）与文档链接，而不是只抛 Win32 码。
   **Pre-flight check + actionable guidance**: probe each writable root's capability (can it write the SACL / does it have `WRITE_OWNER`) before `init()`, and on failure print the **paste-ready fix command** above plus a doc link, instead of a bare Win32 code.
2. **可选的降级而非全盘失败**：若写 SACL 标签失败，是否可以在**明确告知"隔离强度下降"**的前提下，只施加 capability ACE 并继续（或在错误里区分「DACL 写入失败」与「标签写入失败」两个分支）？当前"整条命令路径全死"的代价，比"少了 Low 标签"更大。
   **Optional degradation instead of total failure**: when the SACL label write fails, could DSH still apply the capability ACE and continue, **while clearly reporting reduced isolation strength**? (Or at least distinguish "DACL write failed" from "label write failed" in the error.) Today's cost — the entire command path dying — is larger than the missing Low label.
3. **文档/UI 明确前提**：工作区需位于**调用者拥有完全控制**的目录；非系统盘默认 ACL 不满足，并给出一次性授权步骤。
   **Document the precondition** (both README and UI): the workspace must live in a directory the caller fully controls; non-system drives do not satisfy this by default — include the one-time grant step.
4. **可选的显式初始化命令**（例如 `--grant-workspace-acl`）：在用户知情下完成能力 SID 授权与 Low 标签施加，与当前 standing-grant 的设计一致（保持"常驻 ACE 作复用缓存"的既有语义）。
   **Optional explicit initialization command** (e.g. `--grant-workspace-acl`): perform the capability-SID grant and Low label on the user's explicit behalf, consistent with today's standing-grant design ("persistent ACE as a reuse cache").
5. `read-only` 建议纳入同一预检：它本身不 grant，但 spawn 的 Low 完整性令牌仍依赖标签可达性。
   `read-only` should share the same pre-flight: it grants nothing itself, but the spawned Low-integrity token still depends on the label being reachable.

## 相关 / Related

- **#7771** —— 同一缺陷的另一个入口（目录所有者是 `BUILTIN\Administrators`）/ the other entry point of the same defect (directory owner is `BUILTIN\Administrators`)

*本报告由 DSH agent 定位整理、经人工复核。*
*Located and written up by a DSH agent, reviewed by a human before posting.*

discussions.title: Docs describe Schedule as mounted in the shipped Web composition, but the bundle ships its rows disabled
discussions.body:
## What I found

`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` declares `time-context`, `schedule`, and `ui-schedule` with `disabled: true`, and `packages/bundle/web-app/README.md` states that default: "The shipped composition disables `schedule`, `ui-schedule`, and `time-context` by default."

Four other documents still describe the shipped Web composition as mounting them, and no user-facing page says the feature is off by default or how to turn it on. Observed on `master` at `477b4f4205` (`dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2`).

## Evidence

| Document | Says | Shipped reality |
|---|---|---|
| `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-24-web-default-schedule-composition.md:13` | "inserts `time-context` and `schedule` in its Host row list and leaves `ui-schedule` enabled"; the `web` profile "consequently ships the Automation tasks page, the Session-header reminder clock, … and `schedule_create`, `schedule_list`, `schedule_update`, and `schedule_delete` on every live root Agent" | all three rows carry `disabled: true` |
| same note, line 37 (`Consequences`) | "A deployment that wants the previous behavior **disables** the `time-context`, `schedule`, and `ui-schedule` rows in its own profile patch layer" | a deployment needs the inverse patch to get what the note describes |
| `docs/subsystems/schedule.md` | "The shipped Web bundle mounts time-context, which samples the browser's IANA zone for every prompt." | `time-context` is disabled by default |
| `packages/schedule/schedule/README.md:26` | "The shipped Web bundle mounts the service alongside storage-domain and the Session controller." | true only under an opt-in patch |
| `packages/bundle/web-app/README.md` | "The shipped composition disables `schedule`, `ui-schedule`, and `time-context` by default." | matches the rows |

`apps/web/tests/schedule-after.e2e.ts:843-852` pins the shipped answer: `ui-schedule` is `disabled: true`, and `time-context` and `schedule` each appear exactly once.

The flip came in the `feat(web): disable shipped schedule and time context plugins` change (with `test(web): align shipped composition fixtures with disabled scheduling`). That change does not touch the note it reverses, and its own commit has no body. The note's only later edit appended a spill-budget bullet whose commit message repeats the earlier premise: "The shipped Web composition now puts four Schedule tools on every live root Agent, which pushes a full-preset `cordis_inspect_query` answer past the 12,500-token inline budget."

The note's closing `Consequences` bullet is contradicted as well: it records that "the repository preview image and both Web suites drop their overlay arguments, so one composition change reaches every surface at once", but those arguments came back with the flip — `apps/cli/tests/profiles/web/tests/schedule-timing.expected.e2e.ts:11` and `apps/web/tests/schedule-after.e2e.ts:275,713` pass the two new fixtures.

## Why it matters

1. A note under `implemented/` reads as current reality, so nothing on the page shows that the mount decision was reversed the day after it was recorded; the note's `Alternatives considered` still argues for shipping the rows.
2. `docs/user/guide/schedule.md` documents the whole feature without saying it is off by default, and no page carries the opt-in. The example overlay the note deleted (`apps/cli/config/examples/schedule/cordis.yml`) had been the only copy-pasteable path; the shape now survives only in two test fixtures (`apps/cli/tests/profiles/web/tests/fixtures/schedule.patch.yml`, `apps/web/tests/fixtures/time-context-every-step.patch.yml`).
3. The note's recorded reason for deleting that overlay — "`applyEntryPatches` appends an `insert` list without de-duplicating ids, so keeping the overlay would mount `time-context` and `schedule` a second time" — now works in the opposite direction. A user layer written against the note's instruction duplicates ids that the shipped layer already declares. Nothing fails today, because the shipped copies are disabled and the one-row-per-id invariant is asserted only against the shipped composition, but if the default flips back the same layer becomes two live mounts of one plugin.

## Question

Is the disabled default the intended end state, or a hold while the Automation-tasks surface settles?

- **End state** → the note's Decision paragraph, its "consequently ships …" sentence, and the closing `Consequences` bullets need their realized facts updated, along with the composition sentences in `docs/subsystems/schedule.md` and `packages/schedule/schedule/README.md`. The user guide (or the bundle README) would also need the opt-in recipe, since users cannot discover it today.
- **Hold** → the note could record that, so a reader does not treat the enabled composition as shipped reality.

I am happy to help with wording on either path; this is a report only, per the contribution guidance that external pull requests are not being accepted at the moment.
