discussions.title: Windows: revealNativePath silently reveals nothing — windowsHide: true hides the Explorer window it spawns
discussions.body:
## Title

Windows: `revealNativePath` silently reveals nothing — `windowsHide: true` hides the Explorer window it spawns

## Affected

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.5-rc.3`, **still present in `0.1.7-rc.2`** (published 2026-09-24; verified by
downloading the published tarball and reading `lib/index.js`).

Environment: Windows 10 19045, Node 24.15.0, `dsh@0.1.5-rc.3`, `dsh web`.

## Symptom

Deliverables card → menu → "Show in File Explorer" reports success (the card shows
"已请求在文件资源管理器中显示" / "Requested display in file manager", i.e. `POST /api/present.open?...&action=reveal`
returned 204), but no Explorer window appears.

## Root cause

`runNativeCommand` spawns **every** host command with `windowsHide: true`
(`lib/index.js:17-22` in 0.1.5-rc.3; `lib/index.js:18-37` in 0.1.7-rc.2). On Windows Node maps that to
`STARTUPINFO.wShowWindow = SW_HIDE` (plus `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`). That is the right default for the console helpers
this runner was written for (`reg.exe`, `powershell.exe`, `wslpath`), but `explorer.exe` is a GUI process: the
window it creates exists yet is never shown.

Measured on the same command with only that flag changed:

| spawn options | new window | `IsWindowVisible` |
|---|---|---|
| `windowsHide: true` | created (found via `Shell.Application.Windows()`) | **false** |
| `windowsHide: false` | created | **true** |

The process starts and exits normally, so the route reports success.

## Repro (self-contained; opens at most 2 windows)

```powershell
Add-Type -Namespace W -Name U -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr hWnd);'
$target = 'file:///C:/Windows/win.ini'
node -e "require('child_process').execFile('explorer.exe',['/select,','$target'],{windowsHide:true},()=>{})"
Start-Sleep 4
(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).Windows() |
  Where-Object { $_.LocationURL -eq 'file:///C:/Windows' } |
  ForEach-Object { "{0} visible={1}" -f $_.HWND, [W.U]::IsWindowVisible([System.IntPtr][int64]$_.HWND) }
```

The window is present with `visible=False`; repeat with `{windowsHide:false}` and it reports `visible=True`.

## Secondary issue that makes the failure silent

`runExplorer` accepts **any** `explorer.exe` exit 1 as a successful delegated handoff
(`lib/index.js:233` in 0.1.5-rc.3; `lib/index.js:146` in 0.1.7-rc.2). A genuine failure therefore also returns 204
and the UI claims success. Distinguishing real failures (or at least logging stderr) would have surfaced this bug
immediately instead of presenting it as success.

## Suggested fix

Give the runner a per-call override, and keep the GUI launcher visible:

```diff
-const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal, options = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 	execFile(command, [...args], {
 		encoding: "utf8",
 		signal,
-		windowsHide: true
+		windowsHide: true,
+		...options
 	}, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
```

then at the `explorer.exe` call site — in 0.1.7-rc.2 there is now exactly one, inside `runExplorer`, which serves
both open and reveal:

```diff
-		await run("explorer.exe", args, signal);
+		await run("explorer.exe", args, signal, { windowsHide: false });
```

In 0.1.5-rc.3 the site is `await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);`.
Alternatively, route `explorer.exe` through the visibility policy `dsh-host-open-in-app` already applies
(`launchDetachedApp` passes `windowsHide: options.windowsHide`, false for GUI adapters) — the codebase has the
concept; only the generic runner lacks it.

## Scope

Windows only — macOS `open -R` and Linux `xdg-open` are unaffected. In 0.1.7-rc.2 the blast radius is wider:
`openWindowsPath` now also goes through `runExplorer`, so "open in default application" would open invisibly as
well, not just "show in file manager".

## Why it may have been missed

The comments assume `explorer.exe` hands the request to the already-running desktop process and exits 1; on that
path the window is created by the shell process and stays visible. The hidden-window case needs the spawned
`explorer.exe` to create the window itself, as it does on this machine. Linux/macOS CI would not exercise it.

Unrelated but worth noting: the new `explorerTarget()` escaping work in 0.1.7-rc.2 (commas, equals signs,
non-ASCII percent-escapes, `\\?\` prefixes) is exactly the kind of care this call site needs — the command line
was never the problem.

discussions.title: Bug: 工具调用把系统键盘焦点移到自己的窗口，导致输入被投递到别处并污染用户文本 — 模型无法判断用户是否在打字
discussions.body:
TL;DR
工具调用在启动本地程序时，会把该程序窗口提到操作系统前台，并且键盘焦点随之移入那个窗口。
此后用户敲下的字符不再进入 GUI 的对话输入框，而是被投递给那个程序，因此用户正在输入的
文字会被打乱、插入无关字符。最严重的后果是：用户想插话叫停正在运行的 agent 时打不了字，
而模型执行工具的时刻恰好就是用户最需要叫停的时刻。实测：前台与前台线程内的焦点控件都会
切换到被拉起的进程，持续时间从约 0.25 秒到数秒不等，且不一定会自动恢复——所以表现为
间歇性故障。模型没有任何办法查询"用户此刻是否在打字"，dsh 在前台/焦点发生变化时也不做
任何提示。

Environment
OS：Windows 11 25H2（构建 10.0.26200.9457），x64 / AMD64
客户端：Microsoft Edge 153.0.4234.48（Chromium）—— GUI 是浏览器标签页，不是独立外壳
dsh：0.1.5-rc.1，npm 全局安装（非 dev source 启动），以 dsh web 启动
Node v24.18.0；Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9444 (Desktop)，无 pwsh
工具调用以本地 PowerShell 进程执行
这些进程可用的相关系统 API：SetForegroundWindow、AttachThreadInput、SetCursorPos、mouse_event

实测数据

采样方式：每 100 ms 通过 GetForegroundWindow + GetWindowThreadProcessId + GetGUIThreadInfo
读取前台窗口与"前台线程内当前焦点控件"（只读，不移动光标、不合成按键）。

第一次采样——工具调用占用前台约 0.26 秒后自动弹回：

    [06:52:59.253] msedge        | <chat window title>
    [06:53:02.202] <launched app> | <its window title>    <- 工具调用夺取前台
    [06:53:02.457] msedge        | <chat window title>   <- 255 ms 后

第二次采样——前台在整个采样窗口内都没有恢复：

    [06:59:34.501] fg=msedge        pid=516    tid=6408   focusHwnd=0x705DE
    [06:59:38.418] fg=<launched app> pid=20032 tid=15176  focusHwnd=0x3103DE  <- 焦点已移入该窗口
    [06:59:50.519] end

关键点是 focusHwnd：被夺取期间，前台线程内的焦点控件属于被拉起的程序而不是浏览器。
也就是说期间的按键会被投递到那个窗口。这解释了用户侧的观察——"我正在打字，输入框里却
插入了别的字符，把句子打乱了"，而不是单纯"输入框失去焦点"。

用户侧观察（供参考，未做因果结论）：同一台机器上，在浏览器里另开一个页面打字是正常的；
只有在 GUI 对话页输入时出现上述现象。

Root cause
工具层既不声明也不协调前台/焦点影响；而 dsh 自身在 spawn 时刻并非前台进程，因此被拉起的
子进程可以合法地夺取前台并把键盘焦点带进自己的窗口。

证据链：

工具调用 spawn 出的子进程不携带任何关于 UI 影响的元数据；调用链路上没有任何环节记录
"我要把某个窗口提到前台"这一意图。
由于 dsh 宿主进程不是当前前台进程，子进程可以先附加到前台线程的输入队列
（AttachThreadInput），再调用 SetForegroundWindow，从而绕过通常的前台锁定保护成功。
实测显示这一操作不仅改变了前台窗口，也改变了前台线程内的焦点控件（focusHwnd），
因此键盘输入被路由到了工具自己的窗口。
dsh 在调用前后都不采样、也不比较前台窗口或焦点控件，因此这次变化从未被 dsh 观察到，
既无法上报给用户，也无法告知模型。
模型没有可用的工具、标志或事件来回答"用户现在是否在打字"，因此无法主动选择非侵入式的
执行方式；正确答案在 agent 循环内部无法得知。
用户无法把症状与 agent 关联：工具调用照常返回成功，界面上也没有任何提示表明焦点被移动过。

与第三方 MCP 服务无关（对分诊很关键）
这是工具层的性质，不是某个 MCP 服务造成的，而且复现根本不需要 MCP：

- 复现只用内置 shell 工具调用。真正改路由按键的那几个调用（SetForegroundWindow /
  AttachThreadInput / SetCursorPos / mouse_event / 合成按键）都是通过内置 shell 工具执行的，
  这条路径上没有任何 MCP 服务参与。把 profile 里的 MCP 服务全部移除，缺陷依然存在。
- 本机唯一启用的 MCP 服务是 wallpaper-engine-mcp：一个本地 stdio 服务，包装 Wallpaper Engine 的
  命令行（command: node，args: <install>\server.mjs）。对该服务源码（server.mjs，约 15.7 KB）的
  检查显示 SetForegroundWindow、AttachThreadInput、SetCursorPos、mouse_event、ShowWindow、
  SetWindowPos、SendKeys 出现次数均为 0。它只做一件事——以 -control openWallpaper 启动
  wallpaper64.exe。它完全不含输入或焦点相关逻辑。
- 因此该服务是诱发场景，不是原因。它贡献的只有一点：它是一个会启动 GUI 程序的工具，而该
  程序的窗口会成为前台。任何会启动或提升 GUI 应用的内置工具效果相同。
- 缺陷成立的真正条件是：工具调用没有声明 UI 影响，且宿主不知道用户是否在输入。
  这对内置工具和 MCP 工具同样成立。

对修复方案的实际影响：uiImpact（或等价机制）必须同时能被内置工具与 MCP 工具声明，
否则宿主仍然无法判断哪些调用会移动前台。

Contributing factors（按影响排序）
任何会启动或提升 GUI 程序的工具调用（打开预览、启动编辑器、打开浏览器、聚焦已有窗口）
都会触发——这是被拉起程序的设计行为，不是意外。影响与 agent 启动本地 GUI 工具的频率成正比。
前台不一定会自动恢复。实测中一次 255 ms 弹回、一次整个窗口期未恢复。用户无法预测，
因此实际感受是"时好时坏"。
光标移动是第二条独立通道：SetCursorPos 加合成点击会移动真实指针，并把点击落在指针下方的
窗口上，可能激活用户从未点过的控件。
在单个脚本内部做防护不会收敛。本机的实际过程：脚本无条件抢焦点 -> 用户反馈输入被打乱
-> 改成"先判断用户是否空闲再抢焦点" -> 该判断的第一版把脚本自己的控制台误判为空闲
-> 焦点又被抢走。这一层的每次自研判断都会漏，不变式应由宿主保证。

Audit cleared：
不是输入法缺陷。前台窗口与前台线程内的焦点控件都发生了真实变化，输入法只是损害显现的地方。
不是浏览器或 webview 的 bug。切换发生在两个顶层操作系统窗口之间，用普通 Win32 调用即可
观察到，与任何渲染进程无关。
不是键盘布局问题。没有发生布局切换。
不是系统级键盘故障。同一台机器上另开页面输入正常。

Ask
增加一道会话级闸门，使工具调用不可能静默夺取前台与键盘焦点：

    input:
      focus_guard: true                # 用户可能正在输入时，拒绝会夺取前台/焦点的工具调用
      require_before_foreground: true  # 提升窗口或改变焦点前必须显式确认

让工具声明自身影响级别，例如 uiImpact: none | cursor | foreground | focus；开启闸门后，
在"用户可能在输入"时不执行带前台/焦点影响的调用。判断"可能在输入"的廉价本地信号：
前台窗口是否属于 GUI 自身、以及最近是否有键盘输入。
调用被拒绝时，把原因返回给模型（例如 refused: foreground belongs to the chat window），
使其改用非侵入式方案，而不是静默失败。
可选：提供只读查询，例如 get_user_presence() 返回
{ "foreground_is_gui": true, "idle_ms": 350, "typing": true }。
可选：前台或焦点确实发生变化时，在会话中留一条可见提示，让用户能把症状与 agent 关联起来。

最小可用子集：只做 focus_guard，加上把拒绝原因返回给模型。不需要新 UI，也不需要改变现有
工具语义。注意该机制需同时覆盖内置工具与 MCP 工具。




TL;DR
A tool call that launches a local program raises its window to the OS foreground, and the
keyboard focus moves into that window with it. From then on the user's keystrokes no longer
reach the chat input; they are delivered to the launched program, so the sentence being typed
is scrambled by inserted characters. The most serious consequence: the user's normal way to
stop a running agent is to type into the chat, and that is exactly the moment when typing
breaks. Measured: both the foreground window and the focus control inside the foreground
thread move to the spawned process, for anywhere between ~0.25 s and the whole tool-call
window, and the foreground does not always come back on its own — which is why this is
experienced as intermittent. The model has no way to query whether the user is typing, and
dsh reports nothing when the foreground or focus changes.

Environment
OS: Windows 11 25H2 (build 10.0.26200.9457), x64 / AMD64
Client: Microsoft Edge 153.0.4234.48 (Chromium) — the GUI is a browser tab, not a dedicated shell
dsh: 0.1.5-rc.1, npm global install (not a dev source launch), launched as dsh web
Node v24.18.0; Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9444 (Desktop), no pwsh
Tool calls executed as local PowerShell processes
Relevant OS APIs available to those processes: SetForegroundWindow, AttachThreadInput,
SetCursorPos, mouse_event

Measured

Sampling: every 100 ms, GetForegroundWindow + GetWindowThreadProcessId + GetGUIThreadInfo to
read the foreground window and the focus control inside the foreground thread. Read-only: no
cursor movement and no synthesized keystrokes.

Run 1 — the tool call held the foreground for ~0.26 s and then it came back:

    [06:52:59.253] msedge        | <chat window title>
    [06:53:02.202] <launched app> | <its window title>    <- tool call takes the foreground
    [06:53:02.457] msedge        | <chat window title>   <- 255 ms later

Run 2 — the foreground never came back inside the sampling window:

    [06:59:34.501] fg=msedge        pid=516    tid=6408   focusHwnd=0x705DE
    [06:59:38.418] fg=<launched app> pid=20032 tid=15176  focusHwnd=0x3103DE  <- focus moved into it
    [06:59:50.519] end

The important field is focusHwnd: while the foreground is taken, the focus control inside the
foreground thread belongs to the launched program, not to the browser. Keystrokes during that
window are therefore delivered to that window. This matches the user-side observation — "I was
typing and unrelated characters got inserted into my text and broke the sentence" — rather than
a plain loss of focus.

User-side observation (context only, no causal claim): on the same machine, typing in another
browser page works normally; the corruption only happens while typing in the GUI chat input.

Root cause
The tool layer neither declares nor coordinates foreground/focus impact, and because the dsh
host process is not the foreground process at spawn time, the spawned child can legally take
the foreground and carry keyboard focus into its own window.

Evidence chain:

The child process spawned by a tool call carries no metadata about UI impact; nothing in the
call path records an intention to raise a window or change focus.
Because the dsh host process is not the current foreground process, the child can attach to
the foreground thread's input queue (AttachThreadInput) and then call SetForegroundWindow,
bypassing the usual foreground-lock protection. Measured: this changes not only the foreground
window but also the focus control inside the foreground thread (focusHwnd), so keyboard input
is routed into the tool's own window.
Nothing samples or compares the foreground window or the focus control around the call, so the
change is never observed by dsh and cannot be reported to the user or the model.
The model has no tool, flag, or event that answers "is the user typing right now?", so it
cannot choose a non-intrusive execution mode; the correct answer is unknowable from inside the
agent loop.
The user cannot correlate the symptom with the agent: the tool call still reports success and
no UI affordance indicates that focus moved.

Not caused by a third-party MCP server (important for triage)
This is a property of the tool layer, not of any particular MCP server, and the reproduction does
not need one:

- Reproduction uses only built-in shell tool calls. The commands that actually reroute keystrokes
  are SetForegroundWindow / AttachThreadInput / SetCursorPos / mouse_event / synthesized keys,
  executed through the built-in shell tool. No MCP server is involved in that path. Removing every
  MCP server from the profile does not remove the defect.
- The one MCP server enabled on this machine is wallpaper-engine-mcp, a local stdio server that
  wraps the Wallpaper Engine CLI (command: node, args: <install>\server.mjs). An audit of that
  server's source (server.mjs, ~15.7 KB) found zero occurrences of SetForegroundWindow,
  AttachThreadInput, SetCursorPos, mouse_event, ShowWindow, SetWindowPos and SendKeys. It only ever
  launches wallpaper64.exe with -control openWallpaper. It contains no input or focus logic at all.
- That server is therefore an occasion, not the cause. It contributes exactly one thing: it is a
  tool that launches a GUI program, whose window becomes foreground. Any built-in tool that starts
  or raises a GUI application does the same.
- What the defect actually requires is: a tool call with no declared UI impact, executed without
  the host knowing whether the user is typing. That is true of built-in tools and MCP tools alike.

Practical consequence for the fix: uiImpact (or equivalent) has to be declarable by built-in tools
and MCP tools both, otherwise the host still cannot tell which calls will move the foreground.

Contributing factors (ranked)
Any tool call that launches or raises a GUI program (open a preview, launch an editor, open a
browser, focus an existing window) triggers this by design of the spawned program. Impact
scales with how often the agent launches local GUI tools.
The foreground does not always come back. One run returned after 255 ms; another never returned
within the window. Users cannot predict it, so it is experienced as flaky.
Cursor motion is a second, independent channel: SetCursorPos plus synthesized clicks move the
physical pointer and land clicks in whatever window is under it, which can activate controls the
user never clicked.
Guarding this inside individual scripts does not converge. On this machine: script steals focus
unconditionally -> user reports scrambled input -> script is changed to "check whether the user is
idle before stealing focus" -> the first version of that check misclassified the script's own
console as idle -> focus is stolen again. Every self-imposed check at that layer leaks; the
invariant belongs to the host.

Audit cleared:
Not an IME defect. Both the foreground window and the focus control inside the foreground thread
genuinely change; the IME is only where the damage becomes visible.
Not a browser or webview bug. The transition is between two top-level OS windows and is
observable with plain Win32 calls, outside any renderer.
Not a keyboard-layout problem. No layout switch occurs.
Not a system-wide keyboard fault. Typing in another page on the same machine is unaffected.

Ask
Add a session-level gate so a tool call cannot silently take the foreground and keyboard focus:

    input:
      focus_guard: true                # refuse tool calls that would take the foreground/focus
      require_before_foreground: true  # require explicit confirmation before raising a window

Let tools declare impact, e.g. uiImpact: none | cursor | foreground | focus. With the guard on,
do not execute a foreground/focus-impacting call while the user is likely typing. Cheap local
signals for "likely typing": whether the foreground window belongs to the GUI itself, and whether
there was recent keyboard input.
When a call is refused, return the reason to the model (e.g. refused: foreground belongs to the
chat window) so it can pick a non-intrusive alternative instead of failing silently.
Optional: expose a read-only query such as get_user_presence() returning
{ "foreground_is_gui": true, "idle_ms": 350, "typing": true }.
Optional: when the foreground or focus did change, leave a visible note in the session so the
user can correlate the symptom with the agent.

Smallest useful subset: focus_guard plus reporting the refusal reason to the model. No new UI and
no change to existing tool semantics are required. Note that the mechanism must cover built-in
tools and MCP tools alike.

discussions.title: dsh-settings: one plugin exporting `Config = null` crashes `describe()` for the whole runtime, and the failure surface is a misleading "inactive context" error
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

`SettingsForms.schema()` checks `schema !== undefined` but not `null`. A plugin that exports `Config = null` — a legitimate JS-level fallback when an optional schema build fails — makes `describe()` throw `TypeError: Cannot use 'in' operator to search for 'toJSON' in null`. The throw aborts the entire `describe()` walk, so **every** consumer that calls `ctx.settings.describe()` during activation gets its fiber marked errored, and all subsequent settings reads/writes fail with:

```
cannot get required service "settings" in inactive context
```

The reported error points at Cordis lifecycle semantics, while the actual cause is a null-safety gap one function away. A one-line fix resolves it (verified on a live 0.1.7-rc.2 install).

## Affected code

`packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts` (master, last touched 2026-09-21 in #4587):

```ts
private schema(entry: Entry): z | undefined {
    const schema = entry.fiber?.runtime?.Config
    return schema !== undefined && 'toJSON' in schema ? schema as z : undefined
    //           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ null passes this check, then "'toJSON' in null" throws
}
```

`runtime.Config` is typed `z | undefined`, so the type system says `null` can't occur. But `Config` is a plain JS module export — a plugin can legally produce `null` there. We hit this in the wild (see below), so the type assumption does not hold in practice.

## Failure cascade

1. Plugin A exports `Config = null` and loads fine (its entry is ACTIVE).
2. Any plugin B whose activation path calls `ctx.settings.describe()` — in our case `dsh-better-sidebar@0.21.1`, whose `inject(['settings'])` callback calls `describe()` synchronously — receives the `TypeError` instead of a descriptor list.
3. Cordis marks B's inject sub-context errored; B's cached context still points at the now-dead fiber.
4. Every later settings operation through B (e.g. `POST /sidebar/api/settings.get|update`) fails: `500`/`400` with `cannot get required service "settings" in inactive context`.
5. The same `TypeError` also fires for `dsh-api-settings-controller`'s `describe()` and the invalidation microtask inside `SettingsForms.invalidate()` — so the **core settings UI is affected by the same walk**, not just one plugin.

Notably this is **deterministic and survives restarts**: it is not a race, a peer-range mismatch, or a lifecycle timing issue — every boot with the offending plugin present reproduces it.

## Why this was hard to diagnose (secondary issue)

The thrown `TypeError` is invisible to operators. The plugin callback's failure is caught by Cordis' `_reload` and routed to `ctx.logger.error(...)`, but dsh's logger does not surface plugin-callback errors on stderr by default. The only externally visible artifact is the downstream `"inactive context"` message, which sends investigation toward Cordis activation timing. It took a bisect over 31 installed plugins plus instrumenting the victim plugin's callback to see the real throw. If plugin-callback errors were printed once (plugin name + error), this class of issue would be a five-minute diagnosis.

## Minimal reproduction

```bash
# 1. fresh profile with just the settings consumer
dsh --profile repro --from-default-profile web
dsh plugin --profile repro add dsh-better-sidebar@0.21.1

# 2. add a plugin that statically exports Config = null.
#    Any package with `"dsh.bundle"` and `module.exports.Config = null` works;
#    the real-world trigger we hit is @weibaohui/dsh-smart-title@0.1.5 on Windows
#    (its optional schemastery probe fails there, and its documented
#    graceful-degradation path sets Config = null).
dsh plugin --profile repro add @weibaohui/dsh-smart-title@0.1.5

# 3. boot and call the plugin's settings route
dsh --profile repro --no-open --port 7800
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7800/sidebar/api/settings.get
# → 500 {"ok":false,"error":{"code":"internal","message":"cannot get required service \"settings\" in inactive context"}}
```

Removing the offending plugin (or patching the one line below) immediately restores `200`.

## Real-world trigger

[`@weibaohui/dsh-smart-title@0.1.5`](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-smart-title) builds its Schemastery `Config` in a try/catch and intentionally degrades to `Config = null` when the schema library can't be resolved. On Windows its host-probe path pattern (`<prefix>/lib/node_modules/...`) never matches the npm-global layout (`node_global\node_modules\...`), so the fallback fires for every Windows user. That plugin's authors chose a reasonable JS-level fallback; the crash is on the consumer side. (Filed separately with the plugin.)

## Suggested fix

```diff
   private schema(entry: Entry): z | undefined {
       const schema = entry.fiber?.runtime?.Config
-      return schema !== undefined && 'toJSON' in schema ? schema as z : undefined
+      return schema != null && 'toJSON' in schema ? schema as z : undefined
   }
```

`!= null` covers both `undefined` and `null`, matching the intent ("skip entries with no usable schema") without changing any other behavior.

Verified: applied to the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@0.1.7-rc.2` on a live profile, the previously failing `settings.get`/`settings.update` calls return `200`, the full `describe()` walk completes, and all 31 installed plugins (including the null-Config one) keep working.

Optional hardening, if you want the type system to admit reality instead of fighting it: type `runtime.Config` as `z | null | undefined`, or treat any non-object `Config` as "no schema".

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.7-rc.2` (npm `next`), Windows 11, Node 22
- `dsh-better-sidebar@0.21.1`, `@weibaohui/dsh-smart-title@0.1.5`
- Clean-profile repro also on `0.1.7-rc.2`; `master` source still shows the unguarded check as of 2026-09-25

discussions.title: macOS: voice input is unusable — the app is signed without com.apple.security.device.audio-input, so macOS refuses to prompt for the microphone
discussions.body:
## Summary

Voice input in the **macOS desktop application** is unusable: pressing the microphone button always fails with

> Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings.

No macOS permission prompt ever appears, and **DeepSeek Harness is never listed in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone**, so the user has nothing to enable. The cause is the application's own code signature, not a setting: the bundle is signed with the hardened runtime but **without the `com.apple.security.device.audio-input` entitlement**, so the system refuses to even offer the prompt.

This is provider-independent — it happens before any speech plugin is involved, so the bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice` provider and third-party providers (I maintain a GigaAM provider) are equally affected. The same machine, same UI, works in a browser.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2`, macOS desktop app (arm64)
- macOS 26.5.1 (25F80)
- Repro on a clean start of the app, with the built-in voice input bundle enabled

## Reproduction

1. Start the desktop application and open any session.
2. Open the voice input UI and press the microphone button.
3. Observe: an immediate error message, no system prompt, and no microphone entry for the app in System Settings.

## Root cause (verified)

**1. The signature lacks the entitlement required by the hardened runtime.**

```
$ codesign -dv --entitlements - "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness"
CodeDirectory v=20500 size=444 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=3+7 location=embedded
TeamIdentifier=<redacted>
[Key] com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit
[Key] com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory
[Key] com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation
```

`Info.plist` correctly declares `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, so the plist side is fine — only the entitlement is missing.

**2. tccd denies the request as a matter of policy, for both the audio check and an explicit request** (unified log, `subsystem == "com.apple.TCC"`):

```
Prompting policy for hardened runtime; service: kTCCServiceMicrophone requires
entitlement com.apple.security.device.audio-input but it is missing for
responsible={TCCDProcess: identifier=com.deepseek.dsh, responsible_path=/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness}

Policy disallows prompt for Sub:{com.deepseek.dsh}...; access to kTCCServiceMicrophone denied
```

The app-side log proves the request is actually attempted (`function=TCCAccessRequest, service=kTCCServiceMicrophone` is sent to `com.apple.tccd`), and the daemon answers "policy disallows prompt" — no user-visible prompt is possible, and no TCC record is ever created, which is why the app never appears in the Microphone pane.

**3. Even without the entitlement problem, the renderer cannot be asked first.** `lib/main.js` installs a permission *check* handler that denies `media` unless the OS status is already `granted`:

```js
session.setPermissionCheckHandler((contents, permission, origin, details) => {
  if (permission !== "media") return true;
  return contents != null && contents === primary() && details.isMainFrame
      && applicationFrame(origin) && details.mediaType === "audio"
      && (process.platform !== "darwin" ||
          systemPreferences.getMediaAccessStatus("microphone") === "granted");
});
```

while the only `askForMediaAccess("microphone")` call sits in the permission *request* handler, which the denied check prevents from running. `getUserMedia` is therefore rejected before the operating system is ever consulted. Requesting access from the Host process directly (`systemPreferences.askForMediaAccess`) also ends in the "policy disallows prompt" denial above.

## Expected

Pressing the microphone shows the standard macOS prompt (“DeepSeek Harness would like to access the microphone”); after allowing it, dictation works — as it already does in the browser UI on the same machine, because the browser carries the entitlement.

## Suggested fix

Ship the Developer ID build with the audio-input entitlement, e.g.:

```xml
<key>com.apple.security.device.audio-input</key>
<true/>
```

That is the only missing piece. A cheap regression guard would be a packaging check asserting the entitlement is present in `codesign -d --entitlements -` output of the packaged app.

## Workaround for users

Use the Web UI in a browser (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?token=…` from the launch log) and grant the microphone to the browser in both the browser and macOS. Applications signed without the entitlement cannot capture audio on macOS, so there is no in-app workaround.

discussions.title: 灵枢 Lingshu —— 让 AI Agent 拥有不可遗忘的、可审计的长期记忆   https://github.com/FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory
discussions.body:
给 Agent 接记忆，最怕两件事：① 跨会话就忘；② 记错了还硬说记对了。
我做的灵枢（Lingshu）专治这两点：对话沉淀成纯文本 md 认知图，原文即真源；记 / 取 / 写全部确定性规则裁决，不靠 LLM 拍板。
无幻觉不是口号：四层证据防火墙白箱剔除弱证据（条件层反事实冒充 8/8 全部 REJECT）；写入过 audit→一致性→gated 三道闸门，只有最终 `committed: true` 才算落盘。
我们刻意不把 `ok:true` 当写成功，没落盘就返回 `moved_to: review_queue`，明说没写进去。
检索（检索侧上界）：中文 hit@1 99.0%（六家横评登顶）、英文经中文语义归一化桥接 hit@10 99.8%。  
评测集 `locomo-zh-500` / `bench6` 随仓公开可复现；第三方七轮独立复评 9.258、LoCoMo 逐位复现。  
标准 MCP，三步挂任意宿主（DSH / CodeBuddy / Claude Code…）。MIT。

discussions.title: [0.1.7-rc.2 regression] CJS resolver cannot resolve punycode/; plugins using jsdom fail to load
discussions.body:
### Summary A plugin whose dependency graph contains a CommonJS module that requires `punycode/` fails to load on dsh **0.1.7-rc.2** with `failed to import`, while the identical plugin activates normally on dsh **0.1.5-rc.2**. The fault is in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot`'s new `ResolutionRouter`, which was rewritten for 0.1.7 and no longer guards `createRequire(...).resolve.paths()`. (Issues are disabled on this repo, so I'm reporting here — apologies if Q&A isn't the right category; happy to repost wherever you prefer.) ### Reproduction - Plugin: `dsh-web-search-pro@0.1.14-alpha.1` (plain npm tarball), which imports `jsdom`. - Require chain: `jsdom` → `whatwg-url` → `tr46` → `require("punycode/")`. | dsh | dsh-app-boot | result | | --- | --- | --- | | 0.1.5-rc.2 | 0.1.5-rc.3 | plugin activates: all 11 tools registered, `browser: injected` | | 0.1.7-rc.2 | 0.1.7-rc.2 | `web-search-pro (dsh-web-search-pro): failed to import` | Both runs used an isolated `DSH_HOME` and a profile with the webserver moved off the default port. ### Defect 1 — unguarded `resolve.paths()` throws and masks the real error `ResolutionRouter.routeScoped` (0.1.7-rc.2, `lib/index.js:1422`): ```js for (const searchPath of createRequire(parent).resolve.paths(name)) { ``` `resolve.paths()` returns `null` for a builtin-shadowed name, so `for...of null` throws: ``` TypeError: createRequire.resolve.paths is not a function or its return value is not iterable at ResolutionRouter.routeScoped (.../dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1422) at ResolutionRouter.routePath (...:1554) at Function.wrappedFilename [as _resolveFilename] (...:1771) at Object. (.../node_modules/tr46/index.js:3:18) ``` Note the CJS hook `routePath` forwards the raw request to `routeScoped` with **no builtin filter**, unlike `barePackageName()`, which does call `isBuiltin()`. The 0.1.5 equivalent site was guarded: ```js for (const searchPath of createRequire(anchor).resolve.paths(packageName) ?? []) { ``` 0.1.7-rc.2 has six `resolve.paths` call sites; five are unguarded (lines 1247, 1422, 1475, 2019, 3263 — only 883 keeps `?? []`). ### Defect 2 — the underlying resolution failure: `Cannot find module 'punycode/'` Adding `?? []` to all five sites removes the TypeError and exposes the real error: ``` Error: Cannot find module 'punycode/' Require stack: - .../profiles/rescue/node_modules/tr46/index.js - .../node_modules/whatwg-url/lib/url-state-machine.js ... - .../node_modules/jsdom/lib/api.js at resolveRoutedCjs (.../dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1740:28) at Function.wrappedFilename [as _resolveFilename] (...:1805:16) ``` `punycode` **is installed** in the profile and resolves/loads natively: ``` $ node -e "const r=require('module').createRequire(process.cwd()+'/node_modules/tr46/index.js'); console.log(r.resolve('punycode/'))" /home/gwang/.../profiles/rescue/node_modules/punycode/punycode.js $ node -e "... typeof r('punycode/').toASCII ..." function ``` So native Node resolves it fine, but the router intercepts the require and cannot route it — because it derives search paths from `resolve.paths()` (which treats `punycode` as a builtin and yields nothing) instead of the actual resolution. ### Impact Any plugin that pulls in a CJS dependency requiring a builtin-shadowed name (`punycode` and similar) cannot load on 0.1.7-rc.2. `jsdom` → `whatwg-url` → `tr46` is a very common chain, so this may affect a broad set of plugins. ### Suggested fix 1. Guard every `resolve.paths()` call with `?? []` (restore 0.1.5 behavior). 2. Apply the same builtin filter in the CJS `routePath` hook that `barePackageName()` already applies, so builtin-shadowed specifiers delegate to native resolution or skip routing. 3. Add a regression test that loads a plugin whose dependency graph requires `punycode/` (anything depending on `tr46`/`jsdom`). ### Workaround for plugin authors (until this is fixed) Removing `jsdom` from the dependency graph is enough — the failure only needs *some* CJS module on the plugin's resolution scope to `require('punycode/')`, and `jsdom → whatwg-url → tr46` is the usual route. I replaced `jsdom` with `node-html-parser` (deps: `entities`, `css-select` — no `tr46`/`punycode`/`whatwg-url` anywhere), and the same plugin then activates normally on 0.1.7-rc.2. To check whether your own dependency tree is exposed: ``` node -e "const r=require('module').createRequire(process.cwd()+'/index.js'); console.log(r.resolve.paths('punycode'))" ``` A `null` result is exactly the value the router fails to iterate. You can also just grep the installed tree for `tr46`, `whatwg-url`, or `punycode`. One caveat if you migrate off `jsdom`: `node-html-parser` parses `
`/`` bodies as **raw text**, so `textContent` returns inner markup where a real DOM flattens it (`
x
` yields `"x"` instead of `"x"`). Re-parsing the element's `rawText` (the original escaped source) restores DOM semantics for nested elements, entities, and escaped tag lookalikes alike. Switching to `linkedom`, `cheerio`, or `node-html-parser` all avoid the bug; pick whichever fits your parsing needs.

### Verification of the workaround

- Differential harness over 20 HTML cases (headings, lists, tables, JSON-LD, entities, nested `
`, fragments without ``, invalid selectors): the old jsdom-backed extractor and the new node-html-parser-backed one produce identical output.
- End-to-end on an isolated 0.1.7-rc.2 profile: the plugin goes from `failed to import` to activating fully (11 tools registered, browser service injected) — identical to its behavior on 0.1.5-rc.2.

### Environment

- Node v22.23.2, Linux x64
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.7-rc.2`
- baseline: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.5-rc.3`

discussions.title: Auto review: a reviewer `deny` still opens an "Allow once" approval panel (AUTO_PRESET_SPEC pins approval:"ask"), so a denied call executes on one Enter press
discussions.body:
### Summary

In the `Auto` permission preset (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` 0.1.7-rc.2), a reviewer `deny` does not end the call. It is converted into a user approval request, so the Web client shows the ordinary 拒绝 / 允许一次 panel — and `允许一次` is the primary button (Enter in the detail area allows). This means:

- a reviewer denial is only a suggestion: one click (or one Enter) executes the very call the reviewer refused, with `danger-full-access`;
- this includes `high`-risk denials, which the reviewer policy says must always be denied "even when a human explicitly requests it";
- unattended runs stall: in a real session the call sat waiting for approval for **6 h 14 min**.

Expected: in Auto mode a reviewer denial is final — the tool returns an error result and the agent loop continues, without asking the user.

### Environment

dsh 44.0.0 desktop (Windows), all `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages 0.1.7-rc.2, profile `desktop`, model `deepseek-flash`.

### Evidence (real session log)

Session `session-f02498f1-…`, workspace `G:\workspace`, 2026-09-26 (local):

| time | seq | event |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 02:11:47 | 325 | `permission/preset = auto` |
| 02:22:34 | 408 | `approval/asked`, reason starts with `Auto review denied tool "pwsh"` |
| 08:37:10 | 409 | `approval/decided outcome=allowed-once` (6 h 14 min later) |
| 08:38:17 | 410 | `tool/result` — the denied command executed |
| 08:39:33 | 422 | second `approval/asked`, again `Auto review denied …` |
| 08:39:47 | 423 | `allowed-once`, 14 s later |
| 08:39:56 | 425 | `permission/preset = danger-full-access` (user gave up on Auto) |

The second denial's own reason ends with `故按失败即拒绝处理` ("fail closed") — the reviewer intended a hard deny; the harness turned it into an approvable prompt.

### Root cause

1. `dsh-permission-presets/lib/index.js:52-61` — the Auto spec pins the policy: `AUTO_PRESET_SPEC = { sandbox: "danger-full-access", approval: "ask" }`, with the comment "`ask` routes reviewer denials to the user".
2. `dsh-experimental-auto-review/lib/index.js:480-484` — the pre-execute listener only returns a final `denied` when `ctx.approval.overrideOf(session) === "never"`; under `ask` it returns `askUser(exec, decision.reason)`.
3. `dsh-client-ui-approval/lib/client.js:79,119-134,262` — the panel's primary button is `allowOnce`, and Enter allows.
4. `dsh-tools/lib/index.js:3225-3257, 3439-3491` — `allowed-once` ⇒ `{kind:"allow"}` ⇒ the body dispatches with full access; a `deny` would instead have produced `Error: Auto review rejected tool "X"; its body was not executed` and the loop would have continued.
5. Inconsistency: `dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:530-558` pins in-process children to `never`, so the *same* reviewer decision is final in a child and one-Enter approval in the main session.

### Proposed fix

Minimal change (keeps downstream listeners' precedence, no new API):

```js
const downstream = await next();
if (isAborted(lifecycle.signal)) return { kind: "cancel" };
if (decision.decision === "deny") return downstream.kind === "allow" ? denied(exec, decision.reason) : downstream;
return downstream;
```

`AUTO_PRESET_SPEC.approval` can stay `"ask"` — Auto itself no longer needs it, and other plugins' asks in that session keep working.

Alternatives: (b) keep the escape hatch but make it explicit and safe — default/reject button, no 「允许一次」 for `high`, no Enter-to-allow; (c) make it configurable (`denyEscalation: "final" | "ask"`, default `"final"`); (d) risk-tiered: `high` final, `medium` still human-approvable.

Whatever is chosen, `README.zh.md` (lines 46/58) and the `AUTO_PRESET_SPEC` comment should stop documenting "denied calls request user approval" as intended behaviour.

discussions.title: [Bug] 切会话或刷新后，输入区里粘贴的图永久消失：`session/attachment` 拒绝返回未被会话日志引用的图片（根因已定位，附绕过方案） / Pasted-but-unsent images vanish forever after a session switch or a reload: `session/attachment` refuses images the session log never referenced (root cause located, workaround included)
discussions.body:
### 摘要 / TL;DR

DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` 上，**输入区里粘贴但尚未发送的图片，一旦切换会话或刷新就永久拿不回来** —— 因为它**从未被会话日志引用**，而宿主读取附件的授权判据正是"**会话日志是否引用过**"（`referencedImage`）。
⭐ **而 `0.1.5-rc.3` 上，输入区里粘贴但尚未发送的图片，切换会话仍然存在**。
⭐ 我们**没有要求放宽那道闸门**，而是在**客户端**做了一条可用绕过（本地字节 ＋ 本地 ref，**跨会话切换与跨整页刷新都不丢**），已实机验收，附在下面供参考。

> **TL;DR.** On `0.1.7-rc.2`, an image pasted into the composer but **not yet sent** is **lost forever** once you switch sessions or reload — it is never referenced by the session log, and the host authorizes attachment reads **by log reference** (`referencedImage`).
> ⭐ On **`0.1.5-rc.3` the same pasted-but-unsent image *does* survive a session switch**.
> ⭐ We did **not** ask you to weaken that gate. Instead we built a working **client-side** workaround (local bytes + local refs) that survives both session switches **and** full reloads. Details below.

### ① 现象 / Symptom

在输入区**粘贴一张图** → **切换会话**（或**整页刷新**）→ 回到原会话：**文字草稿在** ✅（`dsh.conversation.<sessionId>`／localStorage）；**图片没了** ❌，且**不再回来**，刷新也救不回。

> Paste an image into the composer, then **switch sessions** (or **reload the page**) and come back: the **text draft survives** ✅ (it lives in `dsh.conversation.<sessionId>` / localStorage), the **image is gone** ❌ and never comes back — reloading does not help either.

### ② 我们测到的链路 / What we measured

| 环节 / Step | 读数 / Reading |
|---|---|
| 切回时客户端会尝试恢复 / client attempts a restore on return | 调用了 `session.readAttachment(attachmentId)` |
| ⭐ **宿主返回 / host answers** | **`session/attachment-invalid`：`"Image is not referenced by this session."`**（`reason: ATTACHMENT_NOT_REFERENCED`） |
| 结果 / outcome | 预览 `1 → 0`；此后每次挂载都重试、每次同样被拒 / preview `1 → 0`; every later mount retries and is refused again |

### ③ 根因（代码位置）/ Root cause

**读取闸门 / the read gate** —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js`（约 `L910-931`）：

```js
/** Read one durable image after proving the Session log references it. */
const ref = referencedImage(source.events, String(request.attachmentId));
if (ref === undefined)
  throw new RemoteError('session/attachment-invalid', 'Image is not referenced by this session.',
                       { reason: 'ATTACHMENT_NOT_REFERENCED' });
```

⇒ 授权依据是 **`source.events`**：**粘贴未发送**的草稿图**不在任何事件里** ⇒ **永远读不回**。

**为什么客户端"自己修"修不动 / why a client-side fix cannot work**：存储是**内容寻址、无会话归属** —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` 的 `saveImage(input)` / `saveImages(inputs)` / `readImage(ref)` **入参没有 `sessionId`** ⇒ 宿主除了日志引用以外**无从判断**。

**一个对照 / a telling asymmetry**：**文件**这条路**已经**有会话级登记 —— `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/commands.js`（约 `L533-545`）`resolvePromptFileReceipts()` → `stagedFile(part.receiptId)`，失败抛 **`'File was not uploaded for this session.'`**（`reason: FILE_NOT_STAGED`）⇒ **文件有"会话级暂存（receiptId）"，图片没有对应物**。

> The gate authorizes **by log reference**; a pasted-but-unsent draft image is never referenced by any event, so it can never be read back. And the store is **content-addressed with no session ownership** (`saveImage`/`readImage` take no `sessionId`), so the host has no other way to authorize the read. Note the asymmetry: **files** already have a session-scoped staging path (`stagedFile(receiptId)` → `'File was not uploaded for this session.'`); **images do not**.

### ④ 与 `0.1.5-rc.3` 的对照（为什么"以前行"）/ Why 0.1.5 behaved differently

| | `0.1.5-rc.3` | `0.1.7-rc.2` |
|---|---|---|
| 粘贴时上传 / upload at paste | **不上传 / no** | 不预上传（发送时才编码上传） / no pre-upload (encoded at send time) |
| 草稿 ref 持久化 / persisted draft refs | **没有 / none** | 也没有（pristine） / none either |
| 恢复机制 / restore path | **没有 / none** | 有（但被上面那道闸门挡住） / present, but blocked by the gate above |
| ⭐ **切走 → 切回 / switch away → back** | ⭐ **图还在 / image survives** | ❌ 图丢 / lost |
| **整页刷新 / full reload** | ❌ 图丢 / lost | ❌ 图丢 / lost |

⇒ 0.1.5 只是**纯内存**活着：它的会话输入壳（`shells`）用 **`binding.sessionId`（字符串）** 作键，作用域重新物化时能**命中原壳并复用**；0.1.7 改用 **`binding`（对象）** 作键 ⇒ 新对象**必然 miss** ⇒ 造一个**全新空壳** ⇒ 内存草稿丢。

⚠️ **我们试过"把键改回稳定身份"这条路，结论是【别这么改】**：改完之后**输入区 `isContentEditable` 由 `true` 变 `false`、粘贴全无效、界面直接坏**（0.1.7 的 shell 与**作用域生命周期**绑定 ⇒ 复用"已释放作用域的壳"会断输入链路）。这一条仅供你们参考，避免重踩。

> 0.1.5 kept drafts **in memory only**, and its shell registry was keyed by `binding.sessionId` (stable), so a re-materialized scope reused the resident shell. 0.1.7 keys it by `binding` (object identity) ⇒ a new scope always misses ⇒ a fresh, empty shell ⇒ the in-memory draft is gone.
> ⚠️ **Reverting the key is NOT a fix**: it broke the composer (`isContentEditable` flipped to `false`, paste stopped working) — because in 0.1.7 the shell is tied to the **scope lifetime**, so reusing a released scope's shell kills the input chain. Mentioned only so nobody re-walks that path.

### ⑤ 我们做成的客户端绕过（已实现并验收）/ Our client-side workaround (implemented & verified)

**思路 / idea**：⭐ pristine 的草稿图**本来就是本地 `File`**（发送时才 `encodeImage(attachment.file)` 内联编码）⇒ **让草稿图活下来根本不必经过服务端**。

1. **字节库 / byte store**：IndexedDB，键＝内容 `sha256`（`crypto.subtle.digest`，不引第三方库）；值＝`{blob, name, mediaType, bytes, width, height, ts}`。
2. **ref 表 / ref table**：复用会话 store（`defineStore({…, persist: "dsh.conversation"})`，整值 JSON 落 localStorage），加 `attachments` 字段，元素＝`{hash, name, mediaType, bytes, width, height, addedAt}`（**本地 hash**，不是服务端 id）。
3. **三个钩子 / three hooks**：
   - **捕获 / capture**（粘贴/拖入/选择，在 `createDrafts` 的图片分支后）：`arrayBuffer()` → `sha256` → IndexedDB put ＋ 描述符打 `draftHash`；
   - **恢复 / restore**（会话挂载/切回）：IndexedDB 取回字节 → 重建 `File` → `browserDraftAttachment` → ⭐ **先把所有 id 注册进注册表，最后才 `adopt`（宣布）** —— 因为 composer 的 prune 效应会**永久删除"已宣布但解析不到"的 id**；取不到字节的 ref **优雅摘掉**；
   - **配额 / quota**：上限 64 MB ＋ LRU；⭐ **被任何会话 ref 引用的条目不淘汰**（引用集从各会话持久化 store 读；**取不到就跳过本轮 sweep**，宁可留着也不误删）。
4. **闸门 / gate**：镜像效应（把活动草稿写回 store）的闸门是"**本挂载代是否已咨询过 store**"，与"恢复是否成功"**解耦**（旧写法"成功才置位"会同时造成"永不恢复"与"refs 写不进 store"两个缺陷）。

**实测验收（六条全过）/ verified: six checks, all pass**：

| # | 验收 / check | 读数 / reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **切走 → 切回 / switch away → back** | ⭐ 图在（预览 `0 → 1`）/ image is back |
| 2 | ⭐ **整页刷新 / full reload** | ⭐ **图仍在**（0.1.5 都做不到）/ still there — 0.1.5 could not do this |
| 3 | 文字草稿 / text draft | 不回归 / unaffected |
| 4 | **发送仍成功 / send still works** | ✅ 实发验证：`POST /api/session/attachment` 成功、消息里出现图、Agent 可见 / actually sent: upload succeeded, the image appears in the transcript |
| 5 | **输入区始终可打字 / input never broken** | 每一步都实测 `DIV.uV2eYG_input.isContentEditable === true` |
| 6 | 配额与回收 / quota & GC | `sweep(1, [liveHash])` ⇒ `{removed:1,total:0}`：**只淘汰未被引用的垃圾，被引用的原封不动** / only the unreferenced blob was evicted |

**代价（如实标注）/ trade-offs (stated plainly)**：⭐ 图只活在**同一浏览器 profile** 内（不跨设备）；同一张图两次粘贴不合并（字节按内容去重）；**文件类草稿不在射程**（本方案只投影 image）。

> The bytes live **only in the same browser profile** (no cross-device); pasting the same image twice does not merge the chips (bytes are de-duplicated by content); **file drafts are out of scope** (images only).

### ⑥ 给上游的两条建议（若想让所有客户端受益）/ Two suggestions if you want this fixed for everyone

1. **上传时记会话归属 / record session ownership at upload**：`POST /api/session/attachment` 带上 `sessionId`，存储侧留一条"会话 ↔ 附件"记录；读取闸门改为 **`referencedImage(events) ?? uploadedBySession(sessionId, id)`**。⚠️ 只放宽**同会话草稿**；跨会话维持现状；旧附件无归属 ⇒ 行为不变。
2. **给图片补一条会话级暂存 / give images a session-scoped staging path**：复用文件那条 `stagedFile(receiptId)` 的思路（粘贴即登记，发送后转正/清理），读取闸门接受这条注册。

⚠️ 我们**不建议**把闸门简单放宽为"客户端声明即放行"——那会让**已知哈希即可跨会话读图**，削弱现有保护。

> (1) record session ownership at upload and accept `referencedImage(events) ?? uploadedBySession(sessionId, id)`; (2) mirror the existing **file staging** path for images. We explicitly do **not** suggest letting a client-declared session authorize reads — that would make any attachment readable by hash and weaken the existing protection.

discussions.title: [BUG反馈] 桌面端创造模式（Creator / cordis preset）加载不到任何磁盘 skill，标准模式正常
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

- 桌面端 **创造模式**下，模型上下文里没有任何 skill 目录（问它有哪些 skill 答不出来，只能自己去磁盘翻 `SKILL.md`），输入 `/` 只剩代码注册的 3 条 office skill；`~/.agents/skills` 等全部消失。
- 同一台机器 **标准模式 / PTC 一切正常**。
- AI查找到的问题：创造模式与标准的唯一差别是 preset 里多的一行 `customSkillDirs`，它指向 **`app.asar` 内部**的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset/skills`；该路径经 Host 的 `ctx.fs` 读取时抛 `TypeError: Cannot mix BigInt and other types`，而 `dsh-skill-filesystem` 只把"路径不存在"视为空，其它错误直接抛出且**没有按根容错** ⇒ 整个 filesystem provider 被丢弃，它名下**所有**根（`~/.agents/skills`、`~/.dsh/skills`、项目根）一起消失。

## 环境

- DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`
- Windows x64 桌面端安装版（Electron 壳，desktop-host 默认端口 `19387`），非 `dsh web`
- profile：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`（bundles = `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` + 若干 experimental bundle + 本地 link 插件 + `dshmarket`）
- 未改动任何 skill 相关代码或配置；现象与是否已有历史对话无关

## 复现

1. 桌面端新建任务，模式选 **创造模式**。
2. 问模型“你有哪些 skill” → 它不知道，会先用文件检索工具去磁盘找 `SKILL.md`。
3. 输入 `/` → 菜单里只有斜杠命令 + `office-docx` / `office-pptx` / `office-xlsx`；`~/.agents/skills/` 下的相关 skills 完全不出现。
4. 换 **标准模式** 重复 2、3 步 → 模型表示自己看见了技能列表，并且立马回答自己的技能，而且输入 `/` 能够看见 `~/.agents/skills/` 下的相关技能。

## 现象 vs 期望

- **现象**：创造模式下 `dsh-skill-filesystem` 的 `list()` 被 reject，注册表记一条 `skill provider "filesystem" skipped: …` 并把观测标为不可缓存；`tool-skill` 在 incomplete 时**整份目录不注入**，所以模型一条都看不到；GUI 的会话 skill 目录用的是 `list()`（不检查 complete），因此 `/` 里只剩另一个 layer 的 office 三条。
- **期望**：创造模式应与标准模式一致地发现本地 skill（随包 3 条 `cordis-*` + `~/.agents/skills` + `~/.dsh/skills` + 项目根）；**单个根不可读不应影响其它根**，更不应让整个 provider 消失，至少应保留其它根并给出可诊断的提示。

## 根因链（带代码位置）

1. 创造模式独有的配置（`packages/bundle/web-app/presets/cordis.patch.yml:143-147`）：

   ```yaml
   - id: skill-filesystem
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
     config:
       customSkillDirs:
         - !!js …createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset/package.json')…, 'skills')
   ```

2. 桌面端该包**只在 `resources/app.asar` 内**（profile 的 node_modules 里没有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`；`app.asar.unpacked` 只解包原生/引擎包），因此这个根解析为 `…\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-agent-preset\skills`。
3. 该路径在 Electron 下**能读**（见证据）：`stat` 是目录、`readdir` 返回三个 skill 目录、`readFile` 正常、`realpath` 正常，Chokidar 4.0.3 也正常 `ready`（原生 `fs.watch` 抛 `ENOENT`，被 Chokidar 吞掉）。**watcher 不是失败点。**
4. 但 `skill-filesystem` 对非 `trustedHost` 的根不走 Node fs，而是走 `ctx.fs` 服务（`packages/skill/skill-filesystem/src/index.ts:753-757`）。
5. **Host 的 `ctx.fs` 在 asar 路径上抛 `TypeError: Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions`**：同一进程内用内置 `read` 工具读上述目录/文件稳定复现；读普通目录（含工作区外目录）正常。差别在**是否经过 `ctx.fs`**，不在路径位置。（具体是 `dsh-fs-local` 还是 `native/system` 沙箱层引入的 BigInt 尚未定位，对结论无影响。）
6. 该错误不是"不存在"：`listSkillRootEntriesFromFileSystem` 只在 `isAbsentSkillPathError` 时返回空，其余 rethrow（同文件 `:759-766`），而 `list()` 的发现循环没有按根容错 ⇒ **整个 provider 被丢弃**。
7. 注册表对 provider 失败是 contained 的，但会把观测标成不可缓存（`packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:602-608`）⇒ `SkillCatalogSnapshot.complete === false`。
8. 两个消费方对 incomplete 的处置不同，正好解释"菜单里还有 office、模型侧一条都没有"：
   - `packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts:225`：`if (!snapshot.complete) return decision` → 模型侧整份不注入；
   - `packages/api/session-controller/src/skill-catalog.ts:77` 用的 `list()` 即 `(await this.snapshot(options)).skills`（`packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:470-472`），不看 complete → `/` 仍列出全局层里代码注册的 `dsh-office` 三条。

## 只读探针证据（Electron 以 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 运行，未修改任何文件）

```
# 原始 Node fs 直接访问 asar 内的 skill 根
STAT ok isDirectory= true
READDIR ok: cordis-composition-reference,cordis-plugin-development,editing-cordis-compositions
WATCH fail: ENOENT … watch 'D:\dsh-desktop\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-agent-preset\skills'
SKILLMD: --- name: cordis-plugin-development desc…
dir  size typeof = number | size = 0     | mtimeMs typeof = number
file size typeof = number | size = 7382  | mtimeMs typeof = number
realpathSync ok: …\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-agent-preset\skills
readdir dirent ok: cordis-composition-reference:dir, cordis-plugin-development:dir, editing-cordis-compositions:dir

# Chokidar 对同一路径
chokidar 4.0.3 → EVENT ready

# 同一进程内内置 read 工具读同一路径（经 ctx.fs）
Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions
```

## 影响范围

- 任何把 `customSkillDirs`（或 `bundledSkillDir` / `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR`）指向 **asar 内目录**的组合，都会以"该 provider 名下所有 skill 一起消失"的形式失败，而不只是丢掉那一个根——用户很难自行诊断。
- 更底层：Host 的 `ctx.fs` 目前无法读取 asar 内路径（BigInt），影响所有经 fs 服务的 asar 读取（内置 `read` 工具即是一例）。
- 附带：asar 内的 skill 无法热更新（无 watch 事件），本次故障把这层问题也一并掩盖了。

discussions.title: [Windows] workspace-write 沙箱在工作区留下的常驻 Low 完整性标签有两个下游症状,且每次授权都会重打
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.7-rc.1**,沙箱后端 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` **0.1.7-rc.1**
- Windows 11 中文版(2026-09 补丁),NTFS 数据盘
- 受影响工作区:一个 Python/Streamlit 项目(自带 `.venv`)、一个含 `.venv` 的游戏服务端项目
- 沙箱模式:workspace-write(非 `--danger-full-access`)

## 一句话

`grantWrite` 给**整棵工作区树**(根上 `(OI)(CI)` 可继承)写入的 **Low 完整性标签**按设计常驻,
导致两个与"写权限"看似无关的下游症状;并且**每次 workspace-write 授权都会重新打标**,
所以"清掉了又回来",极易被误诊成 pip / 杀软 / 网络 / 代理问题。

## 症状(同一根源,三种表现)

### ① 工作区内 venv 的 exe 启动的进程被降级为 Low 完整性

Windows 会把镜像文件的完整性标签施加给从它启动的进程。典型 Python 项目里,
`.venv\Scripts\python.exe` 位于被标 Low 的工作区树下 → 进程也是 Low → **写不了工作区外的任何路径**
(与 DACL 无关,账户对该路径明明是 Full Control)。Python 的 `tempfile` 逐个候选目录都因
完整性检查失败,最后**回退到 `os.getcwd()`**:

```
TMP/TEMP 环境变量完全正确 (C:\Users\<你>\AppData\Local\Temp)
tempfile.gettempdir() → E:\work\my-project        ← 回退到项目根
```

于是 pip / pytest / streamlit 的临时目录全部堆在项目根(`pytest-of-*`、`pip-unpack-*`…)。
实测 A/B:**同一个 `python.exe`**(sha256 相同),标签 Medium 时所有写目标 OK,Low 时除工作区外全 FAIL。

venv 侧的任何 `.exe` 入口(pip.exe / pytest.exe / streamlit.exe)同理:它们自己带 Low 标签时,
由它们发起的安装/测试全部表现异常;走 `python -m pip` 反而可能正常 ——
**"同一个动作时好时坏"正是这个标签存在与否的差分信号**。

### ② 工作区树里的未签名 exe 被 SmartScreen 拦("无法识别的应用")

工作区里任何一个未签名的 exe(游戏引擎、工具、自编译产物……)双击被 SmartScreen 拦下,
提示"阻止了无法识别的应用启动";**同一份字节**拷到 `C:\` 或任何不带 Low 标签的目录就照常启动。

对照实验(编译一个只 sleep 的无害未签名探针,分别从不同目录启动):

| 启动位置 | 完整性标签 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `C:\Users\<你>\normal\` | 无(=Medium) | 启动 OK |
| `<数据盘>\__probe\`(盘根,无标签) | 无 | 启动 OK |
| 同一 exe 的另一份拷贝(无标签目录) | 无 | 启动 OK |
| **沙箱工作过的工作区** | **Low** | **被拦** |

已排除:MotW(全盘 0 个 Zone.Identifier)、Authenticode 签名、文件哈希变化、
云端信誉端点可达性(`smartscreen.microsoft.com` / `wdcp.microsoft.com` 对裸 GET 返回 502/503
是**端点正常行为**,直连与走代理一致)、本机代理。

修复 = 恢复标签:

```powershell
icacls "<工作区>" /setintegritylevel (OI)(CI)Medium /T /C /Q
# 整树 ~47 秒,0 失败;对正在运行的进程无影响(改的是磁盘上的镜像标签)
```

修复后同位置探针启动 OK。

两个工程坑,做自动化排查时务必注意:

- SmartScreen 提示是**模态**的:`Start-Process` 无超时会**永久挂死**(等人工答复);
- 人工点"不运行"后抛出的异常,**外层 HResult 是 `0x80131509`**(InvalidOperationException),
  真正的 **`0x800704C7`(ERROR_CANCELLED)在内层异常** —— 只按外层判会漏掉这个签名。

### ③ 每次授权都会重打 → 复发

实测时间线:把某工作区整树清回 Medium(复验过)→ 约 30 分钟后 dsh 在同一工作区又跑了一轮 →
复查:**根目录又变 Low**(子目录/exe 仍是 Medium,说明重打的是根上那条可继承 ACE,无递归)。
另一个正在使用的 Python 工作区,抽样 **308/309 个文件是 Low**。

"会话活着"的可观测证据:

- `%TEMP%\dsh-*` 每 20~40 秒新增一个(`dsh-acl-locks`、`dsh-workspace-changes-*` 等);
- `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\sessions\<--盘符-路径-->\` 里的 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 持续更新;
- 进程列表可见 `dsh.exe web` + `node ...\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js web`。

项目内脚本、计划任务都**不做**这件事(全查过,`setintegritylevel` 零命中)——只有沙箱会写这个标签。

## 附带发现:Defender 把 dsh 的文件改写判成木马

dsh 通过 `runner.js → pwsh -Command` 对工作区内 GBK 编码的 `.ini`/`.txt` 做
`ReadAllBytes / Replace / WriteAllBytes` 时,**3 次触发 Defender 行为启发式,
记录为 `Trojan:Win32/FileFix.BBA!MTB`(Severity 5,已阻断清理)**,`Get-MpThreat` 至今显示为
"活动威胁"。改写内容完全无害,属误报 —— 但这个"FileFix 式字节级改写"模式正好撞在启发式枪口上,
建议了解:用户侧看到"agent 改了文件却没生效"时,可能其实是 Defender 拦的。

## 最小复现(不碰任何真实项目)

```powershell
# 1) 模拟 grantWrite 留下的标签
$T = "$env:TEMP\__lowlabel_demo"
New-Item -ItemType Directory $T -Force | Out-Null
icacls $T /setintegritylevel '(OI)(CI)Low' | Out-Null

# 2) 编一个未签名探针,放进树里 → 自动继承 Low
Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System; using System.Threading; public class P { public static void Main(){ Thread.Sleep(8000); } }' `
  -OutputAssembly "$T\probe.exe" -OutputType ConsoleApplication
icacls "$T\probe.exe"        # ← Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(I)(NW)

# 3) 启动被拦(桌面会弹模态提示;点"不运行"后看异常链)
try { Start-Process "$T\probe.exe" -PassThru }
catch {
  '{0:X8}' -f $_.Exception.HResult                        # 0x80131509(外层,会骗人)
  '{0:X8}' -f $_.Exception.InnerException.HResult         # 0x800704C7(真签名)
}

# 4) 同一份字节,放到无标签目录 → 正常启动
Copy-Item "$T\probe.exe" "$env:TEMP\probe_ok.exe"
Start-Process "$env:TEMP\probe_ok.exe" -PassThru
```

venv 侧金丝雀(判定一个 Python 工作区是否中招):

```powershell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import tempfile;print(tempfile.gettempdir())"
# 输出 = 项目路径   → 进程被标签降级(中招)
# 输出 = 系统 %TEMP% → 正常
```

## 对 dsh 的建议

1. **文档**:在 workspace-write 说明里写明"会在工作区树上留常驻 Low 完整性标签"并列出下游症状,
   否则用户(以及跑在里面的其他 agent)会顺着 pip/杀软/代理查几个小时。
2. **提供恢复手段**:如 `dsh sandbox restore-labels --workspace X`,或会话结束自动恢复原标签;
   至少给一个"退出后自动清标"选项(`--danger-full-access` 之外的低成本出路)。
3. **考虑令牌侧收口**:既然已是 restricted-token + capability-SID 写允许清单,对象侧 Low 标签对
   "限制沙箱进程"并非必需,副作用却由用户之后在工作区里启动的一切来承担。若有实现依赖,
   建议至少豁免 `.venv/Scripts/*.exe` 这类会被用户直接启动的运行时镜像。
4. **前置条件报错可读性**:工作区所有者缺 WRITE_OWNER 时(数据盘卷根没有 CREATOR OWNER 继承、
   新建目录只有 Modify 的机器很常见),`SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(...)`
   直接 fail-closed——行为正确,但报错看不出是"权限前置条件不满足",容易被当成别的故障。

## 用户侧临时解法(官方方案出来前)

```powershell
icacls "<工作区>" /setintegritylevel (OI)(CI)Medium /T /C /Q   # 幂等,几十秒
# 注意:会话还活着时这只是止血,下一次授权会重打
```

或让 agent 直接用 `--danger-full-access`(不写标签)。

## 我们当时的误诊路径(供后来人少走弯路)

pip 缓存损坏 → 镜像不通 → 杀软/EDR → 系统时间 → 本地代理 → 全部不对。
真实顺序是三层,同一机制在不同前提下的三种出口:

1. 卷根缺 CREATOR OWNER → grantWrite 的 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 失败(Win32 5),沙箱起不来;
2. 标签打上后 → venv 进程被降级,tempfile 回退项目根,"装依赖失败/垃圾堆根目录";
3. 同一标签 → 工作区里未签名 exe 被 SmartScreen 拦,"突然弹无法识别的应用"。

discussions.title: [Bug] build:lib fails with MISSING_EXPORT "SettingsProvider" from dsh-settings on 0.1.7-rc.2
discussions.body:
从 `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2` 升级到上游 master `0.1.7-rc.2` 后，`pnpm run build` 
在 `build:lib` 阶段失败，报 `[MISSING_EXPORT] "SettingsProvider" is not exported 
by "@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings"`。

 在一个 `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2` 的干净 checkout 上执行：
  
   ```
git fetch origin master
   git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD   # FETCH_HEAD = 477b4f42
   pnpm install
   pnpm run build
```

pnpm run build 失败，错误如下：
```
[MISSING_EXPORT] "SettingsProvider" is not exported by "../settings/src/index.ts".
    ╭─[ lib/types/index.js:17:10 ]
    │
 17 │ import { SettingsProvider } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings';
    │          ────────┬───────
    │                  ╰───────── Missing export
────╯
```
build:lib exited with 1，整个 build 中断。

环境：
DSH 仓库版本：0.1.7-rc.2（commit 477b4f42）

升级前版本：dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2（commit ddefc45fbc）

操作系统：[Windows 11 ]

Node.js：v24.19.0

pnpm：v11.7.0

是否带本地补丁：否（本次是纯官方代码裸跑）

补充信息
本地 packages/core/tools/src/index.ts 中有 Symbol.for 改动，
但本次为验证官方代码能否裸跑，该补丁已全部退掉，所以不是补丁导致的。

git status --short 在 merge 后为干净状态。

问题看起来是 lib/types/index.js（构建中间产物）仍按旧方式
import { SettingsProvider } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings'，
但上游 packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts 已经不再以命名导出提供
SettingsProvider，而是改成了 service 模式（ctx.settings）。
