discussions.title: Session references lose their id before the message is durable (blocks click-through)
discussions.body:
# Discussion: session references lose their id before the message is durable

**Where**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-reference` (host half)
**Harness build**: `0.1.6-alpha.1` (running `dsh web`, source launch)
**Impact**: a third-party plugin (an `@` mention plugin) cannot make a *sent* session
reference clickable, because the id is no longer in the durable text.

## What happens

Insert a session reference from the `@` menu (the chat category), then send the
message. The composer and the pre-send queue both carry the wire form; the durable
message does not:

```
draft / queued (agent/inbox/spliced) : @[继续 LoongCrush J 项目的任务](dsh-session:InNlc3Npb24tOWVmZTEyOTctODY3YS00ZmIyLWFkYmQtZWRjNWM5NzhiOTc4Ig)
durable      (user/message)          : @继续 LoongCrush J 项目的任务 继续
```

Both events sit in the same session log, so the difference is directly observable.

## Why

`parseSessionReferenceText()` folds the mention into its display text, and
`prepareDirectMessages()` then freezes that folded text into the message the model
receives:

```ts
// packages/context/session-reference/src/uri.ts
return `@${label}`          // the URI is dropped here
```

The reference itself is not lost for the model — the adjacent `session-reference`
snapshot still carries it — so this is purely a *presentation/durability* question:

| consumer | today |
| --- | --- |
| human (message bubble) | sees the label, cannot click through to that session |
| the model | unaffected: the snapshot still injects the referenced session |
| third-party plugins | cannot offer any action for a sent mention, because nothing maps the label back to a session id |

A client-side plugin cannot reconstruct the id: the rendered chip's `title` is the
folded label, and it is the only thing that survives (verified in the running GUI —
the element carries `title="@继续 LoongCrush J 项目的任务"`, no `dsh-session:` anywhere).

## Suggested options

**A (preferred): keep `@[label](dsh-session:…)` in the durable text and fold only when rendering.**
`parseSessionReferenceText()` already parses the bracket form back into references,
so the injection path is unchanged (one reference in, one snapshot out). Cost: ~60–80
bytes per mention in the log.

**B (smallest): keep folding, but carry the structured references alongside the durable
message** (e.g. `references: [{ sessionId, label }]` on the user message), so a
presenter can anchor each mention to its session.

Either one turns "session mention" into something any UI (and any plugin) can open,
without changing what the model receives.

## Cheapest repro

```sh
# 1. In the Web GUI: @ menu -> past chats -> pick a session -> send the message.
# 2. Decompress that session log (multi-frame zstd) and compare the two event types:
#    agent/inbox/spliced  = wire form
#    user/message         = bare '@label'
```

discussions.title: Proposal: add dsh-safe tool (scripts/dsh-safe) so plugin updates don't break the app — ready branch on fork
discussions.body:
## Problem

Plugins declare `peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` core packages, pinned to the core release they were tested against. The DSH Desktop app bundles a specific core, so after an app update the newest plugin version is frequently incompatible with the bundled core — and app-boot's `evaluatePluginCompatibility` **DENIES the plugin at profile boot** until an exact-version exemption exists in `<profile>/compatibility.json`. On a real Intel-Macbook install this is exactly what made plugin updates break the app.

## Proposal: add `scripts/dsh-safe/`

A dependency-free node helper tool (semver vendored, no npm install) that encodes the app-boot peer contract and lets users keep plugins working across updates:

- `audit` — report every installed plugin vs the bundled core (read-only)
- `spec <pkg>` — print the newest compatible version (paste into the plugin market)
- `fix` — grant exact-version exemptions in `<profile>/compatibility.json` (atomic write, advisory lock, timestamped backup, refuse-on-clobber)
- `pre-update` — run after updating the app: auto-grants exemptions for plugins the new core now rejects so nothing breaks at boot
- `verify` — validates `compatibility.json` against the exact contract `evaluatePluginCompatibility` enforces; doubles as a contract test (active vs stale exemptions)

## Why here

The exemption contract is defined by the core in this repo. A canonical, tested reference implementation next to the enforcing code prevents drift. A mirror proposal to the app repo is open as [dataelement/dsh-desktop#576](https://github.com/dataelement/dsh-desktop/pull/576).

## Ready-to-review branch

PRs are disabled on this repo, so the contribution is on my fork, ready to cherry-pick or open once PRs are enabled:

**Branch:** [`feat/dsh-safe`](https://github.com/Jhingun1/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/dsh-safe) — `scripts/dsh-safe/` (tool + vendored semver + install.sh + 17 passing end-to-end smoke tests in `test/smoke.sh`).

## Safety model

`audit`/`spec`/`verify` strictly read-only; the only file ever written is `<profile>/compatibility.json`; atomic writes under an `O_EXCL` advisory lock; re-read before write with refuse-on-clobber; timestamped backup before every write; malformed files reported and left untouched.

Happy to rework placement, naming, or convert `verify` into a CI check against the contract if that would be more useful.

discussions.title: Feedback after ~30 days of daily production use: long-session cost, plugin compatibility, and overconfident structural analysis
discussions.body:
Hi all — I've been using DSH Web as my main working environment for about a month, and I want to give back the three problems that cost me the most time. Each one comes with measurements, and I've separated **what I measured** from **what I merely suspect**.

**TL;DR** — (1) Long-session cost didn't disappear, it turned into manual work I now maintain by hand. (2) One patch-level upgrade of DSH took six steps, including elevation and downtime, because plugin compatibility has no contract. (3) In structural-analysis tasks the model is overconfident, and its *negative* conclusions ("there is no X") are the expensive ones, because nobody re-checks a "no".

A companion post has five smaller gaps with full reproduction steps: **[[Feedback] Five smaller gaps with reproducible steps](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8033)**.

---

## 0. Who I am and what this sample is

- DSH Web, `profile=web`, on Windows; long-lived runtime; multiple third-party plugins; a mix of Web GUI sessions and IM (WeCom) group sessions feeding the same session.
- Daily driver for real delivery work, not experiments: my last project was a self-contained 1.6 MB operations dashboard built, verified and handed over entirely through DSH sessions.
- I also maintain a public MIT-licensed DSH skill package.
- **Scope warning:** this is **one machine, one very heavy usage pattern** (Windows + many plugins + sandbox + scheduled tasks). The numbers are order-of-magnitude for *my* profile, not averages, and the environment is more extreme than most users'. Items marked **[hypothesis]** are not verified.

---

## 1. Long sessions: the cost didn't disappear, it turned into manual work

### What I measured

Cost structure of one heavy session:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Model calls | 584 |
| Tokens | ~274M |
| Cost | ≈ ¥31.66 |
| **Spent re-reading context** | **98.6%** |
| **Model output** | **0.17%** |

So cost ≈ *average context size* × *number of calls*, and is almost independent of how much is actually produced.

### The part I think matters more than the ratio

To work around the context ceiling, I built an **external memory system by hand**:

| Artifact | Size |
|---|---|
| Handover doc A (runtime / plugins / upgrades) | 605 lines / 66 KB |
| Handover doc B (business project handover) | 1,229 lines / 111 KB |
| Gotchas I had to write down as "never do this again" | 31 |
| Session-history search tool | self-written (no official one available) |
| Plugin × version compatibility health check | self-written |

**The context cost didn't go away — it became the hours I spend maintaining 187 KB of handover documents.** And it still isn't enough.

### Long-session side effects, same session

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Session log | 4.69 MB compressed / **16.68 MB uncompressed** |
| Records | 3,549 (`tool/call` 710, `tool/result` 720) |
| UI must render | **644 chat bubbles + 1,430 tool cards** |
| Largest records | 43 > 50 KB, max 107 KB |
| Web process | 599 MB RSS, 710 s CPU |

Result: the UI visibly degrades, and the user is effectively pushed into starting a new session (losing continuity) or living with the lag.

### The session log is not searchable

The session log is **appended multi-frame zstd**. A one-shot decompress returns only the **first frame** (the file looks empty); streaming decompression dies on frame two with `Unknown frame descriptor`. What I ended up doing is scanning for the magic number `28 B5 2F FD`, splitting frames and decompressing them one by one: 4.69 MB → **1,946 frames** → 16.68 MB → 3,549 JSONL records. Until you reverse that, session history is a black box for both the user and the model.

### Suggestions

1. **Make the context budget visible and archivable in layers.** What needs to survive a long task is *conclusions, contracts, gotchas* — not the raw transcript. Compressing "finished work" into a searchable, verifiable form would remove most of the re-reading. (I'm already doing this by hand; that's the signal.)
2. **Ship the model-facing session-query tool in the default composition.** Verified today on `0.1.7-rc.2` / `profile=web`: `dsh-session-query` and `dsh-session-query-sqlite` (FTS5 backend) are installed, but the **model-facing package `dsh-tool-session-query` is not**. Consequence: in a long session the model has **no built-in way to look up "what did the user actually ask earlier"** — it either relies on what's still in context, or writes its own script to decompress the session log (which is what I do).
3. **Document and expose the session format** ("one zstd frame per append batch") and provide an official read path, e.g. `dsh session grep <pattern>`.
4. **Deal with long-session rendering:** built-in turn collapsing / message virtualisation, plus a threshold hint ("this session has 3,000+ records"). Note that a community plugin already exists that collapses completed turns into a single line — so this is a shared pain, not my edge case.
5. **Treat handover summaries as a product feature.** Heavy users are hand-maintaining 187 KB of them. Auto-generate, verify completeness, update incrementally.
6. **Clarify IM ↔ Web session binding.** Measured: one Web session and several WeCom group sessions **share the same session id**, so group messages and GUI conversation land in the same history (16.68 MB within ~3 hours) and their contexts contaminate each other. Also, **IM bindings do not follow when you fork a session**. Is this intended, or a default worth revisiting?

---

## 2. Plugin compatibility: one patch-level upgrade took six steps

### What I measured

**Three plugin compatibility failures in a single patch-level upgrade**, each printing `dsh: skipping profile bundle` on every start — and note this only goes to **stderr**, never to `.out`, so `grep` in the normal log finds nothing:

1. A third-party plugin declared its peer whitelist only up to `0.1.6-alpha.2` → the plugin had to be upgraded before DSH would load it.
2. A local `link:` plugin whose source had been moved away, leaving a **broken symlink** in `node_modules` → had to be removed from the manifest.
3. An official composition bundle that **no longer exists** in the new install → had to be removed from `bundles`.

**An upstream icon-vocabulary rename broke a plugin, and the error is unreadable.** The new harness renamed `ui-primitives` icons as a whole (`Icon*Outline16` → `Icon*OutlineRegular`), so named imports in the plugin became `undefined` and the panel crashed on render. All the user sees is:

```
Minified React error #138 / #130 — Touch object is missing identifier
```

That error tells you nothing about *which plugin* or *which API changed*; I had to go read the plugin author's release notes to find out. Worse, the same root cause reports a **different number** across versions (`#138` → `#130`), which reads like a new problem.

**Version semantics are counter-intuitive, so upgrades silently do nothing.** The manifest said `^0.53.3`. Under `0.x` semantics that pins the **minor** line (`>=0.53.3 <0.54.0`), so `0.57.0` can never be installed — `install` reports success and the version does not move. I only found out because the panel kept crashing.

**Upgrading requires downtime *and* elevation, and getting the order wrong fails the upgrade.**

- Plugin files are held by the running daemon (a rename probe on the plugin directory returns `Access to the path is denied`), and on Windows swapping packages can hit `EBUSY`. So the safe path is "stop DSH → upgrade → start".
- On this machine the runtime is launched by a scheduled task running as **built-in Administrator with `InteractiveToken`**, so the runtime process is **high-integrity**: `Stop-Process` / `taskkill` from a normal window is denied, and the process's command line is not even readable.
- The switch script, however, **must run in a normal (non-elevated) window**, otherwise the new runtime inherits high integrity and you reproduce the same trap.
- The result is a forced order: **admin disables the watchdog → admin kills the process → normal window swaps the tree → admin re-enables the watchdog.** The watchdog fires every 1 minute, so **if the order slips once (it relaunches the old runtime), the upgrade dies at step 1**. I hit exactly that.

**Plugin management is unavailable precisely where automation is needed.** In an agent session under a workspace sandbox, **any `dsh plugin` command fails immediately**, because the profile lives outside the workspace and the command needs to write a lock file there:

```
Error: EPERM … open '<DSH_HOME>\profiles\web\package.json.lock'
[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]
```

So install/upgrade/remove can only be done from an elevated window, and "let the agent upgrade its own plugins" — the most natural path — is closed. To upgrade **one** plugin I wrote a six-step elevation script plus a plugin compatibility health check.

### What I think this means **[hypothesis]**

**[hypothesis]** The plugin API has no **stability tiering** and no **version-matrix commitment**, so plugin authors can only defend themselves passively by declaring peer ranges — and users absorb the entire upgrade cost. Evidence that the need is real: the plugin I upgraded solved this on its own by declaring only two supported lines (`0.1.5-rc.1` and `0.1.7-rc.2`) and explicitly marking the middle one as transitional.

### Suggestions

1. **A compatibility contract and a version matrix.** Say which plugin APIs are stable and which are experimental, and which DSH release lines are supported. Formalise what that plugin author did by hand.
2. **Startup compatibility health check with actionable errors.** Today I have to grep stderr for `skipping profile bundle`. The UI should say: *this plugin*, *because of this API change*, *run this command*.
3. **Make plugin crashes readable.** A minified React error is zero information for a user; plugin error boundaries should carry the plugin name and version.
4. **Fix the version semantics / provide the upgrade command.** `dsh plugin upgrade --latest` that rewrites the spec and installs in one go, and a UI hint when a plugin is pinned by its spec.
5. **Swap packages without stopping the service** (atomic or deferred replacement) so upgrading a plugin doesn't require downtime.
6. **A legitimate plugin-management path for agent sessions** (or an explicit authorisation entry point) — otherwise this step can never be automated.
7. **Publish the roadmap and the stability commitment.** This is the answer to "what is the main direction of the product": what is core, what is experimental, and what plugin authors may rely on. Speaking as a daily user, that is the single document I most want to read.

---

## 3. Structural analysis: the model is overconfident, and negative conclusions are the dangerous ones

### What I observed

In a real delivery project the model had to infer data structures from web pages and internal APIs. The errors cluster around **one pattern: when reverse-engineering structure from an unstructured interface, the model states a confident but wrong conclusion.**

**Case 1 — read the wrong field, concluded "it doesn't exist", lost a whole round.** The route to a module lives in the menu node's `link` field. The model read `url` for the entire round (always empty) and concluded *"the menu has no promotion module"* — a conclusion that then went into the handover document. The next round, reading the right field, found the entry point (a separate domain, embedded as an iframe by design).

**Case 2 — "no menu entry" read as "no permission", almost a permanent wrong conclusion.** That account's privilege menu contains no "promotion" entry, so the model concluded *"this brand has no promotion data worth looking at"*. In reality, **no menu entry ≠ no API permission** — the gateway authorises by login session and returned 7-day, 30-day and same-day figures plus balance. That wrong conclusion also went into the handover document. Without a second round of verification it would have poisoned every later round.

**Case 3 — ignoring parameter semantics produced data inflated N times.** One endpoint's `recentDays=1` **ignores** the `beginTime`/`endTime` you pass and always returns the latest day. The model's "fetch day by day and sum" therefore produced figures inflated by a factor of N — and the numbers looked perfectly normal.

**Case 4 — a batch of silent correctness bugs, each proven by machine.** All of these were caught by assertions or human review, not by the model:

| Bug | Effect |
|---|---|
| Template read `storeName`/`liveStatus`; the data actually has `name`/`status` | store table showed IDs, status column always empty |
| `#N/A` in a source spreadsheet treated as "closed" | closed-store count overstated |
| City name written both as "杭州" and "杭州市" | **filter silently dropped nearly all matching stores** (single digits vs several hundred) |
| Daily chart X axis reversed | trend read backwards |
| A caption hard-coding one project's figures | both projects displayed the same wrong sentence |
| String-based replace expanding `join("$$")` into `join("$")` | chart silently corrupted |

### Why I consider this the most expensive item

- One wrong attribution = **a whole round (half a day) redone**. I ended up maintaining **31** gotchas in handover documents as "re-doing this costs 30+ minutes".
- The worst part is not the rework, it's the **contamination**: a wrong conclusion recorded in a handover document is inherited by every later round and *reads like verified fact*.
- The most dangerous class is **silent** error: numbers and charts look plausible while the definition is wrong — and I use them to make business decisions.

### My attribution

- **Measured:** the errors cluster in "infer structure from an unstructured interface", and **negative conclusions** (absent / doesn't exist / no permission / request was never sent) fail clearly more often than positive ones.
- **[hypothesis]** The model states "I did not find it in this attempt" as "it does not exist": it does not doubt the **completeness of its own search**, and it does not separate *verified fact* from *unverified assumption* in its output.

### Suggestions

1. **Require cross-verification for negative conclusions.** When the output is of the form "there is no X / it doesn't exist / no permission / the request was never sent", require at least two independent evidence paths (different field name, different entry point, a control account) before it may land as a conclusion — otherwise it must be explicitly labelled *"not found ≠ does not exist"*.
2. **Make structural analysis produce an artifact, not a sentence.** Record which fields were read, from which request, what is measured and what is assumed, in a **re-runnable file**. We already patch this by hand: the project produced a structure-analysis report of **47 measured facts + 11 unverified assumptions + 28 new findings**, plus a re-runnable field-contract checker. That format should be built in.
3. **Generate consumer-side assertions from the inferred contract**, so "read the wrong field" fails before shipping instead of showing an empty column. Every bug in the table above was found by human review, not by tooling.
4. **Signal repeated work.** When the same file/goal is modified repeatedly, or the same endpoint is probed again with contradicting conclusions, surface it: "this area has been attempted N times, results conflict".

---

## What I'm asking for

1. Confirmation of which of the above behaviours are **intended** and which are bugs worth filing (especially: IM↔Web session sharing, `^0.x` spec semantics, plugin management being unavailable to agent sessions).
2. A **public compatibility contract** for plugin authors, and a clear answer on API stability tiers.
3. A **roadmap / stability statement** — what is core, what is experimental, what plugin authors can rely on.

I'm happy to turn any of these into a proper issue with a minimal reproduction, or to test a fix on this setup.

**Environment for everything above:** DSH Web `0.1.7-rc.2` (`profile=web`), Windows, multi-plugin; session-query and skills findings re-verified today on that exact version.

<details>
<summary>中文版（点击展开）</summary>

### 中文版

**TL;DR** —— ①长会话的成本没有消失，它变成了我手工维护的工时；②一次补丁级升级要动六步（含提权与停机），因为插件兼容没有契约；③在结构分析类任务上模型过度自信，而**否定性结论**（"没有 X"）才是最贵的，因为没人会去验证"没有"。

**一、长会话：成本变成了手工劳动。** 本机实测一次高强度会话：584 次调用、约 2.74 亿 token、≈¥31.66，其中 **98.6% 花在重读上下文**，模型输出仅 **0.17%**。为绕开上下文上限，我自建了一套外置记忆：两份交接文档（605 行 / 66 KB 与 1,229 行 / 111 KB）、31 条"别再踩"的硬坑、一个自写的会话检索工具、一套自写的插件兼容体检。**上下文成本没有消失，它变成了我维护 187 KB 交接文档的工时。** 同一条会话的其它代价：日志 4.69 MB 压缩 / 16.68 MB 展开、3,549 条记录、界面要渲染 644 个气泡 + 1,430 张工具卡片、Web 进程常驻 599 MB。会话日志是**多帧追加 zstd**（一次性解压只出第一帧，流式解压报 `Unknown frame descriptor`），我靠扫魔数 `28 B5 2F FD` 切出 **1,946 帧**才能检索。另外：**面型模型的会话检索包缺失**（今天在 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上复核：`dsh-session-query` 与 `dsh-session-query-sqlite` 都在，`dsh-tool-session-query` 不在），所以超长会话里模型没有任何内置手段回查"用户前面说过什么"。**建议**：上下文预算可见 + 分层归档；把面向模型的会话检索纳入默认组合；公开会话格式并提供 `dsh session grep`；内置轮次折叠/虚拟滚动；把"交接摘要"原生化；明确 IM 与 Web 共用 session id 是有意还是默认。

**二、插件兼容：一次补丁级升级要动六步。** 单次升级暴露 3 个兼容问题，且 `dsh: skipping profile bundle` **只写 stderr、不写 `.out`**。上游把图标词表整体改名（`Icon*Outline16` → `Icon*OutlineRegular`）就让插件崩，用户只看到 `Minified React error #138 / #130`——不知道是哪个插件、哪条 API 变了；同一根因在不同版本还报**不同编号**。`^0.53.3` 在 `0.x` 下锁的是次版本，**装不到 `0.57.0`，`install` 会"成功但版本没动"**。插件文件被运行中的守护进程占用，Windows 上换包可能 `EBUSY`，所以更稳的路径是"先停、再升、再起"；而本机运行时由计划任务以**内置 Administrator + InteractiveToken** 拉起，进程是高完整性，普通窗口杀不掉，切换脚本又必须用普通窗口跑 → 正确顺序被逼成「管理员禁看门狗 → 管理员杀进程 → 普通窗口切换 → 管理员恢复看门狗」，看门狗每 1 分钟触发一次，**顺序错一次就死在第 1 步**。更麻烦的是 agent 会话（工作区沙箱）里**任何 `dsh plugin` 命令必然失败**（profile 在工作区外，写 `package.json.lock` 被拒），"让 agent 自己升级插件"这条最自然的路走不通。**建议**：兼容性契约与版本矩阵（那个插件作者已经自己在声明两条支持线了，应由官方推成规范）；启动期兼容体检 + 可执行报错（哪个插件 / 因为哪条 API / 跑什么命令）；插件崩溃报错带上插件名与版本；`dsh plugin upgrade --latest` 直接改 spec 并安装；不停机换包；给 agent 会话一条合法的插件管理通道；**公开 roadmap 与稳定性承诺**——这是"亟需确立产品主要方向"的答案，也是我作为用户最想读到的一份文档。

**三、结构分析：模型过度自信，否定性结论最危险。** 四个案例：①路由在菜单节点的 `link` 字段，模型整轮都在读 `url`（全空），于是判定"菜单里没有该模块"并写进交接文档——下一轮才找到入口；②权限菜单里没有"推广"入口 → 模型判定"该品牌没有推广数据"，实测**菜单无入口 ≠ API 无权限**，网关按登录会话放行并正常返回了数据——这个错误结论也已写进交接文档，若无复核会污染后续所有轮次；③某接口的 `recentDays=1` 会忽略传入的起止时间、恒返回最新一天，"逐日取再求和"得到 **N 倍虚高**且数值看起来正常；④一批静默数据错误（模板读错字段导致列空白、`#N/A` 被当成"未营业"、"杭州/杭州市"两种写法**筛掉了绝大多数本应命中的门店**、X 轴倒序、写死数值、字符串替换把 `join("$$")` 变成 `join("$")`）。**代价**：单次错误归因 = 一整轮返工；最贵的是**污染**（错误结论被后续每一轮继承且看起来像已验证事实）；危害最大的是**静默错误**（数值正常但口径错，而我拿它做经营决策）。**我的归因**（事实）：错误集中在"从非结构化界面反推结构"，且否定性结论的出错率明显更高；**（假设）**模型把"这次没找到"表达成了"不存在"，缺少对自身检索完备性的怀疑，也没有把实测事实与未验证假设分开输出。**建议**：否定性结论强制交叉验证（两条独立证据路径，否则必须标注"未找到 ≠ 不存在"）；结构分析产物化（我手工产出的格式是 **47 条实测事实 + 11 条待验证假设 + 28 条新发现** + 一个可复跑的字段契约核对脚本，这个格式应当内置）；自动生成消费侧断言让错误在上线前报错；识别"重复做功"信号并提示。

**边界声明**：以上是**单人单机**样本，环境（Windows + 多插件 + 沙箱 + 计划任务）比多数用户更极端，数字是我这种用法的量级而非平均值；标注"假设"的部分尚未验证。

</details>

discussions.title: [Feedback] Five smaller gaps with reproducible steps (DSH Web 0.1.7-rc.2, Windows, profile=web)
discussions.body:
This is the companion to my longer post (**[Feedback after ~30 days of daily production use](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8032)**). I'm keeping the five smaller items in one place so they're easy to triage; **happy to split them into five separate issues if that's easier for you** — the titles are listed at the end.

Each item below is self-contained: environment, what I observed, how to reproduce, impact, and what I'd suggest.

> **Desensitisation note:** all group IDs, user IDs, session IDs and machine-specific paths in this post are **placeholders or generic**. I've also removed all client/company names. The technical details — versions, package names, record counts, byte sizes — are unchanged.

**Environment unless stated otherwise:** DSH Web `0.1.7-rc.2`, `profile=web`, Windows, multi-plugin profile, long-lived runtime, sessions fed from both the Web GUI and IM (WeCom) groups.

---

## 1. The model-facing session-query package is not shipped — the model cannot search its own history

**Status: re-verified today on `0.1.7-rc.2`.**

**Observed.** `dsh-session-query` (service contract) and `dsh-session-query-sqlite` (FTS5 backend) are installed. The **model-facing consumer package** (`packages/session-query/tool-session-query` upstream) is **not** part of the published install.

**Evidence.**

```
$ ls <install>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai | grep session
dsh-session-query
dsh-session-query-sqlite
# ... 25 session-related packages in total, including:
#   dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3, dsh-session-persistence-jsonl,
#   dsh-session-projection, dsh-session-log-export, dsh-session-title ...
# (there is no dsh-tool-session-query)
```

`dsh-session-query/README.zh.md` states that reads prefer the live session, that ranked full-text search requires a backend such as `dsh-session-query-sqlite`, and points to `../tool-session-query/README.zh.md` — described there as "for the model as consumer, built on top of this service".

**Impact.** In a long session the model has **no built-in way to look up what the user actually asked earlier**. It can only use whatever is still in context, or write its own script to decompress the session log (which is exactly what I do — see item 4). Users end up copy-pasting history by hand, which is precisely the work that should be automatable.

**Suggestion.** Include `dsh-tool-session-query` in the default composition (the backend already exists), or make it explicitly enable-able via configuration.

---

## 2. No documented filesystem location for user/agent-authored skills — and `skill <name>` gives no hint

**Status: re-verified today on `0.1.7-rc.2`; `<DSH_HOME>/skills` still does not exist.**

**Observed.**

- A skill placed in an ordinary directory (e.g. `<some dir>/skills/ppt-master/`) is invisible: `skill ppt-master` returns
  `"ppt-master" is unknown or no longer available`.
- Searching `<DSH_HOME>`, the DSH install directory and the profile directory turns up **no `skills/` directory** to put one in. `<DSH_HOME>` today contains: `attachments, cache, integrations, llm-deepseek, memories, plugin-src, plugin-src-disabled, profiles, sessions, storages, task-board, vault, ...` — but no `skills`.
- The skill directories that do exist (`dingtalk-*` / `wecomcli-*`) appear to be provided by plugin packages rather than discovered from the filesystem.

**Impact.** A skill that a user or an agent has written cannot be invoked through the `skill` tool; the only workaround is the crude "just read SKILL.md". The skill ecosystem is effectively limited to published plugin packages.

**Suggestion.**

1. Define and document a skill root — e.g. `<DSH_HOME>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` — or support a `skills.dirs` configuration entry.
2. When `skill <name>` fails, say **where skills are loaded from and where one can be placed**, instead of only `unknown or no longer available`. For someone writing their first skill this message is a dead end.

---

## 3. Web UI degrades noticeably on very long sessions; no built-in collapse or virtualisation

**Observed.** After a session accumulated a few thousand records (about 3 hours of continuous development plus IM group traffic), scrolling and typing in the Web UI became visibly laggy.

**Measured, same session:**

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Session log | 4.69 MB compressed / **16.68 MB uncompressed** |
| Records | 3,549 (`tool/call` 710, `tool/result` 720) |
| Must be rendered | **644 chat bubbles + 1,430 tool cards** |
| Oversized records | 43 records > 50 KB, largest 107 KB |
| Web process | 599 MB resident, 710 s cumulative CPU |

**Supporting evidence that this is general, not my edge case:** a community plugin already exists whose whole purpose is to collapse completed turns into a single `processed in Xs` line (kudos to its author) — meaning "long session rendering" is a shared pain.

**Impact.** During long development you must either start a new session mid-task (losing continuity) or work with the lag.

**Suggestion.** Built-in turn collapsing and/or message virtualisation; optionally a threshold hint ("this session has 3,000+ records; consider starting a new one").

---

## 4. The session log is appended multi-frame zstd; there is no official way to read or grep it

**Observed and reproduced.**

```js
// One-shot decompression returns only the FIRST frame:
zstdDecompressSync(readFileSync('session.v3.jsonl.zstd')).toString()
// → a 4.69 MB file yields a single line {"type":"session",...}: it looks empty

// Streaming decompression dies on the second frame:
createZstdDecompress()  // → error: Unknown frame descriptor
```

**What worked** (my current approach): scan for the magic number `28 B5 2F FD`, split into frames, `zstdDecompressSync` each frame, then concatenate:

```
4.69 MB (compressed) → 1,946 frames → 16.68 MB of text → 3,549 JSONL records
```

**Impact.** Anyone — including the application layer — who wants to look up history by keyword has to reverse-engineer the multi-frame layout first, and is likely to conclude "the session is empty" when it isn't.

**Suggestion.**

1. Document the format explicitly: *one zstd frame is appended per batch*.
2. Provide an official read path, e.g. `dsh session grep <pattern>`, or wrap multi-frame decompression in the official reader.

---

## 5. The Web GUI session and IM group sessions share one session id — is that intended?

**Observed.** A single Web session id was mapped to one direct IM conversation **and to several group conversations at the same time**:

```
# environment (Web side)
DSH_SESSION_ID=session-0000…

# dsh-im state mapping (IM side)
"direct:woXXXX…"      → session-0000…
"group:wrXXXX… (group 1)" → session-0000…
"group:wrXXXX… (group 2)" → session-0000…
```

(Group names and IDs replaced with placeholders; the mapping itself is verbatim.)

**Impact.**

1. Group messages and GUI conversation land in **the same history**, so the session grows far faster than pure GUI use — 16.68 MB in about three hours in my case.
2. The two contexts **contaminate each other**: one session is being written from two entry points.
3. When you start or fork a session, **the IM binding does not follow**, which makes it easy to assume "the new session will take over the group messages" — it won't.

**Suggestion.** Please clarify whether this is intended or a default. If it's a default, consider binding IM to its own session by default, or at least badge the session in the UI: *"this session is currently shared by N groups"*.

---

## Ready-to-split titles (if you prefer separate issues)

1. `dsh-tool-session-query` is absent from the published composition — the model cannot search its own session history
2. No documented filesystem location for agent-authored skills — `skill <name>` cannot see them
3. Web UI degrades noticeably on very long sessions; no built-in collapse or virtualisation control
4. Session log is multi-frame appended zstd; no official way to read or grep it
5. The Web GUI session and IM group sessions share one session id — is that intended?

Happy to add a minimal reproduction for any of these, or to test a fix on this setup.

<details>
<summary>中文摘要（点击展开）</summary>

### 中文摘要（五条缺口）

1. **面向模型的会话检索包没有随组合发布**（今天在 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上复核仍成立）：`dsh-session-query` 与 `dsh-session-query-sqlite` 都在，**`dsh-tool-session-query` 不在**。后果：超长会话里模型没有任何内置手段回查"用户前面说过什么"，只能靠上下文残留或自己写脚本解压会话文件。建议纳入默认组合。
2. **用户/agent 自写技能没有可放置的位置**（`<DSH_HOME>/skills` 仍不存在）：放在普通目录里的技能，`skill <name>` 返回 `unknown or no longer available`；建议明确技能根目录（或 `skills.dirs` 配置），并让报错提示"技能从哪里加载、可以放到哪里"。
3. **超长会话让 Web 界面明显卡顿**：3,549 条记录、展开 16.68 MB、需渲染 644 个气泡 + 1,430 张工具卡片、进程常驻 599 MB；社区已有"折叠已完成轮次"的插件，说明是普遍痛点。建议内置轮次折叠/虚拟滚动 + 阈值提示。
4. **会话文件是多帧追加 zstd，没有官方读取方式**：一次性解压只出第一帧（看起来像空文件），流式解压到第二帧报 `Unknown frame descriptor`；我靠扫魔数 `28 B5 2F FD` 切出 **1,946 帧**才能检索。建议把格式写进文档，并提供 `dsh session grep` 之类的官方入口。
5. **Web 会话与 IM 群会话共用同一个 session id**：一个 Web session 同时映射到 1 个单聊 + 多个群聊 → 历史混在一起（3 小时到 16.68 MB）、上下文互相污染、且分叉会话时 IM 绑定不会跟着走。请澄清是有意还是默认。

**脱敏声明**：本贴所有群 ID / userid / session id / 本机路径均为占位符或通用写法，客户与公司名已全部移除；版本号、包名、记录数、字节数等技术细节未改动。

</details>

discussions.title: Feature request: SessionFormatError should name the offending row (seq / row type / source plugin)
discussions.body:
Feature request: SessionFormatError should name the offending row (seq / row type / source plugin)
Context (from closed thread #7800): refusing source.kind === "plugin" rows at write time is intentional and unchanged rc.1 → rc.2 — the producer in our environment was a third-party plugin (dsh-vision-router 2.2.2, fixed by upgrading to 2.2.3). The genuine core-side papercut we hit is the failure mode: the whole batch fails without naming the offending event, the primary turn error is masked, and session-title generation + projection cache fail on the same encoding path — so the producer is not identifiable from the error message.

Suggested change
In assertV4SourceRowAdmission (packages/session/session-format-v3-to-v4/src/message-sources.ts) the whole row is already in scope at the call site — the switch at :32–:40 dispatches on row['type'] — while the source() helper that actually throws (:7–12) only sees a single message. So no new data flow is needed, just pass the row context into the error:

include row.type (and seq where available) in the raised SessionFormatError;
include the source plugin id when the refused source has one.
This turns today's generic "needed producer-owned source" into "row <type, seq> from plugin X was refused" — enough to locate the producer immediately.

Workaround warning for current users (keep as its own paragraph)
Until producers are patched, the interim fix is a reader-side tolerance: rewrite kind:"plugin" rows into a producer-owned shape inside assertV4SourceRowAdmission instead of throwing. It lives in node_modules, so it must be re-applied after every app update. And rows already persisted in session files keep failing on every encode — so disabling the offending plugin alone does not recover existing sessions; only this tolerance (or cleaning the rows) fixes them, while upgrading the producer prevents new rows.

Optional alternative
Admit kind:"plugin" at encode time as a legacy alias and rewrite it to a producer-owned kind — saves every affected plugin user the same papercut.

discussions.title: [Bug] spawn_teammate 不能把队友分派到其他模型或其他厂商
discussions.body:
## Summary

启用 Agent Teams 后，主模型无法把队友分到另一个模型，或另一个已登录厂商。这不是 OAuth 把子会话锁在当前厂商上。`spawn_teammate` 没有模型参数，创建时也没有传入 `agentOptions`，队友只能继承主会话当前的 provider 和 model。

相关讨论：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6985

## Reproduction

1. 启用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`。
2. 用 OAuth 登录两个厂商，并把两边的模型都写入路由。也可在 `subagent-model-selection-settings` 里允许多条 `provider/model`。
3. 让主模型使用 Agent Team，并把某个队友派到另一个厂商的模型。

## Current behavior

`spawn_teammate` 只接受 `name`、`description`、`prompt`、`context`。执行时写入的 `provider` 是子代理通道 `spawn` 或 `fork`，不是 LLM 厂商：

```ts
provider: context === "fork" ? config.forkProvider : config.freshProvider
```

`agentTeams.spawnTeammate` 的 `SpawnTeammateRequest` 同样没有模型字段。`roster` 调用 `subagents.startContinuable` 时只传 `prompt` 和 `parent`，不传 `agentOptions`。子会话因此走 `resolveChildAgentOptions`：没有覆盖项时，继承主会话这次请求的 `provider`、`model` 和 `reasoningEffort`。

能指定 `provider`、`model`、`reasoning_effort` 的是 `subagent`。Agent Team 的 profile patch 把 `tool-subagent` 和 `tool-subagent-fork` 设为 `disabled: true`。`subagent-model-selection-settings` 的允许名单只作用于这条被关掉的工具，`spawn_teammate` 不会读它。

OAuth 凭证按厂商分开保存。子会话只要被创建成另一个已登录的厂商，就会使用那一家自己的令牌。当前工具没有把另一家的 `provider` 和 `model` 传下去，所以这一步不会发生。

已在本机安装的 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 中核对 `app.asar` 里的 `dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team`：`spawn_teammate` 的参数仍是上述四项。

## Expected behavior

`spawn_teammate` 接受可选的 `provider`、`model` 和 `reasoning_effort`。创建队友时把它们放进 `request.agentOptions`，再交给 `startContinuable`。未填写时继续继承主会话。指定了另一条已配置且已登录的路由时，队友使用该路由自己的凭证。若会话启用了模型选择允许名单，显式选择也应受到同一名单约束。

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 0.1.7-rc.2）
- macOS，profile `desktop`
- 已启用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`
- 主会话通过 OAuth 使用已拉取的模型

discussions.title: migrate-sessions-to-v4 子进程在 Windows 上原生崩溃（0xC0000005，node 24.17.0/win32-x64）
discussions.body:
## Summary

在 Windows 上以仓库自带测试跑 `scripts/migrate-sessions-to-v4.spec.ts` 时，迁移 CLI 的子进程会以原生崩溃退出（退出码 3221225477 = 0xC0000005，Access Violation）。隔离跑该文件时 3 条子测试中有 1 条崩溃；在完整单元套件并行负载下崩溃扩大到 5/5 条子测试。同样的代码与用例在 Linux 上无崩溃（详见 Environment）。

## Reproduction

1. Windows x64 机器，checkout `dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`（commit c36a83ff），`pnpm install`。
2. 使用 node v24.17.0（win32-x64）执行：
   `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run scripts/migrate-sessions-to-v4.spec.ts`
3. 观察 `one-time V4 migration command` 下的子测试；崩溃子测试的断言信息为：
   `expected 3221225477 to be +0`（子进程 status 为 0xC0000005）。

完整套件负载下（`vitest run` 全仓库），以下 5 条子测试全部以 0xC0000005 崩溃：
- `preserves none parent/child history and catalog with serial or parallel jobs`
- `preserves zstd parent/child history and catalog with serial or parallel jobs`
- `publishes none successors, preserves sources and current bytes on rerun`
- `publishes zstd successors, preserves sources and current bytes on rerun`
- `shows help, rejects unknown arguments, and logs a missing root failure`

崩溃点不局限于 zstd 相关路径（`none` 变体与 `shows help` 也崩），提示更接近子进程 spawn/启动路径上的原生崩溃，而非具体数据编解码问题。

## Current behavior

- 隔离跑：1/3 子测试崩溃（`publishes none successors, preserves sources and current bytes on rerun`）。
- 全量并行负载：5/5 子测试崩溃，稳定复现。
- 子测试输出显示崩溃发生在迁移子进程内部（stdout 已打印 `Session migration to V4 started ... Node: v24.17.0; platform: win32/x64` 之后）。

## Expected behavior

子进程在 Windows 上正常完成迁移并退出 0（与 Linux 行为一致）。

## Environment

- 仓库版本：`dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`（commit c36a83ff）
- OS：Windows 10 x64（build 19043）
- Node：v24.17.0（win32-x64）
- pnpm：11.7.0（与 packageManager 一致）
- 对照组：同一 tag、同一用例在 Linux x64（Ubuntu 24.04，官方 node v24.17.0 tarball）下无任何崩溃（仅 1 条与本问题无关的 5s testTimeout 超时）。

注：Windows 侧 node 为某 Electron 桌面应用分发的运行时副本（版本号 v24.17.0/win32-x64）；不排除该分发与官方 Windows 构建存在差异。希望上游协助确认：官方 Windows node 构建下能否复现，以及是否为 node 在 win32 的已知问题。当前暂不提交 PR，待确认修复方向。

discussions.title: client-test-runtime 装配解析依赖 pnpm 调用上下文：直接以 node 调用 vitest 时 22 个 client 套件加载失败
discussions.body:
## Summary

`packages/test-support/client-runtime` 的装配测试对 vitest 的**调用方式**有隐含依赖：经 pnpm 上下文（`pnpm run test` / `pnpm exec vitest`）运行时全部通过；直接以 `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run ...` 运行时，22 个 client 套件在加载期失败。该行为在 Windows 与 Linux 上一致（平台无关），上游 CI 因使用 pnpm 脚本而不受影响。

## Reproduction

同一份检出（`dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`，commit c36a83ff，`pnpm install` 后），同一文件系统状态：

| 调用方式 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `pnpm run test`（或 `pnpm exec vitest run <file>`） | ✅ 通过（如 session.client.spec.ts 61/61） |
| `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run <file>` | ❌ 套件加载失败 |

失败文件共 22 个：`packages/api/session-controller`（9）、`packages/api/workspace-controller`（1）、`packages/client/*`（7）、`packages/test-support/client-runtime/tests/assembly-*`（7，含 bundle-roster 自身的装配测试）。

## Current behavior

直接调用时加载期抛出：

```
Error: client-test-runtime: cannot resolve plugin package @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app from @deepseek-ai/dsh-base, @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
 ❯ bundleRoster packages/test-support/client-runtime/src/assembly/bundle-roster.ts:69:13
```

已定位的相关事实：
- `locateManifest`（bundle-roster.ts:69）从 bundle 层锚点（`packages/bundle/base`、`packages/bundle/web-app` 的 manifest 路径）向上按 `createRequire(anchor).resolve.paths(name)` 探测候选 node_modules。
- 干净安装后，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 仅作为 `client-runtime` 的 peerDependencies 落在 `packages/test-support/client-runtime/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` 下；root node_modules 与两个 bundle 锚点的祖先 node_modules 中均无该链接（Windows 与 Linux 相同）。
- 文件系统状态完全相同的情况下，pnpm 上下文可解析成功、直接 node 调用失败；pnpm exec 注入的环境差集包含 PATH 前置 `node_modules/.bin`、`PNPM_PACKAGE_NAME`、`npm_command` 等，具体起作用的变量未逐一二分。

## Expected behavior

测试结果不依赖 vitest 的启动方式：或 `locateManifest` 对纯 workspace 布局有回退解析路径（例如从默认锚点/当前包自身 node_modules 解析，readLayer 层已能成功解析同一包，说明该链接在消费侧是存在的），或在文档中明确「client 套件必须经 pnpm 脚本运行」。

## Workaround（已验证）

在 root node_modules 补建链接后直调也通过（Windows 验证 61/61）：
`mklink /J node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-web-app packages\bundle\web-app`

## Environment

- 仓库版本：`dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`（commit c36a83ff）
- OS：Windows 10 x64（build 19043）与 Linux x64（Ubuntu 24.04/WSL2）双平台复现
- Node：v24.17.0；pnpm：11.7.0（与 packageManager 一致）

当前暂不提交 PR，待确认期望的修复方向（回退解析 or 文档化约束）。

discussions.title: `pnpm run clean` 在 master 上必然失败：`clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types`
discussions.body:
## 环境

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 仓库版本 | `477b4f4205`（master，2026-09-24）——与远端 `refs/heads/master` 完全一致 |
| `scripts/clean.ts` blob | `bb789f298c439a26f39dc5bfceffd878eb8fa3cc`（经 GitHub API 核对，与上游一致） |
| `tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json` blob | `28cdd1bf9c345614c26acdf881636003ebb0ed80`（与上游一致） |
| Node / 包管理器 | Node v25.2.0 / pnpm（以仓库 `packageManager` 字段为准） |

这**不是**本地特殊状态：上述两个文件与 GitHub `master` 提供的字节完全一致。出错路径是纯粹的 TypeScript 配置解析逻辑，与操作系统无关，在 Linux 和 macOS 上应同样复现。

## 概述

在干净的 `master` checkout 上，`pnpm run clean`（即 `tsx scripts/clean.ts`）报错：

```
clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types
```

该失败与工作区里是否有东西可删无关——错误在遍历项目引用图时抛出，**早于**任何存在性检查。因此即使是一个从未构建过的新克隆，也会失败。

由于 `RepositoryCleaner.plan()` 先校验全部目标、`clean()` 只在 `plan()` 返回后才执行删除，这个 throw 会中止**所有**删除。结果是：`pnpm run clean`——清理陈旧构建产物的官方手段——在 master 上完全失效。

## 最小复现

```bash
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
git checkout 477b4f4205
pnpm install
pnpm run clean
# → clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types
# → 退出码 1
```

## 根因

`scripts/clean.ts` 从根项目引用图推导删除目标。对每个声明了 `outDir` 的项目，它断言输出目录遵循仓库的 `lib/types` 约定，仅硬编码了一个例外（`nativeEntryOutput`）——见第 135–144 行：

```ts
if (parsed.options.outDir !== undefined) {
  const typesDirectory = resolve(parsed.options.outDir)
  const outputDirectory = basename(typesDirectory) === 'types'
    ? dirname(typesDirectory)
    : typesDirectory === nativeEntryOutput
      ? typesDirectory
      : undefined
  if (outputDirectory === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: ${repositoryPath(this.root, typesDirectory)}`)
  }
```

而 `tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json`（第 6 行）声明了一个非常规输出目录：

```json
"outDir": "lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types"
```

`basename()` 得到 `desktop-keyboard-test-types`，既不等于 `types`，也不是 native entry 路径，于是守卫抛错。

我审计了仓库内全部 `outDir`（所有 `tsconfig*.json`，约 300 个项目）：**只有这一个不以 `/types` 结尾**，其余都是 `lib/types`。

### 引入过程

| 提交 | 日期 | 变更 |
|---|---|---|
| `787b4e6b9e` | 2026-07-25 | 在 `clean.ts` 中加入 `...end in /types` 断言 |
| `6a82709a2b` | 2026-09-22 | 新增 `tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json`（含非常规 `outDir`），并在 `tsconfig.client.json` 中引用 |

`clean.ts` 断言的不变式在写下时成立，两个月后失效。第二次提交没有同步更新 `clean.ts`。

### 为什么 CI 没抓到

任何 workflow 都从未调用 `clean`——`.github/workflows/` 下不存在 `run: ... pnpm run clean`，也没有对 `clean.ts` 的调用。`scripts/clean.spec.ts` 存在，但同样不在 CI 中运行；`scripts/run-gates.ts` 也没有定义 `clean` gate。因此这个回归对自动化不可见。

## 影响

1. `pnpm run clean` 在 master 上完全不可用——开发者、以及任何串联调用它的脚本都不行。
2. 陈旧构建残留因而不断累积。我的情况是：4 个因包被删除而遗留的目录（`settings-file`、`agent-presets`、`agent-team-web-profile`、`ui-settings-unarchive-sessions`；均为 git 未跟踪，仅含 `lib/` + `node_modules/`）无法通过官方命令清除。
3. 这些残留会进一步**弄坏构建**。`tsdown.config.ts` 以 `packages/*/*` 扫描 workspace，入口为 `lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js`，于是一个已删除包的陈旧 `lib/types/*.js` 仍被当作构建输入。这产生了一个指向完全错误位置的迷惑性报错：

```
[MISSING_EXPORT] "SettingsProvider" is not exported by "../settings/src/index.ts".
    ╭─[ lib/types/index.js:17:10 ]
 17 │ import { SettingsProvider } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings';
```

该文件是 `packages/settings/settings-file/lib/types/index.js`，属于 `601d6761e4` 中已删除包的陈旧产物，仍在 import `dsh-settings` 已不再导出的符号（现在导出的是 `SettingsForms` 等）。报错点名的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`，真正元凶（一个孤儿目录）从消息里完全看不出来。第二个孤儿目录则表现为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets` 的 `[UNRESOLVED_IMPORT]`。

从使用者角度看，最费解的是官方给出的补救路径自我矛盾：构建报错让你「run `pnpm run build` before launch」，而本可修复底层残留的清理命令，却卡在它自己的断言上。

## 修复建议

两种改法都很小；选哪种取决于该守卫的意图。

**方案 A —— 让配置合规（改动最小，保持守卫的既有意图）。**

在 `tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json` 中重命名输出目录，使其满足现有约定：

```diff
-    "outDir": "lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types",
+    "outDir": "lib/desktop-keyboard-test/types",
```

此时 `basename()` 等于 `types`，`dirname()` 得到 `lib/desktop-keyboard-test`，守卫通过。我已核实字符串 `desktop-keyboard-test-types` 在仓库其他位置**没有任何出现**（无消费者、无 `.gitignore` 条目），因此重命名没有额外成本。该项目是根级的 `emitDeclarationOnly` 类型测试夹具，并非发布的包，该目录下没有 tsdown 的同级运行时 bundle，删除其父目录是正确的。

**方案 B —— 泛化 `clean.ts`（若该守卫本意是「面向 package 的」，则这是根因修复）。**

注意 `nativeEntryOutput` 特例其实已被通用规则涵盖：「若末级不是 `types`，则 `outDir` 自身即是完整输出根」。`native/system/packages/entry/lib` 的 basename 是 `lib`，会走 `typesDirectory` 分支——与当前硬编码例外完全一致。这说明该例外与 throw 可以一并替换为：

```diff
-        const outputDirectory = basename(typesDirectory) === 'types'
-          ? dirname(typesDirectory)
-          : typesDirectory === nativeEntryOutput
-            ? typesDirectory
-            : undefined
-        if (outputDirectory === undefined) {
-          throw new Error(`clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: ${repositoryPath(this.root, typesDirectory)}`)
-        }
+        // 项目的 `lib/types` 与 tsdown 产出的同级运行时 bundle 并列，因此整个
+        // `lib` 才是输出根。其他 `outDir` 是专门用途目录、旁边没有别的东西，
+        // 因此该目录自身就是输出根。
+        const outputDirectory = basename(typesDirectory) === 'types'
+          ? dirname(typesDirectory)
+          : typesDirectory
```

随后移除不再使用的 `nativeEntryOutput`，并在 `clean.spec.ts` 增加一个覆盖非常规 `outDir` 的用例。既有的 `assertRepositoryTarget()` 调用仍会把每个目标限制在仓库内。

两种方案的本地补丁我都有，如需可附上，并一并提供回归测试。

## 相关观察（独立问题，优先级较低）

与 `clean` 无关的一点：`tsdown.config.ts` 会把任何匹配 `packages/*/*` 的目录都当作 workspace 成员，并不要求存在 `package.json`。叠加入口 glob `lib/types/*.js`，一个已删除包的残留输出会被静默地当作活跃源码编译。若加上 manifest 要求（或排除无 manifest 的目录），这个失败模式便无法发生，我遇到的迷惑性 `MISSING_EXPORT` 也会消失。之所以提及，是因为它让诊断 `clean` 这个 bug 多花了远不该花的时间；上面的 `clean` 失败才是真正需要处理的事项。

discussions.title: Local System One: a reversible local Search Gate for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
Local System One: a reversible local Search Gate for DeepSeek Harness

I’ve been experimenting with using a small local typed-decision model as a control layer in front of an agent, instead of spending the main LLM on every small routing decision.

The result is Local System One, and it now has a native DeepSeek Harness community bundle:

Repository: "NMTZ-z/system-one-benchmark-lab"
Install branch: "dsh-plugin"

Install it into a headless profile:

dsh plugin --profile headless add github:NMTZ-z/system-one-benchmark-lab#dsh-plugin

The bundle installs in OFF mode by default, so installation itself does not change agent behavior.

The first version intentionally implements only one control primitive: Search Gate.

It uses native DSH lifecycle points to:

- evaluate the user intent once at "agent/pre-step"
- keep the decision scoped to the current turn
- observe actual tool identity at "tools/pre-execute"
- optionally deny a small audited set of public-Web tools
- clear state at "turn/end"

There are three modes:

off -> shadow -> canary

Shadow records the local decision without changing tool execution.

Canary requires explicit acknowledgement, and only deterministic hard rules have deny authority. Model probabilities remain observation-only.

The adapter is fail-open: service errors, malformed responses and timeouts leave the original DSH tool path untouched.

The first validated target is:

DeepSeek Harness: dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2
commit: 477b4f420553e8a52c2fbccc464d7561b239c443

The package declares an exact DSH compatibility fence rather than assuming future Developer Preview releases remain compatible.

Real validation included:

DeepSeek Harness
    -> Nova provider
    -> DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
    -> Local System One Search Gate
    -> native DSH tool lifecycle

We also tested OFF, Shadow, acknowledged Canary, fail-open on service failure, timeout behavior, model-vs-rule authority isolation, cross-turn cleanup, GitHub installation through "dsh plugin", and clean bundle removal.

The goal is not to replace DeepSeek or the Harness agent loop. Local System One stays a small, reversible control plane for decisions where a structured local answer is enough.

Feedback on the integration pattern, Cordis lifecycle usage, and useful additional control gates is welcome.

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.1.7-rc.2 / master：Windows 上「打开目录 / 在资源管理器中显示」的窗口不可见、或只在任务栏不弹前台 —— SW_HIDE 泄漏 + Windows 前台锁
discussions.body:
# [Bug] 0.1.7-rc.2 / master：Windows 上「打开目录 / 在资源管理器中显示」的窗口不可见、或只在任务栏不弹前台

> English version below.

## TL;DR

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.7-rc.2`（以及 master）在 Windows 上通过 `openNativePath()` 打开**目录**时有两个独立缺陷：

1. **窗口被创建，但不可见。** `runNativeCommand` 恒以 `windowsHide: true`（`STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE`）启动子进程；Explorer 会把调用方的显示状态带给它创建或激活的窗口，于是窗口 `IsWindowVisible = false`——而 `POST /open-in-app/open` 依然返回 `200 {ok:true}`，界面无任何报错。
2. **窗口存在，却只在任务栏出现、不弹到前台。** 启动链是「浏览器（前台）→ HTTP → DSH 宿主（后台）→ 子进程」，后台进程被 Windows 前台锁拒绝；即使绕开前台锁，若执行激活的进程随即退出，焦点也会被交还给上一个活动窗口。

**修复**：① 目录改用 `explorer.exe <encoded file URI>` + `windowsHide: false` 启动；② 在**宿主进程内**用 `koffi` 直接调 `user32`（`EnumWindows` 定位窗口 → 最小化 → 还原 → `SetForegroundWindow`），与打开并行、best-effort。

## 版本与环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` **0.1.7-rc.2**（`dist-tags.next`），并对照 `master`
- Windows 11 25H2（build 26200.9457），Node 24.19.0
- 涉及界面：会话头部 open-in-app 的「文件资源管理器」条目（`explorer` 目录 id，win32 上唯一的 `shell-open` 条目），以及 `revealNativePath()` 的「在资源管理器中显示」

## 一、发布产物核验（0.1.7-rc.2 真实 npm tarball）

解开发布包逐处确认（`lib/index.js` 是 exports 映射实际加载的 bundle，`lib/types/*.js` 是随包发布的同伴文件）：

```js
// lib/types/runner.js:14（lib/index.js:22 是同一份 bundle 内的副本）
execFile(command, [...args], { encoding: "utf8", signal, windowsHide: true }, (error, stdout, stderr) => {

// lib/types/path-opener.js:115（lib/index.js:143 同上）
await run('explorer.exe', args, signal);   // 未传启动状态 → 继承 SW_HIDE
```

即：Explorer 重写已发布（`Invoke-Item` 在全包内已无命中），但 **runner 仍硬编码 `windowsHide: true`**，`runExplorer` 也未覆盖它。

## 二、缺陷一：窗口被创建但不可见（SW_HIDE 泄漏）

`windowsHide: true` 在子进程的 `STARTUPINFO` 中设置 `SW_HIDE`；当该子进程请求外壳打开/激活文件夹时，Explorer 会把调用方的显示状态应用到它创建（或激活）的窗口上——窗口不可见，而请求本身"成功"。

**实测**（Windows 11 25H2 build 26200.9457；每次先关闭目标窗口，再启动一次，用 `Shell.Application.Windows()` + `IsWindowVisible`/`IsIconic` 读取状态）：

| 启动方式（0.1.7 的实际 argv） | `windowsHide` | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `explorer.exe <encoded file URI>` | **true**（现状） | **不可见** ❌ `IsWindowVisible=false`、`IsWindow=true`、`IsIconic=false` |
| `explorer.exe <encoded file URI>` | false | 可见 ✅ |
| `rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler <path>` | **true** | **不可见** ❌（证明是启动状态，而非选哪个启动器） |

被隐藏的窗口并未销毁：`ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOW)` 可以恢复（实测有效）。宿主机上曾累计出现 8 个这样的隐形 `file:///D:/Innovation` 窗口。

## 三、缺陷二：窗口只出现在任务栏、不弹到前台

修好可见性后，窗口会正常出现（`IsWindowVisible=true`、`IsIconic=false`），但**不进入前台**：只多出一个任务栏按钮。根因两层，都在 Windows 侧：

1. 后台进程无权抢前台：`SetForegroundWindow` 返回 `False`，系统只闪一下任务栏；
2. 即使用"最小化 → 还原"绕开前台锁成功拿到前台，**执行激活的进程一退出，焦点立刻交还给上一个活动窗口**。

**实测**（同上环境，浏览器为前台）：

| 抬升手法 | 调用返回 | +1s / +4s 实测 |
|---|---|---|
| 裸 `SetForegroundWindow` | False | ❌（副作用：把窗口弄回隐藏） |
| `AttachThreadInput` + `SetForegroundWindow` | False | ❌ |
| `SetWindowPos(HWND_TOP)`（仅调 z 序，不抢焦点） | True | ❌ 观感无变化 |
| `HWND_TOPMOST` → `HWND_NOTOPMOST` | True | ❌ 反而留下一个最小化窗口 |
| 最小化→还原 + `SetForegroundWindow`，**执行进程随即退出** | True | ❌ **1 秒内焦点被交还** |
| 最小化→还原 + `SetForegroundWindow`，**由常驻进程执行** | True | ✅ **前台稳定停在目标窗口** |

结论：抬升必须由**生命周期长于该次点击**的进程执行——这正是把它放进 DSH 宿主进程（而非短命子进程）的原因。

**边界**：若另一个程序正在主动争抢前台（实测中，同机上一个交互式 TUI 控制台就会），任何启动器都无法稳压它。这属于系统级限制，不属于本缺陷。

## 四、修复

### 1）目录分支改用可见启动状态

`packages/util/native-command/src/path-opener.ts` → `openWindowsPath()`，目录交给 Explorer 自身的 CLI，并用可见启动状态；退出码 1 仍视为"已交接给运行中的外壳"（与 `revealNativePath()` 的既有处理一致）：

```diff
-  await run('explorer.exe', args, signal)
+  await run('explorer.exe', args, signal, { windowsHide: false })
```

配套（缺陷一的根因所在，`src/runner.ts`）：把 `windowsHide` 提升为**每次调用可选参数**，默认 `true`，所有既有调用方行为不变：

```diff
+export interface NativeCommandOptions {
+  /** 默认 true；子进程要创建用户窗口的调用方传 false。 */
+  windowsHide?: boolean
+}
 export type NativeCommandRunner = (
   command: string,
   args: readonly string[],
   signal: AbortSignal,
+  options?: NativeCommandOptions,
 ) => Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string }>
-export const runNativeCommand: NativeCommandRunner = (command, args, signal) =>
+export const runNativeCommand: NativeCommandRunner = (command, args, signal, options = {}) =>
   new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     execFile(
       command,
       [...args],
-      { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: true },
+      { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: options.windowsHide ?? true },
```

（文件/文档路径保持原样，不改变"用默认程序打开"的语义。）

### 2）在宿主进程内抬升窗口

`openWindowsPath()` 内，与打开**并行**发起一次 best-effort 抬升（失败不影响已经成功的打开）：

```ts
// 用 DSH 已随装的 koffi 绑定 user32，不起任何子进程
const koffi = (await import('koffi')).default
const lib = koffi.load('user32.dll')
// EnumWindows 找到目标窗口：窗口类 CabinetWClass 且标题前缀为 "<文件夹名> - "
//（标题前缀与系统语言无关）
lib.func('bool EnumWindows(void *lpEnumFunc, intptr_t lParam)')(callback, 0)
// 后台进程被前台锁拒绝，先最小化再还原——还原这一步才解锁激活
lib.func('bool ShowWindow(intptr_t h, int cmd)')(handle, 6)   // SW_MINIMIZE
await delay(140)
lib.func('bool ShowWindow(intptr_t h, int cmd)')(handle, 9)   // SW_RESTORE
await delay(90)
lib.func('bool SetForegroundWindow(intptr_t h)')(handle)
```

因为宿主进程常驻，**不需要任何"保持激活"**（见第三节最后两行实测）。

**延迟**：宿主内直调实测 **窗口成为前台 555 ms**、`openNativePath` 返回 662 ms；其中 `EnumWindows` 单次 2 ms、抬升动作约 230 ms（两次等待 140 + 90 ms），瓶颈回到 `explorer.exe` 自身创建窗口的耗时。

**实现注意**：`koffi` 不允许重复定义同名类型。`koffi.proto("bool EnumWindowsProc(...)")` 必须**定义一次并缓存**——若在轮询循环中每次重新定义，第二次迭代即抛 `Duplicate type name`，而该异常会被 best-effort 的 `catch` 吞掉，表现为"补丁已生效、窗口却完全没有被抬升"，非常难定位。

## 五、影响面

- 仅 Windows；影响所有通过 `openNativePath()` 打开**目录**的界面（最明显的是 open-in-app 的「文件资源管理器」条目），以及 `revealNativePath()` 的「在资源管理器中显示」。
- macOS / Linux 分支与 `argv` 方式启动的条目（VS Code / Windows 终端 / Git Bash）不受影响。
- 与本包 README 已自述的另一条限制无关：非交互会话（服务 / session 0）中 `explorer.exe` 不触发文件关联、约 1 秒后仍返回 1，于是"报成功但什么都没打开"。

---

## English

**Two independent defects when 0.1.7-rc.2 opens a folder on Windows.**

**(1) The window is created but invisible.** `runNativeCommand` always spawns with `windowsHide: true`, which sets `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE` in the child's `STARTUPINFO`; Explorer applies the caller's show state to the window it creates or re-activates, so the window is `IsWindowVisible = false` while `POST /open-in-app/open` still answers `200 {ok:true}` and the UI shows no error. Verified against the published artifact: `lib/types/runner.js:14` (`lib/index.js:22`) hard-codes `windowsHide: true`, and `lib/types/path-opener.js:115` (`lib/index.js:143`) calls `await run('explorer.exe', args, signal)` with no launch-state option. Measured on Windows 11 25H2 (build 26200.9457): `explorer.exe <encoded file URI>` with `windowsHide: true` → invisible window; with `windowsHide: false` → visible. `rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler` with `windowsHide: true` is invisible too, so the flag — not the launcher — is the variable. Hidden windows are not destroyed (`ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOW)` restores them; eight had accumulated on the reporting host).

**(2) The window only appears in the taskbar.** With visibility fixed the window exists (`IsWindowVisible = true`, `IsIconic = false`) but never reaches the foreground. Two Windows-side causes: a background process is refused by the foreground lock (`SetForegroundWindow` returns `False`, the shell only flashes the taskbar), and even the minimize → restore trick that *does* unlock the activation is undone the moment the activating process exits — measured: with an immediate exit the foreground is back on the browser within a second; when the raise runs from a long-lived process it stays. Bare `SetForegroundWindow`, `AttachThreadInput` + `SetForegroundWindow`, `SetWindowPos(HWND_TOP)` and a `HWND_TOPMOST` → `HWND_NOTOPMOST` cycle all failed to raise it (the last one even left the window minimized).

**Fix.** (a) `openWindowsPath()` opens a directory through Explorer's own CLI with a visible launch state — `run('explorer.exe', args, signal, { windowsHide: false })`, keeping exit code 1 as the delegated handoff — and `src/runner.ts` gains a per-call `windowsHide` option (default `true`, so every existing caller is unchanged). (b) The window is raised from the **host process**, in parallel with the open and best effort, using the `koffi` that DSH already ships: bind `user32.dll`, find the window with `EnumWindows` (class `CabinetWClass`, title prefix `"<folder name> - "`, which is locale-independent), `ShowWindow(SW_MINIMIZE)` → 140 ms → `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)` → 90 ms → `SetForegroundWindow`. Because the host outlives the call, no keep-alive is needed. Measured: **foreground after 555 ms**, `openNativePath` returns in 662 ms (`EnumWindows` 2 ms, the raise ~230 ms), leaving Explorer's own window creation as the floor. Implementation trap: `koffi` refuses to define the same type name twice, so `koffi.proto(...)` must be created once and cached — re-creating it inside the polling loop throws `Duplicate type name` from the second iteration, and a best-effort catch turns that into "patched, yet the window is never raised".

**Scope.** Windows only; affects every surface opening a *directory* through `openNativePath()` (most visibly the open-in-app File Explorer entry) and `revealNativePath()`. macOS/Linux branches and `argv`-launched entries (VS Code, Windows Terminal, Git Bash) are unaffected. Unrelated to the README's Known Limitation about non-interactive sessions, where `explorer.exe` opens nothing and still exits 1.

discussions.title: Desktop 窗口贡献 seam：让插件注册独立窗口（桌面伙伴 / 悬浮球 / 状态 HUD）
discussions.body:
## 背景

DSH 的插件模型已经能把 Host 能力（Service / Event / Registry）和浏览器 UI（Slots）都交给社区插件；桌面端也已经有 Electron 壳（`apps/desktop` + `apps/desktop-host`）。我们想做一个"桌面伙伴"插件：作为 Service 被其他插件调用、监听 `session/event` 等事件做出动作反馈，最终形态是一个独立窗口（置顶、透明、点击穿透、不被截屏）。初期可以渲染在主窗口的 Slot 里，但"始终漂浮在桌面上"必须由独立窗口承载。

## 现状限制

- 浏览器插件只能通过 Slots 组合进 Web 文档内部，无法表达"应用窗口之外的桌面 UI"；
- Host 插件运行在 Electron RunAsNode 模式下，拿不到 `BrowserWindow` 等窗口 API；
- Desktop 的安全姿态（renderer 无文件系统、无原始 Electron IPC、无 shell）决定了不能直接向插件开放 Electron 窗口 API；
- 目前做独立窗口只能改 `apps/desktop` 外壳，社区先例是整仓 fork（`mini-yifan/deepseek-harness-orb` 的 `floating-window.ts` / `observation-frame-window.ts` / `selection-toolbar-window.ts` / `macos-sck-napi`），小需求承担了长期合并成本。

## 用例

1. 桌面伙伴 / 桌宠（透明、置顶、点击穿透、可拖动；后续形态为 Live2D）；
2. 悬浮球类助手；
3. 任务状态 HUD、通知气泡、语音条；
4. 上述窗口需要"从截屏中排除自己"（与 Computer Use 共存）。

## 提案：window contribution seam

核心思路：**窗口由 shell 创建并持有，插件只做注册**；复用 DSH 现有 seam 模式，而不是开放 Electron API。

### 规范对齐（Cordis seam 映射）

实现遵循 DSH/Cordis 现有 seam 规范：贡献插件是 **Consumer**，Desktop Host 是 **Provider**（Service Definition 为 `DesktopWindowsService`）；每个窗口是 shell 拥有的 **Window Registry** 里的一条 **Registration**，生命周期挂在贡献方 **Fiber** 的 effect 上（插件卸载 / 移除 bundle 即关窗）；窗口状态变化用 **Cordis Event** 广播，不写入 SessionEvent；Host ↔ Client 走 **TypertRemoteService + API Gateway**（不新增 `/api` interceptor）；窗口内容作为 **Slots 之外的第二类 UI surface** 挂载，复用 `dsh.client` 浏览器 roster 机制；分发仍走 **Bundle / Patch**，不新增 manifest 格式。

### 挂载方式（二选一或并存，想听维护者意见）

- **A. 程序化 Registry（推荐 v1）**：`apps/desktop-host` 提供 application 服务 `ctx.desktopWindows`，插件 `inject` 后 `register()` 并返回 disposer；bundle 契约不变，无需新 manifest 格式。
- **B. 声明式行**：bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入窗口声明行，Loader 直接生效，不需要插件写代码；适合纯展示型窗口，但无法表达运行期条件。

### 内容承载（想听维护者意见）

- **a. Client 插件 surface（倾向）**：窗口挂载该插件声明的 client 半部；复用现有 `dsh.client` 浏览器 roster 机制（`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` 里已有 Host 行与浏览器 roster 行同 bundle 的先例），只是多一个 window surface 挂载点。插件得到正常的浏览器插件环境，Slots 的认知可以直接迁移。
- **b. 受限文档**：窗口加载插件提供的文档，采用与 `apps/desktop/src/platform-view.ts`（持久 partition + preload + 导航阻断）同级的隔离。适合非 DSH UI 的独立视图，但插件需要自带完整前端。

### 能力位（v1 最小集，全部默认关闭）

`alwaysOnTop` / `transparent` / `clickThrough`（none、all、dynamic）/ `excludeFromCapture` / `skipTaskbar` / `focusable` / 尺寸与锚点 / `rememberPosition` / 多显示器策略。

### 安全与边界

- 只有桌面 profile 里已安装的 bundle 能贡献窗口（插件代码本就在 Host 进程运行，"安装即同意"模型不变）；新增风险集中在窗口权限与渲染隔离；
- shell 创建窗口与 preload/partition，插件接触不到 `BrowserWindow` / `webContents`；renderer 依旧无 Node、无原始 IPC；
- 数据通道走 Host Service → TypertRemoteService → API Gateway；
- `excludeFromCapture` 与现有 Computer Use overlay exclusion 机制（ScreenCaptureKit exclude window id / Windows display affinity）对齐而不是另造一条路径，window id 只暴露给 shell 与显式授权的服务；
- 不改变 release identity：窗口是运行期产物，shell/dsh 版本、签名与更新单元不受影响。

## 接口草案

```ts
// Service Definition（application-defined，Desktop Host 提供）
interface DesktopWindowsService {
  register(contribution: DesktopWindowContribution): Promise<() => Promise<void>>
  list(): readonly DesktopWindowSummary[]
  // Cordis Events: desktop-window/created | closed | focus | bounds-changed
}

interface DesktopWindowContribution {
  id: string                                   // profile 内唯一
  surface: string                              // client 插件 surface id（内容模式 a）
  type: 'overlay' | 'panel' | 'notification'
  size: { width: number; height: number }
  anchor?: { corner: 'top-left' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-right'; margin: [number, number] }
  monitor?: 'primary' | 'all'
  rememberPosition?: boolean
  capabilities?: {
    alwaysOnTop?: boolean
    transparent?: boolean
    clickThrough?: 'none' | 'all' | 'dynamic'
    excludeFromCapture?: boolean
    skipTaskbar?: boolean
    focusable?: boolean
  }
}
```

```ts
// 插件侧用法
export const inject = ['desktopWindows']

export function apply(ctx: Context) {
  ctx.effect(() =>
    ctx.desktopWindows.register({
      id: 'desktop-companion',
      surface: '@example/dsh-desktop-companion/ui',
      type: 'overlay',
      size: { width: 320, height: 480 },
      anchor: { corner: 'bottom-right', margin: [24, 24] },
      rememberPosition: true,
      capabilities: { alwaysOnTop: true, transparent: true, clickThrough: 'dynamic', excludeFromCapture: true, focusable: false, skipTaskbar: true },
    }),
  )
}
```

```yaml
# 可选：声明式形态（挂载方式 B），放在 bundle 的 cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: desktop-companion-window
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-window'   # 名义行，实际由 shell 消费
      config:
        id: desktop-companion
        surface: '@example/dsh-desktop-companion/ui'
        type: overlay
        size: { width: 320, height: 480 }
        capabilities: { alwaysOnTop: true, transparent: true, excludeFromCapture: true }
```

## 需要维护者拍板

1. seam 归谁：`apps/desktop-host` 的 application 服务（A）还是 Loader 声明行（B）？两者并存是否合理？
2. 内容模式倾向 a（client surface）还是 b（受限文档）？窗口 surface 是否作为 Slots 之后的第二类 UI 挂载点？
3. v1 支持哪些窗口类型与能力位？点击穿透的命中测试由 shell 还是窗口内容协议负责？
4. `excludeFromCapture` 与 Computer Use overlay exclusion 的关系：复用同一套 window id 注册还是分开？
5. 多显示器 / 混合 DPI 的期望；Linux（无桌面端窗口）时声明如何降级？
6. 命名与词汇：`window contribution` / `desktop window` / `shell surface`，请给一个官方术语。

## 为什么独立 client 不够（预期讨论点）

独立进程完全可以做桌宠（我们也评估过），但满足不了：与桌面端**同一 TCC 身份与权限链**、同一单实例与应用生命周期、开箱即用（而不是"再装一个 App"）、以及**截屏排除需要同进程持有 window id**（Computer Use 场景）。这也是我们倾向 shell seam 而不是外部 client 的原因。相关问题见 #19（原生 App）、#60（外部 GUI / 稳定 runtime 边界）与 #5180（App Plugin：App identity / standalone window 约定，首发于 #3328）——本提案是它们的补充：外部 client 解决"另一个 GUI 接 DSH"，本提案解决"同一个桌面端内的插件窗口能力"。

## 我们愿意做什么

- 先用**纯现有插件 API** 做一个主窗口 Slot 形态的最简示例（Host Service + 事件监听 + client Slot 挂件，不含 Live2D），作为需求证据：https://github.com/BotHarness/dsh-companion-example ；
- 已在 BotHarness 组织下 fork DSH（https://github.com/BotHarness/deepseek-harness ），准备实现上述 seam：`apps/desktop` 最小改动 + `apps/desktop-host` 服务 + docs + 最小示例窗口 + 单测，保持默认关闭、可选、声明式；
- PR 只含 seam 与最小示例；我们的桌面伙伴产品作为独立 bundle 仓库当第一个真实 consumer，不混入 PR。

参考先例：上游 `apps/desktop/src/platform-view.ts`、`update-overlay.ts`、`tray.ts`、`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`；社区 `mini-yifan/deepseek-harness-orb` 的 `apps/desktop/src/floating-window.ts`。
