discussions.title: Baigong Research Atlas: persistent research continuity tools for Harness
discussions.body:
## Baigong Research Atlas: native research continuity tools

Sharing **dsh-research-atlas**, a community Cordis plugin for continuing a research project across agents and AI clients while keeping the same project/task IDs, evidence provenance, revision history and stage handoff.

- Repository and installation: https://github.com/David7583/baigong_research_atlas/tree/main/plugins/dsh-research-atlas
- Release tarball: https://github.com/David7583/baigong_research_atlas/releases/tag/dsh-plugin-v0.1.0
- Acceptance evidence: https://github.com/David7583/baigong_research_atlas/blob/main/docs/harness_plugin_acceptance_20260927.md

The plugin registers `research_atlas_read` and an opt-in `research_atlas_write` with `ctx.tools.register`. It forwards allowlisted operations to an existing local Python core: find/resume a task, begin a run, submit a hash-checked stage package, inspect delivery status, and explicitly index a published revision. It does not use private client conversation history as project identity.

Installation starts disabled; deployment paths are configured by the user. Read-only is the default, and writes require `allowWrites: true`. Harness tool policies still apply. Model SDKs, Provider keys and permission management are not exposed through these tools. This is trusted local integration, not an OS sandbox; authorized evidence can enter the host model context/logs.

Validated with Harness/dsh-tools **0.1.5-rc.3**, Cordis **4.0.2**, Node **24.18.0** on Windows. Checks include 27 existing Python tests, actual Cordis/ToolRuntime calls, full dsh CLI bundle loading, local and tarball installation, unload/removal and a four-stage synthetic executor roundtrip. No new live model inference is claimed by these plugin tests.

Apache-2.0, Ruixin Yang / David7583. Existing baigong attribution and source provenance are retained. The repository follows the `dsh-plugin` discovery convention; this is not a first-party package or a request to merge code into the core repository.

discussions.title: pluginManager: the `web-runtime` / `web-startup` rows are togglable, and disabling them silently kills the whole web surface
discussions.body:
## Summary

The `web` profile contains two rows that *provide* services other rows inject:

- `web-runtime` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) provides `webRuntime`
- `web-startup` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/startup`) provides `webStartup`

Neither module appears in `protectedModules`, so `listPlugins` returns both rows without a
`readOnlyReason`, the Plugin Manager renders their switches as **enabled**, and
`setPluginEnabled` accepts the disable.

Disabling either one writes an override into the profile patch, the dependent rows never
activate, and the app is left serving nothing — while the port is still `LISTENING`. There is
no error, no warning, and no way back through the UI, because `/api/*` starts returning 404.

## Environment

- dsh `v0.1.7-alpha.2` (commit `00102833df`)
- Windows
- profile `web` (`dsh web`), default bundles: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`

Reproduces on a stock profile: `id: web-runtime` and `id: web-startup` are declared only in
`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` (lines 142-143 and 170-177), which
`PROFILE_TEMPLATES.web` always mounts.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Start `dsh web`.
2. Open the Plugin Manager page and find the row `web-runtime` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`).
   Its switch is rendered enabled — there is no lock and no confirmation prompt.
3. Toggle it off.

Equivalent over RPC:

```
POST /api/pluginManager/setPluginEnabled
{ "id": "include:web-runtime", "enabled": false }
```

## Expected

Either the row is protected (switch disabled, `management-required`), or the disable is
refused and the profile patch is left untouched.

## Actual

- The RPC returns `application: "failed"` with the activation diagnostic.
- `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` gains the override
  (`- id: web-runtime` / `disabled: true`) via `writePluginEnabled`. It stays there.
- Port 3080 keeps `LISTENING`, but every `/api/*` request returns **404** — the UI is dead
  while the process is alive.
- stderr stays empty: no error and no warning about the surface being torn down.

The diagnostic produced by `activationDiagnostic`
(`packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts:851-864`) has the form:

```
dsh: warning: <N> entries did not activate
<entry-id> (<module-name>): pending (waiting for service: webRuntime)
```

`N` is profile-dependent (it was 8 on our profile, counting the rows that inject `webRuntime`).

Because `/api` is gone, "enable it again" is not reachable from the UI. Recovery means
editing `cordis.patch.yml` by hand and restarting.

## Root cause

`listPlugins` (`packages/boot/plugin-manager/src/index.ts:216-233`) marks a row read-only only
when

```ts
if (protectedModules.has(entry.moduleName) || entry.entryId === this.ownerEntryId) {
  return { ...entry, readOnlyReason: 'management-required' as const }
}
```

and `setPluginEnabled` (`:382-393`) enforces only `row.readOnlyReason !== undefined`. So the
protection is exactly the `protectedModules` list — and that list covers the infrastructure
rows but not the two rows that hand them their services.

## Why the guard misses it

The authors clearly knew these rows are fatal — they are in `protectedModules`:

| row | module | protected | injects |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connection` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection` | yes | `webRuntime` |
| `webserver` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` | yes | `webStartup` |
| `web-runtime` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` | **no** | — (provides `webRuntime`) |
| `web-startup` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/startup` | **no** | — (provides `webStartup`) |

The consumers are protected; the providers they depend on are not. Disabling a provider kills
its consumers just as effectively, but indirectly, so it slips past a list that was built by
asking "is this row infrastructure?" rather than "does anything depend on this row?".

`protectsManager` (the bundle-level guard) behaves correctly — toggling the
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` *bundle* is refused with `management-required`. The hole is only in
the per-row switch.

## Suggested fix

Add both module names to `protectedModules` in `packages/boot/plugin-manager/src/index.ts`.
The patch below is applied in my local checkout and uncommitted — it is offered as a patch,
since this repository does not accept external pull requests:

```diff
   '@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-plugin-timer', ...
   '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr',
+  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/startup',
 ])
```

Matching is a literal comparison against `entry.options.name`
(`packages/host/plugin-inventory/src/index.ts:91`), so the `/startup` subpath matches as-is;
the export is declared in `packages/bundle/web-app/package.json:21-24`.

Verified after the change, on a restarted instance:

- `include:web-runtime` → `readOnlyReason: management-required`
- `include:web-startup` → `readOnlyReason: management-required`
- `setPluginEnabled(..., false)` on either → `{ application: "failed",
  error: { code: "management-required" }, changed: false }`, nothing written to disk
- `cordis.patch.yml` stays clean
- `npx vitest run packages/boot/plugin-manager` — 5 failed / 145 passed (150), the same five
  on the untouched `00102833df`; no new failures

## Notes

- We considered making `reconcileProfilePatches` roll back a partially failed patch
  generation, and rejected it: `tests/manager.spec.ts:461` ("keeps saved changes after
  activation failure and allows a corrected configuration to retry") explicitly requires the
  override to survive, so a user can fix the config and retry. The correct containment is to
  refuse disabling providers, not to roll back.
- Same class of risk may exist in the other profile templates (`headlessStartup`,
  `sdkAppStartup`, `acpAppStartup` are injected by their app rows). Worth checking whether any
  of those providers is also missing from `protectedModules`.

discussions.title: [Bug][Desktop][Windows] workspace-write can poison the DSH Desktop install directory itself, making Harness unlaunchable after restart
discussions.body:
## Summary

On Windows, DeepSeek Harness Desktop can apparently apply the persistent
`workspace-write` ACL sandbox entries to its **own installation directory**.

Once this happens, the Desktop install tree receives:

- the DSH capability SID ACE
- an `Everyone` deny ACE
- an inheritable Low Mandatory Integrity label

The next launch of DeepSeek Harness then fails because Electron/Chromium
processes launched from the installation tree inherit Low integrity.

In my case this was reproducible twice.

This appears related to #7709, but with a more severe Desktop-specific failure
mode: the directory being poisoned is the directory containing
`DeepSeek Harness.exe` itself.

It may also explain some symptoms similar to #7823.

---

## Environment

- OS: Windows x64
- DeepSeek Harness Desktop: `0.1.7-rc.2`
- Electron: `44.0.0`
- Node: `24.18.1`
- Installation directory:

  `D:\DeepSeek Harness`

- Desktop profile:

  `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`

- Desktop profile contained only the official bundles:

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-desktop",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {},
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Reproduction / observed sequence
1. Harness is healthy
After manually restoring the ACL of:
D:\DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness Desktop launches normally.
The healthy ACL is:
D:\DeepSeek Harness
    APPLICATION PACKAGE AUTHORITY\ALL RESTRICTED APPLICATION PACKAGES:(OI)(CI)(RX)
    NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
    NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
    BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
    BUILTIN\Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(RX,W)
    Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

The application launches successfully in this state.
2. Perform a file/plugin-management operation through DSH
While Harness was running normally, I asked the DSH agent to remove a redundant
desktop-pet/plugin-related item.
After the operation, Harness was closed/restarted.
3. Harness becomes completely unlaunchable
Double-clicking DeepSeek Harness.exe produces no visible window.
Starting it from PowerShell exposes the actual failure:
GPU process launch failed: error_code=18
Desktop renderer exited: launch-failed
GPU process launch failed: error_code=18
FATAL: GPU process isn't usable. Goodbye.

The process exits with:
-2147483645

which corresponds to:
0x80000003 / STATUS_BREAKPOINT

Using --disable-gpu does not fix the crash.
The parent PowerShell process itself is Medium integrity
(S-1-16-8192), so this is not caused by launching Harness from an
elevated or Low-integrity shell.
Critical evidence: install-directory ACL is mutated
Immediately after Harness becomes unlaunchable:
icacls "D:\DeepSeek Harness"

shows:
D:\DeepSeek Harness
    Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(S,DC)
    S-1-4-979659899-60949555:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
    APPLICATION PACKAGE AUTHORITY\ALL RESTRICTED APPLICATION PACKAGES:(OI)(CI)(RX)
    NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
    NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
    BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
    BUILTIN\Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(RX,W)
    Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

These are the same standing ACL changes associated with the Windows
workspace-write sandbox:
- capability SID
- Everyone deny
- inheritable Low integrity label
The drive root itself is clean:
D:\
    NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(OI)(CI)(F)
    NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(OI)(CI)(F)
    BUILTIN\Administrators:(OI)(CI)(F)
    BUILTIN\Users:(OI)(CI)(RX,W)

Therefore the problematic ACL is not inherited from D:\.
Recovery
Removing the capability SID and explicit Everyone deny, and changing the
integrity label from Low back to Medium, immediately restores the Desktop.
The recovery used was:
$root = "D:\DeepSeek Harness"

$acl = (Get-Item $root).GetAccessControl('Access')

$cap = [Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]'S-1-4-979659899-60949555'
$acl.PurgeAccessRules($cap)

$everyone = [Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]'S-1-1-0'

foreach ($r in @(
    $acl.GetAccessRules(
        $true,
        $false,
        [Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]
    )
)) {
    if (
        $r.AccessControlType -eq [Security.AccessControl.AccessControlType]::Deny `
        -and $r.IdentityReference -eq $everyone
    ) {
        [void]$acl.RemoveAccessRuleSpecific($r)
    }
}

(Get-Item $root).SetAccessControl($acl)

icacls "D:\DeepSeek Harness" /grant "*S-1-15-2-2:(OI)(CI)(RX)" /T /C
icacls "D:\DeepSeek Harness" /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)M"

After this, the ACL returns to Medium integrity and DeepSeek Harness launches
normally again.
Reproducibility
This occurred twice.
Sequence observed:
Harness working
    ↓
install directory ACL is healthy / Medium
    ↓
DSH performs file/plugin-related operation
    ↓
install directory receives workspace-write ACL
    ↓
Harness restart
    ↓
Electron renderer/GPU process launch fails
    ↓
0x80000003
    ↓
manually remove workspace-write ACL + restore Medium
    ↓
Harness launches normally again

On the second occurrence, the ACL state was checked immediately after the
failure and the same three workspace-write entries had reappeared.
This makes the correlation highly reproducible.
Expected behavior
The Desktop installation directory must never be treated as a writable
workspace by dsh-sandbox-windows-acl.
At minimum, DSH Desktop should reject / guard against applying
workspace-write provisioning to:
- the directory containing DeepSeek Harness.exe
- its resources directory
- the Desktop installation root
- any parent directory required for launching the Desktop runtime
Ideally the Desktop runtime should canonicalize candidate workspace paths and
fail safely if the requested workspace overlaps the installation tree.
Actual behavior
The Desktop installation tree can receive the persistent workspace-write
security descriptor.
Because the Low integrity label is standing and inheritable, the next launch of
the Desktop itself becomes Low-integrity and Electron exits with
STATUS_BREAKPOINT.
This effectively allows a normal DSH workspace/file-management operation to
make the DSH Desktop unable to launch itself.
Related reports
- #7709 — Windows workspace-write Low integrity label lowers executables
  launched from the labeled tree and can break Electron with 0x80000003.
- #7823 — Desktop installed to a custom Windows directory can fail to launch
  its renderer because of installation-directory ACLs.
This report appears to connect the two failure classes:
the DSH sandbox can place its own Desktop installation directory into the ACL
state that subsequently breaks Electron startup.
Suggested fix
Possible safeguards:
1. Explicitly forbid workspace-write provisioning when the canonical
   workspace path overlaps the Desktop installation directory.
2. Add a Desktop startup check for the workspace-write capability ACE /
   inheritable Low integrity label on the installation root.
3. Provide an official command/API to revoke a standing workspace grant.
4. Avoid leaving an inheritable Low integrity label on executable installation
   trees.
5. If such a path is selected, fail before modifying the directory ACL and show
   a clear diagnostic.
The most important invariant seems to be:
workspace-write must never mutate the security descriptor of the directory
containing the currently installed/running DSH Desktop runtime.

discussions.title: [Windows] 桌面宿主把 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 传给 VS Code,导致「在本地打开」工作区失败(502 launch-failed)
discussions.body:
**说明**:本仓库 Issues 已关闭,故以 Discussion 提交。以下为完整缺陷报告(含环境、逐步复现、根因定位与建议修法);复现脚本与四轮对抗性复核结论见评论。

---

### 环境

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.1.7-rc.2**(`D:\DSHHarness\DeepSeek Harness.exe`,FileVersion 0.1.7-rc.2)
- Windows 11 Pro **10.0.22631** x64
- VS Code **1.137.0**(commit `645f29cc3176500b4b5762ba887cf2a7f0ffdf2c`,x64,**per-user** 安装:`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe`)
- 涉及包(均在 `app.asar` 内 `dsh/node_modules/`):`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app@0.1.7-rc.2`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.7-rc.2`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess@0.1.7-rc.2`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.7-rc.2`

### 现象

会话头右侧「在本地打开」分键按钮(槽位 `conversation.session.header.utilities`,registrant `open-in-app`)选择
**VS Code** 后:未出现预期的工作区窗口,**启动进程约 40 ms 后自行退出**,界面提示「打开失败，请重试」。
宿主路由 `POST /open-in-app/open {"app":"vscode","path":"<workspace>"}` 返回
**502** `{"code":"launch-failed","message":"failed to launch vscode"}`。

关于 200 的语义(避免误读):`launchDetachedApp` 有**两个** resolve 条件 —— ①子进程 **exit 0**;②看护窗口
(`launchWatchMs`)到期时子进程**仍在运行**。因此 200 只代表"判定为已启动",**不保证 GUI 真的打开**;
本例是明确收到 502。

### 复现

**(1) 最小复现 —— 纯 Windows,不依赖 DSH**(在带该变量的环境中执行):

```cmd
set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe" "H:\Harness"
echo %ERRORLEVEL%
:: → 1,耗时约 40 ms
```

stderr:

```
Error: Cannot find module 'H:\Harness'
    at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1524:15)
    ...
    at node:electron/js2c/node_init:2:18159
```

**(2) 环境有/无对照**(用归档脚本 `env-toggle-proof.mjs`;目标默认取一个**新建的空目录**,
以排除目录内可执行入口的干扰;**两次使用同一目标,只改变环境变量**):

```sh
node env-toggle-proof.mjs "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe"
# ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1      -> exit 1 (FAILED)          ← Node 模式
# ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE unset  -> exit 0 / 到期仍在运行     ← 启动判定通过(GUI 是否打开需另行观察)
```

**(3) 变量的作用(交叉印证)**:

```cmd
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe" --version
:: → v24.18.1                     ← Node 的版本,不是 VS Code 的
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\bin\code.cmd" --version
:: → 1.137.0 / 645f29cc3176500b4b5762ba887cf2a7f0ffdf2c / x64
```

**(4) UI 复现**:桌面端打开任一工作区会话 → 点会话头右侧「在本地打开」→ 菜单选 VS Code。

### 根因

1. **宿主进程自身带着该变量**(实测,非推断)。桌面壳以 Electron 的 Node 模式派生核心宿主:
   asar 根 `lib/main.js` 的 `desktopNodeEnvironment(executable, bin, environment)` 返回
   `{ ...environment, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1", ... }`(注释即 "Environment for a Node-mode child process")。
   在宿主进程(**监听 `127.0.0.1:19387` 的那个进程**,本机 PID 70924)内部读到的实测值:

   ```json
   { "pid": 70924, "action": "removed", "before": "1", "after": null }
   ```

   (该记录只证明**当时**的状态,不是实时证明。)

2. **GUI 启动器原样继承**。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app` 的**运行时入口是 `lib/index.js`**
   (`package.json` 的 `exports["."].default`);`launchDetachedApp` 内联在该文件 **第 348 行**,
   第 8 行 `import { scrubbedParentEnv } from "@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess"`:

   ```js
   const env = { ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env };
   ```

3. **`scrubbedParentEnv()` 不剔除 Electron 模式变量**。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js`
   **第 32 行** `const SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN = /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i;`,**第 52 行**遍历时另丢弃
   `DSH_*` 前缀并处理代理变量 —— `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 不在其中。

4. **启动失败被判定为错误**:同一函数中 `child.on('exit', ...)` 对看护窗口内的非 0 退出 reject;
   open 路由据此 `sendJson(res, 502, { code: "launch-failed", ... })`。

5. VS Code 在本机由目录表解析为
   `spec(appPaths('Code.exe'), installRecord('Microsoft Visual Studio Code', 'Code.exe'), file([...]))`
   (目录表 `vscode` 条目),即**直接启动 exe**,因此命中上面整条链。
   本机 `HKCU\...\App Paths\Code.exe` 存在、`Code.exe` 存在 —— 解析本身是健康的。

### ⚠️ 修复边界:不要在宿主全局删除该变量

我们最初的临时变通是"在宿主里 `delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`",**它打断了经 Windows Job runner 的命令执行**。

**前提限定**:以下结论适用于**本次这种 Electron Node 模式宿主 + 当前 Windows Job runner 实现**;
不涵盖直接调用其它可执行文件、其它 provider、或不同宿主启动方式的情形。

源码链(已逐处核对):

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner-launch-B2zsQ1Dz.js`
  **1311–1316 行**:Windows runner 以 `process.execPath`(即桌面 Electron 可执行文件)+ runner 脚本启动;
  **694–695 行**:`childEnv()` → `scrubbedParentEnv()`;
  **1343–1345 行**:`runnerEnvironment()` 取 `childEnv()`,**没有显式补回 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`**。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js`
  **601 行**:`env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation)`;
  **629 行**:`subprocess-local: Windows Job runner exited with ${status} before proving its managed range empty`。

实测后果(删除该变量之后的同一会话内):**实测经该 runner 的 `pwsh` 工具与 `grep` 工具内部 ripgrep 调用均失败** ——
两者都返回上面第 629 行那句(退出码 0、无残留进程,符合"runner 以 GUI 入口启动、未履行 IPC 协议即退出")。
**其它调用未逐一验证**,不作断言。

### 建议修法

1. **应用启动边界(本 issue 的直接修复)** —— `launchDetachedApp`(`lib/index.js:348`,并同步其源文件):
   先清理**继承值**,再合并适配器的**显式值**,以保留 GitHub Desktop `cli.js` 适配器的显式 opt-in:

   ```js
   const inherited = scrubbedParentEnv();
   for (const key of Object.keys(inherited)) {
     if (key.toUpperCase() === 'ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE') delete inherited[key];
   }
   const env = { ...inherited, ...options.env };
   ```

2. **内部 runner 显式声明 Node 模式(独立加固)** —— 在 `runnerEnvironment()` 中为"以 Electron 可执行文件启动
   Node runner"的路径显式提供该变量。需注意的边界:
   - Windows 环境键大小写不敏感,避免产生重复键;
   - 确认这项 bootstrap 设置**不会被带进目标应用**的环境(只作用于 runner);
   - `runnerEnvironment()` 也服务其它启动路径,不能仅凭本次 Windows 反例认定无条件补值已完整验证。

3. **回归要求**(建议随修复一起给出):
   - GUI 子进程环境**已清理**(启动器不再收到该变量);
   - 适配器**显式 opt-in 仍保留**(GitHub Desktop `cli.js` 一路仍以 Node 模式运行);
   - **宿主自身环境不被修改**(`process.env` 不因启动应用而改变);
   - **宿主缺少该变量时**,runner 的握手与目标命令仍然成功(这条正是本次反例的回归测试)。

4. **关于改哪里**:`lib/index.js` 与 `lib/types/resolver.js` 是**生成产物**(后者是同实现的副本),
   本次引用它们只为定位受影响产物;正解是在源文件中修改并重新构建,不宜要求维护者手工维护两份生成代码。

**不建议**用调整 `launchWatchMs` 来掩盖:增大窗口能**覆盖更多较晚发生的失败**,但**不能**修复 Node 模式导致的退出
(本例 42 ms 就结束了);缩短窗口则可能提前判定成功,同样不代表 GUI 已打开。

### 影响面(收窄后的表述)

- **本机实测**:VS Code 在 Windows 桌面端必失败。
- **机制上可能同样受影响**(未逐一实测):凡"被目录表以 `App Paths\*.exe` 直接启动、且自身尊重该变量"的
  Electron 应用 —— 目录表中的 VS Code Insiders、Cursor、Windsurf 属此形态。
- **机制上可豁免**:Electron 应用若关闭了 `runAsNode` fuse,会忽略该变量(官方文档:
  <https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/environment-variables#electron_run_as_node>),故不做"所有 Electron 应用必失败"的断言。
- **未验证**:非 Electron 条目(JetBrains 系、Sublime、Windows Terminal、`shell-open` 走 `explorer.exe`)——
  不直接受此机制影响,但未逐项实测。macOS / Linux 未验证。

discussions.title: Desktop: image attachments re-encoded to webp in attachment store cause 400 'url' field must be a base64 encoded image with OpenAI-compatible local providers, and the poisoned image block stays in session history so later text-only messages also fail
discussions.body:
## Bug

Image attachments in the DSH desktop client are stored in webp format, so any
image the user attaches produces a webp data-url image block. OpenAI-compatible
local providers (tested: LM Studio) reject webp data-urls with
`400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image."`, so every message that
contains such an attachment fails with `INVALID_REQUEST`.

Even worse: the bad image block remains in the session history, and each request
replays the whole history — so **even subsequent text-only messages in the same
session keep returning 400** until the user starts a new session.

## Environment

- DSH desktop `0.1.7-rc.2` (Windows)
- Provider: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint (`http://<lan-ip>:1234/v1`, LM Studio)
- Model: `qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-mtp` (vision-capable; `input: [text, image]`)

## Reproduction

1. In a new DSH desktop session, attach a PNG image (1024x1024, ~330 KB).
2. Send any message — request fails with:
   `400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image."` (`code: INVALID_REQUEST`)
3. Observe the stored attachment object under
   `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects/...`: the file is a **webp** (330476 bytes,
   1024x1024) although the attachment's `name` is still `...png`.
4. In the same session, send a **text-only** message (e.g. "hello") — it fails
   with the same 400, because the session history is replayed with the bad
   attachment block included:

   ```json
   {"type":"image","attachment":{"attachmentId":"sha256:...","mediaType":"image/webp","width":1024,"height":1024,"bytes":330476,"name":"红军小战士.png"}}
   ```

## Evidence

1. **Format mismatch**: the on-disk attachment object is webp while the
   attachment metadata says `.png`; the image block sent to the provider
   carries `mediaType: image/webp`.
2. **Provider acceptance**: sending the same image as a PNG data-url directly to
   the provider returns 200 and the model correctly describes the image content
   (`prompt_tokens` includes the image). Sending the webp data-url returns the
   400 above. So the provider accepts PNG/JPEG data-urls and rejects webp.
3. **History poisoning**: session `273b77bb` timeline (from
   `~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.v4.jsonl.zstd`):
   - user sends the image path -> 400 INVALID_REQUEST
   - user then sends the plain text "你好" (hello) -> **still 400 INVALID_REQUEST**
   - every request replays the full session history including the bad webp
     attachment block, so the whole session is unusable.

## Impact

- Any attached image makes the session unusable with OpenAI-compatible local
  providers that only accept PNG/JPEG data-urls.
- The poisoning is silent: the user sees "just a text message" failing with an
  image-related error and has no way to know why.
- The only workaround is starting a new session and avoiding the attachment
  pipeline (e.g. giving the agent a file path and letting it read the file
  itself).

## Suggestions

- Do not transcode uploaded images to webp in the attachment store; keep the
  original format (or at least keep PNG/JPEG when the target provider is
  OpenAI-compatible).
- If transcoding is required, validate the format against what the provider
  accepts, and surface the conversion to the user.
- A failed request caused by a bad attachment block should not permanently
  poison the session; consider dropping/repairing the block or clearly telling
  the user which attachment broke the session.

## Related

- Similar symptom (empty `url` in image blocks -> `400 Invalid url.`) in Cherry
  Studio's built-in gateway: CherryHQ/cherry-studio#21081. Different signature,
  likely different code path, but the same user-visible failure class (image
  block serialization breaks requests to local OpenAI-compatible providers).

discussions.title: 压缩检查点的前言把同一消息内的交接指令降格为背景，部署侧无法改写或拦截（0.1.5-rc.3，附文件行号与实测）
discussions.body:
# 压缩检查点的前言把同一消息内的交接指令降格为背景，部署侧无法改写或拦截

版本基线 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.5-rc.3`（profile `web`）。以下证据来自本机安装树的源码回读，以及一次真实压缩留下的落账事件。所有路径均为包内相对位置，不含任何个人或环境信息。

## 一、现象

自动压缩产生的检查点是一条 `role: "user"` 的消息，构成为「英文前言 + `<compacted-summary>` + 交接指令正文 + `</compacted-summary>`」。前言与交接指令**同属一条消息，前言在前**。

前言逐字为（`dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:257`）：

```text
This is an automatically generated checkpoint condensing an earlier span of the conversation to free up context. Treat the captured context as established background and build on it without restating it. Continue the task directly from the messages that follow, without acknowledging this checkpoint.
```

其中两句与紧随其后的交接指令直接冲突，且互不替代：

| 前言的子句 | 它削弱的是什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `Treat the captured context as established background` | 把整份交接指令的**性质**由「必须执行」改成「既定背景」，波及全部内容 |
| `Continue the task directly from the messages that follow` | 要求**跳过检查点内容直接继续**，即跳过交接指令本身 |

也就是说，框架在同一条消息里先说「以下是背景、请跳过它、直接从随后的消息继续」，紧接其后放进去的却是一段要求接续会话必须先执行某些动作的指令。

## 二、证据

拼接与落账（均在 `dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js`）：

```text
:211-212  const SUMMARY_OPEN_TAG = "<compacted-summary>";
          const SUMMARY_CLOSE_TAG = "</compacted-summary>";
:257      const CHECKPOINT_PREAMBLE = "…";   （全文见上）
:323-335  function frameSummary(summary) { … }   首块 = 前言 + "\n\n" + 开标签，末块 = 闭标签
:621-632  session.append("user/message", checkpointMessage, { surfaceOp: … });
```

这些符号都不在包的导出面内：该文件唯一的导出语句是 `export { BasicCompactionEngine, BasicCompactionEngine as default };`，`package.json` 的 `exports` 只暴露 `.`。

本机一次真实压缩的落账事件：`compaction/start`、`compaction/summary`、`compaction/end` 各一次且 `compactionId` 相同。那条检查点消息的正文是一段简体中文的祈使式指令，内容为「继续此前的工作，并在做任何其它动作之前先完成若干指定动作」，而它前面就是上述前言。也就是说，同一块标签之内的文本是一份要求执行的指令，而标签之前的那句话要求把它当背景并跳过。

## 三、为什么部署侧无法覆盖它

1. **改不了前言。** 它是模块私有常量；`summarize()` 是该包唯一的子类钩子，且其返回值只放进 `frameSummary` 的中间位置，够不到首末两块。
2. **拦不住这条消息。** 它经 `session.append` 直接落账，不经收件箱，因此不出现在任何一步的 `agent/pre-step` 决策数组里。框架提供的消息流改写点对它无效。
3. **改安装树不可行。** 升级即失效。

三条通道同时封死，因此部署侧唯一能做的只剩「在交接指令自己的文本里声明前言不适用」，而那是靠模型遵循的声明，不是机械保证。

## 四、影响

检查点里的交接指令是压缩之后唯一能告诉接续会话「此前在做什么、还受哪些约束、下一步必须先做什么」的载体。前言把它降格为背景、并要求跳过它，模型据此可能不执行其中的首要动作。

本机观察到的对应形态是：压缩之后的接续会话不完整读取交接指令里点名要求完整读取的文件；把同一份指令手工粘贴进新会话时通常正常。

## 五、建议（任取其一即可）

1. **让前言可配置**，例如提供预设行的配置键，使部署能替换或改写它。
2. **调整前言措辞**，使「捕获内容是背景」与「其后紧接着的那段文本是指令」不再冲突。
3. **把检查点改为经收件箱投递**，使它进入 `agent/pre-step` 的可改写面。这一条同时覆盖该消息目前完全落在自定义面之外的其余情形。

## 六、可复现的核验方式

触发一次压缩，导出该会话的事件流，取检查点那条 `user/message`：其 `content` 的首块以 `This is an automatically generated checkpoint` 起首并含开标签，末块为闭标签，两者之间的内容是一段完整的祈使式指令。

discussions.title: Desktop: image attachments re-encoded to webp in attachment store cause 400 'url' field must be a base64 encoded image with OpenAI-compatible local providers, and the poisoned image block stays in session history so later text-only messages also fail
discussions.body:
## Bug

Image attachments in the DSH desktop client are stored in webp format, so any
image the user attaches produces a webp data-url image block. OpenAI-compatible
local providers (tested: LM Studio) reject webp data-urls with
`400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image."`, so every message that
contains such an attachment fails with `INVALID_REQUEST`.

Even worse: the bad image block remains in the session history, and each request
replays the whole history — so **even subsequent text-only messages in the same
session keep returning 400** until the user starts a new session.

## Environment

- DSH desktop `0.1.7-rc.2` (Windows)
- Provider: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint (`http://<lan-ip>:1234/v1`, LM Studio)
- Model: `qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-mtp` (vision-capable; `input: [text, image]`)

## Reproduction

1. In a new DSH desktop session, attach a PNG image (1024x1024, ~330 KB).
2. Send any message — request fails with:
   `400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image."` (`code: INVALID_REQUEST`)
3. Observe the stored attachment object under
   `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects/...`: the file is a **webp** (330476 bytes,
   1024x1024) although the attachment's `name` is still `...png`.
4. In the same session, send a **text-only** message (e.g. "hello") — it fails
   with the same 400, because the session history is replayed with the bad
   attachment block included:

   ```json
   {"type":"image","attachment":{"attachmentId":"sha256:...","mediaType":"image/webp","width":1024,"height":1024,"bytes":330476,"name":"红军小战士.png"}}
   ```

## Evidence

1. **Format mismatch**: the on-disk attachment object is webp while the
   attachment metadata says `.png`; the image block sent to the provider
   carries `mediaType: image/webp`.
2. **Provider acceptance**: sending the same image as a PNG data-url directly to
   the provider returns 200 and the model correctly describes the image content
   (`prompt_tokens` includes the image). Sending the webp data-url returns the
   400 above. So the provider accepts PNG/JPEG data-urls and rejects webp.
3. **History poisoning**: session `273b77bb` timeline (from
   `~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.v4.jsonl.zstd`):
   - user sends the image path -> 400 INVALID_REQUEST
   - user then sends the plain text "你好" (hello) -> **still 400 INVALID_REQUEST**
   - every request replays the full session history including the bad webp
     attachment block, so the whole session is unusable.

## Impact

- Any attached image makes the session unusable with OpenAI-compatible local
  providers that only accept PNG/JPEG data-urls.
- The poisoning is silent: the user sees "just a text message" failing with an
  image-related error and has no way to know why.
- The only workaround is starting a new session and avoiding the attachment
  pipeline (e.g. giving the agent a file path and letting it read the file
  itself).

## Suggestions

- Do not transcode uploaded images to webp in the attachment store; keep the
  original format (or at least keep PNG/JPEG when the target provider is
  OpenAI-compatible).
- If transcoding is required, validate the format against what the provider
  accepts, and surface the conversion to the user.
- A failed request caused by a bad attachment block should not permanently
  poison the session; consider dropping/repairing the block or clearly telling
  the user which attachment broke the session.

## Related

- Similar symptom (empty `url` in image blocks -> `400 Invalid url.`) in Cherry
  Studio's built-in gateway: CherryHQ/cherry-studio#21081. Different signature,
  likely different code path, but the same user-visible failure class (image
  block serialization breaks requests to local OpenAI-compatible providers).

discussions.title: dsh-self-heal — 启动前闸门 + 崩溃看护 + 有界修复阶梯（附公开仓库）
discussions.body:
## 一、绪论 DSH 的失败模式很特别：**插件树里任何一条目加载失败都是致命的，宿主会在启动后一秒内退出**， 而这时留在界面上的信息往往只有一行 `unknown config key "…"`。我们为此做了一套**宿主之外**的 自诊断 + 有界自修复实现，在真实崩溃上闭环成功过，两个仓库公开、带 CI。这里把**实现**和**过程中量到的 官方接口行为**一并交出来——后者可能对官方自己有用。 ## 二、为什么需要它（可复现的失败模式） 三个实测断言，都来自我们自己的事故记录： 1. **致命性是"条目级"的。** 2026-09-27 我们两次启动**当场退出**，报错只有一条（形如）： ``` : unknown config key ""; allowed keys are ``` 根因是**编辑器改写插件源码换了 inode → `file:` 硬链接断开 → 安装副本留在旧代码，而配置已前进**。 也就是说：**配置与代码的版本漂移 = 起不来**，而报错既不指向"漂移"，也不指向"副本过期"， 只指向"多了一个键"——**它把人引向去删那个键，而正确的动作是 `pnpm install`。** 我们的闸门现在会把这一类拦在启动之前并直接点出是哪一行、哪个包。 2. **同一个组合，探针能跑而宿主起不来；反之亦然。** 所以"退出码"不能作为判据—— 我们因此把**所有**修复判定都改成"真的把组合启起来一次并撑过硬超时"。 3. **失败之后证据极容易随窗口消失。** 我们第一版修复阶梯用 `stdio: 'inherit'`， 控制台一关，**阶梯、会话、以及尚未落盘的 `ladder.md`/`repair-report.md` 一起没了**， 事故目录只剩看护的 4 个文件。 ## 三、官方接口行为（我们实测出来的，可直接当文档补充） 这几条我们**撞过才写下来**，希望官方要么确认、要么修正我们的理解： ### 1. `defineTool` 的契约 ```js defineTool({ name, description, parameters: { … }, // 编译成隐式 open object 根 output: { schema, render }, // render(args, value) => ContentBlock[] async execute(args, exec) { … }, // 处理函数挂在 execute；args 已校验 }) ``` - 处理函数键名是 **`execute`**，签名 `(args, exec)`；`output` **必须**同时给 `schema` 和 `render`。 证据：`dsh-tools/lib/types/schema.d.ts` 的 `DefineToolOptions.execute`、包 README 的 「Register a tool」示例，以及出货代码 `dsh-tool-ask-user/lib/index.js`。 - 注册形态与内置工具插件同构：`ctx.tools.register(defineTool({…}))`，模块导出 `name` / `inject` / `apply`。 ### 2. 插件里的裸标识符**不会**按宿主解析 ``` import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools' // 从插件目录 → ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND ``` 插件按**自己的目录**解析裸标识符。我们最后用 CLI 的 `lib/bin.js` 当锚点： ```js createRequire(/lib/bin.js).resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools') ``` **而且必须放在 `apply()` 里做，不能放模块顶层**——顶层失败 = 模块加载失败 = 致命。 > 建议：若官方希望插件零依赖地拿到 `defineTool`，把它挂到 `ctx.tools`（如 `ctx.tools.define`） > 会让这类插件不必猜测宿主布局。这是我们最想要的一处接口。 ### 3. 补丁不能给**已存在**的行改 `name` 给已有 row 换 `name` 时，装载器输出并**跳过该补丁**： ``` patch: name mismatch for "selfheal" (expected "dsh-plugin-selfheal", got "…"), skipping ``` 这是好的防护，但**它静默**：宿主照常启动，于是"我的实验没生效"和"被测对象没加载" 长得一模一样。我们因此规定：这类实验必须带**对照行**。 ### 4. 配置校验的覆盖面是可以自我说明的 我们让插件导出 `resolvePolicy(config)`，闸门就能在启动前导入安装副本、**用它自己的校验函数** 吃进组合后的配置。没有导出该函数的包，闸门会**如实降级并声明**： ``` [WARN] 没有任何本地包导出 resolvePolicy —— 本次只做了字节一致性检查（覆盖面有限，如实记录） ``` > 建议：把 `resolvePolicy`（或等价的 `validateConfig`）变成**官方约定的可选导出**。 > 这是一个极低成本的改进：插件作者加一个函数，宿主就能在启动前拦住"配置/代码漂移"这一类致命故障。

四、我们的实现（公开仓库）

仓库 | 内容 -- | -- AristotleAsborg/dsh-self-heal | 套件：启动前闸门 / 崩溃看护 / 有界修复阶梯 / 兜底说明 / 安装器 / CI（MIT，中英双语 README，Windows） ### 四层设计（**全部在宿主之外**） | 层 | 做什么 | 判据 | | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | **L0-1 启动前闸门** | 启动前组合 profile 树；把**每个已安装本地包**导入并喂进它自己的 `resolvePolicy`；比对安装副本与源码的**字节** | 确证不一致 → 拒绝启动（exit 1）并打印修复命令 | | **L0 崩溃看护** | 宿主非零退出时打事故包（日志尾部 / 闸门结论 / 组合树），只执行**允许清单内**的唯一修复：`pnpm install` 重同步后复验闸门 | 只按**最后一次**启动尝试分类（早期版本扫全量日志，把历史报错当成新故障） | | **L1 / L1.5 有界修复** | 把事故交给一次 headless 会话，先默认 profile，再降级到出厂 `rescue`；每级 **detached** 运行、输出落事故目录 | **启动探针**：把修复后的组合在备用端口真启动一次并撑过硬超时 | | **兜底** | 都没修好 → 写一份固定位置的排障说明（含本次事故要点） | — |

五、能救什么、救不了什么

这一节是这套东西最该被看清的地方。"自修复"最危险的不是修不好，而是让人以为它什么都能修， 于是出事时先等它，错过了人工窗口。

5.1 判据：先分类，再决定能不能修

看护只按最后一次启动尝试分类（早期版本扫全量日志，把历史报错当成新故障，已修）：

归类 | 触发特征 -- | -- config-code-skew | 日志出现 unknown config key entry-failure | plugin tree failed to load / failed to apply loader entry port-in-use | EADDRINUSE permission | EPERM / EACCES unknown (exit=N) | 以上都不匹配 —— 诚实标注为未知，不硬套一个类

还没验证到的（不要当成已完成）：DSH_SUPERVISOR_RELAUNCH=1 的"修好后自动重启"路径 我们没有端到端测过；本文所有数字均来自单机单实例实测，没有在第二种目录布局的机器上 完整装过一遍。

5.4 即使"能救"，也带着这些界

  • 节流：同一时间窗内修复次数有上限，超出直接跳过 —— 防重启循环优先于"再试一次"。
  • 不越界：修复会话的沙箱以 $DSH_HOME 为界、approval: never；越界写入会被拒， 契约要求它停下并报告，而不是申请提权。
  • 只改一处：契约要求一次只改一件事并立刻校验，每步留回滚命令。
  • 不自己重启：判定 READY-TO-RESTART 后不重启宿主，把决定权留给人（除非显式开启重启开关）。
  • 报告缺失只记警告：判定依据是启动探针，不是"有没有报告"。
## 六、一些已知数据和事实 - **闸门**：每次运行往 `gate.log` 追加一行 `[gate] PASS failures=0 warnings=1`。 `failures=` 即拒绝启动；`warnings=1` 通常只是"端口已被占用"的提示。 - **真启动**：健康组合约 **1.0–1.2 秒** announce URL（多次实测：1048 / 1068 / 1088 / 1214 ms）。 - **修复闭环**：有一次事故的阶梯判定表是 ``` | 级 | 进程 | 报告 | 启动探针 | 判定 | | L1 headless + 修复 overlay | ok | NEEDS-HUMAN(无报告) | ALIVE（已 announce URL） | REPAIRED | ``` ——报告列与探针列**故意可以不一致**，判定看探针列。 - **CI**：`.github/workflows/ci.yml`（Windows runner）四步全绿，最新一次： 其中端到端 85 项，跑在**路径含空格的临时目录**上，并连装两次证明第二次是空操作。 - **事故包不是"文件齐备"的**：13 个真实事故里 `gate.txt`/`console-tail.txt`/`dump-config.txt` 基本都在， 但 `ladder.md` 只有 4 个、`repair-report.md` **0 个**（报告在工作区侧的 `$DSH_HOME\repair-<事故>\`）。**别用"文件齐备"当健康判据。** ## 七、给官方的 3 条建议 1. **让插件能在 `apply()` 里零依赖地拿到 `defineTool`**（例如 `ctx.tools.define`）。 现状迫使插件用 `createRequire(/bin.js)` 猜宿主布局，这对第三方插件是隐性门槛。 2. **把 `resolvePolicy` / `validateConfig` 变成官方约定的可选导出**，并在加载失败时把它接进诊断。 这一个函数就能把"配置与代码漂移"从**致命且报错误导**，变成**启动前一句话说清**。 3. **把"配置漂移"与"未知配置键"在报错里分开。** 我们两次致命事故的报错都是 `unknown config key "X"`，而真实原因是**安装副本落后于配置**。 若报错能提示"该键不在安装副本的允许集合里，可能是副本与源码不同步 → 先 `pnpm install`"， 我们会少走一整轮弯路。 ## 八、我们想要的回应 - 以上四条**接口行为**（`defineTool` 契约 / 裸标识符解析 / 补丁 name 不匹配被跳过 / 配置校验覆盖面） 是否有官方文档可引用？我们愿意按官方口径订正我们的 README。 - 第 7 节的 3 条建议里，哪一条官方认为可行？我们乐意按官方接口改我们的实现， 也乐意把套件拆成"官方想要的形状"。 - 若官方对"宿主之外的自修复"有既定立场（例如认为应由宿主内解决），也请直说—— 我们现在的设计（阶梯在宿主外）是被"宿主可能起不来"这个前提逼出来的， 如果官方认为前提不成立，我们愿意改。

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh-http-proxy 把 undici 专用的 `[::1]` 写进通用 NO_PROXY，Python httpx 等非 Node 子进程直接构不出 client
discussions.body:
## 摘要

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` 把 undici 专用的方括号写法 `[::1]` 混进了标准 `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy` 环境变量。该变量会被 `applyPolicyEnv()` 写进 `process.env`，因此**每个被 spawn 的子进程**都会继承。非 Node 的 HTTP 客户端（Python `httpx` / `requests`）无法解析 `[::1]`，只要构造 HTTP client 就抛异常。

DSH 加入 `[::1]` 是为了修 undici 自身的解析缺陷，但把该缺陷转嫁给了其它语言的客户端。

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 0.1.7-rc.2（打包版 NEXT `2.0.15-next`） |
| 系统 | macOS，Intel |
| 代理 | Clash Verge，系统代理 `127.0.0.1:7897` |
| 受害客户端 | Python 3.13.13 + httpx 0.28.1（uv 管理的 venv） |

## 问题代码

`packages/util/http-proxy/src/policy.ts:33`

```ts
export const LOOPBACK_NO_PROXY: readonly string[] = ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1', '[::1]']
```

注释（同文件 L28-32）说明了 `[::1]` 的动机：

> `::1` and `[::1]` are both listed because the resolved string is also handed to undici, whose matcher reads a bare `::1` as host `:` port `1` and therefore never bypasses it.

传播路径：

1. `policy.ts` `withLoopback()`（L200 附近）把 `LOOPBACK_NO_PROXY` 并进 policy 的 `noProxy`
2. `install.ts` `applyPolicyEnv()`（打包版 `lib/index.js:334`）调用 `writeProxyEnv()`，逐名写入 `process.env`
3. 其 JSDoc 明说覆盖面：

> Publish a policy through the proxy environment variables, which is how the consumers that read an environment rather than a policy object — `node:http`'s `proxyEnv` and **every spawned child** — see the one resolved answer, including the `ALL_PROXY` fallback and the merged loopback bypass that neither derives on its own.


## 观测到的值

```
NO_PROXY=100.122.107.27,192.168.10.32,198.18.0.1,.local,localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]
no_proxy=100.122.107.27,192.168.10.32,198.18.0.1,.local,localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]
```

逐段对应：

| 段 | 来源 |
|---|---|
| `100.122.107.27,192.168.10.32,198.18.0.1` | 该机器的 LAN 字面量（trustedHosts） |
| `.local` | 硬编码 |
| `localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]` | `LOOPBACK_NO_PROXY` |

大小写成对出现（`http_proxy`+`HTTP_PROXY` 等）也符合 `POLICY_ENV_NAMES` 的"both casings are always written or cleared together"。

触发条件（`buildDesktopProxyOverlay`）：未显式导出 proxy，且系统代理探测返回非 DIRECT。因此**与启动方式无关**（Finder / 终端 / 任何 shell 都一样），因为系统代理是机器级设置。

## 复现

### 最小复现（Python + httpx）

```python
import httpx
httpx.Client()
```

在子进程里分别设置 `NO_PROXY` 后的实测结果：

```
FAIL NO_PROXY='[::1]'                          -> InvalidURL: Invalid port: ':1]'
OK   NO_PROXY='::1'
FAIL NO_PROXY='localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,[::1]'  -> InvalidURL: Invalid port: ':1]'
OK   NO_PROXY=''
```

即：**只有带方括号的那一项失败**；裸 `::1` 与空值都正常。

### 真实测试套件（uv + pytest）

一个 1669 用例的单元测试套件，用继承 DSH 环境的 shell 运行：

```
$ uv run pytest tests/unit -q
32 failed, 62 passed, 26 errors     # 仅受影响的 7 个文件
```

清掉方括号后，同一批文件：

```
$ NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,.local" uv run pytest <同样 7 个文件> -q
101 passed
```

受影响文件的失败点全部是构造 HTTP client，与代理连通性无关——`httpx.Client()` 在**解析环境变量**阶段就抛异常，请求根本没发出。

## 影响

- 任何在 DSH 会话里用 bash 工具跑 Python 测试的人都会中招，且报错信息（`Invalid port: ':1]'`）完全不指向根因
- 同样影响 `requests`（同源 urllib 语义）、可能影响其它按 `host:port` 解析 bypass 项的非 Node 客户端
- 纯 Node 侧不受影响；undici 反而**需要** `[::1]`

## 说明

- 未在本报告中确认其它语言客户端的表现，仅列出可能同样受影响。

discussions.title: Remote workspaces in the Desktop app — and the remote side must keep running on its own
discussions.body:
## What I want

I use DSH Desktop on my laptop and keep a workstation in my office. I would like to **open a workspace that lives on that workstation, from the Desktop app, and have it feel exactly like a local workspace** — same UI, same plugins, same settings, no second setup.

## The one thing that must not be compromised

> **The remote side has to be a persistent service.** Closing my laptop must not stop the work. When I come back and reconnect, the conversation is still there — and it kept running while I was away.

This is the part I care about most, and it is the part that is missing today.

## Qoder is the counter-example

Qoder already ships the *interface* I want: an **SSH workspace**, where you pick a registered remote host and commands and file operations run there ([Qoder execution environments](https://docs.qoder.com/zh/qoder/execution-environments)). As a UX reference it is exactly right.

But that mode is not persistent, and that is precisely what I do not want. In my experience with Qoder's SSH workspace, closing the laptop ends the work: the remote side is tied to the local client, the same way VS Code Remote unloads its remote server and cleans up running processes once the client fails to reconnect ([vscode-remote-release#1257](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-remote-release/issues/1257)).

Qoder's own answer for work that must survive is to move it somewhere else entirely: **Cloud Tasks**, which run in Qoder-managed VMs and keep going when the local terminal disconnects ([Qoder cloud mode](https://docs.qoder.com/zh/cli/cloud-mode)); and its remote-control and daemon modes explicitly require the local computer to stay active ([Qoder remote control](https://docs.qoder.com/zh/cli/remote-control)).

So the choices today are: connect to a remote, but the work still depends on my laptop staying awake; or move the work off my own machine into someone else's cloud. **I want neither.** I want the remote-workspace interface *and* the work living on my own workstation as a service that keeps running on its own.

## Where DSH stands today

- The Desktop app can only work on the machine it runs on.
- I can reach my workstation's `dsh web` through a browser, and the work does keep running there — but that is the web surface, not the Desktop app, and it is a separate world.
- Local and remote are **two separate plugin/config sets**: I maintain the same plugins twice.
- There is no way to see the remote work from the Desktop app.

## The ask

1. **Remote workspace in the Desktop app** — pick an SSH host, open a remote directory as a workspace, get the normal Desktop experience on it.
2. **Remote-persistent by design** — the remote side runs as its own service. Laptop closed, network dropped, app quit: the work continues. Reconnect and the conversation is exactly where it was.
3. **One plugin/config set** — a single source of truth shared by the local and remote sides, instead of maintaining two.

## One observation that may be useful

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-ssh` is already published — and on the `next` tag it is the **same version as the current Desktop build (0.1.7-rc.2)** — described as *"Shared OpenSSH connection and versioned POSIX remote helper"*. Nothing shipped in the Desktop app depends on it or bundles it. If that is the intended substrate for this feature, it looks like the foundation is already there and just needs to be surfaced.

## Why I am asking for core support instead of shipping a plugin

I looked into solving this as a plugin, and it does not work cleanly. In DSH, the UI's plugin set and the ownership of sessions and agents come from the Host the window is connected to — and the Desktop window always talks to the local Host. A plugin can add tools and panels, but it cannot make the local Host own a remote session without replacing internal core services, which would be fragile across releases. This feels like it belongs in core.

<details>
<summary>Evidence for maintainers (code references)</summary>

- The Desktop window always loads its own local Host: `dsh-desktop-host` hardcodes `runProfile({ profile: 'desktop', args: ['--no-open', '--port', '19387'] })` and reports that URL to Electron (`dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js:215-240`, `:337`). The Electron main process has a single assignment for the host URL, and no environment variable or setting that points it elsewhere.
- The renderer hardcodes the transport: `__DSH_TRANSPORT__ = { ownsHost: true, streamBaseUrl }` in the frontend bundle; all HTTP is relative-URL, so only the WebSocket origin can be redirected.
- Client plugin bundles are served by the Host: the index HTML loads each plugin as `/plugins/??<pkg>/client.js`, so the UI component set is decided by whichever Host the window talks to.
- Services are single-provider: `ctx.provide()` throws when a name is already registered (`cordis/lib/index.js:813`), and the agent factory is a single slot (`dsh-agent/lib/index.js:429`). A plugin cannot register a second `sessionPersistence` / `sessionQuery` / agent factory.
- A plugin cannot embed the remote UI either: the Desktop main process enforces webview leases and closes any `<webview>` not created by the approved Browser machinery. The built-in right-sidebar Browser tab works, but it shows the web surface.

</details>

## Questions

1. Is remote-workspace support planned? I ask because `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ssh` is published at the same version as the current Desktop build, but nothing shipped uses it.
2. Which shape would you prefer: a configurable remote Host in the Desktop client, a multi-host client, or SSH as a first-class transport?
