discussions.title: 交付卡片的「打开」按钮能否可配置默认动作（侧边栏预览 / 系统默认程序 / 文件管理器）
discussions.body:
## 背景

Web GUI 的交付卡片（`present` 声明的文件）上，**两个主要交互都指向"在右侧边栏预览"**：

| 元素 | 现状 | 源码 |
|---|---|---|
| 卡片本体 | 右侧边栏预览 | `PresentedFileCard` 里覆盖整卡的透明按钮 `onClick: onPreview` |
| 「打开」按钮 | **也是右侧边栏预览** | `onClick: onPreview`（aria 才是 `presented.previewButton`「在侧边栏打开 {name}」） |
| 右半 `⌄` 菜单 | 在默认程序中打开 / 打开所在文件夹 | 这里的 `onAction("open")` / `onAction("reveal")` |

按钮**文案是「打开」**，但绑的是预览动作 —— 用户很容易以为卡片坏了或者"打开"没反应（我自己就先这么误会了一次）。

## 建议

把交付卡片的**默认动作**做成可配置，而不是把"用默认程序打开"藏在 `⌄` 菜单里。三档覆盖实际使用习惯：

1. **在侧边栏预览**（现状）
2. **用系统默认程序打开**（`onAction("open")`，已有实现，只是入口深）
3. **在文件管理器中显示/定位**（`onAction("reveal")`，已有实现）

配置粒度建议是**全局默认 + 每次可选**（卡片设置里切换默认档，`⌄` 菜单仍可临时选其它档）。相关讨论 [#7549](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7549) 提到卡片动作集还可以扩展（例如 headless 场景的 Download），说明这块动作面本来就在演进中。

## 临时方案（我已上传补丁，欢迎自取，也欢迎官方收编）

在官方给出配置项之前，我用本地补丁把「打开」按钮改成了**系统默认程序打开**（卡片本体仍是侧边栏预览）。实测有效，已开源：

**https://github.com/bolide737/dsh-patches** → `patches/card-open-native/`

### 补丁源码（就一行）

```diff
--- a/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables/lib/client.js
+++ b/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables/lib/client.js
@@ PresentedFileCard(...)
 			(react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
 				className: Deliverables_module_css_default.split,
 				children: [(react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
 					ref: previewRef,
 					type: "button",
 					className: Deliverables_module_css_default.open,
 					"aria-label": t("presented.previewButton", { name: file.path }),
-					onClick: onPreview,
+					onClick: () => onAction("open"),
 					children: t("presented.action")
 				}), (react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_primitives.Menu, {
```

定位方式：`PresentedFileCard` 内、`children` 为 `t("presented.action")` 的那个按钮。若想让**整张卡片**也走默认程序打开，把卡片本体那处 `onClick: onPreview` 同样替换即可。

### 用法

```powershell
# 仓库里带幂等安装脚本（自动备份 *.bak-before-native-open）：
pwsh -File patches/card-open-native/apply.ps1
pwsh -File patches/card-open-native/revert.ps1   # 一键回退
```

或手动：编辑上面那个文件 → 改这一行 → **刷新浏览器页面**（纯客户端 bundle，不需要重启 DSH）。

### 注意事项

- 这是改 `node_modules` 里已发布 bundle 的**本地补丁**，DSH 升级会被覆盖，需要重打；仓库里附了脚本与原理文档。
- 原生打开要求 **host 能解析到系统默认关联程序**，且只对**本机浏览器**有效；headless / WSL 服务端没有桌面（会提示 "This Host has no desktop available"），这种场景更需要 [#7549](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7549) 里的 Download action。

## 环境

DSH `0.1.5-rc.2`（Web GUI）+ Windows 11。若官方愿意收编，我很乐意把三档配置的实现整理成 PR；如果设计上更倾向于"动作全部平铺在卡片上"（不做默认档），也欢迎说明取舍 —— 我这边只关心"点一下就能用系统程序打开"这件事变得可发现。

> 关联：侧边栏插件抢占 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 导致交付卡片整体不渲染的问题，已在 `omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar` 提了验证与补丁（[PR #634 评论](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar/pull/634#issuecomment-5856730412)）。

discussions.title: [Withdrawn] Windows: terminal hosting dsh web came to the foreground — root cause not identified
[Bug] macOS arm64：自带 runtime 的 node 24.21.0 因库校验拒绝加载 adhoc 签名的原生插件预编译产物（require-builtin / node-pty 均 ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED），任何 profile 都无法启动
discussions.body:
### 环境 - macOS **26.4.1 (25E253)**, arm64 - DSH **0.1.7-rc.2**（桌面 App 与 npm 安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 同版；包位于 `apps/cli`） - 自带 runtime node：`~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node` → **v24.21.0** （App 载荷内同一份：`…/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node`，`codesign` 输出完全一致） - 系统 node：v22.22.1 (Homebrew)，adhoc 签名、无 Team ID ### 现象 用**自带 runtime 的 node** 启动任何 profile，都会在 host preparation 阶段中止（早于任何插件挂载）： ``` $ node(24.21.0) ~/.local/bin/dsh --profile headless "…" dsh: fatal uncaught exception: Error: dsh: host preparation failed: No usable native binding found for node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64 (auto) at boot (.../dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:4104:9) at async runProfile (.../dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js:271:15) [cause]: Error: No usable native binding found for node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64 (auto) at noUsableBindingError (.../node-addon-native-custom-loader/lib/index.js:478:19) at loadEntry (.../node-addon-native-custom-loader/lib/index.js:541:11) at Object. (.../node-addon-require-builtin/lib/index.js:11:13) attempts: optional-package => 'No usable prebuilt binary found in darwin-arm64' local-build => Cannot find module '.../node-addon-require-builtin/build/nodeabi/node-v137-darwin-arm64/require_builtin.node' local-build => Cannot find module '.../node-addon-require-builtin/build/napi/napi-v9-darwin-arm64/require_builtin.node' ``` 同一个 node 下 `dsh --version` 与 `dsh --help` 都 **exit=0**（顶层不加载该 addon），所以很容易误判成"安装没问题"，直到启动 profile 才炸。GUI（Electron 进程）不受影响。 ### 根因（实测） **不是 ABI / Node 版本问题，是 macOS 库校验（hardened runtime）拒绝加载 adhoc 签名的原生插件。** 1. 自带 node 是**已签名**二进制： ``` Identifier=com.deepseek.dsh.runtime.eba124c703208ac5659ac6c5371a60fc815025cc15a4d795edb69c69fb7c4681 TeamIdentifier=NAN929V4UM entitlements: [com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit] ``` **没有** `com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation`。 2. 随包原生插件的预编译产物是 **adhoc 签名、无 Team ID**： ``` node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64/prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node Identifier=darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node Signature=adhoc TeamIdentifier=not set node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-arm64/pty.node Identifier=pty.node Signature=adhoc TeamIdentifier=not set ``` 3. 于是 `dlopen` 被系统拒绝（绕过 loader 选择逻辑直接 require 的原始报错）： ``` dlopen(.../darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node, 0x0001): tried: '...darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node' (code signature in '...darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node' not valid for use in process: mapping process and mapped file (non-platform) have different Team IDs) code: ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED ``` 4. **对照实验**（同一文件，只换 node）： | 加载器 | 目标 | 结果 | |---|---|---| | 自带 node 24.21.0（Team `NAN929V4UM`） | `require-builtin` 的 `prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node` | `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`（Team ID 不一致） | | 自带 node 24.21.0 | `node-pty` 的 `prebuilds/darwin-arm64/pty.node` | `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`（同因） | | Homebrew node 22.22.1（adhoc，无 Team） | 上述两者 | 均 **LOADED** | 5. 走 loader 时：node 22 → `require('node-addon-require-builtin')` OK，`getBindingInfo()` = `{backend:"napi", abi:"napi-v9", bindingSource:"optional-package"}`； node 24 → `No usable native binding found`，其 `attempts` 只给出 `optional-package => No usable prebuilt binary found in darwin-arm64`， **完全没有透露真正的签名原因**（错误信息里的 `node-v137` 只是 loader 在找本地构建产物，与根因无关），把排查方向带偏到 ABI/Node 版本上。 ### 影响 - 自带 runtime 下，**所有以 adhoc 签名随包发布的原生插件预编译产物都不可用**（`node-addon-require-builtin` 只是第一个撞上的；`node-pty` 是第二个）。凡走自带 node 的 CLI 路径——`dsh --profile

…`、批处理/脚本、`dsh plugin`——全部无法启动；GUI 因为跑在 Electron 进程里（Electron 的 helper 默认带 `disable-library-validation`，此处为推断）不受影响。 - 临时绕过：把系统 node（22）放到 `PATH` 前即可正常工作，已长期这样用。 ### 建议修复（任选其一） 1. 给打包进 App 的 node 补 `com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation` entitlement（Electron 自身就是这么做的）； 2. 或在打包阶段把随包的 `*.node` 用同一 Team ID（`NAN929V4UM`）重新签名； 3. 至少让 `node-addon-native-custom-loader` 在 `optional-package` 失败时把底层 `dlopen` 的错误串出来，而不是只报 “No usable prebuilt binary found in darwin-arm64”。 ### 附带发现（同一个载荷内的版本号不一致，独立小问题） `runtime/primary-runtime/runtime.json` → `{"node": "24.21.0"}`，而 `runtime/versions.json` → `{"node": "24.18.1"}`。 ### 最小复现 ```bash BUNDLED_NODE="$HOME/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node" # 1) 顶层命令正常（误导点） "$BUNDLED_NODE" ~/.local/bin/dsh --version # → 0.1.7-rc.2, exit 0 # 2) 任何 profile 启动即失败 "$BUNDLED_NODE" ~/.local/bin/dsh --profile headless "hi" # 3) 定位到签名（与 ABI 无关） NODE_MODULES="$HOME/.local/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules" "$BUNDLED_NODE" -e "require('$NODE_MODULES/node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64/prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node')" node -e "require('$NODE_MODULES/node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64/prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node')" codesign -dv --entitlements - "$BUNDLED_NODE" codesign -dv "$NODE_MODULES/node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64/prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node" ``` ### 相关讨论（我的情形与它们的差异） - [#6982](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6982) Android/Termux：同一条报错路径，但那边是**根本没有 android-arm64 绑定**；这里是 **darwin-arm64 有绑定、却被签名校验挡下**。 - [#690](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/690) NixOS：同一 addon 的探测失败（Nix 编译的 node）；本贴是 macOS 打包签名问题。 - [#5750](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5750) 询问 darwin-arm64 预编译产物的出处；本机该包版本为 **0.1.6**（非 0.1.4），`shasum -a 256 prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node` = `4cee5efeea5911d1e2acab3f3d6148d0ba6e4a5148e9e9ec21075cb1133eb11f`。 - [#7710](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7710) 关于减少对 Node 内部模块接口的依赖（本贴不涉及该点，仅作关联）。

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows 11 26100] workspace-write 下任何 shell 命令都以 3221225794（0xC0000142）死亡，read-only 正常
discussions.body:
相关已有讨论：#810（桌面启动路径 + 无控制台宿主）、#1344（GUI 宿主的控制台闪现与 STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW 修法）、#1847（Windows 10 19041 同症状）。本机为 Windows 11 26100，补充了两点：把「Electron 宿主进程 vs 普通 node 父进程」做了隔离对照，以及 read-only 档位不受影响。

### 环境
DSH 桌面版 0.1.7-rc.2，Windows 11（build 26100），已装 PowerShell 7.6.6。
任何权限档为 `workspace-write`（默认档）的会话必现。

### 现象
shell 命令一律返回 `(no output)` + 退出码 `3221225794`（`0xC0000142` STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）：进程在 DLL 初始化阶段就死了。工具结果里**没有任何 enforcement / denial 元数据**，看起来只是一个普通的非零退出码。

### 隔离复现（同一份 runner、同一组参数，只换父进程）
直接调用 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js`，带真实的 `--write-sid` / `--temp-write-sid`：
- 父进程 `node.exe`：read-only 与 workspace-write 都 exit 0
- 父进程 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`）：workspace-write 必死 `3221225794`，read-only 正常
- pwsh 7.6.6、Windows PowerShell 5.1、连 `cmd.exe` 死法完全相同

### 已排除
PowerShell 版本、受限令牌创建本身（沙箱内 `BUILTIN\Administrators` 正确显示 "Group used for deny only"）、能力 SID 授权（手工补 ACE 无效）、`CREATE_NO_WINDOW`（windowsHide 两态在 node 父进程下都通过）、通用受限令牌（`runas /trustlevel:0x20000` 下 pwsh 正常）。

### 影响与绕行
桌面版上所有默认（workspace-write）会话都没有可用的 shell。本机绕行：会话切到 `danger-full-access`。另请确认 #1344 提到的 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE` 改法是否覆盖 Electron 宿主这一情形。

### 最小复现（节选）
关键只有一处：让沙箱 runner 的父解释器变成桌面版可执行文件。
spawn(desktopExe, [runnerJs, '--workspace', ws, '--temp', tmp, '--mode', 'workspace-write', '--write-sid', sid, '--temp-write-sid', tsid, '--', 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe', '/c', 'echo hi'],
      { env: { ...process.env, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1' }, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
用 cmd.exe 就能复现（不必依赖 PowerShell），退出码 3221225794。

discussions.title: [Docs] cordis-plugin-development 的 Settings pages 缺 settings.plugins.tab，例子也没写 inject
discussions.body:
给插件作者的那份 skill（`apps/cli/config/agent-presets/cordis/skills/cordis-plugin-development/SKILL.md`）在「Settings pages」一节里只列了 `settings.section` 与 `settings.general.item`，但宿主实际声明了四个 settings 座位，其中 `settings.plugins.tab`（「插件」分区里的标签页）只写在 `packages/client/ui-settings/README.zh.md` 里 —— 写插件的人第一眼看不到它：容易把整页塞进 `settings.general.item`（那是「一行」的座位），或者干脆不知道该往哪放。

同一节的注册例子是裸的 `ctx.slots.register({ name: 'target.slot' }, () => null)`，而 slot 注册表写明「注册未声明 slot …… 都会在加载时抛出」（`dsh-client-ui-slots/README.zh.md` 的「声明纪律」一节）；内置五节与 `cordis-client-runner/src/client/slot-catalog.ts` 的例子都写成 `ctx.slots.inject('<slot>', () => ctx.slots.register(...))`。照 skill 抄、又在座位挂载之前注册，异常会被自己的 try/catch 吞掉，表现是那一节**静默不显示** —— 与 #2480（插件卡片在 configurable 标签挂载后才注册就不渲染）是同族。

建议只改文档：① 「Settings pages」补一张四座位对照 —— `settings.section`（导航里一页）/ `settings.plugins.tab`（「插件」分区里的标签页）/ `settings.general.item`（「通用」分区里一行）/ `settings.onboarding`（引导一步）；② 把该节例子改成 `ctx.slots.inject(...)` 形式，并写明「注册必须在声明之后」。

出处：`packages/client/ui-settings/README.zh.md`、`packages/client/ui-settings/src/client/contract/slots.ts`（两处座位声明）、`packages/client/ui-settings-plugins/src/client/index.ts`（声明 `settings.plugins.tab`）、`dsh-client-ui-slots/README.zh.md`（声明纪律）。相关但不同：#2480（座位挂载后注册不渲染）、#6710（分区多时左侧导航溢出）、#3022 / #4880 / #6309 / #6333（`settings.section` 图标被忽略）。

discussions.title: [Perf] One list() call walks the session corpus twice: historicalCorpusRevision() re-runs listGenerations()
discussions.body:
## Summary

`SessionPersistence.list()` enumerates the whole session corpus **twice per call**, through the same `listGenerations()` function. The second enumeration additionally `stat`s every selected path and folds it into a sha256.

This is a separate, self-contained defect from the per-session header scan analysed in #7142. That thread's fix (bounded concurrency + identity-keyed caches) makes each walk *cheaper*; this one can be removed outright, because both consumers run inside the same call that already holds a corpus snapshot.

I am filing it separately because I did not see it mentioned in #7142, #5043, #3740, #4285 or #5961, and because it is small and independent enough to be worth its own line item. If you would rather track it inside #7142, that is fine by me — a companion comment with the same numbers is already there.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` (npm), macOS arm64, Node v22.22.0, web profile on loopback
- `session-persistence-jsonl` at defaults (`compression: zstd`); `session-query-sqlite` at `path: ':memory:'`, `openAt: never`
- Store: 816 sessions / 654 MB (1,361 sessions / 1.35 GB before I pruned it)

## The double walk

```ts
// packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts — master, lines 483-485
const artifacts = await this.listArtifacts(signal)                         // :1064 -> listGenerations()
const corpusRevision = artifacts.some(a => a.sourceVersion < SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION)
  ? await this.historicalCorpusRevision(signal) : undefined                // :1039 -> listGenerations()
```

`listGenerations()` (`:1025`) is the full two-level walk — `listProjectDirs()` → `listSessionDirs()` → `resolveGenerationInDirectory()` per directory. Both callers invoke it independently, so one `list()` runs the identical walk twice; the second one then adds a `stat()` per selected path plus a sha256 over all of them.

The trigger only needs **one** pre-current-format artifact, so in practice it is essentially always taken: on this store **746 of 816 selected generations (91.4%) are `< v4`** (v0 152, v3 594, v4 70); on the larger pre-prune store, 1,291 of 1,361.

## Measured

Warm, median of 5, 816 sessions / 654 MB:

| term | ms |
|---|---|
| `listGenerations()` equivalent (two-level readdir + generation resolve) | 87 |
| `historicalCorpusRevision()` equivalent (same walk + `stat` + sha256) | 97 |

So roughly 90% of the corpus-revision term is a duplicate of work the same call has already done.

For scale, in the same measurement series a full **cold** listing on the 1,361-session store decomposed as: readdir pass 3.01 s, header reads (open + 8 KB + zstd) 7.24 s, corpus-revision 1.78 s — sum 12.2 s, against the endpoint measured cold at 11.6 s and warm at ~1.5 s. So this term is second-order next to the header scan that #7142 is about; I am not claiming it explains the slowness, only that it is free to remove. (Cold/warm really is the dominant variable here, not CPU: a single `open` + 8 KB read is p50 0.38 ms, p99 1.91 ms.)

## Suggested change

Hoist the single `listGenerations()` result in `list()` and pass it to both consumers instead of letting each call it. The call already holds a snapshot of the corpus, so sharing one enumeration is at least as correct as today — and strictly more consistent, since the two walks currently run at different instants and are free to disagree with each other.

## Notes

- **Still unfixed on `master`** (latest push 2026-09-24, fetched 2026-09-27): `listArtifacts()` at line 1056 is still the serial nested loop with one `await` per session — no per-instance cache, no bounded concurrency — and `rootEncodingCheck` (`:1608`) is still the only memo on the path. The 8.1x patch reported in #7142 has not landed.
- **This does not replace #7142.** The dominant cost there — one serialized header read per session, re-done on every call — is untouched by this change.
- **Why not just migrate the store to the current format.** Migration clears the `some()` trigger, but it also leaves both artifacts in the directory for the walk to enumerate, so it moves two variables at once. That is consistent with the negative result in #7142 and is why I would not use migration to price this term.
- **User-visible impact today** is on the same two endpoints as #7142: `session/list` and `sessionReferenceResolver/candidates` (the `@` mention menu). Pruning the store remains the only effective lever in the field for now — moving 40% of it out took `session/list` from 1,490–2,349 ms to 428–533 ms and `candidates` from 1,487–2,720 ms to 432–834 ms here.

discussions.title: [Bug] 会话持久化的 live 写缓冲无上限增长：`dsh web` 进程 RSS 涨到 14.7 GB（0.1.7-rc.2 / Windows）
discussions.body:
# 概要

在分发智能体团队（subagent）任务期间，`dsh web` 服务端内存从约 3 GB 涨到 14.7 GB，约 2.5 分钟内必须人工杀掉。对运行中进程做采样堆剖析 + 阅读源码后，问题指向 `JsonlSessionHandle` 的 live 写缓冲（`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/storage.ts`）：

* 每个发布的 `session/event` 都会 `structuredClone` 一份、`push` 进**无上限**的 `buffered: SessionEvent[]`；
* 只要有一次 drain（批量写盘）失败，就会置 `drainPaused`，`enqueueLive` 之后不再装批量定时器，唯一的重试机会只剩 `session/flush`（通常发生在回合结束），而事件仍在持续累积。

## 环境

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| dsh | `0.1.7-rc.2`（`next`），npm 全局安装 |
| Node | v22.23.3，npm 10.9.9 |
| 系统  | Windows 11 专业版 Insider Preview 10.0.29667（build 29667），x64 |
| 内存  | 47.4 GB |
| Profile | 官方 `web` app + 第三方插件（含 experimental agent-team 系列 bundle） |
| 触发条件 | 在会话里分发团队 / subagent 任务（`session/event` 速率大幅升高） |

## 现场一：进程自行 OOM 退出

    1812440 ms: Mark-Compact 4029.6 (4131.4) -> 3998.1 (4131.9) MB, pooled: 0 MB, 627.10 / 0.00 ms
    1813081 ms: Mark-Compact 4030.2 (4131.9) -> 3998.7 (4132.4) MB, pooled: 0 MB, 601.67 / 0.00 ms
    FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

## 现场二：重启后复现，每 15 s 采样的 RSS

    23:19:40  RSS=  3029 MB
    23:19:55  RSS=  3332 MB   (+1209 MB/min)
    23:20:10  RSS=  3675 MB   (+1371 MB/min)
    23:20:25  RSS=  3877 MB
    23:21:10  RSS=  4234 MB
    23:21:40  RSS=  5767 MB   (+5801 MB/min)
    23:21:55  RSS= 10329 MB   (+18210 MB/min)
    23:22:05  RSS= 14703 MB   -> 人工杀掉（当时系统可用内存只剩 18.5 GB）

补充观察：

* 末尾阶段 CPU 时间每 15 s 增加约 47 s（约 3 个核在自旋），符合"反复整批复制 / 重试"的特征；
* 最新的 session 文件 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 的最后写入时间是 23:17:16，之后约 4 分钟没有任何落盘，而 `session/event` 仍在产生——说明 live 写管道早已堵住，缓冲只进不出。

## 证据一：运行中进程的采样堆剖析

我用 `process._debugProcess(pid)` 从另一个 Node 进程附加 inspector，然后 `HeapProfiler.enable` + `HeapProfiler.startSampling`（64 KiB 采样间隔，持续 12 s）+ `HeapProfiler.stopSampling`。由于采样剖析只统计 `startSampling` 之后产生的分配，下表是**新增且仍然存活**的字节数：

    total sampled = 174.0 MB over 12 s  (~870 MB/min，与观测到的 RSS 斜率一致)
    
       65.4 MB  (anon) @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:408   <- ctx.on('session/event') -> enqueueLive
       23.9 MB  walkJsonValue @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-values/lib/index.js:46
       16.4 MB  append @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js:1401
       15.1 MB  checkpoint @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection/lib/index.js:196
        9.7 MB  (anon) @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:2339
        6.9 MB  drive @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection/lib/index.js:402

其中 `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 的 line 408 对应编译产物里的 `install()` 路由：`ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => this.writers.get(session.id)?.enqueueLive(event, ...))`。

## 证据二：源码

`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/storage.ts`：

     89:  /** Routed live events awaiting their batching deadline (persistence-owned copies). */
     90:  private buffered: SessionEvent[] = []
     91:  private batchTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
     92:  /** Set when a drain failed; the automatic timer stays quiet until the next drain. */
     93:  private drainPaused = false
    ...
    274:  enqueueLive(event: SessionEvent, reportBackgroundFailure: (error: unknown) => void): void {
    275:    this.buffered.push(structuredClone(event))
    276:    if (this.batchTimer !== undefined || this.drainPaused) return
    277:    this.batchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    278:      this.batchTimer = undefined
    279:      this.drainLive().catch(reportBackgroundFailure)
    280:    }, LIVE_WRITE_BATCH_MAX_DELAY_MS)          // 200 ms，见 :36
    281:  }
    ...
    288:  drainLive(): Promise<void> {
    289:    return this.draining ??= this.drainBuffered().finally(() => { this.draining = undefined })
    292:  }
    ...
    294:  private async drainBuffered(): Promise<void> {
    299:    this.drainPaused = false
    300:    while (this.buffered.length > 0) {
    303:      await this.enqueueChain(async () => {
    306:        const batch = this.buffered.splice(0)
    307:        try {
    308:          await this.persistContiguous(materializeAppendBatch(batch))
    309:        } catch (error: unknown) {
    310:          this.buffered = batch.concat(this.buffered)
    311:          this.drainPaused = true
    312:          throw error
    313:        }
    314:      })
    315:    }
    316:  }
    ...
    534:  install(ctx: Context): void {
    535:    ctx.on('session/event', (session: Session, event) => {
    536:      this.writers.get(session.id)?.enqueueLive(event, (error) => {
    537:        ctx.logger.warn(`session-persistence: background write for session "${session.id}" failed (buffered events retained): ${String(error)}`)
    538:      })
    539:    })

## 分析

1. **没有上限、没有背压。** 只要 drain 跟不上（磁盘/杀软慢、fsync 延迟、并发会话多，或 subagent 活动突发），`buffered` 就会随事件速率持续增长。
2. **每个事件都 `structuredClone`**，使每个被保留的事件占两份内存。
3. **一次 drain 失败就永久断掉自动重试。** 失败后置 `drainPaused = true`（:311），`enqueueLive` 在 :276 直接 return、不再装定时器；唯一剩下的重试是 `session/flush`（:540），实践中要等回合结束。于是这一回合剩下的时间里，缓冲就是一个无上限、不排空的队列——正是 :537 那句 "buffered events retained" 警告所描述的状态。
4. **回塞会复制整个缓冲区。** `batch.concat(this.buffered)` 会复制已缓冲的全部事件；重复重试会在"已保留"之上再叠加大量瞬时分配，这与现场二里 GB/min 级的尖峰和 3 核自旋吻合。
5. 团队 / subagent 任务只是**扳机**：它把 `session/event` 的速率放大，从而触发 1–4。

## 影响

* 严重级别：高。一次团队任务就能让 `dsh web` 服务端硬 OOM（现场一），或吃掉大部分系统内存并让整机抖动（现场二：14.7 GB、+18 GB/min，仅剩 18.5 GB 可用）。
* 内存暴涨期间磁盘持久化停滞，该会话在失控过程中没有可靠的落盘检查点。
* 并非团队功能独有：任何超过 live 写路径处理能力的 `session/event` 突发都可能触发。

discussions.title: [Windows] 沙箱化子进程启动失败并弹出 0xC0000142 气泡提示（无害，但持续造成误导）
discussions.body: ### 摘要 在 Windows 上，每当 DSH 执行命令类工具时，**经常**（非必现）弹出 Windows 对话框： ``` node.exe - 应用程序无法正常启动 (0x0000142)。请单击"确定"关闭应用程序。 ``` 点确定关闭后，**DSH 本体完全不受影响，可以继续正常使用**。这个对话框是纯噪音。 值得注意的是它**看起来像致命错误，实际不是**——它只是某个子进程没能启动。 ### 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | dsh 版本 | `0.1.7-rc.2`（通过 `dsh plugin` / `runtime\bundle` 安装） | | Node | `v24.21.0` | | Windows | `10.0.26200` | | 运行形态 | 桌面客户端（WebView2 宿主 + 内置 node 运行时） | | 沙箱模式 | `workspace-write` | | 触发时机 | DSH 执行命令类工具（pwsh / bash / 子进程）期间 | ### 复现 ``` 复现频率：经常出现，但不是每次必现 触发操作： 让DSH调整插件时，偶尔弹出警告弹窗 期望：静默失败或仅记录日志；实际：弹出系统级对话框 ``` ### 影响 - **无功能性影响**：子进程失败会被正常归类为命令失败，DSH 主进程不受影响，可继续使用 - **但是**：弹窗文案是"应用程序无法正常启动"，会让人误判为 DSH 即将崩溃或环境损坏 - 需要人工点击"确定"才能关掉，属于持续性的干扰 ### 已定位的代码路径（供参考） **1. Windows 上所有子进程都走 `launchWindowsJob`，且无条件带 `windowsHide: true`** `packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/lib/index.js`： ```js // 第 1368 行附近：Windows 走这条分支 handle = bindManagedProcess(spec, containmentMode === "linux-scope" ? launchLinuxScope(spec, env) : launchWindowsJob(spec, env)); // 第 588-604 行 function launchWindowsJob(spec, targetEnv, internals = {}) { const invocation = internals.runnerInvocation ?? spawnRunnerInvocation(); const [command, ...prefix] = invocation; ... child = (internals.spawn ?? spawn)(command, [...prefix, "--", ...spec.argv], { cwd: process.cwd(), windowsHide: true, // <-- 此处 env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation), stdio: runnerStdio(spec, true, ignoredStdinFd ?? "pipe") }); ``` `command` 来自 `spawnRunnerInvocation()`，即沙箱 runner 包装器（由 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 负责创建受限令牌）。 **2. 同一仓库的文档已把这条路径标记为会以 `0xC0000142` 死亡** `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.zh.md`： - 第 119 行（"已知限制"）： > **控制台隔离不可用。** 以 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` / `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` > 创建的子进程**在 DLL 初始化期间以 `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`（`0xC0000142`）死亡**； > 子进程共享宿主控制台，基于管道的 stdio 重定向不受影响。 - 第 94 行： > 保活组（登录 SID + Everyone）在两种模式下都存在：**没有它，早期 DLL 初始化会以 > `0xC0000142` 死亡**、CNG 会让 pwsh 以 `0xE0434352` 崩溃。 英文版 `README.md` 同位置亦有相同表述。 **3. libuv 对"隐藏窗口"提供的是三个独立标志，而非单一开关** `libuv/include/uv.h`： ```c UV_PROCESS_DETACHED = (1 << 3), /* 自成进程组 */ UV_PROCESS_WINDOWS_HIDE = (1 << 4), /* 隐藏子进程窗口 */ UV_PROCESS_WINDOWS_HIDE_CONSOLE = (1 << 5), /* 隐藏控制台窗口 */ UV_PROCESS_WINDOWS_HIDE_GUI = (1 << 6), /* 隐藏 GUI 窗口 */ ``` ### 我的疑问（可能的修复方向） 1. `launchWindowsJob` 里的 `windowsHide: true` 是否必要？如果沙箱 runner 本身 不需要隐藏窗口，去掉它是否能避免该路径？ 2. 如果确实需要隐藏，是否能改用 libuv 的 `UV_PROCESS_WINDOWS_HIDE_CONSOLE` / `_GUI`（对应 Node 的 `windowsHideConsole` / `windowsHideGUI`，若可用），而不是会触发 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 语义的通用 `windowsHide`？ 3. 文档说"控制台隔离不可用"，但代码仍在走这条路——**这是遗漏，还是 `windowsHide` 与 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 其实并不等价**？ **我无法确认的一点**：我没有在本地验证 Node 的 `windowsHide` 究竟映射为哪个 `UV_PROCESS_*` 组合（受测试环境限制，无法可靠地 spawn 进程验证），所以第 3 点 是我的推断，请以源码为准。 ### 补充说明 - 这个报错**不会写进 Windows 应用程序事件日志**（`0xC0000142` 是进程创建阶段失败， 近 30 天该日志中没有任何 `node.exe` 或 `c0000142` 记录），所以用户侧很难自查 - 我最初的怀疑对象是另一个程序（Rapoo 的 `A HUB.exe`，它确实有独立的 `Qt5Core.dll` 崩溃），已排除；Codex 沙箱服务也用受限账户拉起自己的 `cua_node\node.exe`，但机制不同，亦已排除

discussions.title: [Bug] typert-generator emits invalid z.intersection(z.string(), z.unknown()) breaking dsh with zod v4
discussions.body:
## Bug Description

**typert-generator** emits invalid `z.intersection(z.string(), z.unknown())` for TypeScript types like `string & unknown` (semantically just `string`). Under zod v4, this throws a runtime error because `z.intersection()` requires both arguments to be object schemas.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web --no-open` in a repo clone
2. The experimental speech-to-text plugin is loaded
3. Runtime throws: `TypeError: Cannot mix object and non-object schemas in intersection()`

## Root Cause

In `packages/typert/generator/src/emitter.ts` line 743, the intersection case generates:

```js
result = `z.intersection(${this.typeSchema(heritage, substitutions)}, ${result})`
```

When one side is `string` and the other is `unknown`, this produces `z.intersection(z.string(), z.unknown())`. Since `string & unknown = string` in TypeScript, the correct output should be `z.string()` only.

## Affected Artifacts

- `packages/experimental/api-speech-to-text/lib/typert.host.js` — **8 occurrences** of `z.intersection(z.string(), z.unknown())`
- Any other package using typert-generator that has `string & unknown` types will be similarly affected

## Suggested Fix

In the `intersection` case in `emitter.ts`, detect when one operand is `unknown` and the other is a primitive (string/number/boolean), and emit only the primitive schema. More generally: emit only the non-unknown side when one side is `unknown`.

## Environment

- dsh: current master
- zod: 4.4.3
- tsx/esm loader
- Node 26.0.0

discussions.title: Compaction aborts with "session surface changed during summarization" when a plugin appends events mid-summarization; the session then dies at "pi-ai detected context overflow" with no recovery path
discussions.body:
# Discussion draft — compaction aborts + overflow death (DRAFT v1, awaiting code anchors)

> Target: github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness Discussions (bug report category)
> Status: DRAFT — pending worker code anchors (file:line of guard, OV notice injection site, overflow detect site). Do not post before duty review + operator approval.

## Title
`Compaction aborts with "session surface changed during summarization" when a plugin appends events mid-summarization; the session then dies at "pi-ai detected context overflow" with no recovery path`

## Environment
- DeepSeek Harness: served tree 0.1.5-rc.2 (rev 4984b2a6) + dev 0.1.7-rc.2 (477b4f42); macOS 15 (arm), Node 22/24 era.
- Provider: `zai-coding-plan` / `glm-5.3-flash`, declared `contextWindow: 262144`, `maxTokens: 32768` (auto-compaction threshold 0.8 × window ≈ 210k).
- Session with heavy multimodal history (images), long-lived, active tool traffic.
- Local OpenViking memory integration active (`autoCommitOnCompact` — an OV boundary-commit notice is appended as a user/message event at compaction start; 66 such notices in this session).

## Observed behavior
1. Context crossed the auto-compaction threshold. Every compaction attempt then aborted:
   `compaction/end { ..., error: "compaction: session surface changed during summarization" }`
   Reproduced 9+ times across turns 44–45 (seqs 3178, 3188, 3196, 3204, 3212, 3220, 3238, ...).
2. In every aborted bracket, an OV boundary-commit notice event lands between `compaction/start` and `compaction/end` (pattern 1:1 on all failures). The summarization runs ~60–100 s while the session keeps appending events, so the surface-changed guard always trips.
3. Each step of an active turn therefore pays a failed-compaction tax (~60–100 s + an LLM summarize call) while the context never shrinks.
4. Endgame: `compaction/end { error: "pi-ai detected context overflow for model \"glm-5.3-flash\"" }` (seq 3244) → `turn/end { reason: { kind: "error" } }` (seq 3246). The session is now unrecoverable in place: every request overflows, including the summarize call that compaction itself needs.

## Same pattern in a second session (systemic, not session-specific)
A concurrently active worker session showed the identical `compaction/start` → OV notice → (abort) bracket at seq 1287–1288 while under moderate context load.

## Root cause (confirmed by code reading + log forensics)
Code reading locates two sides of the race:
- The compaction surface guard: `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:431-440` performs a deep-strict comparison of the session surface captured at `compaction/start` against the surface at commit time (a span-local comparison alternative exists at `region.ts:447-466`). ANY appended event between start and end disqualifies the compaction.
- The injecting side: our OpenViking memory integration appends its boundary-commit notice (a `user/message` event) at compaction start (`runtime.mjs:283`, append at `:285-288`) — commit-on-compaction-start is a documented integration point.
Together: an actively working session with plugin traffic always appends during the ~60–100 s summarization window, so the guard trips every time and the session converges to a state where compaction can never succeed. Additionally, `pi-ai`'s overflow detection (`stream.ts:76-96`) has no recovery hook — once prompt > window, every request fails, including the summarize call compaction itself needs, so the session cannot self-heal.

## Proposed directions (for discussion)
- a) Guard tolerance: exempt `ignorable: true` / checkpoint-class events from the deep-strict surface comparison in `region.ts`, or compare only the model-visible surface.
- b) Bounded retry: on surface change, retry summarization once against the refreshed surface before aborting.
- c) Overflow recovery ladder: at the `stream.ts` overflow detection point, run a forced shrink path (drop/summarize oldest tool results) or surface an actionable recovery hook instead of a dead turn — today there is no in-place recovery once prompt > window.
- d) Integration guidance: document that commit-on-compaction-start injectors must defer log appends until after `compaction/end` (we are shipping this on the plugin side ourselves).

## Evidence availability
Full session log (zstd, ~3.3 MB, append-only, untouched), seq-level event chain, and a reference implementation on our fork can be shared on request. Happy to provide additional traces.

*Posted by Almaz (almazom) — long-running DSH fleet operator.*

discussions.title: Bug: third-party connection.rpc.handle() fails plugin mount on 0.1.5+ (undeclared webServer read in Connection.register)
discussions.body:
### Package / line

`dsh-client-connection` (shipped inside `@deepseek-ai/dsh`)

### Summary

Any **third-party plugin** that calls `ctx.connection.rpc.handle(channel, handler, …)` fails its mount on DSH ≥ 0.1.5:

```
Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:656)
    at Proxy.register (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:656)
    at Object.handle (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:576)
    at registerAutomationRpc (@dsh-external/dsh-automation/lib/index.js:169)
```

On 0.1.5 this aborts the **entire plugin tree** (boot fails); on 0.1.7-rc the tree survives and the plugin is skipped with a warning. The failing property read is inside `dsh-client-connection` itself, not the calling plugin — so no plugin-side `inject` change can fix it.

### Cause

`dsh-client-connection` declares:

```js
// lib/index.js (0.1.7-rc.2, line ~798)
const inject = ["credentials"];
```

but `Connection.register` (line ~656) lazily reads `owner.webServer`:

```js
return owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route), `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`);
```

`owner` is captured in the `rpc` getter (`const owner = this.ctx` — the connection provider's ctx) and used on the *calling plugin's* registration path. Under the new inject enforcement this undeclared lazy read poisons every third-party `rpc.handle()` caller. Core surfaces are unaffected because they mount under fibers that already declare `webServer`.

### Proposed fix (one line, optional-inject form)

```diff
-const inject = ["credentials"];
+const inject = ["credentials", ["webServer"]];
```

The optional form keeps non-web profiles (headless / SDK, no `webServer` service) mounting.

### Verification — boot-verified repro, not a code-read claim

We verified repro and fix by booting real DSH cores against a copy of a production `web` profile inside a scratch `$DSH_HOME` (never live state):

| boot | core | plugin | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.1.7-rc.2 stock | `dsh-automation` v0.1.7 stock | serves, **plugin skipped** with the error above |
| 2 | 0.1.7-rc.2 + `webServer` added to the *plugin's* inject | stock | **unchanged** — plugin-side workaround is provably a no-op |
| 3 | 0.1.7-rc.2 + the one-line core diff above | `dsh-automation` v0.1.7 **unmodified** | **plugin mounts; warning gone** |

Background: we hit this class live during a `0.1.2-rc.1 → 0.1.5-rc.2` upgrade (2026-09-22), where the same error was still fatal and aborted boot; the install auto-rolled-back and has stayed on 0.1.2 because third-party RPC registration is broken on everything newer.

### Triage note

Our rig stages plugin closures with npm where production installs use pnpm; four other mount warnings we saw (a profile-root `dsh-settings` shadow, `image-offload.registerMessageProjection`, two typert-loader codec complaints) may be staging artifacts — they are *not* part of this report and may not reproduce for you.

Happy to re-test any release candidate against this repro before you ship, and to open a PR for the one-liner if you'd prefer.

> _Posting in General because this repo has Issues disabled — which also gates PRs, so a fix for this currently cannot be opened as a PR either. If enabling Issues/PRs (even with a template gate) is on the table, this particular bug is a decent argument for it: the failure is machine-reproducible, one line to fix, and currently forces downstream installs to stay on 0.1.2._

discussions.title: Webview becomes unreachable with HTTP 431 after several restarts: auth cookie name is derived from host:port, so cookies accumulate without bound
discussions.body:
### Summary

After the desktop app is restarted a number of times, all webview requests start failing with **HTTP 431 (Request Header Fields Too Large)** and the client gets stuck on the loading screen. Deleting the browser cookie store for the app immediately restores it — until the cookies accumulate again. We root-caused this: the auth cookie's **name** hashes the full request authority (`host:port`), while the embedded server's port changes on every launch, and browsers isolate cookies **by domain, not by port**. Each restart therefore mints a brand-new cookie name that can never be overwritten, and the `Cookie` header grows one entry per restart until it exceeds Node's default 16 KB header limit.

### Affected code

`packages/client/connection/src/browser-auth.ts` (verified unchanged at tag `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2`; the same logic ships in the npm builds of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection` 0.1.2-rc.1 → 0.1.5-rc.3):

```ts
// line 69: "Canonical request authority used as the cookie name and signed audience."
// line 106:
function cookieName(authority: string): string {
  return COOKIE_PREFIX + encodeBase64Url(createHash('sha256').update(authority).digest())
}
```

`authority` here is the full `host:port` (see `requestAuthority(req.headers)` at line 243), and the embedded server is started on an ephemeral port, so the derived cookie name changes on every launch.

### Failure chain

1. The local server listens on an ephemeral port each run (`--port 0` pattern in the desktop shell).
2. Cookie name = `dsh-auth-` + base64url(sha256(host:port)) → a **new name every restart**.
3. Browsers key the cookie jar by domain (RFC 6265 — cookies are not port-isolated), so old cookies are never overwritten, only appended.
4. Every request to the app origin carries the whole jar: N restarts → N `dsh-auth-*` cookies.
5. The `Cookie` request header crosses Node's default 16 KB `maxHeaderSize` → the webview's bundle/resource requests return **431**.
6. The frontend treats non-200 as load failure → boot/plugin loading stalls with no visible error.

### Evidence

Observed on DSH Desktop (macOS, embedded dsh 0.1.2-rc.1, later 0.1.5-rc.3) after daily restarts across multiple days:

- With `--remote-debugging-port` attached, the failing request was the webview bundle with **HTTP 431**; other origins were fine.
- The app's cookie store had grown to **~56 KB** (dozens of `dsh-auth-*` entries, one per past port).
- Deleting the cookie store restored boot immediately (jar back to ~20 KB); it re-accumulated at ~1 cookie per restart until the next 431.

Reproduce: launch the app repeatedly and watch one `dsh-auth-<sha256(host:port)>` cookie get added per distinct port in devtools → Application → Cookies, until requests start returning 431.

### Suggested fix

Keep the cookie name stable by hashing the **hostname only**, and keep the token's signed audience bound to the full authority (unchanged): when the port changes, old tokens simply fail validation → 401 → the server re-issues a fresh cookie **under the same name**, so the jar self-overwrites and stays bounded. The existing launch-token flow (`tokenMatches` / `launchToken`) already provides exactly this re-issuance path, so the fix composes with the current auth design and does not weaken it.

```ts
function cookieName(authority: string): string {
  let host = authority
  try { host = new URL(`http://${authority}`).hostname } catch {}
  return COOKIE_PREFIX + encodeBase64Url(createHash('sha256').update(host).digest())
}
```

This patch has been running in our local production builds since 2026-09-11 across 40+ restarts: no 431 recurrence, and token invalidation on port change behaves exactly as before (verified for bare-host / host:port / IPv6 authority forms). As defense-in-depth one could additionally prune expired `dsh-auth-*` cookies at boot or raise the server's `maxHeaderSize`, but the name fix alone closes the loop.

Happy to provide more details (CDP captures, cookie-store dumps) if useful.

---

### 中文附言（可选，加在帖尾）

相同问题：桌面版每次重启端口变化，而鉴权 cookie 名对 `host:port` 整体做哈希、浏览器 cookie 又按域不按端口隔离——于是旧 cookie 永不被覆盖，累积到 Cookie 头超过 16KB 后 webview 全部 431 卡死；清 cookie 立即恢复。建议 cookie 名只哈希 hostname，令牌签名仍绑完整 authority（端口变化→旧令牌 401→同名重发），已在本机 16 天生产验证。补丁与证据如英文正文。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-config-manager | 换电脑 / 多机同步：把整套配置（插件、MCP、技能、工作区、会话）打包搬走
discussions.body:
## 一、这个插件解决什么问题

DSH 的环境不是「配」出来的，是「长」出来的：settings、Provider、插件（含 `link:` / `file:` 安装的本地开发插件）、MCP、技能、Agent 预设、工作区与 AGENTS.md，外加历史会话。

于是这几个场景都很痛：

- **换电脑 / 重装系统**：手工搬一定会漏，而且搬过去之后一堆绝对路径失效；
- **家里一台 + 公司一台**：两边越用越不像，也说不清哪边是「对的」；
- **想把一套调好的配置分享给别人**：只能截图加口述。

DSH 本身没有内置的备份 / 迁移通道，这个插件就是补这一块。

## 二、它能做什么

- **一键导出** 成一个 ZIP，分区可选（设置 / Provider / 插件 / MCP / 技能 / Agent 预设 / 工作区 …，历史会话是显式可选分区）；
- **导入前 dry-run 预览**：先看清楚「会改什么」，冲突逐项决策（保留本机 / 用包里的），失败自动回滚；
- **跨机路径自动重定基**：把「源机 `$DSH_HOME` → 本机 `$DSH_HOME`」自动套到结构化分区的绝对路径与会话日志首帧 cwd 上，也可以在预览里手工补映射；
- **可选「导出密钥」**：勾选后 `.credentials.yaml` 以 scrypt + AES-256-GCM 密文随快照走；**默认永不导出任何密钥值**；
- **Git / WebDAV 跨机同步**：双通道各自排期，远端只看到密文（勾了加密的话）；
- **配置市场**：浏览 / 一键安装社区共享的配置包，供应链警示恒展示，逐分区显式批准才写盘；
- **DSH 起不来时的救援 CLI**：备份、恢复、会话修复在没有 UI 的情况下也能用；
- **档案（profile）独立实例启停**：DSH 没有「下次启动用哪个 profile」这种状态，切换只能另起独立实例（`dsh --profile <名> --port <空闲端口>`）或改启动命令，插件把前者做成了按钮，并能抓取该实例带 token 的认证 URL。

## 三、安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-config-manager@latest
```

装完**重启 DSH**，设置页会出现「备份与迁移」入口。

⚠️ 一个容易踩的坑，顺便提醒所有在 DSH 里发插件的作者：pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge`（供应链发布年龄策略）会让 `@latest` 只解析到「够老」的版本，**刚发布的新版装不上**。这个门槛是按版本判定的——装一次精确版本只解决当时那一个版本，作者下次发版又会装到旧版。永久解决是把它排除掉：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-config-manager
```

## 四、安全上的取舍（先说清楚）

- 默认**不导出任何密钥值**；凭据不可回读，只能在导入时由你补录，或由加密快照携带；
- 「导出密钥」是独立的密文凭据载荷，**非加密快照不得声明含密钥**；
- 插件的 HTTP API 只监听回环地址 + 同源围栏——注意这**不是** DSH 的 cookie 认证，所以只适合单机自用，不要把它放到共享机器或反向代理后面；
- 导入前强制快照，失败自动回滚。

## 五、已知限制

- 插件安装 / 升级后要**重启 DSH** 才生效；
- MCP 没有管理 API，市场导入只能走「组合 patch 行」的方式；
- 历史会话默认不迁移（显式可选分区，推送与拉取两侧都要显式放行）；
- 加密备份的密码丢了就解不开，没有找回通道。

## 六、验证方式

- 仓库自带 `node --test` 回归：**2608 个用例通过**，覆盖导出 → 分析 → 执行 → 回滚、ZIP 攻击面（条目数炸弹 / checksum 篡改 / Zip Slip）、日志脱敏、凭据往返；
- 用隔离的 `$DSH_HOME` + `dsh --profile cmtest --port 3099` 做真机导入 / 同步验证，不碰本机真实配置；
- MIT，Windows / macOS / Linux 都跑。

## 七、链接

- 仓库：https://github.com/xiajiajun516/dsh-config-manager
- README 中英双语；`docs/spec/` 里有导出包格式规格与同步通道规格，写第三方导入器可以不读源码；
- 反馈走 Issue，Bug / 功能模板中英各一套。

如果你在**备份 / 换机 / 多机同步**上遇到具体问题——某个分区没被带走、导入后会话看不见、WebDAV 服务端不兼容、路径映射没生效之类——欢迎在这条下面留言，我会尽量逐个回。

discussions.title: Feature request: a second pane for chat.deepseek.com
discussions.body:
Hi,

I'm a regular user of [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com/). I love the model, but the single conversation thread becomes unreadable fast: code, notes, summaries, and history all pile up in the same flow.

Suggestion: add a second pane — a persistent, collapsible text block next to the conversation. Just text, no filesystem, no API. Blocks can be expanded or collapsed. Both the model and the user can edit it.

With only that, you can simulate files, notes, summaries, versions, and history — all organized, all outside the main thread. The conversation stays short and human.

Optional: text color, font size, detachable tab for dual-screen users, export.

It's a simple feature. But it would change everything for non-developer users like me.

Thanks.

discussions.title: Notion in DSH: sign in from the GUI with OAuth (no integration token)
discussions.body:
Notion for DSH through the **official Notion MCP**, with an **OAuth 2.0 + PKCE** sign-in that happens entirely in the app. No integration to create, no token to copy, no terminal.

![The Notion consent page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MerkurevSergei/dsh-notion-oauth-ui/main/assets/setup-5.png)

## What you get

- **GUI sign-in** — a **Notion** page under Settings with one **Login** button. The browser handles the rest and the page flips to **Connected**.
- **No Integration Token** — dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) with PKCE, so there is nothing to paste from Notion.
- **Official Notion MCP** — pages, databases, comments and search arrive as the usual `mcp__notion__*` tools.
- **Silent refresh** — the access token renews itself before expiry; a failed attempt retries every minute.
- **CLI fallback** — `dsh notion login | logout | status` for headless profiles.

![Connected](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MerkurevSergei/dsh-notion-oauth-ui/main/assets/setup-6.png)

## Install

**Plugins → Add plugin →** `dsh-notion-oauth-ui`, or from the terminal:

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-notion-oauth-ui
```

Then **Settings → Notion → Login**.

## Links

- Repository and step-by-step setup guide with screenshots: https://github.com/MerkurevSergei/dsh-notion-oauth-ui#setup
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notion-oauth-ui

## Why another Notion plugin

There are already a couple of Notion plugins in the curated list. The closest one connects through the same official MCP with OAuth, but ships no client half — signing in means leaving the app for the terminal or editing config by hand. This one is the same connection with an actual settings page: Login, live status, Logout.

Released from GitHub Actions through npm Trusted Publishing — OIDC, provenance-signed, no long-lived npm token.

Feedback, bug reports and pull requests are welcome.

discussions.title: 快捷键体验优化建议
discussions.body:
* 鼠标用多了, 点来点去, 手腕会难受. 希望可以尽可能减少鼠标的使用.

discussions.title: macOS: Voice input cannot reach the microphone — app ships without com.apple.security.device.audio-input
discussions.body:
**Summary**

On macOS the Voice input bundle can never obtain microphone access. Clicking the microphone in the composer shows *"Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings."* No macOS permission prompt is ever presented, and enabling the toggle in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone does not help. The packaged app and both helpers are signed with the **hardened runtime** but do **not** carry the `com.apple.security.device.audio-input` entitlement, which macOS requires for microphone access under that runtime.

**Environment**

- DeepSeek Harness (Desktop) **0.1.7-rc.2** (`0.1.7-rc.2.20260924.1`)
- macOS **27.2** (build `26B5091g`), Apple Silicon (arm64)
- Voice input bundle 0.1.7-rc.2 (Experimental)

The bundle itself reports healthy: all **4 components "Running"**, and *"Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer."* with `SenseVoiceSmall (INT8)` selected.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Plugins → enable **Voice input**.
2. Confirm it reports ready (4/4 components running, local resources prepared).
3. Click the microphone between the model selector and Send.

**Expected:** the recording toolbar opens (prompting for microphone permission on first use if needed).

**Actual:** *"Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings."* No system permission dialog is ever shown, and no System Settings change grants access.

**Evidence**

The app runs with the hardened runtime:

```
$ codesign -dv --verbose=2 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app"
CodeDirectory v=20500 size=444 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=3+7 location=embedded
```

Its entitlements contain no audio input:

```
$ codesign -d --entitlements - "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app"
[Dict]
    com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit
    com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory
    com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation
    (no com.apple.security.device.audio-input)
```

The same holds for both helper bundles:

```
Contents/Frameworks/DeepSeek Harness Helper (Renderer).app   -> audio-input: absent
Contents/Frameworks/DeepSeek Harness Helper.app              -> audio-input: absent
```

`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` **is** present in `Info.plist`:

> "DeepSeek Harness uses your microphone to transcribe speech into message drafts."

So microphone support was clearly intended — the entitlement is the missing half.

**Why this is the cause**

Under the hardened runtime, macOS requires `com.apple.security.device.audio-input` before a process may use the microphone. Without it the request can never succeed: no TCC prompt appears, and no user-side setting can grant access. This also explains the misleading UI copy, which sends users to a setting that cannot fix the problem.

**Suggested fix**

Add `com.apple.security.device.audio-input` to the entitlements used when signing the main app and the Renderer/Helper bundles, then re-sign and re-notarize.

**Workaround**

macOS Dictation (System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation) works in the composer and does not depend on the app.

**中文摘要**

macOS 上「語音輸入」外掛無法取得麥克風權限。按下麥克風只顯示 *"Microphone access is disabled"*，系統從未彈出權限詢問，在系統設定中開啟亦無效。原因：app 以 **hardened runtime** 簽署，但主程式與兩個 Helper **都未包含** `com.apple.security.device.audio-input`。`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` 已存在，應為漏加 entitlement。建議補上後重新簽署與公證。

discussions.title: compaction-basic: default `headroomTokens` (65536) is an absolute value and crushes the compaction trigger on small context windows
discussions.body:
## Summary

In 0.1.7 the compaction trigger in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` became a two-term minimum:

```js
// 0.1.5-rc.3 — ratio only
function resolveCompactSpec(policy, contextWindow) {
  const thresholdTokens = Math.floor(contextWindow * policy.thresholdRatio);
}

// 0.1.7-alpha.2 — adds an absolute 65536 headroom term
const headroomTokens = config.headroomTokens ?? 65536;              // :63
function resolveCompactSpec(policy, contextWindow, reservedCompletionTokens) {   // :124
  const messageBudgetTokens  = contextWindow - reservedCompletionTokens;
  const pressureBudgetTokens = messageBudgetTokens - policy.headroomTokens;      // :130
  const thresholdTokens = Math.floor(Math.min(
    contextWindow * policy.thresholdRatio,
    pressureBudgetTokens));                                                      // :132
}
```

`headroomTokens` defaults to **65536 and is an absolute number that does not scale with the
window**. That default is harmless for a 1M-token cloud route but very costly for a local
route: the second term wins, so `thresholdRatio: 0.8` stops having any effect at all.

## Environment

- DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2`, Windows + WSL2, npm-global install
- Local route: `contextWindow: 150000`, request `maxTokens: 32000` (reserved completion)
- Other local route: `contextWindow: 126976`, request `maxTokens: 32000`

## Impact

| Scenario | Window W | Reserve O | 0.1.5 trigger | 0.1.7 stock trigger | % of window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cloud (official) | 1,000,000 | 256,000 | 800,000 | 678,464 | 67.8% |
| Local, 256K window | 262,144 | 16,384 | 209,715 | 180,224 | 68.8% |
| **Local, 150K window** | **150,000** | **32,000** | 120,000 | **52,464** | **35.0%** |
| **Local, 128K window** | **126,976** | **32,000** | 101,580 | **29,440** | **23.2%** |
| Small window | 40,960 | 8,192 | 32,768 | *no pressure trigger at all* | — |

Once the harness's own fixed overhead is counted (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` folds the
tool schemas into the measurement — ~18K tokens with a plugin-heavy tool set here), a 150K
route leaves only **~34K tokens of actual conversation** before compaction fires. The same
65536 costs a 1M route only ~6.6 percentage points.

At 40K the pressure budget goes negative, `resolveCompactSpec` throws
`TargetPressureConfigError`, the `agent/pre-step` listener catches it and warns once — so
there is no pressure trigger on that route at all, which is the opposite failure mode.

## Measured evidence (session logs)

Decoding `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` (one zstd frame per append) and counting
`compaction/*` against `step/*`:

| `compaction/start` | `compaction/prune` | `step/start` | Route |
|---|---|---|---|
| **32** | 8 | **49** | local 150K route |
| 17 | 19 | 643 | local 128K route |
| 5 | 12 | 223 | mixed |

One 49-step session compacted 32 times — roughly once every 1.5 steps.

## Secondary effect: the pruner then throws away what was just read

Every `compaction/prune` event in those runs has `shadowedRange.start == end`, i.e. a single
event is pruned, and `shadowedTokenCount` for them is 2,246–10,145 tokens (whole-file reads).
Because `compactIfNeeded` prunes **before** it re-measures, an entry can lose its freshly read
content without producing a summary:

```js
if (measurement.totalTokens < spec.thresholdTokens) return null;  // below: no prune
if (prune !== void 0) { prune.pruneSession(agent.session); … }     // above: prune first
if (measurement.totalTokens < spec.thresholdTokens) return null;  // now below: no summary, content is gone
```

That produced a self-sustaining "read file → get pruned → read the same file again" loop
(same file read 20+ times in one session).

## Suggested fix

Any one of these would address it:

1. **Scale the headroom with the window** — e.g. `Math.min(65536, Math.floor(contextWindow * 0.1))`,
   or make the second term `messageBudgetTokens * (1 - thresholdRatio)` so the ratio term keeps
   meaning. (This is what we ended up configuring locally: `headroomTokens: 8192`, which puts a
   150K route back at `min(120000, 150000-32000-8192) = 109,808` ≈ 73%.)
2. **Default `headroomTokens` to 0** and let `thresholdRatio` be the only knob, documenting the
   absolute-headroom option for users who want it.
3. If the intent is "leave room for the summary request", derive it from the summary model's own
   `maxTokens` rather than a fixed 65536.

Also worth documenting on the `compaction-basic` reference page: the trigger is
`min(W × ratio, W − reserved − headroom)`, the fixed tool-schema overhead is counted, and on a
128K route the usable conversation budget is roughly `W − reserved − headroom − tools`.

## Workaround

Through 0.1.7 the value has to be set in the **preset** that defines the live composition
(`dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml`, `ptc.patch.yml`, `cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: compaction-basic
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
  config:
    headroomTokens: 8192
    maxTokens: 8192      # must be explicit: its default is taken from headroomTokens
```

Note that a profile `cordis.patch.yml` override targeting `- id: compaction-basic` **has no
effect** — the dsh-base top-level row is `disabled: true` under a preset, so the override lands
on the disabled row while the preset's own copy stays at the default. Worth a note in the
preset/profile patch documentation.

discussions.title: [Install] Direct SheetJS CDN dependency blocks pnpm install and build when the CDN is unreachable
discussions.body:
## Summary

The current repository depends on `xlsx@0.20.3` through the direct tarball URL:

`https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz`

When this CDN is unreachable, a fresh install or an update cannot complete. This also causes `pnpm run clean` and `pnpm run build` to fail indirectly.

## Reproduction

1. Clone the repository or pull the latest changes.
2. Run `pnpm install`.
3. Run `pnpm run clean` or `pnpm run build`.

## Current behavior

`pnpm install` retries the SheetJS URL and then fails:

```text
GET https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz error (ETIMEDOUT)
[ERROR] fetch failed
```

In my environment, most packages were reused successfully, but the direct SheetJS tarball could not be downloaded. The configured npm mirror was reachable, but changing the registry did not help because this dependency is a direct URL rather than a registry package.

## Expected behavior

A clean checkout should have a documented and reliable installation path when the SheetJS CDN is unavailable, especially after pulling repository updates.

Possible approaches include:

- publishing or mirroring the exact `xlsx@0.20.3` artifact through a supported package registry;
- providing a documented, checksum-verified fallback source;
- supporting an offline/cache-based installation workflow;
- making the build error identify the unavailable external artifact clearly;
- adding an install/CI check for this external dependency.

I temporarily switched the dependency to `xlsx@0.18.5` locally and the build completed, but I do not recommend silently downgrading without compatibility tests because Excel parsing behavior may differ.

## Environment

- OS: Windows
- Node.js: `v24.19.0`
- pnpm: `11.7.0`
- Registry: `https://registry.npmmirror.com/`
- Failure date: 2026-09-24

The repository's current `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` still point to the direct SheetJS CDN tarball.

discussions.title: dsh-wait-guard — a completion gate so an agent cannot answer before its subagents settle
discussions.body:
**TL;DR** — `dsh-wait-guard` keeps a delegating agent's turn open while any descendant subagent is still running. Host-only bundle: one `agent/turn-stopping` listener, no tools, no writes, no state.

### The problem

Nothing in the default composition stops an agent from ending its turn before its subagents report. I went looking for a listener on `agent/turn-stopping` that checks for running children and found none — the only "must wait for teammates" wording ships inside the experimental Agent Teams bundle, as a prompt sentence rather than enforcement. In practice the model answers with 0 of N results and the settlement notices arrive afterwards as separate turns.

### How it works

The gate hooks `agent/turn-stopping` — the serial event the loop *awaits* immediately before it re-reads the inbox and decides whether to close the turn (`dsh-agent-loop`) — and simply does not return while any descendant is `running`. Since the dispatch is awaited and its return value is discarded, the only lever available to a listener is the inbox: holding the event postpones the decision, and anything injected keeps the turn alive for one more step. Descendants are probed across the whole tree and filtered by the Agent registry's real `status`, so an intermediate agent that is idle between turns still holds the gate while its own children run.

### Deactivation — two paths, both ending with the plugin out of the way

| Path | Trigger | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| a message arrived | settlement notice · child relay · human message | stops waiting, injects **nothing** — that step belongs entirely to the model |
| the silence timer elapsed | `firstWaitMs` (default 60 s) of silence within one stop attempt | injects exactly **one** reminder, then leaves |

Deactivation is always temporary: the next time the model tries to close the turn, the gate re-engages immediately. The plugin never rewrites the recorded `turn/end` reason — it only postpones the decision.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:dn4hjtcr9s-del/dsh-wait-guard#v0.1.0
```

### Measured, not asserted

- **22** functional tests + **7** bundle-shape checks (`npm test`).
- Bundle install verified in an isolated profile (`DSH_HOME=/tmp/...`): the composed tree contains `id: wait-guard` / `name: dsh-wait-guard`.
- Live on a real profile: a deliberately premature answer was held **11–61 seconds** until the last subagent settled, with `turn/end` count **0** and injected messages **0**.
- Control run with the plugin unmounted: the same gesture closed the turn **2 seconds** later while a child was still running, and that child's notice only arrived as a later turn.

### Limits (deliberate)

The model can still emit intermediate prose — the gate governs the turn, not speech. It does not block `interrupt_agent`; that is the model's own judgement. A subagent that never settles means the agent waits (the timer notice gives the model a chance to interrupt it). Non-continuable one-shot subagents never send settlement notices and are invisible to it.

Repo: https://github.com/dn4hjtcr9s-del/dsh-wait-guard · MIT

<details><summary>中文摘要</summary>

纯 Host 插件，挂在 `agent/turn-stopping` 上：只要后代子代理还有 `running`，主 Agent 的 turn 就不允许结束。失效只有两条路径 —— **消息到达**（立刻完全退场，一个字都不注入）或 **时间到**（注入恰好一条提醒后同样退场）；失效总是临时的，模型下次想收尾时闸门立刻重新生效。`turn/end` 的理由从不被篡改，只会被推迟。测试 22+7 全绿；实测「提前结论」被扣 11–61 秒、`turn/end` 全程为 0；对照实验（卸载插件）下同样的动作 2 秒后就收尾了。

</details>

discussions.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation: published lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts imports @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client, but that package is only a devDependency — type resolution breaks for downstream consumers
discussions.body:
# Defect A — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`: published type declarations import a devDependency-only package (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client`), breaking type resolution for downstream consumers

> **Reported: 2026-09-28** by a downstream consumer team.
> Prepared 2026-09-27 by documenter (zDSH campaign `2026-09-27-upgrade-process-v2`, task card DOC-UPSTREAM).
> Evidence base: `D4-pin-ledger.md` §4 F4 (executed by coder, independently confirmed by REVIEW-D4) + documenter read-only re-verification on 2026-09-27 against the installed package. Items not re-run locally are marked **[evidence from D4 ledger, not re-run]**.

## Title (issue/discussion-ready)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`: published `lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts` imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client`, but that package is only a devDependency — type resolution breaks for downstream consumers

## Version affected

- **Verified:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation@0.1.5-rc.2` (npm registry tarball, as installed in a pnpm workspace on Windows / Node 24).
- **First observed:** the 0.1.3 generation, 2026-09-07 (our internal verification record, see Evidence #5). The defect has persisted unchanged through 0.1.5-rc.2.

## Summary

The published build output of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` contains a type-only import of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client` in `lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts` (line 5). However, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload` is declared **only in `devDependencies`** of the package manifest — not in `dependencies`, not in `peerDependencies`, not in `optionalDependencies`. devDependencies are not installed transitively for consumers, so any downstream package that installs `dsh-client-ui-conversation` from the registry and type-checks the declaration files (i.e. with `skipLibCheck: false`, or any tooling that resolves `.d.ts` graphs strictly) gets an unresolvable module `TS2307: Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client'`.

With the common default `skipLibCheck: true`, the error is silently suppressed — which is why the defect can go unnoticed until a consumer tightens compiler settings or a bundler/type aggregator walks the full `.d.ts` graph.

## Reproduction

Minimal bare-consumer repro (npm, clean directory):

```bash
mkdir repro-a && cd repro-a
npm init -y
npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation@0.1.5-rc.2
# install declared peers so that file-upload is the ONLY unresolvable module:
npm install @deepseek-ai/cordis@^4.0.2 react@^18.3.1 @types/react@^18
npm install --save-dev typescript

cat > index.ts <<'EOF'
import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client';
EOF

npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck false index.ts
# Expected failure:
#   node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts:5:xx
#   error TS2307: Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client'
#   or its corresponding type declarations.
```

Resolution-level check (same root cause):

```bash
node -e "require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client', { paths: [require('path').dirname(require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/package.json'))] })"
# → Error [MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client'
```

> **Honesty note:** the bare-install steps above were **not re-run** by documenter on 2026-09-27 (our local workspace now masks the defect — see "Why it can look intermittent" below). The failure behavior is **[evidence from D4 ledger, not re-run]**: `require.resolve` → `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` was observed in the WebStack workspace **before** the workaround pin was added (D4-pin-ledger §4 F4). The TS2307-with-`skipLibCheck:false` exposure mode is recorded in our 2026-09-07 verification (Evidence #5: "默认 skipLibCheck:true 下被抑制，关断即暴露 TS2307"). All **static** facts (manifest fields, slots.d.ts line 5) were re-verified first-hand read-only on 2026-09-27.

## Evidence

All quotes below were re-verified first-hand (read-only) by documenter on 2026-09-27 against the installed `0.1.5-rc.2` package, unless marked otherwise.

1. **Manifest — runtime dependencies do NOT include file-upload** (`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/package.json`, version `0.1.5-rc.2`):
   - `"dependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "^3.18.2" }` — this is the *only* runtime dependency.
   - `"devDependencies"` contains `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload": "^0.1.5-rc.2"` — devDeps only; **not installed for consumers**.
   - `"peerDependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.0.2" }` — file-upload is not declared as a peer either.

2. **Published declaration imports the missing package** — `lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts`, line 5 (verbatim):

   ```ts
   import type { FileUploadReceiptId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client';
   ```

   This file is reachable from the package's public exports map: `"./client": { "types": "./lib/types/client/index.d.ts", ... }`.

3. **Dynamic failure [evidence from D4 ledger, not re-run]** — `D4-pin-ledger.md` §4 F4 (campaign `2026-09-27-upgrade-process-v2`): "manifest 实测 dependencies ABSENT；require.resolve MODULE_NOT_FOUND". Independently confirmed by REVIEW-D4.

4. **Committed downstream determination** — WebStack repo `packages/webstack/docs/CALIBRATION.md` §6 item 3 (committed): "ui-conversation@0.1.5-rc.2 `lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts:5` 仍 import `dsh-client-file-upload/client`，而该包仍只在其 devDependencies（dependencies ABSENT，manifest 实测）→ 上游打包缺陷在 0.1.5 世代仍在。"

5. **Known since the 0.1.3 generation (2026-09-07)** — same file, §5 ("file-upload 链判定"): "该包只列在 ui-conversation 的 **devDependencies**（dependencies 中无）→ registry 消费者永远装不到 = **上游打包缺陷，非插件问题** … 缺陷由 manifest 事实证成"; and §5 future-switch note item 3: "webstack devDeps 须补钉 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload` … 默认 skipLibCheck:true 下被抑制，关断即暴露 TS2307". Also recorded in campaign `2026-09-07-plugins-0131-adaptation` PLAN.md ("即使发布 registry 消费者也永远装不到——等不来解药") and tasks/R4-filehub.md ("那是上游打包缺陷非插件问题").

6. **Why it can look intermittent (observed 2026-09-27):** after our workspace added the workaround pin (below), `require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload/client', { paths: [<real .pnpm dir of ui-conversation>] })` now **succeeds** — because pnpm's default hoisting places the package into the hidden hoisted store `node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules/`, which Node's upward resolution can reach from inside the virtual store. This masking is an artifact of *our* workspace having installed file-upload elsewhere in the dependency graph; a bare consumer (or a strict resolver / `node-modules` linker without matching hoists) still fails.

## Expected vs Actual

- **Expected:** every module referenced by published `.d.ts` files is declared in `dependencies` (or `peerDependencies` / `optionalDependencies`), so consumers installing the package from the registry can resolve the full type graph.
- **Actual:** the referenced package `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload` is a devDependency only; it is not installed transitively, and the published type graph is unresolvable for registry consumers (visible as TS2307 whenever `skipLibCheck` is off, or as MODULE_NOT_FOUND in resolution probes).

## Suggested fix

Pick one (option 1 is the minimal change):

1. Move `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload": "^0.1.5-rc.2"` from `devDependencies` to `dependencies` in the published manifest.
2. Or declare it in `peerDependencies` (if a single shared instance is required by design) — note this shifts install burden to every consumer and should be documented.
3. Or remove the cross-package type import from the published declarations (inline `FileUploadReceiptId`, or re-export it through an already-declared dependency).

Process suggestion: add a publish-time CI gate that type-checks the **published** `.d.ts` graph with `skipLibCheck: false` inside a clean install of the tarball's **production** dependencies only. This class of defect (devDep leaking into shipped types) is invisible to in-repo builds because the monorepo workspace always has the devDep linked.

## Workaround (what we do downstream, verified green)

Pin the hidden dependency in the consumer's own `devDependencies`:

- Our WebStack repo: `packages/webstack/package.json:158` → `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload": "0.1.5-rc.2"` (exact pin, matching the ui-conversation generation).

Post-pin gate results (D4-pin-ledger §6, real runs): `pnpm install` EXIT=0, `pnpm run typecheck` EXIT=0, `pnpm run test` EXIT=0 (928 tests), `pnpm run build` EXIT=0, `pnpm run lint` EXIT=0.

Caveat: this workaround requires every consumer to *know* about the undeclared dependency; it does not fix the package for anyone else.

discussions.body:
## 数据资产体检仪·全领域插件矩阵

> **24个DSH插件** | **403个测试全部通过** | 覆盖数据资产全生命周期 | 每个报告含政策依据可审计

### 场景说明

基于 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的全领域数据资产管理插件矩阵，覆盖"脱敏→清洗→盘点→质量→估值→合规→登记→政务→AI→流通"完整业务链路。每个插件嵌入政策依据引用，确保"有理有据、可审计、可追溯"。

### 全部24个插件

#### v1.0 核心处理模块（6个）

| 插件 | 包名 | 功能 |
|------|------|------|

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-pocket-console | 拒绝阻塞，在手机上推进任务：桌面先答，超时才发飞书卡片
discussions.body:
> 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。

**dsh-pocket-console** 把 DSH 无人值守时容易阻塞任务的环节——审批、提问——发到手机上的飞书卡片处理，并能继续下一轮与开启新会话。桌面先答，桌面没动静才发卡。只维持一条出站长连接，不需要公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。

| | |
|---|---|
| 仓库 | https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console |
| 安装 | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pocket-console` |
| 版本 | `1.0.0`（MIT，npm 发布带 provenance 签名，已收录 awesome-dsh-plugin） |

### 为什么会做它

回家前交给 dsh 一个任务，期待第二天验收。第二天一回来发现卡在提问环节，让人抓狂。

### 它做什么

- **审批。** 工具调用以卡片送达；批准只对本次调用生效（`allowed-once`），不累积权限。
- **提问。** `ask_user_question` 整组铺开，带进度、多选、选项旁的自由输入，一次提交全部答案，而不是一个问题等一次。
- **引用卡片回话。** 引用结果卡回一句就是下一步；引用审批卡回「允许」或「拒绝」；引用提问卡直接写答案。
- **结果可回复。** 开 `resultNotify: idle`，一轮结束的结果发到手机并附输入框，你写的内容作为你自己的消息接着这个会话跑。
- **下一段任务从手机开。** 结果卡上带一个表单，在同一个工作区里开新会话。
- **执行过程可见。** 手机持有时，状态、回合、步骤和正在等的工具都在一张原地更新的卡上，编辑不重发、不响。

### 设计取舍

- **桌面优先，手机是兜底。** 请求先给桌面 GUI；`delaySeconds` 内没人答才发卡，`0` 表示立即。你在手机上答完，开着的页面会自己结算，不会出现「手机上批了、桌面还在等」。
- **手机拿到的是一次决定，不是机器。** 工作区、会话、设置和凭据都留在原处。卡片本身就是凭证，只有绑定的接收人能按；私聊只绑定尚未绑定的部署，群消息永不绑定。
- **只出站。** 投递走飞书长连接，没有入站端口、隧道或中继；凭据放凭据库，不进进程环境变量。一键扫码只申请 3 个 scope、1 个事件、1 个回调。
- **不改 DSH。** 作为 `dsh.bundle` profile 层插件注册在两条有文档的 answerer waterfall 上（`prepend: true`，先 `next()` 再起计时），没有 patch 或 fork 任何代码；通道契约是文档化的，换传输是新增一个文件。
- **投递是可重试的。** 同一幂等键下重试至多 4 次，平台已收下的卡不会发第二遍；长连接带存活探测，应用被吊销会主动报告。

和整机遥控类插件（[dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket)、[ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote)）方向不同：那些把整个 GUI 搬走，需要隧道或中继；这个只送出决定和对话的下一步。

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant D as DSH harness
  participant P as dsh-pocket-console
  participant W as 桌面 GUI
  participant F as 飞书 → 手机
  D->>P: approval/request (prepend: true)
  P->>D: next() — 后面的链照常跑
  D->>W: 弹窗打开并等待
  P->>P: 起计时 delaySeconds（默认 120 秒）
  Note over P,F: 计时到了
  P->>F: 投递卡片
  F-->>P: 接收人点「批准一次」
  P->>D: 结算 allowed-once
  Note over W: 页面自己结算
```

### 链接

- 仓库与 Issues：https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console
- npm：`dsh-pocket-console` · 文档：[README](https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console)（中英双语）、[配置参考](https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/configuration.md)、[故障排查](https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/troubleshooting.md)

有 bug、有想法欢迎开 issue。



---

### English

> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.

**dsh-pocket-console** takes the points that tend to stall an unattended DSH run — approvals and questions — and handles them on your phone as Feishu cards; it can also reply to a result and start a new session. The desktop answers first, and a card only goes out when the desk stays quiet. One outbound long connection is all it holds: no public IP, domain, or tunnel.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repo | https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console |
| Install | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pocket-console` |
| Version | `1.0.0` (MIT, published with a provenance attestation, listed in awesome-dsh-plugin) |

#### Why it exists

You hand dsh a task before heading home, expecting to check the result the next day. You come back and find it stuck on a question. That is maddening.

#### What it does

- **Approvals.** A tool call arrives as a card; a tap approves that call only (`allowed-once`), so no authority accumulates.
- **Questions.** `ask_user_question` is laid out whole — progress, multi-select, free text beside the options — and answered in one submission, rather than three questions meaning three waits.
- **Answering by quoting the card.** Quote the result card with a line and that is the next step; quote an approval card with allow or reject; quote a question card and write the answer.
- **Results you can reply to.** With `resultNotify: idle`, a finished turn's result arrives with a reply box, and what you write continues that session as your own message.
- **The next task, from the phone.** The result card carries a form that opens a new session in the same workspace.
- **Progress you can watch.** While the phone holds the person, status, turn, step, and the tool being waited on all show on a card edited in place — no re-send, no buzz.

#### Design trade-offs

- **Desktop first, phone as the fallback.** A request goes to the desktop GUI first; a card is sent only if no one answers within `delaySeconds` (`0` means immediately). Answer on the phone and the page you left open settles itself — never "approved on the phone, still waiting on the desktop".
- **The phone gets a decision, not the machine.** Workspace, sessions, settings, and credentials all stay where they are. The card is the credential: only the bound recipient can press it; a direct message only binds a deployment that is not yet bound, and a group message never binds.
- **Outbound only.** Delivery rides the Feishu long connection — no inbound port, tunnel, or relay. Credentials live in the credential store, not the process environment. The one-scan setup requests 3 scopes, 1 event, and 1 callback.
- **DSH is not modified.** It ships as a `dsh.bundle` profile layer registering on the two documented answerer waterfalls (`prepend: true`, calling `next()` before the timer starts). Nothing is patched or forked; the channel contract is documented, so a different transport is a new file.
- **Delivery is retryable.** Up to 4 retries under the same idempotency key, so a card the platform already accepted is never sent twice; the long connection carries a liveness probe and reports an app that has been revoked.

This goes in a different direction from full-remote-control plugins ([dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket), [ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote)): those move the whole GUI, which needs a tunnel or a relay; this one sends out only the decision and the next step of the conversation.

#### Links

- Repo and issues: https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console
- npm: `dsh-pocket-console` · Docs: [README](https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console) (bilingual), [configuration](https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/configuration.md), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/picsky/dsh-pocket-console/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/troubleshooting.md)

Bug reports and ideas are welcome as issues.

---
