discussions.title: [Bug Report]受限模式下无法捕获子进程输出（Access is denied）；另有间歇的 0xC0000142
discussions.body:
# 受限模式下无法捕获子进程输出（`Access is denied`）；另有间歇的 `0xC0000142`

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 及沙箱包：`0.1.7-rc.2`
- Windows（`DESKTOP-BH7C33A`，管理员账户，UAC 启用）
- DSH 由一个**提权的** cmd 窗口启动（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）——已通过读取该
  node 进程的令牌确认：令牌含 `SeIncreaseQuotaPrivilege` / `SeSecurityPrivilege` /
  `SeBackupPrivilege` 等提权专属特权（均为"存在但禁用"，即默认状态）
- 会话工作区：`D:\DSH`

## 摘要

在 `read-only` / `workspace-write` 下，**任何需要捕获子进程输出的操作都会失败**，
且报错是 `Program 'xxx.exe' failed to run: Access is denied` —— 看起来像"程序起不来"，
实际是"接不上管道"。这一点与本仓库 README 中
「Piped stdio capture is impossible for confined grandchildren」吻合。

但**另有一个阶段完全不同的失败**（`0xC0000142`，进程已创建、加载器失败）会在
**同一次操作**上间歇出现，这条**无法用上述已记载限制解释**，是本次反馈的重点。

## 复现 A：输出捕获（稳定复现）

在 DSH 会话内（`workspace-write`）依次执行：

```powershell
& cmd.exe /c "echo A"                        # A
$out = & cmd.exe /c "echo B"                 # B
$out2 = & cmd.exe /c "echo C" | Out-String   # C
```

**实际结果**：

| # | 写法 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | 直接输出 | ✅ 成功，输出 `A`，退出码 0 |
| B | 赋值捕获 | ⚠️ **不报错，但 `$out` 为空字符串** |
| C | `\| Out-String` | ❌ `Program 'cmd.exe' failed to run: Access is denied` |

**期望**：三种写法都能取得输出；即便受限于 stdio 策略，
也不应表现为**整条命令创建失败**。

**注**：同一个可执行文件、同一时刻、同一个令牌，唯一变量是"是否接管道"。
连跑 3 次直接输出均成功（见复现 B 的观察），说明不是偶发。

### 与文档的两处出入

1. README 称 PowerShell 的匿名管道**可以**工作：

   > anonymous pipes (PowerShell pipelines) work because the restricted token's default
   > DACL carries a full-access restricting-SID ACE

   但实测 C（`| Out-String`）**失败**。（Windows PowerShell 5.1）

2. README 把该限制描述为"捕获不可用"，而实测是**整条命令以 `Access is denied` 失败**。
   对外表现像"程序根本起不来"，会把排查方向引向令牌/特权/ACL。
   （我本人就先往 `SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege` 方向查了很久，见下。）
   建议在错误信息里区分「stdio/管道受限」与「进程创建被拒」。

## 复现 B：间歇的 `0xC0000142`（本反馈重点）

两轮对照，每轮都请使用者留意桌面上是否出现错误框：

| 轮次 | 执行内容 | 命令结果 | 桌面错误框 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 第 1 轮 | `& cmd.exe /c "echo ..."` 直接输出，**连跑 3 次** | 3 次全部成功 | **0 个** |
| 第 2 轮 | 1 次 `\| Out-String` + 1 次赋值捕获 | 前者 `Access is denied`；后者静默返回空 | **1 个** |

错误框内容：

```
cmd.exe - 应用程序错误
应用程序无法正常启动(0xc0000142)。请单击"确定"关闭应用程序。
```

（此前还有过至少一次，未能及时取证。）

### 为什么这条无法用 stdio 限制解释

`0xC0000142` = `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`：**进程已被创建**，失败发生在加载器初始化。
而 `Access is denied` 意味着**进程从未被创建**。两者处于完全不同的阶段。

所以同一次操作观察到**三种结局**，且选中哪个具有**间歇性**：

| 结局 | 报错 | 阶段 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Access is denied` | 进程未创建（`CreateProcessAsUserW` 返回 0） |
| 2 | 静默返回空 | 进程疑似创建但无数据 |
| 3 | `0xC0000142` + 桌面错误框 | 进程已创建，加载器失败 |

这更像受限令牌 / `CreateProcessAsUserW` 路径上的**竞态或状态相关缺陷**，
而不是单一固定限制。

### 与文档的矛盾

README 明确写着：

> The keep-alive group (logon SID + Everyone) is present in both modes:
> **without it, early DLL initialization dies with `0xC0000142`**

而代码里该组**确实存在**（`lib/types-DxezulnA.js`，约 879-885 行）：

```js
mode === "read-only" ? [logonSid, known.world]
                     : [logonSid, known.world, ...writeSids]
```

同 README 中另一条已知致死项（`CREATE_NO_WINDOW` / `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE`）
**不适用**：受限路径传入的创建标志是 `4` = `CREATE_SUSPENDED`。

**即：代码在，却出现了文档声称"没有它才会出现"的故障码。**

### 我未能做到的事

**`0xC0000142` 的触发条件我没抓到。** 上述两轮对照是全部观察；
它只在"有失败"的轮次出现，但**不同步于每一次失败**（2 次失败 → 1 个弹窗）。
如果维护者需要更多信息，请告知要采集什么，我可以再试。

## 已确认**不是**原因的方向（供参考，避免重复排查）

这几条我都实测过，**都不成立**，列出来是为了省下你们和他人的时间：

1. **机器/账户环境有问题** —— 沙箱**外**的普通（**未提权**）shell 起子进程完全正常：
   ```
   PS C:\Users\22104> & cmd.exe /c "echo admin-window-ok"
   admin-window-ok
   ```
2. **调用方令牌缺 `SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege`** —— 该特权**本来就不授予普通管理员账户**；
   实测**提权后**的管理员窗口里同样不出现。它在与不在都不携带信息。
   ⚠ 它在 `whoami /priv` 里很显眼，极易误导（我先上了这个当）。
3. **DSH 宿主进程未提权** —— 直接读取该进程令牌，22 条特权中含提权专属项（见"环境"）。
4. **特定目录不可执行** —— 一度以为 System32 可跑、Program Files 不可跑；
   实际是那轮对照**所有** exe 都用了捕获输出而全部失败，目录不是变量。

## 附：两个取证陷阱（文档里没有，建议补充）

排查过程中踩到两条**会让结论反向**的坑：

1. **`Get-Acl` 的 `Sddl` 属性不包含 SACL** —— 而强制性完整性标签正存在 SACL 里。
   用它判断"目录有没有 Low 标签"会得出**假阴性**。
2. **`Get-Acl -Audit` 在 `SeSecurityPrivilege` 处于"已禁用"时可能静默返回空**，
   而不是抛错。结果无法区分"确实没有"与"读不到"。

若文档能写明这两点，可以省掉后续排查者不少弯路。

## 期望

1. 明确 stdio/管道受限时的行为（最好是在受限模式下自动降级为 inherited stdio，
   或至少在错误信息里说明是 stdio 限制而非进程创建被拒）；
2. 关注 `0xC0000142` 的间歇性 —— 这是本次反馈里唯一无法用既有文档解释的部分；
3. 若需要补采证据，请指出具体项。

discussions.title: Windows desktop app: every sandboxed shell command fails with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)
discussions.body:
# Windows desktop app: every sandboxed shell command fails with `0xC0000142` (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)

## Summary

On Windows, the **desktop app** (Electron) cannot run any confined shell command. Under
`workspace-write` (and `read-only`), every `pwsh`/`cmd`/`git`/… invocation spawned through
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` returns **empty output with `[exit code: 3221225794]`**
= `0xC0000142` `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`. Only `danger-full-access` works.

Root cause: the ACL sandbox spawns children that **must share the host process's console**, and
the desktop Host runs under Electron as a GUI process **without a console**.

## Environment

- Windows 11 Pro for Workstations 23H2, build **22631**, x64
- DeepSeek Harness desktop **0.1.7-rc.2** (Electron **44.0.0**, bundled Node **24.18.1**)
- Same failure reproduced with sandbox package **0.2.0-rc.1** (published 2026-09-28)
- Account: built-in Administrator (SID `…-500`), UAC disabled — **but this is not the cause** (see isolation below; plain Node works on the same account)
- Workspace on NTFS

## Evidence

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`'s own README (Verified boundaries / Modes) states:

> children created with `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` / `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` die during DLL initialization with
> `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED` (`0xC0000142`); children share the host console …

So the sandboxed child needs the host to own a console. The desktop Host is an Electron
(`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`) process, which is a GUI-subsystem process with **no console** (and Chromium
frees any inherited console). Every confined child therefore dies during DLL init.

### Minimal isolation

Same machine, same script, same package — only the host process differs. The script creates an
`AclSandbox` (`workspace-write`) and spawns `cmd /c echo hello`:

```js
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { AclSandbox, tempWriteSid, workspaceWriteSid } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl';

const workspaceRoot = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dshws-'));
const tempDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dshtmp-'));
const sandbox = new AclSandbox({
  writableDirs: [workspaceRoot], tempDir,
  writeSid: workspaceWriteSid(workspaceRoot),
  tempWriteSid: tempWriteSid(tempDir),
  mode: 'workspace-write',
});
await sandbox.init();
const child = sandbox.spawn({ command: 'cmd', args: ['/c', 'echo', 'hello'], cwd: workspaceRoot });
const r = await child.wait();
console.log('exit=', r.exitCode, 'stdout=', JSON.stringify(r.stdout.toString()));
```

| Host process | Has console | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `node.exe` (v24.19.0) | yes | `exit=0`, `"hello\r\n"` |
| `DeepSeek Harness.exe` with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` | **no** | `exit=3221225794` |
| `DeepSeek Harness.exe` + `AllocConsole()` before spawn | yes | **`exit=0`, `"hello\r\n"`** |

`init()` always succeeds; only the child dies. The same happens for `pwsh`, `git`, `cargo`, `bun`.

### Web/CLI version is unaffected

In an older web/CLI setup (same machine/account, `workspace-write`), 283 `pwsh` calls succeeded
with **zero** `0xC0000142` — because that Host is `node.exe` (console subsystem, started from a
terminal). The desktop build is the one that breaks.

## Impact

Any Windows user of the desktop app running under `workspace-write` or `read-only` gets a dead
shell tool. It is not an account/UAC/filesystem issue (the plain-Node run proves the sandbox and
machine are fine).

## Suggested fix

Make the Host own a console before spawning confined children, e.g. call `AllocConsole()` (after
`FreeConsole()`) once at Host startup, or spawn confined commands via a ConPTY/pseudo-console.
`AllocConsole()` in the host was verified to make the sandbox work.

## Reproduce

1. Install the desktop app on Windows.
2. Start a session and keep the default `workspace-write` permission mode.
3. Ask the agent to run any shell command.
4. Observe `(no output)` / `[exit code: 3221225794]`.

discussions.title: [Bug] CLI/Web（`npx`，非 Electron）下受限沙箱的两种失败：stdio 捕获确定性失败 + 间歇的 `0xC0000142`
discussions.body:
# [dsh-sandbox-post-cli.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32751763/dsh-sandbox-post-cli.md)

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 启动方式 | `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`（**纯 CLI / Web profile**） |
| 桌面 / Electron 组件 | **无**（`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` 下无 `*-desktop*` / `*electron*`） |
| `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` | **未设置**（`[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable` 确认为空） |
| 宿主进程 | `node.exe ... \@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js web` |
| 各包版本 | `dsh` / `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` / `dsh-subprocess` / `dsh-subprocess-local` / `dsh-pwsh-sandbox` / `dsh-sandbox-local` / `dsh-win32-process` 均为 **`0.1.7-rc.2`** |
| DSH 宿主令牌 | **提权**（读该 node 进程令牌确认：含 `SeIncreaseQuotaPrivilege` / `SeSecurityPrivilege` / `SeBackupPrivilege` / `SeRestorePrivilege` / `SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege`，均为"存在但禁用" = 默认状态） |
| 工作区 | `D:\DSH` |

## 为什么单独开帖：这是一族报告里缺失的一种形态

`0xC0000142` 已有至少 5 个报告。它们的**环境与表现都不同**，但据我核对，
**没有一个是「非 Electron 的 CLI/Web 形态」**：

| # | 形态 | 表现 | 根因（报告者给出） |
|---|---|---|---|
| #810 | 桌面路径 / 无控制台宿主 | 全部命令 `0xC0000142` | 控制台/创建标志 |
| #1344 | GUI 宿主 | 弹出可见控制台窗口 | `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE` 可修，不再触发 `0xC0000142` |
| #1847 | Windows 10 build 19041 | 外部进程 `0xC0000142` | 未给出 |
| #8130 | 桌面版（Electron） | 全部命令 `0xC0000142` | `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 由桌面宿主注入 → `scrubbedParentEnv()` 未过滤 → 子进程继承 → 受限令牌下加载器失败 |
| #8142 | 桌面版 | **every** sandboxed shell command 失败 | 同 #8130 |
| **本报告** | **CLI / Web（`npx`，无 Electron）** | **仅在使用 stdio 捕获时失败**（`Access is denied`）；另有间歇 `0xC0000142` | **未定论** |

**关键点**：#8130 的根因链第一环（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 存在）在本环境**不成立**，
该变量根本不存在；但**同一个失败码仍然出现**。所以 `0xC0000142` 至少还有**第二条触发路径**。

## 现象一：stdio 捕获导致确定性失败

同一会话、同一可执行文件、同一令牌，**唯一变量是"是否捕获/重定向 stdio"**：

| # | 写法 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `& cmd.exe /c "echo A"` | ✅ 成功，输出可见，退出码 0 |
| B | `$out = & cmd.exe /c "echo B"` | ⚠️ **不报错，`$out` 为空字符串** |
| C | `$out2 = & cmd.exe /c "echo C" \| Out-String` | ❌ `Program 'cmd.exe' failed to run: Access is denied` |
| D | `& cmd.exe /c "echo D > f" 2>&1` | ❌ 失败，目标文件未生成 |

- **A 连跑 3 次全部成功**；**C 每次都失败**。即 C 是**确定性**的，不是偶发。
- 失败时的报错长这样：

```
Program 'cmd.exe' failed to run: Access is denied
+ $out2 = & cmd.exe /c "echo C-pipe-ok" | Out-String
+         ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    + CategoryInfo          : ResourceUnavailable: (:) [], ApplicationFailedException
    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : NativeCommandFailed
```

**注意报错的措辞**：它说 `failed to run`（"跑不起来"），而实际是**接不上 stdio**。
从用户视角看这像"程序坏了 / 权限不足"，会把排查引向令牌与特权方向
（我本人就先往 `SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege` 查了很久，见下文"已排除"）。

### 与官方 README 及社区手册的对照

`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 的 README 记录：

> **Piped stdio capture is impossible for confined grandchildren** — …`spawn(..., { stdio: 'pipe' })`
> inside a confined process fails with EPERM; **inherited and ignored stdio spawns work**, and
> anonymous pipes (PowerShell pipelines) work because the restricted token's default DACL
> carries a full-access restricting-SID ACE.

社区手册（`sandboxai/deepseek-harness-handbook`，`windows-compatibility`，
`verified_at: 2026-08-27`）也写了：

> **Process and output limitations** — Inside a confined PowerShell command, a grandchild that
> tries to capture output through **named-pipe stdio can fail with `EPERM`**. Ordinary
> PowerShell pipelines use **anonymous pipes** and are a different path.
> …**avoid assuming a retry with wider permission fixes an unsupported pipe shape.**

**两处都称"PowerShell 匿名管道可工作"，但本机实测 C 失败。** 三点请一并考虑：

1. 手册自身的验证环境是 **PowerShell 7.6.4**；本机是 **Windows PowerShell 5.1**。
   （手册的 field validation 一节只测了 foreground/background `pwsh` 与 ACL 写边界，
   **未测管道捕获**——所以那句可能是推断而非实测。）
2. 本场景可能是**双层管道**：harness 需捕获工具进程的 stdout 才能把输出回传给模型，
   而我在该进程内又对孙进程做了一次捕获。
3. README 把该限制描述为"捕获不可用"，而实测是**整条命令创建失败并报 `Access is denied`**。
   这个措辞差异是本节最想请维护者确认的点。

## 现象二：间歇的 `0xC0000142`，且与现象一**阶段不同**

两轮对照，每轮都留意桌面是否弹出错误框：

| 轮次 | 执行内容 | 命令结果 | 桌面错误框 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 第 1 轮 | `& cmd.exe /c "echo ..."` 直接输出，**连跑 3 次** | 3 次全部成功 | **0 个** |
| 第 2 轮 | 1 次 `\| Out-String` + 1 次赋值捕获 | 前者 `Access is denied`；后者静默空 | **1 个** |

错误框内容：

```
cmd.exe - 应用程序错误
应用程序无法正常启动(0xc0000142)。请单击"确定"关闭应用程序。
```

（此前另有至少一次，未及时取证。）

### 为什么这不能用 stdio 限制解释

- `0xC0000142` = `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`：**进程已被创建**，失败在加载器初始化。
- `Access is denied`（`ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`）：**进程从未被创建**。

两者处于**完全不同的阶段**，却出现在**同一次操作**上，且选中哪个具有**间歇性**
（2 次失败 → 1 个弹窗，无法确定对应哪一次）。

于是同一次受限 spawn 观察到**三种结局**：

| 结局 | 报错 | 阶段 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Access is denied` | 进程未创建 |
| 2 | **静默返回空**（不报错） | 进程疑似创建但无数据 |
| 3 | `0xC0000142` + 桌面错误框 | 进程已创建，加载器失败 |

这更像受限令牌 / `CreateProcessAsUserW` 路径上的**竞态或状态相关缺陷**，
而不是单一固定能力限制。

### 与文档的矛盾

README 称：

> The keep-alive group (logon SID + Everyone) is present in both modes:
> **without it, early DLL initialization dies with `0xC0000142`**

而代码里该组**确实存在**（`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-DxezulnA.js`，约 879-885 行）：

```js
mode === "read-only" ? [logonSid, known.world]
                     : [logonSid, known.world, ...writeSids]
```

同 README 另一条已知致死项（`CREATE_NO_WINDOW` / `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE`）**不适用**：
受限路径传入的创建标志是 **`4` = `CREATE_SUSPENDED`**。

**即：代码在，却出现了文档声称"没有它才会出现"的故障码。**

补充一条旁证：社区手册的症状对照表覆盖了首命令卡顿（ACL 传播）、`LanguageMode`、
嵌套 CLI `EPERM`、CIM/WMI 缺失、BOM、zstd、Node 版本等，
**但没有 `0xC0000142` 这一条**。这可能说明它尚未被收录为已知边界。

## 已排除的方向（供参考，避免重复排查）

1. **机器 / 账户环境有问题** —— 沙箱**外**的普通（**未提权**）shell 起子进程完全正常：
   ```
   PS C:\Users\22104> & cmd.exe /c "echo admin-window-ok"
   admin-window-ok
   ```
2. **调用方令牌缺 `SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege`** —— 该特权**本来就不授予普通管理员账户**
   （默认只给 `SERVICE` / `NETWORK SERVICE` / `LOCAL SERVICE` / `SYSTEM`）。
   实测：**提权后**的管理员窗口里它**同样不出现**。即在或不在都不携带信息。
   ⚠ 它在 `whoami /priv` 里很显眼，**极易误导**（我先上了这个当）。
3. **宿主进程未提权** —— 直接读该 node 进程令牌，22 条中含提权专属项（见"环境"）。
4. **特定目录不可执行** —— 一度以为 System32 可跑、Program Files 不可跑；
   实际是那轮对照里**所有** exe 都用了捕获输出，于是**全部**失败。目录不是变量。

## 影响

- 任何**捕获输出**的操作在受限模式下不可用：`$x = & tool ...`、`| Out-String`、
  `> log 2>&1`。依赖「跑脚本 + 读日志」的工作流（构建脚本大量使用 `> log 2>&1`）
  **整体不可用**。
- 报错措辞 `failed to run: Access is denied` 具有**强误导性**，
  会把使用者引向"权限/令牌"方向，而不是 stdio 形状。
- 升权到 `danger-full-access` 虽可绕过，但该模式**不套受限令牌**，
  等于实质上放开了文件沙箱——手册亦强调
  「**avoid assuming a retry with wider permission fixes an unsupported pipe shape**」。
  对不熟悉这条边界的用户，这容易变成"每次都无脑升权"的常态。

## 我未能做到的

- **`0xC0000142` 的触发条件没抓到。** 上述两轮对照是全部观察。
- 未能取到 `CreateProcessAsUserW` 失败时的**原始 Win32 错误码**
  （模型侧只能看到被包装过的 `Access is denied`）。
- 未确认工作区目录的**强制性完整性标签**当前是否存在——两条常规读取途径都无效：
  `Get-Acl` 的 `Sddl` 属性**不包含 SACL**；`Get-Acl -Audit` 在
  `SeSecurityPrivilege` 为"已禁用"时**可能静默返回空**而非抛错，无法区分"没有"与"读不到"。
  （这两点建议补进文档，否则后来人容易得出**反向结论**。）

**如果需要补采证据，请指明具体项**（例如打开某个调试开关、或采集受限子进程的环境块 /
令牌 restricting-SID 列表 / 创建标志），我可以再跑。

## 期望

1. **`0xC0000142` 为何会在"keep-alive 组存在"的前提下出现**——
   这是本报告最想得到的答复，也是唯一无法用既有文档解释的部分；
2. stdio 捕获受限时，报错能**区分**「stdio/管道形状不受支持」与「进程创建被拒」
   （当前措辞会误导排查方向）；
3. 确认 README 与社区手册中「PowerShell 匿名管道可工作」这一表述是否准确——
   本机（Windows PowerShell 5.1）实测为**失败**。

discussions.title: DSH | Noema | 帮你找到每轮代码改动中值得先看的地方
discussions.body:
如果你和我一样，即使高强度使用 AI 生成代码，仍然时刻保持对它的警惕，可以看一看这个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，已经适配最新版 0.1.7-rc.2。

Noema 会根据“圈复杂度”和“认知复杂度”的变化幅度快速筛选出这一轮的 diff 应该先看哪里，肯定没法百分百圈准，但复杂度、或者说心智负担变化明显的地方基本都能挑出来，用不着再从头翻。

![Web UI 卡片示例，展示在每轮对话完成后](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wjw99830/dsh-plugin-noema/main/docs/assets/demo.png)

它跟 ESLint 的 complexity 规则、SonarQube 不一样，那些工具关心整个仓库现在有多复杂，超了阈值就报警，面向 CI，Noema 只看这一轮任务把代码改成了什么样子，每轮开始前和结束后各扫一遍工作区，把这一轮的差异贴在对话末尾，不评分也不拦提交，作用就是告诉你先看哪里。

只算三个指标：

- 圈复杂度：代码里独立路径的数量
- 认知复杂度：理解控制流的难度，分支、嵌套和递归都会算进去
- 最大嵌套深度：函数里控制结构最深套了几层

卡片按文件和函数分层，新增和删除会标出来，没变化就先收着。

分数降了不等于代码变好了，只是帮你省下找重点的时间，准确判断还是得靠自己读，所以分析结果只给人看，不进模型上下文。

目前支持 TypeScript（含 TSX）、Python 和 Go，仓库和文档在 [​​​https://github.com/wjw99830/dsh-plugin-noema](https://github.com/wjw99830/dsh-plugin-noema)，感兴趣可以试试。

discussions.title: 这次升级插件不兼容不挂了，不过这次死的插件比较多
web-fetch-http: accept charset labels outside the WHATWG table (latin-1, cp-1252, koi8-r)
discussions.body:
`decoderForCharset` in `packages/web/web-fetch-http/src/policy.ts` refuses any
declared charset that `TextDecoder` cannot resolve, and that default is right —
failing loudly beats returning mojibake. But `TextDecoder` only resolves the
labels the WHATWG encoding table carries, and the table's `latin1` /
`iso-8859-1` spelling does not cover the hyphenated `latin-1`. A server is free
to declare any of them, so a perfectly readable response gets refused over a
label the standard simply never enumerated.

## Change

Route labels that name a real encoding in a spelling outside the table through a
small alias map before constructing the decoder:

```ts
const CHARSET_ALIASES: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map([
  ['latin-1', 'windows-1252'],
  ['cp-1252', 'windows-1252'],
  ['windows-1251', 'windows-1251'],
  ['cp-1251', 'windows-1251'],
  ['koi8-r', 'koi8-r'],
])

export function decoderForCharset(charset: string | undefined): TextDecoder {
  if (charset === undefined) return new TextDecoder('utf-8')
  const label = CHARSET_ALIASES.get(charset) ?? charset
  try {
    return new TextDecoder(label)
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    throw new WebError(`unsupported charset "${charset}"`, 'WEB_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE', { cause: error })
  }
}
```

Only labels with exactly one defensible decoding are listed; `not-a-charset` and
its like stay unlisted, so the loud failure is preserved.

## Where it lives

Since the project does not take external pull requests, the change sits on a
fork: **`RomanCohort/deepseek-harness`**, branch `fix/charset-alias-labels`
(commit `b0028a56ff`), with a test alongside it in
`web-fetch-http/tests/fetch-http.spec.ts`. Posting it here in case it is useful —
take the diff, or tell me if a different alias set would fit better.

discussions.title: 技术分享: 如何构建24插件数据资产管理矩阵 — 架构、降级、零硬编码实践
discussions.body:
## 背景

在DSH上构建数据资产管理能力时，发现官方仅提供10个基础插件，缺少政务巡检、资产估值、合规审查等高级能力。

于是构建了 **24插件完整矩阵**，覆盖全链路：脱敏→清洗→盘点→质量→估值→合规→登记→政务→AI→流通

## 架构设计

### 插件分层

v1.0 基础层: 脱敏→清洗→盘点→包装→编排
v2.0 质量层: 质量评分→血缘→可视化→敏感度分级
v3.0 入表层: 盘点扫描→质量评分→估值→合规→登记→确权
v3.1 扩展层: 政务巡检→城市分类→AI数据集→流通评估

### 无凭据降级模式

DegradedModeController: 无凭据时分类模式独立运行，语义检测降级为本地规则，报告标注 degradedMode: true

### 零硬编码

所有业务规则从 business-rules.json 读取，源码中无硬编码阈值

### matchItemType 四通道匹配

手动指定→名称关键词→编码前缀→流程字段关键词，解决"建设工程规划核实"不含"现场勘查"的匹配盲区

### 异常输入健壮性

6类异常全覆盖：坏JSON、空数据、超长数据、无效URL、部分缺失、非UTF-8

## 测试结果

429 tests passed，语义92.3%，逻辑100%，漏项100%，误报0%

## 链接

GitHub: https://github.com/liuhange789/data-asset-inspector
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liuhange/dsh-gov-data-inspector

如果觉得有帮助，欢迎Star支持！

discussions.title: Office image rendering silently produces empty (fully transparent) PNGs on the macOS native libreoffice-kit engine
discussions.body:
## 中文摘要

DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 内置的 `libreoffice-kit` 在 macOS 上执行 `render` 时，命令返回成功、manifest 正常、`missingFonts` 为空，但写出的 Office 预览 PNG **全透明**。直接按原生 helper 的协议抓取编码前的原始 tile，861,696 个像素全为 0，说明 LibreOffice 从未向调用方提供的缓冲区写入任何内容 —— 既不是字体问题，也不是 PNG 编码问题。

根因：`doc_paintTile` 通过 `SetOutputSizePixelScaleOffsetAndLOKBuffer` → `SalVirtualDevice::SetSizeUsingBuffer` 绑定外部缓冲区，而该方法只有 headless/svp 后端实现；macOS(quartz) 与 Windows(win/gdi) 后端都没有 override，release 构建又编译掉了基类的 `assert`，于是静默返回 `false`。`paintTile` 返回 `void`，`worker.cxx` 无从检测，只能上报成功。

影响：macOS 原生引擎的全部 Office→图片渲染（xlsx/docx/pptx）；`convert`、`recalculate`、CSV 导出与 PDF(PDFium) 渲染不受影响。按源码推断 Windows 原生引擎同样受影响（未在硬件上验证）。已验证可行的绕行路径是 Office → PDF → PDFium。

## TL;DR

`libreoffice-kit render` on macOS (native engine `@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-darwin-arm64@0.1.1`, shipped inside DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2) reports `ok` with a valid manifest, but every Office tile it writes is a fully transparent PNG. The raw pre-encode tile buffer is untouched (all bytes zero), so this is not a font or a PNG-encoding problem: LibreOffice never writes into the caller-provided buffer.

Root cause: `doc_paintTile` binds the caller buffer through `VirtualDevice::SetOutputSizePixelScaleOffsetAndLOKBuffer` → `SalVirtualDevice::SetSizeUsingBuffer`, which only the headless/svp backend implements. The macOS (quartz) and Windows (win/gdi) backends do not override it, and the release build compiles out the base-class `assert`, so the call silently returns `false`. `paintTile` returns `void`, so `worker.cxx` cannot detect the failure and reports success.

Impact: all Office → image rendering (xlsx/docx/pptx) on the macOS native engine. `convert`, `recalculate`, CSV export and PDF rendering (PDFium) are unaffected. The same source reading suggests the Windows native engine is affected as well (not verified on hardware).

## Environment

- DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2, macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon)
- `@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit` 0.1.1, engine `@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-darwin-arm64` 0.1.1 (`backend: "native"`)
- Bundled LibreOffice core `bce0998afefdbc355585ca324285661a2170ba77` (26.8.0.3), configured with `--disable-debug --disable-dbgutil`
- npm `@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit@0.1.2` still pins the macOS engine to 0.1.1, so the latest published release does not change this behaviour.

## Reproduction

```sh
NODE=".../Resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node"
CLI=".../app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit/lib/cli.js"

# any docx/xlsx/pptx
"$NODE" "$CLI" render --input doc.docx --output-dir out --dpi 96
```

Reported result (looks healthy):

```json
{"schemaVersion":1,"backend":"native","rasterEngine":"libreoffice","dpi":96,"pageCount":1,
 "images":[{"index":1,"page":1,"path":".../out/page-0001.png","width":816,"height":1056,...}],
 "missingFonts":[]}
```

Actual PNG content, measured with the bundled Pillow:

| input | raster engine | alpha min/max | distinct colours | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| book.xlsx | libreoffice | 0 / 0 | 1 | empty |
| doc.docx | libreoffice | 0 / 0 | 1 | empty |
| deck.pptx | libreoffice | 0 / 0 | 1 | empty |
| book.pdf (converted from book.xlsx) | pdfium | 255 / 255 | 229 | correct |

## The tile buffer is never written

Driving the native helper directly over its documented stdio protocol (`--operation render-images`, then `P <index> <part> <w> <h> <x> <y> <tw> <th>`) and inspecting `tile-1.rgba` before any JS post-processing:

```
READY: {"ok":true,"kind":"ready","tileMode":1,"documentType":"text","writerRectangles":"284, 284, 12240, 15840"}
PAINT: {"ok":true,"kind":"paint","index":1,"path":".../tile-1.rgba","width":816,"height":1056}
RAW bytes=3446784 px=861696
pixels with alpha != 0 : 0
pixels with RGB   != 0 : 0
```

All 861,696 pixels are zero. A backend that painted anything would at minimum have filled the page background, so the buffer was never touched. `rgbaPixels()` then maps `alpha == 0` to transparent black, which is a faithful conversion of an empty buffer rather than the cause.

## Not an environment, backend-selection or font issue

Same direct-protocol probe, one process per configuration:

| env | non-zero pixels |
| --- | --- |
| (baseline) | 0 |
| `SAL_DISABLESKIA=1` | 0 |
| `SAL_FORCESKIA=1` | 0 |
| `SAL_SKIA=raster` | 0 |
| `SAL_USE_VCLPLUGIN=svp` | 0 |
| `SAL_NOOPENGL=1 SAL_DISABLESKIA=1` | 0 |

`missingFonts` is empty in every run, and `convert`/`recalculate` on the same documents succeed, so document import and layout work.

## Upstream code path

`desktop/source/lib/init.cxx`, `doc_paintTile` (macOS is `UNX` but not `IOS`, so it takes the `#else` branch):

```cpp
#if defined(IOS)
    CGContextRef pCGContext = CGBitmapContextCreate(pBuffer, nCanvasWidth, nCanvasHeight, ...);
    ...
#else
    ScopedVclPtrInstance<VirtualDevice> pDevice(DeviceFormat::WITHOUT_ALPHA);
    pDevice->SetBackground(Wallpaper(COL_TRANSPARENT));
    pDevice->SetOutputSizePixelScaleOffsetAndLOKBuffer(
                Size(nCanvasWidth, nCanvasHeight), 1.0, Point(), pBuffer);
    pDoc->paintTile(*pDevice, nCanvasWidth, nCanvasHeight, nTilePosX, nTilePosY, nTileWidth, nTileHeight);
#endif
```

`vcl/inc/salvd.hxx`:

```cpp
virtual bool SetSizeUsingBuffer(tools::Long /*nNewDX*/, tools::Long /*nNewDY*/, sal_uInt8 * /*pBuffer*/)
{
    // Only the headless/svp virtual device has an implementation.
    assert(false && "unsupported");
    return false;
}
```

Overrides at the pinned revision:

| backend | overrides `SetSizeUsingBuffer` |
| --- | --- |
| `vcl/headless/svpvd.cxx` | yes |
| `vcl/quartz/salvd.cxx` (macOS) | no |
| `vcl/win/gdi/salvd.cxx` (Windows) | no |

Because the engine is built with `--disable-debug --disable-dbgutil`, the `assert` is compiled out and the `false` return is discarded. `SAL_USE_VCLPLUGIN=svp` cannot help: the engine's own build script records that `configure` rejects `--disable-gui` on macOS and Windows, so no svp plugin exists in this static build.

Finally, `worker.cxx` cannot observe the failure, because `paintTile` returns `void`:

```cpp
if (part < 0) document->pClass->paintTile(document.get(), pixels.data(), canvasWidth, canvasHeight, x, y, width, height);
else document->pClass->paintPartTile(...);
// unconditional writePixels() + {"ok":true,"kind":"paint",...}
```

The PDF branch does check its result (`if (!api.paint(...)) throw`), which matches PDFium rendering being correct.

## Suggested fixes, cheapest first

1. Detect the failure instead of reporting success: verify the tile buffer was written, or reject `render` with `unavailable` on native backends that cannot paint into a caller buffer. Today a silently empty image invites callers to conclude that the document itself is broken.
2. Fix the rendering path: extend the `#if defined(IOS)` `CGBitmapContextCreate` branch to `MACOSX` (CoreGraphics is available and the code is nearly reusable), or implement `SetSizeUsingBuffer` in `vcl/quartz/salvd.cxx` and `vcl/win/gdi/salvd.cxx`.
3. Interim product behaviour: on affected native engines, render Office documents through Office → PDF → PDFium internally and label it in the manifest (for example `rasterEngine: "pdfium"`, `source: "pdf-route"`). Verified working locally:

```sh
"$NODE" "$CLI" convert --input doc.docx --output doc.pdf
"$NODE" "$CLI" render  --input doc.pdf  --output-dir preview --dpi 110   # correct image
```

Note that the PDF route follows print settings and cannot reproduce the `--sheet` / `--range` worksheet framing, and that the bundled `office-*` skills currently forbid using PDF conversion as a visual-QA fallback — so with the current instructions an agent on macOS correctly reports "visual inspection unavailable" even though a usable preview is reachable.

discussions.title: Tool-result pruner silently truncates without marker; compaction never fires at default minContextRatio; no heredoc protection in pwsh tool
discussions.body:
# Tool-result pruner silently removes output middles without any marker; compaction never fires at default minContextRatio

## Environment

- DSH harness (deepseek-harness), Windows 11, PowerShell tool
- Preset: `cordis-cc` (standard coding agent)
- Model: GLM-5.3-Flash / DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (both affected)
- Workload: long-running book-production session (multi-hour, 270+ tool calls, heavy Word COM + Python + file operations)

## Bug 1 — Tool-result pruner silently truncates without marking the cut

**Config** (from the default preset's `compaction-tool-result-pruner`):
```yaml
thresholdChars: 8192
headChars: 4096
tailChars: 1024
```

**What happens:** any tool result over 8,192 characters is silently pruned to the first 4,096 + last 1,024 characters. The middle — up to 3,000+ characters — is removed with **no marker, no ellipsis, no indication that anything was cut**. The result looks like a continuous (but wrong) output.

**Why this is dangerous:** the model reads the pruned result as if it were the complete output. It cannot know the middle is missing. In our session, this caused:
- The model to report file counts, page counts, and image counts that were actually from the *tail* fragment, not the full result
- The model to conclude that directory listings were "fabricated" when they were actually pruned (the model saw the first few and last few entries but not the middle)
- A cascade of misdiagnosis where the model re-ran verified work, produced contradictory claims, and eventually refused to use the shell at all

**Reproduction:** run any command that produces >8,192 characters of output (e.g., a recursive directory listing, a Python script with 50+ lines of output). The model sees ~5,120 chars (4,096 head + 1,024 tail) and fills in the gap from context.

**Suggested fix:** insert a visible marker between the head and tail, e.g.:
```
[... 3,072 characters omitted by tool-result-pruner ...]
```
This costs 1 line but tells the model the output is incomplete, preventing confabulation.

## Bug 2 — compaction-basic minContextRatio 0.97 means compaction never runs

**Config** (code default, no preset override):
```
minContextRatio: 0.97
```

**What happens:** compaction only fires when the session reaches 97% of the model's context window. In practice, this means compaction *never* runs for most sessions — the tool-result pruner keeps individual results short enough that the context grows slowly, and the model finishes its task before reaching 97%.

**Why this is dangerous:** pruned tool results (from Bug 1) accumulate unboundedly in the context. Each one is a head+tail fragment that the model partially remembers and partially infers. Over hundreds of tool calls, the context becomes a collage of fragments that the model can't accurately attribute — leading to the model making claims about "what it saw" that don't match any real output.

**Suggested fix:** lower the default `minContextRatio` to something like 0.80, or document prominently that the 0.97 default means "compaction will likely never fire."

## Bug 3 — PowerShell tool doesn't protect against heredocs/here-strings

**What happens:** the `pwsh` tool passes commands directly to PowerShell without checking for here-string (`@'...'@`) or heredoc (`<<EOF`) patterns. On Windows, PowerShell here-strings can contain arbitrary content including:
- Unbalanced apostrophes (which break the enclosing command)
- Backslash sequences (which get halved before the shell sees them)
- Content over ~10K chars (which gets silently truncated by the command-line length limit)

**Evidence:** four independent traps documented and reproduced across multiple sessions on Windows 11 (details in the session tapes and the operator's memory notes). The machine-wide rule (in `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`) forbids heredocs for this reason.

**Existing protection:** the project provides `no_heredoc.py` (a PreToolUse blocker) and `nop hook run --policy block` (a heredoc detector). Both are registered in `~/.claude/settings.json` and work in Claude Code sessions.

**The gap:** the default DSH preset does **not** mount the `dsh-hooks-claude-code` bridge, so these hooks never fire in DSH sessions. A heredoc in a DSH `pwsh` tool call executes without any check.

**Suggested fix (any of):**
1. Mount `dsh-hooks-claude-code` in the default preset with `configPath` pointing at `~/.claude/settings.json` (where the hooks are already registered)
2. Or add a built-in heredoc/here-string check in the `pwsh` tool itself (before execution), similar to `kdp_precheck` for print interiors
3. Or at minimum, document in the preset template that the hooks bridge should be mounted for shell-safety

## Workaround (applied)

All three were worked around in the operator's preset (`agent.cordis.yml`):
- `thresholdChars: 65536` (up from 8,192)
- `minContextRatio: 0.80` (down from 0.97)
- `hooks-claude-code` bridge mounted with `configPath: C:/Users/user/.claude/settings.json`

## Impact

Without these fixes, long-running sessions on the default preset will: (1) silently lose the middle of long tool outputs, (2) accumulate pruned fragments that look like real data, and (3) execute heredocs that may corrupt file content — all three of which cause the model to produce confidently wrong results that are indistinguishable from hallucination.

discussions.title: dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch: cut LLM costs by routing routine tasks to cheap subagent models
discussions.body:
**Cut LLM costs: routine tasks go to cheap subagent models; the main model keeps the hard parts.**

[`dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch`](https://github.com/vitas/dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch) is a dispatch plugin for DeepSeek Harness. A [Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai) (System One) classifier answers six atomic questions about the turn — task class, effort, blast radius, repo-context / explicitness / risk — and a declarative policy decides whether to recommend a subagent handoff, and on which model route. Jev guides; the main agent performs the handoff through the harness-native subagent tool.

**Why it saves money**

- The main model stops spending tokens deciding *who* should do the work — and stops doing mechanical edits itself. Routine work runs on flash-rate routes.
- Quiet by default: `mode: off`, or `once` (explicit `/route`, `/jev`, one classification per request). `auto` is opt-in — the README's advice is to earn it with verdict-log evidence.
- Misses are tunable offline: `jev-replay` re-decides the recorded log against a candidate policy with **zero Jev calls**, so you tighten or loosen thresholds against real traffic before committing anything.

**Guardrails**

- Runtime capability gate: no classification unless a delegation tool, its provider, and remaining depth actually exist; an explicit request gets a "what is missing" diagnostic, ordinary turns stay silent.
- The whole assembled state (path included) is credential-redacted and capped before it leaves the machine; logging is opt-in NDJSON with correlation ids and a `delivered` flag.
- A fork-only setup never receives a named model — `subagent_fork` is fixed-route by design.

**Install**

```sh
npm i -g dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch
```

GitHub: https://github.com/vitas/dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch · npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch

A [`workflow`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/6070) catalog entry in awesome-dsh-plugin is pending review.

discussions.title: Windows: sandboxed PTY shell (minimal preset) still fails at startup on 0.2.0-rc.1 — ACL runner exits 127 with NULL std handles
discussions.body:
### 现象

Windows 11 (Build 26200) + DSH **0.2.0-rc.1**：Agent 预设 `minimal`（持久 PTY shell）+ 任意沙箱（`read-only` / `workspace-write`）时，每条 `pwsh` 都返回 `Error: PTY shell exited during startup`，会话不可用；`standard` 预设或 `danger-full-access` 正常。0.1.7-rc.2 上已于 2026-09-25 通过应用内反馈提交，**0.2.0-rc.1 复测仍 100% 复现**。

### 根因（代码定位 + 实测）

沙箱下 PTY 后端把 `[DeepSeek Harness.exe, …/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js, …]` 当 ConPTY 子进程，即 **GUI 子系统**的桌面 exe（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`）：

- 产品真实形态下（ConPTY 也由同一个 GUI exe 宿主创建），该子进程 `GetStdHandle(-10/-11/-12)` = **0/0/0**，`GetLastError()`=6 `ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE`（而 libuv fd 0/1/2 正常指向 ConPTY）。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process` `lib/index.js` → `inheritedStandardHandles()`（~L551-566）必须用这些句柄填 `STARTUPINFO`(`STARTF_USESTDHANDLES`) 再 `CreateProcessAsUserW`（受限路径 ~L693）→ 第一步就失败，`exit 127`；同包非受限路径 `targetCarrierHandles()`（~L572-582）用 `uv_get_osfhandle` 且工作正常 —— **两条路径取句柄方式不一致就是 bug**。
- runner 宿主固定为 `[process.execPath, runner.js]`（`dsh-sandbox-local` `windowsAclRunnerInvocation()` ~L539-553）；`app.asar.unpacked` 内没有该包，也没有配置 `windowsAclRunnerEntry`。
- runner 的 stderr 到不了 PTY：`dsh-terminal-bash` 只从 `confine()` 取 `.argv`（~L968-971）并抛通用错误（~L501 / ~L989）；管道型沙箱（`dsh-bash-sandbox` / `dsh-pwsh-sandbox`）会消费 `runnerFailureRules`，PTY 路径不会。
- win32 链只有单档位（`PLATFORM_CHAINS.win32 = ["windows-acl"]`），不做功能探测，因此不会 fail-closed。

### 实测（2026-09-28，同一台机器，0.2.0-rc.1）

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| ConPTY → GUI exe 子进程句柄 | **0 / 0 / 0**（对照 console `node.exe`：504/508/512，type=2）|
| runner `--mode read-only` → cmd | **exit 127，0 字节输出** |
| runner `--mode workspace-write`（seam SID）→ cmd | **exit 127，0 字节输出** |
| 对照：纯 `cmd /c echo` | exit 0，输出正常 |

补充：若 ConPTY 改由控制台子系统的 `node.exe` 创建，GUI 子进程能拿到有效句柄、runner 也能镜像子进程退出码，**但受限子进程的 stdout/stderr 仍到不了 PTY（0 字节）**，那条路同样不可用。

### 最小复现

父进程必须是 GUI exe（否则不复现；控制台 `node.exe` 当父进程时走的是上面那条"无输出"路径）：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
& '<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe' .\pty-repro.cjs 'C:\path\to\workspace'
```

脚本（A 对照 / B read-only / C workspace-write，read-only 不改任何 ACL）我放在下面回复里，避免正文过长。

### 建议修法

1. 让沙箱 runner 跑在**控制台子系统宿主**：把 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`（+ `dsh-win32-process` / `dsh-subprocess` / `koffi` / `@koromix/koffi-win32-x64`）落盘到 `resources/app.asar.unpacked`，用自带 `resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node.exe` 启动 `runner.js`。
2. 或至少给 `inheritedStandardHandles()` 加 `uv_get_osfhandle` 兜底；注意这只消除 127，GUI 宿主下子进程输出仍到不了 ConPTY，接线也要一起修。
3. PTY 路径同样消费 `runnerFailureRules`（或至少透出 runner stderr），不要把沙箱启动失败报成 `PTY shell exited during startup`。
4. 在此之前，对 `windows-acl` + PTY 做探测/fail-closed，或明确标注 Windows 上 `minimal` + 沙箱暂不支持。

### 其他

- 0.2.0-rc.1 新增的 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 技能不覆盖此类问题（只处理 ACL 拒绝访问）。
- 与 PowerShell 版本无关：`cmd.exe` payload 一样 127，失败发生在任何 shell 被拉起之前。
- 临时规避：用 `standard` 预设或 `danger-full-access`。
- 相关帖（同报错文案 / 同区域，根因不同）：#1913、#2851、#1406。

### EN TL;DR

- On Windows, `minimal` preset + any sandbox mode (`read-only`/`workspace-write`) fails every `pwsh` call with `Error: PTY shell exited during startup`; `standard` or `danger-full-access` works. Reported in-app on 2026-09-25 against 0.1.7-rc.2 — **still 100% reproducible on 0.2.0-rc.1**.
- The PTY backend spawns the **GUI-subsystem** `DeepSeek Harness.exe` (node mode) as the ConPTY child. In the product's configuration its `GetStdHandle(-10/-11/-12)` are **NULL** (0/0/0, `ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE`), so the ACL runner dies in `inheritedStandardHandles()` (`dsh-win32-process` ~L551-566, used by `CreateProcessAsUserW`) with `windows-acl-run: GetStdHandle failed (Win32 0): null stdin handle` → exit 127. The same file's unrestricted path uses `uv_get_osfhandle` and works.
- `dsh-terminal-bash` only takes `.argv` from `confine()` and reports the generic message, swallowing the runner diagnostic that the pipe-based sandboxes do consume.
- Measured 2026-09-28 on 0.2.0-rc.1: runner read-only and workspace-write both exit 127 with 0 bytes of output; plain `cmd /c echo` under the same ConPTY works.
- Fix: host the runner in a console-subsystem process (ship `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` under `app.asar.unpacked` and launch it with the bundled `node.exe`), plus an `uv_get_osfhandle` fallback and surfacing runner failures on the PTY path.
[BUG报告.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32755830/BUG.md)
[GitHub发帖-PTY沙箱-0.2.0-rc.1.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32755836/GitHub.-PTY.-0.2.0-rc.1.md)
[GitHub发帖-回复1-复现脚本.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32755837/GitHub.-.1-.md)
[GitHub发帖正文.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32755838/GitHub.md)
[Uploading PTY-启动失败-实测结论.md…]()

discussions.title: Startup failure on an occupied port names no address — and "node:net:2666" in the stack reads like a port number
discussions.body:
Summary

When a `dsh web` instance cannot bind because the address is already taken, the startup failure prints the raw error stack and never names the address. The only port-shaped token in the output is a source line inside `node:net`, so `node:net:2666` reads like "port 2666" instead of a source line.

I noticed similar port-occupied issues were discussed in #602 and #3757. However, those threads mostly offered workarounds like changing ports or manually killing processes, and didn't address the misleading error message itself. My fix focuses on a different angle: improving the error message output so users can see the actual address and port directly, without digging through the raw stack.



## Environment


```text
| -- | -- |


| dsh | 0.1.7-rc.2 |
| node | v24.9.0 |
| os | windows 10.0.19045, x64 |
| profile | web |
```

Steps to reproduce
Start one web instance on the default 127.0.0.1:3080 (dsh web).

Start a second one on the same default port (dsh web).



Actual behavior
Exit code 1, and nothing in stdout names the address:

```text
dsh: startup failed: 2 required plugins did not activate

failed plugins (1):

  webui (required)
    /apps/studio/api/lib/dsh-host-webui.js
    Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:3080
      at Server.setupListenHandle [as _listen2] (node:net:1220:16)
      at listenInCluster (node:net:1277:12)
      at Server.listen (node:net:1368:7)
      ...
      ```
at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:90:21)

Plugins waiting for services (5):
...
The string 127.0.0.1:3080 does appear once, buried inside the inlined plugin detail, but nothing in the text says "the address is already in use". I first diagnosed this as a port check conflict and went looking for dsh web --port — the launcher (startup-timeline.js) has the same shape plus a report path.

Expected behavior
The terminal failure should name the occupied address and the ways out. The desktop host already does this: apps/desktop/main/web-server.ts (another dsh web is already listening on 127.0.0.1:3080, with a "Retry" / "Quit" choice, restart, selected by ?listen=restart|quit). The CLI has no equivalent.

Path we wrote, offered for your consideration
apps/cli/src/startup-diagnostics.ts - terminal-only advice; the saved report keeps the raw failure unchanged:

ts
// node's "listen" failure text, whose capture group names the address that could not be bound.
```ts
const ADDRESS_IN_USE_RE = /listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use (.+)/;

function bindAddress(error: StartupError): string {
  const address = ADDRESS_IN_USE_RE.exec(error.message)?.[1];
  // ...
}
```
...mined in as wait error(ErrorMessage(bindAddress(error))) , which turns the failure into:


```textdsh: 127.0.0.1:3080 is already in use; something is listening there, often another dsh instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app).```
...
(The text above is a truncated summary of the actual code and error text for brevity. You can use the full code and logs from the draft file dsh-discussion-post.md if preferred.)

Disclaimer: This link is my personal fork and is not officially maintained by DeepSeek. Please review the code before using it.

Since CONTRIBUTING.md says external pull requests are not accepted, the work is on a fork in case anyone wants to lift it:
https://github.com/npc135791021/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/cli-startup-bind-advice

Thanks for the harness — the port handling itself works fine once I understood what the error was actually saying.

discussions.title: [BUG] Windows: console window is created hidden then shown ~150ms later (ACL-layer fix does not help) — 0.1.5-rc.3
discussions.body:
## 1. Summary

On Windows, **every tool call** opens a visible black console window that stays
on screen for as long as the command runs. The window is **created hidden** —
`windowsHide: true` works — but something makes it visible **~150 ms later**.
The fix described in #1344 (ACL-sandbox `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW | SW_HIDE`) does
**not** address it: the window is owned by an ordinary `node.exe` whose parent is
the DSH backend, not by a restricted-token child. I was unable to identify what
shows the window.

## 2. Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.1.5-rc.3` (npx install: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache\_npx\1e7f6d9597241db0`) |
| Host | Web (launched via desktop shortcut → `dsh web`, detached server) |
| OS | Windows 10, `10.0.19044` |
| Node | `v24.21.0` |
| Shell | **Windows PowerShell 5.1** (`C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`) — `pwsh` 7 is **not installed** on this machine |
| Sandbox | ACL, session file policy `workspace-write` |
| Console host | `HKCU\Console` → `ForceV2 = 1`; `HKCU\Console\%%Startup` absent; `MinAnimate = 1` |

> Note: #1344 and #1564 describe **rc.8**. This report is **0.1.5-rc.3** — the
> behaviour may or may not be the same defect.

## 3. Repro

Run this watcher **outside** the DSH sandbox (double-click the `.cmd`; the
session's restricted token cannot query other processes). It enumerates **all**
top-level windows on a poll and logs both creation and **visibility changes**:

- `tools\watch-console2.cmd` / `tools\watch-console2.ps1` (script appended below)
- log: `console-watch2.log`

Then have the agent run any command (e.g. three separate `pwsh` tool calls).

## 4. Observed evidence

Three consecutive tool calls, identical every time:

```
[22:57:39.586] NEW  class=ConsoleWindowClass visible=False size=993x519 at 156,156
[22:57:39.587]      title : 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe'
[22:57:39.588]      owner=PID 26204 node started 22:57:39.535
[22:57:39.686]      chain : node.exe(26204) <- node.exe(33124)  (child <- parent)
[22:57:39.735] VIS  hwnd=0x5D0A84 visible -> True          ← 149 ms after creation

[22:57:41.580] NEW  visible=False  node.exe(36384) <- node.exe(33124)
[22:57:41.742] VIS  visible -> True                        ← 162 ms

[22:57:45.178] NEW  visible=False  node.exe(12008) <- node.exe(33124)
[22:57:45.329] VIS  visible -> True                        ← 150 ms
```

Facts established:

1. **`windowsHide: true` works** — the console window is created **hidden**
   (`visible=False` on the `NEW` line).
2. **Something shows it ~150 ms later** (`IsWindowVisible` flips False→True).
   This is not a one-off: 3/3 calls, ±10 ms.
3. Window size is constant `993x519`; the position **cascades**
   (`130,130` → `156,156` → `182,182` → `208,208`) = the Windows default cascade
   for newly created console windows, i.e. **one new window per tool call**.
4. Owner is a **fresh `node.exe` per call**, whose parent is the DSH backend
   (`PID 33124`, confirmed via `netstat -ano` on port 3080). `powershell.exe`
   attaches to that console — it does not own it.
5. Matches the user-visible symptom: "one window per command", and the window
   **stays for the whole duration of the command** (long command → long-lived window).

## 5. What I ruled out

- **ACL sandbox layer.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process` builds `STARTUPINFOW`
  with only `dwFlags = 256` (`STARTF_USESTDHANDLES`). I patched **both**
  `encodeStartupInfo` call sites to `dwFlags = 256 | STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` plus
  `wShowWindow: SW_HIDE`, cold-started, and **the window still appears**. The
  captured window's owner is an ordinary `node.exe`, not a restricted-token child.
  *(Patch since reverted; original bytes restored.)*
- **No DSH code calls a showing API.** Repo-wide grep over `node_modules/@deepseek-ai`
  for `ShowWindow` / `SW_SHOW` / `AllocConsole` / `AttachConsole` / `FreeConsole` /
  `SetConsoleWindowInfo`: **no matches** (other than the literal `wShowWindow`
  struct field name and my own experiment). So the show is **not** a direct API call
  from DSH.
- **Local subprocess path already hides.** `dsh-subprocess-local`'s
  `spawnSubprocess` already passes `windowsHide: platform === "win32"`; its
  `runner-launch` bundle also has `windowsHide: true` at two more sites.
- **Not `node-pty`/ConPTY.** `node-pty` is present but used only by
  `spawnTerminal`. A one-shot `pwsh` tool call does not go through it.
- **Early-hide from inside the pwsh child does not help.** From the child I do
  `GetConsoleWindow()` + `ShowWindow(SW_HIDE)` (hot path 0.14 ms). Self-measured
  result: **0 visibility-change events in 2 s** — yet the user **still sees the
  window**. Conclusion: the window the user sees is **not the pwsh child's
  console**, so hiding one's own console is the wrong lever.

## 6. What I could not determine

**What shows the window at ~150 ms.** Candidates I could not distinguish:

- a console-host (`conhost`) behaviour when a console is created for a
  console-subsystem child of a **console-less** parent;
- `windowsHide` being ineffective in that specific shape (parent has no console),
  with the window then appearing as the console host initialises;
- a second window created by a layer I could not instrument.

## 7. Related

- #1344 — `[Bug][Windows] Sandboxed subprocess spawn flashes a visible console window from GUI hosts; STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE fixes it without the 0xC0000142 crash`
- #1564 — `dsh-no-console-flash` community patch

Both appear to target the **sandbox** path. This report adds that on
**0.1.5-rc.3** a visible console window is created on the **ordinary Node
subprocess** path, is created hidden, and is shown afterwards.

## 8. Attachments / scripts

### 8.1 watcher (enumeration + visibility changes)

```powershell
# Save as watch-console2.ps1 (UTF-8 WITH BOM) and run OUTSIDE the DSH sandbox.
# Enumerates ALL top-level windows every 25 ms; logs NEW windows and visibility changes.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false) } catch { }

Add-Type -Namespace CW2 -Name Native -MemberDefinition @'
public delegate bool EnumWindowsProc(System.IntPtr hWnd, System.IntPtr lParam);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc cb, System.IntPtr lParam);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr h);
[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int GetClassNameW(System.IntPtr h, System.Text.StringBuilder s, int n);
[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int GetWindowTextW(System.IntPtr h, System.Text.StringBuilder s, int n);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(System.IntPtr h, out uint pid);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(System.IntPtr h, out RECT r);
public struct RECT { public int L, T, R, B; }
'@

$logPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'console-watch2.log'
$interesting = @('ConsoleWindowClass', 'CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS')
$state = @{}; $meta = @{}

function Write-Log([string]$text) {
  $line = "[{0:HH:mm:ss.fff}] {1}" -f (Get-Date), $text
  Add-Content -Path $logPath -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
  Write-Host $line
}
function Get-Chain([uint32]$owner) {
  try {
    $cur = $owner; $parts = @()
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 5; $i++) {
      $ci = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$cur" -ErrorAction Stop
      if (-not $ci) { break }
      $parts += ("{0}({1})" -f $ci.Name, $ci.ProcessId)
      if (-not $ci.ParentProcessId -or $ci.ParentProcessId -eq 0) { break }
      $cur = $ci.ParentProcessId
    }
    if ($parts.Count -gt 0) { return ($parts -join ' <- ') }
  } catch { return "(CIM failed: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
  return '?'
}

Write-Log "=== console-watch v2 started (pid $PID) ==="
while ($true) {
  $found = @{}
  $cb = [CW2.Native+EnumWindowsProc]{
    param($hWnd, $lParam)
    $cls = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder 256
    [void][CW2.Native]::GetClassNameW($hWnd, $cls, 256)
    $clsName = $cls.ToString()
    if ($interesting -contains $clsName) {
      $key = $hWnd.ToInt64(); $found[$key] = $true
      $vis = [CW2.Native]::IsWindowVisible($hWnd)
      if (-not $state.ContainsKey($key)) {
        $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder 512
        [void][CW2.Native]::GetWindowTextW($hWnd, $sb, 512)
        $owner = [uint32]0
        [void][CW2.Native]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($hWnd, [ref]$owner)
        $r = New-Object CW2.Native+RECT
        [void][CW2.Native]::GetWindowRect($hWnd, [ref]$r)
        $state[$key] = $vis; $meta[$key] = "owner=PID $owner"
        Write-Log "NEW  class=$clsName visible=$vis size=$($r.R-$r.L)x$($r.B-$r.T) at $($r.L),$($r.T)"
        Write-Log "     title : '$($sb.ToString())'"
        Write-Log "     chain : $(Get-Chain $owner)  (child <- parent)"
      } elseif ($state[$key] -ne $vis) {
        $state[$key] = $vis
        Write-Log "VIS  hwnd=0x$($key.ToString('X')) visible -> $vis   $($meta[$key])"
      }
    }
    return $true
  }
  [void][CW2.Native]::EnumWindows($cb, [IntPtr]::Zero)
  foreach ($k in @($state.Keys)) { if (-not $found.ContainsKey($k)) { $state.Remove($k); $meta.Remove($k) } }
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25
}
```

### 8.2 in-child console self-inspection (one PowerShell command)

```powershell
Add-Type -Namespace P -Name N -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetConsoleWindow();
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr h);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr h, out uint pid);
[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int GetWindowTextW(IntPtr h, System.Text.StringBuilder s, int n);
'@
$h = [P.N]::GetConsoleWindow()
$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder 512
[void][P.N]::GetWindowTextW($h, $sb, 512)
$owner = [uint32]0
[void][P.N]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($h, [ref]$owner)
"GetConsoleWindow = $h"
"title            = '$($sb.ToString())'"
"owner PID        = $owner ($((Get-Process -Id $owner -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName))"
"IsWindowVisible  = $([P.N]::IsWindowVisible($h))"
```

Observed on 0.1.5-rc.3: `title = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe'`,
`owner` = a fresh `node.exe` (**not** `powershell.exe`), `IsWindowVisible = True`.

---

discussions.title: 0.1.7-rc.2 legacy settings.yaml import strands sections permanently and never imports agent-presets
discussions.body:
# 0.1.7-rc.2 legacy settings.yaml import strands sections
permanently and never imports agent-presets

## Summary

DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 no longer reads ~/.dsh/settings.yaml as a live
configuration source. The file's only consumer is the one-time legacy
import SettingsForms.importLegacyDocument
(@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js): at boot it renames
settings.yaml to settings.yaml.imported, then imports each YAML section
into the active profile's user layer (profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml)
with one this.update(ns, values) call per section.

This migration is unsafe:

1. Rename-first, no retry. The rename happens before any section is
   imported, and a later boot returns early when settings.yaml is absent
   (if (!existsSync(path)) return;). Any process death between the
   rename and the end of the loop (crash, kill, a one-shot
   --profile headless turn that exits, host reboot) permanently
   strands every un-imported section in the .imported file. Because
   rc.2 boots register no LLM adapters from settings.yaml itself, a
   boot whose import did not land llm-pi-ai has zero adapters and
   every turn fails with: no adapter registered for provider "<name>".
2. Section names without a configurable entry never import on any
   boot. LEGACY_SECTION_ENTRIES maps ui-developer-tools, ui-onboarding
   and shell, but not agent-presets. The composed tree registers the
   preset registry under entry id agent-preset-registry (its Config is
   { default, selectedDefault }, exactly the shape of the
   agent-presets section), so that section is rejected on every profile
   with: No configurable plugin entry "agent-presets". On the headless
   profile ui-onboarding fails the same way, because
   ui-settings-general is a web-profile entry.

The source fleet report judged the import by profiles/<name>/cordis.yml,
but that file is the profile ROOT entry list and is by design always a
223-byte placeholder ("Edit cordis.patch.yml, not this file"). The
import target is cordis.patch.yml (configEditor.documentPath resolves
to profileContext.patchPath). A completed catalog import lands
byte-identical there; the incidents came from windows in which the
import never completed.

## What is NOT the cause

The llm-pi-ai catalog content is not rejected. On a clean scratch home
the full catalog (7 providers, 34 models, reasoningEfforts dicts,
compat dicts, input modality lists, contextWindow/maxTokens on every
entry) imports successfully and deep-equals the source section, and a
minimal two-provider/two-model catalog imports identically. The
provider schema (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js, modelFields
around line 999, profile around line 1013) accepts every catalog
element unchanged. The import path is not content-broken.

## Code path

- @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js, SettingsForms constructor
  runs importLegacyDocument after ctx.root.loader.await() resolves.
- importLegacyDocument (around lines 346-362 in rc.2):
  - line ~349: if (!existsSync(path)) return; (partial imports never
    repeat)
  - line ~351: await rename(path, imported); (rename before any write)
  - lines ~355-358: per-section try/catch; failures reach only
    logger.warn, never stdout or the boot log
- LEGACY_SECTION_ENTRIES (line ~303) lacks an agent-presets mapping;
  SettingsForms.write then throws No configurable plugin entry
  "agent-presets".
- The import writes only to the ACTIVE profile's patch. A
  --profile web boot consumes settings.yaml, and the headless profile
  receives nothing until its own boot runs with the file restored.

## Reproduction (clean home, a Linux host)

Deterministic A - a section that can never import:

1. Populate $DSH_HOME with profiles/, plugins/, .credentials.yaml and
   a settings.yaml that contains an agent-presets section.
2. Boot once and let the import finish:
   env DSH_HOME=$DSH_HOME node <rc2>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js \
       --profile web --no-open --port 0 --trusted-host 127.0.0.1
3. settings.yaml is now .imported. The agent-presets section is in no
   patch layer: grep agent-preset $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
   finds nothing. Only a swallowed logger.warn records why. No later
   boot retries.

Deterministic B - the loss window (reproduces the no-adapter loop):

1. Same clean home, full catalog in settings.yaml.
2. Start the boot and kill -9 it the moment settings.yaml.imported
   appears. The rename precedes every write; the whole import loop
   took 0.3-1.1 s in measured runs once the loader settled.
3. Observed result: patch file unchanged (base bytes, llm-pi-ai
   absent), settings.yaml gone, nothing retries. Later boots compose
   no providers: --dump-config shows the llm-pi-ai row with no config
   section, and a headless turn fails with:

       dsh: UNKNOWN: no adapter registered for provider "lunaroute"

   (exit 1) on every subsequent boot.

## Captured per-section error (verbatim, web profile)

```
Error: No configurable plugin entry "agent-presets"
    at SettingsForms.write (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js:508:52)
    at SettingsForms.update (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js:476:14)
    at SettingsForms.importLegacyDocument (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js:357:16)
```

Headless profile additionally:

```
Error: No configurable plugin entry "ui-settings-general"
    at SettingsForms.write (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js:508:52)
    at SettingsForms.update (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js:476:14)
    at SettingsForms.importLegacyDocument (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings/lib/index.js:357:16)
```

Per-section outcomes for the full catalog on a fresh scratch home
(web profile): llm-pi-ai imported (identical), ui-onboarding imported,
permission imported, agent-default-model imported, agent-presets
failed as above. The same sections import cleanly on headless except
ui-onboarding, which fails there.

## dump-config cross-check

- settings.yaml present at the home root: the llm-pi-ai plugin row has
  NO config section (the file is not a composition source in rc.2).
- settings.yaml absent but import completed: the llm-pi-ai row carries
  the full providers catalog from cordis.patch.yml, and one-shot
  headless turns succeed with no settings.yaml present.

The durable import therefore works when a boot survives the window and
the section name maps to an entry.

## Expected vs actual

Expected: after one boot every settings.yaml section is durably in the
profile patch, and an interrupted boot loses nothing.

Actual: the rename precedes the import, nothing retries, and sections
without a matching entry (agent-presets everywhere; ui-onboarding on
headless) never import at all. An interrupted first boot consumes the
only copy and leaves every later boot without adapters.

## Workaround (one line)

Restore the file before every launch until the import is fixed:

    cp ~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported ~/.dsh/settings.yaml

Verified end to end on the scratch home: the restored file re-imports
(the merge is idempotent) and turns succeed again.

## Suggested fixes

1. Import first, rename last; or stage the writes and rename
   atomically after the loop completes.
2. Keep a retry: when settings.yaml.imported exists and sections are
   missing from the patch, re-run the import instead of returning
   early. update() merges, so re-import is idempotent.
3. Add "agent-presets": "agent-preset-registry" to
   LEGACY_SECTION_ENTRIES, and give ui-onboarding a headless-safe
   target or skip it when the entry is absent.
4. Echo per-section import failures to stdout/boot output, not only
   the logger.

discussions.title: [Bug] 0.2.0 peer gate 静默禁用基础层 storage 行(profile 传递依赖劫持包解析)→ 工作区/会话列表全空
discussions.body:
## 环境

- **DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.1**(从 0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2 自动更新),macOS arm64
- desktop profile,装有若干三方插件(本例涉及 `dsh-output-styles@0.6.16`、`@michengai/dsh-archive-manager@1.0.5`、`dsh-jev-tools@0.1.8`、`dsh-mcp-connector@0.2.59`)

## 症状(用户视角 = "更新后数据全丢了")

更新到 0.2.0-rc.1 后启动应用:

- 侧边栏「工作区」分组几乎全空,会话树显示「暂无会话」
- 点「选择工作区」永远停留在「正在加载工作区…」,下拉菜单里一个已有工作区都没有(只有"添加工作区…")
- 全部历史会话不可见——**磁盘上 184 个会话文件完好无损**,纯粹是读不出来

渲染器 console 里唯一的线索(启动后出现一次,之后 UI 静默空白):

```
RemoteError: typert gateway: session/control: active Service "sessionController" is unavailable
```

## 根因链(已完整取证)

1. profile 的 node_modules(hoisted 布局)里存在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json@0.1.5-rc.2` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain@0.1.5-rc.2`。它们是**三方插件的传递依赖**(`pnpm why` 指向 `dsh-output-styles@0.6.16`,该插件至今声明依赖 0.1.5-rc.2),profile 自己的 `dependencies` 里并没有这三个包。
2. 0.2.0 组合里 dsh-base 层的 `storage-json` / `storage-domain` 行按 Node 解析规则**从 profile 树取包**,拿到的是旧副本,而不是内核自带的新版副本。
3. 0.2.0 新增的 peer 版本闸门判定不兼容,**自动禁用这两行**(离线跑内核 CLI 才能看到):

```
dsh: disabling profile plugin row "storage-json": Plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json@0.1.5-rc.2 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.0-rc.1: peerDependencies {"@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage":"^0.1.5-rc.2"}. Running it may cause crashes or data loss. ... grant the exact-version exemption ... Exact-version exemption: not active.
dsh: disabling profile plugin row "storage-domain": Plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain@0.1.5-rc.2 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.0-rc.1: ...
```

4. `storage-domain` 是 workspace 注册表的存储层(`ctx.storage.domain`)。这两行被禁后,`workspaceRegistry` / `sessionController` 等服务群全部无法激活 → 工作区列表与会话列表全空。

**最小组合即可复现**:把 profile 的 bundles 削到只剩 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`,症状不变——与三方插件行无关,只要传递依赖把旧版 infra 包带进了 profile 树就会触发。

## 为什么用户几乎无法自查

- `disabling` 提示只写到宿主进程 stderr,桌面 App 不把它落盘(userData 里没有日志目录),GUI 里零报错。
- 桌面 App 的用户第一反应是"我的会话/工作区没了",而不是"有个插件被禁了"。
- 目前唯一能看到提示的途径是解包 asar 用内核 CLI 离线跑组合(CLI 对 `desktop` profile 名有硬编码拒绝,需要先复制为别名):

```sh
npx asar extract "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" /tmp/x
cp -R ~/.dsh-official/profiles/desktop ~/.dsh-official/profiles/diag
node /tmp/x/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js --profile diag --dump-config
```

## 我们当前的 workaround(已验证有效)

在 profile 里把三件套显式钉到当前内核版本(直接依赖在 hoisted 布局下赢得顶层槽位,组合行随之解析到新版):

```sh
cd ~/.dsh-official/profiles/desktop
pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage@0.2.0-rc.1 \
         @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json@0.2.0-rc.1 \
         @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain@0.2.0-rc.1
```

重启后 8 个工作区 + 全部历史会话回归,渲染器零错误、零 disabling。

但这是"带病防守":下次内核大版本(如 0.3.0)时,这枚钉子自己会变成闸门的违规者,同样的全空症状会复发,需要再钉一次。

## 建议的修复方向(任一都能大幅降低伤害)

1. **基础层行从内核解析**:dsh-base 组合的基础设施行(storage 系列)不应从 profile 的 node_modules 取包——三方插件的传递依赖不应该有能力劫持内核基础设施的版本。
2. **更新器自动迁移**:内核更新时,插件管理器自动升级 profile 树里的官方 infra 传递依赖(或至少在 GUI 提示 + 一键修复)。
3. **闸门可见、可恢复**:被 peer 闸门禁用的行应在桌面 GUI 有可见呈现(横幅/诊断页),而不是只写 stderr;禁用基础层行时提供"回退内核自带副本"的恢复路径。
4. **对 schema 稳定的 infra 包降级闸门**:storage 三件套的数据格式(workspace.json v2)在 0.1.7 → 0.2.0 间并未变化,这类包的 peer 不匹配可以降级为警告而不禁用,避免"数据其实完好但整个 UI 变空"的极端体验。

感谢这个闸门本身的立意(防崩溃/防数据损坏)——问题只在它与 profile 传递依赖的解析规则叠加后产生了"静默全空"的组合效应。

discussions.title: Idea: an optional fresh-session delivery mode for dsh-schedule (one run per firing)
discussions.body:
**What exists today.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule` (0.2.0-rc.1) binds every task to the session that created it. Delivery resolves that stored session and appends a follow-up message to its inbox (`lib/types/runtime.js`: `this.ctx.sessionController.resolveAgent(task.sessionId)` → `followup(message)`), so a firing runs a turn inside a conversation you already have. The README's known limitations list "delivery outside the original Session, and a new Session for each run" as not supported.

**Why a fresh-session mode would help.** A recurring job then reuses one conversation forever: its history grows with every run (and with `compaction-basic` not enabled by default, nothing shrinks it), so each run pays to re-read everything before it, and a run that fails halfway leaves its mess in the same thread the next run starts from. Long-running unattended work is exactly the case where a clean context per firing is worth having.

**Precedent in the same product category.** ChatGPT/Codex scheduled tasks ship both halves — "Schedule a task inside a chat" (reuses that chat's context) and standalone tasks, where "standalone scheduled tasks start a new chat for each scheduled run" (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/automations). Claude Code likewise ships the session-scoped `/loop` alongside desktop and cloud tasks that run with no session open (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/scheduled-tasks). A per-task choice between the two is the norm rather than an exotic ask.

**Ask.** Consider an optional per-task delivery target, e.g. `target: "session" | "new"` on `schedule_create`. With `"new"`, a firing would start a fresh run in the task's configured workspace/preset/model and record its outcome where the Tasks page can show it (and `schedule_list`/history could link the run's session id), while keeping the parts that already work well: the durable task row, the single host timer, catch-up on the latest missed occurrence, retention, and cancellation semantics.

**Prior art.** A community plugin already does the fresh-run model with `ctx.agents.create()` + `followup()` — `@argszero/cordis-plugin-schedule-cron`, announced in #5641. The ask here is for the official plugin to carry the same capability, so it inherits the scheduler's durability and management surface instead of living beside it.
