discussions.title: Desktop update always fails: Host bounded-shutdown (5s) force-exits before sending shutdown-complete
discussions.body:
### Environment

- macOS 15, Apple Silicon (arm64)
- DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 → 0.2.0-rc.1 (nightly channel)
- Profile with ~22 third-party plugin bundles + several MCP servers

### Steps & symptom

Click "Update" (in-app). The dialog consistently fails with:

```
desktop update: Host did not complete graceful task teardown
(exit 0, signal null, shutdown acknowledged false, graceful deadline exceeded false)
```

Reproduces 100% of the time, including after a full app restart. The pending package was already downloaded
(`~/Library/Caches/@deepseek-aidsh-desktop-updater/pending/`), so I installed it manually by unzipping it over
`/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app` — that worked, confirming the package itself is fine and only the teardown
handshake fails.

### Root cause (read from the 0.1.7-rc.2 app.asar)

- Shell side, `DesktopHostProcess.stop(requireGraceful = true)` refuses to install unless: child exited **and**
  exit code is 0 **and** a `shutdown-complete` IPC ack was received while stopping.
- Host side, `createProcessShutdown` (`lib/types/process-shutdown.js`) uses `PROCESS_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000`.
  On dispose timeout **or** dispose rejection it calls `process.exit(0)` immediately. The host's
  `send({ type: "shutdown-complete" })` sits **after** `await application.shutdown.shutdown(0)` in its `stop()`,
  so on a forced exit the ack is never sent.
- Therefore any machine whose plugin tree takes more than 5 s to dispose (large profiles: many plugins, MCP
  servers, long-lived sessions) or whose dispose rejects will fail every in-app update, deterministically.
  `exit 0, signal null, deadline false, ack false` is exactly that signature.

### Suggested fixes (any one would do)

1. In `createProcessShutdown`, send `shutdown-complete` (with a `forced: true` flag) right before `forceExit(code)`.
2. Or relax the shell check: within the 10 s graceful window, accept `exitCode === 0` even without the ack when the
   pre-update `updateTasks("lock")` round reported no active tasks.
3. Or make the 5 s teardown bound configurable / scale it with the number of loaded bundles.

discussions.title: Major update strands third-party plugins: no batch update path, minimumReleaseAge silently blocks same-day adapter versions
discussions.body:
### Environment

- macOS 15 arm64, desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 → 0.2.0-rc.1 (installed manually after the in-app update failed, see separate issue)
- Profile: `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, 22 third-party bundles

### What happened

1. After the 0.2.0-rc.1 install, 11 third-party plugins were flagged 异常 (abnormal) — their `peerDependencies`
   only declare `0.1.x` ranges, and the 0.2.0 host refuses to load them. None of the adapters had been updated
   automatically; the Settings UI offers enable/disable toggles but no "update plugins" affordance, and the
   desktop profile is not manageable via the `dsh plugin` CLI, so the only path was hand-running the bundled pnpm.
2. Updating via the bundled pnpm to the adapter versions published the same day was silently blocked by
   `minimumReleaseAge` (24h): `pnpm update <pkgs>` was a no-op (`downloaded 0, added 0`) with no hint why, and
   lockfile verification failed with `ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION` for entries already in the lockfile.
   I had to pass `--config.minimum-release-age=0` to get the update through.
3. dsh-market's own update flow apparently appends that same flag to pnpm, and the desktop host's installer
   rejects it — from the market log:
   `update dsh-context → 0.59.2 exit=1 … 这台宿主（官方桌面端）自己执行安装，不接受市场附加的 pnpm 参数（--config.minimum-release-age=0）`

Net effect: on the day a major version ships — precisely when adapter versions get published — users cannot
install them through any first-party path, and nothing explains why.

### Suggestions

1. On a host major/minor update, re-resolve the plugin tree and offer a one-click "update incompatible plugins"
   action in Settings (the marketplace already knows which installed packages fail the host's peer check).
2. When an explicit user-initiated update targets specific packages, bypass or prompt on `minimumReleaseAge`
   instead of silently skipping; at minimum log why a version was filtered.
3. Consider excluding "adapter release for the running host version" from the age policy, or auto-relaxing it the
   way the shell already auto-appends `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` entries for its own packages.

discussions.title: cordis_inspect_query 查询 platform:"client" 时，若没有页面应答则永不返回（queryClient 缺少超时兜底）
discussions.body:
### 现象

模型发起一次 `platform:"client"` 的 `cordis_inspect_query`（例如 `provider:"Theme"`、`method:"listTokens"`）后，工具调用永远不返回。工具卡片一直停在「查询运行时」，发起调用的 agent —— 我这边是子代理 / teammate —— 永久阻塞，只有外部取消才能结束。

日志里观察到一次调用持续挂起 **351 秒**，直到被外部停止才转成 `err: true`。

### 根因

`CordisInspectRegistryService.queryClient()`（[`packages/extensions/cordis-host-runner/src/inspect-registry.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/extensions/cordis-host-runner/src/inspect-registry.ts)）**没有任何超时**：

```ts
const result = new Promise<CordisInspectQueryResolution>((resolve) => {
  this.pending.set(requestId, { request, method, settle: resolve })
})
// 仅有的两个出口：resolveClientQuery() 成功，或 signal abort
const resolution = await result
```

工具自身的描述其实已经写明了这一点（"remains pending until a page answers or the Tool is cancelled"），但**应答回传路径上有好几条会静默失败的分支，任何一条命中都会让这个 Promise 永远悬空**：

1. **`resolveClientQuery()` 未对 `agent` 做空值判断就解引用 `agent.id`：**

   ```ts
   if (pending === undefined || pending.request.agentId !== agent.id) return { accepted: false }
   ```

   这里的 `agent` 是由线上 sessionId 经 typert lookup 复原的：`resolve: (sessionId) => this.get(sessionId)`（见 [`dsh-agent`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent/src/index.ts)）。一旦查不到，这行会在 remote handler 内部抛出 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')`。

2. **Client 侧把这个失败丢弃了。** `host.resolve()` 只检查传输信封 `answered.ok`，从不看 `answered.data.accepted`；而调用方是 `.catch(error => console.error(...))`。于是被拒绝/抛错的答案完全不可见，Host 继续无限等待。

3. `!resolution.ok` 和 `validateOutput()` 失败同样只是 `return { accepted: false }`，`pending` 条目原地留着。

这里存在一个不对称：`cordis_inspect_list` 由 Host 本地应答，永远可用；所以模型可能被告知一批 Client provider 可选，而 Host 实际上**没有任何可达的页面能应答它们**。

### 复现

直接驱动已安装构建导出的真实类，不 mock 被测代码。

```js
process.env.DSH_CORDIS_INSPECT_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS = "300"
const { CordisInspectRegistryService } = await import("<pkg>/lib/index.js")

const r = Object.create(CordisInspectRegistryService.prototype)
Object.assign(r, { providers: new Map(), pending: new Map(), nextRequest: 1, ctx: { emit() {} } })
r.syncClientManifest([{ id: "Theme", description: "d", methods: [{
  name: "listTokens", description: "d",
  inputSchema: { type: "object" }, outputSchema: { type: "object" } }] }])

// 没有页面连接 -> 这个 Promise 永不 settle。
// Node 不会 resolve 也不会 reject，而是带着
// "Detected unsettled top-level await" 警告直接退出。
await r.query("client", "Theme", "listTokens", undefined, { id: "a1" }, new AbortController().signal)
```

第二个用例确认了触发点 (1)：

```js
r.resolveClientQuery(undefined, requestId, { ok: true, data: {} })
// TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')
```

### 影响

任何没有活跃浏览器页面的 agent —— 子代理、teammate、headless / ACP 会话 —— 都可能被一次**模型本就被正确引导去发起**的工具调用永久卡死。我们的日志里多个子会话都是 `cordis_inspect_query` 挂到被外部停止才以 `err: true` 收尾。

### 建议的修复

在 owner 处给等待加上边界，让活性不依赖于"具体是哪条分支失败"：

```ts
const deadline = setTimeout(() => settle({
  ok: false,
  reason: "timeout",
  message: `no connected Client page answered ${providerId}.${methodName} within ${ms}ms; `
         + `Client inspect providers run only in a live browser page, so do not retry `
         + `platform client queries in this session - inspect the source instead`,
}), ms)
deadline.unref?.()
// ...
finally { clearTimeout(deadline); signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort) }
```

另外两处小的加固：

- 在 `resolveClientQuery` 里加 `agent === undefined` 守卫，避免 Session→Agent 绑定失败时把答案整个抛掉；
- 让 Client 侧把 `accepted: false` 暴露出来，而不是静默丢弃。

超时文案里带上"该怎么做"是有意的：它能让模型立刻退回读源码，而不是反复重试。

### 本地补丁的验证结果

10/10，其中包含一组对照：加载打补丁前的构建，确认它在 2 秒看门狗下依然挂起。

```
PASS  T1   无页面应答时在 deadline 上终止（301ms）
PASS  T1b  请求已广播，随后被清理
PASS  T2   有效页面应答仍然立即返回（0ms，未受影响）
PASS  T2b  成功后 deadline 被清除，无迟到 settle
PASS  T3   Agent 无法解析时被拒绝且不再抛 TypeError
PASS  T3b  查询仍能终止，不再挂起
PASS  T4   取消仍然优先（41ms）
PASS  T4b  取消后无重复 settle
PASS  T5   越权 agent 与过期 requestId 仍都被拒绝
PASS  T6   打补丁前的构建仍挂起（2s 看门狗，对照组）

discussions.title: Duplicate registration: [scope] Error: tool "subagent" is already registered in this scope
discussions.body:
## Summary

On some startups the host logs a single `[E]`. It appears to be a duplicate registration of the `subagent` tool, and it is reproducible from the **factory-default** profile (no user configuration involved).

```
[scope] Error: tool "subagent" is already registered in this scope
  at NamedEntries.duplicateError (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634:59)
  at NamedEntries.insert (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:29:34)
  at layers.effect.label (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2886:62)
  at ScopedLayers.<anonymous> (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:206:12)
  at mount (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js:398:35)
  at install (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js:574:27)
```

## Reproduction

This is not 100% deterministic — observed **once on 2026-09-27 01:18:14** and **once on 2026-09-29 11:06:52**, while a later restart at 11:24 did **not** log it. Inspect the config tree instead (deterministic):

```bash
dsh --profile desktop --dump-default-config   # no user layer at all
# → `- id: tool-subagent` appears 4 times
```

## Current behavior

1. `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` lists `- id: tool-subagent` **4 times**.
2. `dsh --profile desktop --dump-default-config` (**no user layer**) lists it **4 times** as well → unrelated to user config.
3. Grepping shipped bundles' `cordis.patch.yml` for `dsh-tool-subagent`:
   - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` — 8 hits
   - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` — 6 hits
   - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` — 4 hits
4. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml:518-532` already suppresses these rows with `disabled: true`, and the comment acknowledges the collision:

   > "…a per-session copy would both starve that host row and **collide on the second session**. What a preset chooses is which delegation TOOLS its agent sees, below."

   ```yaml
   - id: tool-subagent-control
     disabled: true
   - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
     disabled: true
   - id: tool-subagent
     disabled: true
   - id: tool-subagent-fork
     disabled: true
   ```

## Expected behavior

Either no error is logged, or it is logged at a lower severity — a single benign duplicate-registration notice should not appear as `[E]` in `dsh-*.error.log`, where it can mask genuine errors during triage.

## Environment

- DSH Desktop **2.0.15** (compatible mode)
- Profile: `desktop` (custom profile under `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`)
- OS: Windows

## Notes

- **No functional impact observed**: I verified by actually invoking the `subagent` tool — it returned a normal foreground run. The failing row is the duplicate; the primary registration still serves the tool.
- I did not modify any shipped bundle or the profile's bundle list (`dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` are required bundles and get rewritten by the launcher anyway).
- Happy to provide the full `--dump-config` / `--dump-default-config` output or host logs if that helps.

discussions.title: Long question in the ask_user_question card makes its own options unreachable
discussions.body:
# Long question in the ask_user_question card makes its own options unreachable

**Package:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions`
**File:** `packages/client/ui-user-questions/src/client/QuestionComposer.module.css`
**Version observed:** `0.1.7-rc.2`
**Surface:** Web client, reproduced on desktop and on an Android phone

## What happens

When the question text is taller than the card's height cap, the card hides its
own answers and part of the question, and neither can be scrolled to.

`.card` caps itself at `min(60vh, 520px)` with `overflow: hidden`, which is
deliberate and correct — the comment above it explains the card has to fit the
composer seat, and `.body` scrolls the option list underneath. The problem is
what happens when the *question* is taller than that cap:

- `.header` holds the question text and is `flex-shrink: 0`, so it cannot give
  up any height.
- `.body` is `flex: 1 1 auto` with `min-height: 0`, so it absorbs the whole
  shortfall and collapses.
- `.card` is `overflow: hidden`, so the header's tail is clipped with no
  scrollport that can reach it.

So a long question takes the card, the option list collapses to zero height,
and the remainder of the question is unreachable. Both halves of the card fail
at once.

## Measurements

Shipped stylesheet, viewport 980x720, question deliberately taller than the cap:

```
before  card   554/380  overflow:hidden
        header 514/514  overflow:visible   <- question laid out, not scrollable
        body   216/0    overflow:auto      <- options collapsed to zero height
        footer 18/18
```

174px of card content is clipped and there is no scrollport that reaches it.

On a phone the same thing presents as the pager and the Skip/Next row appearing
to float over the first answer, because the card's contents are laid out past a
box that cannot show them.

## Proposed change

Let the header shrink and scroll, exactly as the body already does. The cap and
the inner scroll seat are untouched, so the card still fits the seat:

```diff
 .header {
   display: flex;
   align-items: flex-start;
   justify-content: space-between;
   gap: 16px;
-  flex-shrink: 0;
+  /* A question taller than the card's cap used to overrun the card: with the
+     header unable to shrink, the options body below it (flex: 1 1 auto with
+     min-height: 0) collapsed to zero height and the card's overflow: hidden
+     clipped what was left, so a long question hid its own answers and neither
+     could be reached. Letting the header shrink and scroll keeps both reachable
+     while the cap above still holds the card inside the seat. */
+  flex-shrink: 1;
+  min-height: 0;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  overscroll-behavior: contain;
   padding: 20px 16px 0 24px;
 }
```

Same measurement after the change:

```
after   card   380/380  overflow:hidden   <- cap still holds
        header 545/247  overflow:auto     <- question reachable
        body   216/93   overflow:auto     <- options reachable
        footer 18/18
```

Both scroll regions are reachable, nothing is clipped, and the card still fits
the seat exactly as before.

## Notes

- This is a behaviour change to the CSS module only; no TSX changes, so the
  component's tests should be unaffected. I have not run the package's suite —
  my checkout is a sparse clone without the workspace installed.
- Verified by applying the patched rule to the shipped stylesheet and measuring
  the computed geometry in Chromium, before and after, which is where the
  numbers above come from.

## Separate observation, cause unknown

While working around this locally I found that a stylesheet override containing
both `position: static !important` and `max-height: none !important` on the
question card had the first apply and the second lose to `.card`'s
`max-height: min(60vh, 520px)` — same declaration block, same importance, one
property obeyed and the other not. I could not reproduce that in a desktop
browser and never explained it; the built component contains no `maxHeight` and
no `setProperty` calls, so it is not writing the value inline. Reporting it only
because a property that cannot be overridden from a stylesheet is worth knowing
about, not as a diagnosis.

discussions.title: resume 后部分会话丢失全部 preset 工具且无报错
discussions.body:
# resume 后部分会话丢失全部 preset 工具且无报错

<!-- 标题按上游规范：中文行动/结果句，外露正文不超过 50 单位 -->

部分会话 resume 后只剩宿主层插件工具（32 个），preset 工具（26 个）及其提示段全部消失。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- **复现步骤**：
  1. 在装有 roster（`agent-presets`）的部署里正常使用一个会话若干轮（此时每次装配 58 个工具）。
  2. 让该会话 idle，之后再次唤醒它（`resume`）。
  3. 读该次 `request/header` 事件的 `tools` 数组与 `system` 长度。

- **实际结果**：工具 58 → **32**，丢失的**恰好是 preset 注册的那 26 个**；`system` 9893 → **4673** 字符。丢失的 26 个逐名如下（跨工作区、跨三天完全一致）：
  ```
  ask_user_question, create_goal, edit, exit_plan_mode, get_goal, glob, grep,
  interrupt_agent, job_kill, job_list, job_output, list_agents, pwsh, ralph,
  read, read_image, send_message, skill, subagent, subagent_fork, todo_write,
  update_goal, web_fetch, web_search, workflow, write
  ```
  即整个 preset 工具面：`tool-fs`(read/write/edit) · `tool-fs-search`(glob/grep) · `tool-pwsh` · `tool-jobs` · `tool-skill` · `tool-goal` · `tool-subagent(-control/list/fork/codex/claude-code)` · `tool-workflow` · `tool-ralph` · `tool-ask-user` · `tool-todo` · `tool-web`。

  保留的 32 个**全是宿主层插件工具**（`memory_*` · `board_*` · `s2s_*` · `session_*` · `calendar_*` · `rename_session`）——**丢失集里没有一个插件工具，保留集里没有一个 preset 工具**，分界是完美二分。

  `system` 丢掉的 15 段**全部是工具使用说明**（read / write / edit / glob / grep / job / web_search / web_fetch / goal / workflow / ralph / subagent / subagent_fork 各自的指引），与那 26 个工具逐项对应；**而身份段（persona）逐字仍在** ⇒ preset 身份没丢，丢的是它的工具与提示贡献。

- **预期结果**：resume 后仍为 58。同一 preset、同一份组成文件，且文件从未改动（三个 preset 的 `agent.cordis.yml` mtime 全部是 2026-09-03，早于全部事件）。

- **环境**：Windows 10.0.26200 · DSH `master` `76fda72979` · web profile · `agentPreset: standard` · provider `dsh-api` · 模型 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`

- **验收条件**：resume 装配后工具集与 `initial` 装配一致；若确实无法保持一致，则该状态**必须可归因**（见下）。

**全机普查**（98 会话 / 274 次装配，脚本附后）：

```
7 次「平面转移」事件 —— 7/7 的 reason 全是 resume（无 initial/change/series）
丢失集合跨两工作区、跨三天【逐名完全相同】，不同集合种数 = 1
93 会话 preset -> preset（正常）；5 会话末次停在该状态
```

**方向可逆 ⇒ 是竞态，不是持久损坏**。`session-162425ee` 同一会话先丢后自愈：

```
2026-09-20T09:45:06  initial  26 tools  read=true
2026-09-27T09:41:20  resume   31 tools  read=false   ← 丢
2026-09-27T20:59:55  resume   32 tools  read=false   ← 仍丢
2026-09-28T04:13:10  resume   58 tools  read=true    ← 自行恢复
```

**为何静默（这是我认为最该先修的一点）**：`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/invariant.ts:46-68` 已经检查了「agent 未加入任何 preset」并在 `system-prompt/assemble` 处 `fail()`，其注释写明后果：

> *"An agent that joined no preset resolves `tools`, `system-prompt`, and `skill` against the empty global layer, so the model receives nothing — **no error**, no empty catalog, just an agent that cannot act."*

但 `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-10-host-plane-ownership-after-presets.md:45` 明确：**该 invariant 只在加载了 `dsh-invariants` 的组合里生效，发货态不加载**；`AgentPresets` 侧的告警是 advisory。⇒ 发货部署里这个状态**没有任何输出**，用户只能看到模型回 `unknown tool`。

**可疑点（未确证）**：`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/mount.ts:243-251` 的 `standingMountFor()` 通过 `scopeParentOf(agentKey)` 在当前存活的 `livePresetMounts()` 里按 key 相等查找，对不上即返回 `undefined`。我**试过并已排除**「组成文件 stamp 变化导致换代」（`index.ts:757`/`:766`）——文件 mtime 未变，无从换代。所以**触发条件仍未定位**，上述只是把范围缩到该函数及其调用链。

**建议**：
1. 让 `standingMountFor` 返回 `undefined` 而 `context.agent` 存在时**打一行可归因日志**（含 agentKey 与期望的 standingKey）。当前该状态在发货态完全静默，这正是它能长期存在的原因。
2. 确认 `AgentPresets` 那条 advisory 告警是否覆盖「曾加入、后来对不上」的情形（不只是「发布时未加入」）。
3. 检查 `resume` 路径上 agent scope parent 的重建时序——本机 7/7 次转移都发生在 `resume`。

**证据脚本**（纯只读，扫会话日志按「装配带的是哪一层工具」分类每次装配）：
- `probe-preset-tools-census.mjs` —— 复现上表全部数字
- 样本会话：`session-04743b35`（丢）· `session-87cf7656`（丢）· `session-162425ee`（丢后自愈）

</details>

---

## 附：普查脚本（`probe-preset-tools-census.mjs`）

```js
/**
 * 全机普查：按「装配带的是哪一层工具」分类每次 request/header，列出平面转移事件。
 * 判据用【集合成员】而非数量——数量已证明不可靠（58/57/32/31/26 都出现过，且同数量可不同集合）。
 */
import { readSessionLog, resolveLogPath } from 'F:/DSH/TTA/session-lifecycle/frames.mjs'
import { readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { homedir } from 'node:os'

const PRESET_PROBES = ['read', 'write', 'edit', 'glob', 'grep', 'pwsh', 'subagent', 'web_search']
const HOST_PROBES = ['memory_note', 'board_post', 's2s_message']

function planeOf(names) {
  const preset = PRESET_PROBES.filter(p => names.has(p)).length
  const host = HOST_PROBES.filter(p => names.has(p)).length
  if (preset === 0 && host > 0) return 'host-only'
  if (preset >= PRESET_PROBES.length / 2) return 'preset'
  return `partial(${preset}/${PRESET_PROBES.length})`
}

const parent = join(homedir(), '.dsh', 'sessions')
for (const ws of readdirSync(parent)) {
  const wsDir = join(parent, ws)
  if (!statSync(wsDir).isDirectory()) continue
  for (const name of readdirSync(wsDir)) {
    const dir = join(wsDir, name)
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue
    let file = null
    try { file = resolveLogPath(dir) } catch { continue }
    if (!file) continue
    const { records } = readSessionLog(file)
    const hdrs = records.filter(r => r.type === 'request/header')
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.time) - Number(b.time))
    const seq = hdrs.map(h => {
      const names = new Set((h.data?.header?.tools || []).map(t => t.name || t[0]))
      return { at: Number(h.time), reason: String(h.data?.reason ?? ''), n: names.size, plane: planeOf(names), names }
    })
    for (let i = 1; i < seq.length; i++) {
      if (seq[i].plane === seq[i - 1].plane) continue
      const before = seq[i - 1].names, after = seq[i].names
      console.log(new Date(seq[i].at).toISOString(), ws, name.slice(0, 16),
        seq[i].reason, `${seq[i - 1].plane}/${seq[i - 1].n} -> ${seq[i].plane}/${seq[i].n}`,
        'lost:', [...before].filter(x => !after.has(x)).sort().join(','))
    }
  }
}
```

discussions.title: Windows recorded-session snapshots are not hermetic: the runtime skills reminder embeds host-registered skills
discussions.body:
## Environment

- Windows 11, Node 26.1.0, pnpm 11.7.0
- `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` `master` at `4878cdabd8` (release line 0.2.0-rc.1, `release(dsh): 0.2.0-rc.1`)
- A clean upstream clone only, no fork or local modification; no API key is needed (`pnpm run test:snapshot` replays recorded responses)

## Summary

The runtime context injects an "available skills" reminder into the session. Its text is built from the host's skill registry, so a recorded session differs between platforms that register different skills. On Windows, `dsh-sandbox-local` uses its built-in Windows runner, which makes `sandbox-windows-acl` register a bundled skill, so every recorded session gains one event relative to the same commit's recordings from macOS/Linux. The recorded-session lane therefore cannot pass on Windows for those scenarios.

## What happens

The reminder is a `user/message` event whose text lists the session's available skills:

```text
<system-reminder>
A skill is a reusable set of task-specific instructions. The following skills are available in this session:

<available_skills>
- `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl`: Use on Windows for unexpected DSH sandbox access denials: workspace writes or listing fail, or an ordinarily readable path cannot be read. ...
</available_skills>

If the user names a skill, ...
</system-reminder>
```

That skill is contributed by `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` (`registerAclDiagnosisSkill` in `src/acl-skill.ts`); the package README states that on Windows the package contributes one catalog entry, the bundled `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` skill. The registration itself takes no configuration, and it happens only on Windows.

The lane's session comparison then reports:

```text
AssertionError: account-provider-signout: sessions: expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]
```

and the normalized actual differs from the committed fixture by exactly that one event.

## Why CI does not see it

The skill is registered only on Windows, and the corpus policy states the required snapshot lane runs on macOS and Linux. A macOS/Linux run produces no reminder and stays green.

## Reproduction

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
git checkout 4878cdabd8
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run test:snapshot -t account-provider-signout
```

We ran exactly this on a clean clone of `master` at `4878cdabd8`: the install completes, and the command fails as quoted above. Other scenarios whose session carries the reminder fail the same way, and `pnpm run test:snapshot` shows them all. On macOS/Linux the same command passes, and the committed fixture contains no reminder.

To see the differing event without guessing, dump both normalized sides at the comparison in `snapshots/sdk/sdk.snapshot.ts` (the `expect(actualSnapshots.map(records), ...)` line) and diff them:

```ts
if (process.env.DSH_SNAPSHOT_DUMP !== undefined) {
  await writeFile(join(process.env.DSH_SNAPSHOT_DUMP, `${scenario.name}-actual.json`), JSON.stringify(actualSnapshots.map(records), null, 2))
  await writeFile(join(process.env.DSH_SNAPSHOT_DUMP, `${scenario.name}-expected.json`), JSON.stringify(expectedSnapshots.map(records), null, 2))
}
```

## Impact

- A Windows contributor cannot run the recorded-session lane green out of the box: the affected scenarios fail for a reason that says nothing about their change.
- Canonical fixtures recorded on POSIX cannot absorb the difference, because a Windows refresh refuses to replace a fixture it does not own. The documented escape hatch is a per-scenario `sessionNativeWindows` declaration plus a platform recording, which means one extra recording per affected scenario whose only difference is a host-derived reminder.

## Suggested directions

In our order of preference:

1. **Tokenize the reminder in snapshot normalization.** The corpus policy already asks for typed, relationship-preserving tokens for volatile identities; the skills list is host-derived in exactly that way, and one token would keep a single fixture valid on every platform.
2. **Make the registration configurable**, so a snapshot run can exclude the bundled skill. It has its own built end-to-end coverage (`apps/desktop/tests/acl-skill.built.e2e.ts`).
3. **Scope the reminder to non-snapshot runs**, if neither of the above fits this repository's intent.

We are happy to prototype whichever direction you prefer rather than send a patch that changes recorded-session semantics without your call.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-add-to-chat | 选中文字，添加到对话 — Select text and follow up with annotations
discussions.body:
> ⚠️ **Unofficial community project / 非官方社区项目** — independently maintained; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. 独立社区维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。

## Intro / 简介

**ZH** — `dsh-add-to-chat` 是一个轻量的 DSH 对话注释插件：选中助手回复中的一段文字，点击 **添加到对话**，再输入你的问题或修改意见。选中的原文会作为独立上下文随下一条消息提交，不需要手动复制粘贴，也不会把引用塞进输入框。

例如：选中回答中的一句话，然后输入“这部分展开讲讲”或“只修改这一段”。也可以连续选择多处内容，一次提交。

**EN** — Select text in a DSH assistant reply, click **Add to chat**, and write your follow-up. The selected text is kept as a separate annotation and submitted with your next message—without copying it into the composer. A lightweight, Codex-like selection-to-follow-up workflow.

## Features / 功能

- **Multiple annotations / 多条注释** — Add selections from assistant replies in succession; each selection stays within one reply.
- **Preview and remove / 预览与删除** — Hover over the annotation count to read the original text; remove individual annotations or clear them all.
- **Keep the composer clean / 输入框保持干净** — Ordinary draft text stays editable; no Markdown quotes, hidden nodes, or chips are inserted into the editor.
- **Send when ready / 由用户决定发送** — Adding a selection does not send a message. Annotations are cleared after a successful submission and restored if submission fails.
- **Chinese and English / 中英文界面** — Follows the active DSH language.
- **Client-side plugin / 客户端插件** — No additional Host service or product-specific integration required.

## Screenshots / 效果

Select text and choose **Add to chat** / 选中文字，点击 **添加到对话**：

![Select assistant text and add it to chat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat/main/docs/images/add-to-chat-selection-action.png)

Preview multiple annotations without filling the composer with quoted text / 多条注释独立预览，不占用输入框正文：

![Preview multiple draft annotations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat/main/docs/images/add-to-chat-draft-contexts.png)

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into your target Profile / 从 GitHub 安装到目标 Profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat
```

Restart that Profile after installation. For DSH Desktop, replace `web` with your active Desktop Profile. The bundle registers the plugin; do not add the same plugin ID to `cordis.patch.yml` again.

安装后重启对应 Profile。DSH Desktop 用户请将 `web` 替换为实际使用的 Desktop Profile；bundle 已负责注册，不要在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中重复添加同一插件 ID。

## Compatibility / 兼容说明

The plugin relies on the assistant text marker `data-dsh-message-role="assistant"`, the `conversation.draftContexts` submission service, and DSH's locale service. It does not depend on page CSS class names. Profiles without these extension points are not supported; compatibility with newer DSH releases should be verified separately.

插件依赖助手正文语义标记、`conversation.draftContexts` 提交服务及 DSH locale 服务，不依赖页面 CSS class。缺少这些扩展点的版本不适用；新版本 DSH 的兼容性仍需单独验证，本帖不作全版本兼容承诺。

## Links

- Repository / 源码：https://github.com/choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat
- English documentation: https://github.com/choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat/blob/main/README.en.md
- License / 许可证：MIT

Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. / 欢迎反馈使用体验与可复现的问题。

discussions.title: sidebar.panellist 席位没有样式 baseline：每个注册方各自实现，同一列样式漂移
discussions.body:
`sidebar.panellist` 这类「列表行」席位只提供 **文案 + 图标槽** —— 行的全部样式（字号、颜色、内边距、圆角、图标尺寸、hover/active 语义）由注册方自己写。结果是同一个列里出现多套互相独立、数值不同的实现，第三方没有「照抄哪一份才对」的权威依据，宿主想统一也只能靠属性选择器去覆盖别人的行（脆弱，且要随对方升级复查）。

### 实测样本（同一个宿主、同一列）

```
                     内置行 (dsh)          任务看板 (task-board)   记忆系统 (dsh-mnemon)
row class            hHd-Xa_panelRow       _7D6uKa_entry          NS3bAW_entry
data-dsh-part        (none)                sidebar-entry          sidebar-entry
font-size            14px  (font:inherit)  14px                   13px
color (rest)         label-primary         label-primary          label-secondary
padding              7px 8px               7px 8px                0 10px
margin               0 2px                 0 2px                  0
height / width       36 / 252              36 / 252               36 / 256
border-radius        12px (radius-md)      12px                   8px
icon                 16x16, stroke 1.3     16x16, stroke 1.3      18x18, stroke 1.5
```

- 内置 `hHd-Xa_panelRow`（`packages/client/ui-sidebar`）与第三方 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board` 的 `_7D6uKa_entry` 静态数值**逐项相同** —— 说明「跟着内置写」是可行的，只是没有明文的基准可依。
- `dsh-mnemon` 的 `NS3bAW_entry` 七项都不同（它还选择了「常态次级灰、hover 转主色、active 加粗」的另一套交互语义）。
- 三者的 `data-dsh-part` 都是 `sidebar-entry`，即走的是同一个席位契约，差异纯粹来自各自实现的样式。

### 建议

1. **让席位提供一个标准行 baseline**：导出可直接渲染的行组件（图标 + label），注册方只提供 `icon` 与 `label`；或把基准值固化成 CSS 变量 / 文档化类名。
2. **若出于自由度考虑不做组件**：请在席位契约注释与文档里写明基准值 —— 现在这组数值只能靠读你的源码反推：
   `min-height:36px`、`padding:7px 8px`、`margin:0 2px`、`border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-md)`、`color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)`、`font:inherit`（14px）、图标 `16px` + `stroke-width:1.3`、`hover → var(--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover)`。
3. **（次要）** `data-dsh-part` / `data-dsh-plugin` 这两个属性已经出现在真实 DOM 上。如果它们算稳定契约，值得写进文档（宿主目前就是靠它们做样式兜底的）；如果不算，也请说明，免得下游依赖了非契约属性。

> 相关：给 dsh-mnemon 的样式对齐请求见 omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon#318

discussions.title: [BUG] dsh桌面版下面无害命令(pwsh/cmd echo在内)都报错 `0xC0000142`(STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)
discussions.body:
# Windows ACL 沙箱：桌面版下所有受限控制台命令都以 `0xC0000142`（STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）退出

## Summary

桌面版 Windows 上，`windows-acl` 沙箱（Windows 上唯一的沙箱后端）**完全不可用**：任何跑在它下面的命令都在真正执行之前就以 `3221225794`（`0xC0000142`，`STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`）退出，且没有任何输出。`cmd`、PowerShell 7（`pwsh`）、Windows PowerShell 5.1、Python 一律如此，`read-only` 与 `workspace-write` 两种模式都一样；不受限的 `danger-full-access` 则一切正常，所以最初的表现像是"沙箱随机把 pwsh 干掉"——它和 pwsh 版本无关，也和解释器无关。文件类工具（`read`/`write`/`edit`/`glob`/`grep`）不受影响。我搜过讨论列表中有2起类似bug报告, 仓库也有看起来针对它的修复, 但更新到0.20rc1依然如此. 所以报告上来, 可能之前的fix覆盖不全.

### 受影响的代码（都在本仓库内）

| 包 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` | `packages/sandbox/sandbox-local` | `windowsAclRunnerInvocation()` 用 `process.execPath` 托管 runner —— 一行修复就在此处 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` | `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` | 其受限令牌无法创建控制台的后端；它的 README 里已经记录了由此产生的 `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process` | `packages/subprocess/win32-process` | `createRestrictedProcess()` —— 所有受限子进程创建的唯一收口，可移植修复落在这里 |

**并非 PowerShell 层的问题**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox`（`packages/shell/pwsh-sandbox`）只是把这个失败*报出来*而已。受限的 `cmd` 和 `python` 死法完全一样，所以缺陷在 pwsh 接缝之下，pwsh 相关包不需要改动。

## Reproduction

**在桌面版应用内（用户可见的症状）**：保持默认的 `read-only` 或 `workspace-write` 沙箱，让 agent 执行任意控制台命令——例如 `pwsh -Command '"hi"'`。每次都以 `3221225794` 失败且无输出；把同一条命令切到 `danger-full-access` 就立刻成功。0.17rc2和0.20rc1均有此现象.

**最小复现（原版 Node + 随包发布的 runner，完全不需要 Electron）**：

`spawnSync(process.execPath, [runner, ...])`，其中 `runner` 是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js`：

```js
// repro.mjs
// node repro.mjs <runner.js> <workspace> <tempRoot-existing-dir>
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process')
const [runner, workspace, tempRoot] = process.argv.slice(2)
const base = ['--workspace', workspace, '--temp', tempRoot, '--mode', 'workspace-write', '--', 'cmd', '/c', 'exit']

const show = (label, r) => console.log(label, r.status, '0x' + (r.status >>> 0).toString(16).toUpperCase())

show('attached:', spawnSync(process.execPath, [runner, ...base], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }))
show('detached:', spawnSync(process.execPath, [runner, ...base], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], detached: true }))
```

实测输出：

```
attached: 0     0x0
detached: 3221225794  0xC0000142
```

`detached: true`（`DETACHED_PROCESS`）在这里并不是什么偏门配置——它恰恰是 **GUI 子系统父进程**免费提供的东西，而桌面版正是用 GUI 子系统二进制来托管 runner 的：

* `dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js` —— `windowsAclRunnerInvocation()` 返回 `[process.execPath, builtEntry]`；紧邻的注释还写着 *"The prefix stays `[node, runner, ...]`"*，也就是说这段代码默认 `process.execPath` 就是一个 Node 可执行文件。
* 桌面版里运行时跑在 Electron 主进程内，所以 `process.execPath` 是 Electron 二进制（`…\DeepSeek Harness.exe`）而不是 `node.exe`。而且同一个构建是**故意**把它当 Node 宿主用的：`dsh-desktop-host` 启动包管理器子进程时用的就是 `command: process.execPath`、`env: { ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1", DSH_DESKTOP_NODE_EXECUTABLE: process.execPath, … }`。

于是 ACL runner 实际以 `DeepSeek Harness.exe <runner.js> …` 的身份运行 —— 一个**永远不可能拥有控制台**的 GUI 子系统进程。

## Current behavior

任何受限控制台命令都返回 `3221225794` / `0xC0000142`，stdout 与 stderr 均为空。

runner 自身可以证明是活着的、也无责：给它一个不存在的 `--temp`，它照样会打印 `windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory: …` 并以 `127` 退出 —— **attached 和 detached 两种情况下都是如此**。挂在那个受限孙进程上的是子进程，不是 runner 自己的启动。

同一个 runner、同一套 argv、同一个 workspace/temp、同一个令牌、同一台机器，只有宿主二进制 / spawn 标志在变：

| runner 宿主 | spawn 选项 | 受限 `cmd /c exit` | 受限 `pwsh -c exit` | 受限 GUI 子系统目标 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node.exe` | — | `0` | `0` | `0` |
| `node.exe` | `windowsHide: true`（`CREATE_NO_WINDOW`） | `0` | — | — |
| `node.exe` | `detached: true`（`DETACHED_PROCESS`） | **`0xC0000142`** | **`0xC0000142`** | `0` |
| `DeepSeek Harness.exe`（GUI 子系统） | 以上任意一种 | **`0xC0000142`** | **`0xC0000142`** | `0` |

用到的 GUI 子系统目标是 `DeepSeek Harness.exe -e "process.exit(0)"`（各种配置下都退出 `0`）和 `wscript.exe //B`（退出 `1` —— 一个真实的应用程序退出码，说明它初始化并跑完了）。

由此可以读出三条：

* **控制台子系统目标死，GUI 子系统目标没事。** 故障发生在控制台的*获取*环节，而不是令牌或加载器本身。
* **自己拥有控制台**的 runner（普通启动，或 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` —— 后者仍会创建一个无窗口控制台）能把控制台传下去；**没有控制台**的 runner（`DETACHED_PROCESS`，或任何 GUI 子系统宿主）不能。
* 只改子进程的标志是不够的 —— 必须让 *runner* 手里有控制台可传。

这与该后端自己 README 里记录的已知限制一致（原文：*"console isolation is unavailable — children share the host console (CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE children die with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)"*）：**在受限令牌下，任何控制台的*创建*都会失败**，而桌面版恰好为每一条受限控制台命令都强制走了"创建控制台"这条路。README 那句"子进程共享宿主控制台"的假设，只在宿主*确实*有控制台时成立 —— GUI 子系统的 Electron 宿主永远没有。这一点已在内核层面确认（见附录 A）：失败时 `conhost.exe` 是被**受限子进程自己**创建出来的，带的是受限令牌，并以 `STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED` 结束。

## Expected behavior

受限命令应当和不受限时一样正常执行并返回输出，只是多一层写限制。具体地说：

* `cmd /c exit` → 退出码 `0`
* `pwsh -c "Write-Output …"` → 退出码 `0`，文本出现在 stdout
* PowerShell 5.1、Python 以及其他任何控制台子系统目标同理
* 受限的 GUI 子系统目标保持现有行为（它们本来就能用）

附录 C 里的两个 runner 侧修复，都是在故障配置（无控制台 runner）下实测达到上述结果的，且不丢输出。

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.1`（与 npm `next` 一致） |
| 操作系统 | Windows 10 21H2，build `19044.4529`，运行于移动云电脑（China Mobile cloud desktop / Ecloud VDI）客户机内 |
| 命令目标 | `cmd.exe`、`pwsh 7.6.5`、`powershell 5.1`、CPython |
| 对比的宿主二进制 | `D:\Apps\Node22\node.exe` **v22.23.2** 对比随包发行的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`（Electron；其内嵌 Node 自报 v24.18.1，且 `process.execPath` 就是该二进制） |
| 修复所用的 `node.exe` | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe` —— **v24.21.0**，本桌面版已经随包发行的运行时 |

除 Windows Defender 外没有第三方 AV/EDR。该客户机会向所有进程注入一个 VDI 钩子 DLL，但已排除（见附录 B）。

### 这是否只是某一台机器的问题？

应当不是。触发条件是桌面版给**每一个**安装都固定下来的属性 —— ACL runner 由 GUI 子系统二进制托管，而这种宿主永远不可能拥有控制台 —— 并且该机制与 VDI、注入的钩子 DLL、杀软、解释器统统无关（附录 B）。上面 `detached: true` 那条复现用的是原版 Node，不需要上述任何环境，所以机制本身在任何机器上都可复现；桌面版的症状也应当在该构建的任何 Windows 安装上复现。

但要说明：本文所有测量都是在移动云电脑（China Mobile cloud desktop / Ecloud VDI）客户机内完成的。如果桌面版症状在普通工作站上**复现不出来**，请到这类云电脑环境里再试 —— 那是本报告确认问题的环境 —— 同时始终保留 `detached: true` 那条 runner 用例，作为与机器无关的机制判据。

-----

## 附录 A — 根本原因与内核级证据

Process Monitor抓取了桌面版发出的两组用例；两组里的受限目标都是同一个唯一命名的 `cmd.exe` 副本（`dsh_conhost_probe.exe`），因此这些事件不可能与系统噪音混淆。过滤器：`Process Create` / `Process Exit`。

**用例 1 —— runner 由 `node.exe` 托管（runner 拥有控制台）：受限子进程退出码 `0`**

```
12:36:44.8684867  node.exe (41512, the ACL runner)  Process Create  ...\dsh_conhost_probe.exe         PID: 43548
12:36:44.9049091  dsh_conhost_probe.exe (43548)     Process Exit    Exit Status: 0
```

整条链里没有出现任何 `conhost.exe`：受限子进程**继承**了 runner 已经拥有的那个控制台。

**用例 2 —— 同一个 runner、同一套 argv，但以 `DETACHED_PROCESS` 启动（runner 没有控制台）：受限子进程死亡**

```
12:36:49.3578601  node.exe (42368, the ACL runner)  Process Create  ...\dsh_conhost_probe.exe         PID: 3312
12:36:49.3678602  dsh_conhost_probe.exe (3312)      Process Create  C:\Windows\System32\Conhost.exe    PID: 39400
12:36:49.3682486  dsh_conhost_probe.exe (3312)      Process Exit    Exit Status: -1073741502  (0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)
12:36:49.3684230  Conhost.exe (39400)               Process Exit    Exit Status: -1073741790  (0xC0000022 STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED)
```

按顺序读下来，这就是整个缺陷：

1. 受限子进程没有可继承的控制台，于是它在**自己的进程初始化阶段就申请一个控制台** —— 这也正是 `conhost.exe` 的 `Process Create` 事件归属于受限子进程自身的原因。
2. 因此这个控制台宿主是**代表受限子进程、也就是带着受限令牌**被创建的（低完整性、写受限），并在约 6 毫秒后以 `STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED` 死亡。
3. 它的客户端随后以 `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED` 死亡 —— 也就是桌面版里每条受限命令看到的 `0xC0000142`。

所以这既不是令牌派生的问题，也不是加载器或目标自身 DLL 的问题：**是控制台宿主在受限令牌下被拒绝**，而桌面版把每一条受限控制台命令都送上了这条路。

同一次抓取里还有对照，可以排除"这台机器上控制台创建本身就是坏的"：harness 自己那条**不受限**的 `pwsh.exe`（由 `dsh-subprocess-local` 的 runner 拉起）用同样的方式申请控制台 ——

```
12:36:43.3143864  pwsh.exe (39544, unconfined)  Process Create  C:\Windows\System32\Conhost.exe  PID: 37508
12:36:51.5262558  Conhost.exe (37508)           Process Exit    Exit Status: 0
```

—— 而这个 `conhost.exe` 退出码是 `0`。控制台创建对不受限客户端成功、只对受限客户端被拒，这正是一个无法施加到控制台宿主上的写受限低完整性令牌会产生的结果。

抓取记录里还能看到生产环境的 spawn 模式本身，即桌面版确实是用 `process.execPath`（Electron 二进制）而不是 `node` 来托管 runner 的：

```
12:36:42.1341124  DeepSeek Harness.exe (15596)  Process Create  D:\Apps\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe   PID: 41252
      Command line: "…\DeepSeek Harness.exe" "…\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-subprocess-local\lib\runner.js" -- "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" …
12:36:43.2582556  DeepSeek Harness.exe (41252)  Process Create  C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe
```

（这条是 `dsh-subprocess-local` 的 runner —— 不受限路径，所以上面那个 `conhost.exe` 才会成功；`dsh-sandbox-local` 构造它的 windows-acl 前缀时用的是同一套 `process.execPath` 写法。）

## 附录 B — 已排除的嫌疑项

下面这些在可用的（`node.exe` 宿主）和故障的（`DeepSeek Harness.exe` 宿主）两种配置下**完全一致**：

| 嫌疑项 | 测量 | 结论 |
|---|---|---|
| 进程缓解策略 | 对两个宿主 `Get-ProcessMitigation -Id <pid>`：**无任何差异，全是默认值** | 排除 |
| 令牌 | 从两个宿主各自派生的子进程里执行 `whoami /groups` + `/priv`：完全一致（16 个组、相同 SID 含 `S-1-2-0`/`S-1-2-1`/`S-1-5-11`、`Mandatory Label\High Mandatory Level`、29 行特权），会话 `1` | 排除 |
| 作业对象 | 两个宿主都报告 `IsProcessInJob = true`；两者 `OpenInputDesktop` 都成功（无 `JOB_OBJECT_UILIMIT_DESKTOP`） | 排除 |
| 窗口站 / 桌面 | 两者都是 `WinSta0` / `Default` | 排除 |
| 环境变量 | `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 在*两个*宿主里都存在（而 node 宿主照样能用） | 排除 |
| `windowsHide` / `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`、无控制台 runner | 见上面的矩阵 —— 各自单独都不足以成事 | 排除 |
| 目标路径解析 | 换成绝对路径的 `pwsh.exe` 失败方式相同；换 `cmd`、`python` 也相同 | 排除 |
| 目标解释器 | `cmd` 与 `pwsh` 7、5.1 死法完全一样 | 排除 |
| 第三方 DLL 注入（VDI 钩子） | 同样带着这些钩子 DLL 时，低完整性的 `cmd.exe` 副本运行正常；注入模块在成功的受限运行里同样存在 | 排除 |
| runner 进程启动失败 | 传入坏的 `--temp` 时 runner 会打印自己的错误并以 `127` 退出，在 Electron 宿主下同样如此 | 排除 |
| 仅低完整性本身 | 低完整性标记的 `cmd.exe` 可以运行（`LOWPROBE_OK`，退出 `0`） | 排除 |

时间线备注：本机是 Windows 10 `19044`，而沙箱代码注释里提到的是在 Windows 11 `26200` 上验证过。该缺陷并不限于任一版本 —— 用原版 Node 加 `detached: true` 就能复现 —— 但 Windows 10 用户看到的是桌面版的症状。

## 附录 C — 在故障环境中验证通过的修复方案

### C.1 用真正的 `node.exe` 托管 ACL runner（推荐）

把 runner 宿主解析为一个真正的 Node 可执行文件，而不是 `process.execPath`。本桌面运行时已经随包带了一个（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe`）。配合生产环境本来就用的 `windowsHide: true`，控制台子系统的 `node.exe` 会得到一个属于自己的无窗口控制台，受限子进程再继承它。Node 版本无所谓：上面的矩阵用的是 v22.23.2，下表用的是随包的 v24.21.0 —— 两者都是控制台子系统二进制，都能用：

| runner 宿主 | `windowsHide` | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `DeepSeek Harness.exe`（生产） | `false` | `0xC0000142` |
| `DeepSeek Harness.exe`（生产） | `true` | `0xC0000142` |
| 随包 `node.exe` | `false` | **`0`，stdout `FIX_OK`** |
| 随包 `node.exe` | `true`（生产选项） | **`0`，stdout `FIX_OK`** |

建议改动点：在 `dsh-sandbox-local` 的 `windowsAclRunnerInvocation()` 里解析宿主（例如 `process.env.DSH_NODE` / 随包运行时，回退到 `process.execPath`）。

### C.2 让 runner 自己申请一个控制台（可移植兜底）

如果不想去定位 Node 可执行文件，同样的效果可以落在所有受限子进程创建的唯一收口上（`dsh-win32-process` 的 `createRestrictedProcess`）：runner 没有控制台时，在 spawn 之前先申请一个。四个绑定加一个辅助函数：

```js
// bindingContext(): also koffi.load("user32.dll")
allocConsole:     bind(kernel32, "AllocConsole", "int", []),
getConsoleWindow: bind(kernel32, "GetConsoleWindow", PVOID, []),
setStdHandle:     bind(kernel32, "SetStdHandle", "int", ["int", PVOID]),
showWindow:       bind(user32, "ShowWindow", "int", [PVOID, "int"]),

function ensureRunnerConsole(api) {
  const saved = [-12, -11, -10].map((s) => [s, api.getStdHandle(s)]);
  if (api.allocConsole() === 0) return;              // a console already exists -> no-op
  for (const [s, h] of saved) api.setStdHandle(s, h);
  const w = api.getConsoleWindow();
  if (w !== null) api.showWindow(w, 0);
}
function createRestrictedProcess(api, options, commandLine, creationFlags, startupInfo, processInfo) {
  ensureRunnerConsole(api);
  return api.createProcessAsUserW(options.token, null, commandLine, null, null, 1, creationFlags, null, options.cwd, startupInfo, processInfo);
}
```

在无控制台的 runner（即故障条件）下实测，`createRestrictedProcess` 其余部分保持不变：

| 受限目标 | 修复前 | 加上 `ensureRunnerConsole` |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd /c exit` | `0xC0000142` | `0` |
| `pwsh -c "Write-Output DETACH_FIX_OK"` | `0xC0000142` | `0`，stdout `"DETACH_FIX_OK\r\n"` |
| `cmd /c echo DETACH_CMD_OK` | `0xC0000142` | `0`，stdout `"DETACH_CMD_OK\r\n"` |
| GUI 子系统目标 | `0` | `0` |
| 同一个 runner **本来就有**控制台（对照） | `0` | `0`，行为不变 —— `AllocConsole` 返回 0，分支根本不会进入 |

这个变体输出保真，而且与宿主无关：不需要定位 `node.exe`，所以即便将来 runner 宿主因为别的原因改掉，它依然成立。需要权衡的地方：给 `dsh-win32-process` 增加了 `user32` 依赖和四个绑定；每个 runner 进程从此都持有一个控制台（一个 runner 一个控制台宿主）；窗口只能在 `AllocConsole` 返回之后才隐藏，因此理论上有一瞬闪现 —— 而控制台子系统的 `node.exe` 宿主靠现有的 `windowsHide: true` 就能免费拿到真正无窗口的控制台。首选 C.1，C.2 作为可移植兜底。

### C.3 已实测并否决的方案：给受限子进程加 `DETACHED_PROCESS`

既然根因是"受限子进程去申请控制台"，那么子进程侧的修法就是让它以 `DETACHED_PROCESS` 创建、根本不申请。我们把它打进随包的 `dsh-win32-process`（子进程创建标志在管道路径上是 `0`，见 `lib/index.js:458`；在继承 Job 的路径上是 `4`/`CREATE_SUSPENDED`，见 `lib/index.js:693`），并在同一个无控制台 runner 下测量：

| 受限目标 | 未打补丁 | 打上 `DETACHED_PROCESS` |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd /c exit` | `0xC0000142` | `0` |
| `pwsh -c "Write-Output …"` | `0xC0000142` | `0`，但 **stdout 与 stderr 都是 0 字节** |
| `cmd /c echo DETACH_CMD_OK` | — | `0`，stdout `"DETACH_CMD_OK\r\n"`（完好） |

这个补丁**反过来确认了机制** —— 去掉控制台申请，崩溃就消失 —— 但**不能当作修复方案**：在 `DETACHED_PROCESS` 下，`pwsh` 7 会静默地完全不产出输出（不是改道到 stderr，是真的被丢弃），那等于把响亮的失败换成最要命的解释器上的哑失败。`cmd.exe` 的输出完好，说明这是解释器相关的行为。runner 侧的两个方案都保持输出完整 —— 受限 `pwsh` 的 stdout 被正常捕获为 `FIX_OK` —— 这才是推荐它们的原因。

## 附录 D — 建议的回归测试

`detached: true` 用**原版 Node 加随包 runner** 就能复现，所以现有的 Windows ACL 测试套件无需 Electron 就能覆盖它：

1. runner 正常托管，受限 `cmd /c exit` → `0`
2. runner 以 `detached: true` 托管，受限 `cmd /c exit` → 目前是 `0xC0000142`；必须变成 `0`
3. runner 正常托管，对子进程强制 `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE`，受限 `cmd /c exit` → 目前是 `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`（已在 README 记录）；等到受限令牌下的控制台创建被修好或绕开之后，应当变成 `0`

## 附录 E — 各项测量的取得方式

* 直接使用 runner 调用形式（不经 HLE 包装）：
  `<host> <pkg>/lib/runner.js --workspace <ws> --temp <已存在的目录> --mode workspace-write -- <目标 argv>`
  （agentless 形式：不带 `--write-sid`/`--temp-write-sid`；runner 会自建并清理自己的私有临时子目录。）
* 受限子进程的退出码取自 runner 的退出码 —— runner 会镜像子进程的退出码。
* 控制台状态是在每个宿主内部通过 `koffi` 调用 `kernel32!GetConsoleWindow`、`GetStdHandle`、`AllocConsole` 读出的。
* 令牌 / 作业 / 桌面相关信息取自各宿主派生的子进程（作业、窗口站与桌面都会被继承，因此子进程报告的就是宿主的值）。

discussions.title: workspace-write sandbox on Windows breaks git for Windows: MSYS binaries fail to start, and schannel cannot reach its key store
discussions.body:
**Environment:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1 · Windows 11 · `workspace-write` confinement
**Measured:** 2026-09-29

Two independent restrictions of the session sandbox break HTTPS and SSH for **git for Windows**, and
neither error names the sandbox, so the diagnosis is expensive:

1. **Every MSYS/Cygwin binary fails to initialise.** `sh.exe` and git's *bundled* `ssh.exe` die with
   `couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5` (exit `0xC0000142`, `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`).
   git-for-Windows routes `core.sshCommand` and every credential helper through those binaries, so
   both the HTTPS and the SSH transport are blocked.
2. **Windows schannel needs to write `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Crypto`**, which the sandbox denies, and
   reports that as `schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030E)`.

`gh` is unaffected, because Go implements TLS and credential storage in-process rather than calling
into schannel or the Windows credential store. That asymmetry is the strongest clue — and it is what
makes the failure look like a *git* problem rather than a *sandbox* problem.

---

### Writes outside the workspace are denied

```
%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Crypto        DENIED
%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Crypto\RSA    DENIED
%USERPROFILE%                     DENIED   (control — not crypto-specific)
```

### schannel fails; OpenSSL fixes exactly that half

```
$ git ls-remote origin HEAD
fatal: unable to access '...': schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed:
       SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030E) - No credentials are available in the security package

$ git -c http.sslBackend=openssl -c credential.helper= ls-remote origin HEAD
fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com'      <-- TLS SUCCEEDED; only auth failed
```

The CA bundle (`C:\Program Files\Git\mingw64\etc\ssl\certs\ca-bundle.crt`) **is** readable, so the
OpenSSL backend is viable inside the sandbox. This isolates the schannel fault precisely: OpenSSL
removes it and nothing else changes.

Note `http.sslBackend` is explicitly set to `schannel` in this machine's git config, so the
`GIT_SSL_BACKEND` environment variable does not take effect.

### MSYS/Cygwin binaries cannot start at all

```
$ & 'C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\sh.exe' -c 'echo sh-alive'
0 [main] sh (28324) C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\sh.exe: *** fatal error -
       couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5
exit = -1073741502            # 0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED

$ git ls-remote origin HEAD   # with no core.sshCommand set
0 [main] ssh (27712) C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\ssh.exe: *** fatal error -
       couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5
```

This is the more damaging half, and it appears to be **narrower** than the documented "confined modes
cannot open named pipes" — a native .NET named pipe server starts fine under the same confinement:

```powershell
New-Object System.IO.Pipes.NamedPipeServerStream('dsh-test','Out')   # succeeds
```

So the restriction is specific to whatever Cygwin's initialisation needs — a private pipe namespace,
or a handle right the restricted token lacks. The distinction is worth making explicit in the docs,
because "named pipes are blocked" does not predict `ssh.exe` failing while a .NET pipe succeeds.

### The native Windows ssh works

```
$ ssh -T git@github.com
Hi <user>! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.
```

`C:\WINDOWS\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe` is not a Cygwin program and runs normally under the sandbox.

---

### Impact

- **`git fetch` / `git push` are unusable** in a session without a `danger-full-access` escalation —
  for every repository, not just one.
- The failure is easy to misattribute: it presents as a TLS or credential error, so the natural first
  moves (re-auth, re-issue a token, check the remote URL) all waste time.
- **Any other .NET HTTPS client is broken too** — `Invoke-WebRequest https://…` fails with
  *"The SSL connection could not be established"*. That is wider than git and is not mentioned in the
  sandbox documentation.

### Verified workaround

Point git at the **native** OpenSSH with a bare path, so git execs it directly instead of through
`sh`, and use SSH rather than HTTPS so schannel and the credential manager are never reached.

```powershell
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f $env:USERPROFILE\.ssh\<name> -N ""
# register the .pub with the forge

git config core.sshCommand 'C:/Windows/System32/OpenSSH/ssh.exe'   # bare path: no spaces, no shell
git remote set-url origin git@github.com:<owner>/<repo>.git
```

`~/.ssh/config` maps the host to the key, so the bare-path command needs no arguments:

```
Host github.com
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/<name>
    IdentitiesOnly yes
```

Two details that cost time:

- **`ssh-keyscan` can fail** on `choose_kex: unsupported KEX method sntrup761x25519-sha512@openssh.com`
  against some servers. GitHub publishes its host keys via `gh api /meta --jq '.ssh_keys[]'`, which is
  authoritative and avoids the negotiation entirely.
- **Writing `~/.ssh/known_hosts` is itself denied**, so a forge whose host keys are not already known
  needs one escalated run to seed that file.

Measured after the change, inside the sandbox with no escalation:

```
ssh -T git@github.com    -> authenticated
git fetch origin --prune -> exit 0
git push --dry-run       -> exit 0
```

### Suggested fixes, in order of value

1. **Let Cygwin/MSYS binaries initialise.** The single change that unblocks git for Windows out of the
   box, and the failure a user is least equipped to diagnose.
2. **Allow the schannel key store** (`%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Crypto`) to be written, or document
   `http.sslBackend=openssl` as the supported HTTPS configuration inside a session.
3. **Document the limitations.** "HTTPS from .NET and git-for-Windows does not work inside the
   sandbox; use the native OpenSSH or escalate" would have saved the entire diagnostic above.
4. Consider surfacing *which* path or object was denied, in the error or the session diagnostics. The
   generic message is what made this expensive — the sandbox was never named in any of the three
   symptoms.

Happy to test a fix or provide more detail.

discussions.title: 缺失类似IDE的资源管理器的多文件选中 复制多源码文件路径的功能
discussions.body:
现在的所有独立 Agent GUI 和 IDE 对比 缺失的最不方便的功能就是：
在IDE的资源管理器中 我可以快速的 复制 多个 代码文件 的文件路径 ，或者是文件夹路径，告诉  AI 快速的分析 这几个 文件 ，可以明显快速的 提升AI的分析和聚焦 注意力，而 独立 Agent GUI 缺失这个功能 就是很不方便的 ，要么 再额外 打开 一个 IDE 干这事，有这 功夫 我就直接在 IDE 里面 完成对话了。

discussions.title: High-volume API developer for book-writing software – need guidance on volume discounts / developer support
discussions.body:
Hi DeepSeek team,

I’m Roberto, an Italian developer building a commercial software that writes full books and novels in any language, mimicking a chosen author’s style through a custom algorithm.

The final product integrates your API. My customers will purchase tokens directly through my software, so your API will generate recurring revenue from my user base.

I’ve already spent over $200 on tokens during development. I’m now entering the most token-intensive phase (final composition, style generation, editorial revision, typography, monographs, and full-story rewriting). I expect to more than double my usage in the coming days.

I’m not asking for free credits. I’m asking whether there is a volume discount, developer program, or partnership opportunity for high-consumption commercial integrations like mine.

I tried contacting api-service@deepseek.com but my email was blocked by your antispam filter (550 5.7.0 DT:SPM). That’s why I’m posting here publicly.

What I can offer in return:

Detailed feedback on API behavior for creative writing and long-context generation

Bug reports and real-world usage metrics

A public case study / testimonial once the software launches

A growing stream of paying API customers

Could someone from the team please reply here or DM me? Even a short “no” or “contact this address” would help me move forward.

Thank you for your time and for building a great API.

— Roberto Gabaldo
roberto.colnet@gmail.com

discussions.title: 提议：FileDiff 携带 hunk 起始行号（oldStart/newStart），让 UI 能显示真实行号
discussions.body:
## 背景

`computeHunkDiffs`（`packages/fs/tool-fs/src/diff.ts`）用 `structuredPatch` 算出每个 hunk 后，只保留 `{ path, oldText, newText }`，`hunk.oldStart` / `hunk.newStart` 被丢弃。结果是 UI 端（web DiffBlock、TUI 插件）都无法显示真实行号——文件可能已变，事后读盘反推也不可靠。

## 提议

`FileDiff`（`packages/core/tools/src/presentation.ts`）增加两个**可选**字段：

```ts
export interface FileDiff {
  path: string
  oldText: string | null
  newText: string
  /** hunk 在旧/新文件中的 1-based 起始行；未知时省略 */
  oldStart?: number
  newStart?: number
}
```

`computeHunkDiffs` 直接填入 `hunk.oldStart` / `hunk.newStart`。

- 向后兼容：字段可选，旧会话日志回放与现有消费者不受影响；`isFileDiff` 校验放宽即可。
- 调用期 `presentCall`（无文件内容）保持省略。

discussions.title: [desktop] 卡巴斯基「加密连接扫描」触发高频 TRANSPORT 传输失败；TRANSPORT 错误丢弃底层原因
discussions.body:
# 卡巴斯基「加密连接扫描」触发高频 TRANSPORT 传输失败；TRANSPORT 错误丢弃底层原因

**产品**：DeepSeek Harness（Desktop）
**组件**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`（`DeepSeekAdapter`）
**严重程度**：高（触发时高频传输失败、可致回合中断；错误丢弃底层原因为**可诊断性**阻断）
**类型**：Bug（错误处理 / 诊断信息丢失）；外部触发条件：安全软件「加密连接扫描」

---

## 报告者的话（请先读）

本报告基于 **session 日志实测 + 本机网络对照实验**，可复算。两条结论：

**已证实（确定性）：**

1. **`TRANSPORT` 错误丢弃了底层原因。** 代码只抛出通用文案，真实错误被吞在 `cause` 中且不落日志。

**已定位触发条件（有量化对照）：**

2. 本机上存在一个可开关的外部因素（卡巴斯基的「加密连接扫描」），切换它可使 **97% → 0%** 的传输失败率发生突变（第 5 节，含逐分钟时间轴与统计显著性）。**但其作用机制尚未查明**——报告人已排除应用层 TLS 中间人（第 4 节）。这一条需要你们协助定位。

> 第 1 条是本次排查最大障碍：一个把根因完全吞掉的兜底错误，等于把排查成本全部转嫁给用户。报告人为此走了三次弯路、耗时数小时，最终**仍未能查明机制**，只能给出「可复现的开关」而非根因。

---

## 1. 环境

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows 11 企业版，build 26200 |
| DSH Desktop | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` **0.2.0-rc.1**（`dshBuildCommit` 62962ee48ef60ed1f97c10fffceb294eb3adf719） |
| dsh runtime | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime` **0.2.0-rc.1** |
| Electron | 44.0.0 |
| provider / model | `deepseek-account` / `deepseek-flash` |
| API 主机 | `https://api.deepseek.com` |
| DSH_HOME | `C:\Users\drliu\.dsh`（profile `desktop`） |
| 网络 | 中国大陆；**无代理**（`ProxyEnable: 0`、无 `*_PROXY` 环境变量、WinHTTP 直连） |
| 杀毒软件 | 卡巴斯基标准版 **21.19.7.527**（`avp` 运行中），组件「加密连接扫描」 |
| 日志 | `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |

---

## 2. 现象

### 2.1 模型调用几乎每次都要重试

| Session | 模型调用次数 | `llm/retry` 次数 | **首轮失败率** |
|---|---|---|---|
| 较早（故障期） | 32 | 31 | **97%** |
| 当前（故障段） | 129 | 125 | **97%** |

失败原因**100% 是同一个**：

```
failure.code    = TRANSPORT
failure.message = "DeepSeek Messages transport failed"
```

重试策略（日志 `policyKey` 字段）：

```
["normal", 5, ["EMPTY_RESPONSE","RATE_LIMIT","SERVER","TIMEOUT","TRANSPORT"], 500, 10000, 0.1]
 → mode=normal, maxRetries=5, 可重试码含 TRANSPORT, 退避 500ms→10000ms, 抖动 0.1
```

> 日志中**未见** `RATE_LIMIT`（429）被计入重试，因此**不是限流**，而是传输层失败。

### 2.2 重试耗尽后整个回合失败

当前 session 中有 4 个回合以 TRANSPORT 结束，用户侧表现：

```
本轮运行失败
DeepSeek Messages transport failed
```

### 2.3 失败是**成簇**的

一段典型故障的重试时间线：

```
turn 11 step 4 : retry 1/5 delay  498ms
turn 11 step 4 : retry 2/5 delay 1052ms
turn 11 step 4 : retry 3/5 delay 1983ms
turn 11 step 4 : retry 4/5 delay 3708ms
turn 11 step 4 : retry 5/5 delay 7218ms   ← 全败
turn 11 step 9 : retry 1/5 ~ 5/5          ← 同样全败
```

两种性质不同的失败并存：

| 模式 | 特征 | 后果 |
|---|---|---|
| **零星失败** | 首次重试（约 500ms 后）即成功 | 无感 |
| **成簇失败** | 同一 step 的 5 次重试在约 15 秒内**全部失败** | 回合中断 |

成簇模式下约 15 秒时间窗内该主机完全不可达。**建议分别统计**（第 6.2 节）。

---

## 3. 缺陷：TRANSPORT 丢弃底层原因

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` 的 `DeepSeekAdapter.generate()`：

```js
} catch (error) {
    if (timeoutOf(watchdog.signal, "MESSAGES_IDLE") !== void 0)
        throw new LlmError("DeepSeek Messages stream idle timeout", "TIMEOUT", { cause: error });
    if (options.signal?.aborted)
        throw new LlmError("DeepSeek Messages request aborted", "ABORTED", { cause: error });
    if (error instanceof LlmError) throw error;
    throw new LlmError("DeepSeek Messages transport failed", "TRANSPORT", { cause: error });
}
```

`TRANSPORT` 是**兜底分类**，含义仅为「流迭代器抛出了非超时、非中止的错误」。真实错误只存在于 `cause`，而：

- `cause` **不写入 session 日志**（`llm/retry` 的 `failure` 只有 `message`、`code`）；
- 界面只显示 `DeepSeek Messages transport failed`；
- 故**无法判断**根因是 DNS、TCP reset、TLS 握手、HTTP/2 流重置，还是 undici 层错误。

**这是报告人无法给出机制性根因的唯一原因。**

---

## 4. 本机网络对照实验（已排除应用层中间人）

对 `https://api.deepseek.com` 直连：

| 测试 | 请求数 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /v1/models` | 20 | **20/20 干净 HTTP 401** |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions`（`stream:true`、中等请求体） | 12 | **12/12 干净 HTTP 401** |

- TCP、TLS、HTTP 往返均正常，无重置、无握手失败；
- 对端证书签发者 **TrustAsia DV TLS RSA CA 2025**（`CN=api.deepseek.com`），**非**本地杀毒软件根证书。

**结论**：本机**不存在针对该主机的应用层 TLS 中间人**。这否定了「杀软替换证书做 MITM」这一最直观的机制。

**局限**：以上为**未认证**请求，在鉴权阶段即被 401 拒绝，**未进入真实流式响应阶段**；而故障发生在流迭代过程中（第 3 节）。

---

## 5. 触发条件：卡巴斯基「加密连接扫描」的开关效应（逐分钟对照）

### 5.1 方法

报告人在故障过程中切换了卡巴斯基的「加密连接扫描」，并保留完整 session 日志。日志按分钟统计 `assistant/attempt` 与 `llm/retry`。

### 5.2 切换前的逐分钟失败率

| 分钟 (UTC) | 模型调用 | 重试 | 失败率 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 05:35 | 8 | 7 | 88% |
| 05:36 | 3 | 3 | 100% |
| 05:37 | 6 | 6 | 100% |
| 05:38 | 1 | 1 | 100% |
| 05:40 | 11 | 10 | 91% |
| 05:41 | 3 | 3 | 100% |
| 05:42 | 16 | 16 | 100% |
| 05:43 | 13 | 13 | 100% |
| 05:44 | 12 | 12 | 100% |
| 05:45 | 6 | 6 | 100% |
| 05:54 | 7 | 7 | 100% |
| 05:55 | 8 | 8 | 100% |
| 05:56 | 12 | 12 | 100% |
| 05:57 | 8 | 7 | 88% |
| 05:58 | 9 | 9 | 100% |
| 05:59 | 6 | 5 | 83% |
| **合计** | **129** | **125** | **97%** |

### 5.3 切换点

```
05:59:44.332  turn/end  turn 11  error      ← 最后一个失败回合结束
                  (40 秒空档：报告人在此关闭「加密连接扫描」)
06:00:24.518  turn/start turn 12
```

### 5.4 切换后

**turn 12、turn 13 共 13 次模型调用，`llm/retry` = 0，失败率 0%。**

原始事件序列显示，`assistant/message` 之前**没有** `assistant/attempt`、**没有** `llm/retry-started`、**没有** `llm/retry` —— 即每次**首次尝试即成功**：

```
06:00:24.554  step/start turn12/step1
06:00:30.121  assistant/message turn12/step1     ← 无 attempt/retry 事件
06:00:30.706  step/start turn12/step2
06:00:35.196  assistant/message turn12/step2     ← 无 attempt/retry 事件
...
06:02:18.119  turn/end turn12 completed
06:03:13.674  step/start turn13/step1
06:03:19.227  assistant/message turn13/step1     ← 无 attempt/retry 事件
...
```

### 5.5 统计显著性

在切换前的失败率下（保守取 95%），**13 次调用全部首次成功**的概率约为 **10⁻¹⁷**。

**因此该开关与失败率之间存在确定性关联，不可能是巧合。**

### 5.6 但机制未明（重要）

报告人**无法解释机制**，且本条与第 4 节的证据**方向相反**：

- 第 4 节证明该主机不存在应用层 TLS 中间人（证书为 TrustAsia，非杀软 CA）；
- 若为「替换证书 MITM」，任意 HTTPS 请求都会受影响，而第 4 节 32 次请求全部正常。

**机制候选方向（需你们或 Kaspersky 侧定位）：**

1. 扫描组件对**长时间存活的流式响应**（`text/event-stream`）的处理存在缺陷 —— 可解释为何短请求不受影响、而模型流式调用大量失败；
2. 扫描组件在流式响应的**分块/刷新**过程中注入延迟或缓冲，触发连接层错误；
3. 卡巴斯基官方文档亦承认该组件存在缺陷（原文列出的成因包含 **"Kaspersky application errors"**）。

> 附：卡巴斯基官方文档明确记载「加密连接扫描」会影响第三方软件的 TLS/SSL 通信，并提供分步排查流程（[KESW 兼容性文章](https://support.kaspersky.co.uk/kes-for-windows/11.11.0/troubleshooting/compatibility/15215)）；另一篇记载该扫描以替换证书方式解密流量，并可能产生连接错误，成因包含应用自身缺陷（[加密连接扫描错误](https://support.kaspersky.com/ca/ksos/8.26/troubleshooting/other/13720)）。

---

## 6. 建议修复

### 6.1 优先级最高 —— 让根因可见（成本极低，收益最大）

1. **在 `llm/retry` 事件中记录 `cause`**：至少含底层错误 `name` / `code` / `message`（如 `UND_ERR_SOCKET`、`ECONNRESET`、`EPROTO`）、目标 `host`、请求耗时、尝试序号。当前 `failure` 只有兜底分类，信息量为零。
2. **用户可见错误中带上底层原因**。

> 有了这条，第 5.6 节的机制问题在本次排查中本可直接定论。

### 6.2 优先级高

3. **区分「成簇失败」与「零星失败」**（第 2.3 节）：成簇意味着短时连接不可用。检测到成簇失败时应**暂停重试、等待连接恢复**，而非在 15 秒内耗尽全部预算。

### 6.3 其他

4. **文档**：建议在故障排查章节加入「安全软件的加密连接扫描 / HTTPS 检查可能中断模型流式响应」条目，并给出「为该主机或本应用加白」的指引——**注意本报告的情形是必须整体关闭该组件，加白或「按需扫描」是否能规避尚不明确**。

---

## 7. 附：建议的最小修复契约

> 任何兜底 `TRANSPORT` 错误**必须**在日志与用户可见错误中带上底层 `cause`（name / code / message / 目标主机 / 耗时 / 尝试序号）。
> 检测到连续重试全部失败（成簇失败）时，应暂停并等待连接恢复。

---

## 8. 提交者备注

- 第 2、5 节数字可复算：session 日志为**多帧 zstd**（必须逐帧解压，单次解压只得首片段），统计 `llm/retry`（`data.failure.code`、`data.retry`、`data.delayMs`）、`assistant/attempt`、`turn/end.reason.kind`。
- **日志在回合结束时落盘**，实时观测存在滞后；排查时曾因小样本误判为「已恢复」，需等回合结束后复核。
- 报告人可提供日志统计脚本与原始 session 日志。
- 第 5 节记录的是一份**可开关的确定性触发条件**，而非机制性根因。报告人已尽力排除应用层中间人（第 4 节），机制定位建议由熟悉流式 HTTP 客户端与安全软件交互的工程师接手。

discussions.title: bash/grep/glob tools fail with "spawn bash ENOENT" and "ripgrep provider failure" after desktop app restart
discussions.body:
## Summary

After restarting the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (or during a long-running session), the `bash`, `grep`, and `glob` tools stop working:

- `bash` returns `spawn bash ENOENT`
- `grep` / `glob` return `ripgrep provider failure`

Meanwhile `read`, `write`, `web_fetch`, and MCP tools keep working.

## Reproduction

1. Start the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
2. Restart it (quit and reopen the app, or `killall "DeepSeek Harness"` then reopen).
3. Invoke the `bash` tool → `spawn bash ENOENT`.

The failure is intermittent — it sometimes recovers after another restart.

## Root cause analysis

1. The bash executor spawns the **bare command** `"bash"` (not `/bin/bash`), relying on `PATH` lookup:
   - `packages/shell/bash-local` — `LocalBashExecutor.execute`:
     ```js
     return this.executeArgv(spec, ["bash", "-c", spec.command]);
     ```

2. Executable resolution reads `PATH` from the child environment:
   - `packages/shell/subprocess-local` — `resolveExecutable` / `executableCandidates`:
     ```js
     const path = environmentValue(env, "PATH") ?? "";
     return path.split(delimiter).flatMap(...);
     ```
   - When no candidate exists, it throws `SubprocessExecutableNotFoundError`.

3. The child environment's `PATH` is copied from the harness agent process's `process.env`:
   - `dsh-subprocess` — `scrubbedParentEnv()`:
     ```js
     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env)) ... env[key] = value;
     ```

So when the harness agent process's `process.env.PATH` is empty or missing (which happens after an Electron desktop-app restart where the environment is not fully reconstructed), `resolveExecutable("bash", env)` finds no candidates and throws, surfaced as `spawn bash ENOENT`.

`grep` / `glob` fail for the same reason: they spawn `ripgrep` through `PATH` lookup.

## Evidence

- `read /bin/bash` succeeds (file exists), but the `bash` tool reports `ENOENT` — proving the failure is `PATH` lookup, not a missing file.
- `read` / `write` (fs API) and `web_fetch` (HTTP) continue to work — they don't spawn subprocesses.
- After a desktop-app restart, the `chrome-devtools` MCP's Chrome instance was rebuilt (a previously opened tab disappeared), confirming the app **did** restart — yet `bash` still reported `ENOENT`. So the failure is tied to **agent-context rebuild**, and a restart does **not** recover it.
- When the environment eventually recovered on its own, `bash`/`grep`/`glob` worked again and the process `PATH` was back to `/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin` — directly confirming `PATH` loss as the root cause.

## Suggested fix

In `dsh-subprocess-local`'s `resolveExecutable` (or `childEnv`), fall back to a system default `PATH` when the resolved `PATH` is empty:

```js
const path = environmentValue(env, "PATH")
  ?? process.env.PATH
  ?? "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin";
```

Or make `dsh-bash-local` use the absolute path `/bin/bash`.

discussions.title: High-volume API developer for book-writing software – need guidance on volume discounts / developer support
discussions.body:
Hi DeepSeek team,

I’m Roberto, an Italian developer building a commercial software that writes full books and novels in any language, mimicking a chosen author’s style through a custom algorithm.

The final product integrates your API. My customers will purchase tokens directly through my software, so your API will generate recurring revenue from my user base.

I’ve already spent over $200 on tokens during development. I’m now entering the most token-intensive phase (final composition, style generation, editorial revision, typography, monographs, and full-story rewriting). I expect to more than double my usage in the coming days.

I’m not asking for free credits. I’m asking whether there is a volume discount, developer program, or partnership opportunity for high-consumption commercial integrations like mine.

I tried contacting api-service@deepseek.com but my email was blocked by your antispam filter (550 5.7.0 DT:SPM). That’s why I’m posting here publicly.

What I can offer in return:

Detailed feedback on API behavior for creative writing and long-context generation

Bug reports and real-world usage metrics

A public case study / testimonial once the software launches

A growing stream of paying API customers

Could someone from the team please reply here or DM me? Even a short “no” or “contact this address” would help me move forward.

Thank you for your time and for building a great API.

— Roberto Gabaldo
roberto.colnet@gmail.com

discussions.title: [Suggest] 数据遥测和付费功能透明度改善建议
discussions.body: DeepSeek Harness 是非常好的一款开源产品，但目前的版本在数据隐私等方面需要一些改善。我这里简单提出两点： - 使用官方模型 API 时，应默认关闭 Session Log 上传： 作为用户，我可以理解官方想要持续改进 DeepSeek 模型与产品的意愿和需求，但默认开启这个功能并不足够尊重用户的数据安全与隐私，哪怕它可以被手动关闭。况且 API 服务是商业付费的，也和网页对话等场景不同，在用户本地的 Agent Harness 环境中运行时，上下文历史中可能带有更多未脱敏的隐私信息。 - 网页搜索功能应提供显式关闭入口，如果能支持更多的上游服务接口让用户选择会更好： 目前在配置了官方 DeepSeek API 的情况下，内置的网页搜索功能会不断消耗用户的账户余额，且经过我的实际测试和长期体验，发现模型会倾向于主动调用这个接口而不是用户提供的第三方的搜索技能或工具。作为实用的辅助功能，网页搜索可以默认随 DeepSeek API 服务开启，但应该有明显的关闭入口如设置内的功能选项按钮等用于禁用它以节省 API 调用成本。
