# Defect C — `sandbox-windows-acl` Windows enforcement regression: 0.1.5-generation suite fully green → 0.1.7-rc.2 14 failures on the same machine (restricted child processes fall to ConstrainedLanguage; every granted write/read probe DENIED); reproduces on the pristine official tree

> **Reported: 2026-09-29** by a downstream consumer team.
> Prepared 2026-09-29 by ops from verified campaign evidence: `DEBT-ledger.md` §B1 (authoritative ledger), `P2-progress.md` REVIEW-SYNC-P2 修正3, `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §3.1–3.3/§7 (all in this campaign directory). Items marked **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]** were independently re-checked (git commands / log line reads) during report preparation; items marked **[evidence from retained campaign logs, not re-run]** cite on-disk logs without re-executing the test runs.

## Title (issue/discussion-ready)

`sandbox-windows-acl`: 0.1.5 → 0.1.7-rc.2 Windows enforcement regression — confined child lands in ConstrainedLanguage, granted writes DENIED; 14 suite failures on the same machine and on a pristine official tree

## Version affected

- **Verified failing:** `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` (tag `477b4f4205`) — on (a) our downstream merged tree, which has **zero diff** to `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` since the merge-base, and (b) a **pristine official checkout** (detached worktree at the tag + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, unbuilt).
- **Verified green (same machine, 0.1.5 generation):** our pre-sync base `f30e0da8df` era — full-suite log shows `runner.spec.ts` 14/14 passed and `probe.spec.ts` 3/3 passed (Evidence 1); and the 2026-09-27 campaign full green round: **21879 tests / 0 failed** on the 0.1.5-rc.2 downstream baseline, established after OS update KB5129195 (2026-09-16) **[evidence from campaign record `2026-09-27-upgrade-process-v2/CAMPAIGN-STATE.md`]**.
- **Not tested by us:** `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1` (published 2026-09-28T12:36:21Z) and current master. We note post-rc.2 upstream activity on this package (Evidence 8) and ask maintainers to confirm whether the signature below is addressed there; we can re-test on request.

## Environment (failing runs)

- Windows 10.0.26200 (Insider), x64; Node v24.19.0; pnpm 11.7.0.
- Host PowerShell = FullLanguage. Machine policy state checked clean: Smart App Control `VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState=0`; `__PSLockdownPolicy` not set; WDAC `CodeIntegrityPolicyEnforcementStatus=2` (kernel CI/HVCI on), `UsermodeCodeIntegrity=0`.
- OS updates installed at both the green 0.1.5 baseline and the red 0.1.7 runs: KB5129195 (2026-09-16), KB5126052 (2026-09-11), KB5124007 (2026-09-09) → same OS build across the regression window.
- Honesty note on Node versions: the retained 0.1.5-era full-suite log (Evidence 1) was produced under Node v22.16.0; the 2026-09-27 green round (21879/0F) ran during a campaign window in which our machine records show Node v24.19.0 (indirect evidence, `A2-baseline.md:5`); the 0.1.7-rc.2 red runs are Node v24.19.0. The pristine-official-tree reproduction (Evidence 3) is Node v24.19.0. We did not run a 0.1.5 tree under Node 24 as a dedicated control; the failure mode (restricted pwsh/node child processes, Windows token/ACL layer) is not obviously Node-major-dependent, but we disclose the difference rather than claim a controlled constant.

## Summary

On the same physical machine, the `sandbox-windows-acl` functional suite went from fully green (0.1.5 generation: runner.spec 14 tests, probe.spec 3 tests) to 14 failures on 0.1.7-rc.2 (runner.spec 13 of 19 failed; probe.spec 1 of 3 failed). Between the merge-base and the rc.2 tag, upstream rewrote this package substantially (**22 files changed, +1767/−319**), while our fork carries **zero diff** to it. The failure signature is uniform across every functional case that spawns a real restricted child process:

- the confined pwsh child reports `LANGMODE: ConstrainedLanguage` (tests assert `FullLanguage`; the host pwsh is FullLanguage);
- all capability probes inside the child return `DENIED` — `TARGET-WRITE`, `TEMP-WRITE`, `ESCAPE-WRITE`, `SECRET-READ`, `CIM` — i.e. granted writes do not materialize and the workspace-write policy effectively degrades to read-only semantics.

Unit-level suites that do not spawn real restricted children (acl / grant / token / ffi / workspace-sid / path-boundary / failure-paths) all pass, so the authorization *data* plane looks correct; the break is in the enforcement path (restricted token × ACE × Low integrity label × MIC interaction) on this OS build. The same signature makes the official `workflow-ptc` "Session file policy workspace-write" test fail deterministically on the pristine official tree (companion report, Evidence 7).

## Reproduction

Pristine official tree, isolated worktree (does not touch any downstream working tree):

```
git worktree add --detach <path>/acl-repro 477b4f4205   # tag dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2
cd <path>/acl-repro
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile                           # pnpm 11.7.0
pnpm exec vitest run packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl
# Observed: Test Files  2 failed | 11 passed (13)
#           Tests  14 failed | 150 passed (164)
```

Representative failure output (verbatim, ANSI stripped) — `runner.spec.ts` first failure:

```
FAIL  packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts > windows-acl runner > workspace-write: the confined child writes granted directories only
AssertionError: expected 'LANGMODE: ConstrainedLanguage\r\nTARG…' to contain 'LANGMODE: FullLanguage'
- Expected   LANGMODE: FullLanguage
+ Received   LANGMODE: ConstrainedLanguage
+            TARGET-WRITE: DENIED
+            TEMP-WRITE: DENIED
+            ESCAPE-WRITE: DENIED
+            SECRET-READ: DENIED
+            CIM: DENIED
 ❯ packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts:100:27
```

and `probe.spec.ts`:

```
FAIL  packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/probe.spec.ts > AclSandbox write restriction > allows writes only in granted directories and denies the escape write
AssertionError: child output:
TARGET-WRITE: DENIED
TEMP-WRITE: DENIED
ESCAPE-WRITE: DENIED
SECRET-READ: DENIED
: expected 'TARGET-WRITE: DENIED\r\nTEMP-WRITE: D…' to contain 'TARGET-WRITE: OK'
 ❯ packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/probe.spec.ts:85:48
```

## Evidence

1. **0.1.5-generation green baseline, same machine** — retained full-suite log `G:\000Github\zDSH\zDSH-docs\TMP\vitest-full.log`: line 1160 `✓ packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts (14 tests) 10534ms` with per-test green lines (e.g. "workspace-write: the confined child writes granted directories only ✓ 772ms"); line 2670 `✓ packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/probe.spec.ts (3 tests) 728ms`. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 by direct log read]** Additionally, the 2026-09-27 campaign recorded a **21879 tests / 0 failed** full green round on the 0.1.5-rc.2 baseline, after KB5129195 was installed **[evidence from campaign record]**.
2. **0.1.7-rc.2 red on our merged tree** — retained full-suite log `G:\000Github\DSH\TMP\sync-p2-vitest-final.log`: line 149 `❯ packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts (19 tests | 13 failed) 18712ms`; line 20 `❯ .../probe.spec.ts (3 tests | 1 failed) 842ms`; verbatim failure blocks quoted in Reproduction (log lines 8487–8539). **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 by direct log read]**
3. **Pristine official tree reproduces** — `G:\000Github\zDSH\zDSH-wt\diag-acl-suite.log` (detached worktree at tag `477b4f4205`, frozen install, unbuilt, no downstream code present): `Test Files 2 failed | 11 passed (13)`; `Tests 14 failed | 150 passed (164)`. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 by direct log read; run itself not repeated]** This excludes fork-side code as the cause.
4. **Upstream rewrote the package inside the window** — `git diff --stat c291e7961a 477b4f4205 -- packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` → **22 files changed, 1767 insertions(+), 319 deletions(-)**. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
5. **Zero downstream diff** — `git diff c291e7961a f30e0da8df -- packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` → **0 lines** (merge-base to our pre-sync HEAD). **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
6. **The failing assertion is unchanged across versions** — `tests/runner.spec.ts:100` reads `expect(result.stdout).toContain('LANGMODE: FullLanguage')` identically at `f30e0da8df` (0.1.5 base) and `477b4f4205` (rc.2) **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 via git show]**. The suite grew from 14 to 19 runner tests (upstream added cases); the regression claim rests on the same assertions flipping green→red, and on the whole functional-child-process family failing.
7. **Cross-package impact** — on the same pristine official tree, `packages/workflow/workflow-ptc/tests/source-runtime.compat.spec.ts` "enforces the Session file policy workspace-write" fails deterministically with `ENOENT ... workspace/inside.txt` (authorized write never materializes) — full mechanism chain in our companion report (defect-f). **[evidence from retained log `diag-ptc-official-unbuilt.log`; ops re-verified key lines 2026-09-29]**
8. **Suspect change window** — upstream commits touching this package between merge-base and rc.2 include `d5ad3baeb5` "fix(sandbox): confine Windows deletes with a Low integrity label", `36e632751e` "fix(sandbox): deny the ambient parent-delete right inside granted roots", `3d5ba3b83f` "fix(sandbox): scope the delete deny to containers", `b35a3b29eb` "fix(sandbox): pin ACL source resolution and recognize Node denials", among test/refactor commits **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 via git log c291e7961a..477b4f4205]**. Post-rc.2 master shows an active windows-acl workstream (`1d56bd5628` diagnosis skill for ACL denials, `927b59e138`, `b876f825c7`, `5bab07157f`, `d2d755077b`, `99b887a177`, shipped in `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`) **[live GitHub API check 2026-09-29]** — we have not tested whether these resolve the signature on our machine.
9. **Community context** — a wave of ≈20+ Windows-related regression reports against 0.1.7-rc.2 appeared in this repository's Discussions on 2026-09-26/27 (e.g. #8011 "V8 FATAL writing session projection cache on Windows"), all community-authored with no official replies as of our 2026-09-28 survey **[evidence from campaign intelligence record `P0-campaign-card.md` §4.1; #8011 existence live-verified 2026-09-29]**.

## Related upstream threads (checked live 2026-09-29 — all distinct signatures, listed to aid triage)

- **Host-side grant/init failure family** — #7504 (consolidated: `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` Win32 5 at `grantWrite` when the workspace DACL lacks WRITE_OWNER; data-drive volume; fail-closed: no child ever spawns; thread confirms the Low-label write is new in 0.1.7-alpha.1 and still reproduces on rc.2), #7622 (SACL label write needs SeSecurityPrivilege for non-elevated hosts), #7816, #7720, #7804. **Ours differs:** grant/init succeeds (children do spawn and produce output); the failure is enforcement-side — granted writes denied and child pwsh in ConstrainedLanguage; our workspace roots are on the system drive under the user profile; unit-level grant/ACE suites pass on our machine.
- **Child-launch failure family (0xC0000142 / STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED, exit 127, NULL std handles)** — #8193, #8142, #7836, #7292, #8170, #8158, #8208. **Ours differs:** children launch and run; their in-child capability probes report DENIED.
- **#4924** — ConstrainedLanguage stderr pollution under read-only mode (0.1.5 era). **Ours differs:** version window (0.1.5-green → 0.1.7-red), mode (workspace-write grants not materializing), and scope (the package's own functional test suite).
- **#8209** — workspace-write sandbox breaks git-for-Windows (MSYS binaries fail to start; schannel key store unreachable). **Ours differs:** no binary-start failure; pwsh/node children run but lack their granted capabilities.

## Expected vs Actual

- **Expected:** as asserted by the package's own tests and as observed on this machine with the 0.1.5 generation — a confined child process runs with a WRITE_RESTRICTED token yet keeps FullLanguage mode; granted directories are writable (`TARGET-WRITE: OK`, `TEMP-WRITE: OK`), escape writes and secret reads stay denied, CIM query works.
- **Actual:** on 0.1.7-rc.2 the confined child lands in `ConstrainedLanguage` and **every** probe — including the ones that must succeed under a workspace-write grant — returns `DENIED`. The grant/authorization data plane still passes its unit tests; only real restricted-child-process enforcement fails, for both pwsh and node children.

## Suggested fix direction

We do not claim a specific root cause — the exact broken Win32 link (Low integrity label vs. ACE materialization vs. restricting-SID/MIC interaction on build 26200) was not forensically isolated on our side (honest limitation). We suggest:

1. Investigate the interaction of the delete-confinement rework (`d5ad3baeb5`, `36e632751e`, `3d5ba3b83f`) with Windows Insider build 26200; the uniform `ConstrainedLanguage` + all-DENIED signature suggests the restricted/WriteRestricted token now triggers an OS lockdown evaluation that it did not in the 0.1.5 code path (our hypothesis, confidence: medium).
2. Confirm whether the post-rc.2 `windows-sandbox-acl-diagnosis` workstream already addresses this signature; if it does, a note here would help downstreams pinning rc.2.
3. Consider a Windows CI lane that runs the functional restricted-child-process assertions (from our reading of `ci.yml`, the node-compat matrix is ubuntu-only and the Windows lanes are build/coverage-oriented — inference from static reading, confidence: medium).

We are willing to run the new diagnosis skill / collect additional traces (Process Monitor, token dumps) on request.

## Workaround (downstream)

None possible on the package itself (zero-diff surface for us). We record the 14 failures as platform-conditional red in our downstream test ledger (excluded from our regression gate, tracked per-release), and plan to re-verify against `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`.

discussions.title: [Bug][0.2.0-rc.1] Plugin install rejected by rows the bundle itself disables (plugin-manager checks every patch-inserted name)
discussions.body:
> Posting as a core maintainer of `dsh-tui` (`ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI`) — this is the install failure our users hit on 0.2.0-rc.1, traced to host code.

### Environment

- DSH 0.2.0-rc.1, official desktop on Windows. Upstream `master` is at the same commit as tag `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1` (`4878cdab`), so this is current code.
- Failing install: `@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui@0.11.2` — I maintain `ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI`, and this is what our users hit when they install or update the TUI plugin on 0.2.0-rc.1.

### What the user sees

```text
插件安装失败
@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread@0.1.5-rc.3 与 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 不兼容（要求
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime ^0.1.5-rc.3, @deepseek-ai/dsh-session ^0.1.5-rc.3, @deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout ^0.1.5-rc.3）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets@0.1.5-rc.3 与 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 不兼容（要求
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent, dsh-atomic-write, dsh-invariants, dsh-home-paths, dsh-scope, dsh-session,
  dsh-session-projection, dsh-settings, dsh-system-prompt, dsh-typert-protocol, dsh-tools — all ^0.1.5-rc.3）
```

The installation is then rolled back (`restored package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and node_modules`). Neither package is one the user asked for, and `0.1.5-rc.3` is neither the installed nor the running version — hence the reports of the installer "misreporting dependency versions".

### Root cause

1. `dsh-tui` carries two back-compat shim rows in its own `cordis.patch.yml`, naming pre-rename host packages:

   ```yaml
   - id: dsh-tui-code-runtime
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread'   # renamed to dsh-ptc-runtime-node
     disabled: !!js (…resolves dsh-ptc-runtime-node → true)
   - id: dsh-tui-agent-presets
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets'                # renamed to dsh-agent-preset(-registry)
     disabled: !!js (…resolves dsh-agent-preset-registry → true)
   ```

   On 0.2.0-rc.1 both expressions evaluate `true`, so the rows are disabled and never imported.

2. `packages/boot/plugin-manager/src/operations.ts:249` (`bundleComponentManifests`) collects **every `row.name`** from the bundle's composed insert patches — it never looks at `disabled` and never evaluates `!!js`. Each collected name is then resolved and judged by `evaluatePluginCompatibility` (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/plugin-compatibility.ts:61`), and a hit fails the whole operation (`operations.ts:478`, rejection and rollback at `:489-520`).

3. The startup path does it correctly: `packages/boot/app-boot/src/compatibility-preflight.ts:122` skips rows with `disabled === true`, so at runtime nothing incompatible is ever loaded. Only the installer refuses.

4. `evaluatePluginCompatibility` compares every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer against the single `getDshRuntimeVersion()` (app-boot's own version, `plugin-compatibility.ts:44`). The legacy names were last published at `0.1.5-rc.3`, so `^0.1.5-rc.3` can never be satisfied by `0.2.0-rc.1`: once such a name is fed into the check, an "incompatible" verdict is guaranteed by construction.

5. Where the reported version comes from: `resolveBundleDir` (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts:630`) resolves the **installation anchor first** (Node lookup from the running `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package), so a leftover copy under an older/staging runtime supplies `…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets@0.1.5-rc.3`. The message therefore names a package version that is neither installed in the profile nor provided by the running host.

### Reproduction

Against the shipped 0.2.0-rc.1 packages (`npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.2.0-rc.1`), walking the real `dsh-tui@0.11.2` patch exactly as `bundleComponentManifests` does:

```js
import { composeEntries, evaluatePluginCompatibility, loadOverlayPatches } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot'
const patches = loadOverlayPatches('dsh', '<dsh-tui>/cordis.patch.yml')
const names = new Set()
const visit = (rows) => { for (const row of rows) {
  if (row.group && Array.isArray(row.config)) visit(row.config)
  if (typeof row.name !== 'string' || row.name.startsWith('.') || row.name.startsWith('/') || row.name.includes(':')) continue
  const parts = row.name.split('/')
  names.add(parts.slice(0, row.name.startsWith('@') ? 2 : 1).join('/'))
} }
visit(composeEntries([patches.filter(p => p.insert !== undefined)]))
console.log([...names].filter(n => n.startsWith('@deepseek-ai/dsh-')))
```

Output — the two disabled shim rows are in the checked set, and both verdicts reproduce the message above verbatim (3 peers / 11 peers, all `^0.1.5-rc.3`):

```text
[ '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner' ]

@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread@0.1.5-rc.3 -> INCOMPATIBLE
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets@0.1.5-rc.3 -> INCOMPATIBLE
```

For completeness: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.2.0-rc.1` no longer depends on either legacy name, so nothing else in the 0.2.0-rc.1 tree needs them.

### Impact

- A third-party bundle whose patch carries a conditionally disabled legacy row cannot be installed on 0.2.x at all, even though it loads cleanly: the shim rows are exactly the mechanism that lets one plugin support several host lines.
- The refusal names unrelated packages and pre-release versions of an older line, so users (and plugin authors) reasonably read it as the installer misreporting dependency versions.
- This is not dsh-tui specific — any bundle that keeps a `disabled: !!js` shim, or that mentions a renamed host package anywhere in an `insert:` list, inherits it.

### Suggestions

1. In `bundleComponentManifests`, apply the same admission rule the loader and `compatibility-preflight.ts` use: skip rows whose `disabled` evaluates truthy (which means evaluating the entry schema first, or deferring the component check to the startup preflight, which already has a `ctx` to evaluate against).
2. Tie component resolution to the running installation's version line rather than to any older anchor copy, so a stale `node_modules` from a previous runtime cannot decide what the current host "requires".
3. For retired/renamed package names (`dsh-code-runtime*`, `dsh-agent-presets`, …), emit a distinct diagnosis ("renamed/retired in this host") instead of a peer-range incompatibility, so the message stops implying that the user's plugin is broken.

### Related

- #8202 — a user on 0.2.0-rc.1 hit a same-shaped refusal for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (`dist-tags.latest` is `0.0.1-rc.1` while `next` is `0.2.0-rc.1`), i.e. another case where the version named in the refusal is not the version in play. Secondary observation, not investigated to code level.
- #8199 — same theme of a major host update stranding third-party plugins.

Happy to prepare a patch for (1) and to test it against the TUI bundle if that helps.

---

### 中文摘要

`dsh-tui@0.11.2` 的 bundle patch 带两行**条件禁用的兼容垫片**（旧包名 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread` /
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets`，在 0.2.0-rc.1 上 `disabled: !!js` 恒为 true，运行时根本不会加载）。
但 `plugin-manager` 的安装后复查 `bundleComponentManifests`（`operations.ts:249`）把 patch 里**所有**被提到的包名都当待加载组件去判兼容性，
于是这两行永远命不中的旧 peer 范围（最后发布就是 `0.1.5-rc.3`）让整次安装被拒绝并回滚；报出的版本还来自**旧运行时残留副本**
（`resolveBundleDir` 安装锚点优先）。启动路径是对的（`compatibility-preflight.ts:122` 会跳过 `disabled`），只有安装器误拒。
建议：安装器复用加载器/启动准入的 `disabled` 语义；组件解析绑定当前运行时的版本线；
对已改名/退役的包名给「已改名/已移除」的定向诊断，而不是版本不兼容。

discussions.title: python/sdk-runtime/package.json: duplicate keys @deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime and -node in the same dependencies object (rc.2 lines 33–34/77–78; still on master) — strict JSON tooling rejects or silently de-duplicates
discussions.body:
# Defect D — `python/sdk-runtime/package.json` declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node` twice inside the same `dependencies` object (duplicate JSON keys) — present in `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` and still on master

> **Reported: 2026-09-29** by a downstream consumer team.
> Prepared 2026-09-29 by ops from verified campaign evidence: `DEBT-ledger.md` §B4 (authoritative ledger), `P2-progress.md` 2026-09-28 18:26 entry + 观察项② (this campaign directory). Items marked **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]** were independently re-checked during report preparation.

## Title (issue/discussion-ready)

`python/sdk-runtime/package.json`: duplicate keys `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime` and `-node` in the same `dependencies` object (rc.2 lines 33–34/77–78; still on master) — strict JSON tooling rejects or silently de-duplicates

## Version affected

- **Verified:** `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` (tag `477b4f4205`) — `git show 477b4f4205:python/sdk-runtime/package.json` shows both keys twice within the single `dependencies` object that opens at line 7: lines 33–34 and lines 77–78. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
- **Still present on current master:** fetched via GitHub contents API on 2026-09-29 — same duplicates at lines 33–34 / 77–78. **[ops live check 2026-09-29]**
- Our downstream merged copy (HEAD blob, byte-stable across repeated SHA-256 sampling, `git status` clean) carries the duplicates verbatim at lines 33–34 / 79–80 — the +2 line offset comes from the only two lines we ever added to this file (`dsh-compat`, `dsh-model-slots` dependency insertions; `git diff 477b4f4205..HEAD -- python/sdk-runtime/package.json` shows exactly those two `+` lines and nothing else). **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**

## Summary

The `dependencies` object of `python/sdk-runtime/package.json` contains each of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node` **twice** (all four lines read `"workspace:*"`). RFC 8259 §4 says object member names SHOULD be unique and warns that implementations behave unpredictably with duplicates; ECMAScript `JSON.parse` deterministically keeps the **last** occurrence. Today both copies carry identical values, so runtime resolution is unaffected — the defect is **latent**, but it has three concrete costs:

1. **Strict tooling rejects or flags the file** (JSON Schema validators, `jsonc` no-dupe-keys lint rules, some package-manager code paths).
2. **Any programmatic round-trip silently de-duplicates** — `JSON.parse` → modify → `JSON.stringify` drops the earlier pair, producing an unintended 2-line diff that *looks* like someone removed dependencies. Our sync pipeline had to switch to text-line insertion for this file specifically to avoid that class of surprise (see Workaround).
3. **Future divergence is silent** — if the two copies of a key ever get different values, last-wins resolution hides the edit that got dropped.

## Reproduction

```bash
# from a checkout of dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 (or current master):
grep -n '"@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime' python/sdk-runtime/package.json
#   33:    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime": "workspace:*",
#   34:    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node": "workspace:*",
#   77:    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime": "workspace:*",
#   78:    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node": "workspace:*",
# (all four lines are inside the ONE "dependencies" object that starts at line 7)
```

Round-trip demonstration (Node v24.19.0, run 2026-09-29 on our tree carrying the official content):

```js
const src = fs.readFileSync('python/sdk-runtime/package.json', 'utf8');
const rt  = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(src), null, 4);
// occurrences of '"@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime":'      raw: 2 -> round-trip: 1
// occurrences of '"@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node":'  raw: 2 -> round-trip: 1
// JSON.parse succeeds (last-wins), re-serialize silently drops 2 lines.
```

## Evidence

1. **Official tag content** — `git show 477b4f4205:python/sdk-runtime/package.json | grep -n dsh-ptc-runtime` → hits at lines 33, 34, 77, 78. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
2. **Current master content** — GitHub contents API fetch (2026-09-29), same four lines at 33–34 / 77–78. **[ops live check 2026-09-29]**
3. **Downstream copy is byte-stable and minimally-diffed** — working file SHA-256 identical to `HEAD` blob across repeated sampling; `git diff 477b4f4205..HEAD -- python/sdk-runtime/package.json` = exactly +2 lines (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compat`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-slots`), duplicates untouched. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
4. **Round-trip silent dedup** — measured 2026-09-29: raw 2 occurrences per key → 1 per key after `JSON.parse`+`JSON.stringify` (2 lines dropped total); retained output `G:\000Github\zDSH\zDSH-docs\TMP\pub2-probe\dupkey-roundtrip.log`. **[ops run 2026-09-29]**
5. **Downstream handling record** — during the 0.1.7-rc.2 merge (2026-09-28), our pipeline deliberately avoided JSON round-trip on this file ("round-trip 不安全→文本行插入，JSON_VALID，重复 key 原样保留不越界修复") and listed the defect for upstream reporting (`P2-progress.md` 18:26 A-class entry + 观察项②; `DEBT-ledger.md` §B4). **[evidence from campaign records]**
6. **Prior art in this repository (same defect class, different file)** — #3386 (2026-08-19) and #631 (2026-08-14) reported a duplicate `@deepseek-ai/cordis` key in `packages/host/apiproxy/package.json` `devDependencies` (breaking `bun install` with "Duplicate key ... in object literal"). That is a different file and section from ours; we found **no existing report** covering `python/sdk-runtime/package.json` (live search 2026-09-29). The recurrence across files motivates the repo-wide CI gate suggested below.

## Expected vs Actual

- **Expected:** unique member names per JSON object (RFC 8259 §4 SHOULD), i.e. each dependency listed once in `dependencies`.
- **Actual:** two dependency names listed twice each inside the same object; parsers silently keep the last copy; strict validators and lint rules flag or reject the file.

## Suggested fix

1. Delete the second pair (master lines 77–78), keeping one entry per key. (Both copies are `"workspace:*"`, so this is value-preserving.)
2. Add a CI uniqueness gate for all `package.json` files — e.g. a `jsonc-eslint-parser` `no-dupe-keys` lint over JSON manifests, or a one-line Node check (`JSON.parse` + raw key-count comparison) — so duplicate keys cannot re-enter silently.

## Workaround (downstream)

We never round-trip this file programmatically: dependency additions are done as text-line insertions with a byte-identical round-trip pre-check, preserving the official duplicates verbatim (recorded in Evidence 5). This keeps our diff minimal but obviously does not fix the file for anyone else.

discussions.title: browser-use-stagehand-native: worker-client.ts passes env: {} to new Worker — on Windows the worker's os.tmpdir() degrades to the relative path undefined\temp; the src-mode tsx cache lands in a literal undefined/ directory under the process CWD
discussions.body:
# Defect E — `browser-use-stagehand-native` starts its Worker with `env: {}`; on Windows `os.tmpdir()` inside the worker degrades to the **relative** path `undefined\temp`, so tsx cache (and any temp writes) land in a literal `undefined/` directory under the process CWD

> **Reported: 2026-09-29** by a downstream consumer team.
> Prepared 2026-09-29 by ops from verified campaign evidence: `DEBT-ledger.md` §B5 (authoritative ledger, [handoff-carried] qualification from task card P3-CFIX) + `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §4-U3 (independent trace observation). Items marked **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]** / **[ops live probe 2026-09-29]** were independently re-checked or freshly executed during report preparation.

## Title (issue/discussion-ready)

`browser-use-stagehand-native`: `worker-client.ts` passes `env: {}` to `new Worker` — on Windows the worker's `os.tmpdir()` degrades to the relative path `undefined\temp`; the src-mode tsx cache lands in a literal `undefined/` directory under the process CWD

## Version affected

- **Verified:** `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` (tag `477b4f4205`); the file is byte-identical in our downstream tree (`git diff 477b4f4205..HEAD -- packages/experimental/browser-use-stagehand-native/src/worker-client.ts` → empty). **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
- **Still present on current master:** fetched via GitHub contents API 2026-09-29 — same `const env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}` construction; no post-rc.2 commits touched this package except the 0.2.0-rc.1 release bump. **[ops live check 2026-09-29]**
- We did not bisect when the `env: {}` isolation design was introduced; the report targets the code as it stands at rc.2 and master.

## Summary

`worker-client.ts` (`openBrowserWorker`, consumed via `src/index.ts:106`) deliberately starts the Stagehand worker with an empty environment — line 20 comment: *"Only explicit model credentials cross in workerData; ambient credentials and proxy settings stay outside."* — passing through only `TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH` when set:

```ts
// worker-client.ts lines 21-31 (dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 == master, verbatim)
const env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}
if (process.env.TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH !== undefined) env.TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH = process.env.TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH
let worker: Worker
/* v8 ignore next 3 -- native.e2e.ts starts the bundled Worker through a plain-Node provider fixture. */
if (!import.meta.url.endsWith('.ts')) {
  worker = new Worker(entry, { workerData: config, execArgv: [], env })
} else {
  const source = new URL('./worker.ts', import.meta.url)
  const bootstrap = `import { register } from ${JSON.stringify(import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm/api'))}; register(); await import(${JSON.stringify(source.href)})`
  worker = new Worker(new URL(`data:text/javascript,${encodeURIComponent(bootstrap)}`), { workerData: config, execArgv: [], env })
}
```

On Windows, a worker thread with an empty `env` has no `TEMP`, `TMP`, or `SystemRoot`. Node's `os.tmpdir()` win32 fallback then produces `` `${process.env.SystemRoot}\temp` `` → the **relative** path `undefined\temp`. The src-mode branch (line 29–30) bootstraps **tsx** inside that worker; tsx puts its cache under `os.tmpdir()`, so with CWD = repository root the cache is written to `<repo>\undefined\temp\tsx-<user>\...` — a junk directory that pollutes the working tree, breaks clean-tree checks, and escapes any expectation that temp files live in the OS temp directory. On POSIX the same code degrades to the documented `/tmp` fallback, so the visible damage is win32-specific (inference from Node's documented fallback behavior; not probed on POSIX).

## Reproduction

Minimal probe, Windows 10.0.26200, Node v24.19.0 — replicates the exact `env: {}` worker construction of `worker-client.ts:21-26`:

```js
// probe.mjs
import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads';
import os from 'node:os';
console.log('HOST tmpdir:', JSON.stringify(os.tmpdir()));
const code = 'import os from "node:os"; import {parentPort} from "node:worker_threads";'
  + 'parentPort.postMessage(JSON.stringify({tmpdir: os.tmpdir(), platform: process.platform,'
  + ' TEMP: process.env.TEMP ?? null, TMP: process.env.TMP ?? null, SystemRoot: process.env.SystemRoot ?? null}));';
const w = new Worker(code, { eval: true, env: {} });
w.on('message', (m) => { console.log('WORKER env:{} ->', m.toString()); w.terminate(); });
```

Observed output (run 2026-09-29, retained at `G:\000Github\zDSH\zDSH-docs\TMP\pub2-probe\probe-env-empty.log`):

```
HOST tmpdir: "C:\\Users\\ZS\\AppData\\Local\\Temp"
WORKER env:{} -> {"tmpdir":"undefined\\temp","platform":"win32","TEMP":null,"TMP":null,"SystemRoot":null}
```

End-to-end trace (real runs): after executing src-mode test suites with CWD = repository root, the tree contains

```
<repo>\undefined\temp\tsx-ZS\17906-1512a1911edecc9ddfd4d60687e2031fe03d8a5b
<repo>\undefined\temp\tsx-ZS\17906-26189d99599b6c98e18ff08c29636942a3b9f3eb
... (5 tsx cache entries observed)
```

## Evidence

1. **Source, zero downstream delta** — `worker-client.ts:21-31` quoted verbatim above; `git diff 477b4f4205..HEAD` on the file is empty. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**
2. **Master unchanged** — GitHub contents API fetch 2026-09-29 shows the identical `env: {}` construction. **[ops live check 2026-09-29]**
3. **Live probe** — output above: host tmpdir normal; `env:{}` worker on win32 → `"undefined\\temp"` with TEMP/TMP/SystemRoot all null. **[ops live probe 2026-09-29, Node v24.19.0, Windows 10.0.26200; matches the probe recorded during our P3-CFIX task (`{"tmpdir":"undefined\\temp"}`)]**
4. **On-disk trace** — `undefined\temp\tsx-ZS\17906-<sha1>` ×5 entries at our repository root **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 by directory listing]**; independently observed during our compat diagnosis on 2026-09-29 as an unexplained untracked `undefined/` directory ("某脚本 mkdir undefined 类 bug 痕迹", `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §4-U3). The `tsx-ZS` cache path names tsx (bootstrapped in-worker by line 29–30) as the writer.
5. **Consumer path** — `src/index.ts:106` calls `openBrowserWorker` (the only production entry to this worker construction). **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]**

## Expected vs Actual

- **Expected:** environment isolation for the worker (no ambient credentials/proxy) without breaking OS-level path resolution — `os.tmpdir()` inside the worker should return an absolute, usable temp directory, and tooling caches (tsx) should land there.
- **Actual:** on win32 the empty env makes `os.tmpdir()` return the relative junk path `undefined\temp`; tsx then creates `undefined/temp/tsx-<user>/` under whatever the process CWD is (repository root in dev/test), polluting the working tree and writing outside any temp-directory expectation.

## Suggested fix

Pick one (option 1 keeps the isolation intent intact):

1. **Pass a minimal OS-environment allowlist into the worker env** — on win32: `TEMP`, `TMP`, `SystemRoot` (all three: `SystemRoot` also matters for general Win32 API behavior in the worker); on POSIX: `TMPDIR`. Credentials and proxy variables stay excluded, preserving the documented isolation design.
2. **Set `TSX_CACHE_DIR` explicitly** (and any other SDK temp-dir knobs) from the host to an absolute path — e.g. derived from the host's own `os.tmpdir()` — passed through `env` alongside `TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH`.
3. Host-side hardening regardless of 1/2: fail fast (or warn) if a worker reports a relative `os.tmpdir()`.

## Workaround (downstream, applied)

We added `undefined/` to our `.gitignore` (commit `473c778757`, 2026-09-29) to keep clean-tree checks green. This masks the symptom only — the cache still lands in the CWD, and any downstream without that ignore line sees a polluted working tree. Not a fix.

discussions.title: workflow-ptc: "enforces the Session file policy workspace-write" fails deterministically on Windows build 26200 at dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 — the authorized workspace write never materializes (ENOENT ... inside.txt); reproduces on the pristine official tree
discussions.body:
# Defect F — `workflow-ptc` "Session file policy workspace-write" deterministically fails on Windows build 26200: the authorized workspace write never materializes (`ENOENT ... inside.txt`) — reproduces on the **pristine official tree** at `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2`; same enforcement-chain failure as the `sandbox-windows-acl` suite regression (companion report)

> **Reported: 2026-09-29** by a downstream consumer team.
> Prepared 2026-09-29 by ops. **Evidence source:** the five-element upstream evidence pack `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §3.4 (with §3.1–3.3 mechanism chain and §7 reproduction appendix), authored by researcher during task card SYNC-P3-COMPAT (campaign directory `2026-09-28-sync-017`), produced in isolated detached worktrees (pristine official tag tree + downstream HEAD tree, frozen installs). Items marked **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29]** were independently re-checked (log line reads / source line reads) during report preparation; test runs themselves were not repeated **[evidence from retained diagnosis logs]**.

## Title (issue/discussion-ready)

`workflow-ptc`: "enforces the Session file policy workspace-write" fails deterministically on Windows build 26200 at `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` — the authorized workspace write never materializes (`ENOENT ... inside.txt`); reproduces on the pristine official tree

## Version affected

- **Verified failing:** `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` (tag `477b4f4205`) — pristine official checkout (detached worktree + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, pnpm 11.7.0, **unbuilt**) reproduces the failure; our downstream HEAD tree (built) shows the identical signature → independent of build state and of any downstream change (our delta does not touch workflow/ptc-runtime/sandbox/vendor surfaces involved).
- **Not a 0.1.5 regression for this specific test:** `workflow-ptc` is new in 0.1.7 (0.1.5 name: `workflow-worker-thread`, whose `source-worker.compat.spec.ts` had a single smoke case and no file-policy cases). The workspace-write case comes from official commits `35af8698c2` "execute orchestration in the sandboxed PTC runtime" / `34f80b8e6e`. The regression baseline is therefore the pristine-official-tree self-reproduction below, plus the same-tree `sandbox-windows-acl` suite behavior (which *is* a 0.1.5-green → 0.1.7-red regression on this machine — see companion report).
- **Not tested by us:** `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1` (published 2026-09-28T12:36:21Z), which includes the post-rc.2 `windows-sandbox-acl-diagnosis` workstream; we ask maintainers to confirm whether this is addressed there, and can re-test on request. **[ops live release check 2026-09-29]**

## Environment

- Windows 10.0.26200 (Insider), x64; Node v24.19.0; pnpm 11.7.0.
- Host pwsh = FullLanguage. Machine policy state checked clean: SAC `VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState=0`, `__PSLockdownPolicy` absent, WDAC `CodeIntegrityPolicyEnforcementStatus=2` (kernel CI/HVCI on), `UsermodeCodeIntegrity=0`.
- OS updates installed: KB5129195 (2026-09-16), KB5126052 (2026-09-11), KB5124007 (2026-09-09).

## Summary

The official compat test `packages/workflow/workflow-ptc/tests/source-runtime.compat.spec.ts` — case "enforces the Session file policy workspace-write" — fails deterministically (not a flake; reproduced across isolated reruns and two independent trees). Semantics of the failure: the sandboxed orchestration run **completes** (stopReason `completed`, spec line 56 passes) and the **escape** write outside the workspace is correctly blocked (spec line 57 passes), but the write that the policy explicitly **grants** inside the workspace never appears on disk — the assertion at spec line 58 dies with `ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:/Users/ZS/.dsh-workflow-test-AIaPfg/workspace/inside.txt'`. In other words, `workspace-write` silently degrades to read-only semantics for the real confined child process, while the read-only policy case and the smoke case pass.

On the same pristine tree in the same session, the whole `sandbox-windows-acl` functional family shows the enforcement-side signature: confined pwsh children report `LANGMODE: ConstrainedLanguage` (host is FullLanguage) and every probe — including ones that must succeed under grants — returns `DENIED` (`TARGET-WRITE / TEMP-WRITE / ESCAPE-WRITE / SECRET-READ / CIM`). Unit-level ACL/grant/token suites pass, so the authorization data plane computes correctly; the break is in enforcement against real restricted child processes on this OS build.

## Reproduction

Isolated worktree method (from `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §7; does not touch any downstream working tree):

```
git worktree add --detach <path>/ptc-repro 477b4f4205   # tag dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2
cd <path>/ptc-repro
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile                          # pnpm 11.7.0

pnpm exec vitest run packages/workflow/workflow-ptc/tests/source-runtime.compat.spec.ts
# Observed: (3 tests | 1 failed)
#   Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:/Users/ZS/.dsh-workflow-test-AIaPfg/workspace/inside.txt'
#   (source-runtime.compat.spec.ts:58; lines 56-57 pass)

pnpm exec vitest run packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl
# Observed: Test Files 2 failed | 11 passed (13); Tests 14 failed | 150 passed (164)
#   signature: LANGMODE: ConstrainedLanguage (expected FullLanguage)
#              TARGET-WRITE / TEMP-WRITE / ESCAPE-WRITE / SECRET-READ / CIM: DENIED
```

## Evidence

1. **Pristine official tree, unbuilt, reproduces** — retained log `G:\000Github\zDSH\zDSH-wt\diag-ptc-official-unbuilt.log`: `❯ packages/workflow/workflow-ptc/tests/source-runtime.compat.spec.ts (3 tests | 1 failed) 1639ms`; `Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\ZS\.dsh-workflow-test-AIaPfg\workspace\inside.txt'`; `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 by direct log read; run not repeated]** No downstream code exists in this tree.
2. **Downstream HEAD tree, built, same signature** — retained log `diag-ptc-zdsh-BUILT.log` (1F/2P identical) → independent of build state and of downstream delta. **[evidence from retained diagnosis logs]**
3. **Same-tree enforcement signature** — retained log `diag-acl-suite.log`: `sandbox-windows-acl` suite `14 failed | 150 passed (164)`, `Test Files 2 failed | 11 passed (13)`; runner.spec first failure `expected 'LANGMODE: ConstrainedLanguage…' to contain 'LANGMODE: FullLanguage'` with all probes `DENIED`. **[ops re-verified 2026-09-29 by direct log read]** Detailed in the companion report (defect-c).
4. **Mechanism chain (file:line)** — `workflow-ptc/src/index.ts:166` resolves the policy with the session (`sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session: request.parent.session })`) → `sandbox-policy/src/index.ts:164-169` takes the session-scoped authorized path → `ptc-runtime-node/src/index.ts:110-111` sets cwd to `sandboxPolicy.workspaceRoot`, `:224` calls `ctx.sandbox.confine(...)`, `:236` spawns the child → win32 platform chain selects `windows-acl` (`sandbox-local` PLATFORM_CHAINS, enforcement `partial`) → `materializeAclGrant` installs the workspace-root standing ACE (capability SID derived via sha256 of the canonical workspace root, `workspace-sid.ts`) + private-temp revocable ACE + runner dual-SID flags (`windowsAclRunnerArgv`) → runner uses a WRITE_RESTRICTED token (`token.ts:232`: `DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | LUA_TOKEN | WRITE_RESTRICTED`) + Low integrity label on granted dirs + ambient-delete deny. **[ops re-verified the quoted line numbers on the HEAD tree 2026-09-29 — all listed surfaces carry zero downstream diff]**
5. **Controls / falsification** — unit-level ACL/grant/token/ffi/workspace-sid/path-boundary/failure-paths suites all green (authorization data plane correct); read-only mode green (token restriction works — escape writes blocked); only the "authorized write materializes inside a real restricted child" link fails; both pwsh and node child kinds fail identically; machine lockdown-policy state verified clean (host not in CLM). **[evidence from `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §3.2/§3.4 element 4, logs retained]**
6. **Prior-report check** — researcher search of this repository's Discussions/Issues for `ConstrainedLanguage OR "workspace-write" windows` returned 0 matching reports (2026-09-29) **[evidence from `P3-compat-diagnosis.md` §3.4 element 5]**; ops re-runs a live duplicate check immediately before submission (this card's hard gate).

## Expected vs Actual

- **Expected (per the official test's own assertions):** under Session file policy `workspace-write`, the confined orchestration child can write inside the granted workspace root (`inside.txt` materializes), while writes outside stay blocked.
- **Actual:** the child completes, the outside write is blocked, but the **granted** inside write silently does not happen (`ENOENT` on read-back) — the policy behaves as read-only. Deterministic on this machine/OS build; the whole windows-acl functional enforcement layer shows the same denial signature.

## Suggested fix direction

We do not claim a specific root cause — the exact broken Win32 link (Low integrity label vs. ACE materialization vs. restricting-SID/MIC interaction on build 26200) was not forensically isolated on our side (honest limitation, recorded as open item U2 in our diagnosis). Suggestions:

1. Treat this as the enforcement-side companion of the `sandbox-windows-acl` suite regression (companion report): same signature, same suspected window (delete-confinement rework `d5ad3baeb5` / `36e632751e` / `3d5ba3b83f` interacting with Windows Insider build 26200 — hypothesis, confidence medium).
2. Check whether the post-rc.2 `windows-sandbox-acl-diagnosis` commits (shipped in `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`) resolve it; the new diagnosis skill output on an affected machine would presumably capture exactly this denial pattern.
3. Environment caveat we cannot resolve locally: our machine is an Insider build (26200). Whether GA builds (24H2/25H2) reproduce is untested on our side (planned as a separate VM verification); the failure is deterministic here across two independent trees, and machine policy state is verified clean.

We can run the diagnosis skill, collect Process Monitor / token dumps, or test `0.2.0-rc.1` on request.

## Workaround (downstream)

None possible (zero-diff surface). We record this case as platform-conditional red in our downstream ledger (excluded from our regression gate as an upstream platform issue, re-checked per release).

## Related

- Companion report (same enforcement failure, `sandbox-windows-acl` suite itself, with the 0.1.5-green → 0.1.7-red same-machine comparison): defect-c of this submission wave — URL: https://github.com/assistant-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8219 (submitted 2026-09-29 in parallel with this post; that thread also lists the related-but-distinct upstream families).
- Distinct-signature threads checked live 2026-09-29 (none duplicates this report): #7504/#7622/#7816/#7720/#7804 (host-side grant/init fails with Win32 5 — fail-closed, child never spawns; ours spawns and completes with the granted write missing); #7243/#7244 (PTC control channel not inherited in packaged Desktop, worker-exit 0 — different failure surface and version); #8209 (MSYS/git binaries fail to start under workspace-write).
- Community context: 0.1.7-rc.2 Windows regression wave in this repository (≈20+ discussions on 2026-09-26/27, e.g. #8011), and downstream-compatibility meta thread #8096.

discussions.title: [Bug] macOS 桌面版：原生全屏下点「检查更新…」，在弹窗点确认后整屏变黑且无法恢复
discussions.body:
**环境**

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.0-rc.1（官方构建）
- macOS，窗口处于**原生全屏**
- 入口：菜单栏 →「检查更新…」

**复现步骤**

1. 让主窗口进入原生全屏（绿灯 / ⌃⌘F）
2. 菜单栏 →「检查更新…」
3. 等「正在检查更新…」结束，弹出结果弹窗
4. 点弹窗上的确认按钮
5. → 整个屏幕变黑

**实际结果**

点确认后整屏变黑，且不会自行恢复：窗口不可见、无法继续操作，必须退出进程重新打开才能正常使用。

**期望结果**

弹窗关闭后回到全屏界面，不发生黑屏。

**复现频率**

按同样步骤每次都必现。

**补充线索（未验证，供参考）**

- 更新提示在 darwin 上不是 macOS 原生 sheet，而是一个覆盖父窗口内容区的 `transparent: true` 子窗口（`apps/desktop/src/update-overlay.ts`，调用处 `nativeModal=false`）；该窗口只跟随父窗口的 move/resize，没有全屏相关处理。
- 点确认后走 `DesktopUpdateDialog.finish()`（`apps/desktop/src/update-dialog.ts`）：先向渲染进程发 `changed: null` 隐藏卡片，150 ms 后再 `destroy()` 窗口。
- 黑屏一直持续到进程退出为止，看起来像是覆盖层/父窗口在原生全屏 Space 下没有重新合成回来。

discussions.title: 侧边栏打开文件时生成的临时脚本文件会被火绒识别频繁触发警告
discussions.body: 版本：0.1.7-rc.2 OS：Windows 10 火绒版本：5.0.51.0 DSH 在 Windows 上为支持「应用打开文件 / 提取应用图标」功能，会在 %TEMP% 下创建随机目录（dsh-native-command-XXXXXX ），写入内嵌 C#（Win32 P/Invoke）的 PowerShell 脚本，并以 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 方式执行，目录用完即自删。 该行为序列与恶意软件 dropper 的典型手法高度同构（落盘随机脚本 → Bypass 执行 → 运行时编译 Win32 代码 → 自清理），触发热键等行为引擎的拦截。用户侧表现为：侧边栏文件树打开时反复弹毒、隔离文件，严重干扰使用。

discussions.title: Provider model lists go stale, and the only cure is editing node_modules
discussions.body:
# Provider model lists go stale, and the only cure is editing `node_modules`

**Package:** `@earendil-works/pi-ai` (vendored by `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, pinned `^0.85.1`)
**Observed:** `dsh 0.1.7-rc.2` → `0.2.0-rc.1`, `pi-ai 0.85.1` → `0.87.1`

## What happens

The model picker shows a list that does not match the provider. New models are absent with no
error, so it looks authoritative and is not.

The only way to correct it is to edit the catalog inside the dsh package's own `node_modules`
(`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/opencode-go.json`). That file belongs to npm, not
the profile, so a `dsh` update replaces the tree and the correction is silently reverted.

## Not profile-configurable

The route sets only `apiKeyEnv`. It cannot express the list either: `resolveEntry` resolves
`api = request.api ?? base?.api ?? routeApi`, so a route-level `api` overrides the catalog for
**every** model — and this provider is mixed-protocol. A profile `models:` block breaks the
other protocols. Today: edit `node_modules` (erased each update) or `~/.no-auto` (forfeits all
updates).

## Measured today

| route | live | bundled 0.87.1 | missing | stale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opencode-go` | 30 | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| `openrouter` | **460** | **386** | **80** | **6** |

`opencode-go` is in sync at 0.87.1 by luck: it was **27** at 0.85.1 against a live 30,
including a missing `deepseek-v4.1-flash`. `openrouter` is clearer — 80 live models are
unpickable, 6 bundled ones are dead, and its endpoint needs no key:

    curl -s https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models | jq '.data | length'   # 460

## The part that makes this a bug

**pi-ai already has the machinery for a live catalog, and it is unused.**

`dist/models.js` implements the whole refresh path: `createProvider({ refreshModels,
filterModels })` (~468), `runProviderRefreshPhase()` calling `provider.refreshModels({
credential, stored, publish, allowNetwork, force, signal })` (~125), `refresh()` selecting
every provider with that hook (~141), and `getAvailable()` applying
`provider.filterModels?.(models, credential)` (~271).

But **no shipped provider defines either hook** — `grep -rln 'fetchModels:' dist/providers/*.js`
returns nothing — and the harness never calls `refresh()`: `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js` imports
only `builtinModels, builtinProviders, getBuiltinModels, getBuiltinProviders`. Plumbing built
on one side, never connected on the other.

## What I would suggest

**Wire it up.** Give catalog providers a `fetchModels` and call `refresh()`:

    GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models       # public
    GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models      # Bearer, or public

`filterModels` earns its keep on `opencode-go`: public vs key-filtered differ — **42 public vs
35 with the org key** — and listed-but-unentitled models answer `400 Model is unavailable`.

Two gaps I cannot settle from outside:

- **Metadata.** `/models` returns only `{ id, object, created, owned_by }`; context window,
  cost and reasoning options live in pi-ai's bundle or `models.dev/api.json`. A refresh needs a
  merge policy for live models with no metadata anywhere — guessing limits is worse than
  omitting a model.
- **Wire protocol.** The endpoint does not say whether a model is `anthropic-messages`,
  `openai-completions` or `openai-responses`. I derived it by calibrating against the 27
  shipped models; it held, but the provider should say so.

**Or, if a live refresh is out of scope:** track pi-ai releases more eagerly (0.87.1 has 30
models to 0.85.1's 27 — no new code needed), and at minimum surface the model count and
catalog date in the picker or `dsh doctor`, so "this model does not exist" is distinguishable
from "my list is old". Today they are indistinguishable.

## Why I am reporting it

`dsh` auto-updated and reverted `opencode-go` from a hand-corrected 35 to 27, removing the
model the session was configured to use. Reinstalling pi-ai 0.87.1 fixed it; the next update
will revert that too. I do not expect the profile to carry a model list — only that the
catalog not be a build artifacts that only a `node_modules edit can correct.

discussions.title: Per-session visibility for `conversation.view` tabs (mode-specific tabs)
discussions.body:
### Background

Agent presets define session "modes" (standard / cordis / ptc / custom ones from
community plugins). A plugin that adds a mode also wants mode-specific
conversation tabs. Concretely, we're building a community "group chat" plugin
(`dsh-plugin-group-chat`): sessions created in the group-chat preset should show
three extra tabs (group timeline / member roster / member dialogues), and those
tabs should NOT appear in sessions of other presets.

### Current behavior

`viewTabs()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`
(`lib/types/client/skeleton/ConversationRoot` area, the `slots.entries("conversation.view")`
loop) builds one global tab list shared by every session. The only filtering
precedent is the hardcoded developer-tools check for the `trajectory` tab:

```js
if (!ctx.configForms.developerTools.enabled.getSnapshot() && entry.options.id === "trajectory") continue;
```

Things we tried that do not work:

1. Throwing inside the registration's `inject(sessionId)` — `viewTabs()` never
   calls `inject`, so the tab stays in the bar; only rendering breaks.
2. Mounting the client-plugin row inside the agent preset's plugin list —
   preset-scoped rows appear not to load client modules at all (tabs vanished
   everywhere; only the host half activated).
3. Component-level guards — works for content, but the tabs remain visible in
   every session.

### Proposal

Allow a `conversation.view` registration to declare per-session availability,
consulted when the tab list is built, e.g.:

```js
ctx.slots.register({
  name: "conversation.view",
  id: "group-chat",
  order: -2,
  label: () => "Group chat",
  available: (sessionId, ctx) => presetOf(ctx, sessionId) === "group-chat",
}, View);
```

`viewTabs()` would skip entries whose `available` returns false, and the list
would rebuild when the active session changes (there is already a
`refreshViews()` path keyed on locale / developerTools / slot changes; an
active-session change could reuse it).

A natural companion: expose the session's recorded agent-preset id
(`projectionValues.agentPreset`, as read by `ui-agent-preset`) through a stable
client API so plugins don't reach into the sessions store shape.

### Use case

Community plugin `dsh-plugin-group-chat` (multi-model group chat over
continuable child sessions). Happy to beta-test / contribute a PR if the
approach sounds right.

discussions.title: Windows: pnpm run build fails after following the source installation guide
discussions.body:
# Windows: `pnpm run build` Fails After Following the Official Source Installation Guide

## Background

I wanted to run DeepSeek Harness from source and followed the official instructions:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

However, the build failed on Windows during TypeScript compilation.

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11
- Node.js: v24.11.1
- pnpm: 11.7.0
- Branch: `master`
- Commit: `4878cda`

## Error

The build reported incompatible versions of `micromark-util-types`:

```text
error TS2769: No overload matches this call.

Type 'micromark-util-types@2.0.2' is not assignable to type
'micromark-util-types@2.0.3'

Found 3 errors.
```

The error occurred in:

```text
packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/parse.ts
```

## Workaround

Running `pnpm dedupe` before building resolved the issue:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dedupe
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

After running `pnpm dedupe`, the dependency tree uses a single compatible version of `micromark-util-types`, and the build succeeds.

## Verification

```bash
pnpm list micromark-util-types
```

The resolved version is:

```text
micromark-util-types 2.0.3
```

## Possible Documentation Improvement

Would it be worth adding `pnpm dedupe` to the “Run from source” instructions?

For example:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm dedupe
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

This may help Windows users and other contributors who encounter the same dependency-resolution issue after a fresh checkout.

Thank you for maintaining the project. I hope this report helps improve the setup experience for future contributors.

discussions.title: DSH 沙箱初始化失败：工作区位于数据盘时 grantWrite 报 Win32 5（缺 WRITE_OWNER），会话内一切命令不可用
discussions.body:
TL;DR
只要工作区不在用户目录下（例如新建的 D:\新建文件夹，ACL 来自盘符默认继承），并且会话文件策略是受限模式（workspace-write），DSH 在该工作区启动时执行的工作区授权（grantWrite）就会失败：

代码块


SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\<工作区>)
失败后该会话内所有经沙箱的命令全部不可用——包括完全不需要写入的只读命令（Get-Date 也一样）。文件读写工具不受影响，表现为「文件能看，命令全废」。报错本身不足以自我诊断。

根因：grantWrite 以 WRITE_DAC | WRITE_OWNER 打开工作区根目录，而数据盘的默认继承 ACL 下，账户只能隐式拿到 WRITE_DAC（所有者身份），拿不到 WRITE_OWNER（需要显式 ACE 或 SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege）→ 打开被拒 → Win32 5 → 沙箱初始化整体中止。

这是默认配置命中，不是异常配置：凡把项目放在数据盘/非用户目录的用户都会遇到。

<html>
<body>
<!--StartFragment-->
项 | 值
-- | --
DSH 桌面端 | 0.2.0-rc.1（DeepSeek Harness.exe 文件版本 0.2.0-rc.1 / 产品版本 0.2.0.0）
操作系统 | Windows 11 专业版 25H2，Build 26200.9457（10.0.26200）

<!--EndFragment-->
</body>
</html>
严重性：高
全灭：一旦命中，该会话的命令执行能力为零，且失败发生在会话启动阶段，与具体命令无关。
不可自我诊断：报错只给「Win32 5」，不提示缺失的权限名，用户凭报错无法定位。
默认配置即触发：数据盘默认 ACL 天然不含普通账户的完全控制。这不是用户把权限改坏了，而是没改过才会命中。
同一台机器上每个工作区根各命中一次：新增的 ACE 只作用于该文件夹本身、不向下继承，因此换一个工作区就要重新修一次。

复现步骤
在数据盘（D / E / …）新建一个目录，例如 D:\repro，不做任何权限修改（保持盘符默认继承）。
以该目录为工作区启动 DSH 会话，文件策略保持默认的受限模式（workspace-write）。
执行任意命令，例如 Get-Date。
预期：命令执行（至少只读命令应当能执行）。 实际：命令直接失败，报错固定为：

代码块


SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\repro)

discussions.title: [Issue Reports] 来自 FileSnap 实践的插件开发体验建议：安全事件写入、写前观察与真实宿主测试
discussions.body:
# [Ideas] 来自 FileSnap 实践的插件开发体验建议：安全事件写入、写前观察与真实宿主测试

我是非官方插件 `dsh-filesnap` 的作者。最初给 Codex 做回滚时，我把文件快照与恢复抽成了 FileSnap，再尝试把它接到 DSH，让文件与对话一起回到之前的状态。

开发过程中，我遇到过监听器被事件决策链截断、自定义事件落盘后冷加载失败，以及浏览器／命令入口使用不同 fork 边界等问题。部分是我对契约的误解或插件实现错误，部分反映了外部插件作者仍然不容易跨过的接口边界。

感谢近期对 unarchive、精确 fork、启动诊断及模块解析的改进。这些能力已有对应实现，下面不再把它们作为缺失功能提出。我希望讨论的是：怎样让外部插件更容易使用公共接口，并更早验证用户实际会经过的安装、重启和卸载路径。

**核查范围：**历史故障主要发生于 2026-08-27 至 09-11；2026-09-28 核查过发布版 `0.1.7-rc.2`，起草本帖时于 09-29 又检查了官方固定提交 [`4878cdabd87d`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a) 的相关源码。以下现状判断限定于这些证据，并非在该提交上重新运行了所有故障复现。建议中的接口与流程只是讨论方向。

## 最希望先推进：外部插件安全写入信息性事件

旧版 FileSnap 曾向 Session 写入 `filesnap/point` 等自定义事件。类型扩展使调用能够编译，当前进程也可以工作；但新进程加载日志时会遇到未知事件错误。我一度修改内部 `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` 集合绕过检查，后来发现它仍依赖插件是否已加载、以及读取方是不是同一个模块实例。

当前[已知事件集合的设计说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/packages/core/session/src/known-event-types.ts)明确指出，外部事件的兼容性应依靠持久化的 `ignorable` 标记，而不能依赖当前插件组合；但我检查的 [`Session.append()`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/packages/core/session/src/index.ts#L722) 仍只接收 surface 元数据，构造并冻结的 envelope 中没有对外开放这个标记的写入入口。

FileSnap 从 `0.3.0` 起已移除修改集合的 hack，改用独立 RPC/UI 和插件状态存储，再关联原生轮次与 fork 血缘。这让插件避开了这个缺口，但外部作者仍可能因为“事件类型可扩展”而误以为写入与后续读取也有完整契约。

**初步方向：**考虑为可安全省略的信息事件提供受约束的公共写入路径，明确命名空间、payload 版本和省略语义，并由宿主在冻结之前生成兼容 envelope。不能让任意核心状态事件都通过加一个 `ignorable` 获得放行；不支持的未知事件应在写入边界给出诊断，避免延迟到重启才失败。如果官方倾向于让这类状态一律独立存储，也希望在类型扩展文档和 append 诊断中把这一边界讲清楚。

**建议验收场景：**

1. 用真实持久化后端写入一条受支持的外部信息事件，flush 后退出。
2. 新进程不加载该插件，仍可打开会话并继续正常操作。
3. fork 和格式迁移对该事件的保留／省略行为有明确契约；未知、不可安全省略的事件得到有定位信息的拒绝。

这里希望确认的是受支持的扩展方式，不要求放宽核心事件校验，也不希望将修改内部集合变成推荐用法。

## 其他值得继续改善的边界

### 1. 为写前观察提供明确的扩展点

快照插件需要在变更前取得文件内容。当前 [`fs-observation-policy`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/packages/fs/fs-observation-policy/src/index.ts#L116) 在 write/edit intent 上占据单个决策位置，不调用 `next()`；这是现有契约，后置观察器收不到调用不能简单归为 bug。

FileSnap 通过 `prepend: true` 前置捕获，再 `next()` 交还决策。希望考虑把受支持的路径表达成“决策检查 → 等待写前观察 → 执行变更 → 报告结果”，让观察器不承担授权决定，并明确多观察器顺序、取消和捕获失败策略。

验收可以同时挂两个观察器与一个拒绝策略：拒绝时不写入；允许时捕获先于变更；观察失败有定义好的结果。还需要说明并发边界，避免把一个 hook 理解成文件锁，或声称它能覆盖 shell 等其他写入路径。

### 2. 提供浏览器与 headless 入口共用 fork 的完整示例

当前已有 `SessionStore.fork` 和 [`buildForkSeed`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/packages/core/session/src/fork.ts)。我曾在命令入口复制截断逻辑，导致与浏览器行为不同，这是插件自己的实现与维护问题。

建议先给外部作者一组成对、绑定发布版本的示例，覆盖边界选择、冷会话、preset、workspace、子会话创建及失败清理。如果示例仍必须复制大量 controller 编排，再考虑提取公共服务。验收是两个入口产生一致的历史前缀和合成尾部，作者不用维护两套 `slice()` 规则；文件恢复仍由插件自行协调。

### 3. 让服务与模块身份诊断连起来

官方已有启动诊断和[宿主实例共享规则](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-18-profile-plugin-host-runtime-instances.zh.md)。遇到错误依赖声明或旧 profile 残留副本时，外部作者仍可能只看到“明明注册了却找不到”。

建议在现有诊断上展示服务提供者／消费者、所属 fiber、等待原因，以及关键运行时从宿主和插件两侧解析到的真实路径、版本、入口与实例身份；对打包内联或应声明为 peer 的依赖给出针对性提示。验收是故意引入第二份必须共享身份的运行时后，诊断能指出冲突来源，而不是把所有合法的多版本依赖都当成错误。

### 4. 把真实进程边界测试做成外部插件模板

我曾有 104 个绿色测试证明“事件已经注册”，却没有一个启动未加载插件的新进程读取日志。测试选错边界是插件作者的责任；好的模板能让这类遗漏更容易暴露。

官方已有 [`dsh-loader-smoke`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/packages/test-support/loader-smoke/README.md)，其中 production-profile helper 也说明了仓库内使用的边界。建议基于这些能力，提供独立插件仓库能运行的模板：安装 tarball 到临时 profile，用无密钥回放／mock LLM 驱动真实轮次，再验证重启、卸载后读取和必要的 client 产物。

验收是模板能发现漏打包客户端、重复运行时，以及必须加载插件才能读取的历史数据；可按插件能力选择场景、固定已发布宿主版本运行 CI，不要求每个小插件跑全部宿主测试。

### 5. 配置 watcher 失败时提供可执行的恢复选择

Headless 默认不再强制启用 HMR，polling 也已有支持。剩余建议针对启用监听的环境：当前[配置 watcher 错误路径](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a/packages/boot/hmr/src/watch-config.ts#L77)中，启动时错误使 ready 拒绝；该文件内未看到资源错误自动降级逻辑。

建议识别 `ENOSPC` 等错误，指出配置监听／源码监听中的具体失败位置，并给出关闭 HMR 或切换 polling 的对应配置。可考虑显式启用、仅针对少量配置文件的降级选项，切换时完整关闭旧 watcher 并记录状态；不要默认把整棵源码树改成高频轮询。验收应覆盖失败、降级和卸载，避免泄漏或无限重试。

## 希望维护者帮助明确的方向

如果先推进一项，我会优先选外部信息事件的安全写入契约，因为它直接关系到用户已经保存的会话能否继续使用。

想请教：信息性扩展事件更适合新增受约束的写入入口，还是明确推荐独立存储？其余建议中，哪些已有推荐入口或正在进行的工作，值得外部作者直接复用？如果适合拆分讨论，我倾向于先把事件写入独立成一个聚焦的 RFC，再分别补示例与测试模板的设计。

discussions.title: [Bug] HOME 下同名 package.json 被当作 profile 树自引用，导致该包无法解析（plugin-manager → 插件页/市场/预设同时失效）
discussions.body:
按 CONTRIBUTING 的指引，bug 走 Discussions。下面是一份带**可重跑复现**与**源码级根因定位**的报告（附修复建议与已做的 A/B 验证）。

## Summary

桌面端 **0.2.0-rc.1**（内置 core 0.2.0-rc.1，master `4878cda`）：运行时解析的「自引用」判定会**向上越过 profile 树一路走到用户 HOME**。只要 HOME 下存在一个 `package.json`（其 `name` 与某个「只装在安装树里」的包同名、且带 `exports`），该包就会被强制走原生解析、无法加载。

本机命中 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager`，后果是 `pluginManager` 服务缺失，三个用户可见功能同时失效：

- 设置 → 插件：显示「本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件」（无插件列表）
- 插件市场：安装/更新全部 `exit=127`，提示「请在设置 → 插件 里完成」（而该页同样不可用）
- Agent 预设「创造模式」：显示「加载失败」，悬停原文 `tool-plugin-manager (@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools): never started`

## Reproduction

```sh
APP="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources"
ASAR="$APP/app.asar/dsh"

# 1) 在 HOME 放一个与安装树包同名的清单（name 相同 + 带 exports 即可触发）
printf '{"name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager","exports":{}}\n' > ~/package.json

# 2) 引导桌面 profile，观察 stderr
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_DESKTOP_NODE_EXECUTABLE="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness" \
  "$APP/runtime/bin/node" --expose-internals \
  "$ASAR/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js" \
  "$ASAR" "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop" "$APP/runtime/primary-runtime" \
  "$APP/runtime/pnpm/bin/pnpm.mjs" "$APP/runtime/bin"

# 3) 对照：删掉 ~/package.json 再跑一次
```

> 注意：宿主把端口硬编码为 19387；若已有一个实例在跑，会额外出现 `webserver EADDRINUSE` 以及由它派生的噪声。用空闲端口在进程内复算 `runProfile()`，或先停掉现有实例，都能得到干净结果。

## Current behavior

有 `~/package.json`（同名）时：

```
dsh: warning: 4 entries did not activate
plugin-manager (@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager): failed to import
```

进程内沿 Loader 使用的**同一条** import 路径复现（`ctx.loader.entries()…parent.tree.import(name, [])`），拿到被 logger 吞掉的真实错误：

```
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager'
  imported from /Users/<user>/.dsh/profiles/desktop/
```

同一进程内对照：

| 包 | `pluginPackages.packageOf(name, 'file:///…/profiles/desktop/')` | `tree.import` |
|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` | **undefined** | **ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND** |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools` | **undefined** | **ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND** |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand` | `<asar>/…/dsh-brand` | OK |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` | `<asar>/…/dsh-tools` | OK |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-plugin-inventory` | `<asar>/…` | OK |

并且 `ctx.get('pluginManager')` = **false**，Agent 预设 `cordis` 报 `tool-plugin-manager … never started`。

**删掉该文件后**，同一探针：`pluginManager` = **true**、`packageOf` 返回 `<asar>/…/dsh-plugin-manager`、`import` = OK、stderr 无失败行、5 个预设全部无异常。

## Expected behavior

树外（profile 目录之上，如 HOME、`/Users`、`/`）的 `package.json` 不应影响树内解析：该请求应照常走 interception 从安装树解析，`pluginManager` 正常注册。

## 根因

`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts`

- `routeScoped()` 中有自引用短路：

  ```ts
  if (parentRoutes.selfReferenceName === name || parentRoutes.selfReferenceName === null) {
    const state = { route: { kind: 'native' } }   // 放弃 interception
    return state
  }
  ```

- `selfReferenceName(parent)`（同文件 261 行）从 `dirname(parent)` 起**无边界地向上**找最近的 `package.json`。

profile 的根 include（`<profile>/cordis.yml`）使请求父路径 = **profile 根目录**，于是：

```
selfReferenceName("/Users/<user>/.dsh/profiles/desktop/")
  → 命中 /Users/<user>/package.json（name = "@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager"，带 exports）
  → 返回该 name
```

请求名与 self 名相同 → 强制 native → Node 从 profile 目录解析 → 该包不在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里（它只存在于安装树）→ `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`。

**证据**：给编译后的 resolver 打点（`registerHooks` 的 `load` 钩子注入一行 `console.error`）后，引导期实际出现：

```
[ROUTE] name=@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager parent=/Users/<user>/.dsh/profiles/desktop/
        self=@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager layer=profile active=true tgt=installation <asar>/…
```

即：profile 根这一层的 self 名确实被判成了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager`。按同一算法直接验算，命中链路为 `<profile>` → `…/profiles` → `…/.dsh` → **`/Users/<user>/package.json`**（其余各级无 `package.json`）。

**放大面**：不限于本包的清单副本。任何 HOME 下有 `package.json`（`npm init` 残留、工具误写等），其 `name` 撞上某个安装树包名，就会让那个包静默失效 —— 无诊断、无提示，最终用户看到的还是指向「设置 → 插件」（而该页同样不可用）。

## 修复建议

自引用只可能由「拥有这棵树」的 manifest 声明，遍历不应离开该树：

```diff
-function selfReferenceName(parent: string): string | false | null {
+function selfReferenceName(parent: string, boundary?: string): string | false | null {
   let current = dirname(parent)
   while (true) {
+    // 自引用候选只可能来自本树之内：越过 boundary 即不再考虑，
+    // 否则运营者 HOME 下的 package.json 会被当成 profile 树的自引用。
+    if (boundary !== undefined && current !== boundary && !current.startsWith(boundary + sep)) return false
     const manifestPath = join(current, 'package.json')
```

调用点按层给边界（安装树/链接根的现有语义保持不变）：

```diff
-      parentRoutes.selfReferenceName = selfReferenceName(parent)
+      parentRoutes.selfReferenceName = selfReferenceName(
+        parent, layer.kind === 'profile' ? resolution.profileDir : undefined)
```

**本机已做的最小验证（A/B，同一探针）**

| 实验 | 条件 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `~/package.json`（合成，name 同名 + exports）+ **未打补丁** | `pluginManager = false`；预设 `cordis` = `tool-plugin-manager … never started` |
| B | 同一文件 + **按上面思路给编译产物打补丁** | `pluginManager = true`；预设 `cordis` 无异常 |

（B 的实验方式：用 `node:module` 的 `registerHooks`，在 `load` 钩子里对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js` 施加上述两处改动后引导；不是修改仓库源码。）

建议同时补一条 `packages/boot/app-boot/tests/profile-resolution.spec.ts` 的回归用例：夹具在 profile 树**之上**放一个 `name` 与安装树条目同名、且带 `exports` 的 `package.json`，断言该名字仍走 interception 路由、`packageDir()` 与 `import()` 都命中安装树条目。

需要的话我可以按仓库规范补一个 PR（含该回归用例与本地门禁结果）。

## Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH Desktop | 0.2.0-rc.1（`CFBundleShortVersionString`） |
| 内置 core | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.2.0-rc.1，`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` `4878cda`（已确认与当前远端 master 一致） |
| 平台 | macOS arm64，Electron 44，Node 24.18.1 |
| profile | `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`（12 个 bundle，全部 `ok`） |
| 触发文件 | `/Users/<user>/package.json`，3422 B，内容与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/package.json` 逐字节相同；HOME 下无 `node_modules`/`package-lock.json`，属残留文件 |
