discussions.title: [Bug] Entry#disabled 会被 fiber.dispose()+init() 永久污染并自锁：一行插件"显示已停用"但实际仍在运行
[Bug Report] Windows `workspace-write`：目录 DACL 缺少 `WRITE_OWNER` 时，所有受限 shell 调用以原始 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW Win32 5` 失败（0.1.7-rc.2 无内置诊断/修复路径）
discussions.body:
## Summary

在 Windows 上以**非提权**账户、文件策略为 `workspace-write` 时，工作区目录的 DACL 若**只授予 Modify（即没有 `WRITE_OWNER`）**，沙箱的每一次授权都会失败：

```
SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common)
```

沙箱按设计 fail-closed，于是**所有受限 shell 调用都不可用**（`pwsh` 工具完全无法使用），而且错误信息里既没有指出缺失的权限，也没有指向任何修复入口。同机切到 `danger-full-access`（跳过授权）后立刻恢复正常，说明后端其余部分工作正常。

这本身符合 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 已记录的边界（"被授权目录必须由调用者拥有并授予 `WRITE_OWNER`……DACL 只授予 Modify 的目录现在会大声失败"），因此**本报告的重点不是"失败了"，而是这个失败在 0.1.7-rc.2 上不可行动**：README 承诺的内置 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 诊断/修复技能在该版本**没有随包发布**。

## Reproduction

环境（详见 Environment）：Windows 11 26200.9168，账户 `<MACHINE>\<user>`（Medium 完整性 / 非提权），`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` 全局 npm 安装，`DSH_HOME=C:\Users\<user>\.dsh`，profile `web`，工作区在非系统盘。**文中盘符统一写作 `X:`，机器名/用户名写作 `<MACHINE>` / `<user>`。**

1. 确认工作区目录的 ACL **只给当前用户 Modify**：

```
> icacls "X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common"
X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common S-1-4-60829086-371263548:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
                               S-1-4-979659899-60949555:(I)(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
                               BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
                               BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(F)
                               NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
                               NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(F)
                               NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)
                               NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(M)
                               BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX)
                               BUILTIN\Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(GR,GE)

> icacls "X:\DeepSeek Harness"
X:\DeepSeek Harness S-1-4-979659899-60949555:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
                    BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
                    ... NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M) ...
```

   （`S-1-4-*` 是后端派生/随机的能力 SID；调用者自身只有经 `Authenticated Users` 继承来的 **M**。目录所有者是当前用户。）

2. 确认令牌没有任何可用来合并写入的特权：

```
> whoami /priv | findstr /i "SeRelabel SeSecurity SeTakeOwnership SeRestore"
（无输出 —— 四项特权均不在非提权令牌中）
```

3. **关键判别**：在一个**自己新建、自己拥有**的目录上单独执行三处修改里的第三处（Low 完整性标签），同样被拒：

```
> icacls "X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common\.acl-probe" /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)Low"
X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common\.acl-probe: Access is denied.
Successfully processed 0 files; Failed processing 1 files
```

4. 正常启动 dsh（配置 `workspace-write`），调用 `pwsh` 工具的任意命令 → 复现上文的 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace>)`；同一进程把策略切到 `danger-full-access` 后同一命令立刻成功。

> 我这里的复现跨越三次 dsh 重启都稳定一致（升级前 0.1.5-rc.1 完全正常）。

## Current behavior

- `workspace-write` 下**所有**受限 shell 调用失败，错误只有一行原始 Win32 文本，例如：
  `Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common)`
- 错误信息**未**指出缺失的是 `WRITE_OWNER`（标签位于 SACL，因此合并应用需要它），也**未**给出任何补救路径。
- 用户/Agent 会误以为是"沙箱坏了"或"没重启"；实际只需给自己的目录补上完全控制（见 Workaround）。
- 在本版本（0.1.7-rc.2）上，**README 提到的内置诊断/修复技能不可用**：
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.1.7-rc.2` 的 `package.json` 中
    `"files": ["lib/index.js","lib/runner.js","lib/types-*.js","lib/types/**/*.d.ts"]` —— **不含 `assets`**；实际安装目录下也确实没有 `assets/`。
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local@0.1.7-rc.2` 的 `lib/*.js` 中检索不到 `registerAclDiagnosisSkill` / `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 任何字样。
  - 对照 `master`（0.2.0-rc.2）：`files` 已包含 `"assets"`，并新增 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 与 `yaml` 依赖。
  → 也就是说：**"失败"是设计，"失败后无路可走"是 0.1.7-rc.2 的缺口**。

## Expected behavior

任一即可：

1. 失败信息自解释：明确指出被拒的是**合并写入中的 Low 完整性标签（SACL）**，缺少的是被授权目录上的 `WRITE_OWNER`（所有者只隐含 `READ_CONTROL`/`WRITE_DAC`），并给出可执行的修复提示（例如在链路目录上为当前用户授予完全控制）。
2. 或在调用者拥有有效 `WRITE_DAC` 时**自修复**：为其补上缺失的允许 ACE（正是随包诊断脚本的语义），而不是直接 fail-closed。
3. 至少让 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 在 0.1.7 线上也可用（或回填说明"该技能自 0.2.0 起提供"），避免 npm 安装的用户按 README 找不到它。

## Environment

- dsh：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2`（全局 npm 安装；同机另有 `0.1.5-rc.1` 时一切正常）
- profile：`web`（bundles：`dsh-base`、`dsh-web-app`、`dshmarket`、`dsh-context`、`dsh-zh`、`dsh-blender`、`dsh-comfyui`、`dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`）
- OS：Windows 11 `10.0.26200.9168`（x86_64），账户 Medium 完整性、非提权
- 工作区：`X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common`（所有者 = 当前用户；调用者仅 `Authenticated Users:M`）
- 沙箱相关包：`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.1.7-rc.2`、`dsh-sandbox-local@0.1.7-rc.2`、`dsh-pwsh-sandbox@0.1.7-rc.2`
- 文件策略：`workspace-write`（失败）/ `danger-full-access`（同一命令成功）

## Workaround（本机已验证方向）

因为目录所有者隐含 `WRITE_DAC`，无需提权即可补齐 `WRITE_OWNER`（与随包诊断脚本的修复语义一致：为链路上缺少 `WRITE_DAC`/`WRITE_OWNER` 的目录补当前用户完全控制）：

```
icacls "X:\DeepSeek Harness" /grant "%USERNAME%":(OI)(CI)F
icacls "X:\DeepSeek Harness\DSH-Common" /grant "%USERNAME%":(OI)(CI)F
```

替代方案：把文件策略设为 `danger-full-access`（授权步骤被跳过，已验证可用），或以管理员身份启动 dsh（令牌具备相应特权）。

## 附：相关源码/文档位置

- 边界声明：`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.zh.md` → 「已验证边界」中"被授权目录必须由调用者拥有并授予 `WRITE_OWNER`……DACL 只授予 Modify 的目录现在会大声失败，而不是静默跳过隔离"
- 三处合并写入：`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts`（`grantWrite`：能力 SID 允许 ACE + world SID 的 `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` 拒绝 + Low 禁止上调标签，单次 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW`）
- 诊断/修复技能（master）：`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/assets/diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl/`

discussions.title: [bug] The "Deep diving…" run status keeps showing 5–22 s after the answer is complete — the turn closes late in a workspace with many untracked files
discussions.body:
### 🐛 Description

**What the user sees**: the assistant's answer is fully rendered, yet the run-status line at the bottom of the chat keeps shimmering with `Deep diving…` plus a growing elapsed time for another **5–22 s**, and only then disappears.

What the durable session log of those same turns shows:

- the wait sits **inside the turn, between its `step/end` and its `turn/end`** — i.e. it is host-side work that happens before anything the client renders;
- the client's run-status line is mounted from the Session's `running` flag, and `running` only clears after `turn/end` is appended — which is why the two durations coincide;
- the first tool call of a turn is affected too: in the same workspace one shell command that lists a directory took **21.6 s** because it waits behind the same work;
- **control**: same machine, same client, same model, same plugin composition, but a working directory that is **not inside a git repository** → `step/end → turn/end` = **0.0 s**;
- in this profile the delay coincides with the mounted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes` plugin, which is the **only** listener of `agent/turn-stopping` (a whole-worktree git snapshot per turn); Host Inspect shows all 186 live Loader entries are first-party and **no third-party plugin or `hooks-*` entry is mounted**;
- frequency: every turn in this workspace; the magnitude tracks how much untracked, non-ignored content the work tree holds.

---

### 🖥️ Environment

- **DSH Version**: `0.2.0-rc.2` — `dsh --version` prints `0.2.0-rc.2`; the desktop binary reports `FileVersion 0.2.0-rc.2`; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes` also resolves to `0.2.0-rc.2`
- **Runtime**: DSH Desktop (official Windows x64 build; Web UI rendered inside the app window)
- **OS**: Windows 10 Pro, version 25H2, build 26200.9457
- **Browser**: the desktop app's Electron/Chromium renderer (no external browser involved)
- **Installation Method**: official desktop installer; bundled runtime is Node `24.18.1` + pnpm `11.7.0`
- **Profile / plugins**: profile `desktop` (`dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`); the `workspace-changes` entry is `include:workspace-changes` with **all-default config**
- **Model**: `deepseek-flash` with `reasoningEffort: high`
- **git**: `2.55.0.windows.3` (`core.autocrlf=true`, the Git for Windows default), local NTFS
- **Workspace shape**: `<WORKSPACE>` is a git repository whose work tree holds 11,905 tracked files plus **4,929 untracked, non-ignored files = 177.7 MB**; one generated directory `<GENERATED_DIR>` accounts for ~3.3k files / 172.8 MB and can be regenerated by the build

---

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce

1. Use a git repository whose work tree contains a lot of untracked, non-ignored files (≈178 MB here, in 4,929 files; a repository whose untracked content is small or ignored does not show the effect).
2. Open the Web UI in that directory and send a message that is answered immediately and **changes no file** (e.g. "hello").
3. Watch the run-status line after the answer text is complete; then compare that duration with the `step/end` and `turn/end` timestamps of the same turn in the session log (`~/.dsh/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<session-id>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd`).
4. Separately, send a message whose first action is a trivial shell command and watch how long that first `tool/call` takes to produce its `tool/result`.
5. Repeat the same two messages with the working directory pointing at a folder that is not inside any git repository — both waits disappear.

**Minimal script for the cost behind the wait** — only `git` is needed; nothing is written into the repository (the index is copied out, new objects go to a temp directory that is removed at the end). It runs the same command pair twice: once with a freshly copied scratch index, once with that index reused.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: repro-snapshot-cost.sh <repo>
repo=${1:?usage: repro-snapshot-cost.sh <repo>}
tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/objects"; cp "$repo/.git/index" "$tmp/index"
export GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY="$tmp/objects" \
       GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES="$repo/.git/objects" \
       GIT_INDEX_FILE="$tmp/index" GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
echo "tracked: $(git -C "$repo" ls-files -c | wc -l)   untracked(not ignored): $(git -C "$repo" ls-files -o --exclude-standard | wc -l)"
echo "A: fresh scratch index"; time (git -C "$repo" add --all --ignore-errors 2>/dev/null; git -C "$repo" write-tree >/dev/null)
echo "B: same index reused";   time (git -C "$repo" add --all --ignore-errors 2>/dev/null; git -C "$repo" write-tree >/dev/null)
rm -rf "$tmp"
```

```powershell
# usage: .\repro-snapshot-cost.ps1 -Repo <repo>
param([string]$Repo)
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("dsh-snap-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$tmp\objects" | Out-Null
Copy-Item "$Repo\.git\index" "$tmp\index"
$env:GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY="$tmp\objects"; $env:GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES="$Repo\.git\objects"
$env:GIT_INDEX_FILE="$tmp\index"; $env:GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='0'
'== A: fresh scratch index'; (Measure-Command { git -C $Repo add --all --ignore-errors; git -C $Repo write-tree }).TotalSeconds
'== B: same index reused';   (Measure-Command { git -C $Repo add --all --ignore-errors; git -C $Repo write-tree }).TotalSeconds
Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force
```

Expected on the workspace above: `tracked: 11905   untracked(not ignored): 4929`; A ≈ **14–16 s**, B ≈ **0.2–0.3 s** (and when the scratch object directory is still empty, as on the first snapshot of a Session, A also writes 2,597 objects / 236.4 MB). Both commands exit 1 when git skips files it cannot index (on Windows, names past the path limit) — the same convention the plugin relies on with `--ignore-errors`. The script only measures the cost behind the wait; the user-visible symptom is reproduced by the steps above.

---

### 🎯 Expected Behavior

Once the answer is rendered, the turn should close (and `turn/end` should be appended) without waiting for work that is unrelated to the user's request. A turn that changed no file at all should not make the run status linger.

---

### ❌ Actual Behavior

- A text-only turn in `<WORKSPACE>` stayed open for **20.8 s / 10.9 s / 11.1 s / 21.7 s / 20.6 s / 9.6 s** after `step/end` (six turns across five sessions) before `turn/end` was appended; the UI showed `Deep diving…` throughout.
- The first tool call of a turn in the same workspace took **21.6 s**, and later turns showed 0.0–2.3 s for the same kind of call depending on when the wait landed.
- Interrupting the turn does not help: an aborted turn still wrote `turn/end` **11.1 s** after `step/end` (`reason: aborted/user`).
- Each Session also leaves **236.4 MB / 2,597 loose objects** in `%TEMP%\dsh-workspace-changes-<rand>`, whose file mtime span (12–23 s) is the write window of one snapshot; 7 such directories totalled 1,375 MB at the time of writing.

---

### 📊 Observed Measurements

**A. Session log of one Session in `<WORKSPACE>`**

| Turn | `step/end → turn/end` | First tool call of the turn |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **5.1 s** | **21.6 s** (a directory listing) |
| 3 | 4.8 s | 0.7 s |
| 4 | 4.7 s | 0.0 s |
| 5 | 4.8 s | 0.0 s |
| 6 | 4.8 s | 2.3 s |

**B. Historical Sessions, same `<WORKSPACE>`, text-only turns**: `step/end → turn/end` = **20.8 / 10.9 / 11.1 / 21.7 / 20.6 / 9.6 s**

**C. Control, working directory not inside any git repository** (three Sessions): **0.0 s**

**D. Where the wait lands**: for a slow-ish turn the run status lingers for the tail only (≈4.8 s, the turn-closing work); for a turn that is answered instantly the whole wait lands at the same place and grows to 20 s+.

---

### 📝 Additional Context

- Same observation from the other side: the work also gates the turn's **first tool call**, which is why a trivial shell command can take 21.6 s in this workspace.
- `git status --porcelain -uall` in this repository takes 7.4 s cold and 0.3 s warm, and the workspace has `core.autocrlf=true` (Git for Windows default); the untracked content is ~178 MB in 4,929 files.
- Earlier reports I could find in Discussions (searched workspace-changes / snapshot / stat cache / latency / blocking / running / deep diving and ~20 more terms) cover neighbouring aspects but not this one: [#8120](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8120) (same plugin, tmpfs disk usage), [#7138](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7138) (snapshot attribution), [#3424](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3424) / [#6600](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6600) / [#2993](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2993) (finished work while the UI still shows running, different causes).
- *This report was generated by the official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model running inside DSH — if anything here is inaccurate, please point it out.*

discussions.title: # [Windows] 非系统盘工作区在 sandbox provisioning 阶段 fail-closed（Win32 5），且唯一官方修复手段与「避免 Low 完整性标签副作用」不可兼得
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

在**非系统盘**上使用 DSH（工作区如 `E:\MyWorkspace`），只要该目录的 ACL 是 Windows 盘的默认继承形态，`grantWrite` 就会抛 `Win32 5` 并 **fail-closed** —— 所有 `pwsh` / `bash` / `run_code` 类工具全部不可用，且**每条命令都以同一个错误失败**，没有任何可用性降级路径。

0.2.0 引入的 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 技能确实能修好它（补 `WRITE_OWNER`），但**修好的同时会把 Low 完整性标签写回工作区**，导致两个长期副作用回归。也就是说：**"沙箱能用" 和 "没有 Low 标签副作用" 目前只能二选一。**

---

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 11 (AMD64) |
| 工作区 | `E:\MyWorkspace`（**非系统盘**，NTFS） |
| DSH | `0.1.7-rc.2`（Web / TUI）与 Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` 均可复现 |
| 沙箱包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.2（两者 `grantWrite` 逻辑一致，见附录 A） |
| 数据目录 | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`（与工作区分属不同盘） |

工作区 ACL（`icacls` 关键行，脱敏）：

```
E:\MyWorkspace  BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
                NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
                BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX)
                Authenticated Users:(I)(M)      ← 继承自 E:\ 盘根默认 ACL
                <owner>:(F)                      ← 用户手动加过，之后又移除（原因见痛点 3）
```

---

## 复现

1. 在非系统盘（`E:` / `D:` / `F:`）创建一个目录作为工作区，**不做任何 ACL 调整**（即保持盘根继承的 `Authenticated Users:(M)`）。
2. 启动 DSH（Web 或 Desktop 均可），以该目录为工作区。
3. 执行任意 `pwsh` 工具调用，例如 `Get-Location`。
4. 得到：

```
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(E:\MyWorkspace)
```

5. 此后**任何**命令都返回同一个错误 —— 包括只读命令，因为失败发生在 **spawn 之前的沙箱 provisioning 阶段**。

---

## 痛点（本 issue 的重点）

### 痛点 1：最常见的用户目录形态，恰好是最容易触发失败的形态

`grantWrite` 的注释自己写明了前置条件（`lib/types-*.js`，0.1.7 与 0.2.0 措辞一致）：

> The directory must be owned by the caller AND grant `WRITE_OWNER` (the label lives in the SACL; owner-implicit rights cover only `READ_CONTROL` and `WRITE_DAC`) — a Full-control workspace satisfies both.

问题在于：

- 非系统盘的**盘根默认 ACL** 给的是 `Authenticated Users:(M)`（Modify），**不含 `WRITE_OWNER`**；
- 目录 owner 的**隐式权限只有 `READ_CONTROL` + `WRITE_DAC`**，也不含 `WRITE_OWNER`；
- 因此"用户自己新建一个目录当工作区"这个最自然的行为，**产生的正是会失败的 ACL 形态**。

也就是说这不是边缘 case，而是**默认路径上的坑**。而且系统盘（`C:\`）下用户目录常常带 `(F)`，所以问题会呈现为"换个盘就炸"，进一步增加迷惑性。

### 痛点 2：失败发生在 provisioning 阶段，表现为"整个工具面消失"

`grantWrite` 失败是 **fail-closed by construction**（注释原话："throws on ANY Win32 failure — never spawns unrestricted"）。设计上可以理解，但用户体验是：

- **不是某条命令写不进去，而是所有命令都跑不了**，连 `whoami` 都不行；
- 失败点在 spawn 之前，所以**没有任何"部分可用"降级**；
- **每个 profile 独立 provisioning**，所以 Web / TUI / Desktop 会各自重踩一遍同一个坑；
- 用户无法从 `Win32 5` + `grantWrite(<path>)` 推断出"缺 `WRITE_OWNER`"，更不知道有一个诊断技能可用。**错误信息里没有任何指向解法的线索。**

### 痛点 3：唯一官方修复手段，与「避免 Low 标签副作用」互斥 —— 这是本 issue 的核心

0.2.0 的 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 技能对本文场景的裁决是 `PRECONDITION`，动作是**给当前用户补 `FullControl` allow ACE**。补完之后 `grantWrite` 成功，一切正常。

但 `grantWrite` 成功时，那一次 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 是**三处编辑一起落地**的（源码注释）：

> Each grant applies three edits in ONE `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` call: the capability-SID allow ACE, the deny of `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` to the world SID, and a Low no-write-up mandatory label.

于是：

```
加 FullControl  →  grantWrite 成功  →  Low 标签下发   ← 副作用回归
          移除 FullControl  →  grantWrite 失败  →  降级不打标签  ← 沙箱不可用
```

**这两种状态互为前提，中间没有落脚点。** 用户想要的是"沙箱能用，但工作区保持 Medium"，而当前架构下这个组合不存在。

而且由于 `grantWrite` 的幂等 skip 判据是 **exact ACE + exact deny + exact Low label** 三者齐备，用户也**无法**用 `icacls /setintegritylevel Medium` 手工把标签改回 Medium 来"骗过" skip —— 标签一旦与 Low 不符，apply 分支就会重新执行，再次写回 Low。

### 痛点 4：Low 标签的副作用被明确划到 scope 之外，但用户每天都在撞

官方 README 承认了 Low 标签会外溢：

> A standing Low label outlives DSH and widens the tree for other Low-integrity processes — the workspace's inheritable label survives the session (and same-volume moves) …

技能文档则直接把后果排除在修复范围外：

> Low executable labels and their effects outside DSH are outside this repair's scope.

但实际观察到的两个副作用都是**用户可见、持久、且会传播到 DSH 之外**的：

**4a. 工作区内双击 `.bat` / `.exe` 时出现「无法验证发布者」警告。** 用户在自己刚创建的脚本上双击，得到的是安全警告 —— 这直接破坏"工作区就是我的目录"的直觉。

**4b.（更严重）把工作区里的文件复制出去，文件会被写上 `Zone.Identifier` ADS（`ZoneId=3`，即 MOTW）。** 这条最要命：

- 它是**静默**的 —— 用户不知道文件被打了标记；
- 它会**跟着文件走** —— 把标了 MOTW 的文件发给同事，对方打开时触发 SmartScreen / 受保护视图；
- 它**跨程序生效** —— 与 DSH 无关的编辑器、压缩工具、同步工具都会读出这个 ADS；
- 它是**持久的** —— 即使 DSH 卸载、工作区改名，ADS 仍然依附在文件上。

也就是说：**DSH 在"只是跑了个命令"之后，悄悄改变了用户文件的元数据，并让这个改变传播到 DSH 之外的环境。** 这是我们认为最需要优先解决的一点。

补充说明：这一条是在**移除 `FullControl` 让 grant 失败**之后才消失的 —— 反过来说，官方修复手段必然让它回来。

### 痛点 5：修沙箱的工具，需要沙箱能用才能跑（鸡生蛋）

`diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 是一份 PowerShell 脚本（`assets/diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl/scripts/*.ps1`，约 45 KB / 798 行），必须用 `pwsh` 执行。

但故障场景恰恰是 **`pwsh` 工具完全不可用**（痛点 2）。技能文档也确认沙箱内无法运行：

> The script writes permissions, which the confined token cannot do — run it there and it would report the sandbox's own restriction as a missing right — so request approval for that one command and run it unconfined. A confined run of the script is never useful.

结论是一个**没有出口的循环**：

- 在 DSH 内跑 → 沙箱令牌写不了 ACL，无效；
- 在 DSH 外跑 → 需要用户知道脚本在哪、怎么调，而文档没有给出这条路径的操作说明；
- 想让 DSH 内以非沙箱方式跑 → 只能把整个会话切成「完全权限」(full access)，等于**临时关掉沙箱去修沙箱**。

**建议**：把该技能的调用路径做成"沙箱不可用时也能一键触发"的形态（例如由 host 端直接执行并走 approval，而不是依赖 `pwsh` 工具）。

### 痛点 6：诊断脚本住在临时目录，DSH 一重启就消失

`registerAclDiagnosisSkill()` 的实现是解压到 `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-acl-skill-"))`，并且 "disposal removes the directory"。后果：

- 路径每次启动都变（随机后缀），**无法收藏、无法写进文档、无法做书签**；
- 用户想以后复用这个工具，必须自己手动复制出来；
- 而"什么时候该复制"本身需要用户先知道这个坑 —— 又一次是先有故障才有认知。

技能文档只提醒了不要把 `-Out` 放进去，没有提示"想留下工具请自行复制"。

---

## 已经做得好的部分（希望保留）

不是全盘否定，以下几点确实到位：

1. **0.2.0 新增 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 技能**，第一次给了官方诊断入口，而不是让用户自己 `grep` 源码；
2. 修复是**带备份、带回读验证、失败自动反向回滚**的，还提供了 `ROLLBACK` 命令和（脚本级）`-Restore` 模式，工程上比"手敲 `icacls`"稳得多；
3. `-AllowRoot` 把改动范围锁死在授权目录内，并拒绝 reparse point 和受管应用目录；
4. 明确承诺 **不碰文件内容、不碰 owner、不删 deny ACE、不提权**；
5. 文档诚实 —— 前置条件、边界、已知局限都写清楚了（`READ-ONLY` 的约束、`FILE_DELETE_CHILD` 只继承到目录、hard link 与 AppContainer ACL 的边界等）。

---

## 期望

按优先级：

1. **提供"降级 provisioning"模式（最高优先级）**：当 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 因缺少 `WRITE_OWNER` 而失败时，允许退化为 **DACL-only**（应用 capability-SID allow ACE + `Everyone` deny，**跳过 SACL 的 Low 标签编辑**），并明确告知这是一次降级。理由：write-restricted token 的 restricting-SID 交集检查是主要的强制机制，Low 标签是纵深防御的第二层；牺牲第二层换取可用性，比 fail-closed 更符合实际。这也是社区补丁被迫采用的方案（附录 B）。

2. **把 `grantWrite` 的三处编辑拆开，让 Low 标签可独立开关**。当前"一次调用三件事"的设计使得用户无法只取 DACL 部分，这是痛点 3 的根因。

3. **区分处置 4a / 4b**：至少不该因"创建文件的方式"而给文件写 MOTW。如果 4b 的成因确实是标签策略导致的 ADS 写入，请把它纳入修复范围，而不是排除在 scope 外。

4. **启动期预检 + 可操作的错误信息**：在 provisioning 必然失败时，启动日志/UI 直接给出"缺 `WRITE_OWNER`，可运行 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl`"的提示，而不是让每条命令都重复 `Win32 5`。非系统盘工作区应单独给出提示（这正是最容易踩的形态）。

5. **让诊断技能在沙箱不可用时也能被触发**：走 host 端 + approval，不依赖 `pwsh` 工具链（痛点 5）。

6. **技能资源放到持久位置**，或提供一行命令让用户自行持久化（痛点 6）。

---

## 附录 A：`grantWrite` 在 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.0-rc.2 之间未变

对比两份打包产物（`lib/types-*.js`）：

- 幂等 skip 判据相同：`hasExactGrant(oldAcl, sidPtr) && hasExactDeny(oldAcl, worldSidPtr) && hasExactLabel(labelAcl, lowLabelSidPtr)`；
- apply 分支相同：`mergeAndApply(api, path, Buffer.concat([buildExplicitAccess(worldSidPtr, 3, 64, 2), buildExplicitAccess(sidPtr, 1, GRANT_MASK)]), oldAcl, { kind: "apply", acl: label }, descriptor, "grantWrite")`；
- koffi 绑定签名相同：`setNamedSecurityInfoW` 为 7 参数（`str16, int, uint32, PVOID ×4`），`getNamedSecurityInfoW` 为 8 参数；
- 唯一实质新增是 `ACL_DIAGNOSIS_SKILL` / `registerAclDiagnosisSkill` 以及 `assets/` 目录。

**结论：0.2.0 修的是"诊断与修复的可用性"，不是"这个前置条件本身"。** 因此本 issue 描述的故障在 0.2.0-rc.2 上原样复现。

## 附录 B：社区已被迫用 koffi hook 绕过

社区侧存在 `dsh-acl-sandbox-patch` 这类插件，做法是在 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 收到 `Win32 5` 时**剥离 `LABEL | SACL` 标志重试**，即只应用 DACL 部分，并在进程内标记"降级"状态，同时跳过子进程的 `SetTokenInformation(TokenIntegrityLevel)`。

它的存在本身就是对痛点 3 的佐证：**用户想要的是"沙箱能授权"而不是"沙箱能打标签"**，而当前 API 只提供后者。同时它也说明痛点 1/2 的修复需求足够普遍，以至于有人愿意维护一个第三方 hook。

（此处不主张官方采用任何具体第三方实现，仅作为需求强度的证据。）

---

discussions.title: session-query: a "bounded" readEvent deep-clones the whole session log — synchronous main-thread stall on large sessions
discussions.body:
### Summary

`sessionQuery.readEvent()` is documented as *"one full event plus a **bounded** raw-log context window"*.

Internally it calls `load()`, which `structuredClone`s **every** event in the log:

```ts
// packages/session-query/session-query/src/corpus.ts (current master)
function snapshotLive(session: Session): LogicalSession {
  return {
    header: structuredClone(session.header),
    inheritedEventCount: session.inheritedEventCount,
    events: session.snapshotEvents().map(event => structuredClone(event)),
  }
}
```

**The bound constrains only the returned value, not the work performed.** Reading one event costs a deep copy of the entire session log.

`structuredClone` is **synchronous**. On a large session this is a multi-second-to-minute main-thread block, during which the host **serves no HTTP at all** — the whole Web UI (Settings, other sessions, send/stop buttons) stops responding, **with no error output anywhere**.

### Environment

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` (workspace install), Node `v24.9.0`, Windows
- Session shape: **6,732 events / 31.2 MB raw JSON / 118 turns / 1,311 `tool/result` events**

### What we observed

After sending one message in that session:

- The entire Web UI stopped responding (not just that session): dynamic Settings lists, other sessions' history, and the send/stop buttons all failed
- **No error was printed anywhere** — not a crash, just a synchronously occupied CPU
- The only recovery was killing the process; on the next cold load, crash recovery appended `turn/end { reason: { kind: "interrupted" } }`

### Evidence

**(1) Call stack at the moment of the stall** (captured with `Debugger.pause`, 10 frames):

```text
 0  (anonymous)
 1  snapshotLive            @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:299
 2  load                    @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:125
 3  _readEvent              @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:1209
 4  apply                   @ cordis/lib/index.js:118
 5  readEvent               @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:1202
 6  apply                   @ cordis/lib/index.js:118
 7  readSessionEvent        @ dsh-vision-router/lib/dsh-contract-compat.js:57
 8  eventForSurfaceRepair   @ dsh-vision-router/lib/session-vision-index.js:200
 9  repairToolResultSurface @ dsh-vision-router/lib/session-vision-index.js:247
```

**(2) Self time over a 15-second CPU sample:**

```text
  13,820 ms  structuredClone  @ node:internal/worker/js_transferable:112   <- 92%
     893 ms  (garbage collector)
     788 ms  snapshotLive     @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:299
     217 ms  structuredClone  @ (no url)
```

The main thread was 100% saturated for the whole sampling window, 92% of it inside `structuredClone`.

### Root cause

`readEvent` is supposed to produce one event plus a small window, but the path it takes is:

```js
async readEvent(request, signal) {
  ...
  return this._readEvent(sessionId, seq, before, after, signal);
}

async _readEvent(sessionId, seq, before, after, signal) {
  const loaded = await this._corpus.load(sessionId, signal);   // whole log + full deep clone
  const target = loaded.events[seq];                          // only this one is needed
  ...
}
```

Note that **the same file already contains a non-copying counterpart**:

```ts
// sourceLive() in the same file: no clone at all
function sourceLive(session: Session): LogicalSessionSource {
  return { header: session.header, events: session.snapshotEvents() }
}
```

and the persistence layer already uses a freeze-once / share-without-copying model:

> The backend deep-freezes each event graph **once** before memoization, so later handle reads reuse it **without copying**.

The package documents the cost itself:

> **Exact reads replay whole logs** — `readSession`, `readSurface`, `filterEvents`, and event traces load and validate the complete logical log, so very large histories pay full inspection per call

and this comment shows the migration is known and deferred:

```ts
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-deprecated -- Existing Session history read; migration deferred.
```

**In short: the machinery for avoiding a whole-log copy already exists in this codebase (`sourceLive`, plus the persistence layer's freeze-and-share). `snapshotLive` / `readEvent` is the path that was missed.**

### Scope beyond a single consumer

The incident was triggered by a third-party plugin that called `readEvent` once per repaired sequence on `agent/pre-step` — `O(items × logSize)`, i.e. 1,311 × 31.2 MB. **That plugin switched to the `session/event` feed in its own 2.2.1 and is no longer affected.**

But **the amplifier described here lives in core and remains reachable**: any plugin, tool, or UI path that consumes `readEvent` / `readSession` / `readSurface` / `filterEvents` against a long session pays a full synchronous deep clone for what is documented as a bounded read.

### Suggested changes (by cost/benefit)

1. **Share instead of copying.** `session.snapshotEvents()` is already the shareable path `sourceLive()` uses, and the persistence layer already freezes each event graph once for copy-free reuse. A "detached" result need not be a fresh deep clone — sharing frozen events is enough, or fall back to a lazy / copy-on-write snapshot.
2. **Make the bound real.** `readEvent` should not route through `load()`. It needs one event plus a small window: a slice read on the persistence handle, or the observation path the docs already describe as never copying the log for header/cursor/projection-only consumers. **At minimum, a batch of repairs should take one snapshot, not one per item.**
3. **Bound the synchronous work.** Even with 1 and 2, a pathological log can still stall the loop; consider chunking with yields, or a cap per operation.

### Reproduction

**No private data is required.** Any session with a few thousand events and a few hundred `tool/result` events reproduces this as soon as a consumer calls `readEvent` once per event. Our instance was 6,732 events / 31.2 MB / 1,311 `tool/result` events.

### Notes

- This post contains **no session content**. The attached CPU profile carries only function names, module paths (user name and workspace path replaced with placeholders), and sample timing.
- We are not reporting the third-party plugin — it has been fixed on its own side. We are reporting the **core cost model** it tripped over.

---

**Full CPU profile**: attached below (sanitized — the user name and workspace path are replaced with `<user>` / `<workspace>`; it contains only function names, module paths, and sample timing).

<details>
<summary>中文版（点击展开）</summary>

### 摘要

`sessionQuery.readEvent()` 的文档是："one full event plus a **bounded** raw-log context window"。

但它内部调用 `load()`，而 `load()` 会**逐个事件 `structuredClone` 整个日志**：

```ts
// packages/session-query/session-query/src/corpus.ts（master 分支现状）
function snapshotLive(session: Session): LogicalSession {
  return {
    header: structuredClone(session.header),
    inheritedEventCount: session.inheritedEventCount,
    events: session.snapshotEvents().map(event => structuredClone(event)),
  }
}
```

**也就是说：`bounded` 只约束了返回给调用方的那一段，没有约束它实际做的工作量。** 要一个事件，代价就是一整个会话日志的深拷贝。

`structuredClone` 是**同步**的。在大会话上，这是一次几十秒到几分钟的主线程阻塞 —— 期间宿主**无法响应任何 HTTP 请求**，整个 Web 界面（设置页、其他会话、发送/停止按钮）一起失去响应，**且没有任何错误输出**。

### 环境

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.2`（工作区安装），Node `v24.9.0`，Windows
- 会话规模：**6,732 个事件 / 31.2 MB 原始 JSON / 118 轮 / 1,311 个 `tool/result` 事件**

### 现象

在该会话中发送一条消息后：

- 整个 Web UI 失去响应（不只是该会话）—— 设置页的动态列表、切到其他会话的历史、发送/停止按钮全部失效
- **终端没有任何报错**（不是崩溃，是 CPU 被同步占住）
- 只能强制结束进程；下次冷加载时崩溃恢复补写了 `turn/end { reason: { kind: "interrupted" } }`

### 证据

**① 主线程暂停时的调用栈**（用 `Debugger.pause` 抓取，10 帧）：

```text
 0  (anonymous)
 1  snapshotLive            @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:299
 2  load                    @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:125
 3  _readEvent              @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:1209
 4  apply                   @ cordis/lib/index.js:118
 5  readEvent               @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:1202
 6  apply                   @ cordis/lib/index.js:118
 7  readSessionEvent        @ dsh-vision-router/lib/dsh-contract-compat.js:57
 8  eventForSurfaceRepair   @ dsh-vision-router/lib/session-vision-index.js:200
 9  repairToolResultSurface @ dsh-vision-router/lib/session-vision-index.js:247
```

**② CPU 采样 15 秒的自身耗时分布**：

```text
  13,820 ms  structuredClone  @ node:internal/worker/js_transferable:112   ← 92%
     893 ms  (garbage collector)
     788 ms  snapshotLive     @ dsh-session-query/lib/index.js:299
     217 ms  structuredClone  @ (no url)
```

**主线程在采样窗口内 100% 饱和，92% 花在 `structuredClone`。**

### 根因

`readEvent` 的职责是「一个事件 + 一小段窗口」，但它走的路径是：

```js
async readEvent(request, signal) {
  ...
  return this._readEvent(sessionId, seq, before, after, signal);
}

async _readEvent(sessionId, seq, before, after, signal) {
  const loaded = await this._corpus.load(sessionId, signal);   // ← 整日志 + 全量深拷贝
  const target = loaded.events[seq];                          // ← 实际只需要这一个
  ...
}
```

值得注意的是，**同一个文件里已经有一条不拷贝的对照路径**：

```ts
// 同一文件的 sourceLive()：完全不拷贝
function sourceLive(session: Session): LogicalSessionSource {
  return { header: session.header, events: session.snapshotEvents() }
}
```

而且持久化层已经采用「冻结一次、之后共享」的模型：

> The backend deep-freezes each event graph **once** before memoization, so later handle reads reuse it **without copying**.

包文档本身也承认这个代价：

> **Exact reads replay whole logs** — `readSession`, `readSurface`, `filterEvents`, and event traces load and validate the complete logical log, so very large histories pay full inspection per call

而源码里这条注释说明该迁移是**已知且被推迟**的：

```ts
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-deprecated -- Existing Session history read; migration deferred.
```

**简单说：避免整日志拷贝的机制在这份代码里已经存在（`sourceLive` + 持久化层的冻结共享），`snapshotLive` / `readEvent` 是漏网的那一处。**

### 影响范围不止一个消费者

触发我们这次故障的是一个第三方插件（在 `agent/pre-step` 上**逐条**调用 `readEvent`，复杂度 `O(待修条目数 × 日志大小)`，即 1,311 × 31.2 MB）。**该插件已在自己的 2.2.1 版本改用 `session/event` 事件流，那一侧已经闭环。**

但**这里描述的放大器在核心里，且仍可达**：任何消费 `readEvent` / `readSession` / `readSurface` / `filterEvents` 的插件、工具或 UI 路径，只要面对长会话，都会以「一次 bounded 读取」的代价触发一次整日志同步深拷贝。

### 建议（按性价比排序）

1. **能共享就不要复制。** `session.snapshotEvents()` 已经是 `sourceLive()` 使用的可共享路径，持久化层也已经把每个事件图冻结一次供后续无拷贝复用。「detached 结果」未必需要一次全新的深拷贝 —— 共享已冻结的事件即可，或者退一步做惰性/写时复制。
2. **让 bounded 名副其实。** `readEvent` 不应该经过 `load()`。它只需要一个事件加一小段窗口：可以走持久化句柄的切片读，也可以走那条文档里写明「header / cursor / 投影类消费者永不拷贝日志」的 observation 路径。**最起码，批量修复应当只取一份快照，而不是每条一次。**
3. **给同步工作量加上界。** 即使做完 1 和 2，极端大的日志仍可能卡住事件循环；可以考虑分片让出、或对单次操作设上限。

### 复现

**不需要任何私有数据。** 任何具备「几千个事件 + 几百个 `tool/result`」的会话，只要有消费者对每个事件各调一次 `readEvent`，即可复现。我们这次的具体规模是 6,732 个事件 / 31.2 MB / 1,311 个 `tool/result`。

### 说明

- 本帖**不包含任何会话内容**。附带的 CPU profile 仅含函数名、模块路径（用户名与工作区路径已替换为占位符）和采样时序。
- 我们不是在报告那个第三方插件 —— 它已经在自己的版本里修好了。我们报告的是它踩中的**核心代价模型**。

</details>

---

discussions.title: [功能建议] 右栏（上下文面板）默认宽度可自定义并持久化
discussions.body:
### 概要

右侧 dock（上下文 / 文件预览面板）每次打开都是同一个固定默认宽度——约占视口 40% 以上——在 1920px 屏幕上明显偏宽。分隔条可以拖动，但宽度既不跨重启持久化，也无法配置，导致每个新会话都从过宽的默认值开始。

在**全新安装**的桌面端（0.2.0-rc.2，空 profile、无插件无配置）和 WebUI 0.2.0-rc.1 上验证过：两者默认宽度完全一致，说明这是核心行为，而非本机配置问题。

### 建议

1. **持久化拖动后的宽度**（按 profile 记住，如 localStorage），下次启动恢复；
2. 可选：把默认宽度（px 或 %）暴露为设置项或主题 token，允许用户和插件覆盖；
3. 考虑在大视口下限制首次打开的宽度上限，或改为按比例而非固定值。

### 相关讨论

- #8081 `[Feature Request] sidebars support persistent width`——只提了「拖动后持久化」；本请求是它的延伸：首次打开的**默认值**也应可配置。
- #7791（把侧栏列宽暴露给 `shell.overlay` 的占用方）——同一底层缺口：宽度不在公开的布局契约里。
- #5252（悬停触发的宽度调节与会话导航冲突）——同一分隔条的相关 UX 摩擦。

discussions.title: [Bug] DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash display name misses the decimal point — still present in 0.2.0-rc.2
discussions.body:
Follow-up to #6114 — still reproducible after the recent refactor.

**Environment**
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.2.0-rc.2 (desktop app, macOS arm64, nightly build 2026-09-29T10:18Z)
- The selector row and its hover tooltip both show `DeepSeek-V41-Flash`

**Where it lives now**
The catalog was split out of `index.ts` since the original report. The string is now at
`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/models.ts:9` — `name: 'DeepSeek-V41-Flash'` — completely
unchanged. Line 17 of the same array uses the correct style, `name: 'DeepSeek-V4-Pro'`,
so the two entries are inconsistent with each other.

**Expected**
`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`, matching the official release note:
https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news260910/ ("DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash",
"Set your model to `deepseek-flash`").

**Scope**
Display only. The model id `deepseek-flash` is correct — requests, billing and capabilities
are unaffected. The selector renders `model.name` verbatim, so this single string is the
entire source of the label.

**Possible cause / fix**
`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/image-tokens.ts:4` refers to this generation as
"its current `v41` configuration", so the internal shorthand seems to have leaked into the
user-facing name. One-character fix: `V41` → `V4.1`.

discussions.title: 升级到 0.1.7-rc.2 后设置页打不开（加载提供商目录失败: settings are unavailable in this browser），有解吗？
discussions.body:
设置页打不开：加载提供商目录失败: settings are unavailable in this browser
⭐ 标题（按你发的分类，挑一条复制）
发 Q&A（推荐）：
`升级到 0.1.7-rc.2 后设置页打不开（加载提供商目录失败: settings are unavailable in this browser），有解吗？`
发 General：
`[BUG] 0.1.7-rc.2 设置页打不开：加载提供商目录失败 / settings are unavailable in this browser`
发 Issues（正式报 bug 通道）：
`[BUG] 升级 0.1.7-rc.2 后设置页模型列表打不开：settings are unavailable in this browser`
---
一句话说清楚
升级到 0.1.7-rc.2 之后，设置里的「模型」页面打不开，提示：
> 加载提供商目录失败: settings are unavailable in this browser
结果就是：没法在界面上换模型、加模型，只能去手动改配置文件。
---
我的环境
服务器（Linux / Ubuntu）：用 npm 装的 dsh 0.1.7-rc.2（原来是 0.1.5-rc.3，升完级就出问题了）
本地电脑：DSH 桌面版 0.1.7.0（Windows）—— 也一样打不开
浏览器：电脑 Edge ＋ 安卓手机浏览器 —— 两个都这样
不是偶发，每次打开设置页都这样
---
怎么复现
安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2`
用 `dsh web` 启动，打开界面
点「设置」→「模型」
就出现上面那句提示
---
我已经试过、都没用的（都排除了）
强制刷新（Ctrl + Shift + R）、清掉网站数据、开无痕窗口 —— 都没用
换浏览器、换设备 —— 一样
服务器本身是正常的：接口返回 401（那是正常的登录鉴权，不是坏了），日志里没有报错
不是文件缺失，也不是浏览器不支持
---
我猜问题出在哪（附一行代码）
在客户端这个文件里：
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models/lib/client.js`
有这样一行：
```js
this.failLoad(generation, mirrored.error ?? "settings are unavailable in this browser");
```
这句话的意思是：只有当"读取设置"失败、而且失败原因(error)是空的时候，界面才会显示这句兜底的话。
所以真正的问题被丢掉了 —— 界面只能显示这句容易让人误会的话（看起来像"浏览器不支持"，其实根本不是浏览器的错）。
---
希望官方能看一下这三点
把真正的失败原因显示出来（现在这句会把人往"浏览器问题"上带）
查一下 0.1.7 里"读取设置"这条路：为什么会失败，却不报错
顺带建议：入口页 `index.html` 加 `no-cache`（带哈希的 `assets/` 可以长缓存）—— 免得升级之后浏览器还拿着旧版本
---
看起来是同一个问题的帖子
#4817 升级后不支持第三方模型
#5609 升级后 models 页失效（lazy client bundle race）
#5937 无法添加提供方模型 / 点击无反应

补充（给排查的人）
服务端：`/` 和所有 `/api/*` 都是 401（鉴权正常）；`dsh-web` 进程和隧道进程都是 active
应用日志 `dsh-web.log` 最后一条是启动行，之后没有任何 error / stack
客户端的包文件都在（不是缺文件）
因此判断是接口层静默失败，不是缓存、不是权限、不是浏览器

discussions.title: dsh-three-window: A three-window workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
discussions.body:
[dsh-three-window](https://github.com/psychiiii/dsh-three-window)

A three-window workbench plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

## Features

- **Three windows side by side**, each with its own job and default permission:

  | Window | For | Permission |
  |---|---|---|
  | Chat | Discuss and plan before touching code | read-only |
  | Construct | Change code | workspace-write |
  | Review | Review a change | read-only |

- **Per workspace.** Every workspace keeps its own three windows and their
  history; switching workspaces and reloading the page bring you back where you were.
- **Per-window hooks.** `.dsh/hooks/chat.json`, `construct.json`, and `review.json`
  in your project apply to one window each. Ready-made examples are in
  `examples/hooks/`.
- **Anonymous multi-model review.** Tell the review window what to review, e.g.
  “review the storyboard and the shot list, only the shot lengths”: it finds the
  files in the workspace and asks you in a confirmation card listing each item,
  why it was picked, and what was left out and why. Choose “start” and every
  configured reviewer model reviews it on its own, blind to the others, for at
  most three rounds (if one fails, the others go on), and you get the conclusion,
  the agreed findings, and the disagreements in plain words; choose “change” and
  say what you want instead. The original report opens from the review window. Not only code: documents,
  translations, data, plans, storyboards and other text work, with or without git;
  images, audio, video and Office files themselves are not reviewed. Reviewer
  models are set with the “Review models” button (the window stays locked until
  one is set; a single one runs an ordinary single-model review); each workspace's
  standing guidance is set with “Review guidance”, and workspaces without their own
  use the default in Settings → Windows & review.
- **Model output language.** Each window can have its own language for the
  model's answers to you: pick it from “输出语言：…” at the top right of the
  window, or in Settings → General (the same setting). It governs only what the
  model says to you: code, comments, and commit messages keep following the project.
- **Per-workspace turn prompt.** In the workspace list, ⋯ → “Turn prompt…” sets a
  text that is appended after every message in that workspace, in all three
  windows. A 📌 beside the name marks a workspace that has one and previews it on
  hover. It is stored only in this machine's dsh settings, never in the project.

discussions.title: Sandbox (workspace-write) broken after update: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5) - grantWrite now requires WRITE_OWNER on workspace root
discussions.body:
# Bug report: workspace-write sandbox fails with `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5)` after update (grantWrite requires WRITE_OWNER)

## 环境（脱敏）

- OS: Windows 11（本地桌面版 DSH）
- 受影响版本：本次 dsh-runtime 更新后引入（更新前同一环境、同一工作区正常）
- 沙箱策略：`workspace-write`，审批 `ask`
- 工作区：`D:\<workspace>`（NTFS，根目录继承自盘根的 `Authenticated Users: Modify` 级 ACE，无用户 FullControl 显式 ACE）

## 症状

更新后，workspace-write 模式下**任何**命令都在沙箱授权阶段失败，命令体从未执行：

```
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace>)
```

Win32 5 = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED。切换权限预设到 `danger-full-access` 后立即恢复正常（跳过授权环节），可佐证故障点在沙箱运行器的 ACL 授权一步。

## 根因分析

本次更新后，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 的 `grantWrite` 从「仅写 DACL」（`SECURITY_INFORMATION = 4`）变为「DACL + Low 强制完整性标签一次写入」（`= 20`，同一次 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 同时补 world SID 的 `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` deny 与 Low label）。写 SACL/label 要求调用方持有 `WRITE_OWNER`，而 owner 隐式权利只有 `READ_CONTROL` + `WRITE_DAC`（模块源码注释亦写明：*"The directory must be owned by the caller AND grant WRITE_OWNER … a Full-control workspace satisfies both"*）。

常见的工作区目录（用户自建、仅继承 `Authenticated Users: Modify`）恰好不满足该前提 → `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 返回 Win32 5，且发生在授权阶段，导致该工作区内所有命令不可用。旧版仅写 DACL（owner 隐式有 `WRITE_DAC`），因此更新前无感。

### 叠加的第二层问题（同一报错的另一种触发路径）

工作区内若存在**管理员权限进程创建的子目录**（owner = `BUILTIN\Administrators`，且 DACL/SACL 保护位打开、脱离继承），它拿不到工作区能力 SID（S-1-4-*）的继承 ACE，也没有 Low label。此时 `grantWrite` 已正常通过，但受限令牌（WRITE_RESTRICTED 双通道检查 + 完整性检查）写该子目录时得到 `EPERM`，GUI 报 `[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]`——与第一层报错文本不同，但用户同样难以自行定位。

## 复现步骤

1. 工作区目录仅有继承的 `Authenticated Users: Modify` 级权限（无用户显式 FullControl / 无 `WRITE_OWNER`）。
2. 以 `workspace-write` 预设运行任意命令。
3. 得到 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace>)`。

有效权限可用 `Get-Acl`/AccessCheck 验证：owner 为当前用户、`WRITE_DAC=true`、`WRITE_OWNER=false`。

## 当前 workaround

1. 给工作区根补当前用户显式 FullControl ACE（满足 owner + WRITE_OWNER 前提），例如管理员或 owner 身份执行一次授予权限的操作后即恢复。
2. 对 owner=Administrators、保护位打开的历史子目录，需管理员 PowerShell 一次性修复：
   ```powershell
   takeown /F '<受影响子目录>' /R /D Y
   icacls '<受影响子目录>' /reset /T /C
   icacls '<受影响子目录>' /setintegritylevel '(OI)(CI)Low'   # 注意 PowerShell 中需引号
   ```
3. 临时绕过：会话切到 `danger-full-access`（仅建议用于确认根因，不建议长期使用）。

## 改进建议（对 dsh-runtime）

1. **错误可诊断性**：`grantWrite` 在应用前 AccessCheck 检测 `WRITE_OWNER` 缺失时，抛出携带明确修复指引的错误（如「工作区目录需当前用户 FullControl；见 XXX 文档」），而不是裸抛 Win32 5。当前错误文本无法与权限修复路径关联，用户（和 agent）只能全靠排查。
2. **授权前自检/自动补救**：provision 时若发现工作区根缺 `WRITE_OWNER`，可提示或引导一次修复（或文档化「工作区根需 Full Control」为硬性要求）。
3. **工作区内孤立目录检测**：首次授权后对工作区做一次轻量扫描，对 owner 非 workspace 用户或 DACL/SACL 保护位打开的子目录给出告警（这类目录在受限令牌下必然 EPERM）。
4. **文档**：更新日志/README 明确两点新前提——① 工作区根目录必须授予当前用户 FullControl；② 工作区内不应存在管理员创建、脱离 ACL 继承的子目录。另外 `icacls /setintegritylevel (OI)(CI)Low` 在 PowerShell 中必须给参数加引号，值得写进排查文档。

## 附：与另一已知故障的区分

`dsh` 文档已记录过另一类「pwsh 空输出、退出码恒 0、无副作用」的 win32 运行器故障（切 `danger-full-access` 可恢复）。本次故障同样可通过切预设缓解，但报错文本（`SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(...)`）不同、根因不同，建议归档为独立 issue。

discussions.title: [Windows] Desktop update silently fails to apply — installer stages .new-{GUID} sibling dir, swap never completes, badge returns every launch
discussions.body:
> Related to #8198, but **not** the same defect. That report is the macOS *loud* variant: the in-app update **refuses** the handoff with `desktop update: Host did not complete graceful task teardown (...)`. This one is the Windows *silent* variant: the installer really does run and extracts a complete payload, then the directory swap never completes — and nothing is surfaced anywhere, so the only visible symptom is a badge that comes back on every launch.

## Environment

- Windows x64, Electron 44.0.0
- DeepSeek Harness **desktop 0.2.0-rc.1 → 0.2.0-rc.2**, `nightly` channel
- Per-user install into a custom directory: `D:\dsh dp` (not the default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\...`); `resources/app-update.yml` reports `isAdminRightsRequired: false`
- Feed: `https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/feeds/win-x64/nightly.yml` → `version: 0.2.0-rc.2`, `releaseDate: 2026-09-29T10:35:27.666Z`

## Symptom

The in-app update *appears* to run — the installer executes and the app relaunches — but the installed version never changes, and **no error is shown anywhere**. Every launch reports a new version is available, because the update is genuinely still pending.

## Evidence: two attempts, nothing applied

| Check | Value after two update attempts |
|---|---|
| `HKCU\...\Uninstall\1bf39983-...` → `DisplayVersion` | `0.2.0-rc.1` |
| `<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe` → `FileVersion` | `0.2.0-rc.1` |
| `<install>\Uninstall DeepSeek Harness.exe` | `0.2.0-rc.1` |
| `resources\app.asar` → `package.json` → `version` | `0.2.0-rc.1` |
| Running process image | `<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe` |

Two abandoned staging directories were left next to the install (local time, UTC+8):

| Directory | Created | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `D:\dsh dp.new-{AF76FF91-F53F-48DD-916F-B8272379C0C3}` | 20:41:30 | complete: 10,916 items / 1,015 MB |
| `D:\dsh dp.new-{9AFFA330-238A-497E-B0B3-FDCA67300699}` | 20:42:10 | complete: 10,916 items / 1,015 MB |

Both hold a full, self-consistent app tree: `resources/app.asar` whose `package.json` reads `0.2.0-rc.2` (`dshBuildCommit` `04f392c9ddd144fa426da2045178797da6db6c11`), plus a freshly generated `Uninstall DeepSeek Harness.exe` stamped `0.2.0-rc.2`. So **extraction finished; only the swap into the install directory did not happen.**

## The installer stages deliberately, then fails to swap

The cached installer is intact — SHA-512 matches `nightly.yml` byte-for-byte (`raIlxMQd9ESXgktmViW7QwVLcjBR5JIsrNOu+SpelY8kskdSr2H51/f+ey1EqFI/eIIrKQCuRANMeb5SptRZcg==`, 289,313,640 bytes).

`7z l` on it:

```
Type = Nsis
SubType = NSIS-3 Unicode
$PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z              288160396
$PLUGINSDIR\dsh-7za.exe               489302
Uninstall DeepSeek Harness.exe        267168
```

The staging path is literally the install directory plus `.new-{GUID}` — the installer resolved the correct target and deliberately staged a sibling copy of the whole payload. I scanned the packed `app.asar` (which is uncompressed) for any `.new-` literal: **0 hits**, so this staging is installer-side, not shell-side.

## Why the swap fails (measured, not inferred)

While the app is running, the two files the swap must replace are held open:

```
<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe        -> "The process cannot access the file ... because it is being used by another process."
<install>\resources\app.asar          -> "The process cannot access the file ... because it is being used by another process."
<install>.new-{...}\DeepSeek Harness.exe -> writable (nothing is running from it)
```

Ruled out:

- **Permissions** — creating and deleting a file inside the install directory succeeds.
- **Disk** — 197 GB free on the volume; NTFS, healthy.
- **Corruption** — installer SHA-512 matches the manifest exactly.
- **A space in the install path** — the original install into the same directory succeeded, and the manual re-run below succeeded there too.

## Controlled contrast

Same cached installer, same flags as the in-app path (`--updated /S`), one variable changed: every `DeepSeek Harness.exe` process stopped and the two files above **proven** unlocked before launching.

```
installer exit code : 0        (24 seconds)
installed version   : 0.2.0-rc.2   (verified via exe FileVersion, uninstaller, registry, app.asar)
```

The package, feed, flags and install location are all fine. The only blocker is that the app's own files are still held when the swap runs.

## Relationship to #8198 — and why the ack is not sufficient

#8198 identifies a real gate: `DesktopHostProcess.stop(requireGraceful = true)` refuses the handoff unless the child exited with code 0 *and* sent a `shutdown-complete` ack, while the host's `PROCESS_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000` force-exits before sending that ack. That gate is unchanged in 0.2.0-rc.2 (shell window is 10 s; host still 5 s).

In the case reported here the gate evidently **passed** — the NSIS installer was genuinely launched and extracted a complete payload. So a successful `shutdown-complete` does **not** imply the install is replaceable. What NSIS needs is for the main Electron process to have released `<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe` and `<install>\resources\app.asar` before it starts replacing them. The current gate verifies the child host's teardown, not the parent's file handles, and not the installer's outcome.

## Observability gap

- The update journal (`DesktopUpdateJournal` / `lib/types/update-journal.js`) is opt-in via `DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_JOURNAL_DIR`. Unset by default, so a stock install records **nothing at all**.
- Its last records for an install are `install-confirmed` and `quit-requested`. After `quitAndInstall(true, true)` the process is gone, so the installer's result has no channel back into the app — **even with the journal enabled, this failure is indistinguishable from success.**
- Its error classification is a fixed whitelist of 8 codes; a swap failure produces no `error` state and therefore no code.

## Suggested fixes (any one would help)

1. **Gate the handoff on the install directory, not only on the host ack.** After the host exits, confirm `<install>\<exe>` and `resources\app.asar` can be opened for exclusive write — or simply wait for the main process to exit — before spawning the installer.
2. **Make the swap resilient and honest.** Retry the replace for N seconds; on failure remove the `.new-{GUID}` staging directory and record the outcome so the next launch can report it, instead of failing silently.
3. **Detect the stuck state on next launch.** If a `.new-{GUID}` sibling exists while the feed version is still newer than the running version, surface an actionable message ("the previous update did not apply — quit the app fully and run the installer manually") instead of re-offering the same update forever.

## Workaround

Quit the desktop app **completely** — check Task Manager for `DeepSeek Harness.exe`; tray/background mode keeps processes alive — then run the already-downloaded installer:

```
%LOCALAPPDATA%\@deepseek-aidsh-desktop-updater\installer.exe
```

It completes in about 25 seconds and the badge disappears. Confirmed on this machine after two failed in-app attempts.

---

## 中文摘要

Windows 上应用内更新**静默失效**：安装器确实运行了，把 rc.2 完整解压到 `<安装目录>.new-{GUID}`（10,916 项 / 1,015 MB，含新生成的 `0.2.0-rc.2` 卸载器），但**换入安装目录这一步没有完成**，旧版本原样保留，重启后徽标再次出现，全程无任何提示。已排除权限、磁盘空间、包损坏、路径含空格。

实测原因：换入要替换的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe` 与 `resources/app.asar` 正被运行中的 app 独占锁定（两者都返回 "being used by another process"）。对照实验：同一个安装包、同样的 `--updated /S`，只要在**完全停掉所有进程并确认文件已解锁**后运行，24 秒即成功，版本验证为 0.2.0-rc.2。

与 #8198 同族但不同：那个是**报错并拒绝交接**（宿主 5 秒限时强制退出，`shutdown-complete` 从未发出）；这里是**优雅退出已通过、安装器真的跑了，却仍然换不进去**，而且不报错。说明 `shutdown-complete` 回执不足以保证可替换——NSIS 需要的是主进程已释放 `<exe>` 与 `app.asar` 的句柄。此外 `DesktopUpdateJournal` 默认关闭（`DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_JOURNAL_DIR`），记录止于 `install-confirmed` / `quit-requested`，即使开启也无法区分这种失败与成功。
