discussions.title: DSH | dsh-gfg | Query how Harness tool results were actually formed
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community member.**

**Project URL:** https://github.com/wind342/dsh-gfg

## Introduction

`dsh-gfg` is a lightweight Generation-Fact Graph plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It lets an agent query how a tool result was actually formed.

`gfg_trace({"target_id":"read-1"})` returns a structured formation subgraph linking the durable result back through the observed runtime stages to the original assistant tool call. Relations are bound using native runtime identities rather than timestamps, text similarity, or log proximity.

The reproducible demo runs the published Harness AgentLoop and tool runtime with a scripted LLM adapter:

`read a.txt → hello → gfg_trace`

A second demo denies a call and records an explicit disposition without executing the tool body. Unobserved pre-dispatch policy outcomes are recorded conservatively rather than guessed.

## How it integrates with DSH

The plugin hooks exposed Harness runtime boundaries including `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, `tools/pre-execute`, `tools/execute`, `tools/post-execute`, `tools/result`, and durable `tool/result` events.

Full structured receipts are kept privately with SHA-256 identities, while the model-callable `gfg_trace` and `gfg_get_node` tools expose only a safe structural projection. Ordinary tool outputs are not modified.

This is **formation provenance**, not a causal explanation and not an attempt to capture hidden model reasoning.

## Screenshot / structure

![GFG formation structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wind342/dsh-gfg/main/docs/formation.svg)

## Verification

The current version has **23 passing tests**, including capture ON/OFF output invariance, exact multi-source bindings, denial/failure/cancellation, concurrent and nested calls, session isolation, tamper detection, private-result redaction, and deterministic graph replay.

GitHub Actions is green, and installation through the official Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** profile/plugin path has also been verified.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm demo
```

A live-provider run is not yet part of the verification set. Feedback on the capture boundaries and the model-facing trace format would be especially useful.

Raw production receipts may contain prompts, file contents, arguments, or tool results, so they should be kept private.

discussions.title: web profile: fresh install reports 11 unmet-peer conflicts (cordis 4.0.2 vs ~4.0.4, internal packages 0.1.1-rc.2 vs 0.1.7-rc.2)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Installing the `web` profile's dependencies produces 11 distinct unmet-peer and peer-conflict warnings, and one hard `Conflicting peer dependencies` report, while the harness itself starts and runs correctly. Two independent version lines are mixed inside one profile:

- sibling core packages require `@deepseek-ai/cordis@~4.0.4`, but the profile resolves `cordis@4.0.2`;
- packages at `0.1.7-rc.2` resolve internal packages at `0.1.1-rc.2` (`dsh-attachment`, `dsh-invariants`, `dsh-scope`, `dsh-system-prompt`, `dsh-user-approval`), which is exactly what those packages declare they do not want.

The mismatches surface only on a fresh resolution: once `pnpm-lock.yaml` exists, `pnpm install` prints `Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped` and reports nothing.

## Reproduction

```
dsh plugin --profile web install
rm pnpm-lock.yaml
dsh plugin --profile web install
```

Underlying pnpm: `9.15.9` (the version the `dsh plugin` wrapper reports).

## Current behavior

Fresh resolution prints, verbatim (11 unique lines):

```
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/cordis@~4.0.4: found 4.0.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.1.1-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.1.1-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox@^0.0.1-rc.1: found 0.1.7-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-scope@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.1.1-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-client@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.0.1-rc.1
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-protocol@^0.0.1-rc.1: found 0.1.7-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection@^0.0.1-rc.1: found 0.1.7-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.0.1-rc.1
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.1.1-rc.2
? unmet peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-approval@0.1.7-rc.2: found 0.1.1-rc.2

? Conflicting peer dependencies:
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy

Done in 2.7s
```

Exit code is 0, and `dsh --profile web --dump-config` composes cleanly with no warnings. So this looks like a metadata/consistency issue rather than a runtime break.

Registry facts checked separately, in case they help:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants@0.1.7-rc.2` exists in the registry, so the version the core asks for is published.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent@0.1.7-rc.2` declares `dsh-invariants@0.1.7-rc.2` as a **peerDependency**, not as a regular dependency; the manifest looks correct.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.7-rc.2` declares `cordis@~4.0.4` plus peers at `0.1.7-rc.2` for `dsh-scope`, `dsh-attachment`, `dsh-system-prompt`, `dsh-tools`, `dsh-timeout`, `dsh-subprocess`, `dsh-mcp-resources`, `dsh-llm`.

The profile already carries an explicit override block in `package.json` aimed at exactly this, and it does not change the outcome:

```json
"pnpm": {
  "overrides": {
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants": "0.1.7-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope": "0.1.7-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment": "0.1.7-rc.2"
  }
}
```

...and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` has `autoInstallPeers: false`.

## Expected behavior

A newly created or `dsh plugin install`-ed profile resolves one consistent set of internal packages, so a fresh install completes with no unmet-peer or conflicting-peer output. Alternatively, if mixing lines is intentional for `0.1.7-rc.2`, the expected output would be documented so it can be told apart from an actually broken profile.

## Environment

- DSH core: `0.1.7-rc.2` (`dsh --version`)
- Node.js: `v24.21.0`
- pnpm reported by the installer: `9.15.9`
- OS: Windows 11 Pro, build 28000
- Profile: `web`, `nodeLinker: hoisted`, `autoInstallPeers: false`
- Profile dependencies: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.7-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-{acp,claude-code,codex,dsh-sdk}@0.1.7-rc.2`, plus external plugins `dsh-fast@0.2.17`, `@xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup@0.13.2`, `@ai4gensteam/dsh-agents-swarm@0.6.3`, `dsh-notify-win@0.1.1`

discussions.title: [Windows] 按用户安装启动即崩，报错指向 GPU，实际是安装目录缺少包 SID 读取授权
discussions.body:
下载完官方桌面版后打不开，用其他harness框架下的ds4.1f查了很久并生成了报告，直接复制下来的

>**环境**
> - Windows 11 23H2（Build 10.0.22631）x64
> - **官方桌面版**：包名 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop`，版本 `0.2.0-rc.2`
>   （`DeepSeek Harness.exe` 0.2.0.2），Electron 44.0.0；更新源
>   `https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/feeds/win-x64/`，更新清单签名主体
>   `CN=Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.`
> - 安装方式：默认的**按用户安装**，路径 `C:\Users\<用户>\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\`
>
> **现象**
>
> 双击图标后 1 秒内窗口消失。Windows 事件日志：`异常代码: 0x80000003`。加
> `--enable-logging --v=1` 后 Chromium 日志是：
>
> ```
> ERROR:content\browser\gpu\gpu_process_host.cc:1035] GPU process exited unexpectedly: exit_code=-2147483645
> ... （连续 9 次）
> FATAL:content\browser\gpu\gpu_data_manager_impl_private.cc:417] GPU process isn't usable. Goodbye.
> ```
>
> **根因：安装目录缺少包 SID 读取授权（已用单变量实验确认）**
>
> 我在同一个安装目录上，每次只改**一条**权限、其余条件完全不变，然后不带任何参数启动：
>
> | 安装目录上唯一的额外授权 | 启动结果 |
> |---|---|
> | 不加（只有继承来的 系统/管理员/用户 完全控制 + `Users`/`Everyone`/`RESTRICTED` 读取） | **崩溃** `-2147483645` |
> | 只加 `Authenticated Users` 读取 | **崩溃** `-2147483645` |
> | 只加 `S-1-15-2-2`（ALL RESTRICTED APPLICATION PACKAGES）读取 | **正常启动** |
> | 只加 `S-1-15-2-1`（ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES）读取 | **正常启动** |
> | 两条都加 | **正常启动，连续 3 次全通过** |
>
> 也就是说：**除了"包类型" SID，其他主体（Users / Everyone / Authenticated Users / RESTRICTED）
> 都不行**。这正是 AppContainer 令牌子进程的判定方式 —— 目录的访问判定只看包 SID。
> Electron 44（Chromium 152）的 GPU / 渲染子进程就是这样被创建的，所以**安装目录必须显式授权
> 给 `ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES`（或 `S-1-15-2-2`），否则子进程连自己目录里的 `icudtl.dat`
> 都打不开**，沙箱初始化失败后按设计自杀（`base::ImmediateCrash()` → `0x80000003`），
> 连续 9 次失败后主进程 `FATAL` 退出。
>
> 同时用**原版 Electron 44.0.0**（未经你们改动）+ 二十行 `BrowserWindow` 小程序，在一个同样
> 缺少包 SID 授权的目录里复现了完全相同的结果，`--no-sandbox` 则一切正常 → 与你们的业务代码无关，
> 是安装位置与目录权限的组合问题。
>
> **为什么别的应用没事、而 dsh 会崩**
>
> - `C:\Program Files` 及其子目录 Windows **默认**就授予 `ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES` 读取
>   （实测 SDDL 含 `(A;;0x1200a9;;;AC)(A;OICIIO;GXGR;;;AC)`）→ 按机器安装的 Electron 应用天然没事。
> - **Chrome 的安装器会显式给自己的安装目录写上 `AC` + `S-1-15-2-2` 授权**（实测其
>   `Application` 目录 SDDL 里就是 `(A;ID;0x1200a9;;;AC)(A;ID;0x1200a9;;;S-1-15-2-2)`），
>   所以 Chrome 无论怎么装都正常。
> - `%LOCALAPPDATA%` 及其上级目录在 Windows 上**从不**授予任何包 SID（我在本机用另一个干净用户
>   配置和系统模板都验证过，只有 系统/管理员/用户 三项）。**所以"按用户安装 + 不给安装目录加包
>   SID 授权"= 必崩**，与机器环境无关。这应该能解释其他按用户安装的用户遇到的同类崩溃。
> - 兼容性方面也做了一个对照：`--disable-gpu`、`--use-angle=swiftshader`、
>   `--disable-gpu-sandbox`、`--disable-features=RendererCodeIntegrity`、
>   `--disable-features=NetworkServiceSandbox`、`--disable-features=RendererAppContainer` 全部无效；
>   **只有 `--no-sandbox` 有效**，进一步说明问题在沙箱初始化本身，不在 GPU、也不在某个沙箱特性。
>
> **建议的修复方向**
>
> 1. **安装器补一步**：安装结束时给安装目录加
>    `ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES:(OI)(CI)(RX)` 与 `S-1-15-2-2:(OI)(CI)(RX)`
>    （Chrome 的做法），或
>    ```
>    icacls "<install dir>" /grant "*S-1-15-2-1:(OI)(CI)(RX)" "*S-1-15-2-2:(OI)(CI)(RX)" /T /C
>    ```
>    2. **更新器也要走同一步**：如果自动更新会重建安装目录，ACL 会退回继承状态，用户的
>    应用会在某次更新后突然又打不开。
> 3. 或者把默认安装位置改为**按机器安装**（`C:\Program Files\...`），由 Windows 自带的 ACL
>    覆盖这一需求。
> 4. 另外建议改进错误输出：现在用户看到的是 `GPU process isn't usable. Goodbye.`，
>    会把所有人（包括我）先引向显卡驱动方向。若能在启动失败时提示"安装目录不可访问 /
>    沙箱初始化失败"，会省掉大量无谓排查。上游 `electron/electron` PR #54485 处理的正是
>    "安装目录不可读时报错误导"这一类问题。
>
> **给遇到同样问题的用户的临时办法**（我没有改任何快捷方式）：
>
> ```powershell
> icacls "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness" /grant "*S-1-15-2-1:(OI)(CI)(RX)" "*S-1-15-2-2:(OI)(CI)(RX)" /T /C
> ```
>
> 治本要等安装器修好，因为更新后可能需要重做一次。

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows] workspace-write leaves a permanent Low integrity label on the project, breaking every other tool used on it — several reports, still unchanged in 0.2.0-rc.2
discussions.body:
Once DSH has written to a folder in `workspace-write` mode, three edits stay on its root forever: the capability ACE, `Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)`, and `Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)`. They survive the session and DSH exiting. The README describes this as intentional: the grant is a reuse cache and is never revoked.

**Why this is serious**

Most of us don't use only one tool on a project. DSH edits it, then Codex, Claude Code, an IDE or a plain terminal works on the same folder. The label is inherited by every file in the tree. So after one DSH session, whichever tool starts something from that project gets a Low-integrity process or a refusal, and nothing points at DSH as the cause:

- #7709: Electron/Chromium apps in the project exit with `0x80000003` at startup, with no output and no log.
- #8175: build tools (msbuild, dotnet, npm) refuse or warn about the files, which looks like a Mark-of-the-Web / Internet-zone problem even though no `Zone.Identifier` exists.
- #7735: double-clicking `.bat` / `.cmd` / `.exe` in the project shows "publisher could not be verified" every time.
- #8048: the label can land on the DSH Desktop install directory itself, after which Harness cannot start.

Users end up chasing Electron, antivirus or zone problems for hours. The only recovery today is editing ACLs by hand, and `icacls` cannot remove these entries (error 1332, as the README notes).

Between 0.2.0-rc.1 and rc.2, `sandbox-windows-acl` (`acl.ts`, `grant.ts`) and `sandbox-local` did not change. The reworked diagnose skill reports `LOW_LABEL` but does not remove it.

**What we would ask for**

1. Revoke the workspace grant when the sandbox is done with the folder, instead of keeping it as a cache.
2. Provide an official way to clean folders that are already marked.
3. Until then, say plainly under Known Limitations that programs started from a folder DSH has written to run at Low integrity.

**An approach that works**

We implemented the following against the current `sandbox-windows-acl` / `sandbox-local` code and tested it on real ACLs:

- **Leases.** The runner holds a lease file (`<pid>`, under a directory keyed by the workspace SID) for as long as it runs. When a workspace has had no live lease for ~30 s, the seam revokes the ACE, the deny and the label. Long commands and background jobs keep their access until they exit. Leases left by a crashed runner name a dead pid and are discarded. The next confined command grants again, and it checks the root first, so a grant removed from outside is repaired.
- **Out of process.** Grant and revoke run in a small helper process that the seam awaits. On a checkout with ~133k entries (`node_modules` included) one propagation takes 14–25 s, which should not sit on the Harness event loop.
- **Exact revoke.** `SetEntriesInAclW` with `REVOKE_ACCESS` never removes the deny, and removing a whole trustee would also remove the user's own entries. Instead, copy the DACL minus exactly the explicit entries the grant wrote, and clear the label in the same `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` call. While another capability grant is still on the folder, keep the deny and the label. The user's own entries (including their own `Everyone` entries) are left untouched.
- **Cleanup.** On start, clean registered workspaces that a crash or an older version left marked: one read per workspace, and a write only where a mark is found. Also offer a "clean this folder" action. When the chosen folder only inherits the marks, clean the ancestor that carries them. Refuse while a runner holds a lease there.

The cost is one re-propagation per idle period on large trees. That is far better than a project whose own programs stop working for every other tool.

This has now been reported in several threads over a week without a maintainer response. Could someone working on the Windows sandbox take a look?

---

**中文**

DSH 只要以 `workspace-write` 写过一个文件夹，它的根目录上就会永久留下三项改动：能力 SID 授权、`Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)` 拒绝项，以及 Low 完整性标签 `(OI)(CI)(NW)`。会话结束、DSH 退出后依然存在。README 写明这是有意为之：授权作为复用缓存，从不撤销。

**为什么严重**

很多人写代码不只用一个工具：同一个项目，DSH 改完，再交给 Codex、Claude Code、IDE 或普通终端。这个标签会被树里每个文件继承。于是 DSH 用过一次之后，不管哪个工具从这个项目里启动东西，得到的都是低完整性进程或者被拒绝，而且没有任何提示指向 DSH：

- #7709：项目里的 Electron/Chromium 程序一启动就以 `0x80000003` 退出，没有输出也没有日志
- #8175：msbuild、dotnet、npm 等构建工具拒绝或警告这些文件，看起来像「来自 Internet 区域」，实际上并没有 `Zone.Identifier`
- #7735：双击项目里的 `.bat`/`.cmd`/`.exe` 每次都弹「无法验证发布者」
- #8048：标签可能落到 DSH 桌面端自己的安装目录上，之后 Harness 起不来

用户往往要花几个小时去查 Electron、杀毒软件或 Internet 区域。目前唯一的恢复办法是手工改 ACL，而 `icacls` 删不掉这些条目（README 也写了，错误 1332）。

0.2.0-rc.1 到 rc.2 之间，`sandbox-windows-acl`（`acl.ts`、`grant.ts`）和 `sandbox-local` 没有任何改动；新的诊断技能会报告 `LOW_LABEL`，但不会去掉它。

**希望官方做的**

1. 沙箱用完这个文件夹就收回授权，不要当缓存留着。
2. 提供官方办法，清理已经被打上标记的文件夹。
3. 在那之前，在已知限制里写明：DSH 写过的文件夹里启动的程序会以低完整性运行。

**一个可行的做法**

我们基于现有的 `sandbox-windows-acl` / `sandbox-local` 代码实现了下面这套，并在真实 ACL 上测过：

- **租约**：runner 运行期间持有一个租约文件（`<pid>`，放在按工作区 SID 命名的目录里）。工作区约 30 秒没有活的租约，就撤掉授权、拒绝项和标签。长命令和后台任务在退出前一直保有权限；崩溃留下的租约对应的是已不存在的 pid，会被丢弃。下一条受限命令会先检查根目录再重新授予，所以被外部撤掉的授权也能补回来。
- **放到进程外**：授予和收回交给一个小的辅助进程，seam 等它完成。约 13.3 万条目的仓库（含 `node_modules`）传播一次要 14–25 秒，不该压在 Harness 的事件循环上。
- **精确撤销**：`SetEntriesInAclW` 的 `REVOKE_ACCESS` 删不掉 deny，按整个 trustee 删又会带走用户自己的条目。改为复制 DACL，只去掉授权当初写下的那几条显式条目，并在同一次 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 调用里清掉标签。文件夹上还有其他能力授权时，保留拒绝项和标签。用户自己的条目（包括他们自己的 Everyone 条目）原样保留。
- **清理**：启动时清理崩溃或旧版本遗留标记的已登记工作区，每个只读一次，发现标记才写。另外提供「清理这个文件夹」的操作：选中的文件夹只是继承了标记时，就去清真正带标记的上层；那里有 runner 持有租约时先不动。

代价是大仓库每个空闲周期后要重新传播一次。对每一个别的工具来说，这都远好过项目里自己的程序起不来。

这个问题已经在好几个帖子里报告了一周，一直没有维护者回应。能否请负责 Windows 沙箱方向的同学看一下？

discussions.title: Windows 桌面版：受限模式（workspace-write）下 pwsh 工具必然失败 0xC0000142；同一版本经 npx 启动的 Web UI 正常
discussions.body:
## 环境

- DSH 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（Electron），Windows 10 22H2（10.0.19045，x64）
- 对照组：**同一台机器、同一 dsh 版本**，用 `npx` 启动的 Web UI

## 现象

- **桌面版**：会话文件策略为受限模式时，`pwsh` 工具的任何调用都返回 `exit code 3221225794`（`0xC0000142`，STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED），连最简单的 `echo` 也一样。切到 `danger-full-access` 后，同一条命令立刻正常。
- **Web UI**：同样是受限模式，`pwsh` 完全正常（可用子进程的 `TEMP` 被改写为 `<temp>\dsh-<hash>` 私有目录，确认沙盒确实在生效）。

## 两种启动方式的差异（定位到的关键）

| | 宿主可执行文件 | `process.execPath` |
|---|---|---|
| Web UI（`npx` 启动） | 真正的 `node.exe` | 指向 node |
| 桌面版 | 应用自带的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`，以 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 运行（宿主环境变量里可直接看到） | **Electron 二进制本身** |

## 问题出在哪

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` 构造 runner 前缀时用的是：

```js
[process.execPath, <@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 的 runner 入口>]
```

于是：

- Web UI 下 runner 宿主 = node → 受限执行链正常；
- 桌面版下 runner 宿主 = Electron 二进制（等于再套一层 Electron-as-node）→ **这一层起不来**，整条受限执行链失效，工具层把 runner 的启动失败报成了上面的 `0xC0000142`。

旁证：桌面版进程列表里能看到**活的** `dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner.js` 子进程（说明「Electron 二进制当 Node 子进程」本身并非一律不可行），但**看不到 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js` 进程**。

## 最小复现

**1. Electron 二进制当 Node 用时的子进程行为**

在 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 下用 Electron 二进制跑一个脚本：

- `spawnSync('cmd.exe', ['/c', 'echo hi'])` → `status=0`，正常返回；
- 紧接着 `spawnSync('<PowerShell 7 安装目录>\\pwsh.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-c', 'Write-Output ok'])` → **整个进程静默消失**（无输出、无退出码）。同步 `spawnSync` 与异步 `spawn` 表现一致。

**2. 完全照生产写法启动沙盒 runner**

```
<process.execPath> <...>/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js \
  --workspace <tmp> --temp <tmp> --mode read-only -- cmd /c exit 0
```

- 宿主 = `node.exe`：受限 `cmd`、受限 `pwsh`（7.6.6）、受限 `powershell.exe`（5.1）**全部 status=0**；
- 宿主 = Electron 二进制（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`）：**第一步进程就消失**，日志断在第一个受限子进程之前。

## 已排除

pwsh 的来源与版本（商店 MSIX 与官方 MSI 都试过，且在真 node 宿主下受限运行正常）、ACL 与文件权限、受限令牌与 SID、低完整性标签、`SystemRoot` 缺失、宿主提权（UAC 已关闭）、工作区路径、`cmd.exe` 与 Windows PowerShell 5.1。

## 建议

沙盒 runner 不要以 `process.execPath` 作为宿主：桌面版应改用真正的 Node 解释器（随包内置，或按需解析一个可用的 node），或者在 `process.execPath` 指向 Electron 二进制时另行选择 node 来启动 runner。

discussions.title: [BugReport] [Windows] sandbox-windows-acl 的工作区 grant 会在授予期间给指向 pnpm store 的硬链接打上 Low 完整性标签，使该 store 里的可执行文件以 Low 完整性运行
discussions.body:
# 碳基话:

在从0.2-rc1升级到0.2-rc2时发现发现eslint一直在报错, 无法移除temp下的临时目录. 而我因为写插件图方便将harness源码目录导入进了harness. 导致无法升级,
因为之前的sanbox问题我手动改过完全访问权限, 我以为这个问题, 遂还原无用. 使用其他agent排查老半天终于解决了. 方案简单来说就是给完整性标签全部覆盖回去.


# 硅基话:


## 摘要

在 Windows 上以 `workspace-write` 模式执行受限命令时，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 会向工作区根写入三条常驻的安全描述符改动，其中一条是**可继承（`OI|CI`）的 Low 完整性标签**（`S-1-16-4096` + `NO_WRITE_UP`）。`SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 会立即把可继承 ACE 整树传播，因此该标签也会落在 `node_modules` 内**指向 pnpm 内容寻址 store 的硬链接**上；NTFS 硬链接共享同一个安全描述符，标签于是被写到 **store 的共享文件对象**上并在那里**常驻**。

此后从该 store 硬链出来的可执行文件（`esbuild.exe`、`lefthook.exe` …）会带上 Low 标签。按 Windows 强制完整性规则，进程以 `min(用户完整性, 镜像文件完整性)` 创建，因此这些程序以 **Low 完整性进程**运行，无法删除 Medium 完整性的临时文件/钩子文件，于是 `vite build`、`pnpm install` 等**与 DSH 无关**的流程持续失败，且官方自带的 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 技能**按设计无法移除完整性标签**。

**当前状态（重要）**：报告人机器上的故障**已通过手工清理消失**，本文投稿时**无法再复现**该故障；但机制链条的每一环都已在源码、仓库自带测试、官方文档与本机实测中得到独立确认（见「证据」与附录）。

---

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 11 (10.0.22631) |
| Node | v22.23.2 |
| pnpm | 11.7.0 |
| pnpm store | `D:\.pnpm-store\v11`（与工程同卷，`packageImportMethod` 为默认 hardlink） |
| 仓库 | `D:\work\DS-Harness\deepseek-harness` |
| 被 grant 的工作区根 | `D:\work\DS-Harness`（仓库位于其子目录内） |
| DSH 版本 | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| commit | `639ed015397290b3745d163aafe02ffee4aa3f84` |

---

## 现象

1. `pnpm run build` 在 `apps/web` 的 `vite build` 阶段失败：

   ```
   [vite:esbuild-transpile] remove C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\esbuild-<hex>: Access is denied.
   ```

   每次构建在 `%TEMP%` 留下一个约 1.5 MB 的 `esbuild-<hex>` 残留文件。

2. `pnpm install` 的根 `postinstall` 失败：

   ```
   [install-lefthook] ... lefthook.cmd install --force failed:
   Error: could not replace the hook: remove ...\.git\dsh-hooks\pre-commit: Access is denied.
   ```

3. 两者是**同一类**故障：一个以 Low 完整性运行的可执行文件（esbuild / lefthook）删不掉 Medium 完整性的文件。

---

## 最小复现

1. 准备 Windows + pnpm 工程，pnpm store 与工程在**同一卷**（hardlink 生效）。
2. 以 `workspace-write` 模式、工作区根设为该工程（或含该工程的父目录）执行**一次**受限命令，使 `AclSandbox` provision 工作区 grant。
3. 之后任何时刻：

   ```powershell
   # 应在 node_modules 的 hardlink 上看到 Low 标签
   icacls <root>\node_modules\.pnpm\@esbuild+win32-x64@<ver>\node_modules\@esbuild\win32-x64\esbuild.exe

   # 证明它是 store 文件的硬链接
   fsutil hardlink list <上面的 esbuild.exe>

   # store 里的原始对象同样是 Low
   icacls D:\.pnpm-store\v11\files\<bucket>\<hash>-exec
   ```

4. 对 >1 MB 输入调用 esbuild transform（等价于 Vite 对大 chunk 的 `vite:esbuild-transpile`）即稳定失败：

   ```js
   import esbuild from '<repo>/node_modules/.pnpm/esbuild@<ver>/node_modules/esbuild/lib/main.js'
   let src = ''
   for (let i = 0; src.length < 1_500_000; i++) src += `export const x${i} = ${i}\n`
   await esbuild.transform(src, { loader: 'js', minify: true, target: 'es2022', sourcemap: true, format: 'esm' })
   // → remove C:\Users\<user>\...\Temp\esbuild-<hex>: Access is denied.
   ```

> 复现前提：**必须是"标签仍在"的状态**。一旦标签被清除（见「规避与恢复」），第 4 步会成功且 `%TEMP%` 无残留——这正是本文投稿时的状态。

---

## 根因

### 1. grant 写入三条改动，其中第三条是可继承的 Low 标签（已确认）

`workspace-write` 的 grant 在**一次** `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 调用里应用三条改动（`src/acl.ts`）：

1. 能力 SID 允许项 `S-1-4-x-y:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)`；
2. world 的 `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` 拒绝项 `Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)`（仅容器继承）；
3. **Low 完整性标签 `S-1-16-4096` + `SYSTEM_MANDATORY_LABEL_NO_WRITE_UP` + `(OI|CI)`**。

第 3 条可继承，会**整树传播**（README 自述 "eager full-tree propagation"）。

### 2. 硬链接让标签落到树外的共享文件对象（已确认）

工作区树的 `node_modules` 含大量指向 `D:\.pnpm-store` 的**硬链接**。NTFS 硬链接的两个名字指向**同一个文件对象、共享同一个安全描述符**，所以对链接路径设置安全描述符等于对 store 里的原对象设置。仓库**自带测试**已把这一行为钉死（`tests/runner.spec.ts`，用例名 "partial boundary: a workspace hard link lets the grant reach an external file object"），其注释也写明 "pnpm workspaces commonly contain hard links, so rejecting every multiply-linked file is not a viable profile"。

结果：Low 标签被写到 store 的共享文件对象上（带继承标记 `(I)`）；store 目录自身没有标签，排除了"从 store 目录继承"的可能。

### 3. 进程按 `min(用户, 镜像)` 取得完整性（官方依据）

> "When a user attempts to launch an executable file, the new process is created with the minimum of the user integrity level and the file integrity level."
> —— Microsoft, [Mandatory Integrity Control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/secauthz/mandatory-integrity-control)

因此带 Low 标签的 `esbuild.exe` / `lefthook.exe` 被普通（Medium）用户启动时，进程实际以 **Low 完整性**运行。`NO_WRITE_UP` 不允许它写入/删除 Medium 对象。

### 4. esbuild 的具体失败路径（机制推断，行号已更正）

`esbuild` 的临时文件是 **Node 父进程以 Medium 完整性创建**的（`lib/main.js` 中 `randomFileName()` = `<tmpdir>/esbuild-<hex>`），而执行清理的服务端是那个 Low 完整性的 `esbuild.exe`；删除 Medium 文件触发 `NO_WRITE_UP` 拒绝，服务端报 `remove <path>: Access is denied.`。

注意：**Node 侧的删除是静默失败的**（`lib/main.js` 的 `fsSync.readFile` 对 `unlinkSync` 用了空 catch），因此能在用户面前冒出来的只有服务端那条错误，行号请勿再引 `lib/main.js:774`（该行在 0.28.1 里是 entryPoints 解析）。残留文件恰好约等于输入体积（≈1.5 MB），与"父进程写入成功、子进程删除失败"一致。

---

## 证据

### 已独立确认（本机实测）

| # | 证据 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| E1 | `icacls "<workspace-root>"` 曾出现 `S-1-4-<sid>:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)`、`Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)`、`Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)` | 与 grant 的三条改动逐一对应 |
| E2 | 用仓库算法对**同一路径**现算，得到的 SID 与工作区 ACL 里那条**精确一致** | **精确命中**，排除巧合。算法：`sha256(path)` 前 8 字节，每 4 字节 LE 取 `% 2^30-1` 再 `+1`（`src/workspace-sid.ts`）。该值随路径变化，不随机器/用户变化 |
| E3 | `fsutil hardlink list` 显示 `esbuild.exe` → `\.pnpm-store\v11\files\c0\ea92…-exec`；`lefthook.exe` → `\.pnpm-store\v11\files\b3\1d74…-exec` | 坐实"工作区内的可执行文件就是 store 的硬链接" |
| E4 | store 抽样 40 个 `*-exec`：**Low=0/40 且全部为显式 Medium**；store 目录本身也是 Medium | 这是**清理后**的状态，证明污染可以被移除（也说明当初 `(I)Low` 不是继承自 store 目录） |
| E5 | 无 DSH 限制下跑最小复现第 4 步：`transform: OK, code bytes = 1275374`，`%TEMP%` 残留 **0** | 说明故障与标签状态强相关：标签在 = 失败，标签除 = 成功 |
| E6 | 对照：Medium token 在 `%TEMP%` 写→读→删 1.5 MB × 多次全部成功；提权后实测 Medium 进程可删除 Low 标签文件（`ok=True`） | 排除"通用文件锁"，并确认强制策略**只禁向上写**，不禁止向下写 |
| E7 | esbuild / lefthook 的 Windows 二进制确在 store 内（`@esbuild+win32-x64@0.28.1`、`lefthook-windows-x64@2.1.9`） | 前提成立 |

### 未能复现（诚实声明）

- 故障态下"exe → 子进程降为 Low"的**直接进程观测**（`GetTokenInformation(TokenIntegrityLevel)` 打在那个 esbuild 子进程上）没有取到：标签清除后才具备完整命令能力。E2/E3 与官方规则、仓库测试共同支撑该推断。
- 投稿时 `pnpm run build` 已恢复正常，无法再给出失败日志的实时复现。

---

## 影响

- **机器级、跨项目、持久**：一旦 store 被污染，本机所有使用该 store 的 pnpm 工程都受影响；而 `dispose()` 对工作区 grant 是 standing，**永不撤销**，官方诊断技能又明确**保留完整性标签**（README 的 Known Limitations 自述 "Diagnosis preserves integrity labels — it cannot fix Low-labeled executables affecting programs launched outside DSH"）。
- **症状与病因距离极远**：用户看到的是构建工具/依赖安装报错，几乎不可能归因到 DSH 沙箱。
- **触发门槛低**：pnpm + 同卷 store + 任一次受限命令。

---

## ⚠️ 附带的独立缺陷：清理之后，DSH 再也无法授权（本机复现）

这是报告人在自救过程中踩到的**二级故障**，请一并处理。

执行 `icacls <workspace-root> /reset /T /C /Q` 之后，工作区根的 DACL 只剩从卷根继承的条目（原始输出）：

```
<workspace-root> BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
                 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
                 NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)   ← 只有 Modify
                 BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX)
                 Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)
```

当前用户**没有任何显式 ACE**，而 `Authenticated Users:(M)` **不含 `WRITE_OWNER`**。实测 `CreateFileW(WRITE_DAC | WRITE_OWNER)`：工作区根 **DENIED win32=5**、`D:\.pnpm-store` **DENIED**（对照：仓库子目录与 `%TEMP%` 均为 OK）。

而 `grantWrite` **要求调用者拥有 `WRITE_OWNER`**（标签在 SACL；owner 的隐式权利只覆盖 `READ_CONTROL` 与 `WRITE_DAC` —— 见 `src/acl.ts` 的 JSDoc）。于是此后**每一条受限命令**都在 provision 阶段失败：

```
SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace-root>)
```

DSH 的 sandbox 是 fail-closed，因此**命令根本不执行**（连 `Write-Output "ping"` 也一样），该会话里只剩下不经过沙箱的文件读写工具可用。这与"再跑一次受限命令只是让 grant 重新写入"完全不同。

**可自救的修复**（用户此时仍持有 `WRITE_DAC`，无需提权）：

```powershell
icacls "<workspace-root>" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(OI)(CI)F"
```

**请一并澄清的文档事实**：`icacls /reset` **不会**清除 Low 标签——标签在 SACL，`/reset` 只重建 DACL。真正移除标签的是 `icacls <path> /setintegritylevel Medium`，而它需要 `WRITE_OWNER`，普通权限下会 `Access is denied`（本机实测 exit=5），必须提权执行。

---

## 期望行为

- 沙箱**不得**在**工作区之外**的对象（尤其是跨项目共享的内容寻址 store 文件）上写入**持久**的安全描述符改动；
- 传播前应探测**指向树外的多链接（硬链接）对象**，命中时 **fail-closed** 或降级，而不是污染外部共享对象；
- 必须提供**受支持的撤销/清理路径**，并让诊断技能能够移除 standing grant 与其标签；
- 当工作区根缺少 `WRITE_OWNER` 时，应在**授权前**明确报出"工作区需要 FullControl 而非 Modify"，而不是让整个会话瘫痪；
- 文档需记录该具体症状与规避方式。

---

## 建议修复

1. **传播标签前检测硬链接**：用 `GetFileInformationByHandle` 的 `nNumberOfLinks` 找出多链接对象，并判定其**其它链接名是否在工作区内**；命中树外链接时拒绝或降级。README 目前以 "rejecting multiply-linked files is not viable for ordinary pnpm installations" 为由未处理——但"**拒绝**多链接文件"与"**探测并在命中树外链接时不施加可继承标签**"是两回事，后者正是本 issue 的触发条件。
2. **不要对文件施加可继承标签**。注意：仅"对目录打标签、文件不打"会带来**已知代价**——被限制的子进程将连工作区内**已有**文件都无法删除，等于退回 ADR 关闭删除逃逸之前的状态。因此该方向应表述为"对含树外硬链接的树不施加可继承标签"，或明确接受该代价并同步修改删除封闭性的承诺。
3. **增加 standing workspace grant 的真实撤销入口**（现有 `revokeWrite` 只覆盖可撤销的 temp 授权），并提供清理命令；Dev Note 目前把"回收改名工作区残留 ACE 的清理命令"列为 undecided。
4. **扩展 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl`**：使其能移除 standing 标签/ACE。当前该技能既不能移除标签，其自身文档也未提示这个盲区（只有包 README 的 Known Limitations 提到），用户按技能跑完不会被告知标签仍在。
5. **授权前做权限前置检查**：工作区根缺 `WRITE_OWNER` 时给出可执行的指引（例如提示执行上面的 `icacls /grant`），避免 fail-closed 变成"整个会话不可用"。
6. **降低默认影响或明确告知**：Windows 上默认不挂 ACL 后端，或首次使用时明确告知会**常驻修改安全描述符**。

---

## 规避与恢复

```powershell
# 1) 恢复工作区根的可授权状态（普通权限即可；注意不要再用 /reset）
icacls "<workspace-root>" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(OI)(CI)F"

# 2) 移除工作区树的 Low 标签（需要 WRITE_OWNER → 在【管理员】PowerShell 中执行）
icacls "<workspace-root>" /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)Medium" /T /C /Q

# 3) 恢复被污染的 pnpm store（需要 WRITE_OWNER → 管理员）
icacls "D:\.pnpm-store" /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)Medium" /T /C /Q

# 4) 复跑
node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
pnpm run build
```

**日常规避**：
- 运行 DSH 会话时使用 **完全权限 / `danger-full-access`**，绕开 Windows ACL 后端；
- 或强制 pnpm 复制而非硬链接：`$env:npm_config_package_import_method='copy'` 后重装。

> 注意：只要再跑一次 DSH 的**受限**命令，grant 会重新写入（exact-ACE 跳过只在三条改动都还在时生效，而第 1、2 步已经把两条 DACL 改动清掉了）。因此长期应使用**完全权限模式**。

---

## 相关代码与文档

- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/workspace-sid.ts`（SID 推导：`sha256` 前 8 字节）
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts`（三条改动的合并应用；`grantWrite`/`revokeWrite`；`WRITE_OWNER` 要求见其 JSDoc）
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/token.ts`（`restrictTokenIntegrity`：把受限 token 降到 Low）
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/grant.ts`、`src/index.ts`（workspace grant 为 standing、`dispose()` 不撤销）
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.md`（硬链接边界、standing 编辑、`Diagnosis preserves integrity labels`、eager full-tree propagation）
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts`（"a workspace hard link lets the grant reach an external file object"）
- `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-19-windows-acl-mandatory-integrity-confinement.md`（Low 标签与 token 降权的设计取舍）
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/assets/diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl/SKILL.md`（"never … erase a deny, or replace child permissions recursively"；以及 "A confined run of the script is never useful"）
- Microsoft, [Mandatory Integrity Control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/secauthz/mandatory-integrity-control)（进程完整性 = `min(用户, 镜像)`）

---


需要复现 E2 的读者：对**你自己的**工作区根运行附录第 1 节的脚本即可，SID 必然随路径不同而变化——关键是"ACL 里那条 SID == 按该算法算出的值"这一**一致性**，而非某个固定数值。



# 附录：Windows ACL / 硬链接 / 完整性标签 证据复现手册

配套 issue：[`issue-windows-acl-hardlink-store.md`](issue-windows-acl-hardlink-store.md)。
所有命令均为**只读**，除非明确标注「会改动」。

示位符约定：
- `<workspace-root>` = 报告人的工作区根（即仓库的父目录），下游只有一个 `pnpm` 工程；
- `<repo>` = `<workspace-root>` 内的仓库目录（含 `node_modules`）。

---

## 0. 环境对照

```powershell
(Get-Content '<repo>\package.json' | Select-String '"version"|packageManager')
Get-Content '<repo>\.git\refs\heads\master'
```

观测：

```
"version": "0.2.0-rc.2",
"packageManager": "pnpm@11.7.0",
639ed015397290b3745d163aafe02ffee4aa3f84
```

→ 与 issue 环境表一致（同 commit 也挂在 `refs/tags/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`）。

---

## 1. 工作区 SID 的独立复算（E2）

```powershell
$p = '<workspace-root>'   # 换成你自己的工作区根（注意：必须是 canonical 拼写）
$d = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($p))
$a = [BitConverter]::ToUInt32($d,0) % 1073741823 + 1
$b = [BitConverter]::ToUInt32($d,4) % 1073741823 + 1
"S-1-4-$a-$b"
```

观测（报告人机器）：

```
S-1-4-<sid>          # 该值由路径决定，随路径变化；此处不披露具体数值
```

→ 复算结果与 `icacls "<workspace-root>"` 输出里那条能力 SID **逐字一致**。算法等价于 `src/workspace-sid.ts`：`sha256(canonicalPath)` 前 8 字节，每 4 字节 LE 取 `% (2^30-1)` 后 `+1`。

**判据不是某个固定数值，而是一致性**：ACL 里出现的那条 `S-1-4-*` 必须等于按上式对工作区路径算出的值。读者换用自己的路径，数值必然不同。

---

## 2. store 硬链接关系（E3）

```powershell
$exe = '<repo>\node_modules\.pnpm\@esbuild+win32-x64@0.28.1\node_modules\@esbuild\win32-x64\esbuild.exe'
$lf  = '<repo>\node_modules\.pnpm\lefthook-windows-x64@2.1.9\node_modules\lefthook-windows-x64\bin\lefthook.exe'
fsutil hardlink list $exe
fsutil hardlink list $lf
```

观测（`<repo>` 段已替换）：

```
\.pnpm-store\v11\files\c0\ea922534539bbb08cf3f829b4905a7e92288b43e990b35e9807ac518e59ba2eb9920c64b328677c01e76dd0fffdcba1c0fd26a40f34767da0abd699e62a0d2-exec
\<repo>\node_modules\.pnpm\@esbuild+win32-x64@0.28.1\node_modules\@esbuild\win32-x64\esbuild.exe

\<repo>\node_modules\.pnpm\lefthook-windows-x64@2.1.9\node_modules\lefthook-windows-x64\bin\lefthook.exe
\.pnpm-store\v11\files\b3\1d74ece35dcda441d2f6b51e556274a399cade4bd897f6f5b24a9e459262c1241eca4dd06976669d3bc512ea4439291f23fb8f9610a30e791efec3d18eee98-exec
```

→ 两个可执行文件都是 store 的硬链接（同一文件对象的两个名字）。这里的 `<repo>` 位于 `<workspace-root>` **之内**，而 store 位于其**之外**——正是本 issue 的前提：grant 沿树传播时会顺着硬链接摸到树外的共享对象。

---

## 3. 标签现状（清理后，E4）

```powershell
# store 目录自身
icacls 'D:\.pnpm-store' | Select-String 'Mandatory Label'

# store 内 *-exec 抽样：Low 数量
$all = Get-ChildItem 'D:\.pnpm-store\v11\files' -Recurse -File -Filter '*-exec' | Select-Object -First 40
$low = 0; $tot = 0
foreach ($e in $all) { $tot++; if (icacls $e.FullName 2>&1 | Select-String 'Low Mandatory Level') { $low++ } }
"low=$low total=$tot"
```

观测：

```
Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)
low=0 total=40
```

单个样本（`icacls <store 文件>`）：

```
Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level:(I)(NW)
```

→ 投稿时 store **没有** Low 标签。这是**清理后**的状态；它同时说明该标签可以被移除，且 `(I)` 继承标记对应的传播源不可能是 store 目录（store 目录自己的标签不带 Low）。

---

## 4. 工作区根的 DACL 与标签（原始输出）

```powershell
icacls '<workspace-root>'
```

观测（`/reset` 之后；仅首行路径被替换）：

```
<workspace-root> BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
                 BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(F)
                 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
                 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(F)
                 NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)
                 NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(M)
                 BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX)
                 BUILTIN\Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(GR,GE)
                 Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)
```

关键点：
- **报告人账号没有任何显式 ACE**，只剩从卷根继承的条目（全部带 `(I)`）。
- `Authenticated Users:(I)(M)` 只给 **Modify**，**不含 `WRITE_OWNER`**。
- 标签是无 `(I)` 的**显式** Medium，带 `(OI)(CI)` —— 与 `icacls <path> /setintegritylevel` 的写法一致。

对照：store 内的 `esbuild.exe`（同一个硬链接对象）：

```
BUILTIN\Users:(I)(F)
BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)
Mandatory Label\Medium Mandatory Level:(I)(NW)
```

---

## 5. `WRITE_DAC | WRITE_OWNER` 有效权限探测（本 issue 的二级故障）

```powershell
Add-Type -Namespace A -Name P -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError=true)]
public static extern IntPtr CreateFileW(string path, uint access, uint share, IntPtr sec, uint disp, uint flags, IntPtr tmpl);
public static string Probe(string path) {
  IntPtr h = CreateFileW(path, 0x00040000 | 0x00080000, 7, IntPtr.Zero, 3, 0x02000000, IntPtr.Zero);
  if (h == new IntPtr(-1)) return "DENIED win32=" + Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
  return "OK";
}
'@
foreach ($p in @('<workspace-root>','<repo>','<workspace-root>\.acl-reports','D:\.pnpm-store',"$env:TEMP")) {
  "{0,-18} {1}" -f [A.P]::Probe($p), $p
}
```

观测：

```
DENIED win32=5      <workspace-root>        ← 工作区根：缺 WRITE_OWNER
OK                  <repo>
DENIED win32=5      <workspace-root>\.acl-reports
DENIED win32=5      D:\.pnpm-store
OK                  C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp
```

win32=5 即 `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`。`grantWrite` 的标签写入需要 `WRITE_OWNER`，因此工作区根上 provision 必然失败：

```
SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace-root>)
```

（DSH 是 fail-closed，报此错时**命令不会执行**。）

---

## 6. `icacls /setintegritylevel` 的权限要求（会改动，仅新建的临时目录）

```powershell
$t = Join-Path '<workspace-root>' '.acl-final'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $t | Out-Null
icacls $t /setintegritylevel Low          # 观测 exit=5 / Access is denied（缺 WRITE_OWNER）
cmd /c rmdir /s /q "$t"                    # 清理
```

观测：

```
setintegritylevel exit=5  Successfully processed 0 files; Failed processing 1 files | ...\.acl-final: Access is denied.
```

在**提权**会话中同一操作 `exit=0`，并得到：

```
Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(NW)
```

→ 说明：设置/移除完整性标签需要 `WRITE_OWNER`；普通权限的工作区（只有 Modify）无法完成"清除标签"这一步，必须提权。

---

## 7. 完整性策略的语义对照（提权，仅在 `%TEMP%` 新建的子目录内）

在一个**全新 `%TEMP%` 子目录**里执行（脚本结束即删除）：

| 步骤 | 观测 |
|---|---|
| 给文件打 Low 标签 | `Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(NW)` |
| **Medium 进程删除该 Low 文件** | `ok=True`（删除成功） |
| 在 Low 目录内创建文件 | `ok=True`，新文件标签为 `Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(I)(NW)` |
| **Medium 进程删除该文件** | `ok=True` |

→ 强制完整性策略**只禁止向上写**（Low → Medium 被拒），**不禁止向下写**（Medium → Low 允许）。这正是"Low 进程删不掉 Medium 临时文件"与"用户自己能清理 Low 对象"能同时成立的原因。

---

## 8. esbuild 复现脚本（标签清除后：应当成功）

```js
// verify-esbuild.cjs —— <repo> 换成你自己的仓库路径
const os = require('node:os'); const fs = require('node:fs')
const esbuild = require('<repo>/node_modules/.pnpm/esbuild@0.28.1/node_modules/esbuild/lib/main.js')
;(async () => {
  let src = ''
  for (let i = 0; src.length < 1_500_000; i++) src += `export const x${i} = ${i}\n`
  try {
    const out = await esbuild.transform(src, { loader: 'js', minify: true, target: 'es2022', sourcemap: true, format: 'esm' })
    console.log('transform: OK, code bytes =', out.code.length)
  } catch (e) { console.log('transform: FAILED ->', e.message) }
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500))
  console.log('esbuild-* residue in temp:', fs.readdirSync(os.tmpdir()).filter(n => n.startsWith('esbuild-')).length)
})()
```

观测（**标签已清除**的状态）：

```
tempdir       : C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp
input bytes   : 1500000
transform     : OK, code bytes = 1275374
esbuild-* residue in temp now: 0 (new this run: 0)
```

→ 与 issue 中"标签在 = `remove … Access is denied.` + 约 1.5 MB 残留"形成对照；也说明故障与标签状态强相关。

---

## 9. 关于 `.acl-reports\acl-report-*.jsonl`（既有诊断报告，请勿据此归因）

工作区里存在一份由 `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` 生成的报告。其调用者 token 记录为：

```json
{"kind":"observation","operation":"caller","status":"read","details":{"integrity":"S-1-16-4096 (Low)", "...":"..."}}
```

随后对 `C:\Users\<user>`（`(OI)(CI)(F)`）等路径全部判定：

```json
{"writeDac":false,"writeOwner":false}
```

并以 `PRECONDITION` 结束、`"fixed":0`、`"status":"skipped","reason":"No mutation mode was requested; all reported ACLs were left unchanged."`

**这是受限会话里的假警报**：脚本自己就是 Low 完整性 token，当然读不到 Medium 对象的 `WRITE_DAC`/`WRITE_OWNER`。SKILL.md 本身要求 "Run it unconfined… A confined run of the script is never useful"。此报告为**只读 + skipped，未对 ACL 做任何改动**——可据此排除"诊断技能改坏了 ACL"。

---

## 10. 本次核验产生的临时文件

全部位于 `<workspace-root>` 顶层，均可删除：

- `.acl-verify*` / `.acl-final` / `.acl-snap` / `.acl-verify2/3/4`（测试目录，已逐个清理）
- `.acl-verify-esbuild.cjs`（第 8 节脚本，已删除）
- `acl-verify-elevated.ps1` + `.log`（提权测试，已删除）

未改动 pnpm store 内容、未改动任何既有对象的安全描述符。

discussions.title: ACP tool_call updates carry no kind/location/diff — clients render every tool as a generic card
discussions.body:
## Summary

The ACP adapter sends every `tool_call` with `kind: "other"` and only plain-text result content, so ACP clients cannot tell a shell run from a file edit. In Paseo (and any client that renders `kind`-aware details) all DSH tool calls collapse into a generic "Other — <tool name>" card: the command line and its output are hidden, and `edit`/`write` produce no diff view.

## Details

`toolCallUpdate` in `packages/acp/acp/src/updates.ts` emits a fixed `kind: 'other'` with `rawInput` only, and `toolResultUpdate` forwards just the model-facing text blocks. Meanwhile the tools already carry exactly the presentation data clients need:

- `tool/result` events persist tool-private `meta` — `dsh-tool-fs` puts real hunk diffs there (`meta.diffs = [{path, oldText, newText}]`, the same payload its own `presentResult` consumes).
- Call arguments already expose `file_path` / `path` (locations) and `old_string` / `new_string` / `content` (a call-time diff preview).

So the fix is projection, not new data:

| tool | kind | extra |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bash`, `pwsh` | `execute` | command via `rawInput` |
| `read`, `read_image` | `read` | `locations` from `file_path` |
| `edit`, `write` | `edit` | `locations` + call-time `diff` content from args; result-time `meta.diffs` replace it |
| `grep`, `glob`, `web_search` | `search` | `locations` |
| `web_fetch` | `fetch` | — |
| anything else / plugins | `other` | unchanged |

Result handling picks `meta.diffs` first (falling back to the call-time preview for e.g. `write` on a new file, which reports `diffs: []`), keeps plain text for everything else, and surfaces failure text as `rawOutput.message` so clients can show the real error.

## Working implementation

I run this daily through Paseo. The patch lives on our fork, on top of `rel/dsh-0.1.7-rc.2`:

- Branch: `apple-ouyang/deepseek-harness` [`feat/acp-provider-subagents-0.1.7`](https://github.com/apple-ouyang/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/acp-provider-subagents-0.1.7), commit `be8a4b6d42` ("feat(acp): project tool kind, locations, and diffs onto tool updates")
- Files: `packages/acp/acp/src/updates.ts` (kind map, locations, arg/meta diff projection, error text), `src/session.ts` (call-time diffs remembered per `callId` and reused as the result fallback, including on `session/load` replay), `tests/updates.spec.ts` (kind/location/diff projection cases)

Verified end-to-end: replaying a real session through the patched adapter emits `kind: "execute"` + text output for bash, `kind: "edit"` + `diff` content for edit/write, `read`/`search`/`fetch` with locations — and the client renders command lines and file diffs correctly.

If the direction is acceptable I'm happy to open it as a PR, or restructure around `presentCall`/`presentResult` if you'd rather have each tool own its projection (the name map is the minimal version of that — the durable log only carries the tool name).

discussions.title: open-in-app 拉起外部编辑器失败：宿主继承的 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 使 Code.exe 退化为 Node 模式
discussions.body:
**现象**
Web UI 点 Open In → VS Code，弹"打开失败，请重试"。

**根因**
1. 宿主进程的环境里带有 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 时（例如宿主由 VS Code 扩展宿主 / Claude Code 的 shell 启动，该变量被继承进来）；
2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app` 的 `launchDetachedApp` 以 `{ ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env }` 作为子进程环境拉起 `Code.exe`；
3. 而 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess` 的 `scrubbedParentEnv()`（如 `packages/subprocess/subprocess/src/index.ts`）只剔除凭据字样（*KEY*/*PASSWORD*/*SECRET*/*TOKEN*）与 `DSH_*` 前缀，放行了 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`；
4. `Code.exe` 带该变量启动时会以纯 Node 运行、立即退出，`launchDetachedApp` 据此判定启动失败。

**最小复现（Windows）**
1. 在带 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 的环境里启动宿主：`cmd /k dsh web`（例如在 VS Code 扩展的终端 / Claude Code shell 中执行）；
2. 同环境验证变量生效：`Code.exe --version` 输出的是 Node 版本而非 VS Code 版本；
3. Web UI → Open In → VS Code → "打开失败，请重试"。

**建议修复**
`scrubbedParentEnv()` 比照 `DSH_*` 一并剔除 `ELECTRON_*` 前缀：

    !key.toUpperCase().startsWith("DSH_") && !key.toUpperCase().startsWith("ELECTRON_")

`dsh-ptc-runtime-node` 在构造自身子进程环境时已显式删除 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`，可对齐。若担心影响面，也可只在 `launchDetachedApp` 内、与 `options.env` 合并之前剔除。GitHub Desktop 启动器不受影响——它是在 scrub 之后显式注入该变量的。

**临时绕过**
启动宿主前清掉变量（cmd：`set "ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE="`）即可恢复 Open In。

**环境**
Win11 26200 / dsh 0.2.0-rc.2（npm 全局安装）/ VS Code 1.139.1。宿主环境块实读确认 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 与 `CLAUDECODE=1` 等同时存在，继承链可完整追溯。

PS:本地已用一行补丁验证修复有效。

discussions.title: [RFC] 插件市场与dsh profile 设计
discussions.body:
> 本文只描述现在存在的问题与一个简单的接口来讨论解决方向，不要求官方必须采用。

## 1. 快速预览

官方桌面端的插件市场是生态里最权威可信的分发入口，但当前安装器把安装目标固定为正在运行的那个 profile，这意味着，对于必须自己实现profile才能获得预期功能的插件，他们将不被官方桌面端插件市场分发入口认可。

官方桌面端从市场安装时只能落进当前 profile 的设计在产品定位上确实是非常正确的，但 DeepSeek-Harness 采用多 profile 设计无疑是允许社区制作自建 profile 的插件。尽管考虑到多 profile 的插件管理可以轻易由第三方社区管理器实现，但是无法被用户量最大的官方桌面端的官方插件市场和官方插件管理器安装，对于那些必须拉起独立 profile 的插件是极大的打击。

本提案不是要求把desktop app变成一个多 profile 控制台软件，本提案请求补一个接口：让用户在安装时能看到并选择目标 profile —— 或是官方认为的任何更好的解决方案，目的是为那些在设计上必须拉起独立 profile 的插件提供官方桌面端插件市场的分发与下载可行性，从而避免这些插件被排挤出权威插件入口。

## 2. 背景与证据

### 2.1 现状：安装与管理都绑定"运行中的 profile"

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` 注入 `profileContext`，并把 `this.profile = ctx.profileContext` 作为所有操作的落点（`packages/boot/plugin-manager/src/index.ts:177,192,209`）；安装、移除、列举、开关都写 `this.profile.dir`（同一文件 `:281,303,478,536,543,666,716` 等）。就现有代码看，安装操作没有暴露"目标 profile"入参：一次安装必然落在当前宿主的 profile 上。官方桌面端只有一个 profile：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`（`apps/desktop/src/paths.ts:19`），并且由 Electron 独占（同文件 `:20` 的 lock；CLI 侧另有 `rejectElectronProfile` 明确拒绝第三方 CLI 触碰它，`apps/cli/src/args.ts:83-87`）。

### 2.2 需要独立组合的插件，在市场上没有"归属"

有些插件天生不适合与宿主共用一份组合：

- 它们要改变整个宿主的安全与运行策略，比如沙箱模式、审批策略、会话存储根、模型适配默认值等，而不是只增加一个贡献点；
- 这类取值本来就随界面形态分叉 —— 终端形态与 GUI 形态对沙箱、审批、会话存储的期望不同）；
- 它们的组合层会**按 bundle 层序覆盖**宿主的行：profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 是一个有序数组，新选中的 bundle 追加在末尾，后应用的 patch 按 id 覆盖先前的（`plugin-manager` 的 `selectBundle`；`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts` 的加载顺序）。以社区中一个终端前端插件为例，它的 bundle patch 会覆盖宿主未被官方 web bundle 覆盖的 8 行（`system-prompt` / `llm-deepseek` / `agent-loop` / `session-telemetry-otel` / `plugin-package-inventory-deepseek` / `sandbox-policy` / `approval` / `session-persistence-jsonl`）——影响面是**整个宿主**。

于是从官方市场安装这类插件，只剩三种结果：

1. 装进去不生效：它住进了不属于自己形态的 profile，用户以为装了，实际那个 profile 不是它该运行的宿主形态；
2. 让宿主为它让步：为了能在当前 profile 里工作，它必须覆盖宿主的组合（上一条的 8 行），宿主的安全/存储/模型配置被改写；
3. 被挤出权威入口：插件只能自建通道（自带 bootstrap，在 npm 侧自己跑 `dsh plugin --profile X add`），而官方安装器出于安全考虑不执行插件脚本，用户被推向手敲 CLI 或手改 `profiles/*/package.json`。对于相当多的用户，会认为未被收录于官方插件市场的插件是不被官方认可的。

### 2.3 反证：跨 profile 安装的能力**已经存在**

- `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg>` 就是跨 profile 安装：目标 profile 不存在时由 `initProfile` 初始化（`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts:40`：`PROFILE_TEMPLATES[profile]?.bundles ?? DEFAULT_PROFILE_BUNDLES`），随后正常走 pnpm。
- 也就是说，本提案**不要求任何新机制**：只是把这条已有能力从 CLI 暴露到市场/安装器，并给插件一个**声明**该需求的位置。

## 3. 目标 / 非目标

**目标**

1.  **根本目的：** 让 “需要独立profile的插件" 拥有一条从官方市场出发的安装路径；从而在社区的认知中和其他插件平等存在，而非现在这样，本质被排挤出了权威入口
2. **目前想到的解决方案：** 把 “装到哪个 profile" 的选择权交给用户或者社区插件开发者，以及提供可完全卸载的链路

**非目标**

- 不请求安装期执行插件脚本
- 不请求把 `desktop` profile 开放给第三方 CLI 或任意进程
- 不请求官方代为注册终端/全局命令
- 不要求官方必须采用本提案。

discussions.title: dsh-myskin：一个非侵入式、可逆的 DSH 皮肤插件
discussions.body:
为什么做这个？

DSH 目前还没有内置主题系统，但大家对个性化、皮肤、主题的需求其实挺真实的。
直接改源码、改配置、改进程也能实现，但升级容易坏，而且不可逆。
所以我想试试：能不能用插件的方式，做一层完全可逆的覆盖层？

dsh-myskin 是什么？

一个为 DSH 设计的皮肤插件。核心原则只有一条：不改 DSH 源码、不改配置、不碰进程。
所有视觉变化都通过客户端插件管线注入，关掉开关或点「还原默认」，立刻回到原生外观。

当前版本：v0.3.8
兼容：DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1
Web 和 Desktop 共用同一套客户端插件管线。

能做到什么？

简单说，就是让 DSH 不再千篇一律：

· 🖼️ 更换壁纸：背景换成你喜欢的图，不再只有默认那套
· 📌 贴上喜欢的图片：把中意的图放进界面里
· ✏️ 改掉千篇一律的文字：默认文案换成你自己的
· 🔤 换掉一板一眼的字体：字体也能按喜好来
· 🧲 随心挪动组件位置：布局不再固定，想怎么摆就怎么摆

而且这些都在插件层完成，不改源码、不改配置、不碰进程，关掉就还原。

主要特点

· 🎨 可视化自定义 + 实时预览：不用手写 CSS，改完立刻看到效果
· 🧩 皮肤管理设置页：切换、导入、管理都在 DSH 设置里完成
· 📦 .dshskin 皮肤包格式：方便分发、分享、安装
· ↩️ 完全可逆：皮肤只是一层覆盖，不影响核心功能，一键还原无残留
· 💻 跨端一致：Web / Desktop 共用管线，降低适配成本

安装

作为 DSH 插件安装，一般用 dsh plugin 加到 web profile，然后重启 DSH 就行。
具体步骤可以看仓库 README。

项目地址

https://github.com/WTStarMark/dsh-myskin

欢迎使用，提 issue、PR。十分感谢

discussions.title: 主对话完成后，仍在运行的后台子代理在 UI 上没有可见指示（0.2.0-rc.2）
discussions.body:
> 说明：初版误用了英文（这个仓库的讨论区惯例是中文），已改为中文；代码路径与 API 标识符保持原文。

在默认的 `continuable` 后台模式下，`subagent` 工具会立即返回 `{ kind: "continuable", subagentId }`，而子代理继续运行——**母轮可以在子代理结束之前就答完**。在这段窗口里，页面上没有任何地方表示"还有东西在跑"；唯一与子代理相关的控件是一个计数，所有子代理空闲和一个子代理正在运行时看起来一模一样。

## 复现

1. 让模型把任务委派给子代理（continuable，即默认模式），并让子代理明显跑得比母回答久——例如"起一个子代理，等 90 秒后写一个标记文件"。
2. 等母轮回答结束。此时回答已完成，但子代理仍在运行。
3. 在页面上找"还有东西在跑"的迹象。

## 期望

后台子代理仍在运行时，有**持续的、可见的**指示（会话头部控件呈现运行态，或对话流里一行"子代理仍在运行"），并且能点到那个正在运行的子会话。

## 实际

三处缺口叠在一起，单看每一处都不明显：

**1. 对话流里完全没有子代理的位置。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 不含任何子代理/后台相关渲染（它里面的 `running` 文案只属于 bash、terminal 这类工具卡）。子代理跑在自己的 session 里，父对话的 transcript 没有它的渲染位。

**2. 会话头部控件的可见性判定没把"运行中"算进去。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-subagent/lib/client.js`：

```js
const visible = presentedCatalog !== undefined &&
  (variant === "switcher" || presentedCatalog.state === "error" ||
   presentedCatalog.entries.length > 0);
if (!visible) return null;
```

`runningCount` 只用于 `aria-label` 和展开后的目录内容：

```js
const runningCount = directChildren.filter((e) => e.activity === "running").length;
// aria-label: t(runningCount > 0 ? runningCountKey : totalCountKey, ...)
```

所以有子代理时用户看到的只是一个**静态计数**；"正在运行"必须 hover 或点开目录、看那一列 14px 状态点才知道——而 `activity.running`、`count.running.one/other` 这些文案本来就是现成的。

**3. 还有一段"连计数都没有"的窗口。** 同一个条件要求 `presentedCatalog !== undefined`；目录投影尚未到达时该控件直接渲染 `null`。如果母轮正好在这段窗口里结束，页面对一个正在运行的子代理是**完全沉默**的。

**附带一点：** 正在运行的子代理还可能**不可达**。普通侧栏按设计不列子代理会话（入口就是这个头部目录），而那个入口只在 `listChildren` 已返回条目时才存在——目录投影未到或读失败时，一个正在运行的子代理既没有指示，也没有导航路径。

## 证据（均来自 0.2.0-rc.2 的实际产物，不是推测）

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js` —— continuable 分支的工具描述原文：*"It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles."*；结果 schema 分支 `{ kind: "continuable", subagentId }`。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-subagent/lib/client.js` —— 上面引用的 `visible` 判定与 `runningCount` 用法；该包 README 也写明 running "uses the shared ongoing loader" 是**在目录行内**，且 absent / empty-loading / loaded-empty 的目录都会隐藏计数触发器。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/types/list-children.js` —— 运行态本来就是现成可得的：`activity: sessions.get(entry.id) === undefined ? 'inactive' : 'running'`。所以这是**展示缺口**，不是事实缺失。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js` —— 无子代理/后台相关文案。

## 建议方向（任一条都能消掉这个缺口）

- 把 `runningCount > 0` 纳入头部控件的可见性判定，并让控件本身呈现运行态（而不是只在展开的目录里）。改动最小。
- 会话存在活动子代理时，在头部或对话流给出持续指示，并可点击直达子会话。
- 收到 `kind: "continuable"` 时就先渲染一个占位/指示，不必等目录投影——顺带消掉上面第 3 条窗口。

可复用文案已经存在：`activity.running`、`count.running.one/other`。

---

*在 0.2.0-rc.2（DSH 桌面端，web 组合）上观察。上面三处代码位置是读实际产物核实的；"页面上什么都没有"这一半仍值得一次带截图的复现来坐实——复现时请把子代理给足时间（几分钟），因为可观察窗口就等于子代理自己的运行时长。*

discussions.title: [Bug] Sessions from older releases can't be resumed or opened after upgrading (unknown preset `standard-tools`; v0 subagent descriptor v2 refused)
discussions.body:
Hi, and thanks for dsh. After upgrading a long-lived install from 0.1.5-rc.1 to 0.1.7-rc.2, many older Sessions can no longer be continued, and some subagent transcripts can't be opened at all. I traced both to their cause and checked that `master` (639ed01, 0.2.0-rc.2) still behaves the same. I know external pull requests aren't accepted; fixes with tests are on a fork in case they're useful.

Environment: Linux, npm install of `@deepseek-ai/dsh`, `dsh web` as a systemd service, 197 stored Sessions written by several releases since August.

## 1. A Session whose recorded preset no longer exists can't be resumed

100 of 129 top-level Sessions were created with a directory preset from `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/standard-tools`. 0.1.7 no longer reads that directory, so continuing any of them fails:

```
agent-preset/not-found: Unknown agent preset: standard-tools
details: { agentPreset: "standard-tools", available: ["standard", "ptc", "minimal", "cordis"] }
```

`session/create` with the existing `sessionId` and `cwd` reaches `createOrAdopt` → `composeAgent(storedPreset)` → `agentPresets.resolve("standard-tools")`, which throws. Switching the Session to another preset isn't possible either, because `select` refuses once the Session has started (`agent-preset/locked`). Reading the transcript still works. The 0.1.7-rc.2 upgrade guide doesn't mention that directory presets stopped loading.

**Reproduce:** create a Session under preset `X` and send one message; remove the `X` definition; restart; call `session/create` with that `sessionId` and its `cwd`.

**Proposed change** (one commit on a fork, [diff against master](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...MovieMaker93:deepseek-harness:feat/preset-aliases)): an explicit `aliases` map on `agent-preset-registry`, so a deployment can say which declared preset a retired ID resolves to:

```yaml
- id: agent-preset-registry
  config:
    default: standard
    aliases:
      standard-tools: standard
```

- `resolve`, `mount`/`retain` and `read` follow the alias; the roster lists only declared presets.
- A declaration whose ID is also an alias fails to register; an alias whose target isn't declared reports both IDs.
- The "Unknown agent preset" message says how to map a removed preset.
- Tests: 3 new cases in `registry.spec.ts` (fail on master, pass with the change); 100% coverage of `src/index.ts`. README (en/zh) and its translation record updated.

Until then, the workaround is to declare a `preset-standard-tools` row whose plugin list copies `preset-standard`. With that row, the same Session resumes (verified on a throwaway 0.1.7-rc.2 instance).

## 2. Format v0 subagent transcripts with descriptor v2 are refused

19 subagent child Sessions fail to open on 0.1.5, 0.1.7-rc.2 and current `master`; 0.2.0-rc.2 ships the same checks:

```
SessionFormatUnsupportedError: subagent/descriptor 5 uses unsupported descriptor version 2; source v0 artifact remains unchanged
```

Releases 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-08-10) through 0.1.1-rc.2 (2026-08-21) wrote `subagent/descriptor` v2 into format v0; v3 arrived on 2026-08-24 (#2663) and only added the optional `agentReasoningEffort`. Two checks refuse v2:

- `assertReleasedEventPayload` in `session-format-v0-to-v1` throws for any non-3 descriptor in payload generation 0;
- `subagentDescriptorValue` in `payload-validation.ts`, which the v2→v3 edge also uses, accepts only `version: 3`.

The V3→V4 catalog facts already accept descriptor v1–v3, and `docs/session-format-status.md` states that alpha, beta and RC releases establish released Session-format obligations.

**Proposed change** (one commit on a fork, [diff against master](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...MovieMaker93:deepseek-harness:fix/v0-subagent-descriptor-v2)): accept descriptor v2 in the shared payload validation, reject `agentReasoningEffort` on v2, and keep refusing descriptor versions no release wrote into format v0. Committed generations stay unchanged.

- Tests: 5 new cases in `session-format-v0-to-v1/tests/validation.spec.ts` and one end-to-end test in `session-persistence-jsonl/tests/catalog-migration.spec.ts` (a V0 child with descriptor v2 opens through read and write access, `none` and `zstd`). All fail on master and pass with the change; 100% coverage of the two changed files; the session-format, catalog and JSONL suites pass (1934 tests).
- On a copy of the 197 real Sessions, `master` fails to open 19; with the change all 197 open for read and for write.

Both changed packages type-check, as do the host packages that depend on the preset registry; I didn't run the full-repository build, which needs more memory than my server has. Happy to adjust either change or split it differently if that helps.

discussions.title: [llm-pi-ai] Upstream "Provider returned an empty response" (OpenRouter) falls through classifyPiAiError to non-retryable PI_AI_ERROR
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (Windows), `dsh-llm-pi-ai` serving an OpenRouter route (`api: openai-completions`)
- `dsh-llm-retry` is active through the stock `dsh-base` bundle registration — confirmed at runtime by the presence of `llm/retry-started` session events. So this is not a missing-plugin issue: the retry executor runs, the failure is in classification.

## Symptom

When OpenRouter relays an upstream empty response, the turn ends with an agent error and no retry attempt:

```
attempt t3s2 → error: PI_AI_ERROR Provider returned an empty response
AGENT ERROR t3: Provider returned an empty response
```

Seven attempt-level failures logged across Sep 29–30, all on the same route. `dsh-llm-retry` never fires for them.

## Root cause

`"Provider returned an empty response"` is the upstream provider's error text, relayed verbatim by pi-ai's OpenAI-completions adapter into the terminal `error` event's `errorMessage`. `classifyPiAiError()` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`) has no rule that matches the wording, so it falls to the catch-all:

```ts
  ...
  return 'PI_AI_ERROR'
```

`PI_AI_ERROR` is not in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` (`EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TIMEOUT`, `TRANSPORT`), so `recover()` short-circuits at `!policy.retryableCodes.includes(failure.code)` and the request is never retried.

Note the inconsistency: `mapStopReason()` classifies a locally detected zero-content `stop` as `EMPTY_RESPONSE` — retryable by default. Two paths that both mean "the model produced nothing" disagree; one retries, the other silently ends the turn.

## Why this should be retryable

`EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE`'s own docstring (`packages/llm/llm/src/types/error.ts`) states the principle:

> The attempt produced nothing durable, so retry policy treats it as safe to repeat.

An upstream-relayed empty response is exactly "nothing durable" — the same transient failure as a mid-stream truncation, just worded by a different layer.

## Proposed fix

Narrow: one more rule in `classifyPiAiError`:

```ts
if (/provider returned an empty response/i.test(message)) return 'EMPTY_RESPONSE'
```

Structural (preferred): this is the fourth report on the same regex chain — #4361 (`finish_reason: network_error`), #6595 (localized timeout text), #7691 (textual HTTP 5xx). Each report adds new wording, which suggests text enumeration alone can't keep up. A wording-independent rule would end the whack-a-mole: when a terminal error arrives and the attempt emitted zero content blocks, classify it as `EMPTY_RESPONSE` regardless of message text. That implements the "nothing durable → safe to repeat" principle at the layer that actually knows how much was produced.

## Workaround until then

Provider-level config, no code change required:

```yaml
retryPolicy:
  mode: normal
  maxRetries: 5
  retryableCodes: [EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT, PI_AI_ERROR]
```

Two caveats worth knowing before copying this: `retryableCodes` replaces the default list rather than merging with it, and the `PI_AI_ERROR` catch-all also carries `pending`/`deferred` endings that `mapStopReason()`'s docstring marks as intentionally non-retryable — so it is best scoped to the route that actually needs it.

discussions.title: [Windows Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2] All shell tools die with "PTY shell exited during startup" when sandbox mode is workspace-write (root cause: GUI-subsystem Electron as ACL sandbox runner host + ConPTY)
discussions.body:
### Summary

On the Windows desktop build, every shell tool invocation (pwsh, and even `cmd /c ...`)
fails instantly with the constant error `Error: PTY shell exited during startup` while
the sandbox mode is `workspace-write`. Nothing in the command, path, encoding, or cwd
changes the outcome — the process never lives long enough to execute anything. Setting
`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` (per-session or via the user environment
variable on a fresh session) completely fixes it, which also pinpoints the failing layer.

### Environment

- DeepSeek Harness desktop (official), host `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2`
- Windows 11 Pro x64 (build 26200), zh-CN
- No PowerShell 7 installed → `resolvePwshPath()` falls back to Windows PowerShell 5.1
- Machine has no Git Bash; pwsh is the only shell tool

### Reproduction

1. Fresh session on the desktop build (default sandbox mode = `workspace-write`).
2. Invoke the shell tool with any command — e.g. `echo hello`, `Get-Content <file>`,
   `cmd /c dir C:\`.
3. Every call returns immediately:

   ```
   Error: PTY shell exited during startup
   ```

   No exit code, no stderr, no resolved shell path is surfaced (see "Suggestions").

4. Fix A — set user env var `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access`, fully restart the
   app, open a **new** session → shell tools work.
5. Fix B — in an existing broken session, switch the permission preset back to
   `danger-full-access` → shell tools immediately work again (session events confirm
   `sandbox/mode` switching back).

Note the session-level override semantics: a session whose event stream records
`sandbox/mode: workspace-write` stays broken even after the app is restarted with
`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` in the host process environment (verified by
reading the host process environment block directly). This makes the bug look
intermittent to users, but it is deterministic per (session mode × sandbox runner path).

### Root-cause analysis (source-level, verified locally)

Chain: the persistent shell session goes through `dsh-terminal-bash`'s PTY
(node-pty / ConPTY). When `sandboxPolicy.mode != danger-full-access`, the tool argv is
wrapped by `sandbox.confine()` into the **windows-acl runner**:

```
[process.execPath, <asar>\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js, --workspace …, --temp …, --mode …, --, pwsh …]
```

In the desktop host, `process.execPath` is `DeepSeek Harness.exe` — a **GUI-subsystem
Electron binary run with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE**. Three-way control experiment on this
machine:

| Host binary | ACL runner | ConPTY | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| plain `node.exe` (console subsystem) | yes | yes | ✅ works (prompt, OSC 133 marks all correct) |
| Electron (RunAsNode) | yes | no | ✅ works |
| Electron (RunAsNode) | yes | **yes** | ❌ silent death (0-byte output; non-interactive exits 0 but all output is lost; interactive → inner console child gets no console → dies at startup → PTY reports `session_exit`) |

So the sandbox runner itself is functional; the failure is the **GUI-subsystem host +
ConPTY combination** (an inner console child spawned by a GUI-subsystem parent gets no
console). It likely affects every Windows desktop user while the default
`workspace-write` sandbox is on.

Workaround currently in use: `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` (accepting the
disabled file sandbox as a trade-off).

### Suggestions

1. Fix the runner/PTY interaction for GUI-subsystem hosts (e.g. attach the inner
   process to a fresh console, or avoid ConPTY wrapping of the runner child, or ship a
   console-subsystem helper binary as the sandbox host).
2. Regardless of the fix, surface diagnostics in the tool error: **exit code, first
   lines of stderr, and the resolved shell absolute path**. With the current constant
   one-liner there is nothing to distinguish "shell binary missing" from "sandbox
   runner killed the child", and users cannot self-diagnose.

Happy to provide more traces (node-pty repro scripts, runner logs) if useful.

### 中文摘要（可选读）

Windows 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 在默认 `workspace-write` 沙箱档位下，所有 shell 工具
（pwsh / cmd）启动即死，报错恒定为 `PTY shell exited during startup`，无退出码、无
stderr、无 shell 路径。根因：windows-acl 沙箱 runner 以 GUI 子系统的 Electron
（RunAsNode）为宿主、外层再套 ConPTY 时，内层 console 子进程拿不到控制台即死；纯
node 宿主同一 runner 同一 ConPTY 完全正常（三组对照实测）。`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=
danger-full-access` 可完全规避。另建议工具报错带上退出码 / stderr / 解析到的 shell
绝对路径，便于用户自查。

discussions.title: [Bug] Open Web UI goes permanently blank after dsh restarts from a reinstalled/copied install — in-place plugin swap throws uncaught SlotAssemblyError (0.1.7-rc.2)
discussions.body:
> **中文摘要**：服务端换成"重新安装/复制出来的同一份 dsh"并重启后，已打开的 Web 页面会整页空白且不会自愈（控制台 `SlotAssemblyError: scope 'session-maybe' rendered without an installed adapter`）。原因是插件 rev 由文件元数据 (mtime, ctime, size) 计算，字节完全相同的安装也会得到全新的 rev，页面随即原地替换全部插件，替换过程中的一次渲染抛出未捕获异常。同一份安装重启不受影响；手动刷新即可恢复。已在全新 DSH_HOME + 默认 web profile 上确定性复现。

### Summary

An already-open Web UI tab goes permanently blank — only the boot background color remains — when `dsh web` restarts from an install whose client bundles have different **file metadata**: for example after reinstalling or upgrading via npm, switching install locations, or copying the install. The client reconnects, receives a module graph in which every plugin `rev` changed, swaps every plugin in place, and a render during the swap throws `SlotAssemblyError: scope 'session-maybe' rendered without an installed adapter`. Nothing catches it, the UI root unmounts, and nothing reloads the page. A manual reload fixes it.

Restarting the **same** install (revs unchanged) is fine: the tab reconnects and keeps working.

### Environment

- dsh **0.1.7-rc.2** from npm; fresh `DSH_HOME`, default `web` profile (bundles `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` only)
- macOS 26 on Apple Silicon, Node 24.21, Chrome 153
- First noticed in real use when a running setup was switched from the npx-cache install to a global install of the **same version** while a tab was open.

### Reproduction (deterministic)

```sh
export DSH_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
dsh web --no-open --port 3997        # open the printed URL in Chrome and keep the tab open from here on

# control: stop the server, start the same command again -> the tab reconnects and keeps working

# experiment: make a copy of the install that differs only in file metadata
cp -Rc "$(npm root -g)/@deepseek-ai/dsh" /tmp/dsh-copy   # macOS clone: identical bytes, new ctime (plain cp -R also works)
# stop the server, then start it from the copy with the same DSH_HOME and port
/tmp/dsh-copy/lib/bin.js web --no-open --port 3997
```

| | boot graph `rev` | open tab after reconnect |
|---|---|---|
| baseline | `07aa41f50c60` | normal |
| control: same install restarted | `07aa41f50c60` | `[connection] connection lost, retry #1…#4`, then normal |
| experiment: restarted from the copy | `2a2a22f8737e` | blank ~1 s after reconnecting; still blank after 25 s (DOM 453 → 164 elements, empty `innerText`) |

First console error in the experiment (logged as an error, then again as an uncaught exception):

```
SlotAssemblyError: scope 'session-maybe' rendered without an installed adapter
    at ScopeProvider (/plugins/?? combo bundle, rev=312d928e9f5e)
```

It is followed by `Sidebar Session opening failed: Error: Session reference "session-…" is released` and 20+ × `locale subscriber crashed: Error: uiConversation.binding: unknown session "session-…"`.

### Why this happens (from the shipped code)

- `artifactRevision()` derives a plugin's rev from `mtimeMs`, `ctimeMs` and `size` rather than from content (`packages/client/modules/src/index.ts`, unchanged on `master` as of 2026-09-29). A byte-identical reinstall or copy therefore changes every rev.
- On reconnect, the 0.1.7-rc.2 client compares `entryTargets()` (which include `rev`), bumps its generation and replaces every entry in place.
- During that replacement a slot scope is rendered without its adapter (per the error message). The error is uncaught, and there is no full-page reload fallback: I found no `location.reload` or error boundary in `packages/client/modules/src/client/{entries,system,entry-lifecycle,index}.ts`.

### Suggestions (any one would prevent the dead page)

1. If an in-place reconcile or render fails, fall back to `location.reload()` (or an error boundary with a reload button) instead of leaving a blank page.
2. Derive the rev from bundle content, so a byte-identical reinstall does not trigger a full swap.
3. When the server's install root has changed since the page loaded, send a "reload" frame instead of a graph update.

### Workaround

Close open tabs/app windows before upgrading or reinstalling dsh, or reload the page (⌘R / F5) once the server is back.

### Related

- **#5119** is the closest prior report: the same `session-maybe` scope fails during a client-module update, but there the error is caught by `SlotErrorBoundary` and only the composer disappears. Here the error is thrown from `ScopeProvider`, apparently outside any slot error boundary, so the whole UI unmounts. A reply on #5119 notes that `dsh-client-hmr` ignored `{type:"graph"}` frames in 0.1.5; in the 0.1.7-rc.2 client it handles them (`entries.sync(frame.graph)`), which is what turns a reconnect after a rev change into a full in-place swap.
- #7962 (blank page when the shell's own entry chunk fails to load) and #2752 (blank UI on a plugin service-name conflict) share the symptom — no fallback, blank page — but have different triggers.

### Not yet established

- Not re-tested on 0.2.0-rc.x. The rev derivation is unchanged on `master`, but I have not run master.
- Whether the failing scope is always `session-maybe`: it was in both instrumented runs here (default profile, and a profile with three experimental bundles).

discussions.title: Agent Teams: Per-teammate model selection
discussions.body:
Hi team 👋 — per `CONTRIBUTING.md` I'm bringing this here as an Ideas discussion, since external pull requests aren't accepted at the moment.

## Problem

In Agent Teams, every teammate inherits the Lead's model. There is no way to route individual teammates to different providers/models (a cheap reviewer next to a strong implementer, for example), even though the one-shot subagent tool already supports per-delegation selection through the `subagent-model-selection` setting.

## Proposal

Let `spawn_teammate` accept optional `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` with the same semantics as the subagent tool:

- Omitted values inherit the Lead's route at creation time.
- Selection is gated by the same Host `subagent-model-selection` user setting and the same per-session route allowlist, so **one toggle governs both delegation surfaces** and no new user-facing configuration is needed.
- `list_subagent_models` serves route discovery for Team members as well.
- The durable roster row records the teammate's resolved model, so `list_agents` shows each member's actual model.

The continuation seam already supports this: `startContinuable` accepts `agentOptions`, persists the resolved route in the child's own subagent descriptor, and restores it on cold resume — so no new durability machinery is required.

## One finding that may matter independently

While testing the shipped web composition (standard preset + Agent Teams bundle enabled), both selection surfaces registered `list_subagent_models` into the same agent scope, and **new session creation failed** with `tool "list_subagent_models" is already registered in this scope`. The web preset's nested `tool-subagent` row (with `modelSelectionSettings: true`) coexists with the Agent Teams bundle, whose disables only cover top-level rows. The implementation fixes this with a reference-counted, per-scope shared registration, so a composition mounting both surfaces presents exactly one discovery definition.

## Status

A complete implementation is running and tested locally (based on `master` at `639ed01539`, i.e. 0.2.0-rc.2) and pushed to my fork: [`feat/agent-team-teammate-model-selection`](https://github.com/ivbrajkovic/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/agent-team-teammate-model-selection) — four commits: shared model-selection machinery, service-level route pass-through, the `spawn_teammate` surface, and docs/records.

- Unit tests for every changed path with 100% per-file coverage on the touched `src` files; full repository typecheck, lint, and doc gates pass.
- The keyless `team-targets` snapshot is updated; bilingual package READMEs, subsystem docs, and the `team/member` persistence-type acknowledgement follow the repo's own policy files.
- Live-verified in the web app: Lead on `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`, teammate spawned with `zai/glm-5.3-flash` + `low` effort — the teammate runs and replies on the selected route, and `list_agents` reports both models.

## Offer

Happy to share the patch, walk through the design, or rebase onto whatever base the team prefers — and equally fine if you would rather implement it internally; the design notes and the registration-collision finding above are the main takeaways. Thanks for a great harness!

discussions.title: [Web UI] Copying rendered assistant messages loses spaces and mangles combining diacritics
discussions.body:
# [Web UI] Assistant message text renders joined without spaces (and in a fallback font) around formatting boundaries; copy/paste corruption is a secondary effect

> **Correction (v2):** the original report overemphasized clipboard corruption. The
> **primary defect is on-screen rendering**: portions of assistant messages display
> joined, without spaces, in a different typeface. Copy/paste corruption is a
> secondary effect of the same root cause.

## Summary

In the DSH Web UI, portions of rendered assistant messages display **visually joined —
words running together with no spaces** — and switch to a different (likely fallback)
typeface, typically where the message changes formatting (bold / inline code) or contains
accented characters (Spanish: `í`, `á`). Copying that text out of the page reproduces the
corruption, which appears to be a downstream effect of how the text is being rendered,
not the root cause.

## Observed symptoms

**Primary — on-screen rendering:**
- Words render joined without spaces. A sentence like
  `tampoco los gastaría todos en máquinas` appeared on screen as
  `tampocolosgastarı́ atodosenm aˊquinas`.
- The affected chunks appear in a **different typeface** from the surrounding text
  (consistent with a font-fallback run).
- Accented characters appear **decomposed**: base letter and acute accent rendered as
  separate clusters (`ı` + `´`), sometimes displaced.
- The corruption concentrates where formatting changes ("when the font changes").

**Secondary — copy/paste:**
- Copying the rendered text yields the same joined/decomposed text; pasting into the
  composer inserts a line break per visual line of the source rendering.

## Environment

- dsh: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.3** (installed via `npx`)
- Surface: web UI served at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`
- OS: macOS (x64)
- Browser: Chromium-based (exact version TBD)

## Steps to reproduce

1. Ask the agent for a long Spanish-language response mixing plain text with inline
   formatting (bold, code spans) and accented characters.
2. Look at the rendered message in the web UI, in the region where formatting changes.
3. (Secondary) select and copy that region; paste into a plain-text target.

## Expected result

Text renders with normal inter-word spaces, a uniform typeface, and composed (NFC)
accented characters — on screen and on copy.

## Suspected causes (to be confirmed)

1. **Text emitted as many small styled inline elements without literal whitespace
   between them.** The shipped web bundle of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` includes
   the Shiki syntax highlighter, and formatted runs are emitted as multiple spans. If
   word spacing exists only as styling/element boundaries rather than literal space
   characters in DOM text nodes, the joins collapse **both on screen and on copy** —
   matching all observed symptoms with a single root cause.
2. **Decomposed Unicode (base letter + `U+0301`) in model output** forces a fallback
   typeface for the combining marks (matching the "different font" report) and can
   break cluster shaping.
3. Possibly aggravated **during token streaming** (mid-message re-parse) — unconfirmed
   whether the corruption persists after the message finishes rendering.

## Impact

On-screen readability of assistant messages is broken in the affected regions — this is
the primary defect, not merely clipboard corruption. Session data and workspace files
are unaffected.

## Workarounds

- Ask the agent to put critical content in fenced code blocks or file deliverables.
- If the corruption only appears during streaming, re-open the message after
  generation completes.

## Open questions

- Does the corruption persist after the message finishes streaming, or only during
  generation?
- Browser/version and OS font settings of the affected machine (screenshot available
  on request).

discussions.title: Windows 10 语音输入切出窗口会丢失录音，以及几项交互建议
discussions.body:
使用环境：Windows 10，DSH 桌面版，实验性语音输入（dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle）。

使用时发现一个影响比较大的问题，也有几个想补充的交互建议。

1. 切出窗口会丢失正在录制的内容
开始听写后，如果点击 DSH 窗口以外的地方，当前录音就会消失，没有提示。在 DSH 窗口内，部分交互操作也会触发，不过不是所有点击都会如此。

这个应该算是 bug。录音时切换窗口、查资料或操作别的东西都很正常，不应该因此被当成取消听写。希望会话不因失焦而结束，也不要直接丢弃已经录下的内容，毕竟一整段话很难原样重说。

2. 希望支持 Enter 结束录音并发送
录音过程中按 Enter，结束收音，等音频识别完成后自动发送消息。这样说完就能一步发出去，不必再分别点击停止、等待识别、发送。

3. 希望两分钟后能继续听写
实测录音达到两分钟后，会自动停止收音并进入识别。录下的内容会保留，但想继续说就需要重新开始。

如果两分钟是内部处理的分段限制，希望能在后台切段识别，前台继续收音，文字按顺序追加，让用户可以连续说完，不必跟着内部的分段反复操作。

4. 波形横向滚动有些快
现在波形大约五到十秒就扫过整个显示区域，看起来比较急促。希望放慢横向滚动，让同样宽度显示更长一段录音历史，音量变化仍然实时更新。

最优先希望修复的是第一项录音丢失，其余几项作为交互改进建议。

discussions.title: [Bug] 侧栏「未分组」分组渲染出一个点了没反应的「新会话」按钮 (0.2.0-rc.2)
discussions.body:
**Version**: macOS Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.2.0-rc.2)

## 摘要

侧栏「未分组」分组行右侧渲染了一个「新会话」按钮，图标、tooltip、aria-label 都和真实工作区行完全一致，但点击后**没有任何反应**——不建会话、不报错、不弹提示、不写日志。这个控件在未分组行上应当隐藏或置灰。

## 复现

1. 先让侧栏出现「未分组」分组：存在至少一条不属于任何工作区的可见会话即可（例如原工作区目录被改名/删除，或工作区记录里的 `path` 与会话 cwd 的 `realpath` 不一致）。
2. 展开「未分组」，鼠标悬停在该行右侧的 ⊕ 图标上——tooltip 显示「新会话」，`aria-label` 是「在"未分组"中新建会话」。
3. 点击。主区、侧栏、提示均无任何变化。

换成任意一个真实工作区行上的同一个 ⊕，点击即正常创建。

## 预期

要么能在某个目录里新建会话，要么该按钮不渲染 / 置灰并说明原因。

## 实际

静默 no-op。

## 根因

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js`（0.2.0-rc.2）。

按钮本身对**所有**分组行无差别渲染，且没有 `disabled`：

```js
// ProjectRowItem，约 1341-1358 行
const label = row.workspaceId === void 0 ? t("group.ungrouped") : row.label;
// ...
label: t("actions.newSession"),                    // "新会话"
children: <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onCreate(); }} />
```

但真正的回调处有守卫，而未分组分组的 `workspaceId` 恒为 `undefined`，整个分支被跳过：

```js
// 约 2522-2527 行
onCreate: () => {
  if (group.workspaceId !== void 0) {
    setGroupExpanded(group.key, true);
    startSession(group.workspaceId);
  }
},
```

未分组分组是 `groupByWorkspace()` 合成出来的，`workspaceId` / `cwd` 全是 `undefined`：

```js
// 约 437 行
if (stray.length > 0)
  groups.push(buildGroup("", void 0, void 0, void 0, "", orderedUngrouped(stray, ungroupedOrder, list.byId)));
```

## 关于"该不该能建"

我认为**不能建是合理的**，问题只在界面呈现。会话创建必须落到一个具体目录：宿主 `session.create` 要求 `workspaceId` 或 `cwd` 二选一（否则 `gateway/bad-request: session.create accepts workspaceId or cwd, not both`），客户端走 `connectWorkspace()` → `reuseOrCreateBlank(workspace)`，拿 `workspace.path` 当新会话的 cwd。而未分组是**跨目录**的桶——我这边它同时聚合了两个完全不同目录下的会话（其中一个目录后来被删除，cwd 已无法解析），确实没有唯一 cwd 可填。

## 建议

在 `ProjectRowItem` 里按 `group.workspaceId === undefined` 隐藏该按钮，或渲染成 `disabled` 并给一句 tooltip 说明（例如"未分组的会话不属于任何目录，请在具体工作区中新建"）。

## 对照：全局「新会话」按钮不受影响

左上角那个全局「新会话」按钮在停在未分组会话上时依然可用——`startSession()` 的回退链是 `workspaceId ?? 当前会话所属工作区 ?? 最近更新的工作区`，前两项为 `undefined` 时会落到"最近更新的工作区"正常新建。所以只有分组行上这个 ⊕ 是死的。
