discussions.title: Uncaught ENOENT in OutputCollector.spillAll kills the dsh web server; spill roots also grow unbounded (13 GB measured, volume driven to 197 MB free)
Goal tools vanish from the session tool catalog mid-session, while the goal-round prompt instructs an action they would be needed for
discussions.body:
# Upstream report — @deepseek-ai/dsh goal tools

**Channel:** `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` has GitHub Issues **disabled** (API returns 410); the
README routes bug reports to GitHub Discussions, so this one was posted there, under Q&A.
**Component:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver`, session tool catalog
**Observed:** 2026-09-29, dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 (npx cache `_npx/1e7f6d9597241db0`), Windows, web profile
**Severity:** an agent cannot close its own goal; the loss is silent and costs a full-context
round each turn

## Symptom

1. Early in one session, `create_goal` worked and created
   `goal-af5f3f0e-ca14-4e50-86d0-dcbe208db085` (`maxGoalRounds: 12`, `phase: active`).
2. The goal-round driver then ran 12 rounds normally — each delivering
   `<goal_round>…</goal_round>` (text matches `packages/goal/goal-round-driver/src/prompt.ts:12-26`).
3. **In later turns of that same session**, `create_goal`, `get_goal` and `update_goal` all
   return `unknown tool` (13 attempts; the goal could never be closed from the agent side).
4. The same session, same window, also lost its **native** tools: `pwsh`, `edit`, `write`
   became `unknown tool`. The surviving catalog was MCP servers + `subagent` only. The change
   coincided with a mid-session model switch (`deepseek-v4-pro` → `deepseek-flash`).

## Why this looks like a defect and not a policy

- The round prompt **instructs** the action that is then impossible: *"Before claiming
  completion, gather evidence that the whole objective is achieved, read the current goal, and
  mark it complete."* (`goal-round-driver/src/prompt.ts`)
- Authority explicitly permits goal tools on goal rounds:
  `tool-goal/src/authority.ts` accepts `hasDirectHumanInput()` **or**
  `isMatchingGoalRound()` — the second exists precisely so a goal's own round may mutate it.
- Both shipped and user presets declare the goal rows (`command-goal`, `tool-goal`), so a
  missing preset row is not the explanation.

## Hypotheses to test (in likely order)

1. **Tool-catalog re-composition on model switch drops rows.** A model change mid-session
   recomposes the exposed catalog; non-MCP tools (goal, fs, shell) are lost while MCP servers
   survive. Reproduce: create a goal, switch the seat's model, call `get_goal`.
2. **Live profile-patch hot reload drops rows.** `patchReload: live` re-composes on patch
   edits; check whether a reload rebuilds the catalog and omits rows.
3. **An external tool-shadowing layer filters the catalog.** A local MCP-side integration
   running "shadow mode" (native Read/Grep/Glob denied, its own equivalents mandatory) may be
   rewriting the exposed tool set beyond those three tools.

## Impact

- No agent-side closure path: every round re-sends the whole conversation (the dominant cost
  line in this deployment's own audit) with no way to reach completion.
- 12 post-completion rounds were spent on a finished objective before the operator closed the
  goal by hand.
- An honest agent reports it as a blocker each round — noise that hides real blockers.

## What to capture for a fix

The per-turn tool list the Host sends (`tools` in the request header) across a model switch and
across a patch reload; whether the rows are absent from the catalog or present-but-refused
(a refusal would read differently from `unknown tool`).

discussions.title: Bidirectional Context Branching with Selective Inheritance
discussions.body:
Labels: enhancement, architecture, context-management, compute-efficiency, research-tooling
Status: Open for discussion
Summary
Proposal to replace linear, monolithic conversation histories with a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) primitive supporting bidirectional selective context inheritance. This architecture allows users to branch upward (selectively inheriting subsets of prior context), branch downward (partitioning future context into scoped sub-threads), and merge/partition vector namespaces without destructive edits or token wastage.
1. The Problem
Current conversation models rely on a linear, monolithic paradigm where every turn re-transmits the full history. When exploring alternative directions, users face three suboptimal paths:
 * Message Editing: Destructive; overwrites the original path.
 * New Chat: Lossy; discards all prior context.
 * Manual Copy-Pasting: Error-prone; burns tokens and breaks continuity.
Token Processing Inefficiency
For a conversation of length N, a linear model processes:


For a 50-turn conversation, this yields ~1,275 message-equivalents processed when only ~50 were authored. This architecture forces the platform to absorb unnecessary inference costs while delivering a restricted user experience.
2. Architectural Solution: Bidirectional Selective Branching
Replace the linear message list with a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of message nodes. Each new turn evaluates as a parameterized query over the graph rather than a monolithic replay.
Core Affordances
| Operation | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| Branch Up | Selectively include an arbitrary subset of ancestor messages as context from any new turn point. |
| Branch Down | Pin a scoped subset of context for all future descendant turns. |
| Merge | Combine selected nodes from disparate branches into a unified working context. |
| Partition | Tag a branch as an independent vector namespace for scoped retrieval. |
Paradigm Shift
| Dimension | Traditional Chat (Linear) | Proposed Model (DAG) |
|---|---|---|
| History Topology | Linear sequence ([msg_1 \dots msg_N]) | Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of nodes |
| Forking Mechanism | Destructive edit/overwrite | Non-destructive, multi-parent branching |
| Context Resolution | Full replay per turn | select(nodes, criteria) via selective inheritance |
| Vector Namespace | Monolithic workspace store | Per-node / per-branch isolation |
3. Compute Optimization & Prefix-Cache Economics
Mathematical Impact
 * Shared Ancestors: Transmitted once and reused via persistent prefix caching.
 * Divergence Delta: Branches transmit only their delta plus explicitly selected ancestors.
 * Cache Utilization: Prefix-cache hit rates increase from an estimated ~60% to ~90%+, scaling efficiency linearly with branch multiplicity.
Comparative Metrics (Estimated per 50-Turn Thread with 3 Branches)
| Metric | Linear Model (Current) | Bidirectional DAG (Proposed) |
|---|---|---|
| Tokens Processed / Thread | ~375,000 | ~140,000 |
| Prefix Cache Utilization | ~60% | ~90% |
| Effective Compute / Branch | Full replay | Delta + selected ancestors |
| Estimated Savings | — | ~55% – 65% reduction |
4. Two-Tier UX Design
4.1 Default Mode: "Auto Context" (Average User)
 * Zero Cognitive Overhead: System automatically resolves relevant ancestors using recency and semantic relevance.
 * Interface: Simple boolean toggle: "Include earlier context? ✅" and a single action: "Explore from here".
 * Abstraction: Hides the graph layer entirely while preserving improved output quality.
4.2 Power User Mode: "Context Composer" (Researchers, Developers, Analysts)
 * Graph Visualization: Complete workspace DAG render.
 * Granular Control: Per-node include/exclude toggles, branch color-coding, and custom labels.
 * Vector Scoping: Direct control over namespace boundaries for retrieval.
 * Recombination: Drag-and-drop nodes across branches to synthesize new working contexts.
 * Exporting: Isolate and export branches as standalone collections, JSON payloads, or shareable artifacts.
5. Technical Primitives Required
 * Node-Edge Graph Engine: Messages stored as immutable nodes with labeled directed edges supporting multi-parent relationships (merge points).
 * Context Resolution Pipeline: context_ref payload evaluated per turn via stable topological sort to maximize prefix-cache hits.
 * Vector Namespace Isolation: Query filters bound to branch_id or explicit node sets.
 * API Endpoints: Explicit state transitions for branching and turn-submission.
6. Proposed API Sketch
POST /conversations/{id}/branch
{
  "parent_node_id": "msg_20",
  "direction": "up",
  "context_ref": ["msg_03", "msg_07", "msg_20"],
  "label": "alt-hypothesis-A"
}

POST /conversations/{id}/turn
{
  "branch_id": "br_abc123",
  "content": "...",
  "context_ref": ["msg_03", "msg_07", "msg_20"],
  "vector_scope": "branch"
}

7. Open Engineering Questions
 * Model Evaluation: Do models trained on linear sequential chat degrade when exposed to sparse or topologically reordered selective context? What validation suites are required?
 * Graph-Aware Moderation: How to prevent cross-branch context laundering of restricted or unsafe content?
 * Heuristics: What weighting function (recency vs. semantic distance vs. manual pin) should drive default-mode auto-selection?
 * Migration Strategy: Mapping legacy linear threads to single-path DAG structures.
 *

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows 11 26100][nightly 0.2.0-rc.2] workspace-write 沙箱授权成功，但任何子进程仍以 0xC0000142 死亡（read-only 正常；宿主 UAC 关闭）
discussions.body:
经搜索，#8062 / #8142 / #8193 报过同一症状，本帖补充的是授权侧证据

环境

  • DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2（nightly 通道；@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 的 version 即 0.2.0-rc.2，内置 dsh-base / dsh-web-app 同为 0.2.0-rc.2）
  • Windows 11 build 26100（powershell.exe 5.1.26100.9444）
  • UAC 已关闭：EnableLUA=0、ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0、FilterAdministratorToken=0 → DSH 进程持有完整管理员 / High 完整性令牌，受限令牌由它派生
  • 另已安装 PowerShell 7.6.6（MSI C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe 与 MSIX 各一份）

症状

会话文件策略 = workspace-write 时，沙箱化子进程 100% 失败：

  • pwsh 工具：零输出，退出码 3221225794（0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）
  • 进程内能力不受影响（read / write / glob / grep、web_search / web_fetch 正常）
  • 切到 danger-full-access 立即正常；read-only 也正常

复现（不需要模型、不需要凭据）

powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$exe    = '<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe'
$runner = '<install>\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js'
$ws     = '<workspace>'

& $exe --expose-internals $runner --workspace $ws --temp $env:TEMP --mode read-only -- `
    "$env:SystemRoot\System32\cmd.exe" /c echo read-only-ok     # → 0，打印 read-only-ok

& $exe --expose-internals $runner --workspace $ws --temp $env:TEMP --mode workspace-write -- `
    "$env:SystemRoot\System32\cmd.exe" /c echo ww-ok            # → 0xC0000142，零输出

（每个用例用 Start-Process -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput/-RedirectStandardError 收口； 注意 Electron 是 GUI 子系统，直接用 & 调用不会等待，输出会交错。）

实测矩阵

模式 | 目标程序 | 退出码 | 输出 -- | -- | -- | -- read-only | powershell.exe 5.1 | 0 | ok read-only | pwsh 7.6.6 | 0 | ok / 7.6.6 read-only | cmd.exe | 0 | ok read-only | pwsh，写工作区 | 0 | Access to the path … is denied.（受限确实生效） workspace-write | cmd.exe | 0xC0000142 | 无 workspace-write | hostname.exe | 0xC0000142 | 无 workspace-write | powershell.exe 5.1 | 0xC0000142 | 无 workspace-write | pwsh 7.6.6 | 0xC0000142 | 无 workspace-write | cmd.exe，换 temp 根目录 | 0xC0000142 | 无 workspace-write | cmd.exe，全新无痕工作区 | 0xC0000142 | 无 两模式 | 不存在的目标程序 | 127 | windows-acl-run: CreateProcessAsUserW failed (Win32 2)

最后一行是关键对照：runner 自身失败会打印 windows-acl-run: … 并退出 127。 所以 workspace-write 的 0xC0000142 是子进程被 CreateProcessAsUserW 成功创建之后死在加载器初始化（runner 镜像了子进程的退出码），而不是 spawn 失败、也不是权限拒绝。

关键新增观察：授权是成功的，问题在令牌

在一个全新、无任何 DSH 痕迹的目录上跑 workspace-write，runner 的授权完全按设计落地（运行后的 ACL）：

代码块
Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)                            ← 删除子项拒绝
S-1-4-937184873-641267120:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)         ← 由路径派生的确定性工作区 SID + 写授权
Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)   ← Low 标签

即 grantWrite 与 Low 标签都成功 → 本机不是 WRITE_OWNER / SetNamedSecurityInfoW (Win32 5) 那一类问题 （#8282、#7816、#7504、#7750、#7720、#7804、#7912 与本帖是不同故障点）。

授权成功、子进程仍死在加载器初始化，而 read-only（同一 runner、同一目标、只少一组写 SID）完全正常 → 差异落在 workspace-write 把写 SID 加入受限令牌这一步。给维护者的最短线索： 同一台机器、同一 runner、同一目标，read-only 正常而 workspace-write 全灭，两者的差别只有写 SID。

已排除

  • PowerShell 版本：read-only 下 5.1 与 pwsh 7 都能启动；workspace-write 下 cmd.exe / hostname.exe 同样死 → 与 shell 无关
  • ACL 损坏：仓库自带 diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl.ps1 对工作区链与 %TEMP% 链均 VERDICT=NOT_THIS_CLASS、FIXED=0 GRANTED=0 REFUSED=0
  • 第三方 DLL 注入 / EDR：AppInit_DLLs 为空，进程模块表中无第三方模块
  • 工作区内容、temp 路径：全新目录、更换 temp 根目录均无差别

未能排除的一条（可能的关键线索）

本机 UAC 关闭，因此拿不到中等完整性进程做对照（explorer 启动的进程同样 elevated=yes， 并且没有 stdin 句柄 → runner 以 127 退出）。受限令牌是从完整管理员令牌派生的。 如果这个组合会让 workspace-write 的令牌构造出问题，就能解释「只有 workspace-write 全灭、read-only 正常」。 建议在一台 UAC 开启 / 非提权启动 DSH 的机器上对照一次；或直接检查 workspace-write 里 写 SID 进入 restricting list 与令牌 default DACL 的那段构造。

discussions.title: `pwsh` 工具在 `workspace-write` 下以 `0xC0000142` 死亡：受限令牌 + 控制台隔离标志
discussions.body:
`pwsh` 工具在 `workspace-write` 下以 `0xC0000142` 死亡：受限令牌 + 控制台隔离标志
> \*\*English title:\*\* `pwsh` tool dies with `STATUS\_DLL\_INIT\_FAILED` (0xC0000142) under `workspace-write` — ACL restricted token combined with a console-isolating process-creation flag
>
> \*\*⚠️ 提交渠道（已核实，勿用 issues）：\*\* 该仓库 \*\*GitHub Issues 已关闭\*\*（API 返回 `has\_issues: false`、`open\_issues\_count: 0`），故 `/issues/new` 不可用。
> 请提交到 \*\*GitHub Discussions\*\*：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions
> 并建议\*\*同时\*\*使用应用内 `/feedback`（会释放完整会话日志前缀）。
> \*\*建议标题：\*\* `\[Windows] pwsh tool fails with 0xC0000142 (STATUS\_DLL\_INIT\_FAILED) under workspace-write — ACL restricted token + console-isolating creation flag`
> \*\*建议标签：\*\* `windows` / `sandbox` / `shell` / `bug`
> \*\*版本：\*\* 0.2.0-rc.2 (win-x64)
> \*\*状态：\*\* \*\*根因已由受控实验定位\*\*（见下方"最小触发条件"）
---
结论（TL;DR）
在 Windows 上，ACL 受限令牌（`WRITE\_RESTRICTED` + Low 完整性）与 `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW` 或 `CREATE\_NEW\_CONSOLE` 这两个进程创建标志同时出现时，目标 shell 必以 `STATUS\_DLL\_INIT\_FAILED`（`0xC0000142`）在 DLL 初始化阶段死亡、零输出。
单独任一条件都不致命：
```
受限令牌  {logon SID, Everyone} + Low  +  标志=0                 ->  OK
受限令牌  {logon SID, Everyone} + Low  +  CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW       ->  FAIL 0xC0000142
无限制令牌                              +  CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW       ->  OK
```
`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 的 README 已经写明这条限制：
> \*"\*\*Console isolation is unavailable\*\* — children created with `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW` / `CREATE\_NEW\_CONSOLE` die during DLL initialization with `STATUS\_DLL\_INIT\_FAILED` (`0xC0000142`); children share the host console, and pipe-based stdio redirection is unaffected."\*
而 `dsh-win32-process` 的 README 也声称该原语已经规避了它：
> \*"It preserves console inheritance and \*\*does not add `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW` or `CREATE\_NEW\_CONSOLE`\*\*, which can fail DLL initialization under the restricted token."\*
但实测的失败特征与该限制完全吻合，说明受限路径上仍有一处把控制台隔离标志传了下去。可疑点：`dsh-jobs` 用 `windowsHide` 启动 Windows 子进程（Node 把 `windowsHide: true` 映射为 `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW`），与 `dsh-win32-process` 的承诺不一致。
---
最小触发条件（受控实验）
目标固定为 `C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe`（7.6.6），宿主为 High 完整性进程，令牌由 `CreateRestrictedToken` + `SetTokenInformation(TokenIntegrityLevel)` 构造，进程由 `CreateProcessAsUser` 创建。
矩阵 A — 令牌 × 创建标志（决定性）
令牌	创建标志	结果
无限制	`0`（继承控制台）	✅ OK
无限制	`CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW`	✅ OK ← 该标志单独无害
受限 `{logon, Everyone}` + Low	`0`	✅ OK
受限 `{logon, Everyone}` + Low	`CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW`	❌ FAIL 0xC0000142
受限 `{logon, Everyone}` + Low	`CREATE\_NEW\_CONSOLE`	❌ FAIL 0xC0000142
受限 `{logon, Everyone}` + Low	`DETACHED\_PROCESS`	✅ OK
受限 `{logon, Everyone}` + Low	`CREATE\_NEW\_PROCESS\_GROUP`	✅ OK
受限 `{logon, Everyone}` + Low	`0` + `STARTF\_USESHOWWINDOW`+`SW\_HIDE`	✅ OK ← DSH 实际的窗口隐藏写法无罪
矩阵 B — restricting 列表宽度 × Low 完整性
restricting SIDs	Low	结果
无（普通令牌）	✗	✅ OK
无（普通令牌）	✓	✅ OK ← Low 完整性单独无害
`{S-1-1-0}`（仅 Everyone）	✓	❌ FAIL 0xC0000142
`{logon SID, S-1-1-0}`（DSH 文档所述）	✓	✅ OK
`{Everyone + Authenticated Users + Users + Administrators + SYSTEM + Interactive + Local + ConsoleLogon + LocalService + NetworkService}`（不含 logon SID）	✓	✅ OK ← logon SID 并非唯一必需
矩阵 C — 其它被排除的变量
变量	结果
宿主进程无控制台（以 `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW` 启动自身副本，`GetConsoleWindow()` = 0）后，受限 + 标志=0	✅ OK ← 父进程控制台状态无关
`DISABLE\_MAX\_PRIVILEGE`	✅ OK
把 logon SID 放进 `SidsToDisable`	✅ OK
`powershell.exe` 5.1（.NET Framework）替代 pwsh 7	❌ 同样 FAIL（与 shell 版本无关）
`cmd.exe`（非 .NET）	✅ OK
---
由此确立的因果链
会话沙箱模式为 `workspace-write` → `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 为子进程构造 `WRITE\_RESTRICTED` + Low 完整性令牌。令牌本身是正确的：受控复刻该令牌后，pwsh 7 与 5.1 均能正常启动。
受限路径在创建该子进程时额外传入了控制台隔离标志（`CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW` 或 `CREATE\_NEW\_CONSOLE`）。
在 `WRITE\_RESTRICTED` 令牌下，这两个标志所要求的控制台初始化会执行写类访问检查；restricting SID 列表无法副署该写权限 → 控制台初始化失败 → 早期 DLL 初始化以 `0xC0000142` 死亡，进程零输出。
失败既非 runner 失败（无 `windows-acl-run:` stderr 签名、非退出 127），也非策略拒绝，因此工具层无法分类，用户只看到一个裸退出码。
为什么不是每台机器都复现： 第 3 步的写检查取决于目标控制台对象的 DACL 与 restricting 列表的交集。本机（Windows 11 25H2 / Build 26200，企业安全基线）上 `{Everyone}` 不足以通过而 `{logon SID, Everyone}` 可以——DACL 一旦再收紧或列表再变窄，就会落到失败侧。
---
建议修复
a.（核心）受限路径绝不传控制台隔离标志，并补一道断言
确保受限子进程的创建标志中永不含 `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW` / `CREATE\_NEW\_CONSOLE`，只允许 `0`、`DETACHED\_PROCESS` 或 `CREATE\_NEW\_PROCESS\_GROUP`。`dsh-win32-process` 的 README 已给出该承诺，但实测说明承诺未在整个受限链路上兑现——重点核查 `dsh-jobs` 的 `windowsHide`（Node 将其映射为 `CREATE\_NO\_WINDOW`）是否泄漏到了受限目标的创建调用上。
建议在受限 spawn 前加断言：若标志集合包含这两个位，直接以明确的内部错误失败，而不是让子进程静默死掉。
b.（必做）识别该退出码
把 `3221225794` / `0xC0000142`（`STATUS\_DLL\_INIT\_FAILED`）纳入工具层失败分类，与 runner 失败签名和策略拒绝区分开，映射到专门文案。目前它落在所有分类之外，是"完全无提示"的直接原因。
c.（必做）启动时可服务性探测
在受限模式下做一次一次性探测；若受限 shell 无法启动，则以类似 `SANDBOX\_UNAVAILABLE` 的可操作错误失败（提示改用 `danger-full-access` 或上报）。既然当前没有任何用户侧安装动作能修复本问题，这一探测是避免用户陷入死胡同的唯一机制。
d.（文档）纠正两处表述
`pwsh-local`：`resolvePwshPath` 会静默兜底到 Windows PowerShell 5.1，应至少告警。（注意：本 issue 与 5.1 无关，但该兜底会让排查者误入歧途——本报告的初版就是这么跑偏的。）
`sandbox-windows-acl` / `jobs`：明确"受限路径不得使用 `windowsHide`"。
---
临时规避
方案	操作	说明
单次升权	调用时带 `sandbox\_permissions: danger-full-access` + `justification`	已验证有效；每次需审批
会话级	`/permission danger-full-access`	已验证有效
安装 PowerShell 7	—	❌ 已证伪：安装 7.6.6 并重启后问题依旧
调整 restricting 列表	—	❌ 用户侧不可配置；且列表本身正确
> \*\*当前无用户侧根治手段\*\*，只能以 `danger-full-access` 换取可用性。
---
附 A：复现脚本
随本报告提供自包含实验脚本（PowerShell + C# P/Invoke，仅创建测试进程并读取退出码，不修改任何文件）：
`G:\\工作\\dsh-token-bisect.ps1` — 令牌/标志/控制台状态矩阵，含"无控制台宿主"两阶段实验
运行方式（需管理员；脚本以 `Add-Type` 编译内联 C#）：
```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File .\\dsh-token-bisect.ps1
```
附 B：环境
项目	值
操作系统	Microsoft Windows 11 专业版
OS 版本	10.0.26200，Build 26200，DisplayVersion 25H2，UBR 9457
架构	x64
DSH	0.2.0-rc.2（桌面版 win-x64）
运行时	Node 24.21.0 / Python 3.12.14（随附）
活动 profile	`desktop`
工作区	`G:\\工作`（非系统盘）
宿主完整性	High（已提升），`S-1-16-12288`
令牌 logon SID	`S-1-5-5-1-2318168691`
PowerShell 7	7.6.6（MSI，`%ProgramFiles%\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe`）
Windows PowerShell 5.1	`%SystemRoot%\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe`
安全软件	仅 Windows Defender；`AppInit\_DLLs` 空，`LoadAppInit\_DLLs = 0`
版本矩阵（沙箱相关包）
组件	版本
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-local`	0.2.0-rc.2
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox`	0.2.0-rc.2
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`	0.2.0-rc.2
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local`	0.2.0-rc.2
相关源码 / 文档位置（仓库内）
内容	路径
受限令牌 / 控制台隔离限制 / `0xC0000142` 说明	`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.md`
"不添加 CREATE_NO_WINDOW" 的承诺	`packages/subprocess/win32-process/README.md`
Windows 子进程以 `windowsHide` 启动 Job runner	`packages/jobs/\*/README.md`
pwsh 侧沙箱包装	`packages/shell/pwsh-sandbox/README.md`
shell 路径解析与 5.1 兜底	`packages/shell/pwsh-local/src/resolve.ts`
附 C：已排除的假设（完整清单）
假设	结论	证据
shell 版本 / 5.1 兜底	❌ 排除	安装 pwsh 7.6.6 并重启后仍失败
Low 完整性标签	❌ 排除	仅 Low（无 restricting）可正常启动
restricting 列表缺 logon SID	❌ 排除	不含 logon 但含其它广域 trustee 亦可正常启动
宿主进程无控制台（`windowsHide` 的副作用）	❌ 排除	无控制台宿主下"受限 + 标志=0"仍 OK
DSH 的 `STARTF\_USESHOWWINDOW`+`SW\_HIDE`	❌ 排除	该组合下启动正常
权限剥离 / `DISABLE\_MAX\_PRIVILEGE` / `SidsToDisable`	❌ 排除	均可正常启动
杀软 / 第三方 DLL 注入	❌ 排除	`AppInit\_DLLs` 空，仅 Defender
沙箱整体不可用（`SANDBOX\_UNAVAILABLE`）	❌ 排除	runner 正常启动并 spawn 了子进程；无退出 127
累积状态 / 资源耗尽（重启可缓解类）	❌ 排除	同一进程、同一令牌、同一时刻仅创建标志不同即结果不同（矩阵 A 的 3 与 4）；资源耗尽型故障不会只挑一个标志失败。且故障早于本次会话存在，重启 DSH 亦无变化
控制台隔离标志 + 受限令牌	✅ 确认	见矩阵 A：唯一能精确复现的组合
附 D：附带发现（与主缺陷无关）
该主机是企业网且无法访问证书吊销服务器：
`curl` 报 `schannel: ... CRYPT\_E\_NO\_REVOCATION\_CHECK (0x80092012)`

绕开方式：`curl.exe --ssl-no-revoke`（仍验证证书链），随后以 Authenticode 签名核验补偿。
另：`winget install --id Microsoft.PowerShell` 只提供 MSIX（`msixbundle`），不会创建 `%ProgramFiles%\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe`；如需 MSI 应从官方 Release 获取。

discussions.title: 官网下载的windows客户端无法安装
[sandbox-windows-acl] 标准用户 + 非系统盘工作区下 workspace-write 完全不可用：缺少 WRITE_OWNER 导致 grantWrite 失败
discussions.body:
> 说明：本仓库关闭了 Issues（`has_issues = false`），按 README 指引发到 Discussions / General。正文保留了 bug 报告的结构（复现 → 根因 → 证据 → 影响 → 建议）。 ## Environment / 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | DSH | `0.1.7-rc.2` | | OS | Windows 11 23H2 (build `22631.4460`, AMD64)
（注册表 `ProductName` 显示 "Windows 10 Pro"，是微软已知的 Win11 遗留值） | | 账户 | **标准用户（非管理员）**，`IsInRole(Administrator) == false` | | 工作区 | `D:\dsh`（非系统盘） | | 文件策略 | `workspace-write` | | 相关包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.1.7-rc.2` | ## English summary On a **standard (non-admin) Windows account**, if the workspace directory's DACL grants only `Modify` (the common case for directories on non-system drives, inherited as `Authenticated Users: Modify`), the `workspace-write` backend cannot materialize its grant and **every confined shell call fails** — including a command that writes nothing: ``` SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\dsh) ``` The prerequisite is documented in `sandbox-windows-acl`'s "Verified boundaries", but **not in any user-facing README** (`dsh-sandbox`, `dsh-pwsh-sandbox`, `dsh-base`, `dsh-sandbox-policy`), and the error carries no actionable guidance. The result is that users must approve `danger-full-access` for every command, which defeats the purpose of `workspace-write`. ## 摘要 在标准用户账户下，若工作区所在目录的 DACL **只授予 `Modify`**，`workspace-write` 沙箱无法完成授权物化，**每一条受限 shell 命令都会失败**——包括 `pwd` 这种不写任何东西的命令： ``` SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\dsh) ``` 用户看到的现象是：所有命令都必须请求「完整权限」才能执行，等于 `workspace-write` 在该工作区完全不可用。 前提已记录在 `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.md` 的 "Verified boundaries" 一节，但面向用户的文档均未提及，且报错未给出可操作指引。 ## 最小复现 以标准用户身份，在一个 DACL 只授予 `Modify` 的目录上（例如非系统盘根目录下新建的子目录）： ```powershell # 1) 目录权限：所有者是自己，但没有针对自己的显式 ACE $dir = 'D:\repro-ws' New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null (Get-Acl $dir).Owner # => \ (自己就是所有者) (Get-Acl $dir).Access | Where-Object { $_.IdentityReference -like "*$env:USERNAME*" } # => 空 (没有任何针对自己的 ACE) icacls $dir # => NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M) # BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX) ... (只继承了 Modify) # 2) 标签写入失败 —— 这正是 grantWrite 内部的那一步 icacls $dir /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)Low" # D:\repro-ws: Access is denied. # exit code 5 # 3) 补一条显式的 WRITE_OWNER（TakeOwnership） $me = "$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME" $acl = Get-Acl $dir $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule( $me, 'TakeOwnership', 'ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit', 'None', 'Allow'))) Set-Acl -Path $dir -AclObject $acl # 4) 同一操作现在成功 icacls $dir /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)Low" # Successfully processed 1 files; Failed processing 0 files. # exit code 0 ``` **对照组**：对 `%TEMP%` 下新建的目录（用户有继承来的 `FullControl`）执行第 2 步，**直接成功**，无需任何改动。 ## 根因 `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts` 的 `mergeAndApply` 用**一次** `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 同时应用 DACL 与完整性标签（编译产物 `lib/types-*.js`）： ```js const applyResult = api.setNamedSecurityInfoW( path, 1, labelEdit.kind === "keep" ? 4 : 20, // 4 = DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION // 20 = DACL(0x4) | LABEL(0x10) null, null, newAcl, labelEdit.kind === "apply" ? labelEdit.acl : null); ``` 链条如下： 1. 完整性标签存放在 **SACL**；写入它需要对象的 **`WRITE_OWNER`**。 2. 对象所有者隐式获得的只有 **`READ_CONTROL` + `WRITE_DAC`** —— **不含 `WRITE_OWNER`**（这一点 `sandbox-windows-acl` 自己的 README L122 已写明）。 3. `Modify` 的访问掩码是 `0x1301bf`，**不含** `WRITE_OWNER` 位 `0x00080000`。 4. 因此：DACL 那部分本可成功（owner 隐式 `WRITE_DAC`），但标签那部分失败 → 整个调用返回 `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5)`。 这与 `README.md` L122 / `README.zh.md` L122 记录的边界一致： > **被授权目录必须由调用者拥有并授予 `WRITE_OWNER`。** 所有者隐式获得的只有 `READ_CONTROL` 与 `WRITE_DAC`；标签位于 SACL，因此合并应用还需要 `WRITE_OWNER`（完全控制目录——即正常工作区情形——本就具备）。**DACL 只授予 Modify 的目录现在会大声失败，而不是静默跳过隔离。** 即：该边界是**已知且刻意**的，fail-closed 本身正确。问题在于触发条件在真实环境里很常见，而用户完全拿不到解释。 ### 为什么后端无法自行解决 这是权限自举问题：要在目录上获得 `WRITE_OWNER`，本身就需要该目录的 `WRITE_OWNER`，或管理员特权（如 `SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege`）。标准用户在这类目录上两者都没有。 **本帖不主张改成静默跳过隔离**——无法强制执行时失败是正确的取舍。 ## 实测证据 1. **真实会话**：策略 `workspace-write` 下，一条只有 `pwd` 的命令失败： `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\dsh)` 2. **受控 A/B**：上述最小复现。**同一个继承而来的 ACL**，补 `WRITE_OWNER` 前 `exit 5`、补后 `exit 0`。 3. **端到端（走公开 API）**：补齐后直接调用 `AclSandbox`： ```js const sandbox = new AclSandbox({ writableDirs: [ws], tempDir: null, writeSid: workspaceWriteSid(ws), mode: 'workspace-write', }); await sandbox.init(); // OK（修复前此处抛 Win32 5） ``` 随后 spawn 受限子进程： | 目标 | 结果 | |---|---| | 写工作区内 | `exit=0`，文件创建成功 | | 写工作区外 | `exit=3`，`EPERM`，文件未创建 | 说明**隔离本身工作正常**，卡住的只有「授权物化」这一步。 4. **继承行为（有用的 workaround）**：给 `D:\dsh` 补上可继承的 `(OI)(CI)(M,WO)` 后，其**新建子目录自动继承该 ACE，可直接作为工作区使用**，同样通过第 3 项的端到端验证。 ## 影响 - **触发面比文档假设的宽。** 文档称「完全控制目录——即正常工作区情形——本就具备」，但用户很自然会选非系统盘、移动硬盘、其他分区的工作区；这些目录常由盘根以 `Authenticated Users: Modify` 继承而来，标准用户拿不到 `WRITE_OWNER`。 - **后果是整个工作区不可用**，而非部分功能降级。失败发生在每一条命令上（连只读命令也失败，因为授权在进程 spawn 前物化），用户只能不断批准「完整权限」才能干活——等于必须关掉沙箱，与 `workspace-write` 的设计意图正好相反。 - **报错不可操作**：只给出 `Win32 5`，与真实原因（缺少 `WRITE_OWNER`）之间没有任何提示。 ## 建议 **1. 让报错可操作（最小改动，收益最大）** 在 `grantWrite` 失败且错误为 `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED` 时，说明原因并给出一次性修复命令，例如： ``` SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE: 工作区 "D:\dsh" 未向当前用户授予 WRITE_OWNER。 Windows ACL 后端需要它以写入完整性标签（标签位于 SACL）。 该权限无法由 DSH 自行取得；请以你的账户执行一次： $acl = Get-Acl 'D:\dsh' $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule( "$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME",'TakeOwnership','ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit','None','Allow'))) Set-Acl -Path 'D:\dsh' -AclObject $acl ``` **2. 选定工作区时预检** 在物化授权前检查（owner 是否为当前用户、是否存在有效的 `WRITE_OWNER`），在用户选择工作区时就告警，而不是等到第一条命令失败、且只报一个 Win32 码。 **3. 补文档** 把该前提写进**用户可见**的文档（`dsh-sandbox` / `dsh-pwsh-sandbox` / `dsh-base` / `dsh-sandbox-policy` 的 README），而不只是后端包 README 的 "Verified boundaries"。 **4. 可选的自愈（须用户显式确认）** 调用者已是所有者（隐式 `WRITE_DAC`），因此**有能力**改写自己的 DACL——而后端本来就在做 DACL 变更（能力 ACE + `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` 拒绝项）。可在首次遇到该错误时询问用户是否允许为 owner 补一条 `WRITE_OWNER`。 注意这会改变目录的安全语义（允许该用户取得所有权），因此应当**显式选择加入**，不适合默认静默执行。 ## 附：相关文件位置 | 位置 | 内容 | |---|---| | `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts` | `mergeAndApply`：合并 DACL + 标签的单次 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` | | `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.md` L122
`.../README.zh.md` L122 | 已记录的边界：目录须由调用者拥有并授予 `WRITE_OWNER` | | `packages/sandbox/sandbox/README.md` L12 | fail-closed 原则：无法强制执行时以 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` 失败，绝不不受限运行 |

discussions.title: 【DSH 插件升级 0.1.5 → 0.1.7 复盘经验总结】
discussions.body:
折腾了两天才把六个自研插件从 0.1.5 挪到 0.1.7。插件代码一行没写错，是 DSH 单方面换了合同——表面只跳了两个小版本号，实际新增 48 个子包、移除 6 个：设置系统整块重写成了一张表单，会话日志升到 v4 改了消息来源的规矩，还加了版本门禁和插件管理器。官方这轮的动机，一句话概括就是从「能跑」走向「能管」。

真正花时间的地方不是改动多，是五个坑同时埋着，而且前一个会把后一个藏起来。

插件因为版本门禁没加载，那它当然也不会报注入消息时的那个错——等你把门禁放行了，第二个错才冒出来。所以修完版本门禁之后「多出一个错」，不是修坏了，是那个错本来就在、只是被挡着没露头。设置面板的故障也会被门禁同样遮住。我最大的体会就是这条：修完一个别急着宣布完事，得一路验到能正常对话一轮为止。

论坛上已经有不少相关的了。#7654 是升级恢复清单，偏使用者视角；#7850 讲 plugin add 的补齐逻辑和 dump-config 的退出码；#8096 是接口破坏点清单；#7873 是我自己之前写的 settings 迁移专题。这篇想补的是另一半——插件作者手上那张完整的迁移地图，尤其是这几个坑怎么互相遮蔽，以及怎么分清哪些是升级造成的、哪些是自己本来就有的。

五个坑大概是这样。

第一个最直接，启动日志里一行 skipping，说插件和当前 dsh 不兼容，服务照常起、插件不加载。原因是子包版本跟着主包走，插件里 peer 上界要是停在「0.1.0 时代」，DSH 跳到 0.1.7 之后整个区间就作废了。改 peer 区间就行，官方给的 allow-version 只是临时通行证，别当正解。

第二个是网页报 Failed to load plugins。0.1.7 把客户端那个 settingsScope 服务整个删了，不是改名，是删除，换成 configForms。只把 inject 数组里的字符串换掉、不改调用点是没用的，会卡在下一个调用点。最快的一条路是摘掉浏览器端声明，设置页消失但 host 功能全保留；想留住设置页，就得按新契约重写。

第三个更阴，插件都加载成功了、服务也正常，一发消息就报「本轮运行失败」，而服务端日志干干净净。因为这不是启动错误，是每轮注入时的运行时校验——v4 取消了那种「代寄」式的 kind: plugin，要求每个生产者签自己的名字。这里最容易漏的一步是：插件通常靠判断消息来源，把自己注入的内容排除在记忆之外；只改注入点、不改过滤器，就会每轮把召回的内容又写回自己的记忆库，静默污染，一个字都不报。反过来，只喂给模型、不进会话的那些消息不受这个约束，别一起改。

第四个是本地插件软链悬空。本地插件是 link 装的，node_modules 下面那个只是个软链接，源目录一改名或删掉，链接就悬空，启动期报 ENOENT。别对着悬空链接硬排查代码，它根本没被加载。

第五个最值得单独说：插件「激活成功」了，却注册不出下游要的服务，结果一堆官方插件报 pending，而那个提供服务的插件自己不在 pending 列表里。真凶是 DSH 的服务名等于 patch 条目的 id，不是类里声明的。有个第三方插件就是 disable 了官方的 subprocess，却 insert 成 subprocess-windows，服务名对不上，下游六个官方插件全挂。看告警列表时别默认真凶在里面，它往往不在。顺带一个结论：Windows 上现在不需要这类插件了，0.1.7 官方已经把 Win32 支持做进自带运行时——看它 peer 上界停在官方加支持之前就能判断。

还有个陷阱跟升级无关，但很容易浪费半天：同一台机器上同一个包常常有两三份拷贝。有没有 .git 只能决定哪个该提交，不能决定哪个内容更新，这两件事得分开判。我这次两份副本的方向完全相反——一份是陈旧废料，另一份反而含真实的 API 修复，必须逐文件对比才不会丢东西。依赖版本也要连副本一起比：副本源码和正本一样，但 node_modules 里装的是旧版 schemastery，装上去设置面板会静默消失，静态检查一个字都看不出来。

最后一件事。这轮顺手挖出三个既有 bug，都不是升级造成的，是本来就在那儿、被这轮检查照出来的：有个插件的 apply 没接第二个参数，导致配置文件里十三个字段从来没生效过，一直跑的是硬编码默认值；有个插件同步设置时会把用户在 config.json 里的自定义冲回默认；还有一个在库路径为空时仍然建目录，等于在进程当前目录下凭空建了个文件夹。三个的共同点是注释或文档承诺了一件事，代码没做到。

如果你也在迁 0.1.7、或者卡在某个坑上，欢迎说说你遇到的是哪一种——特别是第五类「激活了却不提供服务」的，我怀疑还有别的触发方式。

--- 以下是AI助手提供的技术细节，不关心的可以跳过 ---

一、这轮到底改了什么

| | 0.1.5-rc.1 | 0.1.7-rc.2 | 变化 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 子包数量 | 273 | 278→321 | 新增 48、移除 6 |
| 设置系统 | dsh-settings-file（插件各自存设置） | dsh-settings + configForms（全文一张表） | 整块重构 |
| 会话格式 | v3（插件注入可签「代寄」） | v4（必须签工号） | 改了规矩 |
| 插件治理 | 随便塞 | 加版本门禁 + 插件管理器 | 开始查证件 |
| 代码运行时 | dsh-code-runtime | dsh-ptc-runtime | 同批大动作 |

四条主线：设置系统重构（旧版每个插件各存各的，并发写会静默覆盖丢配置）、会话格式升 v4（旧格式所有插件消息都签「代寄」，分不清生产者，对记忆类插件是致命伤）、加版本门禁、PTC 化（让模型写一段程序一次跑完，省 token）。

二、五个坑：症状 / 真凶 / 修法

坑 A｜启动期被版本门禁拒加载
症状：dsh: skipping profile bundle "<包名>": Error: Plugin X is incompatible with dsh <版本>。措辞是 skipping，服务照常起，只是插件不加载。
真凶：子包版本跟主包走，peer 写成「0.1.0 时代」的上界后整个区间作废。
修法：改 peer 区间。allow-version --accept-risk 只是临时通行证。

坑 B｜网页报 Failed to load plugins
症状：Failed to load plugins / web boot: N entries did not activate / dsh-xxx: pending (waiting for service: settingsScope)。
真凶：settingsScope 被整个删除（全量子包 grep 0 命中），换成 configForms，是契约级重构。
对照：旧 ctx.settingsScope.bind({namespace}) → 新 ctx.configForms.get(条目id)；旧 scope.get() → 新 settings.describe().find(...)；旧 scope.watch(cb) 实时回调 → 新版没有 watch。

坑 C｜一发消息就「本轮运行失败」
症状：format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind。插件加载成功、服务正常，一输入文字就报，服务端日志干净。
真凶：v4 取消共享的 kind: "plugin"，要求每个生产者声明自己。正确写法 source: { kind: "plugin:<名字>", form: "recall" }。
最容易漏的一步：只改注入点、不改自过滤（message.source?.kind === "plugin"），等于每轮把召回块写回自己的记忆库，静默污染，无任何报错。两处都要认新旧两种形态。
反向克制：只喂给模型、不进会话的消息（ctx.llm.stream({messages})）不受约束，别一起改。

坑 D｜插件软链接悬空
症状：启动期 ENOENT。
真凶：link 装的插件 node_modules 下是软链接，源目录被删/改名后悬空。
修法：修链接或重装。别对着悬空链接排查代码。

坑 E｜插件「激活了」却注册不出服务
症状：一堆官方插件 pending (waiting for service: subprocess)，而提供服务的插件自己不在 pending 列表里。
真凶：DSH 服务名 = patch 条目的 id，不是类里声明的（实测 dsh-subprocess-local 源码里 'subprocess' 字符串 0 命中，服务名只能来自 cordis.patch.yml 的 insert[].id）。
反面教材：dsh-win32@0.17.7 disable 了 id: subprocess，却 insert 了 id: subprocess-windows，下游 6 个官方插件全 pending。
判据一句话：disable 的 id 和 insert 的 id 必须相同。
结论：Windows 上不需要这类插件，0.1.7 官方已把 Win32 支持做进 stock 运行时（dsh-subprocess-local 自带 @deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process）。上界不再抬高 = 上游原生修好了，它成冗余。
补充：pending 会级联（ui-deliverables 等 workspaceChanges、permission 等 shell）→ 先按服务名归因，再按依赖链数，别一个个当独立故障修。

三、遮蔽效应（为什么「越修越多错」）

插件因 peer 不兼容被 skipping → 根本不加载 → 不注入 → 坑 C 不报错
→ 一开版本豁免、插件开始加载 → 坑 C 才浮出水面。

「豁免后反而多一个错」不是豁免的锅，是原来就有、被掩盖了。铁律：豁免 ≠ 保证能跑。区分 skipping（拒绝加载，有豁免机制）和 pending（等服务超时，无豁免机制）——后者只能改代码。

四、两条静默失败门禁（保留设置面板时必须读）

任何一条不过，面板都会静默消失——不报错、不打日志。

门禁①：纯具名导出，别用 export default。判据不是「有没有 default」，而是剥壳后那个值身上有没有 Config。cordis-plugin-loader 的剥壳是两段（先剥 default，若是 ESM 再剥一层），所以模块里有 default，Config 就丢了。

门禁②：每个会被前端写入的字段都要标 .volatile()。一个都没有 → 整个条目被过滤。需要 schemastery >= 3.18.4，低版本调用会抛错、模块加载期就崩 → 稳妥做法加降级包装 vol = (s) => (typeof s.volatile === "function" ? s.volatile() : s)。
特别注意数组字段：isVolatilePath 只沿 dict 往下走、不认数组的 inner → z.array(...) 不盖章，前端写它会被直接拒绝（Config field "x" is not volatile）。
别把「不盖章」当成让字段不上表单的开关。

第三条门禁不存在：曾写「结构必须扁平」，是误判，当晚纠正。volatileForm / isVolatilePath 都是递归的，schema 完全可以嵌套。真正限制只在客户端便捷方法 set(field, value) 一次只能写一个一级键；要写嵌套得走底层 mutate(ops) 传路径。而且违反它会显式抛错，本来就不该和①②并列为「静默」门禁。

五、同机多副本陷阱

判据：「有没有 .git」只决定哪个是提交对象，不决定哪个内容更新。流程：① 用 .git + 工作树是否干净定位正本 → ② 逐文件 diff -u → ③ 合并该保留的、丢弃残留 → ④ 再在正本上做升级。
实测两例方向相反：dsh-resume-screening 的副本陈旧（dsh.client 被删、依赖旧版）→ 忽略；dsh-disk-manager 的副本含真实 API 修复 + 一块该丢的临时探针 → 把改进合并进正本。
依赖版本也要连副本一起比：副本源码可能没差，但 node_modules 装的是旧版 schemastery 3.18.2（没有 .volatile()）→ 所有字段盖不上章 → 面板静默消失，静态检查发现不了。

六、顺手挖出的三个既有 bug

| 插件 | 既有 bug | 性质 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh-hold-to-talk | apply(ctx) 没接第二个参数 → cordis.patch.yml 里 13 个字段从来没生效过 | 文档承诺了但代码没做 |
| dsh-disk-manager | fromFlat() 同步设置时把 schema 里没有的字段重置回默认 → 冲掉用户在 config.json 里的自定义 | 同步时顺手覆盖 |
| dsh-screenshot-capture | vaultPath 为空时仍调 ensureVault → join("", "收件箱") 是相对路径 → 在进程 cwd 下凭空建目录 | 注释承诺「绝不创建无关目录」，代码打脸 |

共同特征：注释/文档承诺了某件事，代码实际没做到。这类「承诺与实现不一致」值得专门扫一遍。

七、验证三连（离线可跑，三关各拦一类错，互不替代）

① volatileForm() 复刻 → 拦「铭牌丢失 / 一个字段都没盖章」
② isVolatilePath() 复刻 → 拦「数组类字段漏盖章 → 前端写不进去」
③ fake ctx 实跑 apply → 拦「调用点没改干净 / 导出形态错」
跑之前确认插件目录已装依赖，没装 schemastery 时 import 会直接失败，别当成代码错。

八、作业流程

1. 备份：源目录外建 .backup/<包名>_<日期>/。别把 .bak 放进包内 lib/ —— files:["lib/"] 会把它一起发到 npm。
2. 坑 A：改 peer 区间。
3. 坑 B：删/改 settingsScope。
4. 坑 C：kind:"plugin" → plugin:<名字> + 同步自过滤。
5. 删死代码：调用点删掉后，只被它调用的函数要一起删。
6. 同步文档：README、CHANGELOG、代码里指向已删代码的注释。
7. 同步测试桩：为旧 API 造的假服务若已无人调用，删掉，否则测试在替一个不存在的契约背书。
8. 版本号 + CHANGELOG → 跑测试 → 交接时强调「必须重启 DSH」。

九、最终落地状态（当时版本）

| dsh-hold-to-talk | 0.1.3 | 只有 settings.register 失效；顺带修「config 从没生效」 |

十、沉淀成规矩

1. 升级前先算，别先改。先跑 peer 验算矩阵 + 全量扫描（谁等 settingsScope、谁注入 kind:"plugin"、谁软链悬空），把该改的清单一次列全。
2. 区分 skipping（拒绝加载，有豁免机制）和 pending（等服务超时，无豁免机制），后者只能改代码。
3. 豁免 ≠ 保证能跑。修完 A 一定会暴露 C。
4. 改 source.kind 必须同步改自过滤，只改一半是静默污染，比报错更难发现。
5. 服务名 = patch 条目的 id，不由类声明。看 pending 列表时别默认真凶在里面，它往往不在。
6. pending 会级联，先按服务名归因，再按依赖链数。
7. 先核官方实现，再看第三方自述。第三方的 README 描述的是它诞生时的 DSH，不是现在这个（本轮两次误判都源于此）。
8. 保存设置面板的两条硬门禁：纯具名导出 + 每个可写字段盖章。失败是静默的。
9. 改完必须重启 DSH，启动时才扫描插件声明，link: 本地插件也一样。
10. 别只修升级的坑。顺手照出来的既有 bug，收益往往更大。

It took two days to move six self-built plugins from 0.1.5 to 0.1.7. Not a single line of plugin code was wrong — DSH unilaterally changed the contract. Two minor version numbers apart on the surface, but 48 subpackages added and 6 removed underneath: the settings system was rewritten into a single form, the session log moved to v4 and changed how message provenance is declared, and a version gate plus a plugin manager appeared. The official motivation, in one line: from "it runs" to "it is governed".

What actually cost the time was not the volume of changes, but that five failure modes were planted at once — and each one hid the next.

A plugin skipped by the version gate never loads, so it never reports the message-injection error either. Clear the gate and the second error surfaces. So "fixing A produced a new error" is not a regression: it was always there, just masked. The same masking applies to the settings-panel failure. The lesson I keep: don't declare victory after fixing one thing — verify all the way to a normal conversation turn.

Related threads already exist. #7654 is an upgrade recovery checklist from a user's angle; #7850 covers plugin add's layer reconciliation and dump-config exit codes; #8096 is an interface-breakpoint list; #7873 is my own earlier write-up on the settings migration. This post fills the other half: the complete migration map from a plugin author's side, how these failures mask each other, and how to tell "caused by the upgrade" from "always broken".

The five failures, briefly.

The first is the most direct: a skipping line in the startup log saying the plugin is incompatible with the current dsh. The service still starts; the plugin just doesn't load. Subpackage versions follow the umbrella version, so a peer bound written in the "0.1.0 era" becomes void once DSH jumps to 0.1.7. Fix the peer range. The allow-version escape hatch is a temporary pass, not the answer.

The second shows up in the browser: Failed to load plugins. 0.1.7 deleted the client-side settingsScope service outright — deleted, not renamed — replacing it with configForms. Swapping only the string in the inject array and leaving the call sites is useless; you get stuck at the next call. The fastest route is to drop the browser-side declaration (the settings page disappears, all host features remain). Keeping the settings page means rewriting to the new contract.

The third is nastier: plugins load fine and services are healthy, but sending a message fails with a v4 provenance error, while the server log stays clean. It is not a startup error — it is a per-turn runtime check. v4 retired the shared catch-all kind: plugin and requires each producer to sign its own name. The easiest step to miss: plugins usually filter their own injected content out of memory by checking the message source. Change only the injection site and not the filter, and you quietly write your own recall blocks back into your memory store every turn — silent self-pollution, zero errors. Conversely, messages fed only to the model and never into the session are not subject to this; don't change those too.

The fourth is a dangling symlink. Locally installed plugins use link:, so node_modules/<name> is just a symlink. Rename or delete the source directory and it dangles, producing an ENOENT at startup. Don't debug code against a dangling link — it was never loaded.

The fifth deserves its own paragraph: a plugin "activates successfully" yet fails to register the service downstream expects, so a pile of official plugins report pending — while the plugin providing the service is itself absent from that list. The real cause: DSH's service name equals the patch entry's id, not whatever the class declares. One third-party plugin disabled the official subprocess and inserted subprocess-windows, so the service name mismatched and six official plugins went pending. When reading a pending list, don't assume the culprit is in it — it usually isn't. Related: on Windows this class of plugin is no longer needed; 0.1.7 ships Win32 support in the stock runtime. A peer upper bound that stopped moving is a good signal the package became redundant.

One more trap, unrelated to the upgrade but easily worth half a day: the same package often exists in two or three copies on one machine. Whether a copy has .git decides which one you commit to, not which one is newer — judge those separately. My two copies went opposite ways: one was stale residue, the other actually contained a real API fix. A file-by-file diff is the only safe way. Compare dependency versions too: identical source plus a stale node_modules (schemastery 3.18.2, no .volatile()) makes the settings panel vanish silently, undetectable by static checks.

Finally, three pre-existing bugs surfaced along the way — none caused by the upgrade. One plugin's apply(ctx) never accepted its second parameter, so thirteen fields in the config file had never taken effect; one reset user customisations in config.json back to defaults when syncing settings; one still created a directory when the vault path was empty, materialising a folder in the process's working directory. All three share one trait: a comment or doc promised something the code never did.

If you're migrating to 0.1.7 too, or stuck on one of these, tell me which one — especially the fifth class, "activates but provides no service". I suspect there are other ways to trigger it.

What changed

| | 0.1.5-rc.1 | 0.1.7-rc.2 | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Subpackages | 273 | 278→321 | +48, -6 |
| Settings | dsh-settings-file (per-plugin) | dsh-settings + configForms (one shared form) | Rewritten |
| Session format | v3 (plugins could send "on behalf of") | v4 (each producer signs its own name) | Rules changed |
| Plugin governance | Anything goes | Version gate + plugin manager | Papers, please |
| Code runtime | dsh-code-runtime | dsh-ptc-runtime | Same batch |

Four threads of intent: settings rewritten (per-plugin stores silently overwrote each other on concurrent writes), session format to v4 (the old shared kind made provenance indistinguishable, fatal for memory plugins), a version gate, and a move to PTC.

Five failures: symptom / cause / fix

A — Rejected by the version gate at startup
Symptom: dsh: skipping profile bundle "<name>": Error: Plugin X is incompatible with dsh <version>. Note the wording: skipping. The service starts; the plugin does not load.
Cause: subpackage versions follow the umbrella version; a peer bound written for the 0.1.0 era becomes void.
Fix: update the peer range. allow-version --accept-risk is a temporary pass.

B — Failed to load plugins in the browser
Symptom: Failed to load plugins / N entries did not activate / pending (waiting for service: settingsScope).
Cause: settingsScope was deleted (zero hits across all subpackages), replaced by configForms — a contract-level rewrite.
Mapping: ctx.settingsScope.bind({namespace}) → ctx.configForms.get(entryId); scope.get() → settings.describe().find(...); scope.watch(cb) → no watch at all.

C — Every message fails with a v4 provenance error
Symptom: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind. Plugins loaded, services healthy, failure on the first keystroke; server log clean.
Cause: v4 retired the shared kind: "plugin". Correct form: source: { kind: "plugin:<name>", form: "recall" }.
Easiest miss: change the injection site without the self-filter (message.source?.kind === "plugin") and you write recall blocks back into your own memory store every turn — silent, no errors. Handle both old and new shapes in both places.
Counter-restraint: messages passed only to ctx.llm.stream({messages}) never enter the session and are exempt — don't change them.

D — Dangling plugin symlink
Symptom: ENOENT at startup.
Cause: link: installs are symlinks; renaming or deleting the source directory dangles them.
Fix: repair or reinstall. Don't debug code against a dangling link.

E — Plugin "activates" but registers no service
Symptom: a pile of official plugins pending (waiting for service: subprocess), while the providing plugin is absent from the pending list.
Cause: DSH's service name equals the patch entry's id, not the class's declaration (verified: dsh-subprocess-local has zero hits for 'subprocess' in source; the name can only come from cordis.patch.yml's insert[].id).
Counter-example: dsh-win32@0.17.7 disabled id: subprocess but inserted id: subprocess-windows → six official plugins pending.
Rule: the disabled id and the inserted id must match.
Conclusion: this class of plugin is unnecessary on Windows; 0.1.7 ships Win32 support in the stock runtime (dsh-subprocess-local bundles @deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process). A peer upper bound that stopped moving means upstream fixed it natively and the package is redundant.
Note: pending cascades (ui-deliverables waits on workspaceChanges, permission on shell) — attribute by service name first, then count along the dependency chain; don't treat each as an independent failure.

Masking: why fixing one thing surfaces another

Gate-skipped → never loads → never injects → failure C never fires.
Open an exemption → the plugin loads → C surfaces.

"Opening an exemption produced a new error" is not the exemption's fault: the error was always there, masked. Rule: an exemption is not a guarantee it runs. Also distinguish skipping (refused load, has an exemption mechanism) from pending (service wait timeout, no exemption mechanism — code change required).

Two silent gates (required reading if you keep the settings panel)

Either one failing makes the panel vanish silently — no error, no log.

Gate 1: named exports only; no export default. The test is not "is there a default" but "does the unwrapped value carry Config". cordis-plugin-loader unwraps twice (default first, then another layer for ESM), so any default in the module loses Config.

Gate 2: every front-end-writable field must be marked .volatile(). Zero marked → the whole entry is filtered out. Requires schemastery >= 3.18.4; lower versions throw at module evaluation → use a fallback wrapper: vol = (s) => (typeof s.volatile === "function" ? s.volatile() : s).
Watch array fields in particular: isVolatilePath walks dict only and does not follow an array's inner, so an unmarked z.array(...) is refused outright on write (Config field "x" is not volatile).
Don't treat "not marking" as a way to hide a field from the form.

The third gate does not exist: I once wrote "the schema must be flat" — that was wrong and corrected the same evening. volatileForm and isVolatilePath are both recursive; nesting is fine. The real limit is that the client convenience method set(field, value) writes one top-level key at a time; nested writes go through mutate(ops) with an explicit path. And violating it throws explicitly, so it never belonged alongside gates 1 and 2 as "silent".

Multiple copies on one machine

Whether a copy has .git decides which one you commit to, not which is newer. Flow: locate the canonical copy by .git + clean worktree → diff -u file by file → merge what to keep, discard residue → upgrade the canonical copy.
Two real cases went opposite ways: dsh-resume-screening's copy was stale (client declaration removed, old dependencies) → ignore it; dsh-disk-manager's copy contained a real API fix plus a throwaway probe → merge the fix, discard the probe.
Compare dependency versions too: identical source with a stale node_modules (schemastery 3.18.2, no .volatile()) makes the panel vanish silently — invisible to static checks.

Three pre-existing bugs found along the way

| Plugin | Bug | Nature |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh-hold-to-talk | apply(ctx) never took its second parameter, so 13 fields in cordis.patch.yml had never applied | Documented but not implemented |
| dsh-disk-manager | fromFlat() reset fields absent from the schema back to defaults, wiping user customisations in config.json | Overwrite during sync |
| dsh-screenshot-capture | Still called ensureVault with an empty vaultPath; join("", "inbox") is relative and created a directory in the process cwd | Comment promised never to create stray directories |

Offline verification triple (each catches a different class; none substitutes for another)

1. Reimplement volatileForm() → catches "lost Config" / "no field marked volatile".
2. Reimplement isVolatilePath() → catches "array field unmarked → front-end cannot write".
3. Run apply against a fake ctx → catches "missed call site / wrong export shape".
Install dependencies first; without schemastery the import fails and that is not a code bug.

Per-plugin workflow

1. Back up outside the source tree: .backup/<pkg>_<date>/. Never put .bak inside the package's lib/ — files:["lib/"] ships it to npm.
2. Failure A: update the peer range.
3. Failure B: remove or rewrite settingsScope.
4. Failure C: kind:"plugin" → plugin:<name>, and update the self-filter too.
5. Delete dead code: functions only reachable from removed call sites go with them.
6. Sync docs: README, CHANGELOG, and comments pointing at deleted code.
7. Sync test stubs: fake services built for the old API should go, or the tests vouch for a contract that no longer exists.
8. Bump version + CHANGELOG → run tests → tell the recipient to restart DSH.

Ten rules to keep

1. Compute before you edit. Run the peer matrix and a full scan first (who awaits settingsScope, who injects kind:"plugin", who has a dangling link) and list the whole work order once.
2. Distinguish skipping (refused load, exemptable) from pending (service timeout, not exemptable — code change required).
3. An exemption is not a guarantee it runs. Fixing A will expose C.
4. Changing source.kind requires changing the self-filter; half a change is silent pollution, worse than an error.
5. The service name equals the patch entry's id, not the class's declaration. Don't assume the culprit appears in the pending list.
6. Pending cascades — attribute by service name, then count along the chain.
7. Read the official implementation before the third party's self-description. A third-party README describes the DSH of its birth, not today's. Two misjudgements this round came from this.
8. Two hard gates to keep the settings panel: named exports only, and every writable field marked. Failures are silent.
9. Restart DSH after changes — plugin declarations are scanned at startup, link: installs included.
10. Don't fix only upgrade damage. Pre-existing bugs found along the way usually pay better.

Test environment

DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 (npm), Windows 11, Node 22, web profile. All verification ran in an isolated instance (separate DSH_HOME, port, and node_modules); the daily-driver instance was never touched.

discussions.title: Delfin — a Windows tray for dsh, focused on version & channel management
discussions.body:
**TL;DR** — Delfin is a Windows tray for dsh. Start / stop / restart, open the Web UI with the
token already applied, and — the part I actually built it for — keep a **pinned, swappable local
runtime** for dsh instead of letting `npx` decide which version you end up running.

## The honest part first

I searched this category before posting. There are already several Windows tray launchers for dsh
(#2493, #2351, #4014, #4723, #5644 and more), and they handle start/stop, single-instance and
process cleanup well — some of them go well beyond what I built, and if that's all you need you
should probably use one of those.

What none of them do is *manage the dsh version itself*. That is the problem that made me write
this, so it's the only thing I'll spend words on here.

## The problem: `npx` quietly pins you to a version

I started with the documented one-liner:

```bash
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

`npx` resolves a version once and writes it into its cache. If it resolves to a range like
`^0.1.1-rc.2`, then per semver **prerelease versions only satisfy that range when
major.minor.patch match exactly**. dsh ships `0.1.2-rc.1`, your "update" keeps launching the old
build, and nothing reports an error. You notice much later, usually by accident.

## What Delfin does instead

- Keeps a local managed runtime (`runtime/`, populated via `npm install --save-exact`) —
  `npx` is not in the launch path at all
- Compares the installed version against the npm registry `dist-tags` itself
- Lets you pin a version, and switch channel between `latest` / `next` / `alpha`
- Can roll back — dsh is a developer preview and interfaces move fast
  (`0.1.2` → `0.1.5` took days), so "known good and stay there" turned out to matter more
  to me than "always newest"

Plus the tray basics: a status dot (green = running, red = stopped) with version + PID in the
tooltip, one-click start / stop / restart, and **Open Web UI**, which pulls the tokenised URL out
of the service log before opening the browser — recent dsh versions return 401 on a direct hit.

![Delfin tray menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konmins/delfin/main/assets/tray-menu-en.png)

Also bilingual (English / 中文) menus — visible above.

## How it differs from the other tray projects here

Only in scope, not in quality: the projects above are Windows launchers and desktop shells.
Delfin is a launcher **plus a version manager** for the dsh package itself. If you never think
about which dsh build you're on, you don't need it. (And no relation to `#4014 dsh-tray-windows`
— similar name, different project.)

## Download

Single-file exe from **[Releases](https://github.com/konmins/delfin/releases)** — no installer,
double-click to run. Requires Node.js (that's what runs dsh). Windows 10 / 11 only.

It is **not code signed yet**, so the first run shows SmartScreen's "unknown publisher" prompt —
"More info → Run anyway" gets you past it.

## 中文

Delfin 是给 dsh 做的 Windows 托盘：一键启停/重启、自动带上 token 打开 Web 界面。但发帖前我翻了
这个分类，托盘工具已经有好几个了（#2493 / #2351 / #4014 / #4723 / #5644），所以这里只说它们
**没做**的那部分 —— **dsh 自身的版本管理**。

起因是 `npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 会把解析到的版本锁进缓存：一旦锁成 `^0.1.1-rc.2` 这类范围，
按 semver 规则**预发布版本只有 major.minor.patch 完全相同才满足约束**，于是 dsh 发了新的 rc，
你这边怎么更新都还是旧的，而且不报错。

现在的做法是不走 npx，改用本地受管运行时（`npm install --save-exact`），版本精确锁定、
可在 `latest` / `next` / `alpha` 之间切换、也能回滚。dsh 接口变化快，我觉得「能锁版本」
比「永远最新」更有用。界面中英双语。

仓库：<https://github.com/konmins/delfin>

---

Not affiliated with DeepSeek. The mark in the tray icon is the trademark of its owner and is used
only to indicate compatibility. Feedback and issues are very welcome.

discussions.title: [Plugin] Render Jupyter notebooks in the document preview (.ipynb)
discussions.body:
**Render Jupyter `.ipynb` notebooks in the DSH document preview** — syntax
highlighting, LaTeX math, and zoomable figures, instead of raw JSON.

- Repo: https://github.com/WuShichao/dsh-ipynb-preview
- npm: [`dsh-ipynb-preview`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ipynb-preview)

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-ipynb-preview
```

Then **restart** DSH, not just refresh: the shell computes its client bundle
revision at startup, so a browser refresh alone won't pick up a new plugin.

### What it does

Without it, opening a `.ipynb` shows its JSON source. With it:

- **Syntax highlighting** for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, JSON, Bash, and INI,
  each with its own grammar — Python's `def`/decorators/keywords, Bash's `cd`,
  INI sections and `;` comments, and so on.
- **Real LaTeX** via a vendored KaTeX: inline `$…$` and display `$$…$$`, in
  paragraphs, lists, tables, and blockquotes. The engine *and* its web fonts are
  inlined into the bundle, so rendering makes **no network request**.
- **Zoomable figures.** Click any output figure to open it, then scroll or `+`/`−`
  to zoom continuously, drag to pan, `0` to fit. The zoom readout is truthful:
  200% is exactly twice the fitted size.
- **Save figures**, named after the notebook (`sample-notebook-cell3-out1.png`).
- Streams, `display_data`, `execute_result`, and error tracebacks with ANSI
  escapes stripped.
- Code cells wrap their source lines.

No runtime dependencies, and no configuration.

### Two things I got wrong, in case they save you the same time

Both are now permanent assertions in the repo.

**1. A free variable in a client bundle blanks the whole window.** The shell
materializes the factory inside its module loader; if the factory throws, that row
has no exports and the *entire* client roster fails to load. What you see is a
blank page, not a plugin error — and `node --check` cannot catch it, because the
reference is syntactically valid. `tests/lint-bundle.mjs` now sweeps both the
template and the built artifact for undeclared identifiers.

**2. `z-index: 9999` is not above application chrome.** My lightbox used 9999. A
fixed header with its own stacking context covered the middle of the toolbar, so
the controls only responded to clicks near their edges — which reads as "broken
buttons", not "covered buttons". It is now `2147483000`, plus padding that keeps
the bar clear of a host header.

I also want to flag the testing gap, because it cost me several wrong fixes:
**React's synthetic event system does not work against a hand-written DOM stub.**
A stub-based suite therefore cannot verify click handlers — dispatching a
synthetic event simply never reaches the handler, and the failure tells you
nothing about your plugin. This repo verifies clicks in a **real browser**:
`tests/make-page.mjs` generates a self-contained page that drives the plugin and
writes every interaction to an on-page log, with an `?auto=1` mode that a headless
browser can dump and read back.

### Verification

Everything ships with the repo, runs offline, and uses no test framework:

```sh
pnpm test
```

- `tests/verify.mjs` — materializes the bundle the way the shell's module loader
  does, then checks the manifest contract, the registrations, the highlighter, the
  math renderer, the Markdown subset, the zoom arithmetic, the stylesheet, and a
  full render of a fixture notebook. Around 170 assertions, and the fixture is
  generated so the assertions read their expected counts from it rather than
  hard-coding them.
- `tests/lint-bundle.mjs` — the free-variable sweep described above.
- `tests/mount.mjs` — mounts against a DOM stub so effects and event wiring
  actually run.
- `tests/check-published.mjs` — fetches the **registry tarball**, unpacks it, and
  renders the fixture through the bundle inside it. CI runs this on release tags.

CI is green on Linux, including a check that the committed client artifact is
byte-identical to a fresh build from the template.

Feedback welcome — especially from anyone whose notebook hits a construct the
renderer doesn't handle. The Markdown subset is deliberately small (headings,
lists, tables, blockquotes, fenced code, links, bold and italic, code spans); tell
me what's missing and I'll add it.

discussions.title: 归档的会话怎么删除或者在其他位置集中显示？
把「客户端行可见性」做成一等扩展输入
discussions.body:
> 验证版本：DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（`0.2.0-rc.1` 同结论）。文中符号名均可在官方仓库按 tag `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2` 检索，附录给了链接。

## TL;DR

DSH 客户端**已经**有「这一行该不该显示」的一等概念（`isVisibleChatNode` + 节点的 `visibility` 字段），官方自己就在用它，而且它驱动**四路**派生逻辑。但它对第三方是**封闭**的：插件想控制显示，只能绕过它去写 DOM/CSS——而 DOM 层与那条管线**互相看不见**，于是产生一系列本可避免的不一致。

**请求**：给第三方一个**派生、可重算**的可见性输入，接进既有的 `isVisibleChatNode` 求值点。插件只提供**声明/数据**，渲染与降级仍由 harness 掌握。

---

## 1. 今天 DSH 是怎么决定「什么该显示」的（事实）

**求值点**：`isVisibleChatNode`（`packages/client/ui-chat`，`contract/chat-visibility.ts`）。规则有两层：

- **字段**：`node.visibility === 'visible'`；
- **kind 政策**：排除 `system-prompt`、普通 `context`（但含工具增删通知的 context 保留）、以及 `command: permission`。

**官方自己就在用它**（说明这不是"为插件新造的概念"，而是既有的核心呈现决策）：

| 标记 `visibility: 'hidden'` 的地方 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation-nodes/assistant.ts` | 投影状态缺失时的 assistant 占位节点 |
| `conversation-nodes/tool.ts` | 投影状态缺失时的 tool-call 占位节点 |
| `ui-plan` 的 `submitted-plan` 节点 | 该节点**永远**不直接渲染成行（计划在别处呈现） |

**它驱动四路派生逻辑**（因此可见性不是"视觉细节"，而是派生的输入）：

- `chat-snapshot-builder`：`nodes.filter(isVisibleChatNode)` 之后才生成 `order`；
- `process-groups`：过程分组的合并与组壳收敛；
- `turn-navigation`：上一个/下一个回合的落点；
- `turn-process-presentation`：过程行的呈现。

**DOM 层另有一套**：视口与测量用 `[hidden]` **属性**做选择器（`use-chat-viewport` 的 `:not([hidden])`），也就是说它认的是 HTML 属性，不是 CSS `display`。

**"折叠"是另一件事**：`TurnProcessNodeView` 的 `turnProcess.setOpen(...)` 只是展开状态，与 `isVisibleChatNode` 无关。折叠的行**仍然在**序列、分组与导航里。

**第三方完全没有入口**：客户端插槽里没有与可见性相关的任何注册项（对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的插槽名做过一次宽口径清点：声明 / 注册 / 渲染三态合计 144 项，无一与可见性相关）。

---

## 2. 今天第三方只能怎么做，以及为什么那是错的位置

三条路，都不对：

1. **在 DOM 座位写 `display: none`**（最常见的做法）。问题：harness 看不见它——视口/测量读 `[hidden]`，分组/导航读 `isVisibleChatNode`，于是隐藏的行**仍参与**高度与分页锚点计算、仍被分组视为"有可见成员"（可能留下空的、可展开的组壳）、仍被回合导航当作可落点。
2. **注入 CSS 按类名隐藏**。更糟：CSS Modules 的类名是构建期哈希，等于把依赖钉在生成物上。
3. **替换节点渲染器**（`conversation.chat.node` 是 keyed 槽，复用 key 会替换实现）。这要求插件重建官方 UI，且两个插件无法共存——把"隐藏一行"变成"接管整棵组件"。

**结论**：第三方被迫在**另一个层**（DOM/CSS）实现一个**已经存在于正确层**（快照投影）的概念，两者必然分叉；而且每个插件都要各自复刻一遍官方规则。

---

## 3. 这是真实且多样的需求（与任何单个插件无关）

**用例 A｜"只要结果"的降噪视图**
用户想隐藏思考过程与工具调用过程，只保留用户消息与最终回答。官方今天给的是**折叠**——但如上所述折叠 ≠ 隐藏（行仍在序列/分组/导航里）。要真正"只要结果"，需要**不可见**。

**用例 B｜用户对单条消息的本地忽略**
"这条我不想再看到"——不改日志、不删会话（会话是只追加的）。纯视图诉求，且**必须可撤销**。

**用例 C｜演示 / 共享 / 录屏的敏感内容遮蔽**
对外演示时屏蔽含密钥、内部路径、客户名或 PII 的行。这是**安全相关**的显示控制：让插件直接操作官方组件树并不合适；声明式入口能把"谁渲染、如何降级"留在 harness。

**用例 D｜教学与考核（关键设计约束的证据）**
先隐藏参考答案或后续内容，等学习者提交后再**显示出来**。这条与任何"撤回"类插件无关，却证明了：可见性必须是**可重算、可逆**的派生状态——粘性的"把节点标记为 hidden"从设计上做不到。

**用例 E｜异步派生视图（第二条关键约束）**
翻译插件在译文就位后隐藏原文；或"摘要视图"隐藏明细。可见性随**异步结果到达**变化，因此求值必须能重跑。

**用例 F｜失败与重试的降噪**
隐藏已被自动重试抹平的失败行（`turn-error` / `model-retry`），让用户只看到最终成功路径。

> 这六个用例的共同点：**策略各不相同，但都只需要同一个能力——"这一行在客户端不可见"。** 策略属于插件/用户，能力属于平台。

---

## 4. 为什么做成一等输入**更规范、更正确**

1. **一致性：把三套并存语义收成一套。** 今天"不可见"至少有三种表达：节点 `visibility`（官方）、CSS `display`（第三方）、`[hidden]` 属性（视口）。三者各自为政，分叉是必然而非偶然。
2. **正确性：派生逻辑只应有一份。** 分组、回合导航、过程呈现、快照 `order` 都依赖可见性。第三方绕过它，就等于要求每个插件**重新实现**这些规则，并随 harness 版本漂移各自出错。
3. **契约化：从"猜结构"变成"用类型"。** 官方文档里没有 DOM 锚点契约，任何一次客户端重构都会**静默**破坏第三方插件（用户看到的是"功能莫名消失"，没有任何报错可查）。类型化的注册面能在编译期暴露破坏。
4. **权责：插件给声明，平台掌执行。** 让插件写 DOM 意味着插件必须拥有并操作官方组件树；而"用户看到什么"恰恰是安全相关的显示控制。声明式入口让执行、降级与（必要时）审计都留在 harness。
5. **与官方立场对齐。** `CONTRIBUTING` 明说"深度可定制"、社区包不比官方包次要。若"能加命令、能加工具，但'显示什么'只能猜 DOM"，这个立场在渲染层是打折的。
6. **顺带的性能收益。** DOM 隐藏是"先构建、再藏起来"；快照层可见性让该行**根本不进入** chat 的 `order` 与渲染。


---

> **详细用例、设计约束、替代方案与证据索引见下一条评论。**

discussions.title: [Bug] Three upgrade blockers from 0.1.1-rc.1 to 0.2.0-rc.2, plus a silent plugin-API break (local fixes included)
discussions.body:
## 中文摘要（TL;DR）

从 `0.1.1-rc.1` 升级到 `0.2.0-rc.2`（`639ed01539`）时，我遇到 4 个会导致"服务起不来 / 历史会话打不开 / 界面白屏 / 统计静默失效"的问题，另有 2 个设计层面的疑问。本机升级前就存在的 **83 个**历史会话里，**12 个一度完全打不开**（其中 7 个已由 §2/§3 的补丁修好，5 个见 §6）；`pnpm install` 曾把 launchd 服务打进崩溃循环。下面每个问题都给了现象、根因、我本地的修法（diff 见各节），以及想请教上游的点。

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.0-rc.2** (`639ed01539`), upgrading from `0.1.1-rc.1` (`5c5b13ad25`); 7358 commits skipped
- macOS arm64, Node v26.5.0, pnpm 11.7.0, run **from a source checkout** (launchd → `pnpm dsh web`, `tsx` on `src`, so a `src` edit only needs a restart)
- web profile with local plugins; one plugin uses `ctx.shell` (see §5)
- ~85 existing Session files written by `0.1.1-rc.1`, plus the default team/tooling git hooks in `.git/dsh-hooks/`

---

## 1. `install-lefthook` fails on a third-party hook entry → `postinstall` fails → launchd crash loop

**Severity: high (service cannot start).**

`pnpm install` (post-install) aborted with:

```
install-lefthook: refusing to overwrite non-regular or multiply linked hook entry ".../.git/dsh-hooks/post-commit"
Command failed with exit code 1
```

`post-commit` / `prepare-commit-msg` there were **not** created by DSH — they are symlinks installed by unrelated local tooling. Because the failure happens inside `postinstall`, the install aborts, the web service never comes up, and launchd `KeepAlive` restarts it in a loop (the log grew to 400+ lines of the same crash).

**Root cause**: `scripts/install-lefthook.mjs` treats *every* existing entry in the shared hooks directory as one it must own, and refuses to continue when it finds one it cannot replace.

**Local fix**: only strictly validate the hooks DSH declares (`pre-commit`, `pre-merge-commit`, `pre-push`); warn and skip anything else.

```diff
diff --git a/scripts/install-lefthook.mjs b/scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
index 653fa2c8dd..59bdfd1fcd 100644
--- a/scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
+++ b/scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
@@ -27,6 +27,13 @@ const INSTALL_LOCK_INITIALIZATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000
 const INSTALL_LOCK_POLL_MS = 50
 const ALLOW_HOOKS_PATH_OVERRIDE = 'DSH_LEFTHOOK_ALLOW_HOOKS_PATH_OVERRIDE'
 const REPOSITORY_EXTENSION_PATTERN = '^extensions\\.'
+
+// Only the hooks `lefthook.yml` declares are rewritten by `lefthook install
+// --force`. Any other entry in the shared hooks directory belongs to a
+// third-party hook manager (for example a team compliance tool): leave it
+// untouched and warn instead of failing the whole installation.
+// Keep this list aligned with the hook keys declared in lefthook.yml.
+const MANAGED_HOOK_NAMES = new Set(['pre-commit', 'pre-merge-commit', 'pre-push'])
 function errorCode(error) {
   return typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error
     ? error.code
@@ -516,6 +523,12 @@ function inspectOwnedHooksDirectory(hooksPath) {
   for (const name of readdirSync(hooksPath)) {
     if (name === OWNERSHIP_MARKER) continue
     const entryPath = join(hooksPath, name)
+    if (!MANAGED_HOOK_NAMES.has(name)) {
+      console.warn(
+        `[install-lefthook] leaving ${JSON.stringify(entryPath)} untouched (not managed by lefthook.yml)`,
+      )
+      continue
+    }
     const entryStat = lstatSync(entryPath)
     if (!entryStat.isFile() || entryStat.isSymbolicLink() || entryStat.nlink !== 1) {
       throw new Error(
diff --git a/scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts b/scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts
index e0717dae76..3b1e9e7b41 100644
--- a/scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts
+++ b/scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts
@@ -492,6 +492,23 @@ syncBuiltinESMExports()
     }
   })
 
+  it.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32')('leaves third-party hook entries alone instead of failing the install', async () => {
+    const fixture = createFixture()
+    const first = await runInstaller(fixture, fixture.main)
+    expect(first.status, first.stderr).toBe(0)
+    const foreignHook = join(hooksPath(fixture, fixture.main), 'post-commit')
+    const externalTarget = join(fixture.container, 'team-hook.sh')
+    write(externalTarget, '#!/bin/sh\necho team\n')
+    symlinkSync(externalTarget, foreignHook)
+    const externalContent = readFileSync(externalTarget, 'utf8')
+
+    const result = await runInstaller(fixture, fixture.main)
+
+    expect(result.status, result.stderr).toBe(0)
+    expect(readFileSync(externalTarget, 'utf8')).toBe(externalContent)
+    expect(readFileSync(foreignHook, 'utf8')).toBe(externalContent)
+  })
+
   it('restores the marker-backed stale hook path when relocation reinstall fails', async () => {
     const fixture = createFixture()
     const oldRoot = fixture.main
```

**Ask**: would you accept narrowing this guard? A third-party entry in `.git/dsh-hooks/` seems like a normal state for anyone who also runs other hook tooling, and the current behaviour turns it into an unbootable service.

---

## 2. v0→v1 migration refuses Sessions written by `0.1.1-rc.1` (frozen disposition list)

**Severity: high (history unreadable).** 71 of 83 old Sessions were refused.

Opening an old Session fails with (abridged):

```
... refuses this format v0 Session: ...; source v0 artifact remains unchanged
```

**Root cause**: the v0 restriction list in `dispositions.ts` is derived from what the **current** source writes. `0.1.1-rc.1` wrote a member that upstream later **removed** (`origin` on `permission/preset`), so a released artifact is judged invalid by a *newer* build.

**Local fix**: accept the released-v0 member as optional.

```diff
diff --git a/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/dispositions.ts b/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/dispositions.ts
index 24702e8bb1..1bab4b2f90 100644
--- a/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/dispositions.ts
+++ b/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/dispositions.ts
@@ -73,7 +73,10 @@ export const RELEASED_V0_EVENT_DISPOSITIONS: Readonly<Record<string, ReleasedV0P
   ),
   'llm/retry-started': disposition(['retryId', 'turn', 'step', 'retry']),
   'model/selection': disposition(['provider', 'model'], ['reasoningEffort']),
-  'permission/preset': disposition(['preset']),
+  // `origin` is optional: 0.1.1-rc.1 wrote it for every selection, upstream later
+  // reverted the field, but released v0 corpora still carry it — accepting it as an
+  // optional member keeps those Sessions readable instead of refusing them.
+  'permission/preset': disposition(['preset'], ['origin']),
   'plan/mode': disposition(['active']),
   'request/context': disposition(['provider', 'model'], ['contextWindow']),
   'request/header': disposition(['header', 'reason'], ['startsSeries']),
```

**Ask**: should the frozen v0 list be driven by **released artifacts** (what old versions actually wrote) rather than by current source? That would make upgrades forward-compatible by construction.

---

## 3. One malformed `agent/inbox/spliced.inserted` member refuses the whole Session

**Severity: high.** After §2, 7 Sessions still failed; each contained **exactly one** bad member.

**Detail**: the released-v0 validator requires every member of `inserted` to be a message record. Third-party hook tooling wrote an **array** in one place, which is sufficient to refuse the entire Session.

**Local fix**: drop only members that cannot be interpreted, log one warning per affected event, migrate the rest.

```diff
diff --git a/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/migration.ts b/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/migration.ts
index 0a4ead8bcf..a57b0fa955 100644
--- a/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/migration.ts
+++ b/packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/migration.ts
@@ -95,13 +95,45 @@ function normalizeReleasedV0Event(
   const steering = normalizeLegacySteering(header, sessionId)
   const retry = normalizeLegacyRetry(steering, sessionId, state.retryIds)
   const compaction = normalizeLegacyCompaction(retry, sessionId, state)
-  const message = normalizeLegacyMessage(compaction, sessionId, state.messageIds)
+  const spliced = normalizeLegacySplicedInserted(compaction, sessionId)
+  const message = normalizeLegacyMessage(spliced, sessionId, state.messageIds)
   if (message.type !== 'assistant/chunk') assertReleasedEventPayload(message, 0)
   const messageId = eventMessageId(message)
   if (messageId !== undefined) state.messageIds.set(message.seq, messageId)
   return message
 }
 
+/**
+ * Drop `agent/inbox/spliced` members that cannot be read as released-v0 messages.
+ *
+ * Third-party hook tooling has written a message's content-block array where a whole
+ * message object belongs. Members that carry neither an `id` nor a `role` are
+ * uninterpretable, so the splice keeps its readable members and reports the drop
+ * rather than refusing the entire Session.
+ */
+function normalizeLegacySplicedInserted(
+  event: SessionFormatEvent,
+  sessionId: string,
+): SessionFormatEvent {
+  if (event.type !== 'agent/inbox/spliced') return event
+  const data = releasedV0Record(event.data, `${event.type} ${event.seq} data`)
+  const inserted = data['inserted']
+  if (!Array.isArray(inserted)) return event
+  const retained = inserted.filter(member => isReleasedV0MessageShaped(member))
+  if (retained.length === inserted.length) return event
+  console.warn(
+    `[session-format-v0-to-v1] Session ${sessionId} ${event.type} ${event.seq}: dropped `
+    + `${String(inserted.length - retained.length)} uninterpretable inserted member(s)`,
+  )
+  return { ...event, data: { ...data, inserted: retained } }
+}
+
+function isReleasedV0MessageShaped(member: SessionFormatJsonValue): boolean {
+  if (typeof member !== 'object' || member === null || Array.isArray(member)) return false
+  const message = member as SessionFormatJsonObject
+  return typeof message['id'] === 'string' && typeof message['role'] === 'string'
+}
+
 function normalizeLegacyCompactionType(event: SessionFormatEvent): SessionFormatEvent {
   const type: string = event.type
   switch (type) {
```

**Ask**: what is the intended policy for `inserted`? Refusing a whole Session over one uninterpretable member seems disproportionate — a skip-with-warning path would keep history readable.

---

## 4. SPA shell is served with a cacheable response → blank page after upgrade

**Severity: medium (UI appears broken until a hard refresh).** The static entry returned `303 → 200` with a cacheable shell, so the browser kept pointing at a stale `assets/index-*.js` from the previous build.

**Local fix**: serve the SPA shell with `cache-control: no-cache`.

```diff
Subject: [PATCH] fix(frontend-static): serve the SPA shell with cache-control:
 no-cache

index.html responses carry no cache-control header, so browsers (Safari in particular) fall back to heuristic caching and can pin a stale shell after a reboot. Its hashed asset URLs then resolve against already-revved (or removed) bundles and the page blanks until a hard refresh. Serve the dist root and configured index path with `cache-control: no-cache`; hashed assets stay header-free since their filenames are immutable.

Adds a regression assertion to the frontend-static spec.
---
 packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts        | 15 +++++++++++++--
 .../frontend-static/tests/frontend-static.spec.ts | 14 ++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 27 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts b/packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts
index 1afd319906..74c72a27ff 100644
--- a/packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts
+++ b/packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts
@@ -3,7 +3,9 @@
  * fallback seat: serves the built frontend directory with explicit index
  * entry points. A readable index renders at the dist root and configured index
  * path; missing paths return 404, traversal outside the dist root is 403,
- * unknown extensions ship as octet-stream, and non-GET/HEAD is 405. Every
+ * unknown extensions ship as octet-stream, non-GET/HEAD is 405, and index
+ * responses ship cache-control: no-cache so heuristic caches cannot pin a
+ * stale shell. Every
  * index response runs through the webserver's index render (structured
  * injection rows, then raw taps). The dist location is workspace knowledge of
  * the composing application, so `distIndex` is typically supplied through a
@@ -76,10 +78,17 @@ export async function serveStatic(
   }
   let body: string | Buffer
   let type: string
+  let cacheControl: string | undefined
   try {
     if (target === distRoot || target === distIndex) {
       body = await renderIndex()
       type = HTML_MIME
+      // The SPA shell must never live in a heuristic cache: without an explicit
+      // policy, browsers (Safari in particular) may pin a stale index.html and
+      // then resolve its hashed asset URLs against already-revved (or removed)
+      // bundles — blanking the page until a hard refresh. Hashed assets below
+      // are immutable-by-name and need no cache header.
+      cacheControl = 'no-cache'
     } else {
       body = await readFile(target)
       type = MIME[extname(target)] ?? 'application/octet-stream'
@@ -92,7 +101,9 @@ export async function serveStatic(
     res.end()
     return
   }
-  res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': type })
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'content-type': type }
+  if (cacheControl !== undefined) headers['cache-control'] = cacheControl
+  res.writeHead(200, headers)
   res.end(body)
 }
 
diff --git a/packages/host/frontend-static/tests/frontend-static.spec.ts b/packages/host/frontend-static/tests/frontend-static.spec.ts
index fda9dcbc3e..2c98ee2cc7 100644
--- a/packages/host/frontend-static/tests/frontend-static.spec.ts
+++ b/packages/host/frontend-static/tests/frontend-static.spec.ts
@@ -84,6 +84,12 @@ async function request(port: number, path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<
   }
 }
 
+/** GET one path and return its cache-control header value, if any. */
+async function cacheControl(port: number, path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<string | null> {
+  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${String(port)}${path}`, init)
+  return response.headers.get('cache-control')
+}
+
 describe('real Loader composition', () => {
   it('serves explicit index entries and files while preserving HTTP error semantics', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
     const loaded = await loadComposition()
@@ -129,6 +135,14 @@ describe('real Loader composition', () => {
     untap()
     expect((await request(port, '/')).body).not.toContain('__T__')
 
+    // The shell ships no-cache so heuristic caches (Safari) cannot pin a stale
+    // index.html whose hashed asset URLs then 404/blank the page; hashed
+    // assets stay header-free (immutable-by-name).
+    expect(await cacheControl(port, '/')).toBe('no-cache')
+    expect(await cacheControl(port, '/index.html')).toBe('no-cache')
+    expect(await cacheControl(port, '/?fixture')).toBe('no-cache')
+    expect(await cacheControl(port, '/app.js')).toBeNull()
+
     // A missing configured index follows the same empty-404 contract for both
     // of its public entry paths and for both supported methods.
     await rm(join(root!, 'dist', 'index.html'))
-- 
2.50.1 (Apple Git-155)
```

---

## 5. Plugin API: `ShellExecutor.run()` → `execute()`, and the breakage is invisible

**Severity: high for plugin authors** — this one cost me hours of debugging, because **no error was visible anywhere**.

In 0.2.0 the shell service converged on a single method (`d6bebc5783 feat(shell): converge on execute() and promote timed-out commands to jobs`):

```js
// before
const result = await ctx.shell.run(ctx.shell.resolve({ command: 'node', args: [...] }))
// after
const handle = await ctx.shell.execute(ctx.shell.resolve({ command: 'node', args: [...] }))
const result = await handle.result()
```

A plugin still calling `run()` throws `TypeError`. In a plugin hook (`tools/pre-execute`, `tools/post-execute`, `agent/turn-stopping`) that throw happened inside the plugin's own `try`, was reported through `ctx.logger.warn`, and **that output goes nowhere I could find**: nothing in the app log, nothing on stdout/stderr, no startup failure, and no "entry did not activate" warning. Every hook silently became a no-op, and the tool ran fine from the user's point of view. I only found it by timestamping the plugin's output files.

**Suggestions** (any one of these would have saved the day):
1. keep a deprecated `run()` shim for one release that forwards to `execute()` — a one-line wrapper would have kept every plugin working;
2. make plugin hook failures **visible** (stderr, a startup log line, or a UI warning) — a swallowed `logger.warn` is indistinguishable from success;
3. document removed/changed plugin API in the release notes (or a `MIGRATION` section).

**Question**: is there a supported way for a plugin to *detect* the shell API version at runtime (short of `typeof` probing)? A capability probe is what I ended up writing, but it feels like something the host should expose.

---

## 6. Sessions with `subagent/descriptor` version 2 are hard-refused

5 Sessions in my data (created 2026-09-15 / 2026-09-23, all in one workspace) fail validation with `subagent/descriptor version: 2` and cannot be opened at all. I have deliberately **not** patched this one, because I could not tell whether v2 is a valid-but-unmigrated format or genuinely corrupt. If it is the former, could it get a migration path (or at least an error message that says what to do)?

---

## What I am asking for

`CONTRIBUTING.md` says external PRs are not accepted, so I am posting these here instead. All patches above are local commits on my checkout; if a different form is more useful to you (a gist, a patch series attached to a reply, or a repo I can point you at), tell me which and I will package it that way.

Thanks — 0.2.0 is otherwise a smooth upgrade for me, and the Session-format migration machinery saved 71 of my old Sessions despite the two guard problems above.
