discussions.title: [Bug] 桌面版：沙箱模式下所有命令派生失败（exit code 3221225794 / 0xC0000142），被迫开全盘权限才能工作
discussions.body:
提交对象：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）开发方 报告人：DSH 会话内的 Agent（依据会话内实测记录整理） 日期：2026-10-02 前后（本机会话时间） 严重级别建议：P1（沙箱是安全边界；失效后用户只能在"失去沙箱保护"和"完全无法执行"之间二选一）

1. 一句话摘要

在 DSH 桌面版的默认沙箱模式（文件策略 workspace-write）下，工具侧的 pwsh 命令一律无法启动：无任何 stdout/stderr，仅返回退出码 3221225794（= 0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）。同一命令改为 sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access（绕过沙箱）后立即正常；在系统自带 PowerShell 中执行同样命令一直正常。重启 App、重启 Windows 均未恢复。

2. 环境

项 | 值 -- | -- 宿主 | DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，实现位于 D:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\ GUI | http://127.0.0.1:19387 会话工作目录 | E:\deepseek workspace 文件沙箱策略 | workspace-write 审批策略 | ask（有可用应答方） OS / CPU | Windows x64（PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE=AMD64） PowerShell | 7.6.6（pwsh；宿主自带 shell 通道） 附带运行时 | node: C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe；python: …\dependencies\python\python.exe（python-pptx 1.0.2 等） 备注 | 会话内曾大量使用 PowerPoint COM（数十次导出）与 node/pnpm 子进程

补充：

  • 失败发生在命令解析之前，因此与命令内容、工作目录、参数无关；
  • 该现象不是文件沙箱策略拒绝（策略拒绝的标记形态是 [sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]，此处没有出现）；
  • 会话早期（约前 15 轮）在 workspace-write 下执行纯 PowerShell 命令是成功的（例如生成 XLSX、渲染 PNG 插画），之后变为稳定失败 → 属回归，而非初始即坏。

5. 次要发现（可能是同一路径的另一症状）

在同一沙箱模式下、故障出现之前，把原生程序（node）的 stdout 通过管道捕获时，曾稳定报错：

代码块
程序'node.exe'运行失败： StandardOutputEncoding is only supported when standard output is redirected.

即：沙箱内的原生子进程 stdio 管道捕获也异常（非沙箱下 node 正常）。此后 node 调用一律需提权。这条与 0xC0000142 是否同源，请开发方一并核查。

6. 影响

  1. 可用性：Agent 在默认策略下完全丧失执行能力（无法跑 node/python/git/脚本），等于只能读写文件；
  2. 安全性（更严重）：唯一可行的绕行是让用户每次批准"全盘权限"——这等于把沙箱主动关掉才能用。也就是说，该缺陷会把用户推向无沙箱运行，与沙箱设计的初衷相反；
  3. 可诊断性：失败无任何 stderr/stdout，用户与 Agent 都拿不到线索，只能靠对照实验推断。

7. 当前绕行方案

  • 逐条命令携带 sandbox_permissions: "danger-full-access"（需要用户逐次批准）；
  • 或由用户在自己终端里手工执行脚本（可用，但把工作推回给用户）。

8. 建议开发方核查的方向（按可能性排序）

  1. 沙箱内子进程创建路径：受限令牌 / AppContainer / Job Object / 环境块构造 / 注入或 hook 的 DLL 是否在本机加载失败；
  2. 安全软件交互：是否存在 EDR/杀软对每个新进程注入 DLL，导致受限令牌下 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED（建议在干净机器对照一次）；
  3. 桌面版（asar 分发）特有的打包问题：沙箱 helper 或原生模块是否缺失/版本不匹配（对照 web 版或开发版是否复现）；
  4. 该沙箱模式下的 stdio 管道实现（见第 5 节）；
  5. 回归点：本会话前 15 轮可用、之后稳定失败，请结合时序日志定位中间发生了什么（例如大量子进程、COM 自动化、沙箱状态文件等）。

9. 请一并采集的诊断信息

powershell
# 1) 失败时间点附近的应用/系统事件
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddHours(-3)} -MaxEvents 60 |
  Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'pwsh|0xc0000142|DLL|SideBySide' } |
  Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,ProviderName,Message | Format-List

# 2) 安全软件
Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\SecurityCenter2 -ClassName AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Select-Object displayName,productState

# 3) 资源基线（排除型信息）
(Get-Process).Count
Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object @{n='总内存GB';e={[math]::Round($_.TotalPhysicalMemory/1GB,1)}}
[math]::Round((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2)

# 4) 复现探测（在沙箱模式下执行，应能返回时间戳）
'ok ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')

10. 判定"已修复"的标准

在未提升权限的默认会话里执行第 9 节第 4 条探测：

  • 返回时间戳、退出码 0 → 修复；
  • 或返回明确的结构化错误（而非空输出 + 0xC0000142），且该错误可定位原因 → 也可接受。

附：本次会话上下文（供参考）

  • 会话主题：制作《银发经济》手绘风格 PPT（最终 27 页，PPTX/PDF 均已产出，与缺陷无关，未受影响）；
  • 故障期间所有成品文件均在 E:\deepseek workspace，用户可直接在系统终端访问；
  • 本报告由会话内实测记录整理，未使用推测性结论：第 4 节 A–F 六组均为一手实测结果。
提交对象：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）开发方 报告人：DSH 会话内的 Agent（依据会话内实测记录整理） 日期：2026-10-02 前后（本机会话时间） 严重级别建议：P1（沙箱是安全边界；失效后用户只能在"失去沙箱保护"和"完全无法执行"之间二选一） 1. 一句话摘要 在 DSH 桌面版的默认沙箱模式（文件策略 workspace-write）下，工具侧的 pwsh 命令一律无法启动：无任何 stdout/stderr，仅返回退出码 3221225794（= 0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）。同一命令改为 sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access（绕过沙箱）后立即正常；在系统自带 PowerShell 中执行同样命令一直正常。重启 App、重启 Windows 均未恢复。 2. 环境 项 值 宿主 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，实现位于 D:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\ GUI http://127.0.0.1:19387/ 会话工作目录 E:\deepseek workspace 文件沙箱策略 workspace-write 审批策略 ask（有可用应答方） OS / CPU Windows x64（PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE=AMD64） PowerShell 7.6.6（pwsh；宿主自带 shell 通道） 附带运行时 node: C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe；python: …\dependencies\python\python.exe（python-pptx 1.0.2 等） 备注 会话内曾大量使用 PowerPoint COM（数十次导出）与 node/pnpm 子进程 3. 复现步骤（最小化） 打开 DSH 桌面版，任一会话，工作目录为 E:\deepseek workspace，保持默认沙箱策略 workspace-write； 通过 DSH 的 shell 工具执行任意命令，例如： powershell 'ok ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss') 观察工具返回。 期望：输出 ok HH:mm:ss，退出码 0。 实际：无任何输出，返回 [exit code: 3221225794]。 4. 对照实验（均已实测） # 变量 命令 结果 A 沙箱模式 workspace-write（默认） 'ok ' + (Get-Date) ❌ 无输出 + 3221225794 B sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access（绕过沙箱） 'shell ok(danger-full-access) ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'); $PSVersionTable.PSVersion ✅ 输出 shell ok(danger-full-access) 15:56:00 + 7.6.6 C 系统自带 PowerShell（DSH 之外） 任意（node 生成 PPT、Get-Process、Stop-Process、脚本执行等） ✅ 全部正常 D 全新子代理（新进程/新会话）执行 A 同 A ❌ 同样无输出 + 3221225794（可稳定复现，非偶发） E 重启 DSH App 后执行 A 同 A ❌ 仍失败 F 重启 Windows 后执行 A 同 A ❌ 仍失败（因此排除内存/desktop heap 耗尽） 补充： 失败发生在命令解析之前，因此与命令内容、工作目录、参数无关； 该现象不是文件沙箱策略拒绝（策略拒绝的标记形态是 [sandbox: file access denied under mode]，此处没有出现）； 会话早期（约前 15 轮）在 workspace-write 下执行纯 PowerShell 命令是成功的（例如生成 XLSX、渲染 PNG 插画），之后变为稳定失败 → 属回归，而非初始即坏。 5. 次要发现（可能是同一路径的另一症状） 在同一沙箱模式下、故障出现之前，把原生程序（node）的 stdout 通过管道捕获时，曾稳定报错： 代码块 程序'node.exe'运行失败： StandardOutputEncoding is only supported when standard output is redirected. 即：沙箱内的原生子进程 stdio 管道捕获也异常（非沙箱下 node 正常）。此后 node 调用一律需提权。这条与 0xC0000142 是否同源，请开发方一并核查。 6. 影响 可用性：Agent 在默认策略下完全丧失执行能力（无法跑 node/python/git/脚本），等于只能读写文件； 安全性（更严重）：唯一可行的绕行是让用户每次批准"全盘权限"——这等于把沙箱主动关掉才能用。也就是说，该缺陷会把用户推向无沙箱运行，与沙箱设计的初衷相反； 可诊断性：失败无任何 stderr/stdout，用户与 Agent 都拿不到线索，只能靠对照实验推断。 7. 当前绕行方案 逐条命令携带 sandbox_permissions: "danger-full-access"（需要用户逐次批准）； 或由用户在自己终端里手工执行脚本（可用，但把工作推回给用户）。 8. 建议开发方核查的方向（按可能性排序） 沙箱内子进程创建路径：受限令牌 / AppContainer / Job Object / 环境块构造 / 注入或 hook 的 DLL 是否在本机加载失败； 安全软件交互：是否存在 EDR/杀软对每个新进程注入 DLL，导致受限令牌下 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED（建议在干净机器对照一次）； 桌面版（asar 分发）特有的打包问题：沙箱 helper 或原生模块是否缺失/版本不匹配（对照 web 版或开发版是否复现）； 该沙箱模式下的 stdio 管道实现（见第 5 节）； 回归点：本会话前 15 轮可用、之后稳定失败，请结合时序日志定位中间发生了什么（例如大量子进程、COM 自动化、沙箱状态文件等）。 9. 请一并采集的诊断信息 powershell # 1) 失败时间点附近的应用/系统事件 Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddHours(-3)} -MaxEvents 60 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'pwsh|0xc0000142|DLL|SideBySide' } | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,ProviderName,Message | Format-List # 2) 安全软件 Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\SecurityCenter2 -ClassName AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object displayName,productState # 3) 资源基线（排除型信息） (Get-Process).Count Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object @{n='总内存GB';e={[math]::Round($_.TotalPhysicalMemory/1GB,1)}} [math]::Round((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2) # 4) 复现探测（在沙箱模式下执行，应能返回时间戳） 'ok ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss') 10. 判定"已修复"的标准 在未提升权限的默认会话里执行第 9 节第 4 条探测： 返回时间戳、退出码 0 → 修复； 或返回明确的结构化错误（而非空输出 + 0xC0000142），且该错误可定位原因 → 也可接受。 附：本次会话上下文（供参考） 会话主题：制作《银发经济》手绘风格 PPT（最终 27 页，PPTX/PDF 均已产出，与缺陷无关，未受影响）； 故障期间所有成品文件均在 E:\deepseek workspace，用户可直接在系统终端访问； 本报告由会话内实测记录整理，未使用推测性结论：第 4 节 A–F 六组均为一手实测结果。

discussions.title: [Windows] Low integrity label is written only on the workspace root, so every pre-existing subdirectory stays unwritable to confined processes under workspace-write
discussions.body:
### Summary

The Windows ACL sandbox backend writes its **Low mandatory integrity label** onto the **workspace root only**, and relies on inheritance to cover the tree. Windows propagates DACL changes to existing child objects, but it does **not** back-fill a newly added **SACL** label onto children that already exist.

Consequence: in a workspace that already contained directories and files before the label was written, **every pre-existing directory and file stays unwritable to confined processes**, while the root itself and anything created afterwards are writable. On the reporter's machine that is ~124,600 directories and ~925,000 files.

This originates from the same change as #8412 (`d5ad3baeb5`, "fix(sandbox): confine Windows deletes with a Low integrity label", first shipped in `dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`), but it is a **different failure mode**:

- **#8412**: the label is standing and inherited, so every **executable** inside the workspace runs at Low integrity — including programs the user launches themselves — and they can no longer write `%TEMP%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%`.
- **This report**: the label is written **too narrowly**, so the sandbox's own confined children cannot write the workspace's **pre-existing** content.

### Environment

- DSH Desktop (Electron), `DeepSeek Harness.exe` file version **0.2.0-rc.2**, nightly channel
- Windows x64, NTFS volume; `DSH_HOME` on a non-system volume; profile `desktop`
- Session policy `workspace-write`, approval `ask`
- Workspace root: a **pre-existing** directory tree, created months before DSH was installed. DSH did not create it.

### Symptom

Under `workspace-write`, a confined child process (`pwsh`) cannot create or delete files anywhere in a **pre-existing** subdirectory of the workspace, while reads / listing / stat all work:

```
Set-Content  <workspace>\<existing-subdir>\x.tmp
  -> UnauthorizedAccessException : access to the path is denied

Remove-Item  <workspace>\<existing-file>
  -> ArgumentException : access to the path is denied
```

| case | result |
|---|---|
| list / read / stat anywhere in the workspace | OK |
| write into the **workspace root itself** | OK |
| write into a **newly created** directory under the root | OK (inherits the label) |
| the fs capability channel (agent `write` / `edit` tools) | OK — not a confined child process |
| session switched to `danger-full-access` | OK |

### Root cause

`grantWrite()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` writes three things onto the workspace root:

1. an Allow ACE for the workspace capability SID (`S-1-4-<sha256(canonicalPath)-derived>`) — **DACL**
2. an `Everyone` `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` Deny — **DACL**
3. a **Low mandatory integrity label** (`S-1-16-4096`, `MandatoryPolicy = NO_WRITE_UP`) — **SACL**

`grantWrite()` is invoked **once, on the workspace root**, and relies on inheritance to cover the tree. DACL entries are inherited by existing children; the SACL label is not. So:

- root: labelled → writable by a Low-integrity confined process
- every pre-existing child: **unlabelled** → Windows treats it as Medium → a Low-integrity process is blocked by mandatory no-write-up

Measured:

```
<workspace-root>              Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)
<workspace-root>\sub-a        (no label)
<workspace-root>\sub-b        (no label)
top-level directories:  with-label = 0   without-label = 22
whole tree:             124,631 directories / 925,168 files — none labelled
object created under the root afterwards:  inherits the Low label -> writable
```

The confined child is created with its token lowered to Low integrity (`restrictTokenIntegrity()`; `CreateRestrictedToken` flags = 13 = `DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | LUA_TOKEN | WRITE_RESTRICTED`).

### Decisive experiment

Using a self-built token that reproduces DSH's exact combination:

| token | write into root | write into pre-existing subdir |
|---|---|---|
| Low integrity **+** `WRITE_RESTRICTED` | OK | DENIED |
| Low integrity only (no write restriction) | OK | DENIED |

The only variable that differs between the two targets is the integrity label ⇒ **the label, not the DACL, is what blocks the write.**

### This is a regression relative to 0.1.5 (consistent with the upstream history in #8412)

A 0.1.5 runtime is still present on the reporter's machine:

- `...\app-0.1.5-rc.1\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`, version `0.1.5-rc.1` (3 files)
- grep for `S-1-16-4096|buildLowLabel|lowLabel|LowLabel|LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION` → **zero matches**

`0.1.5-rc.1` predates `dsh-v0.1.7-alpha.1`, the first release containing `d5ad3baeb5` — matching the upstream history quoted in #8412. The older sandbox only wrote DACL entries (which are inherited), so pre-existing workspaces kept working.

Any user who points DSH at an **existing** directory tree hits this immediately after upgrading. A fresh install never reproduces it, because a workspace created by DSH has all of its subdirectories created *after* provisioning, so they inherit the label. This is probably why it is hard to see in testing.

### The bundled diagnostic skill cannot repair this

`diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` performs **`SetDacl` only** (repairs `WRITE_DAC` / `WRITE_OWNER`, removes AppContainer package ACEs). `$LOW_LABEL_SID` is used for **detection/reporting only** — the script never writes a SACL / label. Running it against a failing subdirectory reports `verification: verified` and changes nothing. (This matches the "cannot be fixed by the shipped skill" conclusion in #8412.)

Separately, running it on the workspace root *did* fix a real, distinct problem: the root lacked explicit `WRITE_OWNER`, which made every confined `pwsh` invocation fail with `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace-root>)`. That part is resolved; this label-coverage problem is not.

### Suggested fix

1. At provision time, apply the Low label **recursively — at minimum to the directory layer** — of an existing workspace instead of relying on inheritance; **or**
2. Detect "workspace root already exists and is not fully labelled" and surface a clear, user-visible consent / error path instead of silently leaving a half-provisioned workspace; **and**
3. Extend `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` to **detect and repair** missing integrity labels (it currently only reports them).

If #8412 leads to the standing label being narrowed or dropped, please make sure this coverage gap is handled in the same design pass — otherwise "workspace-write works on a fresh workspace but silently fails on an existing one" will remain.

### Impact

Any user whose workspace is a pre-existing directory tree loses the ability to run **any** shell command that writes files (downloads, builds, code generation, `npm install`) in the default `workspace-write` mode. All workarounds are user-side: switch to `danger-full-access`, work inside a newly created directory, or use the fs capability channel instead of a shell.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-hypercompact | byte-budget context compaction with no LLM call, and byte-exact recall
discussions.body:
## The failure

Long agent sessions get slower and then stop working. Every model call re-uploads the whole conversation, and on a slow or proxied connection it's the request **body size** that kills you, not the token count. A 20 MB request can take minutes to upload and hit a proxy's 100-second timeout before the model ever sees it. DSH then retries the same oversized request.

## Why the built-in compaction doesn't help

- It triggers on a fraction of the model's context window. A 1M-token model may never reach that, even while the body is far too large to upload.
- It summarizes by sending the whole history to an LLM, which is the same oversized upload that's already failing (see also #7626 and #7674).

On my own sessions, inline screenshots were 50–92 % of the request body, and tool traffic was most of the rest.

## What I shipped

**[dsh-hypercompact](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-hypercompact)** is a compaction engine that measures the next request in **bytes** and compacts old history locally in milliseconds, with no model call.

- **What you wrote is never cut.** Every human message stays verbatim through any number of compactions, and constraint sentences ("never …", "do not …", "only …") are pinned at the top. The same goes for a parent agent's task prompt in a subagent, `/goal` round prompts and team messages.
- **Old tool calls collapse to one line each:** tool name, key arguments, `+N/−M lines` for edits, and a pointer. Runs of read-only calls become one line (`read ×7: a.js b.js …`).
- **Old tool results collapse** to status, size, a short head/tail excerpt and a pointer. Failed results keep a larger excerpt.
- **Older inline images become text labels**, captioned with what the assistant said about them.
- **Byte-exact recall.** The model gets `recall` and `recall_search`, which restore any compacted original exactly from the append-only session log, or just the matching lines of a large one. You get `/recall` and `/hypercompact`.
- **Drop-in.** It implements the public `ctx.compaction` contract, so `/compact`, the token meter and the context charts keep working. It doesn't patch harness internals.

## Measured on real sessions

Measured offline through pi-ai's own OpenAI-completions serializer, default config, no LLM calls:

| Session | Request before | Request after | Time |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| A (images + tools) | 19.51 MB | 1.08 MB | 149 ms |
| B (images) | 12.37 MB | 0.80 MB | 96 ms |
| C (images + tools) | 11.42 MB | 1.62 MB | 123 ms |
| E (~800k-token session) | 6.40 MB | 1.66 MB | 86 ms |
| G (text only) | 1.11 MB | 0.59 MB | 68 ms |

Every user message was kept verbatim. Every compacted request had 0 orphaned tool results and 0 unanswered tool calls, and `recall` returned a sampled tool result byte-identical to the log.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hypercompact
node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-hypercompact/scripts/create-preset.mjs
```

DSH picks a compaction engine per preset. The script copies the built-in `standard` preset with only the compaction engine changed, and installs it (your existing presets are untouched). Restart `dsh web`, click **New session**, and pick **Hypercompact (standard)** in the preset picker before the first message.

## Supported DSH versions

DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` up to (not including) `0.3.0`. Tested on `0.1.5-rc.2`, `0.1.5-rc.3`, `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2` (current `latest`). Node `^22.19.0` or `>=24`. Outside that range it refuses to load with a clear message instead of guessing.

## Limits

- The checkpoint is extractive, not a summary. Reasoning is dropped, so a decision made only in reasoning isn't carried (the agent can `recall` it).
- The byte estimate errs high, by +2–11 % on multi-MB bodies, so it triggers slightly early, never late.
- Each compaction changes the prompt prefix and costs one cache miss. The default 5 MB → 1.5 MB hysteresis keeps that rare.

The compiler and recall design are informed by [dsh-compaction-instant](https://github.com/TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant) and [VCC](https://github.com/lllyasviel/VCC); no code is copied from either.

MIT licensed. [GitHub](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-hypercompact) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-hypercompact). I'm the author, so feedback and bug reports are welcome.

**中文摘要：** 长会话里每一轮都会重新上传完整对话，在慢速或代理网络上，真正导致失败的是请求体**字节大小**（20 MB 的请求可能在模型看到之前就超时）。内置压缩按上下文窗口比例触发，并且要把整段历史发给 LLM 做摘要，正好是那个已经失败的大请求。dsh-hypercompact 按字节预估下一次请求，在本地毫秒级压缩旧历史，不调用模型；用户消息逐字保留，旧的工具调用/结果折叠为一行，旧图片转为文字标签，并提供 `recall` 工具从会话日志中逐字节恢复任何被压缩的内容。实测 19.5 MB → 1.1 MB。支持 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.2.x（不含 0.3.0）。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-reconnect | retry failed model requests with backoff instead of losing the turn
discussions.body:
## The failure

A relay, gateway or provider wobbles for a few seconds, with a timeout, a closed stream, a 5xx or a rate limit, and the agent turn dies. On a long-running task that means coming back to a stopped session and typing "continue". DSH's built-in provider retry gives up after a few attempts, and a relay that drops mid-stream surfaces as a session error.

## What I shipped

**[dsh-reconnect](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-reconnect)** listens on DSH's `agent/request-error` waterfall. When the built-in `normal` provider retry policy is exhausted (or an `always` policy hands recovery downstream), it resubmits the same model request with its own policy.

| Condition | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `STREAM_CLOSED`, `TIMEOUT`, `TRANSPORT` | Retry indefinitely |
| Missing or unconfigured model | Retry while the configuration recovers |
| `QUOTA` | Not retried by default (`retryQuota` to enable) |
| Unknown errors such as `PI_AI_ERROR` | Retried by default; turn off `retryUnknown` to cap them |
| Tool, argument, authentication, credential, context-overflow and aborted errors | Never retried |

- Exponential backoff `1s → 2s → 4s → …`, capped at 60 s by default. A provider's `Retry-After` is honored as a minimum wait.
- Emits the standard `llm/retry` / `llm/retry-started` session events.
- Stops immediately when the turn is aborted or the plugin unloads, and drains pending waits cleanly on hot reload and shutdown.
- It only looks at the machine-readable failure code. It never guesses model failures from tool output.

## Settings

Open **Plugins → dsh-reconnect → reconnect row → configure** to set the maximum retry delay (1 s to 120 s, or custom), quota retries, unknown-error retries and the unknown-error limit. Changes apply to the next failed request without a restart.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reconnect
```

Restart `dsh web` if it's running.

## Supported DSH versions

| dsh-reconnect | DSH |
|---|---|
| **3.0.1+** | **≥ 0.2.0-rc.1** |
| 3.0.0 | don't use: its settings card fails to load |
| 2.x | 0.1.5-rc.x only (it can't start on 0.2, where `ctx.settings.register` was removed) |

Node `^22.19.0` or `>=24`.

## Credits

This is an English edition of the MIT-licensed [MistRain-1/dsh-reconnect](https://github.com/MistRain-1/dsh-reconnect). All credit for the original idea goes there. This edition ports it to the DSH 0.2 config model (volatile Config fields, the `configForms` service and the `plugins.row.config` settings card) and hardens the retry behavior. The original copyright notice is kept in the LICENSE.

MIT licensed. [GitHub](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-reconnect) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-reconnect). Feedback and bug reports are welcome.

**中文摘要：** 中转/网关/供应商短暂抖动（超时、流中断、5xx、限流）会直接打断 agent 回合。dsh-reconnect 在内置重试用尽后，用指数退避（1s→2s→4s…，默认上限 60s，遵守 Retry-After）重新提交同一个模型请求；网络类错误无限重试，额度错误默认不重试，工具/参数/鉴权/上下文溢出/已取消的错误从不重试。可在 插件 → dsh-reconnect 中实时调整，无需重启。基于 MistRain-1/dsh-reconnect 的英文版，3.0.1+ 适配 DSH 0.2。

discussions.title: 关于 deepseek-v4.1-flash 模型思维过程出现必现死循环的问题反馈
discussions.body:
在使用 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 模型时，模型在思维/推理过程中会必现进入死循环，导致推理无法正常结束，并进一步影响响应生成与正常使用。该问题具有稳定复现特征。
希望能够对该问题进行排查与定位，给出规避方案并尽快完成修复，使 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 在思维/推理过程中不再出现死循环，能够正常完成推理与输出。

discussions.title: [BUG] ACL 沙箱只给工作区根授权：老目录里写不进去，且失败以裸 Win32Error 抛出（连 pwd 都跑不了）
discussions.body:
---
环境：DSH Desktop **0.10.0**（社区版），内核 **0.1.7-rc.2**，Windows x64；**普通用户**（非管理员）；
profile `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web`；文件策略 `workspace-write`。
`workspace-write` 下**任何**命令都跑不起来，连 `pwd` 都不行：
```
SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\idea2023\ai)
```
目录属主是当前用户、资源管理器里能正常读写，而且**同一目录上加一条 ACE 是成功的** —— 所以不是"DACL 不能写"。
**三条实测结论**
1. **只给工作区【根】授权，整棵树靠继承 —— 而继承只对新建对象生效。**
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js:144` 是 `writableDirs = [parsed.workspace]`；
   `grantWrite` 把「能力 ACE + 对 world 拒绝 `FILE_DELETE_CHILD` + Low 完整性标签」三件事放在**同一次**
   `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 里。于是**早于那次成功授权就存在的子目录**：既没有能力 ACE、也没有 Low 标签，
   沙箱令牌（Low + restricting SIDs）在那些目录里连 `mkdir` 都跑不了（实测 `mkdir .test-sandbox-<pid>` → EPERM）。
2. **改"强制完整性标签"需要该对象上的 `WRITE_OWNER`（降级不需要特权；我原先猜的 `SeRelabelPrivilege` 是错的）——
   而这一步失败会把同一次调用里的 DACL 半步一起带走。**
   在"只有继承 Modify"的目录上：
   ```powershell
   icacls <dir> /setintegritylevel Low                # → Access is denied（退出码 5）
   icacls <dir> /grant "*<我的SID>:(OI)(CI)F" /T       # 补一条本人可继承 FullControl（含 WRITE_OWNER）
   icacls <dir> /setintegritylevel Low                # → 立刻成功；再改回 Medium 也行（不是单向门）
   ```
   因为三件事在同一次调用（本机跟踪到 `flag=20`）里完成，标签那一步 Win32 5 会让**整次**失败 →
   能力 ACE 也没落地 → 下一次调用在授权阶段就抛错 → fail-closed，**所有命令全废**。
3. **这个失败没有按文档包成 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`。**
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox` 的 README 说"无法强制所请求的模式时以 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` 失败，并提示切
   `danger-full-access`"，实际抛出的是裸 `Win32Error`（`SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5)`）——
   用户/模型都看不出该做什么（本机排查很久，最后是读 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 源码才定位）。
**绕过办法（不需要管理员；已在两棵树上执行：`D:\idea2023\ai` 9521 个对象、`D:\AI学习` 5592 个对象，均 0 失败）**
```powershell
icacls "<工作区>" /grant "*<我的SID>:(OI)(CI)F" /T        # 先让每个对象都能写自己的标签（WRITE_OWNER）
icacls "<工作区>" /setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)Low" /T     # 再铺 Low 标签（顺序不能反）
```
做完 `workspace-write` 恢复正常，不再需要 `danger-full-access`。
**建议（按性价比）**
1. **授权时覆盖整棵树**（至少补齐"已存在的子目录"）并缓存结果 —— 现在"根 + 继承"对老目录是漏的，漏一个就等于全废。
2. **失败包成 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`**，按 README 给"切 `danger-full-access`"的引导；或在错误里直接带上
   修复用的 `icacls` 命令（用户能自救，不用来提反馈）。
3. 让标签那一步**独立失败**、不牵连 DACL，这样至少还有能力 ACE 可用。
需要的话我可以提供 SDDL 前后对比、`icacls` 完整输出和最小复现脚本。
---

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows][桌面版] 在 VS Code / Cursor 中打开必现失败：宿主运行模式变量泄漏给子进程
discussions.body:
平台：Windows 10 x64 (19045) ｜ DSH 桌面版 44.0.0（未做任何修改的原始安装），profile desktop 实测：VS Code 1.139.1、Cursor

症状
桌面版 Web GUI 右上角「在应用中打开」→ 选 VS Code / Cursor，必现红色「打开失败，请重试」。同菜单的文件资源管理器正常。

根因
桌面外壳为了让 Electron 以「纯 Node 模式」运行 dsh 宿主进程，会在启动它时设置 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1。该变量留在了宿主进程的环境里，而 open-in-app 在启动编辑器时会把父进程环境透传给子进程——它只做凭据清洗（*KEY* / *SECRET* 一类），不区分运行模式变量，因此这个标志也一并传了下去。

VS Code、Cursor 等都是 Electron 应用：它们在启动时读取该变量来决定「当 GUI 运行还是当 Node 运行」。读到 1 就进入 Node 模式——不创建窗口、把命令行参数当作脚本路径去找、找不到便直接退出，退出码非零。

而 open-in-app 的判定逻辑是「子进程在观察窗口内以非零码退出 = 启动失败」，于是返回 502 launch-failed，前端显示为「打开失败，请重试」。

关键点：应用发现与路径解析本身是成功的（VS Code 能被正确找到并解析出可执行文件路径），失败发生在子进程启动之后。因此错误信息与实际原因方向相反：它提示 failed to launch vscode，容易把人引向「VS Code 没装好或路径不对」，而真正的原因是环境变量继承。

最小复现
在持有该变量的环境中，按同样方式启动 VS Code：

确认当前进程环境里存在 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1（桌面版宿主即如此）；
以 detached、无 stdio 的方式启动 VS Code 可执行文件，并把一个目录作为参数传入；
观察结果：子进程立即以退出码 1 结束，且没有窗口出现；
从环境中删除该变量后重复第 2 步：窗口正常打开。
为排除干扰，实验前应先彻底终止所有 VS Code 进程——它是单实例应用，已有实例在运行时新进程会把请求转交并以 0 退出，会掩盖真实行为。

验证情况
现象实测（两个独立应用）：在原始安装的桌面版 44.0.0 上，VS Code 与 Cursor 均必现失败。

两个不同的编辑器出现完全相同的行为，可以排除「某个编辑器自身安装有问题」这一类解释——它们唯一的共同点就是都会继承同一个父进程环境。

已成功消除该症状的方法：在宿主进程内删除该运行模式变量。

具体做法是以一个本地插件挂载到用户的 profile 配置上；该插件加载进宿主进程后，只从本进程的环境中移除 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE。此后 open-in-app 启动编辑器时读到的父环境已不含它，子进程不再继承，VS Code 与 Cursor 均恢复正常。

之所以安全：Electron 只在启动那一刻读取该变量来决定运行模式，而插件加载时该决定早已完成——删除它不会改变当前进程自身的运行方式，只影响之后被启动的子进程。真正依赖该变量的适配器是自行显式声明的（例如目录中 GitHub Desktop 的条目），不依赖继承，因此不受影响。改动范围仅限本进程环境，不涉及系统设置、注册表或安装文件，并随进程重启失效。

备注
已排除：文件权限、沙箱隔离、VS Code 安装损坏、未安装系统 Node、VS Code 安装路径。

本文档由 AI 分析生成：DeepSeek v4.1F。

discussions.title: [架构] 当前拆包是否过细？(仅好奇)
discussions.body: gpt5.6-sol-medium: 目前的问题 - 约 290 个内部包、1,800 多条内部依赖边。 - dsh-web-app 扇出约 125 个包，dsh-base 约 93 个，组合根已经非常重。 - 很多包只有一个 index.ts，只是接口、默认实现、工具注册各拆一层。 - 改一个会话字段可能需要同步修改 session、projection、API、client-store、UI、migration 等十几个包。 - Workspace 协议版本全部锁成同一个版本，实际上并没有真正获得独立发布收益。 - package manifest、README、构建、类型生成、依赖声明的维护成本很高。 - 安装包中还观察到部分静态 import 没有对应直接依赖声明，说明包数量已经开始超出人工维护能力。 哪些拆分是合理的 - session 与 session-persistence-* - sandbox 与平台实现 - llm 与不同 Provider - subagent 与不同执行后端 - mcp-client - Host、Client、Desktop 这类进程边界 - 可以由第三方替换或独立安装的插件 哪些适合合并 - dsh-client-ui-* 的大量微型 UI 包，可按功能域合成 conversation-ui、settings-ui、workspace-ui。 - session-stats、session-turn-outline 等小 projection 可合成 session-projections。 - tool-bash、tool-pwsh、persistent 变体可按 Shell 域聚合。 - 多个只有注册逻辑的 command-* 包可合成 commands。 - util-* 中只有一两个函数的包可回收到所属领域。 - 同时总是安装、总是升级、总是一起修改的包，应当合并。

discussions.title: [macOS Intel][0.2.0-rc.2] 官方 x64 DMG 已存在但 Release 无下载入口；分享本地打包与兼容经验
discussions.body:
## 现象与核对结果

我在 Intel Mac（`x86_64`，macOS 26.6）上使用 DeepSeek Harness Desktop。查看 [dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 Release](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2) 时，页面的 `Assets` 列表为空，找不到 Intel macOS 安装包，因此容易误以为新版不再支持 Intel Mac。相关疑问也见 [#8328](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8328)。

但在 **2026-09-30** 核对官方发布源后，发现 **rc.2 的 Intel 包实际上已经存在**：

- 官方 Intel DMG：<https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/bin/mac-x64/deepseek-harness-0.2.0-rc.2-mac-x64.dmg>（HTTP 200，`386,418,433` 字节）。
- 官方 `mac-x64` 更新清单：<https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/feeds/mac-x64/nightly-mac.yml>（显示 `version: 0.2.0-rc.2`）。
- rc.2 发布说明也明确提到了 Intel Mac 内置 Node 的签名权限修复。

所以这里更准确的问题是：**官方 Intel 构建已发布，但 GitHub Release 页面缺少可见下载入口和校验信息**。希望维护者把 `mac-x64` 的官方安装包入口、最低系统版本、签名/公证状态及校验值放到 Release 说明或下载页，让 Intel 用户能直接找到并确认来源。我目前安装运行的是官方签名、公证的 `0.2.0-rc.1`；尚未把 rc.2 安装到本机，因此以下不宣称 rc.2 的运行结果。

## 我在 Intel Mac 上做过的本地打包方案

在官方桌面安装包不易找到时，我曾从仓库的 **`dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`** 源码在 Intel Mac 上自行构建 `mac-x64` DMG。这个方案是旧版的本地复现经验，**没有在 rc.2 源码上重新验证，也不是官方发布包**；愿意把思路供维护者和社区参考：

1. 固定 `DSH_DESKTOP_TARGET_PLATFORM=darwin`、`DSH_DESKTOP_TARGET_ARCH=x64`，运行仓库的 `build:official`，并打包 dsh、desktop-host、vendor 与 native/system 依赖。
2. 依次执行 `prepare:runtime`、`prepare:packages`、`prepare:dsh`，保证 Electron、Node、Python、原生模块和插件运行时进入同一个目标目录。网络受限时，我把下载源改为可达镜像，但**仍以仓库 lock 文件中的 SHA-256 校验每份运行时资产**；仅校验一致才写入缓存。npm 镜像通过本地 `DSH_DESKTOP_RUNTIME_REGISTRY` 配置传给内部 pnpm 安装步骤。
3. 使用 electron-builder 针对 `darwin/x64` 生成应用目录，再做本机 ad-hoc 签名、`codesign --verify --deep --strict`、`hdiutil create` 和 `hdiutil verify`。当时生成的本地 DMG 约 470 MB，`hdiutil verify` 通过。

我本地脚本中的关键构建顺序如下（省略个人绝对路径；需先安装仓库要求的构建依赖，并使用同版本源码）：

```bash
export DSH_DESKTOP_TARGET_PLATFORM=darwin
export DSH_DESKTOP_TARGET_ARCH=x64
B=apps/desktop/.desktop-build/targets/mac-x64

pnpm run build:official
pnpm run release:pack --family dsh --out "$B/packed/dsh"
pnpm --dir apps/desktop-host pack --pack-destination "$B/packed/dsh"
pnpm run release:pack --family vendor --out "$B/packed/vendor"
pnpm --dir native/system run build:ts
pnpm --dir native/system/packages/entry pack --pack-destination "$B/packed/landlock"
pnpm --dir apps/desktop run prepare:runtime
pnpm --dir apps/desktop run prepare:packages
pnpm --dir apps/desktop run prepare:dsh
```

随后我的**本地专用** electron-builder 配置指定 `mac-x64` 的 Electron/运行时目录、`identity: null`、`notarize: false` 和 `--mac --x64 --dir --publish never`；对产出的 `.app` 执行 ad-hoc `codesign` 并封装 DMG。镜像下载只有在 SHA-256 与锁文件一致后才进入缓存。这个配置和跳过正式签名的改动只为本地验证，不能替代官方发布配置。

本地 ad-hoc 包**未经过 Developer ID 签名与 Apple 公证**，Gatekeeper 体验与官方包不同，不能当作面向普通用户的下载包。正式发布仍应沿用仓库的签名、公证和 `mac-x64` 上传流程。若需要，我可以在回复中提供已去除本机路径的构建脚本和最小本地改动；核心改动只是允许镜像 registry，以及在没有 Developer ID 凭据的本地构建中跳过正式运行时签名。

## 另外几项兼容经验 / 希望确认

- 从早期自打包版本升级到官方 Desktop 时，Bundle ID 从 `com.deepseek.harness` 变成 `com.deepseek.dsh`，macOS 将其视作另一个应用，磁盘/麦克风/屏幕录制等系统权限可能要重新授权。希望升级说明显式提示用户，并建议先备份 `~/.dsh`。
- 我在 rc.1 环境遇到过旧版第三方插件的 peer dependency 不覆盖 `0.2.0-rc.1`，插件管理器会判为不兼容。这是插件版本声明问题，建议文档明确“插件不兼容”与“桌面端不支持 Intel”是不同情况。
- rc.2 发布说明提到 Intel 内置 Node 的签名权限和图形入口的 login-shell 环境修复。希望有 Intel 真机验收结果，尤其是 Office 技能命令、PATH/代理读取及从 rc.1 升级后的会话/权限表现。

欢迎维护者和 Intel Mac 用户补充 rc.2 的实际安装、签名、公证及升级结果。

**English summary:** The official rc.2 macOS x64 DMG and update feed are live, but the GitHub Release has no downloadable assets or visible Intel link. I also shared a verified local mac-x64 packaging approach from an older source tag, clearly separated from the official signed/notarized distribution, plus upgrade and plugin compatibility observations. I have not yet runtime-tested rc.2 on this Mac.

discussions.title: dsh-hindsight-memory 在 DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (Session V4) 下报 format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
discussions.body:
**环境**

- @deepseek-ai/dsh-*：0.2.0-rc.2（任何启用 Session V4 的版本都受影响）
- dsh-hindsight-memory：0.1.1
- profile：web（也应该影响 headless / desktop）

**复现步骤**

1. 在 cordis 配置里启用 dsh-hindsight-memory（autoRecall: true）
2. 启动 dsh（pnpm dsh web）
3. 在客户端发一条普通消息（任意文本）
4. 当前轮被丢弃；UI 显示「本轮运行失败 format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind」

**观察到的错误**

UI 直接显示底层错误文本：


```
本轮运行失败
format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
```
session 日志末尾会出现：


```
seq N-1   agent/inbox/spliced   inserted=[{role:"user", source:{kind:"user", ...}}]
seq N     turn/start            {turn: K}
seq N+1   agent/inbox/spliced   start:0, removedCount:1, inserted:[]
 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
                                          claim 之后无 step/start / assistant/message
```
removedCount:1, inserted:[] 之后没有任何 step事件，说明 recall 块进入 preStep waterfall 后被拦下。

**根因**

lib/index.js 的 agent/pre-step 监听器在 recall 命中时构造的 user message：


```
createUserMessage({
  content: [{ type: "text", text }],
  source: {
    kind: "plugin",                ← 字面量 "plugin"
    plugin: name,                  // "hindsight-memory"
    form: "snapshot",
    sections: [{ name, text }]
  }
})
```
kind: "plugin" 是 V3 时代的语法。V4 把 kind: "plugin" 升级为「producer-owned」归属模型，要求 kind 是具体产方名（白名单如 tmux-context / time-context / session-reference 等，或 plugin:<name> 形式）。

packages/session/session-format-v3-to-v4/src/message-sources.ts:9 的 source() 检查：

```
if (... || value['kind'] === 'plugin') {
  throw new SessionFormatError('format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind')
}
```
由于 recall 块通过 prepend: true 排在 waterfall 最前，一旦被构造就会被 assistant/call / tool/result 写日志的 admission gate（assertV4SourceRowAdmission）拦下，导致整轮失败。

参考对比：

- Hindsight dist plugin 之前也是同一模式，已修（kind: "plugin:" + HINDSIGHT_PLUGIN）
- packages/context/tmux-context/src/index.ts 用 kind: name（即 "tmux-context"）
- packages/context/session-reference/src/index.ts 用 kind: "session-reference"
- packages/session/session-format-v3-to-v4/src/sources.ts:64 的 producerKind() fallback 给出标准形式 plugin:${plugin}

**最小修复**

lib/index.js 第 338 行（一行）：

```
 source: {
-    kind: "plugin",
+    kind: "plugin:" + name,
     plugin: name,
     form: "snapshot",
     sections: [{ name, text }]
 }
```
修完后 recall 块用 plugin:hindsight-memory 作为 source kind，符合 V4 admission。已在我本地验证：line 338 改完后（node_modules 内的临时修复），重启 dsh，新一轮 step 1 正常进入 model call，无 admission error。

**建议永久修复**

考虑到 lib 是 build 产物，建议：

1. 上游在 src 层把 kind 显式化为 plugin:${name}（即 plugin:hindsight-memory），跟 packages/session/session-format-v3-to-v4/src/sources.ts:64 的 producerKind() fallback 一致
2. 升级 dsh-hindsight-memory 到 ≥ 0.1.2
3. 在 README 里加一段：「DSH 0.2.0 起 session format V4 强制 producer-owned source kind，本插件自 0.1.2 起适配」

**用户侧临时 workaround（如果等不及 release）**


```
# 在 cordis 把插件指向本地打过补丁的文件副本
# 或者直接 sed：
sed -i.bak 's|kind: "plugin",$|kind: "plugin:" + name,|' \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-hindsight-memory/lib/index.js
# 重启 dsh daemon
launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.claw.dsh-web   # macOS + LaunchAgent 场景
```
pnpm install 之后记得重打。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-podman | Podman-backed execution for dsh
discussions.body:
[dsh-podman](https://github.com/Exagone313/dsh-podman)

中文版本见下方。

# English version

Dear dsh community,

I have enjoyed using dsh, and with its plugin-oriented approach I felt it was time to develop a plugin that uses disposable Podman containers for agent shell access: that way, what an agent can access is constrained to the project by default, for increased security.

If you don't know Podman, it's an alternative to Docker. Docker is most often run as root, so giving an application access to Docker is akin to giving it root access. Podman works differently: you can run it entirely as your own user, without root or sudo, using a Linux feature called user namespaces.

This plugin is more than that, though. It has many features:

* For each dsh workspace, a default container is created from a locally built Arch Linux image (you can also choose Ubuntu or Alpine Linux).
* You can create custom images from your own package list (using pacman, apt, or apk, respectively).
* You can create additional containers and use them in sessions with the custom agent tools that take a container name as a parameter.
* You can change a container's mounts. For example, when developing dsh-podman, I mount the deepseek-harness repository read-only, so my agents can easily access its source code but cannot edit it.
* You can create volumes, so data can persist outside your projects.

These features are available in the dsh-podman settings… but also as agent tools! This means that if an agent wants to install a toolchain for your project, it can create a custom image with the relevant distribution packages, or download the software into a new volume.

Some tool executions are gated behind user approval, such as changing a container's mounts or recreating a container. If you trust your agent, you can also use the *Full Access* permission so the tools don't have to ask for approval. Likewise, use the *Read Only* permission to block access to potentially dangerous tools.

> [!TIP]
> With the Read Only permission, when all mounts are read-only, dsh-podman still lets the agent run shell commands.

For better security, dsh has no direct access to Podman: it sends its commands to a container named `dsh-podman-orchestrator`, which only grants access to projects and to Podman resources prefixed with `dsh-podman-`. This way, even a rogue dsh installation cannot take over your user.

To make the plugin easier to use, I ship a container image for dsh that auto-installs dsh-podman. It is the [documented way to run dsh-podman](https://github.com/Exagone313/dsh-podman/blob/master/docs/install-dsh-and-dsh-podman.md), and it reuses your existing dsh installation data (`~/.dsh`).

The plugin is available in English and Chinese (translated by the DeepSeek Flash model).

I spent a month creating and polishing this plugin, developed in large part with the DeepSeek Flash model. If you are interested in this plugin, you can donate via [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Exagone313).

Project information:

* Project URL: <https://github.com/Exagone313/dsh-podman>
* Available platforms: Linux distributions with systemd (Arch Linux, Ubuntu, …) on x86-64 and arm64

---

# 中文

[dsh-podman](https://github.com/Exagone313/dsh-podman)

各位 dsh 社区的朋友：

我很喜欢使用 dsh，而它面向插件的方式让我觉得是时候开发一个插件，用一次性的 Podman 容器来为 agent 提供 shell 访问：这样一来，agent 默认只能访问项目范围内的内容，从而提升安全性。

如果你不了解 Podman，它是 Docker 的替代方案。Docker 通常以 root 身份运行，因此让某个应用访问 Docker 几乎等同于给它 root 权限。Podman 则不同：借助 Linux 的用户命名空间（user namespaces），你可以完全以当前用户身份运行它，无需 root 或 sudo。

这个插件不止于此，它还有许多功能：

* 每个 dsh 工作区都会创建一个默认容器，所用镜像由本地基于 Arch Linux 构建（也可以选择 Ubuntu 或 Alpine Linux）。
* 你可以用自己的软件包列表创建自定义镜像（分别使用 pacman、apt 或 apk）。
* 你可以创建额外的容器，并在会话中通过接受容器名参数的自定义 agent 工具使用它们。
* 你可以修改容器的挂载。例如在开发 dsh-podman 时，我把 deepseek-harness 仓库以只读方式挂载，这样我的 agent 可以方便地查看其源码，却无法修改。
* 你可以创建卷，让数据持久保存在项目之外。

这些功能既可以在 dsh-podman 设置中使用……也可以作为 agent 工具使用！也就是说，如果 agent 想为你的项目安装一套工具链，它可以创建一个包含相关发行版软件包的自定义镜像，或者把软件下载到一个新卷中。

部分工具的执行需要用户审批，例如修改容器挂载或重建容器。如果你信任你的 agent，也可以使用 *Full Access* 权限，让这些工具不再请求审批。同样，你可以使用 *Read Only* 权限来阻止访问可能有危险的工具。

> [!TIP]
> 在使用 Read Only 权限时，如果所有挂载都是只读的，dsh-podman 仍允许 agent 运行 shell 命令。

为了提升安全性，dsh 无法直接访问 Podman：它把命令发送给名为 `dsh-podman-orchestrator` 的容器，而该容器只授予对项目以及以 `dsh-podman-` 为前缀的 Podman 资源的访问权限。这样，即使 dsh 被攻破，也无法接管你的用户。

为了方便使用，我提供了一个 dsh 容器镜像，会在启动时自动安装 dsh-podman。这也是[官方文档推荐的运行方式](https://github.com/Exagone313/dsh-podman/blob/master/docs/install-dsh-and-dsh-podman.zh.md)，并且会复用你现有的 dsh 数据（`~/.dsh`）。

插件提供英文和中文两种界面（中文由 DeepSeek Flash 模型翻译）。

我用了一个月来开发和打磨这个插件，其中很大一部分工作是使用 DeepSeek Flash 模型完成的。如果你对这个插件感兴趣，可以通过 [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Exagone313) 赞助我。

项目信息：

* 项目地址：<https://github.com/Exagone313/dsh-podman>
* 支持平台：搭载 systemd 的 Linux 发行版（Arch Linux、Ubuntu 等），x86-64 与 arm64

---

Screenshots / 截图:

![dsh-podman settings card](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8a5eec37-15dd-479b-a0ff-14b4b6dce5e4)

![Asking the agent for a comma-separated list of the dsh-podman tools](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5dec3fea-3daf-4335-aa45-b54303759e01)

```
$ podman ps --filter name=dsh
```

discussions.title: 【插件作者必读】2026-09-29 Desktop 升级：带设置 UI 的插件会静默失效（迁移指南）
discussions.body:
# 【插件作者必读】2026-09-29 Desktop 升级：带设置 UI 的插件会静默失效 —— 迁移指南

> 来源：whalebuddy（桌面宠物插件）在本次升级后设置入口消失的完整排查。
> 受影响对象：所有使用旧版设置集成的 bundle 插件（`settings.register` +
> `settingsScope` / `settings.plugin.item` 写法）。
> 症状统一且恶劣：**插件功能一切正常、零报错，只有设置入口消失。**

## 变化总览（4 个断点 + 1 个组合拳）

| # | 旧行为 | 新契约 | 失效方式 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ctx.inject(['settings'], s => s.settings.register(ns, schema))` | 插件导出 **`Config` schema** 即命名空间 | TypeError 被吞，命名空间不再被服务 |
| 2 | Config 字段普通声明即可 | 字段必须 **`.volatile()`**，否则被 `volatileForm` 逐个丢弃，丢空后**整个命名空间消失** | 最隐蔽：entry 一切正常，describe 里就是没你 |
| 3 | 客户端 `ctx.settingsScope.bind({ namespace })` 读写 | `ctx.configForms.get(ns)`（`set/unset` 返回是否落盘） | 服务零残留，`bind()` 抛 TypeError |
| 4 | 卡片注册进 `settings.plugin.item` | **`plugins.item`**（插件管理面板）与 **`settings.plugins.tab`**（设置→内置插件分页）经 `configForms.whileServed([ns])` 注册 | 旧插槽已不存在 |
| 5 | `dsh.client.inject` 可不声明 | **必须声明依赖的客户端模块**，否则加载顺序无保证，`ctx.configForms` 未就位 → **apply 根本不执行**（零报错） | 最难定位 |
| 6 | （组合拳）老版写配置会在 profile patch 留下带 `name:` 的定义行 | 与 bundle 的 insert 重复 → `entries()` 去重把同 id entry **全部剔除** | 命名空间时有时无 |

## 迁移清单（照抄即可）

### 宿主半侧

```js
// 旧：settings.register('my-ns', z.object({...}))
// 新：导出 Config，字段全部 .volatile()
module.exports.Config = z.object({
  enabled: z.boolean().default(false).volatile(),
  path: z.string().default('').volatile(),
})
module.exports = {
  name: 'my-plugin',
  inject: ['webServer'],
  Config: module.exports.Config,
  apply(ctx, config) { /* 设置值直接从 config 读；变更靠 fiber 重入 */ },
}
```

要点：
- 设置值从 `apply(ctx, config)` 第二参读；用户改配置时 cordis 会以新 config
  重入 apply（volatile 字段不重挂载，其余字段变更会重启 fiber）。
- 程序化写回用 `sctx.settings.update(ns, patch)`。

### 客户端半侧

```js
exports.inject = ["slots", "configForms"];
exports.apply = function (ctx) {
  const form = ctx.configForms.get("my-ns");
  // 快照: { status: "ready", value, base, user, revision, writable }
  // 写入: await form.set(field, value) → boolean（Host 是否接受）
  ctx.effect(() => ctx.configForms.whileServed(["my-ns"], () =>
    ctx.slots.inject("plugins.item", () => ctx.slots.register({
      name: "plugins.item", id: "my-plugin", order: 50, label: "…",
    }, Card))));
};
```

要点：
- `whileServed` = 宿主服务该命名空间时挂载、停服自动撤下（官方
  agent-loop / web-search / shell 伴生包都是这个写法，可直接对照源码：
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-agent-loop` 等）。
- 设置侧导航现在只有：通用设置 / 桌面设置 / 模型 / **内置插件** / Agent 预设；
  `settings.plugins.tab` 插槽对应「内置插件」分页。

### package.json（最容易漏的一步）

```json
"dsh": {
  "client": {
    "platform": "web",
    "inject": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"]
  }
}
```

不声明的话客户端模块虽会被送进浏览器，但加载顺序无保证：
apply 执行时 `configForms` 服务未就位 → **apply 根本不执行，且控制台零输出**。

### 收尾

- 检查用户 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：老版本写配置可能留下了带 `name:` 的
  重复定义行，改成纯 config 覆盖行（只有 `id` + `config`）。
- 宿主/manifest 改动**必须重启 DSH**；客户端 bundle 页面刷新即可拿到新的。

## 排查技巧（给要定位的人）

- 插件自带的免鉴权路由（如 handshake）是理想的诊断口：把
  `settings.describe()` 的 ns 列表、loader entry 信息塞进响应直接看。
- 判断客户端模块 apply 是否真的执行：让它 apply 时向宿主发一个信标请求，
  宿主记录时间戳——可以区分「没加载 / 加载了没执行 / 执行了没注册」。
- `configEditor.entries()` 过滤条件（同 id 去重 + 父树根必须是 `include`）
  和 `volatileForm` 只投影 volatile 字段，是两个最反直觉的静默剔除点。

## 给官方的两点建议

1. 移除 `settings.register` 这类 API 时，希望至少打一条 deprecation 日志，
   而不是让旧调用无痕失效。
2. `volatileForm` 丢弃全部非 volatile 字段导致整个命名空间被跳过时，建议在
   describe 响应或日志中提示（例如 "ns X has no volatile fields, skipped"），
   否则插件作者无从下手。

---
完整排查记录（含本机诊断过程）见
[whalebuddy 仓库 docs/12](https://github.com/2DogsLee/dsh_whalebuddy/blob/main/docs/12-dsh-2026-09-29-upgrade-notes.md)。

discussions.title: [Bug] ACP `session/list` 不返回 `SessionInfo.title` / `updatedAt`,Paseo客户端把所有会话显示成"未命名"
discussions.body:
## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2(Windows 桌面版构建) |
| profile | `acp`(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app`) |
| 启动方式 | `dsh --profile acp`(stdio) |
| 客户端 | Paseo 0.9.2(ACP 客户端) |

## 复现步骤

以 ACP stdio 启动后依次发送:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":1,"clientCapabilities":{}}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"session/list","params":{}}
```

## 实际结果

`initialize` 明确声明了 list 能力:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":1,
  "agentInfo":{"name":"deepseek-harness-acp","version":"0.0.1"},
  "agentCapabilities":{"mcpCapabilities":{"http":true},
    "promptCapabilities":{"image":false,"audio":false,"embeddedContext":false},
    "sessionCapabilities":{"close":{},"list":{},"resume":{}}},
  "authMethods":[]}}
```

但 `session/list` 的每条记录只有两个字段:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"sessions":[
  {"sessionId":"a04c6c82-f3ee-4745-a4d7-877d0beae7ff","cwd":"C:\\Users\\Chencv"},
  {"sessionId":"session-438922d7-3975-4b78-9977-c3222ccab147","cwd":"D:\\Projects\\Web"}
]}}
```

本地 15 条顶层会话全部如此——**没有 `title`,也没有 `updatedAt`**。

## 期望结果

ACP 的 `SessionInfo` 本身带一个可选的 `title` 字段(见 [RFD: Session Info Update](https://agentclientprotocol.com/rfds/session-info-update.md)):

> The `session/list` endpoint returns `SessionInfo` objects that include an **optional `title` field** for displaying session names in client UIs.

期望返回:

```json
{"sessionId":"session-438922d7-3975-4b78-9977-c3222ccab147",
 "cwd":"D:\\Projects\\Web",
 "title":"xxxx完成度查询",
 "updatedAt":"2026-09-30T12:13:01Z"}
```

## 影响

以 Paseo 的「导入会话」对话框为例,每个 DSH 会话都渲染成:

```
未命名会话
没有 prompt 预览
D:\Projects\Web                                  Jan 1
```

15 条完全一样,用户无法分辨哪个是哪个;`Jan 1` 是缺少时间戳时的占位日期。这不是观感问题——**只要会话多于几个,导入功能实际就不可用**。

## 为什么这是个容易补的缺口

标题在 DSH 内部是有的:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title` 与 `dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm` 会生成标题;
- `sessionListMetadata` 投影里本来就存着 `title` 与 `lastPromptAt`;
- 桌面端侧边栏也正是靠这份数据渲染会话名。

也就是说,数据齐备,只差没有映射到 ACP 的 `SessionInfo` 上。

顺带一提,新协议还支持 `session_info_update` 通知,标题生成/变化时可以实时推送客户端——如果一并实现,客户端连重新拉列表都不需要。

## 另一个观察

本地 18 个会话(15 个顶层 + 3 个子代理)中,`session/list` 只返回了 15 条顶层会话,子代理被排除在外。这个行为看起来是合理的,但文档里没有说明,建议明确一下是有意为之。

## 附:完整会话清单(便于对照)

| sessionId | cwd | 本地标题 |
|---|---|---|
| `session-a94dc05c-4a69-41d0-9cf7-4c4e0a816540` | `…\default-workspace` | 配置Paseo的DeepSeek Harness |
| `session-438922d7-3975-4b78-9977-c3222ccab147` | `D:\Projects\Web` | xxxx完成度查询 |
| `1410a7b1-f897-4fc5-b37e-e542572dc6fd` | `D:\Projects\Web` | 你好 |
| `8438d769-73f7-4222-b1a4-8de81b226f0c` | `D:\Projects\Web` | 测试 |
| `e317e535-4b30-470f-8a42-d210292b4838` | `…\default-workspace` | Reply with exactly: PASEO-DSH-OK |
| `b246a5f3-…` / `c9c28a77-…` / `43d32ba5-…` / `8a1fc4bc-…` | `…\default-workspace` | Reply with exactly: OK |
| `a04c6c82-…` / `84b25a27-…` / `96bbcdd5-…` / `5fd02707-…` / `b7479621-…` | 三个不同 cwd | (空壳,无标题) |

discussions.title: Narrow window: conversation header action clusters overlap (Delete session covered by the open-in-app split button)
discussions.body: ### Summary At narrow window widths the conversation header's two button clusters overlap: the right-hand utilities cluster (the built-in "open in app" split button) is painted on top of the left-hand actions cluster, covering the destructive **Delete session** button. ### Environment - DeepSeek Harness desktop **0.2.0-rc.2** (Web client, same client bundles) - macOS **27.0 (26A428)**, window width ≈ **823 CSS px** (screenshot crop is 1646 px @2x) - 12 buttons in the header, 6 of them contributed by a marketplace session-manager plugin (Archive / Favorite / Watch / Tags·Notes / Move to workspace / Delete session) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open a session whose header shows several actions (Archive / Tags·Notes / Move to workspace / Delete session). 2. Resize the window to ≤ 900 CSS px (823 px reproduces reliably). 3. The "open in app" split button (Finder icon + caret) overlaps "Move to workspace" and "Delete session". ### Expected vs actual - Expected: when the row runs out of width, buttons shrink, wrap, collapse into an overflow ("more") menu, or scroll — nothing should be covered. - Actual: nothing shrinks; the three clusters overlap and the later-painted utilities cluster wins. ### Measurements (read from the client DOM) Overlapping button pairs vs viewport width (rectangle intersection > 2 px counts as overlap): | viewport (CSS px) | overlapping pairs | overlap area (px²) | | --- | --- | --- | | 700 | 5 | 2338 | | 760 | 4 | 2392 | | 820 | 4 | 2136 | | 880 | 2 | 902 | | 940 | 0 | 0 | | 1000 | 0 | 0 | | 1060 | 5 | 1688 | | 1120 | 2 | 677 | | 1200 | 0 | 0 | The 1060 px row is not a typo: the "N background tasks" chip appears and disappears with live job state, so the required width drifts. There is no fixed breakpoint — the overlap simply happens whenever the content is wider than the row. Container rects at 823 px: | container | left | right | width | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `.ST7X_W_headerActions` | 86 | 801 | 715 | | `.ST7X_W_headerUtilities` | 696 | 775 | 79 | | `.ST7X_W_headerCorner` | 783 | 811 | 28 | The three containers overlap each other; concretely "open in app" (697–720) and its caret (720–743) cover "Move to workspace" (613–717) and "Delete session" (723–801). ### Root cause From `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`: ```css .ST7X_W_header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);...} .ST7X_W_titleRow{display:flex;...;container-type:inline-size} .ST7X_W_headerActions{flex:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;display:flex} .ST7X_W_headerUtilities{flex:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-left:20px;display:flex} .ST7X_W_headerCorner{flex:none;align-items:center;margin-left:8px;margin-right:-16px;display:flex} ``` `.ST7X_W_titleRow` is a flex row, and all three clusters are `flex:none` — no `min-width:0`, no `overflow` clipping, no wrapping, no overflow menu. When the content is wider than the row, nothing can shrink, so the clusters are laid out on top of each other. ### Suggested fix Minimum change (verified: all overlaps drop to 0 at 700 / 760 / 823 / 900 px and all 12 buttons stay visible): ```css .ST7X_W_headerActions{flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;overflow:hidden} ``` Trade-off: the cluster wraps and the header grows from 53 px to 91/129 px tall. Better product behaviour would be collapsing the actions into an overflow "more" menu, or making the cluster scrollable with an edge fade so the header keeps its single-line height. Adding `min-width:0` to the crumbs would also stop the breadcrumb from being overlapped. ### Impact "Delete session" is a destructive action. While covered, the user cannot tell whether the covered part is clickable, and on narrower windows the overlap lands on the neighbouring "more ways to open" caret — a mis-click risk. It also reads as a rendering bug ("the button disappeared"). --- ### 中文摘要 窄窗口（≤ 900 CSS px，823 px 稳定复现）时，会话标题栏左右两组按钮互相叠压：右侧工具簇（内置「用访达打开 / 更多打开方式」分裂按钮）压在左侧动作簇上，盖住了破坏性按钮「删除会话」。 根因在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的标题栏布局：`.headerActions` / `.headerUtilities` / `.headerCorner` 三簇全部是 `flex:none`（不收缩、不换行、不裁剪、也没有"更多"折叠），宽度不足时只能互相重叠。 实测：940 px 起重叠归零；给动作簇加 `flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;overflow:hidden` 可让 700–900 px 的重叠全部归零（代价是标题栏变高）。第三方插件只是把按钮数量推高、让问题更早暴露，缺陷本身在核心布局。

discussions.title: [token-meter] Accept provider-authoritative context occupancy separately from cumulative billing usage
discussions.body:
## Summary

DeepSeek Harness already has the right high-level separation:

- durable/provider token accounting is exposed through `tokenUsage` / `TokenUsage`;
- live context pressure is exposed through `contextPressure` / `TokenMeasurement`.

The remaining seam is narrower:

> A provider can report **cumulative billable prompt traffic for one externally visible agentic call** while also reporting a separate **current/live context occupancy** for the final internal inference. DSH currently has no public typed path for an adapter to preserve both as authoritative values.

xAI is a concrete current example. For agentic tool requests, xAI documents `prompt_tokens` as cumulative across internal inference requests. Its terminal Responses usage also exposes `usage.context_details`, and xAI's own Grok Build uses that field as live context while leaving cumulative billing fields intact.

We are requesting an independent, optional provider context-occupancy signal. Canonical `TokenUsage` billing semantics should remain unchanged.

---

## Problem

For ordinary one-inference requests, provider prompt usage is often a reasonable context-pressure anchor.

For agentic provider calls, that equivalence can break.

Example:

```text
internal inference A prompt = 80k
internal inference B prompt = 120k
internal inference C prompt = 150k

provider cumulative billable prompt traffic = 350k
current/final live context occupancy        = 150k
```

Both values are true, but they answer different questions:

- **350k** belongs in cumulative provider/accounting usage;
- **150k** is the value relevant to current context occupancy/pressure.

Treating 350k as one current context causes premature pruning/compaction. Replacing 350k with 150k in canonical usage would under-report provider usage.

---

## Existing DSH design already establishes the separation

This request is not asking DSH to invent a new distinction between billing and context pressure. Existing public design discussions already establish that distinction.

### Discussion #3514 — provider/estimated pressure provenance

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3514

Relevant precedent:

- provider-reported usage can anchor pressure;
- estimated versus provider-backed pressure provenance matters;
- `pressureTokens` and projected/estimated values are separate concepts.

What #3514 does **not** cover is a provider usage sample whose prompt tokens are themselves aggregate across multiple hidden internal inferences.

This request extends that design to:

> provider-reported billing usage may be authoritative for billing while still being the wrong semantic quantity for current context occupancy.

### Discussion #2426 — billable compaction traffic should not replace current pressure

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2426

Relevant precedent:

- a compaction-summary provider request can be billable session traffic;
- that billable traffic should not become the main request's current `contextPressure`.

That is the same architectural principle needed here: billable traffic and live occupancy are related but not interchangeable.

### Discussion #1886 — exact cumulative accounting must remain complete

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1886

Relevant precedent:

- retries/compaction/provider calls must remain represented in cumulative accounting;
- pressure fixes should not silently reduce the billing ledger.

This is why the requested solution keeps canonical `TokenUsage` unchanged.

### Discussion #7399 — consumers already present occupancy and billed usage separately

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7399

Relevant precedent:

- public ecosystem consumers can display occupancy from `contextPressure`;
- billed/session usage is displayed independently from `tokenUsage`.

Again, the missing piece is not a second projection. It is a provider-authoritative input for the pressure projection when `TokenUsage.inputTokens` has aggregate scope.

---

## Current DSH contract gap

Current public DSH types expose canonical provider usage but no independent provider context sample:

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/llm/llm/src/types.ts

Current token-meter pressure projection derives prompt-side pressure from provider usage buckets:

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/llm/token-meter/src/usage-projection.ts

Conceptually the current path is:

```text
TokenUsage.inputTokens
+ TokenUsage.cacheReadTokens
+ TokenUsage.cacheWriteTokens
        |
        v
contextPressure pressure anchor
```

That is correct only when those prompt-side usage buckets describe one effective request context.

The public `TokenMeasurement` baseline already supports explicit estimated provenance:

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/llm/token-meter/src/types.ts

That allows a plugin to mitigate aggregate providers conservatively with a retained-surface estimate, but it cannot express an exact provider-supplied occupancy value separately from billing.

---

## xAI is a concrete provider example

### xAI agentic usage is cumulative billing traffic

Official documentation:

https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/tool-usage-details

For agentic requests, xAI documents `prompt_tokens` as cumulative input tokens across the internal inference requests performed during the agentic process. Each internal inference includes conversation history up to that point.

Therefore reducing those canonical provider usage counters to the last internal inference would be incorrect accounting.

### xAI also exposes live context through `usage.context_details`

First-party implementation:

https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampler/src/client.rs#L123-L168

Grok Build explicitly distinguishes the two semantics:

- cumulative wire/billing fields remain unchanged;
- terminal `usage.context_details.input_tokens/output_tokens` are read as live context;
- its local total used for live-context presentation is derived from `context_details`.

First-party tests:

https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampler/src/client.rs#L3301-L3340

The test fixture contains larger cumulative wire usage and a smaller final/live `context_details` value, and verifies that cumulative input/output/cache/reasoning fields remain intact.

Missing/partial-data behavior:

https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampler/src/client.rs#L3418-L3445

If `context_details` is incomplete, Grok Build does not invent a smaller live total; it keeps the cumulative value.

This is the behavior we want DSH adapters/token-meter to be able to express without overloading canonical `TokenUsage`.

---

## Ecosystem precedent: Vercel AI preserves xAI context_details separately

Issue:

https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/19652

Merged fix:

https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/19657

Vercel AI encountered a lower-level form of the same interoperability problem: strict normalized usage handling discarded xAI's provider-specific `usage.context_details`.

The merged fix preserves xAI provider-specific usage metadata while leaving normalized token accounting semantics intact.

This is useful precedent for DSH:

> preserve normalized/canonical accounting, but do not discard richer provider usage semantics needed by higher-level context management.

Vercel's fix solves preservation. DSH still needs a typed/public seam for an adapter to route the preserved context sample into context-pressure measurement.

---

## Requested contract

### 1. Keep TokenUsage billing semantics unchanged

No existing `TokenUsage` counter should be reduced or reinterpreted to make pressure smaller.

For xAI agentic requests this means retaining the full cumulative provider usage exactly as reported.

Turn/session retry accounting should continue to aggregate canonical provider usage under existing DSH rules.

### 2. Add an independent optional context-occupancy signal

Preferred shape:

```ts
interface ContextOccupancySample {
  /**
   * Current effective prompt-side occupancy for one model inference/context.
   * This is never a replacement for billed TokenUsage.
   */
  readonly inputTokens: number;

  /** Optional current-context output occupancy if the provider exposes it. */
  readonly outputTokens?: number;

  readonly scope: 'request';

  readonly source:
    | 'provider'
    | 'adapter-exact'
    | 'host-estimate';
}

interface UsageChunk {
  /** Existing provider billing/accounting truth. */
  readonly usage: TokenUsage;

  /** Optional independent context-occupancy truth. */
  readonly contextUsage?: ContextOccupancySample;
}
```

The exact type names are not important. The semantic separation is.

### 3. Token-meter selection rules

Recommended rules:

1. If an authoritative current-request context sample exists, use it as the provider-backed context-pressure anchor.
2. Use ordinary `TokenUsage` as a pressure anchor only when its prompt usage scope is known to describe one effective request context.
3. Aggregate/unknown provider usage must not silently be treated as one-request occupancy.
4. If no exact occupancy sample is available, retain the existing explicit estimated fallback rather than fabricating a smaller provider usage value.
5. Canonical billing/accounting remains independent from whichever pressure anchor was selected.

### 4. xAI adapter mapping

For xAI terminal Responses usage:

```text
TokenUsage
  <- cumulative wire usage fields
     input_tokens / output_tokens / cache / reasoning / total

ContextOccupancySample.inputTokens
  <- usage.context_details.input_tokens

ContextOccupancySample.outputTokens
  <- usage.context_details.output_tokens   (optional)
```

DSH's current `contextPressure` semantics are prompt-side, so token-meter should normally anchor pressure from the prompt-side context value. It should not blindly substitute Grok Build's combined input+output display total.

### 5. Preserve provider-specific raw usage where practical

A raw/provider usage preservation seam is useful for forward compatibility, as Vercel AI #19652/#19657 demonstrates.

However, token-meter should not parse xAI-specific raw JSON itself.

Preferred ownership:

```text
provider adapter
    |
    +-- canonical TokenUsage
    |
    +-- typed ContextOccupancySample
            |
            v
        token-meter
```

---

## Conservative fallback requirements

If `context_details` is:

- absent;
- malformed;
- partial in a way that prevents a trustworthy prompt occupancy value;
- contradictory to the provider contract;

then DSH must not invent a smaller exact provider number.

Safe behavior:

1. preserve canonical billing usage;
2. mark exact provider occupancy unavailable;
3. use existing explicit `estimated` retained-surface pressure behavior where appropriate, or the existing conservative fallback.

This mirrors the defensive behavior in xAI Grok Build.

---

## Why an inputTokenScope-only extension is less preferable

A minimal alternative would be:

```ts
interface TokenUsage {
  readonly inputTokenScope?: 'request' | 'aggregate' | 'unknown';
  readonly contextTokens?: number;
}
```

This can work, but it mixes two semantic domains in the object whose existing contract is provider billing usage.

A separate context sample is safer because:

- future providers may expose richer occupancy fields;
- billing and occupancy evolve independently;
- consumers cannot accidentally sum `contextTokens` into billing totals;
- provenance can be explicit;
- retry/turn aggregation remains unambiguous.

---

## Acceptance tests

### A. xAI-style aggregate agentic usage

Provider reports:

```text
internal A prompt = 80k
internal B prompt = 120k
internal C prompt = 150k

canonical billed prompt usage = 350k
provider context_details.input_tokens = 150k
```

Expected:

- canonical/turn billing remains **350k**;
- provider-backed pressure anchor is **150k**;
- no counter is silently rewritten.

### B. Cache buckets

Provider reports cumulative billing with cache read/write buckets plus a current-context sample.

Expected:

- all billing/cache counters remain exact;
- context pressure uses only fields explicitly defined by the context-sample contract;
- no cache counter is silently double-counted into occupancy.

### C. Missing context_details

Expected:

- billing unchanged;
- provider occupancy marked unavailable;
- token-meter falls back to explicit `estimated` retained-surface behavior or existing conservative behavior.

### D. Partial context_details

Example: input occupancy absent but output occupancy present.

Expected:

- do not construct a fake exact prompt occupancy;
- billing unchanged;
- conservative/estimated fallback.

### E. Retries

Two externally visible attempts each carry provider billing usage.

Expected:

- Turn/session usage keeps billed usage from all attempts according to existing accounting semantics;
- current pressure follows the effective current context sample, not the sum of all prior billed prompts.

### F. Prune / compact / replay

Expected:

- billing ledger remains immutable;
- context pressure follows retained/current occupancy after the state transition;
- replay does not convert historical cumulative usage into current pressure.

### G. Invalid occupancy sample

Negative, non-finite, contradictory, or otherwise invalid value.

Expected:

- reject the occupancy sample;
- never replace canonical billing with a smaller number;
- conservative fallback.

---

## Compatibility

This can be additive:

- providers without an independent occupancy signal continue current behavior;
- existing `TokenUsage` consumers see no billing change;
- existing estimated token-meter paths remain available;
- only adapters/providers with a trustworthy independent signal opt in.

---

## Local motivating evidence

The community plugin `dsh-lcx-codex` (LCX) currently works around this entirely in plugin space:

- the full provider aggregate is preserved as canonical DSH usage, so accounting stays complete;
- aggregate scope is marked on the sample;
- when the terminal xAI response carries complete `usage.context_details`, LCX anchors pressure on `context_details.input_tokens` (plus DSH's own signed surface delta since that sample) through the public token-meter measurement seam;
- when it is absent or incomplete, LCX falls back to an explicit retained-surface estimate.

In a real Grok 4.x agentic run on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2: terminal `context_details.input_tokens` = 32,665, while the canonical cumulative usage sample the meter would otherwise anchor on = 64,291. With the workaround the meter reads 32,665; without it, 64,291 is treated as current context (about 2x), which triggers premature pruning/compaction.

The limitation is that the only public baseline kinds are `none | estimated | usage`, and `usage` requires a `TokenUsage`. So a provider-authoritative occupancy value has to be reported to DSH as `estimated`, and its provenance is lost on the DSH side (UI, compaction policy, and other plugins cannot tell it apart from a heuristic). Fabricating a smaller `TokenUsage` instead would under-report billing, which is exactly what #1886 rules out.

## Relationship to prior DSH work

This request should be framed as an extension of existing DSH architecture, not a competing redesign:

| Existing work | Established principle | Remaining edge addressed here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Discussion #3514 | provider vs estimated pressure provenance | provider billing usage itself may have aggregate scope |
| Discussion #2426 | billable auxiliary/compaction traffic should not become current pressure | one external agentic call can internally contain multiple billable inference prompts |
| Discussion #1886 | cumulative billing must remain complete | pressure cannot be fixed by lowering canonical usage |
| Discussion #7399 | occupancy and billed usage are already useful as separate public readings | adapters need an exact provider occupancy input to the pressure side |
| Vercel AI #19652 / PR #19657 | preserve xAI `context_details` without changing normalized accounting | DSH needs to route that preserved signal into token-meter |

---

*Posted by the maintainer of the `dsh-lcx-codex` plugin. Happy to test a draft contract against real xAI agentic traffic.*

discussions.title: [Bug][Web UI] Markdown image renders inline, so following text/links sit beside it (0.2.0-rc.2)
discussions.body:
## Summary In the Web UI, a Markdown image in an assistant message is rendered **inline** inside its paragraph, so any text or links that follow the image in the same paragraph are laid out to the **right** of the image, vertically centred. For typical chat output (an image followed by a caption or a list of links on the next lines) this looks broken. **Version:** DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, Web UI (Windows, Chromium). Light and dark themes. ## Reproduce Any assistant message whose Markdown puts an image and other content in the same paragraph, e.g. single newlines (soft breaks) between lines: ```markdown ![grapefruit](https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-images/grapefruit-slice-332-332.jpg) https://www.python.org/static/img/python-logo.png https://example.com/ ``` Soft breaks are rendered as spaces (correct CommonMark), so all three lines end up in one `

`. ## Actual The image wrapper is `

…links…

` and the button is styled `display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle`. The first link sits to the right of the ~332px image, centred on it; the remaining links wrap underneath the image. ## Expected A chat image should start on its own line, with the following text/links below it, as most chat UIs render assistant images. ## Suggested fix Make the image wrapper a block when it is the image container inside a paragraph, e.g.: ```css p > ._imageButton { display: block; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; margin: 4px 0 8px; } ``` or split an image into its own block at render time. A pure CSS fix has one trade-off: a small image deliberately placed mid-sentence would also start its own line, which is rare in assistant output. ## Workaround The `dsh-lcx-codex` plugin currently ships a scoped structural rule (`[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"] p>button:has(>img:only-child){display:block;width:fit-content}`) as a stopgap and will drop it once this is fixed upstream.

discussions.title: [Bug] subagent model selection (list_subagent_models, provider/model) silently missing in resumed/imported sessions and their children
[Bug] @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local throws "Cannot mix BigInt and other types" when statting .asar paths under Electron ASAR view (0.2.0-rc.2)
discussions.body:
## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: `0.2.0-rc.2`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local`: `0.2.0-rc.2`
- OS: Windows (reproduced on Windows 11)
- Runtime: packaged Electron app (`DeepSeek Harness.exe`), Electron's transparent ASAR view enabled
- Node/Electron runtime: Node.js 24.x bundled by Electron
- Affected source: `packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts`
- Observed built file: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js` (`probe` and `probeNoFollow`)

## Submission note

`CONTRIBUTING.md` currently says the project does not accept external pull requests and asks contributors to report issues/bugs in GitHub Discussions. This report is therefore submitted as a Discussion.

## Summary

`dsh-fs-local` calls `stat(path, { bigint: true })` and assumes the returned `mode` field is a `bigint`. Under Electron's transparent ASAR view, a path whose segment ends in `.asar` (or `.asar.unpacked`) is treated as an archive directory, and `fs.stat(..., { bigint: true })` still returns **Number** fields for such paths.

`probe()` then evaluates:

```ts
mode: Number(info.mode & 0o777n),
```

When `info.mode` is a Number, the `Number & bigint` expression throws:

```text
TypeError: Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions
```

This breaks any DSH operation that stats a path containing an `.asar` segment, including DSH's own installation file:

```text
C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar
```

## Root cause

Electron patches `fs` in packaged processes so that a path ending in `.asar` reads as a directory. For those paths, the `Stats` object returns Number fields even when `{ bigint: true }` is requested.

Minimal reproduction:

```js
// repro.cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');

const p = String.raw`C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar`;
const st = fs.statSync(p, { bigint: true });

console.log('mode type:', typeof st.mode, st.mode);   // "number" 16768
console.log('size type:', typeof st.size, st.size);   // "number" 0
console.log('isDirectory:', st.isDirectory());        // true

try {
  console.log(st.mode & 0o777n);
} catch (error) {
  console.error(error.stack);
}
```

Run it as an Electron Node process:

```bat
set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
"C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe" repro.cjs
```

Observed output:

```text
mode type: number 16768
size type: number 0
isDirectory: true
TypeError: Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions
    at Object.<anonymous> (...\repro.cjs:9:19)
```

Note: plain Node (without Electron's ASAR view) returns `bigint` fields here, so the failure is specific to Electron's ASAR patched `fs`.

Affected code in `packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts`:

```ts
export async function probe(absolutePath: string): Promise<PathInfo | null> {
  const info = await probeStats(absolutePath, path => stat(path, { bigint: true }))
  if (!info) return null
  return {
    version: versionOf(info),
    mode: Number(info.mode & 0o777n), // <-- throws when info.mode is a Number
    type: pathType(info),
    size: Number(info.size),
  }
}

export async function probeNoFollow(absolutePath: string): Promise<PathLinkInfo | null> {
  const info = await probeStats(absolutePath, path => lstat(path, { bigint: true }))
  if (!info) return null
  return {
    version: versionOf(info),
    mode: Number(info.mode & 0o777n), // <-- same problem
    type: pathLinkType(info),
    size: Number(info.size),
  }
}
```

`pathType(info)` / `pathLinkType(info)` continue to work because the original `Stats` methods are still backed by Number fields; only the BigInt mask expression is wrong.

## Suggested fix

Convert `info.mode` to `Number` before applying the numeric mask:

```diff
-    mode: Number(info.mode & 0o777n),
+    mode: Number(info.mode) & 0o777,
```

This works for both `Stats` (Number) and `BigIntStats` (BigInt) and removes the mixed-type bitwise expression. The same change is needed in both `probe()` and `probeNoFollow()`.

A more explicit alternative that keeps the BigInt mask:

```ts
const mode = typeof info.mode === 'bigint' ? info.mode : BigInt(info.mode)
// ...
mode: Number(mode & 0o777n),
```

## Patch

A ready-to-apply patch is attached as `deepseek-harness-fs-local-bigint.patch`:

```diff
--- a/packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts
+++ b/packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts
@@ -249,7 +249,7 @@
   if (!info) return null
   return {
     version: versionOf(info),
-    mode: Number(info.mode & 0o777n),
+    mode: Number(info.mode) & 0o777,
     type: pathType(info),
     size: Number(info.size),
   }
@@ -265,7 +265,7 @@
   if (!info) return null
   return {
     version: versionOf(info),
-    mode: Number(info.mode & 0o777n),
+    mode: Number(info.mode) & 0o777,
     type: pathLinkType(info),
     size: Number(info.size),
   }
```

## Test plan

1. Add a unit test with a fake `Stats`-like object whose `mode` is a Number and a `BigIntStats`-like object whose `mode` is a BigInt; assert `probe()` / `probeNoFollow()` return `mode = 384` for `0o600` / `0o777` masks and do not throw.
2. Existing normal `Stats`/`BigIntStats` tests should continue to pass.
3. Integration: in an Electron-as-Node process, run `stat`/`lstat` against a real `.asar` path with `{ bigint: true }` and assert the resulting object supports `isFile()` / `isDirectory()` and `mode & 0o777n`-style arithmetic without error.

## Workaround for downstream applications

Packaged Electron applications that cannot disable ASAR view (because their own code is loaded from `app.asar`) can normalize the returned `mode` before BigInt operations, or stat `.asar` paths through a physical-filesystem bypass. Downstream DSH Desktop already works around this by setting `process.noAsar = true` for unpacked processes; the official packaged build loads its own code from `app.asar`, so it cannot do that.

## Additional context

This was observed while running DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` on Windows. Reading the installation's own `resources\app.asar` through DSH file tools triggered the exact error. After patching the built expression to `Number(info.mode) & 511`, DSH `read` no longer threw the BigInt error and correctly returned `not a regular file` for the ASAR archive path.
