discussions.title: dsh安装好后打不开
discussions.body:
标题：桌面端 v0.2.0-rc.2 在 Windows 11 上启动即崩溃（EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT，V8 快照加载）

【环境】
- 系统：Windows 11（NT 10.0.26200）
- CPU：Intel Core Ultra 7 251HX（Arrow Lake）
- 桌面端：v0.2.0-rc.2（dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe，289,313,640 字节，数字签名有效）
- 内置 Electron：44.0.0（resources/version）
- VC++ 运行库齐全（vcruntime140 / msvcp140 / d3d11）

【现象一：官方安装器运行无反应】
双击运行 dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe，6 秒内以 exit code 2 退出：
不弹任何窗口、不创建安装目录、不写注册表项。
已尝试：静默(/S)、交互式、/S /NCRC、指定英文安装路径(/D=D:\DSH)、
杀掉残留进程后重试 —— 全部 exit code 2。

【现象二：手动解包后，应用启动即崩溃】
用 7-Zip 完整解包安装器载荷（9769 文件 / 1015 MB，与重新解包哈希逐字节一致），
放到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness 后运行，捕获到：

Received fatal exception EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT
	DeepSeek Harness!electron::fuses::IsLoadBrowserProcessSpecificV8SnapshotEnabled
	DeepSeek Harness!v8::internal::OptimizingCompileTaskExecutor::Stop
	DeepSeek Harness!v8::HeapSpaceStatistics::operator=
	KERNEL32!BaseThreadInitThunk
	ntdll!RtlUserThreadStart

进程约 14 秒退出，退出码 -2147483645（0x80000003）；
加 --no-sandbox 则为 -36861。
连用户数据目录（%APPDATA%\DeepSeek Harness）都未创建，说明在极早期崩溃。

【已排除】
- 不是安装包损坏：官方 latest 与你下载的文件大小完全一致（289,313,640 字节）
- 不是中文用户名路径：移到 C:\Users\Public\DSH 仍崩溃
- 不是解包不全：重新解包后 6 个关键文件 SHA256 逐字节一致
- 不是 Electron 环境问题：同一台机器上 Cherry Studio（Electron）正常启动，6 个子进程
- 不是 VC++ 运行库缺失

【期望】
希望排查 Electron 44 在该平台加载 v8_context_snapshot.bin 失败的问题；
如有可用构建或规避启动参数，非常感谢。

discussions.title: Web UI：严重卡顿和1.9GB标签页内存占用
discussions.body:
[标题] Web UI：严重卡顿和1.9GB标签页内存占用
[环境] dsh 0.2.0-rc.2（官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh），Web模式，Node v24.21.0，基于Firefox的浏览器
（Zen，构建版本 20260922050124），Linux，16GB内存。

[症状] 一旦流式响应开始，Web UI变得极其卡顿（输入延迟p99为43ms，最大
188ms）。卡顿程度随会话历史总量增加而加剧：删除旧会话可解决；开始新对话
则不行（旧历史仍留在DOM中）。仅标签页进程就达到1.88GB RSS，CPU占用80%。
同一机器上的TUI模式完全正常。

[性能分析证据 - Firefox Profiler，31.9秒采样] 同步重排：47,352次（约1,484次/秒，均匀
分布）；样式重算：94,994次（占线程时间42.6%）；UpdateContainerQueryStyles：95,064次（30.6%）；
DoFlushPendingNotifications：占主线程时间46.1%；GC仅2.28秒（不是瓶颈）。所有重排
原因均指向“Container Query Styles Update”。流式消息以约59个消息事件/秒到达；
每条消息触发约25次强制重排。页面加载时（历史水合）出现第二波47,352次重排。
堆栈符号确认涉及React 18（useSyncExternalStore/useLayoutEffect）及组件ChatView
/ ConversationContent / parseRemoteStreamServerMessage。

[进程证据 - ps aux] dsh Web标签页：1.88GB RSS @ 79.6% CPU；node dsh Web后端：1.29GB；
billion-context服务：338MB。合计约4.7GB（在16GB机器上）。

[复现步骤] 积累大量会话历史，打开Web UI，启动任意流式响应。安全模式/禁用
扩展均无效。

[建议] (1) 虚拟化对话列表——仅渲染可见消息，延迟水合历史记录；
(2) 将流式更新批量合并为每帧一次渲染；(3) 在DOM写入前批量执行几何读取，以打破
布局抖动循环；(4) 缩小或移除消息区域的容器查询；(5) 在后端对历史记录进行分页。

[Title] Web UI: severe jank and 1.9GB tab memory caused by full-history hydration and forced reflow storm
[Environment] dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (official @deepseek-ai/dsh), web mode, Node v24.21.0, Firefox-based browser
(Zen, build 20260922050124), Linux, 16GB RAM.

[Symptoms] Once a streaming response starts, the web UI becomes extremely laggy (input delay p99 43ms, max
188ms). Jank scales with total session history: deleting old sessions resolves it; starting a new
conversation does NOT (old history stays in DOM). The tab process alone reaches 1.88GB RSS with 80% CPU.
TUI mode on the same machine is perfectly fine.

[Profile evidence - Firefox Profiler, 31.9s capture] Sync reflows: 47,352 (~1,484/sec, uniformly
distributed); Styles recalcs: 94,994 (42.6% of thread time); UpdateContainerQueryStyles: 95,064 (30.6%);
DoFlushPendingNotifications: 46.1% of main thread time; GC only 2.28s (not the bottleneck). ALL reflow
causes resolve to "Container Query Styles Update". Streaming messages arrive as ~59 message events/sec;
each message triggers ~25 forced reflows. A second burst of 47,352 reflows occurs at page load (history
hydration). Stack symbols confirm React 18 (useSyncExternalStore/useLayoutEffect) and components ChatView
/ ConversationContent / parseRemoteStreamServerMessage.

[Process evidence - ps aux] dsh web tab: 1.88GB RSS @ 79.6% CPU; node dsh web backend: 1.29GB;
billion-context service: 338MB. Combined ~4.7GB on a 16GB machine.

[Repro] Accumulate large session history, open web UI, start any streaming response. Safe mode / disabled
extensions do not help.

[Suggestions] (1) Virtualize the conversation list - render visible messages only, lazy-hydrate history;
(2) batch streaming updates to one render per frame; (3) batch geometry reads before DOM writes to break
the layout-thrashing loop; (4) scope down or remove container queries in the message area; (5) paginate
history on the backend.

discussions.title: [Bug] Repeated HTTP 400 path-expansion error prevents subsequent turns in an existing conversation
discussions.body:
Root cause and responsible component are unconfirmed.

## Environment

- Windows browser accessing `dsh web`, with a WSL-backed project.
- UI model label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
- Locally installed CLI package `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: `0.2.0-rc.2` (the version serving `dsh web` has not been verified; these may differ).
- An existing long-running conversation with a goal referencing a project work-order file.

## Observed behavior

A turn fails with HTTP 400 and `invalid_request_error`:

```text
a single path expansion cannot exceed 512 candidates
```

Sending a subsequent message asking for a single short `tail` command with a quoted absolute file path fails with the same error. The UI shows a turn failure without displaying a command execution for that new turn. Thus the evidence does not establish that the new command was executed.

Example trace IDs from the reported incident:

- `ea1bc44f0c88c4f492dbdbcc06cfad11`
- `2cbfa852e0b5418b003a95591ce8637b`
- `f9be61c204e933e05557109f5fefb0ad`

Independent local checks showed that previously launched background workers continued executing. The interactive turn failures did not terminate those workers.

## Expected behavior

If a file expansion exceeds a documented bound, identify the offending reference and expose a way to remove or narrow it. The user should be able to send a subsequent turn without being trapped by a previous invalid expansion.

## Attribution and reproduction limitations

- This is an incident report, not a confirmed minimal reproduction.
- A clean conversation test has not been performed.
- The failing request payload and web-serving/plugin versions have not been captured.
- The exact message was not found in the inspected locally installed `@deepseek-ai` JavaScript dependencies.
- The error may originate in a plugin, a provider/gateway request validator, or the harness request/context pipeline. A server trace is needed to distinguish these possibilities.

## Requested investigation

Please identify which component emits this message and whether a retained conversation reference is replayed after a failed expansion. If the error originates upstream of the harness, please provide enough diagnostic context to identify the responsible request field and service.

No private source material, credentials, full request payloads, or unredacted screenshot are included.

discussions.title: dsh-llm-pi-ai：建议跳过内容为空的 user 消息（与 dsh-llm-deepseek 对齐，让替换载体对模型隐身）
discussions.body:
## 问题

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 组装请求时，会把每条历史消息转换后**无条件** push 成 user 消息（`lib/index.js` 约 1345 行）：

```js
const content = userContent(message.content, requestImages, resolveImageAccess);
messages.push({ role: "user", content, timestamp: 0 });
```

`userContent()` 会过滤掉空的 text 块，并在“全部是 text”时 **join 成字符串**。于是一条 `content: []` 的 `user/message`（合法的 v4 surface 替换载体，日志校验与重放均通过）在发往提供方时会变成 `content: ""`。至少一个 OpenAI 兼容网关会直接返回：

```text
400 invalid_request_error: "user message must have content"（param: messages.N.content）
```

已在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2`（`@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.85.x，`openai-completions` 路径）实测复现；删除写入本身与冷读重放都正常，失败点只在发请求那一步。

## 官方 DeepSeek 适配器已有等价逻辑

`dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js:1672`：

```js
if (message.role === "user" && content.length === 0) continue;
```

## 建议修复（一行）

pi-ai 组装请求的循环里：

```js
const content = userContent(message.content, requestImages, resolveImageAccess);
if (content.length === 0) continue;   // '' 和 [] 的 length 都是 0
messages.push({ role: "user", content, timestamp: 0 });
```

或者让 `userContent()` 在无内容时返回 `[]` 而不是 `''`——pi-ai 自己的 `openai-completions` 转换器对空数组已经会 `continue`。

## 为什么重要

插件要“删除 / 恢复”会话内容时，只能追加一条**不带回合**的 `user/message` 替换载体：其他 surface 事件（`system/developer/assistant`）都要求“打开中的 turn+step”，而自己开一个合成回合会打乱 agent loop 的回合计数——它的下一个真实回合会复用被占用的回合号，冷读报 `turn/start does not open the expected turn`，并连带让按回合号隐藏的客户端吞掉那一回合的行。

有了这一行，替换载体就能直接使用 `content: []`：**对所有提供方彻底不进模型输入**（不是空白消息，是消息不存在），同时保持日志合法、不占回合、不影响统计。没有它，插件只能写一条空白/标记消息（零宽空格或 `[deleted]`），模型会看到、甚至会复述出来；此前为规避这一点尝试过“合成回合 + 空 `system/message`”，结果正如上面所述损坏了日志。

同一需求也适用于任何需要“静默替换”的插件（恢复、重跑、编辑等），建议上下游一起对齐这个语义：**空内容的 user 消息一律不进入请求**。

## 复现要点

- 载体写入（成功、可重放）：

```js
session.append(
  'user/message',
  { id: randomUUID(), role: 'user', content: [], source: { kind: 'plugin:<name>' } },
  { surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', startSeq, endSeq }, sourceEventSeqs: shadowed },
)
```

- 下一次模型请求即 400（pi-ai / openai-completions 路径）；把 `content` 换成 `[{ type: 'text', text: '\u200b' }]` 则请求成功，但模型能看到一条空白 user 消息。

discussions.title: 智能体团队插件相关
discussions.body:
在一个会话里使用智能体团队后,团队成员是不是不能修改、删除、新建?
我在一个长的会话里(主会话模型用量0.25b词元,总消耗大概0.6b词元)开启智能体团队后,之后继续在会话内提及智能体团队这一插件,发现以下情况.

**第一次prompt(这一次的prompt里没有明确说要启用新成员):**
我的要求是,要使用智能体团队,并行出发,不等待、不阻塞. 然后你说的必须我定口径.......
**deepseek回复截取:**
收到两项口径决定。并行出发、不等待——现在派 4 个队友，各自独立写盘，我同时做口径落地的量化。
代码Error: code run failed (exception): ToolCallError: Team member limit 8 reached
创建队友Error: Team member limit 8 reached
团队名额上限 8（已有 7 个队友）。改用复用现有队友——直接把他们唤醒接新任务，仍然是并行出发。

**第二次prompt(我尝试用更明确的指令让lead成员修改团队成员):**
开启智能体团队,重新规划团队成员. 然后进行语义解析升级
**deepseek回复截取:**
开启团队前先摸清现状与升级靶点。
现状清楚了。升级靶点分五档，其中班组级是全新粒度。先试能不能新建成员（现有 8 个已满）。
成员上限 8 已满，无法新建。 那就按"重新规划"的本义——把 8 个现有成员整体改制。先建任务板。


我在想如果能让lead成员修改或者删除后新建团队成员,是不是会更好?因为一个长会话运行一段时间后,8 个teammate名额被历史团队占满。后续任务性质发生变化,即使明确要求 Lead “重新规划团队成员”,Lead 也无法删除旧成员并建立新的成员,只能继续复用原来的 8 个成员.我不是很确定这样做会不会对任务的完成质量产生影响,在我目前的情况下,感觉不出来好坏.

我让ai帮我查了一下讨论区,#4642也提到了智能体团队这个插件.

discussions.title: 建议：会话格式 v4 的写入路径对老式 `kind:'plugin'` 硬拒，而读取路径已能兼容改写 —— 建议对齐，并让这类失败可诊断
discussions.body:
## 现象

DSH Desktop nightly（宿主会话格式 v4；编码器 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4@0.2.0-rc.2`）下：

- 仍在写老式 `source: { kind:'plugin', plugin:X }` 的第三方插件，其 `session.append(...)` 会被写入校验拒绝；
- 因为 `append` 的持久化是异步的，插件侧 `try/catch` 抓不到，异常以**未处理的 promise rejection** 形式直接显示给用户：

```
SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
```

- 插件自己的失败日志为空（同步 `catch` 捕不到），会话日志里也没有该行，所以从插件作者视角这些问题几乎是不可见的；用户侧则是每轮对话弹一次内部报错。

## 具体的不对称

同一份编码器里：

- **读取路径**有兼容改写。`rewriteV3MessageSource()` → `rewritePluginSource()` / `producerKind()`（`lib/index.js:87-93`、`:101-107`）会把 `{ kind:'plugin', plugin:X }` 改写成 `{ kind:'plugin:X' }`，并剥掉 `plugin` 字段。
- **写入路径**没有对等改写。`assertV4SourceRowAdmission()`（`:142-152`）只在 `kind === 'plugin'` 时调用 `source()`，而 `source()`（`:124-127`）直接 `throw`。

结果是「历史行读了能自动迁移、新写入却硬拒」，且拒收理由只以内部错误字符串暴露。

## 影响

- 任何沿用 v4 之前写法的插件（本机确认到 `@telosmaylx/dsh-session-notify`、`dsh-layered-memory`、`aegis-method-pack`）在 v4 宿主上都会失效，且失效方式是静默丢弃 + UI 报错。
- 插件作者既拿不到日志、也拿不到「应该改成什么」的提示，只能靠读宿主源码/反编译 asar 才能定位。

## 建议（任选，按性价比排序）

1. **写入路径对齐读取路径**：`assertV4SourceRowAdmission` 遇到 `kind:'plugin'` 时先做与迁移一致的改写（`producerKind()`），而不是直接抛错；至少把「该改成 `plugin:<id>`」写进错误消息，并带上插件名。
2. **让 `session.append` 的失败可被处理**：既然它是异步的，明确把 Promise 作为契约的一部分（或提供错误通道），使插件能按自己的方式记录失败，而不是让 rejection 冒到 UI。
3. **补齐插件契约文档**：把「v4 起 `source.kind` 必须是生产者自有标识（`plugin:<id>` 或具名 producer），老式 `{kind:'plugin',plugin:X}` 已废弃」写成显式契约，并给出时间线与迁移示例；目前插件侧只能从行为反推。

## 证据（本机实测，同版本）

- v4 会话文件（头部 `sessionFormatVersion: 4`）中 `source.kind === 'plugin'` 的行数 = **0**；同文件内 `turn/end` 出现 2 次/1 次，而对应插件的 notice 行 = **0**。
- V3 会话文件（`session.jsonl.zstd`）中同样的 notice 行存在（同一会话 4 条、紧跟 `turn/end`），说明链路此前是通的。
- 该插件自己的日志 543 行内「追加失败」= **0 条**。
- 用宿主打包的同一编码器编码两个 payload：老形状抛 `SessionFormatError`，改成 `kind:'plugin:<id>'` 后通过（保留 `plugin` 字段亦可通过）。

discussions.title: [Bug] `session/create` with `cwd` (or without `workspaceId`) silently creates a session outside any workspace — Ungrouped with `cwd=C:\Windows\System32`
discussions.body:
**RU:** [Баг] `session/create` с `cwd` (или без `workspaceId`) молча создаёт сессию вне воркспейса — Ungrouped с `cwd=C:\Windows\System32`

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Product | DSH (preview) — DeepSeek Harness, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` |
| Version | `0.1.5-rc.3` (resolved via `npx`) |
| OS | Windows, Node.js |
| Component | host RPC `session/create`, `workspace/archiveSession` |

## Summary

`session/create` called with a `cwd` field (or with no `workspaceId`) does not return an error: the session is created, but lands in the "Ungrouped" group with the default `cwd = C:\Windows\System32` instead of the requested workspace.

Root cause: `session/create` accepts and silently ignores the non-binding `cwd` argument instead of rejecting the request or resolving the owning workspace itself. The canonical flow (`workspace/create` → `session/create` with `workspaceId`) is not enforced at the RPC level.

This has reproduced 3 times; one incident produced ~50 duplicate sessions and direct token loss.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Call `POST /api/session/create` with `request: { cwd: "…" }` (no `workspaceId`).
2. The response is `200` with a valid `sessionId`, no warning.
3. In `session/list` the session shows `cwd = C:\Windows\System32` and is not attached to any workspace.

## Expected vs Actual behavior

| | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| `session/create` without `workspaceId` | Rejected (400), or `cwd` resolved to the owning workspace | Accepted silently; session becomes Ungrouped with `cwd=C:\Windows\System32` |
| Archived sessions in `session/list` | Distinguishable (`archived`) or excluded at RPC level | Still listed; only the UI filters them, skewing counters and automation |

## Impact

- Mass generation of "lost" sessions outside the target workspace (Ungrouped).
- The default `cwd` points at `C:\Windows\System32`, so an agent in such a session works in the wrong directory.
- There is no `session/delete` RPC: cleanup is only via `workspace/archiveSession`, yet archived sessions remain in `session/list`.

## Suggested fix

1. Validate `session/create`: missing `workspaceId` + present `cwd` → error, not a silent fallback to `C:\Windows\System32`.
2. Add an `archived` flag to `session/list` so automation does not count archived sessions as live.
3. (Nice-to-have) RPC-level delete / real exclusion of archived sessions from the list.

---

# [Баг] `session/create` с `cwd` (или без `workspaceId`) молча создаёт сессию вне воркспейса — Ungrouped с `cwd=C:\Windows\System32`

**EN:** [Bug] `session/create` with `cwd` (or without `workspaceId`) silently creates a session outside any workspace — Ungrouped with `cwd=C:\Windows\System32`

## Окружение

| Параметр | Значение |
|---|---|
| Продукт | DSH (превью) — DeepSeek Harness, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` |
| Версия | `0.1.5-rc.3` (через `npx`) |
| ОС | Windows, Node.js |
| Компонент | host RPC `session/create`, `workspace/archiveSession` |

## Краткое описание

Вызов `session/create` с полем `cwd` (либо вовсе без `workspaceId`) не возвращает ошибку: сессия создаётся, но попадает в группу «Ungrouped» с дефолтным `cwd = C:\Windows\System32`, а не в запрошенный воркспейс.

Корень: `session/create` принимает и молча игнорирует «чужой» для привязки аргумент `cwd` вместо того, чтобы отвергнуть запрос или самому резолвить воркспейс-владелец. Канонический поток (`workspace/create` → `session/create` с `workspaceId`) ничем не enforced на уровне RPC.

Баг воспроизвёлся 3 раза; в одном инциденте — ~50 дублей сессий и прямые потери токенов.

## Шаги воспроизведения

1. `POST /api/session/create` с `request: { cwd: "…" }` (без `workspaceId`).
2. Ответ — `200` с валидным `sessionId`, без предупреждения.
3. В `session/list` сессия числится с `cwd = C:\Windows\System32` и не привязана к воркспейсу.

## Ожидаемое vs фактическое поведение

| | Ожидается | Фактически |
|---|---|---|
| `session/create` без `workspaceId` | Отвергается (400) либо `cwd` резолвится в воркспейс-владелец | Принимается молча; сессия уходит в Ungrouped с `cwd=C:\Windows\System32` |
| Архивные сессии в `session/list` | Различимы (`archived`) или исключены на уровне RPC | Остаются в списке; фильтрует только UI — сбивает счётчики и автоматику |

## Влияние

- Массовая генерация «потерянных» сессий вне целевого воркспейса (Ungrouped).
- Дефолтный `cwd` указывает на `C:\Windows\System32` — агент в такой сессии работает не там, где нужно.
- Нет RPC `session/delete`: уборка только через `workspace/archiveSession`, но архивные сессии остаются в `session/list`.

## Предложение по исправлению

1. Валидировать `session/create`: отсутствие `workspaceId` + наличие `cwd` → ошибка, а не молчаливый fallback на `C:\Windows\System32`.
2. Добавить признак `archived` в `session/list`, чтобы автоматика не считала архивные сессии живыми.
3. (Желательно) RPC-удаление / реальное исключение архивных сессий из списка.

> Anonymized for public reporting: workspace names, paths, session names/ids and dates have been genericized.

discussions.title: RTL scripts (Persian/Arabic/Hebrew) render flush-left in the Web GUI transcript
discussions.body:
# Bug report — RTL scripts (Persian / Arabic / Hebrew) render flush-left in the Web GUI transcript | field | value | |---|---| | **Product** | DeepSeek Harness (Desktop) | | **Version** | `0.2.0-rc.2` (`FileVersion 0.2.0-rc.2`, `ProductVersion 0.2.0.0`, channel `nightly`, `win-x64`) | | **Platform** | Windows 11 x64, bundled Electron/Chromium | | **Affected packages** | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (MarkdownText), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` | | **Kind** | i18n / bidi correctness | | **Severity** | Cosmetic but blocks comfortable use for every RTL-script user | --- ## 1. Summary The Web GUI never sets a text `direction` on transcript content. Markdown prose is rendered with the CSS initial `text-align: start`, which resolves against the element's computed `direction` — always `ltr`. A Persian paragraph is therefore laid out right-to-left *internally* (the Unicode bidi algorithm handles the script itself) but the block sits flush **left**, with terminal punctuation at the wrong edge and ragged-right/ragged-left inverted. There is no setting, locale entry, or theme token that changes this. The same applies to the user message bubble and to composer drafts. --- ## 2. Steps to reproduce 1. Open the Web GUI (Desktop app, any UI language). 2. Send any message in Persian, e.g. `این یک پیام آزمایشی است.` 3. Read the user bubble, then any Persian reply from the assistant. **Actual** — every Persian block is flush **left**: ``` | این یک پیام آزمایشی است. | | | ``` **Expected** — flush **right**, matching the script's direction: ``` | این یک پیام آزمایشی است. | | | ``` --- ## 3. Root cause ### 3.1 No `direction` is ever set Searching every compiled `@deepseek-ai` client bundle for `documentElement.dir`, `setAttribute("dir"`, or `.dir = "rtl"` returns exactly one hit: - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-terminal/lib/client.js:315` — sets `this.element.dir = "ltr"` on the **xterm** container (i.e. deliberately forcing LTR for the terminal, not managing document direction). `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` maintains `` but has no notion of direction: > "the active locale is applied immediately: the UI copy switches, `` > points at the external id or built-in document tag" > — `dsh-client-locale/README.md` The `dsh.client` manifest schema (`dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js:61-75`) accepts only `platform`, `inject`, `external`, `immediately`. `ctx.theme` overrides colour alias tokens only. There is no extension point that owns direction. ### 3.2 The prose container relies on the `ltr` initial value In the shipped dist stylesheet `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-BPHePDI_.css`: ```css ._markdown_1ypvv_5{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font:var(--dsw-font-markdown-base);color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)} ``` No `text-align`, no `direction`. The source sheet is `packages/client/ui-primitives/src/client/markdown/MarkdownText.module.css` (`.markdown { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: var(--dsw-font-markdown-base); color: ... }`). The only `text-align` declarations in that sheet are `text-align: start` on table cells and `text-align: inherit` — i.e. the design system deliberately lets alignment follow the element's direction. It simply never provides one. ### 3.3 The user bubble has the same gap In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js`: ```css .cJsG2q_bubble{background:var(--dsw-specific-bubble);border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-xl);max-width:100%;font-size:var(--dsh-content-font-size,14px);line-height:calc(22px + var(--dsh-content-font-delta,0px));color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary);white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;padding:10px 16px} ``` No `text-align`, no `direction`. > `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` does hard-code `text-align:left` > on `.v1fjQa_bubble`, which additionally cannot follow the script even once a > direction is introduced. --- ## 4. Proposed fix Adopt `unicode-bidi: plaintext` on block-level prose, which lets each paragraph resolve its own direction from its first strong character while `text-align: start` follows it. English prose, code, and LTR chrome are unaffected because their first strong character is still Latin. ```css /* MarkdownText.module.css */ .markdown, .markdown :is(p, li, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, dt, dd, td, th, figcaption) { unicode-bidi: plaintext; } ``` ```css /* ui-chat bubble */ .bubble { unicode-bidi: plaintext; text-align: start; } ``` An equivalent and arguably more idiomatic fix is to emit `dir="auto"` on the prose root and the bubble, matching what the HTML spec provides for exactly this case. ### 4.1 The descendant selector is required `unicode-bidi` is **not** inherited, and each block box establishes its own bidi paragraph. Applying the property to the container alone has **no effect** on the nested `

` elements the Markdown renderer produces. This was verified — see §5, rows S1 vs S2. ### 4.2 `direction: rtl` was evaluated and rejected A blanket `direction: rtl` does right-align Persian, but it also right-aligns **English prose and code**, which is worse than the current state. Measured in §5, row C. --- ## 5. Verification Measured in Chrome 141 with `Range.getBoundingClientRect()` against the element box (`gapLeft` / `gapRight`; the smaller gap is the alignment edge), using a DOM structure equivalent to the Markdown renderer's output. | variant | selector strategy | Persian `

` | English `

` | Persian `

  • ` | |---|---|---|---|---| | **A** current DSH | none | left | left | left | | **S1** | container only | **left** ❌ | left | **left** ❌ | | **S2** | container + block children | **RIGHT** ✅ | left ✅ | **RIGHT** ✅ | | **S3** | container + `*` | RIGHT | left | RIGHT | | **C** | `direction: rtl` | RIGHT | **RIGHT** ❌ | RIGHT | | **D** | `dir="auto"` | RIGHT | left | left | Raw S2 output: ``` s2-fa gapLeft= 313 gapRight= 0 => RIGHT (bidi=plaintext) s2-en gapLeft= 0 gapRight= 278 => left (bidi=plaintext) s2-li gapLeft= 387 gapRight= 0 => RIGHT (bidi=plaintext) ``` Mixed-content checks under S2 (all correct): | input | result | |---|---| | `سلام، فایل gui-helpers.ps1 را خواندم و خط 42 مشکل دارد.` | RIGHT | | `1. اول read_file صدا زده می‌شود، بعد نتیجه برمی‌گردد.` | RIGHT | | `Result: 123 × 456 = 56,088 — done.` | left | S3 also works but reaches inline elements, which changes isolation semantics for inline runs; S2 is the narrower correct rule. --- ## 6. Impact Every user who writes Persian, Arabic, Hebrew, Urdu, or any other RTL script sees mis-aligned transcript content. Because the misalignment is inverted rather than absent, it is conspicuous: paragraphs begin at the edge the eye is not tracking and end with ragged whitespace on the wrong side. --- ## 7. Workaround available A third-party `dsh.client` plugin can inject the rule as an owned stylesheet (`document.createElement("style")` with `data-plugin` / `data-plugin-css`, as every first-party client plugin does). Selectors that match the CSS-module *local-name fragment* (`[class*="_markdown"]`, `[class*="_bubble"]`) survive hash changes across rebuilds. That workaround is, however, only reachable by users who know to install a plugin, for what is baseline i18n behaviour belonging in the design system. Happy to open a PR adding §4 to `MarkdownText.module.css` and the chat bubble sheet if the direction choice (`unicode-bidi: plaintext` vs. emitted `dir="auto"`) is acceptable.
