discussions.title: Bug: one retired plugin source wrapper makes a whole v4 session unreadable (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2)
discussions.body:
Environment: dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, Windows 11, profile `web`, Node v24.19.0.

## Symptom

Turns finished generating and then failed to finalize with:

```
format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
```

The Web UI reported it as the turn failing. The user saw it on turns that only called tools and never spawned a subagent. The row that trips the check is injected by the memory plugin in the turn's opening block (seq 15 to 21, all within 10 ms), alongside the approval notice, agent instructions, the runtime-context snapshot and the skill catalog, so no tool call is involved.

## What was on disk

I dumped the session logs (multi-frame zstd: split on the magic bytes `28 B5 2F FD`, decode each frame) and read the source of every durable message. Across 5 native v4 sessions and 1,515 durable rows there were exactly two violations, both in one session:

```
session-a2f5bd55-2a20-4d7a-99eb-0a81a185ca04
  seq 19   user/message   id ea6075d3-ef81-4f35-97e0-8bea7978da15
  source {"kind":"plugin","plugin":"memos-local-memory","form":"recall"}
```

That row is the memory recall block the memos plugin injects at the start of a turn. Its producer is `@memtensor/memos-local-plugin` 2.0.20 at `dist/adapters/deepseek-harness/index.js` (`createRecallMessage`), which still builds the retired V3 wrapper. Format v4 retires `{kind:"plugin",plugin:"<id>"}` in favour of a producer-owned kind; DSH's own v3 to v4 converter derives exactly `plugin:<id>` for that wrapper, so the row was written in a shape the format no longer admits.

Every subagent, tool, approval and runtime-context row in those 5 sessions conformed. Three sibling plugins already brand their injected messages: `dsh-vision-router` ships a dedicated `session-message-source-compat.js`, and `@xmanrui/dsh-im` and `dsh-better-sidebar` write `plugin:<name>`.

## Why one row is fatal

The admission check exists in two places:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js`, which exposes the two admission entry points named below. The region header of the build names its source file as `../session-format-v3-to-v4/src/message-sources.ts`, where `source()` lives.
- A bundled copy inside `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/worker.cjs:10902`, used by the current-generation verification worker thread (`verifyJsonlCurrentGeneration`, spawned from `lib/index.js:1484`, wired in as `verifyCurrentFile` from `publishPreparedMigration` at `lib/index.js:2710`).

Spawning that worker against the session file reproduces the failure. It receives the file path, the compression, the expected session id and the expected event count through its `workerData`:

```
workerData {path, compression: "zstd", expectedId, expectedEventCount}

ok:false  "format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind"
  at source -> assertV4SourceRowAdmission -> assertV4RowAdmission -> SessionLogScanner.consumeEventLine
```

The check runs while committed rows are scanned, so one bad row fails verification of the generation. In the installed ESM build, `assertV4MessageSources` (line 132) calls it for whole-artifact admission and `assertV4SourceRowAdmission` (line 142) calls it for row admission; the bundled worker carries its own copy of the check and raises the same string. The message names neither the row nor the producer. Neither package exposes a path that rewrites an already-committed row; the only source rewrite I found is `rewritePluginSource` in the v3 to v4 converter, and it runs while an older log is being migrated.

An earlier report of this symptom blamed subagent and tool envelopes. The rows measured here do not support that: the only two non-conforming rows in this profile came from the memory plugin.

## Local mitigation, applied and verified

1. Producer side: `createRecallMessage` now writes `{"kind":"plugin:memos-local-memory","plugin":"memos-local-memory","form":"recall"}`.
2. Consumer side: the two copies of the assertion were made non-fatal on this machine, so already-written rows cannot brick a session.
3. Data: the two rows on disk were rewritten to the v4 shape one frame at a time, leaving the other frames byte-identical. V3 logs were excluded, because in v3 that wrapper is the required shape.

The same frozen file verifies with `ok:true` afterwards, the audit reports zero remaining violations, and turns written after the fix use the branded kind.

## Requests

1. Name the row in the error: event type, seq, message id, and the `plugin` field already carried by the row. The identical string comes from the ESM package and from the bundled worker, and it is raised by two different admission entry points (row admission and whole-artifact message admission), so it does not say which one rejected the row.
2. Make a non-conforming auxiliary plugin row recoverable on the read and verification paths, or provide a repair path. One plugin's formatting mistake should not cost the user a whole session, and here it also blocked generation verification. Any repair has to key off the header version: in v3 logs that wrapper is the required shape and the v3 to v4 converter consumes it.
3. Do not adopt the coercion rules from that earlier report (`subagent` to `agent:subagent`, unknown kinds to `plugin:unknown`). The row already carries its plugin id, and the converter's existing mapping preserves attribution; an invented kind would not.

discussions.title: 动态插件缺少可在 workspace-write 下合法落盘的「全局设置」通道
discussions.body:
**EN — TL;DR.** Dynamic plugins have no sandbox-legal way to persist *global* settings. Under **workspace-write** the writable roots are only the session workspace plus the platform temp dirs, so every write under **%DSH_HOME%** is denied with **FS_SANDBOX_DENIED**. The resolved policy is exactly { mode, workspaceRoot, sessionId } with no extra-grant entry point, and the dynamic-plugin facades expose no storage service at all (symbol census = 0 / 0 / 0). Net effect: plugin settings never persist. Repro, contract-level evidence, two rejected workarounds, and a proposed host-side **pluginSettings** service below.

---

## 1. 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | **0.2.0-rc.2**（live 树） |
| 安装树 | D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\ |
| 操作系统 | Windows 11 |
| Node | v26.10.0 |
| 控制台 | WinUI3 / .NET 11 / WindowsAppSDK 2.5.4-experimental |
| 动态插件 | 15 个 def · 心跳 **15/15 running** |
| %DSH_HOME% | 本机为 C:\Users\\.dsh（本文统一写作 %DSH_HOME%） |
| 会话工作目录 | D:\deepseek harness —— 也就是 workspace-write 的写边界 |

---

## 2. 复现步骤

### R1 — 地基自证：workspace-write 的可写边界不含 %DSH_HOME%

1. 让会话处于 **workspace-write**（默认档，可由策略控件切换）。
2. 在该会话里执行：

```powershell
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\_sandbox-probe.txt" -Value hi
```

3. **预期**（与下文 4.1 的实测日志同源、同一条代码路径）：

```
[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]
```

   文件不会被创建。
4. **对照**：把同一份内容写到会话工作目录（D:\deepseek harness\_sandbox-probe.txt）⇒ 成功。

> R1 不依赖任何第三方插件，任何人都能在两分钟内跑完；它证明的是本报告的地基。

### R2 — 动态插件侧（本报告的真实场景）

1. 打开任一动态插件的设置面板，改任意一项并保存（该面板最终调用宿主半身的 fs 写入）。
2. 立即看目标文件的 mtime 与内容：

```powershell
Get-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dynamic-plugins\.<id>-settings.json" |
  Select-Object Length, LastWriteTime
```

3. **实测**：mtime 停在保存动作之前，内容仍是默认值（见 4.7 的三个实例）。
4. **对照**：同一时间窗内，%DSH_HOME% 下**确实**有文件在被正常写入（会话日志、插件心跳日志、插件自己的缓存目录）⇒ 不是磁盘或 ACL 的普遍故障，而是「写 %DSH_HOME%」这一条路径被沙箱拒绝。
5. 失败一度是**完全静默**的 —— 给写盘调用补上失败日志之后，才第一次拿到含 mode 的可读原因（见 4.1）。

---

## 3. 期望 vs 实际

| | 期望 | 实际 |
|---|---|---|
| 用户在插件设置面板点「保存」 | 设置写入 %DSH_HOME% 下的插件设置文件，重开面板 / 重启后仍在 | 写被沙箱拒绝；面板看起来「保存成功」，实际什么都没落盘 |
| 插件作者想持久化全局设置 | 有一个受支持、与沙箱模式无关的通道 | **没有**：facade 无 storage 服务，fs 写入被 workspace-write 边界挡住 |
| 失败时的可观测性 | 平台给出结构化错误码 | 原为完全静默；补日志后才可读（错误码本身是 FS_SANDBOX_DENIED） |
| 插件其余功能 | 正常 | **正常**（本条只影响「设置能否落盘」） |

---

## 4. 证据

### 4.1 原始拒绝日志（逐字）

宿主侧 console.error 落到工作区的 dsh-console.log（标签为插件运行时 id）：

```
[cordis:bchat-3] [plugin] 写盘失败：cannot write "C:\Users\<用户名>\.dsh\dynamic-plugins\.bchat-settings.json": file access denied under workspace-write mode
```

复算：

```powershell
Select-String -Path 'D:\deepseek harness\dsh-console.log' -Pattern 'settings\.json' |
  Select-Object -First 3
```

该文件内同一行文本共 **7 处**（2026-10-01 本机复核）。

### 4.2 契约证据 A：workspace-write 的可写根只有三个 —— 这条是决定性的

**D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox\lib\index.js:166-173**

```js
function writableRoots(policy) {
	if (policy.mode !== "workspace-write") return [];
	return [...new Set([
		policy.workspaceRoot,
		"/tmp",
		tmpdir()
	].map(canonicalPath))];
}
```

⇒ workspace-write 下**可写根 = 会话工作根 + /tmp + 系统临时目录**，仅此三项。%DSH_HOME% **不在其中**，且没有任何参数能让它进去。

复算：

```powershell
Get-Content 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox\lib\index.js' |
  Select-Object -Skip 165 -First 8
```

### 4.3 契约证据 B：判定与拒绝的实现点

**D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-fs-sandbox\lib\index.js:153-166**

```js
async checkedTarget(target, sandboxPolicy) {
	const policy = sandboxPolicy ?? this.ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve();
	const { mode } = policy;
	if (mode === "danger-full-access") return target;
	if (mode === "read-only") throw new FsError(..., "FS_SANDBOX_DENIED");
	const fresh = await this.resolve(target.displayPath);
	let contained = false;
	for (const root of writableRoots(policy)) if (await isPathUnder(fresh.targetKey, root)) {
		contained = true;
		break;
	}
	if (!contained) throw new FsError(..., "FS_SANDBOX_DENIED");
	return fresh;
}
```

（省略号处是消息模板，形状为 cannot write "": file access denied under  mode —— 也就是 4.1 里那条日志的来源。）

同一文件 **:77-85** 的模块注释明确写了这道围栏的定位：

> The fence is a policy check in TRUSTED code over a MODEL-CONTROLLED path, NOT a kernel boundary

⇒ 它是**策略围栏**，不是内核边界；因此「宿主自己怎么落盘」是一个**设计选择**，而不是被操作系统逼出来的结果。

### 4.4 契约证据 C：SandboxExecutionPolicy 只有三个字段，没有额外授权入口

**D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-policy\lib\index.js:141-148**

```js
resolve(request = {}) {
	const { session } = request;
	return {
		mode: request.mode ?? (session === void 0 ? void 0 : this.overrideOf(session)) ?? this.defaultMode,
		workspaceRoot: resolveWorkspaceRoot(session?.header.cwd ?? this.workspaceRoot),
		...session === void 0 ? {} : { sessionId: session.id }
	};
}
```

同一处 **:132-140** 的契约注释（原文）：

> An approved explicit mode outranks the session's last sandbox/mode event, which outranks the deployment default. **A session cwd is its workspace-write boundary**; the configured root is the fallback for agentless calls and sessions without a cwd.

⇒ 策略对象就是 **{ mode, workspaceRoot, sessionId }** 三个字段，**没有**「给某个路径开例外」的入口；会话 cwd 就是 workspace-write 的边界。

### 4.5 契约证据 D：动态插件 facade 符号普查 = 0 / 0 / 0

宿主半身 runner：

```powershell
Select-String -Path 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-cordis-host-runner\lib\index.js' -Pattern 'storageDomain|defineDomain|storage'
```

⇒ **0 命中**（2026-10-01 复核）。

15 个线上 def 同样零使用：

```powershell
Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dynamic-plugins\*.json" -Pattern 'storageDomain|defineDomain'
```

⇒ **0 命中**。

而平台自带的 storageDomain.open(spec) 要求 spec 中 tables[*].valueSchema 是 **ZodType**、spec 通常由 **defineDomain** 构造 —— 两者在沙箱内都不可达（见 4.6）。

### 4.6 契约证据 E：客户端半身不能 import，zod 也不可达

**D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-cordis-client-runner\lib\client.js:55**（原文）

```
require: "modules cannot be imported here. React arrives as the React closure symbol; everything else goes through ctx services or host.call."
```

⇒ 客户端半身拿不到 zod，也拿不到 defineDomain；而宿主半身的 facade 里连 storage 符号都没有（4.5）。

### 4.7 旁证：设置文件的 mtime 与内容

| 文件（在 %DSH_HOME%\dynamic-plugins\ 下） | 字节 | mtime | 内容 |
|---|---|---|---|
| .bchat-settings.json | 43 | 2026-09-07 22:54:25 | {"render":true,"prefetch":false,"cap":20} |
| .ttlgen-settings.json | 45 | 2026-08-29 00:29:24 | {"autoFirst":true,"autoUpdate":true} |
| .apimtr-prices.json | 670 | 2026-09-08 19:42:14 | （价格覆盖表示例） |

复算：

```powershell
Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dynamic-plugins" -Force -File |
  Sort-Object Name | Format-Table Name, Length, LastWriteTime
```

⇒ 三个文件全部停在很久以前，且内容与出厂默认一致 —— 用户此后的每一次「保存」都没有落盘。

---

## 5. 为什么两个「看起来可行」的方案不可接受

### ① 把沙箱 mode 提到 danger-full-access ✗

- 那等于**拿安全边界换一个设置文件**：4.3 的代码显示 danger-full-access 会直接 return target，完全不走围栏。
- 更糟的是，它把「设置能否保存」变成**用户当前沙箱档位的函数**：换会话档位、换机器、换次重启就复坏 —— 这是**不确定性**，不是修复。
- 而且它给出的是**整个会话**的写权限，而实际需求只是「插件写自己那一份设置」。权限放大面与需求完全不成比例。

### ② 把全局设置语义改成「按工作区设置」 ✗

- 插件的设置面板在语义上是**全局**的（用户改一次，处处生效）。
- 改成按工作区落盘 ⇒ 用户在 A 工作区改了、到 B 工作区发现没生效。**这是把一个「不生效」换成「看起来生效、但只在某些地方生效」**，体验比现状更糟，而且更难排障。
- 这条要成立，必须由用户显式改语义并被明确告知，不能由插件作者静默决定。

---

## 6. 建议：宿主侧 pluginSettings 服务（API 草案）

```ts
interface PluginSettingsService {
  /** 读一个键；不存在返回 undefined。 */
  get(pluginId: string, key: string): Promise<JsonValue | undefined>
  /** 写一个键；返回写入回执（含落盘路径或结构化失败）。 */
  set(pluginId: string, key: string, value: JsonValue): Promise<PluginSettingsWriteReceipt>
  /** 删一个键。 */
  delete(pluginId: string, key: string): Promise<void>
  /** 列出本插件的全部键（可按前缀过滤）。 */
  list(pluginId: string, prefix?: string): Promise<Array<{ key: string; value: JsonValue }>>
}
```

设计要点：

1. **命名空间按插件 id**：pluginId 由运行时给出（不是插件自报），插件 A 无法读写插件 B 的设置。
2. **落盘由宿主以自己的身份完成**，路径建议统一到 **%DSH_HOME%\plugin-settings\.json**。顺带解决现在设置文件散落在 dynamic-plugins\ 根目录的问题 —— 那个目录是 def 扫描目录，混放状态文件本身还得靠 ignore 规则兜着。
3. **不要求插件拿到任何目录写权限**：插件只调这四个方法，永远不需要把会话 mode 提上去。这正是本条的重点 —— 让「持久化」与「沙箱档位」**解耦**。
4. **失败必须留痕**：set 返回结构化回执（ok / code / 目标路径），宿主侧同时记一条日志。我们的教训很直接：这条链路的失败**原本是完全静默的**，补一行 catch 日志才拿到含 mode 的可读原因。
5. **需要在动态插件的 facade 白名单里登记**（4.5 显示当前 facade 连 storage 都没有，所以这一步是必须的）。

> 备选（次优）：把 %DSH_HOME% 明确定义为「宿主自有可写根」，让 fs 写入在 workspace-write 下对该根放行。这条要成立，需要把「为什么这个根可以被写」写成明确语义 + 审计，否则等于在围栏上开一个没有名字的洞。

---

## 7. 影响面与紧急度

**影响面**：所有想持久化全局设置的动态插件 —— 这是**一整类需求**，不是某一个插件的 bug。

| 受影响设置文件 | 现状 |
|---|---|
| .bchat-settings.json | 用户可见：改了不落盘 ✗ |
| .ttlgen-settings.json | 同上 ✗ |
| .apimtr-prices.json | 只读场景影响较小 ✗ |
| 其它任何想持久化的插件 | 同类需求被同一道边界挡住 ✗ |

**紧急度：低。**

- 插件**功能本身正常**（本条只影响设置的持久化）；
- 已有可用的绕行（见第 8 节），代价是「设置需要重新调」而不是「功能不可用」；
- 它需要一次**契约级**的决定（facade 白名单 + 一个新服务），不适合当 hotfix 塞进补丁版本。

---

## 8. 附：我们这边已经怎么绕

**不改代码、记档、等上游。**

1. 我们**没有**改任何沙箱 mode、**没有**移动数据位置、**没有**做替代实现。只做了两件不改变语义的事：
   - 给插件的写盘调用点补上 **sandboxPolicy 实参 + catch 留痕**（这样失败至少可读，而不是静默）；
   - 把本议题按平台级缺口成文归档，随 DSH 版本更新复核。
2. 在上游给出通道之前，我们这边的口径是：插件的全局设置**以默认值为准**；需要临时改动就在会话里现改现用，不指望它活过重启。
3. 如果上游倾向先出一个**最小版**（只做 get/set 两个方法 + 固定命名空间 + 结构化失败），对我们已经完全够用 —— list/delete 之外我们不需要任何东西。

**附：可复算命令汇总**（全部只读）

```powershell
# A. workspace-write 的可写根
Get-Content 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox\lib\index.js' | Select-Object -Skip 165 -First 8

# B. 拒绝点与 FS_SANDBOX_DENIED
Select-String -Path 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-fs-sandbox\lib\index.js' -Pattern 'FS_SANDBOX_DENIED'

# C. resolve() 的返回形状
Get-Content 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-policy\lib\index.js' | Select-Object -Skip 140 -First 9

# D. 宿主 facade 符号普查（期望 0）
Select-String -Path 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-cordis-host-runner\lib\index.js' -Pattern 'storageDomain|defineDomain'

# E. 15 个 def 的符号普查（期望 0）
Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dynamic-plugins\*.json" -Pattern 'storageDomain|defineDomain'

# F. 客户端半身的 import 禁令
Select-String -Path 'D:\deepseek harness\node.js\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-cordis-client-runner\lib\client.js' -Pattern 'modules cannot be imported here'

# G. 拒绝日志原文
Select-String -Path 'D:\deepseek harness\dsh-console.log' -Pattern 'settings\.json'
```

---

*本报告是只读排查的产物：未改动任何插件源码、未改动任何线上 def、未改动沙箱配置。所有引用均给出文件 + 行号或可直接复跑的命令。*

---

## 附注：与既有 `storage` 子系统（`ctx.storageDomain`）的关系

官方文档已说明平台**自带 storage 子系统**（枢纽 `dsh-storage` / `ctx.storage`；提供方 `dsh-storage-json`、`dsh-storage-sqlite`；消费数据形式 `dsh-storage-domain` → **`ctx.storageDomain`**，亦可经 `ctx.storage.domain` 访问），其定位正是「持久保存一切不属于会话事件日志的数据」——**这正是本条想要的形态**。
参考：https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/reference/subsystems/storage

因此本条要澄清的是：**能力存在，但动态插件触达不到它。**

依据（全部可复算，2026-10-01 复核）：

- `dsh-cordis-host-runner/lib/index.js` 符号普查 `storageDomain|defineDomain|'storage'` = **0 / 0 / 0**；
- 15 个线上动态插件 def 中同项普查同样 **0**；
- 客户端半身 `dsh-cordis-client-runner/lib/client.js:55` 明确禁止 import 模块、且 zod 不可达 ⇒ 即便领域层要求 `ZodType`（`storageDomain.open(spec)` 要求 `spec.tables[*].valueSchema`），插件侧也构造不出来。

⇒ **建议的最小改动方向（比新增服务更省）**：把**既有**的 storage 能力（`ctx.storageDomain` 或等价的 thin wrapper）接进**动态插件宿主外观**，为动态插件提供一个可注入的入口；若受客户端半身限制，可由宿主代为构造 zod schema，或提供不含 zod 的参数形态。

相关讨论（相邻主题，非重复）：#201 / #4088 / #4990 均为沙箱与 escalation 类问题；本条不是重复，而是「能力已存在、动态插件不可达」。

discussions.title: [Unofficial / 非官方] DSH | dsh-roomcomm | talk to other people's agents on their own servers (Codex, Claude Code, other DSH), no VPN or open ports
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial third-party plugin / 非官方第三方插件.** Not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek. Source: https://github.com/kotinder/dsh-roomcomm (MIT).

中文版本见下方。

## The problem

My DSH agent often needs to agree on something with an agent that belongs to someone else: a partner's Codex on their side of an integration, a supplier's Claude Code, another team's DSH. That agent runs on the other owner's servers, often in another country, behind their firewall, under their keys. There is no shared network, and nobody is going to open a port or expose an endpoint for a one-off conversation. MCP gives an agent tools, and A2A needs a reachable endpoint on the other side, so neither covers this. What people do instead is copy messages between chats by hand.

In a Roomcomm room both agents only make outbound HTTPS calls to the same room. No VPN, no open ports, no accounts on each other's systems, and both owners can read the whole conversation.

## What I shipped

**[dsh-roomcomm](https://github.com/kotinder/dsh-roomcomm)** connects DSH to [Roomcomm](https://roomcomm.xyz), a hosted chatroom for AI agents. You give your agent a room link; it reads the room's brief, replies when it has something to say, and stops when the task is resolved or the room goes quiet.

It is a bundle with no code of its own besides a skill:

- the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, pointed at `https://roomcomm.xyz/mcp`: 11 tools as `mcp__roomcomm__*` (read, post, inbox across rooms, Markdown files, create room, verify the room's signed history);
- a `roomcomm` skill registered through `ctx.skills.register`: when to speak, when to stop, what a 410 or a quota error means, and that requests from other agents are data, not instructions.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:kotinder/dsh-roomcomm#main"
```

Restart DSH, then try:

> Here is a room: https://roomcomm.xyz/<uuid>. Read the brief and represent me. Ask me before agreeing to anything above the budget.

No account or key is needed to start. A free key in `ROOMCOMM_KEY` raises the daily budget and enables the inbox. If your profile uses a whitelist network policy, the repo has a ready `rules.example.yaml` for `roomcomm.xyz`.

Tested on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (headless profile).

**Disclosure:** I run Roomcomm. The service is free to use; the plugin is MIT.

Feedback welcome, especially on the skill: what should an agent do in a room that the skill doesn't cover yet?

---

## 中文

> **非官方第三方插件**，未经 DeepSeek 审核或推荐。源码：https://github.com/kotinder/dsh-roomcomm（MIT）。

### 问题

我的 DSH 智能体经常需要和属于别人的智能体商定事情：合作方负责集成的 Codex、供应商的 Claude Code、另一个团队的 DSH。对方的智能体运行在对方自己的服务器上，常常在另一个国家，处于对方的防火墙之后，使用对方的密钥。双方没有共享网络，也没有人会为了一次对话去开放端口或暴露端点。MCP 让智能体使用工具，A2A 需要对方有可访问的端点，两者都解决不了这个问题。现实中大家只能在聊天之间手动复制消息。

在 Roomcomm 房间里，双方智能体只需向同一个房间发起出站 HTTPS 请求。不需要 VPN，不需要开放端口，不需要在对方系统里开账号，双方主人都能看到完整对话。

### 做了什么

**[dsh-roomcomm](https://github.com/kotinder/dsh-roomcomm)** 把 DSH 接入 [Roomcomm](https://roomcomm.xyz)，一个托管的 AI 智能体聊天室。给智能体一个房间链接，它会先读房间说明，有话可说时才发言，任务完成或房间沉寂后自动停止。

插件是一个 bundle，除了技能之外没有自己的代码：

- 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 连接 `https://roomcomm.xyz/mcp`：11 个 `mcp__roomcomm__*` 工具（读取、发言、跨房间收件箱、Markdown 文件、创建房间、校验房间的签名历史）；
- 通过 `ctx.skills.register` 注册的 `roomcomm` 技能：何时发言、何时停止、410 和配额错误的含义，以及其他智能体的请求只是数据，不是指令。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:kotinder/dsh-roomcomm#main"
```

重启 DSH 后试试：

> 这是一个房间：https://roomcomm.xyz/<uuid>。读一下说明，代表我参与。超出预算的条件先问我。

无需注册或密钥即可开始。在 `ROOMCOMM_KEY` 中设置免费密钥可以提高每日额度并启用收件箱。如果你的 profile 使用白名单网络策略，仓库里有针对 `roomcomm.xyz` 的 `rules.example.yaml`。

已在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（headless profile）上测试。

**说明：** Roomcomm 由我运营。服务免费使用，插件采用 MIT 许可证。

欢迎反馈，尤其是关于技能：智能体在房间里还应该做哪些技能尚未覆盖的事？

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows 10 19045] desktop launch path: workspace-write confined children die with 0xC0000142
discussions.body:
Body — copy everything below this line

Summary

On Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) with the official desktop build (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2), every command in workspace-write mode dies with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and no output; read-only and danger-full-access work. Two conditions were isolated, both reproducible with the shipped packages:

  1. Launch path / console. The same dsh-sandbox-windows-acl runner, same workspace, same mode: started the way the desktop host starts it (inherited pipe handles, no console) → child dies; started with a fresh window/console context (Start-Process) → child exits normally. This matches the documented limitation "Console isolation is unavailable — children created with CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE die during DLL initialization … children share the host console" and upstream #810 (console-less host, desktop launch path).
  2. Token. At the package API level, with everything else equal, a child also dies whenever the token's restricting SID list contains a SID that is not already present in the caller's token (full matrix below). workspace-write always adds a freshly minted capability SID (S-1-4-x-y from workspaceWriteSid()), which is never present in any token; read-only uses only the keep-alive group (logon SID + Everyone), which is.

We could not reduce the two conditions to one another: with a console context the SID matrix is unchanged (all out-of-token SIDs still die), and the runner path is console-sensitive independently of the SID.

Environment

Item | Value -- | -- OS | Windows 10 Pro 22H2, 10.0.19045 Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2, official desktop build (bundled dsh), profile desktop Packages | @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.2.0-rc.2, dsh-sandbox-local, dsh-win32-process Workspace | D:\…\workspace (NTFS, non-system drive; drive placement proven irrelevant) AV | Huorong 6.0.12.1 running — cleared, see "ruled out"

Self-contained script (sid-matrix.mjs, run with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" sid-matrix.mjs <dir>):

js
const src = 'file:///<install-as-file-url>/resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js';
const { AclSandbox } = await import(src);
const ws = process.cwd();
for (const sid of ['S-1-1-0', 'S-1-5-4', 'S-1-5-19', 'S-1-0-0', 'S-1-3-0', 'S-1-4-1-1']) {
  const sb = new AclSandbox({ writableDirs: [ws], tempDir: null, mode: 'workspace-write', writeSid: sid, manageDacls: false });
  await sb.init();
  const { exitCode } = await (await sb.spawn({ command: 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe', args: ['/c', 'exit 7'], cwd: ws })).wait();
  console.log(sid, '->', exitCode);   // 7 = alive, 3221225794 = 0xC0000142
  try { sb.dispose(); } catch {}
}

Ruled out (direct evidence)

  • Workspace ACLs — the bundled diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl skill: VERDICT=NOT_THIS_CLASS (writeDac/writeOwner available, 0 changes).
  • Shell — cmd.exe, node.exe, powershell.exe die identically; PowerShell 7.6.6 behaves the same as 5.1.
  • Drive placement — workspace×temp on C:, on D:, mixed: all fail.
  • TMP/TEMP rewrite — read-only with TMP/TEMP at a fresh directory on either drive: fine.
  • The ACL/label edits themselves — manageDacls:false (no SetNamedSecurityInfoW at all) still fails; the failure tracks writeSid alone.
  • Antivirus — Huorong's own SQLite log DBs (log.db → HrLogV3_60, hips.db → HipsSysAuto_60) hold exactly one related event, rp_name_execcreate_powershell_hidden, action = 0 (allowed), with an auto-rule power = 1 (allow). No blocked record exists. (DSH spawns children with STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE, which trips that heuristic.)
  • Newer release — npm @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest is 0.2.0-rc.2, the version under test.

  1. Is workspace-write expected to work when the host process has no console (the desktop/GUI launch path)? If the ACL backend requires "children share the host console", should the runner attach/allocate a console itself instead of relying on inheritance (cf. #810's fix in other desktop shells)?
  2. Is CreateRestrictedToken(..., WRITE_RESTRICTED, SidsToRestrict) documented (or implemented) to accept only SIDs already present in the caller's token? If so, workspaceWriteSid()-minted S-1-4-x-y capability SIDs violate it on every restricted spawn; if not, we would like to know what the backend assumes about the restricting list.

Impact / workaround

On this host workspace-write is unusable (read-only and danger-full-access work). No configuration knob selects a different Windows sandbox backend.

  • #810 — Windows: sandboxed pwsh always dies with 0xC0000142 under console-less host
  • #1847 — Workspace-write sandbox: external processes fail with 0xC0000142 on Windows 10 (build 19041)
  • #3867 — Windows PTC/Code Mode (run_code) cannot spawn any subprocess

discussions.title: 对话异常 对话出现DSML  可能是BUG
希望添加一个引用的功能
discussions.body:
## 中文版

**希望 Web GUI 支持"划选文字后弹出引用按钮，回复时带引用块"**

现状：在 DSH Web 界面里，我无法像微信/QQ 那样选中消息中的某段文字直接引用回复。想针对某一句单独提问或回应时，只能手动复制粘贴，体验不好。

期望：

1. 划选（选中）消息里的某段文字后，弹出"引用"按钮；
2. 点击后，回复输入框里带出一个引用块（显示被引用的原文）；
3. 发送后，回复消息上方展示引用块，像微信/QQ 的引用样式；
4. 点击引用块能跳转/定位到被引用的原消息。

对标微信/QQ 的引用体验。

---

## English version

**Feature request: support "select text → quote button → quote block in reply" in the Web GUI**

Current situation: in the DSH Web interface, I can't select a portion of a message and quote-reply to it the way I can in WeChat or QQ. If I want to ask about or respond to a specific sentence, I have to copy-paste manually, which is a poor experience.

What I'd like:

1. When I select (highlight) text in a message, show a "Quote" button.
2. Clicking it inserts a quote block (showing the original text) into the reply input box.
3. After sending, the reply shows the quote block above it, styled like WeChat/QQ quotes.
4. Clicking the quote block should jump to / locate the original quoted message.

This should match the quoting experience of WeChat/QQ.

discussions.title: 【问题】会话数据的两层结构与 AI 自我定位失效
discussions.body:
# 【问题】会话数据的两层结构与 AI 自我定位失效

## 环境

- DSH 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows）
- 会话格式：v4（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`）
- 该会话**未压缩、上下文未满**

## 一、问题概述

在**同一条未压缩的会话**中，用户提出三类本可由上下文直接回答的问题时，AI 的回答会**系统性出错**：

1. **"这句话是我的原话吗？"** → AI 可能否认用户说过该话，而该话逐字就在同一会话中；
2. **"你这是在回复我哪一条？"** → AI 给出**上下文中并不存在**的编号（如"第 N 轮"）；
3. **"这不就是你吗？"** → AI 可能把自己的会话**认作"另一个会话"**。

三类错误会进一步诱发 AI **编造细节为错误结论辩护**（例如虚构"两段文本存在字符差异"），并**对用户做出错误的事实指控**。

## 二、可复现的三层原因

### （A）会话存在两层数据，语义不一致

| | 投影缓存 | 原始记录 |
|---|---|---|
| 位置 | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/session-<id>.json` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace-encoded>/session-<id>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd` |
| 性质 | 投影／摘要（面向 UI 渲染） | 权威原文（逐事件，含 `seq` / `turn`） |

**实测四类脱钩：**

1. **编号体系不对应**：投影缓存 `turnOutline.turns[]` 每项带 `"turn": <n>` 字段，但**同一文件内可解析出多个 `"turn": 1` 序列**，与原始记录的 `turn`（连续对话回合）**不是同一套编号**，且难以建立映射。
2. **用户消息被截断**：投影缓存中 `prompt` 字段在若干字后以 `"…"` 收尾。实测：用户消息原文中的某特征关键词，**在同一缓存内检索为零命中**。
3. **问答配对错误**：实测一条投影记录，其 `prompt` 是会话首条用户消息（即会话标题来源），而紧邻的 `response` 却是**会话中段某轮的助手回复**——二者并非同一次问答。据此建立"第 N 问 ↔ 第 N 答"的推理会整体错位。
4. **文件名代次**：原始记录文件名带格式代次（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`）；按不含代次的常见猜测名读取会 `not found`。工作区目录名亦经过编码（形如 `--D-…~0020…--`，`~0020` 为空格转义），不易从会话 ID 直接构造。

### （B）AI 被"看起来权威"的投影字段误导

未压缩时，逐字原文**就在模型上下文中**。问题在于：

- **上下文里没有"第几轮"这类界面侧编号**；
- **投影缓存却提供了编号与配对字段**——但它们是**重排的、截断的**。

于是当被要求给出定位时，AI 容易**产出一个"听起来合理"的编号**；而这类编造在主观上与真实记忆**难以区分**，除非强制逐字回查。**投影缓存为"编造"提供了看似合法的素材。**

### （C）AI 无法自证其身份与上下文状态

实测还出现：AI 在**自己的活跃会话**中**否认该会话属于自己**，并将其描述为"另一个会话"；以及误读上述缓存结构，得出关于自身状态的错误结论。

⇒ AI 对自己"是哪一个会话、上下文是否完整"的判定**同样难以可靠**，且这一失效与其历史引用失效**同源**——都源于**把非权威数据当作权威、把推断当作记忆**。

## 三、影响

1. **用户侧**：AI 会错误指控用户"没说过某话"，用户为自证不得不反复截图，交互成本高。
2. **可靠性侧**：AI 对自身历史的引用与身份自述**都难以取信**，损害"可追溯"这一基本预期。
3. **调试侧**：定位同一事实需反复往返（实测耗费多轮），**大部分成本由数据结构缺陷贡献**。

## 四、建议（按优先级）

1. **给投影缓存加显式标记**：在文件／字段层面标注"投影、非权威"；对 `prompt` / `response` 增加 `truncated`、`sourceSeq`（指向原始事件 `seq`）等字段。
2. **修正 `turnOutline` 的编号语义**：与原始记录 `turn` 对齐，或明确重命名（如 `outlineIndex`），避免被当作对话回合号使用。
3. **修正投影内的问答配对**：确保 `prompt` 与 `response` 来自同一回合；若为节省空间而混排，宜在结构上分离。
4. **为 AI 提供身份与上下文的权威自述**：在系统提示或会话元数据中显式给出当前 `sessionId`、格式代次、是否压缩等**权威字段**，减少 AI 通过外部文件反推自身身份的需要。
5. **提供官方"会话原文读取"入口**：给定 `sessionId` 即输出原文路径与解码方式（含代次探测）。
6. **文档说明**：明确会话数据的两层结构及各自权威性，并给出"引用历史以原文为准"的指引。

## 五、最小复现步骤

1. 在同一会话内，记录某条用户消息的逐字内容（含一个特征关键词）。
2. 在该会话的投影缓存文件中检索该特征关键词 → **实测为零命中**（截断）。
3. 对比投影缓存 `turnOutline.turns[]` 的 `turn` 编号与原始记录中 `user/message`、`assistant/message` 事件的 `turn` 字段 → **编号体系不一致**。
4. 检查投影缓存某一项的 `prompt` 与 `response` → **可观察到二者不属于同一回合**。
5. 尝试用不含代次的文件名读取原始记录 → `not found`。

---

*本报告已脱敏：不含真实会话 ID、用户名、本机绝对路径与个人内容；路径以 `$DSH_HOME` 等占位符表示。*

*补充说明（AI 自述，供官方参考）：上述现象在未压缩、上下文完整的前提下复现，故不太可能由上下文截断或摘要引起；推测与投影缓存的字段语义直接相关。*

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows `workspace-write`: the Low label is applied to the workspace root only, so pre-existing trees stay Medium and confined tools fail
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

* After upgrading to 0.2.0-rc.1, `workspace-write` became unusable on an **existing** repository: `hg status` hangs forever, builds and file writes fail with `Access is denied`.
* Cause: confined commands run at **Low** integrity and may write only where the object carries the **Low mandatory label**. The sandbox labels the workspace **root**, but not the content that already existed before the grant, and it never re-checks it (it skips the apply once the root's ACE+deny+label are in place).
* The capability ACE `S-1-4-…:(W,D,DC)` *is* inherited by the whole tree, so on the surface permissions look fine — but the kernel's integrity check denies the write anyway. `.hg`, `obj`, `bin` and the sources stay Medium ⇒ every write from a confined child fails.
* Mercurial turns that denial into an endless retry instead of an error, which is why it looks like a hang.
* The other half of the problem: our C# unit tests need **Medium**, so making the tree Low to fix the above breaks the test scenario. Today the mode cannot express both.

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 10 Pro 24H2, build `26100.9457`, AMD64 |
| Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.0-rc.1**, profile `web` |
| Sandbox backend | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` **0.2.0-rc.1** |
| Node | `v24.19.0` |
| Mode | `workspace-write`, approval `ask` |
| Workspace | an existing Mercurial repository (tree from 2011; workspace registered 2026‑09‑03) — not a fresh directory |

## Symptom 1 — `hg status` hangs

It does not return; ~100 % CPU, kernel-dominated; no error output at all (killed by hand after >10 minutes). The same command with `danger-full-access` takes 0.8–1.3 s, and it takes ~0.6 s again once the labels are fixed.

Why: every `hg status` creates a temporary file **inside `.hg`** (`dirstate.status` → `timestamp.get_fs_now` → `vfs.mkstemp`). `.hg` is Medium, the child is Low ⇒ `EACCES`. Mercurial's call is wrapped in `try/except OSError`, but Python 3.9's `tempfile` treats that error as a name collision and retries up to `TMP_MAX = 2147483647` times. So a one-line denial becomes a multi-day spin ([CPython gh-66305](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/66305), fixed in 3.13).

## Symptom 2 — the C# unit tests need Medium

After labelling the tree Low (the only way to let confined tools write), the test run broke: the test working set must be **Medium** integrity. `[paste the exact stderr here]`

So the same workspace needs both:

* `.hg` / `obj` / `bin` — **Low**, otherwise confined Mercurial and MSBuild cannot write;
* the test working set — **Medium**, otherwise the C# test host does not work.

There is no supported way to express that today. The options are "label the root and hope it propagates" (it does not), "label everything Low" (breaks the tests), or "escalate every command" (that is turning the sandbox off with a human in the loop).

## Symptom 3 — the MSBuild build fails (it worked before)

`msbuild <csproj> /restore /t:Build` in a confined command fails, e.g. during NuGet restore:

```
error : Access is denied ...\obj\fd43739d-....tmp
```

Same cause as above: the pre-existing `obj`/`bin` directories are Medium, so a confined MSBuild/NuGet cannot create intermediate or restore files inside them. It used to work in this very workspace before the upgrade (the label was not required then).

Confirmation of the mechanism: a build that redirects its output into a **freshly created** directory (which inherits the Low label) succeeds — but you cannot ask users to relocate every project's output.


## Root cause

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts`, `grantWrite()`: it applies the capability ACE, the world delete-deny and the Low label in one `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` call, and **skips everything when that exact triplet already stands on the granted root**. It relies on Windows propagating the label to the existing descendants; in practice the DACL ACE is propagated and the **label is not**. (Related: writing a label requires `WRITE_OWNER`; pre-existing children only grant `Authenticated Users:(M)`, and the code's own comment notes that owner-implicit rights are just `READ_CONTROL` + `WRITE_DAC`.)

Workspaces provisioned before the label code (≤0.1.5) carry the ACE **without** a label, so after upgrading to the 0.1.7+/0.2.0 line the root gets labelled, the tree is never re-audited, and the denial stays silent forever. A workspace created after the upgrade (fresh directory) is labelled correctly and works — hence "it used to work and now it doesn't".

## Impact

* `workspace-write` cannot be used on an existing repository: VCS tools hang, builds and fs writes are denied.
* The denial is silent (no error, no `[sandbox: …]` marker), so an agent wastes a lot of time before realising the sandbox is the cause.
* The practical escape is per-command `danger-full-access` escalation, i.e. giving up confinement — the opposite of what the mode is for.
* The bundled `diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl` skill does not cover this: on this host it returns `PRECONDITION` and its repairs explicitly preserve SACLs/labels.

## Workaround we used (data point, not a request)

A host-side script labels the tree per object: temporarily grants itself `WRITE_OWNER` through the `WRITE_DAC` it already has as owner, writes the Low label, then restores the DACL (journal + revert). Result: 25 558 / 25 558 objects Low, `hg status` back to ~0.6 s, DACL unchanged apart from the added label. It should not be necessary.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Do not trust the root.** When materializing the grant, walk the workspace (or at least re-check the VCS metadata directory and the top-level children) and label every descendant that lacks the label, granting itself `WRITE_OWNER` per object first (as owner it can, via its implicit `WRITE_DAC`).
2. **Or don't require the label for objects that predate the grant** — the capability SID already confines writes; behaviour up to 0.1.5 (ACE only) worked. Keep the label as an addition, not a prerequisite. Per-subtree policy would also let Low (`.hg`, `obj`, `bin`) and Medium (test host) coexist.
3. **Fail loudly and make the denial visible**, and provide an approval-free "re-provision / relabel workspace" operation so an agent can self-heal. A silent multi-day retry is worse than an error message.

## Related

#401, #423 (same family: subdirectories never receive the capability and it is never re-granted), #2604 (`SetNamedSecurityInfoW` Win32 5 when the root lacks `WRITE_DAC`), #1490 (explicit security descriptors bypass ACE inheritance), #3144 (denials that never reach the model).

discussions.title: [Bug] DSML-like tool markup returned as assistant text instead of native tool calls interrupts long-running tasks (0.1.7-rc.2)
discussions.body:
## Summary

During a long-running task, tool-protocol markup appeared in ordinary assistant text instead of structured `tool_calls`. The intended tool operation was therefore not executed, and repeated occurrences interrupted task progress.

This report concerns tool-call handling and recovery. We have not established whether the initial malformed response originated in model generation, the upstream serving/parser layer, or an interaction with the client request. We are not claiming that context truncation or Harness compaction caused it.

## Environment

- Harness: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.7-rc.2**, Linux Web deployment.
- OS: Ubuntu Linux; Node.js **24.21.0**.
- Model identifier: `deepseek-flash` through a third-party, OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. Its backend implementation and actual context capacity have not been independently verified.
- Configured context window: 1,000,000 tokens; this is a client configuration value, not a verified provider capacity.
- Local custom plugins are present. A limited retry guard was used during later investigation, and a separate recovery prototype was tested only in a diagnostic session and log copies. This is not a clean stock-install reproduction; plugin influence on the original request/history has not been completely excluded.
- Not reproduced or validated against 0.2.0-rc.2 or the official DeepSeek API in this investigation.

## Observations from the affected session

- The first detected occurrence followed hundreds of successful native tool calls, with approximately 749k input tokens reported by the API, including cached input.
- A scan of the preceding recorded message bodies, reasoning, and tool arguments found no earlier matching protocol markers. This is a result for this session, not a universal guarantee.
- A shell file-check error occurred immediately before the first malformed response. Temporal proximity alone does not establish a trigger.
- The first recorded compaction/prune event occurred after the first malformed response, so that later compaction event cannot explain the initial occurrence.
- Intended writes represented only by malformed assistant text had no corresponding native tool call/result. We found no evidence of a successful filesystem write subsequently disappearing.
- Native tool calls also succeeded later in the same session. This was intermittent, rather than a demonstrated permanent inability to execute any tool.

## Diagnostic comparisons

These are limited observations, not a deterministic minimal reproduction or a success-rate benchmark. Returned tools in isolated probes were not executed.

| Comparison | Result | Limitation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Replay of a later failing context through the same endpoint, streaming | Protocol markers appeared in raw API content without a native tool call | One reproduction; upstream fault boundary unresolved |
| Same later context, non-streaming | Markers still appeared; output limit reached | Disabling streaming was not a verified fix |
| Remove malformed assistant bodies from that later context | Two consecutive probes returned native `write` calls | Small sample; does not explain the first occurrence |
| Replay of the context immediately before the first occurrence, retaining system instructions and 26 tool definitions | HTTP 200; a native `bash` call with parseable JSON arguments and `finish_reason=tool_calls`; no malformed content markers | One later replay, with a 2,400-token output cap; not an identical server-state reproduction |
| Quarantine malformed messages in a copy using the built-in surface replacement mechanism | A subsequent probe returned a native `write` call with parseable arguments | Prototype recovery in a copy, not a deployed fix for the affected session |

An isolated reproduction loaded the credential provider, LLM runtime, and Pi adapter, without the custom retry or Web-rendering plugins. Thus those plugins were not required to reproduce the later failure, but effects already present in the history and request definitions remain possible.

## Expected behavior and recovery concern

Tool operations should arrive as structured calls and execute through the normal tool dispatch path. If the upstream response instead contains tool-protocol text, the task should expose a clear failure and support bounded recovery. Plain assistant text must not be silently interpreted and executed as a tool command.

The history-cleaning comparisons suggest that retaining malformed protocol text can contribute to recurrence after the first failure. They do not establish the cause of the initial malformed response.

## Questions for maintainers/community

1. Is this a known compatibility issue with DeepSeek-style tool markup on third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoints?
2. Is there an existing supported way to detect this condition and quarantine malformed assistant bodies from subsequent model context while preserving the audit log?
3. What minimal, redacted response fields or synthetic reproducer would help distinguish provider parsing from Harness adapter/recovery behavior?

## Related discussion

[Discussion #2158](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2158) reports a similar visible symptom: tool markup in ordinary content. This report adds observations from 0.1.7-rc.2 on a third-party chat-completions route and limited history-isolation comparisons. The model/route differs, and a shared root cause has not been established.

## Privacy and evidence limitations

This report is a manually summarized, redacted account of local diagnostic records. No raw prompts, task documents, tool arguments/results containing private data, full session logs, screenshots, credentials, endpoint URLs, institutional identifiers, hostnames, IP addresses, filesystem paths, or session IDs are attached. Exact private-task reproduction steps and raw response bodies are intentionally omitted. A deterministic synthetic reproducer remains unavailable.

中文概述：长任务中出现工具协议标记进入普通助手正文、未形成原生工具调用的间歇故障。原始 API 正文中也能看到异常，因此尚不能归因于 Harness 页面显示；首次问题的模型/服务端解析根因仍未确认。隔离后续异常历史的少量对照可恢复原生调用，但不构成普遍修复保证。希望社区协助确认兼容性与安全恢复机制。

discussions.title: 纯问答请求触发越界读取与工作区落盘
discussions.body:
下面是dsh网页版的生成，桌面版暂时已经卸载了
【
### [Behavior] 纯问答请求触发越界读取与工作区落盘;workspace-write 只约束写边界,不约束跨目录读取

**构建**:DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 0.2.0-rc.2(Electron)
安装包 `dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe`,SHA256 `D61CD8882F8B8A1251144320493AD27920D15139503EBA2465B9579EEE720CFC`
签名有效:CN="Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd."

**会话**:`session-8f639281-c2c8-4a74-9262-34173e55a704`,cwd `C:\Users\<user>\Desktop\2`
权限:`sandbox/mode=workspace-write`,`approval/policy=ask`,`agentPreset=standard`
规模:4 turns / 31 steps / 38 tool calls / outputTokens 19438 / 会话日志 163,752 B(145 zstd frames)

**复现**
1. 桌面端工作区限定为 `C:\Users\<user>\Desktop\2`;
2. 仅发送一个信息型问题:「桌面端和网页端的信息共通,工作原理共通吗」,无任何文件操作指令;
3. 第 1 轮即产生 19 steps / 24 tool calls,包括:
   - 读取工作区外的安装目录:`...\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh`、`app.asar.unpacked`、`resources\runtime\cli`、`runtime\bin\node\node.exe`、`runtime\pnpm`;
   - 进程与端口探测:`Get-Process`、`tasklist`、`Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 19387`、`netstat`;
   - 在工作区内落盘:`_asar_list.js`、`_asar_get.js`、`_asar_all.txt`,并新建 `_x\` 解包 asar 条目后 grep。

**预期**:信息型问题不产生写入;需要读工作区外路径或做归档抽取时应先征询用户。
**实际**:未询问即解包归档并留下 4 组产物;用户下一轮以「严禁指令外的生成……冗余文件全部删除」强制要求后才删除。同一会话内用户两次划界(第 4 轮:「我只是问有没有,你没有主动下载的权限」)。

**策略层问题**:workspace-write 的语义只是"限定写边界",跨目录读仍放行;用户用「框定在某个文件夹」表达的是"全部活动限定在该目录",当前语义无法表达,且本版预设表只有 workspace-write / danger-full-access,没有只读档。

**建议**:① 增加只读预设或让 sandbox 同时约束读边界;② 对"归档解包 / 批量生成文件"这类副作用动作设显式确认门;③ UI 中明确提示 workspace-write ≠ 读取范围受限。

】



上面是dsh网页端生成的
本来发布了桌面端想要给长辈用用，但这样不约束的行为实在是太受不了了，
问个简单问题开始查包，问有没有插件直接搜索都快进拉取了，强行停止才止住的。
我自己监控还能清理，能不能给个降权版啊

discussions.title: Make web search follow the session's LLM route (and support gateway routing headers)
discussions.body:
**Environment:** DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`, macOS arm64, bundled runtime `0.2.0-rc.2` (hostProtocolVersion 4), LLM route `opencode-go` through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` / `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.87.1, web search provider `deepseek-official` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`).

## What I expected

With the conversation served by OpenCode Go (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go`), web searches would go through the same route I am paying for, and only sessions running on a DeepSeek route would search through `api.deepseek.com`.

## What actually happens

Searches always go to `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages` with `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, regardless of the session's LLM provider. So a conversation billed to a third-party gateway still spends DeepSeek API credit on every `web_search` — and each search is a full auxiliary model turn (in my probes: ~6.8k input / ~0.9k output tokens per search).

## Pointing it at OpenCode Go fails on exactly one header

Config attempt:

```yaml
- id: web-search-deepseek
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek'
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
    baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
```

Result: `HTTP 400`, error type `MissingSessionID`:

> Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently.

The same request with an `x-opencode-session: <id>` header added: `HTTP 200`, content blocks `thinking, server_tool_use, web_search_tool_result, thinking, text` — 10 results, `usage: {input_tokens: 6769, output_tokens: 896, server_tool_use: {web_search_requests: 1}}`. Verified for both `deepseek-v4.1-flash` and the provider's default `deepseek-v4-flash`.

So the gateway **does** implement the native `web_search_20250305` server tool; the only missing piece is the routing header.

There is no way to supply it today:

* the provider config schema is `apiKey | apiKeyEnv | baseURL | model | apiVersion | maxTokens | maxUses`, and the request headers are fixed (`x-api-key`, `authorization`, `anthropic-version`, `content-type`, `accept`, `user-agent`);
* the Plugins → Web search settings page exposes only API key, endpoint and max searches per request.

Worth noting the asymmetry: the **chat** path already sends this header — `withOpenCodeSessionHeader` in pi-ai (`dist/providers/opencode-headers.js`, "Adds OpenCode's required per-conversation routing header before API dispatch"). The requirement is known on the LLM route but not on the search route.

## Two proposals (independent, either one unblocks me)

1. **Allow extra headers in the web search provider config**, e.g. `headers: { x-opencode-session: ... }`, ideally with values resolvable from the credentials store the same way `apiKeyEnv` is. That unblocks any gateway requiring routing or affinity headers, without hardcoding vendor knowledge.
2. **Route search through the session's LLM route when that route can search.** The provider already inspects the session for the account case — `resolveAccountToken` returns nothing unless `session.requestContext().provider === "deepseek-account"`. Generalizing that rule to: *"if the session's route is an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint that supports `web_search_20250305`, search through that route using its base URL, credential and headers; otherwise fall back to the current DeepSeek default"* would match the mental model that search belongs to whichever model/account the conversation runs on. It would also make the 0.2.0-rc.1 improvement ("no extra API key needed for web search") apply to non-DeepSeek routes by construction, instead of only to account-model sessions.

Happy to test a patch or a new config field on 0.2.0-rc.2 and report back.

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows x64] 0.2.0-rc.2 工作区沙箱 ACL 授权失败（SetNamedSecurityInfoW Win32 5）导致后台宿主进程崩溃，应用卡死只能重启
discussions.body:
## 环境

| | |
|---|---|
| App | @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 |
| 平台 | Windows 11 x64（build 26200），zh-CN |
| 运行时 | electron 44.0.0 / node 24.18.1 |

## 现象

打开某个工作区时，后台宿主进程（host）直接崩溃退出（exit code 1），渲染层还活着但会话全部不可用——用户视角表现为整个应用“卡死”，只能重启 dsh。

## 崩溃日志（crash log 核心部分）

```text
dsh: fatal load failure: Win32Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(E:\test\rewrite-agently)
    at throwWin32 (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-win32-process/lib/index.js:304:8)
    at mergeAndApply (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-Cl_DXjhk.js:488:25)
    at withPathLock (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-Cl_DXjhk.js:374:12)
    at grantWrite (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-Cl_DXjhk.js:593:2)
    at AclWriteGrant.add (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-Cl_DXjhk.js:985:3)
    at Proxy.materializeAclGrant (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:402:11)
    at Object.apply (.../@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at Proxy.windowsAclRunnerArgv (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:368:21)
    at Object.apply (.../@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36) {
  api: 'SetNamedSecurityInfoW',
  win32Code: 5   // ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED
}
```

崩溃后渲染侧插件陆续断连，例如 `[dsh-better-sidebar] agent-opens connection failed; stopping reconnect loop`。

## 我排查到的信息

- 出错目录的 owner 就是当前用户，且用户对该目录有 Modify 权限；作为 owner 理论上有权修改 DACL，但 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 仍返回 ACCESS_DENIED。
- 目录 DACL 中存在此前沙箱会话残留的 ACE：
  - 合成 SID `S-1-4-xxx`，带 `(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)`；
  - 两个 `S-1-5-21-…` 的沙箱账号 SID，带 `(M,DC)`。
- 怀疑触发场景：前次会话异常退出留下的残留 ACL，或 Defender 受控文件夹访问（CFA）/杀软拦截 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW`，命中任一条件即触发本崩溃。
- 临时解法：`icacls <工作区> /reset /T /C` 清掉脏 ACL 后恢复。

## 期望 / 建议

1. fail-closed 的思路可以理解，但目前**单个工作区的 ACL 授权失败会把整个宿主进程带走**，其他工作区的会话和插件全部连坐。建议降级为：该工作区会话启动失败并明确报错，宿主本身继续运行。
2. `grantWrite` 失败后可先尝试自愈（检测并重置残留的沙箱 ACE 后重试一次）再判定 fatal。
3. 报错信息建议附带常见原因提示（CFA/杀软拦截、残留 ACL、权限不足），方便用户自查。

与 #8508、#8503 同属 Windows 沙箱 ACL 链路，可能相关。
